ee3c83c07497af9d4bba906f18533b93cfcc8ffa.source: For all of their talk about small government, the Republicans are quite adept at funneling public money to the railroads. I only support that practice when there is a clear rationale, and in this case the rationale was corruption.

b1cda8f522e6006b8b07c43f7f690fd2211360db.source: For better or worse, many view you as a protege of Andrew Jackson (some call you “Young Hickory”). Is it better to embrace this label, or to distance yourself from it?

3662eb717218a957e49089c5aaf2d892b22cd70c.source: For better or worse, people are definitely calling you a new kind of Republican.

dadfe71032ffaf8a3415cd3a31589a85720ba0b0.source: For better or worse, your appearances do make headlines and keep you in front of the American people. Some of your core supporters are confused and concerned, however.

dd09a24632c50d0cfcd4f066a4c9489f4e1a9609.source: For seven months now, Sleepy Joe Biden has barely left the basement of his house. That ends now, and I'm pretty confident the American people won't like what they see from him.

1c09c1c08fff1b321a55e34d8f3db8efe50ecb3d.source: For the first time in over a century, the loser of the popular vote has won the election! Your fellow Democrats are already having flashbacks of 1888, and are blaming Ralph Nader for it.

69bc9476e2de5df8940e7307dbbde37f12603921.source: A couple of weeks go by, and commentators start murmuring about your "pivot" for the general election.
69bc9476e2de5df8940e7307dbbde37f12603921.zh: 几周过去了，评论人士开始低声议论你为大选作出的“转向”。

b1792155a172daff3646bf8f742475421eb8a50a.source: A crime is a crime, no matter what the motive is. I do not support ideas that some victims should be held in higher regard than others.
b1792155a172daff3646bf8f742475421eb8a50a.zh: 犯罪就是犯罪，动机是什么都一样。我不支持认为某些受害者应得到比其他人更多重视的观念。

ddb7457fe440ea1fd87fbf28ece4a0521625db5d.source: A criticism of pensions for Union Army veterans? Not the best move politically.
ddb7457fe440ea1fd87fbf28ece4a0521625db5d.zh: 批评联邦军老兵的抚恤金？从政治上看，这可不高明。

c37e06bf19b22d825c3935543b2569b765c19a82.source: A dubious statement, but it will help you a lot in Iowa this fall. Remember, that's a swing state.
c37e06bf19b22d825c3935543b2569b765c19a82.zh: 这话站不住脚，但今年秋天会在艾奥瓦州帮你不少。记住，那可是摇摆州。

eb055e4107cdd5a3b9fdd5a8f8382a175eb68f9a.source: A famous (some say infamous) General in the Army for many years, LeMay is dismayed by the prospect of Richard Nixon accepting nuclear parity with the Soviet Union. He also is drawn to Wallace's message of social order.
eb055e4107cdd5a3b9fdd5a8f8382a175eb68f9a.zh: 作为一名在陆军服役多年的著名（有人说是臭名昭著）将军，李梅 对 理查德·尼克松 接受与苏联核平等的前景感到沮丧。他还被 华莱士 的社会秩序信息所吸引。

8e12c2d304dbc5d597556c961464961e6ee3bab1.source: A few people are interpreting this as a criticism or repudiation of Eisenhower, which does not play well for you.
8e12c2d304dbc5d597556c961464961e6ee3bab1.zh: 一些人把这解读为批评或否定艾森豪威尔，对你并不有利。

af342e43c474ee457b100cfc9665d603cde59fbb.source: A few voters, women in particular, are offended by your insinuations. Others are just confused, or have learned to tune out your attacks.
af342e43c474ee457b100cfc9665d603cde59fbb.zh: 一些选民，尤其女性，对你的影射感到冒犯。其他人只是困惑，或已经学会不理会你的攻击。

a881dc41cea7193626698da3354b0f027b4775a7.source: A few western states have allowed women the right to vote. Do you take the calls for a women's suffrage Amendment seriously?
a881dc41cea7193626698da3354b0f027b4775a7.zh: 西部已有几个州给予妇女投票权。对于要求通过妇女选举权宪法修正案的呼声，你会认真考虑吗？

ab2b2cb0022254fba92a8d8e9050fd31945ca0d1.source: A formal apology sounds a bit extreme, but we could certainly have expressed our regrets and perhaps saved the Paris Summit from collapse.
ab2b2cb0022254fba92a8d8e9050fd31945ca0d1.zh: 正式道歉听起来有些过头，不过我们确实可以表达遗憾，或许还能避免巴黎峰会破裂。

543a95af962a9b7c5f26c684b22b8f801b56b436.source: A former lobbyist and a strong conservative, Corey Lewandowski is an experienced political operative, though his competency in front of the press has been put into doubt in the past.
543a95af962a9b7c5f26c684b22b8f801b56b436.zh: 科里·莱万多夫斯基曾任说客，是一位坚定的保守派，也是一名经验丰富的政治操盘手，不过，他应对媒体的能力过去曾受到质疑。

0f91da234608ff3e655f0fe310286983dbd7e67e.source: A funny thing happened on January 20, 2009 -- millions of people who supported Bush's deficits suddenly flip-flopped into budget hawks. This group is obviously just a political front for the far right wing of the Republican Party.
0f91da234608ff3e655f0fe310286983dbd7e67e.zh: 2009年1月20日，发生了一件有趣的事：数百万曾支持布什赤字的人，突然摇身一变，成了预算鹰派。这个团体显然只是共和党极右翼的政治门面。

a6da6439de0bb985e147c886eda80caf5ff22d3b.source: A good friend of yours and a backer of Ted Cruz in the primaries, Kellyanne Conway is an ambitious strategist willing to work on behalf of the campaign as its manager and in backing 'alternative facts.'
a6da6439de0bb985e147c886eda80caf5ff22d3b.zh: 凯莉安·康韦是你的好友，在初选中支持过特德·克鲁兹。她是一位野心勃勃的策略师，愿意担任竞选经理，为你的竞选效力，也愿意为“另类事实”撑腰。

da695a490eeb1d4a1b3f8edcd5f2949ccc30e694.source: A good man named Eugene Debs was thrown in prison due to the overreach of President Cleveland.
da695a490eeb1d4a1b3f8edcd5f2949ccc30e694.zh: 一位名叫尤金·德布斯的好人，因克利夫兰总统越权而被关进了监狱。

8b0196baf24e3435c050d87b4d4446142bdc3096.source: A group created by allies of Bernie Sanders' 2016 primary campaign that seeks to promote progressive candidates and policies.
8b0196baf24e3435c050d87b4d4446142bdc3096.zh: 由伯尼·桑德斯2016年初选团队的盟友创建的组织，致力于推动进步派候选人和政策。

2582cfefca48386fa1d67d451a7dd233908ac0bf.source: A huge portion of our health care costs are accrued in the final few days of life. We need to overcome our prejudices and bring a more open mind to this issue.
2582cfefca48386fa1d67d451a7dd233908ac0bf.zh: 我们的医疗成本中，有很大一部分发生在人生的最后几天。我们需要克服偏见，以更开放的态度看待这个问题。

d814a166f403b3b0c78d95a31bd925df150a3301.source: A leaked transcript from Wikileaks shows Hillary Clinton saying in a closed-door speech at Goldman Sachs that she is "center-left, center-right" and that she supports "open trade and open borders". How do you respond?
d814a166f403b3b0c78d95a31bd925df150a3301.zh: 维基解密泄露的一份记录显示，希拉里·克林顿在高盛的一次闭门演说中表示，自己“中间偏左，也中间偏右”，并支持“开放贸易和开放边界”。你会如何回应？

676912eaa4e24b6150bd13333a08fdcb428d6d67.source: A leaked transcript from Wikileaks shows the Clinton campaign working with members of the DNC to collaborate against the campaign of Bernie Sanders in subtle but definite ways, such as the sharing of some debate questions before a primary debate. How do you respond?
676912eaa4e24b6150bd13333a08fdcb428d6d67.zh: 维基解密泄露的一份记录显示，克林顿竞选团队与民主党全国委员会的一些成员合作，以隐蔽但明确的方式联手对付伯尼·桑德斯的竞选，例如在一场初选辩论前分享部分辩论问题。你会如何回应？

b3e5d16ea341f9179c9e0091c59076a867ed6aaf.source: A leaked transcript from Wikileaks shows you saying in a closed-door speech at Goldman Sachs that you are "center-left, center-right" and that you support "open trade and open borders". How do you respond?
b3e5d16ea341f9179c9e0091c59076a867ed6aaf.zh: 维基解密泄露的一份记录显示，你在高盛的一次闭门演说中表示，自己“中间偏左，也中间偏右”，并支持“开放贸易和开放边界”。你会如何回应？

a4a75d833473392bc4ac465bc9da8aeee560ee20.source: A leaked transcript from Wikileaks shows your campaign working with members of the DNC to collaborate against the campaign of Bernie Sanders in subtle but definite ways, such as the sharing of some debate questions before a primary debate. How do you respond?
a4a75d833473392bc4ac465bc9da8aeee560ee20.zh: 维基解密泄露的一份记录显示，你的竞选团队与民主党全国委员会的一些成员合作，以隐蔽但明确的方式联手对付伯尼·桑德斯的竞选，例如在一场初选辩论前分享部分辩论问题。你会如何回应？

776b088ac3477d9c2ee7f63e112dcb77891e6fbf.source: A long-time representative from New York and current leader of the RNC, William Miller stands as Goldwater’s preferred choice for Vice-President, chosen because “he drives Johnson nuts”.
776b088ac3477d9c2ee7f63e112dcb77891e6fbf.zh: 威廉 米勒 是 纽约州 的长期代表，也是共和党全国委员会的现任领导人，他是 戈德华特 的首选副总统人选，之所以被选中是因为“他让 约翰逊 发疯”。

2490abb06506a998be23b8363f5228105f131ba0.source: A longtime advisor of yours, Ron Klain is eager to get into the White House, and will use his connections in Washington to get you there.
2490abb06506a998be23b8363f5228105f131ba0.zh: 罗恩·克莱恩是你的长期顾问，渴望进入白宫，也会动用他在华盛顿的人脉助你实现这一目标。

25d88aad282dae1f6834feeff202a3024bf037cb.source: A longtime ally of the Clintons, Dolan is a master of spin, and is interested in helping you take down Trump.
25d88aad282dae1f6834feeff202a3024bf037cb.zh: 多兰长期与克林顿夫妇结盟，是一位善于引导舆论的大师，有兴趣帮你击败特朗普。

a0bff2ddfc9c02507bf74bf40158a1f501953c6f.source: A lot of Democrats thought your answer was a bit snarky, though it does move you towards the center on immigration issues.
a0bff2ddfc9c02507bf74bf40158a1f501953c6f.zh: 许多民主党人觉得你的回答有点刻薄，不过，它确实让你在移民问题上向中间靠了一些。

eb4d7c63a98367cd3b624f4eef0d24fa091aef55.source: A lot of Republicans made themselves look pretty silly over this issue. We have plenty of over things to bring up.
eb4d7c63a98367cd3b624f4eef0d24fa091aef55.zh: 许多共和党人在这个问题上，把自己弄得相当可笑。我们还有很多其他事情可以谈。

18d8e145c18bcfbc1935c1e9f17ee897ab6bf841.source: A lot of Republicans would prefer you veto this law, but on the other hand you do appear reasonable and conciliatory with this response.
18d8e145c18bcfbc1935c1e9f17ee897ab6bf841.zh: 许多共和党人希望你否决这部法律，不过另一方面，这个回应确实让你显得通情达理、愿意和解。

63ecd7eefec33edd92fca88b23464ebfe6b66c04.source: A lot of farm states are happy to have another market for their grain, and this is a good foreign policy win as well.
63ecd7eefec33edd92fca88b23464ebfe6b66c04.zh: 许多农业州很高兴粮食又多了一个市场，这也是不错的外交收获。

b11bceec683e41697755c55f61c9a2d68cd2392d.source: A lot of moderates blame Republicans as much as or more than Bill Clinton for the partisanship of the 1990s.
b11bceec683e41697755c55f61c9a2d68cd2392d.zh: 许多温和派认为，共和党对20世纪90年代的党派对立，应承担与比尔·克林顿同样多、甚至更多的责任。

5130b5de063f690a5bc01ea5d11763a85d4b9b06.source: A lot of oil companies and national security hawks are upset with this move, and not too thrilled that you have embraced it.
5130b5de063f690a5bc01ea5d11763a85d4b9b06.zh: 许多石油公司和国家安全鹰派对这个决定不满，也不太高兴看到你表示支持。

4208931afa7f87e704e122c0a2b94ba0751a9d7a.source: A lot of people are pleasantly surprised to hear you back away from some of the more dangerous statements you've made. Maybe that will include some independent voters?
4208931afa7f87e704e122c0a2b94ba0751a9d7a.zh: 听到你收回一些更危险的言论，很多人感到惊喜。也许，其中包括一些独立选民？

d8527b0e65c09a6afd46f9c13dd04891c3cb26f1.source: A lot of people are scratching their heads at your sudden change of tone.
d8527b0e65c09a6afd46f9c13dd04891c3cb26f1.zh: 你突然改变语气，让很多人摸不着头脑。

5e72a587c15956da4f1c1426d58fb67531f80d89.source: A lot of people say that Social Security is the third rail of American politics. You may have made some hard-core conservatives happy, but the vast majority of voters disagree with your stance.
5e72a587c15956da4f1c1426d58fb67531f80d89.zh: 许多人说，社会保障制度是美国政治中碰不得的“带电第三轨”。你也许让一些铁杆保守派高兴，但绝大多数选民并不赞同你的立场。

a805f20e61eb925bb096bf8585e6522d46a2e3f2.source: A lot of people see Kaine as a safe, experienced pick. He has little to offer to the wing of the party that supported Bernie Sanders during the nomination fight.
a805f20e61eb925bb096bf8585e6522d46a2e3f2.zh: 很多人认为 凯恩 是一个安全、经验丰富的选择。他对提名战期间支持伯尼·桑德斯的党派没有什么贡献。

9598cc670c6494a4c792e41f9b8f1ae1871764ef.source: A lot of people think this election was yours to lose, and party operatives are already whispering that Nelson Rockefeller will be the frontrunner in 1964. As such, it appears that your chances of becoming President are over. Perhaps you can return to California and run for Governor, or for the Senate again.
9598cc670c6494a4c792e41f9b8f1ae1871764ef.zh: 很多人认为这次选举是你输掉的，政党工作人员已经在窃窃私语说 纳尔逊·洛克菲勒 将成为 1964 年的领跑者。因此，看来你成为总统的机会已经结束了。也许您可以返回加利福尼亚州并竞选州长，或者再次竞选参议院。

887baa2635e715668c452c62e954a0d0ae410680.source: A lot of supporters are confused that you have backed away from your earlier rhetoric on Islam, particularly after a huge terrorist attack.
887baa2635e715668c452c62e954a0d0ae410680.zh: 许多支持者感到困惑：尤其在重大恐袭之后，你竟然放弃了此前关于伊斯兰教的言辞。

5b269f96d1b3dd165dff05b23b43de74e287b7d7.source: A lot of these attacks, unfortunately, are occuring in Democrat-run cities that want to cut policing even further. Who is the real enemy of the Asian-American community?
5b269f96d1b3dd165dff05b23b43de74e287b7d7.zh: 不幸的是，许多袭击发生在民主党管理、还想进一步削减警务的城市。谁才是亚裔美国人群体真正的敌人？

78021461c5d1e5c8a50935b30270a9667570985a.source: A lot of voters are concerned about honesty and integrity in our government. What can you say about yourself in this aspect, particularly in light of your pardon of Richard Nixon?
78021461c5d1e5c8a50935b30270a9667570985a.zh: 许多选民关心政府的诚实与廉正。在这方面，尤其考虑到你赦免了理查德·尼克松，你有什么可以介绍自己的？

93e44a0db4ee2b6df6d3d2ff8f604c89dd0813e4.source: A lot of voters are concerned about honesty and integrity in our government. What can you say about yourself in this aspect?
93e44a0db4ee2b6df6d3d2ff8f604c89dd0813e4.zh: 许多选民关心政府的诚实与廉正。在这方面，你有什么可以介绍自己的？

f57adebbf4a7724d787af0954ca688ea7a052073.source: A moderate Republican from Michigan and another failed challenger to Nixon for the nomination, Romney can help immensely in the Midwest.
f57adebbf4a7724d787af0954ca688ea7a052073.zh: 来自 密歇根州 的温和派共和党人和 尼克松 提名的另一位失败挑战者，罗姆尼 可以在中西部提供巨大帮助。

f7653faef9d7f8e24a326c26a56931a48c16bace.source: A moderate stance like this will help you win a broad coalition of voters in the fall.
f7653faef9d7f8e24a326c26a56931a48c16bace.zh: 这样的温和立场有助于你在秋季选举中团结广泛的选民。

93d8d8454cbbf0126d686f895d6e96d8ec2208f8.source: A naked support of free trade is taking things a little too far for the Democratic Party right now.
93d8d8454cbbf0126d686f895d6e96d8ec2208f8.zh: 眼下对民主党来说，如此毫无保留地支持自由贸易，有些过头了。

27637373ec20211bd5c539e0a2fb4874770df43c.source: A nascent PAC, the Immigrants' List is a bipartisan group seeking to protect immigration in the country.
27637373ec20211bd5c539e0a2fb4874770df43c.zh: “移民名单”是一个新兴的政治行动委员会，由两党人士组成，旨在维护美国的移民事业。

4661a2a49cedeb4b83d8534f4ff02e8648121812.source: A national bank is anathema to most Democrats.
4661a2a49cedeb4b83d8534f4ff02e8648121812.zh: 大多数民主党人都极为反对国家银行。

2ebcf713c8897159b71f6759e947040cc11be40e.source: A new wave of Goldwater’s attack ads have gone out across the nation, highlighting Johnson’s involvement with Bobby Baker and Bill Sol Estes!
2ebcf713c8897159b71f6759e947040cc11be40e.zh: 戈德华特又一轮攻击广告已在全国播出，着重强调约翰逊与博比·贝克及比利·索尔·埃斯蒂斯的关联！

56712586225e4abaa6d2b21b0f28c8474011e231.source: A new wave of attack ads have gone out across the nation, highlighting Johnson’s involvement with Bobby Baker and Bill Sol Estes.
56712586225e4abaa6d2b21b0f28c8474011e231.zh: 新一轮攻击广告已在全国播出，着重强调约翰逊与博比·贝克及比利·索尔·埃斯蒂斯的关联。

6932f97c57972ebd560b4311a9ee79341b2b2dff.source: A nice aside aimed at Clay, but you should show more vigor in defense of your Irish supporters.
6932f97c57972ebd560b4311a9ee79341b2b2dff.zh: 这是对克莱的一次巧妙挖苦，不过，你应该更有力地维护支持你的爱尔兰选民。

6185fd4a3aedcf1cfa829a12bd080c9130f6fecd.source: A noise suddenly grabs your attention, but your vision is still fuzzy.
6185fd4a3aedcf1cfa829a12bd080c9130f6fecd.zh: 一阵噪音突然吸引了你的注意力，但你的视线仍然模糊。

551611a287d54a61a87cc01acdc300da0ee569c1.source: A number of Congressional candidates have made anti-Communism and accusations of Communist sympathies a centerpiece of their political campaigns. Do you support this trend?
551611a287d54a61a87cc01acdc300da0ee569c1.zh: 一些国会议员候选人把反共及指控对手同情共产党，作为竞选的核心。你支持这个趋势吗？

ce156a2f1b9e0560110c07c0fe22229faf7b499d.source: A number of campaign reforms, many to do with finance will likely be enacted in light of Watergate, as the scandal preceding the Checkers speech Nixon gave in 52 is fresh in the minds of many. Other than that, Inflation and the USSR are yours to deal with, although the former will likely be dealt with differently than the past Democratic, New Deal administrations. If you stay true and honest to America and help fix those problems, poor Reagan won't know what's waiting for him in 80.
ce156a2f1b9e0560110c07c0fe22229faf7b499d.zh: 鉴于水门事件，而尼克松1952年“切克斯演说”之前的那场丑闻也仍让许多人记忆犹新，一系列竞选改革很可能出台，其中不少涉及资金问题。此外，通货膨胀和苏联也是你必须应对的挑战；不过，处理通胀的方式，很可能与过去推行新政的民主党政府不同。只要你对美国保持真诚、诚实，并协助解决这些问题，可怜的里根到了1980年就不知道自己会碰上什么了。

a2ba7cf88132002c400e141b5745b7f237b334ac.source: A plurality of your advisors just resigned. The ones staying on are frankly just astonished by how stupid you are.
a2ba7cf88132002c400e141b5745b7f237b334ac.zh: 辞职的顾问成了人数最多的一派。留下的那些人，坦白说，只是对你的愚蠢感到目瞪口呆。

1854ae67bc40ad5e220b6ff1276d7d3a49bac79f.source: A popular congressman from San Antonio, Julián Castro would be willing to campaign throughout his home state of Texas in support of your candidacy.
1854ae67bc40ad5e220b6ff1276d7d3a49bac79f.zh: 朱利安·卡斯特罗是一位来自圣安东尼奥、颇受欢迎的国会议员，愿意走遍家乡得克萨斯州，为你的候选资格助选。

00392f182a91121cae6da3bbdad05bae65368b71.source: A recent Supreme Court decision affirmed an Arizona law allowing officers to check suspected illegal immigrants for proof of immigration status. Do you think this law is a good idea?
00392f182a91121cae6da3bbdad05bae65368b71.zh: 最高法院最近的一项判决认可了亚利桑那州法律中的一项规定，允许警察要求疑似非法移民者出示移民身份的证明。你认为这项法律妥当吗？

5ae1199db254b144c6e3a16af44b6d72023a3a53.source: A recently elected Senator from Florida, Marco Rubio brings strong political connections from that state. As a member of the Cuban-American community, he could help blunt the charge that Romney is indifferent to the rapidly-growing Hispanic community.
5ae1199db254b144c6e3a16af44b6d72023a3a53.zh: 最近从 佛罗里达州 当选的参议员 马尔科·鲁比奥 带来了该州强大的政治关系。作为古巴裔美国人社区的一员，他可以帮助平息罗姆尼对快速增长的西班牙裔社区漠不关心的指控。

fe765fde909ae8d2887b334962ef76d5548336d9.source: A return to the Senate might be in order, so you might defend liberalism from demise during Nixon's administration, or gearing up for a run in 1972. perhaps you can do both. In any case, let's hope Nixon can cool tensions in America and bring the troops home.
fe765fde909ae8d2887b334962ef76d5548336d9.zh: 也许该重返参议院，在尼克松执政期间捍卫自由主义，免其衰亡；也可以为1972年竞选作准备。或许两件事可以同时做。无论如何，希望尼克松能缓和美国的紧张局势，把军队带回家。

53a37eaf4c7469884ea4615e5f0481041db916ad.source: A safe response, but your core voters wanted more from you.
53a37eaf4c7469884ea4615e5f0481041db916ad.zh: 回答稳妥，但你的核心选民希望你做得更多。

70aad06633b3e137cc5c609c1b7487df8bf74264.source: A spoon full of sugar helps the medicine go down?
70aad06633b3e137cc5c609c1b7487df8bf74264.zh: 加一勺糖，就能让苦药容易下咽？

7d4aa1a2a66e7c7cf75be98764158e2b229e65d6.source: A substantial amount. We cannot afford to let ourselves get rolled over by false and misleading claims from our opponent.
7d4aa1a2a66e7c7cf75be98764158e2b229e65d6.zh: 会投放相当多。我们不能任由对手虚假、误导性的说法把我们压倒。

1608274a98670268d88deb62d44d23f1d817d62f.source: A surprisingly liberal tone is detected in your acceptance speech- to the chagrin of your conservative following, even if it does soothe the worries of those across the aisle. One sentence stands out, however.
1608274a98670268d88deb62d44d23f1d817d62f.zh: 你的接受提名演说，出人意料地带有自由主义色彩。这让保守派追随者懊恼，尽管安抚了另一阵营的担忧。不过，有一句话格外突出。

40990d25183903461306a154246602222faef1e4.source: A tie has been forced in the 1964 Election.
40990d25183903461306a154246602222faef1e4.zh: 1964 年选举中被迫打成平局。

243e3f7016647bc256f83f3a674f35b8d803c1ea.source: A tiny sliver of Northern moderates appreciate this rare display of magnanimity.
243e3f7016647bc256f83f3a674f35b8d803c1ea.zh: 极少数北方温和派，欣赏你这次难得表现出的宽宏大量。

a99ca8028c928c751dd01c7769d1712d0a6fa563.source: A top aide to Barack Obama in both his election campaigns, Jim Margolis is a top communications director, and would be sure to up your media game, which could be useful against an opponent like Donald Trump.
a99ca8028c928c751dd01c7769d1712d0a6fa563.zh: 吉姆·马戈利斯在奥巴马两次总统竞选中都担任重要助手，是顶尖的宣传负责人。他能提升你的媒体表现；面对唐纳德·特朗普这样的对手，这会很有用。

b849cf2145414d2b34355921c8e8e4ba6c5bae6a.source: A truce is just a truce. That's it. We're looking to see if the Taliban meet their commitments, and if not, we're going to pulverize them. We have some terrific planes, terrific missiles, and I'm pretty sure they can get the job done.
b849cf2145414d2b34355921c8e8e4ba6c5bae6a.zh: 停战就是停战，仅此而已。我们正在看塔利班是否履行承诺；如果没有，我们就会把他们打得粉碎。我们有出色的飞机、出色的导弹，我相当确信，它们能完成任务。

2005a15e5f0539dd37483ea24fb4b7dee3f57e7e.source: A vicious railroad strike, just weeks before the election, clouds the campaign. Many accuse you of being ineffectual and vaguely anti-union.
2005a15e5f0539dd37483ea24fb4b7dee3f57e7e.zh: 一场激烈的铁路罢工在距选举仅数周时爆发，给竞选蒙上阴影。许多人指责你办事无力，态度还隐隐偏向反工会。

4bf59e22d69cbd9c7f83256bc7263e1c50a4ebe5.source: A video surfaced of Trump describing how he tried to seduce a married woman, and how he can generally kiss women or "grab them by the pussy". 14 women have also stepped forward to accuse him of assault. What is your response?
4bf59e22d69cbd9c7f83256bc7263e1c50a4ebe5.zh: 一段视频曝光，特朗普在其中讲述自己如何试图引诱一名已婚女性，还说一般可以亲吻女性，或是“抓她们的阴部”。另有14名女性出面指控他侵犯她们。你会如何回应？

4c6814810d6f5c9510fc4d12b9a3cd3909ad006f.source: A video surfaced of you describing how you tried to seduce a married woman, and how you can generally kiss women or "grab them by the pussy". 14 women have also stepped forward to accuse you of assault. What is your response?
4c6814810d6f5c9510fc4d12b9a3cd3909ad006f.zh: 一段视频曝光，你在其中讲述自己如何试图引诱一名已婚女性，还说一般可以亲吻女性，或是“抓她们的阴部”。另有14名女性出面指控你侵犯她们。你会如何回应？

39230adc76fb77235bd9efb25afd9a7adef680c6.source: A vote for Mr. Hughes is a vote for war. He was an admirable Justice, but he is sympathy with the most bellicose elements of the Republican Party.
39230adc76fb77235bd9efb25afd9a7adef680c6.zh: 投休斯先生一票，就是投战争一票。他是一位值得尊敬的大法官，但他同情共和党中最好战的势力。

8d14882f6a6bf7502211dcbcc6ff7a13ef8c0da5.source: A wave of strikes and economic turmoil has led to bipartisan support for a new labor law. Do you support Truman's decision to veto the Taft-Hartley Act?
8d14882f6a6bf7502211dcbcc6ff7a13ef8c0da5.zh: 一波罢工潮和经济动荡，使两党都开始支持一项新的劳工法。你支持杜鲁门否决《塔夫脱—哈特利法》的决定吗？

f80dd1b7c733b71408d19658c4e60b743f7ef639.source: A wave of strikes and economic turmoil has led to bipartisan support for a new labor law. The Taft-Hartley Act, limiting the power of labor unions, has been placed on your desk. Will you sign this bill or veto it?
f80dd1b7c733b71408d19658c4e60b743f7ef639.zh: 一波罢工潮和经济动荡，使两党都开始支持一项新的劳工法。限制工会权力的《塔夫脱—哈特利法》已经送到你的办公桌上。你会签署，还是否决？

957aecb72805fdd96aded0ff3e51241cdf5643e4.source: A young, liberal Senate candidate from Minnesota named Hubert Humphrey is pushing for a civil rights plank in the Democratic platform. You can either encourage this movement or nip it in the bud.
957aecb72805fdd96aded0ff3e51241cdf5643e4.zh: 一位来自明尼苏达州、名叫休伯特·汉弗莱的年轻自由派参议员候选人，正推动将民权条款纳入民主党党纲。你可以鼓励这一行动，也可以将它扼杀在萌芽中。

927053b00a8a7cb89b2cfae75c1b7b65bfc1174a.source: AFL-CIO leaders flex their power, cajoling Wallace-friendly union men. Your personal campaign scores big in liberal states, but less so in other areas.
927053b00a8a7cb89b2cfae75c1b7b65bfc1174a.zh: 劳联—产联领袖施展影响力，劝说倾向华莱士的工会成员。你个人的竞选在自由派州收获很大，在其他地区却逊色一些。

065a39767aa7ba8228ff0a43ad387fe819200387.source: Abolishing the minimum wage is definitely a fringe position by this point.
065a39767aa7ba8228ff0a43ad387fe819200387.zh: 到了这个时候，废除最低工资无疑是边缘立场。

e394d03d1fb5c38479dbbd9902a59127d22e27e4.source: Abortion is a contentious issue and your view is unnecessarily conservative. Feminists, led by the National Organization for Women, are enraged and protests become common at your rallies.
e394d03d1fb5c38479dbbd9902a59127d22e27e4.zh: 堕胎是个争议很大的问题，你的观点保守得没有必要。全国妇女组织领导的女权主义者愤怒不已，你的集会上频频出现抗议。

01122de84b25170879a0d9f89ff0f6ce74c9455a.source: Abortion is a terrible, terrible thing. We need judges in this country that will see it that way, and end this practice once and for all.
01122de84b25170879a0d9f89ff0f6ce74c9455a.zh: 堕胎是一件可怕、非常可怕的事。我国需要认同这一点的法官，彻底终结这种做法。

b3e1f3a5d363b1567d9ec79cf7c22b099865b70a.source: Abortion is an evil, murderous practice. I will stand firm against any attempts to protect this barbarism at the federal level.
b3e1f3a5d363b1567d9ec79cf7c22b099865b70a.zh: 堕胎是一种邪恶的杀人行为。我会坚决反对任何在联邦层面保护这种野蛮行为的企图。

75aad5640e08aa3a044a82774804bfe8b9da07a1.source: Abraham Lincoln begins the campaign in a strong position. The new Republican Party is largely united, and his advantage in several Northern states is overwhelming. The challenge will be to win the closer states, like Illinois, New York, and Ohio. To do so he must finesse several hot issues of the day, not the least of which is slavery.
75aad5640e08aa3a044a82774804bfe8b9da07a1.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯 以强势地位开始竞选活动。新的共和党基本上是团结的，他在北方几个州的优势是压倒性的。挑战将是赢得更接近的州，例如伊利诺伊州、纽约州和俄亥俄州。为此，他必须巧妙处理当今的几个热点问题，其中最重要的是奴隶制问题。

052fe872d683da00f8032de004969d702d848dc7.source: Abraham Lincoln runs as the Republican against his rival Stephen A. Douglas. Slavery is the dominant issue and has caused two splinter candidates to step forward -- Breckinridge and Bell -- both with Southern roots.
052fe872d683da00f8032de004969d702d848dc7.zh: 共和党人亚伯拉罕·林肯与他的对手斯蒂芬·A.·道格拉斯竞争。奴隶制是首要议题，并促成两位分裂票源的候选人加入角逐——布雷肯里奇和贝尔，两人都有南方背景。

996f0a911c972805204f17df7096b91c949f4997.source: Abraham Lincoln, Stephen Douglas, and the Election of 1860
996f0a911c972805204f17df7096b91c949f4997.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯，斯蒂芬 道格拉斯，以及 1860 年的选举

a2d50fbdf2fef6d0468727d21a05771e57c468fd.source: Absolutely I do. We should not tolerate high unemployment in this country, and this Act provides the tools to prevent it.
a2d50fbdf2fef6d0468727d21a05771e57c468fd.zh: 我当然支持。我们不应容忍高失业率，这项法案提供了防止这种情况的工具。

d5a58c379e253c07db452ed9a066b8527ea95b04.source: Absolutely I stand by it. People are being assaulted, killed, and and raped all over Europe this past year, and we want it to happen here too?
d5a58c379e253c07db452ed9a066b8527ea95b04.zh: 我当然坚持。过去一年，欧洲到处都有人遭袭击、杀害和强奸；我们也想让这些事在这里发生吗？

0dadc6c6e4b3c314b4dbda056227dca5c2f424a1.source: Absolutely I would. Not only would this prevent a potential war and preserve the Union, but it would remove slavery from the realm of political debate once and for all.
0dadc6c6e4b3c314b4dbda056227dca5c2f424a1.zh: 我当然会支持。这不仅能避免潜在战争、维护联邦，还能让奴隶制彻底退出政治争论。

070fa76460223d9393d50cc29f3635eccced2972.source: Absolutely not. Can you imagine how it would look if we removed ourselves from the ticket in any state? And for an old man like Palmer?
070fa76460223d9393d50cc29f3635eccced2972.zh: 绝不！你能想象，我们在任何一个州退出竞选，会让人怎么看吗？而且，还是为帕尔默这样的老人让路？

b305b77ff924cab63fe30b3846a05fdaf126c498.source: Absolutely not. I don't want him anywhere near the convention. He was a loser in 2012 and he'd lose again if we were crazy enough to give him the nomination.
b305b77ff924cab63fe30b3846a05fdaf126c498.zh: 绝对不应该。我不想让他靠近大会。2012年他是个失败者，如果我们疯到再提名他，他还会再输。

c428cf99d27a9eee9f900c87d29de52bf873c0a5.source: Absolutely not. I wouldn't think of making a bet this large.
c428cf99d27a9eee9f900c87d29de52bf873c0a5.zh: 绝对没有。我不会考虑下这么大的赌注。

8ec093cf84a0303e7de2604362be9b5f89c81920.source: Absolutely. The differences between us are much smaller than the things that unite us. We both wake up every day and fight for average Americans -- for their health care, their housing and education costs, and their personal rights.
8ec093cf84a0303e7de2604362be9b5f89c81920.zh: 当然。我们之间的分歧，远远小于把我们团结起来的共同点。我们每天醒来，都为普通美国人奋斗，为他们的医疗、住房与教育费用，以及个人权利奋斗。

d590da26ef0ce1a36e6feda710bdabd85e52eebd.source: Absolutely. This is just another example of meddling that harms the economy, hurts energy production, and puts hard-working Americans out of work.
d590da26ef0ce1a36e6feda710bdabd85e52eebd.zh: 当然。这又是一个干预经济的例子，损害经济，妨碍能源生产，让勤劳的美国人失业。

599173727e1d9104ff03ce54ea9c1e6103de2566.source: Absolutely. This statement was made with the full support of our campaign.
599173727e1d9104ff03ce54ea9c1e6103de2566.zh: 完全支持。这个声明得到了我们竞选团队的全力支持。

79fe7709e49e209c37f64a4af950c8327c2bc112.source: Absolutely. We can't sit here and play by the niceties of a bygone era while Republicans steamroll us. I'm prepared to appoint four new justices to the Supreme Court.
79fe7709e49e209c37f64a4af950c8327c2bc112.zh: 当然。我们不能还守着早已过时的礼让，让共和党一路碾压我们。我准备给最高法院增设并任命四名大法官。

f1e81a766c2c1ba1a63a4d1dd0a06f01f1c02adb.source: Absolutely. We need to create an environment where American products can compete fairly with foreign imports.
f1e81a766c2c1ba1a63a4d1dd0a06f01f1c02adb.zh: 当然。我们需要创造一种环境，让美国产品能够与外国进口商品公平竞争。

175ca5ef06367f159e65c477b61abfdc89d189b3.source: Adlai Stevenson has served as Vice President in the second term of the Cleveland Administration. Unlike most of Cleveland's associates, he is not a Bourbon Democrat and has come out in favor of Bryan. Selecting him could help soften Bryan's rupture with that wing of the party.
175ca5ef06367f159e65c477b61abfdc89d189b3.zh: 阿德莱·史蒂文森 曾在克利夫兰政府第二任期担任副总统。与克利夫兰的大多数同事不同，他不是波旁民主党人，并且公开支持 布赖恩。选择他可以帮助缓和布赖恩与该党派的决裂。

60e1c6ef0ad7b8f04cd49c1802d574b2765c664e.source: Admires the attempt of Obamacare to reform the system, but sees the change as too incremental. Favors a socialized medical system on the model of most European countries.
60e1c6ef0ad7b8f04cd49c1802d574b2765c664e.zh: 赞赏奥巴马医改试图改革体系，但认为改革幅度太小。主张效仿多数欧洲国家，建立由公共部门统筹的医疗体系。

3361ddbf8b7a576258c9dbaee39cfefd3e77c80e.source: Advisers are advocating a cautious approach this fall to preserve your large lead.
3361ddbf8b7a576258c9dbaee39cfefd3e77c80e.zh: 顾问们主张今年秋季采取谨慎的竞选策略，以保住你的巨大领先优势。

4a8b05aef1e450e9f195596a4ec4e9975b9abb8a.source: Advisers like the bland, non-committal nature of this answer. The important thing is to play it safe and preserve your lead in the polls.
4a8b05aef1e450e9f195596a4ec4e9975b9abb8a.zh: 顾问喜欢这个答案的平淡、不置可否的性质。重要的是要谨慎行事并保持在民意调查中的领先地位。

518e8441043fb2a3d5299ded12313fee4161e1a8.source: Advisors definitely feel that, while your motives are admirable, you are leaving an opportunity on the table.
518e8441043fb2a3d5299ded12313fee4161e1a8.zh: 顾问们确实觉得，虽然你的动机值得赞赏，却白白放过了一个机会。

eb5380c2f259a835c6706cbe23f6f3877fe0fd08.source: Advisors feel that you are definitely leaving something on the table.
eb5380c2f259a835c6706cbe23f6f3877fe0fd08.zh: 顾问认为，你显然没有把这个机会充分利用起来。

aec1b40fdedad811243c52b460059dad95f671ce.source: After a contentious primary, observers wonder how party stalwarts will react to such comments.
aec1b40fdedad811243c52b460059dad95f671ce.zh: 经历激烈的初选后，观察人士想知道，本党坚定的支持者会如何回应这种言论。

40545152d6796be67e4f6b4a6b99b5c518820d64.source: After a couple of days, the health issue recedes to the background.
40545152d6796be67e4f6b4a6b99b5c518820d64.zh: 几天后，健康问题退到了次要位置。

ed1f4720f80ab6049bd909b380c59a9e5ad14397.source: After a few days have passed and tempers have cooled, let us reemphasize our support for current naturalization laws.
ed1f4720f80ab6049bd909b380c59a9e5ad14397.zh: 等过了几天，人们怒气稍平，我们再重申对现行入籍法的支持。

fbf311d70ae91aa19ebfcedd062d605d3cc97e73.source: Absolutely not. I'm looking for ways to end this war with an honorable peace agreement, not ways to incite the wrath of Red China.
fbf311d70ae91aa19ebfcedd062d605d3cc97e73.zh: 绝对不会。我寻找的是以体面的和平协议结束战争的办法，不是激怒红色中国的办法。

371a79df9118517c5d9762c37fdcc071384bdaa2.source: Absolutely not. If anything, we should be increasing the size of government right now to fight the stagnant economy. Had the size of the initial Stimulus Act in 2009 been sufficient, for instance, we wouldn't be having these problems now.
371a79df9118517c5d9762c37fdcc071384bdaa2.zh: 绝对不是时候。恰恰相反，我们现在应该扩大政府规模，应对经济停滞。比如，要是2009年最初的经济刺激法案规模足够大，我们现在就不会遇到这些问题。

bb4bb34b367fa9171bd5504d1ac76ea0c9e12869.source: Absolutely not. Not only would this ruin the federal budget, but it would also eliminate competition and lead to substandard health care for the vast majority of Americans.
bb4bb34b367fa9171bd5504d1ac76ea0c9e12869.zh: 绝对不支持。它不仅会毁掉联邦预算，还会消灭竞争，让绝大多数美国人得到低质量的医疗服务。

5377b1a1633318cc9f9de00813fb7a3f8d8580ae.source: Absolutely not. The United States built this canal and it is a central part of world commerce. Who knows what might happen if we put Panama in charge.
5377b1a1633318cc9f9de00813fb7a3f8d8580ae.zh: 绝对不应该。美国建造了这条运河，它是世界贸易的核心环节。谁知道交给巴拿马管理后会发生什么。

ac2b2ed415a387879289eaf834b5a7e5815e885b.source: Absolutely not. The right to disseminate one's political viewpoints freely is central to American democracy.
ac2b2ed415a387879289eaf834b5a7e5815e885b.zh: 绝对不支持。自由传播政治观点的权利，是美国民主的核心。

841a33f35f741cba7314b86ef3fcd0980c014f15.source: Absolutely not. This is a perfectly reasonable measure, designed to prevent a strike in one industry from crippling the American economy.
841a33f35f741cba7314b86ef3fcd0980c014f15.zh: 绝不支持。这是一项完全合理的措施，旨在避免某个行业的罢工使美国经济陷入瘫痪。

8cf4e46b99b31a2dde04a3365694db335079510c.source: Absolutely not. We cannot show weakness in the face of the Soviet threat, and the Paris Summit collapsed from the intransigence of Nikita Khrushchev.
8cf4e46b99b31a2dde04a3365694db335079510c.zh: 绝不应该。面对苏联威胁，我们不能示弱。巴黎峰会破裂，是尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫拒不让步造成的。

d864fc9321f345fab5e6227fa06ec5642b7aec0d.source: Absolutely there is. There are more trees in the United States now than there were at the time of the American Revolution.
d864fc9321f345fab5e6227fa06ec5642b7aec0d.zh: 绝对监管过多。美国现在的树，比美国独立战争时期还多。

f013abdd64e8e040ccd05983882f917442b8d9b4.source: Absolutely. Anything we can do to work towards energy independence in this country is a positive step. Oil and coal are the foundation of any energy policy, and should be exploited as much as possible.
f013abdd64e8e040ccd05983882f917442b8d9b4.zh: 当然支持。凡是有助于我国实现能源独立的措施，都是积极的一步。石油和煤炭是任何能源政策的基础，应当尽可能开发利用。

b285cde15c3e006427b4737ea9a3ebe57ceec990.source: Absolutely. I will appoint sensible, assertive judges as President. The purpose of the Court is not to simply overturn half of the laws passed by Congress, on picayune Constitutional objections.
b285cde15c3e006427b4737ea9a3ebe57ceec990.zh: 当然。我当上总统后，会任命明智而积极有为的法官。法院的职责，不是凭着琐碎的违宪异议，就把国会通过的法律推翻一半。

ed1f04d10ed06518597397d74949d3678cfa1005.source: Absolutely. I would be honored to give this speech.
ed1f04d10ed06518597397d74949d3678cfa1005.zh: 当然。能够发表这场演说，是我的荣幸。

696b8cb9bea1da22a41787d7842529a9547546fb.source: Absolutely. Marijuana is a dangerous controlled substance, and the federal government has a responsibility to enforce all laws that are currently on the books.
696b8cb9bea1da22a41787d7842529a9547546fb.zh: 当然应该。大麻是危险的受管制物质，联邦政府有责任执行所有现行法律。

8344122cc858ad5d2445c547dc3aa8f9eeb4fd2c.source: After a few days on the front pages, this story begins to take a back seat again.
8344122cc858ad5d2445c547dc3aa8f9eeb4fd2c.zh: 在头版待了几天后，这条新闻又逐渐退居次要位置。

cc091bacc1c7314a33ed0886fd80299ade39330a.source: After a few days, Comey does announce that no new evidence was found. Unfortunately for you, there was a definite effect on the polls as early voting began.
cc091bacc1c7314a33ed0886fd80299ade39330a.zh: 几天后，科米确实宣布，没有发现新证据。对你不利的是，在提前投票开始时，这件事已明显影响了民调。

2cb0ba1ef6330289ea4d634488914d05d4e0e75e.source: After a long and storied career serving the US government, it seems retirement is in store for you. It's unlikely you will get renominated if you try, anyways. Bob Dole will most likely be the next nominee for the presidency. Your son Jeb looks to be interested in politics, perhaps HE could be president one day.
2cb0ba1ef6330289ea4d634488914d05d4e0e75e.zh: 你为美国政府服务多年，经历丰富，如今似乎该退休了。反正即便尝试，你也很难再获提名。鲍勃·多尔很可能成为下一个总统候选人。你的儿子杰布似乎对政治有兴趣，也许有朝一日当总统的是他呢。

b94f3c5b61967cc2d4f6567f85905a003f75f2d9.source: After a long career, people wonder what you're talking about. You seem to be giving isolationist talking points now.
b94f3c5b61967cc2d4f6567f85905a003f75f2d9.zh: 你的政治生涯已经这么长，人们却不明白你在说什么。如今，你似乎在复述孤立主义者的论调。

995e3a89db6e6554311c44473ad8f8216cfff163.source: After all their support, the GLBT community can't believe what you just said. You had better be prepared for a backlash from your liberal base.
995e3a89db6e6554311c44473ad8f8216cfff163.zh: GLBT社群支持你这么久，简直不敢相信你刚才说的话。你最好准备好面对自由派基本盘的反弹。

d017f57f89bfe696cdf90aa7dbe9da6d5ce6ca75.source: After all their support, the LGBT community can't believe what you just said. You had better be prepared for a backlash from your liberal base.
d017f57f89bfe696cdf90aa7dbe9da6d5ce6ca75.zh: LGBT社群支持你这么久，简直不敢相信你刚才说的话。你最好准备好面对自由派基本盘的反弹。

5f12a37834922ce9bd59fd51f2aa1de2ec91b4f0.source: After an election in which many of your supporters claimed democracy itself was at stake, what happens now? Many analysts believe the party will need to go in a completely different direction next time. As for yourself, will you take these results sitting down, or will you prepare yourself for an epic political comeback in 2024?
5f12a37834922ce9bd59fd51f2aa1de2ec91b4f0.zh: 在您的许多支持者声称民主本身受到威胁的选举之后，现在会发生什么？许多分析人士认为，该党下次需要走完全不同的方向。至于你自己，你会坐下来接受这些结果，还是会为 2024 年史诗般的政治卷土重来做好准备？

dcaa507c2e3b29b05d08bae56e8f91730141b51d.source: After an election in which many of your supporters claimed democracy itself was at stake, what happens now? Perhaps the party will need to go in a completely different direction in 2024. As for yourself, it seems that your long, illustrious political career has surely drawn to a close.
dcaa507c2e3b29b05d08bae56e8f91730141b51d.zh: 在您的许多支持者声称民主本身受到威胁的选举之后，现在会发生什么？也许党在2024年需要走一个完全不同的方向。至于你自己，看来你漫长而辉煌的政治生涯肯定已经结束了。

90c6597d8b3ebccab9777d3bfdd26c12a93116f7.source: After an electoral massacre in 1890, Republicans have been trying to step back from the temperance issue. You're not helping them.
90c6597d8b3ebccab9777d3bfdd26c12a93116f7.zh: 1890年选举惨败之后，共和党一直想淡化禁酒问题。你这样做可帮不了他们。

80c75c712801948cac0e4b60a4ad9aeb392ee47f.source: After an upset in the Republican nomination battle, Newt Gingrich heads into the general election with strong support from fiscal and social conservatives. Better known for his House leadership in the 1990s, he must find a way to regain popularity and relevance, and to convince American voters that he can address their economic concerns more effectively than Obama.
80c75c712801948cac0e4b60a4ad9aeb392ee47f.zh: 在共和党提名战中失利后，纽特·金里奇 在财政和社会保守派的大力支持下进入大选。他因在 20 世纪 90 年代的众议院领导地位而闻名，他必须找到一种方法来重新获得支持和相关性，并让美国选民相信他可以比 奥巴马 更有效地解决他们的经济问题。

8d9a0839600e91bc192606e5e0ef6ddb382f6d19.source: After an upset in the Republican nomination battle, Rick Santorum heads into the general election with staunch support from social conservatives. He also has several years of experience as a U.S. Senator.
8d9a0839600e91bc192606e5e0ef6ddb382f6d19.zh: 在共和党提名战中失利后，里克·桑托勒姆 在社会保守派的坚定支持下进入大选。他还拥有多年担任美国参议员的经验。

7f2369fd112d2e9d5a975f38e87434e00cb86e98.source: After both candidates spent months making the case that Romney was too moderate, their joining of forces in the general election leaves little doubt as to the tone they intend to strike.
7f2369fd112d2e9d5a975f38e87434e00cb86e98.zh: 在两位候选人花了几个月的时间证明 罗姆尼 过于温和之后，他们在大选中的联手毫无疑问地表明了他们打算采取的基调。

2c6dece16e4d572b6caf454b8447980db2e500b2.source: After cajoling Nixon into a debate, you have absolutely trounced him. This could be a real turning point in your campaign, which started out looking so hopeless.
2c6dece16e4d572b6caf454b8447980db2e500b2.zh: 你终于劝得尼克松参加辩论，又把他打得落花流水。这可能成为你竞选的真正转折点——起初，这场竞选看起来是那么毫无希望。

b1a98549dd88d1cda4f28bf716e47780c1b1db16.source: After competing as rivals for the Republican nomination, a Rick Santorum and Newt Gingrich ticket would effectively act as a compromise between those camps and consolidate their support and campaign resources.
b1a98549dd88d1cda4f28bf716e47780c1b1db16.zh: 在作为共和党提名的竞争对手竞争后，里克·桑托勒姆 和 纽特·金里奇 票将有效地充当这些阵营之间的妥协，并巩固他们的支持和竞选资源。

dac290115348651f38b6dca8955c15b22130d8ca.source: After days of Trump's "grab them by the pussy" comments dominating the news, the story begins to move on to other things, not the least of which is these leaks.
dac290115348651f38b6dca8955c15b22130d8ca.zh: 特朗普“抓她们的阴部”的言论占据新闻数日后，报道开始转向其他事情，其中这些泄露材料尤其引人注目。

6642ad688a33712bd2743ce51b2b5b9b084c6485.source: After eight years of Bill Clinton, it is clear that the United States needs a true liberal alternative -- one that will fight for fair trade, universal health care, free college, and campaign finance reform. Nader's primary goal in this election is to win 5% of the popular vote, which will qualify the Green Party for federal matching funds in 2004.
6642ad688a33712bd2743ce51b2b5b9b084c6485.zh: 经过八年的 比尔·克林顿，很明显美国需要一个真正的自由主义替代方案——一个将为公平贸易、全民医疗保健、免费大学和竞选财务改革而奋斗的方案。 纳德 在这次选举中的主要目标是赢得 5% 的普选票，这将使 绿党 有资格获得 2004 年联邦配套资金。

9655a4bf280b9c35eda91fe49aaecba1ff8d1a00.source: After eight years of Dwight Eisenhower, two youthful candidates compete to be his successor. Kennedy is a Senator with a moderate record, a telegenic face, and high-minded rhetoric. Nixon is the sitting Vice President with a strong Cold War record, moderate economic views, and potential likeability problems. Nixon begins the campaign as the slight favorite, but every region of the country could be competitive. Key issues are the Cold War, civil rights, and health care.
9655a4bf280b9c35eda91fe49aaecba1ff8d1a00.zh: 艾森豪威尔执政八年后，两位年轻候选人竞相接班。肯尼迪是一位施政记录温和的参议员，外形适合电视镜头，演说富有理想色彩。尼克松是现任副总统，在冷战事务中表现强硬，经济立场温和，但个人亲和力可能成为问题。竞选开始时，尼克松略被看好，不过全国各地区都可能出现激烈争夺。主要议题是冷战、民权和医疗保障。

e993f10007b5271f3f6a837cbbb353744b8269a5.source: After eight years of Ronald Reagan, the nation seems headed for a new direction in government.
e993f10007b5271f3f6a837cbbb353744b8269a5.zh: 经历里根执政的八年后，美国似乎即将迎来新的执政方向。

8c9be80b03ba042149eafa506b8e08896a2e5858.source: After eight years of scandals and excesses from the Clinton Administration, I will return this country to its rightful principles -- small government, clean moral conduct, and the freedom of the people.
8c9be80b03ba042149eafa506b8e08896a2e5858.zh: 克林顿政府八年来丑闻不断、行事过度，我会让这个国家重新遵循应有的原则——小政府、清正的道德操守，以及人民的自由。

d42b08fb884a3fd92a09ff83fac4c1e810d73101.source: After failing to secure the Republican nomination, Ron Paul strikes out as an independent candidate. While it will be a tall order for him to win this election, he hopes to expand his political network and prove the viability of a similar candidate in 2016. His supporters, for their part, now have their biggest stage from which to educate the American public on the fiscal and constitutional issues that Ron Paul holds most dear.
d42b08fb884a3fd92a09ff83fac4c1e810d73101.zh: 在未能获得共和党提名后，罗恩·保罗 作为独立候选人脱颖而出。虽然赢得这次选举对他来说是一项艰巨的任务，但他希望扩大自己的政治网络，并在 2016 年证明类似候选人的可行性。就他的支持者而言，他们现在拥有最大的舞台，可以就 罗恩·保罗 最珍视的财政和宪法问题向美国公众进行教育。

5043dd8ac5d688f59045b13737f5ff51e66175d0.source: After his own failed run for the Republican nomination, Gary Johnson has the inside track on the Libertarian nomination. He also has proven experience as New Mexico's Governor.
5043dd8ac5d688f59045b13737f5ff51e66175d0.zh: 在竞选共和党提名失败后，加里·约翰逊 获得了自由党提名的内线。他还拥有担任 新墨西哥州 州长的丰富经验。

b342e9c811433368cec580657e808a7655004c97.source: After months of denials from liberal pundits, the Clinton email scandal does seem like it will have significant consequences on this election.
b342e9c811433368cec580657e808a7655004c97.zh: 自由派评论员否认了几个月之后，克林顿邮件丑闻看来确实会对这次选举造成重大影响。

99ae0830c2e25ee87a832bed5480c2ad07bccb26.source: After months of hard campaigning, what seemed to be a minor cough has turned into something more. Unfortunately it looks like I will need to take some days off from the campaign to rest and recuperate.
99ae0830c2e25ee87a832bed5480c2ad07bccb26.zh: 经过几个月艰苦竞选，原本看似轻微的咳嗽变得更严重了。不幸的是，看来我需要暂时离开竞选几天，休息恢复。

bbc311a231da3075d2fe7ab943a11b32f9c5483d.source: After the controversies of 2015, the ban doesn't play a big role in the closing stretch of the campaign.
bbc311a231da3075d2fe7ab943a11b32f9c5483d.zh: 经历2015年的争议后，这项禁令在竞选最后阶段并不是一个重要话题。

c7c3723f74010b1ffa3632fe972b3a65964c6da6.source: After the debacle of the convention in Chicago, are you willing to make a statement condemning the student protestors? Or conversely, one blaming the Chicago police?
c7c3723f74010b1ffa3632fe972b3a65964c6da6.zh: 经历芝加哥大会的混乱之后，你愿意发表声明谴责学生抗议者吗？或者反过来，指责芝加哥警察？

d0ba73df79c066829195f16e7f00388413ac3843.source: After the tumultuous 1912, the natural supremacy of the Republican Party has reasserted itself. The next steps are up to you -- perhaps you can lead the repeal of the Adamson Act, or replace it with something more measured and comprehensive. In regards to Europe, best of luck in whatever may occur over the next four years. Finally, Wilson plans to resign before your March 4th inauguration, so that you might assume the office now.
d0ba73df79c066829195f16e7f00388413ac3843.zh: 在经历了动荡的 1912 年之后，共和党 的天然霸主地位再次确立。接下来的步骤取决于你——也许你可以领导废除《亚当森法案》，或者用更慎重和更全面的法案取而代之。至于欧洲，无论未来四年发生什么，祝你好运。最后，威尔逊 计划在您 3 月 4 日就职之前辞职，以便您现在就可以就职。

fbbc17428209204b1b934fd45eaea1b61ba89a46.source: After the tumuluous events of this summer, many in your party are upset that you did not choose an African-American running mate. What can you say to address thiis?
fbbc17428209204b1b934fd45eaea1b61ba89a46.zh: 经历这个夏天的动荡后，党内许多人对你没有选择非裔美国人搭档感到不满。你能说些什么来回应？

79868e27c4b780e01fe8985d795af35747728ff2.source: After the unfortunate death of Abel Upshur in the
79868e27c4b780e01fe8985d795af35747728ff2.zh: 在 Abel Upshur 不幸去世后

ef064279eedf2ed15550476c3d883277f0b6e0d1.source: After your second loss in a presidential election, your chances of being renominated for the presidency, or ANYTHING for that matter is nearly zero. Retirement and an elder statesman position are all that will await you. It seems Americans will once and for all not have Nixon to kick around…
ef064279eedf2ed15550476c3d883277f0b6e0d1.zh: 第二次输掉总统选举后，你再次获得总统提名的机会几乎归零；说到底，再获任何职位提名都希望渺茫。等待你的只有退休，以及政治元老的身份。看来，美国人这次真的再也没有尼克松可供他们攻击和奚落了……

871152c61947257d302e71cd62a840ad231e9059.source: Again, I'd have to say that this is a valid concern. This would set a dangerous precedent for the independence of our nation's executive.
871152c61947257d302e71cd62a840ad231e9059.zh: 还是那句话，我认为这种担忧是合理的。这会为本国行政首脑的独立性开创一个危险的先例。

b7993aedb853b40d01e5fa0ad7184267fef93c7f.source: Again?! You managed to win with the EXACT same margin as you did in 2016. By that, I mean to say... A TREMENDOUS LANDSLIDE! You won bigly! Nobody expected it! With your margins, you've carried Republicans to decent margins in Congress. Democrats can cope and seethe, America's going to be great again! Throw away your prepared remarks accusing the Democrats of fraud, because you're heading back for a second term!
b7993aedb853b40d01e5fa0ad7184267fef93c7f.zh: 又来一次？！你竟然以与2016年完全相同的优势获胜。我的意思是……一场了不起的压倒性胜利！你赢得老大了！没人料到！凭借你的优势，你还带动共和党在国会取得了不错的席位优势。民主党人就自己憋屈、生闷气去吧，美国要再次伟大了！把准备好指控民主党舞弊的演说稿扔掉吧，你即将迎来第二个任期！

6dc70858fc6936547dd9db6295e48614706cba66.source: Agnew's Maryland background and his Greek heritage can help Nixon appeal both to Southern moderates and to blue collar workers who might otherwise be drawn to Wallace.
6dc70858fc6936547dd9db6295e48614706cba66.zh: 阿格纽 的 马里兰州 背景和他的希腊血统可以帮助 尼克松 吸引南方温和派和蓝领工人，否则他们可能会被 华莱士 吸引。

1378364448bf838d575d3d79732896d9d417c09d.source: Agrarian radicals agree with your stance on the tariff commission, but moderates in the business community do not.
1378364448bf838d575d3d79732896d9d417c09d.zh: 激进的农民派赞同你对关税委员会的立场，但商界的温和派并不赞同。

f1200b47665edd5fb06b76a7770bc4e9bc9d1f0d.source: Agrees in principle with the idea of the nuclear family as the bulwark of society. Does not take a hard line on gay marriage, but is probably opposed to it. May be willing to compromise on abortion and gun rights in some cases.
f1200b47665edd5fb06b76a7770bc4e9bc9d1f0d.zh: 原则上认同核心家庭是社会堡垒这一观念。对同性婚姻不持强硬立场，但大概反对。某些情况下可能愿意在堕胎与持枪权问题上妥协。

571d5675256d3d5084bf32b042adbfdb8651462d.source: Already there is talk in the Beltway about your "pivot" for the general election. However, immigration reform is toxic to your core supporters.
571d5675256d3d5084bf32b042adbfdb8651462d.zh: 华盛顿政治圈已经有人议论，你正在为大选作出“转向”。不过，移民改革对你的核心支持者而言是碰不得的议题。

08a36073d29570731e65a68767de6d12d8fecc3b.source: Alright. Way to get that crowd fired up.
08a36073d29570731e65a68767de6d12d8fecc3b.zh: 不错，这可把人群的热情点燃了。

f36f4ad49ba653bebe93cb6159261c30d5b83c92.source: Altgeld is a controversial figure to be sure, but he can greatly help enhance your reputation among urban, immigrant voters.
f36f4ad49ba653bebe93cb6159261c30d5b83c92.zh: 奥尔特格尔德的确颇有争议，但他能极大提升你在城市移民选民中的声望。

efe791d1964affbe71df52708d8042a414acb878.source: Altgeld is free to appear with me at any event, but I will not rearrange my entire schedule to suit his needs.
efe791d1964affbe71df52708d8042a414acb878.zh: 奥尔特格尔德可以与我一起出席任何活动，但我不会为迁就他的需要，重排整套行程。

64d28f508573f50b9cde7594b018046fdd9b0ec3.source: Although the Electoral College was tied, the Democrats have won a solid majority in the House, and will elevate Michael Dukakis to the Presidency.
64d28f508573f50b9cde7594b018046fdd9b0ec3.zh: 尽管 选举人团 平局，但民主党在众议院赢得了绝对多数席位，并将 迈克尔·杜卡基斯 提升为总统。

b0123f10b4ee21da38e1f6f1f7d82979fee80eb3.source: Am I understand that we will be sending thousands of men to dig through the hills of Nicaragua on this pipe dream of a project? Allow me to predict that there will never be a canal in that country.
b0123f10b4ee21da38e1f6f1f7d82979fee80eb3.zh: 你的意思是，我们要派成千上万人，到尼加拉瓜的丘陵里挖掘，去实现这么一个白日梦？容我预言，那个国家永远不会有运河。

de1dac81c824491f9b6ce118409924f02e6c33ac.source: Amazing! You’ve defeated the odds and won the 1964 Election!
de1dac81c824491f9b6ce118409924f02e6c33ac.zh: 太棒了！您战胜了困难，赢得了 1964 年大选！

a66ebe22965a30fb6f4bf62d88e87e00f48176d3.source: America has been undermined for years now. I've been warning about trade with China this entire time, that Clinton and Obama have been signing off on. We have very stupid people in government.
a66ebe22965a30fb6f4bf62d88e87e00f48176d3.zh: 美国这些年来不断被削弱。我一直警告，与中国的贸易有问题，而克林顿和奥巴马却一直同意放行。政府里有一些非常愚蠢的人。

0c138e2f3464c4a6f2603ab5d98b4b357dca2bb2.source: America in 1964 stands unsettled, memories of the beloved late John F. Kennedy still prominent in the nation's memory. As the nation recovers from the shock of November 1963, the 1964 campaign is just beginning, with questions swirling around America’s course in Vietnam, Social Security, and Civil Rights, among others.
0c138e2f3464c4a6f2603ab5d98b4b357dca2bb2.zh: 1964年的美国仍未安定下来，深受爱戴的约翰·F.·肯尼迪总统之死依然烙印在国民心中。国家尚在从1963年11月的震惊中恢复，1964年的竞选已拉开序幕。美国在越南的政策、社会保障和民权等问题，正引发纷纷议论。

1e66078c9925cab75b2ddc83ba7a2a55f1790cf9.source: America should remain tough, but humble. I am concerned about some of our recent interventions in places like Somalia and Serbia.
1e66078c9925cab75b2ddc83ba7a2a55f1790cf9.zh: 美国应当保持强硬，但也要谦逊。我对我们最近在索马里和塞尔维亚等地的一些干预感到担忧。

f2e22459e9b03421d2fbc70d3cf8adb6625daf73.source: America stands surprised at the peculiar situation before them- for the first time in over a century, the winner of the Presidency has not been decided on Election Night. Through some combination of a furious comeback on your behalf and a cruel joke played by God, you have neither failed to or defeated Lyndon Johnson for the Presidency- an exact tie has occurred.
f2e22459e9b03421d2fbc70d3cf8adb6625daf73.zh: 美国对眼前的特殊情况感到惊讶——一个多世纪以来第一次，总统选举之夜尚未确定。通过代表你的猛烈反击和上帝开的残酷玩笑的某种结合，你在总统职位上既没有失败也没有击败林登·约翰逊——已经发生了精确的平局。

c78bb1653d6afeb5cf2368431d7ab547b57871b4.source: Ahh yes, this isn't the number one issue on our hands, but the old Whigs always like to hear a good speech about the national bank.
c78bb1653d6afeb5cf2368431d7ab547b57871b4.zh: 啊，没错，这不是眼下的首要议题，不过，老辉格党人总喜欢听一场精彩的国家银行演说。

a2187b2a3557b5497649394941e5668e79d185ad.source: Al Gore - Earth in the Balance
a2187b2a3557b5497649394941e5668e79d185ad.zh: 阿尔·戈尔 - 平衡中的地球

01da657ba138562b54107e28178f56f3f132be9b.zh: 阿尔·戈尔 承认 2000 年选举

a891d53cb68794915e3c1132001ea98b65d3df55.source: Al Gore enters the 2000 election as the Democratic candidate after eight years as Vice President under Bill Clinton.
a891d53cb68794915e3c1132001ea98b65d3df55.zh: 阿尔·戈尔 在 比尔·克林顿 担任副总统八年后，作为民主党候选人进入 2000 年选举。

637d190d7227804bfd6899be06af60c28ea11f51.source: Al Gore has served as a Senator from Tennessee for three years, and like Bush, is the son of a Senator. He has combined a concern for science and technology with a somewhat conservative record on social issues such as gun control, abortion, and gay rights. He did fairly well in the 1988 nomination battle, finishing third to Dukakis and Jesse Jackson. He is also a baby boomer and could help appeal to younger voters.
637d190d7227804bfd6899be06af60c28ea11f51.zh: 阿尔·戈尔 已从 田纳西州 担任参议员三年，与 布什 一样，是参议员的儿子。他将对科学技术的关注与对枪支管制、堕胎和同性恋权利等社会问题的保守态度结合起来。他在 1988 年的提名战中表现相当出色，以 杜卡基斯 和 杰西·杰克逊 名列第三。他也是婴儿潮一代，可以帮助吸引年轻选民。

19784134394bad7ec241eaae0c0d65498f01d59b.source: Al Gore was the third-highest vote-getter during the Democratic primaries, and we are proud to have him on the ticket to unite our party.
19784134394bad7ec241eaae0c0d65498f01d59b.zh: 阿尔·戈尔在民主党初选中的得票排名第三。他能加入我们的竞选搭档、团结全党，我们深感自豪。

32867a4b0f2537c983dffc49d82726573ec9cb00.zh: 阿拉巴马州——未承诺支持特定候选人的选举人

af52e8d6513455544714903df40d4d35f55acd64.source: Alben Barkley is a longtime Senate Leader for the Democrats, and an elder statesman of sorts within the Democratic Party. He has served his home state of Kentucky loyally for many years, and was a strong advocate of Roosevelt's New Deal. While other candidates have rejected Truman's overtures to serve as his running mate, for what they see as a lost cause, Barkley has graciously agreed to do his part for the 1948 ticket.
af52e8d6513455544714903df40d4d35f55acd64.zh: 阿尔本·巴克利 是民主党的长期参议院领袖，也是 民主党 内的资深政治家。他多年来一直忠诚地为家乡 肯塔基州 服务，并且是 罗斯福 新政 的坚定拥护者。虽然 其他候选人 拒绝了 杜鲁门 作为他的竞选伙伴的提议，因为他们认为这是一场失败的事业，但 巴克利 慷慨地同意为 1948 年的选举尽自己的一份力量。

8db92c0f95e919e5526fa5131d31da505be2fa4b.source: All of the above? This election is a war for the soul of America. There's no attack that I won't make against the Clintons.
8db92c0f95e919e5526fa5131d31da505be2fa4b.zh: 以上全部？这场选举是争夺美国灵魂的战争。对克林顿夫妇，我没有什么攻击是不敢发动的。

6a54b04ec771d29f21269178eebd440ab00d92fb.source: All people contribute to a prosperous America. I support a combination of stronger immigration enforcement with a path to citizenship for people currently in the country. We can do better than we did with the 1986 law.
6a54b04ec771d29f21269178eebd440ab00d92fb.zh: 所有人都在为美国的繁荣作贡献。我支持把加强移民执法与为目前在美国的人提供入籍途径结合起来。我们可以比1986年的法律做得更好。

e653858540e6d9149f383e2840446c244b9e4c93.source: All the best leaders have great speechwriters, and Dan Schwerin is an up-and-coming talent in that field, and a great writer in his own right.  He helped you with writing your memoir, Hard Choices and is now willing to come back on board to help you win this election.
e653858540e6d9149f383e2840446c244b9e4c93.zh: 最出色的领导人都拥有优秀的演讲撰稿人。丹·施韦林是这一领域崭露头角的人才，本身也是一位出色的作家。他曾帮你撰写回忆录《艰难抉择》，如今愿意重返团队，助你赢得大选。

e0d278e5f083b04550c09f8c508f0f20a9fd80d6.source: Already there is talk in the Beltway about your "pivot" for the general election.
e0d278e5f083b04550c09f8c508f0f20a9fd80d6.zh: 华盛顿政治圈已经有人议论，你正在为大选作出“转向”。

8db24de0d15006669fd61b354b809b10887ce392.source: American Exceptionalism -- Providence has given America to the world as an inspiration, and we must vigorously defend the ideals of peace and freedom wherever they may be threatened.
8db24de0d15006669fd61b354b809b10887ce392.zh: 美国例外论——天意将美国赐予世界，作为启迪人心的榜样；无论哪里，和平与自由的理想受到威胁，我们都必须坚决捍卫。

940389727ef10b6e84ca85dc393cc47d0df76c39.zh: 美国阿拉伯裔反歧视联盟

de6470fb61b5931f68719bcc6056ca7fcbc509d9.source: Americans are one people. We will not do special messaging for special interest groups.
de6470fb61b5931f68719bcc6056ca7fcbc509d9.zh: 美国人是一个整体。我们不会为了某些特殊利益群体，另说一套话。

e1e62796b21199a39cba482943ed6a5f7b95d0bf.source: Americans dislike partisan rancor, but is your speech the answer? What are the details? You also have to worry about alienating conservative supporters.
e1e62796b21199a39cba482943ed6a5f7b95d0bf.zh: 美国人不喜欢党派间的恶斗，但你的演说就是解决办法吗？具体细节呢？你还得担心疏远保守派支持者。

a64aec148fbd81a736421608a47f30fe40535d0d.source: Americans generally have a decent opinion of Bill Clinton and Al Gore, and your answer might not fit the times that well. However, it will definitely motivate your conservative base.
a64aec148fbd81a736421608a47f30fe40535d0d.zh: 美国人总体上对比尔·克林顿和阿尔·戈尔评价不错，你的回答可能不太符合当下的气氛。不过，这肯定会鼓舞你的保守派基本盘。

6efd216de7170b21e69918b0757578de12ec145c.source: Americans generally have a decent opinion of Bill Clinton, and your answer might not fit the times that well. However, it will definitely motivate your conservative base.
6efd216de7170b21e69918b0757578de12ec145c.zh: 美国人总体上对比尔·克林顿评价不错，你的回答可能不太符合当下的气氛。不过，这肯定会鼓舞你的保守派基本盘。

9e7a8399dd8fd8974aba3ec70145165f6f4b4c12.zh: 美国人总体上是喜欢避孕药的。

ab34a628a684c1cce4ffcb2b292b24bebbcbafad.source: Americans seem ready to move on from Reagan, but partly on the assumption that you are a pragmatic, moderate administrative type, and not a liberal like Mondale.
ab34a628a684c1cce4ffcb2b292b24bebbcbafad.zh: 美国人似乎准备告别里根，不过这部分是因为他们认为你是务实、温和的行政管理型人物，而不是蒙代尔那样的自由派。

39409c24e25b08bc1833ccceb88d971b00661517.source: Americans want to hear you address this personally, and not watch as you hide behind a spokeswoman.
39409c24e25b08bc1833ccceb88d971b00661517.zh: 美国人想听你亲自回应，而不是看你躲在一位女发言人身后。

5439dbb7ef77852ca95e995576edc366906a446c.source: Americans, and particularly Democrats, do not want a President who sounds like this on the Vietnam issue. Let bygones be bygones.
5439dbb7ef77852ca95e995576edc366906a446c.zh: 美国人，尤其是民主党人，不想要一位在越南问题上这样说话的总统。过去的就让它过去吧。

c684e8ad9a365e0d1695ccbfb96bbfeb8be060ef.source: An advocacy group for Arab-American interests, the ADC has recently taken an interest in opposing support for the state of Israel.
c684e8ad9a365e0d1695ccbfb96bbfeb8be060ef.zh: 一个维护阿拉伯裔美国人利益的倡议团体。ADC最近开始关注反对支持以色列的问题。

82a41c20e2c35621ea65f1647fe304c3dbef7db0.source: An alarming percentage of union voters are inspired by the aggressively racist rhetoric of George Wallace. What will you do to win this group back to your side?
82a41c20e2c35621ea65f1647fe304c3dbef7db0.zh: 乔治·华莱士咄咄逼人的种族主义言论，吸引了多得令人担忧的工会选民。你会怎样把他们争取回来？

a07b97acc6486f4a07cb78c0251145299e9c279b.source: An alarming percentage of voters are inspired by the aggressively racist rhetoric of George Wallace. What will you do to win this group?
a07b97acc6486f4a07cb78c0251145299e9c279b.zh: 乔治·华莱士咄咄逼人的种族主义言论，吸引了数量令人担忧的选民。你会如何争取这个群体？

0cd5b23c7e15d77eb0e835fbf67ea055afb02eca.source: An all-northern ticket has raised a few eyebrows, but maybe it's the best choice given the nature of this election.
0cd5b23c7e15d77eb0e835fbf67ea055afb02eca.zh: 全北方的竞选组合让一些人惊讶，不过，鉴于这场大选的性质，也许这才是最好的选择。

9fd13ebe1d9ed92efc9f28e27c1ccf4f1ee3b420.source: An appeal to sectional pride may be your only trick left.
9fd13ebe1d9ed92efc9f28e27c1ccf4f1ee3b420.zh: 诉诸地域自豪感，或许是你最后剩下的一招。

32b5b732140dee6fd61f7a529bfb7b1c99240ff7.source: An arms control agreement with the Soviet Union isn't worth the paper that it's signed on. I won't participate in that kind of a charade.
32b5b732140dee6fd61f7a529bfb7b1c99240ff7.zh: 与苏联签订军备控制协议，连写它的纸都不值。我不会参与这种闹剧。

f89273eac9168b74372be932e832f4b6e7ea1c0e.source: An attorney for the campaign and a White House Counsel for the Obama Administration who's willing to prep you for the debates against Donald Trump, which could be chaotic if you are unable to command the stage.
f89273eac9168b74372be932e832f4b6e7ea1c0e.zh: 他是竞选团队的律师，曾任奥巴马政府的白宫法律顾问，愿意帮你准备与唐纳德·特朗普的辩论。如果你掌控不了现场，这场辩论可能会变得混乱不堪。

531bc79ed72e0135296c94def5fcd6b948c45d34.source: An embarrassing gaffe has hit papers all over the country- Goldwater suggests the use of nuclear weapons in Vietnam!
531bc79ed72e0135296c94def5fcd6b948c45d34.zh: 一桩尴尬失言登上了全国各地的报纸：戈德华特建议在越南使用核武器！

1174526b520c0659aa924bbb1f70acccc8b6ad50.source: An evangelical Christian or otherwise deeply traditional on social issues. Believes that abortion is murder, and that gay marriage threatens thousands of years of religious and civil precedents. Also favors a traditional role for women and traces many current problems to the women's liberation movement.
1174526b520c0659aa924bbb1f70acccc8b6ad50.zh: 信奉福音派基督教，或在社会议题上持极为传统的立场。认为堕胎就是谋杀，同性婚姻威胁着数千年来的宗教与世俗惯例。也主张女性承担传统角色，把如今的许多问题归咎于妇女解放运动。

a7ffcd14815665dbca4ff86bb7533d19c768d95c.source: An expert of matters of foreign policy, Jake Sullivan is a young operative ready to make his mark in Washington, and help with cementing your positions on the policies of the day.
a7ffcd14815665dbca4ff86bb7533d19c768d95c.zh: 杰克·沙利文精通外交政策，是一位年轻的政治操盘手，准备在华盛顿崭露头角，也能帮助你明确当下各项政策的立场。

8f58d6410c8fa5e3e989c24347a0cb040710021a.source: An interesting response. Pundits are surprised to see you take the high road.
8f58d6410c8fa5e3e989c24347a0cb040710021a.zh: 有意思的回应。评论人士很惊讶，你竟然选择了较为体面的做法。

bbca3694e206661097e54b8415632cb4d2210366.source: An outbreak of COVID-19 has led to a wave of stay-at-home orders and business closures. How will you address this issue as President?
bbca3694e206661097e54b8415632cb4d2210366.zh: 新冠疫情暴发，导致各地纷纷发布居家令，企业停业。作为总统，你会如何处理？

4b71ffcd56c3ab1b214056099e73fc9d16948671.source: An outbreak of COVID-19 has led to a wave of stay-at-home orders and business closures. How will you campaign over  the next few months?
4b71ffcd56c3ab1b214056099e73fc9d16948671.zh: 新冠疫情暴发，导致各地纷纷发布居家令，企业停业。未来几个月，你会如何竞选？

7af1bfd396f556df356f11f07df5776c1c3b8442.source: An unintended consequence, but one we welcome.
7af1bfd396f556df356f11f07df5776c1c3b8442.zh: 这是个意料之外的结果，不过我们乐见其成。

b42522a373445c73a385d2d7f122658132adac5a.source: Analysts and voters detect more of a populist note in your latest political persona.
b42522a373445c73a385d2d7f122658132adac5a.zh: 分析人士和选民感觉，你最新的政治形象带着更多民粹主义色彩。

4a8f60e6457ffb193f8c6d07a54c945782d1a201.source: Analysts are surprised at your refusal to go low against Goldwater. These ads are effective enough but some advisors think you’re leaving some of your most potent arguments on the table by taking the high road.
4a8f60e6457ffb193f8c6d07a54c945782d1a201.zh: 分析人士惊讶于你不肯用卑劣手段攻击戈德华特。这些广告效果还算不错，但一些顾问认为，选择堂堂正正的路线，等于放弃了某些最有力的攻击点。

aa850ef98a3ee7b93b681baa21885e466c7e4465.source: Anderson is an interesting choice. Let's see how it works out.
aa850ef98a3ee7b93b681baa21885e466c7e4465.zh: 安德森是个有意思的选择。看看效果如何吧。

a990dcb7f62031c2af092939c34145ada72c9673.source: Andrew E. Busch & James W. Ceaser - The Perfect Tie: The True Story of the 2000 Presidential Election
a990dcb7f62031c2af092939c34145ada72c9673.zh: 安德鲁·E·布希 & 詹姆斯·W·凯瑟 - 完美领带：2000 年总统选举的真实故事

c203cf5d1afb41fe0fe2d4c47f225c37bf5b25e8.source: Andrew Napolitano is a former New Jersey judge, a writer, and political commentator from the libertarian end of the political spectrum.
c203cf5d1afb41fe0fe2d4c47f225c37bf5b25e8.zh: 安德鲁·纳波利塔诺 是一名前 新泽西州 法官、作家和来自政治光谱自由主义一端的政治评论员。

d197076b22eaf0539300a8614586193b55b32b54.source: Another attack on Truman. Political junkies are delighted by the back-and-forth in this campaign between the two of you.
d197076b22eaf0539300a8614586193b55b32b54.zh: 又一次抨击杜鲁门。你们俩在竞选中你来我往，让政治迷们十分过瘾。

aaf27a15081354b27e06fe29f6541ee1f916d24d.source: Another day, another rally on the campaign trail. What do you prefer to talk about today?
aaf27a15081354b27e06fe29f6541ee1f916d24d.zh: 竞选途中，又是一天，又是一场集会。你今天想谈些什么？

3162764b62c73f1d1bc59d4582b51ae354c0c03f.source: Another day, another speech. What will you say today on the campaign trail?
3162764b62c73f1d1bc59d4582b51ae354c0c03f.zh: 又是新的一天，又有一场演说。今天你在竞选途中准备说些什么？

fa38cef5bf3f8624c8c06fe7cf5c5e0bcd51c3e5.source: Another horrific attack, this time in Nice, France. Many dead and injured. When will we learn? It is only getting worse.
fa38cef5bf3f8624c8c06fe7cf5c5e0bcd51c3e5.zh: 又发生了一场可怕的袭击，这次是在法国尼斯。许多人死伤。我们什么时候才会吸取教训？情况只会越来越糟。

7e3cd83e55a192133c0e084196c5953edd8827f2.source: Another story has broken our way- Goldwater has received an endorsement from the leader of the Alabama Ku Klux Klan!
7e3cd83e55a192133c0e084196c5953edd8827f2.zh: 又有一则消息对我们有利：戈德华特得到了阿拉巴马州三K党领导人的支持！

85469274b20a7c351d0b58a63faf81a1ec81cb92.source: Another talking point that needles the conservative wing of the party.
85469274b20a7c351d0b58a63faf81a1ec81cb92.zh: 这又是一句让党内保守派刺耳的说辞。

f59137d9f1d0cceff4922b1c50539f99e80a37fd.source: Anti-Catholicism continues to be an issue. Major newspapers have published a statement by 150 Protestant clergy, including Norman Vincent Peale, opposing any Catholic as President. Do you have any comment?
f59137d9f1d0cceff4922b1c50539f99e80a37fd.zh: 反天主教情绪仍是个问题。各大报纸刊登了一份由150名新教教士，包括诺曼·文森特·皮尔发表的声明，反对任何天主教徒担任总统。你有什么回应？

cde2020f3c046d3eb9a0ac245db68d591210cb3b.source: Anti-Catholicism has been a huge issue thus far in the campaign, with hundreds of pamphlets and leaflets being distributed across the South and Midwest. Do you have any comment?
cde2020f3c046d3eb9a0ac245db68d591210cb3b.zh: 反天主教情绪至今一直是竞选中的重大问题，数百种小册子和传单在南方及中西部散发。你有什么回应？

7b2d05d5f15f026d4896db9e67faacccbb7286de.source: Anti-Communism is a popular opinion, but you also come off as a flip-flopper and a grandstander with this sudden announcement.
7b2d05d5f15f026d4896db9e67faacccbb7286de.zh: 反共立场很受欢迎，但你突然作出这种宣布，也让自己显得反复无常、爱出风头。

da6eccc354f6be6f3b04e4aca29f8b7ed3fb38d0.source: Anti-Trump forces seize on grim polls for Clinton match-up
da6eccc354f6be6f3b04e4aca29f8b7ed3fb38d0.zh: 反特朗普势力抓住克林顿对决的严峻民意调查

639db23e114aa898be09e6358cbc3b30df93f76b.source: Any "concern" that Republicans have for Bernie Sanders and his supporters is utterly fraudulent. Furthermore, the incidents these leaks mention are minor and had no effect on the nomination.
639db23e114aa898be09e6358cbc3b30df93f76b.zh: 共和党人对伯尼·桑德斯及其支持者的任何“关心”，都是彻头彻尾的虚情假意。此外，这些泄露材料所提到的事件很小，对提名结果没有影响。

d1a0b5cf61b624ae7b20c44e1b67c56438b08f93.source: Any attacks we make will only publicize this group more. Let's stick to our own campaign in this case.
d1a0b5cf61b624ae7b20c44e1b67c56438b08f93.zh: 我们对他们的任何攻击，都只会让这个团体更加出名。还是专心开展我们自己的竞选吧。

fb8a84565b5b9c87d671da5bb384e8d3417a32bf.source: Any chance we can get to expose Trump's complete lack of preparation for the Presidency is a win for us.
fb8a84565b5b9c87d671da5bb384e8d3417a32bf.zh: 只要有机会揭露特朗普完全没准备好担任总统，对我们就是胜利。

2b8ab322f6cd7cd220fa4b8096eef4667e140aa4.source: Any normal businessman -- Bill Gates, Michael Bloomberg, whoever -- they try to pay as little in taxes as legally possible. It's funny how they never go after these people as long as they fund and support the left.
2b8ab322f6cd7cd220fa4b8096eef4667e140aa4.zh: 任何正常的商人，比尔·盖茨、迈克尔·布隆伯格，谁都一样，都会尽量在合法范围内少缴税。有意思的是，只要这些人出钱支持左翼，媒体就从不追究他们。

6cfda51153fda9d6e66436add1497ad1aaf30d35.source: Any story we can get, let's throw it out there. We're going to go with the tactics that have gotten us this far.
6cfda51153fda9d6e66436add1497ad1aaf30d35.zh: 能拿到什么故事，就抛出去吧。我们会继续用那些让我们走到今天的手法。

7b4a36b0d7ee744dd8aeb2eb537bcec93370a483.source: Any trade deals should be negotiated with a fair balance between American and Chinese interests. China is not doing enough to protect the rights of their workers, which gives them an unfair advantage in global trade.
7b4a36b0d7ee744dd8aeb2eb537bcec93370a483.zh: 任何贸易协定都应该在美国与中国的利益之间取得公平平衡。中国在保护劳动者权利方面做得不够，因此在全球贸易中获得了不公平的优势。

73e89e86aee7e18320b2c6cb3782df813feb3ef5.source: Anyone can see that I am a strong supporter of Civil Rights. I don't agree with what Wallace did, but my campaign is about healing this nation and bringing all sides together to face the future.
73e89e86aee7e18320b2c6cb3782df813feb3ef5.zh: 谁都看得出，我坚定支持民权。我不赞同华莱士过去的所作所为，但我的竞选着眼于弥合国家的创伤，让各方携手面对未来。

dcab3b5aebc562f69ea55d6b7b98cadcc2f16124.source: Anyone can see that I've supported road development throughout my career, and I think this would be a positive step for the country.
dcab3b5aebc562f69ea55d6b7b98cadcc2f16124.zh: 谁都看得出，我在整个政治生涯中一直支持道路建设。我认为，这对本国是积极的一步。

08544db4989c7ec6b1bc499a4fcd6ad2311e30db.source: Anyone can see that we have special circumstances this year. If I'm elected, I plan to appoint a commission to research which of these measures were effective, and what we can do differently in 2024.
08544db4989c7ec6b1bc499a4fcd6ad2311e30db.zh: 谁都看得出，今年情况特殊。当选后，我计划设立一个委员会，研究哪些措施有效，以及2024年可以如何改进。

0513dc3550bec1458693d9992718037061576172.source: Anyone can see that we support this idea, but our main emphasis should be on other issues.
0513dc3550bec1458693d9992718037061576172.zh: 谁都看得出，我们支持这个主张，不过，主要精力应当放在其他议题上。

e5608e30989e1bee84c04c13e49275f51336a095.source: Anyone who knows me should know the answer to this question. I support the free coinage of silver at a price ratio of 16-to-1 versus gold.
e5608e30989e1bee84c04c13e49275f51336a095.zh: 了解我的人都该知道答案。我支持按白银与黄金16比1的法定比价实行自由铸银。

d4ba46d4b11e4e5e72bc0da03d9253aeb829caf8.source: Anyone who supports the Union is fine in my book, at least in comparison to the secessionist Southern Democrats.
d4ba46d4b11e4e5e72bc0da03d9253aeb829caf8.zh: 在我看来，凡是支持联邦的人都不错，至少比主张分离的南方民主党人好。

f408c3f11767c3957696d491f4bc4924a5a1d53b.source: Anytime you can mention Hillary Clinton and Goldman Sachs in the same sentence, it's a win for you.
f408c3f11767c3957696d491f4bc4924a5a1d53b.zh: 只要能在同一句话里提到希拉里·克林顿和高盛，对你就是一次得分。

f4aced53337f30a0b5908469523054ca3bc9935f.source: Apparently, there is some discomfort within the Hughes campaign at the content of Roosevelt's speeches, but they are also afraid to antagonize him during a campaign.
f4aced53337f30a0b5908469523054ca3bc9935f.zh: 看来，休斯竞选团队对罗斯福演说的内容有些不安，但又不敢在竞选期间得罪他。

749f72051f2e35e59135f45ae2d141b22575c8d1.source: Apple's use of cheap, Chinese labor via Foxconn has increased the visibility of labor conditions in that country. Do you think that China competes unfairly with the U.S. by denying basic rights to its workers?
749f72051f2e35e59135f45ae2d141b22575c8d1.zh: 苹果公司通过富士康使用廉价中国劳动力，使中国的劳动条件受到更多关注。你是否认为，中国剥夺劳动者的基本权利，从而对美国形成不公平竞争？

22f23daa007cc6c119ffed67cca2c05f3ab53673.source: Appreciate the congrats for being right on radical Islamic terrorism, I don't want congrats, I want toughness & vigilance. We must be smart!
22f23daa007cc6c119ffed67cca2c05f3ab53673.zh: 谢谢大家祝贺我对激进伊斯兰恐怖主义的判断是对的。我不要祝贺，我要强硬和警惕。我们必须聪明起来！

cb0d45eda8261461c388c1edf57b18362d0bf965.source: Are protectionist measures of some kind needed to counteract the dominance of Japan in foreign trade?
cb0d45eda8261461c388c1edf57b18362d0bf965.zh: 是否需要采取某种贸易保护措施，来应对日本在对外贸易中的优势？

526ee465b7418a42dc77924642031bc52cee56b9.source: Are there any personal attacks you would like to throw at Bill and Hillary Clinton over the next few months?
526ee465b7418a42dc77924642031bc52cee56b9.zh: 接下来几个月，你想对比尔和希拉里·克林顿发动什么人身攻击吗？

5b1efdc195c324ee8057f682ff5c7cf65c570e21.source: Are you concerned with some of the activist stances that Earl Warren has taken in his time with the Supreme Court?
5b1efdc195c324ee8057f682ff5c7cf65c570e21.zh: 厄尔·沃伦在最高法院任职期间的一些积极干预立场，让你感到担忧吗？

50cd01c68f189dd47c6d965ba8027de7bd523574.source: Are you considering policies such as a national lockdown or a mask mandate to control COVID-19? Conversely, do you plan to speak out against these ideas?
50cd01c68f189dd47c6d965ba8027de7bd523574.zh: 你是否考虑过全国封锁或强制戴口罩等政策，以控制新冠疫情？反过来，你是否打算公开反对这些想法？

ff13cfe11215b5b57ed707106e6ef4fe7a19fa94.source: Are you going to make your next speech about social engineering, states rights, and the anarchy movement?
ff13cfe11215b5b57ed707106e6ef4fe7a19fa94.zh: 你下一场演讲，打算谈社会改造、州权和无政府主义运动吗？

b57b710a842e189c61d54a49e61bf736b909ee2d.source: Are you kidding? What we’ll lose in the South, we’ll make up ten times over in the rest of the country. Run the ads.
b57b710a842e189c61d54a49e61bf736b909ee2d.zh: 开什么玩笑？南方损失的支持，我们在全国其他地方能十倍地补回来。把广告播出去。

039558a83334686ccbb03d336ee22a6308f10399.source: Are you open to attending the customary three debates with your opponent, Mr. Biden?
039558a83334686ccbb03d336ee22a6308f10399.zh: 你是否愿意按惯例，与对手拜登先生参加三场辩论？

eda9037638d0d5daae3c913e917ed696dc3b103b.source: Are you open to attending the customary three debates with your opponent, Mr. Trump?
eda9037638d0d5daae3c913e917ed696dc3b103b.zh: 你是否愿意按惯例，与对手特朗普先生参加三场辩论？

d3bf6f2cd1a6fb2f5bb28fc06663ebdc06ac6c80.source: Are you out of your mind? A national bank is anathema to the Democratic Party.
d3bf6f2cd1a6fb2f5bb28fc06663ebdc06ac6c80.zh: 你疯了吗？国家银行是民主党最不能容忍的东西。

c620934c56095c402a2749d15dc4657a655919c0.source: Are you pleased with the recent defeat in Congress of the Pacific Railroad Funding Bill, which would have provided federal support to the Southern and Central Pacific railroads.
c620934c56095c402a2749d15dc4657a655919c0.zh: 《太平洋铁路融资法案》最近在国会遭到否决。它本会向南太平洋和中央太平洋铁路提供联邦支持。你对此满意吗？

c89fd5162f76a03668c2c0924ab4eba4c2696925.source: Are you prepared to reaffirm our commitment to the Monroe Doctrine, should any new territories in Latin America gain independence from Spain?
c89fd5162f76a03668c2c0924ab4eba4c2696925.zh: 如果拉丁美洲有新的领地摆脱西班牙、取得独立，你准备重申我们坚持门罗主义吗？

cb2bed174df04795ad62ca3d80ae5061bc4fd0e7.source: Are you satisfied with the economy and the economic policies of this country over the past eight years?
cb2bed174df04795ad62ca3d80ae5061bc4fd0e7.zh: 你对本国过去八年的经济状况和经济政策满意吗？

a7b32956acf3c15b39264f46aab77b8234fe189f.source: Are you satisfied with the progress of desegregation in this country since the passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964?
a7b32956acf3c15b39264f46aab77b8234fe189f.zh: 自1964年《民权法案》通过以来，你对我国取消种族隔离的进展满意吗？

f0e87a7018f2aaae179bd9ad630e677b0dd8bfe7.source: Are you satisfied with the provisions within the 2012 Federal Highway Bill that could salvage over two million jobs in the construction industry?
f0e87a7018f2aaae179bd9ad630e677b0dd8bfe7.zh: 2012年联邦公路法案中的规定可能保住建筑业逾200万个工作岗位，你对此是否满意？

03af683286014b76b7f1fafbe3c59ba984a0f719.source: Are you satisfied with this nation's economic performance over the previous five years?
03af683286014b76b7f1fafbe3c59ba984a0f719.zh: 你对过去五年我国的经济表现满意吗？

491a50ccb232d36788e420c909f3e37d07e041a1.source: Are you still opposed to the Trans-Pacific Partnership? Would you pursue further trade agreements as President?
491a50ccb232d36788e420c909f3e37d07e041a1.zh: 你仍反对《跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》吗？如果当上总统，你会继续推动其他贸易协定吗？

4200d4ba5fb58ec3ddf59a5f12c6193dfe9404b3.source: Are you suggesting that after fifty years of putting pressure on the Communist regime, when we're now so close to restoring democracy to that island, that we suddenly give up and let Castro win?
4200d4ba5fb58ec3ddf59a5f12c6193dfe9404b3.zh: 你的意思是，对共产主义政权施压五十年后，在我们如此接近恢复这个岛国的民主之际，突然放弃，让卡斯特罗获胜？

a4802f2bf2c7a02bba0bde4cdc35e9900ea16fb9.source: Are you taking the side of Grover Cleveland over that of hard-working American railroad men?
a4802f2bf2c7a02bba0bde4cdc35e9900ea16fb9.zh: 你是在站到格罗弗·克利夫兰那边，反对辛勤劳动的美国铁路工人吗？

22f2dbee6c32334771cebbb530d04ebb7ab57e1d.source: Are you trying to lose the election?

6d9db4380fac9ebba8d6cda39726834497f0cd5f.source: Are you trying to win the Mormon vote this year? This is one case where it's definitely best to keep your opinions private.
6d9db4380fac9ebba8d6cda39726834497f0cd5f.zh: 你今年是想争取摩门教徒的选票吗？这件事上，最好还是把个人意见留在心里。

ec8da8a50d75887b04cd75194ce433df1f4b0909.source: Are you willing to meet with German-American and Irish-American political leaders to discuss your beliefs, regardless of your feelings towards their organizations?
ec8da8a50d75887b04cd75194ce433df1f4b0909.zh: 无论你对他们的组织有何感受，你愿意会见德裔和爱尔兰裔美国人的政治领袖，讨论自己的看法吗？

38204103b4bcc704d914bef9a8524efb601498a1.source: Are you willing to rule out any further increases to the federal income tax, if elected President?
38204103b4bcc704d914bef9a8524efb601498a1.zh: 如果当选总统，你愿意承诺不再提高联邦所得税吗？

9a194f0ef017604103beadd735e6255864273168.source: Around the world we have Islamic terror striking at innocent lives, while the Democrats do nothing. If this attack on the LGBT community, this vicious attack, isn't enough to make them wake up, then what is?
9a194f0ef017604103beadd735e6255864273168.zh: 世界各地都有伊斯兰恐怖分子袭击无辜者，民主党却什么也不做。如果这次针对LGBT群体的袭击，这种恶毒的袭击，还不足以让他们醒悟，那还有什么能让他们醒悟？

70df520c84a1fce61d54a60ba55d447366b8fa10.source: Arthur Sewall is a banker and shipbuilder from Maine. As one of few prominent Democrats in that region, he could help balance the ticket with a non-Western presence. His considerable wealth can also help finance a campaign.
70df520c84a1fce61d54a60ba55d447366b8fa10.zh: 阿瑟·休厄尔 是来自 缅因州 的银行家和造船师。作为该地区为数不多的知名民主党人之一，他可以帮助平衡选票与非西方势力的关系。他的巨额财富还可以帮助资助竞选活动。

48ba57a7bff9f4c94d6432ee730975696b63fe7f.source: Arthur Vandenberg is a great man who represents my views for the future of this country. Now let's get going with this campaign.
48ba57a7bff9f4c94d6432ee730975696b63fe7f.zh: 阿瑟·范登堡是位出色的人物，代表了我对本国未来的看法。现在，让我们开始竞选吧。

c06035df31e5ffd45df7f704cd0e5b30abf3f440.source: Arthur Vandenberg was influential in the founding of the United Nations, and has built his reputation as an expert on international affairs. His selection would send a clear message that the days of Republican isolationism are over. He has supported many of Truman's policies, such as the Marshall Plan and the proposed NATO organization. On the other hand, he was also a leading opponent of Roosevelt's later domestic policies.
c06035df31e5ffd45df7f704cd0e5b30abf3f440.zh: 阿瑟·范登堡 在联合国的成立中具有影响力，并建立了国际事务专家的声誉。他的当选将发出一个明确的信息：共和党孤立主义的时代已经结束。他支持许多杜鲁门的政策，例如马歇尔计划和拟议的北约组织。另一方面，他也是罗斯福后来国内政策的主要反对者。

913fa934b2517956c69fb2c0e31e661e60acf56d.source: As 1916 begins, you have a vacancy to fill on the Supreme Court. Advisors are recommending Louis Brandeis -- a choice that is sure to be controversial. What are your thoughts?
913fa934b2517956c69fb2c0e31e661e60acf56d.zh: 1916年伊始，你需要填补最高法院的一个空缺。顾问们推荐路易斯·布兰代斯——这必然是个有争议的人选。你怎么看？

802b48f649f298d6453ac04e01bfb328f0303746.source: As Governor of California, Ronald Reagan will be crucial to your chances in that state. Can you reassure him that you are sufficiently conservative to warrant his enthusiasm after your battle for the Republican nomination?
802b48f649f298d6453ac04e01bfb328f0303746.zh: 身为加利福尼亚州州长，罗纳德·里根对你在该州的胜算至关重要。在共和党提名争夺战之后，你能向他保证，自己的立场足够保守，值得他热情支持吗？

7c24ce528ea4f91e0f9d7525d633559f3b0540d3.source: As Governor of Massachusetts, I have led a capable, liberal administration of that state. I will take this to the national level and undo eight years of failure under Ronald Reagan.
7c24ce528ea4f91e0f9d7525d633559f3b0540d3.zh: 担任马萨诸塞州州长期间，我领导了一届有能力的自由派政府。我会把这套做法推向全国，扭转罗纳德·里根执政八年来的失败。

83f2817c5502a7ff3aba081e5aaa785be6550327.source: As I've thought of this issue more, I now believe it makes sense to support it. It will be politically expedient and morally correct to do so.
83f2817c5502a7ff3aba081e5aaa785be6550327.zh: 经过进一步考虑，我现在认为，支持它是合理的。这样做既有政治上的好处，在道义上也正确。

0c4ef9c792016c9ff9acd83b93ab69036d1761b3.source: As President I will remain vigilant against the Soviet threat. Under no circumstances would I decrease our defense budget.
0c4ef9c792016c9ff9acd83b93ab69036d1761b3.zh: 担任总统后，我会时刻警惕苏联的威胁。在任何情况下，我都不会削减国防预算。

32546975094e9c62b8f02a509f214e088f7ae820.source: As President, I have no desire for war. However, I will spare no effort to protect the legitimate rights of American shipping and commerce.
32546975094e9c62b8f02a509f214e088f7ae820.zh: 作为总统，我并不希望战争。不过，为了保护美国航运和贸易的正当权利，我将不遗余力。

6ce5e5881e5f54326f74cab92db1a911caee4608.source: As President, I will do anything I can to cut income taxes further.
6ce5e5881e5f54326f74cab92db1a911caee4608.zh: 作为总统，我会尽一切努力进一步削减所得税。

b103904772a87b0c30d6b7712683122a7ae7a64e.source: As President, I will push for a higher minimum wage, immigration reform, economic growth, and a responsible foreign policy. We have no idea what my opponent would do.
b103904772a87b0c30d6b7712683122a7ae7a64e.zh: 作为总统，我会推动提高最低工资、移民改革、经济增长，以及负责任的外交政策。至于对手会做什么，我们毫无头绪。

9f412d3b648505913a2eebeb5ec0f056ae7218f7.source: As President, I will reach out to key military leaders for their advice on this issue.
9f412d3b648505913a2eebeb5ec0f056ae7218f7.zh: 作为总统，我会向主要军方领导人征求这方面的意见。

10b2ed0baed364214bcf6329386b336edeca6421.source: As President, I will work with Republicans and Democrats to advocate for programs that all Americans can approve of. We need to move past the divisiveness of recent years and strengthen our economy, Social Security, education, and Medicare. I would prefer to return some of the budget surplus to the people, but I am willing to compromise to get things done.
10b2ed0baed364214bcf6329386b336edeca6421.zh: 作为总统，我会与共和党人和民主党人合作，推动所有美国人都能赞成的项目。我们需要走出近年来的分裂，巩固经济、社会保障制度、教育和老年医疗保险。我倾向于把部分预算盈余还给人民，但愿意为了办成事情而妥协。

271aadbc3051f9f04a5eed29829ac901573963fd.source: As President, I'm confident that all sides can come together and negotiate a long-term peace agreement. Certainly the return of the Sinai or the Golan Heights should not be off the table.
271aadbc3051f9f04a5eed29829ac901573963fd.zh: 担任总统后，我有信心让各方坐下来谈判，达成持久和平协议。当然，归还西奈半岛或戈兰高地的方案不应被排除在谈判之外。

9dd7ddb011f43fc5b9e52d85ffc7430844177d85.source: As President, in spite of what people in the liberal media say, I will work very closely with our foreign allies on issues of importance. Together we can unite against and defeat radical Islamic terror.
9dd7ddb011f43fc5b9e52d85ffc7430844177d85.zh: 尽管自由派媒体有些人那样说，我担任总统后，会在重要问题上与外国盟友密切合作。我们可以团结起来，共同对抗并击败激进伊斯兰恐怖主义。

ba03d339f71fe5d62bb77def4bc126139f53476e.source: As President, would you consider implementing policies such as a national lockdown or a mask mandate to control COVID-19?
ba03d339f71fe5d62bb77def4bc126139f53476e.zh: 担任总统后，你是否会考虑全国封锁或强制戴口罩等政策，以控制新冠疫情？

8d5adac4aeb1b14e52dfe149bd401cc3cc18a212.source: As September approaches, the nation is at serious risk of a national rail strike. What are your plans for dealing with this?
8d5adac4aeb1b14e52dfe149bd401cc3cc18a212.zh: 九月将至，全国铁路大罢工的风险十分严峻。你计划如何应对？

2b29463dc68e653d109ee82877736edd05f68396.source: As a Civil War veteran, I am uniquely positioned to preach a message of sectional unity and Americanism. These states must know that we have allowed bygones to be bygones.
2b29463dc68e653d109ee82877736edd05f68396.zh: 作为内战老兵，我有独特的资格倡导南北团结和美国认同。必须让这些州知道，我们已经不再追究往日的恩怨。

ad9afb8ef013e157478bd229183fcf4c0dd048f8.source: As a Democrat, there's nothing wrong with showing your support for the Clintons.
ad9afb8ef013e157478bd229183fcf4c0dd048f8.zh: 作为民主党人，支持克林顿夫妇并没有什么不妥。

de5e876839b5ef726941c34c578941cd6c144696.source: As a Senator from Ohio and former cabinet member for George W. Bush, Rob Portman would bring insider experience to a Republican Administration.
