He has worked with a particular focus on fiscal and economic issues, where he has advocated for much conservative legislation.
de5e876839b5ef726941c34c578941cd6c144696.zh: 作为 俄亥俄州 的参议员和 乔治·W.·布什 的前内阁成员，罗布·波特曼 将为共和党政府带来内部经验。他特别关注财政和经济问题，并主张采取更为保守的立法。

3f7e2bef7b9db21f8a352fb72113be91ee1bfa33.source: As a challenger in this election, it doesn't make sense for you to praise Eisenhower's economic record.
3f7e2bef7b9db21f8a352fb72113be91ee1bfa33.zh: 作为这次选举中的挑战者，赞扬艾森豪威尔的经济政绩，对你来说并不合理。

b3db2c7edc79fd3c3920d6811438ca4e4073a941.source: As a challenger in this election, it's better to point out problems in the foreign policy of Eisenhower, than to say it has been completely effective.
b3db2c7edc79fd3c3920d6811438ca4e4073a941.zh: 作为这次选举中的挑战者，指出艾森豪威尔外交政策的问题，比宣称它完全有效更好。

a4432367a596d44c6e6c154f53e22a549b67abd0.source: As a conservative Democrat, Chandler supports the calls for law and order and fiscal conservatism. However, he will not stand as Wallace's running mate unless he softens his rhetoric on segregation, which in turn could alienate other Southern states.
a4432367a596d44c6e6c154f53e22a549b67abd0.zh: 作为一名保守的民主党人，钱德勒 支持 法律与秩序 和财政保守主义的呼吁。然而，他不会作为 华莱士 的竞选伙伴，除非他在种族隔离问题上软化言辞，这反过来可能疏远其他南方州。

69789e15be76bc57c62e85d2dc2f1147fb88f2ab.source: As a running mate, Napolitano would bring proven eloquence and media-savvy, and would raise the profile of the Ron Paul campaign, particularly on cable news.
69789e15be76bc57c62e85d2dc2f1147fb88f2ab.zh: 作为竞选搭档，纳波利塔诺 将带来久经考验的口才和媒体悟性，并将提高 罗恩·保罗 竞选活动的形象，特别是在有线电视新闻上。

d9c73a5eec76c562b7beecab7fd5007070c4793d.source: As a sitting U.S. Senator and son of Ron Paul, Rand Paul would make a natural running mate in many ways. He would immediately bring name recognition and political experience to an independent run by the elder Paul.
d9c73a5eec76c562b7beecab7fd5007070c4793d.zh: 作为现任美国参议员和 罗恩·保罗 的儿子，兰德·保罗 在很多方面都会成为天然的竞选伙伴。他将立即为长老保罗领导的独立机构带来知名度和政治经验。

6dd9f5e4c9b2abb5fadd088b72a15d93d0fd1199.source: As a sovereign state, Nevada has every right to reject this proposal. Nobody wants to live next to a toxic nuclear waste site.
6dd9f5e4c9b2abb5fadd088b72a15d93d0fd1199.zh: 内华达州作为拥有自主权的州，完全有权拒绝这项提案。没人愿意住在有毒的核废料场旁边。

f8c2ac36c9484860381a222968f7225ed71be6a4.source: As an ardent pro-slavery candidate (a "Fire-Eater"), it is Breckenridge's job to defend the
f8c2ac36c9484860381a222968f7225ed71be6a4.zh: 作为一名热心支持奴隶制的候选人（“食火者”），布雷肯里奇的工作是捍卫奴隶制

9f875129bc875d6ed0120f5fff788b1c06b2076b.source: As an outsider candidate, this was really your moment to make an impact on American politics and to win a national election. The beltway gossip already has it that Ted Kennedy is the frontrunner for the 1980 nomination. Perhaps you can run again for Governor of Georgia, or make an impact in some other way.
9f875129bc875d6ed0120f5fff788b1c06b2076b.zh: 作为一名局外候选人，这确实是你对美国政治产生影响并赢得全国大选的时刻。环城高速的传闻已经表明 特德·肯尼迪 是 1980 年提名的领跑者。也许你可以再次竞选佐治亚州州长，或者以其他方式产生影响。

4d0a48cefe5d15a1b2ec00f19ea90d1d6e9f5d7a.source: As bad as it is, this clip is just part of an even larger pattern. His insinuations about Miss Universe contestants. His strange statements about his own daughter. There's a bizarre video where he fondles Rudy Giuliani, in drag.
4d0a48cefe5d15a1b2ec00f19ea90d1d6e9f5d7a.zh: 这段视频虽然恶劣，却只是一个更广泛的行为模式的一部分。他对环球小姐参赛者的影射，对自己女儿的奇怪言论，还有一段古怪视频，里面他抚摸着男扮女装的鲁迪·朱利安尼。

55f4ec2615822182664f32905381b069cda40f4f.source: As bad as things are, you might have a shot with a negative message towards the incumbent. Make sure you offer your own solutions too.
55f4ec2615822182664f32905381b069cda40f4f.zh: 局面虽糟，但向现任总统传递负面信息，或许能让你有胜算。记得也提出你自己的解决办法。

719c1533390db179b349aed806525bf4444cc2ef.source: As capital punishment becomes an issue, it's difficult to find a position that doesn't alienate some group of your potential voters.
719c1533390db179b349aed806525bf4444cc2ef.zh: 随着死刑成为议题，很难找到一种不会疏远某些潜在选民群体的立场。

189e3c0b70f556953cf0427da21bfc9bdf82d0da.source: As expected, Hillary Clinton has carried her party's nomination, and now faces an unexpected opponent in Donald Trump. She was traditionally known as a mainstream Democrat, but tacked significantly to the left during the primary campaign. Clinton enters the general election in a strong position, but she'll be under relentless attack on a number of fronts. Can she make the case that she is truly in touch with the American people -- or that Trump would be an even worse option?
189e3c0b70f556953cf0427da21bfc9bdf82d0da.zh: 正如预期的那样，希拉里·克林顿获得了党内的提名，现在在唐纳德·特朗普中面临着意想不到的对手。她传统上被认为是主流民主党人，但在初选期间明显转向左翼。 克林顿 在大选中处于强势地位，但她将在多个方面受到无情的攻击。她能否证明她真正与美国人民保持联系——或者特朗普将是一个更糟糕的选择？

4f5e73ea3950a928d7e4aafb84588b66252bbdbd.source: As expected, Hillary Clinton has carried her party's nomination, and now faces an unexpected opponent in Donald Trump. She was traditionally known as a mainstream Democrat, but tacked significantly to the left during the primary campaign. Clinton enters the general election in a strong position, but she'll be under relentless attack on a number of fronts. Can she make the case that she truly in touch with the American people -- or that Trump would be an even worse option?
4f5e73ea3950a928d7e4aafb84588b66252bbdbd.zh: 正如预期的那样，希拉里·克林顿获得了党内的提名，现在在唐纳德·特朗普中面临着意想不到的对手。她传统上被认为是主流民主党人，但在初选期间明显转向左翼。 克林顿 在大选中处于强势地位，但她将在多个方面受到无情的攻击。她能否证明她真正与美国人民保持联系——或者特朗普将是一个更糟糕的选择？

162337ee6d4e54432abff84ea5ab41de697422b3.source: As expected, this speech has an enthusiastic reception by your strongest supporters, though it's no olive branch to the moderate-liberal wing- and one sentence in particular is gaining attention.
162337ee6d4e54432abff84ea5ab41de697422b3.zh: 正如预料，这篇演说受到最坚定支持者的热烈欢迎，却没有向温和派和自由派伸出橄榄枝。而其中一句话，尤其引起关注。

6dd43d3237135ef9e953f17b8cc6191ef00a6c0e.source: As expected, you have lost the 2000 election.
6dd43d3237135ef9e953f17b8cc6191ef00a6c0e.zh: 正如所料，你输掉了 2000 年选举。

440875fc15c30c21f86b9e6c20e1b82b974583fa.source: As expected, you lost the 1968 election
440875fc15c30c21f86b9e6c20e1b82b974583fa.zh: 正如预料，你输掉了1968年选举。

695df58f123c69f18f78db2c85dff9db1c299b03.source: As expected, you've lost the 1964 Election.
695df58f123c69f18f78db2c85dff9db1c299b03.zh: 正如预期的那样，您在 1964 年选举中失败了。

bd3b052eda372924f7033fe1d3c8c7c3f6f1aa3b.source: As impressive as this feat is, the cruelty of the situation doesn’t end there- Democrats control both the Senate and the House, all but dooming your chances at winning. At the least, take pride in the conservative revolution you have brought to Congress- and, if you’re still open for it, perhaps your old seat in the Senate will be open sooner or later.
bd3b052eda372924f7033fe1d3c8c7c3f6f1aa3b.zh: 尽管这一壮举令人印象深刻，但残酷的情况并没有就此结束——民主党控制着参议院和众议院，几乎注定了你获胜的机会。至少，为你给国会带来的保守派革命感到自豪——如果你仍然对此持开放态度，也许你在参议院的旧席位迟早会空出来。

850dd848e120b6111e2240a1b9fee1fcfc937da4.source: As it stands, this deal is a step in the right direction, but I have some real concerns as well. We're going to seriously reevaluate this deal when I'm in office, and work to renegotiate certain aspects of it.
850dd848e120b6111e2240a1b9fee1fcfc937da4.zh: 就目前而言，这项协议是朝正确方向迈出的一步，但我也有一些实质性担忧。上任后，我们会认真重新评估它，并努力就某些内容重新谈判。

36fab87338ecc946a5ffec702beb465dc1d6a2d7.source: As long as the Communists don't take over in China, your reputation on this issue is safe.
36fab87338ecc946a5ffec702beb465dc1d6a2d7.zh: 只要共产党没有在中国掌权，你在这个问题上的声誉就不会受损。

a272ba29068e9cddbf3ae5ea80ee1ed5de6a597a.source: As most expected, you've lost. This isn't a surprise, as you're a third party. even worse, your second goal of deadlocking the electoral college failed. You did, however, come very close, picking up a number of states you weren't expected to pick up. It seems that your crusade for the south turned out really well. You could run in four years perhaps, and try and win the same coalition, trying to deadlock the election then. You've sent a clear message to the Democrats; the south isn't to be ignored,
a272ba29068e9cddbf3ae5ea80ee1ed5de6a597a.zh: 正如多数人预料，你输了。作为第三党候选人，这并不奇怪。更糟的是，让选举人团陷入僵局的第二个目标，也失败了。不过，你已经非常接近，赢下了几个原本不被看好的州。看来，你为南方而战的行动成效很大。也许四年后，你可以再次参选，争取同样的联盟，再尝试制造选举僵局。你已经向民主党发出明确的信息：南方不能被忽视。

36675b4bbda92d7bdd2873a9ed457c0708fb27bb.source: As most expected, you've lost. This isn't a surprise, as you're a third party. even worse, your second goal of deadlocking the electoral college failed. You did, however, poll a bit higher above what you were set to win. So good job outdoing your predictions. The south isn't done yet, as you've shown here.
36675b4bbda92d7bdd2873a9ed457c0708fb27bb.zh: 正如多数人预料，你输了。作为第三党候选人，这并不奇怪。更糟的是，让选举人团陷入僵局的第二个目标，也失败了。不过，你的得票比原先预计的略高，超出了预期，做得不错。你在这里证明，南方的抗争还没结束。

528b6441f85769671470dbcfd3468606823d015f.source: As most expected, you've lost. This isn't a surprise, as you're a third party. even worse, your second goal of deadlocking the electoral college failed. You won just about as much as expected, and yet it wasn't enough. Your supporters are disillusioned that you weren't able to deadlock the college. That's how it is, though...
528b6441f85769671470dbcfd3468606823d015f.zh: 正如多数人预料，你输了。作为第三党候选人，这并不奇怪。更糟的是，让选举人团陷入僵局的第二个目标，也失败了。你赢得的支持大致符合预期，但仍然不够。你没能让选举人团陷入僵局，支持者感到失望。现实就是如此……

add4e2901036138d44e40b236e8ce6e32399792f.source: Aside from the issue of Texas, do you support the expansion of the United States in general? Into Oregon, other parts of Mexico, Cuba, etc.?
add4e2901036138d44e40b236e8ce6e32399792f.zh: 除了得克萨斯问题，你总体上是否支持美国扩张——进入俄勒冈、墨西哥其他地区、古巴等地？

4f514152e9969596dee22f73e114a32457fb4c09.source: Astounding! You have lost the 1964 Election!
4f514152e9969596dee22f73e114a32457fb4c09.zh: 令人震惊！你输掉了 1964 年的选举！

ce71ad1f80c89c338dce2b185e854a029845f92f.source: At a Trump rally today, a deranged supporter fired at several protestors before he was tackled. Are these rallies getting out of hand?
ce71ad1f80c89c338dce2b185e854a029845f92f.zh: 在今天的一场特朗普集会上，一名失常的支持者朝几名抗议者开枪，随后被扑倒制服。这些集会是不是正在失控？

27fec246c3d54cbed2792ddcd14e9ae3f725d246.source: At a campaign stop today in Harlem, your running mate, Henry Cabot Lodge Jr., seemed to make a promise that your Administration will appoint a black Cabinet member. Do you stand by his statement?
27fec246c3d54cbed2792ddcd14e9ae3f725d246.zh: 今天在哈莱姆的一场竞选活动中，你的搭档小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇似乎承诺，你的政府将任命一位黑人内阁成员。你支持他的说法吗？

1a78445693a00c71d2cdf007e3e125b95e9d80eb.source: At a campaign stop today in Harlem, your running mate, Nelson Rockefeller, seemed to promise that your Administration would propose extensive federal civil rights legislation. Do you stand by his statement?
1a78445693a00c71d2cdf007e3e125b95e9d80eb.zh: 今天在哈莱姆的一场竞选活动中，你的搭档纳尔逊·洛克菲勒似乎承诺，你的政府将提出广泛的联邦民权立法。你支持他的说法吗？

9a0c478a46388b8ade0206a278b07318683432e8.source: At a campaign stop today in Milwaukee, your running mate, Hubert H. Humphrey, seemed to promise that your Administration would propose extensive federal civil rights legislation. Do you stand by his statement?
9a0c478a46388b8ade0206a278b07318683432e8.zh: 今天在密尔沃基的一场竞选活动中，你的搭档休伯特·H·汉弗莱似乎承诺，你的政府将提出广泛的联邦民权立法。你支持他的说法吗？

ebdffea5a3cb6b7a07c6d0d02f376d5b505918d6.source: At one time I was a member of the ACLU, but I've been as concerned as any good American by some of the cases that organization has taken on in the past few years.
ebdffea5a3cb6b7a07c6d0d02f376d5b505918d6.zh: 我曾经是美国公民自由联盟的会员。不过，过去几年这个组织承接的一些案件，也让我像其他爱国的美国人一样忧虑。

c175ee798767fcc424524176f8b713d4d8a18d88.source: At the end of the day, in possibly the most shocking turn of events, the popular vote fell in your favour. Nobody is sure what to make of this, but maybe the Democrats can use their house and senate supermajorities, combined with disaffected Republicans, to pass electoral reform?
c175ee798767fcc424524176f8b713d4d8a18d88.zh: 最终，局势发生了也许最令人震惊的转折：你反而赢得了普选票。没人知道该如何理解这个结果，不过，民主党也许能凭借在参众两院的压倒性多数，加上不满的共和党人，推动选举制度改革？

6f8bfdb7a805d0f283c5494644df179ccfd63848.source: At the national level, this is probably your best position. In certain locales the nativist sentiment does appear to be rising, however.
6f8bfdb7a805d0f283c5494644df179ccfd63848.zh: 从全国来看，这大概是你最好的立场。不过，在某些地方，本土主义情绪似乎正在抬头。

72138b773e01ec033979af95c98fda54e411b543.source: At the very least, a federal law prohibiting the sale of alcohol of Sunday seems appropriate.
72138b773e01ec033979af95c98fda54e411b543.zh: 至少，制定一项禁止星期日售酒的联邦法律，似乎是恰当的。

81aac6a00ce5faef95343372609f414359345c02.source: At this point, it's hard to have any faith that the media will moderate these debates in an impartial manner. I will buy a half hour of time on every major network and make my case directly to the people.
81aac6a00ce5faef95343372609f414359345c02.zh: 到了这个时候，很难相信媒体会公正主持这些辩论。我会在每一家主要电视网买下半小时，直接向人民说明我的主张。

8d69c9f1578ac06210a56343310a626a46a3a9b6.source: Attack ads have developed a habit of showing you
8d69c9f1578ac06210a56343310a626a46a3a9b6.zh: 攻击广告已养成向您展示的习惯

ffc845602d449ec09f8c5c2b1ab6efcf3e55fa7d.source: Attacking Dan Quayle is a no-brainer. You can't let this terrible choice of running mate go unpunished.
ffc845602d449ec09f8c5c2b1ab6efcf3e55fa7d.zh: 攻击丹·奎尔，根本不用多想。选了这么糟糕的搭档，你不能让布什毫无代价地过关。

78b3d3faafa85722f790a450e8c3f9ac823fca3f.source: As part of a balanced campaign strategy, of course we're going to attack Donald Trump on his tax shenanigans. But we just need to make sure our main focus is on the substantive issues affecting working Americans.
78b3d3faafa85722f790a450e8c3f9ac823fca3f.zh: 作为均衡竞选策略的一部分，我们当然会攻击唐纳德·特朗普的税务花招。但必须确保，我们主要聚焦的是影响美国劳动者的实质问题。

f8bbadde79408de5b5da94c75c7fcfaa05178d3b.source: As someone with a long political career, this is a bit of a problem for Clinton.
f8bbadde79408de5b5da94c75c7fcfaa05178d3b.zh: 对于政治生涯漫长的克林顿来说，这有点麻烦。

feccf903cafab8994a8f61af991a7511445eb0fc.source: As the former Governor of Arkansas and a 2008 Presidential candidate, Mike Huckabee is well known nationally, and contains impeccable credentials as a social and religious conservative. He has also spent several years in the media spotlight and is a comfortable public speaker and debater.
feccf903cafab8994a8f61af991a7511445eb0fc.zh: 作为 阿肯色州 的前州长和 2008 年总统候选人，迈克·赫卡比 在全国享有盛誉，并且作为社会和宗教保守派拥有无可挑剔的资历。他还曾在媒体的聚光灯下度过了数年，是一位轻松的公共演讲者和辩论家。

81d3937d4f72bf5383605fdef3d1d08987191e89.source: As the leader of this country, do you plan to wear a mask as you appear at various campaign events and official functions?
81d3937d4f72bf5383605fdef3d1d08987191e89.zh: 作为国家领导人，出席各种竞选活动和公务活动时，你是否打算戴口罩？

dc3cd953517fd88367e0bd2a2a852226325d4713.source: As tragic as any act of terrorism is, you have been sounding the alarm on radical Islam while your opponent refuses to mention the term.
dc3cd953517fd88367e0bd2a2a852226325d4713.zh: 任何恐怖行为都是悲剧，但你一直在对激进伊斯兰主义发出警告，对手却拒绝提及这个词。

22fba1dfb2df91d63bab40ad31d10205352c48db.source: As usual, Hillary has been caught telling lies. For all we know, this is just the beginning. Do we really want a President, and then a month after they're elected we find out they're being blackmailed by Russia or China?
22fba1dfb2df91d63bab40ad31d10205352c48db.zh: 照例，希拉里又被抓到撒谎了。说不定，这还只是开始。我们真想选出一位总统，然后在当选一个月后才发现，此人正遭到俄罗斯或中国的勒索吗？

1ac5cf9b7e5f760f07ebbe7f53a34e61e08146af.source: As usual, you are trusting your instincts over conventional wisdom.
1ac5cf9b7e5f760f07ebbe7f53a34e61e08146af.zh: 照例，你相信自己的直觉，胜过惯常的判断。

2eca8255436cf8fefe24260d2c860f57f3ede227.source: As word gets around that Nixon probably sabotaged the Vietnam peace negotiations, you are the clear beneficiary of an 11th hour surge in the polls. Will it be enough to hand you a victory tonight?
2eca8255436cf8fefe24260d2c860f57f3ede227.zh: 尼克松很可能破坏了越南和平谈判的消息传开，你明显受益，在最后关头的民调中迅速上升。这足以让你今晚获胜吗？

dde44aeb3aa792536e67826e2bf1a7b8d6ecdf78.source: As word of a possible peace deal breaks, Humphrey is surging in the final polls. Will you have the votes you need on election day? Sit down and watch the results come in.
dde44aeb3aa792536e67826e2bf1a7b8d6ecdf78.zh: 可能达成和平协议的消息一出，汉弗莱在最后的民调中迅速上升。选举日，你还能得到获胜所需的票数吗？坐下来，看结果陆续揭晓吧。

db6026afd4ad2af64478a184b70c2a14ad6f1828.source: Asian-American hate is wrong. I'd call on it to stop immediately, and I'm sure any intelligent person understands the difference between holding China accountable, and calling for hate domestically.
db6026afd4ad2af64478a184b70c2a14ad6f1828.zh: 针对亚裔美国人的仇恨是错的。我呼吁立即停止。我相信，任何明智的人都明白，要求中国负责，与在国内煽动仇恨，是两回事。

a587f9161d4a3a1769ab59f6f3dd980b6dedf5c2.source: Asian-American hate needs to stop, right now. As a candidate I am pleading with all Americans to look into their hearts and ask what they can do to help on this important issue.
a587f9161d4a3a1769ab59f6f3dd980b6dedf5c2.zh: 针对亚裔美国人的仇恨必须停止，现在就停止。作为候选人，我恳请每个美国人审视自己的内心，想想能为这个重要问题做些什么。

ecd575fb8259edebcaa6a933de8ec218f7dc8dd0.source: Attempting to receive a endorsement from

915b228737f8b947bf84ebd3695275cd0b41bd03.source: Avoid controversy. That's the way to go.
915b228737f8b947bf84ebd3695275cd0b41bd03.zh: 避开争议，这才是正确做法。

ece8ea469e106e62632aa7586eedb128b0f99cd7.source: Bad answer for a Republican candidate -- too environmentalist.
ece8ea469e106e62632aa7586eedb128b0f99cd7.zh: 对共和党候选人来说，这回答不好，太偏向环保了。

a5f34889d980eca317d15cc76a609eda01ea6a86.source: Bad answer. Americans are not seeking an escalation of the war, and your constituents feel betrayed by your abrupt change towards Vietnam.
a5f34889d980eca317d15cc76a609eda01ea6a86.zh: 回答糟糕。美国人不想升级战争，你突然改变越南立场，也让支持你的选民觉得遭到背叛。

378782f3c9b1eb68bdf726347041fb3feb74330d.source: Bailing out the E.U. is an extremely unpopular position with the American public. Your answer will be in the center of a media firestorm for the next week.
378782f3c9b1eb68bdf726347041fb3feb74330d.zh: 救助欧盟在美国公众中极不受欢迎。未来一周，你的回答将成为媒体风暴的中心。

5e2a5186953bfeefdb7e3f5363b653cabb4dca82.source: Barack Obama attempts to win reelection while Mitt Romney hopes to bring a more conservative vision to the White House. The poor economy and Obama's signature health care initiatives loom large in the 2012 election.
5e2a5186953bfeefdb7e3f5363b653cabb4dca82.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马力争连任，米特·罗姆尼则希望把更保守的施政路线带入白宫。疲弱的经济，以及奥巴马标志性的医疗改革，是2012年选举的重要议题。

2063d956fec34d79507f48dad51b60e27acc952a.source: Barack Obama enters the 2012 campaign as the incumbent, having defeated John McCain in the 2008 election. He has governed as a moderate liberal, passing a health care reform program and taking a hawkish stance on some foreign policy issues.
2063d956fec34d79507f48dad51b60e27acc952a.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马 作为现任总统进入 2012 年竞选，在 2008 年选举中击败 约翰·麦凯恩。他以温和自由派的身份执政，通过了一项医疗改革计划，并在一些外交政策问题上采取强硬立场。

668e800a846ba2551a0dde3686aadc86abc481af.source: Barack Obama has an approval rate right now of more than 50 percent. It seems obvious that we would want to utilize him early and often.
668e800a846ba2551a0dde3686aadc86abc481af.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马目前的支持率超过50%。显而易见，我们希望尽早而频繁地发挥他的作用。

c1a0129b3fb725e03962c29d593e7247b3c01fcd.source: Barack Obama has reduced the deficit of this country by over half since his first year in office, and I will do anything I can to continue his policies.
c1a0129b3fb725e03962c29d593e7247b3c01fcd.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马把国家赤字从就职第一年的水平降低了一半以上，我会尽我所能，延续他的政策。

55b509f074f49316f57545f0a7506c07738def27.source: Barack Obama is a smart, engaging man. I like him and wish him all the best after we defeat him in November.
55b509f074f49316f57545f0a7506c07738def27.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马聪明、风趣。我喜欢他，也希望十一月我们击败他之后，他一切顺利。

7efe8bcd853aa0a70323e625a667d1ec3f8949c5.source: Barack Obama is looking to you for pointers on the content of his convention speech, to make sure it is congruent with your campaign strategy. What should he emphasize?
7efe8bcd853aa0a70323e625a667d1ec3f8949c5.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马想听听你对他大会演说内容的建议，以确保与竞选策略一致。他应该强调什么？

55d2536612382d6ae521df10a79e25429ae30ef7.source: Barack Obama's signature achievement from his first term was a landmark health care reform act. The law will establish insurance exchanges which must meet minimum coverage standards, and also cannot deny people based on pre-existing conditions. To help support these policies, every American will be mandated to purchase health insurance.
55d2536612382d6ae521df10a79e25429ae30ef7.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马第一任期的标志性成就，是一项具有里程碑意义的医疗改革法案。该法将建立医疗保险交易市场，要求达到最低保障标准，也不得因既往病史拒保。为支撑这些政策，每个美国人都将被要求购买医疗保险。

5156bc20d69e35b28bee7a5f10d4a92464fd467b.source: Barack is a decent guy. Our personal feelings for each other are not the issue. What's important are our differences of opinion on how to get the American economy moving.
5156bc20d69e35b28bee7a5f10d4a92464fd467b.zh: 贝拉克是个不错的人。我们彼此的私人感情并不是问题所在。重要的是，我们对如何让美国经济运转起来有不同意见。

e21d5eeb36e01c2b20aa5a6aed85670dcf0bb971.source: Bargaining for wages is the business of a man and his employer. Collective bargaining has no place in American society, and I commend Grover Cleveland for having the courage to act decisively.
e21d5eeb36e01c2b20aa5a6aed85670dcf0bb971.zh: 商议工资是个人与雇主之间的事。集体谈判在美国社会中没有立足之地；我赞赏格罗弗·克利夫兰敢于果断行动。

bdf0481dff4e7d69841492b3ce948eeea5f4647a.source: Barry Goldwater hopes to make up ground quickly, reuniting his party behind his conservative vision after a contentious primary, as well as flipping the South for the first time since Reconstruction.
bdf0481dff4e7d69841492b3ce948eeea5f4647a.zh: 巴里·戈德华特希望迅速缩小差距。经历充满争议的初选后，他需要让共和党重新团结在自己的保守主义路线周围，并争取自重建时期以来首次扭转南方的党派版图。

9cebcd3dd8e0fc9ebbaa4bb12fc56044fc4f7d6c.source: Barry Goldwater is a Senator from Arizona and the uncontested standard-bearer of conservative Republicans. Goldwater is to the right of the party on taxes, spending, and civil rights. Nelson Rockefeller has threatened to walk out of the convention if Goldwater is selected, which would certainly end any chance of winning New York or the Northeast. However, a Nixon-Goldwater ticket might sweep the South, and his advocates say Goldwater will drive conservative turnout nationwide.
9cebcd3dd8e0fc9ebbaa4bb12fc56044fc4f7d6c.zh: 巴里·戈德华特 是来自 亚利桑那州 的参议员，也是保守派共和党无可争议的旗手。 戈德华特 在税收、支出和 民权 方面位于该党的右边。 纳尔逊·洛克菲勒威胁说，如果戈德华特被选中，他将退出大会，这肯定会结束纽约州或东北部获胜的任何机会。然而，尼克松-戈德华特选票可能席卷南方，他的支持者表示戈德华特将推动全国范围内保守派的投票率。

99bed86a0db17ad8e337f4ddb51efe29816bfbab.source: Barry Goldwater is an Air Force veteran, a rugged individualist, and a man of principle. I'm proud to have him on my ticket.
99bed86a0db17ad8e337f4ddb51efe29816bfbab.zh: 巴里·戈德华特是一位空军老兵、坚定的个人主义者，也是一个有原则的人。我很自豪，他能加入我的竞选组合。

8f9e795c3171bf70bf459d86833e2b58b68cb2d6.source: Based on some early results, it appears that many polls significantly overestimated Biden's support. This may be close after all.
8f9e795c3171bf70bf459d86833e2b58b68cb2d6.zh: 根据一些初步结果，许多民调似乎严重高估了拜登的支持率。这场选举可能终究还是很接近。

88dcf549bc95b0b0b5ec20e1d91cc77af4ad093d.source: Based on some early results, it appears that many polls significantly underestimated Trump's support. This may be close after all.
88dcf549bc95b0b0b5ec20e1d91cc77af4ad093d.zh: 根据一些初步结果，许多民调似乎严重低估了特朗普的支持率。这场选举可能终究还是很接近。

519f20e86eb5f4dabac9d94edc71a942a4f411f6.source: Be perfectly honest. How do you like Barack Obama as a person?
519f20e86eb5f4dabac9d94edc71a942a4f411f6.zh: 请完全坦诚地回答。就个人而言，你觉得贝拉克·奥巴马这个人怎么样？

23a8d81415221dd32d3c68c12cd7fb0d12dc7882.source: Before this act, our country caromed from one financial panic to the next. The Federal Reserve is a tremendous step forward.
23a8d81415221dd32d3c68c12cd7fb0d12dc7882.zh: 在这项法案出台以前，我国接连遭遇金融恐慌。联邦储备制度是一个巨大的进步。

bdbabb8ac73d1c2aaceefa862787acd188158d62.source: Before you head to Missouri to spend the election day, is there one last place you want to hit on the campaign trail?
bdbabb8ac73d1c2aaceefa862787acd188158d62.zh: 在前往密苏里州度过选举日之前，你还想最后去哪个地方拉票？

fde5f5166442d12cdaa6ffb753bd9894383fbe9a.source: Before you head to New York to spend the election day, is there one last place you want to hit on the campaign trail?
fde5f5166442d12cdaa6ffb753bd9894383fbe9a.zh: 在前往纽约州度过选举日之前，你还想最后去哪个地方拉票？

27da817a2ac4a96f20beef003aea8cc5626caf7f.source: Beginning in July, the Dow Jones Industrial Average entered an extremely bearish stretch, based on news out of China, losing over 25% of its value by October. A recession seems likely. Will you address this as you campaign?
27da817a2ac4a96f20beef003aea8cc5626caf7f.zh: 受中国传出的消息影响，道琼斯工业平均指数从七月开始进入极度看跌的阶段，到十月已损失超过25%的价值。经济似乎很可能衰退。你会在竞选中谈论这件事吗？

1954080eaa45b99aad2ca096ca8ca5d042203910.source: Behind the scenes my surrogates have plenty of dirt to spread about Romney and the Republicans. As President, I will stick to a message of optimism and hope in my own campaign speeches.
1954080eaa45b99aad2ca096ca8ca5d042203910.zh: 私下里，我的竞选代言人有不少罗姆尼和共和党的黑材料可以散布。作为总统，我在自己的竞选演说中会坚持传递乐观和希望。

160860b0bec91f65146f2414ee2a15f6dd11b0eb.source: Behind the scenes, Obama is not too pleased with your lukewarm stance. One way or another, rumors of a rift leak into the political press.
160860b0bec91f65146f2414ee2a15f6dd11b0eb.zh: 私下里，奥巴马对你不冷不热的立场很不高兴。不知通过什么途径，你们之间有裂痕的传闻流进了政治新闻媒体。

6aad69a8d2413f9958c665d99f61c35e07f947e0.source: Behind the scenes, there are those who have their doubts about having two outsiders on one ticket.
6aad69a8d2413f9958c665d99f61c35e07f947e0.zh: 私下里，有些人对让两位体制外人士搭档参选心存疑虑。

9d3447d773975f79bfdf8c245605196afdc57b05.source: Being a police officer is one of the hardest jobs there is, but they got it very wrong here. I have every confidence that Hennepin County will take the appropriate action against the officers involved in this case.
9d3447d773975f79bfdf8c245605196afdc57b05.zh: 警察是最辛苦的职业之一，但他们在这里大错特错了。我完全相信，亨内平县会对本案涉及的警员采取适当行动。

825ebe6edc9497e30f95c33eabbdb9de76b933bd.source: Being consistent is unquestionably important, but the extensive federal expansions you’re suggesting is frowned upon by most Americans.
825ebe6edc9497e30f95c33eabbdb9de76b933bd.zh: 保持一致当然重要，但你提出大幅扩大联邦职责，大多数美国人对此并不赞同。

278461377e47d940522acac84c4efbc55d0323ad.source: Believe me, I can't wait to debate Hillary Clinton.
278461377e47d940522acac84c4efbc55d0323ad.zh: 相信我，我已经等不及要跟希拉里·克林顿辩论了。

021fca390397a12dbf668de328fa99c6b5acc806.source: Believes that government regulations have put an unaffordable burden on doctors and insurance companies. Supports drastic cuts to Medicare and Medicaid. May support an end to the FDA and other regulatory agencies to restore competitiveness to the American health care system.
021fca390397a12dbf668de328fa99c6b5acc806.zh: 认为政府监管给医生和保险公司带来了无法承受的负担。支持大幅削减联邦医疗保险与医疗补助计划。可能支持撤销食品药品管理局等监管机构，以恢复美国医疗体系的竞争力。

0976e78e2bdd54bcee954dce3c486d8775b53adb.source: Bell's stronghold is the border states. His goal is to be another voice at the table, should Lincoln fail to win the Electoral College, and broker a compromise that would prevent the secession of any Southern states.
0976e78e2bdd54bcee954dce3c486d8775b53adb.zh: 贝尔的据点是边境各州。他的目标是在 林肯 未能赢得 选举人团 的情况下成为谈判桌上的另一个声音，并达成妥协，防止任何南方各州分裂。

76c0cb4ace86484a7bb9fd7e2c3601ae41b2ed79.source: Beltway pundits lament that, seemingly, both parties are falling into the habit of calling for each others' arrest and indictment. What happened to our political norms?
76c0cb4ace86484a7bb9fd7e2c3601ae41b2ed79.zh: 华盛顿政治圈的评论人士叹息，两党似乎都越来越习惯于要求逮捕、起诉对方。我们的政治惯例怎么了？

479fa8382317b92c59142849ed5776617cf268c4.source: Ben Carson is one of the most terrific choices we could have come up with. He's another one of those outsider figures who really got some traction in this race, and he'll help us unite our supporters accordingly.
479fa8382317b92c59142849ed5776617cf268c4.zh: 本·卡森是我们能想到的最出色的人选之一。他也是在这场竞选中真正赢得了声势的体制外人物，会帮助我们团结各自的支持者。

5cf0845e5e2aa42a468c9f9a94c942abad974e48.source: Ben Carson knows just how badly Clinton and Obama have failed the black community. Not to mention, he's a very patriotic, conservative figure who is more than qualified to be my Vice President.
5cf0845e5e2aa42a468c9f9a94c942abad974e48.zh: 本·卡森知道，克林顿和奥巴马把黑人社群辜负得有多严重。更不用说，他是一位非常爱国、保守的人物，担任我的副总统绰绰有余。

f31c916dc12c896cbfc0c351c51ddfad1f6cb72c.source: Ben Carson was a candidate for President in 2016, with a long history within the evangelical community. He has never served in political office, a fact which may be an asset in this election. Carson was one of the Trump's first opponents to publicly endorse him, and he consistently polled relatively high in the black community during the primary season. However, he has also made a number of bizarre statements and may be vulnerable to a sustained attack campaign.
f31c916dc12c896cbfc0c351c51ddfad1f6cb72c.zh: 本·卡森 是 2016 年总统候选人，在福音派社区中拥有悠久的历史。他从未担任过政治职务，这一事实可能是这次选举的一个优势。 卡森 是特朗普 最早公开支持他的反对者之一，他在初选期间在黑人社区的民意调查中始终保持相对较高的水平。然而，他也发表了一些奇怪的言论，可能容易受到持续的攻击。

ab9fb192879ddcb31ce450fd0837e9ad6ec64628.source: Bernie Sanders and I have some differences, but we have far more in common. We cannot allow petty disputes to divide our party in the face of a potential Trump Administration.
ab9fb192879ddcb31ce450fd0837e9ad6ec64628.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯和我有一些分歧，但共同点多得多。面对特朗普可能执政的局面，我们不能让琐碎争执分裂本党。

66b15e01919ac63e0ce0d4e3870068fef1363f77.source: Bernie Sanders has offered to campaign extensively on our behalf, and of course we want to have him on the trail. I'm willing to make a few small promises to make that happen.
66b15e01919ac63e0ce0d4e3870068fef1363f77.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯提出愿意广泛为我们助选，我们当然希望他加入竞选活动。我愿意作出几项小承诺，来促成这件事。

eb5ce73e93184f3a21c6de2ab53b5b8b59b38ad8.source: Bernie Sanders is going to be a very active part of my Administration. We both want what's best for this country and his input will be taken very seriously.
eb5ce73e93184f3a21c6de2ab53b5b8b59b38ad8.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯会在我的政府中发挥非常积极的作用。我们都希望这个国家得到最好的发展，会非常认真地听取他的意见。

8dbcf6a4dfd3a1d2c80ffa874a3565557dca2fb8.source: Bernie Sanders was your main opponent in the nomination battle. There's no pretending that the two of you have a warm relationship, but he does have fierce support from many of your potential voters. On the other hand, if you want to make the case that you're a moderate alternative to Trump's extremism, having Bernie on the ticket will not help on that front.
8dbcf6a4dfd3a1d2c80ffa874a3565557dca2fb8.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯是你在提名战中的主要对手。你们两个的关系并不假装很温暖，但他确实得到了许多潜在选民的强烈支持。另一方面，如果你想证明自己是特朗普极端主义的温和替代者，那么让伯尼加入选票在这方面不会有任何帮助。

519ee8c63bd010cfde6cba665531f9967b2d981a.source: Besides Fairbanks, Elmer Burkett is the only candidate for Vice President with significant support, and Hughes could attempt to elevate him. Burkett has served as Representative and Senator from Nebraska, striking a moderate course on many of the labor and economic issues of the day. His region is more in favor of peace, vis a vis Europe, as well. Nationally, he is less well-known than Fairbanks.
519ee8c63bd010cfde6cba665531f9967b2d981a.zh: 除了费尔班克斯之外，埃尔默·伯克特是唯一获得大力支持的副总统候选人，休斯可以尝试提升他的地位。 伯克特 曾担任 内布拉斯加州 的众议员和参议员，在当今的许多劳工和经济问题上采取了温和的方针。与欧洲相比，他所在的地区也更倾向于和平。在全国范围内，他的知名度不如费尔班克斯。

cef13f77b5b722d0e3edcada13213564d6df5e55.source: Best to lie low on the Iran-Contra issue and hope that Dukakis doesn't bring it up too much.
cef13f77b5b722d0e3edcada13213564d6df5e55.zh: 最好在伊朗门问题上保持低调，希望杜卡基斯不要过多提起它。

746c8197cfd3ec558f3d104cbd3c440c728536c0.source: Betrayal! Many outraged Republicans are having second thoughts about your selection. Things would be much worse, but for the field you are up against.
746c8197cfd3ec558f3d104cbd3c440c728536c0.zh: 背叛！许多愤怒的共和党人，开始重新考虑选择你是否正确。幸好对手是那些人，否则局面会糟得多。

8e2bb9de2aca69be91cf3782b2f5a629fcf885a7.source: Big tax cuts for the rich are not always popular politically, but they are a definite carrot for establishment Republicans to support your campaign.
8e2bb9de2aca69be91cf3782b2f5a629fcf885a7.zh: 为富人提供大规模减税，在政治上并不总受欢迎，但确实能作为诱因，争取建制派共和党人支持你的竞选。

0da41dd23b50a3e6c675514890469c0454b4da8d.source: Bill Clinton is a sick man and his people, including Hillary, have silenced a number of women over the years who tried to speak out.
0da41dd23b50a3e6c675514890469c0454b4da8d.zh: 比尔·克林顿是个病态的人。这些年来，他身边的人，包括希拉里在内，让不少试图发声的女性闭了嘴。

16123e0ba39c4503fd147c7154ba70a20a525d31.source: Bill Clinton is one of the best Presidents we have had in recent memory. His Administration added 23 million jobs and oversaw a booming economy, and I have nothing but good things to say about it.
16123e0ba39c4503fd147c7154ba70a20a525d31.zh: 比尔·克林顿是近些年来最优秀的总统之一。他的政府新增了2300万个就业岗位，带来了经济繁荣。我对他的执政只有赞许。

34fcb7f3a6e64d989afe3452aeb5be00ff74a0e7.source: Bill Clinton pushed through a tax increase, new gun control laws, a lot of environmental regulations, and has been subject to numerous fundraising and corruption allegations. Not to mention his infamous personal conduct in the White House.
34fcb7f3a6e64d989afe3452aeb5be00ff74a0e7.zh: 比尔·克林顿推动了加税、新的枪支管制法和一大批环保法规，还面对大量关于筹款与腐败的指控。更不用说，他在白宫臭名昭著的个人行为。

2920ff06a1906036a9a8b14c56830ea09f611914.source: Bill Clinton was an embarrassment to the United States, and his impeachment was well-deserved. I believe that he should have been removed from office.
2920ff06a1906036a9a8b14c56830ea09f611914.zh: 比尔·克林顿让美国蒙羞，他遭到弹劾是罪有应得。我认为他应当被免职。

8adbf77575f25490b9132dd2b96d8f756db475d8.source: Bill Clinton's partisan attacks have degraded the political culture of our country. I will be a uniter, not a divider, when I am in the White House.
8adbf77575f25490b9132dd2b96d8f756db475d8.zh: 比尔·克林顿的党派攻击败坏了我国的政治文化。入主白宫后，我会团结人民，而不是制造分裂。

ee7a5e8c74ec15bed25bd39a809570a7ba40ff2f.source: Bill Miller is a devout Catholic, a good man, and he has served New York with honor and distinction.
ee7a5e8c74ec15bed25bd39a809570a7ba40ff2f.zh: 比尔·米勒是一位虔诚的天主教徒，是个好人。他为纽约州服务，表现光荣而卓越。

ab2ad40eb22db81805a52296662cd325e59a79d0.source: Bill and Hillary Clinton have thrown millions of American jobs away. And also, a lot of these were jobs that African-Americans could be doing right now, which is why unemployment is so terrible in that community.
ab2ad40eb22db81805a52296662cd325e59a79d0.zh: 比尔和希拉里·克林顿毁掉了数百万美国人的工作。而且，其中许多岗位，本来现在可以由非裔美国人来做；这就是那个社群失业如此严重的原因。

5e3d2084f5b76d70f95f88c683faaf83e121b8f7.source: Bircherism is popular in your homestate of Arizona.
5e3d2084f5b76d70f95f88c683faaf83e121b8f7.zh: 伯奇协会那套思想，在你的家乡亚利桑那州很受欢迎。

5e04e78b84d3bb767ede55763a8eeecd15b05952.source: Blacks and liberals are thrilled, but moderates dislike your approval and promise to continue the policies of the Warren Court.
5e04e78b84d3bb767ede55763a8eeecd15b05952.zh: 黑人和自由派欢欣鼓舞，但温和派不喜欢你赞同沃伦法院，并承诺继续它的路线。

29a553d7cc32088c33eb31d81082307fbd45e89a.source: Blacks wish for a comment, anything about police brutality from you. For whites, this is a great answer, showing that you aren’t just all talk about law and order.
29a553d7cc32088c33eb31d81082307fbd45e89a.zh: 黑人希望听到你对警察暴行有所表态，哪怕说点什么也好。对白人来说，这个回答很好，表明你维护法律与秩序不只是空谈。

d8609f97b8931e455af2d6dbfa2616438ff16852.source: Bob Dole is a staunch conservative who really sets the tone for the direction I want to take.
d8609f97b8931e455af2d6dbfa2616438ff16852.zh: 鲍勃·多尔是坚定的保守派，真正体现了我想要前进的方向。

9064919ab71f310c4b5ce29aa0c5a572667ac4a5.source: Bob Dole is a well-respected, conservative Senator from Kansas. He could unite the party after a divisive primary fight -- Ronald Reagan has singled Dole out as a good choice for running mate. He is popular in the farm states and could help consolidate support in the Plains and Midwest. He is also known to have loose lips on the campaign trail, and does not hold back in his attacks.
9064919ab71f310c4b5ce29aa0c5a572667ac4a5.zh: 鲍勃·多尔 是来自 堪萨斯州 的一位受人尊敬的保守派参议员。在一场分裂的初选斗争之后，他可以团结该党——罗纳德·里根已将多尔选为竞选伙伴的不错选择。他在农业州很受欢迎，可以帮助巩固平原和中西部的支持。众所周知，他在竞选活动中总是言不由衷，并且毫不掩饰自己的攻击。

ccc70da802c3c9feb9b2a39f600f6e7939b775d8.source: Bob Dole is an unexpected choice for running mate, but it could work out well this fall.
ccc70da802c3c9feb9b2a39f600f6e7939b775d8.zh: 鲍勃·多尔是出人意料的搭档选择，但在秋季可能会有好效果。

245a3ba877179decf5293e2740cd5df3844324bf.source: Bob Dole is going to do what Bob Dole does best, and we're proud to have him on our ticket.
245a3ba877179decf5293e2740cd5df3844324bf.zh: 鲍勃·多尔会做他最擅长的事，我们很自豪能与他组成竞选搭档。

c9105b6e9ae5610388c3941d4742ad806c5cb753.source: Bob Dole is the type of Republican that the entire party can get behind, and he has served his home state of Kansas well.
c9105b6e9ae5610388c3941d4742ad806c5cb753.zh: 鲍勃·多尔是全党都能支持的共和党人，也为家乡堪萨斯州尽心服务。

20f2c1b0a95e3577c14fd8bf33e1437b05a537df.source: Bob Dole was Bush's primary rival for the Republican nomination. He has served as a Senator from Kansas since 1969. He is the preferred choice of many in the party, and has a loyal following on Capitol Hill. Many believe he would help immensely in the farm states. On the other hand, Dole served as Gerald Ford's running mate in 1976, and made some over-the-top attacks on Jimmy Carter which served as a distraction. He and Bush also have lukewarm feelings for each other.
20f2c1b0a95e3577c14fd8bf33e1437b05a537df.zh: 鲍勃·多尔 是 布什 共和党提名的主要竞争对手。自 1969 年以来，他一直担任 堪萨斯州 参议员。他是党内许多人的首选，并且在国会山拥有忠实的追随者。许多人相信他将为农业州提供巨大帮助。另一方面，多尔在1976年担任杰拉尔德·福特的竞选搭档，并对吉米·卡特进行了一些过分的攻击，分散了注意力。他和布什彼此之间也有不冷不热的感情。

8c602dcb03b94015763de160ce4257073ae11255.source: Bob Graham has served his home state of Florida well. He has fought tirelessly for education and the environment.
8c602dcb03b94015763de160ce4257073ae11255.zh: 鲍勃·格雷厄姆出色地服务了家乡佛罗里达州。他为教育和环境不懈奋斗。

f13b6eda68c93c2e124ae6bfbbda059d3c89f710.source: Bob Graham has served his home state of Florida well. He is the type of independent thinker we need in the White House.
f13b6eda68c93c2e124ae6bfbbda059d3c89f710.zh: 鲍勃·格雷厄姆出色地服务了家乡佛罗里达州。他正是白宫需要的那种善于独立思考的人。

72c2de82a4d043fe8f8725773a17499817d41a81.source: Bob Graham is a Senator and former Governor from Florida. His popularity in that state could be crucial to a Democratic victory in 2000. He is fairly moderate and was one of Bill Clinton's top choices for running mate before Clinton went with Gore. His focus has been on the environment, education, and intelligence issues.
72c2de82a4d043fe8f8725773a17499817d41a81.zh: 鲍勃·格雷厄姆 是来自 佛罗里达州 的参议员和前州长。他在该州的受欢迎程度可能对 2000 年民主党的胜利至关重要。他相当温和，在 克林顿 选择 戈尔 之前是 比尔·克林顿 竞选伙伴的首选之一。他的重点是环境、教育和情报问题。

09cb3176a9109d4770df9c855822b2669533a646.source: Bobby Baker was a protege and good friend of yours, and your business connections with both men in the 50’s have been widely publicized. Your numbers take a big hit as both Goldwater and the press rakes you for this outright lie. Best hope this blows over soon...
09cb3176a9109d4770df9c855822b2669533a646.zh: 博比·贝克是你提携的后辈，也是你的好友；你在上世纪50年代与这两人的商业关联，早已被广泛报道。戈德华特和媒体抓住这句赤裸裸的谎言猛烈抨击，你的支持率遭到重创。最好盼着风波快点过去……

a8569e128656b8250465ff44ed8feb55dcefd143.source: Boies is a controversial figure to be sure, but he more or less falls into line with your traditional views. Of course, there are a lot of states besides Iowa you need to visit if you're to have a chance...
a8569e128656b8250465ff44ed8feb55dcefd143.zh: 博伊斯的确颇有争议，但大体符合你一贯的观点。当然，你要想有机会，除了艾奥瓦，还得访问许多别的州……

2672faf6b4fb9d9be54606fec67d362536a53ea1.source: Boies will reinforce the Democrats' pivot to liberalism, which could be a plus or a minus depending on the area.
2672faf6b4fb9d9be54606fec67d362536a53ea1.zh: 博伊斯 将加强民主党转向自由主义的立场，这可能是一个优点或缺点，具体取决于该地区。

7b9359d42ce499c89638bfd33e15efd03022fea1.source: Boies's time has passed. We need to avoid appearing with such radical politicians and cultivate the moderate wing of the party.
7b9359d42ce499c89638bfd33e15efd03022fea1.zh: 博伊斯的时代已经过去。我们需要避免与这种激进政客同台，转而争取党内温和派。

fb5a824b707b60066e34b17cb1a81c40776762cf.source: Bolstered by Democratic fundraiser and philanthropist Karla M. Jurveston, Emily's List seeks to promote women's reproductive healthcare in the United States.
fb5a824b707b60066e34b17cb1a81c40776762cf.zh: 在民主党筹款人和慈善家卡拉·M.·尤尔韦特松支持下，“艾米莉名单”致力于促进美国女性生殖医疗。

a422dbe78d216501c0d445979f55befe93e905d7.source: Boos and hisses from the audience! This is what the 'Boy Orator of the Platte' came to talk about?!
a422dbe78d216501c0d445979f55befe93e905d7.zh: 听众一片嘘声！“普拉特河的少年演说家”来这里，就是要说这些？！

9d2101047ff898ecd920df662c59bf743b90c2f6.source: Both your pessimism and the lack of support towards welfare, programs you’ve always fought for, worry core supporters.
9d2101047ff898ecd920df662c59bf743b90c2f6.zh: 你的悲观态度，以及对自己一贯争取的福利项目缺乏支持，都令核心支持者忧虑。

e97bedc012778499cfc337a4e61cec791d7746a4.source: Brandeis's ability is not in question, but he is too radical to be considered for a Court opening. I'd also rather not have the Jewish issue come up during this campaign.
e97bedc012778499cfc337a4e61cec791d7746a4.zh: 布兰代斯的才干无可置疑，但他过于激进，不宜填补最高法院空缺。而且，我也不想在这场竞选中，让犹太人问题成为争论焦点。

6d158943fca66cbbe02df91ec68e665bf364ecc3.source: Bryan Caves to Tammany Hall! -- says the
6d158943fca66cbbe02df91ec68e665bf364ecc3.zh: 布赖恩 通往坦慕尼协会的洞穴！ ——说

573e3e465c2d81a98718bbda5399479b15701608.source: Bryan combines vague, non-sensical appeals to emotion with a near-blasphemous use of religious symbolism. I'm confident that the voters will reject this demagogue.
573e3e465c2d81a98718bbda5399479b15701608.zh: 布赖恩以模糊、荒谬的言辞煽动情绪，还使用近乎亵渎神明的宗教象征。我相信，选民会拒绝这个蛊惑人心的政客。

26cbe19e23c35b1239d403656c8fe6b552cae8be.source: Bryan is the type of do-gooder politician who would attempt to impose his own morality on this independent region.
26cbe19e23c35b1239d403656c8fe6b552cae8be.zh: 布赖恩是那种自以为做好事、非要把自己的道德观强加给这个自主性很强的地区的政客。

4ef0778d8cc78b286f79a096eec3a66fffc91bd4.source: Bryan will state that there can be no relief for debtors or the larger economy without inflation, which he hopes to bring about via "free silver".
4ef0778d8cc78b286f79a096eec3a66fffc91bd4.zh: 布赖恩将主张，若没有通货膨胀，债务人乃至整个经济就无法得到纾困；他希望通过“自由铸银”推动通胀。

8df48da39689ecf2c08cd439d97a20dd7a0dcab2.source: Bryan would drive the important railroads of this region, such as Union Pacific, into bankruptcy by reneging on agreed-upon financing arrangements.
8df48da39689ecf2c08cd439d97a20dd7a0dcab2.zh: 布赖恩会背弃已经约定的融资安排，把当地的重要铁路公司——例如联合太平洋铁路——逼入破产。

7768e9b9db3571d2d368704e17f99282c7af65dc.source: Bryan's naked ambition knows no bounds. It is unbecoming of a candidate to make campaign appearances on his own behalf.
7768e9b9db3571d2d368704e17f99282c7af65dc.zh: 布赖恩赤裸裸的野心毫无止境。候选人亲自四处拉票，有失身份。

349a52dd49c7f9f3eaa2f13f8b7bd342458441a9.source: Bryan's nomination has electrified the western voter, and he is now planning to campaign on the rails, six days a week. Will you break precedent as well and make a speaking tour of the nation?
349a52dd49c7f9f3eaa2f13f8b7bd342458441a9.zh: 布赖恩获得提名后，西部选民群情振奋；如今他计划每周六天乘火车沿途竞选。你也会打破惯例，赴全国各地巡回演说吗？

8d563fce1d22dad83c65690fe2a0c03af3e4c295.source: Bryan's reputation amongst industrial workers is actually suspect (he is often perceived as being too pro-farmer and too evangelical). Do you have any plans to win this traditionally Democratic block of voters?
8d563fce1d22dad83c65690fe2a0c03af3e4c295.zh: 布赖恩在产业工人中的声望其实颇受质疑：人们往往觉得，他太偏向农民，宗教热情也太强。你有什么计划，争取这批传统上支持民主党的选民？

d1ee0efa25dd4e0aba3d6c95740e74c3be4d79c6.source: Bryan's victory stings all the more because after the inept Cleveland Administration, this election shouldn't have been close. Needless to say, your political career is over.
d1ee0efa25dd4e0aba3d6c95740e74c3be4d79c6.zh: 布赖恩 的胜利更加刺痛，因为在无能的克利夫兰政府之后，这次选举本来不应该是势均力敌的。不用说，你的政治生涯已经结束了。

f50f1acba3eb7b2da05c1b6d82167d55ff9b16a9.source: Build the wall! Mexico has exploited our country for twenty years now, dumping murders, rapists, and worse onto our system and stealing our jobs with NAFTA. Believe me, that's not going to last.
f50f1acba3eb7b2da05c1b6d82167d55ff9b16a9.zh: 筑墙！墨西哥剥削我们国家二十年了，把杀人犯、强奸犯，甚至更糟的人塞进我们的社会，还靠《北美自由贸易协定》偷走我们的工作。相信我，这不会继续下去。

970d77764342d31ee55bd187408e1cf70ebdf255.source: Bush has broad appeal and a united base, but lacks experience and gravitas in the eyes of some. Can he make the case that he will move beyond the partisanship of the Clinton years and bring "compassionate conservatism" to the nation?
970d77764342d31ee55bd187408e1cf70ebdf255.zh: 布什 具有广泛的吸引力和团结的基础，但在一些人看来缺乏经验和庄严。他能否证明自己将超越克林顿年的党派之争，为国家带来“富有同情心的保守主义”？

1d0a38a8d7e2a9c9c046ddfe603a2ef469d4a33b.source: Bush is hammering you on the decision not to debate, and it does play into a narrative that you're not up to the job.
1d0a38a8d7e2a9c9c046ddfe603a2ef469d4a33b.zh: 布什正围绕你拒绝辩论的决定穷追猛打，这确实强化了你无法胜任总统的说法。

6eccfcd61ad0246160bc833ed3ecbe21331c678c.source: Bush is pummeling you with negative ads. It's good to fight back and stabilize things.
6eccfcd61ad0246160bc833ed3ecbe21331c678c.zh: 布什正在用负面广告猛烈攻击你。反击并稳住局面，是好事。

088a87a812e166debcfb58e0950e5ded27b3ddcf.source: Bush is pummeling you with negative ads. You need to fight back and stabilize things.
088a87a812e166debcfb58e0950e5ded27b3ddcf.zh: 布什正在用负面广告猛烈攻击你。你需要反击，稳住局面。

af42c60e20c957a1f09d426634971c3f3794aa42.source: Bush must find some way to shake up the race. He could emphasize the strong economy, or attack Dukakis on a number of fronts.
af42c60e20c957a1f09d426634971c3f3794aa42.zh: 布什必须设法改变选情。他可以突出强劲的经济表现，也可以从多个方面攻击杜卡基斯。

900f35a49c57ed49d6e1ea685955a003183f711a.source: Bush stumbled on a couple of occasions, and you did pretty well. Observers believe these debates will definitely help your case.
900f35a49c57ed49d6e1ea685955a003183f711a.zh: 布什有几次失误，而你表现相当好。观察人士认为，这些辩论肯定有助于你争取支持。

17952384ace96470d1a64eeee85a9dde145b9783.source: Business owners should threaten the workers with further unemployment if Bryan wins.
17952384ace96470d1a64eeee85a9dde145b9783.zh: 企业主应当威胁工人：如果布赖恩获胜，他们将面临更多失业。

37aff5d1154307f150dc80d5ac6b9459c5efc472.source: Businessmen are confused about your apparent disregard for law and order.
37aff5d1154307f150dc80d5ac6b9459c5efc472.zh: 你似乎漠视法律与秩序，这让商人们很困惑。

a4ccd36e16dee5603d6a122f831743c64f7df0a5.source: Busing is a pretty unpopular policy, and even more so in your party.
a4ccd36e16dee5603d6a122f831743c64f7df0a5.zh: 校车接送相当不受欢迎，在你党内尤其如此。

537d5c6a1f67d447a73e2386572b08dd45a5236b.source: Busing is not a popular policy, and there's not that much to lose by coming out against it.
537d5c6a1f67d447a73e2386572b08dd45a5236b.zh: 校车接送不是受欢迎的政策，公开反对它，不会让你失去太多。

cf01af84e9d28cae3106841c52b90e836745431a.source: Busing is not a popular policy, but to come out so strongly against it offends some in your party.
cf01af84e9d28cae3106841c52b90e836745431a.zh: 校车接送不是受欢迎的政策，但你如此强烈地反对，也冒犯了党内一些人。

5803d48b57403326f7e08d0d8ea1d56df04396c4.source: Busing is nothing but another conspiracy to mongrelize the races of this country. First it was the Brown decision. Now it's some policy that some academic came up with to send children to school thirty miles from their house as part of some social engineering scheme.
5803d48b57403326f7e08d0d8ea1d56df04396c4.zh: 校车接送不过是又一个让这个国家各个种族“杂种化”的阴谋。先是布朗案判决，现在又有某个学者想出这种政策，把孩子送到离家三十英里的学校，搞什么社会改造工程。

881473f167f866e1e64eeaf9cddd3a780c2fbf45.source: Busing is unpopular, but you’ve pleased dedicated activists and grassroot supporters, who dedicate themselves into organizing and campaigning. Largely, your support has not changed.
881473f167f866e1e64eeaf9cddd3a780c2fbf45.zh: 校车接送并不受欢迎，但你令坚定的活动人士和基层支持者满意，他们全力投入组织与竞选。总体而言，你的支持率没有变化。

0f45cb5c00f384c2f8c4f28a8718b56010bdb49c.source: But for now, sit back and relax, you’ve earned it. Who knows? Maybe next election you’ll even win a state or two.
0f45cb5c00f384c2f8c4f28a8718b56010bdb49c.zh: 但现在，坐下来放松一下，你已经赢得了它。谁知道？也许下次选举你甚至会赢得一两个州。

9dbdfa3afc1a885825d14215109484ef5cc83039.source: But what did you expect? Your main goal was to get the Libertarian agenda out there and hope for a miracle.  The miracle never came.
9dbdfa3afc1a885825d14215109484ef5cc83039.zh: 但是你期望什么？你的主要目标是实现自由主义议程并希望出现奇迹。  奇迹从未出现。

8fbcf67149a7b2a29e7f1a801d5605e555300370.source: By and large, the American people respect the Constitution and don't want to see measures like this put into place.
8fbcf67149a7b2a29e7f1a801d5605e555300370.zh: 总的来说，美国人民尊重宪法，不愿看到实施这样的措施。

57465ca7c3450f4c446b05263677b5b9bb2c39c7.source: By coming out so forcefully, you are gambling that the Northern wing of the party can hand you a victory this fall. Meanwhile the Democrats are making hay with this issue.
57465ca7c3450f4c446b05263677b5b9bb2c39c7.zh: 你如此强硬地表态，是在押注党内北方派能够让你在今秋获胜。与此同时，民主党人正借此大做文章。

e6e80a628a8bd4d5c39cdf77ecab03d20bbdc0b3.source: By coming out so forcefully, you are gambling that the Southern wing of the party can hand you a victory this fall. Meanwhile the Democrats are making hay with this issue.
e6e80a628a8bd4d5c39cdf77ecab03d20bbdc0b3.zh: 你如此强硬地表态，是在押注党内南方派能够让你在今秋获胜。与此同时，民主党人正借此大做文章。

18ccc5a7d182e1eff6fce824ee20962ece91f572.source: By going with Muskie, Humphrey would probably be writing off most of the South and also would be giving Nixon an opening among moderate voters.
18ccc5a7d182e1eff6fce824ee20962ece91f572.zh: 通过选择 马斯基，汉弗莱 可能会注销大部分南方地区，并且也会在温和派选民中为 尼克松 提供一个机会。

ba29e78933bff0643fffd8c41f362be6e2faeb2a.source: By leaning full-force into Humphrey’s record, you’ve fired up your liberal base- at the expense of your chances at winning the South back from Goldwater. Of course, with the lead you’ve started with, does it matter?
ba29e78933bff0643fffd8c41f362be6e2faeb2a.zh: 你全力强调汉弗莱的政绩，鼓舞了自由派基本盘，却牺牲了从戈德华特手中夺回南方的机会。当然，考虑到你一开始就有的领先优势，这重要吗？

153747031db0d92017cfd094cf1b2be632bf42e6.source: By selecting Humphrey, you are writing off the South and pinning your hopes on winning liberals in the North and West.
153747031db0d92017cfd094cf1b2be632bf42e6.zh: 选择汉弗莱，意味着你放弃争取南方，把希望寄托在赢得北方和西部自由派的支持上。

fe51eedca8dfe3172fec4304457e17e004b82edb.source: Can we just clarify my position on all of these fancy programs Johnson created? I oppose all of them. That includes HUD which will infringe on the rights of property owners and increase crime in our working class neighborhoods.
fe51eedca8dfe3172fec4304457e17e004b82edb.zh: 能不能先把我对约翰逊那些花里胡哨的项目的立场说清楚？我一概反对，包括住房与城市发展部。它会侵犯业主的权利，还会让我们的工人阶级社区犯罪增加。

851eb09f381fc2173a745a83d97cd26e3d0be7de.source: Can you comment on the newly created Head Start program?
851eb09f381fc2173a745a83d97cd26e3d0be7de.zh: 你能谈谈新设立的“启蒙计划”吗？

e53bded441ebd0274b5e03de954d2482d0d46ebd.source: Can you elaborate on why your allies intervened so strongly on behalf of Levi Woodbury, to be your running mate?
e53bded441ebd0274b5e03de954d2482d0d46ebd.zh: 你的盟友如此积极地力推利维·伍德伯里担任你的竞选搭档，能否详细解释一下原因？

79904876199d3f867beedca66860b28a134a7a39.source: Can you get your story straight on the gay marriage position? There is already some latent suspicion of your commitment-level from the LGBT community.
79904876199d3f867beedca66860b28a134a7a39.zh: 你能把自己在同性婚姻问题上的立场说清楚、说一致吗？LGBT社群本来就对你的投入程度暗存疑虑。

16caed4493a5f9f6634ae1431e3bfc9144875916.source: Can you really blame Mike in this day and age? One false accusation or misinterpreted statement, and suddenly your entire career can be at risk.
16caed4493a5f9f6634ae1431e3bfc9144875916.zh: 在这个时代，你真的能责怪迈克吗？一次虚假指控，或一句被误解的话，就可能突然危及你的整个职业生涯。

18219b8c1f6e153689984ac4323f1a883d280bb0.source: Can you reassure him that the federal government will respect the rights of the states under your Administration?
18219b8c1f6e153689984ac4323f1a883d280bb0.zh: 您能否向他保证联邦政府将尊重您政府领导下各州的权利？

8602e7d8cdfb407086a4f450db599d3aa8878aa0.source: Can you reassure him that there are limits to your pacifist ideals, particularly in regards to Cuba?
8602e7d8cdfb407086a4f450db599d3aa8878aa0.zh: 你能否向他保证你的和平主义理想是有限度的，特别是在古巴方面？

6718d51742751e9156aa98cbbe0b715b99e94c9a.source: Can you respond to rumors that you would seek to abolish the Supreme Court if elected, due to their recent decisions on the income tax and antitrust issues?
6718d51742751e9156aa98cbbe0b715b99e94c9a.zh: 有传言说，因为最高法院最近在所得税和反托拉斯问题上的裁决，你当选后将谋求废除最高法院。你能回应吗？

5a030b3fd9a1480a817b0881487d8a7a74dd4889.source: Can you state your definitive position on the American monetary system?
5a030b3fd9a1480a817b0881487d8a7a74dd4889.zh: 你能明确说明自己对美国货币制度的立场吗？

2572cf34cb1bf9294fcd2a4ef3aa87f1bbc865f4.source: Can you turn out enough of the base to make up for disaffecting some moderate voters?
2572cf34cb1bf9294fcd2a4ef3aa87f1bbc865f4.zh: 你能动员足够多的基本盘选民投票，弥补失去一些温和派选民的损失吗？

41757b880f6de74737a3f5c2d1ce58e53b0a1945.source: Can you win enough swing voters to compensate for tepid enthusiasm within your base?
41757b880f6de74737a3f5c2d1ce58e53b0a1945.zh: 你能赢得足够多的摇摆选民，弥补基本盘热情不高的缺口吗？

aa9289055c9b3b094b825d190d10c5e17cf3de29.source: Candidates will debate what to do with a $200 billion budget surplus, among other things. In the real world, Florida was decided by 537 votes after 36 days and a Supreme Court decision.
aa9289055c9b3b094b825d190d10c5e17cf3de29.zh: 候选人将就如何运用2000亿美元预算盈余等问题展开辩论。现实中，经过36天的争议和最高法院的裁决，佛罗里达州最终以537票之差决出胜负。

2a65350f3f70b07d2112b760118e228c935d982b.source: Cassius Clay has recently spoken of the need to “throw off the yoke of slavery”, which has reinforced his abolitionist reputation and alarmed many moderates. What is your stance on this?
2a65350f3f70b07d2112b760118e228c935d982b.zh: 卡修斯·克莱最近主张“摆脱奴隶制的枷锁”，进一步强化了他的废奴主义名声，也让许多温和派感到不安。你对此持什么立场？

a12f1523113371c9526179f18b57a5ae8282961a.source: By selecting Johnson, Ron Paul could avoid the splintering of his support to the Libertarian Party. He could also make an appeal to the socially liberal segment of the small government movement, insofar as Johnson is known to be pro-choice and independent of the religious right.
a12f1523113371c9526179f18b57a5ae8282961a.zh: 通过选择约翰逊，罗恩·保罗可以避免他对自由意志党的支持分裂。他还可以向小型政府运动中的社会自由派发出呼吁，因为众所周知 约翰逊 是支持堕胎并且独立于宗教权利的。

07c22d9b92e36606a0900809ed376dbd07fcca6f.source: By selecting Rockefeller, Nixon would dampen his chances against Wallace in the South and would need to run well against Humphrey in the big northern cities to win the election.
07c22d9b92e36606a0900809ed376dbd07fcca6f.zh: 通过选择 洛克菲勒，尼克松 将削弱他在南方对抗 华莱士 的机会，并且需要在北方大城市对抗 汉弗莱 才能赢得选举。

475ed30ce0ef3ea77eda9c721a031877a1f37e35.source: By staking a moderate stance on racial issues, I will win a national majority.
475ed30ce0ef3ea77eda9c721a031877a1f37e35.zh: 在种族问题上采取温和立场，我就能在全国赢得多数支持。

e143655c59315ef9b57d9f947d9bea94269c39da.source: By staking the middle ground between Wallace and Humphrey on racial issues, I will split them apart and win a national majority.
e143655c59315ef9b57d9f947d9bea94269c39da.zh: 在种族问题上，只要站在华莱士和汉弗莱之间的中间立场，我就能把他们的选民分开，在全国赢得多数支持。

6c7e35e66fe45b6806fb0e7725191e1a646cca69.source: By the word extremism, I simply meant patriotism. This is just one big misunderstanding.
6c7e35e66fe45b6806fb0e7725191e1a646cca69.zh: 我说“极端主义”，其实只是指爱国主义。这完全是一场大误会。

a1bd6f7fc786bdd198a630be91d59c20b3c7ee14.source: COVID-19 still reigns terror throughout America, so hopefully, you can help vaccine rollout chug along smoothly, and oversee the economic recovery. After that subsides, any one of your big promises might be your next mission. Build the wall or perhaps renegotiate more fair deals for the hardworking men and women of the glorious manufacturing sector of America. Watch out for those radical Democrats, however, you know them and the liberal media will lambast you at every turn for your choices. You've dealt with them before, though. Just remind them who is president. For now, just sit back and bask in the knowledge that you pulled 2 of the greatest upsets in US political history. MAGA!
a1bd6f7fc786bdd198a630be91d59c20b3c7ee14.zh: 新冠疫情仍在美国肆虐，希望你能帮助疫苗接种顺利推进，并监督经济复苏。待疫情平息，你的任何一项重大承诺，都可能成为下一项任务。筑墙，或者为美国伟大制造业中辛勤工作的男男女女，重新谈判更公平的协议。不过，要当心那些激进的民主党人；你知道，他们和自由派媒体会对你的每个选择横加指责。但你以前对付过他们，只要提醒他们谁才是总统。现在，先安心享受吧：你已经制造了美国政治史上两次最大的冷门。让美国再次伟大！

082f74411049b460e76239146b65bf1070dae3e8.source: Calhoun may be past his heyday, but it serves little purpose to insult him.
082f74411049b460e76239146b65bf1070dae3e8.zh: 卡尔霍恩或许已过了鼎盛时期，但侮辱他没有多少意义。

5ca1bc8ea09ab2b4b4b4b6a931c25a3b2c813b9d.source: California, an important state this fall, is in the midst of a divisive split between Progressives and traditional Republicans. What are your own plans for visiting that state?
5ca1bc8ea09ab2b4b4b4b6a931c25a3b2c813b9d.zh: 加利福尼亚州是今年秋季的重要战场，进步派与传统共和党人之间的尖锐分裂正在撕裂该州党内。你打算怎样安排赴该州的行程？

68ca33417f45ac3d4ab26d6823b6a6144297ff34.source: Calling illegal immigration a “serious problem” raises some eyebrows on the left. But other people hear you as well.
68ca33417f45ac3d4ab26d6823b6a6144297ff34.zh: 把非法移民称为“严重问题”，让一些左翼人士感到意外。不过，也有其他人听到了你的话。

297667782321d355d01640b5207b510c5d308e46.source: Can we all agree that the Black Panthers are a menace to the security of the United States?
297667782321d355d01640b5207b510c5d308e46.zh: 大家能否一致认同，黑豹党危及美国的安全？

f781a457cbcee1693d4d22bfb64cb642e3214d98.source: Cassius Clay is an anti-slavery publisher from Kentucky who has faced numerous threats to his life for the views he has taken. He served in the Kentucky House until his views hindered further political advancement in his home state. He has a wide reputation as an abolitionist publisher, and would help burnish the anti-slavery platform of the Republicans. Detractors claim that Clay is
f781a457cbcee1693d4d22bfb64cb642e3214d98.zh: 卡修斯·克莱 是一位来自 肯塔基州 的反奴隶制出版商，他因所持观点而面临无数生命威胁。他在 肯塔基州 众议院任职，直到他的观点阻碍了他家乡的进一步政治进步。他作为废奴主义出版商享有盛誉，并将帮助完善共和党的反奴隶制纲领。批评者声称克莱是

772ee049aa3f3bc909637c581ae7e538e879bfa0.source: Cassius Clay, a cousin of Henry Clay, has published a letter stating Henry Clay is in accord with the abolitionist movement. Should your party disseminate copies of this letter as an attack?
772ee049aa3f3bc909637c581ae7e538e879bfa0.zh: 亨利·克莱的亲戚卡修斯·克莱发表了一封信，声称亨利·克莱赞同废奴运动。你们党是否应当散发这封信的副本，以此攻击他？

603f97848411a0aa5b1a4bbaf3afdb80f9b59873.source: Cassius Clay, your cousin, has published a letter stating you are in accord with the abolitionist movement. How will you respond to this?
603f97848411a0aa5b1a4bbaf3afdb80f9b59873.zh: 你的亲戚卡修斯·克莱发表了一封信，声称你赞同废奴运动。你会如何回应？

f87eb8a0db4dcb47d1d727f454853129ed12eb13.source: Charles Evans Hughes is the former Governor of New York. He served on the Supreme Court from 1910, until resigning to accept the Republican Nomination. Hughes is a compromise candidate -- he was serving on the Court during the messy 1912 schism. It will be difficult for Hughes to condemn Wilson's legislation without losing support from progressives such as Roosevelt. Many Republicans also favor an aggressive stance against Germany, while others believe Hughes should finesse the issue.
f87eb8a0db4dcb47d1d727f454853129ed12eb13.zh: 查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯 是 纽约州 的前州长。他从 1910 年起在最高法院任职，直到辞职接受共和党提名。 休斯 是一位妥协的候选人——他在混乱的 1912 年分裂期间在最高法院任职。 休斯 很难在不失去 罗斯福 等进步人士支持的情况下谴责 威尔逊 的立法。许多共和党人也赞成对德国采取侵略性立场，而其他人则认为 休斯 应该巧妙处理这个问题。

c0dde04ef23a8ed748c31a9acf4c92d75f34a43a.source: Charles W. Fairbanks has served as a Senator from Indiana, and as Vice President under Teddy Roosevelt. He was seeking the top of the ticket this year, but has agreed to serve as Vice President a second time. Fairbanks supported William Howard Taft during the split in 1912, and would balance the ticket in a more conservative direction.
c0dde04ef23a8ed748c31a9acf4c92d75f34a43a.zh: 查尔斯·W.·费尔班克斯 曾担任 印第安纳州 的参议员，并在 泰迪·罗斯福 担任副总统。他本想今年获得最高席位，但已同意第二次担任副总统。 费尔班克斯 在 1912 年分裂期间支持威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱，并将以更保守的方向平衡选票。

03c13e32c318ff23e71427a55dac5c64a275f2af.source: Chase is a solid choice and a good party man.
03c13e32c318ff23e71427a55dac5c64a275f2af.zh: 蔡斯是个稳妥的人选，也是可靠的本党成员。

1e1f69af9985c771334ae4d30c712b189faecbc7.source: Cheap labor depends on a steady influx of immigrants.
1e1f69af9985c771334ae4d30c712b189faecbc7.zh: 廉价劳动力依赖移民源源不断地到来。

f5633cfd6235301d891fe5c6da8dd72e10b76871.source: Cheap oil is an overall benefit to our economy. I think the majority of voters will understand that this fall.
f5633cfd6235301d891fe5c6da8dd72e10b76871.zh: 廉价石油总体上有利于我们的经济。我认为，今年秋天多数选民都会理解这一点。

ba6f78b1b1a75507c37a1e44f5b19f431a78fa97.source: Cheers and jeers mix in the convention hall, but elsewhere your speech is well-received.
ba6f78b1b1a75507c37a1e44f5b19f431a78fa97.zh: 大会会场里欢呼和嘘声交织，但在其他地方，你的演讲获得了好评。

a2fbd5c86d01dae01659acd314751d1b7572d158.source: Cheers and jeers mix in the convention hall. Observers are surprised by your spotlight on law and order, although the speech is well-received.
a2fbd5c86d01dae01659acd314751d1b7572d158.zh: 大会会场里欢呼和嘘声交织。观察人士对你着重强调法律与秩序感到意外，不过，演讲还是获得了好评。

0ff2ff82003252722637f3945cca23a38b93a723.source: China hawks deride your attempts to hedge on this issue, but overall your statements don't make much news one way or the other.
0ff2ff82003252722637f3945cca23a38b93a723.zh: 对华鹰派嘲笑你在这个问题上含糊其辞，但总体而言，你的表态没有引起多少新闻关注。

0e7befd481671c24d1240d8d7ccc8ab7d067f8a7.source: China is a crucial ally, under duress, and I support Chiang Kai-Shek and the Nationalists in their struggle.
0e7befd481671c24d1240d8d7ccc8ab7d067f8a7.zh: 中国是一个处境危急的重要盟友。我支持蒋介石和国民党进行的斗争。

7e9b3cd96f2916856046351103172105d1bbc352.source: Chris Christie has walked the walk as Governor of New Jersey. I'm going to work with the best people as President.
7e9b3cd96f2916856046351103172105d1bbc352.zh: 克里斯·克里斯蒂担任新泽西州州长时，说到做到。我当上总统后，会与最优秀的人共事。

69fb14aa7300608c7b78dae213947e5ff37f0ac7.source: Chris Christie is a fighter. And we will never apologize for our efforts to fight for the American people, whether it's in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Ohio, or many other terrific states across this wonderful, blessed nation.
69fb14aa7300608c7b78dae213947e5ff37f0ac7.zh: 克里斯·克里斯蒂是个斗士。我们为美国人民奋斗，绝不会因此道歉，无论是在新泽西州、宾夕法尼亚州、俄亥俄州，还是这个伟大而蒙福的国家里其他许多出色的州。

62d0686ea3c629b5c7077a699f8893451ad0b043.source: Chris Christie is the current Governor of New Jersey, and was Trump's first opponent to endorse him, after making his own bid for the Republican nomination. Christie once enjoyed significant bipartisan support in New Jersey, but that has plummeted. His selection would double-down on Trump's image as an unorthodox, East Coast-influenced Republican. This may or may not be helpful.
62d0686ea3c629b5c7077a699f8893451ad0b043.zh: 克里斯·克里斯蒂 是 新泽西州 的现任州长，也是 特朗普 在自己竞选共和党提名后第一个支持他的对手。 克里斯蒂 曾经在 新泽西州 中获得了两党的大力支持，但现在已经大幅下降。他的当选将加倍削弱 特朗普 作为非正统、受东海岸影响的共和党人的形象。这可能有帮助，也可能没有帮助。

31fd93cbf890c5717b96f296e4149f331477279e.source: Chris Christie is the former governor of New Jersey, and made a splash in the 2016 Primaries working on behalf of your first campaign.  While relations with him have grown cold since then, he's still the best debater in the business, and willing to coach you in preparation for your debates against Joe Biden.
31fd93cbf890c5717b96f296e4149f331477279e.zh: 克里斯·克里斯蒂曾任新泽西州州长，在2016年初选中为你的首次竞选助阵，表现引人注目。虽然此后你们的关系逐渐冷淡，他仍是政坛顶尖的辩论高手，也愿意指导你准备与乔·拜登的辩论。

77d8c71eef34fddf4252a7114544b8cb10588cca.source: Christie showed that an agenda of fiscal responsibility and pragmatic, outsider solutions can win in so-called blue states. I know this might sound crazy to the liberal media, but I will win New Jersey in this election.
77d8c71eef34fddf4252a7114544b8cb10588cca.zh: 克里斯蒂证明，财政负责、务实的体制外解决办法，可以在所谓的蓝州获胜。我知道，自由派媒体也许会觉得这话疯狂，但我这次选举会赢下新泽西州。

784f6c466c3148e15f183d7b61ad5125c79c017b.source: Church is an honorable man, but I would never support the weakening of America's fundamental defense abilities. I support investigations, but not cuts to our defense.
784f6c466c3148e15f183d7b61ad5125c79c017b.zh: 丘奇是个正派的人，但我绝不会支持削弱美国的基本防卫能力。我支持调查，却不支持削减国防。

c30c7abb242e0139c784b1e278668963c48b7fcb.source: Church is right on the mark. The people still are not in a position where they can trust our leading government institutions, and that includes the military.
c30c7abb242e0139c784b1e278668963c48b7fcb.zh: 丘奇说得完全正确。人民依然无法信任我国主要的政府机构，军队也包括在内。

becbef3ea952eda8b060e9b6f277d3b8a11d2e74.source: Civil rights continue to be a major issue of the times, with African-American activists like MLK and Malcolm X still marching on the streets for further enforcement and expansion of the Civil Rights Act. What should be our campaign’s approach to them?
becbef3ea952eda8b060e9b6f277d3b8a11d2e74.zh: 民权仍是这个时代的重大议题。马丁·路德·金、马尔科姆·X等非裔美国人活动家仍在街头示威，要求进一步执行并扩大《民权法案》。我们的竞选应如何对待他们？

2cc20da2e510d06772fd5dba148ea608758f5c4d.source: Claude Matthews is the current Governor of Indiana. Highly popular in that state, he has combined populist policies with a firm stance on labor actions. He also matches Bryan's conservatism on public morality issues.
2cc20da2e510d06772fd5dba148ea608758f5c4d.zh: 克劳德·马修斯 是 印第安纳州 的现任州长。他在该州很受欢迎，他将民粹主义政策与对劳工行动的坚定立场结合起来。他在公共道德问题上也符合布赖恩的保守主义。

2779181f1e62f13752e58c627050f60a4f3c34fb.source: Clay would prefer to keep slavery and expansion on the back-burner, and advance his own issues like tariffs, internal improvements, and a national currency. Can he find redemption from his political defeats to Andrew Jackson, and finally break into the White House?
2779181f1e62f13752e58c627050f60a4f3c34fb.zh: 克莱更愿意将奴隶制和扩张放在次要地位，并推进他自己的问题，如关税、国内公共基础设施改善和国家货币。他能否从安德鲁·杰克逊的政治失败中找到救赎，并最终闯入白宫？

c7683962936ed72eef8950f209a1b9a52679243c.source: Clearly what John Brown did was illegal, but without the obstructionism and provocation of the South on slavery, it would have never come to pass.
c7683962936ed72eef8950f209a1b9a52679243c.zh: 约翰·布朗的所作所为显然违法，但如果没有南方在奴隶制问题上的阻挠与挑衅，这件事根本不会发生。

6f2f557b974ae232a292a3c51ca3d5cd75b8fb98.source: Climate change is a hoax purveyed by a collection of scientists and liberal politicians to provide them a pretext for further intervention in the economy.
6f2f557b974ae232a292a3c51ca3d5cd75b8fb98.zh: 气候变化是一群科学家和自由派政客兜售的骗局，目的是为他们进一步干预经济提供借口。

f84254ba9b309132b15e58ada2a8159b5db96f3f.source: Clinton has served as Secretary of State since 2009 and won high praise for her performance, and she would bring added star power to Obama's reelection bid. The risks include offending Joe Biden as well as making Obama appear indecisive to some voters.
f84254ba9b309132b15e58ada2a8159b5db96f3f.zh: 克林顿自2009年起担任国务卿，表现广受赞誉。她能凭借知名度为奥巴马的连任竞选增添声势。风险在于，这可能得罪乔·拜登，也会让部分选民觉得奥巴马优柔寡断。

1e63ac3af002bd3a8077afb6255e756adea79727.source: Colin Powell is a moderate Republican and a key general from the Desert Storm campaign. He enjoys high personal popularity among the American electorate. He would be the first African-American to be a running mate for a major party. It will take some strong inducements to get Powell to run, however. He has repeatedly stated that he is not seeking the role, but perhaps you could persuade him by taking a moderate position on the social issues of the day.
1e63ac3af002bd3a8077afb6255e756adea79727.zh: 科林·鲍威尔 是一位温和的共和党人，也是沙漠风暴战役中的关键将军。他在美国选民中享有很高的个人声望。他将成为第一个成为主要政党竞选伙伴的非裔美国人。然而，需要一些强有力的诱因才能让鲍威尔运行。他一再表示他并不寻求这个角色，但也许你可以通过对当今社会问题采取温和立场来说服他。

7f9f4a3c697ee1591d78fedefafe95703cd41f1a.source: Colin Powell is a uniter, not a divider. I'm serious about working with all types of people to move our country forward.
7f9f4a3c697ee1591d78fedefafe95703cd41f1a.zh: 科林·鲍威尔会团结人民，而不是制造分裂。我是真心要与各种人合作，推动国家进步。

ba588750eeccd4e456eb8956cbe4ed0216ad7c2e.source: Collective bargaining in the public sector is one of the primary contributors to our exploding state deficits, which must eventually be subsidized by the federal government. I agree that the practice should end.
ba588750eeccd4e456eb8956cbe4ed0216ad7c2e.zh: 公共部门集体谈判，是州政府赤字急剧膨胀的主要原因之一，而这些赤字最终必须由联邦政府补贴。我赞同，应该结束这种做法。

6a387736052b3fcf1b9e698023ab41f8cb27b036.source: College administrators are skimming an unbelievable amount of money off of the federal government, and they're using student aid to drive up tuition. It's a terrible thing, really.
6a387736052b3fcf1b9e698023ab41f8cb27b036.zh: 大学管理者从联邦政府那里捞走了令人难以置信的大笔金钱，还利用学生资助抬高学费。真的，这太糟糕了。

687d2f6bb36119807e7a36f30810c805601ac0ff.source: Come on, man! If there was ever a real investigation of Trump's tax practices by the IRS or the FBI, he'd probably be in prison right now. Am I wrong?
687d2f6bb36119807e7a36f30810c805601ac0ff.zh: 拜托，老兄！如果国税局或联邦调查局真的调查过特朗普的税务做法，他现在大概已经坐牢了。我说错了吗？

a3977caaabc7bec333771adc518be72d4fb5fbdd.source: Commentators are discussing your surprisingly moderate acceptance speech, particularly in light of the legislation of your first term.
a3977caaabc7bec333771adc518be72d4fb5fbdd.zh: 评论人士正在讨论你那篇出人意料地温和的接受提名演说，尤其考虑到你第一任期的立法表现，更显得令人意外。

f6e41e5157c4cc1dce2b2ee286971b7d6b62729d.source: Commentators have noticed a remarkably restrained public persona over the last few weeks.
f6e41e5157c4cc1dce2b2ee286971b7d6b62729d.zh: 评论人士注意到，过去几周，你的公众形象异常克制。

8ab478b086a8639a930de6328f6f867c23029252.source: Compared to some of your comments in the primaries, this is a pretty measured position towards the Syrian crisis.
8ab478b086a8639a930de6328f6f867c23029252.zh: 与你初选时的一些话相比，这对叙利亚危机的立场相当克制。

867259ff7ddf975b79a4ff7256db85af5a04b38e.source: Confidence Men: Wall Street, Washington, and the Education of a President
867259ff7ddf975b79a4ff7256db85af5a04b38e.zh: 信心人：华尔街、华盛顿州 和总统的教育

548a75113d9ac471fd8e422e8bfad8c5e2c3cac3.source: Confounding the predictions of many experts, you were able to turn the tables on Al Gore, in spite of the economy and Clinton's popularity.
548a75113d9ac471fd8e422e8bfad8c5e2c3cac3.zh: 与许多专家的预测相混淆的是，尽管经济和 克林顿 很受欢迎，但你还是能够扭转 阿尔·戈尔 的局面。

6b121c8acd00de7a6413bd77eea9dfe591e16a53.source: Congratulations governor! Despite a vicious attack campaign from the Republicans, you've been elected president. And what a win it is! The house and Senate are solidly in your hands, so you should have little trouble passing your legislation
6b121c8acd00de7a6413bd77eea9dfe591e16a53.zh: 恭喜，州长！尽管共和党发起了凶狠的攻击式竞选，你还是当选了总统。而且这是一场多么漂亮的胜利！众议院和参议院都牢牢掌握在你方手中，推动立法应该不会遇到太大困难。

081c423a6c579e55f10e2204487f5d8da7a1abe8.source: Congratulations governor! Despite a vicious attack campaign from the Republicans, you've been elected president. Conservativism still has its place in the mind of the public, as seen with this win, so be prepared to face constant adversaries in the chambers of Congress.
081c423a6c579e55f10e2204487f5d8da7a1abe8.zh: 恭喜，州长！尽管共和党发起了凶狠的攻击式竞选，你还是当选了总统。这次胜利表明，保守主义在公众心中仍占有一席之地，因此要做好准备，持续面对国会两院中的反对者。

b482fdba16c1a8fdd224ffc29a505008082080fc.source: Congratulations governor! Despite a vicious attack campaign from the Republicans, you've been elected president. Democrats are still reeling a bit from the Reagan Revolution, so the win isn't as big as you'd like, but a win is a win after 8 years of Reagan, no?
b482fdba16c1a8fdd224ffc29a505008082080fc.zh: 恭喜，州长！尽管共和党发起了凶狠的攻击式竞选，你还是当选了总统。民主党人尚未完全从“里根革命”的冲击中缓过来，因此优势不如你期望的那么大；不过里根执政八年后，能赢总归是赢，对吧？

6c0f346697acae28e43f7909bf9891bd16fd17bd.source: Congratulations on securing the Democratic nomination for President! As you take the stage to thunderous applause, what would you like to emphasize to kick this campaign off?
6c0f346697acae28e43f7909bf9891bd16fd17bd.zh: 恭喜你赢得民主党总统候选人提名！你在雷鸣般的掌声中走上讲台，想强调什么，为这场竞选拉开序幕？

ecdaffe49fbd89826c9c82a0478d2df21de07aef.source: Congratulations! Despite a challenge from the left in Dukakis, you have held on to win the 1988 election. Not since 1928 have the Republicans won three in a row. Let’s hope you don't turn out like that ill-fated president, Herbert Hoover. The election was quite close, as many predicted, so let’s  hope the good economy and suffering the USSR can carry you through to the midterms.
ecdaffe49fbd89826c9c82a0478d2df21de07aef.zh: 恭喜！尽管杜卡基斯从左翼发起挑战，你还是坚持到了最后，赢得1988年选举。共和党自1928年以来，还没有连续赢得过三次总统选举。希望你别像那位时运不济的总统赫伯特·胡佛一样收场。正如许多人预测的那样，选举十分接近；希望良好的经济形势与苏联的困境能帮你撑过中期选举。

94d99b3c1235a681032a092466b6299a0bfa382b.source: Congratulations! Despite a challenge from the left in Dukakis, you have held on to win the 1988 election. Not since 1928 have the Republicans won three in a row. Let’s hope you don't turn out like that ill-fated president, Herbert Hoover. You didn't do as well as Reagan, however, you still have won by a decent margin, so let’s hope you can work with the Democrats to engineer some bipartisanship legislature.
94d99b3c1235a681032a092466b6299a0bfa382b.zh: 恭喜！尽管杜卡基斯从左翼发起挑战，你还是坚持到了最后，赢得1988年选举。共和党自1928年以来，还没有连续赢得过三次总统选举。希望你别像那位时运不济的总统赫伯特·胡佛一样收场。你虽然不及里根的战绩，但优势依然可观，希望你能与民主党合作，促成两党共同支持的立法。

6ac366974923a3822cc7f47b0a8d8db4bdd044e7.source: Congratulations! Despite a challenge from the left in Dukakis, you have held on to win the 1988 election. Not since 1928 have the Republicans won three in a row. Let’s hope you don't turn out like that ill-fated president, Herbert Hoover. Your margin is certainly impressive, as many thought it would be a closer election due to 2 terms of Republicans.
6ac366974923a3822cc7f47b0a8d8db4bdd044e7.zh: 恭喜！尽管杜卡基斯从左翼发起挑战，你还是坚持到了最后，赢得1988年选举。共和党自1928年以来，还没有连续赢得过三次总统选举。希望你别像那位时运不济的总统赫伯特·胡佛一样收场。你的优势确实惊人，许多人原本认为，共和党已经执政两届，这次选举会更加接近。

d704a90127e664f321b2c6a66854831ba62e576a.source: Congratulations! Despite a well-fought battle from Barack Obama, you've become the first Mormon president and prevented the 3rd re-election in a row. With a respectable win, you will net a few Senate seats, but so few coming your way will likely mean
d704a90127e664f321b2c6a66854831ba62e576a.zh: 恭喜！尽管与贝拉克·奥巴马进行了一场激烈的战斗，你还是成为了第一位摩门教总统，并阻止了连续第三次连任。如果你取得了可观的胜利，你将获得一些参议院席位，但你的席位太少可能意味着

e2cded606145b842c65ed559cb8f3e83947dad94.source: Congratulations! Despite a well-fought battle from Barack Obama, you've become the first Mormon president and prevented the 3rd re-election in a row. Your margin of victory is remarkable, a complete flip of 2008. It seems the US population was ready for change again. The Senate flips a few seats in favour of the Republicans, too.
e2cded606145b842c65ed559cb8f3e83947dad94.zh: 恭喜！尽管贝拉克·奥巴马奋力迎战，你还是成为首位摩门教徒总统，阻止了连续第三位总统赢得连任。你的胜选优势十分惊人，彻底扭转了2008年的局面。看来美国民众又一次准备好迎接改变。参议院也有几个席位转到共和党手中。

8e5983628da033d5c2c7782418322c1aaa0eebce.source: Congratulations! Despite a well-fought battle from Barack Obama, you've become the first Mormon president and prevented the 3rd re-election in a row. it was close, though. Your slim margins will keep the Senate in Democrat’s hands, so be prepared to make concessions to your propositions
8e5983628da033d5c2c7782418322c1aaa0eebce.zh: 恭喜！尽管贝拉克·奥巴马奋力迎战，你还是成为首位摩门教徒总统，阻止了连续第三位总统赢得连任。不过，这次赢得很险。你微弱的胜选优势不足以改变民主党掌控参议院的局面，因此准备好在提案上作出让步吧。

a8a9e5bbc7091e3f7491d5d5c4549b4bbafef33b.source: Congratulations! Despite an intense and vicious battle cast by the Republicans, you have become the first female president and fought off Donald Trump. With your impressively large victory, you also managed to win a number of victories down-ballot, thus making things easier for you.
a8a9e5bbc7091e3f7491d5d5c4549b4bbafef33b.zh: 恭喜！尽管共和党发动了激烈而恶毒的攻势，你仍击败唐纳德·特朗普，成为第一位女总统。凭借令人瞩目的大胜，你还带动本党赢得了同次选举中的若干其他职位，让自己今后更容易施政。

c69692670964ba5d18d1d4772e15a0592b2f6e79.source: Congratulations! Despite an intense and vicious battle cast by the Republicans, you have become the first female president and fought off Donald Trump. Your victory margin gives you some breathing room in the chambers, so make sure you act on your promises or the 2018 midterms will be brutal.
c69692670964ba5d18d1d4772e15a0592b2f6e79.zh: 恭喜！尽管共和党发动了激烈而恶毒的攻势，你仍击败唐纳德·特朗普，成为第一位女总统。你的胜选优势为你在国会两院留下了一些余地，所以一定要兑现承诺，否则2018年中期选举会相当惨烈。

73f08c51d80e2ba9905f26cd00a9be6e6adf2ee0.source: Congratulations! Despite an intense and vicious battle cast by the Republicans, you have become the first female president and fought off Donald Trump. Your victory margin, as small as it is, will force you to be a bit bipartisan, but your years in the government prepared you for this.
73f08c51d80e2ba9905f26cd00a9be6e6adf2ee0.zh: 恭喜！尽管共和党发动了激烈而恶毒的攻势，你仍击败唐纳德·特朗普，成为第一位女总统。你的胜选优势很小，会迫使你在一定程度上谋求两党合作，不过多年政府工作已让你为此做好准备。

d4c21946473030d794e82b705bcb24e373a83806.source: Congratulations! Despite the intense battle from Humphrey and Wallace, you have disproven the doubters and redeemed your name. The bombing halt and Wallace collapsing in the north nearly lost you the election, but you managed to hang on.
d4c21946473030d794e82b705bcb24e373a83806.zh: 恭喜！尽管汉弗莱和华莱士与你激烈交锋，你仍让怀疑者哑口无言，重新证明了自己。停止轰炸，加上华莱士在北方的支持崩塌，差点让你输掉选举，不过你还是守住了胜利。

ab52db4876ee182447a875d44f5c55cf2d99805d.source: Congratulations! Despite the intense battle from Humphrey and Wallace, you have disproven the doubters and redeemed your name. Your lead dwindled a bit as Wallace’s appeal dampened, but your coalition managed to remain intact.
ab52db4876ee182447a875d44f5c55cf2d99805d.zh: 恭喜！尽管汉弗莱和华莱士与你激烈交锋，你仍让怀疑者哑口无言，重新证明了自己。随着华莱士的吸引力减弱，你的领先优势略有缩小，但支持你的联盟仍然团结。

21deccefa675d919435a18e81ae268b1e3f35b09.source: Congratulations! Despite the intense battle from Humphrey and Wallace, you have disproven the doubters and redeemed your name. Your performance in debates and campaigning were widely praised compared to 1960, which allowed you to win with a massive landslide. What a turnaround from 1964!
21deccefa675d919435a18e81ae268b1e3f35b09.zh: 恭喜！尽管汉弗莱和华莱士与你激烈交锋，你仍让怀疑者哑口无言，重新证明了自己。与1960年相比，你在辩论和竞选中的表现广受赞扬，帮助你以压倒性优势获胜。与1964年相比，真是天翻地覆！

35acfc05c14430fac90b97f69f7caaa6d172e7c4.source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in a number of ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. As expected, your Playboy interview prevented a glorious decimation of the Republicans, but you'll take it, seeing as it could have been worse with the economic recovery.
35acfc05c14430fac90b97f69f7caaa6d172e7c4.zh: 恭喜！你虽然从一开始就是热门，却也有不少可能栽跟头的方式。你承载着国家的意愿，向华盛顿那些圈内人发出了明确讯息。正如预料，《花花公子》采访妨碍了你以辉煌的压倒性优势击败共和党。不过，你还是会接受这个结果，毕竟随着经济复苏，情况本可能更糟。

dad732255fd5f78a605c46c07c4e5702b1bd246b.source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in several ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. Many were shocked at the tightness of the election, seeing as the negativity around the GOP and DC in general. Maybe you were TOO honest, Jimmy...
dad732255fd5f78a605c46c07c4e5702b1bd246b.zh: 恭喜！你虽然从一开始就是热门，却也有好几种可能栽跟头的方式。你承载着国家的意愿，向华盛顿那些圈内人发出了明确讯息。鉴于公众对共和党和整个华盛顿政界的不满，选举竟如此接近，让许多人震惊。吉米，也许你太诚实了……

28f243c17e012fccd302e27f20e053358514929a.source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in several ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. They'll need to tread carefully, as the impressive turnaround from 72, despite the playboy interview, shows what America thinks of Ol' Dick Nixon's cronies.
28f243c17e012fccd302e27f20e053358514929a.zh: 恭喜！你虽然从一开始就是热门，却也有好几种可能栽跟头的方式。你承载着国家的意愿，向华盛顿那些圈内人发出了明确讯息。他们必须小心行事：尽管有《花花公子》采访风波，你仍让民主党从1972年的惨败中强势翻身，表明了美国人如何看待老迪克·尼克松的亲信们。

5448f2e85f018923438675aba5edbd3c8d903460.source: Congratulations! You have deadlocked the electoral college with your votes in the South.
5448f2e85f018923438675aba5edbd3c8d903460.zh: 恭喜！你在南方的选票使选举人团陷入僵局。

b2cb7b994dd6ec03a781e60cef41776903609893.source: Congratulations! You have just touched the third rail of American politics. This response alone may be enough to lose you the election.
b2cb7b994dd6ec03a781e60cef41776903609893.zh: 恭喜！你刚刚碰到了美国政治的带电第三轨。仅凭这个回答，就可能让你输掉选举。

4f3b1e4064bc5880ea2a5a598d4a3fca401b31b8.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1844 Election
4f3b1e4064bc5880ea2a5a598d4a3fca401b31b8.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 1844 年选举

ecf96842721efe7e7fb595a80ebf358006f276b3.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1860 Presidential Election.
ecf96842721efe7e7fb595a80ebf358006f276b3.zh: 恭喜！您赢得了 1860 年总统选举。

d796213f1082b6c2f9cc25330ec5c3593ba566e5.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1896 election.
d796213f1082b6c2f9cc25330ec5c3593ba566e5.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 1896 年的选举。

e279b77eec6df9ab1e1eb68649ce878c4c7b7b5d.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1916 election.
e279b77eec6df9ab1e1eb68649ce878c4c7b7b5d.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 1916 年的选举。

2b89034ad2d462cb148b3bcce3a61d0ec8d957ee.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1948 Presidential Election.
2b89034ad2d462cb148b3bcce3a61d0ec8d957ee.zh: 恭喜！您赢得了 1948 年总统选举。

0baa6a9e1c6a4009f0fa761211fe2446d35e8bca.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1960 Presidential Election.
0baa6a9e1c6a4009f0fa761211fe2446d35e8bca.zh: 恭喜！您赢得了 1960 年总统选举。

43374dcef611b2865b25ab0c48802c7ef58fff08.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1964 Republican nomination for President! As you take the stage to cheers and applause from one side of the floor- and stony silence from the other- what will you touch on in your acceptance speech?
43374dcef611b2865b25ab0c48802c7ef58fff08.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了1964年共和党总统候选人提名！你登上讲台，大会一侧欢呼鼓掌，另一侧却冷若冰霜、默不作声。你准备在接受提名演说中谈些什么？

77324bfcdbbe86e8ec93b6422d97af94fd665863.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1968 election!
77324bfcdbbe86e8ec93b6422d97af94fd665863.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 1968 年的选举！

c5003aa95922932fbfc8d639d7bb8f2f13ee64a2.source: Congratulations! You've successfully fought off a challenge from Mitt Romney and the Republicans, to become the third president in a row to win re-election. Mitt Romney calls to congratulate you on your victory, and the Democrats made some gains in either chamber as well, but you will ultimately have to bargain a lot with Republicans to pass legislation. You didn't do as well as 2008, being the first person since FDR to be re-elected with fewer electoral votes.
c5003aa95922932fbfc8d639d7bb8f2f13ee64a2.zh: 恭喜！你成功击退米特·罗姆尼和共和党的挑战，成为连续第三位赢得连任的总统。米特·罗姆尼打电话祝贺你获胜，民主党在两院也有所斩获，但你终究还得经常与共和党讨价还价，才能推动立法。你的表现不如2008年，成为富兰克林·罗斯福之后首位连任时选举人票反而减少的总统。

0992cdb615bd0bddb69bab098c72c709c6a95f29.source: Congratulations! You've successfully fought off a challenge from Mitt Romney and the Republicans, to become the third president in a row to win re-election. Mitt Romney calls to congratulate you on your victory. and the Democrats made some meager gains in either the house as well, but Senate losses will bring you down a notch, and force you to be even more bipartisan than before. Lets hope
0992cdb615bd0bddb69bab098c72c709c6a95f29.zh: 恭喜！您已成功击退了米特·罗姆尼和共和党的挑战，成为连续第三位赢得连任的总统。 米特·罗姆尼来电祝贺你获胜。民主党在众议院也取得了一些微薄的进展，但参议院的损失将使你的地位下降，并迫使你比以前更加两党合作。让我们希望

2d658919aaf3f62cf0014fb8618186f42c292db7.zh: 恭喜！您赢得了 1964 年大选！
