06a51956f02aa6b014456a12405e3da67609f70f.source: Congratulations. You may have found the one political issue that's even more toxic than abolishing Social Security.
06a51956f02aa6b014456a12405e3da67609f70f.zh: 恭喜。你可能找到了唯一一个比废除社会保障更危险的政治议题。

c2749e8beb644ddd15a2106d95275a9004de37c2.source: Congress has just such a bill in the works right now.
c2749e8beb644ddd15a2106d95275a9004de37c2.zh: 国会眼下正在酝酿的，正是这样一项法案。

dd25a5717811754e685af9b72d7bae521711f70c.source: Congress is simply too liberal to be a useful partner in government right now. I hope that the American people will elect Republican congressman to be my partners over the next four years.
dd25a5717811754e685af9b72d7bae521711f70c.zh: 眼下，国会过于自由派，无法成为有用的执政伙伴。我希望美国人民选出共和党议员，在未来四年与我合作。

548020707c3b2baa6f7de95ca5dc03dd86304d7c.source: Congress must function in an orderly fashion, without taking time out from its business to receive ill-conceived petitions. I support the Gag Rule.
548020707c3b2baa6f7de95ca5dc03dd86304d7c.zh: 国会必须有序运作，不能放下正事，花时间受理考虑不周的请愿。我支持禁议规则。

712d4d66ba98cb006aac2e4051afe8fbc6a9de13.source: Congress will now choose from the top three candidates in the electoral vote count. If you are in the top three, you have a great chance. Otherwise, Bell will be the favorite. Your supporters are already preparing a compromise amendment, offering permanent protection for slavery in the South in return for the admission of more free states. You will likely have to make such promises to prevent a deadlock in the House vote.
712d4d66ba98cb006aac2e4051afe8fbc6a9de13.zh: 国会现在将从选举人票计数中排名前三的候选人中选出。如果你能进入前三名，那么你的机会就很大。否则，贝尔将成为热门。你们的支持者已经在准备一项折衷修正案，为南方的奴隶制提供永久保护，以换取更多自由州的加入。你可能必须做出这样的承诺，以防止众议院投票陷入僵局。

ec8dcab35e938a3806ceafbe6df95768f8775e3c.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1976 Presidential Election.
ec8dcab35e938a3806ceafbe6df95768f8775e3c.zh: 恭喜！您赢得了 1976 年总统选举。

9425220212a6f075dd48f8e3a524c4b6ec96d517.source: Congratulations! You have won the 1988 election.
9425220212a6f075dd48f8e3a524c4b6ec96d517.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 1988 年的选举。

afc1bdd6fa366e66f8989622458bc339d56dd295.source: Congratulations! You have won the 2000 election.
afc1bdd6fa366e66f8989622458bc339d56dd295.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 2000 年的选举。

d560370d913eaf7c0ed61fd739b0edae2a4970cf.source: Congratulations! You have won the 2012 election.
d560370d913eaf7c0ed61fd739b0edae2a4970cf.zh: 恭喜！您赢得了 2012 年大选。

2090cf91932bf3bef76a7a5cda78961807ed8b35.source: Congratulations! You have won the 2016 election.
2090cf91932bf3bef76a7a5cda78961807ed8b35.zh: 恭喜！您赢得了 2016 年大选。

6fa366b782bb2c65d872951714dda8e5f10f1251.source: Congratulations! You have won the 2020 election.
6fa366b782bb2c65d872951714dda8e5f10f1251.zh: 恭喜！您赢得了 2020 年选举。

3653ed2f2ef7dbf3690504af55944c9dec1d9c1d.source: Congratulations! You received 5% of the popular vote! You will enable the Green Party to run a vigorous campaign in 2004 and present a true choice to the American people. You’ve run a great campaign these last few months, and you should have no problem getting renominated in 4 years.
3653ed2f2ef7dbf3690504af55944c9dec1d9c1d.zh: 恭喜！您获得了 5% 的民众选票！您将使绿党在2004年开展一场轰轰烈烈的竞选活动，为美国人民提供一个真正的选择。过去几个月你的竞选活动非常出色，四年后再次获得提名应该没有问题。

aaa357fc0447a44692ea6c05d19640b63f587fb0.source: Congratulations! You've successfully fought off a challenge from Mitt Romney and the Republicans, to become the third president in a row to win re-election. Mitt Romney calls to congratulate you on your victory, and the Democrats made some gains in both chambers as well, taking back the house. Many are surprised at the fact that you outdid your 2008 margins.
aaa357fc0447a44692ea6c05d19640b63f587fb0.zh: 恭喜！你成功击退米特·罗姆尼和共和党的挑战，成为连续第三位赢得连任的总统。米特·罗姆尼打电话祝贺你获胜，民主党在两院也有所斩获，夺回了众议院。你的胜选优势竟超过2008年，让许多人感到意外。

398ae5a6c5d9f290b0e2825f8899a20a83619cd7.source: Congratulations! You've successfully fought off a challenge from Mitt Romney and the Republicans, to become the third president in a row to win re-election. Mitt Romney calls to congratulate you on your victory, and the Democrats made some gains in both chambers as well, with the house being just shy of being controlled by them. Your optimistic rhetoric from 2008 wasn't here this time, but Democrats are still satisfied with your electoral vote margin.
398ae5a6c5d9f290b0e2825f8899a20a83619cd7.zh: 恭喜！你成功击退米特·罗姆尼和共和党的挑战，成为连续第三位赢得连任的总统。米特·罗姆尼打电话祝贺你获胜，民主党在两院也有所斩获，距离掌控众议院只差一点。你这次没有重现2008年的乐观豪言，但民主党人仍对你的选举人票优势感到满意。

871e6e609704506f1a9aeed484acb27a87ef3a3e.source: Connally was a loyal Democrat for many years, but anyone can see how their party has lurched away from the mainstream. I think he can remind Americans that Republicans are the sensible, governing party in this country.
871e6e609704506f1a9aeed484acb27a87ef3a3e.zh: 康纳利曾忠于民主党多年，但谁都看得出，民主党已经猛然偏离主流。我认为，他能提醒美国人：共和党才是这个国家理性、能够执政的政党。

734075050388a7b466dfa739db78a95ed1319c43.source: Connally was and is the Governor of Texas who was infamously wounded in the Kennedy Assassination. He would reinforce a moderate image, help deliver Texas to the ticket, and dampen the appeal of Wallace elsewhere to all but the most hard-line segregationists.
734075050388a7b466dfa739db78a95ed1319c43.zh: 康纳利 过去和现在都是 得克萨斯州 的总督，他在 肯尼迪 暗杀中受伤而声名狼藉。他将强化温和的形象，帮助将得克萨斯州带入选票，并削弱华莱士对其他地方除了最强硬的种族隔离主义者之外的所有人的吸引力。

56980852e8d39b0dcab57f3546a1a09d5066a0bf.source: Conservatism doesn't mean anger and divisiveness. I will govern as a sensible, pragmatic conservative and pass reforms that are broadly acceptable to the American people. I will return a part of our historic surplus to all of our hard-working families who pay taxes.
56980852e8d39b0dcab57f3546a1a09d5066a0bf.zh: 保守主义并不意味着愤怒和分裂。我会作为一位理智、务实的保守派执政，推动美国人民普遍能够接受的改革。我会把部分创纪录的预算盈余，还给所有辛勤工作、依法纳税的家庭。

a3e4ce8600b53d0a4b2bcc469f67620eccee87ce.source: Conservative Democrats love this, but it turns off your more liberal supporters.
a3e4ce8600b53d0a4b2bcc469f67620eccee87ce.zh: 保守派民主党人喜欢这个回答，但它令你更偏自由派的支持者反感。

a16f8fda96ccb4d87f5c863f5087209d763fe25c.source: Conservative pundits are very disappointed in your response. You've just reinforced their concerns that you are secretly a moderate.
a16f8fda96ccb4d87f5c863f5087209d763fe25c.zh: 保守派评论员对你的回答十分失望。你刚刚强化了他们的担忧：你其实暗地里还是个温和派。

2afab82235f36fc3d9f2d70c6a9ceea3c52295ad.source: Conservatives distrusted you enough already. Now you've added fuel to the fire in a big way.
2afab82235f36fc3d9f2d70c6a9ceea3c52295ad.zh: 保守派本来就够不信任你了。现在，你又狠狠地火上浇油。

2128d6475fe79170004f3fa4ed00f6995fa18612.source: Conservatives have denounced the 17th Amendment, but it is broadly popular.
2128d6475fe79170004f3fa4ed00f6995fa18612.zh: 保守派谴责第十七修正案，但它广受欢迎。

64df6f77eb8869822114b51600b6069968927cef.source: Conservatives operate under the "big tent" philosophy. This is just one of many valued groups within the conservative umbrella.
64df6f77eb8869822114b51600b6069968927cef.zh: 保守派奉行广纳各方的理念。这只是保守派阵营中许多受重视的团体之一。

48bfee801ef9023df3ac914a5f4f1db2fa28bcd8.source: Cope liberals! Trump wins again! Massive wins! Supermajorities in both houses! Trump became a [Big Shot]!!!11!!!!!!
48bfee801ef9023df3ac914a5f4f1db2fa28bcd8.zh: 自由派，破防去吧！特朗普又赢了！大获全胜！两院都拿下了压倒性多数！特朗普成了[大人物]！！！11！！！！！！

2a3213991d5edcf372ff4b85fe83190e51efb554.source: Core supporters are frustrated by this position.
2a3213991d5edcf372ff4b85fe83190e51efb554.zh: 核心支持者对这个立场感到失望。

73c04c59f8198d85fb6151fd05fb7226d61b719a.source: Corporations have been raising prices much faster than wages have increased, and they are pocketing exorbitant profits as a result. I will fight for the rights of labor, and for better regulation during my next term.
73c04c59f8198d85fb6151fd05fb7226d61b719a.zh: 企业提价的速度远远超过工资上涨，因而攫取了过高的利润。下个任期，我将争取劳工权利，并加强监管。

a5628a9ff9c3a8db64189766182f1737e3903537.source: Corrupt organizations such as Tammany Hall drag the good name of the Democrats through the dirt. I would never debase my Christian ideals for their support.
a5628a9ff9c3a8db64189766182f1737e3903537.zh: 坦慕尼协会这样的腐败组织，把民主党的好名声拖进了泥里。我绝不会为了它们的支持，贬损自己的基督教理想。

81e63bdbf7b59600ad8585f80a54e531b36f1c8d.source: Cory Booker and I will both fight to ensure that all Americans have health care, economic security, and acess to clean water. I'm proud to name him as my running mate.
81e63bdbf7b59600ad8585f80a54e531b36f1c8d.zh: 科里·布克和我都会努力，确保所有美国人拥有医疗保障、经济安全和清洁用水。我很自豪能请他担任我的搭档。

af781a6bb1e845b3d740d66b6d7f6d97a10d4111.source: Cory Booker has been a tireless advocate on behalf of the people of New Jersey, and on behalf of African-Americans everywhere. He will make sure that all groups have the voice they deserve in my Administration.
af781a6bb1e845b3d740d66b6d7f6d97a10d4111.zh: 科里·布克一直不知疲倦地为新泽西州人民，以及各地的非裔美国人发声。他会确保在我的政府中，所有群体都拥有应有的发言权。

cb20836b96714416dadf35cf46fb277748f814f4.source: Cory Booker has more experience in public service than Donald Trump by a mile. He is a sitting U.S. Senator. Any insinuation that he somehow isn't qualified is simply a phony attack by the right-wing outrage machine.
cb20836b96714416dadf35cf46fb277748f814f4.zh: 科里·布克的公共服务经验，远远超过唐纳德·特朗普。他是现任美国参议员。任何暗示他不够资格的说法，都不过是右翼煽愤机器的虚假攻击。

7d2ae5ee924d4549c060000b7509d4135b35b14b.source: Cory Booker is a Senator from New Jersey and was also the Mayor of Newark for several years. Politically, he is a mainstream Democrat, relatively similar to Barack Obama. He is also relatively youthful, with somewhat of a national profile. Turning out the black vote, and preventing even a handful of defectors to Trump, will be essential to a Clinton victory. However, Booker inspires limited enthusiasm amongst Sanders supporters.
7d2ae5ee924d4549c060000b7509d4135b35b14b.zh: 科里·布克 是来自 新泽西州 的参议员，也曾担任纽瓦克市长多年。政治上，他是主流民主党人，与贝拉克·奥巴马比较相似。他也比较年轻，具有一定的国家形象。争取黑人选票，并阻止少数叛逃者投向 特朗普，对于 克林顿 的胜利至关重要。然而，布克在桑德斯支持者中激发的热情有限。

b7e1b8c2419fbcd803b4e68b54b2f92140388f43.source: Cory Booker is a bright, young, energetic man who will be perfectly ready to assume the Presidency from day one. He represents the best and brightest of the African-American community.
b7e1b8c2419fbcd803b4e68b54b2f92140388f43.zh: 科里·布克聪明、年轻、精力充沛，从第一天起就完全准备好接任总统。他代表着非裔美国人社群中最优秀、最聪慧的人才。

6784415a59db201475f05b1ccc39d16d1f966652.source: Cory Booker really impressed me with his thoughtfulness, intelligence, experience, and ability to step in at a moment's notice, should the situation demand it.
6784415a59db201475f05b1ccc39d16d1f966652.zh: 科里·布克深思熟虑、聪慧，有经验，而且能在情况需要时随时接任。这些都给我留下了深刻印象。

e3360d389426dca133432806a6d7619549564aad.source: Could more have been done to prevent the current farm crisis, which has devastated the upper Midwest?
e3360d389426dca133432806a6d7619549564aad.zh: 面对已经重创中西部北部地区的当前农业危机，当初是否本可以采取更多预防措施？

14f53df6951cc0acf6083fa73d733bf1ef268c42.source: Could this be the line of attack which propels you forward this fall?
14f53df6951cc0acf6083fa73d733bf1ef268c42.zh: 这会不会成为今年秋季推动你向前的进攻路线？

72347090e9803fec0a8fb762ce7308f103f0f512.source: Could we have done more to save South Vietnam in 1975, such as air strikes or a limited engagement?
72347090e9803fec0a8fb762ce7308f103f0f512.zh: 1975年，我们是否本可以做得更多，以挽救南越，例如实施空袭或有限军事介入？

63b58f9cd5917e3a8e41fb1b124c282ccbd7624c.source: Craig Shirley - Reagan's Revolution: The Untold Story of the Campaign That Started It All
63b58f9cd5917e3a8e41fb1b124c282ccbd7624c.zh: Craig Shirley - 里根 的革命: 开始这一切的运动的不为人知的故事

dd755491d29f628510c5ea4db305853b884d2a94.source: Crippled America: How to Make America Great Again
dd755491d29f628510c5ea4db305853b884d2a94.zh: 残废的美国: 如何 让美国再次伟大

856e579629b3e7e22b958740161347b5f9392239.source: Critics have said that you wrap yourself in religious imagery too much for a presidential candidate. What is your response?
856e579629b3e7e22b958740161347b5f9392239.zh: 批评者说，对于总统候选人来说，你过多地将自己包裹在宗教意象中。你的回应是什么？

2f18f8ff8443febc7c0f2e68abc6f37150ab3f09.source: Croker is probably worried about my views on the temperance issue. I will assure him that a Bryan Administration will not push for Prohibition.
2f18f8ff8443febc7c0f2e68abc6f37150ab3f09.zh: 克罗克大概担心我在禁酒问题上的看法。我会向他保证，布赖恩政府不会推动禁酒。

868afa120a583969e65fe68c91a1b82b2d88937e.source: Cuba has been lost to the Soviet Union, providing a potential base for Communist aggression on the very doorstep of our nation. I am very unsatisfied with the current situation.
868afa120a583969e65fe68c91a1b82b2d88937e.zh: 古巴已经落入苏联之手，在我国的家门口，为共产主义侵略提供了潜在基地。我对当前局面非常不满。

d3ea268191e0b3e86b2d22e92655957e6449ff91.source: Current policy against Cuba, while obviously not perfect, is on the right track and we should continue it.
d3ea268191e0b3e86b2d22e92655957e6449ff91.zh: 目前针对古巴的政策显然并不完美，但方向正确，应该继续。

c8fbd8eb9c82238069a3ca780458a48461899b33.source: Current practices are much too permissive. Priceless old-growth forest has been almost completely destroyed, and we are headed into the future on an unsustainable trajectory.
c8fbd8eb9c82238069a3ca780458a48461899b33.zh: 现行做法宽松得过分。无价的原始森林几乎已经被毁光，我们正沿着不可持续的轨道走向未来。

06d8525f39b59897722408655467469330b81416.source: Currently the highest income tax bracket pays a rate of 91%. Will you work harder to cut tax rates as President?
06d8525f39b59897722408655467469330b81416.zh: 目前，所得税最高档税率为91%。作为总统，你会更加努力地削减税率吗？

84363ea5f7a229caefcd2260a99e3ae27d6ecd96.source: Dallas is the preferred choice of the Convention, but Polk could intervene on behalf of Levi Woodbury. Woodbury's reputation is more national than Dallas's, but he also comes from a smaller state. Woodbury has served as Secretary of the Treasury and is much more orthodox on economic issues, favoring a limited view of the federal government's powers. This could galvanize Democrats in the closer states in the South and West, but could also be a hindrance in Pennsylvania and New York.
84363ea5f7a229caefcd2260a99e3ae27d6ecd96.zh: 达拉斯 是公约的首选，但 波尔克 可以代表 利维·伍德伯里 进行干预。 伍德伯里 的声誉比 达拉斯 更具有全国性，但他也来自一个较小的州。 伍德伯里 曾担任财政部长，在经济问题上更加正统，支持对联邦政府权力的有限看法。这可能会激励南部和西部较近的州的民主党人，但也可能成为宾夕法尼亚州和纽约州的障碍。

bb6e4a7349869a0735fc31a656f19c575aa7e9a8.source: Dan Quayle has served as a Senator from Indiana for the past seven years. He would be an unexpected choice, and the first baby boomer to run on a national ticket. He does not have a long record of achievement at the highest stage, but he could have some appeal to social conservatives, Midwesterners, and younger voters. There is some skepticism about his intellect, and his campaigning and debating ability.
bb6e4a7349869a0735fc31a656f19c575aa7e9a8.zh: 丹·奎尔过去七年一直担任印第安纳州联邦参议员。选择他会令人意外，他也将成为首位参与全国总统竞选组合的婴儿潮一代政治人物。他在最高层级的政坛尚无长期业绩，但可能吸引社会保守派、中西部选民和年轻选民。外界对他的才智、竞选表现和辩论能力存在疑虑。

e05f4c0c05cc8b1ee4398c1b509d06eec0b9a313.source: Dan Quayle is obviously unqualified to serve as President, should the need arise, and his selection is most certainly a red flag for the capabilities of George Bush.
e05f4c0c05cc8b1ee4398c1b509d06eec0b9a313.zh: 显然，丹·奎尔没有资格在需要时接任总统。选他做搭档，也确实让人警惕乔治·布什的能力。

183fb69c9827f4b9fda0b751a048cbac8f4dd0b4.zh: 大卫·海德勒和乔安妮·海德勒 -

e6abcfb5ee396c481e8d46cd355076259b4cc731.zh: 大卫·赫伯特 唐纳德 -

a8b05b8e26e3456fdc2ed43e87c6d6e63b65f666.source: Debbie Wasserman Schultz is a good friend of yours, and also worked to 'help' in your victory against Bernie Sanders in the primaries.  As chair of the DNC, she could even further cement your relationship with the powerful campaign fund.
a8b05b8e26e3456fdc2ed43e87c6d6e63b65f666.zh: 黛比·沃瑟曼·舒尔茨是你的好友，也曾“帮助”你在初选中战胜伯尼·桑德斯。作为民主党全国委员会主席，她还能进一步巩固你与这个强大竞选资金来源的关系。

dae12a176fbfac648d7da6b7c7a4d75c108830b7.source: Decades of meddling by the U.S. has created these unstable situations in the Middle East. We should have withheld our support for Mubarak when he first took office, instead of giving him billions in military aid.
dae12a176fbfac648d7da6b7c7a4d75c108830b7.zh: 美国几十年来的干涉，造成了中东这些动荡局面。我们本该在穆巴拉克刚上台时就拒绝支持他，而不是给他数十亿美元的军事援助。

677165fd7c6f03ee37443c1325534dea1e61aba7.source: Decent, moderate response that shares the nation’s views, but it has harmed your reputation within your base.
677165fd7c6f03ee37443c1325534dea1e61aba7.zh: 这是个不错的温和回应，与全国的看法一致，却损害了你在基本盘中的声望。

89b8ffb743708b9726afe5e671080a8b8af4243c.source: Deeply religious and traditional in their outlook. May support some exceptions but is generally pro-life. Views homosexuality as a sin and opposes gay marriage. Supports traditional family structures and is also a supporter of gun rights.
89b8ffb743708b9726afe5e671080a8b8af4243c.zh: 信仰虔诚，观念传统。可能支持某些例外，但总体反对堕胎。视同性恋为罪，反对同性婚姻。支持传统家庭结构，也支持持枪权。

34560f6c0da516ad28db28b23840b50358b42eb5.source: Democrat or Republican, we all need to take this situation extremely seriously and listen to qualified medical experts like Dr. Anthony Fauci. I like to call him Tony, he's a hell of a guy!
34560f6c0da516ad28db28b23840b50358b42eb5.zh: 无论民主党还是共和党，我们都需要极其认真地对待局势，听取安东尼·福奇医生等合格医学专家的意见。我喜欢叫他托尼，他真是个了不起的人！

caf146f65d9b28e432a58f8f0acfeb565dbf5637.source: Democratic management of the economy these past eight years has been a clear success. I will continue to protect our unions and support the economy with smart government action.
caf146f65d9b28e432a58f8f0acfeb565dbf5637.zh: 民主党过去八年的经济管理显然是成功的。我会继续保护工会，并通过明智的政府行动支持经济发展。

e659af495f2c8b2ee90495fa0ee1e5a7f76a5030.source: Democratic moderates rejoice at your words, while the liberals fume and declare you no better than Nixon.
e659af495f2c8b2ee90495fa0ee1e5a7f76a5030.zh: 民主党温和派为你的话欢呼，自由派却怒不可遏，声称你与尼克松没什么两样。

f0c487e2029041518f0e4b53519226e57a88244d.source: Democrats are stunned by your complete reversal, which won’t bode well for you this November.
f0c487e2029041518f0e4b53519226e57a88244d.zh: 民主党人对你彻底转变立场感到震惊。这对你十一月的选情可不是好兆头。

ae01bca50b4a101ed77a4ad30998b7a3b446e2d1.source: Democrats are sure to be miffed, especially so if they lost, but you couldn’t care less at this moment. Good luck in 2004!
ae01bca50b4a101ed77a4ad30998b7a3b446e2d1.zh: 民主党人肯定会很生气，尤其是如果他们输了，但你现在不能不在乎。祝你2004年好运！

96ffabdd840b07bb83c669a29104900c34093a38.source: Democrats keep saying these allegations are debunked and that there's no evidence. Can you imagine what they'd be saying if one of my kids was doing cocaine, making $1 million a year in Ukraine? This is media hypocrisy at its finest.
96ffabdd840b07bb83c669a29104900c34093a38.zh: 民主党不停地说，这些指控已被驳倒，没有证据。你能想象吗，要是我的哪个孩子吸可卡因，每年在乌克兰赚一百万美元，他们会怎么说？媒体的虚伪真是登峰造极。

54062deb9fa096c7bd1d1f0d6bfabd095ea19081.source: Despite the environment seemingly being perfect for a Nixon comeback, you had a sudden and shocking reversal of fortunes, and have lost yet another presidential election. Republicans are shocked they have now lost 8 of the last 10 presidential elections. Not only did you lose, but you got crushed. Under the weight of two ideologically different candidates, your moderate positions seemed to not appeal. If the skirmish between liberal and conservative republicans wasn’t already bad, it was going to get a lot worse after this.
54062deb9fa096c7bd1d1f0d6bfabd095ea19081.zh: 尽管环境似乎非常适合 尼克松 卷土重来，但你的命运突然发生了令人震惊的逆转，并再次输掉了总统选举。共和党人感到震惊的是，他们在过去 10 次总统选举中输掉了 8 次。你不仅输了，还被压垮了。在两位意识形态不同的候选人的压力下，你的温和立场似乎没有吸引力。如果自由派和保守派共和党人之间的冲突还不算严重的话，那么此后情况将会变得更糟。

d8a25d60242c55d3dddaea43cd59e3ee63729201.source: Despite the environment seemingly being perfect for a Nixon comeback, you had a sudden and shocking reversal of fortunes, and have lost yet another presidential election. Republicans are shocked they have now lost 8 of the last 10 presidential elections. Somehow you managed to do worse compared to 1960. Nobody is quite sure how that is even possible, but suffice it to say you will receive much of the blame.
d8a25d60242c55d3dddaea43cd59e3ee63729201.zh: 尽管环境似乎非常适合 尼克松 卷土重来，但你的命运突然发生了令人震惊的逆转，并再次输掉了总统选举。共和党人感到震惊的是，他们在过去 10 次总统选举中输掉了 8 次。不知何故，与 1960 年相比，你的表现更差了。没有人完全确定这怎么可能，但足以说明你将受到大部分指责。

cf5032b19d4701ae1f2dbd0be4d0bae52c513236.source: Despite the popularity of Reagan, it seems the American public was ready to move on to a more left-wing president. Dukakis will likely overturn much of the excessive tax cuts of Reagan, and expand social security. Conservativism still has a market, however,  in the American population, as it was a fairly close election. Unfortunately, it was likely your lack of independence from Reagan that caused it. Perhaps a more assertive candidate could run in 4 years?
cf5032b19d4701ae1f2dbd0be4d0bae52c513236.zh: 尽管里根广受欢迎，美国公众似乎还是准备迎接一位更偏左的总统。杜卡基斯很可能撤销里根许多过度减税的措施，并扩大社会保障。不过，这场选举相当接近，说明保守主义在美国民众中仍有市场。遗憾的是，败选很可能是因为你未能展现出足够独立于里根的形象。也许四年后可以让一位更有主见的候选人出马？

190e80f535cf92a50e2507991fe91c8ffb3f59b2.source: Despite the popularity of Reagan, it seems the American public was ready to move on to a more left-wing president. Dukakis will overturn much of the excessive tax cuts of Reagan, and expand social security. Many are shocked you lost by such a large margin and are calling into question if you were even fit for the vice presidency in the first place, or just road the wave of Reagan popularity  .
190e80f535cf92a50e2507991fe91c8ffb3f59b2.zh: 尽管里根广受欢迎，美国公众似乎还是准备迎接一位更偏左的总统。杜卡基斯将撤销里根许多过度减税的措施，并扩大社会保障。许多人震惊于你输得如此惨重，开始怀疑你当初是否有资格担任副总统，还是只是搭上了里根受欢迎的顺风车。

722d0f9f95e2660e450e8834ed98827298525462.source: Democrats like to portray themselves as stronger on racial justice issues. Maybe your best strategy is, indeed, to turn the tables on them. When is the last time Republicans ran anything in Minneapolis?
722d0f9f95e2660e450e8834ed98827298525462.zh: 民主党喜欢把自己描绘成更坚定支持种族公正的一方。也许，你最好的策略确实是反过来攻击他们。共和党上次在明尼阿波利斯掌管什么，是什么时候？

ff38ad7ed5053156be10e03525e4bf9670c95c38.source: Democrats who believe in the gold standard are welcome in our party. We will increase tariffs, to be sure, but in a moderate way that addresses their concerns.
ff38ad7ed5053156be10e03525e4bf9670c95c38.zh: 我们党欢迎支持金本位的民主党人。当然，我们会提高关税，但会采取温和的方式，照顾他们的顾虑。

606de594b6ea4fb9e3f8e51e80df0bd5f6acf30f.source: Dennis Kucinich is a former Congressman from Ohio, and also served as the mayor of Cleveland for two years in the 1970s.
606de594b6ea4fb9e3f8e51e80df0bd5f6acf30f.zh: 丹尼斯·库西尼奇 是来自 俄亥俄州 的前国会议员，并在 1970 年代担任克利夫兰市长两年。

d7b80c12cf898e9be12d69782c5cf6eb87f8c307.source: Depending on your goals, this could be a reasonable course of action.
d7b80c12cf898e9be12d69782c5cf6eb87f8c307.zh: 这或许是个合理做法，取决于你的目标。

0f1bffb049359d526f405b85e9d4c57b65eb43b6.source: Depending on your strategy this fall, this could be a good answer to galvanize the liberal Republican wing.
0f1bffb049359d526f405b85e9d4c57b65eb43b6.zh: 这是否合适，取决于你今年秋季的策略；它可能是激发党内自由派热情的好回答。

8c1d762a419c2f887d68b184694d6d78c7c9eb8a.source: Despite another challenge being thrown at you, you've cast aside George Bush and flipped the script on the Republicans, allowing Democrats to win their own 3 presidential elections in a row. Another commanding win for the Democrats as well, and with this, you have flipped both chambers back. Who cares about 1994, anyways?
8c1d762a419c2f887d68b184694d6d78c7c9eb8a.zh: 尽管又一场挑战摆在面前，你还是击退了乔治·布什，逆转了共和党人的如意算盘，让民主党自己也连续赢得三次总统大选。这又是民主党一次压倒性的胜利，你也因此夺回了两院。现在谁还在乎1994年呢？

999efd985293a9fa78dd51b98639c19a8ab7647b.source: Despite another challenge being thrown at you, you've cast aside George Bush and flipped the script on the Republicans, allowing Democrats to win their own 3 presidential elections in a row. The house and Senate have tightened up in your favour, but you will still have to appeal to moderate Democrats to pass legislation.
999efd985293a9fa78dd51b98639c19a8ab7647b.zh: 尽管又一场挑战摆在面前，你还是击退了乔治·布什，逆转了共和党人的如意算盘，让民主党自己也连续赢得三次总统大选。众参两院的席位变化对你有利，不过你仍须争取温和派民主党人，才能通过立法。

df14739afbbf49537cb4d26bf46e1ab766364404.source: Despite another challenge being thrown at you, you've cast aside George Bush and flipped the script on the Republicans, allowing Democrats to win their own 3 presidential elections in a row. Unfortunately, your win was nowhere near as big as Clinton's, so the chambers are in the Republicans favour for now.
df14739afbbf49537cb4d26bf46e1ab766364404.zh: 尽管又一场挑战摆在面前，你还是击退了乔治·布什，逆转了共和党人的如意算盘，让民主党自己也连续赢得三次总统大选。可惜，你的胜选优势远不及克林顿，因此两院目前仍对共和党有利。

025afc8f9fc0c03294d99381cfca144cec221db0.source: Despite the environment seemingly being perfect for a Nixon comeback, you had a sudden and shocking reversal of fortunes, and have lost yet another presidential election. Republicans are shocked they have now lost 7 of the last 9 presidential elections. With the margins being as close as 8 years ago, you are already having flashbacks of 1960.
025afc8f9fc0c03294d99381cfca144cec221db0.zh: 尽管环境似乎非常适合 尼克松 卷土重来，但你的命运突然发生了令人震惊的逆转，并再次输掉了总统选举。共和党人对他们在过去 9 次总统选举中输掉 7 次感到震惊。时间间隔已接近 8 年前，你已经可以回想起 1960 年的情景了。

bca9610c0d015f37f01d55c71b8697b077e72e4e.source: Despite your best efforts in a tough climate, Richard Nixon will succeed Johnson in the presidency. It was always going to be difficult being so closely associated with an unpopular administration, in a divided party. It seems liberalism very well might be over with this loss, as you have been crushed. A more moderate candidate in 4 years will likely be chosen.
bca9610c0d015f37f01d55c71b8697b077e72e4e.zh: 尽管你在艰难局势下竭尽全力，理查德·尼克松仍将接替约翰逊担任总统。你与一个不受欢迎的政府关系如此密切，党内又四分五裂，竞选注定艰难。你遭遇惨败，这场失利似乎很可能意味着自由主义的终结。四年后，民主党大概会选择更温和的候选人。

44afc6923ee0078bbc04c6b8b20e74b4da0e485b.source: Despite your best efforts in a tough climate, Richard Nixon will succeed Johnson in the presidency. It was always going to be difficult being so closely associated with an unpopular administration, in a divided party. The crime and rioting took a toll on your campaign hard, and Nixon's law and order theme really hit home for many Americans.
44afc6923ee0078bbc04c6b8b20e74b4da0e485b.zh: 尽管你在艰难局势下竭尽全力，理查德·尼克松仍将接替约翰逊担任总统。你与一个不受欢迎的政府关系如此密切，党内又四分五裂，竞选注定艰难。犯罪和骚乱严重拖累了你的竞选，而尼克松的法律与秩序主题，确实说到了许多美国人心里。

7bc6034782d236dc8d81e308506832a22be74f72.source: Despite your best efforts in a tough climate, Richard Nixon will succeed Johnson in the presidency. It was always going to be difficult being so closely associated with an unpopular administration, in a divided party. You still fought hard, and took Nixon to the brink as Kennedy did in 60.
7bc6034782d236dc8d81e308506832a22be74f72.zh: 尽管你在艰难局势下竭尽全力，理查德·尼克松仍将接替约翰逊担任总统。你与一个不受欢迎的政府关系如此密切，党内又四分五裂，竞选注定艰难。不过，你仍然奋力一战，像肯尼迪在1960年那样，把尼克松逼到了胜负边缘。

a35ecff25267a217455fd1119f0fece5db241212.source: Despite your best efforts, Al Gore will succeed Clinton in the presidency. Many Republicans are disappointed with your loss, seeing the Monica Lewinsky scandal, among others a real opening for them to return to the White House. Gore flipping the House and Senate will give him some breathing room, but with the slim margins, he will have his work cut out for him.
a35ecff25267a217455fd1119f0fece5db241212.zh: 尽管您尽了最大努力，阿尔·戈尔仍将成功克林顿担任总统。许多共和党人对你的失败感到失望，认为莫妮卡·莱温斯基丑闻等为他们重返白宫提供了真正的机会。 戈尔 翻转众议院和参议院会给他一些喘息的空间，但由于利润微薄，他的工作将会很困难。

2143be2a960837c680500a2a609852bd5f27426e.source: Despite your best efforts, Al Gore will succeed Clinton in the presidency. Many Republicans are disappointed with your loss, seeing the Monica Lewinsky scandal, among others a real opening for them to return to the White House. Many are shocked at the margin you lost by, seeing the Lewinsky scandal as giving a lot of socially conservative states the impetus to vote for you. Many it really IS just the economy that matters.
2143be2a960837c680500a2a609852bd5f27426e.zh: 尽管您尽了最大努力，阿尔·戈尔仍将成功克林顿担任总统。许多共和党人对你的失败感到失望，认为莫妮卡·莱温斯基丑闻等为他们重返白宫提供了真正的机会。许多人对你的落败感到震惊，认为莱温斯基丑闻给了许多社会保守派州投票给你的动力。对许多人来说，真正重要的只是经济。

d89b4b234d80ba12f6aac88b0dcfa78bf9b763c5.source: Despite the popularity of Reagan, it seems the American public was ready to move on to a more left-wing president. Dukakis will overturn much of the excessive tax cuts of Reagan, and expand social security. You, Let’s unfortunately, were not able to capitalize on the many political mistakes of Dukakis's career, and Republicans are disappointed that they couldn't keep the White House.
d89b4b234d80ba12f6aac88b0dcfa78bf9b763c5.zh: 尽管里根广受欢迎，美国公众似乎还是准备迎接一位更偏左的总统。杜卡基斯将撤销里根许多过度减税的措施，并扩大社会保障。遗憾的是，你未能利用杜卡基斯政治生涯中的诸多失误，共和党人对没能保住白宫感到失望。

2e32238d2051a020b973807db490dc5405665a28.source: Despite the seemingly endless confidence everyone around the world had in you winning, you just weren't able to pull through. It seems the endless barrage of right-wing attacks was just too much for you to handle. Time will tell what Trump does in office, although with gains in both chambers for Democrats, he will certainly have to tone down some of his promises.
2e32238d2051a020b973807db490dc5405665a28.zh: 尽管世界各地的人似乎都坚信你会获胜，你还是没能坚持到最后。看来右翼无休止的攻击实在让你难以招架。时间会告诉我们特朗普执政后会做什么。不过，民主党在两院都有斩获，他肯定得收敛一些竞选承诺。

ead592c6039dfcaf2f8d5cc1ae0492fcb0365405.source: Despite the seemingly endless confidence everyone around the world had in you winning, you just weren't able to pull through. It seems the endless barrage of right-wing attacks was just too much for you to handle. Time will tell what Trump does in office, although with similar margins in the House and Senate to 2014, he will have not too much resistance.
ead592c6039dfcaf2f8d5cc1ae0492fcb0365405.zh: 尽管世界各地的人似乎都坚信你会获胜，你还是没能坚持到最后。看来右翼无休止的攻击实在让你难以招架。时间会告诉我们特朗普执政后会做什么。不过，参众两院的席位差距与2014年相近，他不会遇到太多阻力。

7a9f84b72c104ade84ddc1bbd377341981b708f2.source: Despite the seemingly endless confidence everyone around the world had in you winning, you just weren't able to pull through. It seems the endless barrage of right-wing attacks was just too much for you to handle. Time will tell what Trump does in office, although with the gains they make in each chamber, the only respite the Democrats will have is the midterms.
7a9f84b72c104ade84ddc1bbd377341981b708f2.zh: 尽管世界各地的人似乎都坚信你会获胜，你还是没能坚持到最后。看来右翼无休止的攻击实在让你难以招架。时间会告诉我们特朗普执政后会做什么。不过，共和党在两院都扩大了优势，民主党唯一能指望喘口气的机会就是中期选举。

bf55aeeeddcb04f7063d37cdc52c5a95954979d4.source: Despite you and him having a rocky relationship, Sims is nonetheless a talented a talented speechwriter, and could strengthen your campaigning—as long as you stay on prompter.
bf55aeeeddcb04f7063d37cdc52c5a95954979d4.zh: 尽管你们的关系不太融洽，西姆斯仍是一位才华横溢的演讲撰稿人，能增强你的竞选表现——只要你照着提词器念。

496076415cbc8c0e6d3f0e5887d50e37fc69a445.source: Despite your best effo- whoa. You, uh, REALLY didn't do well. Huh. Biden really won this election, huh? You'd expect such a margin from an inspiring leader, a charismatic Kennedy or Clinton character (not Hillary though), but not from Joe Biden. Some Democrats are starting to, shockingly, believe your accusations. The next few months will be interesting, Donald.
496076415cbc8c0e6d3f0e5887d50e37fc69a445.zh: 尽管你拼尽全——哇。你，呃，还真是表现不佳啊。嗯，拜登真的赢了这场选举，是吗？这么大的优势，人们会想到鼓舞人心的领袖，像肯尼迪或克林顿那样富有魅力的人——可不是希拉里——但不会想到乔·拜登。令人震惊的是，一些民主党人开始相信你的指控了。未来几个月会很有意思，唐纳德。

7613ff121ba586294675997930a098b7f8d337c8.source: Despite your failure, however, the door has been opened for your followers, like Ronald Reagan, to enter Republican politics as mainstream candidates. On another note, the Southern Strategy appears to have worked in full, and Republican strategists are already taking notes on how to exploit the now wide-open South. Though your chapter may be closed, a new chapter of the Republican Party may just be beginning. In any case, your popularity in Arizona remains. Perhaps another term in the Senate is in your future?
7613ff121ba586294675997930a098b7f8d337c8.zh: 然而，尽管你失败了，但你的追随者（例如 罗纳德·里根）作为主流候选人进入共和党政治的大门已经打开。另一方面，南方战略 似乎已经完全发挥作用，共和党战略家已经在记录如何利用现在完全开放的南方。尽管您的章节可能已经结束，但 共和党 的新章节可能才刚刚开始。无论如何，你在亚利桑那州中的受欢迎程度仍然存在。也许你的未来会再连任参议院一届？

34efedb1fb1eebf98806a1dd4e4a8dc2f11c11a4.source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. But my god. Did you EVER lose. The polls were wrong, sure, but in the OPPOSITE direction. Democrats are shocked, poll companies are confused, liberals vindicated, and in the middle of it all, your supporters, metaphorically shaking with anger and grief. You are about to give a press conference on the election results. Make sure you play your cards right so that you can save your image for history.
34efedb1fb1eebf98806a1dd4e4a8dc2f11c11a4.zh: 尽管你已经竭尽全力，乔·拜登仍当选美国总统。不出所料，你的支持者因瞌睡乔当选而震惊、愤怒，他的支持者则为你被赶下台而兴奋。可是，天哪，你输得可真惨。民调确实错了，却错在相反方向。民主党震惊，民调公司困惑，自由派觉得自己终于扬眉吐气。在这一切当中，你的支持者因愤怒和悲伤而浑身发抖——这是一种形容。你即将就选举结果召开新闻发布会，一定要出好手中的牌，保住自己在历史上的形象。

7c9235fccb4fe9e675113294f77f2d6a92042da9.source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. Ironically, your loss margin is identical to that of Hillary in 2016. It seems the red wave of yours never quite panned out, although your Trump poll effect did, as many pundits had you not surpassing 200 votes.
7c9235fccb4fe9e675113294f77f2d6a92042da9.zh: 尽管你已经竭尽全力，乔·拜登仍当选美国总统。不出所料，你的支持者因瞌睡乔当选而震惊、愤怒，他的支持者则为你被赶下台而兴奋。讽刺的是，你落败的差距与希拉里2016年完全相同。看来，你的红色浪潮终究没有出现，不过，你的特朗普民调效应倒出现了，因为许多评论人士曾认为你拿不到超过200票。

a56c2eb53fed774673ddb38af4f78dc1fc2e85f0.source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. Pollsters and Democrats are happy, as the polls were much more accurate this time around. Your base, on the other hand is livid, decrying every state as being fraudulently involved. You are about to give a press conference on the election results. Make sure you play your cards right.
a56c2eb53fed774673ddb38af4f78dc1fc2e85f0.zh: 尽管你已经竭尽全力，乔·拜登仍当选美国总统。不出所料，你的支持者因瞌睡乔当选而震惊、愤怒，他的支持者则为你被赶下台而兴奋。民调机构和民主党很高兴，这次民调准确得多。你的基本盘却怒不可遏，指责每个州都卷入了舞弊。你即将就选举结果召开新闻发布会，一定要出好手中的牌。

4b11e187c5ce9004f209f549a1405fdae6d2273e.source: Despite your best efforts, Al Gore will succeed Clinton in the presidency. Many Republicans are disappointed with your loss, seeing the Monica Lewinsky scandal, among others a real opening for them to return to the White House. The closeness of the election will likely inspire Gore to be a bit more moderate and bipartisan in his decision-making. With the close Senate, it will certainly be needed.
4b11e187c5ce9004f209f549a1405fdae6d2273e.zh: 尽管您尽了最大努力，阿尔·戈尔仍将成功克林顿担任总统。许多共和党人对你的失败感到失望，认为莫妮卡·莱温斯基丑闻等为他们重返白宫提供了真正的机会。选举的接近可能会促使戈尔在决策中更加温和和两党合作。由于参议院关系密切，这肯定是必要的。

c70368de448da18fb9c4da97d3392e86ac03e527.source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. America showed they wanted an outsider, and Carter managed to take that title. Let's hope he can help restore faith in government, and help the inflation die down.
c70368de448da18fb9c4da97d3392e86ac03e527.zh: 尽管竭尽全力，你还是败给了吉米·卡特，成为唯一一位从未通过选举进入白宫的总统。水门事件和越南战争造成的负担，实在让你难以承受。美国表明自己想要一个局外人，而卡特成功占据了这个位置。希望他能恢复民众对政府的信任，让通胀降下来。

d15b43be2f321bc75446ab87f3c4eefb530b87d1.source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. The recovering economy, however, made this election quite close, so you can take solace in the fact that you went down swinging.
d15b43be2f321bc75446ab87f3c4eefb530b87d1.zh: 尽管竭尽全力，你还是败给了吉米·卡特，成为唯一一位从未通过选举进入白宫的总统。水门事件和越南战争造成的负担，实在让你难以承受。不过，正在复苏的经济让选举非常接近。你可以安慰自己：至少你一直战斗到了最后。

a6bf4f6f58c5f249f6043ef22fbf39372f0b7e9a.source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. Your Watergate pardon might go down as one of the most blunderous moves in political history, as otherwise, you might have been able to disassociate yourself with Nixon. You, accordingly, got beaten by a larger than expected margin.
a6bf4f6f58c5f249f6043ef22fbf39372f0b7e9a.zh: 尽管竭尽全力，你还是败给了吉米·卡特，成为唯一一位从未通过选举进入白宫的总统。水门事件和越南战争造成的负担，实在让你难以承受。你对尼克松的赦免，可能会被视为政治史上最严重的失策之一，否则你也许能与尼克松撇清关系。因此，你遭遇了比预料更大的败选差距。

1294d2b4c502163880f025d688c37862347aafbe.source: Despite your best efforts, perhaps it was always an impossible task to beat an incumbent as strong as Johnson from the position you began in. You were certainly never favored, so this comes as no surprise to anyone.
1294d2b4c502163880f025d688c37862347aafbe.zh: 尽管你尽了最大努力，但从你开始的位置上击败像 约翰逊 这样强大的现任者也许始终是一项不可能的任务。你当然从未受到青睐，所以这对任何人来说都不足为奇。

6dc8d7ce5bf95a690de4ac8f6d82654c9ce38e46.source: Despite your best efforts, the Bobby Baker trial remains as an ugly mark for Goldwater to needle you on.
6dc8d7ce5bf95a690de4ac8f6d82654c9ce38e46.zh: 尽管你已竭尽全力，博比·贝克的审判仍然是一处难看的污点，让戈德华特能够继续拿来刺痛你。

80c75a03b56a997d11ad69e2fdb6c6a04bd6ef20.source: Despite your best efforts, there’s no question about it- there’s a massive divide between the Northern, integrationist wing and the Southern, segregationist wing of the Democratic Party. Do you have a plan on bringing the two back together- at the least, for this election?
80c75a03b56a997d11ad69e2fdb6c6a04bd6ef20.zh: 尽管你已竭尽全力，但事实不容否认：民主党内支持种族融合的北方派与支持种族隔离的南方派之间，存在巨大分歧。你有办法让双方重新团结起来吗？至少在这次选举中？

42b5e6e77c948761fbcf06c6abc8bc478f9cd110.source: Did you just say that we should be giving condoms to twelve year olds? Because that's what a lot of your supporters heard, and they can't believe their ears.
42b5e6e77c948761fbcf06c6abc8bc478f9cd110.zh: 你刚才说，要给十二岁的孩子发避孕套？你的许多支持者听到的就是这个意思，他们简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

33d2f23211bea2209d704b8d45f87bc0472eebcd.source: Did you make any deals to reward New York in your administration, to get Horatio Seymour to agree to serve as your running mate?
33d2f23211bea2209d704b8d45f87bc0472eebcd.zh: 为了让霍雷肖·西摩同意担任竞选搭档，你是否达成过在未来政府中优待纽约州的交易？

ddc6c3163b9c543a39b614b1cbef5d396fdf42e9.source: Did you receive 5% of the popular vote? If so, congratulations! You will enable the Green Party to run a vigorous campaign in 2004 and present a true choice to the American people. Also, the Democrats were a little peeved that you "stole" votes from them in this election. Hopefully that doesn't lead to a backlash, especially since they will lose the vote in the House.
ddc6c3163b9c543a39b614b1cbef5d396fdf42e9.zh: 你获得了 5% 的普选票吗？如果是这样，恭喜你！您将使绿党在2004年开展一场轰轰烈烈的竞选活动，为美国人民提供一个真正的选择。另外，民主党对你在这次选举中“偷”了他们的选票感到有点恼火。希望这不会引起强烈反对，特别是因为他们将在众议院失去投票权。

c230f2c162d3577236da38fd6541ed79eebc2eb3.source: Did you seriously just say on a live mic that you favor raising the income tax? And you're a Republican? Your chances of winning this election may have just gone up in smoke.
c230f2c162d3577236da38fd6541ed79eebc2eb3.zh: 你刚才真的对着开着的麦克风说，你支持提高所得税？而你还是个共和党人？你赢得这次选举的机会，可能刚刚就化为乌有了。

2b02db83a7e943dc7b599e0151b97d32d6a1dadc.source: Did you support Bill Clinton's actions leading to the bombing of Serbia?
2b02db83a7e943dc7b599e0151b97d32d6a1dadc.zh: 你支持比尔·克林顿采取导致轰炸塞尔维亚的那些行动吗？

3df11339e3f55c36bc1291bf9c38a03bff54c023.source: Did you support Lyndon Johnson's 1965 intervention in the Dominican Republic?
3df11339e3f55c36bc1291bf9c38a03bff54c023.zh: 你支持林登·约翰逊1965年对多米尼加共和国的干预吗？

3ab48518b2922c61cfb57f5c562119d0d8c59aa3.source: Did you watch the protests at all? What kind of compromise are you suggesting?
3ab48518b2922c61cfb57f5c562119d0d8c59aa3.zh: 你到底看没看那些抗议？你说的是哪一种妥协？

d61e6d08529c0e53dc00128fbcc34de0cdcf92e8.source: Didn't Nixon invent this tactic as a cheap political ploy in the 1960s? This is far from the best way for someone to display their patriotism.
d61e6d08529c0e53dc00128fbcc34de0cdcf92e8.zh: 这招不是尼克松在1960年代想出来的廉价政治把戏吗？这远不是表达爱国心的最佳办法。

e16f4a96fe3bd640428d32a0dcbcb1a42141d9cd.source: Digital History - The Disputed Election of 2000
e16f4a96fe3bd640428d32a0dcbcb1a42141d9cd.zh: 数字历史 - 2000 年有争议的选举

d7c6a8d8b7e4aef509d08b099e8c6b9f7e78b349.source: Dirksen will give you conservative credibility without much baggage on unions, economics, or civil rights. And he could make the difference in Illinois.
d7c6a8d8b7e4aef509d08b099e8c6b9f7e78b349.zh: 德克森能增强你在保守派眼中的可信度，又不会在工会、经济或民权问题上带来太多政治包袱。他也可能成为赢下伊利诺伊州的关键。

c18294bb12f632f06fe3e4537ef5986ad2ea3fe6.source: Disagreements are fine, but at some point you have to temper the open hostility towards the Republican establishment if you want to have a shot.
c18294bb12f632f06fe3e4537ef5986ad2ea3fe6.zh: 有分歧没关系，但如果你想有胜算，到某个时候，就得收敛对共和党建制派公开表现出的敌意。

f388e8f75495bc80aa6a5dd1b3f3b4efd63c58ad.source: Dixie forever! Even with the Long Hot Summer of 1967, nobody guessed that you could do well enough in the Northern states to win the election outright. You have instantly become most polarizing President-elect since Abraham Lincoln.
f388e8f75495bc80aa6a5dd1b3f3b4efd63c58ad.zh: 永远的迪克西！即使 1967 年漫长炎热的夏季，也没有人想到你能在北部各州表现出色，彻底赢得选举。您立即成为自亚伯拉罕·林肯以来最两极分化的当选总统。

8d69b8c84686704be8e2e5fa0707745cb89b7e9b.source: Do FEMA insurance payouts encourage real estate developers to build in disaster prone areas?
8d69b8c84686704be8e2e5fa0707745cb89b7e9b.zh: 联邦紧急事务管理署支付的保险赔款，是否鼓励房地产开发商在容易受灾的地区建房？

25debe7e2e6c4a3554ec45993cadfb6ca0d211a6.source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. The margin of victory, however, was razor-thin, even more so than four years prior. Recount efforts from your supporters and governments are already underway, with Democrats begrudgingly moving along with it. Your supporters are even more rabid with the margin and are calling on VP Pence to overturn the election. You are about to give a press conference on the election results. Make sure you play your cards right.
25debe7e2e6c4a3554ec45993cadfb6ca0d211a6.zh: 尽管你已经竭尽全力，乔·拜登仍当选美国总统。不出所料，你的支持者因瞌睡乔当选而震惊、愤怒，他的支持者则为你被赶下台而兴奋。不过，胜选差距极其微弱，比四年前还小。你的支持者和政府方面已经展开重新计票，民主党虽不情愿，也配合推进。如此微弱的差距，让你的支持者更加狂躁，他们呼吁副总统彭斯推翻选举结果。你即将就选举结果召开新闻发布会，一定要出好手中的牌。

98add8e2d6357705c07c24b19e46fbd4ce372e95.source: Despite your most valiant efforts, Joe Biden has been elected to the US presidency. As expected, your supporters are shocked and furious Sleepy Joe has been elected, and his supporters are thrilled that you are being ousted. The polls were much more accurate this time, as you lost a few southern states, but it always could have been worse. Recounts are unlikely to change much of the result, but you're going to initiate them anyways.
98add8e2d6357705c07c24b19e46fbd4ce372e95.zh: 尽管你已经竭尽全力，乔·拜登仍当选美国总统。不出所料，你的支持者因瞌睡乔当选而震惊、愤怒，他的支持者则为你被赶下台而兴奋。这次民调准确得多，你输掉了几个南方州，不过结果本来可能更糟。重新计票大概改变不了多少，但你还是要启动。

91a3eb3df892c89a2e47f7daef481910b2a60843.source: Dick Cheney is a principled conservative leader. The two of us will govern over a conservative, patriotic administration. Let's turn the page from the Clinton era.
91a3eb3df892c89a2e47f7daef481910b2a60843.zh: 迪克·切尼是一位有原则的保守派领导人。我们两人将领导一届保守、爱国的政府。让我们翻过克林顿时代这一页。

cc587aa0fbd31c0095b3a5fc45d59ee684bce4c8.source: Dick Cheney is a seasoned operative of the Republican Party who has served as White House Chief of Staff, Minority Whip in Congress, Secretary of Defense, and as CEO of Halliburton. He would be a respected choice across the Republican spectrum, and would add experience and gravitas to the Republican ticket.
cc587aa0fbd31c0095b3a5fc45d59ee684bce4c8.zh: 迪克·切尼 是 共和党 的一名经验丰富的特工，曾担任 白宫 参谋长、国会少数党党鞭、国防部长和哈里伯顿首席执行官。他将是整个共和党派系中受人尊敬的选择，并将为共和党选票增添经验和庄严。

05fa889d7939ce8f3848651ed5eef03eb015c084.source: Dick Cheney is the best person for the job. He has served in all kinds of roles and performed admirably in every case.
05fa889d7939ce8f3848651ed5eef03eb015c084.zh: 迪克·切尼是最适合这份工作的人。他曾担任各种职务，每次都表现出色。

a1d2dddb3ffb90136a5a3d8343770781e6e87f86.source: Did Dwight Eisenhower do the right thing when he sent federal troops to Little Rock to ensure the integration of the high school there?
a1d2dddb3ffb90136a5a3d8343770781e6e87f86.zh: 德怀特·艾森豪威尔派遣联邦军队前往小石城，确保当地高中实行种族融合，这样做是否正确？

6ba6510dc5d9761523a6556ebf953c6a7b271385.source: Did the Supreme Court overstep its bounds in

611ad9241402b8d9e8127b7989f56789a068cc92.source: Did you just promise to escalate the war in Vietnam? This might make you popular in certain quarters, but it won't help you win this fall.
611ad9241402b8d9e8127b7989f56789a068cc92.zh: 你刚才是承诺要升级越南战争吗？这也许会让某些群体欢迎你，却无助于你赢得秋季选举。

cd3a380c98c234b7ebde367bbdeedcf3c6220853.source: Do you believe that some revenue should be set aside from our tariffs to finance internal improvements, such as canals and roads?
cd3a380c98c234b7ebde367bbdeedcf3c6220853.zh: 你是否认为，应当拨出部分关税收入，用于运河、道路等国内公共工程建设？

ac9ba4d77261b86b97c6accbe52f17b91386a627.source: Do you believe that the Senate should confirm Merrick Garland, an Obama appointee, to the Supreme Court?
ac9ba4d77261b86b97c6accbe52f17b91386a627.zh: 你认为，参议院应该批准奥巴马提名梅里克·加兰担任最高法院大法官吗？

c19dc92c941a8b24e75e900715e660e01ed490f0.source: Do you believe that the United States can afford a reduction in defense spending?
c19dc92c941a8b24e75e900715e660e01ed490f0.zh: 你认为美国承受得起削减国防支出吗？

b395020c2adc3f7a3d7c2ecd96721933372234c9.source: Do you believe that the black community in most cities overreacted to the assassination of Martin Luther King this past April?
b395020c2adc3f7a3d7c2ecd96721933372234c9.zh: 对于今年四月马丁·路德·金遇刺，你认为多数城市的黑人社区反应过度了吗？

efbae342d6e53a9d56c4dee36ef4a7cc6b6bd693.source: Do you believe that the federal government has any right to issue interest-bearing bonds, such as those sold to J.P. Morgan in 1895?
efbae342d6e53a9d56c4dee36ef4a7cc6b6bd693.zh: 你认为联邦政府有权发行付息债券吗，例如1895年向J. P. 摩根出售的那些债券？

7b1738a834175ffc3bc29f7b3dde676638054585.source: Do you believe that the federal government should monitor and improve important waterways in the interests of commerce, such as the Mississippi River?
7b1738a834175ffc3bc29f7b3dde676638054585.zh: 你认为，联邦政府应当为了商业利益，监督并改善密西西比河等重要水道吗？

a4362d6c002eab13b534b2bdcca24b96967a8ac9.source: Do you believe that the islands of Quemoy and Matsu should fall within the United States defense perimeter in Asia?
a4362d6c002eab13b534b2bdcca24b96967a8ac9.zh: 你认为，金门和马祖应当纳入美国在亚洲的防御范围吗？

8d2ad01214becf2caff1245a96ee64d76cbe35d3.source: Do you believe that the newly implemented federal welfare programs will be effective?
8d2ad01214becf2caff1245a96ee64d76cbe35d3.zh: 你认为新近实施的联邦福利项目能有效发挥作用吗？

6c6271044ad63171a3957fb7bcddce3173b9ed63.source: Do you believe that there should be federal funding for abortions?
6c6271044ad63171a3957fb7bcddce3173b9ed63.zh: 你认为联邦政府应当提供堕胎经费吗？

e8085744df4bd0d53e98c500755984418b226c69.source: Do you believe that voluntary prayer should be allowed in the nation's classrooms?
e8085744df4bd0d53e98c500755984418b226c69.zh: 你认为，应允许全国学校的课堂开展自愿祈祷吗？

62320e9f9469a183711f3edd8d965caa3096150a.source: Do you believe the United States is adequately prepared to defend against the Soviet threat over the next ten years?
62320e9f9469a183711f3edd8d965caa3096150a.zh: 你认为，美国是否已做好充分准备，应对未来十年的苏联威胁？

4b5968f58aee1bb4aa22828e392eca2696d6f098.source: Do you believe the federal government is doing enough to enforce laws against employing illegal immigrants?
4b5968f58aee1bb4aa22828e392eca2696d6f098.zh: 你认为，联邦政府在执行禁止雇用非法移民的法律方面做得够不够？

86710fa62c6675e5af9fc2575cc69710a6a1ea87.source: Do you have a position on the gun control issue?
86710fa62c6675e5af9fc2575cc69710a6a1ea87.zh: 你对枪支管制问题持什么立场？

dd7b10b2b6ce3e921437c3ccef73deb22b0e00ee.source: Do you have a position to take on the calls for the prohibition of alcohol as you campaign this fall?
dd7b10b2b6ce3e921437c3ccef73deb22b0e00ee.zh: 今年秋季竞选时，对于禁酒的呼声，你会采取什么立场？

fe40c4ce9ed7ac06e15a8a6336c1d90dba067458.source: Do you have a rebuttal for allegations that anti-slavery measures will result in a flood of free blacks into the Northern states and the territories?
fe40c4ce9ed7ac06e15a8a6336c1d90dba067458.zh: 有人声称，反奴隶制措施会导致大量自由黑人涌入北方各州和领地。你准备反驳吗？

d351b3848334430b72438a90ca60bb7fcbdfd9d8.source: Do you have any comment on the paramilitary “Wide Awake” clubs that have marched in support of Republicans?
d351b3848334430b72438a90ca60bb7fcbdfd9d8.zh: 对于那些列队游行支持共和党的准军事化“觉醒者”社团，你有什么评论？

61bc8d5259dbdb41f45dcac5512f2d43ba514a2a.source: Do you have any comments on the

07644ad2d9d41f21788c4613f6a3814a745cb722.source: Do I even need to stoop down to the level of CNN and the New York Times? The most important thing is my agenda for American security, liberty, and prosperity.
07644ad2d9d41f21788c4613f6a3814a745cb722.zh: 我有必要自降身份，跟CNN和《纽约时报》纠缠吗？最重要的是，我保障美国安全、自由和繁荣的议程。

d7080531e3739aa6d660f1ea3825e9405a77f95e.source: Do we need more spending in the War on Poverty, especially in light of the riots since 1965?
d7080531e3739aa6d660f1ea3825e9405a77f95e.zh: 我们是否需要在向贫困宣战的项目上增加开支，尤其考虑到1965年以来的骚乱？

52cf1870d6817956d46a3605ae4095623cf26488.source: Do you advocate the international control of nuclear weapons under the United Nations?
52cf1870d6817956d46a3605ae4095623cf26488.zh: 你主张在联合国框架下，对核武器实行国际管制吗？

d7d7fb6e2a97b116663f5e6ed9019912c7c5bb8a.source: Do you agree with Robert Walker's letter, arguing that that slavery issue will be diluted by national expansion?
d7d7fb6e2a97b116663f5e6ed9019912c7c5bb8a.zh: 罗伯特·沃克在信中主张，国家扩张将淡化奴隶制问题。你同意他的观点吗？

391f4f6c241f87a2a67af001f61f89c6d8f1f848.source: Do you approve of Grover Cleveland's handing of the federal budget over the previous four years?
391f4f6c241f87a2a67af001f61f89c6d8f1f848.zh: 你赞同格罗弗·克利夫兰过去四年处理联邦预算的方式吗？

6dbcbb846dd4ebac29e65dd843dbd7d27d467feb.source: Do you believe it is appropriate for Hillary Clinton to run for Senate in the state of New York -- a state where she has never lived?
6dbcbb846dd4ebac29e65dd843dbd7d27d467feb.zh: 希拉里·克林顿从未在纽约州生活过，却要在那里竞选参议员。你认为这样合适吗？

ae77b65126297fef478ad320045a71cc4f0a4c5d.source: Do you believe that Cuba has been lost to the Communists as of this time? If so, do you think it is partially the fault of the United States?
ae77b65126297fef478ad320045a71cc4f0a4c5d.zh: 你认为，古巴目前是否已经落入共产党之手？如果是，美国是否负有部分责任？

825b4aeaea9ede7217bcf6b4c83c345fc61c9c3b.source: Do you believe that Edwin Meese should resign as Attorney General?
825b4aeaea9ede7217bcf6b4c83c345fc61c9c3b.zh: 你认为埃德温·米斯应辞去司法部长职务吗？

3ca9125a4d40f9612c5140753997ee8f9e711efc.source: Do you believe that Elian Gonzalez should have been returned to Cuba?
3ca9125a4d40f9612c5140753997ee8f9e711efc.zh: 你认为埃利安·冈萨雷斯当时应当被送回古巴吗？

bf62b1c1c868370b73a1c957a5092f738e8f8605.source: Do you believe that President Johnson overstepped his bounds in negotiating the Kennedy Round of trade agreements? Do you support the liberalization of international trade under the GATT?
bf62b1c1c868370b73a1c957a5092f738e8f8605.zh: 你认为约翰逊总统在谈判“肯尼迪回合”贸易协定时，超越了自己的权限吗？你支持在《关税及贸易总协定》框架下放宽国际贸易吗？

0e264951fb1c3f90d472baaaef1d1e5de3f06019.source: Do you believe that a Republican victory would result in a flood of free blacks into Northern states and western territories?
0e264951fb1c3f90d472baaaef1d1e5de3f06019.zh: 你是否认为，共和党获胜将导致大量自由黑人涌入北方各州和西部领地？

32a7ab7ecdc22c60393fefb043c9789c701f681c.source: Do you believe that any Southern Whig can call themselves a supporter of slavery, so long as Henry Clay equivocates on the Texas issue?
32a7ab7ecdc22c60393fefb043c9789c701f681c.zh: 只要亨利·克莱还在得克萨斯问题上含糊其辞，南方辉格党人就还能自称奴隶制的支持者吗？

98822bfcc3db1aca87f72091b9c4a0896bf12214.source: Do you believe that certain groups in the United States, for their own narrow interests, are trying to undermine American diplomacy and the global order?
98822bfcc3db1aca87f72091b9c4a0896bf12214.zh: 你认为，美国的某些群体正在为了自己狭隘的利益，破坏美国外交与全球秩序吗？

50df582bc9d76fb4ba14b6492a445410bd398340.source: Do you believe that current levels of defense spending are adequate?
50df582bc9d76fb4ba14b6492a445410bd398340.zh: 你认为目前的国防开支水平足够吗？

78c301057f0cc64aff700f82286fe369516720b4.source: Do you believe that free trade measures destroy more American jobs than they create?
78c301057f0cc64aff700f82286fe369516720b4.zh: 你认为，自由贸易措施使美国失去的工作岗位，比创造的更多吗？

1f79492c5a846c3036865e95aaef5112cb93ee9f.source: Do you believe that immigrant labor is undermining the American worker? Should there be some restrictions put into place on immigration?
1f79492c5a846c3036865e95aaef5112cb93ee9f.zh: 你认为，移民劳工正在损害美国工人的利益吗？应当对移民作出一些限制吗？

4575055ecdf9238faf8517fff3efc9c5105190d5.source: Do you have any comments to make about the candidacy of John Palmer, a Gold Democrat and splinter candidate who is currently campaigning?
4575055ecdf9238faf8517fff3efc9c5105190d5.zh: 约翰·帕尔默是支持金本位的民主党人，如今作为分裂派候选人开展竞选。你对他参选有什么评论？

cfa715adfed6f57143ce1ac5e108b8c2c2357771.source: Do you have any comments to make on the Soviet blockade of Berlin, and the airlift in progress to resupply that city?
cfa715adfed6f57143ce1ac5e108b8c2c2357771.zh: 对于苏联封锁柏林，以及正在进行、为该城补充物资的空运，你有什么意见？

66f1ac8ddda84cf5e44cbf461983d2027333e37a.source: Do you have any criticism of the authorities in Illinois, regarding their failure to properly protect Joseph Smith before his assassination in June?
66f1ac8ddda84cf5e44cbf461983d2027333e37a.zh: 约瑟夫·斯密在6月遭到暗杀前，伊利诺伊州当局未能妥善保护他。对此，你有什么批评？

cc71e0d5069ceceb58fbb2f71af4dd76a7de79a3.source: Do you have any plans to address or change immigration policy if elected President?
cc71e0d5069ceceb58fbb2f71af4dd76a7de79a3.zh: 如果当选总统，你打算处理移民问题或改变移民政策吗？

8f21feec80a98900f07398348f77534dbff4fad1.source: Do you have any plans to attack the nomination of Louis Brandeis to the Supreme Court?
8f21feec80a98900f07398348f77534dbff4fad1.zh: 你打算抨击路易斯·布兰代斯获提名出任最高法院大法官一事吗？

6c5a006e44e448b7679d4598c62d5b93e6064ed8.source: Do you have any plans to change American tax policy?
6c5a006e44e448b7679d4598c62d5b93e6064ed8.zh: 你打算改变美国的税收政策吗？

a5100261526449398bb8b70eafd498cd5ff6a057.source: Do you have any plans to help America's seniors better pay for vital prescription drugs?
a5100261526449398bb8b70eafd498cd5ff6a057.zh: 你打算帮助美国老年人，更好地负担必需的处方药吗？

c2c0201ca811ca32a6b66efe47fe8c74a4b4d450.source: Do you have any plans to reach out to your chief rival for the Republican nomination, William Seward, and reconcile?
c2c0201ca811ca32a6b66efe47fe8c74a4b4d450.zh: 你是否打算向共和党提名战中的主要对手威廉·苏厄德主动示好，与他和解？

ab38a28e3cfff572f8583c4f12ff0fbf602a9763.source: Do you have any statement on the presence of Theodore Frelinghuysen on the Whig ticket, and his association with known anti-Catholic agitators?
ab38a28e3cfff572f8583c4f12ff0fbf602a9763.zh: 西奥多·弗里林海森是辉格党的副总统候选人，又与一些知名的反天主教煽动者有交往。对此，你有什么声明？

a1eac1030a8b35047f1505bedfc45564143e98d5.source: Do you have any statement to make on John Calhoun's “Packenham Letter”, stating slavery to be a positive blessing, and justifying the annexation of Texas as a pro-slavery move?
a1eac1030a8b35047f1505bedfc45564143e98d5.zh: 约翰·卡尔霍恩在“致帕肯纳姆信”中，宣称奴隶制是积极的福祉，并以维护奴隶制为理由，论证吞并得克萨斯的正当性。对此，你有什么声明？

6b63422230e3a1a7f00b0818c456833aed34089f.source: Do you have any statements to make about the Easter Rebellion which transpired earlier this year in Ireland?
6b63422230e3a1a7f00b0818c456833aed34089f.zh: 对于今年早些时候发生在爱尔兰的复活节起义，你有什么意见？

3d81bb4a91d4a446d8fe1732f3e251b260395847.source: Do you have any statements to make about the Federal Reserve Act, which established the Federal Reserve in 1913?
3d81bb4a91d4a446d8fe1732f3e251b260395847.zh: 你对于1913年建立联邦储备制度的《联邦储备法》，有什么声明？

bfffcc5207da5965430d6a559a552d98ae735f3a.source: Do you have any statements to make about the Federal Trade Commission, established in 1914?
bfffcc5207da5965430d6a559a552d98ae735f3a.zh: 你对于1914年成立的联邦贸易委员会，有什么声明？

032995bfa8dbe679930f7aefe7ce6f446f4256fe.source: Do you have any statements to make in regards to gun control or the right to bear arms?
032995bfa8dbe679930f7aefe7ce6f446f4256fe.zh: 对于枪支管制或持有、携带武器的权利，你有什么声明？

55e2d41cb89d8e10a4da17e1435542380d57b544.source: Do you have any statements to make on the tariff question, and/or the recently established Tariff Commission, as you campaign?
55e2d41cb89d8e10a4da17e1435542380d57b544.zh: 竞选期间，你会就关税问题，以及最近成立的关税委员会发表什么意见吗？

038badfea9b9ef1786331f25aa335649fb892107.source: Do you have any thoughts on the Bill Clinton scandal that you would like to share?
038badfea9b9ef1786331f25aa335649fb892107.zh: 关于比尔·克林顿的丑闻，你有什么想说的吗？

e3278d80a110b8c2402f388495a9a58a92960513.source: Do you have anything to say about some of the stories that have circulated around your opponent's son, Hunter Biden?
e3278d80a110b8c2402f388495a9a58a92960513.zh: 对于围绕对手的儿子亨特·拜登流传的一些故事，你有什么话要说？

63acd1bea8fa7b01f4d1a15757451ef73fccb667.source: Do you have anything to say about the Iran-Contra affair, and can you reassure voters that you were not involved?
63acd1bea8fa7b01f4d1a15757451ef73fccb667.zh: 对于伊朗门事件，你有什么要说的吗？你能向选民保证自己没有参与吗？

7be1c2aee701d55a83c8c05fb0aacee53464326c.source: Do you have anything to say about the efforts of some to reopen the Atlantic slave trade?
7be1c2aee701d55a83c8c05fb0aacee53464326c.zh: 对于有人试图重启跨大西洋奴隶贸易，你有什么要说的？

561da9f63918dad3c13378ca0e914768dc0abb88.source: Do you have anything to say about your alleged drug use in the 1970s?
561da9f63918dad3c13378ca0e914768dc0abb88.zh: 对于有人指称你在20世纪70年代吸过毒，你有什么要说的？

da1bd2b631cb48b5ecd6a6b27747ff4333c4042d.source: Do you have anything to say about your relationship with Manuel Noriega of Panama?
da1bd2b631cb48b5ecd6a6b27747ff4333c4042d.zh: 对于你与巴拿马的曼努埃尔·诺列加的关系，你有什么要说的？

80f55ecdbb7b013e721d1cee26f394f7365f5102.source: Do you have plans to attack the Supreme Court for their ruling on gay marriage in 2015?
80f55ecdbb7b013e721d1cee26f394f7365f5102.zh: 你是否打算就最高法院2015年的同性婚姻判决攻击法院？

44c1f2adee8c3636d323b9136df5b7ddb976907b.source: Do you have plans to emphasize a path to universal health care in your campaign?
44c1f2adee8c3636d323b9136df5b7ddb976907b.zh: 你打算在竞选中强调迈向全民医疗保障的途径吗？

bd33d79e9eb675c89db02c84263254f6c8aa7cf3.source: Do you have plans to take in more than the current level of 10,000 refugees per annum from the conflict in Syria?
bd33d79e9eb675c89db02c84263254f6c8aa7cf3.zh: 目前每年接纳1万名因叙利亚冲突而逃难的难民，你是否打算增加这一数量？

8bcb573dedcfb3bb43fd6095e60cb68e1ede749a.source: Do you hope to achieve an arms control agreement with the Soviet Union during your time in the Oval Office? What conditions would you agree to?
8bcb573dedcfb3bb43fd6095e60cb68e1ede749a.zh: 你希望在担任总统期间与苏联达成军备控制协议吗？你能接受哪些条件？

520cc70c71cd8c1c70f242665a350fe77e48267c.source: Do you plan to attack Charles Evans Hughes's stance on preparedness and war with Europe, and if so, how?
520cc70c71cd8c1c70f242665a350fe77e48267c.zh: 你打算攻击查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯在战备与欧洲战争问题上的立场吗？如果打算，会怎么攻击？

bc4a07b576aa935f72466369b934cd91ab3119bc.source: Do you plan to attack Woodrow Wilson's stance on preparedness and war with Europe, and if so, how?
bc4a07b576aa935f72466369b934cd91ab3119bc.zh: 你打算抨击伍德罗·威尔逊在备战和对欧战争问题上的立场吗？如果打算，会如何抨击？

5a492e394e40f9a36612e39031bc79c84b443039.source: Do you plan to make Trump's 2019 impeachment a focus of your campaign? And if so, how much?
5a492e394e40f9a36612e39031bc79c84b443039.zh: 你是否打算把特朗普2019年遭弹劾作为竞选重点？如果是，会着重到什么程度？

491041bfdde99b8db0a6db03d6328b0b177afbd3.source: Do you plan to make a strong effort in any of the non-Southern states?
491041bfdde99b8db0a6db03d6328b0b177afbd3.zh: 你打算在南方以外的某些州大力竞选吗？

cb8bf52a60ecd9c9fbd23fe86bd9e9cd95b55b1d.source: Do you plan to make any attacks against the Liberty Party, a radical abolitionist group that is fielding a third party candidate?
cb8bf52a60ecd9c9fbd23fe86bd9e9cd95b55b1d.zh: 自由党是一个激进的废奴团体，正在推出第三党候选人。你是否打算对他们展开攻击？

02614d10c0bb408017e942075f7013d05c42fce3.source: Do you plan to participate in the customary series of three televised debates with Donald Trump in this election cycle?
02614d10c0bb408017e942075f7013d05c42fce3.zh: 在本届选举中，你是否打算照惯例，与唐纳德·特朗普参加三场电视辩论？

239b489ac8d1dcfbc5c7936adca0949f69bffdf2.source: Do you plan to participate in the traditional three debates, between yourself and Donald Trump?
239b489ac8d1dcfbc5c7936adca0949f69bffdf2.zh: 你打算与唐纳德·特朗普参加传统的三场辩论吗？

1bc72baeb550348d80d031f360b79d02282a6dcb.source: Do you plan to participate in the traditional three debates, between yourself and Hillary Clinton?
1bc72baeb550348d80d031f360b79d02282a6dcb.zh: 你打算与希拉里·克林顿参加传统的三场辩论吗？

9519a1c09a3e11f15c5ef58f3e6b02c66ca44392.source: Do you plan to promise further tax cuts as you hit the campaign trail?
9519a1c09a3e11f15c5ef58f3e6b02c66ca44392.zh: 在展开竞选时，你是否打算承诺进一步减税？

7b3b9f09bccaa85eea1720ab5d180f53c00878fe.source: Do you plan to repeat the rhetoric you used about Mexican immigrants when announcing your campaign?
7b3b9f09bccaa85eea1720ab5d180f53c00878fe.zh: 你打算重申宣布参选时关于墨西哥移民的那些言辞吗？

d8b37b8f4e7ad4021a0225906d68244307b07bc4.source: Do you plan to support the Jones Act -- granting greater autonomy to the Philippines along with a plan to grant independence.
d8b37b8f4e7ad4021a0225906d68244307b07bc4.zh: 你打算支持《琼斯法》吗？它将给予菲律宾更大的自治权，并提出未来独立的安排。

6134a68ba4b109752cc861542016351329568e6f.source: Do you stand by your decision to implement a loyalty program for employees of the federal government? Do you believe that Communist infiltration is a serious threat right now?
6134a68ba4b109752cc861542016351329568e6f.zh: 你仍坚持为联邦政府雇员实施忠诚审查计划的决定吗？你认为共产党渗透目前是严重威胁吗？

84db61fe7975958cf133378e4f97c185d2a3cc3b.source: Do you stand by your position, voiced during the primaries, that you will not deport any illegal immigrant who has not otherwise committed a crime?
84db61fe7975958cf133378e4f97c185d2a3cc3b.zh: 初选期间，你表示不会遣返没有犯下其他罪行的非法移民；你仍坚持这一立场吗？

769de1da8c38ba10c1b75917ab370eb91454700d.source: Do you stand by your statements that there will be absolutely no cuts to Social Security or Medicare under a Trump Administration?
769de1da8c38ba10c1b75917ab370eb91454700d.zh: 你是否仍坚持，特朗普政府绝不会削减社会保障或老年医疗保险？

370b29f8d089e895a6765cd1f38246b543ec49f7.source: Do you still hold a pro-life position on abortion? What do you have to say about previous incarnations of your views on that subject?
370b29f8d089e895a6765cd1f38246b543ec49f7.zh: 你在堕胎问题上仍持反对立场吗？对你此前在这个问题上的不同观点，有什么话要说？

59c053a5b794eff19faded37db3dea00d567509a.source: Do you still support the idea that the federal government should purchase the telegraph patent and manage the technology?
59c053a5b794eff19faded37db3dea00d567509a.zh: 你是否仍然支持由联邦政府购买电报专利，并管理这项技术？

c4c0eb23f3ae1fa22b9e8636ac986474bfe54046.source: Do you support a larger fence or even a wall on the U.S.-Mexico border to prevent illegal immigration?
c4c0eb23f3ae1fa22b9e8636ac986474bfe54046.zh: 你是否支持在美墨边境修建更大规模的围栏，甚至一堵墙，以阻止非法移民入境？

e3ed08cd75ec2875ee16cd0631f01c36fdfe813c.source: Do you support a minimum wage of $1.25 per hour, with some exceptions for small business? Such a measure was recently defeated in Congress.
e3ed08cd75ec2875ee16cd0631f01c36fdfe813c.zh: 你支持将最低工资定为每小时1.25美元，并对小企业给予一些豁免吗？国会最近否决了这类措施。

eba567d010206b27aa63dbcb0e858fe6131d18d7.source: Do you support additional gun control measures at the federal level?
eba567d010206b27aa63dbcb0e858fe6131d18d7.zh: 你支持在联邦层面采取更多枪支管制措施吗？

92370fccb0baaecbadfbff5f42fbdcf75ed1bfdb.source: Do you support additional gun control measures in this country? Can you give some specifics of what you want?
92370fccb0baaecbadfbff5f42fbdcf75ed1bfdb.zh: 你支持美国采取更多枪支管制措施吗？能具体说说你希望采取什么措施吗？

00d713d890300be170a94ea53ee72876cbf5f8d5.source: Do you support allowing the Bush Tax Cuts to expire for high-income households at the end of 2012?
00d713d890300be170a94ea53ee72876cbf5f8d5.zh: 你是否支持让适用于高收入家庭的布什减税政策在2012年底到期失效？

b48af75b43b785620263798b7dcbc1d92d119dcb.source: Do you support an Amendment that would limit the President to a single term in office?
b48af75b43b785620263798b7dcbc1d92d119dcb.zh: 你是否支持通过宪法修正案，将总统任期限制为一届？

d70b6a721ee3eace73c46eed1e6ae9e89926522e.source: Do you support any changes to our current naturalization laws?
d70b6a721ee3eace73c46eed1e6ae9e89926522e.zh: 你是否支持修改现行入籍法？

85bca891b25f2ab2b5a0e82d997e08b8c85ad042.source: Do you support any effort to establish a unified, national currency?
85bca891b25f2ab2b5a0e82d997e08b8c85ad042.zh: 你是否支持建立全国统一货币的努力？

2d22a368536342bfe263bfa17b3a2a9d18a35100.source: Do you support any type of comprehensive immigration reform, and if so, to what extent?
2d22a368536342bfe263bfa17b3a2a9d18a35100.zh: 你是否支持某种全面移民改革？如果支持，改革幅度有多大？

4b57c55ccb6b948cabcd3002ccbaa1a830dd587e.source: Do you support continued subsidies for the production of ethanol fuel?
4b57c55ccb6b948cabcd3002ccbaa1a830dd587e.zh: 你是否支持继续补贴乙醇燃料生产？

3d6cfbfcb4341f7111118723cbc6bc5a7b496622.source: Do you support greater regulation on the sale and labeling of opium, cocaine, and morphine when used in patent medicines?
3d6cfbfcb4341f7111118723cbc6bc5a7b496622.zh: 你支持对成药中使用的鸦片、可卡因和吗啡，加强销售与标签监管吗？

f6a495bc4aab437b3223f6b6c395e3e5321b0a13.source: Do you support the ratification of the Equal Rights Amendment, which states "Equality of rights under the law shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex."?
f6a495bc4aab437b3223f6b6c395e3e5321b0a13.zh: 你支持批准《平等权利修正案》吗？该修正案规定：“美国或任何州，不得因性别而否认或限制法律之下的平等权利。”

c4139efe7d79594e7338df5e45dc8b0d84e5a36e.source: Do you support the recent nuclear deal between the United States and Iran?
c4139efe7d79594e7338df5e45dc8b0d84e5a36e.zh: 你是否支持美国与伊朗最近达成的核协议？

77a3f63338c2b756499f0155aa2818fd8098c5fc.source: Do you support the recent reopening of relations with Cuba?
77a3f63338c2b756499f0155aa2818fd8098c5fc.zh: 你是否支持近期与古巴恢复关系的做法？

37a374766f952e4717bca1db5915057d9c40e446.source: Do you support the recent truce with the Taliban in Afghanistan? What would your policy be in that country?
37a374766f952e4717bca1db5915057d9c40e446.zh: 你是否支持最近与阿富汗塔利班达成的停战安排？你对阿富汗的政策会是什么？

7a6ce1e1027454b166020b2dedddfd79b336629e.source: Do you support the recently ratified 17th Amendment, requiring the direct election of U.S. Senators?
7a6ce1e1027454b166020b2dedddfd79b336629e.zh: 你支持最近获批准、要求直接选举联邦参议员的第十七修正案吗？

581a9741b25c57a3ef4bc022a72b1abee2fcbeb9.source: Do you support the temporary curtailment of American shipping in the Atlantic, in order to reduce the chances of German submarine attacks and the resulting consequences?
581a9741b25c57a3ef4bc022a72b1abee2fcbeb9.zh: 你支持暂时限制美国在大西洋的航运，以减少遭德国潜艇袭击的机会，以及由此产生的后果吗？

15302e0a5b83ef62e2ce528be459d5610fec2405.source: Do you think America is ready for a ticket with
15302e0a5b83ef62e2ce528be459d5610fec2405.zh: 你认为美国准备好迎接一张门票了吗？

13529feb47292480542927bfc4240c5220c329f1.source: Do you think reduced penalties and increased treatment for drug users would help reduce the flow of drugs from Latin America?
13529feb47292480542927bfc4240c5220c329f1.zh: 你认为，减轻对吸毒者的处罚、增加治疗，是否有助于减少从拉丁美洲流入的毒品？

0b5e320bdba86d74fd8546ac62b826cca24e755a.source: Do you think that local jurisdictions should be allowed to use hanging or other forms of capital punishment for crimes?
0b5e320bdba86d74fd8546ac62b826cca24e755a.zh: 你认为，应当允许地方司法辖区以绞刑或其他死刑方式惩处犯罪吗？

da52328a394bb7dba149a4ba0f85bc39ab4d4a53.source: Do you think that new regulations from Bill Clinton have unfairly hurt coal-producing states?
da52328a394bb7dba149a4ba0f85bc39ab4d4a53.zh: 你认为比尔·克林顿出台的新法规，不公平地损害了产煤州吗？

c4dd5c43880cc32c85de1ffbe5e5ad5614dcc1f6.source: Do you think that the Panama Canal should be turned back over to Panama?
c4dd5c43880cc32c85de1ffbe5e5ad5614dcc1f6.zh: 你认为巴拿马运河应交还巴拿马吗？

d19cb7103a89ce77b688992267f25ff72cfb1a59.source: Do you think that the United States Navy is large enough to adequately defend American interests on a global level?
d19cb7103a89ce77b688992267f25ff72cfb1a59.zh: 你认为，美国海军的规模，足以在全球范围内维护美国利益吗？

70f88c3c57f19fc7191cd49b21d81c0dbdde3f49.source: Do you think that the tax cuts in early 1975 were the right economic policy for this country?
70f88c3c57f19fc7191cd49b21d81c0dbdde3f49.zh: 你认为1975年初的减税，是适合我国的经济政策吗？

1ace5576ea7600a75d8e4a4c1192604c3127d7c2.source: Do you think that there should be federal oversight of the New York and Chicago trading markets?
1ace5576ea7600a75d8e4a4c1192604c3127d7c2.zh: 你认为，应当由联邦政府监管纽约和芝加哥的交易市场吗？

93cf8a1308eb6f9d4b94ef45d39e7237ee5a0005.source: Do you think the Death with Dignity Act in Oregon could be a model for broader federal legislation on the issue?
93cf8a1308eb6f9d4b94ef45d39e7237ee5a0005.zh: 你认为，俄勒冈州《尊严死亡法》能否成为联邦在这一问题上扩大立法的范本？

b52c1555e2801b5173273fed6a4c806b18afa614.source: Do you think the Department of Housing and Urban Development, newly created by Lyndon Johnson, serves a useful purpose in American life?
b52c1555e2801b5173273fed6a4c806b18afa614.zh: 林登·约翰逊新设立的住房和城市发展部，对美国社会有实际作用吗？

08d4086e71b35109c06431f8a59d2a718517e391.source: Do you support increased restrictions on handgun ownership?
08d4086e71b35109c06431f8a59d2a718517e391.zh: 你是否支持进一步限制手枪持有？

edbf784f5cf3e33af51a5b0964de654787beb9b9.source: Do you support opening a new dialogue with our Communist adversaries, such as the Soviet Union and China?
edbf784f5cf3e33af51a5b0964de654787beb9b9.zh: 你支持与苏联、中国等共产主义对手展开新的对话吗？

e97193d5fa522cc153b1230acb531e619a2cc0d2.source: Do you support proposals to expand oil drilling in Alaska, and specifically in the Alaska National Wildlife Refuge?
e97193d5fa522cc153b1230acb531e619a2cc0d2.zh: 你支持扩大阿拉斯加石油钻探范围、特别是在阿拉斯加国家野生动物保护区钻探的提议吗？

16bdf8af72d0ee18bea7cb43c22faeaa70b3fcf2.source: Do you support the Child Nutrition Act of 1966, which provides free breakfast and milk to qualified schoolchildren of impoverished backgrounds? Or do you believe that the program is too costly and constitutes a misuse of federal power?
16bdf8af72d0ee18bea7cb43c22faeaa70b3fcf2.zh: 你支持1966年《儿童营养法》吗？它为符合条件的贫困家庭学童提供免费早餐和牛奶。还是你认为，这项计划花费太大，也是在滥用联邦权力？

db5f6016688137aa34135304620c7a622c84ac78.source: Do you support the Clayton Antitrust Act which was recently passed? Do you believe that unions should be exempted from the antitrust regulations?
db5f6016688137aa34135304620c7a622c84ac78.zh: 你支持最近通过的《克莱顿反托拉斯法》吗？你认为，工会应当豁免于反托拉斯法规的限制吗？

6910231f2cca8e78586f6c8ba8ccb2d4ff3bded1.source: Do you support the Humphrey-Hawkins Full Employment Act?
6910231f2cca8e78586f6c8ba8ccb2d4ff3bded1.zh: 你支持《汉弗莱—霍金斯充分就业法案》吗？

04ec28d1ae248722c590f455d0e44e7c3369c86d.source: Do you support the Strategic Defense Initiative, a.k.a. “Star Wars”, designed to produce missile-defense weapons?
04ec28d1ae248722c590f455d0e44e7c3369c86d.zh: 你支持旨在研制导弹防御武器、又称“星球大战”的战略防御倡议吗？

577a9679bdd9ef68ad11bc24a74e4eec7f9df08f.source: Do you support the Supreme Court ruling in 2015 which struck down any prohibition on gay marriage?
577a9679bdd9ef68ad11bc24a74e4eec7f9df08f.zh: 你是否支持最高法院2015年取消同性婚姻禁令的判决？

b604ff62ec412df856511c20a8d4a0d13eccef13.source: Do you support the air strikes and sanctions that have been levied against Iraq, with the goal of weakening Saddam Hussein?
b604ff62ec412df856511c20a8d4a0d13eccef13.zh: 你支持为了削弱萨达姆·侯赛因，而对伊拉克实施的空袭与制裁吗？

faf5eb28ed5b9c6502754d28ebb456a052d930dd.source: Do you support the broader establishment of workers' compensation programs and laws, at the federal level?
faf5eb28ed5b9c6502754d28ebb456a052d930dd.zh: 你支持在联邦层面更广泛地建立工伤赔偿制度和相关法律吗？

265c6fb7edb77d69527ece3e52d0c7c3f37dfd5b.source: Do you support the construction of a 20-foot wall along the entire length of the U.S.-Mexico border?
265c6fb7edb77d69527ece3e52d0c7c3f37dfd5b.zh: 你是否支持沿整条美墨边境修建一堵20英尺高的墙？

6c754aa78dfa5af1dc6e0d558f46a5578a51a84a.source: Do you support the federal funding of primary education, and if so, in what form?
6c754aa78dfa5af1dc6e0d558f46a5578a51a84a.zh: 你支持联邦政府资助初等教育吗？如果支持，应采取什么形式？

c20c624872a4e4884148af52650fe8d619580e6b.source: Do you support the further expansion of the United States into Mexico, Cuba, or the Caribbean?
c20c624872a4e4884148af52650fe8d619580e6b.zh: 你是否支持美国进一步向墨西哥、古巴或加勒比地区扩张？

745d8b24462e428624000079353e529468fc1e39.source: Do you support the level of preparedness established by the recent National Defense Act?
745d8b24462e428624000079353e529468fc1e39.zh: 你支持最近《国防法》确立的战备水平吗？

46006de0ca5d5b5e6fdda7bb7d5eede10883ac75.source: Do you support the lifting of the Gag Rule in Congress?
46006de0ca5d5b5e6fdda7bb7d5eede10883ac75.zh: 你是否支持取消国会的禁议规则？

91d8b110db110da8dee1a38163d4bc5a771afea4.source: Do you support the plans of some in your party to expand the size of the Supreme Court, in order to counteract the Republicans' actions in regard to Merrick Garland and Amy Coney Barret?
91d8b110db110da8dee1a38163d4bc5a771afea4.zh: 为了回应共和党在梅里克·加兰和艾米·科尼·巴雷特问题上的行动，你是否支持党内一些人扩大最高法院人数的计划？

329b9904f209b6136c4db3baa091cb0278539e82.source: Do you support the practice of fracking? What is your overall view on energy policy?
329b9904f209b6136c4db3baa091cb0278539e82.zh: 你是否支持水力压裂？你对能源政策的总体看法是什么？

fe2daccb3ad033c7006c173d6c0a8b6a60087092.source: Does a person not love their country extremely? Do people not believe in their God extremely? I hold my convictions extremely and I hope all that vote for us in November do too.
fe2daccb3ad033c7006c173d6c0a8b6a60087092.zh: 难道一个人不该极其热爱自己的国家？人们不该极其信奉自己的上帝？我对自己的信念极其坚定，希望11月投票支持我们的人也是如此。

cd964cef4371d63b5d83ca58a8bb5cc6bc07f645.source: Does it make sense to attack Northern Democrats as enablers and fellow travelers of the Southern slavery expansion?
cd964cef4371d63b5d83ca58a8bb5cc6bc07f645.zh: 是否应当攻击北方民主党人，指责他们为南方扩张奴隶制提供便利，并与之沆瀣一气？

3e1050a8b54161b2d3d3394723ed30c64a857745.source: Does it make sense to dispose our nuclear waste at Yucca Mountain in Nevada?
3e1050a8b54161b2d3d3394723ed30c64a857745.zh: 把我国的核废料运到内华达州尤卡山处置，是否合理？

88ac48c6279e85b3ddae24ab490a41d6e71d562a.source: Does it still make sense to provide military aid to Pakistan's government?
88ac48c6279e85b3ddae24ab490a41d6e71d562a.zh: 继续向巴基斯坦政府提供军事援助，是否还有道理？

282256788ea4033f8c2b46fa06084931e95038fd.source: Does not favor extreme measures on the social issues of the day. May support civil unions. Sees the feminist movement as a net positive, while criticizing its perceived excesses. Favors sensible regulation of gun ownership.
282256788ea4033f8c2b46fa06084931e95038fd.zh: 不主张在当前社会议题上采取极端措施。可能支持民事结合。认为女权运动总体有益，同时批评其被认为过激的部分。主张合理监管枪支持有。

e58b4bb3b662dea46191db57d28454f5021260d8.source: Does the success of the tin-plate industry within the U.S. prove that protectionism stimulates industry?
e58b4bb3b662dea46191db57d28454f5021260d8.zh: 美国镀锡板产业的成功，是否证明贸易保护能促进工业？

bc95e6d6403daa726a2fe59bf34d5367b0bf41b6.source: Doesn't this hurt Humphrey more than it does myself? Wallace's support amongst union voters in the North helps our campaign.
bc95e6d6403daa726a2fe59bf34d5367b0bf41b6.zh: 这对汉弗莱的伤害不是比对我更大吗？华莱士在北方工会选民中的支持，反而有利于我们的竞选。

4dfd9b6db53a356aa7340f3334d55cba34c05d8c.source: Domestic issues. Let's talk about my plans to protect Social Security, public eduction, and Medicare to ensure the future prosperity of America. Let's remind voters that these are common-sense proposals that appeal to almost everyone.
4dfd9b6db53a356aa7340f3334d55cba34c05d8c.zh: 国内问题。谈谈我保护社会保障制度、公立教育和老年医疗保险的计划，以确保美国未来的繁荣。提醒选民，这些都是合乎常理、几乎人人都能认同的提议。

6bf449162d74262929acdd06a420972bcec182f0.source: Domestic issues. Let's talk about my plans to reform Social Security, education, and Medicare to ensure the future prosperity of America. Let's remind voters that these are common-sense proposals that appeal to almost everyone.
6bf449162d74262929acdd06a420972bcec182f0.zh: 国内问题。谈谈我改革社会保障制度、教育和老年医疗保险的计划，以确保美国未来的繁荣。提醒选民，这些都是合乎常理、几乎人人都能认同的提议。

d4fe60dac5a2a548ab02730d116658cbbf89ee62.source: Don't bring Goldwater's name into this. There are far better ways to attack the Democrats.
d4fe60dac5a2a548ab02730d116658cbbf89ee62.zh: 别把戈德华特的名字扯进来。攻击民主党有的是更好的办法。

54d301fcb54439bd49c7273d527f9d8f1cf68d98.source: Don't celebrate just yet, however. Word has already arrived that South Carolina is planning a secession convention, with other states soon to follow. Your Presidency will surely be defined by how you deal with this challenge. Will you take a hard line against this action, seek a compromise Amendment to protect slavery, or simply allow the states to secede? There are few good choices for you.
54d301fcb54439bd49c7273d527f9d8f1cf68d98.zh: 不过，先别庆祝。有消息称 南卡罗来纳州 正在计划召开一次分裂国家大会，其他州也将很快跟进。你的总统任期肯定取决于你如何应对这一挑战。您会采取强硬立场反对这一行动，寻求妥协的修正案以保护奴隶制，还是干脆允许各州脱离联邦？适合您的好的选择很少。

f87bc4dffe0a0dbaebc9740576e18e788efea127.source: Don't criticize the Tea Party, that's a hopeless debate to get yourself entangled into.
f87bc4dffe0a0dbaebc9740576e18e788efea127.zh: 别批评茶党。把自己卷进那场争论，毫无胜算。

541c63e317b19157b3417ffcd1700c056e4b042a.source: Donald Trump has shown an alarming lack of knowledge about even the basics of U.S. foreign policy. He would set us back many, many years on our objectives in Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and elsewhere.
541c63e317b19157b3417ffcd1700c056e4b042a.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普连美国外交最基本的情况都不了解，令人忧虑。他会让我们在欧洲、亚洲、中东等地的目标倒退很多很多年。

7f3944c6df3dea2e4b35a7ccf0d4ac5a5ceebb7e.source: Donald Trump is a dangerously divisive and corrosive influence on our society. This campaign needs to focus on his attacks against veterans, women, Hispanics, and practically any other group that he can think of.
7f3944c6df3dea2e4b35a7ccf0d4ac5a5ceebb7e.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普给我们的社会带来危险的分裂与侵蚀。这场竞选需要聚焦他对退伍军人、女性、西班牙裔，以及几乎所有他能想到的群体的攻击。

0fc67ead99963be6f2d710d6d76879f0f418c2b6.source: Donald Trump is a uniquely unqualified and dangerous individual to occupy the White House. He has said over and over again that he will immediately repeal Obamacare if he is President, throwing millions off their health insurance.
0fc67ead99963be6f2d710d6d76879f0f418c2b6.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普是个格外缺乏资格、又危险的人，不应该入主白宫。他一再表示，当上总统就立刻废除奥巴马医改，让数百万人失去医疗保险。

31c7f6b45f79aff9f2f94f6a6696334178ab40b1.source: Donald Trump is already using this shooting as an excuse for his vile and unfounded attacks on an entire religion. We are better than that as a nation, and we deserve better than that from our President.
31c7f6b45f79aff9f2f94f6a6696334178ab40b1.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普已经把这次枪击当成借口，对整个宗教发动恶毒而毫无根据的攻击。我们的国家不该这样，我们也理应拥有比这更好的总统。

fba54826a08484db20b3a5cb8365457811430f9a.source: Donald Trump is attacking you almost daily on your 2002 vote in favor of the Iraq War. How do you plan to respond?
fba54826a08484db20b3a5cb8365457811430f9a.zh: 特朗普几乎每天都在攻击你2002年投票支持伊拉克战争的事。你打算如何回应？

45d256b36a7a4b7d4b63e6a15d81fd2b75c3edd8.source: Donald Trump is dangerously divisive and completely unqualified to serve as President. His constantly inflammatory rhetoric towards women, Muslims, Hispanics, and others is Exhibit A, and I plan to call this out repeatedly as I campaign.
45d256b36a7a4b7d4b63e6a15d81fd2b75c3edd8.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普危险地制造分裂，完全没有资格担任总统。他不断针对女性、穆斯林、西班牙裔等群体发表煽动性言论，就是最明显的证据。我打算在竞选中反复揭露这一点。

2a18ecec28cbae0ad5f330e130af336457ce6ef8.source: Donald Trump is dangerously uninformed and unqualified to serve as President. This campaign needs to focus on my experience and qualifications, in contrast to his utterly unserious credentials and statements.
2a18ecec28cbae0ad5f330e130af336457ce6ef8.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对情况的无知令人担忧，也没有资格担任总统。这场竞选需要突出我的经验和资格，与他极不靠谱的资历和言论形成对照。

760b1dd63fde083be53f8410e6e757f169370c52.source: Donald Trump is lying when says he opposed the war. I challenge him to produce a single public statement that he made
760b1dd63fde083be53f8410e6e757f169370c52.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普 说他反对战争是在撒谎。我要求他发表一份他曾发表过的公开声明

829facc7c9135e6d15258a835780a93f6bedb3e4.source: Donald Trump is regularly floating the accusation that Bill Clinton had a male child with an African-American hooker in Little Rock, and that both of you have conspired to bury the story. Do you have any comment?
829facc7c9135e6d15258a835780a93f6bedb3e4.zh: 特朗普不断散布指控，称比尔·克林顿与小石城一名非裔妓女生下了一个男孩，而你们两人串通掩盖这件事。你有何评论？

14df26c5d5dda90870b8ef29be7537acabbb9b8e.source: Donald Trump says he will tear this deal up, should he somehow win this election. That is dangerous and ill-conceived, and really shows how unfit he is to guide America's foreign policy.
14df26c5d5dda90870b8ef29be7537acabbb9b8e.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普说，如果他真能赢得选举，就会撕毁这项协议。这既危险又欠考虑，恰恰说明他多么不适合领导美国外交。

1f7d8de60ad424407165e63ace0f4a131dbf8e01.source: Don't undermine your own position on the tariff issue. It does no good for anyone.
1f7d8de60ad424407165e63ace0f4a131dbf8e01.zh: 别削弱自己在关税问题上的立场。这对谁都没有好处。

4028304844d42820e16dee2a3e3b660503e5c1b1.source: Donald Trump and Hillary Clinton face off in the 2016 election. While he is well-known among the American public, Trump has never served in elected office. Clinton has served as First Lady, Senator, and Secretary of State. Clinton was the presumptive nominee from start to finish, while Trump has shocked the political world.
4028304844d42820e16dee2a3e3b660503e5c1b1.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普与希拉里·克林顿在2016年总统选举中正面交锋。特朗普虽为美国公众熟知，却从未担任过民选公职。克林顿曾任第一夫人、参议员和国务卿。克林顿从竞选伊始到获得提名，一直被视为当然的候选人；特朗普却震动了整个政坛。

711f24b069b4c9fa992d11d77a54831dcb4e9765.source: Donald Trump apologizing for anything makes instant headline news.
711f24b069b4c9fa992d11d77a54831dcb4e9765.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普为任何事情道歉，都会立刻成为头条新闻。

78e7a1fd49e39efd85ef0c91a019fffb619d0d7a.source: Donald Trump claims to be a different kind of politician, but he says he will double down on the failed tax cuts and policies of George Bush. What did Einstein say about the definition of insanity?
78e7a1fd49e39efd85ef0c91a019fffb619d0d7a.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普声称，自己是另一种政治人物，却说要加倍推行乔治·布什失败的减税和政策。爱因斯坦是怎么定义疯狂的来着？

1cb4eb785ddd50d58045aa91a2e8fdaaf3524697.source: Donald Trump flagrantly broke the law and he shouldn't be the President right now. Of course I'm going to bring that up.
1cb4eb785ddd50d58045aa91a2e8fdaaf3524697.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普公然违法，现在根本就不该再当总统。我当然会提起这件事。

b7cb6e84f9fbb7335eebd387d1ca85bab86e7322.source: Donald Trump has already hinted that he won't accept the results of this election, and that any debate cannot be considered fair because of so-called moderator bias. I would prefer to take my case directly to the American people with 30-minute television spots.
