b7cb6e84f9fbb7335eebd387d1ca85bab86e7322.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普已经暗示，他不会接受这次选举结果，还说由于所谓的主持人偏见，任何辩论都不能算公平。我更愿意用三十分钟的电视广告，直接向美国人民陈述自己的主张。

0ef478103929f57096c7f91394a65ffc76d5d9de.source: Donald Trump has assaulted our most vulnerable citizens, given away billions in tax breaks to the top 1 percent, alienated our allies, and utterly failed to address the COVID and policing crises. He must go.
0ef478103929f57096c7f91394a65ffc76d5d9de.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普攻击我们最脆弱的公民，为最富有的1%人群提供数十亿美元减税，疏远盟友，完全没能应对新冠疫情和警务危机。他必须下台。

0a80b5de9a68b0c1800bb37f5f377cd65586d699.source: Donald Trump has repeatedly stepped over the line with his irresponsible rhetoric, and it shouldn't be any surprise that more and more protestors are turning out against him.
0a80b5de9a68b0c1800bb37f5f377cd65586d699.zh: 特朗普不负责任的言辞一再越界，越来越多抗议者站出来反对他，根本不奇怪。

dfef783307f12def70ed55e77ee32e5514527bce.source: Donald Trump has shocked the political establishment by winning the Republican nomination in a divisive contest. He has taken a hard line on immigration and tax cuts, along with unorthodox positions on many other issues. He must unite his own party while finding some way to peel off potential Clinton voters -- or to blunt their enthusiasm for Clinton enough that they stay home. Will he continue the strategy of relentless attack that served him so well in the primary season?
dfef783307f12def70ed55e77ee32e5514527bce.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普 在一场存在分歧的竞选中赢得共和党提名，震惊了政治机构。他在移民和减税问题上采取强硬立场，并在许多其他问题上采取非正统立场。他必须团结自己的政党，同时找到某种方法来剥离潜在的克林顿选民——或者削弱他们对克林顿的热情，让他们呆在家里。他会继续他在初选赛季中表现出色的无情进攻策略吗？

179b30a4d4ff04b92c1b965e4cf77c6ad4dcb458.source: Donald Trump turned around rapidly in a New York City hotel room to see who was wailing his name. To his surprise, hovering right there in front of him, were 3 ghosts. Donald demanded to know their names and purposes. They introduced themselves as Alf Landon, Herbert Hoover, and George McGovern, and explained they were the ghosts of elections past. What, did you expect them to be ghosts of the past, present, and future? That's not how elections work. Anyways, they explain they appear whenever a presidential election is dramatically lost, to comfort the loser, which Donald doesn't appreciate 14 minutes after losing Utah. They explain how, despite his loss, many other wonderful things will happen to him. For one, he will live a long life, as they did prior to their deaths. Trump dismisses, this, noting that he never actually actually lost, because of Sleepy Joe's massive fraud. They all sigh, and vanish into thin air next to Trump, leaving him alone in his room.
179b30a4d4ff04b92c1b965e4cf77c6ad4dcb458.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普 在 纽约州 城市酒店房间里迅速转身，看看是谁在哭喊着他的名字。让他惊讶的是，在他面前，竟然悬浮着三个鬼魂。 唐纳德 要求知道他们的名字和用途。他们自我介绍为阿尔夫·兰登（Alf Landon）赫伯特·胡佛和乔治·麦戈文（George McGovern），并解释说他们是过去选举的幽灵。什么，你以为他们是过去、现在和未来的鬼魂吗？选举不是这样进行的。不管怎样，他们解释说，每当总统选举惨败时，他们就会出现，以安慰失败者，而这唐纳德在失败后14分钟犹他州并不欣赏。他们解释了尽管他去世了，但许多其他美好的事情将会发生在他身上。其一，他将像他们死前一样长寿。 特朗普驳斥了这一点，并指出由于瞌睡乔的大规模欺诈，他实际上从未真正输过。他们都叹了口气，然后消失在特朗普旁边的稀薄空气中，留下他独自一人在房间里。

d917eb6ebadeb07e367111a73335c53be792c2e7.source: Donald Trump would be a disaster for the future of this country. We need to do everything we can to appeal to moderate voters who can be swayed by a qualified candidate. Bernie unfortunately complicates things on that front.
d917eb6ebadeb07e367111a73335c53be792c2e7.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普会给这个国家的未来带来灾难。我们要竭尽所能，争取那些可能被合格候选人说服的温和派选民。不幸的是，伯尼让这方面的事情更复杂了。

faf426e0e24ebf6c448874c97ab51e765e593d1e.source: Donald Trump's actions and comments about women are reprehensible. It would be absurd of us not to bring that up as we campaign, along with other important issues.
faf426e0e24ebf6c448874c97ab51e765e593d1e.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普针对女性的行为和言论应受谴责。竞选时，我们如果不把这件事与其他重要议题一起提出来，那就太荒谬了。

67d1c4d7bd12b0732232623ad211c6c85bb5f9a0.source: Donald Trump's actions and comments about women are reprehensible. It would be asburd of us not to bring that up as we campaign, along with other important issues.
67d1c4d7bd12b0732232623ad211c6c85bb5f9a0.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普针对女性的行为和言论应受谴责。竞选时，我们如果不把这件事与其他重要议题一起提出来，那就太荒谬了。

4b5b9f4dba85e056956f25e36d5c32148b534e1b.source: Donald Trump's voice drawled throughout the hall as he made a victory speech. Even D.C, the pinnacle of liberalism in America, had fallen to 'the Donald'. Reports were showing Bernie Sanders had shot himself, Joe Biden had a heart attack, and Hillary Clinton had been uncontrollably laughing for the past 2 hours. A new era could begin. You can build a wall - maybe a statue to your greatness. Tear down that old statue of that loser Lincoln and show a
4b5b9f4dba85e056956f25e36d5c32148b534e1b.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普 在发表胜利演讲时，整个大厅的声音拖长了。就连美国自由主义的顶峰华盛顿特区也沦落到“唐纳德”。报告显示，伯尼·桑德斯 开枪自杀，乔·拜登 心脏病发作，希拉里·克林顿 在过去 2 小时里一直无法控制地大笑。一个新时代可能会开始。你可以建造一堵墙——也许是一座雕像来纪念你的伟大。拆掉那个失败者的旧雕像 林肯 并展示

1a51bf194f47fda8ffa13395828f0b40d606816a.source: Donald Trump's words go against everything our nation stands for, but I don't think it's correct or helpful to disrupt his rallies or to shout epithets at his supporters.
1a51bf194f47fda8ffa13395828f0b40d606816a.zh: 特朗普的话违背了我国所珍视的一切，但我不认为，打断他的集会或向他的支持者喊辱骂的话，是正确或有益的做法。

9f4cd7b8e02185d5838843f0c2ad2f19fdc19dd8.source: Dukakis does not have an elegant defense prepared for this action, and your attacks seem to really stick.
9f4cd7b8e02185d5838843f0c2ad2f19fdc19dd8.zh: 对于这个举动，杜卡基斯没有准备好得体的辩护，你的攻击似乎相当奏效。

1e433e7a315777b222abb60edd176fa930a1334c.source: Dukakis hammered on the “competence” theme in his speech. It is always good to fight back against that narrative.
1e433e7a315777b222abb60edd176fa930a1334c.zh: 杜卡基斯在演说中反复强调“治理能力”。对这种说辞予以反击，总是好的。

434bd255cca85eefbc297fdc56e8f6ba082d8fb7.source: Dukakis is a good man with a good record as Governor of Massachusetts. I prefer to focus on my own qualifications and experience for the job.
434bd255cca85eefbc297fdc56e8f6ba082d8fb7.zh: 杜卡基斯是个好人，担任马萨诸塞州州长的政绩也很好。我更愿意着重谈自己担任总统的资历与经验。

d5b9c347561a1ea5d3fd7d193f2a534d6ea845ce.source: Dukakis is a left-wing liberal who has vetoed the Pledge of Allegiance, attacked military spending, and allowed convicted murderers into society.
d5b9c347561a1ea5d3fd7d193f2a534d6ea845ce.zh: 杜卡基斯是个左翼自由派，他否决效忠誓词法案，攻击军费开支，还放任已被定罪的杀人犯回到社会。

920412f1b28af09f56fb3b496b2d15d762de3ea9.source: During a fundraiser, you made a comment that around half of Trump's supporters form a "basket of deplorables", with a renewed emphasis on racism, bigotry, and Islamophobia. Do you care to clarify?
920412f1b28af09f56fb3b496b2d15d762de3ea9.zh: 在一次筹款活动中，你说大约一半的特朗普支持者是“一帮可鄙之人”，再次强调了种族主义、偏执与反穆斯林情绪。你打算作进一步澄清吗？

b34f9a5a2b8254cafdb262a148af4b9eaf042c2d.source: During my career, I have met with any number of individuals whom I have disagreed with. I don't see a need to apply a different standard to this situation.
b34f9a5a2b8254cafdb262a148af4b9eaf042c2d.zh: 在我的职业生涯中，我会见过许多与我意见不同的人。我看不出这次为何要另立标准。

608942c92d37d1320a2dc50ca0db2aa0be0bc091.source: During the Great Depression, the federal government began a policy of farm subsidies to stabilize farm incomes and to target a specific output of each crop. Are these policies still necessary in 1960?
608942c92d37d1320a2dc50ca0db2aa0be0bc091.zh: 大萧条期间，联邦政府开始实施农业补贴，以稳定农民收入，并为每种作物设定产量目标。到了1960年，这些政策还必要吗？

98db3a4e1b16e5ceb2a10603f7b592161e9d0398.source: During the past few months, our party has spoken, and we can't deny that Bernie Sanders enjoys a huge amount of support. It's only right that we join forces, and together prevent any possibility of a Trump Administration.
98db3a4e1b16e5ceb2a10603f7b592161e9d0398.zh: 过去几个月，我们党已经表达了意见。我们不能否认，伯尼·桑德斯获得了大量支持。我们理应携手，彻底阻止特朗普政府出现的可能。

5324053a73f7f0b71362e00b6375ea71871cbb52.source: During your tenure, Bain Capital laid off thousands of workers at various companies that it purchased. Are you proud of your work at that company?
5324053a73f7f0b71362e00b6375ea71871cbb52.zh: 在你任职期间，贝恩资本收购的多家公司裁员数千人。你为自己在那家公司的工作感到自豪吗？

7a885f2dc907c284e54fdc2a3a28cad65f502460.source: Dwight D. Eisenhower is a very popular figure in the Midwest and Plains, but not as popular in the South. You’ve recently filmed a television ad appearing with Eisenhower. Where and how frequently would you like to air this ad?
7a885f2dc907c284e54fdc2a3a28cad65f502460.zh: 德怀特·D. 艾森豪威尔在中西部和大平原地区十分受欢迎，但在南方没那么受欢迎。你最近与他共同拍摄了一则电视广告。你希望在哪些地区播放，播放频率又如何？

73cf46d7128ccf4e065bcd68eb49a4a620485e26.source: E-Verify is a good start, but too many companies don't use it. It should be mandatory for any employer hiring more than a few employees.
73cf46d7128ccf4e065bcd68eb49a4a620485e26.zh: E-Verify就业资格核验系统是个好的开端，但不用它的企业太多了。雇用超过少数几名员工的雇主，都应该被要求使用它。

bd4d081a07d276c3db50b28ddc69b96be5c21b84.source: Earl Warren is a great man who represents my views for the future of this country. Now let's get going with this campaign.
bd4d081a07d276c3db50b28ddc69b96be5c21b84.zh: 厄尔·沃伦是位出色的人物，代表了我对本国未来的看法。现在，让我们开始竞选吧。

fb5a5edf9de4a95dfb6e79c0a494e3f315a0927b.source: Earl Warren is the current Governor of California, and enjoys massive popularity in that state. He has pursued a modernizing agenda in California, building a huge, well-funded highway and university system, and other public works projects. He would add a number of crucial votes in his home state, and would distinguish the ticket nationally as a sensible, moderate alternative to Truman.
fb5a5edf9de4a95dfb6e79c0a494e3f315a0927b.zh: 厄尔·沃伦 是 加利福尼亚州 的现任州长，在该州享有很高的知名度。他在 加利福尼亚州 中追求现代化议程，建设规模庞大、资金充足的高速公路和大学系统，以及其他公共工程项目。他将在他的家乡增加一些关键选票，并将该选票在全国范围内区分为 杜鲁门 的明智、温和的替代方案。

fb24922a28b20252abc49436b88b2d630403e5ed.source: Earl Warren is without a doubt the worst Supreme Court justice in the history of the United States. From
fb24922a28b20252abc49436b88b2d630403e5ed.zh: 厄尔·沃伦 毫无疑问是美国历史上最糟糕的最高法院法官。来自

7abbdf720ed21a831b99a9565da5d6b5e7a89260.source: Economists agree that you have staked out a position on the liberal fringe of the economic debate.
7abbdf720ed21a831b99a9565da5d6b5e7a89260.zh: 经济学家认为，你在经济争论中的立场已经处于自由派的最边缘。

fa443a69a7e5dcc79b80206e5a252dabbde7a9e5.source: Economists agree that you have staked out a position on the liberal fringe of the economic debate. Although, your liberal economics and aversion to Vietnam helps as much it hurts, stabilizing the polls.
fa443a69a7e5dcc79b80206e5a252dabbde7a9e5.zh: 经济学家认为，你在经济争论中的立场已经处于自由派的最边缘。不过，你的自由派经济主张和对越南战争的反感，带来的好处与坏处大致抵消，民调保持稳定。

2dfb1dbcf4474f1aa5edb4c1688a397318ebd350.source: Education is a key front in our battle with Communism, and that includes adequate pay and respect for our nation's teachers. I would support additional federal spending on this.
2dfb1dbcf4474f1aa5edb4c1688a397318ebd350.zh: 教育是我们与共产主义斗争中的关键阵线，其中也包括让教师获得足够的报酬和尊重。我会支持增加这方面的联邦开支。

70cdc94708656a9ae82a4ac1906fa58f124b2251.source: Edward Everett is nearing the end of an illustrious political career that includes time served in the House, Senate, as Governor of Massachusetts, Secretary of State, and as President of Harvard. Long known as a conservative, Everett hopes to provide regional balance to the Constitutional Union ticket, and to have the same moderating effect on northern abolitionists that Bell hopes to have on southern fire-eaters.
70cdc94708656a9ae82a4ac1906fa58f124b2251.zh: 爱德华·埃弗里特 的杰出政治生涯即将结束，其中包括在众议院、参议院任职、担任 马萨诸塞州 州长、国务卿和哈佛大学校长。长期以来被称为保守派的埃弗里特希望为宪法联盟选票提供地区平衡，并对北方废奴主义者产生贝尔希望对南方食火者产生的同样的调节作用。

959e37ec5cef1ebb0e255acf99b04c78ec8f72ce.source: Eisenhower advises you to avoid a debate with Kennedy, and you accept that advice. Voters are a little upset that you won't appear, but it could always be worse...
959e37ec5cef1ebb0e255acf99b04c78ec8f72ce.zh: 艾森豪威尔建议你避免与肯尼迪辩论，你接受了建议。选民对你不露面有些不满，不过情况总可能更糟……

279acee1b414291ddeb7ec0bf6a7b3c2887bc455.source: Eisenhower has his own responsibilities as President, but he is able to hit the trail for the last week of the campaign. He will obviously provide a huge boost wherever he appears. What do you think?
279acee1b414291ddeb7ec0bf6a7b3c2887bc455.zh: 艾森豪威尔作为总统有自己的职责，不过能在竞选的最后一周参与拉票。他每到一处，显然都会带来巨大助力。你怎么看？

d126a632646109fb8547642b4a2eb8c80cdbc1e3.source: Eisenhower is furious that you would join the Democrats in repeating the inaccurate “missile gap” allegation.
d126a632646109fb8547642b4a2eb8c80cdbc1e3.zh: 你跟着民主党人一起重复不准确的“导弹差距”指控，艾森豪威尔对此怒不可遏。

74e5555611c4d6d1280043fe094875b10ca1ef1c.zh: 道格拉斯 布林克利 - 杰拉尔德·福特

7fde8a6df58327fc32cbf989b6eaf3c9f309f334.source: Douglas and his party are running on the failed, dishonest policy of popular sovereignty. I want the Republicans to point this out at every opportunity.
7fde8a6df58327fc32cbf989b6eaf3c9f309f334.zh: 道格拉斯及其政党正凭着已经失败、又不诚实的人民主权政策开展竞选。我要共和党人在每一个机会中都指出这一点。

5e7cde5c10c0cf98a1922502f26318c821dcb4db.source: Douglas has a following in several of the states that we must have this fall. We should reserve our harshest criticism for the Southern Democrats and their machinations.
5e7cde5c10c0cf98a1922502f26318c821dcb4db.zh: 在几个我们今秋必须拿下的州，道格拉斯都有追随者。我们应当把最严厉的批评留给南方民主党人及其阴谋。

c90f879a6d473f39038cc2d93a488219be196e8e.source: Douglas has been a proponent of 'popular sovereignty', but this compromise has lost its luster in North and South alike. If he is to deny Lincoln a majority, he must carry some Northern states.
c90f879a6d473f39038cc2d93a488219be196e8e.zh: 道格拉斯 一直是“人民主权原则”的支持者，但这种妥协在北方和南方都失去了光彩。如果他要否认 林肯 多数，他必须赢得一些北方州。

c6bc8f0cef8f7a604799776dbe1ff9cd4b1e712c.source: Dr. Carson is well-known in the black community, and generally respected, even if his political views are at odds.
c6bc8f0cef8f7a604799776dbe1ff9cd4b1e712c.zh: 卡森医生在黑人群体中广为人知，也普遍受到尊重，即使他的政治观点与他们不一致。

91b97bcbce46f817ef15fc86307da7ff1583e8fb.source: Dr. King bamboozled a lot of decent Americans with his rhetoric. I don't condone what happened to him, but most people fail to realize that he was a radical redistributionist and a borderline Communist.
91b97bcbce46f817ef15fc86307da7ff1583e8fb.zh: 金博士用他的言辞蒙骗了许多正派的美国人。我不赞同他遭遇的那件事，但大多数人没有看清，他是个鼓吹激进再分配的人，几乎就是个共产党人。

600215d1e73d92912867fc4ec5cb8c0d754d994a.source: Dr. King is an American hero. I'm proud of his efforts to desegregate the southern schools and businesses, and I was deeply affected by his tragic demise this year.
600215d1e73d92912867fc4ec5cb8c0d754d994a.zh: 金博士是美国英雄。我为他推动南方学校和商界废除种族隔离的努力感到骄傲，他今年的悲惨离世也让我深受触动。

2b99d86ccda40734990083c182e86d44f2ca63d6.source: Dreams from My Father: A Story of Race and Inheritance
2b99d86ccda40734990083c182e86d44f2ca63d6.zh: 我父亲的梦想：种族与传承的故事

206f1ac864ed29e27155f1c464caea67ae2c82c1.zh: 德雷德·斯科特 诉 桑福德

521507956fd6a01558b2725e909bd50619320536.source: Due process for defendants is a Constitutional right. I'm confident that we will find a way to enforce the law in this country without devolving into a police state.
521507956fd6a01558b2725e909bd50619320536.zh: 被告获得正当法律程序保障，是宪法赋予的权利。我相信，我们能找到维护法律的办法，而不至于沦为警察国家。

37d3339b51eb45ce286487e6488136a93d048b4c.source: Due to Romney's evolving positions on health care and social issues over the years, some conservatives question his sincerity. His challenge is to win that faction without alienating mainstream voters.
37d3339b51eb45ce286487e6488136a93d048b4c.zh: 由于 罗姆尼 多年来在医疗保健和社会问题上不断变化的立场，一些保守派质疑他的诚意。他面临的挑战是在不疏远主流选民的情况下赢得该派系的支持。

65e2273355710bde447449f5203be214beb15c99.source: Dukakis attacks you relentlessly for refusing to debate, and it is not helping your position.
65e2273355710bde447449f5203be214beb15c99.zh: 杜卡基斯不断攻击你拒绝辩论，这对你的处境毫无帮助。

6905ad01aa2170ccbd94096e255a930c1462e395.source: Dukakis bases his campaign on competence, but his state was simply riding the wave of a Reagan-created economic boom, which he tries to take credit for.
6905ad01aa2170ccbd94096e255a930c1462e395.zh: 杜卡基斯以治理能力作为竞选基础，可他所在的州不过搭上了里根带来的经济繁荣，他却试图把功劳据为己有。

310c74e0a5d8af65a495f0cf8efdd77d3c7e3845.source: Dukakis did not help himself with an awkward response on capital punishment, and observers agree that you seemed to win.
310c74e0a5d8af65a495f0cf8efdd77d3c7e3845.zh: 杜卡基斯对死刑问题的回答十分别扭，没能为自己加分，观察人士一致认为，你似乎赢了。

af4500a56d10f3fcb3f382fc6135fea3f662276e.source: End subsidies for alternative energy companies -- and for oil companies as well.
af4500a56d10f3fcb3f382fc6135fea3f662276e.zh: 取消对替代能源公司的补贴，也取消对石油公司的补贴。

296c2d5b51271feaa3a81ffc6df530ba07bde169.source: Ending the Gag Rule is definitely a Whig prerogative.
296c2d5b51271feaa3a81ffc6df530ba07bde169.zh: 废除禁议规则，确实是辉格党应当争取的目标。

d8ca72308c9de499d30073027190e92d31194eec.source: Environmentalist groups are dismayed at your response. It will be hard to generate enthusiasm this fall.
d8ca72308c9de499d30073027190e92d31194eec.zh: 环保团体对你的回答感到失望。今年秋天，很难调动他们的热情。

cf080e5393422e76070c53a9d3e8c16cf50eb0ca.source: Ethanol has the potential to radically change our energy equation, and to provide a clean source of renewables. We should continue these subsidies.
cf080e5393422e76070c53a9d3e8c16cf50eb0ca.zh: 乙醇有潜力从根本上改变我们的能源格局，提供清洁的可再生能源。我们应该继续这些补贴。

6eb5d4f99b0a4ac1d28376fda1153d83734cb0fd.source: Evan Bayh has served his home state of Indiana well. He is an independent thinker who consistently seeks bipartisan solutions.
6eb5d4f99b0a4ac1d28376fda1153d83734cb0fd.zh: 埃文·贝赫出色地服务了家乡印第安纳州。他善于独立思考，总是寻求两党都能接受的解决办法。

dee800dadeb45b94216410e1edbe3b3a33377f2f.source: Evan Bayh is a Senator from Indiana and a former Governor. He is broadly popular in that state and is a leader of the moderate wing of the Democrats. This could help the Democrats compete in the Midwest and South, but it could also alienate the left-wing of the party and drive additional support to Ralph Nader's bid.
dee800dadeb45b94216410e1edbe3b3a33377f2f.zh: 埃文·贝赫 是来自 印第安纳州 的参议员和前州长。他在该州广受欢迎，是民主党温和派的领导人。这可能有助于民主党在中西部和南部的竞争，但也可能疏远党内左翼，并为 拉尔夫·纳德 的竞选带来更多支持。

d0cacceed7f3a88dab24920eec7651df1f8058c7.source: Evan Bayh is the best person for the job. He has proven his ability time and time again as a Governor and Senator.
d0cacceed7f3a88dab24920eec7651df1f8058c7.zh: 埃文·贝赫是最适合这份工作的人。担任州长和参议员期间，他一次又一次证明了自己的能力。

f943f7d9d46640b47f3033b57e9c255a25ab0c3d.source: Evan McMullin is an independent candidate for president out of the state of Utah, and seeks to win enough center-right and independent voters in the state to snag its electoral votes and deadlock the election.  While nominally an independent, McMullin's and your goals could align, and some targeted funding (made discreetly, of course!) could go a long way to bolstering his candidacy.
f943f7d9d46640b47f3033b57e9c255a25ab0c3d.zh: 来自犹他州的埃文·麦克马林，以独立候选人身份角逐总统。他希望争取足够的中右翼与独立选民，拿下该州的选举人票，让大选陷入僵局。虽然名义上独立，你们的目标却可能一致。提供一些有针对性的资助（当然要悄悄进行！），可能大大增强他的竞选实力。

7a91c52635d9b3125face1f3b70bbe047b83a2a8.source: Evan who? Have you seen this guy? I'm not too worried!
7a91c52635d9b3125face1f3b70bbe047b83a2a8.zh: 埃文是谁？你见过这个人吗？我可不怎么担心！

d9c0cbcc3e781a0dfa448fde86631ffabd46b43c.source: Even Ford is less opposed to health care measures than this. You've taken a pretty conservative stance here.
d9c0cbcc3e781a0dfa448fde86631ffabd46b43c.zh: 连福特都没有这样反对医疗保障措施。你在这里采取了相当保守的立场。

58ffe774458c085021589b23c45cc1faf227c20c.source: Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. It's good to win the labor vote, but there are other factors to consider as well.
58ffe774458c085021589b23c45cc1faf227c20c.zh: 连杰拉尔德·福特都支持这项修正案。争取劳工选票固然好，但也得考虑其他因素。

4f054a6285d1a6188ef22304410054c01c980a04.source: Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. Some wings of the party are pretty disappointed in this stance.
4f054a6285d1a6188ef22304410054c01c980a04.zh: 连杰拉尔德·福特都支持这项修正案。党内一些派别对你的立场相当失望。

a883420f81649fa27180308e0d7b87357c8e0a44.source: Even Lee Atwater thinks that this attack would be a bridge too far.
a883420f81649fa27180308e0d7b87357c8e0a44.zh: 就连李·阿特沃特都觉得，这种攻击未免太过分。

bc5ce70cfcfb1177a3d999bd5c9273ed2512cb39.source: Elections for Congress have also resulted in an even split among members, and it is extremely unclear who might ultimately win this election. Best of luck in what is sure to be a contentious process.
bc5ce70cfcfb1177a3d999bd5c9273ed2512cb39.zh: 国会选举也导致了议员之间的平分秋色，目前还不清楚谁最终会赢得这次选举。祝你好运，这肯定是一个有争议的过程。

369a043c9f895a7c2139b113a7b67313b4f25cbd.source: Elizabeth Warren has admirably served Massachusetts as a Senator, and she will bring that experience and ability to the national stage as my Vice President.
369a043c9f895a7c2139b113a7b67313b4f25cbd.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦作为参议员，出色地服务于马萨诸塞州。担任我的副总统后，她会把这些经验和能力带到全国舞台。

d4db0d38f2056d500ecd6e47c23c3c118a5e8b3e.source: Elizabeth Warren has been out in front on the issues of student loan debt, consumer finance, and bankruptcy. She is a deeply intelligent woman whom I'm proud to share a ticket with.
d4db0d38f2056d500ecd6e47c23c3c118a5e8b3e.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦在学生贷款债务、消费者金融和破产等议题上走在前列。她极其聪慧，我很自豪能与她搭档参选。

70c6d2584953dece10204a52d7c52c4bf4feaa1f.source: Elizabeth Warren is a Senator from Massachusetts and an icon to progressive Democrats. Selecting her could be a good way to appeal to supporters of Bernie Sanders, but she will expect Clinton to adhere to progressive stances throughout the campaign, as a condition of joining the ticket. Some observers think that having two women on the ticket may be a bit much, and also point out that Warren's home state is safely Democratic.
70c6d2584953dece10204a52d7c52c4bf4feaa1f.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦 是来自 马萨诸塞州 的参议员，也是进步民主党的偶像。选择她可能是吸引 伯尼·桑德斯 支持者的好方法，但她希望 克林顿 在整个竞选过程中坚持进步立场，作为加入竞选的条件。一些观察家认为，选票上有两名女性可能有点多，并且还指出 沃伦 的家乡是民主党。

341eb8446e8291d2f289fafdb913e368a0d5a76e.source: Elizabeth Warren is a Senator from Massachusetts who made a serious run at the Democratic Nomination in 2020. She is generally seen as a solid progressive with a particular interest in financial reform and regulation. Choosing her would anger some supporters who expect an African-American running-mate after this summer's protests.
341eb8446e8291d2f289fafdb913e368a0d5a76e.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦是马萨诸塞州联邦参议员，在2020年民主党总统提名角逐中认真争取过胜利。她通常被视为坚定的进步派，尤其重视金融改革与监管。今年夏天的抗议活动后，一些支持者期待你选择一位非裔竞选搭档；选择她会令这些人不满。

b836825e9e175d10c6034213adf46d822cba819b.source: Elizabeth Warren is a good friend and an icon of the progressive movement. There are very few people in this country who have done more to advance progressive ideals than Ms. Warren.
b836825e9e175d10c6034213adf46d822cba819b.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦是我的好朋友，也是进步派运动的标志性人物。这个国家里，很少有人在推动进步理念上，比沃伦女士做得更多。

c3ff0a6ce0fed81a07c61c32a44f327929486d12.source: Elizabeth Warren is currently fighting the good fight in the Massachusetts Senate race. Would you be open to offering her a position in your Administration if she falls short there?
c3ff0a6ce0fed81a07c61c32a44f327929486d12.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦目前正在马萨诸塞州参议员竞选中为正义而战。如果她在那里落败，你是否愿意在政府中给她一个职位？

9f64cff623d63d3421a7d50d7ce647e688610821.source: Elizabeth Warren is out in front on the issues of debt forgiveness, economic fairness, and in fighting the influence of Wall Street on American policy. She will help us fight the unfair influence of the 1%.
9f64cff623d63d3421a7d50d7ce647e688610821.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦在债务减免、经济公平，以及抵制华尔街对美国政策的影响等议题上走在前列。她会帮助我们对抗最富有的1%人群所施加的不公平影响。

c5fe33aadfb3d51c6cc5be7ecb617580cb7bd851.source: Elizabeth Warren ran an incredible campaign and I'm proud to have us join forces on this year's Democratic ticket. She is someone who can really help pull our party together and maximize turnout this fall.
c5fe33aadfb3d51c6cc5be7ecb617580cb7bd851.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦的竞选十分出色，我很自豪能在今年的民主党竞选组合中与她携手。她真能帮助我们团结全党，让今年秋天的投票率尽可能高。

6d9534e962ace2ce7765c8b088cdc0fbd78eaa5f.source: Everett Dirksen has served the state of Illinois admirably during his time in the U.S. Senate, and I'm proud to have him on my ticket.
6d9534e962ace2ce7765c8b088cdc0fbd78eaa5f.zh: 埃弗里特·德克森在美国参议院任职期间，为伊利诺伊州尽心服务，令人钦佩。我很自豪，他能加入我的竞选组合。

7accd74e57ee1d32bff47d337354b90b27ea9a4f.source: Everett Dirksen is a mainstream Republican who represents the direction that our party should take moving forward.
7accd74e57ee1d32bff47d337354b90b27ea9a4f.zh: 埃弗里特·德克森是一位主流共和党人，代表着本党应当前进的方向。

977250dd39f2673a8b1c925fb46ebc481e4db3bb.source: Everett Dirksen is the Senate Minority Leader, an economic conservative and an internationalist in world affairs. He occupies the middle ground of Republican thought, and hails from the key state of Illinois. He would reinforce Nixon's experience argument, having served in Congress for nearly 30 years. There is no large bloc of the party that would be opposed to Dirksen.
977250dd39f2673a8b1c925fb46ebc481e4db3bb.zh: 埃弗里特·德克森 是参议院少数党领袖、经济保守派和世界事务中的国际主义者。他占据共和党思想的中间立场，来自伊利诺伊州的关键州。他在国会任职近 30 年，将强化 尼克松 的经验论点。党内没有大集团会反对德克森。

585108166c2ea961e57a642153fb30b05d5d186b.source: Every day that we don't invest in solar power is a day that we fall further behind countries like China and Germany. Investment should be increased.
585108166c2ea961e57a642153fb30b05d5d186b.zh: 每一天不投资太阳能，我们就比中国和德国这样的国家落后更多。应该增加投资。

d680aa83b05113ab96afcdbcbb11245a3cdbc46e.source: Every good American should support our current expedition into Mexico, to apprehend the villainous Pancho Villa.
d680aa83b05113ab96afcdbcbb11245a3cdbc46e.zh: 每一位爱国的美国人都应支持我们当前深入墨西哥、抓捕恶徒潘乔·比利亚的远征行动。

f919a48740a8ca399ee145ddf5c930acc84671ba.source: Every man should have a choice on whether to join a union or not. These large outfits monopolize the work force and use their power to perpetrate voter fraud and to enrich their bosses.
f919a48740a8ca399ee145ddf5c930acc84671ba.zh: 每个人都应有权选择是否加入工会。这些庞大的组织垄断劳动力市场，利用手中的权力操纵选举、让工会头目中饱私囊。

e08da923f4fb4c26875526f95fdb09c638dac91e.source: Every man should have a right to bargain for his own wages. Let us reaffirm our opposition to collective bargaining and to radical labor unions.
e08da923f4fb4c26875526f95fdb09c638dac91e.zh: 每个人都应当有权自行商议工资。重申我们反对集体谈判，也反对激进工会。

e39437bc18169e31b5fcd18f3638d9ea3df40dce.source: Every party has political clubs and supporters. I'm proud that we have ours, and they will help drive us to victory in November.
e39437bc18169e31b5fcd18f3638d9ea3df40dce.zh: 每个政党都有自己的政治社团和支持者。我为我们拥有这些人而自豪，他们将帮助我们在11月获胜。

16c883277800dbd24273d4cc258b45a74228d20b.source: Every party has political clubs and supporters. There's no reason to take special alarm at the Wide Awakes.
16c883277800dbd24273d4cc258b45a74228d20b.zh: 每个政党都有自己的政治社团和支持者。没理由对“觉醒者”格外惊慌。

0715ac9c2d930f1c4f0feaaea8dd69e55489837a.source: Everybody knows about these kinds of statements. We shouldn't allow ourselves to be dragged into the gutter on this. Rather, we should focus on policy issues in our campaign.
0715ac9c2d930f1c4f0feaaea8dd69e55489837a.zh: 大家都知道这些话。我们不应该被拖进这种低俗争吵，而应该在竞选中聚焦政策议题。

77e319f32ef92255503f5223b02ffd57fdf0545a.source: Everybody knows that Dan Quayle lost, but decorum requires you to spin it otherwise.
77e319f32ef92255503f5223b02ffd57fdf0545a.zh: 大家都知道丹·奎尔输了，但出于礼仪，你得换一种说法来圆场。

72eff8ad6f82d659b3c4573d816f0c5f42fb0f81.source: Everybody knows that the Democrats are the party of low tariffs, and we intend to keep it that way.
72eff8ad6f82d659b3c4573d816f0c5f42fb0f81.zh: 人人都知道，民主党是主张低关税的政党。我们打算保持这个立场。

b7f4c0c63f678e4dbfe829a0465a3165bf642f72.source: Everybody wants a Transcontinental Railroad, and Republicans have supported this since the beginning.
b7f4c0c63f678e4dbfe829a0465a3165bf642f72.zh: 人人都想要一条横贯大陆的铁路，而共和党从一开始就支持这一点。

7b1945c163e5683b3fc81402081ff3dbc73fd5fe.source: Even Republicans are looking for ways to defuse Cold War tensions these days. This is in line with your actions as President thus far.
7b1945c163e5683b3fc81402081ff3dbc73fd5fe.zh: 在这些日子里，连共和党人都在寻找缓和冷战紧张局势的办法。这也符合你迄今担任总统时采取的行动。

a29543a5856dfe875fc5b4c01a53f61c6b018e18.source: Even as the pace of immigration has declined in recent years, there is fierce disagreement on how to handle the issue of illegal immigrants within the country, and also on how many legal immigrants to allow. Some on the right demand mass deportations, while employers who benefit from cheap labor are more circumspect. At the same time, many liberals and Hispanics urge for some form of recognition and a path to citizenship for illegals.
a29543a5856dfe875fc5b4c01a53f61c6b018e18.zh: 尽管近年移民增长放缓，但如何处理境内非法移民、允许多少合法移民，仍存在激烈分歧。右派中有人要求大规模遣返，从廉价劳动力中获益的雇主则更为谨慎。与此同时，许多自由派人士和拉美裔民众呼吁，以某种形式承认非法移民的地位，并为他们提供入籍途径。

6ede4aaa1ff7f21b7a34ce7b96f259c543d18217.source: Even close advisors feel it was probably a mistake to freeze Bernie out so aggressively from the convention, given the backlash that has ensued.
6ede4aaa1ff7f21b7a34ce7b96f259c543d18217.zh: 鉴于已经引发的反弹，连亲近的顾问都觉得，在党代会上如此坚决地排挤伯尼，大概是个错误。

5e946cc5a67979c5d4f0ea563e5c8191e6f42bb4.source: Even for the anti-war sentiment of the times, this is a little too passive for many.
5e946cc5a67979c5d4f0ea563e5c8191e6f42bb4.zh: 即便当时反战情绪高涨，许多人仍觉得这个立场过于消极。

56b64a7abf9b7e1f73b7cd2210e7c00276ee9ff8.source: Even for those concerned about Republican tactics, many think that adding four new Justices is an aggressive overreach. Others say it is the only option left.
56b64a7abf9b7e1f73b7cd2210e7c00276ee9ff8.zh: 即使担心共和党的策略，许多人仍认为，增加四名大法官是激进的过度反击。另一些人则说，这是仅剩的选择。

6f4e26d5f8e7703d4e829c1d2d6d60e6b39d27d1.source: Even if climate change is real, it's impossible to determine how much of it results from human action. It's just as possible that the earth is warming of its own accord, and it makes no sense to disrupt our economy and potentially cause a depression until we have more information.
6f4e26d5f8e7703d4e829c1d2d6d60e6b39d27d1.zh: 即便气候变化确实存在，也无法确定其中有多少是人类活动造成的。地球完全可能是在自行变暖；在掌握更多信息之前，扰乱我们的经济、甚至可能引发萧条，毫无道理。

5dc3720d8674d1d2a0de7b506b3ed712d51baf41.source: Even if global warming is real, I highly doubt it has anything to do with human activity.
5dc3720d8674d1d2a0de7b506b3ed712d51baf41.zh: 即使全球变暖确实存在，我也非常怀疑它与人类活动有什么关系。

94ddd1eb4b63721dd4a7949e259480306ba89856.source: Even if permitted, I would hope that our states would move to abolish the death penalty.
94ddd1eb4b63721dd4a7949e259480306ba89856.zh: 即使法律允许，我仍希望各州能废除死刑。

b02c0766d86af13348b0ec0a7d05959edb83ff78.source: Even some Republicans see problems in the current setup of Social Security.
b02c0766d86af13348b0ec0a7d05959edb83ff78.zh: 就连一些共和党人，也认为目前的社会保障安排存在问题。

b3d293aadb32681814d1fcfdcbbbbd93dd6bc603.source: Even some solid Republicans are questioning the wisdom of more tax cuts with the current debt and deficit.
b3d293aadb32681814d1fcfdcbbbbd93dd6bc603.zh: 考虑到当前的债务和赤字，就连一些坚定的共和党人也在质疑进一步减税是否明智。

d87e1b91916dfe72e0382d6508e00a19d430e812.source: Even the Northern Democrats support a homestead act. Let's stick to issues where we have a distinction to hammer on.
d87e1b91916dfe72e0382d6508e00a19d430e812.zh: 连北方民主党人都支持宅地法。我们还是抓住那些与对手存在分歧的议题，反复强调吧。

67adef7577c46e2b534c2e0f3c17083b640fe53b.source: Even your opponents have to chuckle a bit at this one.
67adef7577c46e2b534c2e0f3c17083b640fe53b.zh: 听到这一句，连你的对手都得笑上几声。

1160aa1e09be740eb26dbd326d9c26408eaae06c.source: Eventually, after a few days of uproar, your party makes it clear that Butz must go. Unfortunately, this has been a huge distraction and has made you look pretty bad on the evening news.
1160aa1e09be740eb26dbd326d9c26408eaae06c.zh: 闹了几天之后，党内最终明确表示，巴茨必须离职。不幸的是，这件事严重分散了竞选精力，也让你在晚间新闻里显得很糟。

56de03b905dd258fc37ea678ac5ec31aa743c76a.source: Everyone knows that conservative activists are fantastic at negative advertising. Let them do their thing while you give positive, uplifting solutions.
56de03b905dd258fc37ea678ac5ec31aa743c76a.zh: 谁都知道，保守派活动人士很擅长负面广告。让他们各显其能，你则提出积极、鼓舞人心的解决办法。

d72775454ec1df04c39fbde6067d37523ca09c59.source: Everyone knows what I want already. Let's talk about Goldwater, his extremism, and how he's completely unfit for office- that should get them worked up.
d72775454ec1df04c39fbde6067d37523ca09c59.zh: 大家早就知道我想做什么了。我们来谈戈德华特，谈他的极端立场，以及他为什么完全不适合担任总统。这应该能让他们激动起来。

7c52acdbbb1e2ec49b957b675660c3a25250ea84.source: Everyone needs to appeal to their base, but saying you'd end the Department of Education makes you look a bit extreme to most people.
7c52acdbbb1e2ec49b957b675660c3a25250ea84.zh: 人人都需要争取基本盘，但说要撤销教育部，会让多数人觉得你有点极端。

b4d566f1f899a60d2ccb6c544ec3195f6adab98c.source: Everyone thought it impossible, but you’ve pulled it off! You’re the first third-party candidate in over 30 years to win a state, and both you and your supporters are ecstatic. Federal matching funds in 2004 are all but guaranteed, and you’ve established the green party as a force to be reckoned with.
b4d566f1f899a60d2ccb6c544ec3195f6adab98c.zh: 每个人都认为这是不可能的，但你成功了！您是 30 多年来第一位赢得一个州的第三方候选人，您和您的支持者都欣喜若狂。 2004 年的联邦配套资金几乎是有保证的，并且您已将 绿党 确立为一股不可忽视的力量。

c38478737dcc283a88535f6e0de2763cbb42bbd2.source: Everyone thought it impossible, that at best you would get 5%, but you’ve proved everybody wrong! This is the biggest political upset in American history, beating out Truman over 50 years ago. An impromptu party has been arranged at the Green Party headquarters in DC, your answering machine is clogged with congratulatory calls from your supporters, and every news station in the country has been clamouring to get to you for an interview
c38478737dcc283a88535f6e0de2763cbb42bbd2.zh: 每个人都认为不可能，最多只能得到 5%，但你已经证明每个人都错了！这是美国历史上最大的政治动荡，50 多年前就击败了 杜鲁门。华盛顿的绿党总部已经安排了一场即兴派对，你的答录机被你的支持者的祝贺电话堵得满满的，全国各大新闻台都吵着要找你采访

91a863051d151648d7231e7b2366b55cf64f5e8c.source: Everyone who saw it agrees that your final rally was truly an epic sight to behold!
91a863051d151648d7231e7b2366b55cf64f5e8c.zh: 所有看过的人都同意，你最后一场集会的场面确实蔚为壮观！

50642010946a93e33b2737b0c1047e428e54a7ad.source: Everything is going well, except for an unfortunate incident in Texas which is giving Lyndon Johnson some good publicity there. Good luck tonight!
50642010946a93e33b2737b0c1047e428e54a7ad.zh: 一切进展顺利，只有得克萨斯州发生的一件不愉快事件，为林登·约翰逊带来了当地的正面宣传。祝今晚好运！

5e2b8f9c11d242d542feffc0b21a997a761653f1.source: Everywhere you go, large crowds await you. Dewey seems to have the advantage in the polls, but pundits admire your spunk and your fiery speaking style.
5e2b8f9c11d242d542feffc0b21a997a761653f1.zh: 无论你走到哪里，都有大批人群等着你。杜威似乎在民调中占优，但评论人士欣赏你的斗志和火热的演说风格。

b55727980216dbf6fb86479755c626cb7f336f05.source: Evolution teaches disregard for the security and dignity of our fellow man. Left unchecked this 'survival of the fittest' mentality will eventually cause indifference to life itself, from which only calamity can ensue.
b55727980216dbf6fb86479755c626cb7f336f05.zh: 进化论教人漠视同胞的安全和尊严。如果不加约束，这种“适者生存”的心态，最终会使人连生命本身也不在乎，继而只能酿成灾难。

18a74397543b0f5e8f71b29c6e800e6d08c2b293.source: Exactly 100 years after the previous instance of this, the popular vote loser has won the election!. Republicans aren't happy at all, and you can be sure they’re already thinking about 1992.
18a74397543b0f5e8f71b29c6e800e6d08c2b293.zh: 距离上次恰好一百年，普选票落败者又一次赢得了总统选举！共和党人很不高兴，而且可以肯定，他们已经在盘算1992年了。

a76c61002d265c2d2b03bb9fc8338ef6936e777d.source: Favors gay marriage, decriminalization of marijuana, legal access to abortion through at least the first trimester, and wide restrictions on gun ownership. Follows women's issues closely and supports increased funding for women's shelters, child care, birth control, and similar programs.
a76c61002d265c2d2b03bb9fc8338ef6936e777d.zh: 主张同性婚姻、大麻非刑事化、至少允许在怀孕头三个月合法堕胎，并广泛限制枪支持有。密切关注女性议题，支持增加妇女庇护所、托育、避孕等项目的经费。

1a656a2845e2a7f95abf5a168f5c1570b84a49dd.source: Favors gay marriage. Advocates for an immediate end to the drug war and the legalization of marijuana and perhaps other drugs. Thinks abortion should be legal in all circumstances. Supports a total or near-total ban on gun ownership. Supports early education on contraceptives to reduce teen pregnancy.
1a656a2845e2a7f95abf5a168f5c1570b84a49dd.zh: 主张同性婚姻。提倡立即结束禁毒战争，将大麻、甚至其他毒品合法化。认为所有情况下堕胎都应该合法。支持全面或几乎全面禁止持枪。支持早期避孕教育，以减少青少年怀孕。

b8ecf7e2bcc44a436b7778e7f848e6ea3900307f.source: Favors some kind of citizenship program for long-term and young illegal immigrants. Friendly with the Hispanic community and not fundamentally opposed to immigration, but may be opposed to policies such as bilingual education. Supports increases in legal immigration and in visa programs.
b8ecf7e2bcc44a436b7778e7f848e6ea3900307f.zh: 主张为长期居住者和年轻非法移民设立某种入籍计划。与拉美裔社群关系友好，原则上不反对移民，但可能反对双语教育等政策。支持增加合法移民及扩大签证项目。

bf6f408cad1927aab6ba9e6699b348d71d16d28c.source: Favors stimulus measures and not opposed to government programs in principle. Uncomfortable with rapid increases in spending or with entirely new programs and departments.
bf6f408cad1927aab6ba9e6699b348d71d16d28c.zh: 主张刺激措施，原则上不反对政府项目。不赞成支出急剧增加，也不赞成设立全新的项目与部门。

75065fba65823320285916dab85829905f828cb9.source: Favors temporary stimulus measures combined with long-term budget cuts. Generally comfortable with the free market and mainstream economics.
75065fba65823320285916dab85829905f828cb9.zh: 主张把临时刺激措施与长期预算削减相结合。总体接受自由市场和主流经济学。

b0e86ddfab1e3d0d1b0ebae0d27f6620b4e098de.source: Fear and Loathing in Trump Hotel
b0e86ddfab1e3d0d1b0ebae0d27f6620b4e098de.zh: 特朗普 酒店中的恐惧和厌恶

0ad71da5d35bd2d79ebc7276a039b927a16bcbfd.source: Federal tyranny? And what were you saying about

07e5e5bb61fde47dc04beecafafdcdd95a165d57.source: Fighting for the rebirth of a public option is a mainstream position for the Democrats.
07e5e5bb61fde47dc04beecafafdcdd95a165d57.zh: 争取恢复公共医保选项，是民主党的主流立场。

f3c83bf8e905ddfad5c0120325fa98bcb59cc084.source: Financial Fiasco: How America's Infatuation with Home Ownership and Easy Money Created the Economic Crisis
f3c83bf8e905ddfad5c0120325fa98bcb59cc084.zh: 金融惨败：美国对住房所有权和宽松货币的迷恋如何造成经济危机

4fd0d61137ee22fbb8fc495f1f6544352d7eaadb.zh: 第一次肯尼迪-尼克松辩论（视频）

df8f36965a574f6e940fdb1017b4bfd8e125a1fa.source: First and foremost, I will end the war in Vietnam by any means necessary. Beyond that I will support the AFL-CIO and otherwise bear the standard for liberalism in this country.
df8f36965a574f6e940fdb1017b4bfd8e125a1fa.zh: 首先，我会尽一切必要手段结束越南战争。此外，我会支持劳联—产联，并在其他方面扛起美国自由主义的旗帜。

a6d46468ba8ad28f0cf83303c989deff2e462226.source: First and foremost, cuts will be in foreign aid.
a6d46468ba8ad28f0cf83303c989deff2e462226.zh: 首先，削减的将是对外援助。

af7de0ecd4b927e1ec0fbc93b525ace0200a933e.source: Expect Al Gore to unleash a new round of government programs and environmental regulations. You are still youngish, however. If the election was close this time, perhaps you can run again in 2004, or work on behalf your brother Jeb.
af7de0ecd4b927e1ec0fbc93b525ace0200a933e.zh: 可以预料，阿尔·戈尔会推出新一轮政府项目与环保法规。不过，你还算年轻。如果这次只是惜败，或许可以在2004年再次参选，也可以转而帮助你的兄弟杰布。

9313d145925e2358c1be08804e06942675f834a8.source: Expect your hopes of getting elected to be buried under about $50 million of shady, PAC television commercials.
9313d145925e2358c1be08804e06942675f834a8.zh: 等着吧，你当选的希望将被大约5000万美元的可疑政治行动委员会电视广告埋葬。

38efaf6a5ab75f0df18a24b4f9c536e7fd4b0c3e.source: Expect your hopes of getting reelected to be buried under about $50 million of shady, PAC television commercials.
38efaf6a5ab75f0df18a24b4f9c536e7fd4b0c3e.zh: 等着吧，你连任的希望将被大约5000万美元的可疑政治行动委员会电视广告埋葬。

0c7b46b3c5d761febe794118bab01339f6a37209.source: FOX News can now project Biden is the apparent winner in Wyoming
0c7b46b3c5d761febe794118bab01339f6a37209.zh: 福克斯新闻现在可以预测 拜登 是 怀俄明州 中明显的赢家

ab8c4852127dd95858522f88ec9599e059dfc652.source: Fair enough. This doesn't really hurt you, but you need things to break your way fast if you're going to catch up with Carter.
ab8c4852127dd95858522f88ec9599e059dfc652.zh: 也有道理。这并不会真的伤害你，但如果想追上卡特，你需要局势迅速转向对你有利。

fdb178e2f7a0c9ef6ed7d69037e65507bf8eb2c2.source: Fair is fair, right? The Republicans have stolen two seats on the Court with McConnell's chicanery. I think we should create two new justices and appoint them in return.
fdb178e2f7a0c9ef6ed7d69037e65507bf8eb2c2.zh: 公平就是公平，对吧？共和党靠麦康奈尔的诡计，偷走了法院的两个席位。我认为，我们应该新增两个大法官席位，再任命人选，作为回应。

fc72037fa6cbd38833e8cbecd7fb9920665ac4f4.source: Famous actor Ronald Reagan has given a long speech in support of Barry Goldwater in California. The speech, immediately popular nationwide, has been dubbed ‘A Time For Choosing.’
fc72037fa6cbd38833e8cbecd7fb9920665ac4f4.zh: 著名演员罗纳德·里根在加利福尼亚州发表长篇演说，支持巴里·戈德华特。这篇演说迅速风靡全国，被称为《抉择的时刻》。

681b5e6b404dd3d75155f296711222c451fdb25a.source: Farm income has increased. Employment income and jobs have increased. Business income has increased. We've seen great strides in our economy since 1945, and I don't mind telling people.
681b5e6b404dd3d75155f296711222c451fdb25a.zh: 农民收入增加了。工资收入和就业岗位增加了。企业收入也增加了。1945年以来，我们的经济取得了长足进步，我很乐意告诉大家。

4c62f7bf495c6a7238602cbe243ff63f40409254.source: Farm issues aren't as important to voters as they once were, but some do still depend on these subsidies.
4c62f7bf495c6a7238602cbe243ff63f40409254.zh: 农业议题对选民的影响已经不如从前，不过仍有一些人依赖这些补贴。

3ebab310ae908a1b89ebd157df90c2525a9f64c4.source: Favors a mix of diplomatic pressure and sanctions against Iran, would be opposed to bombing until the effects of those policies can be evaluated. Supports other efforts like drone strikes which project force at minimum risk to American troops.
3ebab310ae908a1b89ebd157df90c2525a9f64c4.zh: 主张对伊朗结合使用外交施压与制裁，在能够评估这些政策的效果之前反对轰炸。支持无人机打击等其他行动，以尽量降低美军风险的方式投送武力。

0310a1a12eed5da761a7bc28456d6ada00dcefa6.source: Favors both short-term stimulus and long-term growth in the scope of government. Supports a wide range of regulation to mitigate the excesses of the free market.
0310a1a12eed5da761a7bc28456d6ada00dcefa6.zh: 既主张短期刺激，也主张长期扩大政府职能。支持广泛监管，以缓解自由市场过度发展带来的弊端。

9c93a76ade7b5d0a6747e37e700587cee7a1d8a2.source: Favors civil unions and may support gay marriage. May support reduced penalties for some drug offenses. In general a supporter of gun control, while acknowledging the rights conferred by the Second Amendment.
9c93a76ade7b5d0a6747e37e700587cee7a1d8a2.zh: 主张民事结合，可能支持同性婚姻。可能支持减轻某些毒品犯罪的处罚。总体支持枪支管制，同时承认第二修正案赋予的权利。

6951ff457f6a7de07d7b9d01532668102495412f.source: For you, it seems your political career is over. Bernie Sanders's supporters are angered that you cast their candidate aside, only to lose to a populist like Trump. Whatever happens, your legacy as a politician will be most certainly historical
6951ff457f6a7de07d7b9d01532668102495412f.zh: 对你而言，政治生涯似乎已经结束。伯尼·桑德斯的支持者愤怒不已：你排挤了他们的候选人，最后却输给了特朗普这样的民粹主义者。不论此后发生什么，你作为政治人物留下的遗产都必将载入历史。

d8108acb7e6a2b9b2b1d1ca30e0efe3c86fdcb8d.source: Ford performed well, except for an unfortunate gaffe about the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
d8108acb7e6a2b9b2b1d1ca30e0efe3c86fdcb8d.zh: 除了关于苏联和东欧的一次不幸口误，福特的表现不错。而且，随着选举临近，经济正在改善，选民也开始更仔细地审视局势……

c80387fca3bfa116ad0395d473e156b6a3c90396.source: Foreign policy is not a huge issue in this election. Just avoid saying anything too hawkish or dovish so that you don't attract negative attention.
c80387fca3bfa116ad0395d473e156b6a3c90396.zh: 外交政策并不是这次选举的重大议题。只要避免说得过于鹰派或鸽派，以免招来负面关注就好。

c2252196ea9712f5a6dd31959fc5f38d114238dd.source: Former Vice President Joe Biden was on MSNBC, discussing his recent claims of massive election fraud, "Trump stole this election! I think that's fairly clear."
c2252196ea9712f5a6dd31959fc5f38d114238dd.zh: 前副总统 乔·拜登 在 MSNBC 上讨论他最近关于大规模选举舞弊的指控，“特朗普 窃取了这次选举！我认为这相当清楚。”

8ac762ad6c4a20cc646d5beda0ef600058b11ffe.source: Fortunately for you the Democrats have won a majority of the nation's Congressional delegations. Unfortunately, you also have to deal with George Wallace. He will not allow the Southern states to support any candidate who advocates desegregation.
8ac762ad6c4a20cc646d5beda0ef600058b11ffe.zh: 对你来说幸运的是，民主党赢得了全国国会代表团的多数席位。不幸的是，您还必须处理乔治·华莱士。他不会允许南方各州支持任何主张废除种族隔离的候选人。

cfc9516a6e1a6de6ddc31836252ad8e59b64e236.source: Fossil fuels and coal are the backbone of our energy supply. If we got rid of those, what would we have left? We have to be realistic and realize that our options are limited.
cfc9516a6e1a6de6ddc31836252ad8e59b64e236.zh: 化石燃料和煤炭，是我们能源供应的支柱。如果不要这些，我们还剩什么？我们必须现实一点，认识到选择有限。

7b44b15c0624aff3014b99832a6166cd5b004886.source: Fox News immediately attacks you for “politicizing” Trump's illness. But is that really a bad thing?
7b44b15c0624aff3014b99832a6166cd5b004886.zh: 福克斯新闻立刻攻击你，称你把特朗普的病情“政治化”。但这真的算坏事吗？

e5df30ee353f55ae0b88da1bdedbc14a730e69d5.source: Fracking poisons our drinking water and postpones the development of alternative energy sources. This practice should be outlawed.
e5df30ee353f55ae0b88da1bdedbc14a730e69d5.zh: 水力压裂污染饮用水，延缓替代能源的开发。应该禁止这种做法。

59631817b87fa2bcf0bd06b00a792010a290552b.source: Frank Church has made some recent statements on the campaign trail that even more needs to be done to rein in America's military and intelligence agencies. Do you think he is going too far?
59631817b87fa2bcf0bd06b00a792010a290552b.zh: 弗兰克·丘奇最近在竞选活动中说，还需要进一步约束美国军事和情报机构。你认为他走得太远了吗？

ad721d8cf57d7b3f8e9c7707632106b5448b7382.source: Frank Church has served his home state of Idaho well, and he is the best man for the job.
ad721d8cf57d7b3f8e9c7707632106b5448b7382.zh: 弗兰克·丘奇为家乡爱达荷州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

1b3f17eb2a1434e1ca7fe795026c01b0f1d5080c.source: For the first time since 1888, the loser of the popular vote has won the election! This has many Democrats are very angry, and they are lamenting the Bayh-Celler amendment not passing.
1b3f17eb2a1434e1ca7fe795026c01b0f1d5080c.zh: 自1888年以来，普选票落败者首次赢得了总统选举！许多民主党人对此非常愤怒，痛惜贝赫—塞勒修正案未能通过。

60be38abd007a0080ff45dfb627e4505ce7666bd.source: For the first time since 1888, the loser of the popular vote has won the election! This has many Democrats are very angry, especially at Ralph Nader for "spoiling" the election.
60be38abd007a0080ff45dfb627e4505ce7666bd.zh: 这是1888年以来，首次出现普选票落后者赢得大选！许多民主党人非常愤怒，尤其迁怒于拉尔夫·纳德，怪他“搅局”。

7a37ffbec62ee26c03adc9583cb93e840db5b5eb.source: For the first time since 1888, the loser of the popular vote has won the election! This has many Republicans enraged, especially due to the fact this is the 3rd Democrat in a row winning with less than 50% of the popular vote. Maybe a run in 4 years IS in the books for you...
7a37ffbec62ee26c03adc9583cb93e840db5b5eb.zh: 自 1888 年以来，普选失败者首次赢得选举！这激怒了许多共和党人，特别是因为这是连续第三位民主党人以低于 50% 的普选票获胜。也许四年内的跑步对你来说是在书中......

5535975a6a82cb0adb6a4c4d008a489b620be548.source: For the first time since 1888, the winner of the electoral vote lost the popular vote. It seems many people underestimated how much of an effect Wallace had on your campaign in the south.
5535975a6a82cb0adb6a4c4d008a489b620be548.zh: 自1888年以来，首次出现选举人票胜者输掉普选票的情况。看来，许多人低估了华莱士在南方对你竞选的影响。

99ef5fcb63bc20cf59c295b2f4b2afaf0261afac.source: For the most part, Americans support the efforts to reduce Communist influence in this country.
99ef5fcb63bc20cf59c295b2f4b2afaf0261afac.zh: 总体而言，美国人支持减少本国共产党影响的努力。

e5bdeb80ba0aa863369dfc9d9d351a5aee39180d.source: For the most part, I don't think that's appropriate. There are some limited areas, like relaxing restrictions on foreign ownership, where we can still help out.
e5bdeb80ba0aa863369dfc9d9d351a5aee39180d.zh: 总体而言，我认为这不合适。但在少数方面，我们仍能提供帮助，比如放宽外国人购房的限制。

881329a7d4cb6090f9c7ce1f4e81ada17acd65b4.source: For the most part, I'm going to campaign from home until things settle down. But I do want to make a couple of public speeches (to limited crowds) on our most important issues.
881329a7d4cb6090f9c7ce1f4e81ada17acd65b4.zh: 大部分时候，我会在家竞选，直到局势平稳。不过，我确实希望就最重要的议题，发表几场面向有限人数的公开演说。

8078e9fd3f7e6e11c57227fb39956ced4b717379.source: For the second time in a row, many analysts saw a victory for you as practically impossible. But whatever they say, it is clear that your Make America Great Again agenda has been vindicated. Where do you take things from here?
8078e9fd3f7e6e11c57227fb39956ced4b717379.zh: 许多分析师连续第二次认为您几乎不可能获胜。但无论他们说什么，很明显你的 让美国再次伟大 议程已得到证实。你从这里拿东西去哪里？

ee40540e61798d4ad0c08a0cf5124d02e16aecc4.source: For too long, farmers have been stopped from participating properly in the free market. Cutting their subsidies will benefit both the budget and the farmers.
ee40540e61798d4ad0c08a0cf5124d02e16aecc4.zh: 长期以来，农民一直被阻碍，无法正常参与自由市场。削减补贴，既有利于预算，也有利于农民。

719f7c647cf3f5e44e54bb4cc61ca12fa5307680.source: For two decades I have fought for organized labor and supported the Civil Rights movement. I will focus heavily on my biography as I travel.
719f7c647cf3f5e44e54bb4cc61ca12fa5307680.zh: 二十年来，我一直为有组织的劳工运动奋斗，支持民权运动。巡回竞选时，我会着重讲述自己的经历。

31b969df258a0b4e650423d4574c7bf23317f19c.source: For years, Humphrey has been seen as Johnson's natural successor. This both helped and hurt him in the bitter nomination struggle.
31b969df258a0b4e650423d4574c7bf23317f19c.zh: 多年来，汉弗莱 一直被视为 约翰逊 的自然继承者。这在激烈的提名斗争中既帮助了他，也伤害了他。

732862ce977371a2711730c4088f36d9476646f6.source: Frank Church is a Senator from Idaho, and one of Carter's rivals in the 1976 primaries. He is known for his opposition to the Vietnam War, and his investigations of America's intelligence bureaus. Both of these factors make him appealing to the anti-war bloc of the Democratic Party, and have made him a well-known, national figure in politics. He is also outgoing and charismatic, and could overshadow a more soft-spoken Carter.
732862ce977371a2711730c4088f36d9476646f6.zh: 弗兰克·丘奇 是来自 爱达荷州 的参议员，也是 卡特 在 1976 年初选中的竞争对手之一。他因反对 越南战争 以及对美国情报局的调查而闻名。这两个因素都使他对民主党的反战集团有吸引力，并使他成为政治上著名的全国人物。他也很外向、有魅力，可能会盖过说话更温和的人 卡特。

2d8198b12f4ebd1e461f492addd6e7ab0db722b3.source: Frank Church is committed to openness in government, and in exposing the kinds of intelligence abuses that all Americans deserve to hear about.
2d8198b12f4ebd1e461f492addd6e7ab0db722b3.zh: 弗兰克·丘奇致力于政府公开透明，揭露那些所有美国人都有权知道的情报机构滥权行为。

a523178fd37493fb9c77ba16bb0e9f2ebabfc8cd.source: Frank Church should help burnish your credentials on defense and character issues.
a523178fd37493fb9c77ba16bb0e9f2ebabfc8cd.zh: 弗兰克·丘奇应该能为你在国防和品格问题上的资历增色。

ba083d2c412e9a326c74fea6eb6478c4f669c363.source: Free coinage of silver will debase our currency and make a mockery of us to the rest of the world.
ba083d2c412e9a326c74fea6eb6478c4f669c363.zh: 白银自由铸币会使我们的货币贬值，让我们沦为世界的笑柄。

5298e6a0213ddebceb2e4c748c27c133a19a2371.source: Free trade agreements definitely cost more American jobs than they create, further polarizing our society.
5298e6a0213ddebceb2e4c748c27c133a19a2371.zh: 自由贸易协定肯定会使美国失去比它创造的更多工作岗位，让社会进一步分化。

3e2c2288fb72729eab013ed062ee8491961be8ca.source: Free trade and globalization have been a huge driver of economic growth over the past 25 years.
3e2c2288fb72729eab013ed062ee8491961be8ca.zh: 过去25年，自由贸易与全球化是经济增长的巨大动力。

865f81e66d7102e3c4ca147dd212a77b5b4b0480.source: Free trade is a bulwark of American prosperity. I support our efforts to protect and increase foreign trade.
865f81e66d7102e3c4ca147dd212a77b5b4b0480.zh: 自由贸易是美国繁荣的支柱。我支持我们保护和扩大对外贸易的努力。

9403903b5c1aa7b9a83c00027541fb54a404b168.source: Free trade is an issue that unites the left and far-right in opposition. On the other hand, both main parties generally support it.
9403903b5c1aa7b9a83c00027541fb54a404b168.zh: 自由贸易让左翼与极右翼联合反对。另一方面，两大党总体上都支持它。

f013ceeb869222f5259aeb8444d316a31db56c7c.source: Frightening comments to hear from a so-called Republican!
f013ceeb869222f5259aeb8444d316a31db56c7c.zh: 一个所谓的共和党人，说出这种话，真让人害怕！

51cd18150eead777d300e08ab1ee854646a90a1b.source: From coast to coast and town to town in nearly every public meeting space and private residence, millions of Americans have been captivated, inspired, and in some cases even moved to tears by Republican presidential candidate Mitt Romney, all signs that the nation has undeniably been swept up in full-scale Romneymania. The raw energy and enthusiasm of Romney coupled with his uplifting story of rising from moderate wealth to overwhelming riches are just some of the reasons reverent portraits of the former Massachusetts governor have started appearing in windows across the country, often accompanied by one of Romney's signature inspirational phrases, such as 'let Detroit go bankrupt’, or 'Corporations are people.'
51cd18150eead777d300e08ab1ee854646a90a1b.zh: 从东海岸到西海岸，从一个城镇到另一个城镇，在几乎每一个公共集会场所和私人住宅中，数百万美国人都被共和党总统候选人 米特·罗姆尼 所吸引、鼓舞，在某些情况下甚至感动落泪，所有迹象都无可否认地表明这个国家已经被全面的罗姆尼狂热所席卷。 罗姆尼 的原始能量和热情，加上他从中等财富到压倒性财富的令人振奋的故事，只是前 马萨诸塞州 州长的虔诚肖像开始出现在全国各地窗户上的部分原因，通常伴随着 罗姆尼 的标志性励志短语之一，例如“让底特律破产”或“企业也是人”。

3696b8e45b6726d7db66c4f4a3b643aa9e82eaa8.source: From day one, Trump has failed to take this pandemic seriously, and has actively encouraged behaviors that spread COVID-19. What we see now is the natural consequence of that recklessness, and it only shows how unfit he is to be President of the United States.
3696b8e45b6726d7db66c4f4a3b643aa9e82eaa8.zh: 从第一天起，特朗普就没认真对待这场疫情，还积极鼓励会传播病毒的行为。现在的情况，是这种鲁莽的自然后果，也更加说明他多么不适合担任美国总统。

a7d816d6486a2fe11e8140a739659ec8f6c1c3f4.source: From the start, it's incredible that Hillary Clinton was even allowed to run. We're just fortunate that this news came out before the election. Can you imagine?!
a7d816d6486a2fe11e8140a739659ec8f6c1c3f4.zh: 从一开始就允许希拉里·克林顿参选，简直不可思议。幸好，这个消息在选举之前传了出来。你能想象吗？！

4aecbec7cf39b30637c7297ba3215f98ac793a85.source: From “Lyin' Ted” to a spot on the Supreme Court... But at least this helps you somewhat with the conservative base.
4aecbec7cf39b30637c7297ba3215f98ac793a85.zh: 从“撒谎的特德”，到最高法院席位……不过，这至少在保守派基本盘中帮了你一些。

b5bdf98f2a9f2c5d7daca2eb8732f32ddf4dfe1d.source: Further aid should be directly tied to Pakistan's continuing progress towards openness and democracy.
b5bdf98f2a9f2c5d7daca2eb8732f32ddf4dfe1d.zh: 进一步援助应该直接与巴基斯坦继续迈向开放和民主的进展挂钩。

eb83b361fcb1167ff8e20160f4b8373f4909366d.source: Fusion tickets have been organized in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. Your name will head the ballot in New York and New Jersey.
eb83b361fcb1167ff8e20160f4b8373f4909366d.zh: 纽约、新泽西和宾夕法尼亚已组成联合选举人名单。纽约和新泽西的选票将以你的名字领衔。

7c560ff95fb2dcc63de0f1d6fb3ffee191d888a4.source: Garret Hobart is currently President of the New Jersey Senate and a popular political figure in the Mid-Atlantic region. Before entering politics, he was a successful corporate lawyer.
7c560ff95fb2dcc63de0f1d6fb3ffee191d888a4.zh: 加勒特·霍巴特 目前是 新泽西州 参议院议长，也是大西洋中部地区受欢迎的政治人物。在进入政界之前，他是一名成功的公司律师。

4f4e98b8cddc70339add044b76b8993cc77acc25.source: Gary Johnson? Even the people who voted for you can't believe you won.
4f4e98b8cddc70339add044b76b8993cc77acc25.zh: 加里·约翰逊？即使是投票给你的人也不敢相信你赢了。

e2474f8f8e552ad20d5bfcb7fb62872834932d91.source: Gay marriage should be protected at the federal level. The Defense of Marriage Act should be repealed.
e2474f8f8e552ad20d5bfcb7fb62872834932d91.zh: 同性婚姻应该在联邦层面受到保护。《婚姻保护法》应该废除。

9f1dab4e50eae2c282210929b2f256890cb60518.source: General George Brown, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, has made some comments that Israel has become a "burden" to the national defense effort. Do you agree with this?
9f1dab4e50eae2c282210929b2f256890cb60518.zh: 参谋长联席会议主席乔治·布朗将军发表了一些言论，称以色列已成为国防工作的“负担”。你赞同吗？

c8fe769861f894c2384e1b902c4ef1d0bd0b54ff.source: Generally supports tax cuts and a reduction in government, including entitlement reform. May favor incremental change over sweeping reductions.
c8fe769861f894c2384e1b902c4ef1d0bd0b54ff.zh: 总体支持减税与缩减政府，包括改革依法享有的福利项目。可能更倾向于渐进调整，而非全面削减。

e3e3905c4ead2ea4688722da94e9e7725c542c9a.source: George Bush did not leave office as a popular President. Maybe you can make the case that, underneath everything, Trump and Bush aren't so different after all?
e3e3905c4ead2ea4688722da94e9e7725c542c9a.zh: 乔治·布什离任时并不是一位受欢迎的总统。也许你可以说明，剥去表面上的差别，特朗普和布什其实并没那么不同？

0fc0e477bb16ad398cae9b63086dbd9777a6c3c8.source: George Bush has served as Vice President for eight years, and also as a UN Ambassador, Director of the RNC, and Director of the CIA. He is hoping to succeed the popular Reagan, but fights the impression that he is
0fc0e477bb16ad398cae9b63086dbd9777a6c3c8.zh: 乔治·布什 担任副总统八年，还担任过联合国大使、共和党全国委员会主任和中央情报局局长。他希望能够接替广受欢迎的 里根，但又与自己的印象作斗争。

d3e54a5685dc2e777db4fd29475bfade41e0a369.source: George Bush is Reagan's Vice President, but trails his challenger by several points.
d3e54a5685dc2e777db4fd29475bfade41e0a369.zh: 乔治·布什是里根的副总统，但民调落后于挑战者数个百分点。

06f2356a3df2cc7d1bb363ab0d60cd2e617360b2.source: George Bush is nowhere near as popular as Reagan, and it is not a bad idea to mix in some attacks against him.
06f2356a3df2cc7d1bb363ab0d60cd2e617360b2.zh: 乔治·布什的受欢迎程度远不及里根，穿插一些对他的攻击并不是坏主意。

e9a844b3b8853ad41bb1900bbe09adf6650383fb.source: George Dallas has served as a Pennsylvania Senator, and as Mayor of Philadelphia. Pennsylvania is a crucial state to win if the Democrats are to return to the White House. Dallas would balance the ticket in two ways. First, he is a Northerner. Secondly, he is a moderate on the issues of tariffs and banking, compared to Polk, Jackson, and most other Southerners. He is not a moderate on the issue of expansion, and would help define that as the central Democratic issue in this election.
e9a844b3b8853ad41bb1900bbe09adf6650383fb.zh: 乔治·达拉斯曾任宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员和费城市长。民主党若想重返白宫，宾夕法尼亚州至关重要。他能从两方面平衡竞选组合：首先，他是北方人；其次，相较于波尔克、杰克逊和大多数南方人，他在关税与银行问题上立场较温和。不过，在领土扩张问题上，他并非温和派，能帮助民主党把这一主张确立为本届选举的核心议题。

2f9ca5975654e0b1428134f4b7dff4451f52b377.source: George W. Bush - A Charge to Keep: My Journey to the White House
2f9ca5975654e0b1428134f4b7dff4451f52b377.zh: 乔治·W.·布什 - 保留的电荷: 我的旅程 白宫

7acf79aa0a6d513bcbde51b8a28809c563e4926d.source: George W. Bush attempts to chart a new direction for the U.S., while Al Gore tries to win election as the sitting Vice President. Ralph Nader is a leftist third-party candidate. The economy has been booming, until quite recently, but President Clinton has been through an embarrassing scandal.
7acf79aa0a6d513bcbde51b8a28809c563e4926d.zh: 乔治·W.·布什希望为美国开辟新的方向，现任副总统阿尔·戈尔则力争当选总统。拉尔夫·纳德是一位左翼第三党候选人。直到不久前，美国经济一直繁荣，但克林顿总统陷入了一桩尴尬的丑闻。

4e8284e81112f77865e0b906cfc08129eafe27f0.source: George W. Bush enters 2000 with the support of the Republican establishment and the name recognition of his father. He has governed Texas for five years and won bipartisan support in that state. He seeks to duplicate that formula on the national stage.
4e8284e81112f77865e0b906cfc08129eafe27f0.zh: 乔治·W.·布什 在共和党建制派的支持和他父亲的知名度下进入 2000 年。他已经执政得克萨斯州五年，并赢得了该州两党的支持。他试图在国家舞台上复制这一模式。

38e6ca19478e65fdeea06e3c4f9bdf98ddcf4152.zh: 乔治·华莱士 和 1968 年选举

3c316b9a44e2f428dccbbeffab4d03aeb67597de.source: George Wallace runs with a singular goal in mind -- preventing an electoral college majority, and then using his role as kingmaker to broker an end to desegregation.
3c316b9a44e2f428dccbbeffab4d03aeb67597de.zh: 乔治·华莱士 的竞选目标只有一个——阻止 选举人团 获得多数席位，然后利用他作为拥王者的角色来促成废除种族隔离的结束。

9da0ace0290dfff0f03419699af4cb13f20c9ec1.source: Gerald Ford assumed the Presidency on August 9, 1974, after the resignation of Richard Nixon. His pardon of Nixon is deeply unpopular and is feeding the sentiment for an outsider to assume office. Inflation and unemployment have both weighed on Ford's popularity. On the other hand, Ford enjoys the stature of a President and has negotiated with many foreign leaders. He starts the campaign in second place, and must make up ground quickly while keeping his party united.
9da0ace0290dfff0f03419699af4cb13f20c9ec1.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特 在 理查德·尼克松 辞职后于 1974 年 8 月 9 日就任总统。他对 尼克松 的赦免极不受欢迎，并且助长了局外人上任的情绪。通货膨胀和失业都影响了福特的受欢迎程度。另一方面，福特享有总统的地位，曾与许多外国领导人进行谈判。他以第二名的身份开始竞选，必须在保持党派团结的同时迅速弥补失势。

0382ac2592eb0feb79cec1e2d88b785053188ac3.source: Gerald Ford pardoned Nixon, vetoed a school lunch program, and selected Bob Dole as his running mate. We need to remind the American people that he is far too much of a conservative insider to be President.
0382ac2592eb0feb79cec1e2d88b785053188ac3.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特赦免了尼克松，否决了一个学校午餐项目，还选择鲍勃·多尔作为搭档。我们必须提醒美国人民，他是个过于保守的圈内人，不适合当总统。

2d8b78f4ae2b92234ab6380b16407418febb807c.zh: 作为选民和求职者的德裔美国人

833beb49a24144aac8d8b2bcaef0cf974dd64c23.source: Germans are a key part of our new party and our vote in the Midwest. Let's express our support for the current naturalization laws.
833beb49a24144aac8d8b2bcaef0cf974dd64c23.zh: 德裔是我们这个新政党及中西部选民基础的重要组成部分。让我们明确支持现行入籍法。

f3e421c86ee9e3d96253887ed4892bc9a7ada9f6.source: Getting Tyler out of the race is worth it. He can send us a reasonable list of people who will stay on when we're elected.
f3e421c86ee9e3d96253887ed4892bc9a7ada9f6.zh: 让泰勒退出竞选，值得这样做。他可以给我们一份合理的名单，让上面的人在我们当选后留任。

000e731a51321221a1baf019590a65050f722362.source: Give him a good slot. He was one of our most effective primary challengers after all. And I'll even throw a line into my nomination speech praising the zeal and efforts of his supporters.
000e731a51321221a1baf019590a65050f722362.zh: 给他一个好时段。毕竟，他是初选中对我们最有威胁的挑战者之一。我甚至会在提名演说中加上一句，赞扬他的支持者的热情与努力。

1fbec8eb0c08d4fb2e74dd78e3bf00150fe3ec11.source: Given the Soviet threat, do you support the Selective Service Act which has been passed, even if it may lead to a peacetime draft?
1fbec8eb0c08d4fb2e74dd78e3bf00150fe3ec11.zh: 考虑到苏联的威胁，你支持已获通过的《选择性征兵法》吗，即便它可能导致和平时期的征兵？

feb786ae73143d0b883db44da440110813d6ebd0.source: Given the incredibly close nature of the election, you can certainly set your sights on a political comeback in 1900, if that is what you desire.
feb786ae73143d0b883db44da440110813d6ebd0.zh: 鉴于选举结果极其接近，您当然可以将目光投向 1900 年的政治东山再起，如果您愿意的话。

6dc30064e2428cd1190cb1179b56fba889e3796d.source: Given the incredibly close nature of the election, you can probably set your sights on a political comeback in 2016, if that is what you desire.
6dc30064e2428cd1190cb1179b56fba889e3796d.zh: 鉴于选举结果极其接近，您或许可以将目光投向 2016 年政治上的东山再起，如果您愿意的话。

ddc96955f194bc25430162deccd0ddbe7938c0c7.source: Given the incredibly close nature of the election, you will surely be expected to govern as a moderate, conciliatory President. Right??
ddc96955f194bc25430162deccd0ddbe7938c0c7.zh: 鉴于选举结果极其接近，您肯定会被期望以温和、和解的总统身份执政。正确的？？

706e0dd04f097c28907cc737dc776202ac94ecb4.source: Given the popularity of FDR, it is generally Republicans who favor the two-term limit.
706e0dd04f097c28907cc737dc776202ac94ecb4.zh: 考虑到富兰克林·罗斯福广受欢迎，通常是共和党人支持两届任期限制。

6568b6a41529fbf51c4401fd7036f41b77a9d014.source: Given these times, people are surprised to hear you lash out at the Constitutional Union Party, when both Democratic parties seem to be even worse.
6568b6a41529fbf51c4401fd7036f41b77a9d014.zh: 在这样的时局下，民主党的两个派别看起来都更糟，你却猛烈攻击宪法联邦党，人们对此很惊讶。

441121596737888536828af97fc5972bcfa9b7e2.source: Giving this speech was a good idea. Many people were impressed, and it provided good material for future advertisements.
441121596737888536828af97fc5972bcfa9b7e2.zh: 发表这篇演说是个好主意。许多人印象深刻，它也为后续广告提供了好素材。

075896ff75a08d74b1daaf8fcd73bd0953c11e1f.source: Goldwater accusing anyone of being an extremist is rich. Humphrey is a reasonable man with reasonable ideas, and we’re glad to have him on.
075896ff75a08d74b1daaf8fcd73bd0953c11e1f.zh: 戈德华特居然指责别人是极端分子，真够讽刺。汉弗莱是个讲道理的人，主张也合理，我们很高兴有他加入。

698ec2f614703065e8f27eacd9d0e368eb6381d5.source: Good answer. This appeals to your base, which will lead to an increased liberal and black turnout. However, you’ve alarmed and lost moderates with your statements.
698ec2f614703065e8f27eacd9d0e368eb6381d5.zh: 回答得好。这迎合了基本盘，会提高自由派和黑人的投票热情。不过，你的言论也吓跑了一些温和派。

c6757550537e9eccb51b9488b4f305d2392552f7.source: Good choice. Stick to the high road and speak to the issues. You have friends in low places.
c6757550537e9eccb51b9488b4f305d2392552f7.zh: 选得好。保持风度，把话题放在议题上。暗处自有人替你出手。

99eb170150363262ab4e08e3950ff472b20de7e7.source: Good combination of embracing Clinton and attacking Bush.
99eb170150363262ab4e08e3950ff472b20de7e7.zh: 既认同克林顿，又攻击布什，这个组合不错。

8eb486d62d0a7706d84d9689e7520f5e02c8ca76.source: Good hedge. You can't possibly support this idea, but you can oppose it without sounding like a scrooge.
8eb486d62d0a7706d84d9689e7520f5e02c8ca76.zh: 留有余地，回答得好。你不可能支持这个主意，但反对时也不必显得像斯克鲁奇那样吝啬。

0ac6d209ef1453d17d9e38e2d99699302a05a9a1.source: Good luck in this crucial state.
0ac6d209ef1453d17d9e38e2d99699302a05a9a1.zh: 祝你在这个关键州好运。

2acb747895fb865d51ceb67dfe129c8740ff5a9e.source: Good luck in this year's election. Many people think it will awfully close.
2acb747895fb865d51ceb67dfe129c8740ff5a9e.zh: 祝你今年选举顺利。许多人认为双方会争得极为胶着。

ebe2bb2d26c0ad5a5b7dcc5c0c87a4b3b62a840c.source: Good luck tomorrow, and may you defeat The Donald!
ebe2bb2d26c0ad5a5b7dcc5c0c87a4b3b62a840c.zh: 祝你明天好运，愿你击败“那位唐纳德”！

8e5ea80e087533f9827791b5f82c124dd75d341e.source: Good luck with the election, Mr. Douglas, and may God be with you.
8e5ea80e087533f9827791b5f82c124dd75d341e.zh: 祝你竞选顺利，道格拉斯先生，愿上帝与你同在。

c57e0216997f60f19a397babcfd684b317d47171.source: Good luck with the election, Mr. Lincoln, and may God be with you.
c57e0216997f60f19a397babcfd684b317d47171.zh: 祝你竞选顺利，林肯先生，愿上帝与你同在。

c08ac2912137f4c8ecdb8c4c32131f9a1fd53b20.source: Good luck with your bold agenda for the future.
c08ac2912137f4c8ecdb8c4c32131f9a1fd53b20.zh: 祝你面向未来的大胆施政计划顺利。

7ab34b99fda53e98d7dca8016caf39a4b1075a4e.source: Good move. Promising further regulation to protect the environment pleases the base.
7ab34b99fda53e98d7dca8016caf39a4b1075a4e.zh: 干得好。你承诺加强监管、保护环境，令基本盘满意。

f4e10aa63d0e824d38a7c983449f62a16e5ea462.source: Good people don't agree on every issue. Colin Powell understands that we respect life and the 2nd Amendment.
f4e10aa63d0e824d38a7c983449f62a16e5ea462.zh: 好人也不会在每个问题上都意见一致。科林·鲍威尔明白，我们尊重生命和第二修正案。

a8117a343db9ccaa9b731a17bd701e42dcccae02.source: Good people don't agree on every issue. Tom Ridge understands that we will run a pro-life administration.
a8117a343db9ccaa9b731a17bd701e42dcccae02.zh: 好人也不会在每个问题上都意见一致。汤姆·里奇明白，我们将领导一届反对堕胎的政府。

c26e5f956cedb9da10e8662287ff1aeaf9d30c08.source: Good response. It's important to stand by your policies.
c26e5f956cedb9da10e8662287ff1aeaf9d30c08.zh: 回答不错。坚持自己的政策很重要。

082ceed5d9f3e1fd0792793848a549557d944e24.source: Good riddance. On the issue of silver coinage, you are either with us or you're with the industrialists. Palmer has shown his cards.
082ceed5d9f3e1fd0792793848a549557d944e24.zh: 走了正好。在白银铸币问题上，你不是站在我们这边，就是站在工业家那边。帕尔默已经亮明了自己的立场。

a9c47ffcf0e06de0cdacdb9cec2e2fd8e6d8769d.source: Good way to sound a bit more statesmanlike.
a9c47ffcf0e06de0cdacdb9cec2e2fd8e6d8769d.zh: 这能让你显得更有政治家的风范。

65ceb0b2d9e2a5d82d4c270f53b41f0e63396777.source: Gore has a lot of options in his campaign. He can embrace the legacy of Clinton, for better or worse. Politically, he can run as a centrist, or move to the left and run as a more traditional liberal Democrat than Clinton did. The presence of the well-known Ralph Nader as a Green Party candidate complicates this decision. Gore is essentially campaigning on two fronts.
65ceb0b2d9e2a5d82d4c270f53b41f0e63396777.zh: 戈尔 在他的竞选活动中有很多选择。无论好坏，他都可以接受克林顿的遗产。在政治上，他可以作为中间派参选，也可以转向左翼，作为比 克林顿 更传统的自由民主党参选。众所周知的 拉尔夫·纳德 作为 绿党 候选者的存在使这一决定变得复杂。 戈尔 本质上是在两条战线上进行竞选活动。

4b555ff07421b320ec24423ddc12719ec289e848.source: Goldwater finds himself in a precarious situation as the campaign begins- running against a popular incumbent, a radical reputation, and his own penchant for ugly gaffes, it will take skill and luck to even claw back into contention- let alone win. If he wants any hope at the Presidency, he must find a way to minimize mistakes, appeal to wary moderates, and pull together a party that has wholly fractured below him.
4b555ff07421b320ec24423ddc12719ec289e848.zh: 戈德华特 在竞选开始时发现自己处于危险的境地 - 与一位受欢迎的现任者、激进的声誉以及他自己对丑陋失态的嗜好竞争，甚至需要技巧和运气才能重新进入竞争 - 更不用说获胜了。如果他想在总统职位上有希望，他必须找到一种方法来尽量减少错误，吸引谨慎的温和派，并团结一个在他领导下完全分裂的政党。

1128920f3a5dafb50d96ac54977415942e1779b7.source: Goldwater has been seen as the candidate of the John Birch Society, a fervent group of anti-communist conspiracy theorists. What should we do about this?
1128920f3a5dafb50d96ac54977415942e1779b7.zh: 戈德华特被视为约翰·伯奇协会的候选人，这是一个狂热的反共阴谋论者团体。我们该怎么办？

b9236fdd75036ce961039405168ffe870dde4855.source: Goldwater has famously had a large amount of backing from the ultra-conservative John Birch Society, which has recently been disavowed by numerous prominent conservatives. This has only further hurt Goldwater’s numbers.
b9236fdd75036ce961039405168ffe870dde4855.zh: 众所周知，戈德华特获得了极端保守的约翰·伯奇协会的大量支持，而最近多名著名保守派已公开与该协会划清界限。这进一步损害了戈德华特的支持率。

0a06e9cb324471dcec0d88040d225542d48f27df.source: Goldwater has received an endorsement from the leader of the Alabama Ku Klux Klan. LBJ has already capitalized with attack ads going out nationwide. What should we do?
0a06e9cb324471dcec0d88040d225542d48f27df.zh: 戈德华特得到了阿拉巴马州三K党领导人的支持。约翰逊已借题发挥，在全国播出攻击广告。我们该怎么办？

539af7b756334007bc409e7e28128435a1bf3cb6.source: Goldwater has swung around to attack your Presidency from a different angle, attacking you as too soft and ineffectual on Vietnam to be entrusted with the war. Would you like to respond?
539af7b756334007bc409e7e28128435a1bf3cb6.zh: 戈德华特换了一个角度攻击你的总统任期，指责你在越南问题上过于软弱、毫无作为，不值得托付战争领导权。你想回应吗？

e395e9396ed38d8bbaaf7f98f64ad60b5c3e3f43.source: Goldwater will definitely help your ticket in the South, but LBJ is an even greater force in that region. It will be interesting to see if you can overcome that obstacle.
e395e9396ed38d8bbaaf7f98f64ad60b5c3e3f43.zh: 戈德华特肯定会帮助你的竞选组合争取南方，但林登·约翰逊在当地的影响力更大。你能否克服这个障碍，值得期待。

05e02486521742fab4b290a21e41d286b6d75dba.source: Goldwater/Miller is sure to drive conservative turnout this election season.
05e02486521742fab4b290a21e41d286b6d75dba.zh: 戈德华特／米勒组合，肯定能推动保守派在这次选举中踊跃投票。

7b977a87ed9f21db5f3e4c6bc59fe4775a7d06ce.source: Goldwater’s campaign continues to hit your campaign hard on the Bobby Baker and Billie Sol Estes scandals, accusing you of being a corrupt, lying cheat! What actions, if any, should we take to downplay the issue?
7b977a87ed9f21db5f3e4c6bc59fe4775a7d06ce.zh: 戈德华特阵营继续围绕博比·贝克和比利·索尔·埃斯蒂斯丑闻猛烈攻击你，指责你腐败、撒谎、欺诈！我们应采取什么行动来淡化这一问题，还是不作回应？

6e722feaedf86b216148e353b8f5e4d3a9b7ee61.source: Goldwater’s famous slips of the tongue will provide your attack ads with all the ammunition they can ever need throughout this campaign.
6e722feaedf86b216148e353b8f5e4d3a9b7ee61.zh: 戈德华特那些出名的失言，将为你整个竞选期间的攻击广告提供用不完的素材。

e421019b62e877f319f3f3522a78e420ae3b280b.source: Goldwater’s made a number of bad decisions in his career. We’d be cutting our own arm off to not be using it against him.
e421019b62e877f319f3f3522a78e420ae3b280b.zh: 戈德华特在政治生涯中作过不少糟糕决定。若不利用这些来攻击他，我们就是自断一臂。

62f00526c05eebce3bfb885730463a97e6953fee.source: Goldwater’s record on Social Security has always been in support of the program. This is dirty politics from Johnson.
62f00526c05eebce3bfb885730463a97e6953fee.zh: 戈德华特在社会保障问题上，一贯支持这项制度。这是约翰逊的肮脏政治手段。

0011c4cfbaec237f5c3c0fcb9d67fb3bfe00c358.source: Governor Altgeld of Illinois has proposed that you appear with him in Chicago for a couple of big speeches. Later on he would appear with you in southern Illinois to solidify his support with rural voters. What do you think of this idea?
0011c4cfbaec237f5c3c0fcb9d67fb3bfe00c358.zh: 伊利诺伊州长奥尔特格尔德提议，你与他一起在芝加哥发表几场重要演说。之后，他还会与你一起到伊利诺伊南部，巩固他在农村选民中的支持。你怎么看？

874759fc07063d5c1e2d3ae9148d9b898c75da8d.source: Governor Altgeld was working to mediate the dispute between the Pullman Company and the strikers when Cleveland interfered. There should have absolutely been more time given for these sides to reach an accommodation.
874759fc07063d5c1e2d3ae9148d9b898c75da8d.zh: 克利夫兰插手时，奥尔特格尔德州长正努力调停普尔曼公司与罢工者的争端。绝对应当给双方更多时间，达成和解。

005b3a34d687c4f90a2aae946df86f788a4e8f0c.source: Great answer. This addresses the concerns of law and order moderates and the Democratic base.
005b3a34d687c4f90a2aae946df86f788a4e8f0c.zh: 回答得好。这兼顾了关心法律与秩序的温和派和民主党基本盘的忧虑。

68f2c19139492227a32f647525f933e1f403d472.zh: 格雷格诉 佐治亚州

b5aa7fee9735b2d91ecb3db479395a41206f19bb.source: Gretchen Whitmer is the Governor of Michigan who could bring some undecideds over the line in that state and region. She is seen as a mainstream Democrat with solid experience. Choosing her would anger some supporters who expect an African-American running-mate after this summer's protests.
b5aa7fee9735b2d91ecb3db479395a41206f19bb.zh: 格雷琴·惠特默 是 密歇根州 的州长，他可以让该州和地区的一些犹豫不决的人越界。她被视为拥有丰富经验的主流民主党人。选择她会激怒一些支持者，他们在今年夏天的抗议活动后期待一位非裔美国人的竞选伙伴。

fb510489c5751a1c0961505439672ee041cc650e.source: Grover Cleveland has vetoed more pieces of legislation than any President in our history, increased our deficit, and still found a way to provide J.P. Morgan with a financial windfall from the public purse.
fb510489c5751a1c0961505439672ee041cc650e.zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰否决的法案，比美国历史上任何总统都多。他增加了赤字，却仍然想办法，让J. P. 摩根从公共财政中大发横财。

2d1b27fb63fbfa249aced170fce0474912347871.source: Grover Cleveland is a citizen of integrity who has done his best under trying circumstances. He was simply found to be not up to the job.
2d1b27fb63fbfa249aced170fce0474912347871.zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰是一位正直的公民，在艰难环境中尽了最大努力。只是事实证明，他不胜任这项工作。

cf5066d9c63835baada01e794b59f6b470f099ef.source: Grover Cleveland led the push to repeal the Sherman Silver Purchase Act in 1894. What are your thoughts on his actions during that period?
cf5066d9c63835baada01e794b59f6b470f099ef.zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰在1894年牵头推动废除《谢尔曼白银购买法》。你如何评价他在那段时期的行动？

3f1ff656473a5d06526e47bf5bd215aa08daea49.source: Grover Cleveland may have won New York, but he was also
3f1ff656473a5d06526e47bf5bd215aa08daea49.zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰也许曾赢下纽约州，但他自己也

dd759da10c29865983ff359b5e3266293d79f2c1.source: Grover Cleveland sent federal troops to Illinois to end the Pullman Strike without the request of Governor Altgeld. Was this an overreach on his part?
dd759da10c29865983ff359b5e3266293d79f2c1.zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰未应奥尔特格尔德州长的请求，就派联邦军队到伊利诺伊，结束普尔曼大罢工。这是否越权？

4b7e9d98d10367a09c05bf959778a09242066e40.source: Gun control is ineffective in reducing crime rates. I think a better option would be to examine our sentencing guidelines, and make sure that we put criminals in jail.
4b7e9d98d10367a09c05bf959778a09242066e40.zh: 枪支管制不能有效降低犯罪率。我认为，更好的办法是审视量刑准则，确保将罪犯关进监狱。

2b0f5a2161743c28ce0c5f25c3391696f902e26f.source: Gun rights are protected by the Second Amendment. Furthermore, an armed citizenry is our best defense against crime and government tyranny.
2b0f5a2161743c28ce0c5f25c3391696f902e26f.zh: 第二修正案保护持枪权。此外，武装起来的公民，是我们抵御犯罪和政府暴政的最佳防线。

5ed5bbe4bdce09eb50b8abde084e1432b4c81cd5.source: Hamlin is a solid choice and a good party man.
5ed5bbe4bdce09eb50b8abde084e1432b4c81cd5.zh: 哈姆林是个稳妥的人选，也是可靠的本党成员。

9764d55613a1c22ca7c9bc6d45959412c2007176.source: Handgun ownership should be severely restricted. Any other system makes it too easy for guns to be smuggled to Mexico and to urban gangs within the U.S.
9764d55613a1c22ca7c9bc6d45959412c2007176.zh: 应该严格限制手枪持有。其他任何制度都太容易让枪支被走私到墨西哥，以及美国城市中的帮派手里。

11b05e353d40ab5e199ceae7c2d8195eb04ea3e1.source: Hannibal Hamlin is a Senator and former Governor from Maine and a long-time opponent of slavery. It was this issue that caused him to change his allegiance from the Democratic Party in 1856, in the aftermath of the Kansas-Nebraska Act. Hamlin will help to balance the ticket regionally and give it name recognition.
11b05e353d40ab5e199ceae7c2d8195eb04ea3e1.zh: 汉尼拔·哈姆林 是来自 缅因州 的参议员和前州长，也是奴隶制的长期反对者。正是这个问题导致他在 1856 年堪萨斯—内布拉斯加法案之后改变了对民主党的效忠。 哈姆林 将有助于平衡区域门票并给予其知名度。

463e0a63768644e3a7f0d9f09bcd0b704aa5f998.source: Harold Stassen is a former Governor of Minnesota who resigned to serve in World World II. He was an opponent of isolationism and is a youthful, rising star within the party. He made his own bid for the Republican nomination this year, providing a serious challenge to Dewey. He is from the liberal wing of the Party and might help slightly in the Plains states. He has also opposed Dewey throughout the nomination process.
463e0a63768644e3a7f0d9f09bcd0b704aa5f998.zh: 哈罗德·斯塔森 是 明尼苏达州 的前州长，已辞职并在第二次世界大战中任职。他是孤立主义的反对者，是党内年轻的后起之秀。他今年自己竞选共和党提名，对 杜威 提出了严峻的挑战。他来自该党的自由派，可能会在平原州提供一些帮助。他还在整个提名过程中反对杜威。

ba43831d4a963d94217479a0fef754db62f0f9a4.source: Harold Stassen is a great man who represents my views for the future of this country. Now let's get going with this campaign.
ba43831d4a963d94217479a0fef754db62f0f9a4.zh: 哈罗德·史塔森是位出色的人物，代表了我对本国未来的看法。现在，让我们开始竞选吧。

9263bf9aa15f62cbee1d040c8bac31d924265e8a.source: Harris hits back at you and clarifies her statement (she wouldn't take the vaccine unless the CDC endorsed it), but no matter.
9263bf9aa15f62cbee1d040c8bac31d924265e8a.zh: 哈里斯反击，澄清了自己的话：除非疾病控制与预防中心认可，否则她不会接种。不过，那又如何。

720d7d5d2a412741329ce434cf84f8ad60de167e.source: Harris will add very little to the campaign if he fails to deliver some states in the South, and his young age (37 years) could be alarming to some voters.
720d7d5d2a412741329ce434cf84f8ad60de167e.zh: 哈里斯 如果他未能赢得南方一些州的支持，那么他对竞选活动的贡献微乎其微，而且他的年轻年龄（37 岁）可能会让一些选民感到震惊。

9d02066d8277d9218576b794b3c49111d5ca82d8.source: Harry Truman assumed the Presidency upon the death of FDR, and led the country through the final days of World War II. His popularity has since collapsed. His aggressive stance against the Soviet Union has led to a challenge from the left. His actions during the 1946 strikes have alienated labor unions. His support of civil rights measures has led to a second Democratic splinter party. Truman needs to really shake up the race if he is to have any chance to win.
9d02066d8277d9218576b794b3c49111d5ca82d8.zh: 哈里·杜鲁门 在 富兰克林·罗斯福 去世后就任总统，并领导国家度过了 第二次世界大战 的最后日子。自此他的人气一落千丈。他对苏联的侵略立场引发了左翼的挑战。他在 1946 年罢工期间的行为疏远了工会。他对 民权 措施的支持导致了第二个民主党分裂。 杜鲁门 如果他想有机会获胜，就需要真正改变比赛。

265c178891b630c0023bd7c1ce3426d8f5d13d70.source: Harry Truman is an ineffectual, vacillating, highly unpopular President. We need to hammer on this theme and remind the American people why they need a new leader in the White House.
265c178891b630c0023bd7c1ce3426d8f5d13d70.zh: 哈里·杜鲁门是一位无能、摇摆不定、极不受欢迎的总统。我们需要反复强调这个主题，提醒美国人民为什么白宫需要一位新的领袖。

41c4fddb4cd0e96e03a0ffb3735ea352f8a12a43.source: Henry "Scoop" Jackson is a Senator from Washington who also attempted to secure the 1976 Democratic nomination. He is a more traditional Democrat, favoring both high levels of social spending and a strong national defense policy. He is not popular with the left wing of the party, but would certainly help with moderates, and could swing his home state in the fall elections.
41c4fddb4cd0e96e03a0ffb3735ea352f8a12a43.zh: Henry“Scoop”杰克逊 是来自 华盛顿州 的参议员，他也曾试图获得 1976 年民主党提名。他是一位更为传统的民主党人，支持高水平的社会支出和强有力的国防政策。他不受党内左翼的欢迎，但肯定会帮助温和派，并可能在秋季选举中改变他的家乡。

1dbedd7e756827e4663ce467b75e5dfe5b491f31.source: Henry Cabot Lodge Jr. has an impeccable pedigree, a great war record, and a career that has seen him serve as a Senator and an Ambassador to the United Nations. He is a committed internationalist and a moderate in the party. He appeals to a similar wing of the party as Nelson Rockefeller, but is much more willing to be the running mate on a Nixon ticket.
1dbedd7e756827e4663ce467b75e5dfe5b491f31.zh: 亨利·卡伯特·洛奇 Jr. 拥有无可挑剔的血统、伟大的战争记录以及曾担任参议员和驻联合国大使的职业生涯。他是一名坚定的国际主义者，也是党内的温和派。他吸引了与纳尔逊·洛克菲勒类似的党派，但更愿意成为尼克松选票的竞选伙伴。

21f88aa73c2abaa6d8ac7d328a59242c553bbae2.source: Henry Cabot Lodge has been actively engaged in world affairs for many years, and I am proud to have him appear on my ticket.
21f88aa73c2abaa6d8ac7d328a59242c553bbae2.zh: 亨利·卡伯特·洛奇多年来积极参与国际事务，我很自豪，他能加入我的竞选组合。

39030a5468076dcde38017011ab841b0a76bb404.source: Henry Cabot Lodge is known for his foreign policy experience, and there is some hope he could make Massachusetts competitive...
39030a5468076dcde38017011ab841b0a76bb404.zh: 亨利·卡伯特·洛奇以外交经验著称，人们也希望他能使马萨诸塞州成为值得争取的战场……

9f53d59fd0401606787d4c64db451da24f24de8a.source: Henry Cabot Lodge represents the future of the Republican Party, and represents my own views as well. I'm looking forward to governing with him for the next four years.
9f53d59fd0401606787d4c64db451da24f24de8a.zh: 亨利·卡伯特·洛奇代表共和党的未来，也代表我的看法。我期待未来四年与他共同执政。

5a5b0b69eb8e3e700d0c36923a7a3b0dab9d3098.source: Henry Clay runs in a Presidential election for the third time, and begins as the favorite against Polk. He must quickly define a position on Texas. It will be difficult to do so without alienating some bloc of the Whigs.
5a5b0b69eb8e3e700d0c36923a7a3b0dab9d3098.zh: 亨利·克莱第三次角逐总统宝座，起初被看好能击败波尔克。他必须尽快明确对得克萨斯问题的立场，但无论怎样表态，都很难不疏远辉格党内的某一派。

47cd497e4dff72e118a6a648add3d0e8935e507d.source: Henry Clay supports the idea that the federal government should purchase the telegraph patent and manage the technology. To what extent should you attack him on this?
47cd497e4dff72e118a6a648add3d0e8935e507d.zh: 亨利·克莱主张由联邦政府购买电报专利，并管理这项技术。你应当在多大程度上就此攻击他？

1216e930ade2ef57351b8ce2433c196be8bd557b.source: Henry Clay takes the Democratic line?
1216e930ade2ef57351b8ce2433c196be8bd557b.zh: 亨利·克莱竟然采取了民主党的立场？

7c8db59eb03ee80f9ccd99e1a19cf685682b1068.zh: 亨利·克莱: 基本美国人

a4ca876127a49dd95f1d8a74d1c3ee157fbc822c.source: Henry Teller is a western Republican who was forced to leave his party's convention after their resolution on the silver issue. He could be an unorthodox option if the Democrats are looking to establish a moderate image on the issues outside of free-silver.
a4ca876127a49dd95f1d8a74d1c3ee157fbc822c.zh: 亨利·特勒 是一位西方共和党人，在就白银问题做出决议后被迫离开党的代表大会。如果民主党希望在自由白银之外的问题上建立温和的形象，他可能是一个非正统的选择。

ba28380493341aed47564562f4d3a1efdfe722b7.source: Henry Wallace has instantly derided you for such comments, though they might be playing well in the heartland.
ba28380493341aed47564562f4d3a1efdfe722b7.zh: 亨利·华莱士立即嘲讽了你这番话，不过它在美国腹地也许颇受欢迎。

71ad0e66e2b003a794fe220636432eaa605ad849.source: Has the United States adequately defended against the Communist threat in Indochina? Would you support further action there if necessary?
71ad0e66e2b003a794fe220636432eaa605ad849.zh: 美国是否充分抵御了印度支那的共产主义威胁？如有必要，你会支持在那里采取进一步行动吗？

8b9b477b4f611524e431ea8a62ae8c85cd574a33.source: Has the current Supreme Court contributed to our disorder with decisions such as
8b9b477b4f611524e431ea8a62ae8c85cd574a33.zh: 现任最高法院是否通过以下决定导致了我们的混乱？

e09e6959c4a60336cfe354215c047afae79c9b11.source: Have we forgotten what the early 1980s were like in Miami? I won't stand for appeasing foreign drug cartels.
