e09e6959c4a60336cfe354215c047afae79c9b11.zh: 我们忘了1980年代初的迈阿密是什么样了吗？我绝不容忍姑息外国贩毒集团。

1f877b36fad25efd4ee25fe3d428beaeb8380d68.source: Have you given any thought to programs that would set racial quotas for job hiring or college admissions, in order to accelerate the process of integration?
1f877b36fad25efd4ee25fe3d428beaeb8380d68.zh: 为加快种族融合，有人主张在招聘或大学招生中设立种族配额。你考虑过这类计划吗？

11e6d22e268181244d7148a8da0dab448782d50e.source: Have you seen some of these couples? I believe if a marriage was initiated after 1880, then the pension benefits should cease upon the death of the veteran.
11e6d22e268181244d7148a8da0dab448782d50e.zh: 你见过其中一些夫妻吗？我认为，如果婚姻缔结于1880年之后，抚恤待遇就应在老兵去世时终止。

4da80a71b8a4ab04e8b1e047f66d513dd796d073.source: Have you seen this kid in Arkansas? He looks just like Bill Clinton but there was probably a big cover-up there too.
4da80a71b8a4ab04e8b1e047f66d513dd796d073.zh: 你见过阿肯色州那个孩子吗？他长得跟比尔·克林顿一模一样，不过，这件事大概也遭到大规模掩盖了。

009982c907f97a0cf2c439f4a62cdb3b80769ced.source: Haven’t we done enough? The Civil Rights Act of 1964 was enough of a pain to pass. We’ve given them what they want- I can’t make any promises on legislation past that.
009982c907f97a0cf2c439f4a62cdb3b80769ced.zh: 我们做得还不够吗？通过1964年《民权法案》就已经够让人头疼了。我们已经给了他们想要的东西，不能再对进一步立法作任何承诺。

0d7a4ed36146e14a8d5c5b837cf455d9315e45fa.source: Having Gage as a running mate may increase the appeal to disaffected Democrats who are put off by the radicalism of Bryan.
0d7a4ed36146e14a8d5c5b837cf455d9315e45fa.zh: 让 盖奇 作为竞选伙伴可能会增加对因 布赖恩 的激进主义而感到不满的民主党人的吸引力。

4357482e8621449220fa34df105dac8691eca5ac.source: Having already lost a close nomination battle, many progressives feel let down by your choice of Tim Kaine as running mate. What is your response to this?
4357482e8621449220fa34df105dac8691eca5ac.zh: 许多进步派刚刚在一场激烈的提名争夺中惜败，又对你选择蒂姆·凯恩作为搭档感到失望。你会如何回应？

75c772cd0a0763bde3b67045c06dc87547a238b7.source: Having recently received endorsements from the Ku Klux Klan and the John Birch Society, you need to find a way to distance yourself from extremists and put yourself into the American political mainstream.
75c772cd0a0763bde3b67045c06dc87547a238b7.zh: 你最近得到了三K党和约翰·伯奇协会的支持，需要想办法与极端分子保持距离，让自己回到美国政治主流之中。

08996eaf25795d633f40a598a1e507381ac4d01e.source: He absolutely did, and I would like to see further action to desegregate our schools and enforce our civil rights.
08996eaf25795d633f40a598a1e507381ac4d01e.zh: 他做得完全正确。我希望进一步行动，废除学校的种族隔离，保障我们的公民权利。

75fdd1b35f31dc578d1b5ea8b8eb8bf900693735.source: He can’t stop shooting himself in the foot!
75fdd1b35f31dc578d1b5ea8b8eb8bf900693735.zh: 他就是改不了搬起石头砸自己脚的毛病！

3fd5f4129ff431fec393221044bd5b2c3fca6619.source: He should stick to movies if he has any sense.
3fd5f4129ff431fec393221044bd5b2c3fca6619.zh: 他要是有点脑子，就该继续拍电影。

c9642fb2ca24c28c26f17267f1935cb6e2473adc.source: Headlines like, "Is America Ready for Two Women?" proliferate, for better or worse.
c9642fb2ca24c28c26f17267f1935cb6e2473adc.zh: 不管是好是坏，“美国准备好接受两位女性了吗？”这类头条越来越多。

4a46b57773bbe8872b4782001c69998cb66086e8.source: Health authorities express concern about your refusal to wear a mask at some large events, but will your supporters care?
4a46b57773bbe8872b4782001c69998cb66086e8.zh: 卫生部门对你在一些大型活动中拒绝戴口罩表示担忧，但你的支持者会在乎吗？

614a38df30dcd617807d007772aa4a562d606040.source: Here's Donald Trump's Best Strategy for Winning the White House
614a38df30dcd617807d007772aa4a562d606040.zh: 这是 唐纳德·特朗普 赢得 白宫 的最佳策略

bb582189a1e95330f24c4c1e2c00d96d81def528.source: Herschel Johnson is a former Governor of Georgia with a stated opposition to the Fire-Eaters and talk of secession. He is one of the last leading Democrats of the South to have not bolted to the Southern Democrat splinter party. Unfortunately, it is not very likely that Johnson's presence will help Douglas compete with Breckenridge or Bell in the South.
bb582189a1e95330f24c4c1e2c00d96d81def528.zh: 赫歇尔·约翰逊 是 佐治亚州 的前州长，明确反对食火者并谈论分裂。他是最后一批没有加入南方民主党分裂党的南方民主党领袖之一。不幸的是，约翰逊 的存在不太可能帮助 道格拉斯 与南部的布雷肯里奇或贝尔竞争。

6263efbc6e4d512260f441cad02d8f4124f88ac8.source: High tariffs protect American industry and increase the purchasing power of the consumer. Free silver would throw this system into chaos and even hurt the farmer in the long-term.
6263efbc6e4d512260f441cad02d8f4124f88ac8.zh: 高关税保护美国工业，增强消费者的购买力。自由铸银会使这套制度陷入混乱，长期来看，甚至会损害农民。

c0ecb35424adfebc12af61e9b97aefe943ebfaca.source: Hillary Clinton and Donald Trump face off in the 2016 election. Clinton has served as First Lady, Senator, and Secretary of State. Trump has never served in elected office. Clinton was the presumptive nominee from start to finish, while Trump has shocked the political world.
c0ecb35424adfebc12af61e9b97aefe943ebfaca.zh: 希拉里·克林顿与唐纳德·特朗普在2016年总统选举中正面交锋。克林顿曾任第一夫人、参议员和国务卿，特朗普则从未担任过民选公职。克林顿从竞选伊始到获得提名，一直被视为当然的候选人；特朗普却震动了整个政坛。

f23f23d3d0974e25d7a6a00bec02a9cd237a94ab.source: Hillary Clinton continues to say that I'm unqualified to serve as President, so what was going on her brain when she installed this server?
f23f23d3d0974e25d7a6a00bec02a9cd237a94ab.zh: 希拉里·克林顿一直说我没有资格当总统。那她装这台服务器时，脑子里到底在想什么？

2bc4435e629df2705629b05224c143a8a6c42009.source: Hillary Clinton deleted 32,000 emails under House Subpoena, along with many other crimes. When people see that I'm the only one who can defeat Crooked Hillary, they will reject this nonsense.
2bc4435e629df2705629b05224c143a8a6c42009.zh: 希拉里·克林顿在众议院发出传票的情况下删掉了32,000封电子邮件，还犯下许多其他罪行。人们一旦看清，只有我能击败“骗子希拉里”，就会拒绝这种胡闹。

ccf220dc165f21419f280684f92f4cb406387e9b.source: Hillary Clinton has been on both sides of so many issues it's pathetic. I'm not going to give a speech between now and November where I don't talk about her views on Iraq, gay marriage, illegal immigration, criminal justice, drug policy, free trade, and so much more.
ccf220dc165f21419f280684f92f4cb406387e9b.zh: 希拉里·克林顿在这么多问题上都站过两边，真是可悲。从现在到十一月，我的每一场演说，都会谈她对伊拉克、同性婚姻、非法移民、刑事司法、毒品政策、自由贸易等种种问题的观点。

fce3c8a619d3287a8792cd020180f2f60858e876.source: Hillary Clinton has done an outstanding job as Secretary of State. I would be glad to have her on board for my Administration.
fce3c8a619d3287a8792cd020180f2f60858e876.zh: 希拉里·克林顿作为国务卿表现出色。我很乐意让她加入我的政府。

22f8e83f49781625cf93ada17bc80191e464f7ba.source: Hillary Clinton keeps saying that I'm unqualified to serve as President, so what was going on her brain when she voted for the war in Iraq?
22f8e83f49781625cf93ada17bc80191e464f7ba.zh: 希拉里·克林顿一直说我没有资格当总统。那她投票支持伊拉克战争时，脑子里到底在想什么？

15cd5865a9b44d4a6c189faa7c1be1a4d21f955a.source: Hillary Clinton would be a change for Obama if he chose her as his running mate. Her current home state is New York, though she lived in Arkansas for many years. Her husband is former President Bill Clinton.
15cd5865a9b44d4a6c189faa7c1be1a4d21f955a.zh: 希拉里·克林顿 将是 奥巴马 的一个改变。她目前的家乡是纽约州，尽管她在阿肯色州居住了很多年。她的丈夫是前总统 比尔·克林顿。

a70a590130c6c5d72b84b85b4b17a235da7167f2.source: Hillary Clinton would be a disaster for this country, her husband signed NAFTA, and now she says she wants open markets and many other things.
a70a590130c6c5d72b84b85b4b17a235da7167f2.zh: 希拉里·克林顿会给这个国家带来灾难。她丈夫签署了《北美自由贸易协定》，如今她又说自己想要开放市场，还想要许多其他东西。

05a569c6452bc22b02dfbc1db770d2df45fb0928.source: Hillary has been forced to take on a lighter campaign schedule, at the same time that her "basket of deplorables" comment is going viral. Not a bad series of events for you...
05a569c6452bc22b02dfbc1db770d2df45fb0928.zh: 希拉里被迫减少竞选活动，与此同时，她说的那句“一帮可鄙之人”正在广泛传播。这一连串事情对你倒是很有利……

e37e62341e393659f412878eac9bed17baff3dc3.source: His policies were good, but I was disappointed by the personal scandals of recent years. To emphasize that I am different, I will appear frequently with my own wife, and will not shy away from expressing my affection publicly.
e37e62341e393659f412878eac9bed17baff3dc3.zh: 他的政策很好，但近年来的个人丑闻让我失望。为强调我的不同，我会经常与自己的妻子共同露面，也不会回避公开表达爱意。

ffa5eba75bb4a6d0e96b7090fe83c600c7223a20.source: Hitting back at the conservative propaganda-mongers is definitely your best bet.
ffa5eba75bb4a6d0e96b7090fe83c600c7223a20.zh: 反击保守派宣传贩子绝对是你最好的选择。

8027e0cf5618eac3c3cb915d0ecb21ec19f740eb.source: Hmm... I think we need more research to really know how this program is performing. Our Administration will make this a high priority.
8027e0cf5618eac3c3cb915d0ecb21ec19f740eb.zh: 嗯……我认为，我们需要更多研究，才能真正了解这项计划的效果。我们的政府会把这列为优先事项。

abc979b25680c45ad44ec68845ae86050fb3e9dc.source: Hmm... there is some praise for this stand, but it doesn't seem to have changed much in the polls.
abc979b25680c45ad44ec68845ae86050fb3e9dc.zh: 嗯……有人赞扬这个立场，但它似乎没有使民调发生多少变化。

1849ba35688b7f4ae4e724ba122474b75624e47b.source: Hmmm... Republicans are wondering what you mean by this...
1849ba35688b7f4ae4e724ba122474b75624e47b.zh: 嗯……共和党人正在琢磨，你这话到底是什么意思……

02fcafa6ae61a84d61f71b78c5aa7dd4c7d0e91e.source: Hobart is a strong party man, and the Republicans will certainly be drawing the battle lines clearly if they go with this choice.
02fcafa6ae61a84d61f71b78c5aa7dd4c7d0e91e.zh: 霍巴特 是一个坚强的党派人士，如果共和党做出这样的选择，他们肯定会清楚地划定战线。

0432a5d2f78f1e01c7b4b37aaf18081edbd88053.source: Homesteads are a winning issue in the North. There's no reason to hold back here.
0432a5d2f78f1e01c7b4b37aaf18081edbd88053.zh: 宅地是能在北方赢得选票的议题，没有理由在这里有所保留。

cc7893d0f5daac916273906d374d44988c8c3fcd.source: Honestly I think Bernie is more popular than Joe is, to tell the truth. I don't know why he's allowing himself to be placated like this when he won the last two primaries. It's very weak.
cc7893d0f5daac916273906d374d44988c8c3fcd.zh: 说实话，我觉得伯尼比乔更受欢迎。我不知道，他明明赢了上两次初选，为什么还任由自己被这样安抚。太软弱了。

339e6d8aedc975041bd7627db9e777bf89e9ccdc.source: Honestly, I'd rather that people didn't bring this issue up. People know that Kennedy is Catholic, and this can only galvanize his support from that sector.
339e6d8aedc975041bd7627db9e777bf89e9ccdc.zh: 坦率地说，我宁愿大家别提这个问题。人们知道肯尼迪是天主教徒，这只能激发天主教徒对他的支持。

175f4050c372654b8934e9c33e4b47080dc28f6b.source: Honesty and integrity is good, but voters want to hear about solutions. I have common-sense answers to our nation's problems.
175f4050c372654b8934e9c33e4b47080dc28f6b.zh: 诚实与廉正当然好，但选民想听的是解决办法。对于国家的问题，我有符合常识的答案。

e4d3e7cbcf2a2e4abff759cd456dc320c875faac.source: Honesty and integrity is one thing, but voters want to hear about solutions. I've led our economy back from a steep recession while passing a tax cut for the American people.
e4d3e7cbcf2a2e4abff759cd456dc320c875faac.zh: 诚实与廉正是一回事，但选民想听的是解决办法。我已经带领经济走出严重衰退，同时为美国人民实行了减税。

439bb4d2ad93a6d9fb7c585b0ef629affcc3ee6b.source: Hopefully, Connally can help you win Texas. Even if he's conservative on some issues, he's also a big time insider and a long-time Democrat.
439bb4d2ad93a6d9fb7c585b0ef629affcc3ee6b.zh: 希望康纳利能帮你赢下得克萨斯州。即使他在某些议题上保守，他也仍是个资深圈内人，并曾长期是民主党人。

d8594bb3dac0aa6d586be6f54916edf56d70c556.source: Horace Boies was swept into the Governor's chair in Iowa during the 1890 Democratic rout. He is strongly supportive of low tariffs and free silver, and has a lot of influence in some potentially important states. He is also more moderate on the Prohibition issue.
d8594bb3dac0aa6d586be6f54916edf56d70c556.zh: 霍勒斯·博伊斯 在 1890 年民主党溃败期间被推入 艾奥瓦州 的州长席位。他强烈支持低关税和自由铸银，并且在一些潜在的重要州有很大的影响力。他在禁酒令问题上也更加温和。

54c172c7dd86e2614dbef27ae534c720e106c2a0.source: Horace Boies, the former Governor of Iowa, will be making a big speech tomorrow to capitalize on the crowds at the State Fair. Will you make the overnight trip to Iowa in time to deliver a concluding address to the farmers there?
54c172c7dd86e2614dbef27ae534c720e106c2a0.zh: 艾奥瓦前州长霍勒斯·博伊斯明天将发表重要演说，借州博览会的人潮造势。你会连夜赶往艾奥瓦，及时为当地农民作一场压轴演说吗？

8c5b04df22694fddfa644dc86006c2860fd79918.source: Horatio Seymour has served as Governor of New York and is influential in that state's politics. By selecting him, Douglas would be running with an all-northern ticket, but he could gain valuable votes in the nation's largest state. Seymour has been associated with the "Hunker" faction of New York Democrats, who favor internal improvements and oppose agitation on the slavery issue. It would take some cajoling and possibly more for Seymour to accept the nomination.
8c5b04df22694fddfa644dc86006c2860fd79918.zh: 霍雷肖·西摩 曾担任 纽约州 的州长，对该州的政治具有影响力。通过选择他，道格拉斯将获得全北方的选票，但他可以在全国最大的州获得宝贵的选票。 西摩 与 纽约州 民主党的“Hunker”派系有联系，他们赞成改善国内公共基础设施，反对煽动奴隶制问题。 西摩 需要一些哄骗，甚至可能更多才能接受提名。

f99b4605cff292252b08b1191eb8ad32ae0cbe4c.source: Horrible response. Some very large agricultural corporations and many Midwest voters disagree.
f99b4605cff292252b08b1191eb8ad32ae0cbe4c.zh: 糟糕的回答。几家规模极大的农业公司，以及许多中西部选民，都不赞同。

ba78580323b382bd928b3c0db7095eca3be78e92.source: How Biden Won: Ramping Up The Base And Expanding Margins In The Suburbs
ba78580323b382bd928b3c0db7095eca3be78e92.zh: 拜登 如何获胜：扩大基础并扩大郊区的利润

da337d4a10d784fdba7b0b6de3a9b94b1a5d10a6.source: How Lincoln Won the 1860 Republican Nomination
da337d4a10d784fdba7b0b6de3a9b94b1a5d10a6.zh: 如何 林肯 赢得 1860 年共和党提名

8bb6a3d3b91df232e17219ec7a328fb7d84cd9e8.source: How Presidential Race Was Won--and Lost : George Bush
8bb6a3d3b91df232e17219ec7a328fb7d84cd9e8.zh: 总统竞选是如何获胜和失败的：乔治·布什

a8ab4b614f77ec26f9fcc0d36bc01e87373ad3f8.source: How Presidential Race Was Won-and Lost : Michael S. Dukakis
a8ab4b614f77ec26f9fcc0d36bc01e87373ad3f8.zh: 总统竞选如何获胜和失败 : 迈克尔·S. 杜卡基斯

9e32012cfdd184a6f360a75ff375c878fbde1934.source: How Team Clinton Is Planning to Defeat Trump
9e32012cfdd184a6f360a75ff375c878fbde1934.zh: 团队 克林顿 如何计划击败 特朗普

044a396d789d1bd0d7bb017d1dd320e2324ae252.source: How about enforcing our current immigration law? We tried reform once already, and if it worked, we wouldn't even be discussing this now.
044a396d789d1bd0d7bb017d1dd320e2324ae252.zh: 何不先执行现行移民法？我们已经尝试过一次改革；如果管用，现在根本就不会再讨论这个问题。

62692ddebbeeb5501d62a2a96bc8d351a4f99f98.source: How aggressively should your party attack the Constitutional Unionists and John Bell in this election?
62692ddebbeeb5501d62a2a96bc8d351a4f99f98.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当以多大力度攻击宪法联邦党人和约翰·贝尔？

f394e94d282cc08de6548dfd17f29935f55d0ce9.source: How aggressively should your party attack the Northern Democrats and Stephen A. Douglas in this election?
f394e94d282cc08de6548dfd17f29935f55d0ce9.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当以多大力度攻击北方民主党人和斯蒂芬·A.·道格拉斯？

d6eb36cb5311239d382ba74ff9dad36a73c95ec9.source: How aggressively should your party attack the Republicans and Abraham Lincoln in this election?
d6eb36cb5311239d382ba74ff9dad36a73c95ec9.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当以多大力度攻击共和党和亚伯拉罕·林肯？

0072031e4b7584dab2340c32c4e8133a0d966ad2.source: Honesty is an admirable character trait, but we live in a fickle age. Americans love confidence and hate excuses.
0072031e4b7584dab2340c32c4e8133a0d966ad2.zh: 诚实是可敬的品格，但我们生活在一个人心易变的时代。美国人喜欢自信，讨厌找借口。

2fed2121656d24914fc467f036c46e5b7008fa28.source: Hopefully this doesn't affect the final outcome too much.
2fed2121656d24914fc467f036c46e5b7008fa28.zh: 希望这不会过多影响最终结果。

b777c0833b762580fc86f3e93f8b947d9759aec0.source: Hopefully you are far enough ahead in New York and Pennsylvania that this fusion ticket doesn't matter.
b777c0833b762580fc86f3e93f8b947d9759aec0.zh: 希望你在纽约和宾夕法尼亚的领先优势足够大，不会受到这个联合选举人名单的影响。

bdf6e62173ea3aa39797354db49e5bfa1a6377b4.source: Hopefully you can continue to help the United States recover from the Watergate Scandal, the recent recession, and the debacle of Vietnam. In either case, this will be your final term as President. Speculation is sure to be intense on who will replace you. Will it be Ronald Reagan? Ted Kennedy? Or someone else entirely?
bdf6e62173ea3aa39797354db49e5bfa1a6377b4.zh: 希望您能继续帮助美国从 水门事件 丑闻、最近的经济衰退和越南的崩溃中恢复过来。无论哪种情况，这都将是您作为总统的最后一个任期。关于谁将取代你的猜测肯定会很激烈。会是罗纳德·里根吗？ 特德·肯尼迪？还是完全是别人？

89323e7cf35996d9b82d73ff8202dd8873079696.source: Hopefully you can make good on your promises to clean up Washington and change the political and moral culture of the country. If you are successful, there is no reason you cannot run for reelection in 1980. Just be wary of any economic problems, or of some foreign policy crisis that could dent your popularity.
89323e7cf35996d9b82d73ff8202dd8873079696.zh: 但愿你能兑现承诺，整顿华盛顿政坛，改变这个国家的政治与道德风气。如果做得成功，你完全可以在1980年争取连任。只是要留意经济问题，以及可能损害你声望的外交危机。

c55856eee7f9a5fedd672365b7c23e8accf6c1ef.source: Hopefully you can move the United States in a more modern direction after eight quiet years of Eisenhower, while holding the line against the Soviet Union. At your young age, you have the potential to define the entire decade as President, and perhaps to hand the torch to one of your brothers in the future.
c55856eee7f9a5fedd672365b7c23e8accf6c1ef.zh: 希望您能够在艾森豪威尔的八年平静之后带领美国走向更现代化的方向，同时坚守反对苏联的路线。在你年轻的时候，你有潜力定义作为总统的整个十年，也许将来会将火炬交给你的一位兄弟。

7bbd43117b839a31d6f07a18c0c182984165633b.source: Hopefully you can pull Florida out and win the election. Good luck!
7bbd43117b839a31d6f07a18c0c182984165633b.zh: 但愿你能拿下佛罗里达州，赢得大选。祝你好运！

ead49bcbab3f14feab3337b831b7cab30c449618.source: Hopefully you can pull Ohio and Pennsylvania out and win the election. Good luck!
ead49bcbab3f14feab3337b831b7cab30c449618.zh: 但愿你能拿下俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州，赢得大选。祝你好运！

d18c43033c421e497a96a7dbd12441f8bc14e270.source: Hopefully you can pull these states out and win the election. Good luck!
d18c43033c421e497a96a7dbd12441f8bc14e270.zh: 但愿你能拿下这些州，赢得大选。祝你好运！

3bff20c537c48be0978e22a537eaafb3d26d769c.source: Hopefully you're planning to win this election in the North, and not the South.
3bff20c537c48be0978e22a537eaafb3d26d769c.zh: 希望你是打算靠北方赢得这场大选，而不是靠南方。

26c5fe492b604bc3664db2d228b94bf7f9173a54.source: Hopefully your opponent can make good on his promises to clean up Washington and change the political and moral culture of the country. Perhaps you can still play a role in 1980, or seek your old Congressional leadership positions. In any case, you can still take solace in the fact that you did the right thing by pardoning Nixon and moving the country beyond the Watergate episode.
26c5fe492b604bc3664db2d228b94bf7f9173a54.zh: 但愿你的对手能兑现承诺，整顿华盛顿政坛，改变这个国家的政治与道德风气。或许你在1980年仍能发挥作用，或者谋求重返原来的国会领导职位。无论如何，你仍可以宽慰自己：赦免尼克松、让国家走出水门事件的阴影，是正确的决定。

a0536b1c8574b5de44f525796e065e451b871054.source: How aggressively should your party attack the Southern Democrats and John Breckenridge in this election?
a0536b1c8574b5de44f525796e065e451b871054.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当以多大力度攻击南方民主党人和约翰·布雷肯里奇？

5fed4e2452e540e4f4b3236a633ecd59ce31cc7c.source: How can anyone be satisfied with the course our nation has taken? Inflation is killing the value of the dollar and the gold standard itself is at risk. Unemployment is highest under the Johnson Administration among the very people he claims to care about the most.
5fed4e2452e540e4f4b3236a633ecd59ce31cc7c.zh: 谁能对国家目前的道路感到满意？通货膨胀正在摧毁美元的价值，连金本位本身都面临危险。而在约翰逊口口声声最关心的那些人当中，失业率却最高。

254b2dc6c3f4daf0e5b68ba375ba81bb158ab5f9.source: How can we best prevent another episode like the 1973 oil crisis, which paralyzed the country?
254b2dc6c3f4daf0e5b68ba375ba81bb158ab5f9.zh: 如何才能最有效地防止1973年石油危机那样、让全国陷入瘫痪的事件重演？

f79e46638c0800d6ec6022e311c0a5dc09213634.source: How can you even say something like this? You've placed yourself to the left of Barack Obama on health care...
f79e46638c0800d6ec6022e311c0a5dc09213634.zh: 这种话你怎么说得出口？在医疗问题上，你把自己摆到了贝拉克·奥巴马的左边……

26da2d022d9cd539ae7b2b389f915bf6b6099298.source: How close are we to having an effective vaccine for COVID-19, and what can you tell the American people about its safety and effectiveness.
26da2d022d9cd539ae7b2b389f915bf6b6099298.zh: 我们距离有效的新冠疫苗还有多远？对于它的安全性和有效性，你能告诉美国人民什么？

ba86a9e36e7435f9a64c3188845dd9b5caeec844.source: How concerned are you about events in China? What would you do as President to support Chiang Kai-Shek?
ba86a9e36e7435f9a64c3188845dd9b5caeec844.zh: 你对中国的事态有多担忧？作为总统，你会采取什么措施支持蒋介石？

b5d2708fb0de7e7ea5cdc98eb8087a1aafa9e4ad.source: How concerned are you about the $17 trillion debt that the United States currently owes?
b5d2708fb0de7e7ea5cdc98eb8087a1aafa9e4ad.zh: 你对美国目前欠下的17万亿美元债务，有多担忧？

027cc529ac086bab3a90599134401a6363298237.source: How could we pass up an opportunity like this? I want the ad men on this, as soon as possible.
027cc529ac086bab3a90599134401a6363298237.zh: 我们怎么能错过这样的机会？我要广告团队尽快着手处理。

84661d84c76be59186203d3c39e7cf7efa84c387.source: How did this manage to happen? America stands surprised at the unexpected outcome before them- for the first time in over a century, a winner has not been decided on Election Night. By some strange miracle, Goldwater has battled his way back just far enough to tie the election.
84661d84c76be59186203d3c39e7cf7efa84c387.zh: 这是怎么发生的？美国对眼前的意外结果感到惊讶——一个多世纪以来，第一次在选举之夜尚未确定获胜者。凭借某种奇怪的奇迹，戈德华特 一路奋战，勉强扳平了选举。

986eb6ce74212675d229f16a478ba6e04f5e329c.source: How do you feel about capitalism and the free market?
986eb6ce74212675d229f16a478ba6e04f5e329c.zh: 你如何看待资本主义和自由市场？

9228aa926c60cf0b41f64b2289660b97724d05d6.source: How do you plan to address Obamacare as you campaign?
9228aa926c60cf0b41f64b2289660b97724d05d6.zh: 你打算在竞选中如何谈论奥巴马医改？

0d13f129bc09e346401fd0955b72f46dbc80ca40.source: How do you plan to attack the candidacy of George Bush, if at all?
0d13f129bc09e346401fd0955b72f46dbc80ca40.zh: 你打算如何攻击总统候选人乔治·布什，还是根本不打算攻击？

aabb48156c37b1b21d51187891e6bf2ec4900190.source: How do you view the practice of hydraulic fracturing (aka 'fracking') in the Dakotas and elsewhere?
aabb48156c37b1b21d51187891e6bf2ec4900190.zh: 你如何看待南、北达科他州及其他地区使用水力压裂法，也就是“压裂采油气”的做法？

2299150a62aee6453af16c0706e62fff84b7dec9.source: How does your insurance plan in Massachusetts differ from Obamacare?
2299150a62aee6453af16c0706e62fff84b7dec9.zh: 你在马萨诸塞州推行的医疗保险计划，与奥巴马医改有什么不同？

c9c35006f854066e12c04c9c29815069ee79482e.source: How far are you willing to go to compete in the American South against the campaign of George Wallace?
c9c35006f854066e12c04c9c29815069ee79482e.zh: 为了在美国南方与乔治·华莱士竞争，你愿意做到什么程度？

f358726b29631893ced44473e6a9b677e32fd813.source: How is Nancy Pelosi worth $100 million? I'm not saying that I've never made a single mistake in my 50 year business career, but I earned my money fair and square.
f358726b29631893ced44473e6a9b677e32fd813.zh: 南希·佩洛西怎么会身家一亿美元？我不是说，自己五十年商业生涯里一次错误都没犯过，但我的钱赚得堂堂正正。

3d203b7bd2181317dec8def2002ba47b15b4790d.source: How many times do I have to tell these people I'm on their side before they get the message?
3d203b7bd2181317dec8def2002ba47b15b4790d.zh: 我得告诉这些人多少次，我站在他们这一边，他们才听得进去？

25d93d912ba16e3b9c6f69b626f799d2a62a25d4.source: How much attack advertising will your campaign use?
25d93d912ba16e3b9c6f69b626f799d2a62a25d4.zh: 你的竞选团队会投放多少攻击性广告？

101d5e6785d19993a0daf748657a5df43097afdf.source: How much do you plan to highlight the creation of the Federal Trade Commission as an accomplishment during this campaign?
101d5e6785d19993a0daf748657a5df43097afdf.zh: 在这场竞选中，你准备多大程度上突出建立联邦贸易委员会这一政绩？

948fcc67057ac1ff0c6f091683d94afb28210603.source: How much do you plan to push back against Southern obstructionism on a federal child labor law?
948fcc67057ac1ff0c6f091683d94afb28210603.zh: 你准备以多大力度，反击南方对联邦童工法的阻挠？

e031d7409abbc164e6bf30d0a6edad652ba5a387.source: How much of an issue do you plan to make out of the Democrats' attempt to impeach you, which began in 2019?
e031d7409abbc164e6bf30d0a6edad652ba5a387.zh: 民主党从2019年开始试图弹劾你，你打算在多大程度上拿这件事做文章？

82318b47115bdbb8b42bc70ee868b74205593438.source: How much should your party emphasize its support of a Transcontinental Railroad in this election?
82318b47115bdbb8b42bc70ee868b74205593438.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当多大程度上强调对横贯大陆铁路的支持？

e64a23752b144b3d462cd296b83287ba3560d34a.source: How much should your party emphasize its support of a homestead act in this election?
e64a23752b144b3d462cd296b83287ba3560d34a.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当多大程度上强调对宅地法的支持？

d60cb32c604b92f18cb62eca31a3a49c1930283d.source: How much should your party emphasize its support of canals and infrastructure projects in this election?
d60cb32c604b92f18cb62eca31a3a49c1930283d.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当多大程度上强调对运河和基础设施建设的支持？

35988c18e5de70386ee9361b9ce4158f4bcb39fc.source: How much should your party emphasize its support of higher tariffs in this election?
35988c18e5de70386ee9361b9ce4158f4bcb39fc.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当多大程度上强调对提高关税的支持？

2dfc106772afc9f3ca027859c3bb49b51fcdbea2.source: How much will you emphasize your experience under Ronald Reagan, or in other roles, as you run for President?
2dfc106772afc9f3ca027859c3bb49b51fcdbea2.zh: 竞选总统时，你会在多大程度上强调自己在罗纳德·里根政府及其他职位上的经历？

48b3da69700c26df77c04dd860800607eb1805e0.source: How much will you emphasize your own reform efforts as Governor of New York, as you campaign nationally?
48b3da69700c26df77c04dd860800607eb1805e0.zh: 在全国竞选时，你会在多大程度上强调自己担任纽约州州长期间的改革政绩？

43f38b887cd3bc43fd8376a192d03a7925addd8a.source: How on earth did you pull this off? Hopefully you can soothe the frayed nerves from this turbulent campaign, and move the country past its slavery issues of the 1850s. Your supporters are already preparing a compromise amendment, offering permanent protection for slavery in the South in return for the admission of more free states. An invasion of Cuba may also be in order.
43f38b887cd3bc43fd8376a192d03a7925addd8a.zh: 你到底是怎么做到这一点的？希望您能安抚因这场动荡的竞选而紧张的神经，让这个国家摆脱 1850 年代的奴隶制问题。你们的支持者已经在准备一项折衷修正案，为南方的奴隶制提供永久保护，以换取更多自由州的加入。入侵古巴也可能是有序的。

8d1f373fe0e942bd3983ce4747ce26bb324292be.source: How satisfied are you with the overall economy at present?
8d1f373fe0e942bd3983ce4747ce26bb324292be.zh: 你对当前整体经济状况有多满意？

170e8fa3d648a9b9544ba320d059a6403704863b.source: How serious, at the current time, do you believe the internal Communist threat is?
170e8fa3d648a9b9544ba320d059a6403704863b.zh: 你认为，目前国内的共产主义威胁有多严重？

5611191b6ca72891f048a71005da9826feb0f742.source: How should your party address the slavery issue during this campaign?
5611191b6ca72891f048a71005da9826feb0f742.zh: 在这次竞选中，你们党应当如何处理奴隶制问题？

0bdfd26eb75568cd6ce1be2663f10c89fdc1fd63.source: How the fuck did Florida tie are you fucking kidding me
0bdfd26eb75568cd6ce1be2663f10c89fdc1fd63.zh: 佛罗里达他妈的怎么会打平，你他妈在逗我吗

cfbae4ccc166c6d417160283f4023f46a8c6350f.source: However, Teller adds little in terms of competing for electoral votes. The Western states are fanatically pro-silver and sparsely populated.
cfbae4ccc166c6d417160283f4023f46a8c6350f.zh: 然而，特勒 在争夺选举人票方面几乎没有增加任何内容。西部各州狂热支持白银，而且人口稀少。

9ce4473f3690d4965d0cbf809aae8691de5e9b05.source: However, if Romney wants to unite the conservative base of his party, Pawlenty may not be the best choice.
9ce4473f3690d4965d0cbf809aae8691de5e9b05.zh: 然而，如果罗姆尼想要团结其政党的保守派基础，波伦蒂可能不是最好的选择。

2b99ec03120f9ff729179c1228c125cd7927eea4.source: However, in one of the most bizzarre situations that could have unfolded this election, you actually WON the popular vote, despite losing the election! Maybe their will be bipartisan support for removal of the electoral college now...
2b99ec03120f9ff729179c1228c125cd7927eea4.zh: 然而，这场选举竟出现了一个极其离奇的局面：尽管输掉选举，你却赢得了普选票！也许现在两党都能支持废除选举人团了……

71dfa8d1b427957497836f7ba25d1da9aaf4576c.source: Hubert H. Humphrey was another rival for the nomination with clout among the agricultural and labor wings of the party. He is basically blacklisted by the Southern wing of the party for the stances he has taken on civil rights. Selecting him would sacrifice the South, but should increase the chances of winning states like Illinois, Wisconsin, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and New York.
71dfa8d1b427957497836f7ba25d1da9aaf4576c.zh: 休伯特·H.·汉弗莱 是该党农业和劳工派别中具有影响力的另一位提名竞争对手。他基本上因其所采取的立场而被该党南翼列入黑名单 民权。选择他会牺牲南方，但应该会增加赢得伊利诺伊州、威斯康星州、新泽西州、宾夕法尼亚州和纽约州等州的机会。

4aae0925c3b722a23c9b203940fbc4c2526231f7.source: Hubert H. Humphrey, the senior Senator from Minnesota, is a divisive figure in the Democratic Party- loved and loathed by integrationists and segregationists, respectively, Humphrey is well known as the Democrat’s “happy warrior”. He first rose to prominence in 1948 with his successful lobbying for a civil rights plank in Harry Truman’s campaign, and has maintained a consistently progressive, integrationist record in the Senate ever since
4aae0925c3b722a23c9b203940fbc4c2526231f7.zh: 休伯特·H.·汉弗莱，来自明尼苏达州的资深参议员，是民主党中的一个分裂人物——分别受到融合主义者和种族隔离主义者的喜爱和厌恶，汉弗莱被称为民主党的“快乐战士”。他于 1948 年首次声名鹊起，在 哈里·杜鲁门 竞选中成功游说 民权 纲领，并自此在参议院保持了一贯的进步、融合主义记录

b1e56a8cffebdb80eca94f4d796e28af621fc060.source: Hubert Humphrey and I have the same position on this issue. I support extensive legislation to correct our greatest moral problems in this country.
b1e56a8cffebdb80eca94f4d796e28af621fc060.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱和我在这个问题上的立场相同。我支持广泛立法，纠正本国最严重的道德问题。

c15252670f128a4243cdc71a2839ea4a3e97915d.source: Hubert Humphrey has been an unwavering friend of the farmer, the Negro, and the laborer in his years in the Senate. He is the type of man who reflects my deepest held beliefs on these issues.
c15252670f128a4243cdc71a2839ea4a3e97915d.zh: 在参议院任职期间，休伯特·汉弗莱始终是农民、黑人和劳工的朋友。他反映了我在这些议题上最深切的信念。

9f61fb0fc87a6d0fb924c81a135d2a25cda6fd77.source: Hubert Humphrey has served Minnesota with honor and pride, and I’m certain he’ll carry that drive and motivation with us to the White House.
9f61fb0fc87a6d0fb924c81a135d2a25cda6fd77.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱一直满怀荣誉感和自豪感，为明尼苏达州服务。我确信，他会带着同样的干劲和热情，与我们一道进入白宫。

0f1c056d936a7121e401827ca8bf85537dec9692.source: Hubert Humphrey is an extremist and a socialist. We cannot let this man be one heartbeat away from the Presidency.
0f1c056d936a7121e401827ca8bf85537dec9692.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱是个极端分子，是个社会主义者。我们不能让这个人离总统职位仅有一次心跳之遥。

4002fd67eda26b85ef66514a3380d3ea4136fb5c.source: Hubert Humphrey is another weakspot of Lyndon Johnson's, we could try to attack his running mate to gain an edge in the poll to hopefully swing more conservative-aligned moderates to our side.
4002fd67eda26b85ef66514a3380d3ea4136fb5c.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱也是林登·约翰逊的一个弱点。我们可以试着攻击他的竞选搭档，在民调中取得优势，希望能把更多倾向保守主义的温和派争取过来。

0e3aa89604fafb8f2b8647ee1603838b82f9cf1b.source: Hubert Humphrey is one of the most outspoken liberals in the Democratic Party, and that reputation seems to be following him- Goldwater has recently denounced him as a 'left-extremist'. Should we step in to defend him?
0e3aa89604fafb8f2b8647ee1603838b82f9cf1b.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱是民主党内最直言不讳的自由派之一，这个名声似乎也一直伴随着他。戈德华特最近斥责他是“左翼极端分子”。我们是否应该出面为他辩护？

618902790c5b40dacadc6ab076088b4026ac2cc9.source: Hubert Humphrey opposing welfare? Multiple advisors wonder if they woke up in the wrong timeline.
618902790c5b40dacadc6ab076088b4026ac2cc9.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱反对福利？好几位顾问都怀疑，自己一觉醒来是不是到了另一条时间线。

18049176231905f2bfd08fc76b8059a83336e878.zh: 休伯特 汉弗莱 的就职演说，1969 年 1 月 20 日。

5de405e3510b23b8f79a5bfa478fe1d995ba99d9.source: Hubert Humphrey, ready to lead the country!
5de405e3510b23b8f79a5bfa478fe1d995ba99d9.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱，已经准备好领导国家！

31fd7f293d8f728ee98d05d3673bc41947c1e730.source: Hughes must balance the Old Guard and Progressive wings of his own party -- or cast one overboard entirely.
31fd7f293d8f728ee98d05d3673bc41947c1e730.zh: 休斯必须协调党内老派保守势力与进步派的关系，或者干脆舍弃其中一方。

56280d182c2ca12c8bb74ca0e86f5364560b4129.source: Human Rights -- It's past time that we cut allegiances with dictators like the House of Saud and truly lived up to our ideals. I will only support or give aid to democratically elected leaders.
56280d182c2ca12c8bb74ca0e86f5364560b4129.zh: 人权——我们早该切断与沙特王室这类独裁者的联盟，真正践行我们的理想。我只会支持或援助经民主选举产生的领导人。

55c51f6f2182b4c5963176b7846ef87a8f55ba62.source: Humphrey and the Democrats need to know in the future that they cannot ignore the due concerns of the South and win elections. I will focus on winning potential Humphrey supporters.
55c51f6f2182b4c5963176b7846ef87a8f55ba62.zh: 汉弗莱和民主党必须明白：今后不能一边无视南方应有的关切，一边还想赢得选举。我会着重争取潜在的汉弗莱支持者。

58b83bc97f664d79a463cebc955279c30687af95.source: Humphrey is fighting a war on many fronts. He must present a clear case for liberal ideals, bring back the activist wing of the party, head off Wallace's efforts, and still succeed in his primary task of defeating the odious Nixon.
58b83bc97f664d79a463cebc955279c30687af95.zh: 汉弗莱 正在多条战线上进行战争。他必须为自由主义理想提出明确的理由，带回党内的激进派，阻止华莱士的努力，并仍然成功地完成他击败可恶的尼克松的首要任务。

5000177b69b5dbf683df2eebe6927b268c39cddd.source: Humphrey is more than happy with this, as are African-Americans and liberals across the country. However, moderates who were wary of the first Civil Rights Act recoil at the idea of a second, more radical one- and Southern Democrats are practically frothing at the mouth at the news.
5000177b69b5dbf683df2eebe6927b268c39cddd.zh: 汉弗莱对此十分满意，全国各地的非裔美国人和自由派也是如此。不过，原本就对第一项《民权法案》心存疑虑的温和派，一听到还要推出第二项、更激进的法案便退缩了；南方民主党人听到消息，简直气得口吐白沫。

46e14d1fc6eff2e8c42884e71c7b98575efb7656.source: Humphrey is our main opponent in key states, such as Ohio, Illinois, and California. We must focus on campaigning against him in these key states, or else, god forbid, Wallace actually deadlocks the Electoral College.
46e14d1fc6eff2e8c42884e71c7b98575efb7656.zh: 汉弗莱才是我们在俄亥俄州、伊利诺伊州和加利福尼亚州等关键州的主要对手。我们必须在这些州集中火力对付他，否则——但愿不会如此——华莱士真有可能让选举人团陷入僵局。

e27b25d2cc99e00f4e7c771281ecb05f85c2632a.source: Humphrey tries to hold the line for liberalism in a year of social chaos and racial agitation.
e27b25d2cc99e00f4e7c771281ecb05f85c2632a.zh: 在社会混乱、种族冲突激烈的一年里，汉弗莱试图守住自由派的阵地。

c71f5dddd698dda78c55a4dc022a77a87e0d1c76.source: How these students have not been expelled is beyond me. If Administrators want to be complicit in the degradation of a private university, that is their own business. However, I won't spend a dime of federal money on a school that coddles radical agitators.
c71f5dddd698dda78c55a4dc022a77a87e0d1c76.zh: 这些学生居然还没被开除，我实在无法理解。如果校方愿意纵容一所私立大学堕落，那是他们自己的事。但我不会给一所袒护激进煽动分子的学校拨一分钱联邦经费。

dfd395a6fc68f5a2eb98b40c204fb7ec37f32423.source: How will their campaign play out? Can Clinton continue the legacy of Obama? Can Trump pull off an upset?
dfd395a6fc68f5a2eb98b40c204fb7ec37f32423.zh: 他们的竞选将如何展开？克林顿能否延续奥巴马的政治遗产？特朗普能否爆冷获胜？

5af0deb94c068322adbcc478f146be81670459f7.source: How will their campaign play out? Can Trump pull off an upset? Can Clinton continue the legacy of Obama?
5af0deb94c068322adbcc478f146be81670459f7.zh: 他们的竞选将如何展开？特朗普能否爆冷获胜？克林顿能否延续奥巴马的政治遗产？

b10b321e17dadbc6b558905f18a9a6e6aa01d97e.source: How will you address the Iran-Contra scandal as you campaign for President?
b10b321e17dadbc6b558905f18a9a6e6aa01d97e.zh: 竞选总统时，你会怎样谈论伊朗门丑闻？

d45524d67882bb41c5df5c2addee61ce59d3cb9b.source: How will you reduce the inflation rate, currently around 10% annually, if you are elected President?
d45524d67882bb41c5df5c2addee61ce59d3cb9b.zh: 如果当选总统，你会如何降低目前每年约10%的通货膨胀率？

4e52367e2dc7336e50536684b2c83fae71b458d2.source: How would you prevent campus incidents like the takeover of Columbia University that occurred this past spring?
4e52367e2dc7336e50536684b2c83fae71b458d2.zh: 你将如何防止今年春天哥伦比亚大学遭占领那样的校园事件？

cf05e7e58e64a85c209887577dcbc2c57536307c.source: Howard Baker has served his home state of Tennessee well, and he is the best man for the job.
cf05e7e58e64a85c209887577dcbc2c57536307c.zh: 霍华德·贝克为家乡田纳西州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

dbeaff218bd3e027380d8c8a4c9c005cbaa99897.source: Howard Baker is a Senator from Tennessee who has served since 1967, and who was nearly appointed to the Supreme Court by Richard Nixon. The first Republican since Reconstruction to be elected to the Senate from his state, he is heavily involved in the passage of most legislation, and is a leading voice among Congressional Republicans. He has a moderate reputation, and is not a first choice of the Reaganites.
dbeaff218bd3e027380d8c8a4c9c005cbaa99897.zh: 霍华德·贝克 是来自 田纳西州 的参议员，自 1967 年以来一直任职，差点被 理查德·尼克松 任命为最高法院法官。他是自 重建时期 以来第一位从本州当选参议员的共和党人，他积极参与了大多数立法的通过，并且是国会共和党人中的主要代言人。他名声一般，并不是里根派的首选。

7357291431952ca74a4dc92fd9131173d63d56a2.source: Howard Baker is a good guy to have at your side.
7357291431952ca74a4dc92fd9131173d63d56a2.zh: 霍华德·贝克是个值得与你并肩的人。

ba33d5b2c0f69dbe32e027842d58a7f7c1d7cf39.source: Howard Baker is a good guy to have at your side. Just don't expect him to help much in Tennessee against a guy like Carter.
ba33d5b2c0f69dbe32e027842d58a7f7c1d7cf39.zh: 霍华德·贝克是个值得与你并肩的人。只是别指望面对卡特这样的对手，他能在田纳西州帮上太多。

57102a3ff2a162a23d4a7e4035a250e21733186b.source: Howard Baker knows how to get things done in Washington, and he has always fought hard for the Republican agenda.
57102a3ff2a162a23d4a7e4035a250e21733186b.zh: 霍华德·贝克懂得如何在华盛顿把事情办成，也始终为共和党的议程奋力工作。

1393e0796253fcc2c7fc212eb0c3b28cd097cc8f.source: However the anti-war, liberal wing of the party will surely recoil at this selection.
1393e0796253fcc2c7fc212eb0c3b28cd097cc8f.zh: 然而，党内的反战自由派肯定会对这一选择产生畏缩。

f749ec9841c4c9e0f2f60e50019ee40c6dffc319.source: However, Grover Cleveland is immensely unpopular due to the depression, and the Democrats may wish to avoid further association with his Administration.
f749ec9841c4c9e0f2f60e50019ee40c6dffc319.zh: 然而，格罗弗·克利夫兰由于经济大萧条而非常不受欢迎，民主党人可能希望避免与他的政府有进一步的联系。

42a1a66fadfd32920140bb96ca8588815af98d1d.source: However, Reagan will not help Nixon very much in the competitive Northeast and Midwest states where he must challenge Humphrey.
42a1a66fadfd32920140bb96ca8588815af98d1d.zh: 然而，里根 在他必须挑战 汉弗莱 的竞争激烈的东北和中西部州对 尼克松 没有多大帮助。

f2098f709f7a61c02d19c18615fd8171c492f476.source: Humphrey will balance the ticket with Johnson, and his ties to unions will boost the campaign in the Midwest, as will his liberal stances in the Northeast. However, he expects Johnson to strongly support civil rights, and his reputation will only serve to push the segregationist wing of the party further away.
f2098f709f7a61c02d19c18615fd8171c492f476.zh: 汉弗莱 将与 约翰逊 平衡选票，他与工会的关系将推动中西部的竞选活动，他在东北部的自由主义立场也是如此。然而，他预计约翰逊会大力支持民权，而他的声誉只会将党内的种族隔离派推得更远。

50760b404c168b74f7dc43a96c2742711926cbed.source: Humphrey will spend the rest of the campaign needling you on this issue. Of course, you've started out with such a lead that it hopefully won't matter in the end.
50760b404c168b74f7dc43a96c2742711926cbed.zh: 汉弗莱会在余下的竞选中不断拿这个问题刺你。当然，你一开始就领先那么多，希望最终不会因此受影响。

576cab65b6e036167650bb70eef25c0897a2ac19.source: Hunter Biden is my son, but in this case his judgment was a little off. I'm prepared to fully apologize for any mixed signals this created.
576cab65b6e036167650bb70eef25c0897a2ac19.zh: 亨特·拜登是我的儿子，但在这件事上，他的判断有点偏差。我愿意为这可能传递的任何含混信号，充分道歉。

769c191163fe2e94fe9ea4485e09c3975274a030.source: Hunter's payments were an attempt to bribe Joe Biden, end of story. All we wanted to do was look into it, and we had this impeachment nonsense. If this doesn't show how crooked the Democrats are, I don't know what does.
769c191163fe2e94fe9ea4485e09c3975274a030.zh: 付给亨特的钱，就是为了贿赂乔·拜登，事情就是这样。我们只是想查一查，结果就冒出了这场弹劾胡闹。如果这还不能说明民主党多么腐败，我就不知道还有什么能说明了。

12323e8b648fdbe06109455b37f5732a5edb9637.source: I abhor any instance where extra-judicial punishment is meted out by the passions of an inflamed mob. My party will speak out against this practice in our platform.
12323e8b648fdbe06109455b37f5732a5edb9637.zh: 我憎恶一切因暴怒人群的激情而施行的法外惩罚。本党将在党纲中谴责这种做法。

67a6f43ada7d2fe76256243f8ad89b14c0374357.source: I absolutely agree. The embargo against Cuba is a disgrace.
67a6f43ada7d2fe76256243f8ad89b14c0374357.zh: 我完全赞同。对古巴的禁运是耻辱。

18c5e570de6f77f0577e347eb8a7f0dee5a12bb1.source: I absolutely believe that the development of telegraph lines should take its place alongside canals, harbors, and railroads as a national prerogative.
18c5e570de6f77f0577e347eb8a7f0dee5a12bb1.zh: 我坚信，发展电报线路应当与运河、港口、铁路一样，成为国家应当承担的事务。

be0926c4659018e969c4d7c07fff3bf6df95a1a3.source: I absolutely believe that the federal government should be providing funds, to the states of course, for them to apply to education spending on our country's youth.
be0926c4659018e969c4d7c07fff3bf6df95a1a3.zh: 我当然认为，联邦政府应该提供资金——当然是拨给各州——让它们用于本国青少年的教育开支。

844c63b200bce196c7af2a12706b883ee3b1a07b.source: I agree with General Brown, to be honest. We would have never had the Oil Crisis in '73 if we weren't closely aligned with Israel.
844c63b200bce196c7af2a12706b883ee3b1a07b.zh: 坦白说，我赞同布朗将军。如果我们没有与以色列紧密结盟，就根本不会遭遇1973年的石油危机。

12375d4e74b3d5fd65846b95d21bbfb1f2940ed0.source: I agree with the concept of 'survival of the fittest'. It is the destiny of the strong to expand at the expense of the weak.
12375d4e74b3d5fd65846b95d21bbfb1f2940ed0.zh: 我赞同“适者生存”的观念。强者以牺牲弱者为代价扩张，这是命运使然。

32b74fb4eac8e2e5d54517227ef1949e5f11e57f.source: I agree. We can definitely split the South if we make a strong play for it this year. I will visit extensively.
32b74fb4eac8e2e5d54517227ef1949e5f11e57f.zh: 我同意。如果今年积极争取，我们肯定能分走南方的选票。我会广泛访问当地。

1420d64a71cbac9fa4791e68a270d06c0d2010f2.source: I agree. We can't have this kind of thing on the Ford Administration. He should leave immediately.
1420d64a71cbac9fa4791e68a270d06c0d2010f2.zh: 我同意。福特政府不能容忍这种事情。他应立即离职。

5481053a66bb6ca3a31eb7c1b9459f79bdcaea16.source: I already made one speech that was entirely devoted to this issue back in 2008. Bringing it up more often runs the risk of distracting the American people from the most important issues of this campaign.
5481053a66bb6ca3a31eb7c1b9459f79bdcaea16.zh: 早在2008年，我就作过一场完全专门谈这个问题的演说。更频繁地提起它，可能会让美国人民忽略这次竞选最重要的议题。

9b8de88dd4248cbf62662d7ac0cd83c87985d987.source: I am 100% committed to the coinage of silver. It's important however, that we strike a moderate tone on other issues to expand our appeal as widely as we can.
9b8de88dd4248cbf62662d7ac0cd83c87985d987.zh: 我百分之百支持白银铸币。不过，为了尽可能扩大支持，在其他问题上，我们必须采取温和的语气。

87c2f19efe23005b55ee1a2095e2045d32059078.source: I am Catholic and proud of it. I will not respond to bigoted attacks or innuendo, and I trust that these attacks will only help me by driving higher Catholic turnout.
87c2f19efe23005b55ee1a2095e2045d32059078.zh: 我是天主教徒，并以此为荣。我不会回应偏执的攻击或影射，相信这些攻击只会提高天主教徒的投票热情，反而帮助我。

64cbf3b79e9aba1996d646b1480b7f3f4dc80c22.source: I am a capable, pragmatic leader who will bring the Massachusetts Miracle to bear on a national scale. We will move past Reagan's scandals and into the future.
64cbf3b79e9aba1996d646b1480b7f3f4dc80c22.zh: 我是一位有能力、务实的领导人，会让马萨诸塞奇迹在全国发挥作用。我们将走出里根的丑闻，迈向未来。

50e66b3d3fd224e0a50a732fecd07afdff0624f4.source: I am a firm believer in free trade. This would not help anybody and it would further distort our economy.
50e66b3d3fd224e0a50a732fecd07afdff0624f4.zh: 我坚信自由贸易。这帮不了任何人，只会进一步扭曲我们的经济。

1fc04e9ad3fc6769f6fb36f530e0c2831c6e1fb7.source: I am a firm proponent of the free market. We simply need effective regulation to make sure that the economy works as best as it possibly can.
1fc04e9ad3fc6769f6fb36f530e0c2831c6e1fb7.zh: 我坚定支持自由市场。我们只需要有效监管，确保经济尽可能良好运转。

899564a6f7f049f7b5f5049d01114962d95d58d3.source: I am a moderate who supports the free coinage of silver. I am not a radical as so many claim. It is McKinley's antiquated insistence on the gold standard that is truly radical.
899564a6f7f049f7b5f5049d01114962d95d58d3.zh: 我是支持白银自由铸币的温和派，并不是很多人声称的激进分子。真正激进的，是麦金莱对过时金本位制的执着。

15e8d77256641aa2b05ac4ebc6520ce778878b2e.source: I am a national candidate, and my law-and-order appeal is universal. I will travel into the North and the West and campaign for any voter who is concerned about the future of our country.
15e8d77256641aa2b05ac4ebc6520ce778878b2e.zh: 我是一位全国性的候选人，我维护法律与秩序的主张适用于所有地方。我会前往北方和西部，争取每一位关心国家未来的选民。

ae2db97c30a455e3790143fe0b2c174362b1badc.source: I am a personal friend of Andrew Jackson, and have repeatedly taken advice from him throughout my political career. I'm proud of this and I believe it to be an asset in this campaign.
ae2db97c30a455e3790143fe0b2c174362b1badc.zh: 我是安德鲁·杰克逊的私人朋友，在政治生涯中多次向他请教。我为此感到自豪，也相信这能为此次竞选加分。

52257842758d987311d15591bce3d4e2ee6273b6.source: I am a pro-choice candidate, and I support the
52257842758d987311d15591bce3d4e2ee6273b6.zh: 我是一名支持堕胎的候选人，我支持

98c377dbb8c313a067b1dc7fb14c87a6381358ee.source: I am a pro-life candidate for President, but I understand that we have certain legal protections in place. At the very least, we can end taxpayer funding for this practice.
98c377dbb8c313a067b1dc7fb14c87a6381358ee.zh: 我是一位主张保护未出生生命的总统候选人，但我明白，我们目前已经有一些法律保护。至少，我们可以停止由纳税人出钱资助堕胎。

4dba39f064bcf443a284fd155456a63a7d649914.source: I am a pro-life candidate, but I do not support an amendment for this purpose.
4dba39f064bcf443a284fd155456a63a7d649914.zh: 我是反对堕胎的候选人，但不支持为此制定修正案。

536ed4add1981471d596547268401c9acd4b82df.source: I am a proud "wet" in the alcohol debate. What a man drinks is no one's business but his own.
536ed4add1981471d596547268401c9acd4b82df.zh: 在禁酒争论中，我是个坚定的“反禁酒派”。一个人喝什么，只是他自己的事，旁人无权干涉。

f63ef0ca938ea835af1a4d1a656391e7f0434daa.source: I am a proud Methodist. We all pray to the same Christian God and there is no need to use divisive, radical religious rhetoric.
f63ef0ca938ea835af1a4d1a656391e7f0434daa.zh: 我自豪地信奉循道宗。我们向同一位基督教上帝祈祷，没必要使用激进、制造分裂的宗教言辞。

47b99ef84d446cdd4e082daf2b1c703a3164d0d0.source: I am a serious candidate for President of the United States. I will protect law-abiding Americans from social disorder and I will win the war in Vietnam.
47b99ef84d446cdd4e082daf2b1c703a3164d0d0.zh: 我是一位认真竞选美国总统的候选人。我会保护守法美国人免遭社会混乱之害，并赢得越南战争。

6d538a0ca7fe8dbd45fb6a027d5e8744c095b88b.source: I am a strong supporter of labor unions and I would support this type of measure.
6d538a0ca7fe8dbd45fb6a027d5e8744c095b88b.zh: 我坚定支持工会，也会支持这类措施。

9f3edd56a71a013a37d6c3b14a6811110f907fde.source: I am a strong supporter of labor, but I also think that working hour restrictions are more appropriate for women and children than for grown men.
9f3edd56a71a013a37d6c3b14a6811110f907fde.zh: 我坚定支持劳工，但也认为，限制工作时间更适用于妇女和儿童，而不是成年男子。

da5b928bba8d8952ae9d16d3ab87ec1696d6cae6.source: I am against the annexation of Texas. And just to show that this does derive from sectional prejudice, I am also against expansion into Oregon or other regions.
da5b928bba8d8952ae9d16d3ab87ec1696d6cae6.zh: 我反对吞并得克萨斯。为表明这一立场确实出于地域偏见，我也反对向俄勒冈或其他地区扩张。

0ae7f2aa20b34f62cd61491024ed66b171d8f3b5.source: I am as much in favor of the annexation of Texas as Mr. Polk is. To insinuate otherwise is nothing but dishonesty writ large.
0ae7f2aa20b34f62cd61491024ed66b171d8f3b5.zh: 我与波尔克先生一样支持吞并得克萨斯。任何暗示并非如此的说法，都是赤裸裸的谎言。

0031d84405c54217159aac4fbeb1648d7263df8b.source: I am as satisfied as I can be. With sound defense policies and strong economic growth, we should continue to maintain our advantage over the Soviet Union.
0031d84405c54217159aac4fbeb1648d7263df8b.zh: 我已尽可能感到满意。只要国防政策稳健、经济强劲增长，我们就应该继续保持对苏联的优势。

4d7cb07e1789192a4ffa88fe27835a965ac5861d.source: I am calling out the leadership class on their failures, and because of this many lies have been spread about me. I support legal immigration and a safe zone for Syrian refugees, but you'd have no idea if you were listening to the folks in the media.
4d7cb07e1789192a4ffa88fe27835a965ac5861d.zh: 我揭露领导阶层的失败，因此，许多人散布关于我的谎言。我支持合法移民，也支持为叙利亚难民建立安全区，但如果只听媒体那些人，你根本不会知道。

93f673a0cf3d3b45fbcc75c43d75261f150a9878.source: I am campaigning on the issue of ending desegregation. That is my appeal and that is the issue I will stick to.
93f673a0cf3d3b45fbcc75c43d75261f150a9878.zh: 我的竞选主张是停止废除种族隔离。这就是我的诉求，也是我会坚持的议题。

649c875ce78e0543baa91a6d8405eaa3ef7b9723.source: I am deeply concerned by Comey's decision to reopen a settled case, and I'm confident that there are no new revelations here. We're going to focus on our message during the closing stretch of this campaign?
649c875ce78e0543baa91a6d8405eaa3ef7b9723.zh: 我对科米决定重启一个已经了结的案件深感忧虑，也相信这里不会有什么新发现。在竞选最后阶段，我们要聚焦于自己的主张，不是吗？

9774a5e8268e82bad5a68483c4c153c685ece2db.source: I am deeply pro-life. The taking of life should never be legal under any circumstances.
9774a5e8268e82bad5a68483c4c153c685ece2db.zh: 我坚决反对堕胎。在任何情况下，剥夺生命都不应该合法。

9df25eb4b68ef6cbb339e452aa953467a134f8a2.source: I am disappointed with the backward status of our Navy. We need a more vigorous fleet, and we need a canal in Nicaragua to more closely link our two coasts.
9df25eb4b68ef6cbb339e452aa953467a134f8a2.zh: 我国海军的落后状况让我失望。我们需要一支更强劲的舰队，也需要尼加拉瓜运河，更紧密地连接东西两岸。

634ff7c58ece88fcd367ca339e7ba0c0a50849d7.source: I am disappointed with the half measures taken in this act. If Senators were directly elected by the people, they would be less beholden to the types of financial interests who wrote their own tariffs into this law.
634ff7c58ece88fcd367ca339e7ba0c0a50849d7.zh: 我对这一行为中采取的半措施感到失望。如果参议员由人民直接选举产生，他们就不会那么受那些将自己的关税写入该法律的经济利益集团的影响。

c42cabaaf8393c199e1b57fca096f07ea06c1d3c.source: I am the President of the United States and we should exploit that fact. Show me presiding over the Bicentennial, meeting with Queen Elizabeth, and generally looking like a President. My record speaks for itself.
c42cabaaf8393c199e1b57fca096f07ea06c1d3c.zh: 我是美国总统，我们应充分利用这一点。展示我主持建国二百周年纪念活动、会见伊丽莎白女王，以及其他体现总统风范的场面。我的政绩不言自明。

5e7fe6e25281f68692512890897bfe39292e1b50.source: I am the candidate of hope and change. In my next term, I will advance civil rights even further, and create a society that is equal in every way. On this, I give my word.
5e7fe6e25281f68692512890897bfe39292e1b50.zh: 我是代表希望与变革的候选人。在下一任期，我将进一步推动民权，建立一个各方面都平等的社会。对此，我郑重承诺。

6fa638ec81c529dcbc0bb3694db6e620e0ca1031.source: I am the candidate of responsibility and pragmatism. Civil rights has been advanced as far as it must be- any further action will simply be federal overreach, and must be avoided. The South has nothing to fear from a Johnson Presidency.
6fa638ec81c529dcbc0bb3694db6e620e0ca1031.zh: 我是代表责任与务实的候选人。民权已经推进到必要的程度，任何进一步行动都只是联邦政府越权，必须避免。南方不必害怕约翰逊执政。

0bc4f4ce9d50f941a2f0c4867b7206a99c3c8a3e.source: I am the candidate of stability, of safety, and of responsibility. Civil rights will be treated with the care and attention it requires under a Johnson Presidency, with no extreme actions for one side or the other.
0bc4f4ce9d50f941a2f0c4867b7206a99c3c8a3e.zh: 我是代表稳定、安全和责任的候选人。在约翰逊执政期间，我们会以应有的审慎和重视对待民权问题，不会为任何一方采取极端行动。

376b61af1bf58a69d5baf5c833e06251bce37e64.source: I am the candidate who brings the reasonable, tested ideas of sound money, protection, and prosperity. Bryan on the other hand will usher in radicalism and instability.
376b61af1bf58a69d5baf5c833e06251bce37e64.zh: 我带来的是合理且经过检验的主张：稳健货币、贸易保护与繁荣。而布赖恩只会带来激进主义与动荡。

96b5f037a3ceb33dbbc2a880c9e1129d65aee75e.source: I am the law and order candidate. The riots, the Democrat riots really, and the efforts to undermine the Supreme Court, the phony Russia investigation, and ignoring our immigration laws. It's all coming from the Democrats.
96b5f037a3ceb33dbbc2a880c9e1129d65aee75e.zh: 我是维护法律与秩序的候选人。骚乱，实际上是民主党的骚乱，破坏最高法院的企图，虚假的俄罗斯调查，无视移民法。这些全是民主党干的。

f3548f19d82c10cd431e59f5472d99e515580b72.source: I am the most progressive candidate ever for President of the United States. We are pushing for a higher minimum wage, better health care, immigration reform, and police reform. Tim Kaine stands fully behind that agenda.
f3548f19d82c10cd431e59f5472d99e515580b72.zh: 我是有史以来最进步的美国总统候选人。我们在争取提高最低工资、改善医疗、移民改革和警务改革。蒂姆·凯恩完全支持这套议程。

181e38afd9aea8d720675910e739179f61eeea81.source: I am the true choice for Americans concerned about the environment and Social Security. I will enact strict regulation of the oil and coal industry, fight against big agriculture and GMO's, and support research and subsidies for alternative energy. I will increase funding and benefits for Social Security.
181e38afd9aea8d720675910e739179f61eeea81.zh: 对于关心环境和社会保障制度的美国人，我才是真正的选择。我会严格监管石油和煤炭行业，对抗大型农业企业和转基因产品，并支持替代能源的研究和补贴。我会增加社会保障制度的经费和福利。

d1a3f304a264642c802533c7d1405453c3b26b9c.source: I am the true conservative in this election. I support free enterprise, a hard line against Communism, and a devolution of responsibilities to the state governments.
d1a3f304a264642c802533c7d1405453c3b26b9c.zh: 我是这次选举中真正的保守派。我支持自由企业、对共产主义采取强硬路线，并把权责下放给州政府。

10cd046be75708cba19e5329b1ce8f4fe1a253db.source: I am going to be pretty explicit in calling out the rhetoric and demagoguery of Donald Trump throughout this election.
10cd046be75708cba19e5329b1ce8f4fe1a253db.zh: 整场选举中，我都会相当明确地批判特朗普的言辞与煽动手法。

0752a4c6e13587c61921b04c997b1877d0d27abf.source: I am my own man. I respect Bill Clinton in many ways, but his personal conduct was lacking in this case.
0752a4c6e13587c61921b04c997b1877d0d27abf.zh: 我有自己的原则。我在许多方面尊重比尔·克林顿，但他在这件事上的个人操守确实有问题。

25b2d447959b173283c35af8da913b648f5fdff1.source: I am not a radical like Goldwater. I am a pragmatic, moderate problem-solver who will tackle the challenges of inflation and disorder with even-handedness.
25b2d447959b173283c35af8da913b648f5fdff1.zh: 我不是戈德华特那样的激进派。我是务实、温和的问题解决者，会以公允的态度应对通货膨胀和社会失序。

e021e8ea45740eee1b21808ad68778f7076485f9.source: I am opposed to radicalism from any region, and that includes anti-slavery radicalism. The Whig Party is a national party with a national program that will benefit all regions equally.
e021e8ea45740eee1b21808ad68778f7076485f9.zh: 我反对任何地区的激进主义，也包括反奴隶制的激进主义。辉格党是全国性政党，有一套让各地区平等受益的全国纲领。

1b95c4629decc7ee9b29eda55b70e6a0b331c80d.source: I am opposed to these plans and believe that the courts have erred greatly.
1b95c4629decc7ee9b29eda55b70e6a0b331c80d.zh: 我反对这些计划，认为法院犯了严重错误。

a4076a7c92e5ed44b4bb4cec86b2dcdae1cd5716.source: I am opposed to this idea. Why should I turn myself into a lame duck and project weakness before the voting for my first term even starts?
a4076a7c92e5ed44b4bb4cec86b2dcdae1cd5716.zh: 我反对这个想法。连第一个任期的投票都还没开始，我为什么就要让自己变成跛脚鸭，表现出软弱？

88d22839819a896c75f5c29df9ddfd6a91a32321.source: I am preparing a severe criticism of Russia as we speak, a very very strong criticism I think you'll agree. For seeking to divide us as a nation by releasing this information about Hillary Clinton and her political tricks.
88d22839819a896c75f5c29df9ddfd6a91a32321.zh: 就在我们说话的此刻，我正在准备严厉批评俄罗斯，非常非常严厉的批评，我想你会同意。因为它试图通过泄露希拉里·克林顿及其政治伎俩的信息，分裂我们的国家。

e0a2ab3a716ce9d41ad76c9ce56282a39e67830a.source: I am proud to have kept this country out of war, and I will make every effort to do so if elected for a second term.
e0a2ab3a716ce9d41ad76c9ce56282a39e67830a.zh: 我自豪地让这个国家没有卷入战争。如果当选连任，我将竭尽所能，继续做到这一点。

7da7b7f8cdb6b73b3f9d0b8bdcd0e1418e8b9050.source: I am really hoping to keep this campaign focused on the issues, but if Hillary wants to use this "war on women" nonsense, I reserve the right to call her out on it, along with Bill.
7da7b7f8cdb6b73b3f9d0b8bdcd0e1418e8b9050.zh: 我真的希望这场竞选能围绕具体议题展开。不过，如果希拉里要拿“向女性宣战”那套胡话做文章，我保留揭穿她和比尔的权利。

f29fe9b0130241a8b8e2803d0c5fa87bc380ca84.source: I am satisfied with our progress over the past few years. We have prevented further expansion while avoiding any major wars.
f29fe9b0130241a8b8e2803d0c5fa87bc380ca84.zh: 我对过去几年的进展满意。我们阻止了进一步扩张，也避免了任何重大战争。

6a0902fe9928697149d2bc389f055078c0e21532.source: I am self-funding and independent from special interests. Hillary Clinton has taken money from Goldman Sachs, Saudi Arabia, Russia, and many large donors within the United States. Who do you trust?
6a0902fe9928697149d2bc389f055078c0e21532.zh: 我的竞选自己出钱，不受特殊利益集团左右。希拉里·克林顿拿过高盛、沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯，以及美国许多大金主的钱。你信谁？

9d4c734a5623ba03e5348b4606c8aca0333b338f.source: I am steadfast against the annexation of Texas and the expansion of slavery. I believe that Birney's followers should be made aware of this point.
9d4c734a5623ba03e5348b4606c8aca0333b338f.zh: 我坚决反对吞并得克萨斯，反对扩张奴隶制。我认为，应当让伯尼的追随者清楚这一点。

307f1474e697e46e4ca66f8b2683c6bff6fdb5e4.source: I am supportive of a civil rights bill and will work with Congress to get one written and passed.
307f1474e697e46e4ca66f8b2683c6bff6fdb5e4.zh: 我支持民权法案，会与国会合作起草并推动通过。

a76388fbf9c9420646dfcaccc7365b698eb5dfcc.source: I am the true conservative when it comes to gun rights, abortion, taxes, and many other issues. It would be terrible if we let the left-wing media divide us in the face of Hillary Clinton.
a76388fbf9c9420646dfcaccc7365b698eb5dfcc.zh: 在拥枪权、堕胎、税收和许多其他问题上，我才是真正的保守派。面对希拉里·克林顿，如果我们让左翼媒体把我们分裂开，那就太糟糕了。

d288464793639428fcb600bdac5fbf1b9e209ed5.source: I am willing to make an expansive deal with Palmer. He may remain on the ballot in Illinois, but must remove himself completely from the other northern states. In turn I will give him free reign in the entire South.
d288464793639428fcb600bdac5fbf1b9e209ed5.zh: 我愿意与帕尔默达成一项范围广泛的协议。他可以留在伊利诺伊的选票上，但必须完全退出其他北方州的竞选。作为交换，我会让他在整个南方放手竞选。

ef7b77d2392bf14bb3558dae633dd6d0f4f211e5.source: I am willing to wait until the emotions surrounding this issue can recede a bit. If that means delaying the admission of Kansas, I will reluctantly accept that.
ef7b77d2392bf14bb3558dae633dd6d0f4f211e5.zh: 我愿意等这个问题周围的情绪稍微平息。如果这意味着推迟接纳堪萨斯入联邦，我也会勉强接受。

b0d94cc2df54c4480f52cff34cb8ded1a8795800.source: I appreciate the faith of the American people and consult always with the Lord before I make my decisions. I will run a moderate, sensible agenda that appeals to the broad majority.
b0d94cc2df54c4480f52cff34cb8ded1a8795800.zh: 我尊重美国人民的信仰，作决定前也总会向上帝寻求指引。我将推行温和、务实的纲领，争取广大多数人的支持。

d1dd51e1f1f1ce276523cefa966af6beadf3a756.source: I barely said a word. Now if the Democrats and their friends in the media want to rig this election with fake polls and massive voter fraud, they will see what it looks like when someone incites violence.
d1dd51e1f1f1ce276523cefa966af6beadf3a756.zh: 我几乎没说什么。不过，如果民主党和他们在媒体里的朋友想靠虚假民调和大规模选举舞弊操纵这场选举，他们就会见识到，真正煽动暴力是什么样。

93d750185178f00c3f74b2e83c0bc08e39d889b5.source: I believe a fair course would be to press for legislation requiring an 8-hour workday for railroads, along with other compromises.
93d750185178f00c3f74b2e83c0bc08e39d889b5.zh: 我认为，公平的做法是推动立法，规定铁路行业八小时工作制，同时达成其他妥协。

ae8031c101bff64f229e2498b1984f9dc20b526e.source: I believe a minimum wage is at the very least a bad economic idea, and possibly unconstitutional. I do not support this increase.
ae8031c101bff64f229e2498b1984f9dc20b526e.zh: 我认为，最低工资至少是一项糟糕的经济政策，也可能违宪。我不支持这次提高。

47f6b6a406d408f6832dc61a902e83c1b52de5a2.source: I believe it was a hasty and impetuous move by the Truman Administration to support the creation of Israel. I have to come out against this measure.
47f6b6a406d408f6832dc61a902e83c1b52de5a2.zh: 我认为，杜鲁门政府支持建立以色列，是仓促、冲动之举。我必须公开反对这项措施。

146374cfeb4d90a82a6510d074e06b27df6f914f.source: I believe strongly in the two-term precedent, but I don't believe it should be enforced by Constitutional Amendment.
146374cfeb4d90a82a6510d074e06b27df6f914f.zh: 我坚信两届任期的惯例，但不认为应该通过宪法修正案强制执行。

81ea9daf1063674867db55d9540c79d87395bf61.source: I believe that American companies should every right to bid on foreign oil contracts with our allies.
81ea9daf1063674867db55d9540c79d87395bf61.zh: 我认为，美国企业应当完全有权竞标盟友的海外石油合同。

a6a058d79a78c497ef1f26c721bad6d0c64c7eeb.source: I believe that Burkett appeals to the voters of the West, and will help us win those states back to the Republican fold.
a6a058d79a78c497ef1f26c721bad6d0c64c7eeb.zh: 我认为，伯克特对西部选民有吸引力，能够帮助我们把这些州重新争取到共和党一边。

776acf6121897571fb3b5ee6ccf405102b100b8d.source: I believe that Eisenhower did what he had to do in this case, to make sure the decisions of our Supreme Court are enforced.
776acf6121897571fb3b5ee6ccf405102b100b8d.zh: 我认为，在这件事上，艾森豪威尔为确保最高法院的判决得到执行，做了必须做的事。

2f8133e57c27a94999527897fe6c85957c69268d.source: I believe that Senators should be elected by the legislature of each state, in line with the original Constitution.
2f8133e57c27a94999527897fe6c85957c69268d.zh: 我认为，应当按照原宪法，由各州议会选举联邦参议员。

c9b58e25025ec0380ee27567a41eab5e8338e917.source: I believe that a Republican Congress, working with a Republican President, will be able to come to accord on the key issues of our time.
c9b58e25025ec0380ee27567a41eab5e8338e917.zh: 我相信，共和党控制的国会与共和党总统合作，能够在当今重大议题上达成一致。

6679cc15e8f5515dc9a497bcf7412823f78d86a8.source: I believe that abortion should be safe, legal, and rare.
6679cc15e8f5515dc9a497bcf7412823f78d86a8.zh: 我认为，堕胎应该安全、合法，而且尽量少发生。

b02c0fbf955c6b7a21a89b7056acae8af03ecb53.source: I believe that any immigrant who seeks a new life in the United States should be required to pass a literacy test.
b02c0fbf955c6b7a21a89b7056acae8af03ecb53.zh: 我认为，任何希望在美国开始新生活的移民，都应当通过识字测试。

11ae73bab60a36308d7246ac827785d677159d48.source: I believe that any recovery that has occurred was incidental to those tax cuts. The cause was a combination of natural economic strength and increased spending.
11ae73bab60a36308d7246ac827785d677159d48.zh: 我认为，任何复苏都只是碰巧发生在这些减税之后。真正的原因，是经济本身的活力，加上支出增加。

81b3a678a8ba74bfaee20ee4ba9caa8f0211c035.source: I believe that black lives matter. I fully support this group in their objectives. They are the civil rights group of our time.
81b3a678a8ba74bfaee20ee4ba9caa8f0211c035.zh: 我相信，黑人的命也是命。我完全支持这个团体的目标。他们是我们这个时代的民权团体。

3bc7b761ca9e0ab0ff4a854143128200d3f5837c.source: I believe that both the black community and the police overreacted in many areas. First and foremost, we must speak out against violence wherever it may occur -- and against whoever is the source of it.
3bc7b761ca9e0ab0ff4a854143128200d3f5837c.zh: 我认为在许多地方，黑人社区和警察都反应过度了。最重要的是，无论暴力发生在哪里、来自何人，我们都必须公开反对。

9f8f8019ea8478db7867a7dba393810175620a47.source: I believe that capital punishment is ineffective at reducing crime, and is not applied in an equal manner. I do not support the practice.
9f8f8019ea8478db7867a7dba393810175620a47.zh: 我认为，死刑不能有效减少犯罪，其适用也不平等。我不支持死刑。

9ed3777abfaeb67feadd6a905b34c51c5bd71648.source: I believe that existing government agencies can handle the issues we have. It does upset any decent American to see rivers filled with black sludge and industrial waste.
9ed3777abfaeb67feadd6a905b34c51c5bd71648.zh: 我认为现有政府机构足以处理这些问题。看见河流充满黑色污泥和工业废料，任何正派的美国人都会感到痛心。

77756c8916b763833a678c33b4f1530475f84c21.source: I believe that free trade creates jobs. If I didn't believe that, I wouldn't support it.
77756c8916b763833a678c33b4f1530475f84c21.zh: 我相信，自由贸易能够创造就业。如果不相信这一点，我就不会支持它。

c2a62927ff4ee246602e46ba9cadd3bde48fd31b.source: I believe that nothing would better unite our party than a pledge like this. Perhaps it will help progressives to support me now, if they can plan on running their own candidate in 2020.
c2a62927ff4ee246602e46ba9cadd3bde48fd31b.zh: 我相信，没有什么比这样的承诺更能团结本党了。如果进步派可以打算在2020年推出自己的候选人，也许就愿意现在支持我。

f695bbbf69f8d5c9aad4b35d89d3d1e272537bb9.source: I believe that the United States, in line with the “Manifest Destiny” ideal, should expand wherever feasible.
f695bbbf69f8d5c9aad4b35d89d3d1e272537bb9.zh: 我认为，美国应当遵循“天定命运”的理想，在条件允许的地方扩张。

4ab40fd02d4ceb02ac5c23577f692b0bda0ca81e.source: I believe that the prohibition of alcohol would be a positive benefit for our country.
4ab40fd02d4ceb02ac5c23577f692b0bda0ca81e.zh: 我认为，实行禁酒将有益于我们的国家。

d2dc854cc715396f545f47ec47eecea606ac4df4.source: I believe that the troop strength we have now is sufficient to hold the lines until we obtain a peace agreement.
d2dc854cc715396f545f47ec47eecea606ac4df4.zh: 我认为现有兵力足以守住防线，直到我们达成和平协议。

e963b781ce708fdc91927cc2bb83f82026849b17.source: I believe that ways can be found to minimize forced busing while also remaining true to the Nation's ideals and our educational goals.
e963b781ce708fdc91927cc2bb83f82026849b17.zh: 我相信，我们能够找到办法，尽量减少强制校车接送，同时仍然忠于国家的理想和教育目标。

b29c5ef814553065c022b01a7dcbf693d48a1b0c.source: I believe that we need more vigilance in the area of defense, for both military equipment and for missile development. We currently have a missile gap with the Soviet Union.
b29c5ef814553065c022b01a7dcbf693d48a1b0c.zh: 在国防方面，无论军事装备还是导弹研制，我们都需要更加警惕。目前，我们与苏联之间存在导弹差距。

8b35ff390ee49e5d23a390b37089444ec5cdf6fd.source: I believe that we need to consider any measure to reduce our nation's crime epidemic, including new gun control legislation.
8b35ff390ee49e5d23a390b37089444ec5cdf6fd.zh: 我认为，为遏制全国的犯罪浪潮，我们需要考虑一切措施，包括新的枪支管制立法。

29dfad64063d5932f61f674e855eaaebdca9692c.source: I believe that we need to return control of education to the states and to the people. I would end the Department of Education as President.
29dfad64063d5932f61f674e855eaaebdca9692c.zh: 我认为，应当把教育的控制权还给各州和人民。作为总统，我会撤销教育部。

3c94fc5b6ea7c3e93c1ebe225b07a1b85f380838.source: I believe the Federal Reserve was an unnecessary and destabilizing change to the nation's banking system.
3c94fc5b6ea7c3e93c1ebe225b07a1b85f380838.zh: 我认为，建立联邦储备制度是对国家银行体系一次没有必要、反而破坏稳定的变革。

a8902de74e7467663a3af537900d874f99fb6c6d.source: I believe the appointment of Louis Brandeis to the Court shows exceptionally poor, and dangerous, judgment on the part of Woodrow Wilson.
a8902de74e7467663a3af537900d874f99fb6c6d.zh: 我认为，伍德罗·威尔逊任命路易斯·布兰代斯进入最高法院，显示出他极其糟糕、而且危险的判断力。

f15ab73970e423ea91f4b83cb2d3b4e900d68572.source: I believe this is a good policy, and I'm willing to make compromises in the area of immigration enforcement to build a working coalition.
f15ab73970e423ea91f4b83cb2d3b4e900d68572.zh: 我认为，这是好政策。我愿意在移民执法方面妥协，以建立一个能合作的联盟。

f629e7ee8682ad3f8aa3cc7a3da3de709e3a3d7a.source: I believe this is the kind of thing which might backfire on us. Voters want solutions, not petty attacks.
f629e7ee8682ad3f8aa3cc7a3da3de709e3a3d7a.zh: 我认为，这类攻击可能适得其反。选民想要解决办法，而非琐碎的攻击。

ce44d410b0523fffd080b17a416e76eaa1608c54.source: I believe this is warranted in the industrial trades. Let us not forget that all hands are needed on the farm, not least of all in this day and age.
ce44d410b0523fffd080b17a416e76eaa1608c54.zh: 我认为，这在工业行业中是必要的。可别忘了，农场需要所有人手，尤其是在眼下这个时代。

85d51b24b7252f4ee16007bcfc54191b4e9cdc49.source: I believe this letter to be disingenuous at best. Further expansion will reopen the debate on slavery rather than suppress it.
85d51b24b7252f4ee16007bcfc54191b4e9cdc49.zh: 这封信往好里说，也是不够坦诚。进一步扩张将重新引发奴隶制争论，而不是平息它。

b45d35d02d63d4aa1f9630deebf1d0bd00095182.source: I believe we haven't gone far enough on this issue. Saddam Hussein is a destabilizing leader, and he must be removed for the Middle East to truly prosper.
b45d35d02d63d4aa1f9630deebf1d0bd00095182.zh: 我认为，我们在这个问题上做得还不够。萨达姆·侯赛因破坏稳定，只有让他下台，中东才能真正繁荣。

4b098e2ff6075fa7c8da8ccf6909711aabdfc9ef.source: I believe we need to defend South Vietnam at all costs, whatever commitment of our forces that entails.
4b098e2ff6075fa7c8da8ccf6909711aabdfc9ef.zh: 我认为，无论意味着投入多少兵力，我们都需要不惜一切代价保卫南越。

cb7fcfe70978c70a8d7b044f213dbcb3d82a6cfc.source: I believe we should address this problem directly -- by adding a prescription drug benefit to Medicare.
cb7fcfe70978c70a8d7b044f213dbcb3d82a6cfc.zh: 我认为，我们应当直接处理这个问题——在老年医疗保险中加入处方药福利。

11b5f69803974829308543441eafabc6c911bb14.source: I believe we should implement an immediate moratorium on the testing of nuclear devices.
11b5f69803974829308543441eafabc6c911bb14.zh: 我认为应立即暂停核装置试验。

9b7b47fc7e4f0db31b288d4aaa791f8c3f425e1f.source: I believe, if a state wishes to impose capital punishment, that it should have every right to do so.
9b7b47fc7e4f0db31b288d4aaa791f8c3f425e1f.zh: 我认为，如果一个州希望实行死刑，就应当完全有权这样做。

bce63ece78fb60458aee886a585ab703b0e30094.source: I believe, regardless of how we feel about Donald Trump, that he won his party's nomination and should not be challenged in this manner.
bce63ece78fb60458aee886a585ab703b0e30094.zh: 我认为，不论我们如何看待特朗普，他已经赢得本党提名，不应该以这种方式挑战他。

cdfcedcd2d4ed15b5e2dd37222ab5bc6b1dafe18.source: I can certainly see the need for some legislation, but it should be addressed at the state level.
cdfcedcd2d4ed15b5e2dd37222ab5bc6b1dafe18.zh: 我当然能理解有必要制定一些法律，但应当在州一级处理。

231f680903c3bdd42dadaa47b6a5a7e0d4b67740.source: I can see both sides of this issue, but if Congress passes this Act I won't veto it as President.
231f680903c3bdd42dadaa47b6a5a7e0d4b67740.zh: 我能理解双方的看法，但如果国会通过这项法案，担任总统后我不会否决它。

83a224adedebb8fcdd78a938a42c9d781b12d5c5.source: I can see both sides of this. It is a hugely disruptive practice, yet we need to fight for integration somehow.
83a224adedebb8fcdd78a938a42c9d781b12d5c5.zh: 我能理解双方的看法。这种做法造成了很大的扰动，但我们也必须设法争取种族融合。

fc9ef93beb3caf6e184b51bb2b6e3e16d7f8f88d.source: I can think of no better way to reinforce my commitment to peace and neutrality than to meet with such groups.
fc9ef93beb3caf6e184b51bb2b6e3e16d7f8f88d.zh: 要重申我对和平与中立的承诺，我想不出比会见这些团体更好的办法。

f2dca11fa83b129187ed429aa717714096663570.source: I can't attack Bryan like the papers can without losing some of my luster. Let them publish the defamatory cartoons and opinion pieces.
f2dca11fa83b129187ed429aa717714096663570.zh: 如果我像报纸那样攻击布赖恩，就会损害自己的声望。那些诽谤性的漫画和评论，就让报纸去刊登吧。

072d6f2dee3d9fc72d835e9152ee4b5ad525313e.source: I can't believe we haven't done this yet. How on earth are we supposed to win a war against an insidious enemy with one hand tied behind our back?
072d6f2dee3d9fc72d835e9152ee4b5ad525313e.zh: 我真不敢相信我们至今还没这么做。面对阴险的敌人，还要自缚一臂，这仗究竟怎么打得赢？

3730bfb118d329c800bfff8fd69abbba7e550483.source: I can't fuckin think of anything funny for Ford, he is so bland, just pretend this gif is playing and he is falling down the stairs.
3730bfb118d329c800bfff8fd69abbba7e550483.zh: 我他妈真想不出福特有什么好笑的。他实在太无趣了，你就假装那个动图正在播放，他正从楼梯上摔下来吧。

6128768c2d158bc3ee55ecd5c6e975ae588361ee.source: I can't make a conclusive statement on this issue. I'm sure that between myself and Congress we can work out a good solution once I'm elected.
6128768c2d158bc3ee55ecd5c6e975ae588361ee.zh: 在这个问题上，我还不能作出明确表态。我相信当选之后，我和国会能共同找到一个好办法。

74d977a6eac5c4db9ead23b73bea06ff88de982c.source: I can't make any promises about our Administration at this point, but I support the sentiment of this statement.
74d977a6eac5c4db9ead23b73bea06ff88de982c.zh: 目前，我还不能对政府作出任何承诺，不过支持这个声明的出发点。

6bce44f395e06a306eafc4e1aaa3060ebda99c84.source: I can't make any promises about our Cabinet at this point, but I support the sentiment of this statement.
6bce44f395e06a306eafc4e1aaa3060ebda99c84.zh: 目前，我还不能对内阁人选作出任何承诺，不过支持这个声明的出发点。

828e0de36cb55caf90d25cceadd3e8945ada4603.source: I can't make promises in advance about where I will or won't visit.
828e0de36cb55caf90d25cceadd3e8945ada4603.zh: 我不能事先承诺会去或不会去哪些地方。

270e93c8578d33cf414d879cd1cac2b37637caff.source: I can't say who exactly will be in the Cabinet, but I'm not opposed to having Democrats in my Administration.
270e93c8578d33cf414d879cd1cac2b37637caff.zh: 我无法具体说谁会进内阁，但不反对在我的政府中任用民主党人。

30960c916cee316329e2da7b95962f09bd926473.source: I can't speak to the conduct of Bill Clinton in office. I am my own man, running my own campaign for President. To emphasize my independence, I am not accepting Clinton's offer to make campaign appearances on my behalf.
30960c916cee316329e2da7b95962f09bd926473.zh: 我无法代比尔·克林顿解释他的任职行为。我有自己的原则，正在开展自己的总统竞选。为强调独立性，我不会接受克林顿为我助选的提议。

b7008bab3019087fd220e49ba92c9693b2ef711b.source: I can't stress this enough. The most important thing we can do right now is increase our tariffs to protect American business.
b7008bab3019087fd220e49ba92c9693b2ef711b.zh: 再怎么强调都不为过：眼下最重要的，就是提高关税，保护美国工商业。

bc64674212b736aeda34204767584f6f3c1a5389.source: I can't support it. You know, once upon a time we actually had a legislature in this country which debated the laws and made these kinds of decisions.
bc64674212b736aeda34204767584f6f3c1a5389.zh: 我无法支持。你知道，曾几何时，这个国家还真有一个立法机关，会辩论法律，作出这类决定。

8325a643c27a06254b67217a37222160ab6874de.source: I cannot support the exploitation of foreign peoples in good conscience. The Bible states that thou shalt not kill, and that is my position as well.
8325a643c27a06254b67217a37222160ab6874de.zh: 凭良心说，我不能支持剥削外国人民。《圣经》说，不可杀人；这也正是我的立场。

a6c2066cf2684fd03d6d4069414f46cb7a9599b3.source: I can’t think of a man more consistently behind measures I support than Hubert Humphrey. He’s been fighting the good fight since 1948, and I’m proud to stand with him on this campaign.
a6c2066cf2684fd03d6d4069414f46cb7a9599b3.zh: 我想不出还有谁能像休伯特·汉弗莱那样，一贯支持我赞成的政策。他从1948年起就在为正义事业奋斗，我为在这场竞选中与他并肩而立感到自豪。

d5a07e5f4b0a1af5152de9b73193c6ea59b4814e.source: I chose the best person for the job, period. Equality is about giving everybody an equal chance to prove themselves... it doesn't mean you have litmus tests or only consider candidates of a certain race.
d5a07e5f4b0a1af5152de9b73193c6ea59b4814e.zh: 我选了最适合这份工作的人，就这么简单。平等，是给每个人证明自己的同等机会……不是设定某种立场筛选标准，或只考虑某个种族的候选人。

f406187b0bfca1aaa0714f114904e6fc3ee63425.source: I commend this piece of legislation. Already we see many Americans receiving health care who would otherwise be stricken with serious and/or fatal conditions.
f406187b0bfca1aaa0714f114904e6fc3ee63425.zh: 我赞赏这项立法。我们已经看到，许多原本会遭受严重甚至致命疾病困扰的美国人，现在得到了医疗服务。

a7eea71b4b64bdc90246f356e0dd1171457889bd.source: I couldn't really comment until I saw what the specifics of the case would be.
a7eea71b4b64bdc90246f356e0dd1171457889bd.zh: 在了解具体情况之前，我实在无法评论。

1615e5d550b1c3ea097c9b51354f4fd8ebed92dc.source: I did some things when I was younger that I'm not proud of. But my record in office and my conduct over the past two decades is clear. I stopped drinking in 1986 and never looked back.
1615e5d550b1c3ea097c9b51354f4fd8ebed92dc.zh: 年轻时，我做过一些并不引以为豪的事。但我的执政记录和过去二十年的行为，都是明摆着的。我在1986年戒酒，此后再也没喝过。

fc9d13aeb65c227b31d5a9eb5b3817d8b4631c60.source: I disagree strongly and believe that General Brown should be removed from this position for such comments. Israel is one of our most valued allies.
fc9d13aeb65c227b31d5a9eb5b3817d8b4631c60.zh: 我坚决反对这种说法，认为布朗将军应该因这些言论被免职。以色列是我们最珍视的盟友之一。

db45266ebb3251f5a4696c6bea7a4f436da78b6b.source: I disagree with John Calhoun across the board, which leads to my opposition to the annexation of Texas.
db45266ebb3251f5a4696c6bea7a4f436da78b6b.zh: 我在各方面都不同意约翰·卡尔霍恩，因此也反对吞并得克萨斯。

7b948e647135f2e064985f0fc0dcb1f2e14b94ae.source: I dislike Fidel Castro as much as anyone. We should keep the embargo but also look for other ways to democratize that country.
7b948e647135f2e064985f0fc0dcb1f2e14b94ae.zh: 我和任何人一样不喜欢菲德尔·卡斯特罗。我们应该维持禁运，但也寻找其他办法，推动该国民主化。

5429f8beb4c274589b430a3bf325784df167baaf.source: I do agree with the idea that education is a local matter. I'm not especially opposed to busing where local authorities deem it necessary, but I would only use the federal government in extraordinary circumstances.
5429f8beb4c274589b430a3bf325784df167baaf.zh: 我确实认为教育是地方事务。当地主管部门认为有必要时，我并不特别反对校车接送，但我只会在特殊情况下动用联邦政府。

6a7cb9881c9e46e0a948b66f212c47b777eaae10.source: I do believe we should defend these islands. We are committed to the defense of Taiwan, and that commitment must include all of Taiwan to be credible.
6a7cb9881c9e46e0a948b66f212c47b777eaae10.zh: 我确实认为，我们应当保卫这些岛屿。我们已经承诺保卫台湾；要让这个承诺可信，就必须包括台湾的所有地区。

54db07caabdd0664606def64468ca178468e7643.source: I do not see the authority for regulating this under the Commerce Clause of the Constitution. This is something that individual states would need to investigate.
54db07caabdd0664606def64468ca178468e7643.zh: 我看不出，宪法的商业条款授予了监管此事的权力。这个问题需要由各州自行研究。

e13aa5888bfb14bc68dc77f4623078e32d142714.source: I do not support new gun control laws. We need better enforcement of the existing laws we have. The Assault Weapons Ban should be allowed to expire.
e13aa5888bfb14bc68dc77f4623078e32d142714.zh: 我不支持新的枪支管制法。我们需要更好地执行现有法律。《攻击性武器禁令》应当到期失效。

349945d4d6382019bba1644586e7e58a45442d56.source: I do not support this action that we have taken.
349945d4d6382019bba1644586e7e58a45442d56.zh: 我不支持我们采取的这项行动。

0ad5ee2c4689180bf6c9c0f2160c72d44b86993f.source: I do support the effort this year to establish workers' compensation for federal employees.
0ad5ee2c4689180bf6c9c0f2160c72d44b86993f.zh: 我确实支持今年为联邦雇员建立工伤赔偿制度的努力。

cdd50e1cd98ae2b7190e3918c8fd442bf708563e.source: I do support the intervention. We also need to reexamine our policies in general towards Latin America to ensure higher economic growth and more political freedom there.
cdd50e1cd98ae2b7190e3918c8fd442bf708563e.zh: 我确实支持这次干预。我们也需要全面重新审视对拉丁美洲的政策，以确保当地经济增长更快、政治自由更多。

a4ecfbf2733a52cc70be08062442d8adb493b44b.source: I do, and I would especially single out German-Americans in this regard, for their support of an expansionist German state.
a4ecfbf2733a52cc70be08062442d8adb493b44b.zh: 是的，尤其是德裔美国人：他们支持一个奉行扩张政策的德国。

cb698522f652edc25b9d298c3c352b3ae9e4b2a2.source: I do, and I would especially single out Irish-Americans in this regard, for their strenuous opposition to Great Britain.
cb698522f652edc25b9d298c3c352b3ae9e4b2a2.zh: 是的，尤其是爱尔兰裔美国人：他们强烈反对英国。

ec9957a047e027c816db6aceb50397f5b039f5b8.source: I don't agree with that course of action. The Border Patrol is in place to do just that job.
ec9957a047e027c816db6aceb50397f5b039f5b8.zh: 我不赞成这样做。边境巡逻队的职责正是干这件事。

6cac9f101bb07a208bc5eaff8c0d1382086133ff.source: I don't believe so. Our nation's security depends on being adequately prepared to face Soviet aggression.
6cac9f101bb07a208bc5eaff8c0d1382086133ff.zh: 我不这么认为。国家安全取决于是否充分准备好应对苏联的进攻。

fdbac1840c6703d88e8507fa434b76a5aa0b7abe.source: I don't believe that blacks and whites will ever mix socially in this nation, but that cannot change the fact that blacks are citizens of this nation, and should be given the voting and property rights to match that status.
fdbac1840c6703d88e8507fa434b76a5aa0b7abe.zh: 我不认为黑人与白人会在本国社会中真正融合，但这不能改变黑人是本国公民的事实。他们应当享有与这一身份相符的投票权和财产权。

19672959280c416f23e95e7a0a62f8da2288e184.source: I don't believe that it is constitutional or advisable for the federal government to undertake an internal improvements program.
19672959280c416f23e95e7a0a62f8da2288e184.zh: 我认为，由联邦政府推行国内公共工程计划，既不合宪，也不明智。

d08026c3e91de24748ac6828e3b003b2d080c115.source: I don't believe that outside parties should regulate the working arrangements between a man and his employer.
d08026c3e91de24748ac6828e3b003b2d080c115.zh: 我不认为，外人应当干预个人与雇主之间的工作安排。

43abaae52bd69f2f7cdbd98a231cb8dec918f700.source: I don't believe that we should have one set of laws for business, and another for unions. This act is another example of federal overreach.
43abaae52bd69f2f7cdbd98a231cb8dec918f700.zh: 我不认为企业和工会应当各自适用一套法律。这项法案又是联邦政府越权的一个例子。

b54c7a6a0eeb55a1678463f29f19d1d9907aa59f.source: I don't believe the tariff issue would resonate in our current campaign. I will focus on other issues as I speak to the voters.
b54c7a6a0eeb55a1678463f29f19d1d9907aa59f.zh: 我认为，关税问题难以在当前竞选中引起共鸣。我向选民讲话时会关注其他议题。

5599ab31bc336db4a842a75ca8c147ef3a593538.source: I don't have a strong stance on this Amendment. I support the popular will of the people on this issue.
5599ab31bc336db4a842a75ca8c147ef3a593538.zh: 我对这项修正案没有强烈立场。在这个问题上，我支持人民的意愿。

db0c02ac005fad4e775b587b57e71353ba822c17.source: I don't have any comment on this plan. It's far too early to determine how the war will end, who will win, or what the peace arrangements might be.
db0c02ac005fad4e775b587b57e71353ba822c17.zh: 我对这个计划没有评论。现在判断战争如何结束、谁会获胜、和平如何安排，都还太早。

267a220286ac57c1d4c4d6e5b02e3c34d9c8ae21.source: I don't have any comment. I trust the people of New York to make the right decision on this issue.
267a220286ac57c1d4c4d6e5b02e3c34d9c8ae21.zh: 我没有什么要说的。我相信纽约人民会在这个问题上作出正确决定。

d60f42bf9580760fd3bc02d67222bf600c45ef2d.source: I don't have any comment. The General's views are his own.
d60f42bf9580760fd3bc02d67222bf600c45ef2d.zh: 我没有评论。将军的观点只代表他自己。

1ad1d3fd93226aac5bec8e48f3b0eac1a5440437.source: I don't have anything to say on this plank one way or the other. I'm prepared to accept the judgment of my party on this issue.
1ad1d3fd93226aac5bec8e48f3b0eac1a5440437.zh: 对这项条款，我不打算表态支持或反对。我准备接受本党在这个问题上的判断。

67ce72700f048b720010db48d99d5eb4da70aad7.source: I don't have strong feelings on this provision. If such a measure were passed by Congress I would sign it.
67ce72700f048b720010db48d99d5eb4da70aad7.zh: 我对这一条款没有强烈意见。如果国会通过这类措施，我会签署。

20b4ab9e69ff64c4e0f05539b4448916f5e15f86.source: I don't intend to explicitly rebuke such claims, but I will not emphasize the peace issue as I campaign this fall.
20b4ab9e69ff64c4e0f05539b4448916f5e15f86.zh: 我不打算明确驳斥这些说法，但今年秋季竞选时，也不会着重强调和平问题。

38bd215a026d57f4cbc4388687d3ebf343ea0c97.source: I don't know how many times a man can deny an unjust allegation before fatigue sets in.
38bd215a026d57f4cbc4388687d3ebf343ea0c97.zh: 我不知道，一个人要否认多少次不公的指控，才会感到疲惫。

4fe7c492f7c9bf7e08d5394452a406d268ee9490.source: I don't know how they come up with these stories, but I can assure you they are all lies. You'd better believe there will be some libel suits coming!
4fe7c492f7c9bf7e08d5394452a406d268ee9490.zh: 我不知道他们怎么编出这些故事，但可以向你保证，都是谎言。你最好相信，诽谤诉讼马上就要来了！

dc1462d6efd2d8f2b1641ca35a7ef74f13b01733.source: I don't know how this man could live with four years of William McKinley just to save the face of his friend Grover Cleveland. No true Democrat would vote for him.
dc1462d6efd2d8f2b1641ca35a7ef74f13b01733.zh: 我不明白，这个人怎么会为了保全朋友格罗弗·克利夫兰的面子，就甘愿忍受威廉·麦金莱执政四年。真正的民主党人绝不会投他的票。

eb2766b8137c9f30aba157c87a008443ab498940.source: I don't know what's really going on here, but can you imagine how the media would be covering it if this was Donald Jr.? Can there be any more doubt they are in the tank for Sleepy Joe?
eb2766b8137c9f30aba157c87a008443ab498940.zh: 我不知道这里到底是怎么回事，但你们想想，假如换成小唐纳德，媒体会怎么报道？他们一边倒地袒护瞌睡乔，这还有什么可怀疑的吗？

ff780378ada5e65d290f4572cad7bc4edf0594b0.source: I don't know, to be perfectly frank. Things are going well for now, but we will have many challenges to meet in places like Cuba, Lebanon, Latin America, Indochina, and elsewhere.
ff780378ada5e65d290f4572cad7bc4edf0594b0.zh: 坦率地说，我不知道。目前情况不错，但我们还将在古巴、黎巴嫩、拉丁美洲、印度支那及其他地区面对许多挑战。

823c25c6e25b0a4e1f827ac75f716d834388e2be.source: I don't particularly like Barack. It's hard to feel good about someone who promotes policies as misguided as his.
823c25c6e25b0a4e1f827ac75f716d834388e2be.zh: 我不怎么喜欢贝拉克。一个人推行那么错误的政策，很难让人对他有好感。

114c3e857998bc2984e78104b8dd52856e8c7e69.source: I don't plan to address women's suffrage in this campaign. There are more important issues at hand.
114c3e857998bc2984e78104b8dd52856e8c7e69.zh: 我不打算在这次竞选中讨论妇女选举权。眼下还有更重要的议题。
