bd7cbc17346793f4594de51271f6d3cc2f16dab8.source: I don't plan to give this act more than cursory mention as I campaign. There are better issues to focus on.
bd7cbc17346793f4594de51271f6d3cc2f16dab8.zh: 我在竞选中只打算简略提及这项法案。还有更值得关注的议题。

d9b1dfb104326c563f71762e345db056e5cd5098.source: I don't plan to say much about Charles Evans Hughes one way or the other. I believe we have better things to campaign on.
d9b1dfb104326c563f71762e345db056e5cd5098.zh: 我不打算就查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯多作正面或负面评论。我们有更值得用来竞选的议题。

e64bd57dc034e7215a0dbec92bd8e4ea20e34f4a.source: I don't really care too much one way or the other. As long as we have sufficient supplies in the U.S., we should ship grain to whoever will pay for it.
e64bd57dc034e7215a0dbec92bd8e4ea20e34f4a.zh: 我并不特别在意支持还是反对。只要美国国内供应充足，谁愿意出钱，我们就应该把粮食卖给谁。

0995797893628ed27b9393076ec527f4c1514d43.source: I don't really have a strong statement to make on this Amendment. This is an issue for Congress and the states to decide.
0995797893628ed27b9393076ec527f4c1514d43.zh: 对于这项修正案，我没有特别强烈的意见。这应由国会和各州决定。

899ed87e34fcb788260cbf719cbebf902cf7c069.source: I don't see a need to take an active role in arbitrating this labor conflict. Let the unions and railroads work out a solution between themselves.
899ed87e34fcb788260cbf719cbebf902cf7c069.zh: 我看不出，有必要积极参与仲裁这场劳资冲突。让工会和铁路公司自行商定办法吧。

7ff65f4153febebe705e7a9dad7dacc7b3e70f97.source: I don't see who has the authority to stop this. This is another example of regulation that would fall outside of the scope of the Commerce Clause in the Constitution.
7ff65f4153febebe705e7a9dad7dacc7b3e70f97.zh: 我看不出，谁有权阻止这种做法。这又是一种超出宪法商业条款范围的监管。

cf0332ca872caa5a4dedd8aa5ba41aebe1dad7a5.source: I don't share every belief that this group has, but I'm not going to cancel my membership because of some spurious insinuations from the right.
cf0332ca872caa5a4dedd8aa5ba41aebe1dad7a5.zh: 我并不赞同这个团体的每一种主张，但也不会因为右翼一些毫无根据的影射，就取消自己的会员资格。

3cbbf73eaf1439e99da569d7351b2229740ea3a7.source: I don't support an Amendment on this issue, but I will personally promise not to run for reelection.
3cbbf73eaf1439e99da569d7351b2229740ea3a7.zh: 我不支持为此修宪，但我个人会承诺不竞选连任。

96e138be3b871129d6385962f89afb0cb143463b.source: I don't support cuts, to be sure, but neither do we need increases. We have made great strides in reducing tension with the Soviet Union.
96e138be3b871129d6385962f89afb0cb143463b.zh: 我当然不支持削减，但也不需要增加。我们在缓和与苏联的紧张关系方面，已经取得很大进展。

d076fd7a4f4871bd359dcb9b24e864aedbab67f2.source: I don't support the further expansion of the United States. We should be focused on the development of the territories that we have, and not on gaining new ones.
d076fd7a4f4871bd359dcb9b24e864aedbab67f2.zh: 我不支持美国进一步扩张。我们应当专注于开发已经拥有的领地，而不是获取新的领土。

688453b8d70e5c3276079fbfed1dc48ad20120a5.source: I don't support the mandated closing of shops on Sunday.
688453b8d70e5c3276079fbfed1dc48ad20120a5.zh: 我不支持强制商店在星期日停业。

b24263033eb7361673345e59272c98364834f39c.source: I don't think anyone opposes the idea of providing milk to our poor kids. My contention, however, is that the state and local governments are more in tune with their needs than some bureaucrats in Washington.
b24263033eb7361673345e59272c98364834f39c.zh: 我想没人反对给贫困儿童提供牛奶。不过，我认为州政府和地方政府比华盛顿那些官僚更了解孩子们的需要。

28e968cabdcee5eac2dde4c3f54c09f8115d61ee.source: I don't think that kind of escalation is wise. The last thing we need is a regional war. I would stick to our mission of defending South Vietnam and preventing the spread of Communism.
28e968cabdcee5eac2dde4c3f54c09f8115d61ee.zh: 我认为这样升级战事并不明智。我们最不需要的就是一场地区战争。我会坚持原有使命：保卫南越，阻止共产主义蔓延。

9dcc86637328a0785b373768a7516d9ca200c2fe.source: I don't think that personal conduct is a good issue to bring into this campaign.
9dcc86637328a0785b373768a7516d9ca200c2fe.zh: 我不认为个人品行适合作为这次竞选的议题。

1a963c6d6ad98bdb47b8a4d5333f680f5615fbd3.source: I don't think that this is a necessary step, at this time.
1a963c6d6ad98bdb47b8a4d5333f680f5615fbd3.zh: 我认为，眼下没有必要采取这项措施。

f7b6176c31d26ba3ead7a1c4ae7c47d09abd2a06.source: I don't think these mandates and lockdowns are a good idea, really. But if that's what San Francisco and New York want to do, as long as they don't impose on the rest of us.
f7b6176c31d26ba3ead7a1c4ae7c47d09abd2a06.zh: 我真不认为，这些强制规定和封锁是好主意。不过，如果旧金山和纽约想这么做，只要别强加给我们其他人就行。

bc229a2bcec8e04767604e9f4c696e956e00b846.source: I don't think this is an issue. It just goes to show how as we become more modern in our views as a society, that sexual harassment will become less of an issue in the workplace.
bc229a2bcec8e04767604e9f4c696e956e00b846.zh: 我不认为这是什么问题。这恰好说明，随着社会观念越来越现代，职场性骚扰将逐渐减少。

500524e752c8aa8e445d1fb41bf904c6b908a999.source: I feel like discussing the incredible danger that Bryan represents to our Republic.
500524e752c8aa8e445d1fb41bf904c6b908a999.zh: 我想谈谈，布赖恩对我们共和国构成的巨大危险。

d5c5b3da40eedf79794dc91d0b96870008a47ff6.source: I fully blame the protestors for what happened. Their goal from day one was to spur a violent confrontation and disrupt the convention.
d5c5b3da40eedf79794dc91d0b96870008a47ff6.zh: 我认为发生的一切全是抗议者的责任。他们从一开始就想挑起暴力冲突，扰乱大会。

05372473e0fc345b771d49947a36cfcbe7c6eb8b.source: I fully support Barack Obama's actions in regards to Cuba.
05372473e0fc345b771d49947a36cfcbe7c6eb8b.zh: 我完全支持贝拉克·奥巴马对古巴采取的行动。

c5a2be5d7d41908a5799a04cca5ff90961108d2d.source: I fully support Israel's right to defend herself. However, I believe that these territories should be returned to the Arab states as a first step towards peace negotiations.
c5a2be5d7d41908a5799a04cca5ff90961108d2d.zh: 我完全支持以色列的自卫权。不过，我认为应先将这些领土归还阿拉伯国家，以此迈出和平谈判的第一步。

3f35a92987384166a5ace077e2b3810e74da03ba.source: I fully support gay marriage, but I'd like to see every state make this decision for itself.
3f35a92987384166a5ace077e2b3810e74da03ba.zh: 我完全支持同性婚姻，但希望每个州自己作决定。

cb8368ad668b8a6691e2e9316a07c25fd82dd0fe.source: I fully support the Supreme Court in this decision. I don't know how someone in 1968 can stand up and fight against two peoples' right to marry each other.
cb8368ad668b8a6691e2e9316a07c25fd82dd0fe.zh: 我完全支持最高法院的这个判决。我不明白，在1968年，怎么还会有人站出来反对两个人结婚的权利。

e1d96f9856c8eac8d43adf3804edc59347c04300.source: I go more the other way on this issue. I think that more states should be right-to-work. Unions dangerously distort the economy and the political process.
e1d96f9856c8eac8d43adf3804edc59347c04300.zh: 在这个问题上，我更倾向于相反方向。我认为更多州应实行工作权法。工会危险地扭曲了经济和政治过程。

af6976c00fa06e948bdc88c4098b445308a23d53.source: I grew up middle-class and intrinsically understand their concerns. Bush grew up as the millionaire son of a Senator, and has remained out of touch ever since.
af6976c00fa06e948bdc88c4098b445308a23d53.zh: 我在中产家庭长大，深知他们的忧虑。布什是参议员家的百万富翁之子，此后也一直脱离普通人的生活。

80937e81d8f99009b9f823c9e5bc98479f036528.source: I had hoped that popular sovereignty would resolve the slavery issue, but the intransigence of the Southern bolters has convinced me otherwise. I now believe that slavery must not be permitted in any new state or territory.
80937e81d8f99009b9f823c9e5bc98479f036528.zh: 我曾希望人民主权原则能解决奴隶制问题，但那些脱离党派的南方人的顽固态度，让我不再这样想。现在我认为，任何新州或领地都不得允许奴隶制存在。

2ae00ee734f60846037d1d14ecc9e3709bca241e.source: I had issues with this particular agreement, but I would still support the expansion of trade as President.
2ae00ee734f60846037d1d14ecc9e3709bca241e.zh: 我对这份具体协定有异议，但作为总统，我仍会支持扩大贸易。

77f57ec71099bfa03fc73ba5b7d3785073ad0ad3.source: I had to make a decision based on the evidence we had at the time. I would not make this vote, knowing what I know today.
77f57ec71099bfa03fc73ba5b7d3785073ad0ad3.zh: 我必须根据当时掌握的证据作决定。如果当时知道今天所知道的，我就不会那样投票。

ecfa8ae5a1a80054a39b450907526d5445c38b5b.source: I hate how politicized the Democrats have made the Court, but there are better ways of dealing with it than court-packing. Maybe we can all sit together and come up with some term limits, as long as it's fair for everyone.
ecfa8ae5a1a80054a39b450907526d5445c38b5b.zh: 我讨厌民主党把法院搞得如此政治化，但解决它有比扩充法院更好的办法。也许大家可以坐下来，想想任期限制，只要对所有人公平。

5e5327c585793c8b576e22f851768ddf59ba5cfb.source: I hate to admit it, but we need whatever support we can get. Keep quiet on this.
5e5327c585793c8b576e22f851768ddf59ba5cfb.zh: 我不愿承认，但任何能得到的支持，我们都需要。对此保持沉默。

e6e864e9c671461b1472ea72c4c58a3a98d53a1f.source: I have a plan to spend $350 over the next 10 years to help those who need it the most, to attend college.
e6e864e9c671461b1472ea72c4c58a3a98d53a1f.zh: 我计划在未来十年花费350美元，帮助那些最需要帮助的人上大学。

a63b0faf319586fb6713ce6c616713a698c2b21d.source: I don't think we need to belabor the point. I pledge to the American people that I will restore honor and dignity to the White House when I am President.
a63b0faf319586fb6713ce6c616713a698c2b21d.zh: 我想，我们没必要反复强调这件事。我向美国人民保证，担任总统后，我会让白宫重拾荣誉和尊严。

50e64dde757764af6ff31a5c04efe0c3996fb4ff.source: I don't think we need to make huge changes to a system that works for the majority of the people it is supposed to help.
50e64dde757764af6ff31a5c04efe0c3996fb4ff.zh: 对这个能帮助多数目标人群的制度，我认为不需要大幅改革。

9947cc6560dfd4dad1d6889136d473b56c74df09.source: I don't think we should jump to any conclusions based on one or two years of data. I'm glad you bring this up though. It's a subject worthy of further study by an official panel.
9947cc6560dfd4dad1d6889136d473b56c74df09.zh: 我认为，我们不应该仅凭一两年的数据就仓促下结论。不过，很高兴你提出了这个问题。这是一个值得由正式小组进一步研究的话题。

d0b6141b568247c558b788cbcfd3cf2a79e40101.source: I don't want to address civil disorder directly, but we should be clear that we oppose any changes to our naturalization laws.
d0b6141b568247c558b788cbcfd3cf2a79e40101.zh: 我不想直接评论骚乱，但我们应当明确表示，反对修改入籍法。

f3c2c41c866147b1147ff754615e43492ef9d3e8.source: I don't want to comment on an issue that is best left to the voters of Arizona.
f3c2c41c866147b1147ff754615e43492ef9d3e8.zh: 这个问题最好交给亚利桑那州选民，我不想对此发表评论。

f67b1af1b9e63c38e8f88ae890d6c105249c0813.source: I don't want to speculate on what kind of incriminating new evidence might be in these emails. I just want to focus on our Make America Great Again agenda during the closing stretch of this election.
f67b1af1b9e63c38e8f88ae890d6c105249c0813.zh: 我不想猜测这些电子邮件中可能有什么新的不利证据。在选举的最后阶段，我只想聚焦于我们“让美国再次伟大”的议程。

df65e8716f4116c47c50670659ce2f0b86aac637.source: I don’t believe we have a good chance at these two states, but I would like to put effort into winning New Hampshire. We had a great primary showing there.
df65e8716f4116c47c50670659ce2f0b86aac637.zh: 我不认为我们在这两个州有多少胜算，但我想把力量投入新罕布什尔州。我们在那里初选表现很好。

67e7d5b816fbcdc7a3ab07f7293ee372400c81a7.source: I doubt that it is even Constitutional for the federal government to control railroad rates. This will never happen in my Administration.
67e7d5b816fbcdc7a3ab07f7293ee372400c81a7.zh: 我甚至怀疑，联邦政府管制铁路运价是否合宪。我的政府绝不会这样做。

218333499f484fbf5307efb5fae34f2ea20f6870.source: I doubt that things will come to that point, and we must not address this issue during our current campaign.
218333499f484fbf5307efb5fae34f2ea20f6870.zh: 我怀疑事情会发展到那一步。我们在当前竞选中绝不能讨论这个问题。

b54b6e5b9b729074a780ebd8f5d52c31393dcee6.source: I dream of a country where every citizen has clean air to breathe. The Clean Air Act is a good start but I'm not opposed to further legislation in this area.
b54b6e5b9b729074a780ebd8f5d52c31393dcee6.zh: 我梦想中的国家，每个公民都能呼吸清洁空气。《清洁空气法》是个良好的开端，我也不反对在这一领域进一步立法。

ca6a129c860224383fbe266cf55f904b065cb2ee.source: I encourage every state to expand the suffrage to women as soon as possible.
ca6a129c860224383fbe266cf55f904b065cb2ee.zh: 我鼓励各州尽快将选举权扩大到妇女。

f9bff107868ea367e0f2730e1439d0bb0a1f22db.source: I envision an American canal, built by American workers, property of the American government, supporting the actions of a robust American Navy. I fully support these plans.
f9bff107868ea367e0f2730e1439d0bb0a1f22db.zh: 我设想的是一条美国的运河：由美国工人建造，属于美国政府，支持强大的美国海军行动。我完全赞成这些计划。

f53c501b3dbab9f8a94b9e93b30ea65a77035a01.source: I favor a hands-off approach to the economy. The federal government has no business stepping in and breaking a company into pieces.
f53c501b3dbab9f8a94b9e93b30ea65a77035a01.zh: 我主张不干预经济。联邦政府没有理由插手，把一家企业拆成碎片。

ccc39e7b4626645ea7f64bb6e62d7059b49c8e30.source: I favor a more cautious approach really. I'm a little concerned by some of the tactics we've seen recently in the civil rights movement.
ccc39e7b4626645ea7f64bb6e62d7059b49c8e30.zh: 其实，我更赞成谨慎一些。最近民权运动中的某些策略，让我有点担忧。

a27eb42339f4aaf9e0abc1f13cd6cbc2626fcaf5.source: I have a substantial record of reform and progressivism as Governor of New York, and as a Supreme Court Justice. I won't hesitate to say so as I campaign.
a27eb42339f4aaf9e0abc1f13cd6cbc2626fcaf5.zh: 无论作为纽约州州长，还是最高法院大法官，我都有丰富的改革和进步主义政绩。我在竞选中会毫不犹豫地指出这一点。

e133b4ca5f57fde017c433eeb68930e423b71fb4.source: I have always been on the more moderate wing of the party. We need to emphasize my anti-Communism and my record as a Senator if we hope to win back the Eisenhower Democrats.
e133b4ca5f57fde017c433eeb68930e423b71fb4.zh: 我一直属于党内较温和的一派。如果想争取支持艾森豪威尔的民主党选民回归，我们就需要强调我的反共立场和参议员政绩。

e6b19ba74c45a3f1cb35211ff4c7971063b8950a.source: I have always supported the Democratic ideal, that the citizens of any given state or territory should be allowed to decide the slavery question according to their own dictates.
e6b19ba74c45a3f1cb35211ff4c7971063b8950a.zh: 我一向支持民主党的理想：任何州或领地的公民，都应当能够按照自己的意愿决定奴隶制问题。

b16a1e31f64c3f482ed44a0ac2933b5499a61369.source: I have an open mind on this issue, but it would depend on who needs the money and what case they can make during the federal budget process.
b16a1e31f64c3f482ed44a0ac2933b5499a61369.zh: 我对此持开放态度，但要看谁需要这笔钱，以及他们在联邦预算制定过程中能提出什么理由。

384210df71e738780c0bb0428608f88c50af3043.source: I have more credibility than Nixon does on the issues of law-and-order. I trust that southerners will see through his empty appeals on this issue.
384210df71e738780c0bb0428608f88c50af3043.zh: 在法律与秩序问题上，我比尼克松更可信。我相信南方人能看穿他在这个问题上的空洞呼吁。

39d04975c1dfb89ee9479be2ae0d27a246055964.source: I have no comment to make on Darwinism. This is completely irrelevant to my expected duties as President of the United States.
39d04975c1dfb89ee9479be2ae0d27a246055964.zh: 我对达尔文主义没有评论。这与我预期承担的美国总统职责，毫不相干。

d23b30bfeb0b7d012de404276638027fda039540.source: I have no plan to cut taxes. If anything, we might need some increases to strengthen Social Security.
d23b30bfeb0b7d012de404276638027fda039540.zh: 我不打算减税。真要说的话，我们可能还需要加税，以巩固社会保障制度。

f65580799d9f0e98996cf146a3ae91516627f609.source: I have no problems opposing the policies of Lyndon Johnson. If he wants to try and sabotage my campaign, we'll just have to live with it.
f65580799d9f0e98996cf146a3ae91516627f609.zh: 我并不介意反对林登·约翰逊的政策。如果他想破坏我的竞选，我们也只能接受这个现实。

e0e36b63e5f3136e4a400c07656dd8b0f8a3b50a.source: I have no real comment to make, but I'm sure that the voters in Texas will be incensed at the incivility of this episode.
e0e36b63e5f3136e4a400c07656dd8b0f8a3b50a.zh: 我没有什么特别的评论，不过相信得克萨斯州选民会对这次事件中的无礼行为感到愤怒。

57015266b7c5a201fb0b93e5a9de37b70afe0c53.source: I have nothing to hide. I'm proud to protect the freedom of conscience that every American should enjoy.
57015266b7c5a201fb0b93e5a9de37b70afe0c53.zh: 我没有什么要隐瞒的。我很自豪，能捍卫每个美国人都应享有的良心自由。

1f02e35bb07c8a94aceaeda0aab28cc6709d738b.source: I have opposed the Trans-Pacific Partnership for many of the same reasons that Trump brings up. The bipartisan support for free trade that he inveighs against simply doesn't exist.
1f02e35bb07c8a94aceaeda0aab28cc6709d738b.zh: 我反对《跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》的许多理由，与特朗普提出的相同。他所抨击的两党共同支持自由贸易，根本就不存在。

8ce7f2a0dfb44931d7d01501aa4fed592d491990.source: I have ordered a halt to this program, albeit too late in this case. We will immediately counterattack these charges with examples of federal furloughs gone awry under the Reagan Administration.
8ce7f2a0dfb44931d7d01501aa4fed592d491990.zh: 我已经下令停止这项计划，尽管就这个案件而言为时已晚。我们会立即举出里根政府期间联邦囚犯离监休假酿成事故的案例，反击这些指控。

80994c90d55f236223597a5505602e33c81fa474.source: I have served as Vice President for seven years. We will emphasize this experience, but talk more about what I will do, than what Ronald Reagan has done.
80994c90d55f236223597a5505602e33c81fa474.zh: 我已担任副总统七年。我们会强调这段经历，但更多谈我将做什么，而非罗纳德·里根已经做了什么。

ae8737dddd9e639b9faf22a546236a1fad43c1b1.source: I have sought the guidance of our Savior on this issue, and I cannot support the execution of our lost souls in good conscience.
ae8737dddd9e639b9faf22a546236a1fad43c1b1.zh: 我在这个问题上寻求过救主的指引。凭良心说，我不能支持处死那些迷失的灵魂。

7482993be24d76f9d6c13a19c334db8bc825c996.source: I have the experience to grow our economy, strengthen our military, create millions of new, high-paying jobs, and much more. I will be a President for all Americans when I am in office.
7482993be24d76f9d6c13a19c334db8bc825c996.zh: 我有经验推动经济增长、增强军队实力，创造数百万个新的高薪工作岗位，以及做更多事情。执政后，我会做全体美国人的总统。

005bbf9c6c4a37d2c15925271f214e6d73523f2b.source: I have the utmost respect for James Comey and our terrific agents in the FBI. It seems like Hillary may have gotten lucky on this one.
005bbf9c6c4a37d2c15925271f214e6d73523f2b.zh: 我极其尊重詹姆斯·科米和联邦调查局那些出色的探员。看来希拉里这回可能走运了。

3680ead7a97f716f79bb2f2aedfc05d15d7c9cc8.source: I haven't really thought about it. Let's just stick to what we're doing.
3680ead7a97f716f79bb2f2aedfc05d15d7c9cc8.zh: 我没怎么想过。我们就继续现在的做法吧。

90a655cccb2ca2eb3aa8b43d827b3894b6460fd5.source: I hope Palmer will see fit to remove himself unilaterally from the most hotly contested border states. His is purely a protest candidacy however, and I cannot remove myself from a ballot on his behalf without looking like a buffoon.
90a655cccb2ca2eb3aa8b43d827b3894b6460fd5.zh: 我希望帕尔默能自行决定，退出竞争最激烈的边界州。不过，他参选纯粹是为了表达抗议；我不能为了他从选票上撤名，否则就像个傻瓜。

506085121b6feb03a379f27387afc36ea2fa7734.source: I hope for all of our sakes that these programs work, but history proves that they may well have unintended consequences.
506085121b6feb03a379f27387afc36ea2fa7734.zh: 为了大家的利益，我希望这些项目能奏效，但历史证明，它们很可能带来意想不到的后果。

860d2bd1b04a95f666012c9ea13c4b45ec33e77c.source: I hope that this isn't necessary, but it would be irresponsible to rule anything out at the present time.
860d2bd1b04a95f666012c9ea13c4b45ec33e77c.zh: 我希望不必加税，但现在就排除任何可能性，是不负责任的。

c64c022f3a1262352ca34a5946d20a8a09fbe5ef.source: I hope to hit on the theme of reform and progressivism frequently during our campaign. This is a great chance to do that.
c64c022f3a1262352ca34a5946d20a8a09fbe5ef.zh: 我希望在竞选中经常谈改革与进步主义。这是个绝佳的机会。

b2c5bd5b3127f4abaa947d3e7a08a480bf5a4fed.source: I intend to announce new restrictions on foreign travel and shipping which will greatly reduce the chance of incidents with Germany, and thus reestablish a true neutrality in this war.
b2c5bd5b3127f4abaa947d3e7a08a480bf5a4fed.zh: 我打算宣布对海外旅行和航运的新限制，大幅减少与德国发生冲突的机会，从而在这场战争中重新确立真正的中立。

b869e9bad8ae8d406e4c899db2551e6e39947373.source: I join the chorus of voices calling for the resignation of Edwin Meese.
b869e9bad8ae8d406e4c899db2551e6e39947373.zh: 我也加入呼吁埃德温·米斯辞职的行列。

ee1b7589493200f58c77707404502512b8d67023.source: I know a lot of Democrats are concerned that I'm too moderate. I will make it a point to express support for a staunch liberal platform this fall.
ee1b7589493200f58c77707404502512b8d67023.zh: 我知道，许多民主党人担心我过于温和。我会在秋季竞选中明确支持坚定的自由派纲领。

6704d16bba8c6343e9bbe52488523ddd1632b6f9.source: I know this is a bold step, but I believe that Nelson Rockefeller represents the future of our party, and I believe he will be a dynamic leader of this party and nation for many years to come.
6704d16bba8c6343e9bbe52488523ddd1632b6f9.zh: 我知道，这是大胆的一步，不过相信纳尔逊·洛克菲勒代表本党的未来，而且未来多年，他都将是本党和国家充满活力的领导人。

d0f37130ea3e0982f0f49b1362212a337f1e2016.source: I like Amy Coney Barrett. She's a staunch conservative, a true Catholic thinker, and widely praised across the conservative spectrum.
d0f37130ea3e0982f0f49b1362212a337f1e2016.zh: 我喜欢艾米·科尼·巴雷特。她是坚定的保守派，真正的天主教思想者，在各路保守派中广受赞誉。

34d731a70501dba8de1c9626aaad2b2ef656db0c.source: I love fracking. We need to do anything we can to support it.
34d731a70501dba8de1c9626aaad2b2ef656db0c.zh: 我喜欢水力压裂。我们应该尽一切可能支持它。

5c18bfe9180e6be9503a46bbc33d2f14bc87f8c3.source: I oppose this Amendment, as many labor unions do, because it would jeopardize protections for female workers in areas such as working hours or tasks.
5c18bfe9180e6be9503a46bbc33d2f14bc87f8c3.zh: 和许多工会一样，我反对这项修正案，因为它会危及女性劳动者在工作时间、工作任务等方面受到的保护。

2eb1424c19fc5d5d2610232146e42d7de6a3e2e6.source: I plead guilty. I don't have experience with the broken political culture of Washington, unlike my opponent. I will clean this system up when I am President.
2eb1424c19fc5d5d2610232146e42d7de6a3e2e6.zh: 这点我认了。我不像对手那样，熟悉华盛顿败坏的政治文化。担任总统后，我会整顿这个体制。

1e0ece7d4b550ffe1b67f60d7062c7963a382a32.source: I pray for peace, but we will not compromise the rights of American shipping and commerce. We are fully prepared to take the fight to Germany if interference continues.
1e0ece7d4b550ffe1b67f60d7062c7963a382a32.zh: 我祈求和平，但我们不会牺牲美国航运与贸易的权利。如果干扰继续，我们已完全准备好与德国交战。

a49db524dfb85b8f6b2ea49ff919d804d9342c05.source: I prefer a slightly different program, offering health insurance to the elderly that they can choose to purchase. The proposed program was mandatory, and also covered only those covered by the Social Security Act.
a49db524dfb85b8f6b2ea49ff919d804d9342c05.zh: 我更倾向于略有不同的计划，让老年人自行选择是否购买医疗保险。原提案要求强制参加，而且只覆盖《社会保障法》所涵盖的人。

8fbec343e4c08bf445d555aaa6244cad8bd0d127.source: I prefer to focus on making responsible use of our budget surplus and securing prosperity for the next generation of Americans.
8fbec343e4c08bf445d555aaa6244cad8bd0d127.zh: 我愿意把重点放在负责任地使用预算盈余，以及保障下一代美国人的繁荣上。

dd81b52cf5aa7d1c16ce5a46fe066a7ea8cf4600.source: I probably won't use the word “rapist” again. But I will, you know, remind people that Hillary Clinton was saying she was “adamantly against illegal immigrants”. What made her change her mind?
dd81b52cf5aa7d1c16ce5a46fe066a7ea8cf4600.zh: 我大概不会再用“强奸犯”这个词。但我会，你知道，提醒大家，希拉里·克林顿自己说过，她“坚决反对非法移民”。是什么让她改变主意的？

2a81fb1ec6468d38ada3dfe9425c9a96b0237533.source: I promised no cuts to Social Security and Medicare. And we're going to repeal and replace the Obamacare disaster. You should see how people cheer when I talk about that!
2a81fb1ec6468d38ada3dfe9425c9a96b0237533.zh: 我承诺，不削减社会保障和老年医疗保险。我们还要废除并取代奥巴马医改这场灾难。你真该看看，每当我说起这个，大家欢呼成什么样！

407c22501e4f63216faf78edacf6447ce4cf9534.source: I question the premise that the Department of Education should be providing funds in the first place. Education is a local concern.
407c22501e4f63216faf78edacf6447ce4cf9534.zh: 我质疑的是，教育部一开始就该不该提供经费。教育是地方事务。

42e9eb8ddb6fe39452fe52d210a5203b99a27226.source: I question this premise, to be frank. It's still not clear to me exactly what role Nixon had in the Eisenhower Administration, or what policies of his have been implemented.
42e9eb8ddb6fe39452fe52d210a5203b99a27226.zh: 坦率地说，我质疑这个前提。我仍不清楚，尼克松在艾森豪威尔政府中究竟起过什么作用，或他的哪些政策已经付诸实施。

f4cb8da252b9c1ecf6f974dc66d552021a5e74d2.source: I really don't have a lot to say about this situation. You never like to see a situation like this, whether it's the police, whether it's the drugs. It's just sad.
f4cb8da252b9c1ecf6f974dc66d552021a5e74d2.zh: 对于这个情况，我实在没多少可说的。你总不愿看到这种事发生，无论是警察的问题，还是毒品的问题。就是令人难过。

54f09567543cc402f69c22c7e1279bf95535c6c4.source: I really hate to do this, but we gotta try and lower her profile. I love Sarah, she's incredible, but we need her to be incredible around the people who appreciate her incredibility.
54f09567543cc402f69c22c7e1279bf95535c6c4.zh: 我真不愿这么做，但我们得尽量降低她的曝光度。我喜欢萨拉，她很了不起，但我们需要她在欣赏她这种了不起的人面前，继续表现得了不起。

4cceb35c6c3c28727cabe7d86738d4c370a729b5.source: I love free trade. This is another case where the media has taken a couple of sentences in a three-hour speech and made up a totally phony story. All I am saying is we've got to look out for America first in these trade deals.
4cceb35c6c3c28727cabe7d86738d4c370a729b5.zh: 我热爱自由贸易。媒体又从一场三小时的演说里抽出几句话，编出完全虚假的故事。我说的不过是，在这些贸易协议中，我们必须把美国放在第一位。

12371a61725ad2b82330416ed3ef34102b2f9009.source: I love our military. We're going to do a gigantic rally in Pensacola, Florida, and we're going to win Florida on election day.
12371a61725ad2b82330416ed3ef34102b2f9009.zh: 我热爱我们的军队。我们要在佛罗里达州彭萨科拉办一场规模巨大的集会，选举日我们就要赢下佛罗里达州。

43a7fc8f2fd100cf273fe3833ae416f46166498d.source: I made my reputation by debating Stephen A. Douglas. These extraordinary times call for extraordinary action by the candidates for President.
43a7fc8f2fd100cf273fe3833ae416f46166498d.zh: 我正是通过与斯蒂芬·A.·道格拉斯辩论而成名。非常时期，需要总统候选人采取非常行动。

428b53d7b706538ad7457b6cca128e94beeb9a2a.source: I made my selection based on who is most qualified to serve as President, should the situation ever arise. Tim Kaine has served as a Governor and a Senator over the couse of many years, and he is a reliably progressive Democrat.
428b53d7b706538ad7457b6cca128e94beeb9a2a.zh: 我的选择依据是：如果真出现那种情况，谁最有资格担任总统？蒂姆·凯恩多年来担任过州长和参议员，是一位可靠的进步派民主党人。

1fe369e7bc2b2f9a06430eff73d26e864accc743.source: I meant what I said, and it's unfortunate that it has to be a big issue with some folks. But I told the American people, "I will never tell a lie."
1fe369e7bc2b2f9a06430eff73d26e864accc743.zh: 我说的就是我的真实想法。遗憾的是，有些人非要把它闹成大事。但我已经告诉美国人民：“我绝不会撒谎。”

43f2385083b6d56d058426750d8663e95d83b1b3.source: I neither support, nor do I oppose this idea for an Amendment. My job as President will be to enforce the law as it stands.
43f2385083b6d56d058426750d8663e95d83b1b3.zh: 对于这项宪法修正案提议，我既不支持，也不反对。我当上总统后的职责，是执行现行法律。

0ed33e3a25be06e9b803f9827e23220bfb51c01a.source: I never attacked the character of Ben Carson. I have no idea where you people in the media get this stuff. He's going to make a terrific Vice President. I predict that his face will one day be on the Mt. Rushmore of Vice Presidents.
0ed33e3a25be06e9b803f9827e23220bfb51c01a.zh: 我从没攻击过本·卡森的人品。我不知道你们这些媒体人从哪里听来的。他会是一位出色的副总统。我预言，有一天他的面孔会出现在副总统版的拉什莫尔山上。

fab1ce613177c48103efef41231ff3e542462a07.source: I never meant that I was going to keep all Muslims from entering the United States. All I meant, was that we can't have people coming here with possible ties to ISIS until we figure out what's going on.
fab1ce613177c48103efef41231ff3e542462a07.zh: 我从没说过，要禁止所有穆斯林进入美国。我的意思只是，在弄清情况之前，不能让可能与“伊斯兰国”有关的人进来。

b396531208a3bf5b67c670d0a80d810aa9e1d1ca.source: I obtained my nomination based on the Texas issue, and people know that. We need to pivot now, and make the case for other parts of our platform.
b396531208a3bf5b67c670d0a80d810aa9e1d1ca.zh: 我凭借得克萨斯问题上的立场获得提名，这一点人们都清楚。现在我们需要转移重点，阐明纲领的其他部分。

a8ffcb7adfeb980530d85f2cd20e41fa1cf72aff.source: I oppose child labor and believe the states should pass laws against the practice, as New York did while I was Governor. But it is not a matter for the federal government to interfere in.
a8ffcb7adfeb980530d85f2cd20e41fa1cf72aff.zh: 我反对童工，并认为各州应当立法禁止，就像我担任州长时纽约州所做的那样。但这不是联邦政府应该干预的事务。

4a558ce2fbf98a0014f602b40e4df5e1fa77bd7f.source: I oppose these plans. The ANWR is an environmental treasure of the United States, and the oil gained from any exploitation will be relatively limited.
4a558ce2fbf98a0014f602b40e4df5e1fa77bd7f.zh: 我反对这些计划。北极国家野生动物保护区是美国的生态瑰宝，而且开发它能获得的石油相对有限。

bb3f1f717fc7900249415df5296db8fa078e8ebc.source: I really want us to look into increasing the child tax credit, in closing some loopholes for the banks on Wall Street, and so on. We have some good things there that will send the right message to the American people.
bb3f1f717fc7900249415df5296db8fa078e8ebc.zh: 我确实希望研究提高儿童税收抵免，堵住华尔街银行的一些漏洞，等等。这里有些不错的措施，可以向美国人民传达正确的信息。

12b937d8ec0e7624c0d4ff0a7a052d818c31c68f.source: I refuse to comment on this issue. My spokeswoman will remind the American people that the real issue is who will be a better President for the country.
12b937d8ec0e7624c0d4ff0a7a052d818c31c68f.zh: 我拒绝对此发表评论。我的女发言人会提醒美国人民，真正的问题是，谁更适合担任国家的总统。

ccae75ce75a74a51bbc2e71c23ed24c788c5955d.source: I refuse to condone this kind of a plan. I have limits on what I will do to win an election.
ccae75ce75a74a51bbc2e71c23ed24c788c5955d.zh: 我拒绝认可这种计划。为了赢得选举，我也有不能逾越的底线。

a9c9d0c2ea8ac01dd83844f88546f66b7aa97985.source: I refuse to meet with any hyphenated-American group which places another identity above that of American.
a9c9d0c2ea8ac01dd83844f88546f66b7aa97985.zh: 凡是将另一种身份置于美国人身份之上的族裔团体，我都拒绝会见。

11f6d8ce86869080ec8dc9b811758c64c39840e1.source: I refuse to politicize the security of the United States. Wilson and I are both in support of the current measures.
11f6d8ce86869080ec8dc9b811758c64c39840e1.zh: 我拒绝把美国的安全问题政治化。威尔逊和我都支持当前的措施。

ff8047c58c9f96a7ef43c0c50efbb6c3adc45397.source: I regret not taking active steps, as CIA Director, to limit our dealings with Manuel Noriega in the 1970s.
ff8047c58c9f96a7ef43c0c50efbb6c3adc45397.zh: 我后悔在20世纪70年代担任中央情报局局长时，没有采取积极措施，限制我们与曼努埃尔·诺列加的往来。

d5cacad9ec76ec00dc30f327f8322680a1c518bf.source: I said some things in a private conversation that I shouldn't have, but think about what's at stake in this election. And think about all the times that Hillary Clinton helped her husband abuse and silence women.
d5cacad9ec76ec00dc30f327f8322680a1c518bf.zh: 我在私下谈话中说过一些不该说的话，但想想这次选举牵涉的重大问题。再想想希拉里·克林顿多少次帮助丈夫虐待女性，压制她们的声音。

f13b9c8a58de730961c497bc9256e82b3dd4242d.source: I see how this is appealing to some conservatives, but it still represents the interference of the federal government in education.
f13b9c8a58de730961c497bc9256e82b3dd4242d.zh: 我明白，这对一些保守派很有吸引力，但它仍然意味着联邦政府干预教育。

7aaafe36de0cbff5532c45c93c353da2f8acf49b.source: I see what you're doing, and I like it. It might not be a bad thing to compromise on some issues outside of silver coinage.
7aaafe36de0cbff5532c45c93c353da2f8acf49b.zh: 我明白你的用意，而且很赞同。在白银铸币以外的某些问题上作些妥协，未必是坏事。

10543e0c9b7fb9a1c3bf753a8b37cb384bf65517.source: I see. We shall do our best in any case.
10543e0c9b7fb9a1c3bf753a8b37cb384bf65517.zh: 明白。无论如何，我们都会尽力。

c7e89a5e0caf935ed89d601658c11a98b7108824.source: I served honorably in the U.S. Army, but Bush was basically a war hero. We should focus on areas where we have more of an advantage.
c7e89a5e0caf935ed89d601658c11a98b7108824.zh: 我在美国陆军光荣服役，但布什基本上算得上战争英雄。我们应当着重谈那些我们更有优势的方面。

ebdbb97ba7f5317a5d66c043681ae342c29730bb.source: I should be out there talking to the American people. That doesn't mean we do rallies with 10 thousand people, but we can't afford to just sit around in our basement for the next five months.
ebdbb97ba7f5317a5d66c043681ae342c29730bb.zh: 我应该出去与美国人民交谈。这不意味着办一万人参加的集会，但我们不能在未来五个月里，只坐在自己的地下室。

ddb3fce67698eff14e62698f9cf2fc410b4dabcf.source: I should have been more aware that something was going on, based on some meetings I attended, and I regret not doing more to stop this at the time.
ddb3fce67698eff14e62698f9cf2fc410b4dabcf.zh: 根据我参加过的一些会议，我本该更加留意到有事情正在发生。我后悔当时没有采取更多措施加以阻止。

fac3e7c9dd3cc1386be3594400ec283dd86b1d39.source: I stand by my actions 100%. The buck stops here.
fac3e7c9dd3cc1386be3594400ec283dd86b1d39.zh: 我完全坚持自己的决定。责任到我这里为止。

a82be8d61f9bb9c22f56442a810876855c382fed.source: I stand by that statement 100 percent. And I will push for immigration reform within my first 100 days as President.
a82be8d61f9bb9c22f56442a810876855c382fed.zh: 我百分之百坚持这项表态。而且，我会在担任总统的头100天内推动移民改革。

ecc6dd78e837fa0e8d4846e0e13c5557b6b8c7ab.source: I stand for a national bank or an independent Treasury -- whichever can gain the most support. I would require any national bank to maintain a branch in every state.
ecc6dd78e837fa0e8d4846e0e13c5557b6b8c7ab.zh: 我支持国家银行或独立国库，哪一种能获得更多支持，就采用哪一种。我会要求任何国家银行都在每个州设立分行。

a7e777fea4fb62d93fb224dd1c2205947c0cb9fb.source: I stand for a national bank, broadly similar to the late Second Bank of the United States.
a7e777fea4fb62d93fb224dd1c2205947c0cb9fb.zh: 我主张设立一家国家银行，大体类似于已经撤销的美国第二银行。

09563e61725468bc5cff3fd1e43ca47effe595bb.source: I stand for the continuation of Ronald Reagan's policies and legacy. Let us allow an ascendant conservatism to guide us into the future.
09563e61725468bc5cff3fd1e43ca47effe595bb.zh: 我主张继续罗纳德·里根的政策，继承他的政治遗产。让正在崛起的保守主义引领我们走向未来。

687a3537805072b2e53348c32afb35c04aa8da02.source: I stand here tonight as my own man. I will work day and night to support the hard-working American people. I will make sure our debt is paid down, and that senior citizens and middle class families are protected into the future. I will protect our most important programs from attacks and budget cuts.
687a3537805072b2e53348c32afb35c04aa8da02.zh: 今晚，我站在这里，有自己的原则。我将日夜工作，支持辛勤劳动的美国人民。我会确保偿还债务，保障老年人和中产家庭的未来。我会保护我们最重要的项目，不让它们遭到攻击和预算削减。

beea03cf36817def0b5754ec6bc36645dfdb990c.source: I stand here tonight as my own man. We have much more work to do to ensure that America's prosperity flows to all of the people. We need more spending for education, infrastructure, and important research. We also need to protect Social Security, Medicare, and the environment.
beea03cf36817def0b5754ec6bc36645dfdb990c.zh: 今晚，我站在这里，有自己的原则。要让美国的繁荣惠及所有人，我们还有许多工作要做。我们需要增加教育、基础设施和重要研究的投入，也需要保护社会保障制度、老年医疗保险和环境。

5a0b0053580a2a430bb2d10d9c672eca767e6877.source: I stand opposed to any annexation of Texas. It will reopen settled questions and distract our nation from its important political issues, such as economic development.
5a0b0053580a2a430bb2d10d9c672eca767e6877.zh: 我反对以任何形式吞并得克萨斯。这会重新挑起已平息的争议，分散国家对经济发展等重要政治议题的注意力。

b7a5a47611e78c8ef14f950b5bca50bb69cb0639.source: I stand opposed to the expansion of women's suffrage.
b7a5a47611e78c8ef14f950b5bca50bb69cb0639.zh: 我反对扩大妇女选举权。

a476ee5402682bb0bba9586882d35ada394285ee.source: I stand opposed to the legal segregation of our schools. Legal segregation promotes inferior education. I also think that busing promotes inferior education. My goal is to see every child in this country get a good education.
a476ee5402682bb0bba9586882d35ada394285ee.zh: 我反对以法律维持学校种族隔离。法定隔离会降低教育质量，我认为校车接送也会降低教育质量。我的目标，是让这个国家的每个孩子都得到良好教育。

b0cd0606dc78614819f4e684ca9048b0800bffc5.source: I strongly support the right of a woman to choose. We need to defend this right, and we should increase funding for women's health services, unconditionally.
b0cd0606dc78614819f4e684ca9048b0800bffc5.zh: 我坚决支持女性自主选择的权利。我们需要捍卫这项权利，并无条件增加女性医疗服务的经费。

4346a01f63f8d011f19417c5482e0fb5548e92dc.source: I strongly support this idea and will work to implement it as President. All parents deserve to choose where their child will attend school.
4346a01f63f8d011f19417c5482e0fb5548e92dc.zh: 我大力支持这个想法，担任总统后会推动实施。所有家长都应能选择孩子去哪所学校。

c8c9a80e6654d2b6e16d073baad9ed7b488801d9.source: I strongly support what we have done to end the insidious practice of segregation in the South. However I'm also alarmed at some of the ideas I've heard about forced integration of neighborhoods, or the proposed busing of students to distant schools.
c8c9a80e6654d2b6e16d073baad9ed7b488801d9.zh: 我强烈支持我们为终结南方阴险的种族隔离制度所作的努力。不过，我也担忧一些主张，例如强制社区种族融合，或用校车把学生送到远处学校的提议。

7d260e08be321694ad454828b8de16bc5949d373.source: I support African-Americans in this country and I oppose police brutality. But these activists are a different story. There have been some very hateful things said, and they are tied to a number of riots that we've seen.
7d260e08be321694ad454828b8de16bc5949d373.zh: 我支持本国非裔美国人，也反对警察暴力。但这些活动人士是另一回事。有些话充满仇恨，而且他们与我们看到的多场骚乱有关。

19380c762e8ea9ade3d62d25085316bc25edd67b.source: I support Mr. Meese from the politically motivated attacks of late.
19380c762e8ea9ade3d62d25085316bc25edd67b.zh: 我支持米斯先生，反对近期那些出于政治动机的攻击。

3309dc12d4e0560a423d25057e8d0bea3255c33e.source: I support Social Security, but I think the program is most solvent in its current form.
3309dc12d4e0560a423d25057e8d0bea3255c33e.zh: 我支持社会保障，但认为维持目前的形式，最能确保这项制度的偿付能力。

8168ef242a47e43bb4d7c2112ff3e2e31dc403b0.source: I support Truman's veto. The National Labor Relations Act was put in place to protect the rights of labor, and it should be respected.
8168ef242a47e43bb4d7c2112ff3e2e31dc403b0.zh: 我支持杜鲁门的否决。《全国劳工关系法》是为保护劳工权利而制定的，理应得到尊重。

0d74734f99a0011aa42ef903f1ced7baddcd1ec8.source: I support a League of Nations, and American participation in it. We can no longer safely ignore the affairs of the world.
0d74734f99a0011aa42ef903f1ced7baddcd1ec8.zh: 我支持国际联盟，也支持美国参加。我们再也不能置身世界事务之外，还指望安然无恙。

f24290b10eea859b5944b343490942a4dc0be7df.source: I support a bailout of the European Union if necessary. Waiting until this debt contagion causes a double-dip recession in the U.S. is not an option.
f24290b10eea859b5944b343490942a4dc0be7df.zh: 必要时，我支持救助欧盟。我们不能等到债务危机蔓延、导致美国经济二次衰退再行动。

50e9b7fb6397c77868b2e6daa14857cf678c9edb.source: I support a civil rights plank in the Democratic platform. We can't concede this issue to Republicans and the Progressive Party if we want to compete in the industrial states.
50e9b7fb6397c77868b2e6daa14857cf678c9edb.zh: 我支持在民主党党纲中纳入民权条款。如果想在工业州争取胜利，我们就不能把这个议题让给共和党和进步党。

586e4d0181d400f13094c5e775b793650cdeead6.source: I support a civil rights plank, and furthermore I will personally take executive action to desegregate the Armed Forces. I believe we can turn the black vote if we take initiative on this issue.
586e4d0181d400f13094c5e775b793650cdeead6.zh: 我支持民权条款，而且还会亲自采取行政行动，废除军队中的种族隔离。我认为，只要主动推进这个议题，就能争取黑人选票转而支持我们。

5e472879b3a4ba9a5af774f8701b00612d051afd.source: I support a fair shake for every American. I support programs that help black businesses. I support desegregation. I oppose groups like the Black Panthers that have contributed to the rioting and chaos that has swept the nation these past three years.
5e472879b3a4ba9a5af774f8701b00612d051afd.zh: 我支持公平对待每个美国人，支持扶助黑人企业的项目，支持废除种族隔离。我反对黑豹党这样的组织，因为它们助长了过去三年席卷全国的骚乱和混乱。

d906c4cd7d826ab85f71f26a9dc97517149c7bbf.source: I support a federal workers' compensation program which all dangerous industries would be required to participate in.
d906c4cd7d826ab85f71f26a9dc97517149c7bbf.zh: 我支持设立联邦工伤赔偿制度，要求所有危险行业都必须参加。

ef12bbc967b804f6f5899dda88f35fca76f0eed8.source: I support a national bank, and one clear argument for the bank is the total chaos we've had with our currency since 1837.
ef12bbc967b804f6f5899dda88f35fca76f0eed8.zh: 我支持国家银行。自1837年以来，我们的货币陷入一片混乱，这就是支持设立国家银行的一项有力理由。

b7658796efd15ef0e32ccbed1d49e7e52313261c.source: I support a new era in U.S. - Communist relations. We have to be realistic and accept that Communism is here to stay, and work within that framework to find reasonable compromise in foreign affairs.
b7658796efd15ef0e32ccbed1d49e7e52313261c.zh: 我支持开启美国与共产主义国家关系的新时期。我们必须面对现实，承认共产主义不会就此消失，并在这个前提下，在外交事务中寻求合理妥协。

c9a575d11674935335bdc589d20ee6da14a9e0f9.source: I support a strict adherence to the gold standard, which is fundamental to American prosperity.
c9a575d11674935335bdc589d20ee6da14a9e0f9.zh: 我支持严格坚持金本位制，这是美国繁荣的根本。

7b4b03671d2d0f66f96d8d88da954d57460542c8.source: I support a strong, overwhelming response against whoever perpetrated this attack. Any government that harbors such terrorists should be overthrown, even if it requires the commitment of American troops.
7b4b03671d2d0f66f96d8d88da954d57460542c8.zh: 无论是谁实施了这次袭击，我都支持作出强有力、压倒性的回应。任何庇护这类恐怖分子的政府都应被推翻，即使这意味着投入美国军队。

194c77a5f56559cc9aee954cabb60936f60a2abb.source: I support a wall and I support the presence of American troops. The purpose of the military is to defend our borders.
194c77a5f56559cc9aee954cabb60936f60a2abb.zh: 我支持修墙，也支持部署美军。军队的职责就是保卫我们的边界。

174d9f09b8eaaa946f19be1d0174cc3ffa6c29d5.source: I support abstinence-only education, and believe that federal funding should be tied to adherence with this policy.
174d9f09b8eaaa946f19be1d0174cc3ffa6c29d5.zh: 我支持只讲禁欲的性教育，并认为，联邦资助应该以遵循这项政策为条件。

bbb970a72924d013f59d226efc61abc0f43c6827.source: I support an amendment like this, so long as it contains exceptions for rape, or to protect the health of the mother.
bbb970a72924d013f59d226efc61abc0f43c6827.zh: 我支持这样的修正案，只要它对强奸导致的怀孕或保护母亲健康的情况保留例外。

e776f41a73173a75517b2098131a94f6f1bdf8a9.source: I support an independent Treasury, but not one that would disseminate a national currency.
e776f41a73173a75517b2098131a94f6f1bdf8a9.zh: 我支持独立国库，但不支持由它发行全国性货币。

112fdc3e2bdae8cb154b162b145f22632eb49ad0.source: I support any federal effort to increase the health and well-being of women in America.
112fdc3e2bdae8cb154b162b145f22632eb49ad0.zh: 我支持联邦政府采取任何措施，增进美国女性的健康和福祉。

6f5f4895402170104662c721da0d691dca41b4f0.source: I support common-sense measures to reduce gun violence in this country.
6f5f4895402170104662c721da0d691dca41b4f0.zh: 我支持采取符合常识的措施，减少本国枪支暴力。

797815a76d9b8155ce6867fc96426ffa0a1ab40a.source: I support increased federal hate crime legislation. No American should ever feel like a target of intimidation because of their identity.
797815a76d9b8155ce6867fc96426ffa0a1ab40a.zh: 我支持加强联邦仇恨犯罪立法。任何美国人都不应因为自身身份，而感到自己成为恐吓的目标。

913ed029880ee1ca1a699a5d24653b6f0354b491.source: I support letting the cuts expire. It's time that wealthy Americans paid their fair share for the opportunities our society gives to them.
913ed029880ee1ca1a699a5d24653b6f0354b491.zh: 我支持让减税政策到期失效。富裕的美国人应该为社会给予他们的机会缴纳公平的一份税款。

bd277f221fa1a2a8ff404aba8e01b52327ce3341.source: I support our actions in this theatre. For minimal cost we were able to stop a potential genocide and put a dictator to justice.
bd277f221fa1a2a8ff404aba8e01b52327ce3341.zh: 我支持我们在这一战区的行动。我们以极小的代价，阻止了一场可能发生的种族灭绝，并让一位独裁者接受司法制裁。

a588a39ce501b84effef9762908a8a6562d12bc8.source: I support our current airlift and hope that it leads to an agreeable conclusion.
a588a39ce501b84effef9762908a8a6562d12bc8.zh: 我支持当前的空运，希望它能促成各方可以接受的结局。

999c566b832971ee36209bfcb0fdf6a970f8866a.source: I support our current banking system, and would not support any ill-conceived attempts to centralize our finances.
999c566b832971ee36209bfcb0fdf6a970f8866a.zh: 我支持现行银行制度，不会支持任何考虑不周、试图集中控制国家金融的做法。

f9d57be0bc9c2c9de876cb764a0982fd13997f41.source: I support our current free banking system, and I see no need for the Treasury to insulate its operations from the state-chartered banks.
f9d57be0bc9c2c9de876cb764a0982fd13997f41.zh: 我支持现行自由银行制度，看不出有什么必要让国库业务与各州特许设立的银行隔离开来。

7b4574a2d4a75332b267a4299ebe4e9ea890a79a.source: I support our current naturalization laws as they stand.
7b4574a2d4a75332b267a4299ebe4e9ea890a79a.zh: 我支持维持现行入籍法。

f8f0b53824eddeead5418fa4922083b8516747e0.source: I support our police officers, who are working so hard to uphold the law in this country.
f8f0b53824eddeead5418fa4922083b8516747e0.zh: 我支持我们的警察。他们为了维护本国法律，如此辛勤地工作。

d32547c6549aaa1c87869dade8334b8aa23f9202.source: I support the Clayton Antitrust Act and would hope to see further measures enacted to protect the rights of labor in this country.
d32547c6549aaa1c87869dade8334b8aa23f9202.zh: 我支持《克莱顿反托拉斯法》，并希望进一步立法，保护本国劳工的权利。

dd13477df250e8fa23698d84d3d94a523947a4ec.source: I support the Federal Reserve in general, but I believe that we should have established a more centralized, federal government bank.
dd13477df250e8fa23698d84d3d94a523947a4ec.zh: 我总体上支持联邦储备制度，但认为我们本应建立一家权力更集中的联邦政府银行。

69d5bcb8b1f8187a29c972c8f4468c4e2a225317.source: I support the Federal Trade Commission and will take a broad interpretation of its power over the next four years.
69d5bcb8b1f8187a29c972c8f4468c4e2a225317.zh: 我支持联邦贸易委员会，未来四年将对其权限作宽泛解释。

8358368c41d285804ad21a481a257e492062bbe6.source: I support the HUAC, although I do wish it could be a little more aggressive in its rooting out of Communist influence.
8358368c41d285804ad21a481a257e492062bbe6.zh: 我支持非美活动调查委员会，不过我确实希望，它清除共产党影响的行动能更积极一些。

9907406bfbe62d5efdd8491ace8e1049987c6b35.source: I support the Israeli state, and I'm pleased that Truman and I are in agreement on this issue.
9907406bfbe62d5efdd8491ace8e1049987c6b35.zh: 我支持以色列，也很高兴杜鲁门和我在这个问题上意见一致。

fdb22c208b20bdb595ae2f24ca9a68c73c4eee5b.source: I support the Marshall Plan and believe that it is a force for the future peace and prosperity of our world.
fdb22c208b20bdb595ae2f24ca9a68c73c4eee5b.zh: 我支持马歇尔计划，认为它有助于世界未来的和平与繁荣。

b48d83e99567828b3a2bc538a7108495aa5e1a35.source: I support the Monroe Doctrine as established American policy.
b48d83e99567828b3a2bc538a7108495aa5e1a35.zh: 我支持门罗主义，这是美国既定的政策。

c8fbb3a839d3adc3492f44c33d4f611cca2b1b24.source: I support the War on Poverty as it stands. We have passed a lot of new initiatives and we should wait to see what effect they have. To me, cracking down on the law and order issues is more important.
c8fbb3a839d3adc3492f44c33d4f611cca2b1b24.zh: 我支持目前的向贫困宣战计划。我们已经推出许多新举措，应先看看它们的效果。对我来说，更重要的是强力解决治安与秩序问题。

75d73d069200cdf0a34d1037bb230818d4e82ec5.source: I support the annexation of Texas, so long as the admission of that state is paired with the admission of a free state. I will briefly mention that my positions on other issues are well-known and remain the same.
75d73d069200cdf0a34d1037bb230818d4e82ec5.zh: 我支持吞并得克萨斯，前提是接纳该州入联邦的同时，也接纳一个自由州。我会简要说明，我在其他议题上的立场众所周知，而且没有改变。

2d416b4a200861e8537fb8a1782f8886306fc4cb.source: I support the civil rights movement, but I'm a little concerned about the disregard for the law that some of these activists have shown.
2d416b4a200861e8537fb8a1782f8886306fc4cb.zh: 我支持民权运动，但一些活动人士漠视法律的做法，让我有些担忧。

368ff58130cdd31c96565d67f191f12b7aa7fb91.source: I support the coinage of silver, and this action was a step in the wrong direction. It took money out of the system when we needed it the most, and is partly to blame for the depth of our current downturn.
368ff58130cdd31c96565d67f191f12b7aa7fb91.zh: 我支持白银铸币，这个举动是倒退。我们最需要货币的时候，它却抽走了货币，也是当前萧条如此严重的部分原因。

986313e2482748bc47b1d982adbd60cb10a12df2.source: I support the expansion of benefits, which were set at fairly low levels during the 1930s and have been eaten up by our recent inflation.
986313e2482748bc47b1d982adbd60cb10a12df2.zh: 我支持提高福利待遇。它们在1930年代定得相当低，又被近期的通货膨胀侵蚀了。

805bf7cb51c4f6af2be4ddf1932ca01a05e6c484.source: I support the free, unlimited coinage of silver at a fixed price ratio of 16-to-1 against gold.
805bf7cb51c4f6af2be4ddf1932ca01a05e6c484.zh: 我支持以固定的金银比价16∶1，自由、无限制地铸造银币。

14c1115b61e157055f36d407df6f8904f0c4e486.source: I support the free, unlimited coinage of silver at the current market price of 30-to-1 against gold. This ratio should be frequently adjusted to match actual prices in order to avoid another run on the Treasury's gold supply.
14c1115b61e157055f36d407df6f8904f0c4e486.zh: 我支持按当前市场价格，以金银比价30∶1自由、无限制地铸造银币。这个比价应当经常调整，以符合实际价格，避免国库的黄金储备再次遭到挤兑。

725dc6ac4a694d4369af77cf8bf440e9ba35a2fc.source: I support the hardworking teachers and firefighters of Ohio and elsewhere.
725dc6ac4a694d4369af77cf8bf440e9ba35a2fc.zh: 我支持俄亥俄州及其他地方辛勤工作的教师和消防员。

857b36f76559822ce9f148ba6e98adbbf7d9c948.source: I support the overall thrust of this policy. Foreign trade supports our Cold War allies, reduces the cost of goods in America, and supports a broader economic prosperity.
857b36f76559822ce9f148ba6e98adbbf7d9c948.zh: 我支持这项政策的总体方向。对外贸易能支持我们的冷战盟友、降低美国商品价格，并促进更广泛的经济繁荣。

d202d0770b3bc3021cdba11a779ee7307018378f.source: I support the passage of a Constitutional amendment protecting the right of women to vote.
d202d0770b3bc3021cdba11a779ee7307018378f.zh: 我支持通过一项宪法修正案，保障妇女的投票权。

5ca7703e73bfc950789d1f24d5a95e7f043d3143.source: I support the passage of this Amendment, and think it is a good thing for America.
5ca7703e73bfc950789d1f24d5a95e7f043d3143.zh: 我支持通过这项修正案，认为它对美国有益。

88a9857d9ffdd712f653aa972aa4ccb767db1f2c.source: I support the personal liberty laws, and would favor a repeal or scaling back of the Fugitive Slave Law.
88a9857d9ffdd712f653aa972aa4ccb767db1f2c.zh: 我支持个人自由法，也赞成废除或削弱《逃奴法》。

9bdd93cfe0971e77c6361d53c3884d8bc8623ad0.source: I support the right for local schools to decide whether to include a daily, voluntary prayer.
9bdd93cfe0971e77c6361d53c3884d8bc8623ad0.zh: 我支持地方学校自行决定，是否每天开展自愿祈祷。

16b554589a1ceb4378677c9d0e911d626df4a54b.source: I support the right of women to control their reproductive destiny. This should be defended at the federal level.
16b554589a1ceb4378677c9d0e911d626df4a54b.zh: 我支持妇女掌握自身生育命运的权利。联邦政府应当捍卫这一权利。

e8e671a65edca8cd4817a41f57d3e4a66dc2c817.source: I support the right to bear arms, with a couple of common-sense restrictions. We need background checks at gun shows, and better prevention measures to keep guns away from the mentally ill.
e8e671a65edca8cd4817a41f57d3e4a66dc2c817.zh: 我支持持有武器的权利，也支持一些合乎常理的限制。我们需要在枪展上进行背景审查，并采取更好的预防措施，防止精神疾病患者获得枪支。

51c47fc3e52bfa8eccfcd81cacae81c45051c333.source: I support the traditional policy of non-interference in European affairs, as is best for our national interest.
51c47fc3e52bfa8eccfcd81cacae81c45051c333.zh: 我支持传统上不干预欧洲事务的政策，这最符合我国的利益。

118c56707f8434a65f9846c42ec4bc87ed8a2e65.source: I support these international trade negotiations, but we must be sure that we don't undermine the rights of our own unions with one-sided agreements.
118c56707f8434a65f9846c42ec4bc87ed8a2e65.zh: 我支持这些国际贸易谈判，但必须确保我们不会签下片面的协议，损害本国工会的权益。

746baaf79425a0a1406e925b5f9f11d3f152649c.source: I support this Amendment as a necessary step towards the political health of this nation. We need to, periodically,  have a fresh point of view in government. Ours is not an imperial nation.
746baaf79425a0a1406e925b5f9f11d3f152649c.zh: 我支持这项修正案，认为它是保障国家政治健康的必要一步。我们需要定期为政府注入新的视角。我们不是一个帝国。

2529c113dd14b141836348bf5e3429d2d082c5a7.source: I support this aid and think it is a necessary step to combat the Soviet Union.
2529c113dd14b141836348bf5e3429d2d082c5a7.zh: 我支持这项援助，认为它是对抗苏联的必要一步。

fc4d29492add553a49b162ad4a1459bc120cd559.source: I support this aid, but I think we could have been more careful about the cost.
fc4d29492add553a49b162ad4a1459bc120cd559.zh: 我支持这项援助，不过认为我们本可以更谨慎地控制成本。

6c0e9485b5955bfc7dbc36c44b73761c0949a3bd.source: I support this as a positive step, and I'm eager to see how current negotiations play out.
6c0e9485b5955bfc7dbc36c44b73761c0949a3bd.zh: 我支持这样做，认为它是积极的一步，也很期待看到目前的谈判结果。

da5ba24dfe149f704011e635d4ae67b883a3a761.source: I support this deal, but I will work very hard as President to see that it is aggressively enforced.
da5ba24dfe149f704011e635d4ae67b883a3a761.zh: 我支持这项协议，但当上总统后，我会非常努力，确保严格执行它。

8c6cc6cc676e52a59c42fc1d266efe93f2740db2.source: I support this kind of thing in limited cases where there is a clear threat. But I'm worried about some of the ill-defined, open ended commitments we are getting ourselves into with other countries, and with the United Nations.
8c6cc6cc676e52a59c42fc1d266efe93f2740db2.zh: 在威胁明确的少数情况下，我支持这类行动。但我们对其他国家以及联合国作出的一些承诺，界限不清，也没有终点，这让我担忧。

cbd5c8273bfc8bfdd198b853a062927124d7fd42.source: I support this measure, and believe it would be greatly beneficial to millions of American workers.
cbd5c8273bfc8bfdd198b853a062927124d7fd42.zh: 我支持这项措施，相信它会使数百万美国劳动者大受裨益。

8c548e04ffba1f42ed3bf714db3f4022a33cde85.source: I support this program, but I'm concerned with some of the actions I'm seeing from the FBI and the House Un-American Activities Committee. We need to balance this program with appropriate concern for due process and civil liberties.
8c548e04ffba1f42ed3bf714db3f4022a33cde85.zh: 我支持这项计划，但联邦调查局和非美活动调查委员会的一些行动让我担忧。实施计划时，我们必须兼顾正当法律程序和公民自由。

f74a3fc3e0d7625c5676d0be7c98e0a5663eb75b.source: I support unions and I oppose the excesses of leaders such as Jimmy Hoffa. Unions, cleansed of their corrupt elements, should play a central role in the American economy.
f74a3fc3e0d7625c5676d0be7c98e0a5663eb75b.zh: 我支持工会，反对吉米·霍法等领导人的过度行为。清除腐败分子之后，工会应该在美国经济中发挥核心作用。

061eb68da461f023ad81401e6723f2f26cd6778c.source: I support universal health care coverage in this country, financed by the federal government.
061eb68da461f023ad81401e6723f2f26cd6778c.zh: 我支持由联邦政府出资，在本国实现全民医疗保障。

cb3cbeb74fe0d6a4d507bc704133974d3f86fc13.source: I supported both of these actions in general. I criticized specific aspects of their implementation. I'm interested to know why Bush would distort the truth on this.
cb3cbeb74fe0d6a4d507bc704133974d3f86fc13.zh: 总体而言，这两次行动我都支持。我批评的是实施过程中的具体问题。我倒想知道，布什为什么要在这件事上歪曲事实。

a98b7743eeb2c233edaa1a1e48e89e2e21362077.source: I take a very narrow view of the term "monopoly". There is a need for these statutes but they open up a lot of danger for political witch hunts.
a98b7743eeb2c233edaa1a1e48e89e2e21362077.zh: 我对“垄断”采取非常狭义的解释。这些法律确有必要，但也容易被用来发动政治迫害。

1e57d85084065cc4a8922b3245f1c13f4d711b84.source: I talked to a lot of terrific women, including several African-Americans, and ultimately I went with the person who was most ready to be President from day one. That doesn't mean it wasn't a tough decision.
1e57d85084065cc4a8922b3245f1c13f4d711b84.zh: 我与许多出色的女性谈过，包括几位非裔美国人。最终，我选择了从第一天起最能胜任总统的人。这并不意味着，决定并不艰难。

c24ebf3f34cc8123e0cba270b66656a742090c04.source: I talked with a lot of people before I made my decision, and Karen Bass stood out as someone with the judgment and experience to work with me in the White House.
c24ebf3f34cc8123e0cba270b66656a742090c04.zh: 决定之前，我与许多人谈过，卡伦·巴斯因其判断力和经验脱颖而出，能够在白宫与我共事。

5432b76ed833f9c0dd6f649baafe361f642623cc.source: I talked with a lot of people before I made my decision, but Susan Rice stood out as someone who is extremely well-rounded, intelligent, and able to help our Administration in multiple ways over the next four years.
5432b76ed833f9c0dd6f649baafe361f642623cc.zh: 决定之前，我与许多人谈过，但苏珊·赖斯脱颖而出。她能力全面、聪慧，能在未来四年从多个方面帮助我们的政府。

89c693d0067f1bf62ecaf5660a129c50a4b67df2.source: I think anyone is aware of Hubert Humphrey's position and we're glad to have him on our ticket. We plan to look at any reasonable measure in this area.
89c693d0067f1bf62ecaf5660a129c50a4b67df2.zh: 我想，大家都了解休伯特·汉弗莱的立场，我们也很高兴他加入竞选组合。我们打算考虑这个领域内的任何合理措施。

943ddca1b72c57ea96f91772bd0cad9f8da0c500.source: I think anyone who has managed money can tell you there is a place for U.S. Treasuries in any professional portfolio. Allowing the Social Security fund to invest in other securities opens a huge number of potential problems and conflicts of interest.
943ddca1b72c57ea96f91772bd0cad9f8da0c500.zh: 我想，任何管理过资金的人都能告诉你，专业投资组合里，总有美国国债的位置。允许社会保障基金投资其他证券，会带来大量潜在问题与利益冲突。

c21d257314404fe812b8c53e65a17e2291616c4f.source: I think civil unions are an acceptable compromise for the majority of mainstream Americans.
c21d257314404fe812b8c53e65a17e2291616c4f.zh: 我认为，对大多数美国主流民众来说，民事结合是一种可以接受的折中方案。

96344b3b8d5807a7e00609ae3e1c05bb4295f591.source: I think if Ronald Reagan hopes for a future in this party, he'd better toe the party line when it comes to our election this fall.
96344b3b8d5807a7e00609ae3e1c05bb4295f591.zh: 我认为，如果罗纳德·里根希望在本党有前途，就最好在今年秋季选举中遵守党的路线。

9e1cbfac897822d8eb08dfd3b603c0b1054dba9d.source: I think it is a noble goal, but it would add too much of a financial burden to the federal budget, which is already running a deficit.
9e1cbfac897822d8eb08dfd3b603c0b1054dba9d.zh: 我认为目标很高尚，但它会给已经存在赤字的联邦预算增添过重负担。

c470605770a04653a967d4246e3ebd69b519e9f0.source: I think it would make a good TV ad if we went to Texas and spoke with some of the people who have been put out of work by the oil crash there. Let's ask them how they feel about the Reagan economy.
c470605770a04653a967d4246e3ebd69b519e9f0.zh: 我想，去得克萨斯州访问一些因当地石油业崩跌而失业的人，会是一则不错的电视广告。问问他们对里根经济有什么感受吧。

a3c2bae475912a16bdd28a276df63b63722e2232.source: I think it's obvious that we plan to spend a lot of time campaigning with Bernie Sanders, and that we're making a real effort to incorporate his message into our campaign.
a3c2bae475912a16bdd28a276df63b63722e2232.zh: 我想，很明显，我们计划花很多时间与伯尼·桑德斯共同竞选，也在认真努力，把他的主张融入我们的竞选。

3e2bb5b43e9da937803e91fd1a4e280e0a486e0b.source: I think my position on guns has been pretty clear, really. We've stood firm against any new restrictions on gun ownership.
3e2bb5b43e9da937803e91fd1a4e280e0a486e0b.zh: 我觉得，自己在枪支上的立场很清楚。我们一直坚定反对任何新的持枪限制。

bbca5d8a24c0da2e0ae58db601e673e85b881ca4.source: I think our best chance this year will come from winning the Midwest and Northeast. I can't make any promises about visiting the South.
bbca5d8a24c0da2e0ae58db601e673e85b881ca4.zh: 我认为，今年最好的机会来自赢下中西部和东北部。我不能承诺会访问南方。

ea5fa6a6070f97a01b9c21da4809696da74cbe18.source: I think part of any good campaign involves speaking about my past, and as Governor of New York I successfully pushed for some of the first anti-discrimination laws in the country.
ea5fa6a6070f97a01b9c21da4809696da74cbe18.zh: 我认为，任何出色的竞选都应当谈谈自己的经历。担任纽约州州长时，我成功推动了全国最早的一批反歧视法律。

1b5981b9f7bf9038db7819672813f34f2d4a6046.source: I think some people need to grow up and view our national security in a more realistic fashion.
1b5981b9f7bf9038db7819672813f34f2d4a6046.zh: 我认为，有些人需要成熟一点，以更现实的眼光看待国家安全。

49f2cbaac7efe961b1dce8601bbd59d8e3919374.source: I think that what we have now is sufficient. There's no need to constantly revisit this issue when the Border Patrol has seen documented success in reducing immigration over the past few years.
49f2cbaac7efe961b1dce8601bbd59d8e3919374.zh: 我认为现有措施已经足够。过去几年，边境巡逻队在减少移民入境方面取得了有据可查的成绩，没必要老是重新争论这个问题。

929459a7dfe8f974d48484d36cc81a6934d89c3c.source: I think that what we're doing now is fine. There is no point in revisiting this issue, since the Yucca Mountain plans have been scrapped in any case.
929459a7dfe8f974d48484d36cc81a6934d89c3c.zh: 我认为目前的做法没问题。反正尤卡山计划已经取消，再谈这个问题也没意义。

1172252b4a0d96ba2df43e04858b3a98238e1a08.source: I think that's a little extreme. I do support measures to assist displaced workers in Michigan as they seek other jobs and education.
1172252b4a0d96ba2df43e04858b3a98238e1a08.zh: 我认为，这有点过头了。不过，我支持帮助密歇根州失业工人寻找其他工作、接受教育的措施。

2c93b5791a8c0a2ad260eb951e9d2ffc237db35f.source: I think the current forms of tax exemptions and aid we have are sufficient. This would be another huge, costly, and complicated program to administer when we are trying to reduce our deficit.
2c93b5791a8c0a2ad260eb951e9d2ffc237db35f.zh: 我认为，现有的免税和援助方式已经足够。我们正在努力削减赤字，这又会是一个庞大、昂贵、管理复杂的项目。

dd396035c51788a4e4cef01893c11b0f3087677e.source: I think the fact that this regime collapsed so fast once American troops were gone shows how unsound it really was. We should have never fought the Vietnam War in the first place.
dd396035c51788a4e4cef01893c11b0f3087677e.zh: 美军撤离后，这个政权如此迅速地垮台，说明它本来就不稳固。我们根本就不该打越南战争。

9cc3a4c2b7ad7b9a361ca3da4e2bc014429a8923.source: I think the interview speaks for itself. We need to focus on the issues and not on tabloid gossip.
9cc3a4c2b7ad7b9a361ca3da4e2bc014429a8923.zh: 我认为，采访本身已经说得很清楚。我们应关注实际议题，而不是小报八卦。

e6c56d4b0121a1318e33197acb7d2daeb7532db3.source: I think the system we have in place is working. There will be ebbs and flows in the water level, but we've already seen it start to rebound the last couple of years.
e6c56d4b0121a1318e33197acb7d2daeb7532db3.zh: 我认为，现行制度运作良好。水位会有起有落，但过去几年，我们已经看到它开始回升。

49ed21211c91fcba08d09dddf037152f04f5fc95.source: I think there are better themes to touch on. Let's focus on our plans for national defense and economic growth, and also focus more on Kennedy's inexperience.
49ed21211c91fcba08d09dddf037152f04f5fc95.zh: 我认为，有更好的主题值得讨论。让我们着重谈国防和经济增长计划，也更多强调肯尼迪缺乏经验。

c0b4495a7d6f05cae6b2809ac4eeaadda8a9157d.source: I think there are definitely programs that the federal government can get involved in to improve public health, but I also support our current system of private care and insurance.
c0b4495a7d6f05cae6b2809ac4eeaadda8a9157d.zh: 我认为，联邦政府确实可以参与一些改善公共健康的计划，但我也支持现行的私人医疗服务和保险体系。

6955f8716128cbbb3d1631e4490dab7fa0229c9e.source: I think there are legitimate questions to be asked about how much the Communists have embedded themselves into departments of the government. I support the measures we have in place to combat this.
6955f8716128cbbb3d1631e4490dab7fa0229c9e.zh: 共产党人在政府部门中究竟扎根多深，确实值得追问。我支持现有的应对措施。

7145a003fc13d70c4049c1c90cde5e6cf1b596b6.source: I think there are more important issues for us to be focusing our efforts on. Extending the suffrage to women carries with it a whole host of dangers.
7145a003fc13d70c4049c1c90cde5e6cf1b596b6.zh: 我认为，还有更重要的问题值得投入精力。把选举权扩大到妇女，会带来各种各样的危险。

21f54743c788a127082a914eb8f50aae1c6a18b9.source: I think there's a lot of blame for both sides. Surely we can all agree that violence cannot be condoned, whatever the source.
21f54743c788a127082a914eb8f50aae1c6a18b9.zh: 我认为双方都有不少责任。无论暴力来自哪一方，都不能纵容，这一点大家总能同意吧。

cc0a7bcebda70e557540efcf04da5b632fafd2a3.source: I think these programs need to be phased out over time, but in such a way that we don't bring sudden instability to our nation's farm policy.
cc0a7bcebda70e557540efcf04da5b632fafd2a3.zh: 我认为，这些计划需要逐步取消，但实施方式不能突然扰乱本国农业政策的稳定。

32e30aa92e6a2c26f8bbe890d6edb1da3511e85f.source: I think this bodes ill for the future of American politics. I support debate on legitimate political issues, but not the casual and spurious accusations about Communist sympathies.
32e30aa92e6a2c26f8bbe890d6edb1da3511e85f.zh: 我认为，这对美国政治的未来不是好兆头。我支持围绕正当的政治议题辩论，但不支持随意、无根据地指控别人同情共产主义。

d8f205759651b891410e79814db886d6002b5987.source: I think this is a good idea that will show I'm serious about openness in government.
d8f205759651b891410e79814db886d6002b5987.zh: 我认为这是个好主意，能表明我认真对待政府的公开透明。

c4fab75d179c8ce96e2f4fe740c35b1c02a82938.source: I think this is a good idea, and we need something to shake this campaign up.
c4fab75d179c8ce96e2f4fe740c35b1c02a82938.zh: 我认为这是个好主意，我们也需要一些事情来改变竞选局势。

432119e455a9540f53f166816d2a5b5bad2b09c0.source: I think this is a naive, misguided campaign that will split liberal support and risks putting George W. Bush in the White House. I will attack Nader's campaign and call upon him to withdraw.
432119e455a9540f53f166816d2a5b5bad2b09c0.zh: 我认为这场竞选天真而误入歧途，会分散自由派的支持，有可能把乔治·W.布什送进白宫。我会攻击纳德的竞选，并呼吁他退出。

e8a935205e0a42119f8a7935eb93531fac0dc120.source: I think this is a necessary expedient which we should implement immediately. It is important to set a precedent now, before other countries develop the bomb, that nuclear war will never again become state policy.
e8a935205e0a42119f8a7935eb93531fac0dc120.zh: 我认为，这是必要的应对办法，应该立即实施。在其他国家研制出核弹之前，我们必须确立先例：核战争绝不能再成为国家政策。

f8f94306c28107166fddf7e1861b06bd7b1e0b7b.source: I think this just serves to reinforce how detached and out of touch Romney is from the average working American. This is a man who spends more money maintaining a horse than most people earn in an entire year.
f8f94306c28107166fddf7e1861b06bd7b1e0b7b.zh: 我认为，这只能再次证明罗姆尼与普通美国劳动者有多疏远、多脱离现实。这个人养一匹马花的钱，比多数人一整年挣的还多。

6be6b7683108631cd4436f8c79184cd8ec7e54cc.source: I think we can do everything we can to discourage abortion. But I'd say it depends ... if we're talking about making abortion illegal then that's a different story. You can be pro-life without saying it should be illegal.
6be6b7683108631cd4436f8c79184cd8ec7e54cc.zh: 我认为，我们可以尽一切努力阻止堕胎。不过，我会说，要看情况……如果我们谈的是将堕胎定为非法，那就是另一回事了。你可以反对堕胎，但不主张它应该违法。

5ffc90372cafc57f7f6fc5c0a760a06e5d21c6d2.source: I think we can take limited steps to bring this trade back into balance, but in general we should celebrate the expansion of world trade with our allies.
5ffc90372cafc57f7f6fc5c0a760a06e5d21c6d2.zh: 我认为，可以采取有限措施，使这项贸易恢复平衡。但总体而言，我们应该欢迎与盟友之间的世界贸易扩展。

f11b61f0a7c072dd6a8b9026e2dd8809aae183b6.source: I think we could be doing more to purchase homes from the banks, and perhaps rent them out until the situation improves. This would help support a price recovery.
f11b61f0a7c072dd6a8b9026e2dd8809aae183b6.zh: 我认为，我们可以做更多事，从银行手中收购房屋，或许先出租，直到情况改善。这会有助于房价回升。

231dd62e85fb2570e46dee1b04e327320eb9821b.source: I think we have more to lose than to gain by going after the black vote heavily. So many Republican politicians have proven the futility of that course of action.
231dd62e85fb2570e46dee1b04e327320eb9821b.zh: 我认为，大力争取黑人选票，得不偿失。已经有那么多共和党政客证明，这种做法徒劳无功。

77b8f5ad6b29dc99b973289f17ea98dc43e3cb86.source: I think we need to preserve a level of dignity in this campaign, and talking about things like sodomy and bestiality might be a little bit too far for some people.
77b8f5ad6b29dc99b973289f17ea98dc43e3cb86.zh: 我认为，这场竞选需要保持一定尊严，谈论鸡奸与兽交之类的事情，对某些人来说可能有些过头。

e6c115dd0ebf10052f191e155023d65e8c9f932d.source: I think we've done enough in this area. My goal as President will be to move beyond the strife and scandals of the past few years.
e6c115dd0ebf10052f191e155023d65e8c9f932d.zh: 我认为，我们在这个领域已经做得够多了。担任总统后，我的目标是让国家走出过去几年的冲突和丑闻。

f8e90330478663c78cabece4fb9c74bccf387ee7.source: I think you've seen with my running mate that I take the Republican Party very seriously, and believe me, I want to see us win in November and prevent a complete disaster under Hillary Clinton.
f8e90330478663c78cabece4fb9c74bccf387ee7.zh: 我想，从我的搭档人选就能看出，我非常认真地对待共和党。相信我，我想看到我们在十一月获胜，避免希拉里·克林顿执政带来的全面灾难。

8509e73989e87ba42b2b5b2edb4ac256929e744d.source: I want to see us pass a gigantic tax cut for the middle and the working class. That's really where the focus should be -- we've got to get everyday Americans spending again to make this country great.
8509e73989e87ba42b2b5b2edb4ac256929e744d.zh: 我希望我们为中产阶级和工人阶级通过大规模减税。这才是我们真正该聚焦的——必须让普通美国人重新消费，让这个国家伟大起来。

884bcf6a512a69e34144f7a72eb1e4477c0d6196.source: I want to see us running ads on TV, criticizing this relationship. Along with Iran-Contra and Dan Quayle, this episode really brings up questions about Bush's competence.
884bcf6a512a69e34144f7a72eb1e4477c0d6196.zh: 我希望我们投放电视广告，批评这种关系。加上伊朗门和丹·奎尔，这件事确实让人怀疑布什的能力。

c1247d4f15e5f79ee39685831b7621e11d9c2922.source: I want to tie myself to Reagan as closely as possible. He is a broadly popular figure in this country.
c1247d4f15e5f79ee39685831b7621e11d9c2922.zh: 我想尽可能紧密地与里根联系起来。他在全国广受欢迎。

f770cb605f610f2578afc094dbab1b8c8137a3e1.source: I want us to do a high-profile appearance with Bernie in Michigan, once the campaign gets going. We don't agree on every issue, but I want to embrace his economic message and show people that our party is unified.
f770cb605f610f2578afc094dbab1b8c8137a3e1.zh: 竞选展开后，我希望我们与伯尼在密歇根州高调共同亮相。我们并非在每个议题上都一致，但我想接受他的经济主张，让大家看到本党的团结。

890accb8bb0c2f975c7328f5f822557e080a1328.source: I want us to focus on Pennsylvania, with maybe a quick stop over the border in Ohio.
890accb8bb0c2f975c7328f5f822557e080a1328.zh: 我希望我们聚焦宾夕法尼亚州，也许越过州界，去俄亥俄州短暂停留。

445871c1cce7f158d62db8c604fe56814f68b38b.source: I want us to put all of our spare resources into Iowa and Minnesota.
445871c1cce7f158d62db8c604fe56814f68b38b.zh: 我要把一切富余资源都投入艾奥瓦和明尼苏达。

361b348fcdd9e0dd9855a71798bb1ff2ac2c31f7.source: I was a supporter of this deal at first, but I'm very disappointed to see some of the provisions that made it into the final version. I unfortunately cannot support the TPP at this point.
361b348fcdd9e0dd9855a71798bb1ff2ac2c31f7.zh: 我起初支持这项协议，但看到最终版本纳入的一些条款，感到非常失望。很遗憾，目前我不能支持跨太平洋伙伴关系协定。

74fbf8b537122e83ef8cecf4e89c209273f0e429.source: I was absolutely not involved with these dealings at any point, and I was appalled to find out about them.
74fbf8b537122e83ef8cecf4e89c209273f0e429.zh: 我在任何时候都绝对没有参与这些交易，得知此事时，我十分震惊。

23f2291c9cf3dd39cedc0fcfeca4b550f6b38c69.source: I was disappointed with this decision. I would certainly appoint judges who see the wisdom in teaching our kids a few lessons about morality.
23f2291c9cf3dd39cedc0fcfeca4b550f6b38c69.zh: 我对这个裁决感到失望。我一定会任命那些明白向孩子传授一些道德知识有其道理的法官。

11edea5007697627132fc5a5a6de7078b93a65f2.source: I was just asking questions, you know, and then we had this entire phony impeachment scandal. I never said he did something wrong, I just said we have to look into this, and we really should, and Ukraine is the country that can do it.
11edea5007697627132fc5a5a6de7078b93a65f2.zh: 你知道，我只是问些问题，结果就闹出整场虚假的弹劾丑闻。我从没说他做了坏事，只是说必须调查，也确实应该调查，而乌克兰正是能查的国家。

eb840ab2219f1a9f4393b27703bf228e2a5f256a.source: I was opposed to this bill. We might have provided land grants and funding for railroads in the past, but that practice will end under my Administration.
eb840ab2219f1a9f4393b27703bf228e2a5f256a.zh: 我反对这项法案。过去，我们或许提供过铁路赠地和资金，但在我的政府任内，这种做法将结束。

ccce94b8309dec6e120e442b1127794c7acf5f27.source: I was trying to have an honest conversation about the challenges of living a righteous life. I think once people stop and think about it, they will understand that.
ccce94b8309dec6e120e442b1127794c7acf5f27.zh: 我只是想坦诚谈谈过正直生活时面临的挑战。我想，人们只要停下来想一想，就会理解。

63cabb4f85bc16edf67b6b92d2af7260c91efcb8.source: I thought it was very interesting when this decision was handed down. And not all the judges agreed, but you know, what can I really say about it? These are extremely intelligent people, these judges.
63cabb4f85bc16edf67b6b92d2af7260c91efcb8.zh: 这个判决公布时，我觉得很有意思。也不是所有法官都同意。不过，你知道，我又真能说什么呢？这些法官都是极其聪明的人。

3d51c137c99fdc22d8bb1485893e5101616d8d1c.source: I trust that the European Union will find a way to resolve this issue.
3d51c137c99fdc22d8bb1485893e5101616d8d1c.zh: 我相信，欧盟会找到解决这个问题的办法。

918e586e3693fe052e302a0a74853da2ccc7c20a.source: I understand some of the issues with this. Nobody respects women more than I do, but at the same time, I have an absolutely tremendous amount of respect for Mike Pence.
918e586e3693fe052e302a0a74853da2ccc7c20a.zh: 我理解这其中的一些问题。没有人比我更尊重女性，但同时，我也极其尊重迈克·彭斯。

b381c023428cfce22b40f125ebbd3464153e6cba.source: I understand the impulse to help America's families, but the Reserve should be used in cases of national emergency only. This action is unwise.
b381c023428cfce22b40f125ebbd3464153e6cba.zh: 我理解帮助美国家庭的心愿，但储备只能在国家紧急情况下动用。这一行动并不明智。

491eff31f6580c44201952527af97339a4da8e38.source: I used the same email practices as Colin Powell and many other people in government. I was far too busy dealing with Russia, the Arab Spring, and the E.U. crisis to keep track of how IT was setting up my email system.
491eff31f6580c44201952527af97339a4da8e38.zh: 我采用的电子邮件做法，与科林·鲍威尔及许多政府人士相同。我忙着处理俄罗斯、阿拉伯之春和欧盟危机，根本无暇追踪信息技术人员如何配置我的邮件系统。

6eed1f68a20627b3d811c67af42f5c6b7d7fd8d5.source: I want Barack Obama to be actively involved in our campaign. And more specifically, I want him to really campaign hard in places like Detroit, Milwaukee, Philadelphia, and others where we need high levels of African-American support.
6eed1f68a20627b3d811c67af42f5c6b7d7fd8d5.zh: 我希望贝拉克·奥巴马积极参与我们的竞选。具体来说，我希望他在底特律、密尔沃基、费城等地大力助选，因为我们需要这些地方非裔美国人的高度支持。

9d86b5d2ea0d807cba3f2be561cbdede6a8174ca.source: I want Eisenhower to campaign up and down the Eastern Seaboard.
9d86b5d2ea0d807cba3f2be561cbdede6a8174ca.zh: 我希望艾森豪威尔在东海岸各地竞选。

94afe72e5050fdb820e714240f22029c2c481b5e.source: I want Eisenhower to focus on the Midwest.
94afe72e5050fdb820e714240f22029c2c481b5e.zh: 我希望艾森豪威尔集中争取中西部。

8327fba4ecb3233038be829c4a44033e92328048.source: I want Eisenhower to plant himself in New York, and to stay there until election day. That state is too important to take chances with.
8327fba4ecb3233038be829c4a44033e92328048.zh: 我希望艾森豪威尔一直待在纽约州，直到选举日。这个州太重要，不能冒险。

0735b7fc6bfa121a1d6d30dbaebd00724c9c7eb5.source: I want Eisenhower to travel to California and the West Coast.
0735b7fc6bfa121a1d6d30dbaebd00724c9c7eb5.zh: 我希望艾森豪威尔前往加利福尼亚州和西海岸。

ba64a8d397b1108e46925cca1d01e4a35fbe7bf3.source: I want Obama to make a targeted appeal to the African-American community to help make my case.
ba64a8d397b1108e46925cca1d01e4a35fbe7bf3.zh: 我希望奥巴马专门向非裔美国人社群发出呼吁，帮助说明支持我的理由。

c1bf7298c928fd77741f4fdaa9c98355b73016f3.source: I want to campaign this fall on the passage of a child labor law. I will personally appeal to any recalcitrant Senators, to consider the electoral success of Democrats this fall.
c1bf7298c928fd77741f4fdaa9c98355b73016f3.zh: 我想在今年秋季竞选中，把童工法的通过作为政绩。我会亲自向任何顽固阻挠的联邦参议员呼吁，让他们考虑民主党今年秋天的选举成败。

c38b78acc8a4b770f197a746f4db0150ae2842a7.source: I want to remain silent on this.

ce0471e743b93a5ea28f55b5c85f7ffe629b5d57.source: I want to run a series of compare-and-contrast advertisements, comparing my own humble background with that of George Bush.
ce0471e743b93a5ea28f55b5c85f7ffe629b5d57.zh: 我要投放一系列对比广告，将我自己平凡的出身与乔治·布什的出身相比较。

6abd413ffed22f56bc9b7c8fd94daee5cd9a2ab9.source: I was using "rapists" as a figure of speech. But I will, you know, remind people that Hillary Clinton was saying she was "adamantly against illegal immigrants". What made her change her mind?
6abd413ffed22f56bc9b7c8fd94daee5cd9a2ab9.zh: 我说“强奸犯”，只是一种修辞。不过，你知道，我要提醒大家，希拉里·克林顿以前说过自己“坚决反对非法移民”。是什么让她改变了主意？

99e353b2f175188cfe25dd4c95f2f69556ae90ef.source: I was very sad when the public option was taken out of the Affordable Care Act. This is something we must fight for over the coming years, along with adequate funding and controls on prices.
99e353b2f175188cfe25dd4c95f2f69556ae90ef.zh: 公共医保选项被从《平价医疗法案》中删除时，我非常难过。未来几年，我们必须争取恢复它，同时争取充分的资金和价格控制。

4e562c7ea3749fb5c8b9619032b4ec1f5b94d709.source: I will address the long-term danger that liberalism has to create an ossified, uncreative society. I will also emphasize the danger to our individual and collective rights that is inherent Obama's philosophy.
4e562c7ea3749fb5c8b9619032b4ec1f5b94d709.zh: 我会谈自由主义可能造成的长期危险：让社会僵化，失去创造力。我也会强调，奥巴马的理念本身给我们的个人及集体权利带来的威胁。

38aaf2873fa84d832612c8408fc95f1ef0818917.source: I will admit my guilt and apologize to the American people for hiding this story. I will say it was a mistake in judgment to believe that this would not come to light in our modern media environment.
38aaf2873fa84d832612c8408fc95f1ef0818917.zh: 我会承认过错，并为隐瞒此事向美国人民道歉。我会说，在现代媒体环境下，以为这件事不会曝光，是我判断失误。

fdf1f19a71163c4ee16bb1782a034ddae187fa0d.source: I will apologize about this whole mess. And I'll ask where Clinton's apology is for the email server, the war in Iraq, the dead ambassador in Benghazi, and so many other issues of importance.
fdf1f19a71163c4ee16bb1782a034ddae187fa0d.zh: 我会为这整场混乱道歉。然后，我会问：克林顿对邮件服务器、伊拉克战争、班加西遇难的大使，以及那么多其他重要事情，道歉又在哪里？

d8bf96d92381fcc3735dad0f541135014704f78b.source: I will apologize and admit that Playboy was not the best forum to discuss my Christian faith.
d8bf96d92381fcc3735dad0f541135014704f78b.zh: 我会道歉，并承认《花花公子》不是讨论基督教信仰的最佳场合。

361dd7aa7ef9a9ab69b086916a71486a48a845be.source: I will apologize for this remark when Trump apologizes for his "rapist" comments about Hispanics, his constant attacks on women, and his failure to condemn white supremicist supporters.
361dd7aa7ef9a9ab69b086916a71486a48a845be.zh: 等特朗普为把西班牙裔称作“强奸犯”、不断攻击女性，以及不肯谴责白人至上主义支持者而道歉时，我就会为这句话道歉。

e73d54d71f16485915e4e84c19f3f6f7a30a124a.source: I will appear in Pennsylvania and spend the latter half of the day in Ohio. These are two huge states that we can bring into the fold.
e73d54d71f16485915e4e84c19f3f6f7a30a124a.zh: 我会在宾夕法尼亚州露面，当天后半段前往俄亥俄州。这两个大州，我们都可能争取到。

f1f9ccd42ea90a5ad84d21ab90c4abfabedc8b5e.source: I will appear in Pennsylvania and spend the latter half of the day in Ohio. These are two huge states that we can secure.
f1f9ccd42ea90a5ad84d21ab90c4abfabedc8b5e.zh: 我会在宾夕法尼亚州露面，当天后半段前往俄亥俄州。这两个大州，我们都能争取到。

6a60927aa5fff6e088fed99a00a708d9bd9e9a6f.source: I will appoint judges who support religious freedom in the United States. Absolutely.
6a60927aa5fff6e088fed99a00a708d9bd9e9a6f.zh: 我会任命支持美国宗教自由的法官。当然会。

4764bbb5ad393075e4dc519093585327ec48ab03.source: I will ask the American people if they really want to vote for a third term of Bill Clinton, and remind them that I am the true conservative alternative. I will remind them of Al Gore's campaign finance violations and frequent misrepresentations to the American people.
4764bbb5ad393075e4dc519093585327ec48ab03.zh: 我会问美国人民，他们是不是真的想投票给比尔·克林顿的第三届任期，并提醒他们，我才是真正的保守派选择。我会提醒他们，阿尔·戈尔违反竞选资金规定，还经常向美国人民作不实陈述。

e6003edcdf7532a0d91b93dfdd0d7e57c9c50342.source: I will attack George Bush relentlessly. I will expose Bush as a phony and an elitist, corporatist conservative and not as the moderate that he presents himself as.
e6003edcdf7532a0d91b93dfdd0d7e57c9c50342.zh: 我会不断攻击乔治·布什。我会揭露布什是个虚伪的人，是精英主义、亲大企业的保守派，而不是他自己所描绘的温和派。

54dcb30f31b80486526496c3dcdcd2114158ee07.source: I will attack the idea that any good Protestant would vote against my candidacy because I happen to be a Catholic.
54dcb30f31b80486526496c3dcdcd2114158ee07.zh: 我要抨击这样的想法：只因为我恰好是天主教徒，一位正直的新教徒就应该投票反对我。

d83b649dfebe342782f76632783080bde9dc9f53.source: I will avoid any mention of Texas. The main focus of my acceptance will be an elucidation of my economic principles, including a national bank, a tariff, and internal improvemnets.
d83b649dfebe342782f76632783080bde9dc9f53.zh: 我将完全不提得克萨斯。接受提名的信将主要阐明我的经济原则，包括国家银行、关税和国内公共工程。

5cd160f482d1f409808549883a155c5a79b7243e.source: I will be a President for all Americans. Black, brown, Latino, gay, straight, Christian, Jewish, Muslim, rich, poor, or middle-class. I'm a uniter, not a divider.
5cd160f482d1f409808549883a155c5a79b7243e.zh: 我要做全体美国人的总统。黑人、棕色人种、拉丁裔，同性恋、异性恋，基督徒、犹太教徒、穆斯林，富人、穷人，或中产阶级。我会团结大家，而不是制造分裂。

b143d363e00ee44aae64137c8a17c77b3f8d0012.source: I will be very proud to continue with the policies and economy that Obama has left our country with.
b143d363e00ee44aae64137c8a17c77b3f8d0012.zh: 我将非常自豪地延续奥巴马给国家留下的政策与经济局面。

455195927d500d75a5d529830a773ee8f2be5163.source: I will break precedent by actively campaigning, and I will focus my stops in the state of Illinois.
455195927d500d75a5d529830a773ee8f2be5163.zh: 我将打破先例，积极开展竞选，并把行程重点放在伊利诺伊州。

f916961060aff4423a20f3c58547ca3145013f9b.source: I will break precedent by actively campaigning, and I will focus my stops in the state of New York.
f916961060aff4423a20f3c58547ca3145013f9b.zh: 我将打破先例，积极开展竞选，并把行程重点放在纽约州。

8357ec0acbc58918a2c9e39514df64fef59ba7c2.source: I will bring new, dynamic leadership to this country as President. I don't see how this line of argument puts me at any disadvantage.
8357ec0acbc58918a2c9e39514df64fef59ba7c2.zh: 作为总统，我将为这个国家带来新颖、充满活力的领导。我看不出，这种论点怎么会让我处于劣势。

d4afbf8d1e93b180e956285e4e16c1fb1dddaf5d.source: I will call on all Americans who have been cast aside by our winner-take-all economy and our lopsided tax cuts, to unite and send the Republicans a clear message this fall.
d4afbf8d1e93b180e956285e4e16c1fb1dddaf5d.zh: 我将号召所有被赢家通吃的经济和偏向一方的减税政策抛在身后的美国人团结起来，今年秋天向共和党发出明确的信息。

2e539a786257aa9a3e00737dc3ae566a9726b1cb.source: I will campaign as a conciliatory, moderate conservative. I will emphasize my record as the Governor of Texas, and my support across different groups and parties. We will minimize any talk of budget cuts or overturning existing programs. We will resist the temptation to criticize Bill Clinton.
2e539a786257aa9a3e00737dc3ae566a9726b1cb.zh: 我会作为一位愿意和解的温和保守派展开竞选。我会强调自己担任得克萨斯州州长的政绩，以及跨群体、跨党派的支持。我们会尽量少谈削减预算或推翻现有项目，也会克制批评比尔·克林顿的冲动。

82eccf4c8c3e552e811607d8beb79bd333f93900.source: I will campaign as a mainstream liberal Democrat, emphasizing key parts of our platform and pressing the case for more vigilance in our national defense.
82eccf4c8c3e552e811607d8beb79bd333f93900.zh: 我会以主流自由派民主党人的身份竞选，强调党纲的关键部分，并力陈加强国防警惕的必要性。

fc47adbc88b3366e91572f73a99ff869102312f6.source: I will casually refer to Mr. Clinton as “the rapist” and imply that his people, including Hillary, have silenced a number of people over the years who tried to speak out.
fc47adbc88b3366e91572f73a99ff869102312f6.zh: 我会随口称克林顿先生为“强奸犯”，并暗示，多年来，他身边的人，包括希拉里，让许多试图发声的人闭了嘴。

5ac46ea3be5d9c898f6263f54ce6841872382500.source: I will compare and contrast my business record with the corruption and incompetence of Hillary Clinton, and question why she is even allowed to run for President. We're going to Make America Great Again!
5ac46ea3be5d9c898f6263f54ce6841872382500.zh: 我会对比自己的经商成绩与希拉里·克林顿的腐败、无能，并质问，为何竟然允许她竞选总统。我们要让美国再次伟大！

220331305879b344f235550aeccee24710023cba.source: I will compare and contrast my stellar business record with the corruption and incompetence of Hillary Clinton, and remind voters of my views on Obamacare, tax cuts, and immigration. We're going to Make America Great Again.
220331305879b344f235550aeccee24710023cba.zh: 我要把自己辉煌的商业成绩，与希拉里·克林顿的腐败和无能作比较，也要提醒选民我在奥巴马医改、减税和移民上的立场。我们要让美国再次伟大。

534966dbf35d64940804a6d6d326d80c078914c6.source: I will concentrate on Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio.
534966dbf35d64940804a6d6d326d80c078914c6.zh: 我将把精力集中在伊利诺伊、印第安纳和俄亥俄。

f9ed8c5b0c70bb86d489df83f3106db11dde60a8.source: I will crack down on dope-smoking, homosexuality, LSD binging, illegal protesting, and flag-burning. These practices are the tools of left-wingers and Communists who wish to undermine our society.
f9ed8c5b0c70bb86d489df83f3106db11dde60a8.zh: 我会严厉打击吸毒、同性恋、滥用迷幻药、非法抗议和焚烧国旗。这些都是左翼分子和共产党人用来破坏我们社会的手段。

e5579e58d2eb91d6105e691e945d6ced659f373c.source: I will deemphasize the political aspect of this campaign, as much as practicable, and emphasize my own personality and leadership ability. Of course I will still make strong statements on the Cold War.
e5579e58d2eb91d6105e691e945d6ced659f373c.zh: 我会尽可能淡化这场竞选的政治色彩，强调自己的个性和领导能力。当然，我仍会在冷战问题上发表强硬言论。

b1f1b913a1d45b368343ebd22bc1aa76b22c3adf.source: I will defend a woman's right to choose against any type of outside attack or meddling. We need to fight the recent attacks on abortion access.
b1f1b913a1d45b368343ebd22bc1aa76b22c3adf.zh: 我会捍卫女性的选择权，反对任何外来的攻击或干涉。我们需要抵抗近期对堕胎服务获取渠道的攻击。

9e762065ceef5ca976f7a7e81e218ab4245694f6.source: I will defer to military brass on this question. They should do whatever best protects American interests and the safety of our troops.
9e762065ceef5ca976f7a7e81e218ab4245694f6.zh: 在这个问题上，我会尊重军方高层的判断。他们应该采取最能维护美国利益与我军安全的做法。

0af0e3b8dd2a7f5300f360a69c4e4d67acbe32da.source: I will definitely take someone's views on the rights of the unborn into account when making judicial appointments.
0af0e3b8dd2a7f5300f360a69c4e4d67acbe32da.zh: 任命法官时，我肯定会考虑其对未出生者权利的观点。
