112e7cfb649bc0bf230cdffb45357b10f13ee602.source: I will definitely work towards the control of nuclear weapons as President. I sincerely hope that we can work out a reasonable agreement on this issue.
112e7cfb649bc0bf230cdffb45357b10f13ee602.zh: 担任总统后，我一定会努力推动核武器控制。我衷心希望我们能就此达成合理协议。

997f29aea31d93eea61017ce9163f481eb26c46a.source: I will dispatch a military expedition into Mexico to apprehend Pancho Villa. The expedition will operate in any area where the Carranza government does not have control.
997f29aea31d93eea61017ce9163f481eb26c46a.zh: 我将派远征军进入墨西哥，抓捕潘乔·比利亚。远征军将在卡兰萨政府没有控制的任何地区行动。

fafcd29d9c0d4672c696087d17dfbf1d73ec5ef4.source: I will do a much better job than the clueless Democrats when it comes our national security. Democrats couldn't even guard a single embassy, and they say they can defeat ISIS?
fafcd29d9c0d4672c696087d17dfbf1d73ec5ef4.zh: 在国家安全方面，我会比那帮毫无头绪的民主党人做得好得多。民主党连一座使馆都保护不了，还说自己能打败“伊斯兰国”？

990698854ee6c810be32c665eeac01e993840119.source: I will do everything in my power to defend the Great Society initiatives that we have. In those cases where these programs fail to eradicate poverty, I will not hesitate to augment them.
990698854ee6c810be32c665eeac01e993840119.zh: 我会竭尽所能，捍卫现有的伟大社会举措。如果这些项目未能消除贫困，我会毫不犹豫地加强它们。

9dd2fa02fb34ce613a77c2bb3ed158214bc3feae.source: I will examine this issue very carefully. If government has helped to finance some of these railroads, it's only fair for government to have a say in their operations.
9dd2fa02fb34ce613a77c2bb3ed158214bc3feae.zh: 我会仔细研究这个问题。政府既然资助过某些铁路，就理应有权过问它们的经营。

11f1377ec9348682073763e38f68228ab4210d97.source: I will express my support for the annexation of Texas, and a favorable resolution to the Oregon situation. On other issues, we will continue Van Buren's efforts to establish an Independent Treasury, and will move to reduce tariffs.
11f1377ec9348682073763e38f68228ab4210d97.zh: 我将表明支持吞并得克萨斯，并支持以有利于我们的方式解决俄勒冈问题。在其他议题上，我们将继续范布伦设立独立国库的努力，并推动降低关税。

958d17cd3c6852d49aa4114c1272d3fb47c49502.source: I will fight hard to preserve the landmark Affordable Care Act when I am President. This program is one of Barack Obama's great legacies.
958d17cd3c6852d49aa4114c1272d3fb47c49502.zh: 我当上总统后，会全力维护具有里程碑意义的《平价医疗法案》。这个项目是贝拉克·奥巴马的一项重大政治遗产。

f633ca133f62645d23e814c1dabf7589029ea886.source: I will focus extensively on how Republicans and Democrats alike have betrayed the American environment. I will hammer on the themes of carbon emissions, GMO crops, giveaways to corporations, and other areas where both parties have failed the American people.
f633ca133f62645d23e814c1dabf7589029ea886.zh: 我会着重说明，共和党和民主党如何共同背叛了美国的环境。我会紧抓碳排放、转基因作物、给企业输送好处，以及两党辜负美国人民的其他领域。

ec89c98aaf947589859c806020c80ed3d0ca5c05.source: I will focus extensively on how Republicans and Democrats alike have betrayed the American worker through trade agreements like NAFTA and a lack of protection for American industry. My campaign will focus on opponents of globalization who have no one else to vote for.
ec89c98aaf947589859c806020c80ed3d0ca5c05.zh: 我会着重说明，共和党和民主党如何通过《北美自由贸易协定》等贸易协议，以及不保护美国工业的做法，共同背叛了美国劳动者。我的竞选将着重争取那些没有其他候选人可选的反全球化人士。

e9ab2441ab2eedfa6b3a7339f267e48a99e59103.source: I will focus most of my speech on the need to win in Vietnam. I will promise the American people that with more aggressive action, we can end the war there and bring our troops home.
e9ab2441ab2eedfa6b3a7339f267e48a99e59103.zh: 我的演讲将主要强调必须赢得越南战争。我会向美国人民承诺：只要采取更积极的行动，我们就能结束那里的战争，让部队回家。

025612db803a7dafeb771b1d42ca12dab51f77fe.source: I will give a statement encouraging the State of Georgia to protect the safety of Mr. King, while criticizing him for participating in these inflammatory and illegal protests.
025612db803a7dafeb771b1d42ca12dab51f77fe.zh: 我会发表声明，敦促佐治亚州保护金先生的安全，同时批评他参与这些煽动性、非法的抗议。

8a156c5f25a6c03cc9355e2553a8d21145f2d3e6.source: I will give an honest speech about the challenges I was facing in 2009, what I did to address them, what I tried to do that was blocked by Republican obstructionism, and what jobs policies I will continue to push for in my second term.
8a156c5f25a6c03cc9355e2553a8d21145f2d3e6.zh: 我会坦诚地讲述2009年我面临的挑战、为应对这些挑战采取的行动、我试图做却遭共和党阻挠的事情，以及第二任期会继续推动哪些就业政策。

8eb626db104efc687fedfc34fa79c1895c6e4f8f.source: I will give one big speech in New York City to open my campaign. Even if winning that state is hopeless, we need the national press.
8eb626db104efc687fedfc34fa79c1895c6e4f8f.zh: 我会在纽约市发表一场重要演说，为竞选揭幕。即便赢下该州毫无希望，我们也需要全国媒体的关注。

54706b51c819f06655fee09045a103f9fc61da1f.source: I will hammer on the theme that Obama has completely failed the United States as President. He has presided over the largest deficit increases and highest unemployment rate in almost a hundred years.
54706b51c819f06655fee09045a103f9fc61da1f.zh: 我会反复强调，奥巴马作为总统，彻底辜负了美国。他执政期间，赤字增幅最大，失业率也达到近百年来最高。

8172a17fd887edb0d81f309eb720f548682fd4eb.source: I will do everything in my power to make a four-year degree available without cost to the students of tomorrow.
8172a17fd887edb0d81f309eb720f548682fd4eb.zh: 我会尽我所能，让未来的学生无需付费，就能取得四年制大学学位。

b6478c052e7d851f31a30bf44b357bde1bc05d4c.source: I will do my best to ensure that this program is managed soundly and does not become some kind of welfare program without accountability.
b6478c052e7d851f31a30bf44b357bde1bc05d4c.zh: 我会尽力确保这个项目管理得当，不让它变成一个无人问责的福利项目。

7a3a1274497732bc96b3d126bb108def024e208a.source: I will do what is necessary to preserve freedom and human rights in Syria. It's impossible to say whether that means committing the U.S. military or not at this point.
7a3a1274497732bc96b3d126bb108def024e208a.zh: 为了维护叙利亚的自由与人权，我会采取必要行动。目前还无法说，这是否意味着动用美军。

ef6e86ce179995f95d72c5b4d7630757510b3c66.source: I will emphasize my record and experience as Governor of Texas. I will remind voters that I have worked across the aisle, won support from many different groups, and will be a uniter, not a divider, when I arrive in Washington.
ef6e86ce179995f95d72c5b4d7630757510b3c66.zh: 我会强调自己担任得克萨斯州州长的政绩和经验。提醒选民，我曾跨党派合作，赢得许多不同群体的支持；到了华盛顿，我会团结人民，而不是制造分裂。

5fe33719bcf8778023234a6cc596929017ddb51c.source: I will emphasize my record and experience as Vice President to Bill Clinton. Voters are satisfied with the economy and direction of the country, and it is my job to continue the policies that have led to our current prosperity.
5fe33719bcf8778023234a6cc596929017ddb51c.zh: 我会强调自己担任比尔·克林顿副总统期间的政绩和经验。选民对经济和国家方向感到满意，我的任务就是延续那些带来当前繁荣的政策。

e6d9ca9ab8514f52c8a5032f0df194035fe170b2.source: I will emphasize that I am my own man, and that I believe the one-sided neutrality of Woodrow Wilson is at risk of pushing us into a war with Germany.
e6d9ca9ab8514f52c8a5032f0df194035fe170b2.zh: 我会强调自己有独立的主张，并认为伍德罗·威尔逊片面的中立政策，有把我们推入对德战争的危险。

115828122ab6c28df2bd47973bca7dd3165bc23b.source: I will emphasize that I am self-funding and independent from special interests. Then I will document to the last detail who Hillary Clinton has taken money from, and what she did for them. Can you say Goldman Sachs?!
115828122ab6c28df2bd47973bca7dd3165bc23b.zh: 我会强调，竞选是我自己出钱，不受特殊利益集团控制。然后，我会把希拉里·克林顿收过谁的钱、替他们做过什么，一一记录到最后一个细节。听说过高盛吗？！

0df80313f83be4318b4623ecce0195c36249a72e.source: I will emphasize that I made mistakes in the past that I'm not proud of, and that I've always been up front with the American people about that fact. I will also remind the voters that I have not drank alcohol since 1986, and question why this came out five days before the election.
0df80313f83be4318b4623ecce0195c36249a72e.zh: 我会强调，过去我犯过一些自己并不引以为豪的错误，而且一直坦诚地向美国人民承认这一点。我也会提醒选民，我自1986年以来就不再喝酒，并质疑为什么这事恰好在选举前五天曝光。

ee02c1a1903bb2d9eb17a249e2433c132ab7caf0.source: I will emphasize the conservatism of my views and my governing philosophy. I will remind the American people that I am strong on defense and that I'm pro-life, pro-free market, pro-business, and deeply religious.
ee02c1a1903bb2d9eb17a249e2433c132ab7caf0.zh: 我会强调自己观点和执政理念中的保守主义。我会提醒美国人民，我在国防上强硬，反对堕胎，支持自由市场、支持企业，而且信仰虔诚。

bbe5e9f8afcf523291249d439c248c415d3f2219.source: I will emphasize the point that the Republican Party has a big tent. We are the party for anyone who tries to work hard and get ahead in America.
bbe5e9f8afcf523291249d439c248c415d3f2219.zh: 我会强调，共和党广纳各方。我们是属于每一个在美国努力工作、争取出人头地的人的政党。

620e9869c015cb46551f69f0b39bcf86e793e607.source: I will never appear on a fusion ticket with Breckinridge, but I will take my name off the ballot in the slave states (barring Missouri, of course). Hopefully he and Bell will reciprocate in the north.
620e9869c015cb46551f69f0b39bcf86e793e607.zh: 我绝不会与布雷肯里奇出现在同一个联合选举人名单中，但会撤下自己在蓄奴州选票上的名字——当然，密苏里除外。希望他和贝尔在北方投桃报李。

0abd112a5632c0e0b1f3f4e6796dced7e671a01e.source: I will never support a national bank, but I do advocate an independent Treasury, so that federal funds won't be tied up in local speculations.
0abd112a5632c0e0b1f3f4e6796dced7e671a01e.zh: 我绝不会支持国家银行，但我主张设立独立国库，让联邦资金不致卷入地方上的投机活动。

4f6c1aeb70a9ea7dd12e383963d32923d2d400e4.source: I will never tell a lie to the American people. My Southern Baptist faith and my family have guided me for my entire life. I will make sure my biography and home town get heavy coverage in our advertisements.
4f6c1aeb70a9ea7dd12e383963d32923d2d400e4.zh: 我绝不会向美国人民撒谎。我的美南浸信会信仰和家庭，指引了我的一生。我会确保广告大篇幅介绍我的经历和家乡。

641ab302863666cbd2343c774d23049743a1141f.source: I will not deny that I knew and worked with Baker and Sol Estes back in the 50’s- that is public knowledge. However, not once did I take part in nor know of either of their fraudulent schemes. I trust that my name will be exonerated as the truth comes out.
641ab302863666cbd2343c774d23049743a1141f.zh: 我不会否认，上世纪50年代我认识贝克和索尔·埃斯蒂斯，也与他们共事过，这是众所周知的。但我从未参与他们的任何欺诈计划，也从不知情。我相信，随着真相浮出水面，我的清白会得到证明。

31cb33b3eaa391fb4834056b4487f747e89e3f01.source: I will not deport any undocumented immigrant who is working hard and playing by the rules in this country, that is correct.
31cb33b3eaa391fb4834056b4487f747e89e3f01.zh: 没错，我不会驱逐任何在这个国家努力工作、遵守规则的无证移民。

d282052e213d03c188720e5fd5677ff42ba54439.source: I will not leave Springfield, but I will make several public speeches and pronouncements to make my positions clear.
d282052e213d03c188720e5fd5677ff42ba54439.zh: 我不会离开斯普林菲尔德，但会发表几次公开演说和声明，明确我的立场。

734189f50eb47ab15cc8f4df9f33a46e290fcb0d.source: I will not support a program that delivers pension funds to the very men who rebelled against our Constitution. I hope this is the last time I ever have to answer this question.
734189f50eb47ab15cc8f4df9f33a46e290fcb0d.zh: 我不会支持把抚恤金发给那些曾经反叛我国宪法的人。希望这是我最后一次回答这个问题。

02a7e59c9939eac22ae1328ffc3f613d662da212.source: I will open with a defense of the annexation of Texas, and then spend the rest of the letter attacking Henry Clay and his obfuscations on the issue.
02a7e59c9939eac22ae1328ffc3f613d662da212.zh: 我将开篇为吞并得克萨斯辩护，接着用信中其余篇幅，抨击亨利·克莱在这个问题上故意混淆视听。

a2ab9f4d8dd45d72d55f0fac4144843cae0c524e.source: I will open with a full-throated defense of the annexation of Texas. I will also express my support for our current banking system, and for large reductions to our tariff rate.
a2ab9f4d8dd45d72d55f0fac4144843cae0c524e.zh: 我将开篇大力为吞并得克萨斯辩护，同时表明我支持现行银行制度，并主张大幅降低关税税率。

339b3009a0fc912f63292f97dd5f4f27615b5a1d.source: I will personally visit New York to discuss the upcoming election with Seward, pending his acquiescence of course.
339b3009a0fc912f63292f97dd5f4f27615b5a1d.zh: 当然，前提是苏厄德愿意。我会亲自前往纽约，与他讨论即将到来的大选。

6b5455b1cf78dd9c68e750444c9b64c419018472.source: I will pledge a new commitment to liberalism and economic revival. Our social programs and unions need to be protected. In those areas where Republicans continue to stand in the way of progress, we will look for other ways to get things done.
6b5455b1cf78dd9c68e750444c9b64c419018472.zh: 我会承诺重新致力于自由主义和经济振兴。我们的社会福利计划和工会需要保护。在共和党继续阻碍进步的领域，我们会寻找其他办法把事情办成。

5a167b8ec5ff376429dbdef094d6cf12b3c706b3.source: I will hold a press conference and ask the American people what else George Bush is lying about. Not only did he admit to cocaine use, but now he has been caught red-handed attempting to hide a DUI arrest.
5a167b8ec5ff376429dbdef094d6cf12b3c706b3.zh: 我会召开记者会，问美国人民，乔治·布什还在什么事情上撒谎？他不仅承认使用过可卡因，现在还被当场抓住，试图隐瞒酒驾被捕的经历。

38985372b459fc60363ce3d42a6c55661af591b7.source: I will hold a press conference and remind people that we really don't know anything about this guy. What other hidden, perverse notions does he have?
38985372b459fc60363ce3d42a6c55661af591b7.zh: 我会召开记者会，提醒人们，我们其实对这个人一无所知。他还有什么隐而不露、反常的想法？

07cf486f4907c18265ea3db2d65d1d407a1d12ed.source: I will hold massive rallies in New York and try to run up my vote total in the left-leaning, uncontested states of that region. People should not be afraid to vote for me.
07cf486f4907c18265ea3db2d65d1d407a1d12ed.zh: 我会在纽约举办大型集会，努力提高在该地区偏左、胜负没有悬念的州的得票总数。人们不应害怕投我一票。

c459cf42a1dca95614b42cc5cdb9fc73f696ae75.source: I will immediately apologize for any lapses that occurred while I was Secretary of State, and will pledge to do anything possible to cooperate moving forward, so that we can get to the bottom of this.
c459cf42a1dca95614b42cc5cdb9fc73f696ae75.zh: 对于我担任国务卿时出现的任何疏漏，我会立即道歉，并承诺今后尽一切可能配合，以查明真相。

c478344d8c62f53075930f8fef0dd07dd344d7a8.source: I will increase taxes on wealthy Americans to stabilize the federal budget and reduce our debt.
c478344d8c62f53075930f8fef0dd07dd344d7a8.zh: 我会提高对富裕美国人的税收，以稳定联邦预算、减少债务。

32219cd5c7b38d581851b05be80822064a1f21e0.source: I will let the cameras into the White House so the people can see for themselves. I'm a normal, approachable, friendly President. I didn't spend my whole life trying to run for the office.
32219cd5c7b38d581851b05be80822064a1f21e0.zh: 我会让摄像机进入白宫，让人民亲眼看看。我是个普通、平易近人、友善的总统，并没有一辈子都在谋划竞选这个职位。

804dfa874bc56c8b97548eaa655854c1af2a7c71.source: I will make it a point to disavow racial divisiveness as I travel, lest there be any doubt of my stance. We can solidly defeat Humphrey outside of the South and win a mandate for real governance.
804dfa874bc56c8b97548eaa655854c1af2a7c71.zh: 我会在巡回竞选时明确反对挑动种族对立，让人们对我的立场不再有疑虑。我们可以在南方以外稳稳击败汉弗莱，赢得切实治理国家的授权。

4e8fe64727232e90114ca7408342ddedf5d06e6c.source: I will make it a point to disavow racial divisiveness as I travel, lest there be any doubt of my stance. We can solidly defeat Nixon and lock Wallace outside of the South and win a mandate for real governance.
4e8fe64727232e90114ca7408342ddedf5d06e6c.zh: 我会在巡回竞选时明确反对挑动种族对立，让人们对我的立场不再有疑虑。我们可以稳稳击败尼克松，把华莱士的影响限制在南方，赢得切实治理国家的授权。

c3b9e28c94a4543479b621cefc9037b62b69f4b8.source: I will make my standard stump speech highlighting the dangers of the gold standard and advocating for free silver.
c3b9e28c94a4543479b621cefc9037b62b69f4b8.zh: 我会发表惯常的竞选演说，强调金本位的危险，并主张自由铸银。

c2becc9287d94a5e442de2b2f7d535b9b482caec.source: I will make one final stop in New York to campaign.
c2becc9287d94a5e442de2b2f7d535b9b482caec.zh: 我将在纽约作最后一次竞选停留。

8bb3bfb172c08eae52643fe8b402fcee68228da4.source: I will mention this aspect of my biography frequently, particularly in contrast with Dan Quayle.
8bb3bfb172c08eae52643fe8b402fcee68228da4.zh: 我会经常提起这段经历，特别是拿它与丹·奎尔作对比。

2656f1db0293a790acc3131e3383eb13d90efeaf.source: I will move the nation forward to a new era, with continued employment growth and concern for the well-being of our citizens -- a kinder, gentler era.
2656f1db0293a790acc3131e3383eb13d90efeaf.zh: 我将带领国家迈入一个新时代，继续促进就业增长，关心国民福祉——一个更加仁厚、更加温和的时代。

5fec876709e23ae16e8be2b83a94d4606797739c.source: I will pledge to visit every state in the Union before election day. I stand for every working man in this country, and I'll let them know all about it before this is done.
5fec876709e23ae16e8be2b83a94d4606797739c.zh: 我会承诺在选举日前访问联邦每一个州。我代表这个国家的每一位劳动者，这场竞选结束之前，我会让他们都明白这一点。

5c68809bfa4e71e090419b9687f05c8ae397d44b.source: I will pledge, as much as possible, to continue the policies of Dwight Eisenhower when I am President. I will also emphasize my experience in Eisenhower's Administration, particularly in world affairs.
5c68809bfa4e71e090419b9687f05c8ae397d44b.zh: 我会承诺，担任总统后尽可能延续德怀特·艾森豪威尔的政策。我也会强调自己在艾森豪威尔政府中的经验，尤其是国际事务方面。

714b9177c56441a10a41028022263ea938ecc44e.source: I will praise Johnson's social programs like Medicare, while also lamenting the disorder in the streets. I will pledge to work with Democrats to find common ground at home and to end the war in Vietnam.
714b9177c56441a10a41028022263ea938ecc44e.zh: 我会赞扬约翰逊的联邦医疗保险等社会项目，同时对街头混乱表示痛心。我会承诺与民主党人合作，在国内寻求共识，并结束越南战争。

24b1232b6169638f6d1e5ebff94b02689f2c4d8a.source: I will praise the leadership of Eisenhower, but emphasize to concerned Republicans that I will be a more orthodox conservative when I am President.
24b1232b6169638f6d1e5ebff94b02689f2c4d8a.zh: 我会赞扬艾森豪威尔的领导，同时向心存疑虑的共和党人强调：当上总统之后，我会是一个更加正统的保守派。

f22b9c8fb074d6595250766140dc3652fa63815c.source: I will promise a fresh start in overcoming the gridlock in Washington. In my second term I will reach out to moderates and sensible Republicans to find common, pragmatic solutions to our most pressing issues.
f22b9c8fb074d6595250766140dc3652fa63815c.zh: 我会承诺，以新的开始打破华盛顿的政治僵局。第二任期，我会主动接触温和派及讲道理的共和党人，为我们最迫切的问题寻求共同、务实的解决办法。

97f92169538a59e29ae12e11e5c934d1b733d0e7.source: I will promise to the convention floor that I am a true conservative on gun rights, abortion, taxes, and many other issues. It would be terrible if we let these issues divide us in the face of Hillary Clinton.
97f92169538a59e29ae12e11e5c934d1b733d0e7.zh: 我会向大会代表保证，在持枪权、堕胎、税收等许多议题上，我是一名真正的保守派。面对希拉里·克林顿，如果让这些问题分裂我们，那就太糟了。

e491b437ea7165cee482fbe1053fe5e2f6dbd40a.source: I will provide as many troops as our generals say they need. One of the reasons we are losing this war right now is because we are not fully committed to it.
e491b437ea7165cee482fbe1053fe5e2f6dbd40a.zh: 将领们说需要多少军队，我就提供多少。我们现在打不赢这场战争，其中一个原因就是投入得还不够彻底。

d2743ca56312d591d2e5e12cf4fadb01b85df8ae.source: I will push for comprehensive immigration reform within 100 days of taking office. This will bring security to millions of families and make it harder for companies to exploit foreign workers.
d2743ca56312d591d2e5e12cf4fadb01b85df8ae.zh: 我会在就职100天内推动全面移民改革。这将让数百万家庭安心，也让企业更难剥削外国劳动者。

b931030fc5b177baf182368ef966b9639b0e03e4.source: I will put my word in as a supporter of Silas Wright.
b931030fc5b177baf182368ef966b9639b0e03e4.zh: 我会出面表态，支持赛拉斯·赖特。

4685186bce5255a7ef311ad7f10193fa2d85aa89.source: I will put out the olive branch to our conservative friends and talk about the need for less spending, a limited foreign policy, and Communist influence in the government.
4685186bce5255a7ef311ad7f10193fa2d85aa89.zh: 我会向保守派朋友伸出橄榄枝，谈谈削减开支、有限度的外交政策，以及政府中的共产党影响。

7d9c2dd383b971d3b47bd058d51403686068781e.source: I will put significant effort into cutting emissions, working with our global partners, and in increasing the funding for our scientific institutions. Donald Trump, on the other hand, says this is all some conspiracy from China.
7d9c2dd383b971d3b47bd058d51403686068781e.zh: 我会大力推动减排，与全球伙伴合作，并增加对科研机构的资助。唐纳德·特朗普却说，这一切都是中国的某种阴谋。

8900bf90111304dc6506a8ff0e6fa7c936add47e.source: I will reach out to moderates and conservative Democrats and attempt to build an all-encompassing coalition. It's time that America had a true leader in charge.
8900bf90111304dc6506a8ff0e6fa7c936add47e.zh: 我会主动争取温和派及保守派民主党人，尝试建立广泛包容的联盟。美国是时候由一位真正的领导人掌舵了。

f3acb2fa2612c7b218e0464a406d83260b035d83.source: I will reaffirm my support for the Great Society and pledge to do everything in my power to end the Vietnam War.
f3acb2fa2612c7b218e0464a406d83260b035d83.zh: 我会重申对伟大社会的支持，并承诺竭尽所能结束越南战争。

617c526d58a17e18f9d5cd58197d62d4006d8db5.source: I will relentlessly focus on the issues like our terrible trade deals, our decaying military, repealling and replacing the Obamacare disaster, and more.
617c526d58a17e18f9d5cd58197d62d4006d8db5.zh: 我要坚持不懈地聚焦那些议题：糟糕的贸易协议、日益衰败的军队，废除并取代奥巴马医改这场灾难，以及更多问题。

6be50064a30577bf26d8054958c38448db232216.source: I will remain in Illinois for the final week of this campaign.
6be50064a30577bf26d8054958c38448db232216.zh: 在竞选最后一周，我将留在伊利诺伊。

c528aea387ad15fdd871898794300d3a22bd1f04.source: I will remind the American people that I am a uniter, and that I will make our country whole again. I think the message will be pretty clear.
c528aea387ad15fdd871898794300d3a22bd1f04.zh: 我会提醒美国人民，我是个团结者，会让国家重新团结完整。我想，这个信息会很清楚。

5cb50c0b575d15b7ea5d67b23cd41cc684ba44ed.source: I will remind the American people that this election is about the issues of who will better lead the nation. Personal foibles like a DUI arrest in 1976 should not factor into the voting.
5cb50c0b575d15b7ea5d67b23cd41cc684ba44ed.zh: 我会提醒美国人民，这场选举关注的是谁能更好地领导国家。1976年因酒驾被捕这样的个人过失，不应成为投票时的考量。

f3517c34a81d4da6eae918d7edbb7f026c374bf5.source: I will remind the American people that we stand at a critical juncture in the Civil Rights movement, pledge my full support, and also pledge to end the violence in the streets.
f3517c34a81d4da6eae918d7edbb7f026c374bf5.zh: 我会提醒美国人民，我们正处于民权运动的关键时刻，承诺给予全面支持，也承诺结束街头暴力。

53ec0b3b9680260af9f9097c9d369cba7a823f7f.source: I will remind them that we support Cuban independence.
53ec0b3b9680260af9f9097c9d369cba7a823f7f.zh: 我会提醒他们，我们支持古巴独立。

06f1c67ebc2801ecd9819e6b4c8506be39d126a1.source: I will repeat my opinion that the goal is desirable, but impractical in our current political environment.
06f1c67ebc2801ecd9819e6b4c8506be39d126a1.zh: 我会重申自己的看法：这个目标值得追求，但在当前政治环境下并不现实。

1ef755553af1c4f0c6b7f80578a962a7099f64b3.source: I will return these checks. It is not appropriate for politics to be infused with this kind of money.
1ef755553af1c4f0c6b7f80578a962a7099f64b3.zh: 我会退还这些支票。让这样的巨款涌入政治，是不恰当的。

63a2ef5935cda6816eff3b84bc26df56a3571fcc.source: I will run an uplifting, positive campaign focusing on the issues that concern the American people. I trust that they will see through any petty, unfounded attacks that our opponents come up with.
63a2ef5935cda6816eff3b84bc26df56a3571fcc.zh: 我会开展鼓舞人心的正面竞选，聚焦美国人民关心的议题。我相信，他们能看穿对手那些小气又毫无根据的攻击。

f26b9d3d3cddbc0593282fcac40585ac455d2c4f.source: I will sign this reluctantly. I support the income tax increase on higher incomes, but not the introduction of a tariff commission. Such a commission will invariably be too friendly to big business in its recommendations.
f26b9d3d3cddbc0593282fcac40585ac455d2c4f.zh: 我会勉强签署。我支持提高高收入者的所得税，却不支持设立关税委员会。这种委员会提出建议时，必然会过于偏向大企业。

285082a9b3281ad0c5345065c619ffaff927b42e.source: I will spare no effort to assist our nation's unions in their struggle with the railroads, including direct intervention if necessary.
285082a9b3281ad0c5345065c619ffaff927b42e.zh: 我将不遗余力地帮助本国工会，与铁路公司抗争；必要时，也包括直接干预。

d498a9472b3fc142d7bf52871c7f129655f94f57.source: I will speak about the FTC at every opportunity, and waste no effort at implying that its work has only just begun at the present point.
d498a9472b3fc142d7bf52871c7f129655f94f57.zh: 我会抓住每个机会谈联邦贸易委员会，不遗余力地暗示：它的工作，在目前才刚刚开始。

0833db030c05b5b6685d2230b8146e8ba67e70bd.source: I will talk about what I have accomplished in New York -- public works, a balanced budget, anti-discrimination laws, business creation, and funding for teachers and universities. This is the future of our party.
0833db030c05b5b6685d2230b8146e8ba67e70bd.zh: 我会谈自己在纽约州取得的成就：公共工程、预算平衡、反歧视法律、促进企业发展，以及为教师和大学提供资金。这就是本党的未来。

d38d1eb55a06cb54db5b8e16b349701026fbaf1c.source: I will talk at great length about how we've drifted from the tradition of liberalism that was built by the likes of Roosevelt, Johnson, and Humphrey. I will reaffirm my commitment to this vision in my second term.
d38d1eb55a06cb54db5b8e16b349701026fbaf1c.zh: 我会详细谈谈，我们如何偏离了罗斯福、约翰逊和汉弗莱等人建立的自由主义传统。我会重申，第二任期将致力于实现这一愿景。

85c1f723b3b07a4e5993bb9b221d5f1cd26c1117.source: I will travel and make a number of paid speeches to support the Clinton Foundation's global outreach. I will write a book about some of the difficult choices I made as Secretary of State. This will flex my loyalty to Obama and my foreign policy credentials.
85c1f723b3b07a4e5993bb9b221d5f1cd26c1117.zh: 我会出访并发表多场有偿演说，支持克林顿基金会的全球工作。我还会写一本书，谈谈担任国务卿时作过的一些艰难抉择。这会展示我对奥巴马的忠诚，以及我的外交资历。

b88790e03575528c4be67c700f6617fa75ab908d.source: I will undertake a full review of all military aid with a distinguished panel as soon as the election is over.
b88790e03575528c4be67c700f6617fa75ab908d.zh: 选举一结束，我就会组织一个卓有声望的小组，全面审查所有军事援助。

0b63e035eebd9039e3cd6b821a21c167411e9d12.source: I will unite our country, not tear it apart. We have such an odious, unpopular, unqualified candidate from the Republican side that there really is just one choice.
0b63e035eebd9039e3cd6b821a21c167411e9d12.zh: 我会团结国家，而不是撕裂国家。共和党推出的候选人如此可憎、不受欢迎、缺乏资格，大家其实只有一个选择。

dd72fe5b04befecbea7c428fb83fbbb6db4ad627.source: I will uphold the law as President, but I think it should be left to each state to decide. I would support an Amendment on this issue.
dd72fe5b04befecbea7c428fb83fbbb6db4ad627.zh: 担任总统后，我会依法办事，但我认为这个问题应由各州自行决定。我会支持就此提出宪法修正案。

d0eb031e80376bd2e1761ada331577f4bb888e82.source: I will veto this Act. I support a federal income tax, but not to the level that this bill imposes. It also introduces an estate tax and an excess profits tax.
d0eb031e80376bd2e1761ada331577f4bb888e82.zh: 我会否决这部法律。我支持联邦所得税，但不赞成把税提高到这个法案规定的水平。而且，它还增设遗产税和超额利润税。

00410d27d5daaed823ff40e06bafb91b75799eff.source: I will visit states like Ohio, Michigan, and Pennsylvania that have been especially hard hit by global trade agreements and the outsourcing of manufacturing jobs.
00410d27d5daaed823ff40e06bafb91b75799eff.zh: 我会访问俄亥俄、密歇根和宾夕法尼亚等州，这些州受到全球贸易协定和制造业岗位外包的冲击尤其严重。

d72c7ac816ee517499057f6b51bf2744124bd1ed.source: I will withdraw American troops from Vietnam as soon as possible. The South Vietnamese should be capable of defending their own borders if they are as afraid of the Communist menace as they say they are.
d72c7ac816ee517499057f6b51bf2744124bd1ed.zh: 我会尽快从越南撤出美军。如果南越人真像自己声称的那样害怕共产主义威胁，他们就应有能力保卫自己的边界。

a80a95062efc16b8e2018aaaa69a27f5fbcd7fcd.source: I will withdraw my name from the slave state ballots. We must find a way to stop Lincoln.
a80a95062efc16b8e2018aaaa69a27f5fbcd7fcd.zh: 我将从奴隶州选票中撤回我的名字。我们必须找到一种方法来阻止林肯。

d0b30c43109a5bdeabb76f261de2826cf3e085c5.source: I will write a book about the challenges facing America, and on my fight for healthcare access, fair pay, the environment, and the economy. From the time that I was First Lady of Arkansas until now, I have always fought to give every American a fair shake.
d0b30c43109a5bdeabb76f261de2826cf3e085c5.zh: 我会写一本书，谈美国面临的挑战，以及我在医疗服务获取、公平薪酬、环境和经济问题上的奋斗。从担任阿肯色州第一夫人直到今天，我一直在为每个美国人争取公平的机会。

31bb43a0392839afa1137d9c733e9cba79fa9c29.source: I will speak to the general issues of the future -- free silver, higher wages, worker's rights, an end to child labor, and women's suffrage.
31bb43a0392839afa1137d9c733e9cba79fa9c29.zh: 我会谈关系未来的广泛议题：自由铸银、更高工资、工人权利、结束童工制度，以及妇女选举权。

51980c4c92c77aca2b319eae6daf1913f5d27eab.source: I will spend the end of my campaign with my brother Jeb in Florida. This state will be critical to our chances.
51980c4c92c77aca2b319eae6daf1913f5d27eab.zh: 竞选最后阶段，我会与弟弟杰布一起待在佛罗里达州。这个州对我们的胜算至关重要。

03be0c458572524fdd4018494e3e0e7aaa297846.source: I will spend the end of my campaign with my running mate in Florida. This state will be critical to our chances.
03be0c458572524fdd4018494e3e0e7aaa297846.zh: 竞选最后阶段，我会与搭档一起待在佛罗里达州。这个州对我们的胜算至关重要。

b0e7f5476a7e7f33bf904be1b63a618085225e87.source: I will stand behind the "red lines" that we have set, and I will take vigorous action to defend the Syrian people against Assad, Russia, Iran, ISIS, and other malevolent influences.
b0e7f5476a7e7f33bf904be1b63a618085225e87.zh: 我会坚持我们划下的“红线”，积极采取行动，保护叙利亚人民，使他们免受阿萨德、俄罗斯、伊朗、“伊斯兰国”及其他恶意势力的侵害。

eac413730c3200690b5d49a638cccfc40bc79a41.source: I will stand up for Grover Cleveland for the rest of my life. I believe that he is a great man whom our history will greatly vindicate.
eac413730c3200690b5d49a638cccfc40bc79a41.zh: 我会终生支持格罗弗·克利夫兰。我相信，他是一个伟大的人，历史将充分证明他的价值。

bf46fccfc6590ab4604655a8af7d97b1023b1efe.source: I will stick to the states where Richard Nixon is leading, and emphasize my credentials as a law-and-order conservative. If I can keep Nixon below 270, I have a real chance at brokering an end to desegregation after this election.
bf46fccfc6590ab4604655a8af7d97b1023b1efe.zh: 我会紧盯理查德·尼克松领先的州，强调自己是维护法律与秩序的保守派。只要能让尼克松拿不到270票，我就真有机会在选后谈判中换取停止废除种族隔离。

b4dd0a29913af3fd90abf9d09612d1c2fe6b05ce.source: I will strike a middle ground on the Texas question, supporting annexation so long as it doesn't lead to war with Mexico, or to significant opposition from any section of the country.
b4dd0a29913af3fd90abf9d09612d1c2fe6b05ce.zh: 我将在得克萨斯问题上采取折中立场：只要吞并不会引发与墨西哥的战争，也不会招致国内任何地区的强烈反对，我就支持。

e09fe54a95cf8c7b93424001c0aec351dfc8c35c.source: I will support any fusion tickets which can be organized,
e09fe54a95cf8c7b93424001c0aec351dfc8c35c.zh: 我将支持任何可以组织的融合门票，

5fb1512a24769f290f70c23db3db7b64f55f7c22.source: I will support whatever candidate agrees to rescind the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and agrees to appoint justices who will overturn
5fb1512a24769f290f70c23db3db7b64f55f7c22.zh: 我将支持任何同意废除 1964 年 民权法案 并同意任命将推翻的法官的候选人

75f6d996a68d74a782a70f9f7d00b454af674035.source: I will tactfully criticize the police overreaction and then pivot towards a promise to end the war in Vietnam.
75f6d996a68d74a782a70f9f7d00b454af674035.zh: 我将巧妙地批评警方的过度反应，然后转向承诺结束越南战争。

828764e18990b079f147b462e72df5d60394602e.source: I will take my name off the ballot in those states. We just need to make sure Lincoln doesn't win them.
828764e18990b079f147b462e72df5d60394602e.zh: 我会把自己的名字从这些州的选票上撤下。我们只需要确保林肯赢不了这些州。

885d5cbd092c1e72fb70e22b8035f07ad9a2182e.source: I will take the attack to George Bush, who has all of the weaknesses of Ronald Reagan, with none of the strengths. He was born with a silver foot in his mouth.
885d5cbd092c1e72fb70e22b8035f07ad9a2182e.zh: 我会向乔治·布什发起进攻。他有罗纳德·里根的所有弱点，却没有他的任何长处。他是含着银脚出生的。

f7af1226ab257a72f5a02ac3e0bf915716698f16.source: I will talk about the myriad methods that the Republicans use to divide our country. I will remind everyone that Democrats are truly the party of the common person -- regardless of background or income level.
f7af1226ab257a72f5a02ac3e0bf915716698f16.zh: 我会谈共和党用来分裂国家的种种手段。我会提醒大家，民主党才是真正属于普通人的政党，不论其出身或收入水平。

a7ebc8ac34682fc18e40823528524d0514bda24f.source: I would be open-minded about this issue. Without a clear statement of good faith, backed by concrete action, I have a hard time believing that the Soviet Union will come around to arms control.
a7ebc8ac34682fc18e40823528524d0514bda24f.zh: 在这个问题上，我愿意保持开放态度。但如果苏联没有明确展示诚意，并以具体行动作保证，我很难相信它会接受军备控制。

82c14895aac66707f2832bec4dad7f655e8e5df9.source: I would be willing to take this step and see what develops. It is imperative that we end the war in Vietnam as soon as possible.
82c14895aac66707f2832bec4dad7f655e8e5df9.zh: 我愿意采取这一步，看看局势如何发展。我们必须尽快结束越南战争。

22f40432fd9f7ef5b4d1bd5bc0aabcda5f2031bf.source: I would certainly sign this into law, but not if that means railroading a bill through Congress against the wishes of its elected members.
22f40432fd9f7ef5b4d1bd5bc0aabcda5f2031bf.zh: 我当然愿意签署，但前提不是违背民选议员的意愿，强行把法案推过国会。

31b5a26e4a8a05075185b1697fb972d5c9cab830.source: I would consider a pretty heavy bombing campaign there. We're going to bomb ISIS. We're going to bomb Assad. We're going to bomb the oil.
31b5a26e4a8a05075185b1697fb972d5c9cab830.zh: 我会考虑在那里发动相当猛烈的轰炸。我们要轰炸“伊斯兰国”，轰炸阿萨德，轰炸石油设施。

1d721d8230915e0f084a516327c91584a2546ed7.source: I would encourage Democrats in Congress to oppose the Trans-Pacific Partnership when it comes to a vote.
1d721d8230915e0f084a516327c91584a2546ed7.zh: 《跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》付诸表决时，我会鼓励国会民主党人投票反对。

4b447dfadb6e0777e731bcccce8f22963a454e26.source: I would encourage everyone out there to wear a mask in public. It's just common sense and it will help our struggling small businesses. There could be some legal issues around a mandate, I'm not the expert, but just wear the mask, people!
4b447dfadb6e0777e731bcccce8f22963a454e26.zh: 我鼓励大家在公共场合戴口罩。这只是常识，也会帮助处境艰难的小企业。强制规定可能有一些法律问题，我不是专家，但大家就戴口罩吧！

26ab6086f9baf5d1eee65164c76f0969c7fe718c.source: I would establish an iron-clad lockbox for the Social Security fund. When we allow the federal government to borrow our Social Security money, we put every senior in this country at risk.
26ab6086f9baf5d1eee65164c76f0969c7fe718c.zh: 我要为社会保障基金设立一个牢不可破的“保险箱”。允许联邦政府借用我们的社保资金，就会让全国每一位老年人都面临风险。

c37a1a5d0bdbea7bec80947b80fcfaded3de794c.source: I would focus on removing dictators like Saddam Hussein and Kim Jong Il from power. They threaten the stability of the world and perpetrate evil upon their people.
c37a1a5d0bdbea7bec80947b80fcfaded3de794c.zh: 我会把重点放在让萨达姆·侯赛因和金正日这样的独裁者下台。他们威胁世界稳定，对自己的人民作恶。

46216a4bb37595289bf1c323ef6dd663b40d3da6.source: I would gladly sign such a bill into law.
46216a4bb37595289bf1c323ef6dd663b40d3da6.zh: 我会欣然签署这样的法案，使其成为法律。

44a5374ebe3d9ee0fc8ea66c55bdb80ff67ccd75.source: I would have to see the specific situation being proposed before I could give my own opinion on the matter.
44a5374ebe3d9ee0fc8ea66c55bdb80ff67ccd75.zh: 在提出个人意见之前，我必须先看看具体建议是什么。

078b145974e31460b19c746f84223f34a5aca97e.source: I would have us move into East Germany if this blockade continues. We're the ones with a nuclear bomb. Why should we be afraid of the Soviets?
078b145974e31460b19c746f84223f34a5aca97e.zh: 如果封锁继续，我会让我们进入东德。拥有核弹的是我们，为什么要怕苏联？

96b3e2594a6b4cf9bb19f9726116e59a7ed0d3ce.source: I would hope that we could negotiate an annexation with Mexico before moving forward, to avoid any diplomatic incidents.
96b3e2594a6b4cf9bb19f9726116e59a7ed0d3ce.zh: 我希望在采取行动之前，能够先与墨西哥谈妥吞并事宜，以免引发外交风波。

f0e860b7453a91bcf23b88d5ad6ed48a8bf373d5.source: I would like to change my previous position. With the passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, I shall make no attempt to remove this law, but I will oppose further legislation, such as mass busing or forced integration.
f0e860b7453a91bcf23b88d5ad6ed48a8bf373d5.zh: 我想改变此前的立场。1964年《民权法案》既已通过，我不会试图废除它。不过，我会反对进一步立法，例如大规模跨区校车接送或强制种族融合。

270bf9cf09dac95c17860d1ad71574eb4a01894c.source: I would like to clarify in regards to the Civil Rights Act of 1964. Despite my vote against the bill, I will uphold it as President. I would like to see it repealed- I still believe it is unconstitutional- but a President cannot ignore laws that he dislikes.
270bf9cf09dac95c17860d1ad71574eb4a01894c.zh: 我想澄清对1964年《民权法案》的立场。虽然我投票反对这项法案，但担任总统后，我会执行它。我仍认为它违宪，希望将它废除，但总统不能无视自己不喜欢的法律。

762365832b728461def535e6312ba36fe683ca24.source: I would like to remind civil rights conscious voters that I was fighting for civil rights long before they were popular, as well as helping found the Arizona Chapter of the NAACP.
762365832b728461def535e6312ba36fe683ca24.zh: 我想提醒关心民权的选民：早在民权还不受欢迎时，我就已为之奋斗，还帮助建立了全国有色人种协进会的亚利桑那州分会。

39765ea1ecb6455e099ed11c70ab5b0b054f0401.source: I would love to go against Nixon in a televised debate. We could use the exposure and I'm confident that I would win.
39765ea1ecb6455e099ed11c70ab5b0b054f0401.zh: 我很愿意与尼克松进行电视辩论。我们需要更多曝光，而且我有信心获胜。

e13ccf33a315640c0998e20096cdcf530e68e1ec.source: I would make our final campaign stops in New York.
e13ccf33a315640c0998e20096cdcf530e68e1ec.zh: 我会把最后几站竞选活动安排在纽约州。

96175d2e5da36503897d01c900b25122d092ca38.source: I would need to see the details of these Amendments before I could take a position.
96175d2e5da36503897d01c900b25122d092ca38.zh: 在表态之前，我需要看看这些宪法修正案的细节。

6f07914ee7fc35cbd7b73ff0eb5decab64cdffcd.source: I would need to think about this issue a little more before reaching a final decision.
6f07914ee7fc35cbd7b73ff0eb5decab64cdffcd.zh: 在作出最终决定之前，我还需要多考虑一下这个问题。

30e3a81f8289cda95d9bd7a9c45bcee28aa970d9.source: I would not go to the lengths of John Calhoun, but Texas would certainly help expand the market for slavery in our country.
30e3a81f8289cda95d9bd7a9c45bcee28aa970d9.zh: 我不会像约翰·卡尔霍恩那样走得那么远，但得克萨斯无疑有助于扩大我国的奴隶市场。

952c6a45f84fdec2154dad579df59bfdf3b4dd30.source: I would not support a measure like this. This would be an unnecessary and unconstitutional interference into the rights of our states.
952c6a45f84fdec2154dad579df59bfdf3b4dd30.zh: 我不会支持这类措施。这是对各州权利不必要、而且违宪的干预。

2c05865d108b9c0f666390fc2fbcaf9300c1b0ca.source: I would not support any Amendment that irrevocably protects slavery in the South. We would have to see if a more narrow compromise was possible.
2c05865d108b9c0f666390fc2fbcaf9300c1b0ca.zh: 我不会支持任何不可撤销地保护南方奴隶制的宪法修正案。我们得看看，能否达成范围更小的妥协。

565d3a8a1be6e0e20ee56267b53553819eddbd1b.source: I would not. The Protocol exempts 80% of the world, including major population centers such as China and India, from compliance, and would cause serious harm to the US economy.
565d3a8a1be6e0e20ee56267b53553819eddbd1b.zh: 我不会支持。议定书让世界上80%的地区免于履行义务，包括中国和印度这样的主要人口大国，而且会严重损害美国经济。

8d07658d85da0894aaf25e76086a7c1d396ab667.source: I would object to any immigration act which included a literacy test.
8d07658d85da0894aaf25e76086a7c1d396ab667.zh: 我反对任何包含识字测试的移民法案。

4349c5e501b407d3b5498e48416020095f9accf0.source: I would only consider very minimal measures, to keep guns from the hands of the insane.
4349c5e501b407d3b5498e48416020095f9accf0.zh: 我只会考虑非常有限的措施，防止精神失常的人拿到枪。

463102391823461f1ca1906b18f4773c752a2a84.source: I would only support limited steps on this issue, like a ban on “cop killer” bullets. Overall, I'm an opponent of increased gun control.
463102391823461f1ca1906b18f4773c752a2a84.zh: 在这个问题上，我只会支持有限措施，例如禁止“杀警子弹”。总体而言，我反对加强枪支管制。

2bfbf4b46979f91c32e1c79ad25db84eeb1c9d00.source: I would oppose this measure without strong protections for the rights of American workers and employers.
2bfbf4b46979f91c32e1c79ad25db84eeb1c9d00.zh: 如果没有对美国工人和雇主权利的有力保障，我就会反对这项措施。

0707e7a7c149abe783e6538472c81a50b840737b.source: I would prefer a national bank, but I would be willing to sign a bill which created an independent Treasury.
0707e7a7c149abe783e6538472c81a50b840737b.zh: 我更倾向于国家银行，但也愿意签署设立独立国库的法案。

c9993763261890f99cd9771d1cceb4928e3953e8.source: I wish we would have had the guts to intervene in Cuba the way we did in the Dominican Republic. I will do anything I can as President to prevent a Communist insurgency in Latin America.
c9993763261890f99cd9771d1cceb4928e3953e8.zh: 我真希望当年我们有胆量，像干预多米尼加共和国那样干预古巴。担任总统后，我会尽我所能阻止拉丁美洲的共产主义叛乱。

2ed86e878218ba3c98d2d0f47a69200644d901b4.source: I won my party's nomination as a moderate, conciliatory politician. We will continue this strategy in the general election, and above all we'll avoid the mistakes of McGovern in '72.
2ed86e878218ba3c98d2d0f47a69200644d901b4.zh: 我以温和、寻求和解的政治家形象赢得党内提名。大选中，我们会延续这一策略，尤其要避免麦戈文1972年的错误。

d278dec69c20b5a3a1298d1cc8637c24399140ab.source: I won't be making any statements about Chicago in my campaign. We should forget this as soon as possible and move on to the issues affecting our country.
d278dec69c20b5a3a1298d1cc8637c24399140ab.zh: 我不会在竞选中就芝加哥事件发表任何声明。我们应尽快把它抛在脑后，转向影响国家的实际问题。

e4e95c1efd0f4f6860cc9072d0e12355a74c79e6.source: I won't be making any statements about this issue as I campaign.
e4e95c1efd0f4f6860cc9072d0e12355a74c79e6.zh: 竞选期间，我不会就这件事发表任何声明。

62b829c77fe8b64bc41a77d47ffc041b431cb91d.source: I won't risk a debate with Humphrey. We can defeat him without one.
62b829c77fe8b64bc41a77d47ffc041b431cb91d.zh: 我不会冒险与汉弗莱辩论。没有辩论，我们照样能击败他。

b5f8c7ccf2a46c72d2a45f5f8f2566186ef029a7.source: I won't take any active steps to support or oppose this measure, but I will not wield the veto if Congress passes it.
b5f8c7ccf2a46c72d2a45f5f8f2566186ef029a7.zh: 我不会积极支持或反对这项措施，但如果国会通过，我不会行使否决权。

08d8606856a6e599acb4b05570c0171d80b5ac1c.source: I won’t be the one to lose the Solid South. With enough subtle hints, under-the-table deals, and backpedaling on earlier promises and policies we’ve made, we’ll reel the South back in yet.
08d8606856a6e599acb4b05570c0171d80b5ac1c.zh: 我绝不会成为丢掉“稳固南方”的那个人。只要给出足够多的暗示、进行幕后交易，并在先前的承诺和政策上作些退让，我们仍能把南方拉回来。

49b2fac3b0552ad141545c8551214f4ae19ead36.source: I would absolutely support a law like this as President. It is past time that our nation had health coverage for all.
49b2fac3b0552ad141545c8551214f4ae19ead36.zh: 担任总统后，我绝对会支持这样的法律。我国早就应该让所有人都享有医疗保障了。

fbc5a9742274d53969c5368e83bcf3be424b64ae.source: I would actually redouble the points that Roosevelt is making about our lack of military preparation.
fbc5a9742274d53969c5368e83bcf3be424b64ae.zh: 实际上，我会进一步强化罗斯福对我国军事准备不足的批评。

0630df6c6e07182983a28f1b695ecf351568ef43.source: I would advocate that we compromise on the issue of tariff increases and strike a moderate tone. We need to do as much as possible to make this election about slavery, and slavery alone.
0630df6c6e07182983a28f1b695ecf351568ef43.zh: 我主张在提高关税的问题上作出妥协，采取温和语气。我们应当尽可能让这次大选围绕奴隶制展开，而且只谈奴隶制。

45edc301ea23f2ded7e017a22f9a857a07abb9bc.source: I would attack any person who asserts that working with the Second Bank of the United States is poor preparation for government.
45edc301ea23f2ded7e017a22f9a857a07abb9bc.zh: 凡是声称在美国第二银行工作不足以为从政作准备的人，我都会抨击。

bce65d02919722a88e23f675c305c6f756cc31f6.source: I would be forced to veto such a measure as President.
bce65d02919722a88e23f675c305c6f756cc31f6.zh: 如果我是总统，就不得不否决这样的措施。

5648ed6274fffc482c7bfe830c9e8f05aafe3e0c.source: I would be happy to disavow the use of Super PAC advertising if my opponent would as well. Unfortunately the other side will do anything to win this election, regardless of how it aligns with the will of the public.
5648ed6274fffc482c7bfe830c9e8f05aafe3e0c.zh: 只要我的对手也肯放弃，我很乐意声明不使用超级政治行动委员会的广告。遗憾的是，对方为了赢得这次选举什么都做得出来，根本不管是否符合公众意愿。

f23f6683be8e3fb00851b36c62f0781dde4a8202.source: I would be open to this, depending on how the economy goes in the next year or two.
f23f6683be8e3fb00851b36c62f0781dde4a8202.zh: 我愿意考虑，这取决于未来一两年的经济情况。

1070f2419ce643d6e4ce77a149321f0c38d91a68.source: I would prefer that the measure grant immediate independence, but I can support it in its current form.
1070f2419ce643d6e4ce77a149321f0c38d91a68.zh: 我更希望，这项措施给予立即独立。不过，以目前的形式，我也能支持。

7283f5e8b7a7b6d65ab4bec3ea635641a9f95f53.source: I would prefer to see it go, but there's not much I could do to make that happen as President. It's an issue for South Carolinians to decide.
7283f5e8b7a7b6d65ab4bec3ea635641a9f95f53.zh: 我更愿意看到它消失，但作为总统我无能为力来实现这一目标。这是南卡罗来纳州人需要决定的问题。

a0912bd244a1d22f6c6159120a6abc51b80cf794.source: I would prefer to see us allocate this money to new and existing government programs so that all Americans can share in our prosperity.
a0912bd244a1d22f6c6159120a6abc51b80cf794.zh: 我更愿意把这笔钱拨给新建和现有的政府项目，让所有美国人都能分享我们的繁荣。

57ff52a45e3d512a3f215f57f52f9ba3eaba32c6.source: I would redouble our efforts on this front. Too many of our nation's elderly are unable to afford decent medical care in their advanced years.
57ff52a45e3d512a3f215f57f52f9ba3eaba32c6.zh: 我们会加倍努力推动这件事。本国太多老年人到了晚年，却负担不起像样的医疗服务。

59254d86d14727f217eafe5314d911d3cc469c44.source: I would support any agreement, as long as the United States keeps the land that is south and east of the Colombia River.
59254d86d14727f217eafe5314d911d3cc469c44.zh: 只要美国保住哥伦比亚河以南及以东的土地，我就支持达成协议。

097a142975e8c74804d2ad0f8c29d1c7f6e877f7.source: I would support such an Amendment if it gained traction within our system. I'm just sorry to see that the chances seem unlikely.
097a142975e8c74804d2ad0f8c29d1c7f6e877f7.zh: 如果这样的宪法修正案在我国制度内赢得广泛支持，我会赞成。可惜，目前看来，通过的希望很渺茫。

1c0ff2211c930e0f846f229583a0b025564eb5d6.source: I would support the use of massive air strikes or tactical nuclear weapons to defend our ally, South Vietnam.
1c0ff2211c930e0f846f229583a0b025564eb5d6.zh: 我会支持发动大规模空袭，或使用战术核武器，保卫我们的盟友南越。

b815702415dc47b839057c7c33fad7723cc1c6c4.source: I wouldn't go to these extremes, but anyone should be concerned about a President who is forced to follow the dictates of the Pope.
b815702415dc47b839057c7c33fad7723cc1c6c4.zh: 我不会走到这些极端，不过任何人都应该担忧：一位总统若被迫听从教皇的指令，会怎样？

598984bf5a88f165f207679fc72d0cea025b5032.source: I wouldn't phrase it in his manner. I think we can afford some cuts to our defense budget, but as a Navy man myself, I will always respect our military.
598984bf5a88f165f207679fc72d0cea025b5032.zh: 我不会用他的方式措辞。我认为我们承受得起一些国防预算削减，但我自己也是海军出身，始终会尊重军队。

1376a6abad3b685620b76029b375b00dc53f15c4.source: I'd like to see more widespread licensing and registration of handguns and rifles, but it has been repeatedly defeated in the past.
1376a6abad3b685620b76029b375b00dc53f15c4.zh: 我希望更广泛地要求手枪和步枪持有人取得许可、办理登记，但过去这类提案一再遭到否决。

e69317225260369d912960f0c3cc7573cf0ad449.source: I'd love to have Bernie Sanders out there campaigning for us, but the things he is asking for are simply unrealistic. I'm not going to sit here and bargain away my platform when I'm the one who won the nomination.
e69317225260369d912960f0c3cc7573cf0ad449.zh: 我很希望伯尼·桑德斯出来为我们助选，但他提出的要求实在不切实际。赢得提名的是我，我不会坐在这里，拿自己的政纲讨价还价。

6c6ba652d8c64f9810c736f232b93c79f16db3bd.source: I'd prefer to avoid that kind of thing if we can.
6c6ba652d8c64f9810c736f232b93c79f16db3bd.zh: 如果可以，我宁愿避免这类事情。

d065da5fb39f2733b1cdf16c00763d5c64eb1f29.source: I'd rather not discuss this issue right now while diplomatic negotiations are in progress.
d065da5fb39f2733b1cdf16c00763d5c64eb1f29.zh: 外交谈判正在进行，我现在宁愿不讨论这个问题。

198cb85d071a7a3f794b04c02fab123598831c22.source: I'll agree to wait until January 21st to make my new nominee, if the Democrats will agree to build the wall, pass my stalled stimulus bill, and pass our infrastructure bill.
198cb85d071a7a3f794b04c02fab123598831c22.zh: 如果民主党同意筑墙，通过我搁置的经济刺激法案和基础设施法案，我就同意等到1月21日，再提出新的人选。

91e94232fed95264e548263cdc70acf07d9de660.source: I'll make every effort to get us out of Afghanistan and end this war, but the way that Trump has gone about it has been completely backwards. His recent deal does nothing but embolden the Taliban in their attempts to take over.
91e94232fed95264e548263cdc70acf07d9de660.zh: 我会竭尽所能，让我们撤出阿富汗，结束战争，但特朗普的处理办法完全本末倒置。他最近的协议，只会让塔利班在夺取政权的企图上更加大胆。

819f12f5f75feff63fc16d28a9dcb3864c1e6c3b.source: I'll say whatever comes to mind at a given moment. But the thing is, we're going to get Mexico to build a wall, and then we're going to do something to reform the immigration system.
819f12f5f75feff63fc16d28a9dcb3864c1e6c3b.zh: 想到什么，我当时就说什么。不过，关键是，我们会让墨西哥修一堵墙，然后采取一些措施改革移民制度。

fb05dedaef456d372b57197598d1a2b98e68c8d1.source: I'll spend the last day in California with my running mate, and then fly back to New York.
fb05dedaef456d372b57197598d1a2b98e68c8d1.zh: 我会在加利福尼亚州与竞选搭档一起度过最后一天，然后飞回纽约州。

9cfd925aff9584ea63e1b205d2c6e657b5bfbfa3.source: I'm a big supporter of domestic oil production. One thing we can definitely do is begin to drill in Alaska.
9cfd925aff9584ea63e1b205d2c6e657b5bfbfa3.zh: 我大力支持国内石油生产。我们肯定能做的一件事，就是开始在阿拉斯加钻探。

0a49605c919720a8f9a1c5d5081790a2c6c5caf6.source: I'm a liberal in the tradition of Franklin Roosevelt and Harry Truman and John Kennedy. Americans will appreciate that on election day.
0a49605c919720a8f9a1c5d5081790a2c6c5caf6.zh: 我是继承富兰克林·罗斯福、哈里·杜鲁门和约翰·肯尼迪传统的自由派。美国人在选举日会认可这一点。

a19bdf70f34adfe57d44e3006c4c2533992ed50d.source: I'm a moderate candidate, and my purpose is to tie the different strands of our party into a unified whole. My appointments will reflect this.
a19bdf70f34adfe57d44e3006c4c2533992ed50d.zh: 我是一位温和的候选人，目的是把党内不同力量团结成一个整体。我的人事任命也会体现这一点。

71b41367b5c6556d5ebd10729cba9f9e53cdd035.source: I'm a pro-life candidate. Very pro-life. I think only if a woman is in serious danger should she be able to receive an abortion.
71b41367b5c6556d5ebd10729cba9f9e53cdd035.zh: 我是反对堕胎的候选人。非常反对。我认为，只有女性面临严重危险时，才应该可以接受堕胎。

c7451508f3240783afeec75637535586de381793.source: I'm a proud moderate on the abortion issue.
c7451508f3240783afeec75637535586de381793.zh: 在堕胎问题上，我是一名自豪的温和派。

b6778ced8e8c470ed4b7aa58524f1b1cb88e8040.source: I'm all for some programs to provide jobs, but this Act has too many mandates and goals that are inconsistent with each other. We can't have a balanced budget, full employment, and low inflation at the same time.
b6778ced8e8c470ed4b7aa58524f1b1cb88e8040.zh: 我完全赞成某些创造就业的项目，但这项法案的强制要求和目标太多，彼此矛盾。我们不可能同时做到预算平衡、充分就业和低通胀。

5aa63476cca419882882d5d049ff3d00bd7d26bb.source: I'm an approachable, open guy with an open Administration. Let's emphasize my mainstream values and positions, and avoid extremist rhetoric or attacks on Jimmy Carter.
5aa63476cca419882882d5d049ff3d00bd7d26bb.zh: 我是个平易近人、坦率的人，领导着一个开放的政府。我们应强调我符合主流的价值观和立场，避免极端言辞或攻击吉米·卡特。

9368d632d3cdaf3d2e4d8c203c2d0dae6d9d8687.source: I'm an opponent of gun control overall, but some common-sense measures like the 1968 Act are appropriate.
9368d632d3cdaf3d2e4d8c203c2d0dae6d9d8687.zh: 总体上我反对枪支管制，但1968年法案这样符合常识的措施，是适当的。

b5dd143d114738f06d2d6a07b129ce30ef2fecf9.source: I'm calling Congress into session now so that the American people can see how little they are capable of accomplishing. If they don't vote the Republicans out this fall then I don't know what to say.
b5dd143d114738f06d2d6a07b129ce30ef2fecf9.zh: 我现在就召集国会开会，让美国人民看看他们能做成的事有多少。如果选民今年秋季还不把共和党人赶下台，那我也没什么可说的了。

577c28bf72a942cc7386dc0c3d8c9a9fb7984623.source: I'm concerned about any citizen who would embrace the presence of a hyphen in their American identity.
577c28bf72a942cc7386dc0c3d8c9a9fb7984623.zh: 任何公民若认同在“美国人”身份之前加上族裔前缀，都让我担忧。

35b7fe79e68e62867819d6e2622f607c7af2f7be.source: I'm going to go with Barbara Lagoa. She's done a terrific job on the Florida Supreme Court for a number of years, and they are really raving about her down there.
35b7fe79e68e62867819d6e2622f607c7af2f7be.zh: 我要选芭芭拉·拉戈阿。她多年来在佛罗里达州最高法院做得很出色，那边的人对她赞不绝口。

c4160c502df8b5ea9e7c08232f98e389bd4d5e7c.source: I'm going to listen to our medical experts and stay at home to stop the spread. There are plenty of ways to get the message out on TV and in social media now. We're all in this together.
c4160c502df8b5ea9e7c08232f98e389bd4d5e7c.zh: 我会听取医学专家的意见，待在家里，阻止传播。如今，通过电视和社交媒体传递主张的办法很多。我们都在共同面对这件事。

4abfa5622b506bbaad788ad65e30ace7f666024b.source: I'm in no position to comment on the conduct of the war. When I'm President I will do everything in my power to seek peace, but I cannot undermine the current Administration.
4abfa5622b506bbaad788ad65e30ace7f666024b.zh: 我不便评论战争的指挥。担任总统后，我会竭尽所能寻求和平，但不能拆现任政府的台。

067884111e2f6e2ff21b493d25156abe1dad2b34.source: I'm just going to run my campaign and whatever happens between those two will happen.
067884111e2f6e2ff21b493d25156abe1dad2b34.zh: 我只管开展自己的竞选，他们两个会怎么样，就随他们去吧。

8ac67ca0bc2f34a4897f57dc1f2997e72c39c5a1.source: I'm just going to run my campaign and whatever happens with those two will happen.
8ac67ca0bc2f34a4897f57dc1f2997e72c39c5a1.zh: 我只管开展自己的竞选，他们两个会怎么样，就随他们去吧。

7895063bc107dfb4c7a1d7a373459964683345b0.source: I'm just going to run my campaign, and whatever happens with those two shall happen.
7895063bc107dfb4c7a1d7a373459964683345b0.zh: 我只管开展自己的竞选，他们两个会怎么样，就随他们去吧。

0a5b9ef6a31e14209c4d20a5de44645afa76c9b1.source: I'm more worried about Nixon than Wallace. We need to focus on winning Ohio, Missouri, Illinois, and California if we're gonna win.
0a5b9ef6a31e14209c4d20a5de44645afa76c9b1.zh: 比起华莱士，我更担心尼克松。要想获胜，我们必须集中力量赢下俄亥俄州、密苏里州、伊利诺伊州和加利福尼亚州。

6ae902755e53a3b3cc592c61d423085bf4c87372.source: I'm more worried about keeping the rest of the South from going to Nixon. I'm less concerned about Humphrey's chances in Texas.
6ae902755e53a3b3cc592c61d423085bf4c87372.zh: 我更担心南方其他地区会倒向尼克松。相比之下，汉弗莱在得克萨斯州的胜算没那么令我在意。

3e874d635990bb959c8fb6d8dc834fb51cecb201.source: I'm more worried about keeping the rest of the South from going to Wallace. I'm less concerned about Humphrey's chances in Texas.
3e874d635990bb959c8fb6d8dc834fb51cecb201.zh: 我更担心南方其他地区会倒向华莱士。相比之下，汉弗莱在得克萨斯州的胜算没那么令我在意。

4dcb2b59f8472812d4e2ccd83e62c1f4f157b246.source: I'm more worried about sticking it to Humphrey than I am about Nixon. If it comes down to a negotiated election, I'd rather have Nixon in the driver's seat because I think we can work with him.
4dcb2b59f8472812d4e2ccd83e62c1f4f157b246.zh: 比起尼克松，我更在意给汉弗莱一点颜色看看。如果最终要靠谈判决定选举，我宁愿让尼克松掌握主动，因为我认为我们能与他合作。

9ec112e9c5a9599a16d7f3be562cde4206ced68a.source: I'm neutral when it comes to the death penalty. This is an issue for the states to decide.
9ec112e9c5a9599a16d7f3be562cde4206ced68a.zh: 对死刑，我保持中立。这应由各州决定。

4ae443f0fd0e2426f22b947e70ec51bdeab51545.source: I'm no fan of Scott Walker, but I thought the recall effort was taking things a step too far.
4ae443f0fd0e2426f22b947e70ec51bdeab51545.zh: 我不喜欢斯科特·沃克，但我觉得罢免行动有点过头了。

872465b48dfe98d74343b9a11498cfa1bcce05c7.source: I'm not comfortable coordinating my message with the press. I trust that they will find the right way to present a contrast between me and my opponent.
872465b48dfe98d74343b9a11498cfa1bcce05c7.zh: 我不愿与新闻界协调宣传口径。我相信，它们会找到恰当的方式，呈现我与对手的差别。

13ec027a96c19e711cc42edee93ef6ef4a3b0d2a.source: I'm not comfortable with committing the federal government to the area of home construction, especially with all of the other responsibilities it has taken on over the past two decades.
13ec027a96c19e711cc42edee93ef6ef4a3b0d2a.zh: 我不赞成让联邦政府承诺介入住房建设，尤其考虑到过去二十年它已经承担了那么多其他职责。

01ae17212fd21e3196429e55998f9598af09d369.source: I'm convinced that this program will work. This is a good compromise allowing private insurers to conduct business, while securing access to health insurance for more Americans. If anything, the increased transparency will reduce insurance costs.
01ae17212fd21e3196429e55998f9598af09d369.zh: 我确信这项计划会奏效。这是一种不错的折中方案，既允许私人保险公司经营，也让更多美国人获得医疗保险。至少，提高透明度将降低保险成本。

006f8fd0c39b81e428abec7e674027b14e671066.source: I'm deeply concerned about this whole episode. We don't know yet whether there was a crime or not, but you can be sure that a Trump Administration will be looking into this some more.
006f8fd0c39b81e428abec7e674027b14e671066.zh: 我对整件事深感忧虑。我们还不知道究竟有没有犯罪，但可以肯定，特朗普政府会继续深入调查。

9a0850c8057bcc168648b6138c378d6d87e40ae7.source: I'm doing everything in my power to get the wall built. We've made some good progress actually, and another four years will really help us all out.
9a0850c8057bcc168648b6138c378d6d87e40ae7.zh: 我正尽一切所能，把墙建起来。其实我们已经取得了不错进展，再有四年，真会对大家都大有帮助。

109a0a8f54610fbd808d0015131586c6f1059c09.source: I'm feeling great now. I was a little sick, and now I'm not. I'm looking forward to closing this campaign out strong with some huge Keep America Great rallies.
109a0a8f54610fbd808d0015131586c6f1059c09.zh: 我现在感觉很好。之前有点不舒服，现在好了。我期待着强势完成竞选，办几场大型“让美国保持伟大”集会。

6b0c1f3144e66fd493f78880332f19dfbbed2f6b.source: I'm glad for the men who produce tin for a living, but we need to consider the overall effect of this policy. I don't have a glib answer for you at this point.
6b0c1f3144e66fd493f78880332f19dfbbed2f6b.zh: 我为靠生产镀锡板谋生的人感到高兴，但我们需要考虑这项政策的整体影响。眼下，我不能随口给你一个轻巧的答案。

d2095efe6cbb51ef9177f5e9e50877de7f46d44d.source: I'm glad that we have reached out to Cuba, but I would like to have seen a little more insistence that they liberalize their country first.
d2095efe6cbb51ef9177f5e9e50877de7f46d44d.zh: 很高兴我们向古巴伸出了手，但我希望，先要求他们放宽国内管制的态度再坚决一点。

6e663207444842b0f8992ddd33039cfe9993b5d9.source: I'm going through the Plains and Mountain states. I could personally talk to a third of the voters in that region, as sparsely populated as it is.
6e663207444842b0f8992ddd33039cfe9993b5d9.zh: 我要走遍大平原和山地各州。那里人烟稀少，我没准能亲自和当地三分之一的选民谈上话。

b9abb452fb102d34e844838d4039f093bb842544.source: I'm going to announce during my acceptance speech that I support a minimum wage of $15 an hour.
b9abb452fb102d34e844838d4039f093bb842544.zh: 我会在接受提名的演说中宣布，我支持每小时15美元的最低工资。

ab5708a6973d5cd536317eee638add1ad7b53d5a.source: I'm going to appoint judges who are extremely strong on the Second Amendment, and on
ab5708a6973d5cd536317eee638add1ad7b53d5a.zh: 我将任命对第二修正案非常强有力的法官，并且

8bcd54f5c9ed448139af8f04c7a08646caa4fb01.source: I'm going to be making a reference to Trump University in almost every speech that I make.
8bcd54f5c9ed448139af8f04c7a08646caa4fb01.zh: 几乎每一场演说，我都会提到特朗普大学。

c205c76df7df4fd707d7e6af7008d99d0f9928b6.source: I'm going to be taking a hard look at the economic conditions from my first day in office, and recommending the appropriate action from there.
c205c76df7df4fd707d7e6af7008d99d0f9928b6.zh: 从上任第一天起，我就会仔细审视经济状况，再据此建议采取恰当行动。

4471dad27ae45987be1eba6f796d08279241b9de.source: I'm going to defer to local administrators on that question. That's not something the President should be involved with.
4471dad27ae45987be1eba6f796d08279241b9de.zh: 在这个问题上，我会尊重地方管理者的决定。这不是总统应该插手的事。

6caaa07cf593ef30e160af3ccd70408065aabd2e.source: I'm going to eviscerate Henry Wallace and bring the so-called Progressive Party back into the fold. I support universal health care and civil rights just the same as they do, and they are running for vanity's sake alone if they support Wallace.
6caaa07cf593ef30e160af3ccd70408065aabd2e.zh: 我要猛烈抨击亨利·华莱士，把所谓的进步党支持者争取回来。我和他们一样支持全民医疗保障和民权；如果他们支持华莱士，那参选就纯粹是为了满足虚荣心。

ebc9b58274fe1dc02bcb1fcb044df48fbaef5cbe.source: I'm not convinced of the veracity of this theory. It contravenes accepted Christian teaching in a large number of ways.
ebc9b58274fe1dc02bcb1fcb044df48fbaef5cbe.zh: 我不确信，这个理论是真的。它在许多方面，违背了公认的基督教教义。

b5736164edca2c6ca1eadd1d1316086eb7c78ce8.source: I'm not going to comment on a decision like this one. I certainly don't support miscegenation laws by any means, but I also think the Court has to be careful about overstepping the rights of the states.
b5736164edca2c6ca1eadd1d1316086eb7c78ce8.zh: 我不准备评论这样的判决。我当然绝不支持禁止跨种族婚姻的法律，但也认为最高法院必须谨慎，不能侵犯各州的权利。

a9b553a074b27483fad507ee41929453d4735b10.source: I'm not going to comment on the speeches of Teddy Roosevelt -- there is too much to lose in antagonizing him.
a9b553a074b27483fad507ee41929453d4735b10.zh: 我不会评论泰迪·罗斯福的演说——得罪他的代价太大了。

d8c9b46f9d7c83b0909afe7ca3e44ea31eba3e8e.source: I'm not going to dignify this letter with a response.
d8c9b46f9d7c83b0909afe7ca3e44ea31eba3e8e.zh: 我不会作出回应，让这封信显得值得认真对待。

39197be2d2fc587e2dd9afd2cbe2821597a1274b.source: I'm not going to make any statements condemning these laws during the present campaign. That would be a hasty, alienating move on our part.
39197be2d2fc587e2dd9afd2cbe2821597a1274b.zh: 在当前竞选中，我不会发表声明谴责这些法律。那样做仓促而且会疏远选民。

73c731eaba11259e27a27e34471ebb1d50053b23.source: I'm not going to spend the 2020 campaign focusing on 2019 issues. We need to talk about our plans to fight this COVID-19 epidemic and rebuild the economy.
73c731eaba11259e27a27e34471ebb1d50053b23.zh: 我不会在2020年竞选中，盯着2019年的议题不放。我们需要谈谈应对新冠疫情、重建经济的计划。

89ddfe0d0b05ad2ef224557fac22a88f2c1261b8.source: I'm not opposed to comprehensive immigration reform. We just need to build a wall first, and deport the people who have no right to be in the United States.
89ddfe0d0b05ad2ef224557fac22a88f2c1261b8.zh: 我不反对全面移民改革。但我们需要先修一堵墙，再遣返那些无权留在美国的人。

08c44d7c4181a18fd889726e11b4834a4049fc7b.source: I'm not satisfied with how well teachers are paid in this country, and I'd encourage local jurisdictions to address this issue further. We need to strike a good balance in this regard.
08c44d7c4181a18fd889726e11b4834a4049fc7b.zh: 我对本国教师的薪酬水平不满意，会鼓励地方政府进一步处理这个问题。我们需要在这方面取得良好的平衡。

11d92376a351f958154ffe943ab766d74df8958b.source: I'm not so sure about this. Such a system will surely displace many existing towns and neighborhoods, and provide an entirely new area for federal interference in local matters.
11d92376a351f958154ffe943ab766d74df8958b.zh: 我对此并不十分赞同。这样的系统必定会迫使许多现有城镇和社区迁移，也会为联邦干预地方事务开辟一个全新领域。

a41769d76a22ee9c124995fba69a1fdf1403b3ad.source: I'm not sure about that to be honest. Scott Brown is a bit moderate for the kind of Republican I envision having in my cabinet. We'd rather have staunch, reliable conservatives on the team.
a41769d76a22ee9c124995fba69a1fdf1403b3ad.zh: 说实话，我不太确定。斯科特·布朗有点太温和，不太符合我心目中共和党内阁成员的样子。我们更希望团队里都是坚定、可靠的保守派。

920fc4d4d7f050f38c371c60bb8389767dab345f.source: I'm not sure how much I have in common with someone like Obama. I don't really have an opinion one way or the other.
920fc4d4d7f050f38c371c60bb8389767dab345f.zh: 我不确定自己和奥巴马这样的人有多少共同点。我谈不上喜欢或不喜欢他。

5b879aa68c1a464fdaf1860febb33429903cb16d.source: I'm not sure if we should commit our troops to additional combat theatres at the present time. We shouldn't be attempting to navigate Syrian politics.
5b879aa68c1a464fdaf1860febb33429903cb16d.zh: 我不确定，我们现在是否应该把军队投入更多战场。我们不该试图左右叙利亚政治。

0c2cd780e8edb9c43f2ab2662fc14764831a2d31.source: I'm not sure it's practical or desirable from a military standpoint to defend two tiny islands that are much closer to the Chinese mainland than they are to Formosa.
0c2cd780e8edb9c43f2ab2662fc14764831a2d31.zh: 从军事角度看，保卫两座距中国大陆远比距台湾更近的小岛，是否实际、是否值得，我并不确定。

2ab9a54a05ef6992b0c041dcd4dc3209292372e8.source: I'm not sure what kind of Christianity the Republicans adhere to, but it is of dubious merit in guiding our government.
2ab9a54a05ef6992b0c041dcd4dc3209292372e8.zh: 我不确定，共和党人信的是哪一种基督教；但用它来指导政府，实在难说有什么可取之处。

c7cb1e577b6cd4cfdca1cfcad41cd83b722f392d.source: I'm not surprised. Trump has been less than honest in any number of areas throughout his life.
c7cb1e577b6cd4cfdca1cfcad41cd83b722f392d.zh: 我不意外。特朗普这一生，在很多方面都不够诚实。

87df4c4730d50eae69c9db9537742d757d32f577.source: I'm not the one who has a say in the matter. It sounds like he doesn't want to speak there anyway, and so be it.
87df4c4730d50eae69c9db9537742d757d32f577.zh: 这件事不是我说了算。听起来他本来就不想在那里演说，那就随他吧。

102c30107646381e471e7b0b1c532cbd44c7262a.source: I'm not touching this issue with a ten foot pole. If anyone asks, I will deflect deflect deflect.
102c30107646381e471e7b0b1c532cbd44c7262a.zh: 我绝不碰这个问题。有人问起，我就转移话题，转移话题，再转移话题。

d0d4021a312d9389a98716121959f8baead52bf1.source: I'm not very comfortable with the activities of this committee, and I believe they should be scaled back to a minimum.
d0d4021a312d9389a98716121959f8baead52bf1.zh: 我对这个委员会的活动颇有疑虑，认为应该将其缩减到最低限度。

a385514a1b6f55ed37a1e6842cc4c721ec21d03c.source: I'm not very satisfied at all. Off the record, however, we cannot change much without risking a Chinese flight from our Treasuries and a possible trade war.
a385514a1b6f55ed37a1e6842cc4c721ec21d03c.zh: 我一点也不满意。不过，私下说，要是改变太多，就可能让中国抛售我国国债，也可能引发贸易战。

28772eeb7067aa217a3ebe7a3facd16130f2da6f.source: I'm open to some kind of compromise that would provide guarantees on slavery in the South, as long as it would not allow the extension of slavery to new states or territories.
28772eeb7067aa217a3ebe7a3facd16130f2da6f.zh: 我愿意考虑某种为南方奴隶制提供保障的妥协，前提是不得让奴隶制扩展到新州或领地。

1f6dfdf67836a8acb2eaf8d047807da557d9ede3.source: I'm opposed this personally. I think that, you know, different states have different opinions on this matter and it's best left to them to decide on the issue.
1f6dfdf67836a8acb2eaf8d047807da557d9ede3.zh: 我个人反对同性婚姻。我觉得，你知道，各州对此有不同看法，最好让他们自己决定。

e522df0c75c9ff07b17759b4abbe781b58ea1dc7.source: I'm opposed to desegregation, environmentalism, defeatism, social engineering, busing, declining property values, and unchecked rioting. My candidacy appeals to southerners and northerners alike.
e522df0c75c9ff07b17759b4abbe781b58ea1dc7.zh: 我反对废除种族隔离、环保主义、失败主义、社会改造、校车接送、房产贬值，以及无人遏制的骚乱。我的参选既吸引南方人，也吸引北方人。

64e572a1841dfc86566a59e035b5877ecb826958.source: I'm opposed to fracking, and I think we need a lot more regulation of the practice.
64e572a1841dfc86566a59e035b5877ecb826958.zh: 我反对水力压裂，认为我们需要大幅加强对这种做法的监管。

cf1811565b7062e9facb48fdad362e564d963b3f.source: I'm opposed to the death penalty overall, but I could support it for a few particularly heinous crimes.
cf1811565b7062e9facb48fdad362e564d963b3f.zh: 总体上我反对死刑，但对少数特别严重的罪行，可以支持使用死刑。

6719ce687774904e88177528662a212b60b5861f.source: I'm opposed to the expansion of foreign trade at the present time, when we are already dealing with a large trade deficit.
6719ce687774904e88177528662a212b60b5861f.zh: 目前，我们已经面临巨额贸易逆差，我反对进一步扩大对外贸易。

13374a0579460302939656cdf6d5c0954d8dd247.source: I'm opposed to the practice of abortion personally, but I would support a federal law protecting access to this procedure in the most dire cases for the woman, such as when her life or health are in danger.
13374a0579460302939656cdf6d5c0954d8dd247.zh: 我个人反对堕胎，但会支持联邦法律，在妇女面临最危急的情况，例如生命或健康受到威胁时，保障她接受这种手术的机会。

ffe418bfd7f16dcdc4a01df0c4ef87353f93a6bc.source: I'm opposed to the provision of federal funds for primary education. It will inevitably lead to other forms of interference in what should be a state and local matter.
ffe418bfd7f16dcdc4a01df0c4ef87353f93a6bc.zh: 我反对为初等教育提供联邦资金。这必然会引出其他干预，而教育本应由州和地方负责。

39e708e7265a1137d013d28adac20a058204ba99.source: I'm personally opposed to abortion, but I respect this decision and will not try to overturn it.
39e708e7265a1137d013d28adac20a058204ba99.zh: 我个人反对堕胎，但尊重这项判决，不会试图推翻它。

222c19e4a8762a8fd97c8eddbe3c4b4de1efc717.source: I'm predisposed to support this measure, but of course it depends on the specific negotiations that would play out.
222c19e4a8762a8fd97c8eddbe3c4b4de1efc717.zh: 我倾向于支持这项措施，不过当然还要看具体谈判结果。

923cb7014f7d0a727a31c85f2b660731c9ec4012.source: I'm prepared to give Senator Sanders some significant input into our platform and our campaign. He ran a very good race and said a lot that resonated with the American people.
923cb7014f7d0a727a31c85f2b660731c9ec4012.zh: 我准备让桑德斯参议员对我们的政纲和竞选发挥重要影响。他的竞选很出色，许多主张引起了美国人民的共鸣。

85f7b3709229d2b81ce34db54cd7b2ff07e3b723.source: I'm prepared to go even further on this issue. I will personally oversee a sweeping investigation of the State Department, Department of Defense, and other agencies which are prone to infiltration.
85f7b3709229d2b81ce34db54cd7b2ff07e3b723.zh: 我准备在这个问题上更进一步。我将亲自监督，对国务院、国防部及其他容易遭到渗透的机构展开全面调查。

adc49ff29c8a82ad88150eaa31cc562e4db83243.source: I'm prepared to stand behind Louis Brandeis as a Court nominee. He has devoted his life to fighting for the common man against the business trusts of this nation.
adc49ff29c8a82ad88150eaa31cc562e4db83243.zh: 我准备坚定支持路易斯·布兰代斯出任最高法院大法官。他毕生都在为普通民众奋斗，对抗本国的商业托拉斯。

dff62bce63c5b626462f375116deef6b6d2f065b.source: I'm probably the most pro-life individual, maybe ever. And you know, one of the big issues in this election is the judges. Very important issue.
dff62bce63c5b626462f375116deef6b6d2f065b.zh: 我大概是最反对堕胎的人，也许是有史以来最反对的。你知道，这次选举的一大议题就是法官。非常重要的议题。

39237a93675f4f2cf9722e4b1b50708306c6e4a4.source: I'm proposing a pretty big bill, you might have noticed, around $2 trillion to rebuild our roads, develop mass transit and green energy, and repair critical human infrastructure needs as well. We must move forward as a country.
39237a93675f4f2cf9722e4b1b50708306c6e4a4.zh: 你也许注意到了，我提出的法案规模相当大，约二万亿美元，用于重建道路，发展公共交通和绿色能源，也满足关键的民生基础设施需求。国家必须向前走。

26b14450e6c5d800d7be792d70f140b48b79ad7d.source: I'm proud of my son. He's overcome a lot to find success in life. This campaign is about the American people and their struggles and opportunities. I'm not going to spend my time talking about Trump and Ukrainie.
26b14450e6c5d800d7be792d70f140b48b79ad7d.zh: 我为自己的儿子自豪。他克服了许多困难，在生活中取得成功。这场竞选关乎美国人民，以及他们的奋斗和机会。我不会把时间花在谈论特朗普和乌克兰上。

c31962f79ea8c0fd910e162c1503da77d3f2a92d.source: I'm proud that we were able to elect an African-American as President in this country. I really am. But we need to focus on the future now, and not on what may have gone right or wrong the last few years.
c31962f79ea8c0fd910e162c1503da77d3f2a92d.zh: 我国能选出一位非裔美国人担任总统，我很自豪，真的。但现在，我们需要聚焦未来，而不是过去几年可能做对或做错了什么。

c28cc4a6fbcddd13db0667aa0311f0fd685da17e.source: I'm proud to be a member of the American Civil Liberties Union.
c28cc4a6fbcddd13db0667aa0311f0fd685da17e.zh: 身为美国公民自由联盟的会员，我很自豪。

06086e482a3b3665308df89be521598e71b19802.source: I'm proud to call Mike Pence one of my closest friends. He's done a terrific job as Vice President and will be great over the next four years.
06086e482a3b3665308df89be521598e71b19802.zh: 我很自豪能把迈克·彭斯称作最亲近的朋友之一。他作为副总统做得很出色，未来四年也会很棒。

c6e9d8e4f481adb022cd520afd9ee27146784ae0.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Cassius Clay of Kentucky.
c6e9d8e4f481adb022cd520afd9ee27146784ae0.zh: 能与肯塔基州的卡修斯·克莱搭档参选，我感到自豪。

e2a60095c3469608326c9dd67dc6c92e498723e2.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Hannibal Hamlin of Maine.
e2a60095c3469608326c9dd67dc6c92e498723e2.zh: 能与缅因州的汉尼拔·哈姆林搭档参选，我感到自豪。

502671854471334504fcbf46cb88d997f13b44d2.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Herschel Vespasian Johnson of Georgia.
502671854471334504fcbf46cb88d997f13b44d2.zh: 能与佐治亚州的赫歇尔·维斯帕先·约翰逊搭档参选，我感到自豪。

bb97b582158ecaead89178392aa07c02a90677f1.source: I'm the trusted, steady leader that we need in a time of national crisis. I worked in the White House, actually worked, for eight years next to my great friend Barack Obama.
bb97b582158ecaead89178392aa07c02a90677f1.zh: 国家危机时刻，我们需要一位值得信赖、稳健的领导者，我就是这样的人。我在白宫，与我的好朋友贝拉克·奥巴马共事八年，是真正做事的八年。

632dd9cf9ec47483d152a54d0df99ffbf9ab5b47.source: I'm very concerned about John Palmer. If he is gaining support maybe it means there is a valid criticism we must face up to.
632dd9cf9ec47483d152a54d0df99ffbf9ab5b47.zh: 我很担心约翰·帕尔默。如果他的支持在增长，也许说明有些批评确实有道理，我们必须正视。

4a0ceee79d755efb0fcc612bd65949c22424774e.source: I'm very concerned about this issue. I would like to see our funding level increase for the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, so that adequate resources are in place to pursue these claims.
4a0ceee79d755efb0fcc612bd65949c22424774e.zh: 我十分关注这个问题。我希望增加平等就业机会委员会的经费，以确保有足够资源追查这些申诉。

271242323dc9f111a4e59e914fb701369854216b.source: I'm very skeptical of the idea that we can trust oil companies to look out for the interests of the little guy. There should be greater regulations to preserve the safety of our water supply.
271242323dc9f111a4e59e914fb701369854216b.zh: 我很怀疑，能否相信石油公司会照顾普通人的利益。应该加强监管，保障我们的供水安全。

a9178cd5623d137005932a8fe84aa6a5552a7aff.source: I'm very worried about the falling water levels in that area. If this continues, then we would eventually need to consider taking action.
a9178cd5623d137005932a8fe84aa6a5552a7aff.zh: 我很担心该地区水位下降。如果这种情况持续，我们最终就需要考虑采取行动。

f3c2978dd9511d1c447409b95b371db8abbd6f83.source: I'm warning Mitch McConnell right now. Either he can back off and wait until this election is over with to nominate a justice, or I will do everything in my power to expand the size of the Court as President.
f3c2978dd9511d1c447409b95b371db8abbd6f83.zh: 我现在就警告米奇·麦康奈尔：要么退让，等这场选举结束再提名大法官；要么我当总统后，就会尽一切所能扩大法院人数。

10d3535997d4ec088b989ebd403a89d9ffbdc33f.source: I'm working around the clock right now to put $2,000 into the hands of every American. We need to get the economy open again, and we need to get people spending money.
10d3535997d4ec088b989ebd403a89d9ffbdc33f.zh: 我现在正夜以继日地工作，要让每个美国人拿到2000美元。我们需要重新开放经济，让大家重新花钱。

2d57b3433a2cf2360d0ff531d2a12e14cd6fcc09.source: I'm worried that for most or all of 1967, Lyndon Johnson repeatedly assured us that the North Vietnamese were on their last legs. It's difficult to assess the situation when we can't rely on the information that we have.
2d57b3433a2cf2360d0ff531d2a12e14cd6fcc09.zh: 我担心的是，在1967年的大部分时间，甚至全年，林登·约翰逊都一再向我们保证北越已经奄奄一息。如果连获得的消息都不能相信，就很难判断局势。

527bc099e479bfb5e36ea95af1aab049202e96ad.source: I've always been an advocate of “pay-as-you-go liberalism”, as I've put it. I believe that we can pass the programs this country needs without destroying the fiscal health of the government.
527bc099e479bfb5e36ea95af1aab049202e96ad.zh: 我一向主张自己所说的“量入为出的自由主义”。我认为，我们能够通过国家需要的计划，而不损害政府的财政健康。

0419e6eee8fae4d0f67e035eef99b04d081b31bb.source: I've always believed in trying to change an institution from within. My family has consistently voted against segregation in our church, and will continue to do so.
0419e6eee8fae4d0f67e035eef99b04d081b31bb.zh: 我一直相信，应努力从内部改变一个机构。我们家在教会始终投票反对种族隔离，今后也会继续这样做。

3b0fc3cdcf0b11a26935b7228a89e5701716cab6.source: I've always believed that you need the best person for the job, and what Nikki showed me during her time in my Administration was really impressive. She can really be an inspiration for women and children of immigrants everywhere.
3b0fc3cdcf0b11a26935b7228a89e5701716cab6.zh: 我一直相信，职位就该交给最适合的人。妮基在我的政府任职时，所展现的能力让我印象深刻。她真能鼓舞各地的女性和移民子女。

420d753501efc7e638592ee277201afa1b63c1f8.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Horatio Seymour of New York.
420d753501efc7e638592ee277201afa1b63c1f8.zh: 能与纽约州的霍雷肖·西摩搭档参选，我感到自豪。

73f99ed3a0a174f57eb042cf94f4b597e56e4d66.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with James Guthrie of Kentucky.
73f99ed3a0a174f57eb042cf94f4b597e56e4d66.zh: 能与肯塔基州的詹姆斯·格思里搭档参选，我感到自豪。

577d623116afb88a96a69f5d219dc4205575af30.source: I'm proud to share a ballot with Salmon Chase of Ohio.
577d623116afb88a96a69f5d219dc4205575af30.zh: 能与俄亥俄州的萨蒙·蔡斯搭档参选，我感到自豪。

1d0e8acd56cccb13078f5ab02f0ed5662d90323e.source: I'm proud to sign this into law. I think the broad majority of Americans can stand behind its provisions.
1d0e8acd56cccb13078f5ab02f0ed5662d90323e.zh: 我很自豪，能签署这项法律。我认为，广大多数美国人都能支持它的条款。

6c8fe2a04a9bdd416f95c814a1657de4225ba5b7.source: I'm proud to stand for election with Jesse Jackson as my running mate. Let the so-called attack ads keep coming.
6c8fe2a04a9bdd416f95c814a1657de4225ba5b7.zh: 杰西·杰克逊与我搭档参选，我感到自豪。就让那些所谓的攻击广告继续来吧。

faaa44daa3604998842d57da3b1d87e2bce6dea2.source: I'm proud to stand with Black Lives Matter in the wake of this incident. We need to fight the root causes of black poverty, defund the police, and fight for equity in our society and government.
faaa44daa3604998842d57da3b1d87e2bce6dea2.zh: 这件事发生后，我很自豪能与“黑人的命也是命”运动站在一起。我们需要应对黑人贫困的根源，削减警察经费，并在社会和政府中争取公平。

b0f0d95ba63d5ac6b3d199f86e3a9bad2abc3ec3.source: I'm really impressed with Amul Thapar. You know he was one of my first federal appointments, which they don't talk about very much, a really great guy.
b0f0d95ba63d5ac6b3d199f86e3a9bad2abc3ec3.zh: 阿穆尔·塔帕尔给我留下了深刻印象。你知道，他是我最早任命的一批联邦法官之一，媒体很少提这一点。他真是个很棒的人。

95abc5601f78854277bf8925d1db14cbb2e792c8.source: I'm scared to take my own medicine sometimes for fear of what might be in there. Medicines should be clearly labeled with their ingredients, so that those who wish to avoid intoxicating substances can do so.
95abc5601f78854277bf8925d1db14cbb2e792c8.zh: 有时我连自己的药都不敢吃，怕里面有什么成分。药品应当明确标注成分，让那些想避开使人醉迷的物质的人，能够做到。

0c9cc65959d1560bd47fde78e04d9ab5831e49d8.source: I'm sure people out there will make these attacks on their own initiative, but we shouldn't emphasize this too much.
0c9cc65959d1560bd47fde78e04d9ab5831e49d8.zh: 我相信，自有人会主动发动这些攻击，但我们不应过分强调。

a255ca000ae2854c639eba689dde5f8189aa57ff.source: I'm sure that Croker is concerned about the patronage positions his men will receive. Patronage jobs for New York men will be plentiful in my administration.
a255ca000ae2854c639eba689dde5f8189aa57ff.zh: 我相信，克罗克在意的是，他的人能得到哪些酬庸官职。我的政府，会为纽约人提供充足的这类职位。

71f342346cead302552cacae47f48763490721fb.source: I'm sure that Mr. Coxey is a well-intentioned citizen, but I see no constitutional authority for implementing a federal public works program.
71f342346cead302552cacae47f48763490721fb.zh: 我相信，考克西先生是一位善意的公民，但我看不出，宪法授予了实施联邦公共工程计划的权力。

4bd17474ba1da618687ac04b47971b06cdd9cea4.source: I'm sure that these are just rumors and speculation. It would be irresponsible of me at this point to extend my obvious condemnation of this step.
4bd17474ba1da618687ac04b47971b06cdd9cea4.zh: 我相信，这些只是传闻和猜测。此时就发表我显然会持有的谴责意见，是不负责任的。

49fd216dc0c851d9c4c565cc96d4d82732cca431.source: I'm the best thing that's happened to CNN since the Gulf War. If I stop tweeting for a couple of weeks, they'll run a story about me every hour asking why!
49fd216dc0c851d9c4c565cc96d4d82732cca431.zh: 我是海湾战争以来CNN遇上的最大福星。要是我有几周不发推文，他们就会每个小时做一次报道，追问我为什么不发！

22bd0f12d2520308500625c89d73dba3f4286177.source: I'm the pro-business President, a lot of people have been saying that. We want a decently sized, targeted infrastructure bill that will keep our economy competitive and reserve an appropriate space for private enterprise.
22bd0f12d2520308500625c89d73dba3f4286177.zh: 我是支持企业的总统，许多人一直这么说。我们希望有一项规模适当、目标明确的基础设施法案，让经济保持竞争力，也为私人企业保留恰当的空间。

d9a5fd20f49239032ea68b073e54024d7bbc04e5.source: I've apologized for my role in this university already, and I will again today.
d9a5fd20f49239032ea68b073e54024d7bbc04e5.zh: 我已经为自己在这所大学中的角色道过歉，今天还会再道歉。

ead1e602f2138d9ad017d3b8fdb28c994499b394.source: I've appeared with George Wallace, just the same as I've appeared with any other Democrat who sought our nomination this year. People don't need to read any special significance into this.
ead1e602f2138d9ad017d3b8fdb28c994499b394.zh: 我和乔治·华莱士一同露面，就像我与今年其他争取本党提名的民主党人一同露面一样。人们不必从中解读什么特别含义。

f9946b0ad7ff47b42e3475e5e212ba9cfb2171f9.source: I've been a champion debater for my entire life. I'd be happy to go against Kennedy on TV.
f9946b0ad7ff47b42e3475e5e212ba9cfb2171f9.zh: 我一辈子都是辩论高手。很愿意在电视上与肯尼迪交锋。

8becbb15ee1283f069e45ed311dae70a7088d0c4.source: I've been an advocate of a Transcontinental Railroad for the past decade. We need to make sure that is appreciated by the voters.
8becbb15ee1283f069e45ed311dae70a7088d0c4.zh: 过去十年，我一直主张修建横贯大陆铁路。我们必须确保选民知道这一点。

2d8dbb82e1431aae140c92f5af2a963791acb3ca.source: I've been around politics long enough to know that you
2d8dbb82e1431aae140c92f5af2a963791acb3ca.zh: 我涉足政治已经足够长的时间了，知道你

b0d9076d336b22f97bf6ba5f8c1dec1185604e19.source: I've been misrepresented a lot, you know. It's funny actually, I've always been a conservative person. A lot of people have known that from the start.
b0d9076d336b22f97bf6ba5f8c1dec1185604e19.zh: 你知道，人们常常歪曲我。其实挺好笑的，我一直是个保守的人，很多人从一开始就知道。

8cff03ea2b5dc1d522ec5c1ef0afd117a1aed52f.source: I've been the candidate of the conservatives this entire campaign, and I won't change that here. We're going to hit home on fiscal responsibility, tax breaks, escalation in Vietnam- red meat for our base.
8cff03ea2b5dc1d522ec5c1ef0afd117a1aed52f.zh: 整个竞选期间，我一直是保守派的候选人，现在也不会改变。我们要着重强调财政责任、减税，以及在越南升级军事行动，给基本盘来些最能激发热情的主张。

ded71a709eeddbaa858a93412f18bb347a28cf5f.source: I've been very impressed with Hubert Humphrey's ideas and moral courage throughout his political career. He is the type of person who would make a great President of this country.
ded71a709eeddbaa858a93412f18bb347a28cf5f.zh: 休伯特·汉弗莱在整个政治生涯中展现的思想和道德勇气，都让我十分钦佩。他是那种能成为本国出色总统的人。

a0cb6705777e754e9a77b1f1044abcde84a11c96.source: I've changed my position on health care over the years after much reflection. We should focus on doing anything we can to overturn Obamacare, rather than dwelling on what I used to think years in the past.
a0cb6705777e754e9a77b1f1044abcde84a11c96.zh: 多年来，经过深思熟虑，我改变了医疗政策立场。我们应该集中精力，竭尽所能推翻奥巴马医改，而不是纠缠我多年前的想法。

948b24a759f212c2608b627c5c3c8526fdd78e2d.source: I've gotta tell you, I'm pretty surprised. It would be a shame if we decided this election based on politically motivated prosecutions, rather than the issues.
948b24a759f212c2608b627c5c3c8526fdd78e2d.zh: 我得说，我挺意外。如果我们靠出于政治动机的起诉来决定这场选举，而不是靠议题，那就太遗憾了。

09d7f7fff7cc45878b7d13a4952a7cd031130019.source: I've known Scott Brown for many years. If that was something he'd be interested in, we are always glad to have qualified individuals working on our side.
09d7f7fff7cc45878b7d13a4952a7cd031130019.zh: 我认识斯科特·布朗很多年了。如果他有兴趣，我们始终欢迎有能力的人到我们这边工作。

364f4b5bf97b11119b97c85fe24d0ae668ff2e11.source: I've never been comfortable with the Social Security program, and I would like to see it rolled back.
364f4b5bf97b11119b97c85fe24d0ae668ff2e11.zh: 我一直对社会保障制度有所保留，希望缩减它。

8f64f364d6e8660525066afae30e2fce27f1daf7.source: I've seen some of the catastrophes we've had, and maybe something like a better background check system could help, within reason you know.
8f64f364d6e8660525066afae30e2fce27f1daf7.zh: 我看到过我们经历的一些灾难，也许完善背景审查制度这类措施，能在合理范围内有所帮助，你知道的。

eebec3204d6c5c04fb43261b077af2de9e64f2a8.source: I've supported gun regulations when and where they actually make sense. But the leftist media just wants to make me look like an extremist, regardless of the facts.
eebec3204d6c5c04fb43261b077af2de9e64f2a8.zh: 在枪支管制确实合理的情况下，我支持过这些措施。但左翼媒体就是想把我描绘成极端分子，根本不管事实。

a8eb8aabf72180617119ca42621d933478557882.source: I've supported internal improvements throughout my career, but telegraph lines are a different thing. I trust that private individuals can build these.
a8eb8aabf72180617119ca42621d933478557882.zh: 在整个政治生涯中，我一直支持国内公共工程，但电报线路是另一回事。我相信，私人可以建设这些线路。

25484aea7d8207c065ef53cd8fac58a3a551158b.source: I've supported the Israeli state from the beginning. I'm glad that Truman came around, but he absolutely sent the wrong message by vacillating on this issue until the very last moment.
25484aea7d8207c065ef53cd8fac58a3a551158b.zh: 我从一开始就支持以色列建国。很高兴杜鲁门终于改变态度，但他一直摇摆到最后一刻，显然传递了错误的信号。

dfc46efdf28c1971963748b91af5197b423a96a6.source: I've taken our country and led it past the nightmares of Watergate and Vietnam. Anyone can see that I've led an open, honest Administration.
dfc46efdf28c1971963748b91af5197b423a96a6.zh: 我已经带领国家走出水门事件和越南战争的噩梦。谁都看得出，我领导的是一个公开、诚实的政府。

982f270257deee68096913972ba2da6f0e28cc66.source: I've thought carefully about this issue and consulted with our military advisors. Based on those conversations we have decided to end the practice of drone strikes, effective immediately.
982f270257deee68096913972ba2da6f0e28cc66.zh: 我仔细思考过这个问题，也咨询了军事顾问。根据这些讨论，我们决定立即停止无人机打击。
