b3553bdebe59e8c7df73fffb58c45420ea282b70.source: I've tried to explain to her that we have an election coming up, and we don't need all this bad press, but she won't listen.
b3553bdebe59e8c7df73fffb58c45420ea282b70.zh: 我已经试着向她解释，大选临近，我们不需要这些负面报道，但她不肯听。

e149e5c12cc7e03a3e0ae1887dd615066b4c2202.source: I've undertaken the amusements of our times, perhaps a little more than most, but it has never had any bearing on the work I have done.
e149e5c12cc7e03a3e0ae1887dd615066b4c2202.zh: 我参与了这个时代常见的消遣，或许比多数人还多一点，但这从来没有影响我履行公职。

1aa7e0bcc14c9d9ceeaa9a3d49c414c923dbdba9.source: I've walked the walk on this issue. As Vice President, I was the one who personally certified Donald Trump's election in January of 2017. Trump's rhetoric is extremely irresponsible and dangerous to the future of democracy in this country.
1aa7e0bcc14c9d9ceeaa9a3d49c414c923dbdba9.zh: 在这个问题上，我做到了言行一致。2017年1月，我担任副总统时，亲自主持认证了唐纳德·特朗普当选。特朗普的言论极不负责任，对这个国家民主的未来十分危险。

dbb61f8ae15549cbb4e1fd3a50312ec1cb037532.source: ISIS and radical Islamic terrorism is the greatest threat to our wonderful nation. I will mercilessly combat radical Islam from my first day in office, including a Muslim ban.
dbb61f8ae15549cbb4e1fd3a50312ec1cb037532.zh: “伊斯兰国”和激进伊斯兰恐怖主义，是我们这个伟大国家面临的最大威胁。从上任第一天起，我就会毫不留情地打击激进伊斯兰主义，包括实施穆斯林入境禁令。

172d821b67f37c6554957f006e411d9fe37403ec.source: Ideally we should be spending much more on our infrastructure. Doing so would increase overall employment and pave the way for future prosperity.
172d821b67f37c6554957f006e411d9fe37403ec.zh: 理想情况下，我们应该在基础设施上投入更多。这样会增加整体就业，为未来繁荣铺平道路。

952f284852f2b9b886de21e9ded83ab9ba6792fa.source: If Democrats would join us in supporting a more robust election system with a complete paper audit trail, voter ID, and other common sense measures, then there wouldn't be these questions floating around.
952f284852f2b9b886de21e9ded83ab9ba6792fa.zh: 如果民主党与我们一起，支持一个更健全的选举制度，配备完整的纸质审计记录、选民身份证明，以及其他合乎常识的措施，就不会有这些疑问了。

eba4e1ee61adf284a25baa5d8922fb1013e89cb4.source: If elected as President, what would you do to lower the inflation rate in this country, which currently stands at over 4%?
eba4e1ee61adf284a25baa5d8922fb1013e89cb4.zh: 如果当选总统，你会采取什么措施，降低我国目前超过4%的通货膨胀率？

409d1f3bd4ecdb15f3dfe0f5a026aa0e10af2c6e.source: If elected, what will you do to get the student and Negro riots in this country under control?
409d1f3bd4ecdb15f3dfe0f5a026aa0e10af2c6e.zh: 如果当选，你会怎样控制这个国家的学生和黑人骚乱？

5ea65c84227a2fe1af4ab7af438a3bcc1eb19b12.source: If everyone would just wear a mask, the rate of transmission would drop by a lot, and we could all together beat this pandemic.
5ea65c84227a2fe1af4ab7af438a3bcc1eb19b12.zh: 如果大家都戴口罩，传播率就会大幅下降，我们就能共同击败这场疫情。

b174c7695cd04d64feee19a6e453c1020e519fae.source: If he keeps talking like that, we won’t even need to campaign.
b174c7695cd04d64feee19a6e453c1020e519fae.zh: 他要是继续这么说，我们连竞选都不用了。

45006afd492a2e64282a2da7c9ad09e5b5b6fafa.source: If it wasn't already bad enough for you, the popular votes ended up going in your favour. The public and the Democrats are enraged and in despair, as the will of the people to remove the man who pardon Nixon failed. If the Bayh-Celler amendment didn't pass previously, surely the support to pass it will be present now?
45006afd492a2e64282a2da7c9ad09e5b5b6fafa.zh: 更糟的是，你最终反而赢得了普选票。公众和民主党既愤怒又绝望：人民希望赶走那个赦免尼克松的人的意愿，竟然落空了。贝赫—塞勒修正案此前没能通过，这次总该有足够支持了吧？

c1255881b5652b633951e7d9950e7e4ad04d4105.source: If it's really true that Russia collaborated to release this information about Hillary Clinton's private speeches to Goldman Sachs, then I totally disavow and denounce these illegal leaks.
c1255881b5652b633951e7d9950e7e4ad04d4105.zh: 如果真是俄罗斯参与泄露了希拉里·克林顿对高盛的私下演说，那么我完全与这种非法泄露行为划清界限，并予以谴责。

6e575ed411cea7b55aa769b64732620d88af7a49.source: If our opponent does that kind of thing, then we will certainly follow suit.
6e575ed411cea7b55aa769b64732620d88af7a49.zh: 如果对手用这种手段，我们当然也会跟进。

20f0137a0234c3bc0749b30e0030d62ca02d6b03.source: If practical I would support a program that allows younger workers to invest a certain portion of their Social Security taxes into a different program.
20f0137a0234c3bc0749b30e0030d62ca02d6b03.zh: 如果可行，我会支持一项计划，允许年轻劳动者把一部分社会保障税投入另一种计划。

07cdb20b418278073ceb37e53f0f8e662eb153ee.source: If the Court rules that slaves can be brought into free states without consequence, then we will effectively have a slave nation on our hands. This is the type of Southern aggression that we must be ever-vigilant against.
07cdb20b418278073ceb37e53f0f8e662eb153ee.zh: 如果法院判定，奴隶可以被带入自由州而不失去奴隶身份，那么我们实际上就成了一个全国蓄奴的国家。这正是我们必须时刻警惕的南方进逼。

767cd3acccca9401ad8670770eb407e309f00522.source: If the radical left would stop stonewalling me on every issue, maybe we could come together and find a better solution on immigration reform.
767cd3acccca9401ad8670770eb407e309f00522.zh: 如果激进左翼别在每个议题上都阻挠我，也许我们就能携手，为移民改革找到更好的办法。

95889b5e0997e95ec23ffee66c6e8e898ab2fd5c.source: If there is no majority in the electoral college, what are your goals at the bargaining table?
95889b5e0997e95ec23ffee66c6e8e898ab2fd5c.zh: 如果选举人团中无人获得过半数，你在谈判桌上的目标是什么？

86bbed2c7ceb9294683a99da675f40f68c85ad00.source: If there were doubts about you winning South Carolina, they should be gone now.
86bbed2c7ceb9294683a99da675f40f68c85ad00.zh: 如果之前还有人怀疑你能否赢下南卡罗来纳州，现在应该不再怀疑了。

13ea1a9e188f80b63542693287abefa170194116.source: If they can get a Bryan-Watson ticket on the ballot, good for them. We will sort this issue out after we win the election in November.
13ea1a9e188f80b63542693287abefa170194116.zh: 如果他们能让布赖恩—沃森组合出现在选票上，那就随他们去吧。等我们十一月赢下大选，再解决这个问题。

5043416a3243084b7b733fc92ad4c943383345cd.source: If this was your opinion, why did you pick Humphrey as your running mate?
5043416a3243084b7b733fc92ad4c943383345cd.zh: 如果你持这种看法，为什么还选汉弗莱作竞选搭档？

34146a7a7ecc022f1045924a68ae63d1b2bfa3b0.source: If Goldwater wants a fight over Vietnam, we’ll give him one. It would be practically  criminal not to, with the ridiculous ideas he’s spewed about it.
34146a7a7ecc022f1045924a68ae63d1b2bfa3b0.zh: 戈德华特想在越南问题上开战，我们就奉陪。看看他喷出的那些荒唐主意，不反击简直就是罪过。

860f7ed6ed328aa495915e3d6b237ab515001603.source: If Hillary Clinton doesn't stop sending leftist protestors to my events, how does she expect to not have Trump protestors disrupting her speeches?
860f7ed6ed328aa495915e3d6b237ab515001603.zh: 如果希拉里·克林顿不停止派左翼抗议者来我的活动，她凭什么指望特朗普的抗议者不会打断她的演说？

3417cc06ca3fcc5f06302cafd5ffa80763a55314.source: If Hillary wants to go around claiming that we're corrupt somehow, I think there's more than enough ammunition here to fight back.
3417cc06ca3fcc5f06302cafd5ffa80763a55314.zh: 如果希拉里想四处宣称我们有什么腐败行为，我想这里有足够多的材料可以反击。

b23840b08d1ba52b0f4fd1dc1b15246983afb8fe.source: If I am elected, this type of thing would not happen. This question has no relevance to events.
b23840b08d1ba52b0f4fd1dc1b15246983afb8fe.zh: 如果我当选，这种事情就不会发生。这个问题与实际局势无关。

986871923c33b90c893a791c9a84fd444f3118aa.source: If I knew what I know now, I wouldn't have voted "yes". But real culprit of this war was George Bush and the Republicans, using faulty intelligence.
986871923c33b90c893a791c9a84fd444f3118aa.zh: 如果当时知道我如今知道的情况，我就不会投赞成票。但真正酿成这场战争的，是乔治·布什和共和党人，他们使用了错误情报。

900c516bbfa0d37b212c8d15ed29b5868f63c94e.source: If Merkel fails in this mission, we all will be affected negatively. I have the utmost faith that she realizes this and will act accordingly.
900c516bbfa0d37b212c8d15ed29b5868f63c94e.zh: 如果默克尔没能完成这个任务，我们所有人都会受到不利影响。我完全相信，她明白这一点，也会据此行动。

90c96152712847fac2b51fc0c0fab03e7a3a74c5.source: If Mr. Wilson continues to allow American ships to travel in dangerous areas, it is only a matter of time before we are drawn into war. His claims to be the peace candidate ring hollow.
90c96152712847fac2b51fc0c0fab03e7a3a74c5.zh: 如果威尔逊先生继续允许美国船只驶入危险海域，我们被拖入战争只是时间问题。他自称是和平候选人，听起来空洞无物。

c0ce77533aa1bc9b4bf88cf5844daa261bcdd5d8.source: If Palmer will remove himself from the ballot in Kentucky, Indiana, West Virginia, Maryland, and Delaware, then I will give him free reign in the Deep South.
c0ce77533aa1bc9b4bf88cf5844daa261bcdd5d8.zh: 如果帕尔默退出肯塔基、印第安纳、西弗吉尼亚、马里兰和特拉华，我就让他在深南部放手竞选。

8791859f3b0fb5c80746478e8d56605a41d90c68.source: If Romney is willing to endorse me and give a speech supporting me, we can let him into the convention hall.
8791859f3b0fb5c80746478e8d56605a41d90c68.zh: 如果罗姆尼愿意支持我，并发表支持我的演说，我们可以让他进入大会会场。

44c77a597d24a0c52b19e277d34ead512507d2c8.source: If Trump thought he was going to win this election, he wouldn't be saying these kinds of things. I'm confident that we're going to win, and that the American people will have full faith in the outcome this year.
44c77a597d24a0c52b19e277d34ead512507d2c8.zh: 如果特朗普觉得自己会赢，就不会说这种话。我相信我们会获胜，美国人民也会充分信任今年的结果。

8c5c3b328ae412feac3b2a22087216cc1d8be24d.source: If Wallace comes even close to achieving this, he will have cemented his reputation as one of the great villains of American political history -- or as a true hero in certain, narrow quarters.
8c5c3b328ae412feac3b2a22087216cc1d8be24d.zh: 如果 华莱士 甚至接近实现这一目标，他将巩固自己作为美国政治史上最大恶棍之一的声誉，或者作为某些狭窄领域的真正英雄。

17bc588510a331aeedc22b7a1ce721a3378dddfa.source: If any Southern state was to secede, would you use military force as President to preserve the Union?
17bc588510a331aeedc22b7a1ce721a3378dddfa.zh: 如果某个南方州脱离联邦，作为总统，你会动用武力维护联邦吗？

68a236488b368a1d2799401bde10cc071ac5e8ac.source: If anything, we need to escalate the bombing of North Vietnam. I don't go to bed at night with the feeling that they truly respect the power of America.
68a236488b368a1d2799401bde10cc071ac5e8ac.zh: 要说有什么需要改变，那就是加大对北越的轰炸力度。我每晚睡觉时，都不觉得他们真正敬畏美国的力量。

375ddd770119c14f05df2eda5873d9da0ae1e0cc.source: If victory for the left means eight years of Bill Clinton and a term for Al Gore, then it is a shallow victory indeed. Bill Clinton has pushed cherished Republican proposals like NAFTA and welfare reform to fruition. I will end this betrayal of the American worker.
375ddd770119c14f05df2eda5873d9da0ae1e0cc.zh: 如果左翼的胜利，就意味着比尔·克林顿执政八年，再让阿尔·戈尔执政一届，那这样的胜利实在太浅薄了。比尔·克林顿把《北美自由贸易协定》和福利改革这些共和党珍爱的提案，变成了现实。我会结束这种对美国劳动者的背叛。

69af6fe8d91a0de27b129cfe7535e207e344235b.source: If we are serious about avoiding entanglement in a European war, then we should not allow merchants to put American lives at risk of attack in known war zones.
69af6fe8d91a0de27b129cfe7535e207e344235b.zh: 如果我们真心要避免卷入欧洲战争，就不应允许商人在已知的战区，让美国人的生命暴露在遭受攻击的危险之中。

fed5172057cf42284407a18dc44a2f96bf2644d4.source: If we continue our current economic policies, the economy should continue to recover into the 1960s and we will see a rebound in our employment rate.
fed5172057cf42284407a18dc44a2f96bf2644d4.zh: 如果继续实行当前的经济政策，经济应该能在1960年代继续复苏，就业率也会回升。

bafd9c8ce374e1e018aab963e0081b92657d3259.source: If we could be sure that the benefits would spread equally to the different states, I think a public works program could be helpful at this point.
bafd9c8ce374e1e018aab963e0081b92657d3259.zh: 如果能确保各州均等受益，我认为，眼下推行公共工程计划可能有所帮助。

2d29fab26c640b6a4475a1f6b23eb8751bcb68bf.source: If we could manage it, I would increase the number of justices on the Court so that we can dissipate the influence of the reactionaries presently in control there.
2d29fab26c640b6a4475a1f6b23eb8751bcb68bf.zh: 如果办得到，我会增加最高法院的大法官人数，削弱目前掌控法院的反动派的影响。

fe0a38f0fc3ac50925561472aca3417950c679aa.source: If we created jobs like this at a set minimum wage, it would benefit everyone. Private sector wages would increase and economic insecurity would be greatly mitigated for millions of people.
fe0a38f0fc3ac50925561472aca3417950c679aa.zh: 如果我们按固定最低工资创造这种工作，人人都会受益。私营部门工资会上涨，数百万人的经济不安全感也会大幅减轻。

66cb9f86318aa69e7c1bea23c95e0a6c26ec17ea.source: If we had peace in Vietnam and more investment in education here at home, we wouldn't be having these riots.
66cb9f86318aa69e7c1bea23c95e0a6c26ec17ea.zh: 如果越南实现和平，国内教育得到更多投资，我们就不会面对这些骚乱。

c6e2162c606cfca30f3bdf1df12db586013d85f3.source: If we look back to the days of Abraham Lincoln, one of our greatest leaders, he said that sometimes you need to have a public position and a private position on some issues to drive true progress.
c6e2162c606cfca30f3bdf1df12db586013d85f3.zh: 回顾亚伯拉罕·林肯的时代，他是我们最伟大的领导人之一。他说，有时在某些议题上，你需要有一套公开立场和一套私下立场，才能真正推动进步。

fc487d58d5828dcfd7f0b4bf98da3c83bd96a9e3.source: If we must make a decision, we should appeal to the progressive element of the party. These voters are the most likely ones to bolt for Wilson this fall.
fc487d58d5828dcfd7f0b4bf98da3c83bd96a9e3.zh: 如果必须作出取舍，我们就应当争取党内进步派。这些选民最有可能在今年秋季转投威尔逊。

f2029b7e45338667589ace763c1b058fb023f651.source: If we want a chance to get back in this fight, we need the moderates on board. Our speech will be on unity and strength in the party as much as it is about my ideals.
f2029b7e45338667589ace763c1b058fb023f651.zh: 如果我们还想重新投入这场较量，就得争取温和派。演说不仅要谈我的理想，也要同样强调全党的团结和力量。

e900d58a6ecb80a9cfdc660b1934954b996a90ee.source: If we want to scoop up some states in the South, we can't say anything too agressive about racial issues. Let's just focus on Humphrey for now.
e900d58a6ecb80a9cfdc660b1934954b996a90ee.zh: 如果我们想拿下南方一些州，就不能在种族问题上把话说得太冲。眼下还是集中对付汉弗莱吧。

70de1e1f2ee4bbef30c4e8f14beec5ed19772195.source: If we win Florida, this election is over. I want us doing events all over the state.
70de1e1f2ee4bbef30c4e8f14beec5ed19772195.zh: 只要赢下佛罗里达州，这场选举就结束了。我希望我们在全州各地开展活动。

b05e0668e98956aa4744d3f4d5250071f811600d.source: If you're going to win, you need to make a few new friends ... or dampen enthusiasm for Hillary.
b05e0668e98956aa4744d3f4d5250071f811600d.zh: 如果想赢，你就需要交几个新朋友，或者削弱大家对希拉里的热情……

6acdaaadef346ae272a2de24fd398fc26aff0451.source: Ignoring Clinton is a good idea, and the rest of this strategy establishes your conservative bona fides. It could be interesting.
6acdaaadef346ae272a2de24fd398fc26aff0451.zh: 不谈克林顿是个好主意，这套策略的其他部分也证明了你确实是保守派。可能会有点意思。

3d80c9c054de90efb8e08347936fe2ddc66cbd20.source: Ike is too popular not to have this playing in every household.
3d80c9c054de90efb8e08347936fe2ddc66cbd20.zh: 艾克如此受欢迎，这则广告非得让家家户户都看到不可。

27080e1d6cf60ab1c09f75b88b440ef15fa18fe8.source: Immediate independence is a little unsettling to some, but it shouldn't make too much of a difference.
27080e1d6cf60ab1c09f75b88b440ef15fa18fe8.zh: 立即独立让一些人略感不安，但应该不会造成太大影响。

402b3e92236d8eb900d00d82d43a78094e918d41.source: Immediate independence of the Philippines is not the popular position for Republicans.
402b3e92236d8eb900d00d82d43a78094e918d41.zh: 立即让菲律宾独立，在共和党人中并不受欢迎。

d7460ce0be94931a030acb10bcb125ad147f6118.source: Immigration is not a big issue in this election. Better to just focus on your core platform.
d7460ce0be94931a030acb10bcb125ad147f6118.zh: 移民并不是这次选举的重要议题。最好专注于你的核心纲领。

8973b11cad7db5a253e5da135b92219a2561e12c.source: Immigration is not a big issue in this election. There's no reason to make an unforced error like this.
8973b11cad7db5a253e5da135b92219a2561e12c.zh: 移民并不是这次选举的重要议题。没理由像这样自己犯错。

dad5eff1cd3971c342069dc5019437e5dbe1010c.source: Immigration restriction is more of a Whig position, and it does you little good to advocate for it.
dad5eff1cd3971c342069dc5019437e5dbe1010c.zh: 限制移民更像是辉格党的主张，提倡这一点，对你没有多少好处。

a8f6d952bcb5a61c8e5d5419eac10ee146eaa7bd.source: Impeachment was a very polarizing issue, and maybe it is best to just move on to other things.
a8f6d952bcb5a61c8e5d5419eac10ee146eaa7bd.zh: 弹劾是一个引发强烈政治分歧的问题，也许最好转而讨论其他事情。

46d173f511aad8a1111e37b4f805ae52d6c278b6.source: In 1972, George McGovern proposed replacing the income tax exemption with a $1,000 guaranteed minimum income, for every American citizen. Are you interested in this type of proposal?
46d173f511aad8a1111e37b4f805ae52d6c278b6.zh: 1972年，乔治·麦戈文提议取消所得税免税额，改为向每个美国公民提供1000美元的最低收入保障。你对这类提议有兴趣吗？

9221620875debdb754d67797023a0abb2f4950cc.source: In 1977, you vetoed a law requiring teachers to begin the school day with a recitation of the Pledge of Allegiance. What were you thinking?
9221620875debdb754d67797023a0abb2f4950cc.zh: 1977年，你否决了一项要求教师以宣读效忠誓词开始每天课程的法案。当时你是怎么想的？

ed7bc69aecced06be22dbc8eb9568dd3367e913b.source: In Europe, secondary education is publicly funded. I'm just pointing that out...
ed7bc69aecced06be22dbc8eb9568dd3367e913b.zh: 在欧洲，中等教育由公共资金资助。我只是指出这一点……

ea453373b4a7c269c3ed2b45cc9a56cb978c52b5.source: In November 2011, Ohio voters rejected a law to limit collective bargaining power for public unions. Do public sector unions such as teachers' and police unions have too much bargaining power?
ea453373b4a7c269c3ed2b45cc9a56cb978c52b5.zh: 2011年11月，俄亥俄州选民否决了一项限制公共部门工会集体谈判权的法律。教师和警察工会等公共部门工会，是否拥有过多的谈判权？

9973ce35356405f676619e495ad8165a3ae7de79.source: In Texas, a man named James Byrd was brutally murdered in what many call a hate crime. What is your opinion of federal hate crime legislation?
9973ce35356405f676619e495ad8165a3ae7de79.zh: 在得克萨斯州，一位名叫詹姆斯·伯德的男子遭到残忍杀害，许多人称之为仇恨犯罪。你对联邦仇恨犯罪立法有什么看法？

840fb56ad8825cc1b3f520fc9061dc50faf94fba.source: In a close election, your electoral votes in the South have prevented either candidate from winning a majority. Get ready to put the squeeze on Humphrey and Nixon.
840fb56ad8825cc1b3f520fc9061dc50faf94fba.zh: 在一场势均力敌的选举中，你们在南方的选举人票阻止了任何一位候选人赢得多数席位。准备好挤压汉弗莱和尼克松。

8861212543da0c018d0b247cdefacc872780e47c.source: If we're going to talk about “competence” in government, which party has cut inflation, unemployment, and interest rates by over half during the 1980s?
8861212543da0c018d0b247cdefacc872780e47c.zh: 如果要谈政府的“治理能力”，那么在20世纪80年代，是哪个政党将通胀率、失业率和利率都降低了一半以上？

65f11fd7802fde8129680d8928b7294a34f4e7dd.source: If we're so bent on avoiding war, why are we expanding the Army and contracting for new weapons?
65f11fd7802fde8129680d8928b7294a34f4e7dd.zh: 既然我们如此执意避免战争，又为什么要扩充陆军、订购新武器？

ebed17ab649e77c13db415d92a2d0b9728ed2872.source: If you can end the War in Vietnam and roll back the excesses of the Great Society, you may just go down as a truly great President. Good luck working with a Democratic Congress, however...
ebed17ab649e77c13db415d92a2d0b9728ed2872.zh: 如果你能结束越南战争并减少 伟大社会 的过分行为，你可能会作为一位真正伟大的总统走下坡路。不过，祝你与民主党国会合作好运……

71a9f3c312a15a322d09b231a1717957e38c0ad7.source: If you look at these mass shootings we keep seeing, assault weapons are responsible for 90 percent of the problem. Everyone wants them banned except a small group of extremists and NRA lobbyists who have bought the Republican Party wholesale.
71a9f3c312a15a322d09b231a1717957e38c0ad7.zh: 看看这些接连发生的大规模枪击，突击武器造成了其中90%的问题。除了少数极端分子，以及把共和党整个买下来的全国步枪协会说客，大家都想禁掉它们。

96b31e952dab3110da21c02e846c7fa41f44c290.source: If you look at what's happening right now with Dirty Nancy, it's a disgrace. We have a second package all ready to go, and she's blocking it until the election to make me look bad. They're putting dirty politics over helping Americans.
96b31e952dab3110da21c02e846c7fa41f44c290.zh: 看看“肮脏南希”现在的做法，真是耻辱。我们的第二套方案都准备好了，她却要阻挠到选举时，让我难堪。他们把肮脏政治放在帮助美国人民之上。

4561a8db434549d2809c70e135bcd9206ad3d671.source: If you look at what's happening right now with Trump and Mitch McConnell, they're holding up important legislation here. Hopefully everyone will come to their senses and it won't be an issue by next year.
4561a8db434549d2809c70e135bcd9206ad3d671.zh: 看看特朗普和米奇·麦康奈尔现在的做法，他们在阻挠重要立法。希望大家都会清醒过来，让这不再成为明年的问题。

a7d7d96e72a2b740b2f9f6970ec1096362074def.source: If you think that the current political dynamic is good for you, then hammering on The Wall in your speeches will do nothing but reinforce it.
a7d7d96e72a2b740b2f9f6970ec1096362074def.zh: 如果你认为，当前政治态势有利于你，那么在演说中反复强调那堵墙，只会进一步巩固它。

bfb9cd48bcd75838ada04c513853a91c58b0ceca.source: If you want harmony in your campaign, you'd be well advised to agree with the statements of Rockefeller.
bfb9cd48bcd75838ada04c513853a91c58b0ceca.zh: 如果想让竞选团队和睦，最好赞同洛克菲勒的声明。

de5528cff5d6c5b5b508e336ae01517fcff771e6.source: If you want to reunite your party, your appeal to moderates is certainly a step in the right direction, though the media focuses on one sentence in particular...
de5528cff5d6c5b5b508e336ae01517fcff771e6.zh: 如果你想重新团结全党，争取温和派确实是朝正确方向迈出的一步，尽管媒体把注意力集中在其中一句话上……

e6fb9703de05d95f65eff0cb364cfddcc8cc4bbc.source: If you want to win New Hampshire, supporting this move can't hurt.
e6fb9703de05d95f65eff0cb364cfddcc8cc4bbc.zh: 如果想赢下新罕布什尔州，支持这个决定并没有坏处。

81f250f1fae7bde3c7ef5bd849e3cfb3e48b02c3.source: If you'll remember my debate with Harold Stassen, I got this nomination in the first place by remaining above such type of politics.
81f250f1fae7bde3c7ef5bd849e3cfb3e48b02c3.zh: 如果你还记得我与哈罗德·史塔森的辩论，就会知道，我之所以获得提名，正是因为没有陷入这种政治手段。

ca4f7d426695682aaf64ac59b76812b4e21a9e7e.source: If you're a Bernie supporter, you should be outraged by this manipulation of the democratic process. It looks like the fix was in for Crooked Hillary from the day she started running!
ca4f7d426695682aaf64ac59b76812b4e21a9e7e.zh: 如果你支持伯尼，就该对这种操纵民主程序的行为感到愤怒。看来，从“骗子希拉里”开始参选那天起，就已经有人替她内定好了结果！

ed988323a08eec17bd39f601d2ac6a2d3bd3590f.source: In an unusual move, the Populist Party has supported you for President while nominating their own running-mate. The man is Thomas Watson of Georgia -- a known radical. What do you have to say about this bizarre situation?
ed988323a08eec17bd39f601d2ac6a2d3bd3590f.zh: 民粹党在提名自己的竞选伙伴的同时支持您竞选总统，这是一个不寻常的举动。此人是 佐治亚州 的托马斯·沃森 (Thomas Watson)——一位著名的激进分子。对于这种离奇的情况你有什么想说的呢？

d72c1a497bb46c65d7b6c52508570dc3d4398d07.source: In an utterly flabbergasting turn of events, the Democratic landslide forecast by every pundit from May to November has been turned completely on its head. They may be struggling to explain it on ABC, but the news is true all the same- by a combination of the Goldwater campaign’s competence, your complete and utter collapse in the last few months, and what seems like divine intervention, Barry Goldwater will be the next President.
d72c1a497bb46c65d7b6c52508570dc3d4398d07.zh: 在一个完全令人震惊的事态发展中，所有专家预测的从 5 月到 11 月的民主党将取得压倒性胜利，结果完全被颠覆了。他们可能很难在 ABC 上解释这一点，但这个消息仍然是真实的 - 通过 戈德华特 竞选活动的能力、过去几个月你的彻底崩溃以及看似神圣的干预，巴里·戈德华特 将成为下一任总统。

2629968c43b8cbf9f1fb1afb5269dded89e255b2.source: In anticipation of this attack, I've actually made some effort in the past year or so to scale back my amusements. I don't believe it is ever too late for a man to change their conduct.
2629968c43b8cbf9f1fb1afb5269dded89e255b2.zh: 我早就料到会有这种攻击，所以过去一年左右，确实已努力减少这些消遣。我相信，一个人想改变自己的行为，永远不算太晚。

58928ee59b8224d6db92798c9156c38ff9723cad.source: In climate of ‘68, this is unreasonably dovish. And it’s generated easy attacks that you are weak against Communism, and at worst, a crypto-Communist.
58928ee59b8224d6db92798c9156c38ff9723cad.zh: 在1968年的氛围下，这个立场偏鸽派得不切实际。对手很容易攻击你对共产主义软弱，甚至暗地里就是个共产党人。

36ce9a2b0528bd68170f81215eecddfc815de084.source: In defiance of the popular will, the Democrats immediately slashed tariffs and created an income tax upon their rise to power. We propose to undo these actions.
36ce9a2b0528bd68170f81215eecddfc815de084.zh: 民主党一掌权，就违背民意，大幅削减关税并设立所得税。我们主张撤销这些措施。

b7e8dfe9d63230b64f844b75b3b8be818470cc18.source: In general, is the Supreme Court too obstructionist in their rulings on economic issues? Would you appoint judges who would bring a new perspective to these issues?
b7e8dfe9d63230b64f844b75b3b8be818470cc18.zh: 总体而言，最高法院在经济问题上的裁决，是否过于阻碍改革？你会任命能为这些问题带来新视角的法官吗？

a7aa231b50751b02645b83bd83277b4d543c4880.source: In general, what is your view on the providing of foreign aid to American allies?
a7aa231b50751b02645b83bd83277b4d543c4880.zh: 总体而言，你怎么看待向美国盟国提供援助？

8d11f68d25173dc245fae9b0e5917cd6f80b231a.source: In general, your party supports liberalized trade -- unless you are really trying to push yourself over the top in a couple of states.
8d11f68d25173dc245fae9b0e5917cd6f80b231a.zh: 总体而言，你的党支持贸易自由化——除非你确实想靠这个议题，在几个州争取足以获胜的额外支持。

4b310da88c4828b91d86306ea710c0ec5f374b62.source: In light of your scathing and unrestrained jeremiads against Ben Carson before the Iowa Caucuses, what makes you now think that he is a good running mate?
4b310da88c4828b91d86306ea710c0ec5f374b62.zh: 在艾奥瓦州党团会议前，你曾对本·卡森作出尖刻而毫不留情的长篇斥责。如今又是什么让你觉得，他是合适的竞选搭档？

80dd5c6bd24d3851f9e9bd3aa213d6e6165beb45.source: In limited areas where we have new industries forming, tariffs can be higher. They should be low on most products.
80dd5c6bd24d3851f9e9bd3aa213d6e6165beb45.zh: 在少数新兴产业领域，关税可以较高，但大多数产品的关税应当较低。

75bae14e287ad437f28b9440df471920d27781e4.source: In limited cases, such as those currently in place, there is a role for vouchers. But improving public education should be our primary focus.
75bae14e287ad437f28b9440df471920d27781e4.zh: 在目前已有的某些有限情况下，学券能发挥作用。但我们的首要任务应该是改善公立教育。

4f2ffb9563cd492a6ee8e4ae0f96e08ce5861b94.source: In a comeback for the ages, you defeated Thomas Dewey and shocked the nation. Prepare for another four years in the White House. There is much work to be done. You have an ambitious domestic agenda, and face a dangerous foreign situation with the Soviet Union. With a new Democratic majority in Congress, you can hopefully push for universal health care and a repeal of the Taft-Hartley Act.
4f2ffb9563cd492a6ee8e4ae0f96e08ce5861b94.zh: 千古复出，你击败了托马斯·杜威，震惊全国。为 白宫 中的另外四年做好准备。还有很多工作要做。你们有雄心勃勃的国内议程，并面临与苏联的危险外交局势。随着民主党在国会取得新的多数席位，您有望推动全民医疗保健和废除《塔夫脱-哈特利法案》。

973bc6ddbe82f35de8a659d847528e97b001fa34.source: In a few cases, we did have to go a little further than the New Freedom ideals would imply, but we plan to take a more moderate course during my second term.
973bc6ddbe82f35de8a659d847528e97b001fa34.zh: 在少数问题上，我们确实不得不超出“新自由”理想所暗示的界限，但第二任期，我们计划采取更温和的路线。

d976247095a398f07c5993573feee3f184cbeeee.source: In a hearing today, a New York judge has set the trial date for the Trump University lawsuit to August of this year. Do you have any comment?
d976247095a398f07c5993573feee3f184cbeeee.zh: 在今天的听证中，一名纽约法官将特朗普大学诉讼的审判日期定在了今年八月。你有何评论？

103a9447c1ad53c245e851ce8d7a687753b1e2c9.source: In a hearing today, a New York judge has set the trial date for the Trump University lawsuit to December of this year. Do you have any comment?
103a9447c1ad53c245e851ce8d7a687753b1e2c9.zh: 在今天的听证中，一名纽约法官将特朗普大学诉讼的开庭日期定在了今年12月。你有什么评论？

13e14d2a1b4f60d24ddb1a685a0fbb38914494f4.source: In a nail-biter, you lost. Despite polling showing you being up for most of the campaign, Trump has come back at the last minute with a shocking victory. With an extremely slight electoral margin of victory, Donald Trump will be the next President. The House remains in Democratic hands, though the Senate will be decided by two upcoming Senate elections in Georgia.
13e14d2a1b4f60d24ddb1a685a0fbb38914494f4.zh: 经过一场令人屏息的胶着较量，你输了。尽管竞选的大部分时间里，民调都显示你领先，特朗普却在最后关头反扑，赢得惊人的胜利。凭借极其微弱的选举人票优势，唐纳德·特朗普将成为下一任总统。众议院仍由民主党掌控，但参议院将取决于佐治亚州即将举行的两场参议员选举。

a25c43066c9636c1df1b7d1a0835a5cc3a8746ca.source: In a perfect world, with fair trade, then more trade is always better. But we cannot be blind to the fact that China and other countries are cheating and ignoring many provisions of our trade deals, and deeply harming American workers in the process.
a25c43066c9636c1df1b7d1a0835a5cc3a8746ca.zh: 在一个实行公平贸易的理想世界里，贸易总是越多越好。但我们不能无视：中国等国正在作弊，漠视贸易协议中的许多条款，并在这个过程中严重伤害美国劳动者。

9caf5e910719c4685a67aa3a6ea56d351809a4ea.source: In a prime-time national speech, I will directly address the candidacy of Mr. Wallace and appeal to the better nature of our union voters.
9caf5e910719c4685a67aa3a6ea56d351809a4ea.zh: 我会在黄金时段发表全国讲话，直接回应华莱士先生的参选，并呼吁工会选民展现理性与善意。

c23597c78a4a24275e2fcb8628b4f9f83de2310d.source: In a shock to all parties involved, neither Hubert Horatio Humphrey nor Richard Milhous Nixon will be the next president of the United States. Somehow, you managed to come out on top. Southerners are ecstatic, liberals are foaming at the mouth, and the black population has never been more fearful.
c23597c78a4a24275e2fcb8628b4f9f83de2310d.zh: 所有阵营都震惊了：下一任美国总统既不是休伯特·霍雷肖·汉弗莱，也不是理查德·米尔豪斯·尼克松。不知怎么，你竟然脱颖而出。南方人欣喜若狂，自由派气得口吐白沫，而黑人群体从未如此恐惧。

71a96331e332569eed295c307c0817b9ea262944.source: In a shocker, you lost. Polling showed that you were
71a96331e332569eed295c307c0817b9ea262944.zh: 令人震惊的是，你输了。民意调查显示您是

dd8bd61e2f3ccfe4b8e69df76d991e084a16244a.source: In spite of a hard-fought challenge from Michael Dukakis, you have held on to succeed Ronald Reagan.
dd8bd61e2f3ccfe4b8e69df76d991e084a16244a.zh: 尽管面临来自 迈克尔·杜卡基斯 的艰苦挑战，你还是坚持了下来，取得了成功 罗纳德·里根。

90c81c0a7123aff391f0142ec68a222e7f0a3169.source: In spite of a hard-fought challenge from Mitt Romney, you have held on to the Presidency.
90c81c0a7123aff391f0142ec68a222e7f0a3169.zh: 尽管面临来自 米特·罗姆尼 的艰苦挑战，您仍然保住了总统职位。

97ae77fb57d077b1867a256d5457e8b192f835b5.source: In spite of a real scare from Mr. Bryan, you have done your part to preserve good order in the United States.
97ae77fb57d077b1867a256d5457e8b192f835b5.zh: 尽管 布赖恩 先生确实吓坏了您，但您已经尽了自己的努力来维护美国的良好秩序。

570a02c9888281d3319e782cd848524f74c02b2a.source: In spite of anti-war sentiment elsewhere, most voters are deeply upset by the death of Americans at the hand of Pancho Villa.
570a02c9888281d3319e782cd848524f74c02b2a.zh: 尽管在其他问题上有反战情绪，大多数选民对美国人死于潘乔·比利亚之手，仍感到极为愤慨。

2c3982878533180c5b4bc0ac5bc2bdcfc03a8612.source: In spite of everything, I hate to see something like this. You know, she was at my wedding. A lot of people forget that, but I never want to see her undergo physical harm. I wish Hillary a speedy recovery and I'm sending her my thoughts.
2c3982878533180c5b4bc0ac5bc2bdcfc03a8612.zh: 尽管有这一切，我仍不愿看到这种事。你知道，她参加过我的婚礼。很多人忘了这一点，但我绝不想看到她身体受到伤害。我祝希拉里早日康复，也向她表达慰问。

2a515dd4cb21b2136c8db31b5be14de8b4e081ee.source: In spite of the 269-269 tie in the electoral college, Republicans control a majority of state delegations in the House of Representatives. A lot of liberals are absolutely distraught and outraged that the election came down to such a technicality, but hey, those are the rules!
2a515dd4cb21b2136c8db31b5be14de8b4e081ee.zh: 尽管 选举人团 中以 269-269 平局，共和党控制着众议院的大多数州代表团。许多自由派人士对选举陷入如此技术性的问题绝对感到心烦意乱和愤怒，但是嘿，这就是规则！

46601299128b311af1bcd8269037d53c7bbe7c9f.source: In spite of the 269-269 tie in the electoral college, Republicans control a majority of state delegations in the House of Representatives. After an election in which many of your supporters claimed democracy itself was at stake, what happens now? Perhaps the party will need to go in a completely different direction in 2024.
46601299128b311af1bcd8269037d53c7bbe7c9f.zh: 尽管 选举人团 中以 269-269 平局，但共和党控制着众议院的大多数州代表团。在你的许多支持者声称民主本身受到威胁的选举之后，现在会发生什么？也许到 2024 年，该党需要走一个完全不同的方向。

611baf7968021f12b1b06ac15a0f83affa5cb513.source: In spite of you being the favorite, things just never seemed to click once the real campaigning began.
611baf7968021f12b1b06ac15a0f83affa5cb513.zh: 尽管你是最受欢迎的，但一旦真正的竞选活动开始，事情似乎就永远不会顺利。

6956d7e7f4f2f8697985018bd37a7e7993f9be90.source: In spite of your best efforts, Barack Obama has been reelected to a second term as President.
6956d7e7f4f2f8697985018bd37a7e7993f9be90.zh: 尽管您尽了最大努力，贝拉克·奥巴马 仍再次当选为总统。

3861206cab027c22f98fc605fae937240d6f1eae.source: In spite of your spirited defense, Mitt Romney has won the Presidency. Nearly two centuries after the ill-fated campaign of Joseph Smith, Romney will become America's first Mormon president.
3861206cab027c22f98fc605fae937240d6f1eae.zh: 尽管你们奋力辩护，米特·罗姆尼还是赢得了总统职位。在约瑟夫·史密斯（Joseph Smith）不幸的竞选活动近两个世纪后，罗姆尼将成为美国第一位摩门教总统。

be7f718bccb8c68e6e4aa8020d330ffdcc9c7713.source: In the 1990s or early 2000s, this might have been a mainstream Democratic position, but it is starting to feel a bit behind the times for many of your supporters.
be7f718bccb8c68e6e4aa8020d330ffdcc9c7713.zh: 在二十世纪九十年代或本世纪初，这也许还是民主党的主流立场，但对许多支持者来说，它开始显得有点落后于时代。

33b674d288ed3e6a0f1497ba5fb7c7c4bdae7200.source: In the best-case scenario, this complicates your attempt to win moderate voters. But you don't help matters by doubling down on this.
33b674d288ed3e6a0f1497ba5fb7c7c4bdae7200.zh: 即使往好处想，这也会让你更难争取温和派选民。而你加倍坚持这种说法，并没有让局面好转。

55e70ad510e6c7c6e40f8c4d214041fb438f9601.source: In making appointments to your campaign (and by implication, when you are President), will you favor traditional Republicans, Progressives, or try for an even balance?
55e70ad510e6c7c6e40f8c4d214041fb438f9601.zh: 在任命竞选团队成员时——也意味着日后担任总统时——你会偏向传统共和党人、进步派，还是尽量均衡安排？

2690704b7ab24a6c686012638b576bb3d165a72e.source: In one of the great turnarounds of American politics, you have salvaged your once-wrecked political career and shed your label as a 'loser' once and for all. As it turns out, the press
2690704b7ab24a6c686012638b576bb3d165a72e.zh: 在美国政治的伟大转变之一中，你挽救了曾经被毁的政治生涯，并一劳永逸地摆脱了“失败者”的标签。事实证明，媒体

04f007536f7e0048e860cd3549f63e269f0fb164.source: In one of the strangest events that took place during this campaign, you didn't end up winning the popular vote, despite winning the electoral vote! Republicans are quite angry about this, and you can't help but crack a smile, and wonder why you and Bill could never surpass 50% of the popular vote. Maybe in 2020?
04f007536f7e0048e860cd3549f63e269f0fb164.zh: 这场竞选出现了一件极其奇怪的事：尽管赢得了选举人票，你却没能赢得普选票！共和党人对此很愤怒，你忍不住微微一笑，心想，怎么你和比尔就从来没能拿到超过50%的普选票呢？也许2020年能做到？

8f5ea2397973f10769b1e50dd9a6ff161c47a909.source: In our volatile environment, it is hardly helpful to have many thousand young men marching in pseudo-military garb, professing their support for the Republicans.
8f5ea2397973f10769b1e50dd9a6ff161c47a909.zh: 在我们这个动荡的局势下，成千上万的青年穿着仿军事服装游行，宣称支持共和党，实在无助于局面。

3c49d5f1f61fbd6eb8932d8f56033925a77356dd.source: In part due to statements like this, America is rapidly becoming polarized on the question of COVID precautions. Will that help you in November?
3c49d5f1f61fbd6eb8932d8f56033925a77356dd.zh: 部分由于这类言论，美国在新冠防护问题上正迅速走向对立。这会在十一月帮助你吗？

b775c25749240691a6c793711b0f1ca84cb93264.source: In reality though, it's unclear if Rand Paul would want to take on this role, as it would alienate him from the Republican Party and make a successful run for him in 2016 almost impossible.
b775c25749240691a6c793711b0f1ca84cb93264.zh: 但实际上，尚不清楚 兰德·保罗 是否愿意担任这个角色，因为这会使他与 共和党 疏远，并使他在 2016 年成功竞选几乎不可能。

b02df635b089bcd82eafe046c4af324c09f75de8.source: In spite of a hard-fought campaign from Barack Obama, you have won the Presidency. Nearly two centuries after the ill-fated campaign of Joseph Smith, you will become America's first Mormon president. Your next steps are to select a cabinet and  prepare a rousing inauguration speech. On the political front, you may have the support needed to overturn Obamacare. Or you could focus on tax cuts, or other policies entirely.
b02df635b089bcd82eafe046c4af324c09f75de8.zh: 尽管 贝拉克·奥巴马 进行了一场艰苦的竞选活动，您还是赢得了总统职位。在约瑟夫·史密斯不幸的竞选活动近两个世纪后，您将成为美国第一位摩门教总统。您的下一步是选择内阁并准备激动人心的就职演说。在政治方面，您可能拥有推翻奥巴马医改所需的支持。或者你可以专注于减税或完全其他政策。

a307b55d39ef2570833fd6886bea503c93b18001.source: In spite of a hard-fought challenge from Charles Evans Hughes, you have held on to the Presidency.
a307b55d39ef2570833fd6886bea503c93b18001.zh: 尽管面临来自 查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯 的艰苦挑战，您仍然保住了总统职位。

7f8ffa1bd98150efb50d52352e95c6aa401daa48.source: In spite of a hard-fought challenge from Donald Trump, you have become the first woman elected to serve as President.
7f8ffa1bd98150efb50d52352e95c6aa401daa48.zh: 尽管面临来自 唐纳德·特朗普 的艰苦挑战，您仍然成为第一位当选总统的女性。

2939f9a02ffbef3c86351a05bb47ca606669cc25.source: In spite of a hard-fought challenge from George Bush, you have held on to succeed Ronald Reagan.
2939f9a02ffbef3c86351a05bb47ca606669cc25.zh: 尽管面临来自 乔治·布什 的艰苦挑战，您还是坚持了下来，取得了成功 罗纳德·里根。

8f0fe0ef60e218112daecffb2ac0b734bba26a61.source: In spite of a hard-fought challenge from Hillary Clinton, you have shocked the world with your election victory.
8f0fe0ef60e218112daecffb2ac0b734bba26a61.zh: 尽管面临来自希拉里·克林顿的艰苦挑战，您的选举胜利震惊了世界。

f8b6fd17ff19fb755c0e61b3ad8ed68d1d0b0548.source: In this day and age, this might be the best stance. Voters like the fact that we're not at war right now.
f8b6fd17ff19fb755c0e61b3ad8ed68d1d0b0548.zh: 在如今这个时代，这也许是最好的立场。选民喜欢我们现在没有打仗这个事实。

0e43172fb21289ed7142e02149032267e7d0e5fa.source: In yet another situation that is sure to anger Democrats, you have lost the popular vote, despite winning the election. You can bet the electoral college is going to be discussed a lot over the next 4 years, but you're not going to let anything happen to it, will you?
0e43172fb21289ed7142e02149032267e7d0e5fa.zh: 在另一种肯定会激怒民主党的情况下，尽管赢得了选举，但你还是失去了普选。您可以打赌，选举人团 在接下来的 4 年里将会被广泛讨论，但您不会让它发生任何事情，不是吗？

8edef5fa757bbdbe8726b7be0aac8bb31bf6caa4.source: In your acceptance speech at the 1964 Republican National Convention, you said 'And may I remind you that extremism in the defense of liberty is no vice.' What did you mean by that?
8edef5fa757bbdbe8726b7be0aac8bb31bf6caa4.zh: 在1964年共和党全国代表大会接受提名的演说中，你说：“我要提醒大家，为捍卫自由而采取极端立场，并非恶行。”你这句话是什么意思？

645c09885245bfed676e49f38b61c72a1f53a7fe.source: In your infamous Playboy interview, you also referred to Lyndon Johnson as "lying, cheating, and distorting the truth." This might make you look honest, but it could destroy your chances of winning Texas if you don't apologize.
645c09885245bfed676e49f38b61c72a1f53a7fe.zh: 在那场声名狼藉的《花花公子》采访中，你还说林登·约翰逊“撒谎、欺骗、歪曲真相”。这也许让你显得诚实，但如果不道歉，就可能毁掉你赢得得克萨斯州的机会。

178608fc3fb14c8254819ead15e490b13c35f51a.source: Incidents in the Life of a Slave Girl

129203e0428a790204c05b4a60b199e286e85c2d.source: Increasing the American troop presence, yet again, in Afghanistan is definitely not a popular position at the moment.
129203e0428a790204c05b4a60b199e286e85c2d.zh: 目前，再一次增加美国在阿富汗的驻军，肯定不是受欢迎的立场。

8b53cc3476f6d724c51d73050e4f688b20ac29b8.source: Incredibly idealistic, but it’s brought cheers from doves and the New Left.
8b53cc3476f6d724c51d73050e4f688b20ac29b8.zh: 极其理想主义，不过，鸽派和新左派为之欢呼。

efe23621dc6a1a090036699a3af94fd604d5a2f8.source: Indiana has always been the critical swing state. Let's spend most of our time there while also crossing over into Illinois and Kentucky.
efe23621dc6a1a090036699a3af94fd604d5a2f8.zh: 印第安纳一直是关键的摇摆州。我们大部分时间留在那里，同时也跨境访问伊利诺伊和肯塔基。

17a05130c3dcc46fd902403ebc0a15eb8e03c8f0.source: Ineffective, immoral, and illegal. Intellectuals in improperly influential offices are destroying the United States.
17a05130c3dcc46fd902403ebc0a15eb8e03c8f0.zh: 无效、不道德，而且违法。那些占据职位、拥有不当影响力的知识分子，正在毁掉美国。

0750c4d480d306a1840480b363f23046c1ccdf57.source: Infrastructure spending is farily popular across the spectrum. It wouldn't hurt you to be more supportive of it.
0750c4d480d306a1840480b363f23046c1ccdf57.zh: 基础设施支出在各种政治立场的人中，都相当受欢迎。更积极地支持它，对你没有坏处。

18d65f483bae5b2a07efc04636cacc2abdd04c55.source: Infrastructure spending is farily popular across the spectrum. There's nothing wrong with going big here, politically.
18d65f483bae5b2a07efc04636cacc2abdd04c55.zh: 基础设施支出在各种政治立场的人中，都相当受欢迎。从政治上说，大手笔没有什么不对。

f6f3eb44538a3a5280a9f05bc7ed59ab6871b806.source: Interesting answer, though a few people are mumbling about you comparing yourself to Lincoln.
f6f3eb44538a3a5280a9f05bc7ed59ab6871b806.zh: 回答有点意思，不过有些人正在嘀咕，你竟然把自己比作林肯。

474c625406fcbeb10a55a667ce5a885961c22b99.source: Interesting argument. It seemed to be pretty clear that you meant, at the very least, all Muslims who were not U.S. citizens.
474c625406fcbeb10a55a667ce5a885961c22b99.zh: 这个论点挺有意思。之前你的意思似乎相当明确：至少是所有非美国公民的穆斯林。

d18740b32dd460180057f0fca04e8dd686575662.source: Interesting campaign strategy. But you will lose a good number of votes in states like Florida and Ohio, and every little bit helps if you want to hit 5% nationally.
d18740b32dd460180057f0fca04e8dd686575662.zh: 竞选策略有点意思。但你会在佛罗里达和俄亥俄等州丢掉不少选票；要想在全国达到5%，每一点票数都有用。

f98883cc636da2f3be38580461dc46334a7b8170.source: Interesting ideas, but immigration is not a big issue in this election. But no harm, no foul.
f98883cc636da2f3be38580461dc46334a7b8170.zh: 想法有点意思，但移民并不是这次选举的重要议题。不过，既然没造成什么损失，也就无妨。

1e1357d14fb5f49967cf724c5ae2f0974c3091bf.source: Interestingly enough, Ford ended up winning the popular vote. Republicans are more shocked than angry. Perhaps passing a new version of the Bayh-Celler amendment can be among your reforms?
1e1357d14fb5f49967cf724c5ae2f0974c3091bf.zh: 有意思的是，福特最终赢得了普选票。共和党人更多是震惊，而不是愤怒。或许，推动一个新版的贝赫—塞勒修正案，可以成为你改革的一部分？

315771ab408cca94fb184ca0c5f2b21bfb6da9af.source: Interestingly enough, you've lost the popular vote despite winning overall, for the first time since 1888. Republicans aren't too happy about losing 3 elections in a row to someone who won less than 50% of the popular vote.
315771ab408cca94fb184ca0c5f2b21bfb6da9af.zh: 有趣的是，你虽然赢得了大选，却输掉了普选票。这是1888年以来的第一次。共和党人对连续三次输给普选票未过半的候选人，十分不满。

b3eef707cd81b1d2e1ff5fbfd1ab78e829fb5c34.zh: 国内交通与公共工程建设

6d240bdb198d66ddf78e11b92e6adb8f2f16aa17.source: Internal areas of the country have the same rights to use our waterways as the coastal regions. Making the Mississippi more navigable and more flood-resistant could prove to be an economic windfall.
6d240bdb198d66ddf78e11b92e6adb8f2f16aa17.zh: 内陆地区与沿海地区，同样有权使用我国的水道。改善密西西比河的通航和防洪条件，可能带来巨大的经济收益。

8957cc15f304308921bf1f4a7040e00c2108b31a.source: International trade will undermine the prosperity of the working man as quickly as it will undermine the sovereignty of the United States. I don't support any of these global organizations.
8957cc15f304308921bf1f4a7040e00c2108b31a.zh: 国际贸易既会损害劳动者的福祉，也会损害美国的主权。我不支持任何这类全球性组织。

f7903567b9e770b7646f13d555396b802f11bf82.source: Iowa is a key state and this should help you there.
f7903567b9e770b7646f13d555396b802f11bf82.zh: 艾奥瓦是关键州，这应该有助于你在那里争取支持。

aea71dd291f1331f19a8e8456b45f7d185cd1215.source: Irish voters notice your unexpected strong support of their position -- as do others.
aea71dd291f1331f19a8e8456b45f7d185cd1215.zh: 爱尔兰裔选民注意到，你出人意料地大力支持他们的立场——其他人也注意到了。

139c76d8862480d391ff18fb56a5f2d77d396664.source: Is it any coincidence that the Clintons had Chelsea during the roughest part of Bill's political career? The people of Arkansas were beginning to figure out that there's no love in Clinton relationship. Just a naked ambition for power, that's all.
139c76d8862480d391ff18fb56a5f2d77d396664.zh: 克林顿夫妇在比尔政治生涯最艰难的时候生下切尔西，这难道是巧合？阿肯色州人民当时开始看清，克林顿夫妇的关系里没有爱，只有赤裸裸的权力野心，仅此而已。

5a2fa9d4a3f7ad42e288f2fb2b90d87bb738dc6b.source: Is it generally appropriate for federal courts to issue injunctions against striking unions?
5a2fa9d4a3f7ad42e288f2fb2b90d87bb738dc6b.zh: 一般而言，联邦法院针对罢工工会发布禁令，是否恰当？

d6ea3f699dc743114a4fad598addddb61188e821.source: Is it time for the federal government to cut spending, even with the economy growing at less than 2% annually?
d6ea3f699dc743114a4fad598addddb61188e821.zh: 即使经济年增长率不足2%，联邦政府是否也到了该削减支出的时候？

cf2c03ed6921de70b97f4a8dfff7cd3fcdea19b3.source: Is it true that you are a “card-carrying” member of the American Civil Liberties Union?
cf2c03ed6921de70b97f4a8dfff7cd3fcdea19b3.zh: 你真的是美国公民自由联盟的一名“持有会员证”的会员吗？

631a956bcadffedbcccaa4a85a092e38330a7c60.source: Is it true that you claimed to have invented the internet?
631a956bcadffedbcccaa4a85a092e38330a7c60.zh: 你真的声称过，是你发明了互联网吗？

0e6a1d1a1886b88cd68c10036e839e4f10af22f4.source: Is the House Un-American Activities Committee going too far in its attempts to root out Communist influence, or should it be doing more?
0e6a1d1a1886b88cd68c10036e839e4f10af22f4.zh: 众议院非美活动调查委员会清除共产党影响的行动，是否已经走得太远，还是应该做得更多？

ad3eb77d21ccf8f69b6635c056efa718c7da4e17.source: Is the United States adequately prepared to defend against the Soviet threat today?
ad3eb77d21ccf8f69b6635c056efa718c7da4e17.zh: 今天，美国是否已做好充分准备，应对苏联的威胁？

4085ced671c3c2433ce041e789df663d1c02a343.source: Is the United States too reliant on fossil fuels for its energy needs?
4085ced671c3c2433ce041e789df663d1c02a343.zh: 美国在能源需求上，是否过于依赖化石燃料？

002142ccebd5131433150199d70f6934efb90c06.source: Is there a particular state that you believe the party should concentrate its resources into during the final days of the campaign?
002142ccebd5131433150199d70f6934efb90c06.zh: 在竞选的最后几天，你认为党应当把资源集中到哪个州？

9d12d375728a064e028b0b65215aa7c36676246a.source: Is there a particular state that you would concentrate your efforts on during the final days of the campaign?
9d12d375728a064e028b0b65215aa7c36676246a.zh: 在竞选的最后几天，你会把精力集中到哪个州？

3c0f3d63f674e9b606a4e9583dae4a8aa8cb9167.source: Is there a particular state where your party should concentrate its resources and most talented speakers as the election draws near?
3c0f3d63f674e9b606a4e9583dae4a8aa8cb9167.zh: 大选临近，你们党是否应当把资源和最优秀的演说家集中到某个州？

997ecdfbaf7ecf9c30d8b91ec7f5718f270d55ec.source: Is there anyone left in the United States who approves of Grover Cleveland? We need to move on from his failed Administration.
997ecdfbaf7ecf9c30d8b91ec7f5718f270d55ec.zh: 美国还有谁赞同格罗弗·克利夫兰吗？我们需要告别他那失败的政府。

e79bd593dbf24d30141198af6ff586b80035a2ce.source: Is there anything you can say during your acceptance speech at the national convention to shake this race up?
e79bd593dbf24d30141198af6ff586b80035a2ce.zh: 在全国代表大会的接受提名演说中，你能说些什么，来打破这场竞选的僵局？

805da48473941e541ade2e6bd634d1e9b4d8917f.source: Is there something you can do to give the Southern Whigs political cover from the incessant attacks that they are in league with an anti-slavery party?
805da48473941e541ade2e6bd634d1e9b4d8917f.zh: 南方辉格党人不断受到攻击，被指责与反奴隶制政党为伍。你能否采取什么措施，替他们提供政治上的辩护？

14fc0137b1bba5f1ea5e59120a6648e9bc30b4bf.source: Is there too much regulation of the American logging industry?
14fc0137b1bba5f1ea5e59120a6648e9bc30b4bf.zh: 美国伐木业受到的监管是否过多？

c7285897e6515f61a556f29e6aaf3199c7c556a0.source: Is this a real question? Where states refuse to uphold their responsibilities, the federal government should step in. Perhaps we can argue about the severity of the penalty, but never about the crime itself.
c7285897e6515f61a556f29e6aaf3199c7c556a0.zh: 这真是个问题吗？各州拒绝履行责任时，联邦政府就应该介入。也许我们可以争论处罚的严厉程度，但绝不能争论行为本身是不是犯罪。

7726066f7165337bf93d06c67ff6db07a896f29d.source: Is this even a real issue, or just some propoganda being put out there by Xi Jingping and the Communist Chinese Party?
7726066f7165337bf93d06c67ff6db07a896f29d.zh: 这到底是真问题，还是习近平和中国共产党散布的宣传？

1c6e1098cfcb49f3c2cb240bb2cc6ec71474a582.source: Is this question some kind of a joke? We need to withdraw all American troops from Vietnam.
1c6e1098cfcb49f3c2cb240bb2cc6ec71474a582.zh: 这个问题是在开玩笑吗？我们必须把所有美军撤出越南。

19fa4bb1cd912213ced5188a6e9bdfa708809829.source: Is your campaign planning to allow Ron Paul a high-profile speaking slot at the Republican Convention, in light of the number of delegates that he commands?
19fa4bb1cd912213ced5188a6e9bdfa708809829.zh: 考虑到罗恩·保罗掌握的代表票数量，你的竞选团队是否打算让他在共和党全国代表大会上获得一个引人注目的演讲时段？

d295694402e32890a5981ef3faac6ccbb633be61.source: In the final analysis, every dollar spent on defense is taken from more productive uses within our economy. I will look for ways to find common ground with the Soviet Union so that we can cut defense spending.
d295694402e32890a5981ef3faac6ccbb633be61.zh: 归根结底，国防每花一美元，就使经济中更有生产效益的用途少了一美元。我会寻求与苏联达成共识，以便削减国防开支。

a0ceef12735e0bfb0d913e33136c005daacc58ca.source: In the most general terms, what will be your overall campaign strategy against Obama?
a0ceef12735e0bfb0d913e33136c005daacc58ca.zh: 概括来说，你对阵奥巴马的总体竞选策略是什么？

5fbb7c4cecdaa0c7ef6c85dfa335a31bda79605a.source: In the most general terms, what will be your overall campaign strategy against Romney?
5fbb7c4cecdaa0c7ef6c85dfa335a31bda79605a.zh: 概括来说，你对阵罗姆尼的总体竞选策略是什么？

32a2eaa85e2889b3c1b2e67204819f6eb32a7402.source: In the next issue of Playboy, there's an interview where you used the words "screw" and "shack up" and confessed, "I've committed adultery in my heart..." Many of your religious supporters are furious. What can you say to explain yourself?
32a2eaa85e2889b3c1b2e67204819f6eb32a7402.zh: 在下一期《花花公子》的采访中，您使用了“拧”和“同居”等词并承认，“我在心里犯了通奸……”您的许多宗教支持者都感到愤怒。你能说什么来解释自己？

119fd2fd33011eae1d2e1c6bdd9c4f8e1b1e6486.source: In the past you have expressed varying opinions about abortion. Can you reassure the evangelical Christian movement that you are 100% pro-life in all circumstances?
119fd2fd33011eae1d2e1c6bdd9c4f8e1b1e6486.zh: 过去，你对堕胎表达过不同意见。你能否向福音派基督徒保证，在任何情况下，你都百分之百反对堕胎？

87e5b5a94640d177ed743fad41c967f1e5d28e86.source: In the wake of Trump's nomination, a number of prominent anti-Trump Republicans are organizing to cast votes for Libertarian Gary Johnson as a protest, with an emphasis on the Western states. What are your thoughts?
87e5b5a94640d177ed743fad41c967f1e5d28e86.zh: 特朗普获提名后，一些知名的反特朗普共和党人正组织起来，准备以投票支持自由意志党的加里·约翰逊来表示抗议，尤其着重于西部各州。你怎么看？

7c8a533195fe410177d90a8c5bab040355044bd3.source: In the wake of your nomination, a few anti-Trump conservatives are organizing to cast votes for Evan McMullin as a protest, with an emphasis on the Western states. What are your thoughts?
7c8a533195fe410177d90a8c5bab040355044bd3.zh: 你获得提名后，一些反对特朗普的保守派正组织选民以投票给埃文·麦克马林的方式表达抗议，尤其着眼于西部各州。你对此有什么看法？

8712560357200dcd3c6cd7327228621d7f11f754.source: In the wake of your nomination, a number of prominent anti-Trump Republicans are organizing to cast votes for Libertarian Gary Johnson as a protest, with an emphasis on the Western states. What are your thoughts?
8712560357200dcd3c6cd7327228621d7f11f754.zh: 你获提名后，一些知名的反特朗普共和党人正组织起来，准备以投票支持自由意志党的加里·约翰逊来表示抗议，尤其着重于西部各州。你怎么看？

3dbfb0270f721263faabcd6920be58c98e6b764d.source: In the world we live in now, we need to remain vigilant, lest we see the world overwhelmed by Communist expansion. I think this measure is, unfortunately, a necessary one.
3dbfb0270f721263faabcd6920be58c98e6b764d.zh: 在如今这个世界，我们必须保持警惕，以免共产主义的扩张席卷全球。我认为，尽管令人遗憾，这项措施仍是必要的。

779fa55b9062341cc3467d1c52bb8bfe3cb5f3f7.source: In this case, I desired to emphasize my commitment to reform, and to introduce new blood into the national office of Vice President.
779fa55b9062341cc3467d1c52bb8bfe3cb5f3f7.zh: 这次，我希望强调自己对改革的承诺，并为副总统这个全国性职位引入新血液。

6a0b47851579c3e4246eb51cff9edfc16fe51cec.source: In this day and age you gotta use social media. You gotta. Now I think we can all agree that a general election is different from a primary so I might tone it down a little on some things, but you gotta use social media.
6a0b47851579c3e4246eb51cff9edfc16fe51cec.zh: 在这个时代，你得用社交媒体。非用不可。大家应该都同意，大选跟初选不一样，所以有些事情上我也许会收敛一点，但社交媒体非用不可。

56034bd205a7abd6e9fae7acb001bbabbb551e9f.source: It has been a raucous and emotional couple of weeks in America, and you are certainly doing your part to keep it that way.
56034bd205a7abd6e9fae7acb001bbabbb551e9f.zh: 美国这几周喧闹而情绪激动，你显然也在尽自己的力，让这种局面继续。

ed2abf07a99c5c365ccb9058fca89d070136b832.source: It has been alleged that opportunistic young women have married Union Army veterans for the sole purpose of exploiting the pension system. Do you consider this to be a form of corruption? Would you implement some standards that widows must meet before they can inherit these pensions?
ed2abf07a99c5c365ccb9058fca89d070136b832.zh: 有人声称，一些投机的年轻女子与联邦军老兵结婚，纯粹是为了钻抚恤金制度的空子。你认为这算腐败吗？你会规定，遗孀必须符合某些条件，才能继领这些抚恤金吗？

f1497b144f6d80492addbbb3fd148d97c7186de7.source: It has taken a couple of years after the end of the war, but I can already see that many new houses are being built by private developers to resolve this shortage, and I can only predict that this trend will continue without any special action by the government.
f1497b144f6d80492addbbb3fd148d97c7186de7.zh: 战争结束后过了几年，我已经看到私人开发商正在建设许多新住房，缓解短缺。我只能预计，即便政府不采取特别行动，这个趋势也会持续。

22b0ed29f852037a34566bb2964fbfa25235f8c8.source: It is November 2nd, only five days before the voting. News has just broken that George Bush was arrested for drunken driving in 1976. What is your response?
22b0ed29f852037a34566bb2964fbfa25235f8c8.zh: 现在是11月2日，距投票只有五天。乔治·布什在1976年因酒后驾车被捕的消息刚刚曝光。你会怎样回应？

4ba3f49d621f4aefae4e8d1e3dee57c4425ce431.source: It is November 2nd, only five days before the voting. News has just broken that you were arrested for drunken driving in 1976. What is your response?
4ba3f49d621f4aefae4e8d1e3dee57c4425ce431.zh: 现在是11月2日，距投票只有五天。你在1976年因酒后驾车被捕的消息刚刚曝光。你会怎样回应？

9fa2f007bc09e6d531a306b05a863faadaffb86b.source: It is a net positive that you are embracing Clinton's legacy. Just keep in mind that there's a trade-off -- some left-wing voters believe that Clinton is too moderate.
9fa2f007bc09e6d531a306b05a863faadaffb86b.zh: 认同克林顿留下的政绩，总体上对你有利。不过要记住，这也有代价——有些左翼选民认为克林顿太温和。

3f77805174f12de039cb261e3305e7a5ada4ffb8.source: It is good to have a united party, heading into the fall. Make sure to keep Seward happy if you win.
3f77805174f12de039cb261e3305e7a5ada4ffb8.zh: 临近秋季大选，保持党内团结是件好事。如果获胜，别忘了让苏厄德满意。

4c65a8f755844536e9b3d09b3c6f8dbccd10847c.source: It is important to keep the Democratic Party moving into the future. We need to act on civil rights, education, and health care over the coming term.
4c65a8f755844536e9b3d09b3c6f8dbccd10847c.zh: 让民主党继续走向未来十分重要。下个任期，我们需要在民权、教育和医疗保障方面采取行动。

ef028a90f87862f1ff7eb24a259764cd945b0a14.source: It is important to keep the Republican Party moving into the future. We need to act on civil rights, education, and health care over the coming term.
ef028a90f87862f1ff7eb24a259764cd945b0a14.zh: 让共和党继续走向未来十分重要。下个任期，我们需要在民权、教育和医疗保障方面采取行动。

bceaec95e4f6b43f04882e87871d8381f728efa9.source: It is important to nail down our conservative base by emphasizing tax cuts, my evangelical background, opposition to abortion, a strong defense, and limits to government spending. We will ignore Bill Clinton, but paint Al Gore as out of touch.
bceaec95e4f6b43f04882e87871d8381f728efa9.zh: 重要的是，通过强调减税、我的福音派背景、反对堕胎、强大的国防和限制政府开支，巩固保守派基本盘。我们不谈比尔·克林顿，但会把阿尔·戈尔描绘成脱离民众的人。

7ea1ea615abfeeb9332bf93ed577037896e7449a.source: Israel has every right to these territories they now occupy. They were attacked from all sides by an enemy bent on their destruction.
7ea1ea615abfeeb9332bf93ed577037896e7449a.zh: 以色列完全有权拥有目前占领的这些领土。它遭到四面八方的敌人攻击，而那些敌人一心要将它消灭。

bfbe07698e53fa3ece67863abb0f579b9792cb7c.source: It agonizes me that we do not have this protection in place. Have we not seen children who are seven years old losing their hands in the cotton looms?
bfbe07698e53fa3ece67863abb0f579b9792cb7c.zh: 我们竟然还没有这种保障，真让我痛心。难道我们没见过，七岁的孩子在棉纺织机里失去双手吗？

369bae2d2ea59fb4f319bd1b2abd92cd77933131.source: It appears that Wilson's agenda will remain in effect domestically. In world affairs, it remains to be seen how the situation in Europe will finally resolve itself. As to your own prospects, it is unclear what your next steps will be. The Supreme Court seat you once enjoyed has now been lost for the foreseeable future.
369bae2d2ea59fb4f319bd1b2abd92cd77933131.zh: 看来威尔逊 议程将在国内继续有效。国际事务中，欧洲局势最终如何解决还有待观察。至于你自己的前景，目前还不清楚你下一步会做什么。你曾经享有的最高法院席位现在在可预见的未来已经失去了。

6812a7eee1f9271ba4105290d52309a22bf11bf6.source: It baffles me how someone could be ashamed to display the American flag. It seems a little unpatriotic to me.
6812a7eee1f9271ba4105290d52309a22bf11bf6.zh: 居然有人羞于展示美国国旗，我实在不理解。在我看来，这有点不爱国。

d33ced96c54f71fac54515fcf7479f6aef760d60.source: It can't hurt you to be magnanimous once in awhile.
d33ced96c54f71fac54515fcf7479f6aef760d60.zh: 偶尔大度一点，对你没有坏处。

3c27e4cac711cc9e84cd43956856ce5dca7cb29c.source: It comes as no surprise to anyone but the most devoted Goldwater supporters, but you have emerged victorious from the 1964 Election- an outcome that was never in doubt. Your supporters sit back in smug satisfaction as Goldwater delivers a muted concession speech, and you can rest assured that another four years in office awaits you.
3c27e4cac711cc9e84cd43956856ce5dca7cb29c.zh: 除了最忠实的 戈德华特 支持者之外，任何人都不会感到惊讶，但你们在 1964 年的选举中取得了胜利 - 这是一个不容置疑的结果。当 戈德华特 发表无声的败选演讲时，您的支持者沾沾自喜地坐了下来，您可以放心，还有四年的任期等待着您。

f25a987d3ed7d71e1c37dc02809afd07597fa150.source: It does not help your stature to be attacking a third-party candidate like Ralph Nader.
f25a987d3ed7d71e1c37dc02809afd07597fa150.zh: 攻击拉尔夫·纳德这样的第三党候选人，并不能提升你的地位。

60d45dd070c75c5f3ced6cd68c38283470dd5b16.source: It does not look good for Al Gore, noted environmentalist, to come out against the Kyoto Protocol.
60d45dd070c75c5f3ced6cd68c38283470dd5b16.zh: 阿尔·戈尔这位知名环保人士，出来反对《京都议定书》，可不好看。

0ef27be1f6d29020eb3d40c62c2ded1391fdd992.source: It doesn't look good to rebuke your running mate in such a hawkish manner.
0ef27be1f6d29020eb3d40c62c2ded1391fdd992.zh: 用如此鹰派的方式斥责自己的搭档，可不太好看。

725c020394f6a249f30d137925d430306f69ba8e.source: It doesn't matter so much how to stack up to Bush -- anything you can do to subliminally convey that you
725c020394f6a249f30d137925d430306f69ba8e.zh: 如何叠加到 布什 并不那么重要——你可以做任何事情来下意识地传达你

559f4a1c9c8f5916ee55dcc56bca6e38c83482fc.source: It doesn't matter what the “label” is that we use. The important thing is the issues we will decide upon.
559f4a1c9c8f5916ee55dcc56bca6e38c83482fc.zh: 我们使用什么“标签”并不重要。重要的是我们将怎样决定这些议题。

42a9786f2ac131d393ac85e77630f1326b071c22.source: It doesn't seem like this revelation has changed much. If the election is close, some voters might jump to Gore instead of you.
42a9786f2ac131d393ac85e77630f1326b071c22.zh: 看来，这次曝光没有改变多少事情。如果胜负接近，有些选民可能会转投戈尔，而不是你。

48369bedac5387ae65d4c4e95fe77625fde210d8.source: It falls outside the scope of the Constitution for the federal government to regulate the working conditions within a factory. This is not something that the President has control over.
48369bedac5387ae65d4c4e95fe77625fde210d8.zh: 联邦政府规范工厂内部的劳动条件，超出了宪法规定的权限。这不是总统能管的事。

45155952fb78c7381ac0475be476e833300103d1.source: It isn't my place to step into these kinds of disputes. I would hope that people see Hillary Clinton as the best candidate for President when they look at the ballot.
45155952fb78c7381ac0475be476e833300103d1.zh: 我不适合介入这种争执。我希望，大家看选票时，会认为希拉里·克林顿是最佳总统候选人。

38c2b93eb4e96a45564353f43331ce7f76bdb9f9.source: It just seems all the little things affecting your campaign were too much to handle. Maybe you should have emphasized your relation to Clinton more. Maybe you should have moved politically left to catch some votes from Nader. Maybe you should have moved politically RIGHT to appeal to the south. Whatever it is, George Bush will be the next president. As it has since 94, the House and Senate will be Republican hands firmly, as they made some small gains.
38c2b93eb4e96a45564353f43331ce7f76bdb9f9.zh: 看来，影响竞选的种种小事加在一起，终究让你无力应付。也许你应该更强调自己与克林顿的关系；也许你应该向左靠拢，争取纳德的一些选票；也许你应该向右靠拢，吸引南方选民。无论如何，乔治·布什将成为下一任总统。共和党又取得了一些小幅进展，众参两院将像1994年以来一样，牢牢掌握在他们手中。

80311976b46369cc1efeeb9f9f242e175288cb3e.source: It just seems all the little things affecting your campaign were too much to handle. Maybe you should have emphasized your relation to Clinton more. Maybe you should have moved politically left to catch some votes from Nader. Maybe you should have moved politically RIGHT to appeal to the south. Whatever it is, George Bush will be the next president. At least with the close margin, Bush's bipartisanship will have to be on full display.
80311976b46369cc1efeeb9f9f242e175288cb3e.zh: 看来，影响竞选的种种小事加在一起，终究让你无力应付。也许你应该更强调自己与克林顿的关系；也许你应该向左靠拢，争取纳德的一些选票；也许你应该向右靠拢，吸引南方选民。无论如何，乔治·布什将成为下一任总统。至少，胜负差距如此接近，布什将不得不充分展示两党合作的态度。

51523627b894bf4db638e7b541eeb137cd199f36.source: It just seems all the little things affecting your campaign were too much to handle. Maybe you should have emphasized your relation to Clinton more. Maybe you should have moved politically left to catch some votes from Nader. Maybe you should have moved politically RIGHT to appeal to the south. Whatever it is, George Bush will be the next president. Bush won by a larger than expected amount, and as such, the Senate and House will favour him heavily. I guess his bipartisanship won't be needed for the next two years...
51523627b894bf4db638e7b541eeb137cd199f36.zh: 看来，影响竞选的种种小事加在一起，终究让你无力应付。也许你应该更强调自己与克林顿的关系；也许你应该向左靠拢，争取纳德的一些选票；也许你应该向右靠拢，吸引南方选民。无论如何，乔治·布什将成为下一任总统。布什的胜选幅度大于预期，因此众参两院都会大力支持他。我想，接下来两年，大概也用不着他的两党合作了……

f311852ed89d9262529cddbd8d45152eacb47a92.source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. Democrats are despondent that after 8 years of George Bush, you weren't able to revitalize the country in time. The house has also stayed Republican and the senate is eerily close to being in their hands as well.
f311852ed89d9262529cddbd8d45152eacb47a92.zh: 看来美国认为你的第一个任期影响力不够。经济低迷以及你的承诺未能兑现你在 2008 年雄心勃勃的言论可能导致了这一点。民主党人感到沮丧的是，在 乔治·布什 实施 8 年后，你们未能及时振兴国家。众议院也仍然是共和党，而参议院也几乎掌握在他们手中。

f1a480efee8f61afee7b738ca6b51af3e38c9cc7.source: It is important to shore up our support from liberal Democrats, especially with Ralph Nader in the race. I will pledge to increase spending on our most valued social programs, continue to increase taxes on high-earners like Clinton did, and I will look for other areas where I can appeal to the left.
f1a480efee8f61afee7b738ca6b51af3e38c9cc7.zh: 巩固自由派民主党人的支持很重要，尤其是拉尔夫·纳德也在参选。我会承诺增加我们最珍视的社会项目的投入，像克林顿一样继续提高高收入者的税负，并寻找其他能吸引左翼的领域。

3864ef317205e8722c8103d04519b10af535e5ab.source: It is my dream to see a Prohibition Amendment passed before I die.
3864ef317205e8722c8103d04519b10af535e5ab.zh: 我梦想在有生之年，看到一项禁酒宪法修正案获得通过。

619a272dc5675244de9f39f1e72689f9081bbec2.source: It is my firm position that we need to nationalize the railroads of this country. Their power has stood beyond reproach for too long.
619a272dc5675244de9f39f1e72689f9081bbec2.zh: 我的立场很坚定：我们需要把本国铁路收归国有。它们的权势不受质疑，已经太久了。

0ff1c11035252c2a40271e31d9a5b57f78d50fd5.source: It is not a good idea to cut the size of the government in the midst of a recession. Shrinking payrolls at the state level have served to drag down our most recent recovery.
0ff1c11035252c2a40271e31d9a5b57f78d50fd5.zh: 在衰退中缩减政府规模，不是好主意。州政府雇员减少，已经拖累了最近这轮复苏。

abf1db157015cbad88eeeeb284ac1aecae10abc9.source: It is not my place as a politician, running for a position in the Executive Branch, to comment on the performance of the Court.
abf1db157015cbad88eeeeb284ac1aecae10abc9.zh: 我作为竞选行政职位的政治人物，不宜评论法院的表现。

b3d02115c56749fea3d475180e1b21b99e2fd96e.source: It is not worth addressing the violence outside. I will make a general pledge for law and order and focus my speech on the trials of the working man.
b3d02115c56749fea3d475180e1b21b99e2fd96e.zh: 场外的暴力不值得专门谈论。我会作出维护法律与秩序的一般承诺，把演讲重点放在劳动者的艰难处境上。

1d5339579f41ebd066db1425205a2f0ee9a808e1.source: It is probably a bad idea to run against the record of Bill Clinton, given his popularity. Better to just ignore him and focus on other issues.
1d5339579f41ebd066db1425205a2f0ee9a808e1.zh: 考虑到比尔·克林顿的受欢迎程度，拿他的执政记录开刀大概不是好主意。最好干脆不谈他，关注其他问题。

4bdd2d893fa7628d9ae158f459bc7806d897ff7c.source: It is risky to run an overtly negative campaign after the recent Clinton-Gingrich battles. It might be better to focus on your own plans for government.
4bdd2d893fa7628d9ae158f459bc7806d897ff7c.zh: 最近刚经历克林顿与金里奇的争斗，公开开展负面竞选是有风险的。也许更应该关注你自己的执政计划。

c73f0c0fa40527fb3ffddae33a4851033a5ad3ca.source: It is the responsibility of the worker to put aside such funds as are necessary to protect them from these events. This is why we have mutual aid societies in place.
c73f0c0fa40527fb3ffddae33a4851033a5ad3ca.zh: 工人有责任自行储备必要的资金，防范这类遭遇。我们设立互助会，就是为此。

4aa5feaaf7dff64c88a6e192445b2f60e289c86b.source: It is time for America to move past this issue. I will issue an immediate pardon if I am elected President.
4aa5feaaf7dff64c88a6e192445b2f60e289c86b.zh: 美国是时候翻过这一页了。如果当选总统，我会立即予以赦免。

7637faf037a15eeba22109edee5eb1af45a269ef.source: It is time that we presented the American people with a true choice for the future of this country. Me and Barry Goldwater will do that loud and clear.
7637faf037a15eeba22109edee5eb1af45a269ef.zh: 是时候在本国未来的方向上，为美国人民提供真正的选择了。巴里·戈德华特和我会鲜明、有力地做到这一点。

1503ba2be60d92fd331bbcf091ffda2a10aca131.source: It is true that relations with Congress have been stormy. But what else can you expect when the House is mostly Democrat, and you're a Republican?
1503ba2be60d92fd331bbcf091ffda2a10aca131.zh: 你与国会的关系确实风波不断。不过，众议院大多是民主党人，你却是共和党人，还能指望什么？

736dcffb5996fb3d5dcf87e08ea22eb932da95d0.source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. Democrats are despondent that after 8 years of George Bush, you weren't able to revitalize the country in time. The house has also stayed Republican and the senate is eerily close to being in their hands as well. Paul Ryan might be casting a lot of tie-breaking votes. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
736dcffb5996fb3d5dcf87e08ea22eb932da95d0.zh: 看来，美国人认为你的第一个任期成效不够显著。经济复苏乏力，你的承诺也没能兑现2008年豪言壮语的雄心，这大概就是原因。经历了乔治·布什的八年执政，你仍未能及时让国家重振旗鼓，民主党人心灰意冷。众议院仍由共和党掌控，参议院也几乎落入他们手中，形势令人不安。保罗·瑞安可能要多次投出打破平票的关键一票。希望罗姆尼的经商经验能带领美国走向经济繁荣。

36ca5d6cd81a483a7047cd271206e4d39da54b92.source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. Democrats are despondent that after 8 years of George Bush, you weren't able to revitalize the country in time. The house has also stayed Republican and the senate is eerily close to being in their hands as well. Paul might be casting a lot of tie-breaking votes. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
36ca5d6cd81a483a7047cd271206e4d39da54b92.zh: 看来，美国人认为你的第一个任期成效不够显著。经济复苏乏力，你的承诺也没能兑现2008年豪言壮语的雄心，这大概就是原因。经历了乔治·布什的八年执政，你仍未能及时让国家重振旗鼓，民主党人心灰意冷。众议院仍由共和党掌控，参议院也几乎落入他们手中，形势令人不安。保罗可能要多次投出打破平票的关键一票。希望罗姆尼的经商经验能带领美国走向经济繁荣。

dfc04de981f5908f8945efa36189f599760010c1.source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. Democrats are despondent that after 8 years of George Bush, you weren't able to revitalize the country in time. The house has also stayed Republican and the senate is eerily close to being in their hands as well. Ryan might be casting a lot of tie-breaking votes. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
dfc04de981f5908f8945efa36189f599760010c1.zh: 看来，美国人认为你的第一个任期成效不够显著。经济复苏乏力，你的承诺也没能兑现2008年豪言壮语的雄心，这大概就是原因。经历了乔治·布什的八年执政，你仍未能及时让国家重振旗鼓，民主党人心灰意冷。众议院仍由共和党掌控，参议院也几乎落入他们手中，形势令人不安。瑞安可能要多次投出打破平票的关键一票。希望罗姆尼的经商经验能带领美国走向经济繁荣。

0b635c0a02fce961056dc4a41cf105dd3bdaf4b8.source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. The swing compare to 2008 is staggering, and just goes to show how unpopular you are. The Senate has gone red as well. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
0b635c0a02fce961056dc4a41cf105dd3bdaf4b8.zh: 看来，美国人认为你的第一个任期成效不够显著。经济复苏乏力，你的承诺也没能兑现2008年豪言壮语的雄心，这大概就是原因。与2008年相比，选情转变之大令人咋舌，足见你有多不受欢迎。参议院也转为共和党控制。希望罗姆尼的经商经验能带领美国走向经济繁荣。

2b20a6fad2cad86c3af94b6b8994dabc58368a67.source: It might not be the worst thing to find some other avenue of attack.
2b20a6fad2cad86c3af94b6b8994dabc58368a67.zh: 另找一条进攻路线，也许不是坏事。

d0597b88a7d681592375e2755c7d4988925f4b7c.source: It might not be traditional Republican policy, but no one can deny that these are unusual and exceptional times.
d0597b88a7d681592375e2755c7d4988925f4b7c.zh: 这也许不是传统共和党政策，但没人能否认，我们处在不同寻常、特殊的时代。

575ee2db2dd8340dcce050a95eb503bc804ade2e.source: It never hurts to remind the voters of your time in the military.
575ee2db2dd8340dcce050a95eb503bc804ade2e.zh: 提醒选民你曾在军中服役，总没有坏处。

e6a917e23218e6e102fd1d876e54cc6c18cb5817.source: It never hurts to strike a note of confidence going into the home stretch.
e6a917e23218e6e102fd1d876e54cc6c18cb5817.zh: 进入最后冲刺时，表现出信心总不会有坏处。

c30eb42da4c5031c6071619b0558be196709617d.source: It seems Obama will have another four years to recover the economy, as well as deal with the middle east. Republicans are despondent that you didn't defeat him, as they felt he was a very exploitable incumbent. Another crushing defeat was not what the Republicans needed, but at least they are keeping their house majority.
c30eb42da4c5031c6071619b0558be196709617d.zh: 看来，奥巴马将再有四年时间恢复经济、处理中东事务。共和党人本以为他这个现任总统有许多弱点可供攻击，你却没能击败他，让他们十分沮丧。又一场惨败绝非共和党所需要的，不过至少他们保住了众议院多数。

63fc4a557a98826360f0092568b8b2dccad74256.source: It seems Obama will have another four years to recover the economy, as well as deal with the middle east. Republicans are despondent that you didn't defeat him, as they felt he was a very exploitable incumbent. Fortunately, you did better than McCain, although that might have just been the stagnant economy that caused that.
63fc4a557a98826360f0092568b8b2dccad74256.zh: 看来，奥巴马将再有四年时间恢复经济、处理中东事务。共和党人本以为他这个现任总统有许多弱点可供攻击，你却没能击败他，让他们十分沮丧。好在你的表现胜过麦凯恩，尽管这可能只是经济停滞造成的。

649cf2b5262d1dcda3dd167aa7ae19ce45cf37c4.source: It seems Obama will have another four years to recover the economy, as well as deal with the middle east. Republicans are despondent that you didn't defeat him, as they felt he was a very exploitable incumbent. Fortunately, you did much better than McCain, and it wasn't another landslide loss.
649cf2b5262d1dcda3dd167aa7ae19ce45cf37c4.zh: 看来，奥巴马将再有四年时间恢复经济、处理中东事务。共和党人本以为他这个现任总统有许多弱点可供攻击，你却没能击败他，让他们十分沮丧。好在你的表现远胜麦凯恩，并没有再次遭遇压倒性的惨败。

98024afaeed347969d700388426a8e6724e7ca42.source: It seems Obamacare will survive, as your veto power will stop any attempts at that. you'll also be given another chance to bring recovery to the economy after the Bush recession. If all goes well, you can leave a stronger country for Hillary Clinton in 2016 to take the reins of.
98024afaeed347969d700388426a8e6724e7ca42.zh: 看来，奥巴马医改将得以保留，你的否决权会挡住任何废除它的尝试。布什任内的衰退过后，你也将再获一次推动经济复苏的机会。如果一切顺利，你可以留下一个更强大的国家，让希拉里·克林顿在2016年接手。

b8f83a559c95b7e63464e71c54a79f5042fde566.source: It seems that with George W. Bush and a Republican majority, the United States can expect some conservative policy-making over the next four years. Hopefully Bush comes through on his promise to govern in a bipartisan, conciliatory manner.
b8f83a559c95b7e63464e71c54a79f5042fde566.zh: 看来，由于 乔治·W.·布什 和共和党占多数，美国可以预期在未来四年内会制定一些保守的政策。希望 布什 兑现他以两党和解方式执政的承诺。

74dd4d401ef32b97578da05f03cbb8a6bd126670.source: It just seems that America didn't think your first term was impactful enough. The sluggish economy, as well as your promises not meeting your ambitious 2008 rhetoric likely led to this. You still did do a lot, and it's clear that many Americans thought you deserved a second chance with the margin of victory. Let’s hope Romney's business experience can guide America to a prosperous economy.
74dd4d401ef32b97578da05f03cbb8a6bd126670.zh: 看来，美国人认为你的第一个任期成效不够显著。经济复苏乏力，你的承诺也没能兑现2008年豪言壮语的雄心，这大概就是原因。你毕竟还是做了不少事；从胜负差距也能看出，许多美国人认为你值得再获一次机会。希望罗姆尼的经商经验能带领美国走向经济繁荣。

853050763848cf6cbc618b1857774c27ab930024.source: It looked like a hopeless case as you accepted the nomination, but you have run an outstanding campaign in the interval.
853050763848cf6cbc618b1857774c27ab930024.zh: 当你接受提名时，这看起来像是一个无望的情况，但你在这段时间里进行了出色的竞选活动。

bed593d0a58f8e66d65962327aa93c9640b7abbd.source: It looks like Gore has received a solid bounce heading into election night. This might help you pick up a few wavering votes.
bed593d0a58f8e66d65962327aa93c9640b7abbd.zh: 戈尔看来在选举之夜前获得了明显的支持率提振。这可能帮你争取到几张摇摆不定的选票。

f4b5e452ce83caaa5c7d83c02b8a6f416bbb0357.source: It looks like Humphrey has enjoyed a last minute surge in the polls, thanks to a breakthrough in peace negotiations. Will this help cause a deadlock in the electoral college?
f4b5e452ce83caaa5c7d83c02b8a6f416bbb0357.zh: 和平谈判取得突破，似乎让汉弗莱在最后关头的民调中上升。这会有助于造成选举人团僵局吗？

c81afebf58cfded849893efd7ef8bcbf3a8b9675.source: It looks like Nixon is the favorite, so I'm going to focus most of my efforts on campaigning where he's ahead.
c81afebf58cfded849893efd7ef8bcbf3a8b9675.zh: 看来尼克松是获胜热门，所以我会把大部分精力放在他领先的地方竞选。

5b5dc9389fad65bfd9c63402948618b259118f06.source: It makes perfect sense to warn Americans of the dangers involved in such commerce, but it is not the place of the government to actively interfere in it.
5b5dc9389fad65bfd9c63402948618b259118f06.zh: 警告美国人这类贸易的危险完全合理，但政府不应主动干预。

3b45018f85a28ad7f3bb2f93cad57030d2315458.source: It makes sense to track gun sales over a period of time, to get a better picture of who is buying them, and to try and arrest more important cartel leaders.
3b45018f85a28ad7f3bb2f93cad57030d2315458.zh: 追踪一段时间的枪支销售，有助于更清楚地了解买家身份，并尝试逮捕更重要的贩毒集团头目，这样做有道理。

f909702af1f32df10de21794ef2667e60227ab7c.source: It may be a hard sell, but you need to make the case that
f909702af1f32df10de21794ef2667e60227ab7c.zh: 这可能很难推销，但你需要证明这一点

b1393a7aa6bf5c976d626a8f30086546804f7614.source: It may have been an off-the-cuff statement, but it has erupted onto the headlines, likely to your detriment.
b1393a7aa6bf5c976d626a8f30086546804f7614.zh: 这也许只是随口的一句话，却突然登上头条，很可能对你不利。

2a387c6bade053bf7fc560430797e95f1cb18d0a.source: It might be best if I don't appear overly friendly to leading Democrats. Especially one as unpopular as Van Buren.
2a387c6bade053bf7fc560430797e95f1cb18d0a.zh: 我最好不要显得与民主党领袖过于亲近，尤其是范布伦这样不受欢迎的人。

cfe3a4ce91a45e847f6550eb2fb8d5c5faf4437d.source: It might be better to admit that something happened and address it.
cfe3a4ce91a45e847f6550eb2fb8d5c5faf4437d.zh: 也许最好承认确实发生过什么，并正面回应。

c3cdca4910e97f946bd0040e5f98e580e3281f05.source: It might be in our best interest to play down such rhetoric in this particular campaign. Our base in the North will vote for us anyway, and it's not as if we have any Southern support to lose at this point.
c3cdca4910e97f946bd0040e5f98e580e3281f05.zh: 在这次特殊的竞选中，淡化这种言辞或许更符合我们的利益。北方基本盘反正会投给我们，而眼下我们在南方也没有什么支持可失去了。

6242a7b1e73dcad37c1dad61b939a838cb5e1888.source: It might not be a bad idea to keep hammering away at Hillary. It could help you to make this a contest of who is more unpopular.
6242a7b1e73dcad37c1dad61b939a838cb5e1888.zh: 继续猛攻希拉里也许不是坏主意。这可能有助于把选举变成一场比谁更不受欢迎的较量。

7ea670ca7b2ce4044e869ff83345a9b054309bf5.source: It seems that with George W. Bush and a Republican majority, the United States can expect some conservative policy-making over the next four years. Hopefully Bush comes through on his promise to govern in a bipartisan, conciliatory manner. A lot should depend on the margin of his victory, and whether it was large or small.
7ea670ca7b2ce4044e869ff83345a9b054309bf5.zh: 看来，由于 乔治·W.·布什 和共和党占多数，美国可以预期在未来四年内会制定一些保守的政策。希望 布什 兑现他以两党和解方式执政的承诺。很大程度上取决于他的胜利幅度，以及胜利的大小。

691b5413b06a035fa8fd3c95bd7da2c582e26486.source: It seems the right-wing political machine was too much for you. The constant barrage of attacks and a strong economy have propelled Bush to the white house. Likely due to the moderate opinions of Bush, and the close election will force him to govern across party lines.
691b5413b06a035fa8fd3c95bd7da2c582e26486.zh: 右翼政治机器似乎实在太强大，你难以招架。接连不断的攻击和强劲的经济将布什送入白宫。布什的温和观点，加上接近的选举结果，很可能会迫使他跨越党派界线执政。

0b2f1a290527f8f211e362fec4b7b55bb0cf1bef.source: It seems the right-wing political machine was too much for you. The constant barrage of attacks and a strong economy have propelled Bush to the white house. Many are shocked at Bush's comeback, seeing as you were the favourite early on. Reagan's popularity was just too much for you to deal with.
0b2f1a290527f8f211e362fec4b7b55bb0cf1bef.zh: 右翼政治机器似乎实在太强大，你难以招架。接连不断的攻击和强劲的经济将布什送入白宫。你早期最被看好，因此许多人对布什的逆转感到震惊。里根的人气实在令你无从应对。

27720f70d8f6e9b8c1039a8d89cc2f0eafeaf117.source: It seems the right-wing political machine was too much for you. The constant barrage of attacks and a strong economy have propelled Bush to the white house. Many are shocked at your massive loss, as you weren't even favoured to lose in the first place. Most people think you should have stuck up for yourself more, and not ignore the attacks Bush made.
27720f70d8f6e9b8c1039a8d89cc2f0eafeaf117.zh: 右翼政治机器似乎实在太强大，你难以招架。接连不断的攻击和强劲的经济将布什送入白宫。你原本甚至不被看作会输的人，因此许多人震惊于这场惨败。大多数人认为，你本该更多为自己辩护，而非无视布什的攻击。

9c7e6a50400aa4e30e1e269aaa052525b8f075f1.source: It seems to be hurting you no matter what, but at least you've put in a good response to this attack.
9c7e6a50400aa4e30e1e269aaa052525b8f075f1.zh: 看来这件事无论如何都会伤害你，但至少你对这次攻击作出了不错的回应。

7a7642ff234162859a393eec63c22ca0854b434c.source: It seems to some that you do believe that climate change is real.
7a7642ff234162859a393eec63c22ca0854b434c.zh: 在有些人看来，你确实相信气候变化是真的。

cfd385b9cd7d44a0a1b48b8cc0fd7d414294fd42.source: It seems very unlikely that the Senate will ever come up with the votes to ratify this agreement. I don't know how my support or opposition would change that equation.
cfd385b9cd7d44a0a1b48b8cc0fd7d414294fd42.zh: 参议院看来极不可能凑齐批准这项协定所需的票数。我不清楚，自己的支持或反对能怎样改变这个局面。

23417bc766afe2f49f7e449a99b621ccc2e8288b.source: It seems you're looking to strike a balance between cocooning yourself too much from the public on the one hand, and ignoring scientific advice on the other.
23417bc766afe2f49f7e449a99b621ccc2e8288b.zh: 看来，你正在两者之间寻找平衡：既不让自己过度与公众隔绝，也不无视科学建议。

94985dafbb71a92833a1423ce0e2fd964f39084d.source: It sounds like to aiming to win the turnout battle with a motivated base. Is that the best strategy for a 2012 environment? Perhaps.
94985dafbb71a92833a1423ce0e2fd964f39084d.zh: 听起来，你打算靠热情高涨的基本盘赢得投票率之战。这是适合2012年形势的最佳策略吗？也许吧。

b66135c13e21a26ea09507ffabce658f468efa77.source: It sounds like you are making for a strong play for the type of moderate who used to vote for Cleveland before that man's incompetence was exposed.
b66135c13e21a26ea09507ffabce658f468efa77.zh: 听起来，你正在大力争取那些曾经支持克利夫兰、后来发现他无能的温和派。

42d2270cc18a3d31529562ff3bde2a7e2740d94d.source: It sounds like you are running a sensible, moderate campaign. Will the votes in the center be there for you?
42d2270cc18a3d31529562ff3bde2a7e2740d94d.zh: 听起来，你正在开展一场务实、温和的竞选。中间派的选票，会支持你吗？

ad3b863052c711784daf7d2496d337aa0618f7ce.source: It sounds like you want to stick to the basics and win a real mandate this fall.
ad3b863052c711784daf7d2496d337aa0618f7ce.zh: 听起来您想坚持基本原则并在今年秋天赢得真正的授权。

1dba7537e9f45ff1678095af0810ef4722f6c0ea.source: It turns out that you will be running against Trump, likely with a significant fundraising advantage.
1dba7537e9f45ff1678095af0810ef4722f6c0ea.zh: 结果，你要面对的是特朗普，而且很可能拥有显著的筹款优势。

83246849adfd2498336927c3e164590a8bf8d292.source: It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. The least you can do is show some contrition.
83246849adfd2498336927c3e164590a8bf8d292.zh: 当初接受这场采访就是个坏主意。你至少应该表现出一点悔意。

8440b14bb32705cffcb791ce9be24daa77593825.source: It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. You don't need to make things worse by digging your heels in.
8440b14bb32705cffcb791ce9be24daa77593825.zh: 当初接受这场采访就是个坏主意。你没必要死不认错，把事情弄得更糟。

5fe8c176151f6043ef28ec09534c97d2a46cac39.source: It was always going to be a longshot after your first, tumultuous years in office. With luck, Dewey will defend the New Deal reforms and continue your foreign policy. As for you, who knows what history will say of your Presidency? You made some momentous decisions, but will ultimately leave office under a cloud of unpopularity. Perhaps you could serve another term in the Senate?
5fe8c176151f6043ef28ec09534c97d2a46cac39.zh: 在你执政的第一个动荡的几年之后，这总是一个渺茫的机会。幸运的话，杜威将捍卫新政改革并继续你的外交政策。至于你，谁知道历史会如何评价你的总统任期呢？你做出了一些重大决定，但最终会在不受欢迎的阴云下离任。也许你可以在参议院连任一个任期？

4b8c9b9076c434a19349a40b4997ee6798f75477.source: It was always going to be tough to defeat the Vice President to someone as popular as Eisenhower. However, you still have your seat in the Senate. At your young age, there is no reason you couldn't be a strong contender for President in 1964 or 1968, especially if this election was close. Let's just hope the Democrats don't blame your defeat on your religion.
4b8c9b9076c434a19349a40b4997ee6798f75477.zh: 要击败像 艾森豪威尔 这样受欢迎的人的副总统总是很困难。然而，你仍然在参议院拥有席位。在你年轻的时候，你没有理由不能成为 1964 年或 1968 年总统的有力竞争者，特别是如果这次选举势均力敌的话。我们只希望民主党不要将你的失败归咎于你的宗教信仰。

a65bc8b730844bb3dd3f07c741177d70458ae445.source: It was stock market and railroad company chicanery which caused the Panic of 1893. Sensible regulation of this process could have saved us all a lot of trouble.
a65bc8b730844bb3dd3f07c741177d70458ae445.zh: 正是股票市场和铁路公司的欺诈，造成了1893年恐慌。如果合理监管这些活动，我们本可以少受许多苦。

77fa37a4ad72f98db739df4f20138ee9909d913f.source: It won't cripple your chances of winning the election, but there are some concerns about how passive you've been on addressing this issue.
77fa37a4ad72f98db739df4f20138ee9909d913f.zh: 这不会严重损害你的胜算，但有人担心，你处理这个问题时过于被动。

c450314cdf19fc76999ca06b50dc6c35e6f80194.source: It would be better in some cases if we could get Congress to make these decisions, but I do support the stances Mr. Warren has taken on the Court.
c450314cdf19fc76999ca06b50dc6c35e6f80194.zh: 有些决定最好由国会作出，不过，我确实支持沃伦先生在最高法院采取的立场。

8ff7257f28364cf338505617bcb6ff943cb4c527.source: It would be better to reserve judgment on this issue until after the election. Many moderates would support some kind of compromise if the alternative was secession and civil war.
8ff7257f28364cf338505617bcb6ff943cb4c527.zh: 在大选结束前，最好暂不对这个问题作出判断。如果另一种选择是分离和内战，许多温和派都会支持某种妥协。

88622ecbe25f436d049adf9b47ca7846604203ba.source: It would be inhumane to suggest that we shouldn't be giving payouts to people who lose everything in a natural disaster.
88622ecbe25f436d049adf9b47ca7846604203ba.zh: 有人在自然灾害中失去了一切，如果说我们不该向他们赔付，那是不人道的。

75f93de94db6376307fe36480e711e8363c94ab1.source: It would be irresponsible of me to speculate on this practice without a thorough understanding of the facts.
