One of the first things I will do after the election is to establish a bipartisan commission to fully investigate this issue, and to present its recommendations.
75f93de94db6376307fe36480e711e8363c94ab1.zh: 不充分了解事实，就对这种做法作推测，是不负责任的。选举后，我首先会做的事情之一，就是设立两党委员会，全面调查这个问题，并提出建议。

8fd9bdc93f93caa3fa03589fa4bbf2e1864a044a.source: It would be very unwise for us to pull back from Afghanistan at the present time. I'm going to meet with our generals and our national security establishment when I'm elected, and we're going to come up with a plan to give Afghanistan the support it needs.
8fd9bdc93f93caa3fa03589fa4bbf2e1864a044a.zh: 目前从阿富汗撤退，会是非常不明智的。当选后，我会与将领和国家安全部门会面，制定计划，向阿富汗提供它所需要的支持。

e2b5707660fd24851c41b7b8c2c6ecbe077ddbe1.source: It would depend on the scope of the program. We could certainly use a limited number of modern, well-constructed federal roads to connect our different regions.
e2b5707660fd24851c41b7b8c2c6ecbe077ddbe1.zh: 这取决于计划的规模。建设少量现代化、质量良好的联邦道路，连接不同地区，确实会有用。

a1aead69a27716bd3499da124330cc8e11ca8652.source: It would depend on things like how the law worked, and how we would pay for it. But I'm not opposed to it in theory.
a1aead69a27716bd3499da124330cc8e11ca8652.zh: 这取决于法律如何运作、我们如何支付费用等问题。不过，原则上我并不反对。

3b652fd2de3ca606cc6e5c405c810209725c6220.source: It would not be wise, at this point, to make any statements supporting or opposing prohibition in our campaign. There are too many people on both sides of this issue.
3b652fd2de3ca606cc6e5c405c810209725c6220.zh: 现阶段，在竞选中表态支持或反对禁酒都不明智。双方的支持者都太多了。

6100a408b82be39b6c7c48403b7da6a258935cb2.source: It would probably be better not to repudiate Clinton so harshly. Not only is he broadly popular, but you also served with him for eight years.
6100a408b82be39b6c7c48403b7da6a258935cb2.zh: 大概最好别那么严厉地否定克林顿。他不仅广受欢迎，你还与他共事了八年。

03e5e1d63b9cb03e542eb5290c2ccc8345a98d18.source: It would probably be better to remain non-committal on this issue, for now.
03e5e1d63b9cb03e542eb5290c2ccc8345a98d18.zh: 眼下，在这个问题上大概还是不作明确承诺更好。

a81e299752c9c20c7b7fc3b87f566268efcd2b2c.source: It wouldn't be responsible of me to comment at this point. As President I will consult with our military leaders to determine what is appropriate.
a81e299752c9c20c7b7fc3b87f566268efcd2b2c.zh: 此时发表意见，并不负责任。作为总统，我会与军方领导人商议，确定怎样做才合适。

e015f4a03d9ca41e5882e5413e887138f304c743.source: It wouldn't hurt to mix in some old photographs of myself in military dress with the tough-on-defense ads we run.
e015f4a03d9ca41e5882e5413e887138f304c743.zh: 在我们那些强调国防强硬立场的广告里，穿插一些我当年身着军装的照片，也没有坏处。

1dbfc1f33b882fb059faa7cb4dea788bf8666154.source: It's a bad sign when a Democrat has to compete for Maryland and Delaware, but if you do win there you should have a good shot at this election.
1dbfc1f33b882fb059faa7cb4dea788bf8666154.zh: 民主党人竟然需要争夺马里兰和特拉华，这可不是好兆头。不过，如果在那里获胜，你就很有希望赢下这场大选。

256d3291696cf08b669a625a5a0a47f4a215310e.source: It's a bit much to say that Boies's day is over, although he is a bit past his political prime.
256d3291696cf08b669a625a5a0a47f4a215310e.zh: 说博伊斯的时代结束了，未免过头；不过，他确实已稍稍过了政治生涯的巅峰。

37bd76f9854db7f61a9578f6adc771d3bde43704.source: It's a bit of a gamble to play up liberalism this much in 2012 America, but you will certainly have a motivated base.
37bd76f9854db7f61a9578f6adc771d3bde43704.zh: 在2012年的美国，如此强调自由主义有点冒险，但你的基本盘肯定会充满干劲。

25fa12f0d8ed25dacc5d1fd3573fb607a3fafcaf.source: It's a bit uncomfortable when you discuss the near bankruptcy of the Treasury. After all, wouldn't silver coinage just cause this same problem again?
25fa12f0d8ed25dacc5d1fd3573fb607a3fafcaf.zh: 谈起国库濒临破产，多少令人尴尬。毕竟，白银铸币不就会再次造成同样的问题吗？

6d68aefec166e6ef5855176d72a0341733dc4eab.source: It's a bold move, but I will campaign for the Democratic cause across the North.
6d68aefec166e6ef5855176d72a0341733dc4eab.zh: 这是个大胆的举动，不过，我将走遍北方，为民主党的事业竞选。

39047d737c6300819aeef8b5456dc6d7be4a826c.source: It's a brave stance you're taking in this day and age. Let's see how it goes.
39047d737c6300819aeef8b5456dc6d7be4a826c.zh: 在如今这个时代，你采取这个立场很勇敢。看看效果如何吧。

9b70c8fa405396e0c4da920e8630f7b416530870.source: It's a difficult issue to address, but putting yourself in sympathy with John Calhoun is certainly not the right way to do it.
9b70c8fa405396e0c4da920e8630f7b416530870.zh: 这是个棘手的议题，但表示认同约翰·卡尔霍恩，肯定不是处理它的正确方式。

678b168b6ebf6c5bef935cf5226cc0d09593c875.source: It's a divisive issue, but on the balance Americans don't want to hear about plans to escalate the Vietnam War.
678b168b6ebf6c5bef935cf5226cc0d09593c875.zh: 这是个分裂选民的议题，但总体而言，美国人不想听到升级越南战争的计划。

455451d7346a2c773f3e98e850f6b169c6c02c1a.source: It's a good start at least…

2e40ffc1428808babb04a1d49bca4a6d4916e652.source: It's a little hard to duck your own responsibility, since you signed this legislation, but it does have its opponents.
2e40ffc1428808babb04a1d49bca4a6d4916e652.zh: 既然这项法律是你签署的，就很难回避自己的责任，不过它确实也有反对者。

10c3dc0373ba286d2440c994c644fe85ca7d25c3.source: It's a little odd that you would pick Goldwater as your running mate, and then call for more civil rights legislation. Some of your supporters are confused.
10c3dc0373ba286d2440c994c644fe85ca7d25c3.zh: 选戈德华特作竞选搭档，却又呼吁更多民权立法，有点奇怪。一些支持者感到困惑。

9f54f3cb7a602b7f4d53cb0c0ca851832258b3f9.source: It's a little tone-deaf to speak out so much against the anti-Communism trend at this point.
9f54f3cb7a602b7f4d53cb0c0ca851832258b3f9.zh: 在这个时候，如此大力抨击反共潮流，显得有些不识时务。

dab0958caacc0c939af64ff755b6dbde17c5aaf4.source: It's a minor civil case, pursued by a few disgruntled people for political purposes. Most people were very satisfied with Trump University.
dab0958caacc0c939af64ff755b6dbde17c5aaf4.zh: 这只是几名心怀不满的人出于政治目的提起的小小民事案。多数人对特朗普大学非常满意。

3e75b5ab9a219543b7adb60e2fc1147073f99d21.source: It's a miracle! You have won the 2012 election.
3e75b5ab9a219543b7adb60e2fc1147073f99d21.zh: 这是一个奇迹！您赢得了 2012 年大选。

170555b2174dccda85e1c6e624119261c05d203a.source: It's a shame that Grover Cleveland allowed his supporters to bolt the party the moment it became clear their faction had lost this year's nomination.
170555b2174dccda85e1c6e624119261c05d203a.zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰一看自己的派系失去了今年的提名，就放任支持者脱离本党，实在令人遗憾。

d09a90b53f37a74b6f014cc1094a3b0edad13600.source: It's a shame that it takes a global pandemic for us to get serious about the right to vote. The future of democracy demands that we protect the vote in this country, and I intend to push for federal legislation to do just that.
d09a90b53f37a74b6f014cc1094a3b0edad13600.zh: 我们竟然得等到一场全球疫情，才认真对待投票权，实在遗憾。民主的未来要求我们保护这个国家的投票权，我打算推动联邦立法，做到这一点。

95c9c8da1c4982541f7fb095f13030ec64bb1fba.source: It's a shame that this policy wasn't implemented decades ago. For too long, rural Americans have been forced to travel up to thirty miles to retrieve the mail they are entitled to.
95c9c8da1c4982541f7fb095f13030ec64bb1fba.zh: 这项政策几十年前就该实行，却一直没有，实在遗憾。长期以来，农村居民为了领取本应属于自己的邮件，被迫走上最多三十英里的路。

1032824b4bf38535a2c337c348a868c29c5452d6.source: It's a shame that we need to even campaign in these beacons of the South. But if we have to, let us do it with effluence.
1032824b4bf38535a2c337c348a868c29c5452d6.zh: 我们竟然还需要在这些南方重镇竞选，实在令人遗憾。不过，既然非做不可，就放开手脚去干吧。

25c610f3adb86a4bdd4ca224bafa0e9c44c67cf6.source: It's a small thing, but it does help with the abolitionist bloc to remind them of the alternatives out there...
25c610f3adb86a4bdd4ca224bafa0e9c44c67cf6.zh: 这只是小事，不过，提醒废奴派还有哪些其他选择，确实有助于争取他们……

405338935b91b3a231b68d1072900c868a0659d5.source: It's an age old question -- does apologizing help to clear the air around a certain issue, or does it just make you look weak?
405338935b91b3a231b68d1072900c868a0659d5.zh: 这是个老问题：道歉是有助于消除某件事的疑虑，还是只会显得软弱？

4e947fea68b479f3ab205a5437cb8ab6ab86614c.source: It's an easy victory for you to criticize John Brown.
4e947fea68b479f3ab205a5437cb8ab6ab86614c.zh: 批评约翰·布朗，对你来说很容易得分。

ba59badf9e2609d0a6b1dc001e7bb5895215a653.source: It's best if we avoid making any statements on this issue.
ba59badf9e2609d0a6b1dc001e7bb5895215a653.zh: 我们最好不要就此发表任何声明。

d94dd5de55d79cedc2870096e08586936457ee9a.source: It's best not to wade into the middle of a controversy -- we should not make any large trip to California during this campaign.
d94dd5de55d79cedc2870096e08586936457ee9a.zh: 最好别卷入争端——这次竞选中，我们不应大张旗鼓地前往加利福尼亚州。

7707bd520685dfea313c090e15fcf673bea28e48.source: It's best to stay clear of the Catholicism issue. Anybody who thinks it's important in this election already knows about it.
7707bd520685dfea313c090e15fcf673bea28e48.zh: 最好避开天主教问题。任何觉得它会影响这次选举的人，都已经知道此事。

62cc5d4a5323a6f2084c3e75b8be067add93e5b0.source: It's certainly alarming to hear statements like these from someone as high-up as Joe Biden. Hopefully he can explain himself a little more clearly in the next few days.
62cc5d4a5323a6f2084c3e75b8be067add93e5b0.zh: 听到乔·拜登这样身居高位的人说出这种话，确实令人担忧。希望未来几天，他能把自己的意思解释得更清楚些。

39702540cbffceabd40bf1081d8ae4878ae45637.source: It's distressing to some of your liberal and elderly supporters to hear you referencing potential Social Security changes.
39702540cbffceabd40bf1081d8ae4878ae45637.zh: 听到你提及可能调整社会保障，一些自由派与老年支持者感到不安。

0b3d0523845d466fe52a4216082c8713970d211b.source: It's extremely important that you do not appear to be implicated in this scandal. And if you did hear a stray word or two, you could count on Reagan's team in any case.
0b3d0523845d466fe52a4216082c8713970d211b.zh: 绝不能让你看上去牵涉这桩丑闻，这至关重要。即便你偶然听到过一两句话，反正还有里根的团队可以依靠。

9242e5d43ccc03b98b93288a4cbc0829830bc5ce.source: It's fine to bring the attack to Trump. Just make sure to mention what you have to offer as well.
9242e5d43ccc03b98b93288a4cbc0829830bc5ce.zh: 向特朗普发动攻击没问题，只是也别忘了说清楚，你能为大家带来什么。

07f0e8c4d51612cab3a08bd25d310e6946366e9b.source: It's fine to support the police, but not in a way that deflects questions about Black Lives Matter or seems to imply that movement isn't helpful.
07f0e8c4d51612cab3a08bd25d310e6946366e9b.zh: 支持警察没问题，但不能借此回避关于“黑人的命也是命”的问题，或暗示这个运动没有帮助。

9bd492bd566d31df2643b120e50dc52fb1695249.source: It's funny how a lot of these supposed hate crimes are taking place in New York and San Francisco. I'm sure they're very inspired by me!
9bd492bd566d31df2643b120e50dc52fb1695249.zh: 有意思的是，许多所谓的仇恨犯罪都发生在纽约和旧金山。他们肯定是受到我的鼓舞了！

ee7095569307ce6f5181d5792b5e7ba18cb4934b.source: It's going to be difficult at this point to build support for the rollback of Social Security.
ee7095569307ce6f5181d5792b5e7ba18cb4934b.zh: 到了这个时候，要争取支持缩减社会保障，已经很困难了。

8015c064ce892f9eb3ac8c98120aabd94f731e2c.source: It's going to happen when it happens, I'm hoping by the end of the year. And shortly thereafter we can finally put an end to the destructive liberal lockdowns that have done so much to damage our country.
8015c064ce892f9eb3ac8c98120aabd94f731e2c.zh: 该成功时就会成功，我希望是在年底之前。随后不久，我们就终于能结束破坏性的自由派封锁，它们给国家造成了太多损害。

00d5aefc7dec9787dfb26741619b39d1bb385bd9.source: It's good to be aggressive during the campaign, but can you back it up if you are elected?
00d5aefc7dec9787dfb26741619b39d1bb385bd9.zh: 竞选时采取强硬姿态是好事，但如果当选，你能兑现吗？

bd1ef2514e6ca34488d8c854c241b88f18225f74.source: It's good to hit back hard, even if a few bloviators question how this affects your "likeability".
bd1ef2514e6ca34488d8c854c241b88f18225f74.zh: 强硬反击是好事，哪怕有几个夸夸其谈的人质疑，这会如何影响你的“亲和力”。

d80aa62db56e86aa45ea1c24c4d48b06413e1a3a.source: It's good to mix things up and hit Democrats where they're vulnerable, especially in areas where your criticism might catch on with independent voters.
d80aa62db56e86aa45ea1c24c4d48b06413e1a3a.zh: 换换打法，攻击民主党的弱点，是好事，尤其是在可能引起独立选民共鸣的方面。

5152f8c68eebd3b04091a4b4bf931c9031333481.source: It's no surprise to anyone that you’re dragging muck into the race, but the ads your staff come up with are extremely effective- including such classics as the “Daisy” ad, among others.
5152f8c68eebd3b04091a4b4bf931c9031333481.zh: 你在竞选中抹黑对手，谁也不会感到意外；但幕僚制作的广告确实极其有效，其中就包括“雏菊”等后来成为经典的广告。

12023a0bba6a3948d22e07bc816ab38dec67cad1.source: It's not a big deal in this election, but there are some people who dislike Trump, yet are still uncomfortable with the tactics of these protestors.
12023a0bba6a3948d22e07bc816ab38dec67cad1.zh: 这在本次选举中不是大事，但有些人虽然不喜欢特朗普，仍对这些抗议者的手法感到不安。

a721a6eaedf672b94c6b55687259bd26eb469721.source: It's not hard to notice your progressive emphasis with this answer.
a721a6eaedf672b94c6b55687259bd26eb469721.zh: 这个回答鲜明地体现了你对进步派立场的强调。

9a7d33e0ca4fe1c6f541785f58d2155d4ff11b4a.source: It's not like anyone is asking you to comment on this, but it could have been an interesting gambit, given the stakes of this election.
9a7d33e0ca4fe1c6f541785f58d2155d4ff11b4a.zh: 并没有人要求你对此发表评论，不过，考虑到这场选举的重大利害，这本可以是一招有意思的棋。

6850c703d3b24b411ebefde211f9a39c60b04c88.source: It's not often that I feel shame. People who know me can agree. But I am very sorry for the way I acted in this situation, and we can't allow one ill-advised conversation to derail the entire future of the United States.
6850c703d3b24b411ebefde211f9a39c60b04c88.zh: 我不常感到羞愧，了解我的人都会同意。但对于自己在这件事中的表现，我非常抱歉。我们不能让一次欠考虑的谈话，毁掉美国的整个未来。

0144e0a332724a50860abe5863cb74a08038ff0c.source: It's not out of the question for you to sweep the middle plains, but everything will have to go just perfectly for you.
0144e0a332724a50860abe5863cb74a08038ff0c.zh: 你并非没有可能横扫中部平原地区，不过，一切都得恰到好处才行。

9802e635ca8e3807a863cf813da242340a4149a4.source: It's not quite clear what you mean, but it doesn't seem to be an attack on the program itself.
9802e635ca8e3807a863cf813da242340a4149a4.zh: 你的意思不太明确，不过看起来并不是在攻击这个项目本身。

0fc20ec3cc70dceb908373383f8ab0d07bbb75f8.source: It's not the job of government to regulate labor disputes, but the fact of the matter is that these strikers were allowing no rail traffic to pass through Chicago whatsoever. Something needed to be done.
0fc20ec3cc70dceb908373383f8ab0d07bbb75f8.zh: 政府的职责不是调解劳资争端，但事实是，这些罢工者不让任何铁路运输经过芝加哥。总得采取行动。

3b2cb4e1c077421e75e5091282f846c460ef8edd.source: It's not very practical to defend West Berlin, in its isolated location, if the Soviets continue to escalate. I'd prefer to focus on building our defenses in the rest of West Germany.
3b2cb4e1c077421e75e5091282f846c460ef8edd.zh: 西柏林孤悬在外，如果苏联继续升级事态，保卫它并不现实。我宁愿集中精力，加强我们在西德其他地区的防御。

a2e675764dcd5c35650d663e4ed1f5aac22597cf.source: It's not yet clear whether this attack was actually terrorism. Both you and Trump are coming under some criticism for jumping to that conclusion.
a2e675764dcd5c35650d663e4ed1f5aac22597cf.zh: 目前还不清楚，这次袭击究竟是不是恐怖主义。你和特朗普都因急着作出这个结论而受到一些批评。

3b6a69cee8837786464eb6f48e012933c590d352.source: It's now up to you what you do as president. Maybe you go full-on populist, as you did in the campaign, or appeal to the establishment with some more orthodox Republican policy. Either way, you will be making history by this win.
3b6a69cee8837786464eb6f48e012933c590d352.zh: 接下来如何担任总统，就由你决定了。你也许会像竞选时那样，彻底走民粹主义路线；也许会采用更符合共和党正统的政策，争取建制派。不论如何，这场胜利都会让你载入史册。

b18500329d3e50cc8952ee54b098bba39aeba0f1.source: It's one thing to run as a liberal Republican, but advocating for national health care is probably taking things a bit too far.
b18500329d3e50cc8952ee54b098bba39aeba0f1.zh: 以自由派共和党人的身份参选是一回事，但主张全国性医疗保障，大概就走得有些太远了。

c04bb9276e992e1eb8b2f6c9c269f4898bd9f6a8.source: It's only right to consider a judge's views on the right to choose when making appointments.
c04bb9276e992e1eb8b2f6c9c269f4898bd9f6a8.zh: 任命法官时，考虑其对选择堕胎权利的观点，才是正确做法。

5e26bdc6c6c2e4273cfd7f5862cdb4a4a39dff14.source: It's good to support Israel, especially if you expect to win your home state this fall.
5e26bdc6c6c2e4273cfd7f5862cdb4a4a39dff14.zh: 支持以色列是好事，尤其如果你希望今年秋季赢下自己的家乡州。

95675eddfa333595cd2c182f605dcf998d1a4590.source: It's hard to get elected with the opposition of both the agribusiness and oil interests.
95675eddfa333595cd2c182f605dcf998d1a4590.zh: 同时遭到农业企业和石油利益集团反对，很难当选。

09bde4db5a689615f08cf28edee3f1e5534e2e9c.source: It's hard to know what to do with this question. It might well be best to give a non-committal answer and hope the issue goes away after this election.
09bde4db5a689615f08cf28edee3f1e5534e2e9c.zh: 很难判断这个问题该怎么处理。或许最好不作明确承诺，希望选举后这件事就不再受到关注。

e0fda1326c2eb3ba12baf6ea9cedc6142619b0d0.source: It's hard to make Hunter Biden stay in the mainstream news, but your supporters are certainly keeping up with his story.
e0fda1326c2eb3ba12baf6ea9cedc6142619b0d0.zh: 让亨特·拜登持续留在主流新闻里很难，但你的支持者确实一直在关注他的故事。

a51ab1410d9347c646ba62c7aa54df7b2ffdd991.source: It's hard to sound too aggressive on the Cold War, but this might do it. A lot of people think this is an extreme idea.
a51ab1410d9347c646ba62c7aa54df7b2ffdd991.zh: 在冷战问题上很难显得过于强硬，但这个主张可能做到了。许多人认为，这个想法太极端了。

326bc9b7a55cbaabbbe7be4e4508bada9a19c205.source: It's hard to visit certain places in the heat of a campaign. I will do a tour of the U.S. where I visit all 50 states and highlight the people we're fighting for with Obama's policies, and whom we'll keep fighting for when I'm President.
326bc9b7a55cbaabbbe7be4e4508bada9a19c205.zh: 竞选进入白热化阶段后，有些地方很难安排访问。我会巡访美国全部五十个州，突出那些我们正通过奥巴马的政策为之奋斗的人；等我当上总统，我们还会继续为他们奋斗。

fcbef349bedb2c47f2ff5e5bf1a73c0326dfa383.source: It's important for people to remember the truth about our opponents. I will emphasize how their plans will kill Medicare as we know it, do nothing to combat the sluggish economy, and will only make the rich richer.
fcbef349bedb2c47f2ff5e5bf1a73c0326dfa383.zh: 民众必须记住，我们的对手究竟是什么样的人。我会强调，他们的计划将毁掉现行联邦医疗保险，无助于解决经济低迷，只会让富人更富。

786def88553497864923f4078519599b5d2576f6.source: It's important to have judgment and leadership experience in the White House, and Gretchen Whitmer has shown over and over again, as Governor of Michigan, that she has what it takes to get the job done.
786def88553497864923f4078519599b5d2576f6.zh: 白宫需要判断力和领导经验。格雷琴·惠特默担任密歇根州州长以来，一再证明，她具备完成工作的能力。

9b52087c7e772d943b3f4d0abd6addd9497cb60b.source: It's important to remain above the fray and continue with the positive message of our campaign.
9b52087c7e772d943b3f4d0abd6addd9497cb60b.zh: 重要的是不卷入纷争，继续传达我们竞选的积极信息。

3f033c8ab290e6012e443fc9d5e09e375c589c01.source: It's important to stick to your principles, but your answer is not calibrated to win a majority of voters in November.
3f033c8ab290e6012e443fc9d5e09e375c589c01.zh: 坚持原则很重要，但你的回答不是为了在11月赢得多数选民而设计的。

dab688340076673edd4c577b64178607fbd87e7d.source: It's incredible that Hunter Biden isn't in jail right now, when you get down to it. Some Ukranian oligarch was giving him $1 million to do absolutely nothing, and Sleepy Joe was in on it too. Where is the FBI?
dab688340076673edd4c577b64178607fbd87e7d.zh: 说到底，亨特·拜登现在还没坐牢，简直不可思议。某个乌克兰寡头付他一百万美元，让他什么也不做，瞌睡乔也参与其中。联邦调查局在哪里？

4a09c5fd99542f557c90c28084babde2a4311ef9.source: It's never a bad idea to lob attacks at Trump, so long as that is balanced with a positive program of your own.
4a09c5fd99542f557c90c28084babde2a4311ef9.zh: 攻击特朗普从来不是坏主意，只要同时提出自己的积极方案。

934d5d1bc2131d1ee9c8d7b54c5ae87588678ef8.source: It's nice to talk about the New South, but there is sure to be a backlash (especially from the Southern Baptist vote). On the other hand, this could help you a bit elsewhere.
934d5d1bc2131d1ee9c8d7b54c5ae87588678ef8.zh: 谈新南方当然不错，但肯定会引发反弹，尤其是在美南浸信会选民中。另一方面，这也可能让你在其他地方略有收获。

625b8e1ac03f9acdfb6fbb27aeb67dd9aad24362.source: It's pathetic how losers like Ted Cruz and Jeb Bush, these guys couldn't even get 10 percent of the vote, and now they're the judge and jury? Sad!
625b8e1ac03f9acdfb6fbb27aeb67dd9aad24362.zh: 特德·克鲁兹、杰布·布什这种失败者，连10%的票都拿不到，现在倒当起了法官和陪审团？真可悲！

76a96ecddc7deed77449ad8c6847cd379f0b98b1.source: It's pretty simple, really. The left wants to take all of the guns in this country and destroy them, whatever the Constitution says about it. Some of them might not admit that, but it's the truth.
76a96ecddc7deed77449ad8c6847cd379f0b98b1.zh: 其实很简单。左翼想把全国所有枪支收走、销毁，不管宪法怎么说。有些人也许不承认，但这就是事实。

e2c5af12549e85ef9cc06fe7951cb20af9a616ce.source: It's probably a little better to take the attack to George Bush. We will obviously give Massachusetts some mention, but it is not the main focus.
e2c5af12549e85ef9cc06fe7951cb20af9a616ce.zh: 向乔治·布什发起进攻，大概更好一些。我们当然会提到马萨诸塞州，但不会以此为主要焦点。

a87a4f880de033b1bc8b874fb6415ba68a5cd74d.source: It's probably best not to praise the effects of Taft-Hartley during this campaign if you want to keep labor happy.
a87a4f880de033b1bc8b874fb6415ba68a5cd74d.zh: 如果你想让劳工满意，竞选期间大概最好别赞扬《塔夫脱—哈特利法》的效果。

2b04c961562953e83e412cfe1207361c2cd2ba02.source: It's probably best to ignore Bill Clinton, and focus your statements on Bush, Gore, and the two-party system in general.
2b04c961562953e83e412cfe1207361c2cd2ba02.zh: 大概最好别谈比尔·克林顿，而是把发言重点放在布什、戈尔和整个两党制上。

62ea27ed9a8fb3bda7772abccf82b9f8624563ed.source: It's probably not best to speak out against anti-Communism movements in public, no matter your personal feelings.
62ea27ed9a8fb3bda7772abccf82b9f8624563ed.zh: 不管你个人怎么想，公开抨击反共运动大概都不是上策。

dad3859a75213fc3b842c44baa36008b534ba6d2.source: It's probably smart to cut your losses and move on from this issue. But for the first time now, a lot of people are questioning your judgment...
dad3859a75213fc3b842c44baa36008b534ba6d2.zh: 及时止损、翻过这一页，大概是明智的。不过，现在第一次有许多人开始怀疑你的判断力……

963352e40d2799f2f8a2040fcb3f4c35b72ee0f2.source: It's probably time to admit that there isn't much of a difference between our plans. I was simply forced to pander to extreme elements of the Republican Party during our primary election process.
963352e40d2799f2f8a2040fcb3f4c35b72ee0f2.zh: 也许是时候承认，我们的方案没什么区别了。在党内初选期间，我只是被迫迎合共和党的极端派别。

e5d676ae3dd2548153cde3a27273f02cd6634c5a.source: It's rarely a bad idea to tie your fortunes to the popular Bill Clinton.
e5d676ae3dd2548153cde3a27273f02cd6634c5a.zh: 把自己的政治前途与受欢迎的比尔·克林顿联系起来，很少会是坏主意。

d62ae2f8240ca9c55a56a1cc3383f5a32b1bb9bf.source: It's really a ludicrous thing. You have the same people who led John McCain and Mitt Romney to defeat. And now they've given me the same terrible advice for months. We're not gonna change a thing.
d62ae2f8240ca9c55a56a1cc3383f5a32b1bb9bf.zh: 这实在荒唐。就是那些带着约翰·麦凯恩和米特·罗姆尼走向失败的人，如今又连续几个月给我同样糟糕的建议。我们一点也不会改。

51a2f9fc21fd698aed628640987baf128d80073c.source: It's risky to attack Carter so heavily. Voters like him as a person -- even some who might be on the fence about his politics or readiness for office.
51a2f9fc21fd698aed628640987baf128d80073c.zh: 如此猛烈地攻击卡特很冒险。选民喜欢他的为人，甚至包括一些对他的政治主张或任职准备仍然犹豫的人。

1056824d8a6890ef54183fcba2d36ccd867e8f3b.source: It's risky to attack Carter so heavily. Voters like him as a person -- even some who might be on the fence out his politics or readiness for office.
1056824d8a6890ef54183fcba2d36ccd867e8f3b.zh: 如此猛烈地攻击卡特很冒险。选民喜欢他的为人，甚至包括一些对他的政治主张或任职准备仍然犹豫的人。

f38a6e3b62f71016a371ace20f07d825c403cf52.source: It's so unfair what's happening, it's a tragedy. You have paid outside agitators breaking up my events and violating my 1st Amendment rights, and then the media is covering them to discredit my campaign.
f38a6e3b62f71016a371ace20f07d825c403cf52.zh: 发生的事情太不公平了，是一场悲剧。有拿钱办事的外来煽动者打断我的活动，侵犯我的第一修正案权利，然后媒体又报道他们，抹黑我的竞选。

2619b2194fe281c577dbb6f28d0310dcb3d07e12.source: It's something we should keep on the table. The entire idea of our intervention in Iraq was to unleash a wave of democratic movements in the Middle East. Hopefully Syria qualifies as such.
2619b2194fe281c577dbb6f28d0310dcb3d07e12.zh: 我们应该保留这个选项。我们干预伊拉克的整个理念，就是在中东掀起民主运动的浪潮。希望叙利亚也能算其中一例。

ac9bc5e9641ba77826617f2964a4f55ade03da0f.source: It's time that the two halves of our country fully reconciled. Confederate veterans should be helped as much as Union veterans.
ac9bc5e9641ba77826617f2964a4f55ade03da0f.zh: 国家的南北两部分该彻底和解了。邦联军老兵应当像联邦军老兵一样得到帮助。

91669d39d33c56c32db649f4ba35b076e8a6ae42.source: It's time that we had severe restrictions on who we let into this country. A walk down the streets of New York is hardly distinguishable from the Tower of Babel, and these new arrivals crush the bargaining power of the American worker.
91669d39d33c56c32db649f4ba35b076e8a6ae42.zh: 该严格限制允许哪些人进入我国了。走在纽约街头，几乎与置身巴别塔没什么两样；这些新来者严重削弱了美国工人的议价能力。

70cecc7768dbbdb37943f78b53b6bf1285120212.source: It's time we think about implementing a series of public works projects to occupy our excess labor force. This will improve business by placing more money in the hands of consumers.
70cecc7768dbbdb37943f78b53b6bf1285120212.zh: 该考虑实施一系列公共工程，吸纳我们过剩的劳动力了。这会让消费者手中有更多钱，从而改善商业景气。

9c8181293fa10f3a8266cb63ad2d8dd8977e3afa.source: It's too early to say who exactly will be included in my Cabinet when I win this election. In all cases I will nominate the most qualified individual.
9c8181293fa10f3a8266cb63ad2d8dd8977e3afa.zh: 现在就说我赢得选举后具体会让谁进入内阁，还为时过早。任何情况下，我都会提名最有资格的人。

7ce5d56b9138e635b1aa7dda0315a7ce668b7094.source: It's unbelievable really. I saw the video, we all saw the video. And think, this is in a place run entirely by Democrats. We've all seen them cover up these incidents before, maybe they'll step in this time and prosecute the officer.
7ce5d56b9138e635b1aa7dda0315a7ce668b7094.zh: 这真是难以置信。我看了视频，我们都看了视频。想想，这地方完全由民主党管理。我们都见过他们以前掩盖这些事，也许这次会介入，起诉那个警员。

d5b9557394d0136f4a1468a9d50dd9556f124624.source: It's unclear what effect this will have, but it is an interesting move.
d5b9557394d0136f4a1468a9d50dd9556f124624.zh: 还不清楚这会有什么效果，但确实是个有意思的举动。

a698fcf00de390cdc8695f2a5d20e6dd2384bf23.source: It's unfortunate that we've become less vigilant on the internal Communist threat in recent years. Espionage and infiltration of our government is as serious a threat as external Soviet action.
a698fcf00de390cdc8695f2a5d20e6dd2384bf23.zh: 遗憾的是，近年来，我们对国内共产主义威胁的警惕有所放松。间谍活动和对政府的渗透，与苏联在国外的行动一样，是严重威胁。

4b6add4d594d50577899a826b2c22bfc675d3b53.source: It's up to you what you want to do next. A run in 4 years isn't totally out of the question, but after your decades in politics, you might be burnt out. In any case, let’s hope Bush can continue the economic prosperity and tone down the foreign policy intervention, such as in Somalia. Anything more like that would be a disaster...
4b6add4d594d50577899a826b2c22bfc675d3b53.zh: 接下来想做什么，由你自己决定。四年后再选，并非完全不可能，但从政几十年后，你可能已经心力交瘁。无论如何，但愿布什延续经济繁荣，并减少索马里那样的对外干预。再来这样的事情，可就会酿成灾难……

7ebb1678c9ce799e66fc7cfeda610b4e6c896362.source: It's very important for our party to remain united and to put up a unified front against Donald Trump. And that's a two-way street, I'm sure we can both find some common ground and make a good show of unity.
7ebb1678c9ce799e66fc7cfeda610b4e6c896362.zh: 我们党必须保持团结，以统一阵线对抗唐纳德·特朗普，这非常重要。而团结需要双方共同努力。我相信，我们能找到共同点，充分展现团结。

c8b0c8704ca3fa12ee9ff2ba0aa3ca9fc8040409.source: It’s good to stick by your proposals and policies.
c8b0c8704ca3fa12ee9ff2ba0aa3ca9fc8040409.zh: 坚持自己的主张和政策是好事。

05df2e4500a96666c9a8f06bbc1be0687f3e46a8.source: James Comey, FBI Director, has made a late announcement that additional emails have surfaced in your case, thanks to an investigation into Anthony Weiner. What are your thoughts?
05df2e4500a96666c9a8f06bbc1be0687f3e46a8.zh: 联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米在竞选末期宣布，由于对安东尼·韦纳的调查，你的案件中又出现了更多电子邮件。你对此有什么看法？

19d5c245557790bbf0a0ab4113c1f480d3a547cd.source: James Guthrie served as Secretary of the Treasury under Franklin Pierce, and paid off most of the federal debt during that term. He is a slaveholder and states' rights advocate, but a bitter opponent of secession. His selection would allow Douglas to run with a Southerner who is still somewhat connected to the national political scene. Guthrie has also long advocated internal improvements and owns a railroad, which could attract some limited crossover support from former Whigs.
19d5c245557790bbf0a0ab4113c1f480d3a547cd.zh: 詹姆斯·格思里 担任富兰克林·皮尔斯领导下的财政部长，并在此期间偿还了大部分联邦债务。他是一名奴隶主和各州权利倡导者，但也是分裂国家的强烈反对者。他的选择将允许道格拉斯与一位仍与国家政治舞台有一定联系的南方人一起竞选。 格思里还长期主张改善国内公共基础设施，并拥有一条铁路，这可能会吸引前辉格党人的一些有限的交叉支持。

6bc3ac45668cc87a16f13b52df78d4bbbbe36bcd.source: James K. Polk won the Democratic nomination as a dark horse candidate, after Martin Van Buren was rejected for being soft on the Texas issue. He is a former Speaker of the House, and also served as Governor of Tennessee. Polk's support is strongest in the South, but he must hold some Northern states to win. To do this, he could exploit the Oregon issue, fond memories of Andrew Jackson, and the emerging Catholic vote. Note that John Tyler has yet to formally renounce his independent bid.
6bc3ac45668cc87a16f13b52df78d4bbbbe36bcd.zh: 马丁·范布伦因在得克萨斯问题上态度不够坚决而遭否决后，詹姆斯·K.·波尔克以黑马之姿获得民主党提名。他曾任众议院议长和田纳西州州长。波尔克在南方的支持最强，但必须保住若干北方州才能获胜。为此，他可以利用俄勒冈问题、民众对安德鲁·杰克逊的怀念，以及日益重要的天主教选民。请注意，约翰·泰勒尚未正式放弃独立参选。

aa8a9594d739aaef007bd8232dbd19f35bc097bc.source: Jeff Sessions has been one of the most conservative, patriotic members of the Senate for the last two decades, fighting to fix our broken immigration system, the deficit issue, and defending our wonderful police.
aa8a9594d739aaef007bd8232dbd19f35bc097bc.zh: 过去二十年，杰夫·塞申斯一直是参议院最保守、最爱国的议员之一，努力修复我们破败的移民制度，解决赤字问题，并捍卫我们出色的警察。

863279f82d244ceb3e2917b322b6f8bd8296dd6c.source: Jeff Sessions has been there fighting with us from the beginning. And it's about loyalty. This is someone who's a tremendously loyal person who's gonna help us get a lot of terrific things accomplished.
863279f82d244ceb3e2917b322b6f8bd8296dd6c.zh: 杰夫·塞申斯从一开始就跟我们并肩奋斗。这讲究的是忠诚。这个人极其忠诚，会帮助我们完成许多了不起的事。

70505e47a67eab2faeb7f05e018c0c0a1d958e10.source: Jeff Sessions, a Senator from Alabama, was the first major Republican politician to endorse your candidacy. He could help shore up some potentially shaky support on the right of the Republican party. Conversely, Alabama is not competitive, and sustained attacks on Hillary Clinton may be all that is needed to keep that wing in line.
70505e47a67eab2faeb7f05e018c0c0a1d958e10.zh: 杰夫·塞申斯，来自 阿拉巴马州 的参议员，是第一位支持您的候选资格的主要共和党政治家。他可以帮助巩固一些可能不稳定的右翼支持共和党。相反，阿拉巴马州 不具有竞争力，并且对 希拉里·克林顿 的持续攻击可能就是保持该侧翼整齐划一所需的全部内容。

40aefda07ad2ab61b4a7b3e4ae5fc36dd24fea92.source: Jeffrey Toobin - Too Close to Call: The Thirty-Six-Day Battle to Decide the 2000 Election
40aefda07ad2ab61b4a7b3e4ae5fc36dd24fea92.zh: Jeffrey Toobin - 势均力敌：决定 2000 年选举的三十六天之战

ddb0dbf888811257954ac490a64e96dec9688746.source: Jesse Jackson shaking hands. Do you have any comment?
ddb0dbf888811257954ac490a64e96dec9688746.zh: 杰西·杰克逊 握手。您有何评论？

a7dfde7b3571ac89a2f54ce73f34d84ebff28185.source: Jesse Jackson was Dukakis's most successful challenger for the Democratic nomination. He has consistently pushed liberal positions, and would be the first African-American to appear on a major party ticket. In the environment of 1988, his race could be an asset and a liability. Many of supporters feel that his success in the primaries should warrant his selection as the running mate, and passing him up could dampen enthusiasm among black and liberal voters.
a7dfde7b3571ac89a2f54ce73f34d84ebff28185.zh: 杰西·杰克逊 是 杜卡基斯 最成功的民主党提名挑战者。他一贯推行自由主义立场，并将成为第一个出现在主要政党候选人名单上的非裔美国人。在 1988 年的环境下，他的种族既可能是一种资产，也可能是一种负担。许多支持者认为，他在初选中的成功应该保证他被选为竞选伙伴，而放弃他可能会削弱黑人和自由派选民的热情。

b5d1000f3bd6acf82bbe1f07ba38d4c5f8bbd17b.source: Jesse Jackson was a controversial choice, even though he did do well in the primaries. Among other things, Jackson is pretty far to the left, even for a Democrat.
b5d1000f3bd6acf82bbe1f07ba38d4c5f8bbd17b.zh: 选择杰西·杰克逊作搭档很有争议，尽管他在初选中确实表现不错。原因之一是，杰克逊的立场相当偏左，即使按民主党人的标准也是如此。

aff9e095f98a2f8ab70879514d49de4d46a657b3.source: Jesse Jackson was the second-highest vote-getter during the Democratic primaries, and we are proud to have him on the ticket to unite our party.
aff9e095f98a2f8ab70879514d49de4d46a657b3.zh: 杰西·杰克逊在民主党初选中的得票排名第二。他能加入我们的竞选搭档、团结全党，我们深感自豪。

b681b2651b9916353df7f0a8498c3fc176f4a806.source: Jill and I are praying for a full and speedy recovery for President Trump. As someone who has dealt with tragedy, you never want to see this kind of thing happen to anyone.
b681b2651b9916353df7f0a8498c3fc176f4a806.zh: 吉尔和我正为特朗普总统尽快完全康复祈祷。经历过悲剧的人，绝不希望看到任何人遭遇这种事。

4ff15fb8d565043188c19d8fd9e54f4b6013070a.source: Jimmy Carter has been president for 8 years. Inflation has subsided to a steady amount, with unemployment dropping to virtually 0%. The budget had been balanced in 78, and poverty and hunger have been eradicated, as everyone unemployed became a farmer, and is eating peanut butter and peach jam sandwiches. the USSR on the 21st of January had seceded all their land to the USA and declared their government dissolved. Most importantly of all, the government is now trusted more than ever under the leadership of Jimmy Carter, who beat up Richard Nixon on live TV in 1981, garnering a 99% approval rating. Mondale has already won the most recent election 873 electoral votes to 0 against those sorry Republicans, who disbanded shortly after. All is good in the world, thanks to our wonderful leader, Jimmy Carter.
4ff15fb8d565043188c19d8fd9e54f4b6013070a.zh: 吉米·卡特已经当了八年总统。通胀降至稳定水平，失业率几乎降到0%。预算早在1978年就平衡了，贫困和饥饿也被消灭，因为所有失业者都去当农民，吃着花生酱配桃子果酱三明治。1月21日，苏联把全部领土割让给美国，并宣布解散政府。最重要的是，吉米·卡特领导下的政府如今获得了空前的信任；他在1981年电视直播中痛揍理查德·尼克松，赢得99%的支持率。蒙代尔刚刚在最新一届选举中，以873张选举人票对0票，击败了那些可怜的共和党人，共和党不久后就解散了。多亏我们伟大的领袖吉米·卡特，世界一片美好。

3b46e76cadae9a9681f67c9292fe0de9418bb98d.source: It’s no use. Those men haven’t voted for a Democrat since Roosevelt. Let’s keep focusing on the groups we know we can win.
3b46e76cadae9a9681f67c9292fe0de9418bb98d.zh: 没用的。自罗斯福以来，那些人就没给民主党人投过票。我们还是继续关注那些确定能够争取的群体吧。

7a559ca56bed094a9e94d6a3c1ad29d909c302fc.source: It’s not the strongest rebuttal, but it takes some of the edge off the attacks while maintaining a conservative outlook.
7a559ca56bed094a9e94d6a3c1ad29d909c302fc.zh: 这不是最有力的反驳，不过在维持保守立场的同时，也稍稍削弱了攻击的锋芒。

c3e0483b428daba3c14158e582a25c7262f2e8e0.source: It’s the best answer for the events that transpired in Chicago, but nobody is swayed by your rebuke of both sides.
c3e0483b428daba3c14158e582a25c7262f2e8e0.zh: 这是对芝加哥事件最好的回应，但你对双方的谴责没有说动任何人。

eef0e26ccf522fbfe470cd0f0cb9c9f7fd21fa9e.source: It’s the expected reply, so nothing really changes on the national stage.
eef0e26ccf522fbfe470cd0f0cb9c9f7fd21fa9e.zh: 这是意料之中的答复，因此全国局势没有什么变化。

5a476249ffe2a4401201a02198fe0ea544a263af.source: It’s valuable to stick by your morals, but America isn’t clamoring for aggressive integration.
5a476249ffe2a4401201a02198fe0ea544a263af.zh: 坚持道德原则值得肯定，但美国人并没有争相要求强力推进种族融合。

ed2c57c25c072d0febc076a9abf8f4098c8c1ac8.source: I’d rather put effort into winning the South. Vermont and Indiana are hopeless.
ed2c57c25c072d0febc076a9abf8f4098c8c1ac8.zh: 我更愿意把力量投入南方。佛蒙特州和印第安纳州没有希望。

1f204650f4ef458a79bbcb6986a7654de8a72292.source: I’m not sure. Maybe everywhere, really.
1f204650f4ef458a79bbcb6986a7654de8a72292.zh: 我还不确定。也许各个领域都该削减。

bcd509fa85f91fd5a04bb922c29a846d67c84f77.source: Jack Kemp is a Congressman from New York who has served since the early 1970s. Before that, he was a well-known professional football quarterback. He was one of the main architects and proponents of Reagan's supply-side tax cuts, and is known to be a staunch fiscal conservative. This could cut both ways in a general election. He would be a good choice for most Republicans, and is consistently mentioned as a possible running-mate.
bcd509fa85f91fd5a04bb922c29a846d67c84f77.zh: 杰克·肯普 是来自 纽约州 的国会议员，自 1970 年代初期以来一直任职。在此之前，他是一位著名的职业橄榄球四分卫。他是里根供给侧减税的主要设计者和支持者之一，并被认为是坚定的财政保守派。这在大选中可能是双向的。对于大多数共和党人来说，他将是一个不错的选择，并且一直被认为是可能的竞选伙伴。

f62e69719d71052dacec354c59b37b0e4cda4a0d.source: Jack Kemp is a fine choice for Vice President.
f62e69719d71052dacec354c59b37b0e4cda4a0d.zh: 杰克·肯普是个很好的副总统人选。

1e73d40a2eb0879bf5c84bf9e52771548fb24ba7.source: Jack Kemp is a towering figure within the Republican Party, and we're proud to have him on our ticket.
1e73d40a2eb0879bf5c84bf9e52771548fb24ba7.zh: 杰克·肯普是共和党内举足轻重的人物，我们很自豪能与他组成竞选搭档。

31f64fb2e365909c1ba711d6c8dd9bcb30d872cf.source: Jackson's selection was unpopular with some people, but they have to admit that you're a fighter.
31f64fb2e365909c1ba711d6c8dd9bcb30d872cf.zh: 有些人不喜欢你选择杰克逊，但他们也不得不承认，你敢于斗争。

27dc58879dd83249a408ba17aab27a861fcbfd96.source: Jacob Coxey's protests fell on deaf ears in 1894. With so many men out of work, is there any role for a public works program that would keep them occupied until business improves?
27dc58879dd83249a408ba17aab27a861fcbfd96.zh: 1894年，雅各布·考克西的抗议无人理会。如今这么多人失业，能否通过公共工程，让他们在经济好转前有些活干？

4180c2732eb6b07d7893bba7e60f106961c57f22.source: James Buchanan had a lot of experience in government. Abraham Lincoln didn't. So what if I'm a little unseasoned? I have the instincts for the job.
4180c2732eb6b07d7893bba7e60f106961c57f22.zh: 詹姆斯·布坎南有很多政府工作经验。亚伯拉罕·林肯却没有。我略显生疏又怎样？我有胜任这份工作的直觉。

0720d38c94ceff6be3d5122149d1e9d5c7da2c75.source: James Comey, FBI Director, has made a late announcement that additional emails have surfaced in Hillary Clinton's case, thanks to an investigation into Anthony Weiner. What are your thoughts?
0720d38c94ceff6be3d5122149d1e9d5c7da2c75.zh: 联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米在竞选末期宣布，由于对安东尼·韦纳的调查，克林顿案中又出现了更多电子邮件。你对此有什么看法？

bec99d1b9f2f18c9906eb14964e0395927ebcfab.source: Jimmy Carter has served as Governor of Georgia for one term, and has never held an elected office in Washington. In an era of public disgust with Watergate, Vietnam, and the economy, Carter has used his outsider status to win the Democratic nomination. He is an outspoken Southern Baptist, and a moderate within the party on social and economic issues. He begins with an early lead in the polls against Gerald Ford.
bec99d1b9f2f18c9906eb14964e0395927ebcfab.zh: 吉米·卡特做过一届佐治亚州州长，从未在华盛顿担任民选公职。公众厌恶水门事件、越南战争和糟糕的经济，卡特借助政坛局外人的身份赢得了民主党提名。他公开信奉美南浸信会，在党内的社会与经济议题上属于温和派。竞选初期，他在民调中领先于杰拉尔德·福特。

11af5fb0ddad0da0cb42e4ba5a1d7552a24c6681.source: Jingoists and so on favor this stance, but there is a significant German bloc of Republicans who you should still be worried about.
11af5fb0ddad0da0cb42e4ba5a1d7552a24c6681.zh: 沙文主义者等人支持这个立场，但共和党内还有相当一批德裔选民，你仍需顾及他们。

1984ba6f1e10bafbfd3bf223e19e67037ae286de.source: Joe Biden and Donald Trump face off in a heated 2020 election campaign. Held in the wake of a COVID-19 pandemic and nationwide protests, turnout is expected to be through the roof. Can Joe Biden hold together a large enough coalition of anti-Trump voters to make Trump a one-term President, or will Trump pull of another huge upset after trailing in the polls?
1984ba6f1e10bafbfd3bf223e19e67037ae286de.zh: 乔·拜登与唐纳德·特朗普在2020年展开激烈的总统竞选。新冠疫情和席卷全国的抗议浪潮尚未平息，预计投票率将大幅攀升。乔·拜登能否团结足够多的反特朗普选民，让特朗普只做一届总统？还是特朗普会在民调落后的情况下，再次爆冷获胜？

eeafe969f6f48dcced553582fa4a2436b2ac3689.source: Joe Biden came back from the dead to win the Democratic Party's nomination, and seems to enter the campaign slightly ahead in the polls against incumbent Donald Trump. Emotions are running high, even more than usual, in this campaign. Can Biden live up to his promise to calm tensions, or will he be overwhelmed by events?
eeafe969f6f48dcced553582fa4a2436b2ac3689.zh: 乔·拜登 起死回生，赢得了 民主党 的提名，并且似乎在与现任 唐纳德·特朗普 的民意调查中稍稍领先进入竞选。在这次竞选活动中，人们的情绪高涨，甚至比平时还要高涨。 拜登 能否兑现他平息紧张局势的承诺，还是会被事件压垮？

4d9a819f0090f94ef9f4553d32383c55136d20d4.source: Joe Biden has been meeting with Bernie Sanders, Elizabeth Warren, and other such politicians in an attempt to unite the Democratic Party. Do you plan to highlight these events in your speeches?
4d9a819f0090f94ef9f4553d32383c55136d20d4.zh: 乔·拜登一直在与伯尼·桑德斯、伊丽莎白·沃伦等政治人物会面，试图团结民主党。你是否打算在演说中着重提起这些事？

7e2a9af627adfa51590f4b571428a946d6716ca9.source: Joe Biden is a bit annoyed you won without him, though.
7e2a9af627adfa51590f4b571428a946d6716ca9.zh: 乔·拜登 不过，你在没有他的情况下获胜有点生气。

0ac4b5b36e7ae08b5148474756d50b42f02dac5f.source: Joe Biden is a joke, really. He's 78 years old, sits in his basement all day, probably has dementia, and many other issues. Is he the person who will stand up for you and for America?
0ac4b5b36e7ae08b5148474756d50b42f02dac5f.zh: 乔·拜登真是个笑话。他78岁了，整天坐在地下室里，大概患有痴呆，还有许多其他问题。这种人能为你们、为美国挺身而出吗？

378af4778de4b612c6f1d004f3c0d84fd119de62.source: Joe Biden is acting like a moderate right now, but you'd better believe that behind the scenes, he'll be spending a lot of time listening to out-of-touch liberals like Elizabeth Warren.
378af4778de4b612c6f1d004f3c0d84fd119de62.zh: 乔·拜登现在装得像个温和派，但你最好相信，私下里，他会花很多时间听伊丽莎白·沃伦这种脱离现实的自由派的意见。

93e7f41c29d68cba8b1026647a4f906f10a65d5b.source: Joe Biden is definitely more popular with independents than the progressive left is. One way to hit at Biden is to suggest that he's not the one really calling the shots in the modern Democratic Party.
93e7f41c29d68cba8b1026647a4f906f10a65d5b.zh: 乔·拜登在独立选民中，肯定比进步派左翼更受欢迎。一种攻击他的办法，是暗示在今天的民主党里，真正作决定的不是他。

95e42f31efdd34305dd0d37fb8109fcb54ab9978.zh: 约翰·贝拉米 福斯特 & 弗雷德·马格多夫 -

37aeca9e479cf1d62a46a1afe74db8b04ab1fe4a.source: John Bricker is a former Governor and current Senator from Ohio who served as Dewey's running mate in 1944, on a ticket that lost to FDR. He is closely aligned with Robert Taft and the conservative wing of the party. Both Bricker and Taft are popular in Ohio, and they helped Dewey win that state in 1944. If the election tightens up this time, Bricker's influence in Ohio could prove critical. However, the country does seem to be moving away from Bricker's brand of isolationism.
37aeca9e479cf1d62a46a1afe74db8b04ab1fe4a.zh: 约翰·布里克 是 俄亥俄州 的前州长和现任参议员，曾于 1944 年担任 杜威 的竞选伙伴，但最终输给了 富兰克林·罗斯福。他与罗伯特·塔夫脱和党内保守派关系密切。 布里克和塔夫脱在俄亥俄州中都很受欢迎，他们帮助杜威在1944年赢得了该州。如果这次选举紧张，布里克在俄亥俄州中的影响力可能会至关重要。然而，该国似乎确实正在摆脱布里克的孤立主义品牌。

e4340b418c6526f3387a2cbb314040228b972f44.source: John Bricker is a great man who represents my views for the future of this country. Now let's get going with this campaign.
e4340b418c6526f3387a2cbb314040228b972f44.zh: 约翰·布里克是位出色的人物，代表了我对本国未来的看法。现在，让我们开始竞选吧。

a7b2b4307ef7e4a45f749fe891428e22408f99f4.source: John C. Breckinridge is the Southern answer to Stephen Douglas as Democrat nominee. Like Douglas, Breckinridge has little chance of winning the election outright. He does have a good chance of winning all or most of the Southern states, though.
a7b2b4307ef7e4a45f749fe891428e22408f99f4.zh: 约翰·C.·布雷肯里奇 是南方对斯蒂芬 道格拉斯 作为民主党候选人的答案。与道格拉斯一样，布雷肯里奇彻底赢得选举的机会很小。不过，他确实有很好的机会赢得所有或大部分南部各州。

3706773119b09c6eb748d075e44a4668522c5fda.source: John Connally bolted from the Democrats to the Republicans in 1973. He was Governor of Texas for six years, and could help greatly in winning that state. He is strong on defense issues and conservative on social issues, and could even be seen as an olive branch to the Reaganites. He has good name-recognition, having been wounded in Kennedy's assassination.
3706773119b09c6eb748d075e44a4668522c5fda.zh: 约翰·康纳利 于 1973 年从民主党转向共和党。他担任 得克萨斯州 州长六年，对赢得该州有很大帮助。他在国防问题上强硬，在社会问题上保守，甚至可以被视为里根派的橄榄枝。他有良好的知名度，曾在肯尼迪的暗杀中受伤。

12af8fcafef9a85349ddba7dc1ba157c06fbe533.source: John Connally has served his home state of Texas well, and he is the best man for the job.
12af8fcafef9a85349ddba7dc1ba157c06fbe533.zh: 约翰·康纳利为家乡得克萨斯州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

0221a9a6ce0dc6d95bd646841dc271524b9c12b4.source: John D. Rockefeller has nothing to fear from a McKinley Administration. I reject the calls of certain mountebanks for the break-up or socialization of Standard Oil.
0221a9a6ce0dc6d95bd646841dc271524b9c12b4.zh: 约翰·D.·洛克菲勒不必担心麦金莱政府。我反对那些江湖骗子鼓吹拆分标准石油公司，或把它改为社会所有。

fb838cf2a3ef348708494701c82d48fb1506d6fb.source: John Danforth has served his home state of Missouri well. I think he has a record that all Americans can get behind.
fb838cf2a3ef348708494701c82d48fb1506d6fb.zh: 约翰·丹福思出色地服务了家乡密苏里州。我认为，他的政绩能得到所有美国人的支持。

80ab5d1e1af7e3423240796b471545aa6260a8d4.source: John Danforth is a strong, religious man with a good heart. He is a wonderful example of a leader that conservatives can produce.
80ab5d1e1af7e3423240796b471545aa6260a8d4.zh: 约翰·丹福思坚定、虔诚而善良。他是保守派所能培养出的领导人的一个杰出典范。

d83e310425926f9c09b884d727ee48344261c46a.source: Joe Biden is the current Vice President and Obama's presumptive pick for 2012. He served as a Senator from Delaware for many years.
d83e310425926f9c09b884d727ee48344261c46a.zh: 乔·拜登 是现任副总统，也是 奥巴马 2012 年的推定人选。他曾担任 特拉华州 的参议员多年。

7f74d27dadb306f388e3de3c556df758219a88ec.source: Joe Biden made what can only be described as a gaffe on the campaign trail today. What are your comments?
7f74d27dadb306f388e3de3c556df758219a88ec.zh: 乔·拜登今天在竞选途中说了句只能称为失言的话。你如何评论？

1dc3ea7659fb9e6ab5257733c9f7b64536f95b14.source: Joe Lieberman is a historic choice for Vice President, and a valued member of the Democratic Party.
1dc3ea7659fb9e6ab5257733c9f7b64536f95b14.zh: 选择乔·利伯曼担任副总统，具有历史意义。他也是民主党一位受到重视的成员。

6a28e5d7b6dbc4c747bcdb58d86b6e8c6b6fc1df.source: Joe Lieberman is a moderate Democrat and Orthodox Jew who has served as a Senator from Connecticut. He would be the first Jewish candidate or running mate from a major party. He was also a prominent critic of Bill Clinton's missteps during his time in the White House. Geographically, Lieberman could help with Gore's vote total in the critical state of Florida.
6a28e5d7b6dbc4c747bcdb58d86b6e8c6b6fc1df.zh: 乔·利伯曼 是一位温和的民主党人和正统犹太人，曾担任 康涅狄格州 的参议员。他将是第一位来自主要政党的犹太候选人或竞选伙伴。他也是 比尔·克林顿 在 白宫 任职期间失误的著名批评者。从地理位置上来说，利伯曼 可以在 佛罗里达州 的关键状态下帮助提高 戈尔 的投票总数。

2f4d74d6264576b6ad7e82d484f89f0c34e9d9ce.source: Joe Lieberman is an independent thinker who has challenged people of all views. These are the people I want in my administration.
2f4d74d6264576b6ad7e82d484f89f0c34e9d9ce.zh: 乔·利伯曼善于独立思考，曾向持各种观点的人提出挑战。这正是我希望政府中拥有的人才。

9c05032aa882fcd23f2a51546c6e4cdade6c3d5e.source: John Anderson always speaks his mind and fights for what he believes in. These are the kind of people we need in my next Administration.
9c05032aa882fcd23f2a51546c6e4cdade6c3d5e.zh: 约翰·安德森始终直言自己的想法，为信念而奋斗。我的下届政府正需要这样的人。

ca06e2453379ebadf0aba3ce1e90bf1ef3c54fe6.source: John Anderson has served his home state of Illinois well, and he is the best man for the job.
ca06e2453379ebadf0aba3ce1e90bf1ef3c54fe6.zh: 约翰·安德森为家乡伊利诺伊州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

d3bdd8b527a03554a8e0e1d15146198d1a9c1e28.source: John Anderson is a lifelong Republican and he has the right views on all the important issues for our country. We need a guy like him if we hope to win the independent voters away from Jimmy Carter.
d3bdd8b527a03554a8e0e1d15146198d1a9c1e28.zh: 约翰·安德森终身都是共和党人，对国家所有重要问题都有正确看法。如果我们希望从吉米·卡特那里争取独立选民，就需要他这样的人。

4eb4bdd47884a4991225283743a12bb20c118716.source: John Anderson is a long-time Congressman from Illinois who has conservative fiscal views, moderate social views, and was a strong critic of Richard Nixon during the Watergate hearings. His presence could help win moderates and could swing the state of Illinois. He could also help mitigate, at least somewhat, against Carter's outsider reputation. He would not do much to win back the conservative, Reaganite wing of the party.
4eb4bdd47884a4991225283743a12bb20c118716.zh: 约翰·安德森 是来自 伊利诺伊州 的长期国会议员，他具有保守的财政观点和温和的社会观点，并且在 水门事件 听证会上强烈批评 理查德·尼克松。他的存在可以帮助赢得温和派并可能改变 伊利诺伊州 的状态。他还可以帮助减轻（至少在某种程度上）卡特 的局外人声誉。他不会做太多事情来赢回党内保守的里根派。

193e9812625eb2dd77506d3b1cfb560ff13e736d.source: John Bell is a former Whig who has no stated position on the slavery issue, in spite of himself being a slaveholder. Bell's only position is to fight for the preservation of the Union under any circumstance. The vagueness of this stance is both an asset and a liability.
193e9812625eb2dd77506d3b1cfb560ff13e736d.zh: 约翰·贝尔 是前 辉格党人，尽管他自己是奴隶主，但他在奴隶制问题上没有明确的立场。贝尔唯一的立场是在任何情况下都为维护联邦而战。这种立场的模糊性既是优点也是缺点。

95e347b5bf19c1707225d51f062c68774584eefc.source: John Kerry is a Senator from Massachusetts. He gained prominence in his youth as a Vietnam Veteran Against the War. He also won a Silver Star in that war. He is a solid liberal on the political spectrum. His home state is strongly Democratic, but his views may help the Democrats reduce the loss of support to Ralph Nader. He can also be helpful in New Hampshire.
95e347b5bf19c1707225d51f062c68774584eefc.zh: 约翰·克里 是来自 马萨诸塞州 的参议员。他年轻时作为一名反战越南退伍军人而声名鹊起。他还在那场战争中赢得了银星勋章。他在政治领域是坚定的自由主义者。他的家乡是一个强有力的民主党州，但他的观点可能有助于民主党减少对拉尔夫·纳德的支持损失。他还可以在 新罕布什尔州 方面提供帮助。

04d9c672d31a71023a65f31947198a01ccb10649.source: John Kerry is the best person for the job. He has proven his ability time and time again over his years in the Senate.
04d9c672d31a71023a65f31947198a01ccb10649.zh: 约翰·克里是最适合这份工作的人。在参议院任职多年，他一次又一次证明了自己的能力。

1b3ceef73721dcd7cb0764520614fdee200f1350.source: John Kerry is the type of principled, liberal thinker we need in our administration. He has worked tirelessly on behalf of all Americans.
1b3ceef73721dcd7cb0764520614fdee200f1350.zh: 约翰·克里是一位有原则的自由派思想者，正是我们政府需要的人。他一直为全体美国人不懈努力。

73d9872c2364739dbbb67b0d4d25554eb86fcb05.source: John McCain is certainly not all too happy about you winning, however, especially with his former running mate...
73d9872c2364739dbbb67b0d4d25554eb86fcb05.zh: 约翰·麦凯恩 当然对你获胜不太高兴，尤其是和他的前竞选搭档……

ba41a8cf5c2cc4b841078abda064f3340f23572b.source: John Palmer is a splinter candidate put forward by Democrats who favor the gold standard. He has little chance of winning the general election, but a very good chance of pulling enough votes from Bryan to cause his defeat in certain states. This is the goal of conservative Democrats who simply wish to hold out until 1900 and nominate a better candidate than the radical Bryan.
ba41a8cf5c2cc4b841078abda064f3340f23572b.zh: 约翰·帕尔默 是由支持 金本位制 的民主党人提出的分裂候选人。他赢得大选的机会很小，但很有可能从布赖恩中拉取足够的选票，导致他在某些州失败。这是保守派民主党人的目标，他们只是希望坚持到 1900 年并提名一位比激进派更好的候选人 布赖恩。

96984268a704d66492da4662c3d4d3a8f45577c6.source: John Palmer, a Gold Democrat, is also running against Bryan. He has offered to remove his name from the ballot on the East and West Coast if you will do the same in the South. He argues that this will consolidate the anti-Bryan vote. What do you think?
96984268a704d66492da4662c3d4d3a8f45577c6.zh: 支持金本位的民主党人约翰·帕尔默也在与布赖恩竞争。他提议：如果你把自己的名字从南方各州的选票上撤下，他就退出东西海岸的竞选。他认为，这能整合反布赖恩的选票。你怎么看？

51d202fb16a2898208f1e704155b8d34f583c376.source: John Rockefeller is concerned about the possible effects of the Sherman Antitrust Act, passed in 1890. It seems that certain rabble-rousers believe this law should be used to break up Standard Oil. Can you reassure him that you will take a narrow interpretation of this law in your Administration?
51d202fb16a2898208f1e704155b8d34f583c376.zh: 约翰·洛克菲勒担心，1890年通过的《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》会产生什么影响。似乎有些煽动者认为，应当用这部法律拆分标准石油公司。你能向他保证，执政时会狭义解释这部法律吗？

87de1f88b685deb96aa8eff947e915c098cec9b7.source: John Danforth served four terms as Senator from Missouri. He has broad experience in government, and as a moderate Republican would reinforce Bush's claim to be a uniter. Danforth also has close relationships with conservative stalwarts such as Kit Bond, Clarence Thomas, and John Ashcroft, and would not arouse undue suspicion from the conservative wing of the party. Winning Missouri back would be a key piece of any Republican victory in 2000.
87de1f88b685deb96aa8eff947e915c098cec9b7.zh: 约翰·丹福思 从 密苏里州 担任参议员四届。他在政府方面拥有丰富的经验，作为一名温和的共和党人，他会强化布什作为团结者的主张。 丹福思还与基特·邦德、克拉伦斯·托马斯和约翰·阿什克罗夫特等保守派中坚分子关系密切，不会引起党内保守派的过度怀疑。赢回 密苏里州 将是 2000 年共和党胜利的关键部分。

b52ee0f0f0bcdab7722b64a0bb13cef9fd752419.source: John F. Kennedy has served as a Senator since 1953. He comes from a wealthy political family, and possesses a youthful, telegenic appearance. He has been a moderate Senator in the past, and faces the challenge of winning over liberals who preferred other candidates. Furthermore, almost any stance that Kennedy takes on civil rights will alienate a key bloc of his party. One strategy to finesse these points and focus on the Cold War. Kennedy would be the first Catholic President.
b52ee0f0f0bcdab7722b64a0bb13cef9fd752419.zh: 约翰·F.·肯尼迪自1953年起担任参议员。他来自富裕的政治家庭，拥有年轻、上镜的外表。他过去一直是一位温和派参议员，面临着赢得支持其他候选人的自由派人士的挑战。此外，肯尼迪 对 民权 采取的几乎任何立场都会疏远其政党的一个关键集团。巧妙处理这些问题并聚焦于冷战的策略之一。 肯尼迪 将成为第一位天主教总统。

36f9a1988d52095a93d459f14e53246508d8ce4e.source: John Glenn became the first American to orbit the earth during the Space Race of the 1960s. Now serving as a Senator from Ohio, he could be crucial to winning that state in November. Unfortunately, his keynote speech at the national convention has just landed with a thud. He is relatively new to the Senate and still has some outsider appeal, and does not have a long history with any particular wing of the party.
36f9a1988d52095a93d459f14e53246508d8ce4e.zh: 约翰·格伦 在 20 世纪 60 年代的太空竞赛中成为第一个绕地球运行的美国人。现在担任 俄亥俄州 的参议员，他可能对于 11 月赢得该州至关重要。不幸的是，他在全国代表大会上的主题演讲刚刚轰动一时。他对参议院来说相对较新，仍然具有一些局外人的吸引力，并且与党内任何特定派别没有悠久的历史。

fd861b53217dc431aab9477ce2abcba4527a0521.source: John Glenn has served his home state of Ohio well for many years, and we are proud to have him on our national ticket.
fd861b53217dc431aab9477ce2abcba4527a0521.zh: 约翰·格伦多年来出色地服务于家乡俄亥俄州。他能与我们搭档参加全国大选，我们深感自豪。

caf07e4223bd82c175b470bd6e38e19b8d34e946.source: John Glenn has served his home state of Ohio well, and he is the best man for the job.
caf07e4223bd82c175b470bd6e38e19b8d34e946.zh: 约翰·格伦为家乡俄亥俄州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

03ebfb924a30ab9577a8d04fb98adf428ba9a76f.source: John Glenn is a Senator from Ohio, whose name has been in the mix for President or Vice President for several years. He originally gained fame as an astronaut in the 1960s, and has fostered a reputation as a moderate Democrat, with a particular interest in science and education. Needless to say, he comes from a crucial state in any national election.
03ebfb924a30ab9577a8d04fb98adf428ba9a76f.zh: 约翰·格伦 是来自 俄亥俄州 的参议员，其名字多年来一直在竞选总统或副总统。他最初在 20 世纪 60 年代作为一名宇航员而出名，并树立了温和民主党的声誉，对科学和教育特别感兴趣。不用说，他来自任何全国选举中都至关重要的州。

9534c82602e03cd044c9ed26e0744ca1d7640764.source: John Glenn is a broadly popular choice.
9534c82602e03cd044c9ed26e0744ca1d7640764.zh: 约翰·格伦是一个广受欢迎的选择。

4099eb4934c3c05f3aaa04246961f9414cbec112.source: John Glenn is an American hero, and he has the right ideas about government. I'm proud to have him with me.
4099eb4934c3c05f3aaa04246961f9414cbec112.zh: 约翰·格伦是美国英雄，对政府也有正确的主张。能与他携手，我很自豪。

71edf33d61be53523aa5ebcc6a53b0a421f2a65d.source: Julian Castro is a bright, young, energetic man who will be perfectly ready to assume the Presidency from day one. He represents the best and brightest of the Hispanic community.
71edf33d61be53523aa5ebcc6a53b0a421f2a65d.zh: 朱利安·卡斯特罗聪明、年轻、精力充沛，从第一天起就完全准备好接任总统。他代表着拉美裔社群中最优秀、最聪慧的人才。

27c8c8e1e72b01432b10f5f88bf2e43580b8b9ee.source: Julian Castro is the current Secretary of Housing and Urban Development, under the Obama Administration. He is one of the Democratic Party's highest profile Hispanic politicians, and is a fresh face on the national scene. On the other hand, he is somewhat light on experience, and many argue that Trump's presence will ensure Democratic dominance of the Hispanic vote, regardless of Castro's selection.
27c8c8e1e72b01432b10f5f88bf2e43580b8b9ee.zh: 朱利安·卡斯特罗 现任住房和城市发展部部长，隶属于 奥巴马 管理局。他是 民主党 最引人注目的西班牙裔政治家之一，也是国家舞台上的新面孔。另一方面，他的经验有些不足，许多人认为，无论 卡斯特罗 的选择如何，特朗普 的存在将确保民主党在西班牙裔选票中的主导地位。

d6965cdb24dab8d20d2cccb4fdd4e5ab73799b14.zh: 朱利安·E·泽利泽 - 吉米·卡特

9fa148ee1f3f72a7867e5e1bb2cac6f6db0b6f17.source: July 8, 1916: Alice Paul Pushes Presidential Nominee to Support Suffrage
9fa148ee1f3f72a7867e5e1bb2cac6f6db0b6f17.zh: 1916 年 7 月 8 日：爱丽丝 保罗 推动总统候选人支持选举权

0b6e7e06d25e9695aea936287d0c4ea66f220d57.source: Just drill baby. We need more development of our fossil fuels to reduce foreign dependence.
0b6e7e06d25e9695aea936287d0c4ea66f220d57.zh: 钻就对了，宝贝。我们需要更多开发化石燃料，减少对外国的依赖。

da8b5961b08c9642f36889ba599a110b49100558.source: Just hit him on this as much as you can. It's a weak spot for him.
da8b5961b08c9642f36889ba599a110b49100558.zh: 尽管抓住这点攻击他。这是他的弱点。

d9917a3d42a82a75fe1d1cf481b2408f638968a7.source: Just in the past 12 months, Congress has passed the Marshall Plan and Taft-Hartley with bipartisan support. They have passed an expansive farm bill, and will be considering housing legislation soon. I don't see why I couldn't work with this Congress.
d9917a3d42a82a75fe1d1cf481b2408f638968a7.zh: 仅仅过去十二个月，国会就以两党支持通过了马歇尔计划和《塔夫脱—哈特利法》。他们通过了一项内容广泛的农业法案，而且即将审议住房立法。我看不出自己有什么理由不能与这个国会合作。

0c02b1e6b09876a01042540cff231fb7ff781499.source: Just lately, it seems like this committee has uncovered shocking revelations about Communists in government. Americans definitely want to see more of this.
0c02b1e6b09876a01042540cff231fb7ff781499.zh: 就在最近，这个委员会似乎揭露了关于政府内共产党人的惊人情况。美国人确实希望看到更多这样的揭露。

b42fc8a6c53d74cd8a6c77d256a9ac276fcc19b5.source: Just look at all the good work he did in New Jersey. This is a guy who knows how to lead, and who knows how to help us Make America Great Again.
b42fc8a6c53d74cd8a6c77d256a9ac276fcc19b5.zh: 看看他在新泽西州干了多少好事。这个人懂得如何领导，也懂得如何帮助我们让美国再次伟大。

fce39d50f6a7eb29199d7bddd631e00b7e964503.source: Kamala Harris has the experience to be an effective President from day one. Her judgment and intelligence as California's Attorney General and U.S. Senator have been on display for everyone to see.
fce39d50f6a7eb29199d7bddd631e00b7e964503.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯有经验，能从第一天起有效担任总统。她担任加利福尼亚州司法部长和美国参议员时展现的判断力与才智，大家都有目共睹。

1cae155b934fe6f07d4e98969246d67dd61d9f67.source: Kamala Harris is a Senator from California who made her own run for President in 2020. She would be acceptable to moderates and financial supporters, has some appeal to progressives, and brings diversity to the ticket. She's not the preferred choice of most progressives.
1cae155b934fe6f07d4e98969246d67dd61d9f67.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯 是来自 加利福尼亚州 的参议员，她自己竞选 2020 年总统。她会受到温和派和财政支持者的接受，对进步派有一定的吸引力，并为选票带来多样性。她并不是大多数进步人士的首选。

310a7cd7f2e99e9b3b68f26e898f1230ed669302.source: John Sergeant ran with Henry Clay in 1832, and has served in Congress on three occasions. He worked for the Second Bank of the United States, and strongly favors a revival of the national banking system. He is also known as an opponent of slavery, even voting against the Missouri Compromise in 1820. Obviously, this background could help Clay in certain regions, and hurt him in others. Sergeant has also been out of political office for over three years.
310a7cd7f2e99e9b3b68f26e898f1230ed669302.zh: 约翰·萨金特 于 1832 年与 亨利·克莱 一起竞选，并曾 3 次在国会任职。他曾在美国第二银行工作，强烈支持复兴国家银行体系。他也被认为是奴隶制的反对者，甚至在1820年投票反对密苏里妥协。显然，这种背景可能会在某些地区帮助克莱，但在其他地区伤害他。 萨金特 也已不再担任政治职务三年多了。

3d9ac18bf562b6ce9d69bca6b6ffbdfcb77ad3e4.source: John Tyler is pleased with your position on the Texas issue, and is prepared to withdraw his candidacy. Can you give him assurances that certain appointees of his will be safe in their positions, should you be elected?
3d9ac18bf562b6ce9d69bca6b6ffbdfcb77ad3e4.zh: 约翰·泰勒很满意你在得克萨斯问题上的立场，准备退出竞选。如果你当选，能否向他保证，让他指定的某些官员继续留任？

c264a2a7b986a563138c183d496fb261dc273229.source: John Tyler lacks any broad base of support. It's more important to reserve these appointments for loyal Democrats.
c264a2a7b986a563138c183d496fb261dc273229.zh: 约翰·泰勒没有广泛的支持基础。更重要的是，把这些任命留给忠诚的民主党人。

af4bd9b4875fb2c0e905d05dce54c80d46722b01.source: Johnson enters 1964 with every advantage he could ever want- incumbency, popularity, momentum, and a divided opposition. Almost everyone predicts a landslide for Johnson- all he needs to do is to minimize his mistakes and capitalize on Goldwater’s extremism, and victory should come easily enough.
af4bd9b4875fb2c0e905d05dce54c80d46722b01.zh: 约翰逊 进入 1964 年，拥有他想要的一切优势——在位、受欢迎程度、势头和分裂的反对派。几乎每个人都预测约翰逊会取得压倒性胜利——他所需要做的就是尽量减少自己的错误并利用戈德华特的极端主义，胜利应该会很容易到来。

a179142d851fc2c6c06bb3909a66ab96a5529766.source: Johnson is a deeply unpopular President. I don't think his threats are credible here. I will loudly call for peace in Vietnam.
a179142d851fc2c6c06bb3909a66ab96a5529766.zh: 约翰逊是一位极不受欢迎的总统。我不认为他的威胁在这里有多大分量。我会大声呼吁越南和平。

06d6b0eb735333b7d5e8e5fb7d3f0960712cb949.source: Johnson is unpopular, but he’s the most powerful mover and shaker within the party. Criticizing his governance just earned you his wrath.
06d6b0eb735333b7d5e8e5fb7d3f0960712cb949.zh: 约翰逊虽然不受欢迎，却仍是党内最有权势的人物。批评他的治理，让你招来了他的怒火。

178314657bcfeaed79d101788b29c991c4150bd2.source: Johnson’s weak point is the Bobby Baker case. Let’s talk about Baker and Billy Sol Estes.
178314657bcfeaed79d101788b29c991c4150bd2.zh: 约翰逊的弱点是博比·贝克案。我们来谈贝克和比利·索尔·埃斯蒂斯。

3b129ea2ecc588f3dd37ed1c8e68a90d079d2e44.source: Joseph Lane is the first Governor of Oregon and a supporter of slavery, in spite of that state's free-soil status. His original home state is North Carolina. He agrees with Breckinridge on all major issues, and gives him a chance to pick up a few electoral votes in a place very distant from the Deep South.
3b129ea2ecc588f3dd37ed1c8e68a90d079d2e44.zh: 约瑟夫·莱恩 是 俄勒冈州 的第一任州长，也是奴隶制的支持者，尽管该州具有 自由土地 的地位。他原来的家乡是北卡罗来纳州。他在所有重大问题上都同意布雷肯里奇，并让他有机会在距离深南部很远的地方获得一些选举人票。

05b27c8594dd21a40fc2feb9cd37ffddf1285067.source: Joseph Schumpeter coined the term of "creative destruction". Society will never evolve if some people aren't relocated into more productive pursuits from time to time.
05b27c8594dd21a40fc2feb9cd37ffddf1285067.zh: 约瑟夫·熊彼特提出了“创造性破坏”这个术语。如果不时让一些人转向生产力更高的工作，社会就永远不会进步。

0de28cb7e14b14798c36733f92a8822d7279f52d.source: Jules Witcover - Marathon: The Pursuit of the Presidency, 1972-1976
0de28cb7e14b14798c36733f92a8822d7279f52d.zh: 朱尔斯·威特科弗 - 马拉松：总统职位的追求，1972-1976

6f2736f80b79fb7f95d67bfe1f4835aa41b63626.source: Known simply by 'Omarosa,' Omarosa was a contestant on the first season of your hit, ratings-getting, award-winning reality TV show The Apprentice, and has been a friend of your's since.
6f2736f80b79fb7f95d67bfe1f4835aa41b63626.zh: 大家通常只称她为“奥马罗萨”。她曾参加你那档热门、高收视率、获奖的真人秀《学徒》的第一季，自那以后就一直是你的朋友。

79d32d84789f087ca26086fdd6416a4201be0082.source: Kung flu is nothing but a criminal attempt by China, an act of war almost, if you think about it, to plunge the globe into chaos and undermine our election in favor of Joe Biden. Let's not forget which one of us is a stooge to China.
79d32d84789f087ca26086fdd6416a4201be0082.zh: “功夫流感”无非是中国的一次犯罪企图。想一想，几乎就是战争行为，企图让全球陷入混乱，破坏我们的选举，让乔·拜登获胜。别忘了，我们俩谁才是中国的傀儡。

4e1ac9ff68aacc90e5b9c438eb026215414058f6.zh: 洛杉矶时报，1988 年 11 月 10 日 -

0a2962dfe0e3f0f5948275f84f2192798194ebf7.source: Labor agitators and agrarian radicals are threatening to overthrow our system of government. They have put forward a preposterous array of Constitutional Amendments and confiscatory welfare programs.
0a2962dfe0e3f0f5948275f84f2192798194ebf7.zh: 劳工煽动者与激进的农民派正威胁着要推翻我们的政府制度。他们提出了一堆荒唐的宪法修正案和掠夺财产的福利计划。

b43255a847a0cb3530c91507a7fa4a017c5b476d.zh: 劳工阵营和工会并不赞同。

305cb1a8c0ff9f9f97df3e21f6148d2ccb338b62.source: Labor is ecstatic, and unions start winning back Wallace supporters. Union states are especially delighted by your response.
305cb1a8c0ff9f9f97df3e21f6148d2ccb338b62.zh: 劳工阵营欣喜若狂，工会开始争取回华莱士的支持者。工会势力强的州尤其欢迎你的回应。

648456c8e83be55946c16cdc41b8724d1c929eab.source: Labor leaders are skeptical, but at the same time Mr. Bryan is known to be primarily a farmers' candidate.
648456c8e83be55946c16cdc41b8724d1c929eab.zh: 工会领袖仍有疑虑，但布赖恩先生也众所周知，主要代表农民。

6def02f4ab528cc467f77cbe8e60499167113a7a.source: Labor unions have been needlessly undermined by the Taft-Hartley Act, and by self-serving investigations from both parties. I will do anything I can as President to support our nation's laborers.
6def02f4ab528cc467f77cbe8e60499167113a7a.zh: 《塔夫脱—哈特利法》和两党谋取私利的调查，不必要地削弱了工会。作为总统，我会尽一切努力支持本国劳工。

7528b1591dcf9a016d5d85b998cdbcae1dc2b915.source: Lady Bird Johnson, LBJ's wife, has been spat on by a gathering of far-right protestors in a Dallas hotel lobby. What are your thoughts?
7528b1591dcf9a016d5d85b998cdbcae1dc2b915.zh: 林登·约翰逊的妻子伯德夫人，在达拉斯一家酒店大堂遭到一群极右翼抗议者吐口水。你对此怎么看？

00e9248f0a1b27eee261781050d44700fde9f975.source: Larry Sabato - Overtime! The Election 2000 Thriller
00e9248f0a1b27eee261781050d44700fde9f975.zh: 拉里·萨巴托 - 加时赛！ 2000 年选举惊悚片

4f480ea6153917dcc0f3b323f0f36606b2f94810.source: Law and order is the primary theme of my campaign. We also need to encourage investment in the ghettoes to ensure a high quality of life and prevent these occurrences.
4f480ea6153917dcc0f3b323f0f36606b2f94810.zh: 法律与秩序是我竞选的首要主题。我们也需要鼓励对贫困黑人聚居区的投资，改善生活质量，防止类似事件发生。

9fcccd96f5d71a6ba9ed519ef547afce17b9a8b0.zh:
劳伦斯·莱西格 -
然而，

62609952bda2472ff0e1cffbe5a251252c22f957.source: LeMay is prone to make off the cuff remarks about the use of nuclear weapons, however, which could lead to concerns about Wallace's foreign policy vision.
62609952bda2472ff0e1cffbe5a251252c22f957.zh: 李梅 很容易就使用核武器发表即兴言论，这可能会导致人们对 华莱士 外交政策愿景的担忧。

5bbe8d32d591bd0c1436446ccfe8f6e3fee82e91.source: Kamala Harris is the first Indian, the first African-American woman who would be Vice President. She has succeeded in every role she has been elected to, and I'm proud to stand next to her in this campaign.
5bbe8d32d591bd0c1436446ccfe8f6e3fee82e91.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯将成为第一位印度裔副总统，也是第一位非裔美国女性副总统。她在每一个通过选举获得的职位上都取得了成功，我很自豪能在这场竞选中与她并肩。

ef5296776183e27d5e532a4050ca46905289c151.source: Karen Bass is a Congresswoman from California and Chair of the Congressional Black Caucus. She has taken more progressive policy stances (including support for Medicare For All) than some of the other candidates, with the attendant supporters and detractors.
ef5296776183e27d5e532a4050ca46905289c151.zh: 卡伦·巴斯 是来自 加利福尼亚州 的国会女议员兼国会黑人核心小组主席。与一些 其他候选人 相比，她采取了更为进步的政策立场（包括对 联邦医疗保险 For All 的支持），同时也有支持者和反对者。

08d2fb1aaf6f33afc434ed50c181187bb92233a9.source: Keep pointing out the practical problems associated with silver coinage so that Americans can make an informed decision this November.
08d2fb1aaf6f33afc434ed50c181187bb92233a9.zh: 继续指出白银铸币在实际运作中的问题，让美国人在今年十一月作出明智的选择。

6db064795f2a09801d4ae307cbaaa91eba2b166c.source: Keep pressing your outsider credentials and promising reform.
6db064795f2a09801d4ae307cbaaa91eba2b166c.zh: 继续强调你是体制外人士，并承诺改革。

db7ec625c89b4e1293c41dfe07498d762afa1222.source: Keep pressing your outsider credentials and tying Hillary to Goldman Sachs, Saudi Arabia, and so on.
db7ec625c89b4e1293c41dfe07498d762afa1222.zh: 继续强调你是体制外人士，并把希拉里与高盛、沙特阿拉伯等联系起来。

f46d8f134e07f87738c34ea10d6c4904eced891b.source: Keep the debate right where you want it. This answer will cause you few problems from either the left or the right.
f46d8f134e07f87738c34ea10d6c4904eced891b.zh: 把辩论维持在你想要的方向。这个回答几乎不会让你遭到左派或右派的麻烦。

c786099e5b1f71d39e33bab25a1df67a54d17d95.source: Keep throwing the red meat to your supporters.
c786099e5b1f71d39e33bab25a1df67a54d17d95.zh: 继续给支持者送上他们爱听的强硬话吧。

78dcb2baa0a02ec5ced1ee7236b82e07969b652a.source: Ken Salazar is the former senator from Colorado, and once was Obama's Secretary of the Interior. He remains widely popular in his home state and in the Southwest generally, and is willing to campaign on your behalf in the region.
78dcb2baa0a02ec5ced1ee7236b82e07969b652a.zh: 肯·萨拉查曾任科罗拉多州联邦参议员，也曾出任奥巴马政府的内政部长。他在家乡和整个西南部仍广受欢迎，愿意在这些地区为你助选。

35b90fdf170a9e68bde525815c1e8be6c7baa268.source: Kennedy has managed to come across as your equal in these debates, and that alone is a good start for him...
35b90fdf170a9e68bde525815c1e8be6c7baa268.zh: 在这些辩论中，肯尼迪成功表现出与你旗鼓相当，单是这一点，对他来说就是个不错的开端……

e93cefc7b1e0ab75bb2748a8f9dee7020b8359e9.source: Kennedy is questioning your hesitation on this issue. Fortunately, however, the average voter has never heard of Quemoy and Matsu.
e93cefc7b1e0ab75bb2748a8f9dee7020b8359e9.zh: 肯尼迪正质疑你在这个问题上的犹豫。幸好，普通选民从来没听说过金门和马祖。

f9e3569a54cba569e95c35002e2d703f89dff50b.source: Kennedy was the clear winner in the first debate, and it looks like he's received a bump in the polls.
f9e3569a54cba569e95c35002e2d703f89dff50b.zh: 肯尼迪明显赢得了第一场辩论，看起来他的民调支持也有所上升。

c8df7d1d37fbb1906c0a352d7721c0957ad0b322.source: Kennedy will not accept the nomination, however, unless Humphrey repudiates the hawkish policies of President Johnson. This could cause problems with moderates and more importantly with the Democratic establishment.
c8df7d1d37fbb1906c0a352d7721c0957ad0b322.zh: 肯尼迪 将不会接受提名，除非 汉弗莱 否认总统 约翰逊 的鹰派政策。这可能会给温和派带来问题，更重要的是会给民主党建制派带来问题。

f9bceb080135677f3bb8fc5fa16f0a6a98b6ee0b.source: Left-wing media is certainly not happy about yet another revelation of Hillary's ideological flexibility.
f9bceb080135677f3bb8fc5fa16f0a6a98b6ee0b.zh: 希拉里在意识形态上的灵活性又一次被曝光，左翼媒体当然不高兴。

4f8c0a5abb1a7ffe812f4e47daaf39dd9c58f67e.source: Let Goldwater spout his nonsense. We don’t need to tie ourselves to Humphrey any further than we already have- we still need moderates to win, after all.
4f8c0a5abb1a7ffe812f4e47daaf39dd9c58f67e.zh: 就让戈德华特胡说八道吧。我们没必要比现在更紧地绑在汉弗莱身上，毕竟还得靠温和派才能赢。

542d45bfb258e4ad30370f0a92d326251acde944.source: Let it be known that I side with the states on the civil rights issue. I will not change this.
542d45bfb258e4ad30370f0a92d326251acde944.zh: 我要让大家知道，在民权问题上，我站在各州这一边。这个立场不会改变。

a218c1c8bee58c4dafd3d56b600066a86830cfa7.source: Let there be no question that I support the preservation of the Union above all else.
a218c1c8bee58c4dafd3d56b600066a86830cfa7.zh: 毫无疑问，我把维护联邦置于一切之上。

9cdf4c1a30f6368d856bde397a67037886a4d8c9.source: Let us bring our message to the citizens of the Pacific Coast. Winning these three states could swing the entire election.
9cdf4c1a30f6368d856bde397a67037886a4d8c9.zh: 把我们的主张带到太平洋沿岸的民众那里去。拿下这三个州，可能改变整场选举的结果。

e7be748f421ae52b7f59679a45662b7d105ccd7c.source: Let us talk about fiscal conservatism and our plans to reduce inflation.
e7be748f421ae52b7f59679a45662b7d105ccd7c.zh: 我们来谈财政保守主义，以及我们降低通胀的计划。

d41660032aec346873449bb3a0cca5b019b723f6.source: Let's address our speech to the workers and voters of the mid-Atlantic, who have been abandoned by the Democrats' nominee for this election.
d41660032aec346873449bb3a0cca5b019b723f6.zh: 让我们把这场演说讲给中大西洋地区的工人和选民听。他们已被本次大选的民主党候选人抛弃。

391de547b9f55ede61e91c8870a43a925d7a1bbf.source: Let's all come together -- women, Hispanics, Muslims, moderates, college students, military veterans, African-Americans -- to defeat Donald Trump!
391de547b9f55ede61e91c8870a43a925d7a1bbf.zh: 让我们所有人携起手来——女性、拉美裔、穆斯林、温和派、大学生、退伍军人和非裔美国人——击败唐纳德·特朗普！

32da6d3978731faecb3e360d2ddfd7cf681066e4.source: Let's attack George Bush as a creature of his political handlers, who lacks any deep-seated convictions or a record of governing competence.
32da6d3978731faecb3e360d2ddfd7cf681066e4.zh: 我们来攻击乔治·布什，说他受竞选操盘手摆布，既没有坚定信念，也没有胜任政府工作的政绩。

1566afbc7e3908410a5cd8cc3f3bfc7aa414465b.source: Let's attack the Reagan deficit, Bush's performance as Vice President, and mix in some spots to defend against Bush's dishonest allegations on various issues.
1566afbc7e3908410a5cd8cc3f3bfc7aa414465b.zh: 我们来攻击里根造成的赤字、布什担任副总统的表现，再穿插一些广告，反驳布什在各个问题上不诚实的指控。

c1b565d8f09ec8c4d536e80753e3c109719386ec.source: Let's avoid making any strong statements on this issue, and keep our focus to the debate on slavery and other things.
c1b565d8f09ec8c4d536e80753e3c109719386ec.zh: 让我们避免在这个问题上发表强硬声明，继续把重点放在奴隶制等议题的争论上。

89e6a58f0735930b975820721646d72e905a9b71.source: Let's be cautious with this idea. Nixon is a skilled debater, and the last thing we need right now is a campaign setback on national television.
89e6a58f0735930b975820721646d72e905a9b71.zh: 对这个主意，我们还是谨慎些吧。尼克松很擅长辩论，眼下我们最不需要的，就是在全国电视观众面前遭遇竞选挫折。

6c9040fb940fcf4db350dd84cb547d89e2ebcef8.source: Let's be honest with ourselves. Kennedy is great on television and he did very well debating Hubert Humphrey in the primaries. We should probably avoid this.
6c9040fb940fcf4db350dd84cb547d89e2ebcef8.zh: 我们还是面对现实吧。肯尼迪很适合电视，而且在初选中与休伯特·汉弗莱辩论时表现出色。我们大概应该避免这样做。

9ee1c658d4a4cc9f34401d44b4d165120bca0a57.source: Let's continue to emphasize our platform and my own experience in government, which dates to the War of 1812.
9ee1c658d4a4cc9f34401d44b4d165120bca0a57.zh: 让我们继续强调自己的纲领，以及我自1812年战争时期就开始积累的从政经验。

91d0c6fc0501d9994583ce4bb8560a11fc26b89b.source: Let's continue to focus on the Midwest. Ohio, Illinois, Indiana, Michigan, etc.
91d0c6fc0501d9994583ce4bb8560a11fc26b89b.zh: 继续把重点放在中西部：俄亥俄、伊利诺伊、印第安纳、密歇根等州。

e0739c0e181bdcb4debb968f78f77465fdebe7f1.source: Let's discuss immigrants as little as possible in our campaign and platform. It's a no-win situation for us.
e0739c0e181bdcb4debb968f78f77465fdebe7f1.zh: 我们应当在竞选和纲领中尽可能少谈移民。这对我们是个两头不讨好的问题。

96e9d2aa5239474e4be69d3baf71c5f0a77481e0.source: Let's discuss world affairs. I support the annexation of Hawaii and I support the independence of Cuba. I support a stronger Navy.
96e9d2aa5239474e4be69d3baf71c5f0a77481e0.zh: 谈谈国际事务吧。我支持吞并夏威夷，支持古巴独立，也支持建立更强大的海军。

b7a3b475798bd7dcc301007233a45bd3d8c898da.source: Let's emphasize that both Democrats and Republicans have sold out the American worker to the interests of corporations. I will remind people of NAFTA, the WTO protests, and other decisions that have decimated American manufacturing.
b7a3b475798bd7dcc301007233a45bd3d8c898da.zh: 我们来强调，民主党和共和党都为了企业利益出卖了美国劳动者。我会提醒人们，《北美自由贸易协定》、反对世界贸易组织的抗议，以及其他重创美国制造业的决定。

9b731587211c26b6c720febe0772d545958754b8.source: Let's focus on Iowa and the Dakotas. My presence can swing those states.
9b731587211c26b6c720febe0772d545958754b8.zh: 把重点放在艾奥瓦和南北达科他。我亲自到场，可以扭转这些州的选情。

1bd299dcff2b0fde40fe4e5a60c5b4afdebea6e8.zh: 让我们集中精力争取新英格兰。

f7e3a683ac26ddcdc09f8189d3637e79ed298b2e.source: Let's focus on my record as a Greek immigrant who has risen to the highest positions in American life, along with my competence and liberal values.
f7e3a683ac26ddcdc09f8189d3637e79ed298b2e.zh: 我们来着重宣传我作为希腊移民、跻身美国社会最高层的经历，以及我的能力和自由派价值观。

fc70d5497fa9eb0413941ca2ea725254e3f98501.source: Let's focus on the Great Society- Medicare, Social Security expansions, and the Civil Rights Act. These are all things I have championed in my first two years, and I will champion them further in my next four.
fc70d5497fa9eb0413941ca2ea725254e3f98501.zh: 我们重点谈伟大社会：老年医疗保险、扩大社会保障，以及《民权法案》。这些都是我执政头两年一直倡导的政策，接下来的四年我还会进一步推动。

daaa11ec0490bf044aff3326bf2503ab4cc6d582.zh: 让我们集中精力争取中西部。

fb1dc0f556ba87d8b2e20ac6d5f00902c5073ba7.source: Let's gather some of these leaflets and show them to the media and to major newspapers. I think they demonstrate the lengths that some people will go to discredit my candidacy.
fb1dc0f556ba87d8b2e20ac6d5f00902c5073ba7.zh: 让我们收集一些这种传单，交给媒体和各大报纸。我认为，它们说明了一些人为了抹黑我的参选，能做到什么程度。

baa040acc14ad8090c7926bfda0124a79d353f6c.source: Let's give a good speech about how I am the mainstream, conservative candidate who will control spending and return our surplus to the American people.
baa040acc14ad8090c7926bfda0124a79d353f6c.zh: 我们来好好讲一讲，我是主流的保守派候选人，会控制开支，把预算盈余还给美国人民。

40cbc85a616263c100bb93bbf1170759588e05e1.source: Let's give a good speech about how I am the mainstream, liberal candidate who will help hard-working Americans and use our surplus to shore up important government programs.
40cbc85a616263c100bb93bbf1170759588e05e1.zh: 我们来好好讲一讲，我是主流的自由派候选人，会帮助辛勤劳动的美国人，用预算盈余巩固重要的政府项目。

6fcff295958ad77b0afe9895b0b81e6e58a4e671.source: Let's give a good speech about the need for big changes to American politics and society. I will remind voters that the Democrats and Republicans are two sides of the same corporate policies, and attack Al Gore's pretensions to stand for the American worker.
6fcff295958ad77b0afe9895b0b81e6e58a4e671.zh: 我们来好好讲一讲，美国政治和社会为什么需要大变革。我会提醒选民，民主党和共和党不过是同一套亲企业政策的两面，并攻击阿尔·戈尔冒充美国劳动者代言人的姿态。

353bca671b5b9fe7999d3b6943da27d53aeb1d43.source: Let's give the keynote address to Elizabeth Warren. Mr. Sanders will speak as well, but I think emphasizing Ms. Warren will be a good middle-ground.
353bca671b5b9fe7999d3b6943da27d53aeb1d43.zh: 让伊丽莎白·沃伦作主旨演讲吧。桑德斯先生也会发言，但我认为，着重突出沃伦女士，是个不错的折中办法。

d8153bfed7e671e2fb6810743b1b66351e0184ee.source: Let's give them a real show- promise expansions to Civil Rights, more Social Security and welfare expansions, and a continued commitment to liberal ideals.
d8153bfed7e671e2fb6810743b1b66351e0184ee.zh: 我们给他们来场真正精彩的演说：承诺进一步推动民权、扩大社会保障和福利，并继续坚持自由主义理想。

b5609e4b5f802a916a934bc118f31ec64ce96815.source: Let's go back through Illinois and criss-cross that state.
b5609e4b5f802a916a934bc118f31ec64ce96815.zh: 让我们再去一趟伊利诺伊州，跑遍全州。

e7891c4bb2b2d0b47d4c1ca70ada0ccc83fe60ad.source: Let's go to Ohio and Michigan.
e7891c4bb2b2d0b47d4c1ca70ada0ccc83fe60ad.zh: 让我们去俄亥俄州和密歇根州。

0f781c03fe1c4ca575b9b53a84769928cc105df2.source: Let's have him leave the day that the article comes out. That way the connection is clear.
0f781c03fe1c4ca575b9b53a84769928cc105df2.zh: 让他在文章发表当天离职吧。这样，两件事的关系就很清楚了。

d00a4dc3bcc0b6d476d4fa76a2c0755d15b9f609.source: Let's hit on the issue of tariffs. These voters need to be reminded that tariffs increase the cost of farm equipment and other manufactured goods.
d00a4dc3bcc0b6d476d4fa76a2c0755d15b9f609.zh: 着重谈关税问题吧。必须提醒这些选民，关税会增加农具和其他制成品的价格。

61a4309b9230f06496d40f1c9dd69a6b6139e488.source: Let's hope it doesn't come to that. She is a brilliant, talented woman and no matter what happens, there will always be a place for her in government.
61a4309b9230f06496d40f1c9dd69a6b6139e488.zh: 希望不至于走到那一步。她是一位聪明、有才华的女性；不论结果如何，政府里总会有她的位置。

2fed5f63a262eefefe49dbc7bcf32c09600cca1b.source: Let's just wait and see how this all plays out before we go throwing wild accusations at each other. I have every confidence that this will be a fair election.
2fed5f63a262eefefe49dbc7bcf32c09600cca1b.zh: 别急着互相抛出狂妄的指控，先看看事情如何发展。我完全相信，这会是一场公平的选举。

6b37c971ae126265a73cc55ce16221428f470bca.source: Let's keep a low profile on this issue and hope it passes. We don't need to make things worse by issuing controversial statements.
6b37c971ae126265a73cc55ce16221428f470bca.zh: 这个问题上，我们应当保持低调，盼它自行过去。没有必要发表有争议的声明，让局面更糟。

7f0ea94b93edebb6caa5b6153bb9c0c6c8bd2a85.source: Let's keep our efforts broadly focused on the North.
7f0ea94b93edebb6caa5b6153bb9c0c6c8bd2a85.zh: 让我们把精力放在整个北方。

a28795ce338f6d70c63cd5a7584704c5e0311345.source: Let's keep our mouth shut on this issue, and stick to our opposition to slavery.
a28795ce338f6d70c63cd5a7584704c5e0311345.zh: 这个问题上就别开口了，还是坚持反对奴隶制吧。

126ff0a10c93382a212216eca2e75b76f82f07ae.source: Let's keep the focus on illegal immigration, a strong military, tax cuts, and fixing Obamacare. We're going to Make America Great Again.
126ff0a10c93382a212216eca2e75b76f82f07ae.zh: 让我们继续聚焦非法移民、强大的军队、减税，以及修复奥巴马医改。我们要让美国再次伟大。

f728ea3f2c31be39d26b4052ab645022b3a0dc4e.source: Let's keep the tour as short as possible. I will take a train to San Francisco and deliver a few speeches in that city, but will not tour the entire coast.
f728ea3f2c31be39d26b4052ab645022b3a0dc4e.zh: 尽量缩短行程。我会乘火车到旧金山，在城里发表几次演说，但不会巡访整个海岸。

93b00a3b7c49e817b22ada6a0ae8bea78e79592d.source: Let's let the AFL-CIO campaign amongst the unions. I will focus on winning the anti-war voters back to our side, and I will reaffirm my commitment to Civil Rights so we can win the minority vote.
93b00a3b7c49e817b22ada6a0ae8bea78e79592d.zh: 让劳联—产联去工会中竞选吧。我会着重把反战选民争取回来，重申对民权的承诺，以赢得少数族裔选票。

6400c64f497f7e77a609f6128ad6e56159dd6676.source: Let's make a call to Mrs. King to offer our condolences, and let's demand the release of Mr. King.
6400c64f497f7e77a609f6128ad6e56159dd6676.zh: 让我们给金夫人打个电话，向她表示慰问，并要求释放金先生。

dacc5d4551a668dc4464b5d1b419f17fdfc7a55e.source: Let's make a final swing to the West Coast, and California in particular, before the voting begins.
dacc5d4551a668dc4464b5d1b419f17fdfc7a55e.zh: 投票开始前，让我们最后巡回西海岸，尤其是加利福尼亚州。

8e6295c8207ce380307f46dbfa8260030b0c673e.source: Let's make a public comment criticizing this arrest, and expressing our hopes that this situation doesn't escalate any further.
8e6295c8207ce380307f46dbfa8260030b0c673e.zh: 让我们公开批评这次逮捕，表达希望事态不要进一步升级的愿望。

a39c746fa77edd3de1ad31836e5e1e6267227375.source: Let's make one last general tour of the Midwest. Starting in Ohio, we will travel west and end in North Dakota, before moving down to Nebraska on Election Day.
a39c746fa77edd3de1ad31836e5e1e6267227375.zh: 最后再全面巡访一次中西部。从俄亥俄出发，向西行进，最后到北达科他，然后在投票日南下内布拉斯加。

b139180570015d4332de3893e4e0220de758a08f.source: Let's moderate our stance on the tariff issue a bit, given the peculiar nature of this election.  Even President Buchanan appears to be changing his views.
b139180570015d4332de3893e4e0220de758a08f.zh: 鉴于本次大选的特殊情况，我们在关税问题上的立场应当稍微温和一些。就连布坎南总统似乎也在改变看法。

bf00b48824490cdf1427e7c2cace3d67648765d3.source: Let's not appear too hasty here. We need to run as a national party and avoid alienating Northerners.
bf00b48824490cdf1427e7c2cace3d67648765d3.zh: 我们别显得过于急切。我们需要以全国性政党的身份参选，避免疏远北方人。

b1acc929a0c43bcc6ae3f6ba6f695557e67b0268.source: Let's not complicate this too much. The election pivots around Pennsylvania -- we're going to spend our final day in Pennsylvania, with an enormous rally of celebrities and party heavyweights.
b1acc929a0c43bcc6ae3f6ba6f695557e67b0268.zh: 别把这事搞得太复杂。选举的关键就在宾夕法尼亚州——最后一天我们就在宾夕法尼亚州，办一场名人和党内重量级人物云集的大型集会。

d7bd8de0d3aedcc172a54e9d01def6c4fe91c2da.source: Let's not complicate this too much. The election pivots around Pennsylvania -- we're going to spend the morning in Pittsburgh and the evening in Scranton.
d7bd8de0d3aedcc172a54e9d01def6c4fe91c2da.zh: 别把这事搞得太复杂。选举的关键就在宾夕法尼亚州——我们上午去匹兹堡，晚上去斯克兰顿。

42dff43b671c480bb331f4b2d69e283213e7fa48.source: Let's not make any divisive statements on this issue. The public is hardly clamoring for my opinion in any case.
42dff43b671c480bb331f4b2d69e283213e7fa48.zh: 我们不要在这个问题上发表容易引发分裂的言论。反正公众也没有迫切要求我表态。

1c2613563e247dd1ed925c596434c8afc1415a5b.source: Let's not make any statements on this issue. There are too many people on both sides of it who might take offense.
1c2613563e247dd1ed925c596434c8afc1415a5b.zh: 我们不要就此发表声明。双方都有太多人可能因此受到冒犯。

da7b1fe44d5e01588de04c1294a2264fd129b896.source: Let's not waste our time in a hostile state. We must sow our seed upon the good earth where it will multiply.
