da7b1fe44d5e01588de04c1294a2264fd129b896.zh: 别在敌意深重的州浪费时间。我们必须把种子撒在好土上，才会结出丰硕的果实。

1c91c198a4912c52b4d1f98fff8c8edb63f761b0.source: Let's put a couple of statements into my next campaign speech to address this issue, and reassure the public that I take no orders from the Pope.
1c91c198a4912c52b4d1f98fff8c8edb63f761b0.zh: 在下一次竞选演说中，让我们加入几句话回应这个问题，让公众放心：我不听命于教皇。

4f50f692b26e090fbe919e2f6df05be9613a6b4c.source: Let's remind the immigrant populations that Bryan is a religious fanatic who opposes the sale of alcohol.
4f50f692b26e090fbe919e2f6df05be9613a6b4c.zh: 提醒移民群体：布赖恩是个宗教狂热分子，反对出售酒类。

db701ec41aad3fa2dcd35ea7f4134647961bea62.source: Let's remind the voters that we will clean government up after four years of Democratic incompetence.
db701ec41aad3fa2dcd35ea7f4134647961bea62.zh: 提醒选民：经历了民主党四年的无能执政，我们会整顿政府。

68176b9608042d017a3c94f8b5690185644dfc0b.source: Let's reserve judgment and wait to see how this trial turns out.
68176b9608042d017a3c94f8b5690185644dfc0b.zh: 我们先别下结论，等着看审判结果吧。

aaddcdf542014c1dbdd77c2ff5c0e860b122b619.source: Let's see if you've managed to pull it off. Election night will be interesting.
aaddcdf542014c1dbdd77c2ff5c0e860b122b619.zh: 看看你是否成功了吧。选举之夜会很有看头。

05dcb147aa098aaa8ba6961cdf85eadee55877b0.source: Let's see what kind of an effect this story has on the final days of the campaign.
05dcb147aa098aaa8ba6961cdf85eadee55877b0.zh: 看看这个故事，会对竞选最后几天产生什么影响。

2bfe2518834eefede5a90b37fc5dbd0a3e3697d2.source: Let's skirt this issue and attempt to focus our campaign on other things. There's not much for us to gain here.
2bfe2518834eefede5a90b37fc5dbd0a3e3697d2.zh: 让我们避开这个问题，尽量把竞选重点放在其他事情上。我们在这里没有多少好处可得。

9d8094e248861ecf9e8afcc33c7e9253e1e81d20.source: Let's spend our last day in California and then fly home.
9d8094e248861ecf9e8afcc33c7e9253e1e81d20.zh: 让我们最后一天待在加利福尼亚州，然后坐飞机回家。

d5f6efffe6eea3408ca37d23786395b4bcc1c2e0.source: Let's spend our last day in New York and then fly home.
d5f6efffe6eea3408ca37d23786395b4bcc1c2e0.zh: 让我们最后一天待在纽约州，然后坐飞机回家。

d99cd23a2158069cf0bb50cd0884829dfdc5e7e4.source: Let's spend the entire week in Illinois. That is the largest state that we have a chance to win.
d99cd23a2158069cf0bb50cd0884829dfdc5e7e4.zh: 把整周都用在伊利诺伊吧。这是我们有机会赢下的最大州。

1ef6ea1f7ff3acda9c7a3808207c6d5131fbae02.source: Let's step back a couple years. In the run-up to the 2016 election, you have the luxury of being your party's presumptive nominee, along with a significant amount of time to prepare for the campaign. How will you take advantage of this time?
1ef6ea1f7ff3acda9c7a3808207c6d5131fbae02.zh: 让我们回到几年前。在2016年选举前，你有一个有利条件：大家普遍认为你会成为本党的提名人，而且你有充足的时间筹备竞选。你会怎样利用这段时间？

7cde67b78c14a42ab99dba7a0d8feaa0e11dd462.source: Let's take a step back. George Bush and Dick Cheney lost over 20 million emails from their time in office. I have already turned over every relevant email from my time as Secretary of State. Anything else is a right-wing hit job.
7cde67b78c14a42ab99dba7a0d8feaa0e11dd462.zh: 让我们退一步看看。乔治·布什和迪克·切尼丢失了任内的二千多万封电子邮件。我已经交出了担任国务卿期间所有相关邮件。其他说法都是右翼的恶意攻击。

1f08a0a85787f09039620198aded03cc3ca6c760.source: Let's take the fight to Bryan. I want us to be campaigning the hardest in Missouri, Nebraska, Kansas, and Iowa. Our extra cash will ensure a landslide on election night.
1f08a0a85787f09039620198aded03cc3ca6c760.zh: 把战线推到布赖恩那里去。我要我们在密苏里、内布拉斯加、堪萨斯和艾奥瓦投入最大的竞选力度。我们的额外资金将确保选举之夜大获全胜。

8d90196b7b3755991dfba794f001b3ee418f40bc.source: Let's take this opportunity to make a major speech on the topic. I will address this issue exclusively in a televised speech, and put it to rest for good.
8d90196b7b3755991dfba794f001b3ee418f40bc.zh: 让我们借此机会，专门就这个问题发表一篇重要演说。我会通过电视演说集中回应，让争议彻底平息。

a3b56ffdea99ff4dc81f5f3649d2d172761ac95d.source: Let's talk about Donald Trump's proposals. He would deport millions of undocumented immigrants, tearing holes in their communities and ravaging regional economies. And let's not get started on the Wall...
a3b56ffdea99ff4dc81f5f3649d2d172761ac95d.zh: 来谈谈唐纳德·特朗普的提议吧。他要驱逐数百万无证移民，撕裂他们的社区，严重破坏地方经济。更别提那堵墙了……

393f341ffa3d6821da8b8b1a38ba12d72013eb1c.source: Let's talk about how we are allowing large corporations to ruin the American environment for their own profits, while everyday people suffer from pollution, unclean water, and a dangerous lack of regulation on food and prescription drugs.
393f341ffa3d6821da8b8b1a38ba12d72013eb1c.zh: 我们来谈谈，如何任由大企业为了自己的利润破坏美国环境，而普通人却承受污染、不洁净的水，以及食品和处方药监管严重不足的危险。

22f560532d69aac1baae2542c822920bbcc83187.source: Let's talk about the importance of reviving American business. Our tariff act will give them the protections they need to succeed.
22f560532d69aac1baae2542c822920bbcc83187.zh: 谈谈振兴美国工商业的重要性吧。我们的关税法，将提供企业成功所需的保护。

ac8a04469080c3cf393c476b2eda9566b0c525a8.source: Let's try to avoid this issue in our campaign statements and speeches. No good can come of it.
ac8a04469080c3cf393c476b2eda9566b0c525a8.zh: 竞选声明和演说中，尽量避开这个议题吧。讨论它不会带来好处。

9f9a2d8e584b163aec11ae835505d8fa2e2c3764.source: Let's try to finesse this point. It is understandably concerning to the border states to see so many young men of the North marching in military formation, with a clear organization about them.
9f9a2d8e584b163aec11ae835505d8fa2e2c3764.zh: 我们要巧妙处理这一点。如此多的北方青年组织严密、按军事队列游行，难免让边界州担忧。

306f18e92d4912ab1d4edd6af3e693bbe745fdf8.source: Let's wait a few years and see how things go before we consider the next steps.
306f18e92d4912ab1d4edd6af3e693bbe745fdf8.zh: 先等几年，看看情况如何，再考虑下一步吧。

6990663361e2d4ec7baa7b98b0ac42544b0b0021.source: Let's wait and see and how the public reacts to this.
6990663361e2d4ec7baa7b98b0ac42544b0b0021.zh: 先等等，看看公众会怎么反应。

b4727d4eb8774bcd11e3b57129c47346390398b8.source: Let’s campaign in the Plains. We have a real shot there.
b4727d4eb8774bcd11e3b57129c47346390398b8.zh: 我们到大平原地区竞选。我们在那里确实有机会。

1806c135e860728cbc865c3149e1987f0a896df1.source: Let’s campaign in the border states- Arkansas, Tennessee, and North Carolina.
1806c135e860728cbc865c3149e1987f0a896df1.zh: 我们到边界州竞选：阿肯色州、田纳西州和北卡罗来纳州。

6acf558ccb4bdd9c3b5a05aff208067dfa056b4d.source: Let’s counter-attack Johnson on the inflation issue. This hurts the Social Security program more than anything I’ve proposed.
6acf558ccb4bdd9c3b5a05aff208067dfa056b4d.zh: 我们来反击约翰逊的通胀问题。它对社会保障制度的伤害，比我的任何提议都大。

59e6dc86b30c7b176582c27ecf8f42da860623a9.source: Let’s hope you’re more than just a flash in the pan and can run a similar campaign in 2004. The Green party may even find itself in the White House someday - and it’s all thanks to you.
59e6dc86b30c7b176582c27ecf8f42da860623a9.zh: 希望您不仅仅是昙花一现，还可以在 2004 年开展类似的活动。有一天，绿党 甚至可能会出现在 白宫 中 - 这一切都归功于您。

c6cd1856dbcad0c559f9a8dbd6866acc8e53e5a0.source: Let’s talk about Goldwater’s extremism and scandals.
c6cd1856dbcad0c559f9a8dbd6866acc8e53e5a0.zh: 我们来谈戈德华特的极端立场和丑闻。

4996f3f0b79a4aca15763faa260bd480dbc4fc31.source: Let’s talk about Southern issues and our commitment to respecting the rights of the states.
4996f3f0b79a4aca15763faa260bd480dbc4fc31.zh: 我们来谈南方议题，以及我们尊重各州权利的承诺。

0aecdec63b1f97cb213dba2f8035ff0fc634b0f9.source: Let’s talk about Vietnam, the Cold War, and what we’re doing to fight communism.
0aecdec63b1f97cb213dba2f8035ff0fc634b0f9.zh: 我们来谈越南、冷战，以及我们为对抗共产主义正在采取的行动。

64512ec91d174fe80b62dd6fe39984572448d4e6.source: Let’s talk about the Great Society, the Civil Rights Act, and my accomplishments in office.
64512ec91d174fe80b62dd6fe39984572448d4e6.zh: 我们来谈伟大社会、《民权法案》和我的执政成就。

f0c3820c18be381c7fe78296498b6ff4c750ce31.source: Liberals and activists are ecstatic with this answer, even as moderates shy away and Southern Democrats rage. Will their enthusiasm be enough?
f0c3820c18be381c7fe78296498b6ff4c750ce31.zh: 自由派和活动家为这个回答欣喜若狂，温和派却退缩了，南方民主党人更是怒不可遏。他们的热情够用吗？

32b4105c5438a4080bc0938172b66cc1e4521b1a.source: Liberals have been complaining about Afghanistan for years, practically since we went there. Now when I finally do something about it, they can't stand that I'm the one fixing this and they start attacking me.
32b4105c5438a4080bc0938172b66cc1e4521b1a.zh: 自由派抱怨阿富汗好多年了，几乎从我们进去的时候就开始。现在，我终于采取行动，他们却受不了问题是由我解决的，又开始攻击我。

f3b4d524333d00f406742104f4789cab0f2abad0.source: Liberals sense a bit of compromise in this response, when it comes to the issue of abortion.
f3b4d524333d00f406742104f4789cab0f2abad0.zh: 在堕胎问题上，自由派从这个回答中感到了一丝妥协。

cab69c27ae57f25d31cff542cbc97816da870b20.source: Life is one of those beautiful, beautiful things, it really is. And a lot of people, you know, it's always surprised me how many people have mixed feelings about life.
cab69c27ae57f25d31cff542cbc97816da870b20.zh: 生命是一种很美好、很美好的东西，真的。你知道，有那么多人对生命抱着矛盾的态度，一直让我很惊讶。

aa84e0f7716990f1ed790d2bf44ab31b65acb746.source: Like many people, I had some concerns with specific provisions in this deal. But overall, it is a worthwhile step in the right direction.
aa84e0f7716990f1ed790d2bf44ab31b65acb746.zh: 和许多人一样，我对协议的一些具体条款有所顾虑。但总的来说，这是朝正确方向迈出的一步，值得肯定。

a13928f08120f128395b23560f3ba0687f094a17.source: Like many women, I was sickened and appalled to see Donald Trump bragging about assault in casual conversation. Are these the values that we stand for in America, and that we want to teach our children?
a13928f08120f128395b23560f3ba0687f094a17.zh: 和许多女性一样，看到唐纳德·特朗普在闲聊中吹嘘侵犯女性，让我恶心而震惊。这是我们在美国所坚持、想教给孩子的价值观吗？

3f563296c5b4bb9c9e3eea4757737c7349122917.source: Like me, Gretchen Whitmer is somone who understands the issues that everyday Americans are facing. Throughout her career in Michigan, Gretchen Whitmer has stood up for the American worker and American industry.
3f563296c5b4bb9c9e3eea4757737c7349122917.zh: 和我一样，格雷琴·惠特默了解普通美国人面临的问题。在密歇根州的整个职业生涯中，她一直捍卫美国劳动者和美国工业。

de0909b349bcf16d52c9a1d8983fc388470b4603.source: Like most candidates, I will remain above the fray personally, and allow my supporters to stump on my behalf.
de0909b349bcf16d52c9a1d8983fc388470b4603.zh: 像多数候选人一样，我个人将置身竞选纷争之外，让支持者代我巡回演说。

173448ff1b3142923f1997ffbcd08f94af7a7ca2.source: Limit this ad to the Plains and Midwest. Ike enjoys the most popularity there.
173448ff1b3142923f1997ffbcd08f94af7a7ca2.zh: 只在大平原和中西部播放这则广告。艾克在那里最受欢迎。

3008e916f2f5c93dde6b80bef402d87b204df82e.source: Limited silver coinage is a good compromise. I support a program like that of Bland-Allison where the government purchases around $2 million of silver each month.
3008e916f2f5c93dde6b80bef402d87b204df82e.zh: 有限铸银是个不错的折中办法。我支持类似《布兰德—艾利森法》的计划，让政府每月购买约200万美元的白银。

1a20108fb2cccdd488994a9b6090ecf096c6f0d7.source: Lincoln and his party are abolitionists, whether they care to admit it or not. I don't believe a majority in the North would support them if this were fully understood.
1a20108fb2cccdd488994a9b6090ecf096c6f0d7.zh: 无论他们是否愿意承认，林肯及其政党都是废奴主义者。如果北方人充分了解这一点，我不相信多数人还会支持他们。

b85b56dd4770d895090f5d6fa4d450b676646bac.source: Lincoln begins with the lead, and must simply hold his Northern coalition together to take the victory.
b85b56dd4770d895090f5d6fa4d450b676646bac.zh: 林肯开局领先，只需维系北方的支持联盟，就能赢得大选。

66dbdf3de36ca433ea9464b9725bdf0104eaa32d.source: Living Apart: How the Government Betrayed a Landmark Civil Rights Law
66dbdf3de36ca433ea9464b9725bdf0104eaa32d.zh: 分居：政府如何背叛地标 民权 法律

492f91aeb99b1d0a3d0ad8a7a510407a38f4b390.source: Lloyd Bentsen has been involved in the government of this country since 1948. He is eminently qualified to advise our Administration from the first day.
492f91aeb99b1d0a3d0ad8a7a510407a38f4b390.zh: 劳埃德·本特森自1948年以来就在参与国家治理。他完全有资格从第一天起，为我们的政府提供建议。

36a388a9c016b932d968f66e7c6f4bb869f87ecc.source: Lloyd Bentsen has served as a Senator from Texas since 1971. In his first Senatorial election, he defeated George Bush. He is viewed as a moderate Democrat, particularly on economic issues. Texas could be a competitive state in the fall, and Bentsen's presence would help there. He is also very experienced on the national political stage. No Democrat has ever lost Texas and gone on to win a Presidential election.
36a388a9c016b932d968f66e7c6f4bb869f87ecc.zh: 劳埃德·本特森 自 1971 年以来一直担任 得克萨斯州 的参议员。在他的第一次参议员选举中，他击败了 乔治·布什。他被视为温和的民主党人，尤其是在经济问题上。 得克萨斯州 可能会在秋季成为一个竞争性的州，而 本特森 的存在将会对此有所帮助。他在国家政治舞台上也非常有经验。从来没有民主党人在输掉 得克萨斯州 后又赢得总统选举。

6f872cdb308ec578f1a33a47f22ca38746adc7b6.source: Lodge put you in a tight spot with this statement, unless you intend to run a very progressive campaign on civil rights.
6f872cdb308ec578f1a33a47f22ca38746adc7b6.zh: 除非你打算在民权问题上采取非常进步的竞选立场，否则洛奇这番话让你陷入了两难。

e0621e2283cdb969c21aec2460dad024e05f6893.source: Look, when it comes down to it, my policies will Keep America Great, and Joe Biden's will bring socialism and decay back to our great and wonderful country. That's more important than any corruption or scandals that his son is involved in.
e0621e2283cdb969c21aec2460dad024e05f6893.zh: 说到底，我的政策会让美国保持伟大，乔·拜登的政策却会让社会主义和衰败重返这个伟大而美好的国家。这比他儿子涉及的任何腐败和丑闻都更重要。

087716a2808db559d5280d10ce3ef372414a5d61.source: Lyndon Johnson has attacked our record on social security greatly, even running an ad where our own running mate Bill Miller says we wish to destroy the social security system! How should we fight back against these ads?
087716a2808db559d5280d10ce3ef372414a5d61.zh: 林登·约翰逊猛烈攻击我们在社会保障问题上的立场，甚至播出一则广告，让我们自己的竞选搭档比尔·米勒说出，我们想摧毁社会保障制度！我们该怎样反击这些广告？

1071039415f1c2d248d6fcba87f17ded553ff599.source: Lyndon Johnson has created more programs and agencies than any President except for FDR. I will act more in line with the wishes of the American people.
1071039415f1c2d248d6fcba87f17ded553ff599.zh: 除富兰克林·罗斯福外，没有哪位总统设立的项目和机构比林登·约翰逊更多。我会更切实地按照美国人民的意愿行事。

98aa0bd7c9582cca75130f209adf8ee769847f77.source: Lyndon Johnson is a loyal Southerner and Senator from Texas who will spare no effort to advance a Democratic agenda.
98aa0bd7c9582cca75130f209adf8ee769847f77.zh: 林登·约翰逊 是一位忠诚的南方人，也是来自 得克萨斯州 的参议员，他将不遗余力地推进民主党议程。

06737303a17db2bfe221ac444594a54b6c2ed6ff.source: Lyndon Johnson is a powerful member of the Democratic Party, having served as Senate Majority Leader for the past five years. Many Southern states are threatening to bolt to a segregationist ticket -- Johnson is the only person with the clout to save most of those states. Texas will also certainly be lost with any other running mate. At the same time, his vote for the Taft-Hartley labor act in 1947 is still a sore spot for unions, and could dampen their enthusiasm for the ticket.
06737303a17db2bfe221ac444594a54b6c2ed6ff.zh: 林登·约翰逊 是 民主党 的重要成员，在过去五年中担任参议院多数党领袖。许多南方州都威胁要支持种族隔离主义——约翰逊是唯一有能力拯救大多数州的人。 得克萨斯州 也肯定会输给任何其他竞选伙伴。与此同时，他在 1947 年对《塔夫脱-哈特利劳工法》的投票仍然是工会的痛处，可能会挫伤他们的热情。

41158aaab7ac2cf14c9f7aadeb6d306c80c8105d.source: Lyndon Johnson shares my political beliefs and will be my close partner in government for the next four years.
41158aaab7ac2cf14c9f7aadeb6d306c80c8105d.zh: 林登·约翰逊与我持有相同的政治信念，未来四年，他将是我执政中的密切伙伴。

54740003955148e45dbc978dbc5a2292f22542a7.source: Lyndon Johnson, in his crude way, swears that he will slit your throat if you oppose his policies on Vietnam while campaigning. Will you risk his wrath and be your own man on the trail?
54740003955148e45dbc978dbc5a2292f22542a7.zh: 林登·约翰逊用他粗鲁的方式发誓：如果你在竞选时反对他的越南政策，他就要割断你的喉咙。你会冒着激怒他的风险，在竞选途中坚持自己的主张吗？

e7de10bcde639794f089fe37d6dcbb5dd38c4bb6.source: Lyndon calls you to inform that you have his complete support, securing the base. But a portion of moderates are spooked by your commitment to expanding the Great Society.
e7de10bcde639794f089fe37d6dcbb5dd38c4bb6.zh: 林登打来电话，告诉你他完全支持你，稳住了基本盘。但你承诺扩大伟大社会计划，也吓到了部分温和派。

ae37e97410229ee269752ed80ee60b428990d852.source: Mainstream pundits seem to think you've made a political blunder, but they've been wrong before. Meanwhile, your rallies just got even wilder.
ae37e97410229ee269752ed80ee60b428990d852.zh: 主流评论人士似乎认为，你犯了一个政治错误，不过他们以前也错过。与此同时，你的集会变得更加狂热了。

e6d28517dee338f7578d9b866a75cd20d1174d0a.source: Major gains have been achieved in Texas, but voters sense your hesitancy towards Wallace. Polls across the nation have only been affected slightly.
e6d28517dee338f7578d9b866a75cd20d1174d0a.zh: 你在得克萨斯州收获很大，但选民也察觉到你对华莱士的犹豫态度。全国民调只有轻微变化。

6e2118bdfe130ff597e48b9f1ef2e855a622cd18.source: Making the subject about states rights is possibly the worst way to oppose it as a Democrat.
6e2118bdfe130ff597e48b9f1ef2e855a622cd18.zh: 身为民主党人，却把问题扯到州权上，可能是表达反对时最糟糕的办法。

f841e11edced88d69d76b4d6d3991f4ef164c87e.source: Making up ground in the South is better than expanding our massive lead in the North. It hurts me to say it, but hold back on the attacks for now.
f841e11edced88d69d76b4d6d3991f4ef164c87e.zh: 在南方缩小差距，比进一步扩大北方已经巨大的领先优势更有价值。虽然这话让我难受，但暂时别发动这些攻击。

db2e11499b50dd8a59a4010b48d1bf5ecf49bd9c.source: Managing the economy is one thing that the Democrats have done right. You should own this issue -- not be running from it.
db2e11499b50dd8a59a4010b48d1bf5ecf49bd9c.zh: 经济管理是民主党做对的一件事。你应该把它当作自己的优势，而不是躲着不谈。

05d66b4067a96df32d136f8a9940672979ee45e6.source: Many Democrats are calling for an expansion to the Supreme Court, to counteract some of your controversial appointments. Will you be adding your voice to this debate?
05d66b4067a96df32d136f8a9940672979ee45e6.zh: 许多民主党人呼吁扩大最高法院人数，以回应你的一些有争议的任命。你是否会加入这场讨论？

7710d265e5aa21fbfb40b81b486a5dbc4572f344.source: Many Democrats are worried that this election will be stolen, and want you to stick up for the process a bit more than you seem to be doing.
7710d265e5aa21fbfb40b81b486a5dbc4572f344.zh: 许多民主党人担心，这场选举会被偷走，希望你能比目前表现出来的，更积极地维护程序。

aef22c7f8ebc1ae230787b8f6dbade219fa83605.source: Many accuse your heated rhetoric of fueling violence at your rallies, which have become known for their protestors and altercations. What are your thoughts?
aef22c7f8ebc1ae230787b8f6dbade219fa83605.zh: 你的集会因抗议者与冲突而出名；许多人指责，你激烈的言辞助长了集会暴力。你怎么看？

e0c4704ab61aa9f824b5b53ed41dd80928b832e6.source: Many advisors believe that your only chance to come back against Dukakis is to go on the attack.
e0c4704ab61aa9f824b5b53ed41dd80928b832e6.zh: 许多顾问认为，你逆转杜卡基斯优势的唯一机会，就是主动攻击。

38bac90dbbc5cba41e3fbc8b11094afb34fa1257.source: Many are also angered of your dropping of Joe Biden, which they feel cost you some votes and possibly the election. Biden himself has already yelled at you for losing the election.
38bac90dbbc5cba41e3fbc8b11094afb34fa1257.zh: 许多人也对你放弃 乔·拜登 感到愤怒，他们认为这让你失去了一些选票，甚至可能失去了选举。 拜登他自己已经因为你落选而对你大喊大叫了。

5c0447c1c2efcd12712c6872642d79423cd4112b.source: Many are confused at your seeming passivity in the face of a Republican broadside.
5c0447c1c2efcd12712c6872642d79423cd4112b.zh: 面对共和党的猛烈攻击，你似乎无动于衷，这让许多人不解。

bcb9c5a32a3ec4434a59a526e9c90486fc103bca.source: Many are surprised to hear you hedge your position on the bank issue.
bcb9c5a32a3ec4434a59a526e9c90486fc103bca.zh: 听到你在银行问题上开始含糊其辞，许多人都很意外。

0f484a006029e5335d18450f4e388621ce0a2eca.source: Many are surprised to hear you take such a strong anti-war position as the Republican nominee.
0f484a006029e5335d18450f4e388621ce0a2eca.zh: 作为共和党提名人，你采取如此鲜明的反战立场，让许多人感到意外。

7c849d5b5772b7fca1fc058332162327b731936b.source: Many fail to see the logic in your reasoning, but those who do cheer you on for standing by your words.
7c849d5b5772b7fca1fc058332162327b731936b.zh: 许多人看不懂你的道理，但听懂的人为你坚持自己的话而喝彩。

c27e80be12f30d3f86f5b96ece87016b17115994.source: Many have started taking a second look at some of Ben Carson's past statements. Do you agree with his comparisons of Obamacare to slavery?
c27e80be12f30d3f86f5b96ece87016b17115994.zh: 许多人开始重新审视本·卡森过去的一些言论。你是否赞同他把奥巴马医改比作奴隶制？

a3c562509299bb7ec8cc2eb6c8adb2920e65c593.source: Many in the conservative wing of the Republican party weren't too keen on you being the nominee, so it's unlikely you'll get nominated again. You still do have a future in politics, so perhaps you could join the Senate or run for governor again, as New England is showing an increasing willingness to elect moderate Republicans on the gubernatorial scale. You might be able to carve out a strong base of support, based on one of your political or personal aspects, to win in either of these positions.
a3c562509299bb7ec8cc2eb6c8adb2920e65c593.zh: 共和党 保守派中的许多人不太热衷于让你成为提名人，所以你不太可能再次获得提名。你在政治上仍然有前途，所以也许你可以加入参议院或再次竞选州长，因为 新英格兰 越来越愿意在州长级别上选举温和的共和党人。您也许能够根据您的政治或个人方面之一建立强大的支持基础，以赢得这些职位中的任何一个。

2d53633680612c09864119c15cc4270873ff92ca.source: Many in the party are surprised by your protectionist tone.
2d53633680612c09864119c15cc4270873ff92ca.zh: 党内许多人对你的贸易保护主义口吻感到意外。

f81eb4f2953e37c8c3d97f8f1d4831d852cb497a.source: Lord knows the railroad men can swing an election. But then again, so can the railroad workers. California will be a close state.
f81eb4f2953e37c8c3d97f8f1d4831d852cb497a.zh: 谁都知道，铁路老板能左右一场选举。但铁路工人同样也能。加利福尼亚将是一场激烈的争夺。

b7ba1a5e1219e9cb5869a52bd3b5d084054b9080.source: Lord knows you've gone on aggrieved attack mode plenty of times over the past four years. But is it enough to get you over the hump for a second term?
b7ba1a5e1219e9cb5869a52bd3b5d084054b9080.zh: 天知道，过去四年你有多少次摆出受害者姿态，发动愤怒攻击。不过，这足以帮你跨过门槛，赢得第二个任期吗？

c7a5c73587817177c07797fc145d8d31f2b268d3.source: Loud cheers from the audience! A tariff man through and through!
c7a5c73587817177c07797fc145d8d31f2b268d3.zh: 听众欢声雷动！你真是个彻头彻尾的关税支持者！

c68bee25a69a31244f497a5973a71996fb1a00e2.source: Loyal Democrats need all the patronage jobs they can get, but will your handling of the situation cost you any in Tyler's home state of Virginia?
c68bee25a69a31244f497a5973a71996fb1a00e2.zh: 忠诚的民主党人希望尽可能多地获得政治酬庸职位，但你处理此事的方式，会不会让你在泰勒的家乡弗吉尼亚州损失选票？

7875814b917fee2e31e7a39ccb51519a5baa3b75.source: Luckily for you, mainstream media sources won't touch this story with a ten foot pole, especially not this close to the election.
7875814b917fee2e31e7a39ccb51519a5baa3b75.zh: 你很幸运，主流媒体对这个故事避之唯恐不及，尤其是在如此接近选举的时候。

143b99c37d10b93b82ef64ba055dc706c9fcdbf6.source: Lyman Gage has jumped around quite a bit in his political career, changing parties already on a couple of occasions. While he is moderate on the tariff issue, he is fiercely pro-gold, for which he currently stands as a Republican.
143b99c37d10b93b82ef64ba055dc706c9fcdbf6.zh: 莱曼·盖奇 在他的政治生涯中跳来跳去，已经几次更换政党。虽然他在关税问题上态度温和，但他强烈支持黄金，目前他是共和党人。

f6c238481b62486bfc10dd554997b2dedd7a4fe8.source: Lyndon B. Johnson aims to maintain his large lead in the polls, defending his policies while keeping both integrationist and segregationist voters of the Democratic Party on board.
f6c238481b62486bfc10dd554997b2dedd7a4fe8.zh: 林登·B.·约翰逊希望保持民调中的巨大领先优势。他既要捍卫自己的政策，也要同时留住民主党内支持种族融合和支持种族隔离的选民。

ef2d7c9f6539516edb0eb1f50cf939fd43c5dc9b.source: Lyndon B. Johnson was not elected President, nor was he intended to be running for President in 1964. However, after the death of John F. Kennedy, Johnson was thrust into the limelight of the highest office in America. His Presidency so far has revolved around continuing Kennedy’s policies, as well as advancing ambitions of his own. The Great Society is already moving forward, buttressed by expansions to Social Security and the landmark Civil Rights Act of 1964. In foreign affairs, Johnson has expanded American involvement in Vietnam- a widely popular decision, even if undercurrents of dissent have begun to brew.
ef2d7c9f6539516edb0eb1f50cf939fd43c5dc9b.zh: 林登·B.·约翰逊 没有当选总统，也没有打算在 1964 年竞选总统。然而，在 约翰·F.·肯尼迪 去世后，约翰逊 被推到了美国最高职位的聚光灯下。迄今为止，他的总统任期一直围绕着继续肯尼迪的政策以及推进他自己的雄心。在社会保障和1964年具有里程碑意义的民权法案的扩展的支持下，伟大社会已经在向前发展。在外交事务中，约翰逊扩大了美国对越南的参与——这是一个广受欢迎的决定，即使异议的暗流已经开始酝酿。

606831b321d72e958018e0f3d524bc427d3edbb9.source: Lyndon Johnson has aired an ad depicting a little girl picking flowers, followed by the sound of a nuclear countdown. This ad, known as the ‘Daisy’ ad, is causing much trouble for the Goldwater campaign.
606831b321d72e958018e0f3d524bc427d3edbb9.zh: 林登·约翰逊播出了一则广告：小女孩正在摘花，随后响起核爆倒计时。这则被称为“雏菊”的广告，给戈德华特阵营带来了很大麻烦。

ed0f85dc6e4a1439d4e7153bf4261acc3fc405dc.source: Many in your party are in favor of Prohibition, but there is a significant minority on the other side. Particularly among the German wing.
ed0f85dc6e4a1439d4e7153bf4261acc3fc405dc.zh: 党内许多人赞成禁酒，但也有相当一部分人持反对意见，尤其是德裔群体。

d2209340121f13fde05df2622da35f6c5e9a5fba.source: Many left-wing groups are organizing huge protests at Donald Trump's rallies, some of which involve blocking traffic or forcing the cancellation of speeches. Do you have anything to say about these tactics?
d2209340121f13fde05df2622da35f6c5e9a5fba.zh: 许多左翼团体正在特朗普集会周边组织大规模抗议，其中一些会堵塞交通，或迫使演说取消。你对这些手法有什么话要说？

ed7382f82a381aa6a66a45e191525f8738d8d75a.source: Many observers believe that you are too cavalier about the Republican attack machine.
ed7382f82a381aa6a66a45e191525f8738d8d75a.zh: 许多观察人士认为，你对共和党的攻击机器太不当回事了。

65da638155fd0918468869ce2a4e868ed909e8c5.source: Many of Clinton's weaknesses lie buried in her past. You have to be relentless on the attack.
65da638155fd0918468869ce2a4e868ed909e8c5.zh: 克林顿的许多弱点埋在过往里。你必须毫不留情地攻击。

ac8e7e5f0be5980ef6e78591853d66d114587cac.source: Many of your core supporters are energized by your pugnacious and righteous stance on this issue. More neutral pundits see a “race to the bottom” in America's political rhetoric.
ac8e7e5f0be5980ef6e78591853d66d114587cac.zh: 许多核心支持者因你在这个问题上好斗而义正辞严的立场受到鼓舞。较为中立的评论人士，则认为美国的政治言论正在“竞相突破底线”。

d6c14eebbc50a07192036bf920a774bae62d1fc0.source: Many of your supporters are despondent that you have faltered to the likes of Donald Trump. Many in the left wing of the party are furious that you pushed their candidate aside, only to lose. Time will tell how Trump operates as President. As for you, a long and sometimes ambiguous political career seems to be coming to its end.
d6c14eebbc50a07192036bf920a774bae62d1fc0.zh: 你的许多支持者对你对 唐纳德·特朗普 之类的人犹豫不决感到沮丧。党内许多左翼人士对你将他们的候选人推到一边却最终失败感到愤怒。时间会告诉我们特朗普如何担任总统。至于你，漫长且有时模糊的政治生涯似乎即将结束。

978e7c6f55beb9fb9071843854243d0f0ecec600.source: Many of your supporters are despondent that you have faltered to the likes of Hillary Clinton. Republicans in general believe this was a very winnable election, and are enraged that you came in to blow it. As for your next moves, will you recede quietly from the public spotlight? Or will you do anything you can to case doubt on the legitimacy of the results?
978e7c6f55beb9fb9071843854243d0f0ecec600.zh: 你的许多支持者对你对 希拉里·克林顿 之类的人犹豫不决感到沮丧。共和党人普遍认为这是一场非常有可能获胜的选举，并对你的到来感到愤怒。至于你的下一步行动，你会悄然退出公众的视线吗？或者你会尽一切努力来质疑结果的合法性吗？

3cb1116a1417e66fa4f725d4d65522c4ec382aab.source: Many of your supporters are despondent that you have faltered to the likes of Hillary Clinton. Republicans in general believe this was a very winnable election, and are enraged that you came in to blow it. Luckily, there are any number of ways for you to take advantage of your newfound exposure. One rumor even has you founding a television station to profit from the aggrieved sensibilities of your followers. The future is in your hands.
3cb1116a1417e66fa4f725d4d65522c4ec382aab.zh: 你的许多支持者对你对 希拉里·克林顿 之类的人犹豫不决感到沮丧。共和党人普遍认为这是一场非常有可能获胜的选举，并对你的到来感到愤怒。幸运的是，您可以通过多种方式利用新发现的机会。有传言甚至说你创办了一家电视台，从追随者的愤愤不平中获利。未来掌握在您手中。

c1abe3a8a3c9912484202dced26d78ae93ccbc2a.source: Many of your supporters were hoping for a more vigorous stance.
c1abe3a8a3c9912484202dced26d78ae93ccbc2a.zh: 你的许多支持者原本希望你立场更坚决些。

3444650dec50037f772dac5835860d414d3b6e3e.source: Many of your supporters, especially the Jewish community, disagree. The New Left have capitalized, fearmongering that it’s the end for separation of church and state based on your rhetoric.
3444650dec50037f772dac5835860d414d3b6e3e.zh: 你的许多支持者，尤其是犹太人社区，并不赞同。新左派借题发挥，根据你的言论渲染恐慌，声称政教分离要完了。

6a3531e279a714b3a9f0dceefd0e2867e7ed2793.source: Many patent medicine purveyors operate in a single locale, and do not cross state lines. Where appropriate, I would support regulation, but only where the Constitution allows it.
6a3531e279a714b3a9f0dceefd0e2867e7ed2793.zh: 许多成药商只在一个地方经营，不跨州营业。在适当情况下，我支持监管，但仅限于宪法允许的范围。

327a935ea8ad5d3bd0d1dbb5ca8fb71e9f032251.source: Many people are questioning your credibility and fitness based on this issue. There are too many sources and witnesses for you to deny these things completely.
327a935ea8ad5d3bd0d1dbb5ca8fb71e9f032251.zh: 许多人因为这件事，质疑你的可信度和任职资格。消息来源和证人太多，你不能把这些事情全盘否认。

b1d1d35e14d1b1e973be10a9f89645baab30ccd9.source: Many people believe that you are escalating and tacitly encouraging this situation, rather than speaking out against it.
b1d1d35e14d1b1e973be10a9f89645baab30ccd9.zh: 许多人认为，你是在激化、默许助长这种局面，而不是公开反对。

1faecae1d1bc54219d7dfaba679d90038b8aa91f.source: Many progressive commentators are outraged by your seeming snub of Bernie Sanders, and stories about a potential rift dominate the political news for several days.
1faecae1d1bc54219d7dfaba679d90038b8aa91f.zh: 许多进步派评论人士，对你似乎冷落伯尼·桑德斯感到愤怒。可能出现裂痕的报道，连续几天占据政治新闻。

fff3bfbd2816c05d05e690a37036cc116172c686.source: Many progressives believe that you are trying way too hard to win over independent support in this election, even to the extent of flirting with racist rhetoric to do so.
fff3bfbd2816c05d05e690a37036cc116172c686.zh: 许多进步派认为，你在争取独立选民支持上用力过猛，甚至不惜靠近带有种族主义意味的说辞。

6900476b3ec3dc86d5d57cb4f5f361fd114dbe02.source: Many pundits deride your remarks as dangerous and inflammatory, and also point to the polls showing you way behind in the race.
6900476b3ec3dc86d5d57cb4f5f361fd114dbe02.zh: 许多评论人士嘲笑你的言论危险、煽动，还指出民调显示你在竞选中远远落后。

552a1fd5ad9b12bba1f70c98212cab5982dc482a.source: Many remember your role (for better or worse) in unmasking Alger Hiss and other incidents, and are surprised to hear you talking about “witch hunts” now.
552a1fd5ad9b12bba1f70c98212cab5982dc482a.zh: 许多人记得你在揭露阿尔杰·希斯及其他事件中的作用，无论他们对此评价好坏；如今听到你谈论“政治猎巫”，都感到惊讶。

db54cb7815f3b48ec2705ebed0efd10ced4c64ff.source: Many rural Democrats are upset at the strong position you have taken.
db54cb7815f3b48ec2705ebed0efd10ced4c64ff.zh: 许多农村地区的民主党人对你如此强硬的立场感到不满。

7bc47540c22f7d3c46c86943c2e51976fc434569.source: Many schools are squandering the resources of the federal government. I support providing school vouchers directly to parents, so that they can choose where their child goes.
7bc47540c22f7d3c46c86943c2e51976fc434569.zh: 许多学校正在浪费联邦政府的资源。我支持直接向家长发放教育券，让他们选择孩子去哪所学校。

b76f58001ea8c584b12cf5ba773418004649ea5f.source: Many think this answer strikes the wrong tone in the aftermath of tragedy.
b76f58001ea8c584b12cf5ba773418004649ea5f.zh: 许多人认为，在悲剧发生之后，这个回答的语气很不合适。

dacff0386baf6c94523e523f32441494da031b99.source: Many traditional Republicans are wondering where the “compromise” with progressives begins, and how you're any better than Roosevelt.
dacff0386baf6c94523e523f32441494da031b99.zh: 许多传统共和党人正纳闷：与进步派的“妥协”究竟从哪里开始？你又比罗斯福好在哪里？

f6a17edf3d0b55858a3e2dcd0cfd9f8c89c2c657.source: Many voters struggle to make sense out of your rationale.
f6a17edf3d0b55858a3e2dcd0cfd9f8c89c2c657.zh: 许多选民难以理解你的理由。

1c82931af1b7f10bf83bf639d0b136fe033723b3.source: Many voters, women in particular, are deeply offended by your unsubstantiated insinuations.
1c82931af1b7f10bf83bf639d0b136fe033723b3.zh: 许多选民，尤其女性，对你那些毫无根据的影射深感冒犯。

06f8c36a28e4d9865a0b203dd861f1e78fcbb69a.source: Maybe in limited cases, where unions are a threat to public safety or where they undermine an essential industry. The courts are notoriously conservative, however, and definitely take this practice too far.
06f8c36a28e4d9865a0b203dd861f1e78fcbb69a.zh: 在少数情况下，也许可以，比如工会威胁公共安全，或破坏关键行业。不过，法院向来以保守著称，运用这种办法时肯定走得太远了。

422883e6487e9d83d5b4dd34a6acbf5a51768121.source: Maybe it was illegal, maybe it wasn't. Mr. Barr can decide that. All I'm saying is, does it matter? We know that Hunter had no expertise in the oil industry, and they're paying him $1 million a year while his father is Vice President.
422883e6487e9d83d5b4dd34a6acbf5a51768121.zh: 也许违法，也许不违法。巴尔先生可以判断。我只是在说，这重要吗？我们知道亨特没有石油行业的专业知识，他父亲当副总统时，那些人却每年给他一百万美元。

007c2d8f846b7b536f6b201bbeda5411e257f49e.source: Maybe some limited spots, asking if we really know who Jimmy Carter is. Or attacking him on one of these issues. But let's not go overboard.
007c2d8f846b7b536f6b201bbeda5411e257f49e.zh: 或许可以做一些有限的短广告，问问我们是否真的了解吉米·卡特，或就其中某个议题攻击他。但不要过火。

94c23980393dead7ccc5a3d6345a1b2997c0bb00.source: Maybe there wasn't a crime here after all. I can admit when I'm wrong. I just thought these payments looked weird and that someone should look into it, was that a crime?
94c23980393dead7ccc5a3d6345a1b2997c0bb00.zh: 也许这里终究没有犯罪。我错了也能承认。我只是觉得这些付款很奇怪，应该有人查一查，这就算犯罪吗？

a16deef6437c445c44e80ccdd2827e104884fd2f.source: Maybe these debates have outlived their usefullness anyway. Still, there are some whispers that you may have made a mistake.
a16deef6437c445c44e80ccdd2827e104884fd2f.zh: 也许这些辩论早已失去用途。不过，仍有人低声议论，说你可能犯了个错误。

5f61e21898b4c14b67ee7aec199072621b7c1414.source: Maybe this contributed, but we also increased spending which certainly did its part to stimulate the economy.
5f61e21898b4c14b67ee7aec199072621b7c1414.zh: 减税也许起了一些作用，但我们也增加了支出，这当然也刺激了经济。

cbaed5c7dbe8a7c6e97403501d56b916b8be3d7d.source: Maybe this issue has been caught up in a bit of rhetorical excess, but I will be very tough on illegal immigration when I am President.
cbaed5c7dbe8a7c6e97403501d56b916b8be3d7d.zh: 这个问题可能被一些夸张言辞搅得失了分寸，但我担任总统时，会非常强硬地对待非法移民。

cfb262ffd741f62fbecc1719d02d868a594faea8.source: Maybe we had our disagreements over the exact size and nature of this spending, but nobody seriously thinks that we should stop funding our highways.
cfb262ffd741f62fbecc1719d02d868a594faea8.zh: 也许我们对这笔支出的具体规模与性质有过分歧，但没人会认真主张，停止为公路提供资金。

7f15bda065681350c989fa3f8bd470977ee93a7a.source: Maybe your best bet here is to turn this into a "both sides" partisan story. And it's not as if you're wrong about Bush.
7f15bda065681350c989fa3f8bd470977ee93a7a.zh: 也许最好的办法，是把这件事变成一个“两党都如此”的党争故事。再说，你对布什的说法也不是错的。

dba8bc56db23dcaea6215d6b8d5c7331da74fe8b.source: Maybe, even for you, discretion is the better part of valor on this front.
dba8bc56db23dcaea6215d6b8d5c7331da74fe8b.zh: 也许在这件事上，即使是你，也该知道谨慎才是勇敢的上策。

05531dd6bfe552e53f12bceeae860e434c930d95.source: McGovern lost pretty badly in '72, if you'll remember. It might not the best strategy to copy his policies.
05531dd6bfe552e53f12bceeae860e434c930d95.zh: 如果你还记得，麦戈文1972年输得很惨。模仿他的政策，恐怕不是最佳策略。

6459a8f21a37711c3ad228df03bb410b4fccdef4.source: McKinley enjoys near universal support from the financial elite, a massive advantage in campaign funding, and a devoted following in the Northeast and Upper Midwest, including his home state of Ohio.
6459a8f21a37711c3ad228df03bb410b4fccdef4.zh: 麦金莱 享有金融精英几乎普遍的支持，在竞选资金方面拥有巨大优势，并在东北部和中西部北部（包括他的家乡州 俄亥俄州）拥有忠实的追随者。

b994818ab46d9f6ef2240a8410fd682c1a09a9e0.source: McKinley has proposed some of the most dastardly tariffs to ever see the light of day in this country.
b994818ab46d9f6ef2240a8410fd682c1a09a9e0.zh: 麦金莱提出的关税，简直是这个国家所见过最卑劣的一批。

9e8bef9abdb10399400c35b4138e63845173fc88.source: Many working-class Americans are convinced and impressed by the eloquence of your speech. This will definitely help you.
9e8bef9abdb10399400c35b4138e63845173fc88.zh: 许多工薪阶层美国人被你雄辩的演讲说服，印象深刻。这肯定会帮助你。

108d1973bfeeb7b730b2d51cd22a170dbf49cfee.source: Martin Van Buren, Democrat and President until 1841, will be making a tour of the country to visit various friends and political figures. Will you extend the invitation for him to stay at your estate for a few days?
108d1973bfeeb7b730b2d51cd22a170dbf49cfee.zh: 民主党人马丁·范布伦曾任总统，直到1841年卸任。他即将巡游全国，拜访各位朋友和政界人物。你是否会邀请他到你的庄园住上几天？

f279e79c19d8a48698a2991a270934af4ce1be44.source: Masks are a big factor, as you can see I'm wearing one right now. Our businesses are getting killed by these Democrat lockdowns. Anything that will help us reopen, if it's masks or anything, it's a good thing.
f279e79c19d8a48698a2991a270934af4ce1be44.zh: 口罩很重要，你看，我现在就戴着。民主党的封锁快把我们的企业害死了。任何能帮助重新开放的办法，口罩也好，其他也好，都是好事。

e7ccc0ae64e92238e5d1016d51c515e40068d4bd.source: Massachusetts has one of the lowest crime rates in the nation. We need to turn the tables and attack Bush and Reagan relentlessly on the national crime rate.
e7ccc0ae64e92238e5d1016d51c515e40068d4bd.zh: 马萨诸塞州的犯罪率是全国最低的几个州之一。我们要扭转攻守之势，抓住全国犯罪率问题，不断攻击布什和里根。

42e306bb6cd8070eff618606c1108ffb0589a9dd.source: Mathews has broken a couple of strikes in the past, however, and this could dampen his appeal to the industrial elements of the party.
42e306bb6cd8070eff618606c1108ffb0589a9dd.zh: 然而，马修斯过去曾破坏过几次罢工，这可能会削弱他对党内工业元素的吸引力。

13bd7f85b0f80ffa6270fabaa30e0ae390811243.source: Matthew Quay is a Senator from Pennsylvania, who has entertained his own aspirations on the Presidency. In 1896, Pennsylvania is still the second-largest state in the Union, and Quay could virtually ensure a victory there.
13bd7f85b0f80ffa6270fabaa30e0ae390811243.zh: 马修·奎 是来自 宾夕法尼亚州 的参议员，他对总统职位抱有自己的愿望。 1896年，宾夕法尼亚州仍然是联邦第二大州，奎实际上可以确保在那里取得胜利。

cd897a55f9bf9fd8c859db9d4462d51cba07f9e0.source: Maybe 1912 was just an anomaly, brought about by Roosevelt's grandstanding. It has been over 20 years since the Democrats defeated a united Republican Party, and that advantage shows no sign of abating.
cd897a55f9bf9fd8c859db9d4462d51cba07f9e0.zh: 也许 1912 年只是一个异常现象，是由 罗斯福 的哗众取宠所带来的。民主党击败统一的共和党已经过去了 20 多年，而且这种优势没有减弱的迹象。

a1b2db5c63e72f8ee647aabd61fad21569560bc1.source: Maybe I didn't personally sit down and invent the internet. But I was crucial in fighting for the funding that allowed our universities to build this system.
a1b2db5c63e72f8ee647aabd61fad21569560bc1.zh: 也许我没有亲手坐下来发明互联网。但在争取经费、让我们的大学能够建立这个系统的过程中，我发挥了关键作用。

cba60ce8c08360be289e1673546e12aafd1dcd27.source: Maybe I will. Maybe I won't. I'm sure the fake media will be very interested to find out when I win the election in November.
cba60ce8c08360be289e1673546e12aafd1dcd27.zh: 也许我会，也许我不会。我敢肯定，假媒体会非常想知道，等我十一月赢得选举后究竟会怎么做。

638f8cc9fc370df80bc0f63ec54a23a155784737.source: Maybe a couple of general statements against them, but overall we should avoid doing anything which might alienate former Whigs from joining the Republicans.
638f8cc9fc370df80bc0f63ec54a23a155784737.zh: 可以作几次笼统批评，但总体上，我们应当避免疏远那些可能加入共和党的前辉格党人。

51ae070d6baafad0f6b6b453c211c0ac4cfa265d.source: Maybe if Bill Clinton and some other people I can think of would have followed this common-sense recommendation, their lives would have been much simpler.
51ae070d6baafad0f6b6b453c211c0ac4cfa265d.zh: 如果比尔·克林顿，以及我想得到的某些其他人，也遵守过这条合乎常识的建议，他们的生活也许就简单多了。

91f5597686ee8043c646ac9c29f5ed61dfda6794.source: Michael Dukakis has been elected three times as Governor of Massachusetts. His chances this year seem to be good, if he can press the case for his own ability and challenge the readiness of Bush. Dukakis has won the nomination without aligning himself firmly with a specific wing of the party. His national reputation is positive, but inchoate. He will be expected to define himself more clearly, and may need to explain some older votes and decisions as they become known.
91f5597686ee8043c646ac9c29f5ed61dfda6794.zh: 迈克尔·杜卡基斯 已三次当选为 马萨诸塞州 州长。如果他能证明自己的能力并挑战 布什 的准备情况，他今年的机会似乎很好。 杜卡基斯 赢得了提名，但没有与党内的某个特定派别坚定地结盟。他的全国声誉是积极的，但还处于起步阶段。人们预计他会更清楚地定义自己，并且可能需要在一些旧的投票和决定为人所知时对其进行解释。

b6967094f4e11469b19ffe0fc7000908e0ecca9f.source: Michael Dukakis, Governor of Massachusetts, is a new figure on the national scene. Can he keep the good feelings going through election day?
b6967094f4e11469b19ffe0fc7000908e0ecca9f.zh: 马萨诸塞州州长迈克尔·杜卡基斯是全国政坛的新面孔。他能否将当前的良好势头保持到投票日？

6d759fa4eeeb2effb3254b86d9cc27c5ee5e8561.source: Michael Dukakis: The Photo Op That Tanked
6d759fa4eeeb2effb3254b86d9cc27c5ee5e8561.zh: 迈克尔·杜卡基斯：失败的照片

fe23d26642ed219afaef84639c3297a11d01a3ff.zh: 迈克尔·克拉尼什 & 斯科特·赫尔曼 -

3342da9cf7364b942b960baf2da058253efb924f.source: Michigan was one of the hardest hit states in the recent recession. Do you support higher taxes on foreign vehicles while that auto industry regroups in that state?
3342da9cf7364b942b960baf2da058253efb924f.zh: 密歇根州是近期衰退中受创最重的州之一。在该州汽车业重振旗鼓期间，你是否支持提高对外国汽车征收的税？

d0be0728f51241b5226cc8b456e7dccf7f7f25fd.zh: 密歇根州、威斯康星州和艾奥瓦州

3013ac1b44102e19fa8f70f7e546fb99741db0e7.source: Mike Pence has served as your Vice President for the past four years, sticking to all of your talking points and staying out of the limelight. Most feel he should be rewarded for this loyalty with another turn on the top of the ticket. He also helps shore up your support with social conservatives.
3013ac1b44102e19fa8f70f7e546fb99741db0e7.zh: 迈克·彭斯 在过去四年中一直担任你们的副总裁，坚持你们所有的谈话要点并远离聚光灯。大多数人认为，他的这种忠诚度应该得到奖励，并在门票顶部再转一次。他还帮助巩固你对社会保守派的支持。

80226afe9f08558eaee49fbee4ea77adee460d94.source: Mike Pence is a former Congressman and the current Governor of Indiana. He is a popular figure among social conservatives and would help assuage concern about Trump among party insiders. He would add executive experience to the ticket and make few mistakes on the campaign trail, but he could also undercut Trump's outsider credentials.
80226afe9f08558eaee49fbee4ea77adee460d94.zh: 迈克·彭斯 是 印第安纳州 的前国会议员和现任州长。他是社会保守派中受欢迎的人物，有助于缓解党内人士对 特朗普 的担忧。他会在竞选过程中增加高管经验，并且在竞选过程中很少犯错误，但他也可能削弱特朗普的局外人资历。

939bae6e2a12a38e891418f142f45151106bb67b.source: Mike Pence is an incredible, incredible human being. He's been in there for many years, fighting for religious liberty, tax cuts, and a strong military.
939bae6e2a12a38e891418f142f45151106bb67b.zh: 迈克·彭斯是个了不起、了不起的人。这些年来，他一直在为宗教自由、减税和强大的军队奋斗。

bf0682e7cb8cd122931d74d70639f5edb47316df.source: Millard Fillmore was an influential Congressman before leaving that body in 1843. He has strongly supported Whig economic policies such as a tariff and national bank. He has taken stances against the expansion of slavery, without veering into the dangerous territory of abolitionism. He is well-connected to New York politics, and his selection would undoubtedly motivate the party in that crucial state.
bf0682e7cb8cd122931d74d70639f5edb47316df.zh: 米勒德·菲尔莫尔 在 1843 年离开国会之前是一位有影响力的国会议员。他强烈支持 辉格党人 经济政策，例如关税和国家银行。他采取了反对奴隶制扩张的立场，但没有转向废奴主义的危险领域。他与纽约州政治关系密切，他的当选无疑将在这个关键州激励该党。

a39352330a6fa1d05d65b91df51e88083f3d3d2d.source: Miller and I agree on just about everything. I chose him because I believe we represent the future of this country.
a39352330a6fa1d05d65b91df51e88083f3d3d2d.zh: 米勒和我几乎在所有事情上都意见一致。我选择他，是因为我相信，我们代表着这个国家的未来。

e86b8365a87627458e7f72bdf65b5034439467c1.source: Millions of American men accepted their responsibilities and served admirably, but I can see the case for an eventual pardon. Perhaps towards the end of my term.
e86b8365a87627458e7f72bdf65b5034439467c1.zh: 数百万美国男子承担了责任，光荣地服役。不过，我能理解最终予以赦免的理由，或许可以在任期临近结束时进行。

a624716cf74a27d894f030cb75a5ec66d8002d11.source: Millions of satisfied Americans are watching you embrace the legacy of Clinton and pledge to continue it.
a624716cf74a27d894f030cb75a5ec66d8002d11.zh: 数百万满意的美国人正在看着您拥抱 克林顿 的遗产并承诺继续下去。

2fac2c402da10db996ed382fdf7bb442d95a40e3.zh: 米兰达诉 亚利桑那州

a8b196bbee6a2a4a9867bd4175a434280339d27f.source: Mitt Romney enters the 2012 campaign as the Republican challenger. He has a record of public service as the former Governor of Massachusetts and he also headed Bain Capital for many years. He is generally perceived as a pro-business moderate and a competent manager.
a8b196bbee6a2a4a9867bd4175a434280339d27f.zh: 米特·罗姆尼 作为共和党挑战者进入 2012 年竞选活动。他拥有作为 马萨诸塞州 前州长的公共服务记录，并且还领导贝恩资本多年。他通常被认为是一位支持商业的温和派和一位称职的管理者。

2762c557f1030fbfd742bfef4a7aad85095829ee.source: Mitt Romney was the CEO of Bain Capital for many years. What can you say about his time at that firm?
2762c557f1030fbfd742bfef4a7aad85095829ee.zh: 米特·罗姆尼曾多年担任贝恩资本首席执行官。关于他在这家公司的经历，你有什么话要说？

ecc865d1566321b6f70dd57ee1299e7ac8a24d8f.source: Mitt and I certainly have our differences, but his story of success at Bain Capital is an admirable example of American enterprise in action.
ecc865d1566321b6f70dd57ee1299e7ac8a24d8f.zh: 米特和我当然有分歧，但他在贝恩资本的成功经历，是美国企业精神发挥作用的可敬典范。

6fd986833765e9460f3fd36a9952c7657ae9a86a.source: Moderate Republicans have been quite dissatisfied with the course of Goldwater’s campaign, and many major figures on the liberal-moderate wing have refused to endorse him. There may be an opportunity to win these moderates over. Should we go for it?
6fd986833765e9460f3fd36a9952c7657ae9a86a.zh: 温和派共和党人对戈德华特的竞选走向十分不满，自由派和温和派中的许多重要人物都拒绝为他背书。我们也许有机会争取这些温和派。要试一试吗？

3b42a83bc05fdf80e250b09243fc974f08ca8ace.source: Moderates like this appeal, even if it disappoints liberals and activists nationwide. Will it be enough to push you over the top?
3b42a83bc05fdf80e250b09243fc974f08ca8ace.zh: 温和派喜欢这一呼吁，尽管它让全国各地的自由派和活动家失望。这足以让你取得最后的胜利吗？

076b65a84b4f13caf3d5f81d49a805ffa96efccd.source: More drama on the Trump University front. People just don't understand!
076b65a84b4f13caf3d5f81d49a805ffa96efccd.zh: 特朗普大学方面，又有一出戏。大家就是不理解！

f196c3b58998c76957c915de57bc306dd4d76a48.source: More sound and fury from your camp.
f196c3b58998c76957c915de57bc306dd4d76a48.zh: 你们这边又是一阵雷声大雨点小。

8c4cf734b9b3dab603af64f316b5fee95736a5cd.source: More tax cuts are not part of the Democratic Party orthodoxy at this point.
8c4cf734b9b3dab603af64f316b5fee95736a5cd.zh: 进一步减税，目前并不符合民主党的主流政策立场。

2580de3b98708938d84e0633292789c1f9eaa701.source: More tweets. More pearl clutching from the media. Maybe you know something they don't?
2580de3b98708938d84e0633292789c1f9eaa701.zh: 推文更多了，媒体大惊小怪的次数也更多了。也许你知道些他们不知道的事？

aff7aa14d1b2cb6440d639134b625fc75bbc4f9b.source: Most Americans want to see an increase in the minimum wage, and I stand by my support for this measure.
aff7aa14d1b2cb6440d639134b625fc75bbc4f9b.zh: 多数美国人希望提高最低工资，我仍坚持支持这项措施。

e718cc86f0fc7d1fa19ed9b1c325de6669f241b7.source: Most Americans wonder if you hit your head the wrong way getting out of bed this morning.
e718cc86f0fc7d1fa19ed9b1c325de6669f241b7.zh: 大多数美国人怀疑，你今天早上起床时是不是把脑袋撞坏了。

8b2baa657885777d8ecd04d64940db0a94e79a22.source: Most Republicans do not support widespread bailout programs.
8b2baa657885777d8ecd04d64940db0a94e79a22.zh: 多数共和党人不支持大范围的救助计划。

899e031ec8de09bcf927b767549b73f786e48042.source: Most Republicans favor this Amendment after the overreach of FDR. Many wonder why you see things differently.
899e031ec8de09bcf927b767549b73f786e48042.zh: 在富兰克林·罗斯福越权之后，大多数共和党人支持这项修正案。许多人不明白，你为什么持不同看法。

39907ea663416c0245e79f6e89c767f2de50ada7.source: Most foreign companies also build their cars in the United States and employ thousands of Americans. This policy would be like robbing Peter to pay Paul.
39907ea663416c0245e79f6e89c767f2de50ada7.zh: 多数外国公司也在美国制造汽车，雇用数千名美国人。这种政策无异于拆东墙补西墙。

0af3a213367367cce31acad5edc5e510d86a83c5.source: Most in your party disagree. On the other hand, you do come from a region that opposes gun control.
0af3a213367367cce31acad5edc5e510d86a83c5.zh: 党内多数人并不赞同。不过，你确实来自一个反对枪支管制的地区。

2d5b09222863a2cc803ffad011144bdc337250da.source: Most people seem to think that your debates were inconclusive and will have little effect on the race.
2d5b09222863a2cc803ffad011144bdc337250da.zh: 多数人似乎认为，辩论没有分出高下，对选情也不会有什么影响。

f4cae885c843abac1cde39cac962f2e6a3abfec1.source: Most respected economists are highly critical of trade restrictions and protectionism, yet your running-mate is well known for espousing these positions. Is that something you also embrace?
f4cae885c843abac1cde39cac962f2e6a3abfec1.zh: 大多数受尊重的经济学家都严厉批评贸易限制和保护主义，但你的搭档以支持这些立场著称。你是否也认同？

6a3006d7ea84fdfad164356da57c5d0e33efc206.source: Mr. Clay has certainly shown unusual reticence on the Texas issue, but many Southern Whigs are perfectly fine people.
6a3006d7ea84fdfad164356da57c5d0e33efc206.zh: 克莱先生在得克萨斯问题上确实异常缄默，但许多南方辉格党人都很不错。

048fb460d5837455fc78456d17900bf663944e7b.source: Mr. Dukakis was simply following the law as handed down in
048fb460d5837455fc78456d17900bf663944e7b.zh: 杜卡基斯先生只是在遵循

872402c4edde512cf7c730766fccbcd3135f2f42.source: Mr. McKinley, don't be naive. You have the press on your side, now use it!
872402c4edde512cf7c730766fccbcd3135f2f42.zh: 麦金莱先生，别天真了。新闻界站在你这一边，就好好利用它！

3736a90390386acd2cda6b8f38bc174ea96d6d89.source: Mr. Reagan's words are his own. I admire the President, but I would never go so far as to throw names at our opponent.
3736a90390386acd2cda6b8f38bc174ea96d6d89.zh: 里根先生的话是他自己的意见。我敬重总统，但绝不会过分到用辱骂称呼攻击我们的对手。

9168e32766f1e842df904cfc433d70c5a20504d4.source: Mr. Trump's attacks are grotesque and outrageous. I trust that Americans of all persuasions will vote this type of rhetoric down in November.
9168e32766f1e842df904cfc433d70c5a20504d4.zh: 特朗普先生的攻击怪诞、骇人。我相信，不同立场的美国人都会在十一月用选票拒绝这种言辞。

dcc6f3876b616bc1e6f58ba6f5ccbb6473af1267.source: Mr. Trump's gross and outlandish rhetoric should disgust any decent, hard-working women in our society. We need to show that there is no place for this rhetoric.
dcc6f3876b616bc1e6f58ba6f5ccbb6473af1267.zh: 特朗普先生粗俗、离谱的言辞，应该让社会中每一位正派、勤奋的女性反感。我们需要表明，这种言辞没有立足之地。

c917ff9a2d7ecaa8b4019ac5ec3fd6467cb29fd2.source: Mr. Wilson has veered between ineptness on the one hand, and sudden, radical solutions on the other. I am the safe, pragmatic alternative in this contest.
c917ff9a2d7ecaa8b4019ac5ec3fd6467cb29fd2.zh: 威尔逊先生一会儿无能失措，一会儿又突然推出激进的解决办法。在这场竞选中，我是稳妥、务实的选择。

88722b3f13e0ecd2223d5b226aa9419a1611430d.source: McKinley is a Civil War veteran and a patriot, but he is also the favorite. You need to vigorous if you're to have a chance.
88722b3f13e0ecd2223d5b226aa9419a1611430d.zh: 麦金莱是内战老兵，也是爱国者，而且还是领先的热门人选。你要想有机会，就必须加把劲。

1226b74cfaad27106197eb57a4e1f803fe1df697.source: McKinley is a fanatical defender of an obsolete monetary system. He is a front-man for big business and the New York financiers.
1226b74cfaad27106197eb57a4e1f803fe1df697.zh: 麦金莱狂热地维护一套过时的货币制度。他是大企业与纽约金融家的台前傀儡。

d4054fd140ea34c74a00f31ebe5503f3158104a4.source: McKinley will make the case for traditional Republican policies, including a strong defense of the gold standard.
d4054fd140ea34c74a00f31ebe5503f3158104a4.zh: 麦金莱将捍卫传统共和党政策，尤其是坚定维护金本位制。

bfa009065236799a1b44fa680aa0c92db103ecde.source: McKinley will run a radical pro-monopolist Administration that should frighten any ordinary American.
bfa009065236799a1b44fa680aa0c92db103ecde.zh: 麦金莱将组成一个激进地支持垄断者的政府，任何普通美国人都该感到害怕。

7a8568fe8f508ce4a1d41171afab9e4f77e1c181.source: McKinley's insistence on the gold standard has alienated many prominent Republicans from his own party, such as Henry Teller.
7a8568fe8f508ce4a1d41171afab9e4f77e1c181.zh: 麦金莱坚持金本位，已经让亨利·特勒等许多重要的共和党人疏远了自己的党。

90a840a383435b43bb8f087f268b2868249c6d30.source: McKinley's support of high tariffs is a crime which strangles American commerce. Similar protectionist programs have twice been rejected by American voters in the past ten years alone.
90a840a383435b43bb8f087f268b2868249c6d30.zh: 麦金莱支持高关税，这是扼杀美国商业的罪行。仅在过去十年中，美国选民就已两次拒绝了类似的贸易保护政策。

5536b346ed290841c91e32ec13a37b78960adfc9.source: Medicare is a good program. We need to find some way of controlling costs and of more effectively managing care, but the overall program is sound.
5536b346ed290841c91e32ec13a37b78960adfc9.zh: 联邦医疗保险是个好计划。我们需要想办法控制成本、更有效地管理医疗服务，但整个计划是健全的。

6bfcbaf7600898cf5920e054e6ab6546986c5b9c.source: Medicare is only the beginning of what we need to do in this country. I support a national health care system for all Americans.
6bfcbaf7600898cf5920e054e6ab6546986c5b9c.zh: 老年医疗保险只是我国必要改革的开端。我支持为所有美国人建立全国性的医疗保障制度。

b67ac6c2668f405edbd0dd8472534a37d6be7c10.source: Medicare is the first step towards socialized medicine in this country. We need to end this program as soon as possible and return health care to the states and to the people.
b67ac6c2668f405edbd0dd8472534a37d6be7c10.zh: 老年医疗保险，是我国走向医疗社会化的第一步。我们必须尽快终止这项计划，把医疗事务重新交还各州和人民。

c6c20080e2319bd14eb420d8b997b259239a0fb1.source: Meese is under a cloud of suspicion, and it is better not to tie yourself too closely to his fortunes.
c6c20080e2319bd14eb420d8b997b259239a0fb1.zh: 米斯正笼罩在疑云之下，最好别把自己的前途与他绑得太紧。

dfe822a7848dce14e80f214ebdf62e5ff6d13988.source: Mentioning Hillary Clinton is always a good way to keep your party unified.
dfe822a7848dce14e80f214ebdf62e5ff6d13988.zh: 提到希拉里·克林顿，总是维持本党团结的好办法。

2127108ac9ef8509ee67e9ce74e0707d94c35175.source: Mexicans are beautiful, beautiful people. It's unfortunate how some people in the media tried to twist a couple of words around to make it sound like something completely different. But that's how they operate.
2127108ac9ef8509ee67e9ce74e0707d94c35175.zh: 墨西哥人是很美好、很美好的人民。有些媒体人把几个词歪曲成完全不同的意思，实在遗憾。但他们就是这样干事的。

dae3e277341ef3fe572cd9efa720128d75b9d423.source: Mexico has been in turmoil for years, and anyone with foresight could have anticipated the problems that have arisen from our undefended border. Wilson did not.
dae3e277341ef3fe572cd9efa720128d75b9d423.zh: 墨西哥多年来动荡不安。任何有远见的人，都能预料到边境缺乏防卫会引发这些问题，威尔逊却没能做到。

6a3a6317ed67ed5bdbc391d0fac086771488bd80.source: Mr. Wilson's vacillations on the issue have emboldened potential adversaries and led to unfortunate events like the sinking of the
6a3a6317ed67ed5bdbc391d0fac086771488bd80.zh: 威尔逊 先生在这个问题上的犹豫不决，让潜在的对手更加胆大妄为，并导致了诸如沉船之类的不幸事件。

f2de847e4dc3d40b78d1f267c4bce342a6093747.source: Mr. Woodbury was a critical part of Jackson and Van Buren's Cabinets, and he has the right viewpoint on the Treasury and tariff questions.
f2de847e4dc3d40b78d1f267c4bce342a6093747.zh: 伍德伯里先生是杰克逊和范布伦内阁中的重要成员，在国库和关税问题上，也持有正确的观点。

ab3d82c48b29257f0a87ab47c5cef3bc7616fa57.source: Much as changed, but I stand as committed to the ideals of the New Freedom as I was in 1912. I will be circumspect about committing the country to further federal legislation, beyond that which we have achieved during my first term.
ab3d82c48b29257f0a87ab47c5cef3bc7616fa57.zh: 许多事情已经改变，但我依然像1912年那样，坚定信奉“新自由”的理想。在第一任期已有成果之外，我会谨慎对待进一步推动联邦立法的承诺。

e4be3ddc4c48de0a4ea4412581c0d23b50545063.source: Much of California's livelihood comes from gold mining. I reject any call to undermine gold through the free coinage of silver.
e4be3ddc4c48de0a4ea4412581c0d23b50545063.zh: 加利福尼亚很大一部分生计来自金矿。我反对一切通过白银自由铸币削弱黄金地位的主张。

d5a78d3de076d11628bc3591453c0946912dd0b2.source: Much of the party, LBJ, moderates, and conservative Democrats are extremely elated. It proves to the country you’re not a radical left-wing, communist sympathizer.
d5a78d3de076d11628bc3591453c0946912dd0b2.zh: 党内许多人、约翰逊、温和派和保守派民主党人都极其高兴。这向全国证明，你不是同情共产主义的激进左翼。

d7d38894d6a0db815391fcb692c07df2c001c1a7.source: Muskie is a Senator from Maine, and although he has a low national profile he could help Humphrey solidify his base and carry the Northeastern states.
d7d38894d6a0db815391fcb692c07df2c001c1a7.zh: 马斯基 是来自 缅因州 的参议员，虽然他的全国知名度较低，但他可以帮助 汉弗莱 巩固他的基础并控制东北各州。

a19ca37d20b7547ff2c3d7e20db5c490f169d85d.source: My God, someone has to step in and protect good order in this society. This is just another instance of federal judges taking control over an issue that's simply none of their business.
a19ca37d20b7547ff2c3d7e20db5c490f169d85d.zh: 天哪，总得有人出面维护这个社会的正常秩序。这又是联邦法官插手一个根本不关他们的事的例子。

e126e72620b57b651db05c42ce5b4becf6a1fcc4.source: My God, this is a truly frightening question. Responsibilities of government need to be turned over to the states, and the federal government needs to be drastically reduced in size.
e126e72620b57b651db05c42ce5b4becf6a1fcc4.zh: 天哪，这个问题真令人害怕。政府职责应交还各州，联邦政府的规模必须大幅缩减。

c140859905257ed6fb4b6c950da20d2bd81be320.source: My administration will bring back the era of the budget surplus, and will work towards the professionalization of the federal government. We will continue to phase out the 'spoils system' in accordance with the Pendleton Act.
c140859905257ed6fb4b6c950da20d2bd81be320.zh: 我的政府将恢复财政盈余，推进联邦行政的专业化。我们将依照《彭德尔顿法》，继续逐步废除“政党分赃制”。

5a0d61edba3a9a9f83907b4a51f0c2fb047afede.source: My biography is an asset to our campaign, and I will not hesitate to emphasize it.
5a0d61edba3a9a9f83907b4a51f0c2fb047afede.zh: 我的个人经历对竞选有利，我会毫不犹豫地强调它。

10482e2e5a1908706bf5e2ffa25113498434ff25.source: My budget will cut taxes and return a portion of our budget surplus to the American people. Everybody who pays taxes will receive a reduction.
10482e2e5a1908706bf5e2ffa25113498434ff25.zh: 我的预算会减税，把部分预算盈余还给美国人民。每个纳税人都能享受减税。

bdb0b407acfb0474b675656dc80fd6bd09169eff.source: My campaign isn't about Bill Clinton. I prefer to focus on the future, and on the issues that will strengthen our country and economy.
bdb0b407acfb0474b675656dc80fd6bd09169eff.zh: 我的竞选不是围绕比尔·克林顿展开的。我愿意关注未来，以及能让国家和经济更加强大的问题。

058beee8b82507ff5545d667b85ff2d5ba397179.source: My campaign will reach out to workers across the American spectrum, while Bryan's policies will leave them defenseless against foreign competition and will debase their wages.
058beee8b82507ff5545d667b85ff2d5ba397179.zh: 我将向美国各界工人争取支持；布赖恩的政策却会让他们在外国竞争面前毫无保障，并使他们的工资贬值。

a1b3b48d9f9aabda2119d5d44bbafdee92d17d3c.source: My conservative credentials are beyond all question. It's really just sour grapes, and not accepting the will of the Republican voters in the primaries which is driving this.
a1b3b48d9f9aabda2119d5d44bbafdee92d17d3c.zh: 我的保守派资历毫无疑问。驱使这些人的，其实就是吃不到葡萄说葡萄酸，不接受共和党初选选民的意愿。

0d39d131523dd83b1aef3bec6256cb26ce2ecf90.source: My faith calls for the true equality of man. Our Constitution enshrines the ideals that each man has God-given rights which cannot be ignored by any earthly power.
0d39d131523dd83b1aef3bec6256cb26ce2ecf90.zh: 我的信仰要求人类真正平等。我们的宪法确立了这些理想：每个人都有上帝赋予的权利，任何世俗权力都不能漠视。

9135633ea00007b45d3df1f86489afc189936474.source: My family has tried for many years to work for change in the Plains Baptist Church, but I can see now that we have failed. I have no choice but to withdraw my membership.
9135633ea00007b45d3df1f86489afc189936474.zh: 我们家多年来一直努力推动普莱恩斯浸信会教堂改变，但我现在看得出，我们失败了。我别无选择，只能退出教会。

88618be6eeeb13e83179922a1580c9275b5c5683.source: My first action as President will be to reinstate higher tariffs. This is an American policy that supports American factories and American workers.
88618be6eeeb13e83179922a1580c9275b5c5683.zh: 我当上总统后的第一件事，就是恢复较高的关税。这是支持美国工厂、美国工人的美国政策。

2779c2e6951fc9ffe78d8dc4e16b30a21ac3624a.source: My goal as President will be to reduce abortions in this country to the lowest level possible. We can increase education and funding for contraception, to reduce unwanted pregnancies. I might be open to ending late-term abortions.
2779c2e6951fc9ffe78d8dc4e16b30a21ac3624a.zh: 作为总统，我的目标是尽可能减少美国的堕胎数量。我们可以加强教育，增加避孕措施的经费，减少意外怀孕。我可能愿意考虑禁止晚期堕胎。

a794cc0898dfc873a6075c8d565557677b95b755.source: My goal from the start has been to create an Administration that looks like the rest of America. I'm proud to have a woman as my running-mate, and you'll see with some of my other picks for Attorney General, Secretary of Defense, and so on, that I'm very serious about giving everyone a shot.
a794cc0898dfc873a6075c8d565557677b95b755.zh: 从一开始，我的目标就是组建一个能代表美国面貌的政府。我很自豪能有一位女性搭档。看看我为司法部长、国防部长等职位选择的其他人选，你就会知道，我确实认真地想给每个人一个机会。

37f612a641abadf1ac2d6e0c137a1be0abd35636.source: My goal is President will be to negotiate a comprehensive peace treaty between North and South Vietnam and end this war. That is the only real solution.
37f612a641abadf1ac2d6e0c137a1be0abd35636.zh: 我担任总统后的目标，是促成南北越全面和平条约，结束这场战争。这才是唯一真正的解决办法。

64c0f0f6ab38cb769d28c13be0ccfd3b1d3ef129.source: My goal is a world without nuclear weapons. While being mindful of reality, I hope to negotiate an expansive agreement that can put an end to the arms race.
64c0f0f6ab38cb769d28c13be0ccfd3b1d3ef129.zh: 我的目标是一个没有核武器的世界。在顾及现实的同时，我希望通过谈判达成广泛协议，终结军备竞赛。

9fe335809fb34b4e2d98f64bea03b741c2ecfa8c.source: My goal is to sweep the South and prevent either candidate from achieving an electoral majority. I will make this region my primary focus.
9fe335809fb34b4e2d98f64bea03b741c2ecfa8c.zh: 我的目标是横扫南方，让其他两位候选人都无法取得选举人票过半数。我会把竞选重点放在这个地区。

822bb8a1db25ac3609ad74004d7f06fe76ffba7c.source: My heart goes out the victims of this shooting. I will be going to Orlando in the next couple of days to pay my respects to the victims.
822bb8a1db25ac3609ad74004d7f06fe76ffba7c.zh: 我由衷地向这次枪击的受害者表达慰问。未来几天，我会去奥兰多，向受害者致意。

7429d08884faa609c1cf4217666daffe89a750c5.source: My heart goes out to the fantastic and resilient people of France, it's one of the most beautiful countries, as they deal with unspeakable tragedy.
7429d08884faa609c1cf4217666daffe89a750c5.zh: 法国是最美丽的国家之一。这个国家了不起而坚韧的人民正承受着无法言说的悲剧，我由衷地向他们表达慰问。

fc1c04227ace4424300ee6ace3b4f71458ffeab6.source: My heart goes out to the victims of this terrible attack. I will give a speech in a few days about the importance of defeating ISIS and religious extremism in all of its forms.
fc1c04227ace4424300ee6ace3b4f71458ffeab6.zh: 我由衷地向这场可怕袭击的受害者表达慰问。几天后，我会发表演说，强调击败“伊斯兰国”和一切形式宗教极端主义的重要性。

fd62942949c64e7c23f348fec1a8221c3dd67d99.source: My heart goes out to the victims of this terrible attack. I will give a speech in a few days about the importance of tolerance and diversity in our society.
fd62942949c64e7c23f348fec1a8221c3dd67d99.zh: 我由衷地向这场可怕袭击的受害者表达慰问。几天后，我会发表演说，强调宽容和多元在我们社会中的重要性。

51a89480fe5cdd1e05667d2ce9d8c485e204a2af.source: My heart goes out to those affected by this terrible attack. My thoughts and prayers are with the great nation of France, and I will travel to France to pay my respects to the victims.
51a89480fe5cdd1e05667d2ce9d8c485e204a2af.zh: 我由衷地向所有受这场可怕袭击影响的人表达慰问。我牵挂伟大的法国，为它祈祷，也会前往法国，向受害者致意。

641117bed4a39540b177d66ddd334b0b1bc7e112.source: My history as Governor of New York shows that I can balance the need for reform with respect for established institutions.
641117bed4a39540b177d66ddd334b0b1bc7e112.zh: 我担任纽约州州长的经历表明，我能够在改革需要与尊重现有制度之间取得平衡。

0d63ff9f2b6b556eb30aa72b389e4705babbb277.source: My internal polling shows we have a real shot at Texas. Why wouldn't I campaign there?
0d63ff9f2b6b556eb30aa72b389e4705babbb277.zh: 我们的内部民调显示，我们在得克萨斯州确实有机会。我为什么不去那里竞选？

70573d25b9f318181799c01887b578bec764b22e.source: My message will be a message of hope. After four years of economic blight the American people need to feel good about themselves, and they need to know that their efforts will be rewarded with material prosperity.
70573d25b9f318181799c01887b578bec764b22e.zh: 我传递的将是希望。经历四年经济萧条，美国人民需要重新振作，也需要知道，努力将换来物质上的繁荣。

aceead578acf213a8e8f562441a51bf83522fa8f.source: My opponent will raise taxes, and so will I. He won't tell you. I just did.
aceead578acf213a8e8f562441a51bf83522fa8f.zh: 我的对手会加税，我也会。他不会告诉你，而我刚刚说了。

bc1107af7fd34b9fe99f0db77786577671ee2f03.source: My opponent's ideas are almost as dangerous to the survival of the United States as the Democratic traitors were in the 1860s.
bc1107af7fd34b9fe99f0db77786577671ee2f03.zh: 我对手的主张危及美国的存续，危险程度几乎不亚于1860年代那些民主党叛徒。

1b909511e0f3a0ff2f5336ce13f406aaee8e7fa8.source: My opposition to the annexation of Texas is known, but we could more explicitly tie that maneuver to the expansion of slavery.
1b909511e0f3a0ff2f5336ce13f406aaee8e7fa8.zh: 我反对吞并得克萨斯的立场已经众所周知，不过我们可以更明确地指出，这一举动与扩张奴隶制之间的联系。

5fa558b066f57b2e24416a70bf2bde7d8710a01e.source: My party and I support the acquisition of Cuba, and of other territories if possible.
5fa558b066f57b2e24416a70bf2bde7d8710a01e.zh: 我和本党都支持取得古巴，并在可能的情况下取得其他领土。

5d128c4f2e08e9764b0b99ff38dff9e3c7ffc562.source: My plan was a good plan for Massachusetts. Obamacare is bad because it forces an individual mandate on the American public.
5d128c4f2e08e9764b0b99ff38dff9e3c7ffc562.zh: 我的计划很适合马萨诸塞州。奥巴马医改不好，因为它强迫美国公众接受个人强制投保。

ddfb068d746045b8f78f034d4c844c0534088088.source: My plan was effective for Massachusetts because that state has better human capital. The United States as a whole has too much obesity, diabetes, and chronic illness to make collective insurance viable.
ddfb068d746045b8f78f034d4c844c0534088088.zh: 我的计划在马萨诸塞州有效，是因为该州的人力资本质量更好。美国整体的肥胖、糖尿病和慢性病太多，集体投保无法维持。

3f26c8a049e12b9f4374344778950ff355b90475.source: My policies will work better at cracking down on unlawfulness, because I'm actually going to address the root issues that have caused this recent trouble.
3f26c8a049e12b9f4374344778950ff355b90475.zh: 我的政策能更有效地打击违法行为，因为我会真正解决导致近来动荡的根本问题。

9a3d28dda7dbe014144ac7198dd5c89ee38d5814.source: My position on Texas is known. I will explain my own background more carefully, and emphasize that the Democrats are a national party that fights for the benefit of all sections.
9a3d28dda7dbe014144ac7198dd5c89ee38d5814.zh: 我在得克萨斯问题上的立场已经众所周知。我将更详细地介绍自己的背景，强调民主党是一个全国性政党，为各地区的利益而奋斗。

d09041d38dd9788d26845134ecf011787f570536.source: My position on this issue is clear, but we're going to focus on immigration and other issues more than trade.
d09041d38dd9788d26845134ecf011787f570536.zh: 我在这个问题上的立场很清楚，但我们会更多聚焦移民和其他议题，而不是贸易。

0c796921a9badeefcbd6fbfe1cd4538ae187bb16.source: My position on this system has not changed -- I cannot support the creation of a federal program to lend money directly to farmers.
0c796921a9badeefcbd6fbfe1cd4538ae187bb16.zh: 我对这个制度的立场没有改变——我不能支持建立一个直接向农民放贷的联邦计划。

58650ad5af727958563bb639aef84ac57e265390.source: My primary focus is to return law and order to this country. The riots, the murders, the drug use, and the protests we've seen since 1965 are unacceptable.
58650ad5af727958563bb639aef84ac57e265390.zh: 我的首要任务是恢复这个国家的法律与秩序。自1965年以来出现的骚乱、谋杀、吸毒和抗议，令人无法接受。

04bbb613b461fc623ed4a026893f1a4ef5321e8c.source: My priority as President will be to fight for law and order in this country. The Court had good intentions but I am concerned that they overstepped their bounds in these cases.
04bbb613b461fc623ed4a026893f1a4ef5321e8c.zh: 担任总统后，我的首要任务是为这个国家的法律与秩序而奋斗。最高法院的本意是好的，但我担心这些案件的判决超出了它的权限。

ed3367a4f253fadcd2890f5796ecd780e424170b.source: My record as Governor of New York shows that I am willing to enact progressive reforms, and to combat machine politics. I will bring this mentality to the national stage as President.
ed3367a4f253fadcd2890f5796ecd780e424170b.zh: 我担任纽约州州长的政绩表明，我愿意推行进步主义改革，打击政治机器。作为总统，我会把这种作风带到全国。

d516fd6c4bae33cde38850f8ec30d1aee05135d5.source: My record over the past four years speaks to itself. Record low unemplyoment. Terrific success with tax cuts and foreign policy. If it wasn't for China releasing COVID, this election wouldn't even be a contest.
d516fd6c4bae33cde38850f8ec30d1aee05135d5.zh: 过去四年的政绩说明了一切。创纪录的低失业率，减税和外交上的出色成功。要不是中国放出新冠病毒，这场选举根本就没有悬念。

af59b87285cd14a61c532b0cecd199c7dcd4bd08.source: My record speaks for itself. For the time being, we just need to keep the party energized and avoid any statements which might be deemed as controversial.
af59b87285cd14a61c532b0cecd199c7dcd4bd08.zh: 我的政绩已经说明了一切。眼下，我们只需要保持党内热情，避免任何可能被认为有争议的言论。

984e48feed01e6b1275b5d9352b04254ac97a6bd.source: My speech fill focus on our success in avoiding the war in Europe, along with a promise that we will continue to take every effort to avoid provocation in that theatre.
984e48feed01e6b1275b5d9352b04254ac97a6bd.zh: 我的演说将着重谈我们成功避免卷入欧洲战争，并承诺继续竭尽所能，避免在那个战场上制造事端。

bc2112fb42e834ca1e8210a73e722cec9ca3f562.source: My speech will hinge on a defense of liberalism and on the strong economy. I will call for a truce in Vietnam and for a truce on the racial issues in our country.
bc2112fb42e834ca1e8210a73e722cec9ca3f562.zh: 我的演讲将取决于对自由主义和强劲经济的捍卫。我将呼吁在越南停火，并在我国的种族问题上停火。

c2860fc86fd9905cd9f1ab3c4bd57ab9689ee938.source: My surrogates have plenty of points to make about the failure of the Obama Administration. As the nominee, I will take the high road and stick to a message of optimism and American renewal.
c2860fc86fd9905cd9f1ab3c4bd57ab9689ee938.zh: 我的竞选代言人有很多话，可以用来说明奥巴马政府的失败。作为提名人，我会保持风度，坚持传递乐观和美国振兴的信息。

3ab05ffce7aa748e5c92543621c3cbaec17ff146.source: My vote in favor of this authorization was one of the toughest of my career. And I will admit, the war didn't go as well as Bush promised it would. But ultimately, we removed a murderous dictator and replaced him a parliamentary democracy.
3ab05ffce7aa748e5c92543621c3cbaec17ff146.zh: 投票赞成这项授权，是我整个政治生涯中最艰难的决定之一。我承认，战争进展并不像布什承诺的那样顺利。但最终，我们推翻了一位残暴的独裁者，建立了议会民主制度。

c7aca6f2fd69cd9970caf4dd02f331e1b585a95b.source: My wife's public approval rating is something like 75%. I wish I had her touch with the media.
c7aca6f2fd69cd9970caf4dd02f331e1b585a95b.zh: 我妻子的公众支持率好像有75%。真希望我也有她应对媒体的本领。

70ba475a8eae1ad3c454684bf2f141f190e49e57.source: NOTE: scenario created in March 2016, may not reflect subsequent events.
70ba475a8eae1ad3c454684bf2f141f190e49e57.zh: 注意：本剧本制作于2016年3月，可能未反映此后发生的事件。

b227e56692cdefeb4f258bded12b84431611cb03.source: National health insurance is not a Republican issue.
b227e56692cdefeb4f258bded12b84431611cb03.zh: 全国医疗保险不是共和党的议题。

da0cdb8dcdbace7e5ae3b11a97fb76a248b24ff6.source: Nationalize the railroads? What has gotten into you? You might as well quit now, you'll never win in November.
da0cdb8dcdbace7e5ae3b11a97fb76a248b24ff6.zh: 铁路国有化？你这是怎么了？不如现在就退出吧，你十一月绝不可能赢。

330d60b6d96077aa2969fe3addf03ce6e73406d9.source: Nativism appears to be on the rise, but you are probably better off, on the whole, taking a more moderate tack.
330d60b6d96077aa2969fe3addf03ce6e73406d9.zh: 本土主义似乎正在抬头，不过总体而言，你大概还是采取较温和的路线更好。

a8d479eaf739fa9cfd63c1bc9b63a132fee10104.source: Nearly every Republican in Congress voted in support of Taft-Hartley, and Robert Taft is a key member of the party. There is definitely consternation at your stance.
a8d479eaf739fa9cfd63c1bc9b63a132fee10104.zh: 国会中几乎所有共和党人都投票支持《塔夫脱—哈特利法》，罗伯特·塔夫脱也是本党的重要人物。你的立场确实让党内感到不安。

069e685ceb1cd9c12de32416eaae382434bacd8b.source: Needless to say, Obama is very popular among African-Americans and should help you maintain turnout in that demographic.
069e685ceb1cd9c12de32416eaae382434bacd8b.zh: 不用说，奥巴马在非裔美国人中非常受欢迎，应该能帮你维持这一群体的投票率。

ddc27d1eb54076bf1a76d12260fe5dfda81efc31.source: Negroes take offense to your response, viewing it as parroting Nixon and worse, Wallace. Even right-wing whites admit that you echo Wallace.
ddc27d1eb54076bf1a76d12260fe5dfda81efc31.zh: 黑人对你的回应感到冒犯，认为你在鹦鹉学舌地重复尼克松，甚至更糟，重复华莱士的话。连右翼白人都承认，你在附和华莱士。

6ac7278cc44e6b4d8701743707b43d59e6ad22f2.source: Negroes vigorously applaud you, but most whites do not believe police overreacted when quelling the riots.
6ac7278cc44e6b4d8701743707b43d59e6ad22f2.zh: 黑人热烈地为你鼓掌，但多数白人不认为警察平息骚乱时反应过度。

31e2bccac268e68e6be3ff83e13b0e2cff3353b9.source: Nelson Rockefeller is a very capable man, and I will be proud to have him serve as my Vice President.
31e2bccac268e68e6be3ff83e13b0e2cff3353b9.zh: 纳尔逊·洛克菲勒十分能干。由他担任我的副总统，我会感到自豪。

04de1b3630e75bcebabce22be5f9fe06960a8242.source: Nelson Rockefeller is the well-known and popular Governor of New York. Currently he refuses to serve as Vice President. However, if he was given assurances that he is the Republican heir apparent, and additional promises that Nixon will run as a liberal Republican with a strong stance on civil rights, he might be persuaded. With Rockefeller on the ticket, victory in New York will be nearly assured, as will defeat in the South.
04de1b3630e75bcebabce22be5f9fe06960a8242.zh: 纳尔逊·洛克菲勒 是 纽约州 著名且受欢迎的总督。目前他拒绝担任副总统。然而，如果他得到保证他是共和党的法定继承人，并额外承诺 尼克松 将作为一个对 民权 持强硬立场的自由共和党人参选，他可能会被说服。有了洛克菲勒，纽约州的胜利几乎已成定局，南方的失败也将如此。

8cf84b65c04ef05eae6b328cc2203d17c65bb848.source: Never Trumpers wince as Ted Cruz finally endorses you.
8cf84b65c04ef05eae6b328cc2203d17c65bb848.zh: 特德·克鲁兹终于背书支持你，“绝不支持特朗普”阵营的人看得直皱眉。

94bcafe684ac5bce08582c4d1f61d14bc377aa07.source: Never has a candidate been so far ahead in a Presidential election, only to come up short. After your heartbreaking loss in 1960, it's going to take a long while for you to recover from this new defeat.
94bcafe684ac5bce08582c4d1f61d14bc377aa07.zh: 从来没有哪个候选人在总统选举中遥遥领先，却最终落败。在经历了 1960 年令人心碎的失败之后，你需要很长时间才能从这次新的失败中恢复过来。

85f75d2110d6ababefa58028e3f668a88084ba7b.source: New York and California are important states, and of course I support the uplift of primitive peoples with American influence. What's not to like in this arrangement?
85f75d2110d6ababefa58028e3f668a88084ba7b.zh: 纽约和加利福尼亚很重要。当然，我也支持通过美国的影响，提升原始民族的文明水平。这种安排有什么不好？

6099cbe84c01375f3536eb6da99ad84a64794ff1.source: New York is a traditional Democratic stronghold, and I'm confident that the people of that state will support my message. We will campaign there extensively.
6099cbe84c01375f3536eb6da99ad84a64794ff1.zh: 纽约是民主党的传统重镇，我相信，该州人民会支持我的主张。我们将在那里大力竞选。

d91f61d3c18bc4d14c599e36d423a8cc36bb7d12.source: New York politics are dominated by a highly corrupt, patronage-based outfit known as Tammany Hall. Their boss, Richard Croker, has so far been indifferent to your campaign. Are you willing to make concessions to arouse his enthusiasm?
d91f61d3c18bc4d14c599e36d423a8cc36bb7d12.zh: 纽约政坛被一个高度腐败、靠官职酬庸维系的组织所掌控，人称坦慕尼协会。它的头目理查德·克罗克，到目前为止，对你的竞选态度冷淡。你愿意作些让步，激起他的热情吗？

cdfca99dfa6086f3605255a04b8c0ed151835289.source: New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.
cdfca99dfa6086f3605255a04b8c0ed151835289.zh: 纽约州、新泽西州和宾夕法尼亚州。

7978662cbabfd7ccc3e9ab680c36d45bf483ce5c.source: New York. A lot of things will need to go right for you to win there this year.
7978662cbabfd7ccc3e9ab680c36d45bf483ce5c.zh: 纽约州。今年要想在这里获胜，许多事情都得恰好顺利才行。

21f4bb478a1d037f534c6686e60b42f838785639.source: Newton Baker has served as Secretary of War since the early part of 1916. Some advisors are encouraging Wilson to replace Marshall with Baker. The two have a much better working relationship, and Baker was formerly the mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. His nomination may help in Ohio, but it would also create headlines and arouse some Marshall supporters.
21f4bb478a1d037f534c6686e60b42f838785639.zh: 牛顿·贝克 自 1916 年初以来一直担任战争部长。一些顾问鼓励 威尔逊 用 贝克 取代 马歇尔。两人的工作关系要好得多，贝克曾任克利夫兰市市长，俄亥俄州。他的提名可能会对俄亥俄州有所帮助，但也会成为头条新闻并激起一些马歇尔支持者。

88310d03fe14a077a8e56fa90ef540059d2bb053.source: Newton Baker is the best man for the job. Regardless of any political gossip, the President needs a reliable working partner as Vice President.
88310d03fe14a077a8e56fa90ef540059d2bb053.zh: 牛顿·贝克是担任这个职位的最佳人选。不管政界有什么闲言碎语，总统都需要一位可靠的副总统作为工作搭档。

37297fdd374564278fb8835b8fc739a1648143e0.source: Newton Baker is the progressive choice for Vice President, and I have every confidence in his abilities.
37297fdd374564278fb8835b8fc739a1648143e0.zh: 牛顿·贝克是副总统人选中的进步派选择，我对他的能力完全有信心。

120680b39788ff08f9ff2428c16fad8da40b5879.source: Nice rant, but it’s quite extreme and has horrified Democrats.
120680b39788ff08f9ff2428c16fad8da40b5879.zh: 骂得痛快，但实在太极端，把民主党人吓坏了。

79649e1b1abefaa46fa8bab402a9754ac2ca936f.source: Nice try, but you’re attempting to appeal to those who distrust you and are firmly in Nixon’s camp. Worse, the black community has taken your choice of words as a racist dog whistle.
79649e1b1abefaa46fa8bab402a9754ac2ca936f.zh: 尝试不错，但你试图争取的，是那些不信任你、又坚定站在尼克松阵营的人。更糟的是，黑人群体把你的措辞视为带有种族主义暗示的“狗哨”。

244b0c3fd5dedac5ce9caccc711ee9cd400365d4.source: Nigel Farage is a member of the European Parliament, founder of UKIP and was the architect of the UK's vote to leave the European Union last year, and is one of the few commentators who predict you've got a shot, and as something of a charismatic himself, is willing to fly in to coach you in the coming debate.
244b0c3fd5dedac5ce9caccc711ee9cd400365d4.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇是欧洲议会议员、英国独立党的创始人，也是去年英国投票脱离欧盟的推动者。他是少数认为你有望获胜的评论者之一，自己也颇具个人魅力，愿意飞来指导你准备即将举行的辩论。

fe130096d55efa2f84ad8fc2beb67b96dd2b4625.source: Nikita Khrushchev, Premier of the Soviet Union, has been overthrown by Leonid Brezhnev! This has hurt the Goldwater campaign, which has been using belligerent quotes from Khrushchev to gather votes from foreign policy minded voters.
fe130096d55efa2f84ad8fc2beb67b96dd2b4625.zh: 苏联总理尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫被列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫推翻了！戈德华特阵营一直利用赫鲁晓夫的好战言论，争取关注外交政策的选民，这次事件让他们受到打击。

d78b9ff2d069c8e16cf6498e3a287e25a2d17bae.source: Nikki Haley has served as the Governor of South Carolina, and as a UN Ambassador. She could help you moderate your image and try to close the female vote. Choosing her would probably lead to hard feelings between yourself and Pence, but would your voters care?
d78b9ff2d069c8e16cf6498e3a287e25a2d17bae.zh: 妮基·黑利 曾担任 南卡罗来纳州 的州长，并担任联合国大使。她可以帮助你调整你的形象并尝试关闭女性投票。选择她可能会导致你和 彭斯 之间产生不愉快的感觉，但你的选民会在乎吗？

ece9a68afb3483555ce984772f4e8f0cb5fa84a7.source: Nixon agreed to debate you, but unfortunately he did not repeat his 1960 missteps. The inconclusive outcome does little to change the overall picture of the campaign.
ece9a68afb3483555ce984772f4e8f0cb5fa84a7.zh: 尼克松同意与你辩论，但不幸的是，他没有重蹈1960年的覆辙。辩论未分胜负，几乎没有改变竞选的总体局势。

816782b754830862445c46575a4ff05dfe59e04a.source: Nixon attempts to present himself as a law-and-order candidate who will bear the standard of Republicanism.
816782b754830862445c46575a4ff05dfe59e04a.zh: 尼克松力图以维护法律与秩序的候选人形象，扛起共和党的旗帜。

0b81f7efd00b4b2997cb82a613f698684a034450.source: Nixon is better known than you are, you're a good debater, and you're telegenic. Why would you not want to debate him?
0b81f7efd00b4b2997cb82a613f698684a034450.zh: 尼克松比你更知名，你擅长辩论，镜头前形象也好。为什么不愿与他辩论呢？

4f847e074a53c7fcac78c73def050ad01c2b0d8b.source: Nixon is our main opponent in key states, such as Ohio, Illinois, and California. We must focus on campaigning against him in these key states, or else, god forbid, Wallace actually deadlocks the Electoral College.
4f847e074a53c7fcac78c73def050ad01c2b0d8b.zh: 尼克松才是我们在俄亥俄州、伊利诺伊州和加利福尼亚州等关键州的主要对手。我们必须在这些州集中火力对付他，否则——但愿不会如此——华莱士真有可能让选举人团陷入僵局。

3c7ee2c9fdddd44cbfeff98be7a271740755a3ab.source: Nixon is questioning your hesitation on this issue. Fortunately, however, the average voter has never heard of Quemoy and Matsu.
3c7ee2c9fdddd44cbfeff98be7a271740755a3ab.zh: 尼克松正质疑你在这个问题上的犹豫。幸好，普通选民从来没听说过金门和马祖。

542d783b278add09a05ec03c5782e7be7a9ee947.source: Nixon needles you a bit on this point, but it isn't too controversial.
542d783b278add09a05ec03c5782e7be7a9ee947.zh: 尼克松在这一点上挖苦了你几句，不过争议不算太大。

afdc457b2b82254c4649a5d84f550bbf8c84267c.source: Nixon refuses to debate you, and most of the voters know it. This will definitely hurt him at the polls.
afdc457b2b82254c4649a5d84f550bbf8c84267c.zh: 尼克松拒绝与你辩论，而且大多数选民都知道。这肯定会损害他的得票表现。

e654ef8e8ddbdf2e8aeafb6d22ea1fb79ad8ae48.source: Nixonland: The Rise of a President and the Fracturing of America
e654ef8e8ddbdf2e8aeafb6d22ea1fb79ad8ae48.zh: 尼克松：总统的崛起与美国的分裂

976d9a3e5112cf007b9272eabe425a2730c5d31e.source: No Democrat has ever been elected President without winning Texas. Even so, liberal supporters are not pleased with this answer.
976d9a3e5112cf007b9272eabe425a2730c5d31e.zh: 还没有哪个民主党人未赢下得克萨斯州却当选总统。即便如此，自由派支持者也不喜欢这个回答。

0aaef4fbbcdf814490ff8fcbe9cf46b06c4dd502.source: No Evidence For Voter Fraud: A Guide To Statistical Claims About The 2020 Election
0aaef4fbbcdf814490ff8fcbe9cf46b06c4dd502.zh: 没有选民欺诈的证据：2020 年选举统计声明指南

c9c5e80188938d9757526f0879e71bd94fcd0074.source: No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, for the first time since 1824. Unfortunately for you, a majority of states have Republican controlled congressional delegations.
c9c5e80188938d9757526f0879e71bd94fcd0074.zh: 没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来的第一次。对您来说不幸的是，大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团。

bafe78cf24ac5eb73d67409f76844203f69db4a8.source: No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Fortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes accordingly.
bafe78cf24ac5eb73d67409f76844203f69db4a8.zh: 没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次出现这种情况。幸运的是，美国大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团，他们将相应地投票。

f0f5e2174fedd5eaf730fd7be396c4e8909ccac9.source: No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Fortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for you accordingly.
f0f5e2174fedd5eaf730fd7be396c4e8909ccac9.zh: 没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次出现这种情况。对您来说幸运的是，美国大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团，他们会相应地为您投票。

f4c596721388f6cdcb5bf31dec3afc702c7baeb3.source: No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. However, this  was entirely irrelevant to your chances as a third-party candidate.
f4c596721388f6cdcb5bf31dec3afc702c7baeb3.zh: 没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次发生这种情况。然而，这与您作为第三方候选人的机会完全无关。

2ca483fb5c2d9d66f9050b757c064d182d7d23c9.source: No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Unfortunately  for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for William McKinley.
2ca483fb5c2d9d66f9050b757c064d182d7d23c9.zh: 没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次发生这种情况。对您来说不幸的是，美国大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团，他们将投票给 威廉·麦金莱。

54bc54ce816b6698aa0f57bea534701b798b8114.source: No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Unfortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for Mitt Romney.
54bc54ce816b6698aa0f57bea534701b798b8114.zh: 没有候选人获得多数选举人票，这是自 1824 年以来第一次发生这种情况。对您来说不幸的是，美国大多数州都有共和党控制的国会代表团，他们将投票给 米特·罗姆尼。

e0ab150bf0a1e823a8f751f1d348e489ca1cde6c.source: No candidate captured an Electoral College majority.
e0ab150bf0a1e823a8f751f1d348e489ca1cde6c.zh: 没有候选人获得 选举人团 多数。

7306070013becbb1379b05bfadc3daf1cb0aa523.source: No candidate has captured an Electoral College majority.
7306070013becbb1379b05bfadc3daf1cb0aa523.zh: 没有候选人获得 选举人团 多数。

ef59e188f49cbcf3ec5caf6039e2a73b11de9240.source: No candidate has won a majority in the Electoral College.
ef59e188f49cbcf3ec5caf6039e2a73b11de9240.zh: 没有候选人在 选举人团 中赢得多数席位。

c65114fed8cb1b45a920d3a257250e3563254f50.source: No candidate secured a majority in the Electoral College.
