However, the Republicans won a majority in Congress and will elevate Trump to the Presidency. Time will tell how things go in that regard. As for you, a long and sometimes ambiguous political career seems to be coming to its end.
c65114fed8cb1b45a920d3a257250e3563254f50.zh: 没有候选人在 选举人团 中获得多数席位。然而，共和党赢得了国会多数席位，并将 特朗普 提升为总统。时间会告诉我们这方面的进展如何。至于你，漫长且有时模糊的政治生涯似乎即将结束。

8a2f390501b21422c780fb5da5bbd6a1b5ab9955.source: No candidate secured a majority in the Electoral College. However, the Republicans won a majority in Congress and will elevate you to the Presidency. Time will tell how things go in that regard. Any mutual affection between you and Congress is predicted to be short-lived, but you've pulled off a number of surprises to get this far.
8a2f390501b21422c780fb5da5bbd6a1b5ab9955.zh: 没有候选人在 选举人团 中获得多数席位。然而，共和党赢得了国会多数席位，并将把你提升为总统。时间会告诉我们这方面的进展如何。预计你和国会之间的任何相互感情都将是短暂的，但你已经取得了许多令人惊讶的成果才能走到这一步。

89f1bca4f69b00b915375a391d0398774f427548.source: No comment really. It's unfortunate that the right-wing media is circulating numerous unfounded rumors about by health. The people will see these are lies as I campaign vigorously over the coming weeks.
89f1bca4f69b00b915375a391d0398774f427548.zh: 我实在没什么可评论的。右翼媒体传播大量关于我健康的无根据谣言，令人遗憾。未来几周，我会积极竞选，让大家看出这些是谎言。

5a76b5ef3f06b0128623adbfd258822bed42e0db.source: No matter how you frame it, you are definitely moderating your position on this issue. Some even discuss a "pivot" again…
5a76b5ef3f06b0128623adbfd258822bed42e0db.zh: 不管你怎么表述，你在这个问题上的立场确实变得更温和了。有些人甚至又开始讨论“转向”……

f1af6fc975ef95be7d7f61961b998016070d8950.source: No matter what she says now, we know Hillary Clinton was a hawk on Iraq, she opposed gay marriage, she loved NAFTA and China, she was anti-illegal immigration, and much more. I don't know how her supporters can trust her.
f1af6fc975ef95be7d7f61961b998016070d8950.zh: 不管她现在怎么说，我们都知道，希拉里·克林顿在伊拉克问题上是鹰派，反对过同性婚姻，热爱过《北美自由贸易协定》和中国，反对过非法移民，还有许多其他事。我不知道她的支持者怎么能信任她。

8a012d4b3d8584cc82a5538829e234fb35caa3ef.source: No matter what she says sometimes, we know Hillary Clinton is weak on national security, supports open borders, radical social change, and probably gun confiscation while we're at it. I don't know how the American people can trust her.
8a012d4b3d8584cc82a5538829e234fb35caa3ef.zh: 不管她有时怎么说，我们都知道，希拉里·克林顿在国家安全上软弱，支持开放边界、激进的社会变革，顺带说一句，大概还支持没收枪支。我不知道美国人民怎么能信任她。

66b11b5bcc8990bcbc97efcac66a13f8c32c0228.source: No one understands the challenges facing the United States on the global stage better than Susan Rice. She has the experience to lead this country in a challenging 21st century world.
66b11b5bcc8990bcbc97efcac66a13f8c32c0228.zh: 没有人比苏珊·赖斯更了解美国在全球舞台上面临的挑战。她有经验，能够在充满挑战的二十一世纪世界中领导这个国家。

912130d0da0b24c15864ab01aa9288ee31060eee.source: No sensible investor would put a dime into the Social Security program if they weren't forced to by law. It is unfair to ask America's workers to put money into a program that has no promise of ever providing them with benefits.
912130d0da0b24c15864ab01aa9288ee31060eee.zh: 如果不是法律强制，没有理性的投资者会把一分钱投入社会保障计划。让美国劳动者缴钱给一个根本不能保证他们最终能领到待遇的计划，是不公平的。

e49582294e8cabddd0074b874650bf9af06437e9.source: No wonder she was working so hard to cheat Bernie Sanders out of the nomination. She's the Goldman Sachs candidate, folks, plain and simple.
e49582294e8cabddd0074b874650bf9af06437e9.zh: 难怪她那么卖力地作弊，剥夺伯尼·桑德斯获得提名的机会。各位，她就是高盛的候选人，明明白白。

8f082007934cd1169750e7c6164ad0de8a216603.source: Not only is this a serious issue, but Harry Truman is complicit in it. It is no secret that he is, along with most Democrats, complacent on the issue of Communist infiltration.
8f082007934cd1169750e7c6164ad0de8a216603.zh: 这不仅是个严重问题，哈里·杜鲁门也负有责任。他和大多数民主党人一样，在共产党渗透问题上掉以轻心，这并不是什么秘密。

48c5e1edc9ef0df14885bc662d7d8b29f4cfa4b0.source: Not only is this answer unorthodox for a Republican, but those tax cuts were your policy!
48c5e1edc9ef0df14885bc662d7d8b29f4cfa4b0.zh: 这个回答不仅不符合共和党通常的立场，而且那些减税本来就是你的政策！

05dd3750fdf3d0ada88cc1f31931155659fe3279.source: Not only will I speak about this issue, but I will use it to attack Truman. I've supported civil rights all along, while Truman seems to have come around at the 11th hour, and for transparent political gain.
05dd3750fdf3d0ada88cc1f31931155659fe3279.zh: 我不仅会谈这个问题，还会用它来抨击杜鲁门。我一直支持民权，而杜鲁门似乎到最后关头才改变态度，目的显然是捞取政治利益。

e13410895151850f16409c689377ae3ea22e4932.source: Not only would this greatly improve working conditions for Americans, it would increase employment by spreading our working hours amongst more people.
e13410895151850f16409c689377ae3ea22e4932.zh: 这不但能大幅改善美国人的劳动条件，还能把工作时数分给更多人，从而增加就业。

14b64e049b1c53f967e2b77e08484f6dd092886a.source: Not particularly. Our campaign would prefer to move on to other issues to be perfectly honest.
14b64e049b1c53f967e2b77e08484f6dd092886a.zh: 没有什么特别的评论。坦率地说，我们的竞选团队更希望转向其他议题。

829acf09cabda1ff52aaa54835839073b4663546.source: Not really. I'm all for compromise between the sections, but how could we have a permanent Amendment to the Constitution? Couldn't we have another Amendment to amend that Amendment?
829acf09cabda1ff52aaa54835839073b4663546.zh: 不太支持。我完全赞成各地区之间的妥协，但我们怎么能有一项永久不变的宪法修正案？难道不能再通过另一项修正案，去修改这一项吗？

01fcf057a6c8742ad2907c98e31414f1018c2961.source: Not really. I'm the President and Carter is an upstart from Georgia. Let's keep it that way.
01fcf057a6c8742ad2907c98e31414f1018c2961.zh: 不太想。我是总统，卡特只是佐治亚州来的新晋人物。还是维持这个局面吧。

4dbf7dcd4438d5178aebd58bdf0274aacedde56b.source: Not really. We're starting this campaign with a huge lead. I'd rather not roll the dice on that.
4dbf7dcd4438d5178aebd58bdf0274aacedde56b.zh: 不太想。竞选刚开始，我们就遥遥领先。我宁愿不拿这个冒险。

4ed7d25a536a446e2444e35fec93dc87025351e8.source: Not the worst answer, but still a bad one. Your supporters are disturbed by enforcing religion on American children through the state.
4ed7d25a536a446e2444e35fec93dc87025351e8.zh: 不是最糟糕的回答，但依然很差。你要通过国家强制美国儿童接受宗教，令支持者不安。

f81abb95b6bf4675aa6005e1061f2e4e090510d6.source: Nothing seems to be more of a litmus test for how people feel about you than The Wall.
f81abb95b6bf4675aa6005e1061f2e4e090510d6.zh: 似乎没有什么比那堵墙更能检验人们对你的态度。

ded674fab84fd77b871ceba756f47ec1c583f9d4.source: Nothing wrong with keeping your name in the headlines, but people have come to expect it.
ded674fab84fd77b871ceba756f47ec1c583f9d4.zh: 让名字留在新闻头条上没什么问题，但大家已经习以为常。

f2d4adf83afbd6c181a339e07f8dd7592d1ebc61.source: Nothing wrong with that response. It's important to keep the National Rifle Association happy as a Republican candidate.
f2d4adf83afbd6c181a339e07f8dd7592d1ebc61.zh: 这个回答没问题。作为共和党候选人，让全国步枪协会满意很重要。

05951434bfe95b1296ce69471c1167d065db5f83.source: Nothing you just said will be acceptable to the anti-war crowd. To make matters worse, data shows you have lost support.
05951434bfe95b1296ce69471c1167d065db5f83.zh: 你刚才说的，没有一句能让反战群体接受。更糟的是，数据显示你的支持率下降了。

0b3fa6ef4178f253d65fc4afaf1c3d13a14c285e.source: Now it looks as through you're shutting Romney out, which makes you look isolated, etc. and makes Mormons mad.
0b3fa6ef4178f253d65fc4afaf1c3d13a14c285e.zh: 现在看来，你似乎在把罗姆尼拒之门外；这让你显得孤立无援等等，也让摩门教徒生气。

604dcea34b23ee48b481da5d96823f8ce787c311.source: Now you must press forward with your efforts to defend the Great Society and to end the war in Vietnam. Failure in the latter case could be devastating when you seek reelection in 1972. After all, just look at what happened to the once-lustrous reputation of Lyndon Johnson over the past four years...
604dcea34b23ee48b481da5d96823f8ce787c311.zh: 现在你必须继续努力保卫 伟大社会 并结束越南战争。当你在 1972 年寻求连任时，后一种情况的失败可能是毁灭性的。毕竟，看看林登·约翰逊曾经辉煌的声誉在过去四年里发生了什么......

f402d3780ff816a753b72469e0ecba8c09835f62.source: Nuclear power has proven itself to be a dangerous policy idea. We should be moving away from nuclear and into more environmentally friendly types of energy.
f402d3780ff816a753b72469e0ecba8c09835f62.zh: 事实已经证明，发展核能是一项危险的政策主张。我们应该逐步摆脱核能，转向更环保的能源。

c8047db31ce9050a6c6639c7a0b4ac6636fa6823.source: NumbersUSA is a right-wing group of activists who oppose new immigration to the New United States, and have sought to bolster their influence with Republican policymaking with your candidacy.
c8047db31ce9050a6c6639c7a0b4ac6636fa6823.zh: NumbersUSA是一个反对向“新美国”新增移民的右翼活动团体，并试图借助你的参选，加强自己对共和党政策制定的影响。

4694f57eb8e31b58a739f667e4534d944ae349d8.source: Obama emphasizes turnout repeatedly in his speeches across these areas.
4694f57eb8e31b58a739f667e4534d944ae349d8.zh: 奥巴马在这些地区的演说中，反复强调投票率。

93741a7a612c6d04f737c561e7d56f312d7a41c2.source: Obama has come under some criticism, but many people also favor the new stance towards Cuba.
93741a7a612c6d04f737c561e7d56f312d7a41c2.zh: 奥巴马受到了一些批评，但许多人也支持对古巴的新立场。

c540e087aeb39eaf5952d035f90ac04483f6aab2.source: Obama should focus on Donald Trump, and the danger that he represents for the future of our country.
c540e087aeb39eaf5952d035f90ac04483f6aab2.zh: 奥巴马应该着重谈特朗普，以及他给国家未来带来的危险。

27d715ade22ebf7a35714759c003d0b1dd966135.source: Obama should focus on his accomplishments and the improving economy, and then on how I will uphold his policies and legacy as President.
27d715ade22ebf7a35714759c003d0b1dd966135.zh: 奥巴马应该着重谈自己的成就、经济改善，以及我当上总统后将如何维护他的政策与政治遗产。

173eee9d901a00c91d0aef34b3f0c16a072911f4.source: Obama will attempt to make the case that his stewardship prevented economic disaster after the 2008 financial crisis.
173eee9d901a00c91d0aef34b3f0c16a072911f4.zh: 奥巴马将努力证明，正是他的执政措施避免了2008年金融危机后发生经济灾难。

510b88c255b68fbf5217ed31e0544192efa57fdb.source: Obama's administration has been dogged by a severe recession and an unconvincing recovery, which he has consistently blamed on the policies of his Republican predecessor and on the obstructionism of his political opponents in Congress.
510b88c255b68fbf5217ed31e0544192efa57fdb.zh: 奥巴马 政府一直受到严重衰退和令人难以置信的复苏的困扰，他一直将其归咎于共和党前任的政策和国会政治对手的阻挠。

96690ef3c552b79161e3443118014625794977fc.source: Obama's disastrous management has driven this program into the ground. We're going to stop the rate increases and the disaster stories of people being turned away from the health care they deserve.
96690ef3c552b79161e3443118014625794977fc.zh: 奥巴马灾难性的管理把这个项目搞垮了。我们要阻止费率上涨，不再让那些本应得到医疗服务的人遭到拒绝，酿成悲剧。

dc4e527b82e7826581d8b27f56bb7d4b055d4d1b.source: Obama's popularity numbers are lukewarm, and the economy is bad. This could work for you.
dc4e527b82e7826581d8b27f56bb7d4b055d4d1b.zh: 奥巴马的人气不温不火，经济也不好。这可能对你奏效。

f1a77a6baf088507b558b655f44973f357409ce5.source: Obamacare did not go far enough. We will fight very hard for universal health care when I am President, in whatever form that may take. This has been my fight for over 20 years now.
f1a77a6baf088507b558b655f44973f357409ce5.zh: 奥巴马医改走得还不够远。我当上总统后，我们会全力争取全民医疗保障，不论最终采取哪种形式。这是我已经坚持二十多年的奋斗。

53eebf8e7a0859972a848ef1f601cc052c710075.source: Obamacare is not slavery, period. But one thing that's very unfair with the media -- they will sit there through a three hour speech and ignore the whole speech, and use one phrase in a hit piece. And who knows if he even meant to say it, or he was tired after a long day?
53eebf8e7a0859972a848ef1f601cc052c710075.zh: 奥巴马医改不是奴隶制，就这么简单。但媒体有一点很不公平：他们坐在那里听了三小时的演说，却忽略整场演说，只挑一句话写攻击文章。谁知道他是不是本来就想那么说，或者只是忙了一整天，累了？

6b23617445644ed52fa7b94cc87d153fc1a4ab4c.source: Obamacare is one of the biggest disasters in the history of the United States. We're going to totally repeal this monstrosity and let free enterprise fix our health care system.
6b23617445644ed52fa7b94cc87d153fc1a4ab4c.zh: 奥巴马医改是美国历史上最大的灾难之一。我们要彻底废除这个怪物，让自由企业来修复我们的医疗体系。

ee0dd5c69842eb2ff040c9eb5ab6aed2626bbec9.source: Obamacare is the biggest disaster in the history of the United States in at least the last 100 years. Dr. Carson and myself, he is a medical doctor you know, we might use different words to mean the same thing.
ee0dd5c69842eb2ff040c9eb5ab6aed2626bbec9.zh: 奥巴马医改至少是过去一百年美国历史上最大的灾难。卡森医生和我，你知道，他是位医生，我们可能用不同的话表达同一个意思。

725bd19de97c08f5ae9067301fba0abd7535216f.source: Observers agreed that Humphrey seemed to be the better debater, but you avoided any serious mistakes. Overall the impact will be minor.
725bd19de97c08f5ae9067301fba0abd7535216f.zh: 观察人士一致认为汉弗莱辩论表现更好，但你避免了严重失误。总体影响不会太大。

601035663aa10cdd0eb2a28b6e34474bfdfe0480.source: Observers are surprised at your relatively moderate stance.
601035663aa10cdd0eb2a28b6e34474bfdfe0480.zh: 观察人士对你相对温和的立场感到意外。

f3dfcfaf12bc09721f925ff25d56dfaf114f1fe3.source: Observers are surprised at your sudden, warm feelings for the Irish.
f3dfcfaf12bc09721f925ff25d56dfaf114f1fe3.zh: 你突然对爱尔兰人表现出热情，让观察人士感到惊讶。

6c4eb3680d8d003b3830940e06b1e3777d346a08.source: Observers believe that Israel launched a surprise attack first and question your logic. You’ve also gone against Johnson and the State Department on this issue.
6c4eb3680d8d003b3830940e06b1e3777d346a08.zh: 观察人士认为以色列先发动了突袭，质疑你的逻辑。在这个问题上，你也与约翰逊和国务院唱了反调。

5fa4db0bd35336b16c4bd8b553b7932d9bc473dd.source: Observers widely believe that Dan Quayle lost the Vice Presidential debate to Lloyd Bentsen. Do you agree?
5fa4db0bd35336b16c4bd8b553b7932d9bc473dd.zh: 观察人士普遍认为，丹·奎尔在副总统辩论中输给了劳埃德·本特森。你同意吗？

b4a0b1fcd2a03c411c94791f619b836d815f859d.source: Obviously a couple of firms went bankrupt, but that happens sometimes with new companies. We shouldn't let that distract us from the overall idea of this project. Funding should remain as is.
b4a0b1fcd2a03c411c94791f619b836d815f859d.zh: 显然，有几家公司破产了，但新企业有时就是会这样。我们不应该因此偏离这项计划的整体思路。资助应该维持现状。

b281465031b2e11995d3eb82f7eeebe97c125339.source: Obviously he was quite successful. I'm not convinced that all of that success came in a way that the American people would approve of, but that's up to the voters to decide.
b281465031b2e11995d3eb82f7eeebe97c125339.zh: 显然，他相当成功。我不能确定，这些成功全都是以美国人民认可的方式取得的，但这该由选民决定。

1ba59369ad92a293e6ab6bacd3c5c5c9cf8decc6.source: Obviously it is helpful to remind the voters of my achievements, but our primary focus should be on Woodrow Wilson and the issues of 1916.
1ba59369ad92a293e6ab6bacd3c5c5c9cf8decc6.zh: 显然，提醒选民我的政绩很有帮助，但我们应当主要关注伍德罗·威尔逊和1916年的议题。

b0798c6e49df89bcf6f72fff94450898bb4aa29c.source: Obviously this helps in New York, but you're also getting a little bump nationally from the popularity of Eisenhower.
b0798c6e49df89bcf6f72fff94450898bb4aa29c.zh: 这显然有助于争取纽约州，同时，艾森豪威尔的高人气也为你带来了一点全国性的提升。

96e01972650d9183092feb63746af6742189e4f5.source: Obviously this helps in the Midwest, but you're also getting a little bump nationally from the popularity of Eisenhower.
96e01972650d9183092feb63746af6742189e4f5.zh: 这显然有助于争取中西部，同时，艾森豪威尔的高人气也为你带来了一点全国性的提升。

b8895785e0cbf0e84f355d6b5f7d710b5a536ca0.source: No, I don't think so. The last thing we need is a return to the abuses of the past.
b8895785e0cbf0e84f355d6b5f7d710b5a536ca0.zh: 不，我不这么认为。我们最不需要的，就是重蹈过去滥伐的覆辙。

e11feb540844f459f4c598dfed92b02d9e14dc3c.source: No, I will not. I have a good chance of winning them and I need every vote I can get.
e11feb540844f459f4c598dfed92b02d9e14dc3c.zh: 不，我不会退出。我很有希望赢得这些州，也需要争取每一张选票。

7b61acf921741c7970757a0de184afb4eed5b7ca.source: No. No! NO! You can salvage this. Sleepy Joe has stolen the election! Fraud! You will not let Donald Trump's name be smeared!
7b61acf921741c7970757a0de184afb4eed5b7ca.zh: 不，不！不！你可以挽救这个。瞌睡乔偷走了选举！欺诈罪！你不会让唐纳德·特朗普的名字被抹黑！

2993f2bd7f35211c09b78d1d558f57b60ca93e3e.source: Nobody can deny that the situation on the southern border is a problem right now, and one that we take very seriously. I'm going to do everything I can to resolve this issue when I'm President.
2993f2bd7f35211c09b78d1d558f57b60ca93e3e.zh: 没有人能否认，南部边境目前的状况是个问题，我们也非常认真地对待。我当上总统后，会竭尽所能解决它。

10726e3a5d3c53181b9841d1476a4496c6f4de8a.source: Non-Intervention -- Most of our foreign troop deployments are relics of the Cold War. We need to stop occupying other nations and focus on fixing our problems here at home.
10726e3a5d3c53181b9841d1476a4496c6f4de8a.zh: 不干涉——我们大部分海外驻军都是冷战的遗留。我们需要停止占领别国，把精力放在解决国内问题上。

a17a99747cd3af4d876a3c1fed463f58e300eeb8.source: None of that changes the fact that the country is facing a depression with millions out of work. Are you the man to lead the nation back into greatness?
a17a99747cd3af4d876a3c1fed463f58e300eeb8.zh: 所有这些都没有改变这样一个事实：该国正面临着数百万人失业的萧条。你是带领国家走向伟大的人吗？

7f0ec41966fe01729dc3d106ba9ae62a37a6ad86.source: Not a bad choice. You don't want to distance yourself from the primary arena just as the campaigning picks up.
7f0ec41966fe01729dc3d106ba9ae62a37a6ad86.zh: 这个选择不错。竞选正升温时，你可不想远离主战场。

38f22ba0a913e37975aa70f41909a88f714d8c7a.source: Not at all. Even companies that have been caught red-handed hiring illegals have gotten away with token fines. This happens all of the time in the meat processing industry, for instance.
38f22ba0a913e37975aa70f41909a88f714d8c7a.zh: 完全不够。就连被当场抓住雇用非法移民的公司，都能靠象征性罚款过关。例如，肉类加工业就经常发生这种事。

bbfa97bdee8db17e25b149f5c2ff6416dd4f1c1e.source: Not at all. It would violate the norms of our times, and in any case we have a lead that we should preserve.
bbfa97bdee8db17e25b149f5c2ff6416dd4f1c1e.zh: 完全不打算亲自竞选。这有违当今惯例。况且，我们已经领先，应当保持这个优势。

67d5efaf66dd00872d9ceb443554610e433fdbb9.source: Not at all. This argument has come up in the past, but we should take a more careful analysis of it this time around.
67d5efaf66dd00872d9ceb443554610e433fdbb9.zh: 完全不认为如此。这种论点以前也出现过，但这次我们应该更谨慎地分析。

f8cac551144d1f7cad9ae9f4fa65fba7f0207ade.source: Not only are you opposing a popular measure, but you're using the leftist rhetoric of Henry Wallace as you do so.
f8cac551144d1f7cad9ae9f4fa65fba7f0207ade.zh: 你不仅在反对一项受欢迎的措施，还使用了亨利·华莱士式的左翼言辞。

e12ae2427728fedb921df68f17a9d285a9b45da0.source: Not only does it undercut your claims as Eisenhower's successor, but it also offends Eisenhower personally when you criticize his economic record.
e12ae2427728fedb921df68f17a9d285a9b45da0.zh: 这不仅削弱了你作为艾森豪威尔继承人的说法，批评他的经济政绩也会让他本人感到冒犯。

55eeb0dec30b9742e5b98185c899dde6ec6226a8.source: Not only does it undercut your claims as Eisenhower's successor, but it also offends Eisenhower personally when you criticize his foreign policy.
55eeb0dec30b9742e5b98185c899dde6ec6226a8.zh: 这不仅削弱了你作为艾森豪威尔继承人的说法，批评他的外交政策也会让他本人感到冒犯。

6e50442e6f4578506212edc11455a5b672cf695c.source: Not only is Truman enjoying a wave of positive publicity for the Berlin Airlift, but your own ideas seem extreme to the public.
6e50442e6f4578506212edc11455a5b672cf695c.zh: 杜鲁门正享受柏林空运带来的正面宣传，而你的主张在公众看来又过于极端。

7adfb1fc31244766c9448b3c137a930e2b80f064.source: Obviously this helps on the East Coast, but you're also getting a little bump nationally from the popularity of Eisenhower.
7adfb1fc31244766c9448b3c137a930e2b80f064.zh: 这显然有助于争取东海岸，同时，艾森豪威尔的高人气也为你带来了一点全国性的提升。

66d468ca578c7ffe75340424373e395c6d467fea.source: Obviously this helps on the West Coast, but you're also getting a little bump nationally from the popularity of Eisenhower.
66d468ca578c7ffe75340424373e395c6d467fea.zh: 这显然有助于争取西海岸，同时，艾森豪威尔的高人气也为你带来了一点全国性的提升。

49da39db6dcfc9e4f9de1f12c0d6384e5c7b1cf1.source: Obviously we'll mention this some, but our main focus will be on the here and now.
49da39db6dcfc9e4f9de1f12c0d6384e5c7b1cf1.zh: 我们当然会有所提及，但主要还是着眼于当下。

bfa36304d61caca05f1f36961750505eb49beb29.source: Obviously, Europe needs some kind of aid after the horrors of World War II. I will be careful to see that this plan is fairly administered and does not become excessive.
bfa36304d61caca05f1f36961750505eb49beb29.zh: 显然，经历第二次世界大战的浩劫之后，欧洲需要某种援助。我会认真确保这项计划公平实施，而且不至于过度扩张。

3f292007b85c30630eed6cce2df77efc4cdca7b4.source: Of course I am opposed to the policies of Scott Walker. The only reason I wasn't in Wisconsin on the day of his recall election was that I needed to campaign in more competitive states to maximize our chances of winning this fall.
3f292007b85c30630eed6cce2df77efc4cdca7b4.zh: 我当然反对斯科特·沃克的政策。罢免投票当天我没去威斯康星州，唯一原因是我需要在竞争更激烈的州竞选，尽量提高今年秋天获胜的机会。

539f41420e7ab91433d3603c9b813ad7897fea50.source: Of course I will always act in the best interests of the United States. We are keeping all options on the table, but it's irresponsible at this point to go into further details.
539f41420e7ab91433d3603c9b813ad7897fea50.zh: 我当然始终会以美国的最佳利益为准。我们保留所有选项，但在现阶段透露更多细节是不负责任的。

76d7191f16bf19541a528aa8797aa9e1ea13ea47.source: Of course the government has a right to do this. Whether it is advisable or whether President Cleveland negotiated a good interest rate is another debate.
76d7191f16bf19541a528aa8797aa9e1ea13ea47.zh: 政府当然有这个权利。至于这样做是否明智，或克利夫兰总统是否谈到了有利的利率，那是另一个问题。

f8572919912978b758ee85a99f01b244c8d6613b.source: Of course this war was controversial, but I oppose any pardon for people who evaded their military service. This would not send the right message in a future crisis.
f8572919912978b758ee85a99f01b244c8d6613b.zh: 这场战争当然有争议，但我反对赦免逃避兵役的人。这会在未来危机中传递错误的讯息。

0440828990d786eb1502c4d90cced0de1b1d8901.source: Of course we denounce rioting and lawlessness, but we do support some attempt to change our naturalization laws.
0440828990d786eb1502c4d90cced0de1b1d8901.zh: 我们当然谴责暴乱和违法行为，但也支持尝试修改入籍法。

765c96fd28535445489a69bc1a51c3fc684c0646.source: Of course we should. This is one of most effective attacks we have against the shenanigans of the Republicans.
765c96fd28535445489a69bc1a51c3fc684c0646.zh: 当然应该。这是我们针对共和党胡作非为所能发动的最有效攻击之一。

11e6293a3fede09a93532db1a3ece60ae4518d8e.source: Of course we'll support this railroad, but there are other issues we should emphasize in this campaign.
11e6293a3fede09a93532db1a3ece60ae4518d8e.zh: 我们当然会支持这条铁路，不过，这次竞选中还有其他议题应当强调。

a52312b058206171a73db46efd1c74d89327fe7e.source: Of course you've expressed reservations in private, but it's going to be difficult to win this fall if you're defending yourself against Communism allegations everywhere you go.
a52312b058206171a73db46efd1c74d89327fe7e.zh: 你当然曾在私下表达过保留意见，但如果走到哪里都要为自己辩解、应对亲共指控，今年秋季就很难胜选。

992a42e6e9c46f3c70870b6d62280189b49231ed.source: Of course, The Donald is already using these attacks to agitate for further measures against Muslims... and to blame you and the Obama Administration for incompetence.
992a42e6e9c46f3c70870b6d62280189b49231ed.zh: 当然，“那位唐纳德”已经借这些袭击煽动对穆斯林采取更多措施，也指责你和奥巴马政府无能……

947b09ebf6c2121ef3aea2c3a729707db9f41058.source: Of course, this type of dissension in the Republican ranks only helps you.
947b09ebf6c2121ef3aea2c3a729707db9f41058.zh: 当然，共和党内部这种分歧，只会帮助你。

c07fce5638288988e58346f66b43dd89daabb357.source: Of course, you still have to deal with the possibility that Humphrey and Nixon dislike you so much that they will simply strike a deal with each other. Whatever happens, it's sure to be interesting.
c07fce5638288988e58346f66b43dd89daabb357.zh: 当然，你仍然需要面对这样一种可能性：汉弗莱 和 尼克松 非常不喜欢你，以至于他们会简单地互相达成协议。无论发生什么，它肯定会很有趣。

6c7b3a5f17bef8bd833698d8680fe1d7469f63c8.source: Off the record, I am uncomfortable with this, but I prefer not to make a public statement about it.
6c7b3a5f17bef8bd833698d8680fe1d7469f63c8.zh: 私下说，我对此不太认同，但我不愿公开表态。

d74ed8c8e095e71bb90ec9cefb3a4c7001d6806e.zh: 俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州

02f33c549442eb68239e81d961791e9fdbdd4650.source: Ohio is a must-win state for both candidates, and Portman's presence could be crucial to a Republican victory there.
02f33c549442eb68239e81d961791e9fdbdd4650.zh: 俄亥俄州 是两位候选人都必须获胜的州，波特曼 的存在对于共和党在那里的胜利至关重要。

141c3ce93b05d9c09e1067a0a32bb7ac18eb3c10.source: Oil prices have spiked to nearly $40 a barrel. We need to help hard-working Americans in states like New Hampshire by making temporary allowances from our reserve.
141c3ce93b05d9c09e1067a0a32bb7ac18eb3c10.zh: 油价已飙升至每桶近40美元。我们需要暂时动用储备，帮助新罕布什尔等州勤劳的美国人。

1774b8eebfc8e3263e033a98945b41135875fc5c.source: On many industrial issues, such as the Pullman Strike and his pardon of the Haymarket anarchists, Altgeld is too radical. I would prefer not to appear with him.
1774b8eebfc8e3263e033a98945b41135875fc5c.zh: 在普尔曼大罢工、赦免干草市场案无政府主义者等许多与劳资有关的问题上，奥尔特格尔德过于激进。我宁愿不与他同台。

67d47bd8c220fff635b6c9d179c880da3e64c3ef.source: On occasion it makes sense to bring this up. Over the years I have helped out many in need through the Mormon Church, both with my time and through charity. We should make sure the American people know this about me.
67d47bd8c220fff635b6c9d179c880da3e64c3ef.zh: 偶尔提起这个，有道理。多年来，我通过摩门教会帮助了许多有需要的人，既投入时间，也提供善款。我们应该让美国人民了解这一点。

d3698b571136fc5a2d16adca1c54d823f1c49b87.source: On the Sunday before election day, your church has canceled its services rather than admit a black minister as a member. Will you terminate your own membership?
d3698b571136fc5a2d16adca1c54d823f1c49b87.zh: 选举日前的那个星期日，你的教会宁愿取消礼拜，也不接纳一位黑人牧师成为成员。你会退出教会吗？

461b47b28c52c7ef236663214bfb8734f3bfe381.source: On the balance I would not appoint another justice like Mr. Warren. Desegregating our schools was one thing, but he has gone off the deep end on these issues like school prayer, Miranda rights, and other activist decisions.
461b47b28c52c7ef236663214bfb8734f3bfe381.zh: 总的来说，我不会再任命沃伦先生这样的法官。废除学校种族隔离是一回事，但在学校祷告、米兰达权利以及其他体现司法能动主义的判决上，他已经走火入魔了。

279f9ea5a39609a9f4242997758b3429447dd53a.source: On the balance, your party is surprised to hear you take this stance.
279f9ea5a39609a9f4242997758b3429447dd53a.zh: 总的来说，党内人士对你采取这个立场感到意外。

a79c46b7ce31cc4a4f1cc3d0f3ba2e82be84e8f6.source: On the domestic front, it appears that your support of labor and progressivism has been rewarded. Internationally, let's all hope that fears of war with Germany prove to be unfounded.
a79c46b7ce31cc4a4f1cc3d0f3ba2e82be84e8f6.zh: 在国内方面，看来您对劳工和进步主义的支持得到了回报。在国际上，我们都希望对与德国发生战争的担忧被证明是没有根据的。

f4820959a78328208ce74d02434d2d272504bb2e.source: On the domestic front, let's hope that your achievements survive. Internationally, no one can say what might happen next. In a novel move, you have offered to do your part by resigning immediately, rather than waiting until March 4th.
f4820959a78328208ce74d02434d2d272504bb2e.zh: 在国内方面，希望你们的成就能够延续下去。在国际上，没有人能预测接下来会发生什么。你采取了一个新颖的举动，提出立即辞职，而不是等到 3 月 4 日。

ec8775457d9c5770d5bb4625ccf1dc3da0c75281.source: On the one hand, you are criticized for ducking out on the debate. On the other hand, millions of supporters tune in to watch you inveigh against Hillary Clinton and the biased media.
ec8775457d9c5770d5bb4625ccf1dc3da0c75281.zh: 一方面，人们批评你逃避辩论。另一方面，数百万支持者收看节目，听你痛斥希拉里·克林顿和有偏见的媒体。

c3500bbfa6e2609b9bef3a5b31aafad611ba196b.source: On the one hand, you have taken the high road. On the other hand, crime is huge issue and you are definitely leaving it on the table.
c3500bbfa6e2609b9bef3a5b31aafad611ba196b.zh: 一方面，你保持了风度；另一方面，犯罪是个重大议题，你显然没有充分利用这个机会。

1e0ffbed5f32be0cd76a7b613b3791d4490a6351.source: On the other hand, Ryan has only served as a Congressman and has little experience running in a national or even a statewide election.
1e0ffbed5f32be0cd76a7b613b3791d4490a6351.zh: 另一方面，瑞安 只担任过国会议员，几乎没有参加全国甚至全州选举的经验。

2a251ae27192f4ba7e32883eb4178ba0e38a51a8.source: On the political front, it appears that Obamacare will survive and go into effect. While the economy has not recovered as strongly as Obama hoped and promised, he will now have four more years to leave a strong legacy to his Democratic successor. No doubt the Republicans will learn from your failure and come back stronger in 2016.
2a251ae27192f4ba7e32883eb4178ba0e38a51a8.zh: 在政治方面，奥巴马医改 似乎将继续存在并生效。尽管经济尚未像 奥巴马 希望和承诺的那样强劲复苏，但他现在还有四年的时间为他的民主党继任者留下丰厚的遗产。毫无疑问，共和党将从你们的失败中吸取教训，并在 2016 年变得更加强大。

c7732601014027ee5cbdf00e827efc27fe524f4c.source: On the political front, it appears that Romney will make a push for more tax cuts to revive the economy. He will also try to repeal your health care law. If your defeat was narrow enough, you may be able to attempt a comeback in 2016.
c7732601014027ee5cbdf00e827efc27fe524f4c.zh: 在政治方面，罗姆尼 似乎将推动更多减税以重振经济。他还将尝试废除你们的医疗保健法。如果你的败局足够小，你或许可以在 2016 年尝试东山再起。

b8e15b2e1122e279e397a778ca9726003b3cdb33.source: On the political front, it appears that your health care legislation that was passed in early 2010 will survive and go into effect. While the economy has not yet recovered as strongly as you hoped and promised, you will now have four more years to leave a strong legacy to your Democratic successor.
b8e15b2e1122e279e397a778ca9726003b3cdb33.zh: 在政治方面，2010 年初通过的医疗保健立法似乎将继续存在并生效。尽管经济尚未像您希望和承诺的那样强劲复苏，但您现在还有四年的时间为您的民主党继任者留下丰厚的遗产。

c4ce292882984af08a522857698174cf3c30e912.source: On the political front, it is unclear how much of your agenda you will be able to push forward with the current Congress. Hopefully your victory has helped Democrats further down the ballot. Start packing and prepare to move back into the White House!
c4ce292882984af08a522857698174cf3c30e912.zh: 在政治方面，目前尚不清楚您能够在本届国会中推进多少议程。希望你的胜利有助于民主党在选票上进一步落后。开始收拾行李，准备搬回白宫！

eb7b4892931452e8eb67c0cd5ea9638394d07e3c.source: On the political front, you can continue the Clinton legacy and strengthen Social Security for generations to come. Perhaps you can succeed on health care where Clinton came up short? Or maybe you can create a future of renewable energy for America. Just be wary of a (George or Jeb?) Bush challenge in 2004.
eb7b4892931452e8eb67c0cd5ea9638394d07e3c.zh: 在政治方面，您可以为子孙后代延续 克林顿 遗产并加强 社会保障。也许您可以在 克林顿 的医疗保健领域取得成功？或者也许你可以为美国创造可再生能源的未来。只是要警惕 2004 年的（乔治还是杰布？）布什 挑战。

6722579eabb137f04a467500068ae35ff1c44613.source: On the political front, you can push for tax cuts to spur the economy and return the budget surplus to the American people. You might also pursue education and immigration reform, individual Social Security accounts, and new laws to defend the family and the sanctity of life.
6722579eabb137f04a467500068ae35ff1c44613.zh: 在政治方面，可以推动减税来刺激经济，并将预算盈余返还给美国人民。您还可能追求教育和移民改革、个人社会保障账户以及捍卫家庭和生命神圣性的新法律。

592ea36cbf6c151d1f898e6be638fc41c506eb00.source: On the political front, you can work a Democratic House to overturn the worst excesses of Reagan. Internationally, you can hopefully oversee a period of relaxed tension with the Soviet Union.
592ea36cbf6c151d1f898e6be638fc41c506eb00.zh: 在政治方面，你可以在民主党众议院工作来推翻 里根 中最严重的过激行为。在国际上，您有望度过一段与苏联紧张关系缓和的时期。

39fd275a1fcbd540fb16fd4ff4e56aeb16f50d49.source: On the political front, you have the bully pulpit in your favor, but both parties in Congress are likely to oppose your next moves, albeit for different reasons. Can you build a working coalition?
39fd275a1fcbd540fb16fd4ff4e56aeb16f50d49.zh: 在政治方面，你的讲坛对你有利，但国会两党都可能反对你的下一步行动，尽管原因不同。你能建立一个工作联盟吗？

7e8d21d8bb8d20c1dbb3202159d1d8b9c46b4272.source: On the political front, you have the bully pulpit in your favor, but support in Congress in uncertain. Will you govern as a more traditional conservative, or will you make a break from orthodoxy?
7e8d21d8bb8d20c1dbb3202159d1d8b9c46b4272.zh: 在政治方面，你的讲坛对你有利，但国会的支持却不确定。你会以更传统的保守派的方式执政，还是会打破正统观念？

53c4ec61aa5ebc1e325f4bc7eaca39ecdef160ed.source: On the upside, hesitant Southern Democrats are eagerly throwing their support behind you. On the downside, liberals and Humphrey suspect that something’s up, hurting your numbers across the North.
53c4ec61aa5ebc1e325f4bc7eaca39ecdef160ed.zh: 好的一面是，原本犹豫的南方民主党人正热切地转而支持你；坏的一面是，自由派和汉弗莱怀疑你另有盘算，使你在整个北方的支持率下降。

1a6905b07997820b3cd68b094e7813a426b5b99d.source: On the weekend before the election, Lyndon Johnson's peace negotiations have collapsed with the North Vietnamese. Even worse, there are rumors that a Nixon operative has sabotaged the negotiations. Nixon swears to you on his honor that he is innocent. Will you make this an issue over the last two days of the campaign?
1a6905b07997820b3cd68b094e7813a426b5b99d.zh: 选举前的那个周末，林登·约翰逊与北越的和平谈判破裂了。更糟的是，有传言称尼克松的一名政治助手破坏了谈判。尼克松以名誉向你保证自己清白。你会在竞选最后两天拿这件事做文章吗？

5196f4ea0b5f73fc6172c7900253dec7bab57e17.source: On yet another issue, Dukakis does not mount an effective defense or counterattack to your campaign.
5196f4ea0b5f73fc6172c7900253dec7bab57e17.zh: 又一个议题上，杜卡基斯未能对你的竞选攻势作出有效辩护或反击。

176e2def8d27893804db8480727317291faff02c.source: Once left for dead politically, the 1960 runner-up returns to the national stage marketing himself as the "New Nixon".
176e2def8d27893804db8480727317291faff02c.zh: 1960 年的亚军选举结果一度在政治上陷入死亡，并在全国舞台上将自己推销为“新 尼克松”。

a3c167496cb1f7d87e0eb51791dd2dbc3431a9d8.source: Once we reinstitute our tariffs, this deficit will disappear. Best of all, the lion's share of these taxes will be paid by foreign merchants.
a3c167496cb1f7d87e0eb51791dd2dbc3431a9d8.zh: 一旦恢复我们的关税，赤字就会消失。最妙的是，这些税的大部分将由外国商人支付。

c6db7e728e949a2778f55c6005f2a2a653ac64d3.source: Once your views become well-known, Southern Democrats will defect in droves for John Palmer, the Bourbon Democrats' splinter candidate.
c6db7e728e949a2778f55c6005f2a2a653ac64d3.zh: 一旦你的观点广为人知，南方民主党人就会成群结队地转投约翰·帕尔默——波旁民主党分裂派的候选人。

c7592fa28f434dd8c324e9b8691850603bda79fb.source: One can never be sure when the inspiration of love will strike. Widows' pensions should be protected unconditionally.
c7592fa28f434dd8c324e9b8691850603bda79fb.zh: 谁也说不准，爱情会在什么时候降临。遗孀的抚恤金应当得到无条件保障。

7e58613f548b1d9aefa690f5d2d77954660b000c.source: One final round trip- Vermont, New Hampshire, and Indiana!
7e58613f548b1d9aefa690f5d2d77954660b000c.zh: 最后再巡回一圈：佛蒙特州、新罕布什尔州和印第安纳州！

3759ce4e737fb6da1bef1d596d272f5e09fc0655.source: One hardly has to be an arch-conservative to be concerned about the elevation of Brandeis to the Supreme Court.
3759ce4e737fb6da1bef1d596d272f5e09fc0655.zh: 并非只有极端保守派，才会对布兰代斯进入最高法院感到担忧。

9d7032ef4de9911c6dd0a428afc664476a0af85d.source: One hundred percent. If we don't see the level of deaths and cases go down in this country, then we need to do whatever it takes to bring those into line.
9d7032ef4de9911c6dd0a428afc664476a0af85d.zh: 完全赞同。如果这个国家的死亡和病例数量没有下降，我们就得尽一切必要手段，把它们降下来。

f208e12887f6b88bc9ffd58523c2693f856ad56f.source: One of my highest priorities in office will be a canal through Nicaragua, which will greatly enhance our national trade. Democrats lack the ambition for such far-reaching projects.
f208e12887f6b88bc9ffd58523c2693f856ad56f.zh: 我上任后最优先的事务之一，就是修建横贯尼加拉瓜的运河，大幅促进本国贸易。民主党缺少推动这种长远工程的雄心。

08bbda28b06dfc5ae4db5c1709c3a331d6fbbf08.source: One of the first things we're going to do when I'm President is to make a full assessment of the nation's infrastructure and where we need to improve. And once we have that, then I can help us pass an informed and targeted infrastructure bill that addresses real priorities.
08bbda28b06dfc5ae4db5c1709c3a331d6fbbf08.zh: 我当上总统后，首先要做的事情之一，就是全面评估全国的基础设施，以及需要改善的地方。掌握这些情况后，我就能推动通过一项依据充分、有针对性的基础设施法案，解决真正的优先事项。

9888e08fe4994dd85af1b9a6a3edc1f7b9a06376.source: One of the founders of Breitbart News, Steve Bannon is a darling of the far-right, and has been a crucial ally of your's during the primary.  He's previously been accused of spouting racism and anti-semitism, but who cares?  They spread the same sort of stuff around about you, after all.
9888e08fe4994dd85af1b9a6a3edc1f7b9a06376.zh: 布赖特巴特新闻网的创始人之一史蒂夫·班农深受极右翼欢迎，也是你在初选期间的重要盟友。他曾被指责散布种族主义和反犹言论，但谁在乎呢？毕竟，他们也用同样的话抹黑你。

3d36328baccd6cbd5c70d5dca1d2e0ea4d411cc9.source: One of the greatest human tragedies of the Trump Administration is the situation on the southern border. We will stop separating families, and we will do whatever it takes to reform our immigration processing in a sensible, humane manner.
3d36328baccd6cbd5c70d5dca1d2e0ea4d411cc9.zh: 特朗普执政期间最大的人道悲剧之一，就是南部边境的状况。我们会停止拆散家庭，并尽一切必要努力，以合理、人道的方式改革移民处理程序。

0ce9489c5c5fecab7556a29ee8ff3b477d6f0be9.source: One of the most influential lobbies, 'big pharma' as it is derisevely known has been the most signficant roadblock against liberal attempts at reforming US healthcare policy.
0ce9489c5c5fecab7556a29ee8ff3b477d6f0be9.zh: 这是最有影响力的游说团体之一，常被贬称为“制药巨头”。它一直是自由派尝试改革美国医疗政策时最重大的阻碍。

a9e938fd1d01d19f86955fbc133883e9a6d2f5c2.source: One of your chief rivals for the nomination, Pete Buttigieg dropped out before Super Tuesday to endorse your candidacy.  In return, he wants a job in the White House. Until then, he's willing to stump for you.
a9e938fd1d01d19f86955fbc133883e9a6d2f5c2.zh: 皮特·布蒂吉格曾是你争取提名的主要对手之一，在“超级星期二”前退选并支持你。作为回报，他希望在白宫谋得职位。在那之前，他愿意为你巡回助选。

c54ac041c87bbefda2654193f4ff5f37ec8dfd07.source: One of your favorite lines -- and a favorite of your supporters also.
c54ac041c87bbefda2654193f4ff5f37ec8dfd07.zh: 这是你最爱说的话之一，你的支持者也很喜欢。

1178e24194df33d59b1b4d779df7bbeeb489343b.source: One thing we've really got to do is make the Republican Party more inclusive. We used to get so many votes, and there are a lot of people out there more concerned about their jobs, about this illegal immigration farce, and many other things.
1178e24194df33d59b1b4d779df7bbeeb489343b.zh: 我们确实必须做的一件事，就是让共和党更有包容性。我们过去能获得那么多选票。外头有很多人更关心工作、非法移民这场闹剧，以及许多其他事情。

0953675f8febf9c127752e90476b84b0b7866d25.source: One ugly incident may not swing too many voters to your side, but any little bit helps late in a campaign.
0953675f8febf9c127752e90476b84b0b7866d25.zh: 一次丑陋的事件，也许不会使太多选民转向你，但竞选临近结束时，能多争取一点也好。

18165a15c8994c173a8895311c74a68e8bff8741.source: Only a very limited amount, for the most compelling projects. Otherwise the tariff should be for revenue purposes only.
18165a15c8994c173a8895311c74a68e8bff8741.zh: 只能拨出极少一部分，用于最有说服力的工程。除此之外，关税应当仅以筹集财政收入为目的。

17e9c3c1e0ddbd69b78e83deab7390dfc2c03861.source: Only if they proved themselves capable of repelling Communist aggression. The best thing we can do right now is escalate the war with more American troops.
17e9c3c1e0ddbd69b78e83deab7390dfc2c03861.zh: 只有南越证明自己有能力击退共产主义的进攻才行。眼下，我们能做的最好选择，就是增派美军、升级战争。

e0ae17fe4415feb24884ebd63f212f4003c45410.source: Only if we could establish one without chartering a new national bank.
e0ae17fe4415feb24884ebd63f212f4003c45410.zh: 只有在不必特许设立新国家银行的情况下，我才会支持。

ca5e9f79010777f7471f8c9d65254ae74a7a6d3f.source: Only if we had clear assurances that other nations would not develop a nuclear bomb, and a means of enforcing those assurances.
ca5e9f79010777f7471f8c9d65254ae74a7a6d3f.zh: 只有在明确保证其他国家不会研制核弹，并有办法确保这些保证兑现的情况下，我才支持。

52592eb3a98f85c60d8f4d4e2bb1ab9668a0e2a3.source: Only on rare occasions where there is a clear abuse from the railroads. For the most part they simply charge what the traffic will bear.
52592eb3a98f85c60d8f4d4e2bb1ab9668a0e2a3.zh: 只有铁路公司明显滥用权力时，才应偶尔干预。大多数情况下，它们不过是按货运业务所能承受的水平收费。

06bcd5644ad6194389be70c73d69133dc7d6dc7c.source: Only some very minor changes, like increasing the waiting period before new citizens may vote.
06bcd5644ad6194389be70c73d69133dc7d6dc7c.zh: 只做一些很小的调整，例如延长新公民取得投票资格前的等待期。

06ebaad09c5a3c5c49b6698fe1014ba90d4fa63d.source: Opposed to nearly all foreign interventions. Does not support intervention in Iran. Argues that American intervention in previous decades caused the situation in Iran in the first place. Generally a vocal critic of Israel.
06ebaad09c5a3c5c49b6698fe1014ba90d4fa63d.zh: 反对几乎所有对外干涉。不支持干涉伊朗。主张正是美国过去几十年的干涉，才首先造成了伊朗今天的局面。通常公开批评以色列。

5039b5aba3bc1e326748f9087db3670b56f60912.source: Opposing these actions places any candidate well outside of the American mainstream. We will attack Dukakis relentlessly on this point.
5039b5aba3bc1e326748f9087db3670b56f60912.zh: 反对这些行动，会使任何候选人都远离美国社会的主流立场。我们将就此毫不留情地攻击杜卡基斯。

e0937b7dc4007776366ab923823fdd59c311d12f.source: Opposition to the reopening of the slave trade is a no-brainer.
e0937b7dc4007776366ab923823fdd59c311d12f.zh: 反对重启奴隶贸易，是不假思索就能作出的选择。

aab66e2c8e01a3fc7bb9ca881603b3103d81fe72.source: Oregon is a different issue than that of Texas. In Oregon we have an existing, legitimate claim.
aab66e2c8e01a3fc7bb9ca881603b3103d81fe72.zh: 俄勒冈与得克萨斯是不同的问题。对于俄勒冈，我们已经拥有合法的领土主张。

1aa883e7e74ac76e546aa2b78d405fcd0e2e676b.source: Osama Bin Laden was living in a mansion that the government paid for with our money. It's time for this relationship to end.
1aa883e7e74ac76e546aa2b78d405fcd0e2e676b.zh: 奥萨马·本·拉登住在一座豪宅里，而那座豪宅是政府用我们的钱付账的。是时候结束这段关系了。

fc081971a0af5138d9830425d6a859607e718377.source: Other Republican issues such as tariffs, homesteads, and a trans-continental railroad also dominate the discussion.
fc081971a0af5138d9830425d6a859607e718377.zh: 关税、宅基地和跨大陆铁路等其他共和党问题也主导了讨论。

975c78fde56fb30e5b52c57db6284f21cc35539a.zh: 我们的案例 乔·拜登

e88f9b6f335cc182c1d12571e76878d4f36bcdf1.source: Our campaign is much better positioned to address the concerns of ordinary Americans than Bryan's. He is overly focused on the silver issue.
e88f9b6f335cc182c1d12571e76878d4f36bcdf1.zh: 与布赖恩相比，我们的竞选更能回应普通美国人的关切。他太执着于白银问题了。

4d86d704a29cb36feb35796161692683d2838161.source: Our case is hopeless in this election. I will go south and speak out against secession, to the best of my capacity.
4d86d704a29cb36feb35796161692683d2838161.zh: 这次大选，我们已经毫无希望。我将尽力前往南方，发表反对脱离联邦的演说。

5949c5f67f0483cbd6ed3c8ce209e69f571efbda.source: Our chances are bad enough without instigating a Southern walkout from our convention. This kind of thing will have to wait until our position is a little stronger.
5949c5f67f0483cbd6ed3c8ce209e69f571efbda.zh: 我们的胜算已经够低了，不能再引发南方代表退出党代会。这类事情得等我们的地位更稳固一些再说。

cf40568e464476a1d1cc579b426ef0c4540e8437.source: Our church has been open to some black attendees in the past, but this particular man is already the member of another church, and is clearly a Republican operative.
cf40568e464476a1d1cc579b426ef0c4540e8437.zh: 过去，我们教会也曾允许一些黑人参加活动，但这位先生已经是另一所教会的成员，而且显然是共和党的政治工作人员。

ccccb14c75adde0f33899fc84d1aaf4c751d46c4.source: Our current economic path is not sustainable. We need to continue the growth we have seen but we cannot allow this inflation we have to continue.
ccccb14c75adde0f33899fc84d1aaf4c751d46c4.zh: 我们目前的经济道路不可持续。我们要保持已经取得的增长，却不能让这样的通胀继续下去。

e89149140788c1e0075ffef65e5ee50a453ee4c9.source: Our current laws are in need of great revision, in light of the troubles we have had with recent immigrants.
e89149140788c1e0075ffef65e5ee50a453ee4c9.zh: 鉴于新近移民带来的种种问题，现行法律需要大幅修改。

969622c41f3874f9e550cb80a47d05cd458881eb.source: Our current minimum wage is sufficient in my opinion. The minimum wage is a necessary expedient but we shouldn't be increasing it so much that we cause unemployment.
969622c41f3874f9e550cb80a47d05cd458881eb.zh: 在我看来，目前的最低工资已经足够。最低工资是必要的应对措施，但不应涨得太多，以致造成失业。

e6410d3eaa2d4e4d330e163871b406d80d280097.source: Our current system is more democratic than any alternative that could be devised. Let the private banks issue currency in line with their own strength and prosperity.
e6410d3eaa2d4e4d330e163871b406d80d280097.zh: 现行制度比任何可能提出的替代方案都更民主。让私营银行根据各自的实力和经营状况发行货币吧。

1a9cb6dfa146925322abe6a97ac05d45757526e3.source: Our first priority is always to have strong law enforcement. We also need more spending on education, more integration in our schools, and more programs to ensure that blacks can advance in our society after the stain of segregation.
1a9cb6dfa146925322abe6a97ac05d45757526e3.zh: 我们的首要任务始终是有力执法。我们也需要增加教育支出，推动学校进一步融合，设立更多项目，让黑人在种族隔离留下的污点之后，能够在社会中获得向上发展的机会。

ee3fe10c972851cf47c036171e645b196e829432.source: Our first resort should be to negotiate with Japan and take steps to enhance the competitiveness of American industry. But I wouldn't take anything off the table.
ee3fe10c972851cf47c036171e645b196e829432.zh: 我们的首选应是与日本谈判，并采取措施增强美国工业的竞争力。不过，我不会排除任何手段。

65b839878b0276871f7da9f2b5b14d5fc111ad25.source: Our former immigration policy was a national embarrassment. This country was built by immigrants and my only complaint right now is that the overall number of visas is still far too low for our needs.
65b839878b0276871f7da9f2b5b14d5fc111ad25.zh: 过去的移民政策让国家蒙羞。这个国家是移民建设起来的，我现在唯一的不满，就是签证总量仍然远远满足不了我们的需求。

835074ab8dc565623a486fa14e55b6a1473949ba.source: Our goal in this campaign should be to avoid any mention of the Supreme Court. There's not much to gain by talking about this decision.
835074ab8dc565623a486fa14e55b6a1473949ba.zh: 这次竞选的目标，应当是避免提及最高法院。讨论这项判决，没有多少好处。

768fdcfded05f898d143bf2bf94dabb6246bf9aa.source: Outside of a few students and radicals, nobody agrees with your viewpoint.
768fdcfded05f898d143bf2bf94dabb6246bf9aa.zh: 除了少数学生和激进派，没有人赞同你的观点。

881771365d0380a90f49db6793e7b304119b54de.source: Over a million unborn children are killed every year in this country. We need judges who will overturn
881771365d0380a90f49db6793e7b304119b54de.zh: 这个国家每年有超过一百万未出生的婴儿被杀害。我们需要能够推翻的法官

23890025a067dbf291892fdae1bc22141c17055d.source: Over half of all sexual harassment complaints filed in 2011 were dismissed -- an increase from previous years. Do you think enough is being done to prevent sexual harassment in the workplace?
23890025a067dbf291892fdae1bc22141c17055d.zh: 2011年提出的性骚扰申诉中，有一半以上被驳回，比例比往年上升。你认为，防止职场性骚扰的措施足够了吗？

601e323ec8124ea3bd21305a4b71963696696d0f.source: Over the past five years we've sent a message to criminals that their rights are more important than the rights of law-abiding Americans. I don't know how anyone was surprised at the rioting and social chaos that we've seen since then.
601e323ec8124ea3bd21305a4b71963696696d0f.zh: 过去五年，我们向罪犯传递的讯息是：他们的权利比守法美国人的权利更重要。我不明白，为什么还会有人对之后的骚乱和社会混乱感到惊讶。

fdf13a8cd022351eb80c832ae5f5ebec4c978338.source: Over the years I've actually been tremendous friends with the Clintons. I really have. While they would be a disaster for the country, I don't want to get into that messy personal stuff.
fdf13a8cd022351eb80c832ae5f5ebec4c978338.zh: 这些年来，我和克林顿夫妇其实是非常要好的朋友，真的。虽然他们会给这个国家带来灾难，我却不想卷进那些乱七八糟的私事。

fb6fc97ea4a8572458b2d9e354735d3115fe2df7.source: Overall the deficit is still low. Furthermore, if we allow the free coinage of silver the amount of our deficit will decrease commensurably as our currency inflates.
fb6fc97ea4a8572458b2d9e354735d3115fe2df7.zh: 总体而言，赤字仍然很低。此外，如果允许白银自由铸币，随着通货膨胀，赤字的数额也会相应减少。

d5d2964a630dcdbd00d9abbf54f94554dbf7d092.source: Overall, are you satisfied with the trade relationship between the U.S. and China?
d5d2964a630dcdbd00d9abbf54f94554dbf7d092.zh: 总体而言，你是否满意美中贸易关系？

dc5b11e7e5dd6724f5b914dd3aa5f6ab0a602d69.source: Overall, the Trump University issue seems like a loser for you.
dc5b11e7e5dd6724f5b914dd3aa5f6ab0a602d69.zh: 总体而言，特朗普大学这个问题似乎会让你吃亏。

35c996519e9fe98b567d3cc603d1181408272328.source: Part of any compromise with Southern Democrats would involve a resolution in the territories. By what rights should planters be denied their opportunity to purchase western land?
35c996519e9fe98b567d3cc603d1181408272328.zh: 与南方民主党人达成任何妥协，都应当包括解决领地问题。凭什么剥夺种植园主购买西部土地的机会？

2c025582565b29692bc353f849c2a590e4f4b637.source: Part of any future compromise with Southern interests may involve the admission of Kansas as a slave state. We should not preclude that possibility at the current time.
2c025582565b29692bc353f849c2a590e4f4b637.zh: 未来与南方利益集团达成的妥协，可能包括接纳堪萨斯以蓄奴州身份加入联邦。眼下我们不应排除这种可能。

8eb950ad1604bf0eb51773f8f264bdee87b2faa1.source: Part of my campaign is about moving beyond the legacy of Obama and fighting more assertively for systemic ecnomic change. My focus will be more on appearing with Elizabeth Warren, Bernie Sanders, and others.
8eb950ad1604bf0eb51773f8f264bdee87b2faa1.zh: 我的竞选有一部分，就是超越奥巴马的政治遗产，更积极地争取系统性的经济变革。我会更着重于与伊丽莎白·沃伦、伯尼·桑德斯等人共同亮相。

8a06343fd5e8853baa03cbabf0cfb5d080db4c61.source: Part of our current economic problem is the inability of Congress to pass programs which would help the American worker. I'd rather see us have more housing, more roads, and better health care than to see us with an unnecessary surplus.
8a06343fd5e8853baa03cbabf0cfb5d080db4c61.zh: 我们当前经济问题的一个原因，是国会无法通过有助于美国劳动者的计划。与其维持不必要的盈余，我宁愿看到更多住房、更多道路和更好的医疗保障。

156a7b4ce6fd70e5cbce8245f1d919a9009074a5.source: Our goal is a society that works for everyone. The Black Panthers have instigated some ugly incidents, and I believe on the balance that they have done more harm than good for the cause of integration.
156a7b4ce6fd70e5cbce8245f1d919a9009074a5.zh: 我们的目标，是建立一个让所有人都能过上好日子的社会。黑豹党挑起过一些恶劣事件，总的来说，我认为它们对种族融合事业的危害大于贡献。

b82957f079cff4ee0d58147ad2f2714edf438da3.source: Our inflation is being caused by all of this Great Society nonsense that Johnson passed. I will slash these programs, slash our deficits, and end our inflation problem overnight.
b82957f079cff4ee0d58147ad2f2714edf438da3.zh: 我们的通货膨胀，正是约翰逊通过的那些“伟大社会”荒唐政策造成的。我会大幅削减这些项目、削减赤字，一夜之间结束通胀问题。

27955bdeb4ad5b8418fd1c09f642a197d9e3d825.source: Our most productive citizens need further tax cuts to stimulate business confidence, investment, and further job creation.
27955bdeb4ad5b8418fd1c09f642a197d9e3d825.zh: 我们最有生产力的公民需要进一步减税，以提振企业信心、促进投资，并创造更多就业。

0589605bd3b5028bf7c35134cb7b4f436a56c1c9.source: Our national party should avoid addressing this issue.
0589605bd3b5028bf7c35134cb7b4f436a56c1c9.zh: 我们这个全国性政党应当避免评论此事。

717ff362587bb4af3f40aa0115ed4fdb40c24f71.source: Our party must stand for the abolition of slavery in this country.
717ff362587bb4af3f40aa0115ed4fdb40c24f71.zh: 我们党必须主张废除本国的奴隶制。

469360a01f4c4b38e823df91728cc50713450772.source: Our party rejected Seward because of his unpopularity in states like Illinois and Indiana. Let's wait until after the election before we extend the olive branch to him.
469360a01f4c4b38e823df91728cc50713450772.zh: 我们党没有提名苏厄德，是因为他在伊利诺伊和印第安纳等州不受欢迎。等大选结束，我们再向他伸出橄榄枝吧。

b927fe10c9171fba9b76882fe2de585cb45fb115.source: Our party supports a high tariff and I'm proud of that fact. We need to emphasize this point during our campaign.
b927fe10c9171fba9b76882fe2de585cb45fb115.zh: 我们党支持高关税，我为此自豪。竞选时必须强调这一点。

7decad3f51ca0a8358e75442af6d0f8cc0c362ce.source: Our position on higher tariffs is in the platform for everyone to read and discuss. We don't need to belabor the point.
7decad3f51ca0a8358e75442af6d0f8cc0c362ce.zh: 我们对提高关税的立场已写入纲领，供所有人阅读讨论，没有必要反复强调。

0726ee8974f141e3ffaa55fdf192bd7f76d694bb.source: Our position on the railroad is clearly stated the platform. Our primary focus needs to be on halting the spread of slavery.
0726ee8974f141e3ffaa55fdf192bd7f76d694bb.zh: 我们的铁路立场已在纲领中明确写出。主要精力应当放在阻止奴隶制扩张上。

f61e47941754e63ee2e81eef8be86195f48ed73d.source: Our prosperity depends on the expansion of trade, especially with neighboring countries like Mexico and Canada. We should also expand our programs to support and retrain workers who are displaced.
f61e47941754e63ee2e81eef8be86195f48ed73d.zh: 我们的繁荣有赖于扩大贸易，特别是与墨西哥和加拿大等邻国的贸易。我们也应扩大项目，支持并再培训失去工作的劳动者。

3f2f6f59dc57b663164fb7370d278f27bd57ec5d.source: Our relationship with China, depends on China. If they show a greater willingness to cooperate, then we can rebuild our relationship from the damage that Trump inflicted. If they continue to act in a hostile manner, we'll have to react accordingly.
3f2f6f59dc57b663164fb7370d278f27bd57ec5d.zh: 我们与中国的关系，取决于中国。如果他们表现出更大的合作意愿，我们就能从特朗普造成的损害中重建关系。如果他们继续采取敌对做法，我们也必须相应回应。

edf9670cc7f57987ea68b868747c128d401770dd.source: Our speakers should converge on Illinois from all directions. We need to blanket this state with advertising and with political parades.
edf9670cc7f57987ea68b868747c128d401770dd.zh: 我们的演说者应当从四面八方汇聚伊利诺伊，用广告和政治游行覆盖全州。

2a12bec25bff5afa94e09e766231cea78f2a02ee.source: Our strategy in Afghanistan under Barack Obama was a total disaster with the surge. All I'm saying is we need to stop wasting our time and get our troops out, and I'd like to see that happen by the end of my term.
2a12bec25bff5afa94e09e766231cea78f2a02ee.zh: 贝拉克·奥巴马时期，我们在阿富汗靠增兵推进的战略，完全是一场灾难。我只是在说，别再浪费时间了，让军队撤出来。我希望在本届任期结束前做到。

3d362fc1595c86f672fdec1de64b9cfb93bda17d.source: People had their doubts about whether you were prepared to energize your base with the communism issue, but you have proven them wrong.
3d362fc1595c86f672fdec1de64b9cfb93bda17d.zh: 人们原本怀疑，你是否准备借共产主义议题激发基本盘，但你证明他们想错了。

0b70e1760bfd22fca588ffd95d92434554d7e052.source: People have been saying all along that a recession would make Clinton's chances harder, since Democrats would be somewhat incriminated.
0b70e1760bfd22fca588ffd95d92434554d7e052.zh: 大家一直都在说，经济衰退会让克林顿更难取胜，因为民主党多少会受到牵连。

ae34eb19015a7411d294db9e3cc643812832e110.source: People have different opinions about the ACLU. I won't go into it too much on this campaign.
ae34eb19015a7411d294db9e3cc643812832e110.zh: 人们对美国公民自由联盟看法不同。这场竞选中，我不会多谈这个问题。

4248a5bda1371b7b11c3f33ebfcd49aa21063ea5.source: People joke about what “serious danger” means, but you seem to be leaving the door open to some exceptions.
4248a5bda1371b7b11c3f33ebfcd49aa21063ea5.zh: 人们拿“严重危险”的含义开玩笑，但你似乎为某些例外留了余地。

fa2d23a7cd87f9528a134a349b6f57ec50203ab7.source: People know all about Donald Trump and the dozens of scandals that have unfolded around him. I think we're better off talking about solutions to the COVID-19 crisis and the economy.
fa2d23a7cd87f9528a134a349b6f57ec50203ab7.zh: 大家都知道唐纳德·特朗普，以及围绕他出现的数十桩丑闻。我想，还是谈解决新冠危机和经济问题的办法更好。

16aac02c92f0c51a73a5e732daa417ea15ab9287.source: People know that you have a strong opinion on the national bank -- there's no need to veer into extremism.
16aac02c92f0c51a73a5e732daa417ea15ab9287.zh: 人们知道，你在国家银行问题上立场鲜明，没有必要走向极端。

35588e7ef32cfa2ae7fb1f981f33bb79404d5b95.source: People like Dwight Eisenhower, and it's rarely a bad idea to assume his legacy.
35588e7ef32cfa2ae7fb1f981f33bb79404d5b95.zh: 人们喜欢德怀特·艾森豪威尔，承继他的政治遗产，通常不会是坏主意。

5217968c1812988f426170cca7ff649556cb903e.source: People note a bit of an attack from the left in these statements.
5217968c1812988f426170cca7ff649556cb903e.zh: 人们注意到，这些话多少带着从左翼角度发动攻击的意味。

80796fba11c2d1fa6d59b4e9b1de433b90f29cf6.source: People note that you are vigorously pushing for more economic stimulus and relief payments.
80796fba11c2d1fa6d59b4e9b1de433b90f29cf6.zh: 人们注意到，你正大力推动更多经济刺激和救助款。

e610d8542f1f1d4cb02987ffa965bbe715893786.source: People note your emphasis of Pence's strong conservative credentials.
e610d8542f1f1d4cb02987ffa965bbe715893786.zh: 人们注意到，你强调了彭斯坚定的保守派资历。

bbafbbd4abc7640a0bb7bcdc9d64941290bbf272.source: People note your emphasis of Sessions's strong conservative credentials.
bbafbbd4abc7640a0bb7bcdc9d64941290bbf272.zh: 人们注意到，你强调了塞申斯坚定的保守派资历。

3d3b658cfd0f055006c27cde62e939d20705ed2e.source: People notice your surpisingly strong tone on global warming.
3d3b658cfd0f055006c27cde62e939d20705ed2e.zh: 人们注意到，你在全球变暖问题上的语气出人意料地强硬。

b73f908930870ddc9e8d054b426218874f680112.source: People notice, for better or worse, that you aren't a typical Republican when it comes to guns.
b73f908930870ddc9e8d054b426218874f680112.zh: 不管是好是坏，人们都注意到，在枪支问题上，你不是典型的共和党人。

9793d702be62c4484d95e82f4410476591e820c9.source: People on all sides mostly see you trying to strike a middle path on the "Bernie question".
9793d702be62c4484d95e82f4410476591e820c9.zh: 各方大多认为，你在“伯尼问题”上试图走一条中间路线。

4861c074ee11c0e3f48f334088343039fcb3b19d.source: People on the left continue to spread lies and misinformation about our attempts to develop a vaccine. No less than Kamala Harris just said she wouldn't take it. That's the biggest threat to recovery during my second term.
4861c074ee11c0e3f48f334088343039fcb3b19d.zh: 左翼继续对我们开发疫苗的努力散布谎言和虚假信息。连卡玛拉·哈里斯都刚说，她不会接种。这才是我第二任期经济复苏的最大威胁。

0bca925690e7f7b5068527c8e2286690e65054e4.source: People sense that you're trying to hedge on a difficult issue.
0bca925690e7f7b5068527c8e2286690e65054e4.zh: 人们觉得，你在一个棘手问题上试图两面讨好。

f1331df4f652ddf9fa8214615c909bc1220f3e29.source: People want an outsider in government. I'm in a unique position to unite the country and move it towards a newer, more open chapter in its history.
f1331df4f652ddf9fa8214615c909bc1220f3e29.zh: 人民希望政府里有个局外人。我处在一个独特的位置，能够团结国家，引领它进入历史上一个崭新、更加开放的篇章。

277cb25c5249f66136c93a34ff6b46126717a9c5.source: Parts of the party are falling back in line, albeit begrudgingly. It’s better than nothing.
277cb25c5249f66136c93a34ff6b46126717a9c5.zh: 党内一些人开始重新服从统一步调，尽管很不情愿。总比没有好。

1794a0cbdff8e2d4a62bf203162ba9ff903f748a.source: Paul Ryan has gained national attention with his work on the federal budget as a Congressman from Wisconsin. His advocacy for deficit reduction appeals to a wide range of moderate conservatives, and his home state of Wisconsin promises to be a close call on election night.
1794a0cbdff8e2d4a62bf203162ba9ff903f748a.zh: 保罗·瑞安 作为 威斯康星州 国会议员，在联邦预算方面的工作引起了全国关注。他对削减赤字的主张吸引了广泛的温和保守派，而他的家乡州威斯康星州有望在选举之夜险些获胜。

15741b98da2174f05b26878d03a52f9892a72503.source: Pell Grants and government aid serve to inflate the cost of college by a commensurate amount. This program does not benefit students in any way and serves as a boondoggle for administrators.
15741b98da2174f05b26878d03a52f9892a72503.zh: 佩尔助学金和政府资助，只会让大学费用相应上涨。这项计划丝毫没有让学生受益，反而成了学校管理者浪费公帑的项目。

9037737e325592a088a3928cd0dfdcb6de108081.source: People are confused by your sudden shift on what should be a winning issue.
9037737e325592a088a3928cd0dfdcb6de108081.zh: 在一个本应有利于你的议题上突然转向，让人们感到困惑。

658c318bf60ae9fca1ab58d86cdbf3000058010b.source: People are noticing the amount of time you are putting into Illinois. Do you have a plan which depends upon that state?
658c318bf60ae9fca1ab58d86cdbf3000058010b.zh: 人们注意到，你在伊利诺伊花了很多时间。你的计划是不是仰赖这个州？

d1ef3cbcd667dedebd10bcb576f2f9bac46eb7c1.source: People are noticing the amount of time you are putting into New York. Do you have a plan which depends upon that state?
d1ef3cbcd667dedebd10bcb576f2f9bac46eb7c1.zh: 人们注意到，你在纽约花了很多时间。你的计划是不是仰赖这个州？

b29a95ee3e4554aa63adb7075281567048994346.source: People are noting your surprisingly nuanced tone on the abortion issue.
b29a95ee3e4554aa63adb7075281567048994346.zh: 人们注意到，你在堕胎问题上的语气竟然如此细致、有分寸。

94e41fe997c5b633da4da1725d4bd09bfea97f28.source: People are scratching their heads at the speech you just gave. Does this represent some kind of a break with the Democratic leadership?
94e41fe997c5b633da4da1725d4bd09bfea97f28.zh: 人们对你刚才的演说感到困惑。这是不是意味着，你与民主党领导层发生了某种决裂？

703cb949f6875e715cc3bd356862a1e5c8a58e67.source: People are surprised at your passive stance towards Trump.
703cb949f6875e715cc3bd356862a1e5c8a58e67.zh: 人们对你如此被动地对待特朗普感到意外。

1c9d0b1bf7aebcdaf223ee9c8a188e6b123da91f.source: People are surprised to hear you in sympathy with the progressive wing of the Democratic coalition.
1c9d0b1bf7aebcdaf223ee9c8a188e6b123da91f.zh: 听到你赞同民主党联盟中的进步派，人们感到惊讶。

6c90007399110bc6ed6d354253369fdbfa978bdd.source: People are whispering that you sound more like Barry Goldwater than Gerald Ford.
6c90007399110bc6ed6d354253369fdbfa978bdd.zh: 人们私下议论，说你听起来更像巴里·戈德华特，而不是杰拉尔德·福特。

96335ebe80bc475f4305d48817eec158d61cb5af.source: People are whispering that you sound more like Ronald Reagan than Gerald Ford.
96335ebe80bc475f4305d48817eec158d61cb5af.zh: 人们私下议论，说你听起来更像罗纳德·里根，而不是杰拉尔德·福特。

afe7cf899689c3a41d9c30ff940154700e102b7f.source: People are wondering if they are reading your words correctly. Annexation was supposed to be the primary issue of your campaign.
afe7cf899689c3a41d9c30ff940154700e102b7f.zh: 人们怀疑自己是不是看错了你的话。吞并本来应该是你竞选的首要议题。

68452c941c88e403162947ba0cb27843afa4dc4b.source: People are wondering what you were thinking when you said this.
68452c941c88e403162947ba0cb27843afa4dc4b.zh: 大家都在想，你说这话时到底是怎么想的。

8cd18ca879fe939f48fa3f5a92923d81fb40e9e8.source: People certainly love Elizabeth Warren, but Sanders's relatively minimal role does not go unnoticed.
8cd18ca879fe939f48fa3f5a92923d81fb40e9e8.zh: 人们当然喜欢伊丽莎白·沃伦，但桑德斯的角色相对微不足道，也没有逃过大家的眼睛。

8d4f6852f38f00b5ef44879a49a2913b9210a485.source: People detect a subtle change of position in your stance on Syria.
8d4f6852f38f00b5ef44879a49a2913b9210a485.zh: 人们察觉，你对叙利亚的立场有了微妙变化。

35ed13eedf5cb2a7c478b17eefc5480fb3aeacb8.source: People disagree on this practice and decision, but the Supreme Court deserves our respect.
35ed13eedf5cb2a7c478b17eefc5480fb3aeacb8.zh: 人们对堕胎和这项判决意见不一，但最高法院值得我们尊重。

98428623fe75756d0d065ac97668ea92a2651f6f.source: People want to see a President who is tough on Communism, but even some staunch anti-Communists feel that sending troops to such tiny and remote islands is ill-advised.
98428623fe75756d0d065ac97668ea92a2651f6f.zh: 人们希望总统强硬对抗共产主义，但即便一些坚定的反共人士，也认为把军队派到如此偏远的小岛并不明智。

d27828d98039df46790459891d87cb820a8a1ec7.source: People will definitely have second-thoughts when they see the Republican Congress turn its back on its own platform. Consensus seems to be that this was a brilliant maneuver on your part.
d27828d98039df46790459891d87cb820a8a1ec7.zh: 看到共和党控制的国会背弃自己的党纲，人们肯定会重新考虑。大家似乎一致认为，你这一招十分高明。

d3661043126baf7679dc38f44aff53ce12b6ac5f.source: People wonder if you're using this position to hedge away from your college tuition plan.
d3661043126baf7679dc38f44aff53ce12b6ac5f.zh: 人们怀疑，你是否借这个立场，给自己的大学学费计划留退路。

1fb8eb3116ea795a7aa800b577c8a25386ab402e.source: People wonder what you mean by this. You emphasize that you're not talking about income tax increases.
1fb8eb3116ea795a7aa800b577c8a25386ab402e.zh: 人们不明白你这是什么意思。你强调，自己并不是在谈提高所得税。

48d4988b569de5b41eb8553184f008102852e14f.source: People, by and large, will judge the Party on its own merits. But Clay's comments have not been helpful.
48d4988b569de5b41eb8553184f008102852e14f.zh: 总体上，人们还是会根据党的表现来判断，不过克莱的言论并没有帮上忙。

42e0867c7dd57bb647cf55cbfdac44c73add8fe8.source: Perhaps a good sentiment for a more united time, but disaffected liberals in the party fail to see what common goals are left.
42e0867c7dd57bb647cf55cbfdac44c73add8fe8.zh: 在更团结的年代，这番话也许动听，可党内不满的自由派看不出，还剩下什么共同目标。

60f97c7eecb1d281cc2b36050808a0f97be79f33.source: Perhaps as a compromise with the sentiment of the Deep South, we could accept a new position on this issue.
60f97c7eecb1d281cc2b36050808a0f97be79f33.zh: 或许，为了向深南部的情绪作出妥协，我们可以在这个问题上接受一个新立场。

c62c519936d54922902f03eac15c62761f6d2bd1.source: Perhaps if collective bargaining was protected, companies would have less cause to fear their own employees.
c62c519936d54922902f03eac15c62761f6d2bd1.zh: 如果集体谈判得到保障，企业也许就没那么多理由害怕自己的雇员了。

2c429948e4dba4bf2a5834054c40a25b523e4d72.source: Perhaps if our goal is to prevent drinking on Sunday, or public drunkenness, I am all for those measures. But a blanket temperance law is a different story.
2c429948e4dba4bf2a5834054c40a25b523e4d72.zh: 如果目标是禁止周日饮酒，或禁止在公共场所醉酒，我完全支持。但全面禁酒的法律，就是另一回事了。

e5ee6d5e92ef46c0ac0476fdf18dad3fcc16eb4f.source: Perhaps in limited cases. I am skeptical of these programs because they place too much faith in Mexican authorities to pursue cases once they cross the border.
e5ee6d5e92ef46c0ac0476fdf18dad3fcc16eb4f.zh: 也许在少数情况下可行。我对这些行动持怀疑态度，因为枪支越过边境之后，行动能否继续侦办，过分依赖墨西哥当局。

bace9dab091ea77b71420f49959730d7adfaaa2d.source: Perhaps in part to your vague statements, in comparison to most other issues, gay marriage does not come up very frequently in this election.
bace9dab091ea77b71420f49959730d7adfaaa2d.zh: 也许部分原因在于你含糊的表态，与大多数其他议题相比，同性婚姻在这次选举中并不经常被提起。

a9339b59442f2b40c15e2abf5893b4ccd49d1993.source: Perhaps it is best to defer on this issue for now, and point to the agencies in charge of such a decision.
a9339b59442f2b40c15e2abf5893b4ccd49d1993.zh: 也许现在最好暂不作判断，指出应由主管机构决定。

ff74191754453facceca39ba0a5a201bdea42a32.source: Perhaps it was always a long-shot -- the American people just seemed ready to move on from Reagan.
ff74191754453facceca39ba0a5a201bdea42a32.zh: 也许这始终是一个渺茫的机会——美国人民似乎已经准备好从 里根 继续前进。

a9e7007ed130fe67d07f26030cd20a60a5b4c7ca.source: Perhaps it was always a long-shot, with the Democrats in such a commanding position after eight years of Bill Clinton. In any case, at least you are still the Governor of Texas.
a9e7007ed130fe67d07f26030cd20a60a5b4c7ca.zh: 也许这始终是一个渺茫的机会，因为民主党在比尔·克林顿八年后占据了如此主导的地位。无论如何，至少你还是得克萨斯州的总督。

cebf2cead207c314c7e4bce5cc8aa541b01264f5.source: Perhaps not a Constitutional Amendment. These should be reserved for the most serious of issues. I think we can investigate maybe other ways to prevent money from having an undue influence in politics.
cebf2cead207c314c7e4bce5cc8aa541b01264f5.zh: 也许不该动用宪法修正案。修宪应留给最重大问题。我认为，我们可以研究其他办法，防止金钱对政治产生不当影响。

20a340ac623b66aa0f4a6fdcd92c69f88e87f8a2.source: Perhaps the abolitionist wing of the party got a little ahead of themselves when they foisted Cassius Clay onto the ticket.
20a340ac623b66aa0f4a6fdcd92c69f88e87f8a2.zh: 党内废奴派把卡修斯·克莱硬塞进竞选组合时，或许有些操之过急了。

050d124c14a91240df323ae773ab2dfea488810b.source: Perhaps the media attention would be beneficial in building excitement for your campaign on a national scale?
050d124c14a91240df323ae773ab2dfea488810b.zh: 也许媒体的关注有助于在全国范围内激发您的竞选活动热情？

61529d7206bb9eecfac7f21f05d51f44b3fbe660.source: Perhaps the media should stop asking you questions about Dr. King and instead your role in Nixon’s presidential transition.
61529d7206bb9eecfac7f21f05d51f44b3fbe660.zh: 媒体或许应该停止问你对金博士的看法，转而问问你将在尼克松的总统交接中扮演什么角色。

06be9c8c1308ae6c84278364e89753c6b544a617.source: Perhaps there is a misunderstanding. I will defend labor unions, fight against the temperance movements, and ensure adequate patronage jobs for New York Democrats. All I ask in return is that they deliver New York to the ticket.
06be9c8c1308ae6c84278364e89753c6b544a617.zh: 也许有些误会。我会捍卫工会、反对禁酒运动，并为纽约民主党人提供足够的酬庸官职。作为回报，我只要求他们替我们的竞选组合拿下纽约。

8274ac7eb824bcde599b9af9587a8796af7223b7.source: Perhaps there is a role for this, but our primary focus should be on targeting the cartels overseas and on providing military and economic support to any government that will assist us in that endeavor.
8274ac7eb824bcde599b9af9587a8796af7223b7.zh: 这也许有一定作用，但我们的首要重点应该是打击海外贩毒集团，并为愿意帮助我们的政府提供军事与经济支持。

8250062b1e2f8b5f16366cae2aec158f3d7a07d4.source: Perhaps we can consider letting these expire at some point in the future, but for now we are mired in a stagnant economy and need to avoid tax increases.
8250062b1e2f8b5f16366cae2aec158f3d7a07d4.zh: 也许将来某个时候可以考虑让它到期，但眼下经济停滞不前，我们需要避免增税。

923946526c4cc14181d2a44dc95f1abd0fffc879.source: Perhaps. It depends on if these tariffs cause other countries to retaliate against our agricultural goods. This is always a risk when tariffs are increased in haphazard fashion.
923946526c4cc14181d2a44dc95f1abd0fffc879.zh: 也许吧。这取决于，这些关税是否会使其他国家报复我国农产品。随意提高关税，总会有这种风险。

89cabc2e735c0963ebd713f02b26c5b7a7e47acc.zh: 美国药品研究与制造商协会

d47ae818d198d889bfe32f5e639508d8029f2268.source: Playboy definitely twisted these words to make them worse than they were. I will apologize profusely to the Johnson family and clarify this statement.
d47ae818d198d889bfe32f5e639508d8029f2268.zh: 《花花公子》确实歪曲了这些话，让它们比原来更难听。我会郑重向约翰逊家人道歉，并澄清这番话。

dbe6c2d02bb77279d6f3dcd12ba8db315f922407.source: Pointing at your accomplishments elevates the tone of the campaign, as well as adding a nice sheen to your image.
dbe6c2d02bb77279d6f3dcd12ba8db315f922407.zh: 强调你的政绩，提高了竞选的格调，也让你的形象更加光彩。

b0923f6ca09dc13f8eb9bb31e9f7e4259de50889.source: Pointing attention to Johnson’s faults is always a good thing.
b0923f6ca09dc13f8eb9bb31e9f7e4259de50889.zh: 让人们把注意力转向约翰逊的过错，总是好事。

f959b017cc4b48b4ca1ce489015a363459c0c371.source: Political issues are secondary to character issues, and the Democrats are anxious to win after '68 and '72.
f959b017cc4b48b4ca1ce489015a363459c0c371.zh: 政治问题比品格问题次要，民主党在 68 年和 72 年之后渴望获胜。

f6e7e4519faca34d17b5e76a43a0f7678bf51240.source: Political issues are secondary to character issues, and there's no need to pigeonhole yourself yet.
f6e7e4519faca34d17b5e76a43a0f7678bf51240.zh: 政策议题不及品格问题重要，你现在没有必要给自己的立场套上固定标签。

9b7237c6d9867d3be68f47885e1d79aa0d5c82a3.source: Politically, Nixon will hammer on the issues of "law and order", and on ending the war in Vietnam. He hopes to pick up enough mainstream support to split the difference between Humphrey's liberalism and Wallace's extremeism.
9b7237c6d9867d3be68f47885e1d79aa0d5c82a3.zh: 政治上，尼克松 将重点讨论“法律与秩序”问题以及结束越南战争。他希望获得足够的主流支持来区分汉弗莱的自由主义和华莱士的极端主义。

7d6ced8275ab92384fb033f786fd25e283ef60d2.source: Politically, it may be perilous to come out this supportive of China, particularly with stories about Hong Kong and Xinjiang increasingly finding their way into the news.
7d6ced8275ab92384fb033f786fd25e283ef60d2.zh: 在政治上，如此公开支持中国可能很危险，尤其是关于香港和新疆的报道越来越多。

e80edb97b81bdb0918e1b2569498ba4e513c0449.source: Polk: The Man Who Transformed the Presidency and America
e80edb97b81bdb0918e1b2569498ba4e513c0449.zh: 波尔克：改变总统和美国的人

55170458e247c9390752436f30ffde0177df134e.source: Polls are swinging your way a bit in the aftermath of this announcement. Could this be the break that gets you over the hump?
55170458e247c9390752436f30ffde0177df134e.zh: 这项公告之后，民调略微向你倾斜。这会不会正是让你跨过难关的转机？

c4d4ad78a81d4eb9fa5061ba89b9dbc1e01ddc4c.source: Poor citizens love it, but moderates and conservatives are less amused.
c4d4ad78a81d4eb9fa5061ba89b9dbc1e01ddc4c.zh: 贫困民众喜欢它，但温和派和保守派没那么高兴。

1f61f310f2be33afd75784cd402653000fb4d55d.source: Possibly most agonizing of all is the fact that you won the popular vote despite losing the election. You and your fellow Democrats are sure to be discussing the electoral college again for a while, but don't expect a Trump presidency to do anything about it...
1f61f310f2be33afd75784cd402653000fb4d55d.zh: 也许最令人痛苦的是，你明明赢得了普选票，却输掉了选举。你和民主党同僚肯定又会讨论选举人团一阵子，但别指望特朗普执政后会对此采取什么行动……

be0bdf3d5ba2c6a7ae725950de42e411630e3fc8.source: Pragmatism -- Our foreign policy right now is effective. We need to guide foreign nations towards democracy and open markets. Doing so will increase the world's prosperity and decrease the chance of future wars.
be0bdf3d5ba2c6a7ae725950de42e411630e3fc8.zh: 务实主义——我们目前的外交政策行之有效。我们需要引导外国走向民主与开放市场。这样做将使世界更加繁荣，也会降低未来发生战争的可能性。

edc3d77ce6def762536f55aa8c9b7d876a0fb82e.source: Preparedness is a bellicose policy which leads us closer to the very thing we are preparing against -- war, that is.
edc3d77ce6def762536f55aa8c9b7d876a0fb82e.zh: 备战是一项好战政策，会让我们更接近本来要防范的事——也就是战争。

aefae1c42aa3dbf3e131766585f343f85f283df0.source: President Clay is sure to obstruct the annexation of Texas. Hopefully a new President can bring this to a better conclusion in four years. In the meantime, your voice may hold some influence, in an advisory capacity, with the Democratic majority in Congress. It is unlikely, however, that you will be nominated for President over the likes of Lewis Cass, James Buchanan, or others in 1848.
aefae1c42aa3dbf3e131766585f343f85f283df0.zh: 克莱总统肯定会阻碍得克萨斯州的吞并。希望新总统能够在四年内给这个问题带来更好的结果。与此同时，你的声音可能会以顾问的身份对国会中的民主党多数派产生一定的影响力。然而，您不太可能在 1848 年击败刘易斯·卡斯 (Lewis Cass)、詹姆斯 (James) 布坎南 或其他人而被提名为总统。

c9b9eb6e5034340b616d38c3f1c932a016a8b340.source: President Donald Trump enters the campaign with the advantages of incumbency, yet seems to be the underdog for a second time. Can Trump piece together a winning coalition again, and will it be the same one that got him over the finish line in 2016? The pandemic and Black Lives Matter movement only serve to complicate his task even further.
c9b9eb6e5034340b616d38c3f1c932a016a8b340.zh: 总统 唐纳德·特朗普 凭借在任总统的优势进入竞选，但似乎第二次处于劣势。 特朗普 能否再次组建一个获胜联盟，这会是 2016 年让他冲过终点线的那个联盟吗？大流行和“黑人生命也是命”运动只会让他的任务更加复杂。

2128ebbbf33d4773982aef66b0af5501a8a59a81.source: President Gerald Ford attempts to win election to office after replacing Richard Nixon in 1974, and narrowly defeating Ronald Reagan for the Republican nomination. Jimmy Carter is a new face on the national scene, having served as Governor of Georgia. He will make the case that the nation needs new blood after the scandals of the Nixon era. Both candidates are seen as moderate by the standards of their party. The battleground states are in the West, the Midwest, and the Northeast.
2128ebbbf33d4773982aef66b0af5501a8a59a81.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特总统于1974年接替理查德·尼克松，随后险胜罗纳德·里根，获得共和党提名。如今，他希望通过选举正式赢得总统职位。曾任佐治亚州州长的吉米·卡特是全国政坛的新面孔。他将强调，经历尼克松时代的丑闻后，美国需要新鲜血液。按各自党内的标准，两人都属于温和派。主要战场位于西部、中西部和东北部。

7ba17868fb0fa02cddc31f62e6cee4e060b4c3ab.source: President Polk is sure to go through with the annexation of Texas. You can only hope it doesn't lead to war. Even if the U.S. is successful in the short-term, the acquisition of such territory is sure to reopen the slavery question in a way which may hurt the Whigs. As for your own fortunes, you have likely missed your last chance to become President. How will your legacy be remembered?
7ba17868fb0fa02cddc31f62e6cee4e060b4c3ab.zh: 总统 波尔克 肯定会吞并 得克萨斯州。你只能希望它不会导致战争。即使美国在短期内取得成功，获得这些领土也肯定会以可能损害辉格党人的方式重新引发奴隶制问题。至于你自己的命运，你很可能已经错过了最后一次成为总统的机会。您的遗产将如何被铭记？

882ecb7b097e871ce3b63c713e3a50905fe376e5.source: President Trump has repeatedly dodged the question when asked whether he will accept the results of this year's election. Do you have any statements to make?
882ecb7b097e871ce3b63c713e3a50905fe376e5.zh: 特朗普总统多次被问到是否接受今年的选举结果，却一再回避。你有什么话要说？

dd69ad664dd6c2ecca27f23529b65bdede1e4e40.source: President Tyler has defined the key issue of this election with his proposed annexation of Texas. James K. Polk, the Democrat, gained his nomination by favoring the measure. Henry Clay, the Whig, has more latitude.
dd69ad664dd6c2ecca27f23529b65bdede1e4e40.zh: 泰勒总统提出吞并得克萨斯，为本届选举确立了核心议题。民主党人詹姆斯·K.·波尔克因支持这一提议而获得提名；辉格党人亨利·克莱则有更大的回旋余地。

f9a1e9a9a086783533c1b8af18907b902edfbb83.source: Probably a smart move to walk back from these comments, although it does undermine your claims to honesty by a small amount.
f9a1e9a9a086783533c1b8af18907b902edfbb83.zh: 收回这些话，大概是明智的做法，尽管多少损害了你自称诚实的形象。

c5390ba68478e292c5b70e98a3ca40edeaaec764.source: Probably best to avoid yet another controversy involving Romney.
c5390ba68478e292c5b70e98a3ca40edeaaec764.zh: 大概最好别再引发一场与罗姆尼有关的争议。

1da6404d7043b283655d3e80b16b3744d853b6c4.source: Probably best to ignore this letter.
1da6404d7043b283655d3e80b16b3744d853b6c4.zh: 大概还是不理会这封信最好。

8e87c40aa59f57a69a0334bed6845c73ae27b7c8.source: Probably opposed to Obamacare. Would probably support malpractice reform and other incremental measures to cut overall health care costs, without challenging the larger regulatory system.
8e87c40aa59f57a69a0334bed6845c73ae27b7c8.zh: 大概反对奥巴马医改。可能支持医疗事故责任制度改革等渐进措施，以降低医疗总成本，但不挑战整体监管体系。

e3aef6c45fe97572364e7cff4136fea47834ae01.source: Probably the best answer. The nation doesn't like interracial marriage, but doesn’t want laws pertaining to its legality.
e3aef6c45fe97572364e7cff4136fea47834ae01.zh: 这大概是最好的回答。全国民众不喜欢跨种族婚姻，但也不希望用法律来规定它是否允许。

5437755c1ff0de0a328fef14b5b97cb0d33cce4f.source: Probably the correct answer for this minefield. You have to stick up for liberalism nationally.
5437755c1ff0de0a328fef14b5b97cb0d33cce4f.zh: 面对这个雷区，这大概是正确答案。你必须在全国捍卫自由主义。

dd7938817fd8cbdb8419e227ad9610707fc62365.source: Probably the effect is about equal, but it does allow American workers to focus on what they do best, which makes us more prosperous.
dd7938817fd8cbdb8419e227ad9610707fc62365.zh: 带来的得失大概相当，但它能让美国工人专注于自己最擅长的工作，使我们更加繁荣。

8aa8689370624624b8c3c08debbe7acf64caa46d.source: Programs like Head Start are the only way that we will end poverty in our cities and rural districts. I fought for this program from the beginning and I will support it as President.
8aa8689370624624b8c3c08debbe7acf64caa46d.zh: 启蒙计划这样的项目，是消除城市和农村贫困的唯一办法。我从一开始就在为这个项目奋斗，担任总统后也会支持它。

553fb5715ba5ccf36ced80bd4e75d54e5bd74a97.source: Progressive supporters praise your courageous position on immigration, but these statements will also make it hard to win back working-class Rust Belt voters.
553fb5715ba5ccf36ced80bd4e75d54e5bd74a97.zh: 进步派支持者赞赏你在移民问题上勇敢的立场，但这些话也会让你更难赢回铁锈地带的工人阶级选民。

8f8857c858ce39378e858eec39bb700f69d8e5e7.source: Progressives are pleased to see your anti-TPP position carry over into the general election.
8f8857c858ce39378e858eec39bb700f69d8e5e7.zh: 进步派很高兴看到，你反对TPP的立场延续到了大选。

6f2b5f54ceaa37ebfd8ca9417409012799537e9c.source: Progressives are starting to believe that you really walk the walk on TPP. Behind the scenes, Obama is not pleased with you, however.
6f2b5f54ceaa37ebfd8ca9417409012799537e9c.zh: 进步派开始相信，你在TPP问题上确实说到做到。不过，私下里奥巴马对你并不高兴。

b3773149bc796b62b4ad59a4751b6ccef3d9973b.source: Progressives fear that you are planning to abandon the $12/hour push, now that you have gotten Sanders out of the way.
b3773149bc796b62b4ad59a4751b6ccef3d9973b.zh: 进步派担心，既然你已经把桑德斯挤开，就打算放弃争取每小时12美元最低工资了。

f26910a8413f7c5e397dc8842a3132988b749402.source: Publicly, of course, I support any ally of the United States. But Kai-Shek has proven himself to be a disappointment, if you really want to know the truth. I will be careful about making any statement or policy which would commit the U.S. to his further defense.
f26910a8413f7c5e397dc8842a3132988b749402.zh: 在公开场合，我当然支持美国的任何盟友。不过，真要说实话，蒋介石的表现令人失望。我会谨慎作出任何表态或政策，以免使美国承诺进一步保卫他。

a12e909c3ad7071ed55d3e4d74019744f740b4c1.source: Pundits accuse you of dragging this campaign into the gutter, but maybe that's the point?
a12e909c3ad7071ed55d3e4d74019744f740b4c1.zh: 评论人士指责你把竞选拖进了污言秽语的泥潭，不过，也许这正是你的目的？

0fb370f66c22f3c79187b9e4b950a2b5564293c2.source: Pundits and political pros are shocked at your collapse. The second-guessing will likely come fast and furious from your party. The Republicans have now lost five Presidential elections in a row, and have no obvious standard-bearer to break the trend in 1952. As for your own career, you are still the Governor of New York, but it is pretty unlikely that you'll be given another chance to prove yourself on the national stage.
0fb370f66c22f3c79187b9e4b950a2b5564293c2.zh: 专家和政治专家对你的崩溃感到震惊。你的聚会可能会迅速而激烈地进行事后批评。共和党现在已经连续五次总统选举落败，并且没有明显的旗手能够打破1952年的趋势。至于你自己的职业生涯，你仍然是纽约州的州长，但你不太可能再有机会在国家舞台上证明自己。

2d815bbb99035b88777f2ea590b52ee0cd12a3ac.source: Pundits are asking whether you've implied that your plan doesn't go far enough.
2d815bbb99035b88777f2ea590b52ee0cd12a3ac.zh: 评论员都在问，你是否暗示自己的方案改革力度还不够。

25cb67bcfc1aed0ca8b32e64a3d1592b94a041cd.source: Pundits are noting a serious tone and a focus on COVID and competency in your opening speeches.
25cb67bcfc1aed0ca8b32e64a3d1592b94a041cd.zh: 评论人士注意到，你开场的演说语气严肃，着重强调新冠疫情和执政能力。

7cc9ffc8b9c1729c33553016bff8e4bcaa8e90fb.source: Pundits are noting a strong focus on Donald Trump's excesses in your opening speeches. Are you satisfied to make this election a referendum on Trump?
7cc9ffc8b9c1729c33553016bff8e4bcaa8e90fb.zh: 评论人士注意到，你开场的演说着重强调唐纳德·特朗普的过分行为。你愿意把这场选举变成对特朗普的全民评价吗？

924c0ca6a101e8f21b4de8da6eaf6bd430c54b48.source: Pundits are noting a strong focus on infrastructure and the economy in your opening speeches.
924c0ca6a101e8f21b4de8da6eaf6bd430c54b48.zh: 评论人士注意到，你开场的演说着重强调基础设施和经济。

2d64060cbf340e78c3c6bb107c08a058a6618c28.source: Pundits are noting a strong focus on unity and diversity in your opening speeches.
2d64060cbf340e78c3c6bb107c08a058a6618c28.zh: 评论人士注意到，你开场的演说着重强调团结与多元。

730f3641a0345cfcffc6869be3358f0d513fb19d.source: Pundits are shocked, trying to figure out how you managed to capture states outside the deep south to win it all. What happens next is entirely unknown. Its likely a crusader against the civil rights bill will happen, as well as the deconstruction of Great Society, and the escalation of Vietnam. Whatever happens, sit back and relax knowing you've done the greatest upset in US political history!
730f3641a0345cfcffc6869be3358f0d513fb19d.zh: 专家们感到震惊，试图弄清楚你是如何设法占领 深南部 之外的州并赢得这一切的。接下来会发生什么是完全未知的。很可能会发生针对民权法案的十字军东征，以及伟大社会的解构和越南的升级。无论发生什么，坐下来放松一下，因为你知道你已经造成了美国政治历史上最大的麻烦！

b671bfb981ce8f064c14c1085e3c175afcbb4a4c.source: Pundits are surprised by your harsh tone towards the Reds, but it’s dissolved the constant claims relating you to Communism. It’s clear you’re no pushover.
b671bfb981ce8f064c14c1085e3c175afcbb4a4c.zh: 评论人士对你针对赤色分子的强硬语气感到意外，但这打消了那些不断把你与共产主义联系起来的指控。显然，你不是任人拿捏的软柿子。

718e2ecbc814d7de2233bce78794b3ba66a5ff3b.source: Pundits are unanimous that you seemed, by far, the less presidential of the two candidates. Many are skeptical, though, that it will have any effect in this environment.
718e2ecbc814d7de2233bce78794b3ba66a5ff3b.zh: 评论人士一致认为，你在两人中远远更缺乏总统风范。不过，许多人怀疑，在这种政治环境下，这能有什么影响。

2c30d429b40edf137916b1e6398d9520e6b72ece.source: Pundits are unanimous that you seemed, by far, the more presidential of the two candidates. Many are skeptical, though, that it will have any effect in this environment.
2c30d429b40edf137916b1e6398d9520e6b72ece.zh: 评论人士一致认为，你在两人中远远更有总统风范。不过，许多人怀疑，在这种政治环境下，这能有什么影响。

223377731abd0a40dc154dfd7923f81c940ecd9c.source: Pundits are unsurprised by your campaign taking swings at Goldwater right out the gate, but it's having its intended effect.
223377731abd0a40dc154dfd7923f81c940ecd9c.zh: 评论员对你的竞选一开始就攻击戈德华特毫不意外，不过这些攻击正在达到预期效果。

ae27fd73eec936368fb20e75b6d09d6bbc7cac3e.source: Pundits conclude that your speech was somewhat moderate, unifying, and surprisingly non-controversial. Some just thought it was boring.
ae27fd73eec936368fb20e75b6d09d6bbc7cac3e.zh: 评论人士认为，你的演说有些温和、强调团结，而且出人意料地不具争议。有些人只觉得无聊。

953f92539cd3ef2e39a0644d461c853124da0f29.source: Pundits detect the standard, Democratic talking points in your speech that will appeal to a wide variety of potential supporters.
953f92539cd3ef2e39a0644d461c853124da0f29.zh: 评论人士在你的演说中听到了民主党的常规宣传口径，会吸引各种潜在支持者。

fd6ebcc14d10ef8fd4b118c7764b6cb582fee366.source: Pundits have started questioning the so-called Pence Rule, based on your running-mate's refusal to dine alone with a woman. What are your thoughts?
fd6ebcc14d10ef8fd4b118c7764b6cb582fee366.zh: 评论人士开始质疑所谓的“彭斯规则”，也就是你的搭档拒绝单独与女性共进晚餐的做法。你对此有什么看法？

4380a18f7cf112b1f9d4245311319214ff852498.source: Pundits have taken to callng you two "the odd couple", but Sanders is very popular with a variety of voter blocks.
4380a18f7cf112b1f9d4245311319214ff852498.zh: 评论人士开始把你们称作“不般配的一对”，但桑德斯在各种选民群体中都很受欢迎。

ef659bb8cfa3ee5310b393a3af5e1cf94c7d648c.source: Pundits may say it's a bad idea, but Sarah Palin can whip your crowds into a frenzy.
ef659bb8cfa3ee5310b393a3af5e1cf94c7d648c.zh: 评论人士也许会说这不是个好主意，但萨拉·佩林能让你的集会人群陷入狂热。

8f583fa350e68682eca803252281a908706ad3b0.source: Pundits note that Sherrod Brown is a surprisingly populist choice, and immediately focus on the implications for Ohio and the rust belt.
