8f583fa350e68682eca803252281a908706ad3b0.zh: 评论人士注意到，选择谢罗德·布朗出人意料地带有民粹主义色彩，立即开始关注这对俄亥俄州及铁锈地带的影响。

7c0040ad5dba2dcec029015bd84df217eece2cbd.source: Pundits note that Sherrod Brown is a surprisingly populist choice, and immediately focus on the implications for the rust belt.
7c0040ad5dba2dcec029015bd84df217eece2cbd.zh: 评论人士注意到，选择谢罗德·布朗出人意料地带有民粹主义色彩，立即开始关注这对铁锈地带的影响。

0040293b94a4c8b82c386e5e103a77ac03b7b81b.source: Pundits note that tax cuts have not been a big part of your stump speeches, whatever the implications may be.
0040293b94a4c8b82c386e5e103a77ac03b7b81b.zh: 评论人士注意到，不论这意味着什么，减税在你的巡回竞选演说里并没有占太大比重。

051574eff860a36d858f55890faa1784b4575db8.source: Pundits note that you are keeping your distance from the progressive left and presenting yourself as a much more traditional Democrat.
051574eff860a36d858f55890faa1784b4575db8.zh: 评论人士注意到，你正与进步派左翼保持距离，把自己塑造成更传统的民主党人。

b03655160353a4513b304cc09854754f1f5dbe9e.source: Pundits note the surprisingly strong tone of your speech about ISIS.
b03655160353a4513b304cc09854754f1f5dbe9e.zh: 评论人士注意到，你关于“伊斯兰国”的演说语气出人意料地强硬。

f79ae94c046ef3e5a6d1085ef4ba5f01fe2e20f2.source: Pundits note your emphasis of Pence's experience and credentials.
f79ae94c046ef3e5a6d1085ef4ba5f01fe2e20f2.zh: 评论人士注意到，你强调了彭斯的经验和资历。

97da089f8e2098dbb1a511c02a0d82473a48051e.source: Pundits note your emphasis on moderation, in constrast to the tone you set in the primaries.
97da089f8e2098dbb1a511c02a0d82473a48051e.zh: 评论人士注意到，你强调温和，与初选时的基调有所不同。

b97b81b61b54fbb5840a59a4a34e2e437e287aa9.source: Pundits note your emphasis on pragmatism, in constrast to the tone you set in the primaries.
b97b81b61b54fbb5840a59a4a34e2e437e287aa9.zh: 评论人士注意到，你强调务实，与初选时的基调有所不同。

fab7db6b625aa0f483331cf22db16e17bf91d2e6.source: Pundits on both the left and the right debate your about-face on this issue.
fab7db6b625aa0f483331cf22db16e17bf91d2e6.zh: 左翼与右翼的评论人士，都在讨论你在这个问题上的彻底转向。

d3d89568a1b08f45512b3097ef3b7e35456548ad.source: Pundits question whether you're giving the right number here, but it is true that many other politicians are quite wealthy.
d3d89568a1b08f45512b3097ef3b7e35456548ad.zh: 评论人士质疑，你这里说的数字是否正确，不过，确实有许多其他政治人物相当富有。

5308e2a1f17ebd2d19db4361b1499aca74b4c93c.source: Pundits saw few surprises in your acceptance speech, but you once again got your message across to millions of potential voters.
5308e2a1f17ebd2d19db4361b1499aca74b4c93c.zh: 评论人士认为，你的接受提名演说没什么出人意料之处，但你又一次把自己的信息传达给了数百万潜在选民。

bf5f150f8d9800b4703e564e600c2abdf2f6766d.source: Pundits seem to agree that Hillary Clinton was much better prepared than you, but emotions are so high that it's not clear whether it matters.
bf5f150f8d9800b4703e564e600c2abdf2f6766d.zh: 评论人士似乎一致认为，希拉里·克林顿的准备比你充分得多。不过，公众情绪如此激烈，还不清楚这是否真的重要。

486c40d73b5198f216aa33fbc568f316affd65c9.source: Pundits seem to think that you did surprisingly poorly against Trump, even if he was his usual wild self.
486c40d73b5198f216aa33fbc568f316affd65c9.zh: 评论人士似乎认为，面对特朗普，你的表现出人意料地差，尽管他也还是一贯狂放的样子。

0858651ec200279c617e8c98fa8386a010a71c40.source: Pundits speculate on your attempts to recreate the "Obama coalition" with your running-mate.
0858651ec200279c617e8c98fa8386a010a71c40.zh: 评论人士猜测，你正试图通过搭档人选重建“奥巴马选民联盟”。

86d35430a0d1478abf45a265c9ed769a2df61371.source: Pundits talk a lot about the surprisingly pugnacious and populist tone of your acceptance speech.
86d35430a0d1478abf45a265c9ed769a2df61371.zh: 评论人士热议你的接受提名演说中，那出人意料的好斗与民粹主义基调。

3fdc4c8082870d1d7102dd151c9e600d9dd9e82f.source: Pundits talk a lot about you eschewed ideology to take the attack to Trump.
3fdc4c8082870d1d7102dd151c9e600d9dd9e82f.zh: 评论人士热议你放下意识形态争论，转而直接攻击特朗普的做法。

d69a738b60510d368a3ce633fd271b0bd3fac2b0.source: Pundits, as much as they hate to admit it, must conclude that you really outperformed Clinton in the debates.
d69a738b60510d368a3ce633fd271b0bd3fac2b0.zh: 评论员尽管不愿承认，也只能得出结论：你在辩论中的表现确实胜过克林顿。

19567ae36f02d45550be699c194585e6f9199dba.source: Put out a magazine article denouncing all these crazy conspiracies, but don't mention the Birchers by name.
19567ae36f02d45550be699c194585e6f9199dba.zh: 发表一篇杂志文章，谴责这些疯狂的阴谋论，但不要点名伯奇协会的人。

ec9400b8a2f901f6041bf698de79746de486289b.source: Quay is not the cleanest politician however, and his long history makes him unpalatable to potential crossover Democrats.
ec9400b8a2f901f6041bf698de79746de486289b.zh: 奎 并不是最干净的政客，他悠久的历史使潜在的跨界民主党人无法接受他。

e46f8aaf361b1574b3bcd24feb847c98534fd538.source: Questions the underlying assumptions of capitalism. Supports massive increases in government programs, and would support government ownership of key industries, where appropriate.
e46f8aaf361b1574b3bcd24feb847c98534fd538.zh: 质疑资本主义的基本假设。支持大幅扩大政府项目，并在适当情况下由政府拥有关键行业。

f5e29980b1221f9ae26f48db3c98324f8eecbc42.source: Railroads gouge hardworking American farmers year after year, while giving preferred rates to large companies. I won't allow it.
f5e29980b1221f9ae26f48db3c98324f8eecbc42.zh: 铁路公司年复一年地敲诈辛勤的美国农民，却给大公司优惠运价。我不会允许这种做法。

e79a8412ef3b1df2d7777796a48f3b008f92371d.source: Ralph Nader enters the 2000 election as the Green candidate after years as an activist and consumer advocate.
e79a8412ef3b1df2d7777796a48f3b008f92371d.zh: 拉尔夫·纳德 在担任活动家和消费者权益倡导者多年后，作为绿党候选人参加 2000 年选举。

93ddb9d14b029ade293369c83f53f96d013ea528.source: Rather than directly imposing ourselves on Mexican territory, we should be seeking other ways to assist the rightful government in securing that country.
93ddb9d14b029ade293369c83f53f96d013ea528.zh: 与其直接进入墨西哥领土强加干预，我们更应该另寻办法，协助其合法政府恢复国家安全。

e6bb7fce2263c59c1026251e7500a74f0197e225.source: Read my lips. There will be no new anti-gun legislation when I am President.
e6bb7fce2263c59c1026251e7500a74f0197e225.zh: 听清楚了。我当总统期间，绝不会出台新的反枪支立法。

102d0d5c64a334bdb4f23a77ac39dc0a7a2a057b.source: Read my lips. There will be no new taxes under my Administration.
102d0d5c64a334bdb4f23a77ac39dc0a7a2a057b.zh: 听清楚了。在我执政期间，绝不增加新税。

d515f0eb618e26d9154665e7aa89da298f287e4d.source: Reagan and I have real common ground on the law and order issue. I will remind him of this when we discuss our politics.
d515f0eb618e26d9154665e7aa89da298f287e4d.zh: 里根和我在法律与秩序问题上确实有共同立场。谈论政治时，我会提醒他这一点。

a800ff246560d016e395fbb2a4316625420f89cc.source: Reagan has a substantial following among Republicans, and you should probably be more diplomatic when you talk about him.
a800ff246560d016e395fbb2a4316625420f89cc.zh: 里根在共和党人中有相当多的追随者，谈到他时，你或许应该更圆融一些。

41d58ed9fb08536dc831cbec40b206280513186a.source: Reagan himself admitted he was only trying to tell a joke, which came off poorly. I think we should move on to other issues.
41d58ed9fb08536dc831cbec40b206280513186a.zh: 里根自己承认，他只是想讲个笑话，结果效果很不好。我认为，我们应该转向其他议题。

8445983809bb6b2d61a54fc7099e3c890c0c14e9.source: Reagan is popular, but people also want to see you distinguish yourself. There is an undertone of criticism that you lack influence, and that you don't stack up to Reagan.
8445983809bb6b2d61a54fc7099e3c890c0c14e9.zh: 里根很受欢迎，但人们也想看到你展现自己的特色。有些批评隐约认为，你缺乏影响力，也比不上里根。

062b690a454a42a9009fd8f27b1148203922246b.source: Reagan may not be pleased with your perfunctory gestures, but he is also not that popular with the northern wing of the party. Everything is a trade off.
062b690a454a42a9009fd8f27b1148203922246b.zh: 里根也许不满意你敷衍的示好，不过，他在党内北方阵营中也没那么受欢迎。凡事总有取舍。

ee0e33bb8820e4ba3467aeb874afa9db4281728c.source: Reagan's supporters are just a vocal minority right now. It's good to unite the party, but will this really help you beat Jimmy Carter in 1976?
ee0e33bb8820e4ba3467aeb874afa9db4281728c.zh: 里根的支持者目前只是声音很大的少数派。团结全党固然好，但这真的有助于你在1976年击败吉米·卡特吗？

d581aaf6af9b5236fc7a15b1c2bf12262ee71f02.source: Realistically, the Democratic split is fantastic news for us. Let's not galvanize the Southern block even further by attacking them.
d581aaf6af9b5236fc7a15b1c2bf12262ee71f02.zh: 说实在的，民主党分裂对我们是天大的好消息。不要再通过攻击，让南方阵营更加团结。

109bb10e2c85768f9458be3a2ee6be1e95e3846e.source: Reasonable people can disagree on the merits of these actions. We don't have much to gain by bringing them into the campaign.
109bb10e2c85768f9458be3a2ee6be1e95e3846e.zh: 理性的人可以对这些行动是否妥当持不同意见。把它们带进竞选，对我们没有多少好处。

5f4651aba7f79ae8afa83e8908129623f106e777.source: Reasonable, intelligent people should be able to distinguish between criticism of China, and criticism of Asian-Americans in the United States. It's very sad and unfortunate that some can't understand this, and we need to do everything possible to prevent these kinds of attacks.
5f4651aba7f79ae8afa83e8908129623f106e777.zh: 理性、明智的人应该分清，批评中国，与批评生活在美国的亚裔美国人，是两回事。有些人不明白这一点，令人悲伤和遗憾。我们需要尽一切可能防止这类袭击。

63aff3311ccadc2cbc7ce6fa95245f55d0ba6328.source: Recent articles have discussed Donald Trump paying no federal income taxes in some previous years, or having a secret Chinese bank account. Is this something you want to emphasize?
63aff3311ccadc2cbc7ce6fa95245f55d0ba6328.zh: 最近的报道谈到，唐纳德·特朗普在过去某些年份没有缴纳联邦所得税，或拥有一个未公开的中国银行账户。这是你想着重强调的事情吗？

f57357bb499912891e9775f8a5633a0314867db9.source: Recent articles have discussed you paying no federal income taxes in some previous years, or having a secret Chinese bank account. What is your response?
f57357bb499912891e9775f8a5633a0314867db9.zh: 最近的报道谈到，你在过去某些年份没有缴纳联邦所得税，或拥有一个未公开的中国银行账户。你会如何回应？

7852edc1a7040a30ec9fd998078a977fd243eb88.source: Recent reports have highlighted the large amount of money that you and your wife spend on racing horses. Have you ever bet more than $10,000 on a horse race?
7852edc1a7040a30ec9fd998078a977fd243eb88.zh: 近期报道关注了你和妻子在赛马上花费的大笔金钱。你是否曾在一场赛马上下注超过1万美元？

6875b371badd3bb2d37fea16f79573f8f79cb570.source: Recently, Martin Luther King Jr. was arrested at a sit-in in Atlanta, and has now been sentenced to four months in prison for failing to get a Georgia driver's license after moving to that state. Do you have any comment or action you would like to take?
6875b371badd3bb2d37fea16f79573f8f79cb570.zh: 小马丁·路德·金最近在亚特兰大的一场静坐抗议中被捕，如今因迁居佐治亚州后没有取得该州驾照，被判入狱四个月。你想发表什么意见，或采取什么行动吗？

4e0a8e52e24e5ad881a86863de0f7f0ef1a348fa.source: Red meat for the conservative base.
4e0a8e52e24e5ad881a86863de0f7f0ef1a348fa.zh: 这是保守派基本盘最爱听的强硬话。

580b0e541c5cd3930f8bec29db6707d0783abae7.source: Red-blooded Americans cheer your baiting of the Irish in this incident.
580b0e541c5cd3930f8bec29db6707d0783abae7.zh: 自诩铁血爱国的美国人为你借这件事挑衅爱尔兰人而喝彩。

67cc1cb232d85de0a86044edbeb07619f84e6512.source: Red-blooded Americans cheer your strong stance on this position.
67cc1cb232d85de0a86044edbeb07619f84e6512.zh: 自诩铁血爱国的美国人为你的强硬立场喝彩。

61aeb63ee4be8ec7d1d070936e55c0f907194b64.source: Reed made his own attempt at the 1896 nomination and selecting him as running mate may help to mend the fences. However, Maine and New England are non-competitive regions in this election.
61aeb63ee4be8ec7d1d070936e55c0f907194b64.zh: 里德在 1896 年的提名中做出了自己的尝试，选择他作为竞选伙伴可能有助于修补关系。然而，缅因州和新英格兰是本次选举的非竞争区域。

eba1f1357a4d6cbe796877bd9c58079d230be128.source: Regardless of my personal feelings, it is not the place of the President to override the will of Congress, unless the law in question is unconstitutional.
eba1f1357a4d6cbe796877bd9c58079d230be128.zh: 撇开我的个人看法，除非法律违宪，否则总统不应凌驾于国会意志之上。

282a26a7f3c0c18375b7d070d38469ce4695ebee.source: Regardless of our feelings about the slavery issue, it is undemocratic for Congress to deny the people the right to petition the government. I believe the Gag Rule should be lifted.
282a26a7f3c0c18375b7d070d38469ce4695ebee.zh: 无论我们如何看待奴隶制，国会剥夺人民向政府请愿的权利，都是不民主的。我认为应当取消禁议规则。

14f0e107157576c1b1a6f93051dda5fe427e8124.source: Regardless of our personal feelings, it always concerning when a religious leader and Presidential candidate can simply be killed by a mob.
14f0e107157576c1b1a6f93051dda5fe427e8124.zh: 不管我们个人怎么看，一个宗教领袖兼总统候选人竟然会被暴民杀害，总是令人忧虑的。

c393e3341bccbd759108605875ea06398cf48fde.source: Regardless of personal feelings, this Amendment obviously went through a stringent ratification process and reflects the overwhelming majority of the people.
c393e3341bccbd759108605875ea06398cf48fde.zh: 不论个人感觉如何，这项修正案显然经过严格的批准程序，反映了压倒性多数民众的意愿。

3fc63cf67328e3825788b14a831271a142fb1509.source: Regardless of the outcome this time, you have built a legion of devoted followers who will support anything you do. If you play your cards right, you just might get another shot against McKinley in four years...
3fc63cf67328e3825788b14a831271a142fb1509.zh: 无论这次结果如何，你已经建立了一批忠实的追随者，他们会支持你所做的任何事情。如果你的牌打对了，你可能会在四年内再次对抗麦金莱……

459884d23058415b976aae7dd034d64d817b8d1e.source: Regardless of the recent news, it looks like Bush has received a solid bounce heading into election night. But you might get a few more votes if Gore looks to be losing.
459884d23058415b976aae7dd034d64d817b8d1e.zh: 尽管最近有这些消息，布什看来还是在选举之夜前获得了明显的支持率提振。不过，如果戈尔看上去要输，你可能会多拿到一些选票。

2ffbbe1a5ccbabba0b391c550afee226b56f97fb.source: Regardless of your personal feelings, would you sign an act which established an independent Treasury for the government's funds?
2ffbbe1a5ccbabba0b391c550afee226b56f97fb.zh: 撇开个人看法，你是否会签署一项法案，为政府资金设立独立国库？

580d8c0fbe50b2f7ab048d4ab9cf84fadd274276.source: Regardless of your views on the banking question, many accuse your running mate of being too closely tied to the Second Bank of the United States, and too inexperienced in government. What is your response?
580d8c0fbe50b2f7ab048d4ab9cf84fadd274276.zh: 无论你在银行问题上持什么看法，许多人都指责你的竞选搭档与美国第二银行关系过密，而且缺乏从政经验。你如何回应？

18e6439aebebd76b963275973cb2e2aa8598e2e5.source: Repeal of Taft-Hartley is bound to appeal to the union wing of the party.
18e6439aebebd76b963275973cb2e2aa8598e2e5.zh: 废除《塔夫脱—哈特利法》，必然能吸引党内工会派系。

27d4ee099a21dc75c9cee240c660396220b281bb.source: Repeatedly, Mr. Trump has refused to acknowledge the consequences of his divisive rhetoric, and events at his rallies continue to escalate. What will it take for him to acknowledge that he is responsible?
27d4ee099a21dc75c9cee240c660396220b281bb.zh: 特朗普先生一再拒绝承认，他分裂民众的言辞会造成后果，而集会上的事件不断升级。要怎样，他才肯承认自己负有责任？

b8962da42d6b3394792c5f33a747353949aa046f.source: Republic, Lost: How Money Corrupts Congress--and a Plan to Stop It
b8962da42d6b3394792c5f33a747353949aa046f.zh: 共和国，迷失：金钱如何腐蚀国会——以及阻止它的计划

7a1a6cdadfc1412570f3aa4d22b47ccae9a3ec02.source: Republican delegates are happy, but is staunch conservatism the best route to electoral success in this era?
7a1a6cdadfc1412570f3aa4d22b47ccae9a3ec02.zh: 共和党代表很高兴，但在这个时代，坚定的保守主义真是赢得选举的最佳路线吗？

8ec837088b567295731045375881a281ef867a5b.source: Republican tax cuts from Reagan and Bush have driven the fiscal condition of this country into a dire condition. Now Donald Trump says he wants to cut taxes for the rich even more.
8ec837088b567295731045375881a281ef867a5b.zh: 里根和布什的共和党减税政策，把这个国家的财政推入了严峻境地。现在，唐纳德·特朗普又说，要进一步为富人减税。

2476fcc86919597d222f8b2aa1fe133a8e8dd835.source: Republicans are known to love ambition, but building for the sake of building? Just to pick up the slack for a bunch of loafers? Not so much.
2476fcc86919597d222f8b2aa1fe133a8e8dd835.zh: 共和党人向来喜欢雄心壮志，但为建设而建设，仅仅为了给一群游手好闲的人找点活干？那可没这么受欢迎。

dc3b0e7547ee09bee1a407bede094a7b83d9949b.source: Republicans don't like to hear you calling for more spending at this stage of the game.
dc3b0e7547ee09bee1a407bede094a7b83d9949b.zh: 竞选到了这个阶段，共和党人不喜欢听你呼吁增加开支。

b2891f82cd3062210f52e84b86426351b12502d3.source: Republicans have stood behind such legislation all along. It would have become law years ago without the obstruction of Southern Democrats.
b2891f82cd3062210f52e84b86426351b12502d3.zh: 共和党一直支持这类立法。要不是南方民主党人阻挠，它早在几年前就已成为法律。

500d049567e28649ce8127e704a980d6cae1a5ee.source: Republicans rave about the deficit when a Democrat is President. But when it's time to cut taxes for the top 1%, suddenly it's not an issue any more. I wonder why that is?
500d049567e28649ce8127e704a980d6cae1a5ee.zh: 民主党人当总统时，共和党人大谈赤字；可一到给最富有的1%人群减税的时候，赤字突然又不算问题了。不知道这是为什么？

ce7ac5ea5faa4b6fbd0a446582877bf4162d1048.source: Returning Elian to Cuba was unconscionable. I did not support this decision by the Clinton Administration.
ce7ac5ea5faa4b6fbd0a446582877bf4162d1048.zh: 把埃利安送回古巴，是不顾良心的做法。我不支持克林顿政府的这个决定。

2eb7ed5cdd35db5114eb53c1a4c1999f831821c7.source: Richard M Nixon, how do you plead on 1 count of treason against the United States of America, 1 count of misappropriation of campaign funds, 1 count of obstruction of justice, one count of abuse of power, one count of…
2eb7ed5cdd35db5114eb53c1a4c1999f831821c7.zh: 理查德·M 尼克松，您如何就 1 项叛国罪、1 项挪用竞选资金罪、1 项妨碍司法罪、1 项滥用权力罪、1 项…

23d4b35b0b89e3300f5b56c6623cbc7fa7968ab5.source: Richard Nixon and I entered Congress in the same year, 1947, and have both served in the highest levels of government for some time.
23d4b35b0b89e3300f5b56c6623cbc7fa7968ab5.zh: 理查德·尼克松和我在同一年，也就是1947年进入国会，而且都已在政府高层任职了一段时间。

a6d0d91d335becfd86fce6aa9413a2159f7c1dd0.source: Richard Nixon has made "experience" the centerpiece of his campaign. What do you have to say on this point?
a6d0d91d335becfd86fce6aa9413a2159f7c1dd0.zh: 理查德·尼克松把“经验”作为竞选的核心。你对此有什么话要说？

628fb109f8f285d8459e9dd8789b147203d5334f.source: Richard Nixon has served as Vice President for eight years, and begins the campaign as the better known of the two candidates. He has long been known as a staunch anti-communist and a Cold Warrior. Nixon faces similar problems as Kennedy, to a lesser extent -- different wings of the party have different demands on civil rights. On the other hand, Nixon might be in a better position than Kennedy to paint himself as strong on defense. Some voters also feel Nixon is cold and unrelatable.
628fb109f8f285d8459e9dd8789b147203d5334f.zh: 理查德·尼克松 已担任副总统八年，并以两位候选人中较知名的身份开始竞选。长期以来，他一直被认为是坚定的反共主义者和冷战战士。 尼克松 面临着与 肯尼迪 类似的问题，只是程度较轻——党的不同派别对 民权 有不同的要求。另一方面，尼克松 可能比 肯尼迪 处于更好的位置，可以将自己描绘成强大的防守者。一些选民还觉得 尼克松 冷漠且不相关。

1883edf53edb194156ff960f87910b3ee3c7ce34.source: Richard Nixon is a California yankee and an interloper. He does not deserve the support of a decent southern man.
1883edf53edb194156ff960f87910b3ee3c7ce34.zh: 理查德·尼克松是个加利福尼亚来的北方佬，是个外来插手的人。他不配得到正派南方人的支持。

b1bc6f7f240bbb1029d5d14fa6bf9ca8d84a540b.source: Richard Nixon, as he heard all this droning from the judge, closed his eyes, waiting for the sentence to end. He had been up all night, unable to sleep due to all the stress from the trial. Before he knew it, he’d fallen unconscious. All of a sudden, he jolted awake to the sound of the judge screaming; "NIXON! What do you plead?..."
b1bc6f7f240bbb1029d5d14fa6bf9ca8d84a540b.zh: 理查德·尼克松，当他听到法官的嗡嗡声时，闭上眼睛，等待判决结束。由于审判带来的压力，他彻夜未眠，无法入睡。在他意识到之前，他已经失去知觉了。突然，他被法官的尖叫声惊醒。 “尼克松！你恳求什么？……”

6a4ea1e1755ed4001e3ed3df1ae81b68d232b0b6.source: Richard Nixon, perhaps remembering the debacle of 1960, has expressed little interest in a debate this election. Will you challenge him to one?
6a4ea1e1755ed4001e3ed3df1ae81b68d232b0b6.zh: 理查德·尼克松也许还记得1960年的惨痛经历，对本届选举的辩论兴趣不大。你会向他发出辩论挑战吗？

c75536bdb3f8995342e2a67bba6d837adab0772f.source: Richard Nixon, the former Vice President, has given a speech attacking Hubert Humphrey in support of Goldwater’s campaign. Nixon still enjoys a fair amount of popularity in America- we can’t simply ignore his comments.
c75536bdb3f8995342e2a67bba6d837adab0772f.zh: 前副总统理查德·尼克松发表演说，攻击休伯特·汉弗莱，为戈德华特助选。尼克松在美国仍颇受欢迎，我们不能对他的评论置之不理。

91dcc363eccb5554057975398602ba0a0195c814.source: Richard Nixon’s voice still holds sway, and Goldwater’s numbers see a rise- at your expense. Hopefully, he won’t run in 1968.
91dcc363eccb5554057975398602ba0a0195c814.zh: 理查德·尼克松说话仍然有影响力，戈德华特的支持率上升，而代价由你承担。希望他不会在1968年参选。

e820b3db22fa5af5671d482787907e62529084e3.source: Right now we have the strongest economy almost in the history of the United States. Unemployment is at 3% and our national output is growing at a furious pace. Compared to this, our 4% inflation rate is a pretty minor concern.
e820b3db22fa5af5671d482787907e62529084e3.zh: 我们现在的经济，几乎是美国历史上最强劲的。失业率为3%，全国经济产出正以惊人的速度增长。相比之下，4%的通胀率只是个很小的问题。

a7e326d08af06beff794a9818690ef7b56c2ae0b.source: Right now we're incredibly close, I expect to have a major announcement about the vaccine any day now. Under my leadership we've developed one of the most effective vaccines in human history.
a7e326d08af06beff794a9818690ef7b56c2ae0b.zh: 我们现在已经非常接近成功，我预计随时会有疫苗的重大消息。在我的领导下，我们开发出了人类历史上最有效的疫苗之一。

a3e381c7e5c657d40c47ba0f97db3fda6a73f3a0.source: Ronald Reagan and I do not agree on every issue. I trust that he will work for the team in 1968 if he wants a future in the Republican Party.
a3e381c7e5c657d40c47ba0f97db3fda6a73f3a0.zh: 罗纳德·里根和我并非在每个问题上都一致。如果他想在共和党内有前途，我相信他会在1968年为全党出力。

654dfa9ed153c7e3280f41346eb587ef97bcd1d6.source: Ronald Reagan and some of his allies can't hide their disappointment in your running mate, and some of them are even saying Carter is better than a Ford-Anderson Administration. Do you have any comment?
654dfa9ed153c7e3280f41346eb587ef97bcd1d6.zh: 罗纳德·里根和他的一些盟友，掩饰不住对你搭档选择的失望，甚至有人说卡特也比福特—安德森政府更好。你有什么评论？

1723ed25a2e4117439bf08ef18e2e5cecb60ec6a.source: Ronald Reagan referred to Michael Dukakis as an “invalid” during a recent speech. Do you care to make any comment on that?
1723ed25a2e4117439bf08ef18e2e5cecb60ec6a.zh: 罗纳德·里根在最近一次演说中称迈克尔·杜卡基斯是个“病人”。你想作何评论？

c4283245db663f7bcff76b6f03af93588ca3b781.source: Roosevelt is still a popular figure, particularly among the type of progressive voter we hope to attract. I will refrain from any explicit criticism of his statements.
c4283245db663f7bcff76b6f03af93588ca3b781.zh: 罗斯福仍然颇受欢迎，尤其是在我们希望争取的进步派选民中。我不会明确批评他的言论。

12889236d067c7392cc686afc55be99a18f890a8.source: Rubio is also considered more conservative than some of Romney's other options, and is on good terms with the Tea Party movement. Florida is another must-win state for the Republicans in 2012.
12889236d067c7392cc686afc55be99a18f890a8.zh: 鲁比奥 也被认为比 罗姆尼 的其他一些选项更为保守，并且与 茶党 运动关系良好。 佛罗里达州是共和党2012年另一个必胜的州。

decf387369515a62121e01d1baecebf0a6acceaf.source: Running as a liberal and an evangelical, his primary issue is the inflation of the currency through the free coinage of silver. This gives him fanatical support amongst the farmers of the South and the West. Lacking the funds to run a large campaign, Bryan will bring his speaking talents to bear by touring the United States.
decf387369515a62121e01d1baecebf0a6acceaf.zh: 作为一名自由派和福音派人士，他的首要问题是通过白银的自由铸币造成货币通货膨胀。这使他得到了南部和西部农民的狂热支持。由于缺乏开展大型活动的资金，布赖恩 将通过美国巡回演出来发挥他的演讲才能。

81df7e932654f4d966ff8900f31dc33361d196be.source: Running to Lose? The Candidacy of John C. Breckinridge
81df7e932654f4d966ff8900f31dc33361d196be.zh: 跑步会输？ 约翰·C.·布雷肯里奇的候选资格

6f9dce3fa68bb87c2be864a1570490487dafe49a.source: Russia, not against them. This is just more unnecessary military spending.
6f9dce3fa68bb87c2be864a1570490487dafe49a.zh: 俄罗斯，不反对他们。这只是更多不必要的军费开支。

52db7e7f811d70854bd70ce847799b08f1f2a532.source: Sadly, some attacks never lose their luster.
52db7e7f811d70854bd70ce847799b08f1f2a532.zh: 遗憾的是，有些攻击永远不会失去吸引力。

872b57a52c6807a9d1236fa1d6ddcd8eb4a80012.source: Salmon Chase has served as Governor of Ohio and was influential in the founding of the Republican Party. He has worked on the behalf of fugitive slaves as an attorney and has strong anti-slavery credentials, while stopping just short of a call for outright abolitionism. He is also known to be ambitious, and might be an uneasy number two man to campaign with.
872b57a52c6807a9d1236fa1d6ddcd8eb4a80012.zh: 萨蒙·蔡斯 曾担任 俄亥俄州 的州长，并对 共和党 的成立具有影响力。他曾作为律师代表逃亡奴隶工作，并拥有强有力的反奴隶制资历，同时还差点停止呼吁彻底废奴主义。众所周知，他雄心勃勃，与他一起竞选可能会成为一个令人不安的二号人物。

bd74b141ddfb3114c52e994a7672ca69f59dc741.source: Sanders brings the convention floor to its feet, helping to define the Democrats as a staunchly progressive party.
bd74b141ddfb3114c52e994a7672ca69f59dc741.zh: 桑德斯让大会全场起立，帮助将民主党塑造成一个坚定的进步派政党。

68bc8f912d82b530db09176e0c5838d66b34e5d9.source: Santorum's challenge will be the unite the business wing of the Republicans after defeating their preferred candidate, and to offer something to swing voters in the electorate at large.
68bc8f912d82b530db09176e0c5838d66b34e5d9.zh: 桑托勒姆 的挑战将是在击败他们喜欢的候选人后团结共和党的商界人士，并为广大选民中的摇摆选民提供一些东西。

1db1087515d8a7ebe57a537472bfd0135cd41c69.source: Sarah Palin is the former Governor of Alaska and ill-fated running mate on John McCain's 2008 ticket. Many people believe that she alienated some moderate support and may have cost McCain the election. On the other hand, she endorsed your candidacy relatively early and is still something of a folk hero on the right. In any case, she would certainly help you grab an even greater share of the headlines this fall.
1db1087515d8a7ebe57a537472bfd0135cd41c69.zh: 莎拉·佩林 是 阿拉斯加州 的前州长，也是 约翰·麦凯恩 2008 年选举中命运多舛的竞选搭档。许多人认为她疏远了一些温和派的支持，并可能导致麦凯恩选举失败。另一方面，她相对较早地支持了你的候选资格，并且仍然是右翼的民间英雄。无论如何，她肯定会帮助你在今年秋天占据更大的头条新闻。

73b28a8ef387022a62296bd34bc208adee50a741.source: Scoop Jackson has served his home state of Washington well, and he is the best man for the job.
73b28a8ef387022a62296bd34bc208adee50a741.zh: “斯库普”杰克逊为家乡华盛顿州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

f80d6cb1498883bcd8942cd7ff0edc5f8dfbf3fa.source: Scoop Jackson has the right ideas about what it means to be a Democrat -- strong on defense, and tireless in his fight for working class American.
f80d6cb1498883bcd8942cd7ff0edc5f8dfbf3fa.zh: “斯库普”杰克逊对民主党人的使命有正确认识：国防强硬，并为美国工人阶级不懈奋斗。

e2975e6d1e3e0d705243ad5d2df6780614498acd.source: Scoop Jackson is a polarizing choice, but he has his advantages.
e2975e6d1e3e0d705243ad5d2df6780614498acd.zh: “斯库普”杰克逊是个让人意见两极分化的选择，但他也有自己的优势。

d08f53befe58b1940f45d36531f08576b1b91c58.source: Scoop Jackson stands for common-sense American values. I support a strong defense myself, and anyone can get a little concerned over how much the federal courts have interfered with education in this country.
d08f53befe58b1940f45d36531f08576b1b91c58.zh: “斯库普”杰克逊代表符合常识的美国价值观。我自己也支持强大国防；联邦法院对国内教育干预这么多，谁都会有点担忧。

b632a45fc2a84c0e13cb45ae24ca2cf1c42628d2.source: Scorched earth tactics might be necessary given the state of the economy. Just make sure to keep a little bit of your patented optimism.
b632a45fc2a84c0e13cb45ae24ca2cf1c42628d2.zh: 考虑到经济状况，焦土式攻击或许有必要。不过，别忘了留一点你那标志性的乐观。

f1f965dda3f6be899d591fe906a9130da0a7b220.source: Scoring political points using Dr. King’s death is tone deaf, which negates any potential support you could have gained. However, many are animated by your speech, which prevents any slippage in the polls.
f1f965dda3f6be899d591fe906a9130da0a7b220.zh: 拿金博士之死捞取政治资本，实在不识时宜，抵消了你本可能得到的支持。不过，许多人也受到演讲鼓舞，使民调没有下滑。

29bdf24c19d3542bc4ca3376c7a92ac620955615.source: Scott Brown did a tremendous job in the Senate. And, you know, its a shame that we can't get more people like him elected from the so-called blue states.
29bdf24c19d3542bc4ca3376c7a92ac620955615.zh: 斯科特·布朗在参议院干得非常出色。而且，你知道，我们没能从所谓的蓝州选出更多这样的人，真可惜。

51391d10a00e0ec98e5c88c4e5c90f9dfabcb3c0.source: Scott Brown gained national attention for his upset of Martha Coakley in the 2010 Massachusetts Senate race. He was voted out in 2012, and has had trouble gaining political traction in his (admittedly liberal) region, in spite of taking relatively moderate views. Brown has blue-collar bona fides and could help Trump reinforce his anti-establishment image. Geographically, he may provide some measure of help in winning New Hampshire.
51391d10a00e0ec98e5c88c4e5c90f9dfabcb3c0.zh: 斯科特·布朗 因在 2010 年 马萨诸塞州 参议院竞选中击败玛莎·科克利 (Martha Coakley) 而受到全国关注。他于 2012 年被选下台，尽管他的观点相对温和，但在他（公认的自由派）地区却很难获得政治支持。布朗拥有蓝领的真诚，可以帮助特朗普强化他的反建制形象。从地理上来说，他可能会为获胜提供一定程度的帮助新罕布什尔州。

32ec477faec6d4d33aabd19f0c332f1aad88d2a2.source: Scott Brown is currently fighting the good fight in the Massachusetts Senate race. Would you be open to offering him a position in your Administration if he falls short there?
32ec477faec6d4d33aabd19f0c332f1aad88d2a2.zh: 斯科特·布朗目前正在马萨诸塞州参议员竞选中为正义而战。如果他在那里落败，你是否愿意在政府中给他一个职位？

c5a2b423e2da1794268393b95a81560308e5e808.source: Senators should be selected by state legislatures. Why on earth would you want to debase the dignity of that body?
c5a2b423e2da1794268393b95a81560308e5e808.zh: 联邦参议员应当由州议会选出。为什么非要贬损参议院的尊严？

0011d987e2bfb84fccc8ff98c5058169c70e2013.source: Sending troops to Syria is not a popular option, and is confusing coming from someone who opposed the same in Iraq
0011d987e2bfb84fccc8ff98c5058169c70e2013.zh: 向叙利亚派兵并不受欢迎，而一个反对向伊拉克这样派兵的人说出这话，也令人困惑。

04c6b955a50f717d882a06796ca2abc8cea74129.source: Separate is inherently unequal. There is nothing preventing women from serving in combat roles.
04c6b955a50f717d882a06796ca2abc8cea74129.zh: 隔离本身就是不平等。没有什么理由阻止女性担任作战岗位。

7694b568ed6479d74d463195f4d2c8e978433aed.source: Settle in and wait for the returns. Hopefully you can hold on for the win!
7694b568ed6479d74d463195f4d2c8e978433aed.zh: 坐下来等计票结果吧。希望你能守住胜利！

183d497db5f8f2dac722fbe44719c75e3c650542.source: Settle in and wait for the returns. Hopefully you can pull off a comeback for the ages!
183d497db5f8f2dac722fbe44719c75e3c650542.zh: 坐下来等计票结果吧。希望你能完成一场载入史册的逆转！

02aee36600b9096b308f5fc3982f5fd4178654f7.source: Settle into a nice, comfortable chair and wait for the telegraph results to come in. Downtown Canton is thronged with supporters who await a glimpse of you.
02aee36600b9096b308f5fc3982f5fd4178654f7.zh: 找把舒服的椅子坐好，等电报传来选举结果吧。坎顿市中心挤满了支持者，都盼着见你一面。

8f4f4581f81e8b187c96b675d5382d32b9ff4c82.source: Settle into your parlor and await the telegraph results. Best of luck good sir, you have fought a brave battle.
8f4f4581f81e8b187c96b675d5382d32b9ff4c82.zh: 在客厅里安坐，等电报传来选举结果吧。祝你好运，先生；这一仗，你打得很勇敢。

b21fba3f6e43caac39aa61dedda156b8bed5b64f.source: Seven Administrations have dealt with Manuel Noriega, dating back to the 1950s. As soon as his drug ties became known, it was the Reagan Administration that moved to indict him.
b21fba3f6e43caac39aa61dedda156b8bed5b64f.zh: 从20世纪50年代开始，已有七届政府与曼努埃尔·诺列加打过交道。他与毒品的联系一经查明，正是里根政府采取行动起诉了他。

e9eea69d057eced99a58b59577e795f6984f8da3.zh:
善政七项原则
然而，

2788ebd341a41f8cc58f738acb093da4718d7245.source: Sewall is an uninspiring choice to most Democrats however, as he considered to be on the conservative wing of the party, and has few political connections.
2788ebd341a41f8cc58f738acb093da4718d7245.zh: 休厄尔 对于大多数民主党人来说是一个平淡的选择，因为他被认为属于党的保守派，并且几乎没有政治关系。

d26822e92e82d3c01fed2e5b2de8f6bd75e636a8.source: Seward is a highly popular figure in New York and Northeast. There are some murmurs of disappointment at your treatment of him.
d26822e92e82d3c01fed2e5b2de8f6bd75e636a8.zh: 苏厄德在纽约和东北部极受欢迎。有人私下对你待他的方式感到失望。

fa8ed0391d4ec7947d1db9f84eafcaadf3a9bd3a.source: She was supposed to be the head of the Consumer Financial Protection Board, remember? Republican obstructionism prevented that. I'm confident that she will do well against Scott Brown in the Massachusetts Senate race.
fa8ed0391d4ec7947d1db9f84eafcaadf3a9bd3a.zh: 她原本该出任消费者金融保护局负责人，记得吗？共和党的阻挠让这事没成。我相信，在马萨诸塞州参议员竞选中，她对阵斯科特·布朗会有不错的表现。

159d234c17265c7f04d8c8fa1c91b06945ad5099.source: She went on television after this attack and she lied. All to cover up her own failures in security. And now she wants to be President?
159d234c17265c7f04d8c8fa1c91b06945ad5099.zh: 那次袭击后，她上电视撒了谎，全是为了掩盖自己在安保上的失职。现在她还想当总统？

e4cfbf408fc5fc382b7a5eef90cd61a3468338f0.source: She's probably expecting a lot of attacks on this issue -- let's keep her off balance by focusing on other things.
e4cfbf408fc5fc382b7a5eef90cd61a3468338f0.zh: 她大概料到我们会在这件事上大量攻击，那就聚焦其他事情，让她摸不准吧。

d085be38cba697afe184e27305257bff9ec05d41.source: Sherrod Brown also happens to be a deeply qualified Senator with extensive experience in government. And we must admit that the current system isn't working for places like Ohio, Pennsylvania, Michigan, and others.
d085be38cba697afe184e27305257bff9ec05d41.zh: 谢罗德·布朗同时还是一位资格充分、政府经验丰富的参议员。我们必须承认，现行体制对俄亥俄州、宾夕法尼亚州、密歇根州等地并不奏效。

43315caa25b7d5e5e575a7c08fbb36516014a889.source: Sherrod Brown has a record as one of the most progressive members in the Senate, and he has fought for his home state of Ohio for his entire career.
43315caa25b7d5e5e575a7c08fbb36516014a889.zh: 谢罗德·布朗是参议院最进步的议员之一，整个职业生涯都在为家乡俄亥俄州而战。

473ea5893e006ad9de9de83e89135b165d088f08.source: Sherrod Brown has served as a Congressman and Senator for over 20 years, tirelessly advocating for the American people. He has the experience and qualifications that we need in our Administration.
473ea5893e006ad9de9de83e89135b165d088f08.zh: 谢罗德·布朗担任众议员和参议员二十多年，一直不知疲倦地为美国人民发声。他拥有我们政府所需要的经验和资格。

81732d5028724e6d0ac785240d5d6d5742ff6765.source: Sherrod Brown has served his home state of Ohio for most of his life, fighting for workers and everyday people. He has won numerous statewide elections there as well.
81732d5028724e6d0ac785240d5d6d5742ff6765.zh: 谢罗德·布朗大半生都在服务家乡俄亥俄州，为劳动者和普通民众奋斗。他也在那里多次赢得全州范围的选举。

c88ce0e56836e42794ca7749565861b14be0e496.source: Sherrod Brown is a Senator from Ohio with a long history in that crucial state. He has generally been on the liberal end of the Democratic spectrum, but could help Clinton compete in the Midwest. Brown is reluctant to serve as a running mate this year. Clinton will need to give assurances that her change of position on trade issues, like the Trans-Pacific Partnership, is a permanent change, and was not one of political expediency.
c88ce0e56836e42794ca7749565861b14be0e496.zh: 谢罗德·布朗 是来自 俄亥俄州 的参议员，在该关键州拥有悠久的历史。他总体上属于民主党的自由派，但可以帮助克林顿在中西部竞争。布朗今年不愿意担任竞选搭档。 克林顿需要保证她在跨太平洋伙伴关系等贸易问题上立场的改变是永久性的改变，而不是政治权宜之计。

43b3b47e6b8a192ab1fded74a2937aa5df6e343e.source: Sherrod Brown is serious about ensuring that all workers are well paid, and protected from the impact of unfair trade deals. We're going to give him a significant voice in my Administration.
43b3b47e6b8a192ab1fded74a2937aa5df6e343e.zh: 谢罗德·布朗认真致力于确保所有劳动者获得良好报酬，并免受不公平贸易协议的冲击。我们会让他在我的政府中发挥重要作用。

77d43786901c4e955a037e08885a5d930c3d007f.source: Should American workers have the right to invest their Social Security withholdings in private accounts?
77d43786901c4e955a037e08885a5d930c3d007f.zh: 是否应该允许美国劳动者把扣缴的社会保障金投入私人账户？

d546393178dc997289eda95d230ee611842c2bfa.source: Should Angela Merkel be doing more to preserve to Euro as the European Union's common currency?
d546393178dc997289eda95d230ee611842c2bfa.zh: 安格拉·默克尔是否应该采取更多措施，维持欧元作为欧盟共同货币的地位？

b43d8928074370ad6ccb7b289b92077dc560abe6.source: Should Confederate veterans be included in the federal Civil War pension system?
b43d8928074370ad6ccb7b289b92077dc560abe6.zh: 邦联军老兵应当纳入联邦的内战抚恤金制度吗？

0b49335de8299c4d7424242b71d003819d6ee36b.source: Should Lyndon Johnson have been able to prevent the Tet Offensive?
0b49335de8299c4d7424242b71d003819d6ee36b.zh: 林登·约翰逊本应能够阻止春节攻势吗？

13c21a8e59f22250ba53750185ac9224d6157451.source: Should Mitt Romney be given a speaking slot at the Republican Convention this year, given the tension between you two?
13c21a8e59f22250ba53750185ac9224d6157451.zh: 考虑到你和米特·罗姆尼之间的紧张关系，今年共和党全国代表大会是否应该给他一个演讲时段？

d6732f95c3e96e5ecbed34891222f972b174d67b.source: Should there be a ban on nuclear weapons testing?
d6732f95c3e96e5ecbed34891222f972b174d67b.zh: 是否应禁止核武器试验？

cdcd405f537ba9f82f2322b95adc4cdf4bc73750.source: Should there be greater regulation or even price controls on railroad shipping rates?
cdcd405f537ba9f82f2322b95adc4cdf4bc73750.zh: 应当加强对铁路货运费率的监管，甚至实行价格管制吗？

60dfe98e7f791576580c7d150876bbe73ce714be.source: Should there be some regulation of working hours for children, particularly those under the age of 12 or 13?
60dfe98e7f791576580c7d150876bbe73ce714be.zh: 应当规范儿童的工作时间吗，尤其是十二三岁以下的儿童？

9fe3330cbc38efcc3f89b69064fe2474391e062c.source: Should your party attack Henry Clay's personal conduct? His gambling, womanizing, dueling, and generally irreligious nature?
9fe3330cbc38efcc3f89b69064fe2474391e062c.zh: 你们党是否应当攻击亨利·克莱的个人品行——赌博、拈花惹草、决斗，以及总体上不虔诚的作风？

d6bd3843e8179e601aea5cde4fd4f7bcb6b4b54f.source: Should your party continue its familiar attacks on the “black Republicans” as abolitionists and supporters of social and political equality for blacks?
d6bd3843e8179e601aea5cde4fd4f7bcb6b4b54f.zh: 你们党是否应当继续沿用惯常攻击，称“黑色共和党人”为废奴主义者，并指责他们支持黑人享有社会与政治平等？

b838ef9bacd10d6b9de5646f13b383b93553b62c.source: Should your party make any statements indicating the potential support of a national bank in this election?
b838ef9bacd10d6b9de5646f13b383b93553b62c.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党是否应当发表声明，表示可能支持设立国家银行？

8a814d5f4433433e98966c0ed28ba25835ead04d.source: Sign it. Labor actions in the steel and coal industries nearly paralyzed our economy, and the public is fed up.
8a814d5f4433433e98966c0ed28ba25835ead04d.zh: 签署。钢铁和煤炭行业的劳工行动，几乎让经济陷入瘫痪，公众已经受够了。

b31844dde446f16249daf96ec8ec22c246b4ba3f.source: Significant concern is beginning to develop among Republicans over the level of immigration that has been permitted.
b31844dde446f16249daf96ec8ec22c246b4ba3f.zh: 共和党人开始对获准入境的移民数量产生严重担忧。

6c7f6a60fdb7184bf400a124fe6ce14cfb0a8d60.source: Silas Wright, the protege and successor to Van Buren, has been mentioned as a candidate for Governor of New York. He seems hesitant. Will you write him a letter imploring him to enter the race?
6c7f6a60fdb7184bf400a124fe6ce14cfb0a8d60.zh: 范布伦的门生和政治接班人赛拉斯·赖特，被提议为纽约州州长候选人，但他似乎有些犹豫。你会写信恳请他参选吗？

e9884f935674e1bcdac531d7a78c1c8b98998ed9.source: Silence is the worst of all choices here.
e9884f935674e1bcdac531d7a78c1c8b98998ed9.zh: 在这里，沉默是所有选择中最糟糕的。

0bbbbf5f3464a96f354992c6744791e3f7b2d9ca.source: Silence may be the best course, given the divisiveness of this issue.
0bbbbf5f3464a96f354992c6744791e3f7b2d9ca.zh: 鉴于这个问题容易引发分裂，沉默或许是最好的办法。

e200a99274346facca6a71c7463c3efefe41b01f.source: Silver coinage is just one part of my platform. Let's not forget the struggles of the urban worker in his efforts to unionize and obtain fair wages.
e200a99274346facca6a71c7463c3efefe41b01f.zh: 白银铸币只是我纲领的一部分。别忘了，城市工人还在为组织工会、争取公平工资而奋斗。

3f0d7a1cb5812e6ed5289a21a51a8329c4bf9c59.source: Similarly aligned in terms of ideology, Miller differs from Goldwater in terms of origin as a Catholic New Yorker. He has been effective in helping Republicans win House seats, but is little-known by the greater public. Though he may be from New York, few expect his selection to have much effect in swinging the state to the Goldwater campaign.
3f0d7a1cb5812e6ed5289a21a51a8329c4bf9c59.zh: 在意识形态方面类似，米勒 与 戈德华特 的不同之处在于天主教纽约人的出身。他有效地帮助共和党赢得众议院席位，但鲜为公众所知。尽管他可能来自纽约州，但很少有人预计他的选择会对该州转向戈德华特竞选产生很大影响。

b3506bb9ca5ae51b9baa17438a2ae6b1fe403ca8.source: Since Kucinich is a proponent of many left-wing views on economics, he could be a bridge candidate for Paul to draw protest votes from both the far left and right of the political spectrum. Paul could certainly use Kucinich to emphasize his anti-war, anti-DEA, and anti-Federal Reserve views as a common cause amongst both of these groups.
b3506bb9ca5ae51b9baa17438a2ae6b1fe403ca8.zh: 由于 库西尼奇 是许多左翼经济观点的支持者，因此他可以成为 保罗 的桥梁候选人，以吸引政治光谱中极左和极右的抗议选票。 保罗 当然可以使用 库西尼奇 来强调他的反战、反 DEA 和反美联储观点，这是这两个群体的共同事业。

64371a2b149db76baeeb06d32f6e6fac4400830c.source: Since its formation in 2013, Black Lives Matter has made its lot in Washington supporting social justice for African-Americans.
64371a2b149db76baeeb06d32f6e6fac4400830c.zh: 自2013年成立以来，“黑人的命也是命”运动，在华盛顿致力于支持非裔美国人的社会公正。

cc96882ac693cbcc07e7eb804853c9f4176aed34.source: Since the Southern vote is lost already, this just might help you a shade in those states where you can still compete.
cc96882ac693cbcc07e7eb804853c9f4176aed34.zh: 既然南方选票已经丢了，这么做或许能让你在那些仍有竞争力的州稍微获益。

44341eee73ddc23f5068760a3236b4dc80e24f4b.source: Since the founding of our country, the free market has always been a bulwark of our prosperity.
44341eee73ddc23f5068760a3236b4dc80e24f4b.zh: 自建国以来，自由市场始终是我国繁荣的支柱。

0db1df4e3c267a8955a5be2fa65d2e93a4b28a40.source: Skeptical of action against Iran. Also critical of other measures such as drone strikes which can potentially kill innocent civilians. Thinks terrorism is in large part a reaction against American overreach.
0db1df4e3c267a8955a5be2fa65d2e93a4b28a40.zh: 对向伊朗采取行动持怀疑态度。也批评无人机打击等可能杀害无辜平民的措施。认为恐怖主义很大程度上是对美国过度干预的反应。

d52907deec4fdba1771c7f84c479ffa4f870df38.source: Skeptics believe that you passed over more experienced nominees to select someone from Florida. Which isn't to say that Lagoa isn't highly qualified.
d52907deec4fdba1771c7f84c479ffa4f870df38.zh: 怀疑者认为，你放弃了经验更丰富的提名人，转而选择一个佛罗里达州的人。这并不是说，拉戈阿不够资格。

c1a3abd7d10f2aba529012c1e1c99a1a54662564.source: Skeptics wonder if you're even close to making a real vaccine announcement, but it's certainly in line with your personality to promise big.
c1a3abd7d10f2aba529012c1e1c99a1a54662564.zh: 怀疑者想知道，你到底是否真已接近公布疫苗的消息。不过，许下宏大承诺，确实很符合你的性格。

ca4e0553b0ed7a1e66ddf095d9d51b93261c6c69.source: Sleepy Joe Biden and I have an incredible difference of opinion on what is best for this country, but ultimately whatever the voters say about it, that's the last word.
ca4e0553b0ed7a1e66ddf095d9d51b93261c6c69.zh: 对于什么最有利于国家，瞌睡乔·拜登和我有极大的分歧，但归根结底，无论选民怎么说，他们的决定就是最终结论。

05c35b8249f97edac8b25ce99ae647c9b81449bd.source: Sleepy Joe couldn't get 100 people to show up to his rallies if he tried -- so he's using COVID as an excuse. It almost makes you wonder if anyone's even voting for him.
05c35b8249f97edac8b25ce99ae647c9b81449bd.zh: 瞌睡乔就算努力，也凑不出一百人参加集会，所以他才拿新冠当借口。几乎让人怀疑，到底有没有人投票给他。

38853bffb812e03a0033000347f09407f2f36558.source: Slow down Mitt... you can't just antagonize a key part of your electoral coalition like that.
38853bffb812e03a0033000347f09407f2f36558.zh: 慢着，米特……你不能就这样得罪选举联盟中的关键一部分人。

755d3020b6a747739b41e3d5b0ef1a1811db5b1d.source: Social Security is a winning issue. In these final days, we must expose Johnson’s lies about our opinion on the subject, and turn the tables back on him.
755d3020b6a747739b41e3d5b0ef1a1811db5b1d.zh: 社会保障是能赢得选票的议题。在最后几天，我们必须揭穿约翰逊对我们立场的谎言，反过来让他陷入被动。

4c30ffafa7a8dd038697f1d91d724fc7b05bf340.source: Some accuse you of flip-flopping after you decided to bail out New York. It's good to emphasize that they passed reforms first.
4c30ffafa7a8dd038697f1d91d724fc7b05bf340.zh: 你决定救助纽约后，有人指责你反复无常。强调他们先进行了改革，是个好办法。

2458d6b03f27a3c577fab115254ad1b3faa88408.source: Some advisors are privately alarmed at the long, meandering, and aggressive stump speeches that Sarah Palin is giving. Do you have any thoughts about reining her in?
2458d6b03f27a3c577fab115254ad1b3faa88408.zh: 一些顾问私下里对萨拉·佩林冗长、东拉西扯而咄咄逼人的巡回竞选演说感到担忧。你是否考虑过约束她？

252d3845b7cae29d5ae324c2b22b47d0271c2f65.source: Some aggression is good, but voters also want to hear positive solutions.
252d3845b7cae29d5ae324c2b22b47d0271c2f65.zh: 适度进攻是好事，但选民也想听到积极的解决办法。

83200979fc2055b47a437be988aaad580d2e1c2f.source: Some allies hoped to see a bit of a stronger statement from you on this issue.
83200979fc2055b47a437be988aaad580d2e1c2f.zh: 一些盟友希望，你在这个问题上的表态能更强硬一点。

3056287910b6c7f21c51e713fd316214306698f7.source: Some are interpreting this as a criticism or repudiation of Eisenhower, which does not play well for you.
3056287910b6c7f21c51e713fd316214306698f7.zh: 有人把这解读为批评或否定艾森豪威尔，对你并不有利。

c1c5744b69fe3502e456c38caa8c74747a6ca4b7.source: Some commentators sense a bit of small-c conservatism in your answer.
c1c5744b69fe3502e456c38caa8c74747a6ca4b7.zh: 一些评论人士从你的回答中感到了一点保守、谨慎的倾向。

0e1866726f3b72bf92c7b91dce76b7be15517c31.source: Some critics are saying that Cory Booker's resume is a little thin to be named as your running mate, and that you are dangerously close to pandering. What is your response?
0e1866726f3b72bf92c7b91dce76b7be15517c31.zh: 一些批评者认为，科里·布克资历尚浅，担任你的竞选搭档还不够，而且你已经危险地接近刻意讨好特定选民。你会如何回应？

6575b08e4b8a8b5a975cc4d3a2836e92fe58708f.source: Some defense hawks are upset at the idea of conceding the Panama Canal, but others think this will help build positive sentiment for the United States.
6575b08e4b8a8b5a975cc4d3a2836e92fe58708f.zh: 一些国防鹰派对交出巴拿马运河感到不满，另一些人则认为，这有助于增进对美国的好感。

5d08219b2af3378662b298814d6f5033b444d8b4.source: Some die-hard Roosevelt supporters agree, but overall there is broad support for the Amendment.
5d08219b2af3378662b298814d6f5033b444d8b4.zh: 一些坚定的罗斯福支持者赞同你，但总体上，这项修正案得到了广泛支持。

808ac2a0b10e7aa8b5245bbf151b174e965196cc.source: Some economists estimate that the unemployment rate would be 1-2% lower if unemployment benefits were not so long in duration.
808ac2a0b10e7aa8b5245bbf151b174e965196cc.zh: 一些经济学家估计，如果失业待遇的领取期限没这么长，失业率会降低1至2个百分点。

6f7868f0f87a5b9b50e516de50aa1d57d59ceda3.zh: 一些受环保主义影响的支持者不同意。

e7f8f9c04344155fbda341af98d28098e5906bee.source: Some have proposed implementing an Environmental Protection Agency at the federal level to combat industrial pollution. Would you support this as President?
e7f8f9c04344155fbda341af98d28098e5906bee.zh: 有人提议在联邦层面设立环境保护署，以治理工业污染。担任总统后，你会支持这个提议吗？

663eba7b2e8edfd89bf040ec0e41108188c7a5e8.source: Some have suggested that Scoop Jackson is too conservative for the Democratic Party. Can you explain a little why you've selected a defense hawk and anti-busing Senator as your running mate?
663eba7b2e8edfd89bf040ec0e41108188c7a5e8.zh: 有人说，“斯库普”杰克逊对民主党而言太保守了。能解释一下，你为什么选择一位国防鹰派、反对校车接送的参议员作为竞选搭档吗？

99b0e6cebc43b5816516ceff2cf3233b961791ae.source: Some her views I think have become, you know, a little extreme perhaps. Ms. Warren has good intentions but I'm not sure that I would go so far as to offer her another position in an Obama Administration.
99b0e6cebc43b5816516ceff2cf3233b961791ae.zh: 我觉得她的某些观点，你知道，也许变得有些极端了。沃伦女士的用意是好的，但我不确定自己是否愿意在奥巴马政府中再给她一个职位。

d45acd107f7e694faf62951ee32caff46ff9ffe3.source: Some in the South are a bit alienated, but you need all the help you can get in other regions.
d45acd107f7e694faf62951ee32caff46ff9ffe3.zh: 南方有些人感到疏远，不过在其他地区，你需要争取所有能得到的帮助。

1b7a85dfba92ecea3388f14bcd8d61472711556b.source: Some in your party are glad to hear this, but it is also an unpopular position in the South.
1b7a85dfba92ecea3388f14bcd8d61472711556b.zh: 党内一些人很高兴听到这番话，但这个立场在南方并不受欢迎。

071653e7b7429bab263b6987ab92b96c254cb988.source: Some labor leaders have called for regulation standardizing a ten or even an eight hour workday. Do you support these calls?
071653e7b7429bab263b6987ab92b96c254cb988.zh: 一些工会领袖要求立法统一规定十小时，甚至八小时工作制。你支持这些要求吗？

5e9226b106db5efbc48e13f664c398539add3436.source: Some limited, sensible regulation is prudent. Overall, the right to own a gun should be protected.
5e9226b106db5efbc48e13f664c398539add3436.zh: 适度、合理的监管是审慎之举。总体而言，持枪权应该得到保护。

46b81c332725ca019ffc7d6aa2e27fec5fc78cf9.source: Some mainstream economists question your logic on this issue, but this position plays well on the left.
46b81c332725ca019ffc7d6aa2e27fec5fc78cf9.zh: 一些主流经济学家质疑你在这个问题上的逻辑，但这个立场很受左翼欢迎。

6dfb8d3f8f2ef092ba5468e39af95b727632b6a8.source: Some notice a bit of hesitancy to touch on Humphrey’s record with this response, sparking rumors that you plan to run a moderate campaign this election season. This is a bit deflating to your liberal base.
6dfb8d3f8f2ef092ba5468e39af95b727632b6a8.zh: 有人从这个回答中察觉到，你对谈论汉弗莱的政绩有些迟疑，于是传出流言，称你打算在本次竞选走温和路线。这让自由派基本盘有些泄气。

2d5c99a80a86af8a5d23d8941b913eebb1687e1a.source: Some notice your reticence to discuss abortion.
2d5c99a80a86af8a5d23d8941b913eebb1687e1a.zh: 有人注意到，你不愿多谈堕胎问题。

512ba9a2fcde671ea455f997ca29644e656204b2.source: Some observers have argued that an embargo of Cuba makes little sense in a post Cold War environment. What do you think?
512ba9a2fcde671ea455f997ca29644e656204b2.zh: 一些观察者认为，在冷战后的环境下，对古巴实施禁运没什么道理。你怎么看？

97bac09792d0c5429e2c0c3b8f78e0a96154ae7a.source: Some of the border states (Virginia, Maryland, Kentucky) are very close this year. Do you have a strategy to make these states jump to the Republican side?
97bac09792d0c5429e2c0c3b8f78e0a96154ae7a.zh: 今年有些边界州——弗吉尼亚、马里兰和肯塔基——选情十分胶着。你有什么策略，让这些州转而支持共和党？

8fdf994f897bdcb6bf87986dd9ac6bb63a15e7f1.source: Some of your core Democratic voters are worried and confused by your equivocal tone on impeachment, given how obviously guilty they believe Trump to have been.
8fdf994f897bdcb6bf87986dd9ac6bb63a15e7f1.zh: 一些民主党核心选民对你在弹劾问题上含糊其辞的语气，感到担忧和困惑，因为他们认为特朗普的罪责显而易见。

35bfaef042b5e92266c7fc4d04f385dd610b2a60.source: Some of your most ardent supporters, including some major donors, are wondering about your judgment in selecting Bernie Sanders as a running mate. Can you say something to reassure them?
35bfaef042b5e92266c7fc4d04f385dd610b2a60.zh: 你一些最热忱的支持者，包括一些大金主，对你选择伯尼·桑德斯作为搭档的判断有所疑虑。你能说些什么，让他们安心？

246339086fd28f62e1172cd1a47f9b53297eba69.source: Some of your operatives want to attack Carter for the way he has equivocated on abortion, gun control, busing, labor issues, and so on. Will you approve a series of ads labeling him as a "flip-flopper"?
246339086fd28f62e1172cd1a47f9b53297eba69.zh: 你们的一些特工想要攻击 卡特，因为他在堕胎、枪支管制、校车、劳工问题等问题上模棱两可。你会批准一系列把他贴上“人字拖”标签的广告吗？

e5a3341949cab10356f176931e73db8f4ca5309c.source: Some of your supporters are upset that you aren't taking a stronger stand on admitting Syrian refugees.
e5a3341949cab10356f176931e73db8f4ca5309c.zh: 你的一些支持者很不满，认为你在接收叙利亚难民上没有采取更强硬的支持立场。

cbc35b9c5fba895602007410e2186d714c826f35.source: Some of your supporters expected candidates like Robert Kennedy to be selected as your running mate. Can you explain why you chose Hubert Humphrey instead?
cbc35b9c5fba895602007410e2186d714c826f35.zh: 你的一些支持者原本以为，你会选择罗伯特·肯尼迪等人作为竞选搭档。你能解释为什么最终选了休伯特·汉弗莱吗？

a2b836d6ca6095dc8f4da9718d737ac6f4de4335.source: Some on the left have criticized your reliance on drone strikes to project American interests, stating that they lead to unnecessary civilian casualties. What can you say to this?
a2b836d6ca6095dc8f4da9718d737ac6f4de4335.zh: 左派中有人批评，你依赖无人机打击来维护美国利益，造成了不必要的平民伤亡。对此你有什么话要说？

54e006a4d515e99eaf922e65e070f427654b11be.source: Some on the left thought that you were not very vigorous in your opposition to the anti-union policies of Governor Scott Walker in Wisconsin. What do you have to say about this?
54e006a4d515e99eaf922e65e070f427654b11be.zh: 左派中有人认为，你对威斯康星州州长斯科特·沃克反工会政策的反对不够坚决。对此你有什么话要说？

15da4ceebe7562c4e35e19447c62b30cb073d259.source: Some on the right assert that you are just “following in Trump's footsteps”, but overall it seems that American policy towards China is shifting no matter who is in power.
15da4ceebe7562c4e35e19447c62b30cb073d259.zh: 右翼有些人说，你只是在“追随特朗普的脚步”。不过，总体来看，无论谁执政，美国对华政策似乎都在变化。

c992cfadc959c858bee452b8f8e5b119e7f1be0e.source: Some people agree, but many conservatives are wondering what was so moderate about Bill Clinton.
c992cfadc959c858bee452b8f8e5b119e7f1be0e.zh: 有些人赞同，但许多保守派正在问，比尔·克林顿究竟哪里算温和。

5b54fadd9f72a94150e644ae2c0896bc964de6b9.source: Some people are noticing the somewhat moderate tone of this statement.
5b54fadd9f72a94150e644ae2c0896bc964de6b9.zh: 有些人注意到，这个表态的语气还算温和。

4b43da01614d68a9b7bbae40193e3218044ac61e.source: Some people have suggested implementing a minimum wage, under which people may not be employed. Do you think this would help increase wages or would it simply put more men out of work?
4b43da01614d68a9b7bbae40193e3218044ac61e.zh: 有人提议设立最低工资，禁止雇主以低于该标准的工资雇人。你认为这能提高工资，还是只会让更多人失业？

9a3986d1c8b9e7e700e578fbc1c927e68511b1b2.source: Some people on both sides of the spectrum note that you are trying to finesse this issue.
9a3986d1c8b9e7e700e578fbc1c927e68511b1b2.zh: 两边的一些人注意到，你正在巧妙地处理这个问题。

f5437a883bdb8c48ee2a2276a34a1fb8b25399fb.source: Some people talk change, others cause it.
f5437a883bdb8c48ee2a2276a34a1fb8b25399fb.zh: 有人空谈变革，有人促成变革。

a8d6512e55b7a8688c4f9d94f3ab3f649236f708.source: Some people under me put this scheme together, and when I found out, I fired them. It's as simple as that. This whole thing is the media trying to set up a false equivalency between myself and Crooked Hillary.
a8d6512e55b7a8688c4f9d94f3ab3f649236f708.zh: 我手下有些人搞出了这套做法，我发现以后就把他们开除了。就这么简单。整件事都是媒体想把我和“骗子希拉里”硬说成一路货色。

938bc469292f28c4eb99d495f4d2ea56861be247.source: Some political opponents mock your calls for "repeal and replace",  but it's a mainstream talking point for your party.
938bc469292f28c4eb99d495f4d2ea56861be247.zh: 有些政治对手嘲笑你“废除并取代”的呼声，但这确实是你们党主流的宣传口径。

962041fd6a750f015c2d4faa1dc1f2658bc96d55.source: Some pro-life and pro-gun groups are concerned about your selection of Colin Powell as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
962041fd6a750f015c2d4faa1dc1f2658bc96d55.zh: 一些反堕胎和拥枪团体，对你选择科林·鲍威尔作竞选搭档感到担忧。你能多谈谈他吗？

5fd8630e3adbe1f256b4360cafa60fafc21287a8.source: Some pro-life groups are concerned about your selection of Tom Ridge as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
5fd8630e3adbe1f256b4360cafa60fafc21287a8.zh: 一些反堕胎团体对你选择汤姆·里奇作竞选搭档感到担忧。你能多谈谈他吗？

f858b3b5c36eec145f97327e247e334e952accb2.source: Some sense a missed opportunity, but others agree that the angles of attack on Humphrey are weak at best outside of the South.
f858b3b5c36eec145f97327e247e334e952accb2.zh: 有人觉得错失了一次机会，但另一些人也认同：在南方以外，对汉弗莱的攻击点，充其量也很薄弱。

9074b356b283151a7d061975d71584a49387d5cb.source: Some sense a veiled softening of your position on the Muslim ban.
9074b356b283151a7d061975d71584a49387d5cb.zh: 有些人感觉，你在穆斯林入境禁令上的立场正在不露声色地软化。

1d1863de4a201d8746c69ba257d87c054e5f91d9.source: Some steps were needed to curtail abuse by business, but the Commission has far too much power over legitimate, honest businessmen in this country.
1d1863de4a201d8746c69ba257d87c054e5f91d9.zh: 我们确实需要采取措施遏制企业的不当行为，但委员会对本国正当经营、诚实守法的商人拥有的权力实在太大了。

33cd3553475030f0317a6c68df71ebaa039d56de.source: Some suggest you lack the experience and qualifications for to be President. What do you say?
33cd3553475030f0317a6c68df71ebaa039d56de.zh: 有人认为，你缺乏担任总统的经验和资格。你怎么回应？

cefbe5ec8c68b38c362f2197244ec694e3114bf1.source: Some supporters are disappointed by this statement.
cefbe5ec8c68b38c362f2197244ec694e3114bf1.zh: 一些支持者对这番话感到失望。

0df05c0e83fb19bc5a4cd3d5eaa3f4d202a161b6.source: Some theorists have suggested that the government create guaranteed jobs at the federal minimum wage, to help support the labor market. Is this something that you would consider?
0df05c0e83fb19bc5a4cd3d5eaa3f4d202a161b6.zh: 一些理论研究者建议，政府按照联邦最低工资标准提供有保证的工作岗位，以支撑劳动力市场。你会考虑这种做法吗？

4b187a9ef393eae18a1cf8a2ba77e9c0decd3e4f.source: Some think you are too restained on this issue, if that's easy to believe.
4b187a9ef393eae18a1cf8a2ba77e9c0decd3e4f.zh: 有人觉得，你在这个问题上过于克制了——如果这种评价还算可信的话。

38a122c0a2003b6229725cdd510b028bb06669cc.source: Some think you've gone a little too far with these comments, but as usual your supporters are fired up.
38a122c0a2003b6229725cdd510b028bb06669cc.zh: 有些人认为，你这番话有点过了头，不过照例，你的支持者斗志高昂。

4b17d35b8f5f765b1a18edae6a381b82ec63b501.source: Some wonder if it's just a cynical political ploy, but you get your face on the local news in a lot of places across the country.
4b17d35b8f5f765b1a18edae6a381b82ec63b501.zh: 有人怀疑，这不过是算计精明的政治手段，但全国许多地方的当地新闻都出现了你的面孔。

aa1c0070726655ca694161f1404b845d25f352b1.source: Sometimes if you feel strongly about something, you have to back that up with a little cash. $10,000 is nothing for someone who's as wealthy as I am.
aa1c0070726655ca694161f1404b845d25f352b1.zh: 有时，如果你坚信某件事，就得拿点钱来支持自己的话。对我这么富有的人来说，1万美元不算什么。

fc160f96a90a5ae0a6433aea7fae81e8ba3e63e4.source: Somewhat counter to initial expectations, you continue to press the conservative case as you campaign.
fc160f96a90a5ae0a6433aea7fae81e8ba3e63e4.zh: 与最初的预期有些不同，你继续在竞选中力陈保守派的主张。

0168bb2972221ebfaebc63aceb1385aa2af61274.source: Sorry! You have lost in a squeaker.
0168bb2972221ebfaebc63aceb1385aa2af61274.zh: 抱歉！你已经输给了吱吱声。

7f491a1cce5da740ba9df0b8a82eda7c3a7c785c.source: Sorry! You have lost the 1896 election.
7f491a1cce5da740ba9df0b8a82eda7c3a7c785c.zh: 抱歉！你输掉了 1896 年的选举。

842df09dc3416307f616b94ef70a7a5f2782234e.source: Sorry! You have lost the 2000 election.
842df09dc3416307f616b94ef70a7a5f2782234e.zh: 抱歉！你输掉了 2000 年的选举。

b04a94b83de9946a2e3c12a83443aed63e0c38dd.source: Sorry! You have lost the 2012 election.
b04a94b83de9946a2e3c12a83443aed63e0c38dd.zh: 抱歉！你输掉了 2012 年选举。

7ff5fb4f180bda1e3211f79a0fb0f64b3ea4a47c.source: Sorry! You have lost the 2016 election.
7ff5fb4f180bda1e3211f79a0fb0f64b3ea4a47c.zh: 抱歉！你输掉了 2016 年选举。

126fbfb19f7ebce3220cc5c9aa339e079c55f8e7.source: Sorry! You have lost the 2020 election.
126fbfb19f7ebce3220cc5c9aa339e079c55f8e7.zh: 抱歉！你已经输掉了 2020 年选举。

1cc7cbe63f40f4f9c0022d0e7114a0541d58830c.source: Sorry, you did not prevent an electoral college majority.
1cc7cbe63f40f4f9c0022d0e7114a0541d58830c.zh: 抱歉，您没有阻止 选举人团 多数。

a073807d316e054d916701c2a5515257528d539c.source: Sorry, you have lost the 1916 election.
a073807d316e054d916701c2a5515257528d539c.zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 1916 年选举。

e0b76db6350ee4842209c83a512fd2c33a9c3646.source: Sorry, you have lost the 1960 Presidential Election.
e0b76db6350ee4842209c83a512fd2c33a9c3646.zh: 抱歉，您在 1960 年总统选举中失败了。

911c07a720c2043dc1f72011f185262ebac19ce1.source: Sorry, you have lost the 1968 election.
911c07a720c2043dc1f72011f185262ebac19ce1.zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 1968 年的选举。

cef6c6691a932a8736df5dbbd70f9fb67af30e2c.source: Sorry, you have lost the 1976 Presidential Election.
cef6c6691a932a8736df5dbbd70f9fb67af30e2c.zh: 抱歉，您在 1976 年总统选举中失败了。

c8d856336c632f31db9835d61c79d7f7865e0f6a.zh: 很遗憾，你输掉了2016年大选

034e9769ca63ca8cbc5a00544b256786128b08ea.zh: 很遗憾，你输掉了1968年选举。

19ebe6b749e45043c0622526f1fba2ff359f68e7.zh: 很遗憾，你输掉了1976年选举。

49fc16d40e76a21c248eea87f571222eb00e5e53.zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 2016 年选举

81bc0d818a38f6a53d2793377d61b3e2830fbbe9.zh: 很遗憾，你输掉了2020年大选。

dd8789b992cf0c2f8ea258361cd6700510d33f0e.zh: 很遗憾，你输掉了1988年选举。

8340e35daae6d46e7063d3a57e4a59f86c283cb0.zh: 很遗憾，你输掉了2000年大选

5fa0677535567d2aed176dfc0b5ca48d0d27a797.source: Sorry. You have lost the 1844 Election
5fa0677535567d2aed176dfc0b5ca48d0d27a797.zh: 抱歉。你输掉了 1844 年选举

785c80dc62d13df91473706c8d498b992edb2abc.source: Sorry. You have lost the 1860 Presidential Election.
785c80dc62d13df91473706c8d498b992edb2abc.zh: 抱歉。你输掉了 1860 年总统选举。

21c7c51c74f4c16221f6c76618038a2ff17b5049.source: Sorry. You have lost the 1948 Presidential Election.
21c7c51c74f4c16221f6c76618038a2ff17b5049.zh: 抱歉。你输掉了 1948 年总统选举。

0bbfc17a03ca6f446800da358c769cc94c97269c.source: Sorry. You have lost the 1988 election.
0bbfc17a03ca6f446800da358c769cc94c97269c.zh: 抱歉。你输掉了 1988 年的选举。

dff7ca9fc5c811697c401f57cdb868a2c4644957.source: Sources have indicated that Johnson is close to reaching a breakthrough in negotiations with the North Vietnamese, which could almost assure a Democratic win on Tuesday. An operative with connections to the South Vietnam government is willing to sabotage these negotiations with promises that you will offer a better deal when elected. Will you take a chance on this plan?
dff7ca9fc5c811697c401f57cdb868a2c4644957.zh: 消息表明，约翰逊即将在与北越的谈判中取得突破，这几乎能确保民主党在周二获胜。一名与南越政府有联系的人，愿意破坏这些谈判，向他们保证你当选后会提供更好的条件。你会冒险实施这个计划吗？

18f36693976fdc0c7aff6e25d9d2ca4025b5d706.source: Southern Democrats are reassured by your last-minute appeal, even if liberals and activists are infuriated by your flip-flopping. Will the South carry you to victory?
18f36693976fdc0c7aff6e25d9d2ca4025b5d706.zh: 你在最后关头的呼吁让南方民主党人放心了，尽管自由派和活动家对你的反复无常十分愤怒。南方会把你送上胜利的宝座吗？

080e347e1a9d4ca5c2ad4c1e6164af0ca8d52f62.source: Southern Republicans are insisting that you visit their region extensively during this campaign, claiming that Kennedy will be vulnerable in some states. What are your thoughts?
080e347e1a9d4ca5c2ad4c1e6164af0ca8d52f62.zh: 南方共和党人坚持要求你在竞选期间广泛访问当地，声称肯尼迪在一些州容易失利。你怎么看？

e45fbf0df1185033a9b41c096130d3377cd3d17c.source: Speaking out for solar power won't help you much this fall.
e45fbf0df1185033a9b41c096130d3377cd3d17c.zh: 今年秋天，公开支持太阳能对你没多大帮助。

04fbeb60bd062356a3c69e621ad987d73a30984b.source: Speeches are a big part of any campaign, and yours is no exception. What would you like to talk about today?
04fbeb60bd062356a3c69e621ad987d73a30984b.zh: 演说是任何竞选的重要组成部分，你的竞选也不例外。今天你想谈些什么？

1f117a8b26f87d335bb45b5fbd86cb9bd4065292.source: Spiro Agnew has served as the Governor of Maryland since 1967, and he brings a reputation as a moderate on many issues including civil rights and the environment.
1f117a8b26f87d335bb45b5fbd86cb9bd4065292.zh: 斯皮罗·阿格纽 自 1967 年以来一直担任 马里兰州 州长，他在 民权 和环境等许多问题上享有温和派的声誉。

fcfeb51d69b314c0c3427dd1fd910c8f5dc7f482.source: Statements like these are exactly what you need to fire up your base this fall.
fcfeb51d69b314c0c3427dd1fd910c8f5dc7f482.zh: 今年秋天，你正需要这种表态来点燃基本盘的热情。

05458cf7ed5fc22996ac02f6fa49b954ed28a527.source: Statements like this are a bit tone-deaf in the 2016 environment.
05458cf7ed5fc22996ac02f6fa49b954ed28a527.zh: 在2016年的环境下，这种表态有点不懂民情。

64a4acda7beb5c01d72d4adb95dcb013bf26af56.source: Stein will most likely feature as a footnote in the 2012 election, though she could draw support from Obama if he veers too close to the political center.
64a4acda7beb5c01d72d4adb95dcb013bf26af56.zh: 斯坦 很可能会在 2012 年选举中作为脚注，尽管如果 奥巴马 过于接近政治中心，她可能会获得支持。

3b9d3af37d24c6d274e4a05e3ddd1ae4ca00e3b3.source: Stephen Douglas, thanks to a Democratic schism, has little hope of winning the election outright. His path to victory involves throwing the election the House, and finishing in the top three in the electoral vote count. In this case, he could win or at least deny the Republicans a victory.
3b9d3af37d24c6d274e4a05e3ddd1ae4ca00e3b3.zh: 斯蒂芬 道格拉斯，由于民主党分裂，彻底赢得选举的希望渺茫。他的胜利之路包括让选举进入众议院，并在选举人票数上名列前三。在这种情况下，他可能会赢得或至少不会让共和党取得胜利。

26aa2442de937ea0ede1b2b4918ea1da2cd424ae.source: Stick to your bread-and-butter appeals. This is red meat for the kind of people who will vote for you this fall.
26aa2442de937ea0ede1b2b4918ea1da2cd424ae.zh: 坚持那些最能吸引你选民的老主张。这种话正合秋季会投你票的人胃口。

6edc79de2c43855edb905874453aa83899fdb9dc.source: Still, you’ve run a decent campaign, and your campaign has tried the best it could. You have a chance to cross that 5% threshold in the next election at least, considering you’ve been a perennial candidate for 8 years now. Good luck in 2004!
6edc79de2c43855edb905874453aa83899fdb9dc.zh: 尽管如此，您的竞选活动还是不错的，并且您的竞选活动已尽了最大努力。考虑到你已经成为常年候选人 8 年了，你至少有机会在下一次选举中跨越 5% 的门槛。祝你2004年好运！

a1cc8d2a9eda1be6fea26f57acb95be6ebbcb91c.source: Strom Thurmond will cost you some southern states, but hopefully you can make up for it in other regions.
a1cc8d2a9eda1be6fea26f57acb95be6ebbcb91c.zh: 斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德会让你失去一些南方州，但愿你能在其他地区弥补损失。

27690f7b54c45fc8d8f81be473a5586fdab8f6e3.source: Stuart Symington has served his home state of Missouri well for many years, as Harry Truman himself has noted, and is a staunch Democrat.
27690f7b54c45fc8d8f81be473a5586fdab8f6e3.zh: 正如哈里·杜鲁门本人指出的那样，斯图尔特·赛明顿多年来为家乡密苏里州尽心服务，是一位坚定的民主党人。

dc32732893f756603bb9de3e58a9cecfee64f853.source: Stuart Symington is a close friend of mine and a tireless advocate for liberalism in the United States. I look forward to working with him for the next four years.
dc32732893f756603bb9de3e58a9cecfee64f853.zh: 斯图尔特·赛明顿是我的密友，也是美国自由主义不知疲倦的倡导者。我期待未来四年与他合作。

e58d26fe0972a882f79c7d2980ce396404234e29.source: Stuart Symington was a minor contender for the nomination, but he is a respected Senator on foreign policy issues and has good rapport with Kennedy. He has served as Secretary of the Air Force and was a more outspoken opponent of McCarthyism than Kennedy was, which makes him appealing to liberals. His home state of Missouri should be very close in the fall, but he is somewhat unpopular in the Deep South.
e58d26fe0972a882f79c7d2980ce396404234e29.zh: 斯图尔特·赛明顿 是提名的次要竞争者，但他在外交政策问题上是一位受人尊敬的参议员，并且与 肯尼迪 关系良好。他曾担任过空军部长，并且比 肯尼迪 更直言不讳地反对麦卡锡主义，这使他对自由主义者有吸引力。他的家乡密苏里州秋天的状态应该非常接近，但他在深南部有点不受欢迎。

24cb912935fd7785aa76bde03eb293dfe0259b86.source: Students and radicals agree with you. Nobody else does, resulting in you being firmly outside the mainstream.
24cb912935fd7785aa76bde03eb293dfe0259b86.zh: 学生和激进派赞同你，其他人都不赞同。结果，你彻底站到了主流之外。

5fe6365ac56b0e219bae3bc5e0ab98b2c5ce6c57.source: Students are the future of this country and they need all the help they can get to make it through college, especially considering how much tuition has been increased over the past few years.
5fe6365ac56b0e219bae3bc5e0ab98b2c5ce6c57.zh: 学生是国家的未来，他们需要尽可能多的帮助，才能读完大学；尤其考虑到过去几年学费涨了那么多。

dc3497e6f4c871d1cf8637c43fc1705081a074af.source: Support and opposition to the Serbia air strikes is all over the place. Mainstream politicians support the action, while a combination of anti-war leftists and anti-Clinton Republicans oppose it.
dc3497e6f4c871d1cf8637c43fc1705081a074af.zh: 对塞尔维亚空袭的支持和反对，并不按单一阵营划分。主流政界人士支持这次行动，反战左翼与反克林顿的共和党人则联合反对。

111625e3c85589d53aede302ff24b1d4fac13071.source: Support for a federal infrastructure program is quite limited within your party.
111625e3c85589d53aede302ff24b1d4fac13071.zh: 你们党内对联邦基础设施建设计划的支持相当有限。

6122d9a58677be2ef8c0ff3fd29cc52c390c356f.source: Support for this party is confined to the South and border states, and we shouldn't waste our time in attacking them.
6122d9a58677be2ef8c0ff3fd29cc52c390c356f.zh: 这个党的支持仅限于南方和边界州，我们不该浪费时间攻击他们。

62677548752984f1dbc57beb7b1591381c5128ad.source: Supporters and opponents both notice the subtle change of tone about immigration.
62677548752984f1dbc57beb7b1591381c5128ad.zh: 支持者和对手都注意到，你谈移民时的语气有了微妙变化。

00e27bfe001eb2ab14d595fe273a4ec2c13c3176.source: Supporters are energized by your aggressive campaign. And inflation is an issue that worries everyone right now.
00e27bfe001eb2ab14d595fe273a4ec2c13c3176.zh: 你积极进攻的竞选让支持者振奋。通货膨胀眼下也是所有人都担忧的问题。

91a5631eae42eba1b95bbd5e812b965aefb2a5fb.source: Supporters are surprised and upset to hear you take a new position on the bank issue.
91a5631eae42eba1b95bbd5e812b965aefb2a5fb.zh: 听到你在银行问题上改变立场，支持者既意外又不满。

af6bf7064c11a8bb237cc96fe8485caa16775a9e.source: Supporters want to see vigilance on the Communism issue.
af6bf7064c11a8bb237cc96fe8485caa16775a9e.zh: 支持者希望在共产主义问题上保持警惕。

fa4ee7967fa1535cb45a429805852130854a0c1d.source: Supports Obamacare but also would support a public insurance agency to ensure minimum coverage standards are met at an affordable cost. Believes that malpractice suits are conducive to good care by providing oversight of the medical system.
fa4ee7967fa1535cb45a429805852130854a0c1d.zh: 支持奥巴马医改，也支持设立公共保险机构，以可负担的成本确保达到最低保障标准。认为医疗事故诉讼通过监督医疗体系，有助于提高医疗质量。

39931f37e5a4aa77ed7b597e9ecd33d03bd8c971.source: Supports Obamacare more or less as is. Rejects calls for a public option but supports an insurance mandate and also strongly supports the existing Medicare system.
39931f37e5a4aa77ed7b597e9ecd33d03bd8c971.zh: 基本支持原有奥巴马医改。反对增设公共医保选项的呼声，但支持强制投保，也坚决支持现有联邦医疗保险制度。

e94a574969a79901a4612dc6bf7ef7653ef20406.source: Supports a greater role for the free market in the halth care sector. Opposed to Obamacare. Probably would not support an end to the FDA or other, more radical measures.
e94a574969a79901a4612dc6bf7ef7653ef20406.zh: 支持让自由市场在医疗领域发挥更大作用。反对奥巴马医改。大概不会支持撤销食品药品管理局，或其他更激进的措施。

09af675fbb96358f5e6d5d8f55f7991281931952.source: Supports a path to citizenship for most illegal immigrants. Would relax immigration restrictions from all sources. Sees current border security as adequate, and does not believe it is the main issue in the current immigration debate.
09af675fbb96358f5e6d5d8f55f7991281931952.zh: 支持为多数非法移民提供入籍途径。会放宽对各类来源移民的限制。认为现有边境安保已经足够，也不认为它是当前移民争论的主要问题。

d0592f432599488546fb01223b8840493d1e174a.source: Supports and opponents both note that you are not really rocking the boat on this issue.
d0592f432599488546fb01223b8840493d1e174a.zh: 支持者与反对者都注意到，在这个问题上，你并没有真正打破现状。

112b9bb805bfc44a40ddb28d6084b0ce2f48498d.source: Supports the immediate deportation of all illegal immigrants living in the United States. Supports the construction of a border wall. Takes a hard line on legal immigration and visa approvals. Sees Hispanics and other immigrants as a threat to American culture and as a strain on social programs.
112b9bb805bfc44a40ddb28d6084b0ce2f48498d.zh: 支持立即遣返所有居住在美国的非法移民。支持修建边境墙。对合法移民与签证审批持强硬态度。认为拉美裔及其他移民威胁美国文化，并加重社会福利计划的负担。

ab142ee2fa9a138f5398ecd1bcde9b9cfd724d18.source: Sure enough, the mudslinging tone of your campaign continues.
ab142ee2fa9a138f5398ecd1bcde9b9cfd724d18.zh: 果然，你的竞选继续保持着抹黑对手的论调。

f9589546f5e32bec4b5e8689808bcf85176038ba.source: Surely the second-guessing will be intense, but if things were close you could probably run again in 2004.
f9589546f5e32bec4b5e8689808bcf85176038ba.zh: 当然，事后批评会很激烈，但如果情况接近的话，你可能会在 2004 年再次参选。

8ec2c389e72572f0acb605f9ee502fa954150b7c.source: Surprisingly, your disastrous answer has flown under the radar. Your advisors are incredibly relieved and set up on a emergency meeting to prevent you from spouting further nonsense.
8ec2c389e72572f0acb605f9ee502fa954150b7c.zh: 出人意料，你这个灾难性的回答没有引起注意。顾问们大大松了一口气，安排了紧急会议，以免你再胡说八道。

01cf6d2c0832c844bfece7ca71a47dace03bdc37.source: Susan Rice was a UN Ambassador and a National Security Advisor to Barack Obama, and brings decades of foreign policy experience. She would be a true center-left pick, but has never run for elected office. Her foreign policy record would also be a turnoff to progressives.
01cf6d2c0832c844bfece7ca71a47dace03bdc37.zh: 苏珊·赖斯 曾任联合国大使和 贝拉克·奥巴马 的国家安全顾问，拥有数十年的外交政策经验。她将是真正的中左翼候选人，但从未竞选过民选公职。她的外交政策记录也会令进步人士望而却步。

e03e67ac176fc471e32fcfda6315e2e2131b2b0c.source: Symington is perfectly capable, but politically he doesn't bring any particular region outside of Missouri to the fold.
e03e67ac176fc471e32fcfda6315e2e2131b2b0c.zh: 赛明顿完全能胜任，但从政治上说，除了密苏里州，他并不能为我们特别争取到哪个地区。

88560057434d0b31f1ae2bf1ff9a9ed1dcd26d29.source: Sympathy for Eugene Debs? This will not help you in the fall.
88560057434d0b31f1ae2bf1ff9a9ed1dcd26d29.zh: 同情尤金·德布斯？这对你秋季的大选可没有帮助。

2726537b10cc2eaa9b61faf8557478a66c30fa15.source: Taking a page out of George Wallace’s book, eh? To say the least, it didn’t go well.
2726537b10cc2eaa9b61faf8557478a66c30fa15.zh: 这是在学乔治·华莱士那一套，是吧？总之，效果很不好。

f38554a40bc25ea84786a21f7c6df1e165e64e92.source: Talk of immigration reform is not popular in your own party. However, you seem to keep your support almost no matter what you say.
f38554a40bc25ea84786a21f7c6df1e165e64e92.zh: 谈移民改革，在你自己的党内并不受欢迎。不过，你似乎几乎无论说什么，都能保住支持。

5b917b53d666fadd5b0943fd271dcfd5cfe5ceac.source: Talk of personal foibles is probably just sound and fury in this election.
5b917b53d666fadd5b0943fd271dcfd5cfe5ceac.zh: 这次大选中，对个人缺点的议论，多半只是空嚷嚷。

ce5daed1a38d4f760cdd77ace33784abbe78cbbf.source: Talking about a bankrupt Social Security program is a right wing scare tactic. We could afford to increase benefits if we really wanted to.
ce5daed1a38d4f760cdd77ace33784abbe78cbbf.zh: 说社会保障计划已经破产，是右翼吓唬人的手段。只要我们真想做，完全负担得起提高待遇。

86b586c0e61cd6b5aa2236841a5f95339efbe318.source: Tammy Duckworth cares about our country. She nearly made the ultimate sacrifice serving our country in Iraq, and in the years since then she has been an excellent Senator and an expert on foreign policy issues.
86b586c0e61cd6b5aa2236841a5f95339efbe318.zh: 塔米·达克沃思关心我们的国家。她在伊拉克为国服役，几乎付出生命。此后这些年，她成为一位出色的参议员，也是一位外交议题专家。

9e3f90b854923f19eda43117faeaf4ffc447af07.source: Supports deportation of illegal immigrants living in the United States, with no exceptions based on time spent in the country. Supports construction of a wall and increased border security. May favor incremental measures to avoid the disruption would follow from deporting up to 20 million people in a short period of time.
9e3f90b854923f19eda43117faeaf4ffc447af07.zh: 支持遣返居住在美国的非法移民，不因居留时间长短而破例。支持修墙并加强边境安全。可能倾向于渐进措施，以免短时间内遣返多达2000万人造成社会混乱。

e2086fef098599ef2846de600527f28b9cf8067a.source: Supports deportation of illegal immigrants, but may be willing to offer select, long-term residents a path to citizenship. May or may not advocate for a reduction in legal immigration. Supports increased border security as the best way to solve the issue in the long-term.
e2086fef098599ef2846de600527f28b9cf8067a.zh: 支持遣返非法移民，但可能愿意为部分长期居民提供入籍途径。可能主张减少合法移民，也可能不主张。支持加强边境安全，认为这是长远解决问题的最佳办法。

d545179d2014d49c42e94ea224fb1c07f4e92df9.source: Supports deportation of newly arrived illegal immigrants, a path to citizenship for some long-term residents, and increased border security. Generally sees legal, skilled immigrants as an economic asset.
d545179d2014d49c42e94ea224fb1c07f4e92df9.zh: 支持遣返新近入境的非法移民、为部分长期居民提供入籍途径，并加强边境安全。总体认为合法的技术移民是经济财富。

04e4d1e2a208d4cd78bd2d3c4338bc9354842ddc.source: Supports firm action against Iran and would consider an invasion if necessary. Also supports a strong military. Pays some respect to international alliances and institutions, and does not support radical measures like withdrawing from the U.N.
04e4d1e2a208d4cd78bd2d3c4338bc9354842ddc.zh: 支持对伊朗采取强硬行动，必要时会考虑入侵。也支持强大的军队。一定程度上重视国际联盟与机构，不支持退出联合国等激进措施。

fdcc62727a33512b25a6c0627411e95b16b0b135.source: Supports growing the economy through large tax cuts, a sweeping reduction in the public sector, and overhaul of Social Security & Medicare, and possibly by reducing the power of the Federal Reserve to inflate the currency.
fdcc62727a33512b25a6c0627411e95b16b0b135.zh: 支持通过大幅减税、全面缩减公共部门、彻底改革社会保障与联邦医疗保险来发展经济，也可能主张削弱美联储增发货币的权力。

a207a8b645531449b937650e7db66ccdb048b81b.source: Supports huge increases in legal immigration. Would not attempt to deport individuals currently living in the United States. Supports the basic premises of multiculturalism and programs like bilingual education.
a207a8b645531449b937650e7db66ccdb048b81b.zh: 支持大幅增加合法移民。不会试图遣返目前居住在美国的人。支持多元文化主义的基本理念，以及双语教育等计划。

5e63319066e317c21e9049b33ad7199c919acd42.source: Supports smaller government in principle. May be willing to compromise and to consider temporary stimulus programs, in exchange for other concessions.
5e63319066e317c21e9049b33ad7199c919acd42.zh: 原则上支持小政府。可能愿意妥协，以换取其他让步为条件，考虑临时刺激计划。

ec60fb512101d82c8737aa07bea5546a911e3398.source: Supports some effort to collectively insure the poor and the chronically ill. May disagree with certain aspects of Obamacare or may not support a mandate, but agrees that the current system needs more intervention.
ec60fb512101d82c8737aa07bea5546a911e3398.zh: 支持采取一定措施，为贫困者和慢性病患者集体提供保险。可能不同意奥巴马医改的某些部分，或不支持强制投保，但认同现行体系需要更多干预。

42c7fcf91b2315d4d32e934bd1089b888ab47cfb.source: Tammy Duckworth is a Senator from Illinois who served in Iraq and has been active in foreign policy issues. She could help in the Midwest, but was also born in Thailand (as a U.S. citizen) and will need to deflect questions about her eligibility. Additionally, many party activists are expecting an African-American to be selected as well.
42c7fcf91b2315d4d32e934bd1089b888ab47cfb.zh: 塔米·达克沃思 是来自 伊利诺伊州 的参议员，曾在伊拉克服役并积极参与外交政策问题。她可以在中西部提供帮助，但她也出生在泰国（作为美国公民），因此需要转移有关她资格的问题。此外，许多政党活动人士预计一名非裔美国人也将被选中。

6b422c6ce25fd27640c8b80edc2c77a15a600e0d.source: Tammy Duckworth is a fighter, a Midwesterner, and a progressive. She knows what it means to overcome adversity, and she understands the challenges that Americans are facing.
6b422c6ce25fd27640c8b80edc2c77a15a600e0d.zh: 塔米·达克沃思是斗士、中西部人，也是进步派。她知道克服逆境意味着什么，也了解美国人面对的挑战。

cd50a618ab09e69443b1cfbf57527002e6eefd41.source: Tariffs are a winning issue in the North. There's no reason to hold back here.
cd50a618ab09e69443b1cfbf57527002e6eefd41.zh: 关税是能在北方赢得选票的议题，没有理由在这里有所保留。

b68c07e24cc2f187174fbb0a323e88d93b537fe8.source: Tariffs are highly popular in the North. Since the Southern wing has defected anyway, it might change your political calculations.
b68c07e24cc2f187174fbb0a323e88d93b537fe8.zh: 关税在北方极受欢迎。既然南方派已经离党，这或许应该改变你的政治盘算。

2cce5d29faaba83058dfcb4edd448e381b5863c5.source: Tariffs should be limited to the minimum amount necessary to raise sufficient revenue for the federal government.
2cce5d29faaba83058dfcb4edd448e381b5863c5.zh: 关税应当限于联邦政府筹得足够收入所必需的最低水平。

8c491defea8d605907d63ea4713fc374edc0d03d.source: Tax cuts for the middle class are always popular.
8c491defea8d605907d63ea4713fc374edc0d03d.zh: 给中产阶级减税总是受欢迎的。

a275643c92183e97016e4d2101e1a53f1cd16775.source: Ted Cruz was Trump's main rival for the Republican nomination. He is a Senator from Texas who has consistently taken conservative and evangelical positions during his political career. He will only serve as a running mate if Trump makes assurances about his position on the health care issue, federal spending, abortion, and other social issues. He has made it clear that he will withdraw from the ticket if Trump appears to deviate from his promises.
a275643c92183e97016e4d2101e1a53f1cd16775.zh: 特德·克鲁兹 是 特朗普 共和党提名的主要竞争对手。他是来自 得克萨斯州 的参议员，在政治生涯中一直采取保守派和福音派立场。只有 特朗普 保证他在医疗保健问题、联邦支出、堕胎和其他社会问题上的立场，他才会担任竞选伙伴。他已明确表示，如果 特朗普 似乎背离了他的承诺，他将退出投票。

95cfd0d639ad36720db585cf09dda40277511993.source: Television advertising has become a greater part of political campaigning in the last few years, with more and more families owning televisions every day. As such, we need to decide on the tone of what we air to the public- it could color this election from day one.
95cfd0d639ad36720db585cf09dda40277511993.zh: 过去几年，拥有电视的家庭越来越多，电视广告在政治竞选中的分量也越来越重。因此，我们需要决定向公众播放什么基调的广告；它可能从第一天起就影响这场选举的观感。

7075609dadfb9f56de041edc2e441d562884f090.source: Television advertising is coming to dominate the political campaign season. Where should the greatest emphasis be placed in your ads?
7075609dadfb9f56de041edc2e441d562884f090.zh: 电视广告正在主导竞选季。你的广告应当把重点放在哪里？

fe31fabaf5c8a6abd21e7d2f7de733afc638917a.source: Television commentator Sean Hannity recounts a single, private conversation between himself and Trump in 2003 where Trump said he opposed the war.
fe31fabaf5c8a6abd21e7d2f7de733afc638917a.zh: 电视评论员肖恩·汉尼提回忆了一次2003年与特朗普的私下谈话，据他所说，特朗普当时表示反对战争。

1a178c31ad5d425f1a46374b1b8fdfb540eb5d08.source: That was the strained voice of Elizabeth Warren, sitting around a table near the Senate floor in Washington DC. Accompanying her was Joe Manchin, Chuck Schumer, and a few other high-profile Democrats senators. 'I still can't wrap my mind around it' Manchin hoarsely says to the table. 'He shouldn't have even gotten more than 350 votes on a good day, but he eclipsed that by a lot.' Nobody responded, they just looked around nervously. 'Do you think, he, you know... rigged it? Not trying to be a conspiracy theorist, but c'mon. This is unprecedented. Everyone remained silent. To the surprise of them, if they could verify it accurately, none of them knew of any plot of this calibre. The only person who might have known anything was Biden, and he hasn't responded to any calls. Had the US finally, truly, visually, had their democratic process violated?
1a178c31ad5d425f1a46374b1b8fdfb540eb5d08.zh: 这是 伊丽莎白·沃伦 紧张的声音，他坐在华盛顿特区 华盛顿州 参议院附近的一张桌子旁。陪同她的还有乔·曼钦、查克·舒默和其他几位知名的民主党参议员。 “我还是无法集中注意力，”曼钦沙哑地对桌子说道。 “在美好的一天，他本不应该获得超过 350 票，但他远远超过了这个数字。”没有人回应，只是紧张地环顾四周。 “你认为，他，你知道……操纵了它吗？”不想成为阴谋论者，但来吧。这是前所未有的。大家都保持沉默。让他们惊讶的是，如果能够准确核实的话，他们竟然没有人知道有这样的阴谋。唯一可能知道任何事情的人是拜登，并且他没有回复任何电话。美国的民主进程是否最终、真正、直观地遭到了侵犯？

d3aa2a7f1b8c950df18a1d33e60b6031f75d170b.source: That's a great question. It's hard to speculate on what might have been, but it at time it seemed clear that Mubarak had to go.
d3aa2a7f1b8c950df18a1d33e60b6031f75d170b.zh: 这是个很好的问题。很难推测另一种做法会带来什么结果，但当时显然觉得穆巴拉克必须下台。

f9fafcf1b2185cfbf0b366fac8dd198560a0afa7.source: That's a ridiculous statement. Of course some partisan Democrats are making that case, but Mr. Quayle more than held his own.
f9fafcf1b2185cfbf0b366fac8dd198560a0afa7.zh: 这种说法荒唐透顶。当然，有些偏袒本党的民主党人会这样说，但奎尔先生的表现完全不落下风。

db2f9e35f407fa953cccb76e4a6de0c712babfde.source: That's a solid play. Don't give the liberals any openings to attack you on the Social Security issue.
db2f9e35f407fa953cccb76e4a6de0c712babfde.zh: 这招很扎实。在社会保障问题上，别给自由派留下任何攻击你的空当。

84ad20b7c041e6ac02becc15c012a76150173776.source: That's a very bad idea. Women in combat roles will not pull their weight, and will undermine unit morale.
84ad20b7c041e6ac02becc15c012a76150173776.zh: 这是个很糟糕的主意。女性在作战岗位上无法尽到应有的职责，还会损害部队士气。

bb8e0c3d0ca24bce9e02b705464e37590fe3dd34.source: That's an issue for the states to decide. You know, the federal government does not support collective bargaining for its employees, so it's not appropriate for me to comment on a state matter.
bb8e0c3d0ca24bce9e02b705464e37590fe3dd34.zh: 这是由各州决定的问题。你知道，联邦政府也不支持自己的雇员进行集体谈判，所以我不适合评论一个州的问题。

b272899bf4392d6eadfa3e038a784c3868ff4fd4.source: That's not a good idea. Let's be realistic and devote our efforts to the states that matter.
b272899bf4392d6eadfa3e038a784c3868ff4fd4.zh: 这不是好主意。现实一点吧，把精力投向真正关键的州。

6e2f64162bd45b2308d6acbaa6db9b250c20cc29.source: That's not an entirely relevant question, because I agree with Johnson's stance in Vietnam. We cannot cave in to Communist aggression and maintain our standing in the world.
6e2f64162bd45b2308d6acbaa6db9b250c20cc29.zh: 这个问题不完全适用，因为我赞同约翰逊的越南立场。我们不能一边屈服于共产主义的进攻，一边还想维持自己在世界上的地位。

f563d7dd3735c3125db3bc53b1ddc006190917b5.source: That's not quite what I said, actually. I was only referring to immigrants who have been in this country for many years and integrated into their communities.
f563d7dd3735c3125db3bc53b1ddc006190917b5.zh: 其实，我并不是这么说的。我说的只是那些已在美国生活多年、融入所在社区的移民。

699fd8f0cdae9257eeefc45de339ad7b1e5b094f.source: Ten years after the landslide victory of Donald Trump, the United States had changed a lot. The wall was built, the 'Mexicans' were deported, and Hillary was locked up; yet, even though his country had rejected everything he believed in, Biden had still found happiness.
699fd8f0cdae9257eeefc45de339ad7b1e5b094f.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普取得压倒性胜利十年后，美国发生了很大变化。隔离墙建成，“墨西哥人”被驱逐出境，希拉里被关起来；然而，尽管他的国家拒绝了他所信仰的一切，拜登仍然找到了幸福。

fb081ca24399728117c12bc7cbe7dc0a130d4dc7.source: Texas is the issue that can reignite your chances this fall! But there a few whispers that your banking policy comes straight from 1832.
