fb081ca24399728117c12bc7cbe7dc0a130d4dc7.zh: 得克萨斯问题能够重振你在今秋获胜的希望！不过，有些人私下议论，你的银行政策简直是照搬1832年的主张。

e77c00a55c31517b06e643b891146c7d807043de.source: Texas is the issue that can reignite your chances this fall! Clay is certainly prone to attack on that front.
e77c00a55c31517b06e643b891146c7d807043de.zh: 得克萨斯问题能够重振你在今秋获胜的希望！克莱在这个问题上确实容易受到攻击。

402791584973499cd7f36ea5007cae38a1a37cfa.source: Texas is the issue that can reignite your chances this fall! Especially with the equivocation of Henry Clay.
402791584973499cd7f36ea5007cae38a1a37cfa.zh: 得克萨斯问题能够重振你在今秋获胜的希望！亨利·克莱含糊其辞的态度，尤其对你有利。

bd9ba0a6bcde8af7456f0ea570bb0d8c715c9989.source: Texas should be fertile ground for the George Wallace message. If Humphrey and Johnson get into a rift, I think we've got a real shot in that state. I will try my best to win it.
bd9ba0a6bcde8af7456f0ea570bb0d8c715c9989.zh: 得克萨斯州应该很适合传播乔治·华莱士的主张。如果汉弗莱与约翰逊闹翻，我认为我们在那个州真有机会。我会尽力拿下它。

fd773babc6e748d3a4796f1314d3d6ae56128883.source: That dirty little snake will regret it soon enough.
fd773babc6e748d3a4796f1314d3d6ae56128883.zh: 那个卑鄙的小人，很快就会后悔。

bc970ef6a675cce4cab82e691cca64d330a8f148.source: That doesn't sound like a good idea to me. Perhaps with high schoolers it makes more sense to, you know, delve into some of those details.
bc970ef6a675cce4cab82e691cca64d330a8f148.zh: 我觉得这不是什么好主意。也许对高中生来说，你知道，讲一些具体细节更合适。

74ddc4ef04fbb6c671dd5d718616f50e04f820ae.source: That is nearly two years. We need unemployment benefits but these extensions were clearly out of control.
74ddc4ef04fbb6c671dd5d718616f50e04f820ae.zh: 那可是将近两年。我们需要失业待遇，但这些延长期限显然已经失控。

7bc7e5404336bfbf1e6b3212e01b53384731a086.source: That is not what your voting base wants to hear on this issue.
7bc7e5404336bfbf1e6b3212e01b53384731a086.zh: 在这个问题上，这可不是你的选民基本盘想听的话。

2e9e0aaaf79616ea90522024195527562fd721cc.source: That seems like a pretty obvious move to me. The Whigs have always had trouble finessing this issue.
2e9e0aaaf79616ea90522024195527562fd721cc.zh: 我觉得这么做显而易见。辉格党一直很难巧妙地处理这个问题。

a311dfa11a0dc0ac7155f956ac04b237d9476840.source: That solution is so obvious that it's a shame it hasn't been implemented yet. Without a market for drugs in the United States, there would be no cartels.
a311dfa11a0dc0ac7155f956ac04b237d9476840.zh: 这个解决办法显而易见，却还没有实施，实在可惜。如果美国没有毒品市场，也就不会有贩毒集团。

5e1ae12e52dc421926f7b07e26716088083e00de.source: That was a good, honest response. Unfortunately, you'd better be prepared to lose some votes in Arizona and Nevada.
5e1ae12e52dc421926f7b07e26716088083e00de.zh: 这回答不错，也诚实。遗憾的是，你最好准备好在亚利桑那州和内华达州损失一些选票。

2a98302d9ff905760c4b08a25f9ec6a92714d668.source: That was a very tough event for many of us to take, no matter what our backgrounds were. I believe that more precautions should have been taken to keep things from getting out of hand, but we must also remember that most Negroes wanted no part of these riots.
2a98302d9ff905760c4b08a25f9ec6a92714d668.zh: 无论出身如何，那件事都让我们许多人难以承受。我认为本应采取更多预防措施，避免局面失控，但我们也必须记住，大多数黑人并不想参与这些骚乱。

03a4662fbf5b81884909716a548e01bfaef0e52a.source: That's not the best solution for us to take. The last thing we need right now in the financial sector is some kind of arbitrary, destabilizing government action.
03a4662fbf5b81884909716a548e01bfaef0e52a.zh: 这不是最好的解决办法。金融业眼下最不需要的，就是政府采取某种武断、破坏稳定的行动。

95e00a75f40ca5bd0d772f0e7275580e69e10ba0.zh: 那太荒唐了。当然不支持。

3695ff1c950db624124bfa5f246a6e5d7d93b6bf.source: The 17th Amendment is broadly popular among most voters, and it is best to support it.
3695ff1c950db624124bfa5f246a6e5d7d93b6bf.zh: 第十七修正案在大多数选民中广受欢迎，支持它才是上策。

9c28413810c2a1ba5e2e92fb9ccaed1b85308612.zh: 1948 年民主党大会（新闻短片）

a3f96b57e08109f62d3887fa7116901bdb8b1276.zh: 1948 年共和党大会（新闻短片）

0f65a8ab43483710c8ee3daf187ed6f268893a7a.source: The 1948 election begins with President Truman trailing badly in the polls. Thomas Dewey, loser in 1944, is widely expected to redeem himself this time around. Truman not only has to deal with Dewey, a moderate Republican, but also with two splinter candidates. Henry Wallace is a far-left candidate with the Progressive Party, while Strom Thurmond runs as a Dixiecrat. Some hot issues are the Soviet Union, civil rights, the "Do-Nothing" Congress, and the Taft-Hartley Act.
0f65a8ab43483710c8ee3daf187ed6f268893a7a.zh: 1948年选举开始时，杜鲁门总统在民调中大幅落后。1944年败选的托马斯·杜威被普遍看好，有望在本届一雪前耻。杜鲁门不仅要应对温和派共和党人杜威，还要面对两位分裂民主党票源的候选人：亨利·华莱士代表进步党参选，立场极左；斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德则以迪克西民主党人的身份参选。苏联、民权、“无所作为”的国会，以及《塔夫脱—哈特利法案》，都是热点议题。

7f2d4eab7786507bb17c098c67565d9c4588cefb.source: The 1964 Campaign is drawing to a close, and chances don’t look good for Goldwater’s success. Are there any last minute statements you’d like to make to win voters over?
7f2d4eab7786507bb17c098c67565d9c4588cefb.zh: 1964年竞选即将结束，戈德华特获胜的前景并不乐观。你想在最后关头发表什么声明，争取选民吗？

986ffb746aa8020e2b6ca64629ed4b2fd01f333e.source: The 1968 election enters its final stretch in chaos. Riots are a frequent occurrence as the Vietnam War divides the nation, and Johnson's "Great Society" is under full attack.
986ffb746aa8020e2b6ca64629ed4b2fd01f333e.zh: 1968年总统选举在混乱中进入最后阶段。越南战争使国家分裂，骚乱频频发生，约翰逊的“伟大社会”计划也受到全面攻击。

ef24dfdd41adb97874cda7e137d11be1c175e488.source: The 42nd president of the United States and your husband, Bill Clinton has had a... troubled relationship with you, but separation was never an option for you two; not considering who you both are.  Some of your advisors are urging you to bring Bill closer and make him a more instrumental part of the campaign. Willy's slickness could be of use.
ef24dfdd41adb97874cda7e137d11be1c175e488.zh: 美国第42任总统比尔·克林顿是你的丈夫，你们的关系曾经……波折不断。但考虑到你们各自的身份，分开从来不是一个选项。一些顾问敦促你拉近与比尔的距离，让他在竞选中发挥更重要的作用。“滑头威利”的圆滑本事，或许能派上用场。

5445ba8f67f030a31909c29502f2cd1ac5516096.source: The ACLU may be popular on some northeastern college campuses, but in most of the U.S. this association should be a millstone. We will obviously highlight it.
5445ba8f67f030a31909c29502f2cd1ac5516096.zh: 美国公民自由联盟也许在东北部某些大学校园里很受欢迎，但在美国大多数地方，与它有联系应当是个沉重包袱。我们当然会突出这一点。

b851d833721be55da5b4a11bc4312cf40baf5d04.source: The AFL-CIO is a centerpiece of the great American bargain. Our economy can never thrive unless the people who work to keep it going thrive as well. I fully support the AFL-CIO.
b851d833721be55da5b4a11bc4312cf40baf5d04.zh: 劳联—产联是美国社会重大利益协调安排的核心。维持经济运转的劳动者如果不能过上好日子，经济就不可能繁荣。我完全支持劳联—产联。

8541a4d4ef31d416dc31faf7b785829ab0f1f3bd.source: The AFL-CIO is one of your fiercest supporters and you’re slamming them? They’ve retracted their endorsement of you and union masses have swapped to Wallace.
8541a4d4ef31d416dc31faf7b785829ab0f1f3bd.zh: 劳联—产联是你最坚定的支持者之一，你却抨击他们？他们已经撤回对你的支持，大批工会成员转投华莱士。

a044f9f8da856f53d75ec4bb8f161fb46c5ceede.source: The Adamson Act has deeply alarmed the business wing of the party, and they are not excited to see you on board with it.
a044f9f8da856f53d75ec4bb8f161fb46c5ceede.zh: 《亚当森法》让党内商界派系深感不安，他们并不乐见你支持它。

8bbcca75e5b9fad6da58c2707f482c7408ba0e70.source: The Affordable Care Act (i.e. 'Obamacare') will cap annual premiums, require minimum coverage levels, and outlaw discrimination against people with pre-existing conditions. What do you think?
8bbcca75e5b9fad6da58c2707f482c7408ba0e70.zh: 《平价医疗法案》，即“奥巴马医改”，将限制年度保费、要求最低保障水平，并禁止歧视已有疾病的人。你怎么看？

1bf5382a4f7b08b5c8251076174c306154f696ec.source: The American Federation of Labour and Congress of Industrial Organizations is the largest federation of trade unions in the United States.
1bf5382a4f7b08b5c8251076174c306154f696ec.zh: 美国劳工联合会—产业工会联合会，是美国最大的工会联合组织。

d54bb700e576026e59e2785137651c5c8e4b301d.source: The American people are sick and tired of hearing about Clinton's emails.
d54bb700e576026e59e2785137651c5c8e4b301d.zh: 美国人民已经听够了克林顿的电子邮件，烦透了。

772d3fccfd7a3e7db250a5739a97f6d263ffaf91.source: The American people deserve to hear the truth. I support this strategy.
772d3fccfd7a3e7db250a5739a97f6d263ffaf91.zh: 美国人民有权听到真相。我支持这个策略。

858ac2b9eda2c156ce0f8db7a8a6370e3f71bc0c.source: The American people disapprove of the war, but they also don’t want communism spreading across Southeast Asia.
858ac2b9eda2c156ce0f8db7a8a6370e3f71bc0c.zh: 美国人民反对这场战争，但也不想让共产主义在东南亚扩散。

e1852de8a57a7b8ba5e96f58b2ac1ffb08bfef9d.source: The American public is tired of the war in Afghanistan, but military advisors warn that extricating the U.S. presence there may not be so easy.
e1852de8a57a7b8ba5e96f58b2ac1ffb08bfef9d.zh: 美国公众已厌倦阿富汗战争，但军事顾问警告，想摆脱美国在当地的驻军和介入，可能没那么容易。

0eedb8ad80d88f27cff9d8e223d9f804e125c114.source: The American public will never know what might have transpired with you in the Oval Office. As it is, you are sure to enjoy a long retirement after this one...
0eedb8ad80d88f27cff9d8e223d9f804e125c114.zh: 美国公众永远不会知道你在椭圆形办公室里可能发生了什么。事实上，在这之后你一定会享受漫长的退休生活......

bd37bba4fb258f2f914a524b82b0c4fa01c07d0b.source: The Audacity of Hope: Thoughts on Reclaiming the American Dream (Vintage)
bd37bba4fb258f2f914a524b82b0c4fa01c07d0b.zh: 无畏的希望：关于重拾美国梦的思考（复古）

102f621e72956f719f0622c4825159f0f80a47e4.source: The Benghazi allegations seem worn out at this point.
102f621e72956f719f0622c4825159f0f80a47e4.zh: 到了这个时候，班加西指控似乎已经说滥了。

279fae77704a9c564f2a571754203a3f20abdbe4.source: The Berlin Airlift is dominating the headlines and building positive sentiment for Truman. But that's the way things go...
279fae77704a9c564f2a571754203a3f20abdbe4.zh: 柏林空运占据新闻头条，给杜鲁门带来了良好的舆论。不过，事情就是这样……

547ad1ff7d75531af6b732b52eb0db3a1d3c9ab6.source: The Berlin Airlift, as it is called, is making headlines in the United States and is definitely helping to restore your popularity.
547ad1ff7d75531af6b732b52eb0db3a1d3c9ab6.zh: 这场被称为“柏林空运”的行动，在美国登上了新闻头条，确实有助于恢复你的民望。

f5ac48f3901ece9dee4c5784210da750e9e16436.source: The Black Panthers are a radical group of militants who are plotting the overthrow of the United States government. It is my firm position, in accordance with the Constitution, that anyone planning treason against our country should be imprisoned and possibly executed.
f5ac48f3901ece9dee4c5784210da750e9e16436.zh: 黑豹党是一群激进的武装分子，正密谋推翻美国政府。我的立场非常明确：依据宪法，任何策划叛国的人都应被监禁，甚至可能被处死。

460726749f3d1d462d038b542d1785679a124dfc.source: The Bush campaign continues to use dishonest language to scare the American people. I'm a pragmatist and a moderate Democrat. Bush is the real extremist in this race.
460726749f3d1d462d038b542d1785679a124dfc.zh: 布什阵营不断用不诚实的说辞恐吓美国人民。我是务实派，也是温和派民主党人。这场选举中真正的极端分子是布什。

cb5586bbd8c28561e970168c1d7a1a71bef65f5f.source: The Bush campaign has repeatedly called you a “liberal” or “the liberal Governor”, and so on. Do you embrace the label of “liberal”?
cb5586bbd8c28561e970168c1d7a1a71bef65f5f.zh: 布什阵营反复称你为“自由派”“自由派州长”等。你接受“自由派”这个标签吗？

a62830ec78a606fa0806d2fc6107aeace0f3c41b.source: The Bush campaign is attacking the Massachusetts prison furlough program, which included furloughs for convicted murderers. One such person, Willie Horton, killed again in Maryland. What is your response?
a62830ec78a606fa0806d2fc6107aeace0f3c41b.zh: 布什阵营正在攻击马萨诸塞州的离监休假制度，连已定罪的杀人犯也能获准离监。其中一人威利·霍顿在马里兰州再次杀人。你将如何回应？

8b3f5b225d2a01c9a6ba1e29f9eea8a659a4531e.source: The Bush campaign is attacking your opposition to the invasion of Grenada, and bombing of Libya. What is your response?
8b3f5b225d2a01c9a6ba1e29f9eea8a659a4531e.zh: 布什阵营正在攻击你反对入侵格林纳达和轰炸利比亚的立场。你如何回应？

0088b961c18037c9522514d8977af5fa872b9d6e.source: The Bush campaign is highlighting the pollution in Boston Harbor to counter your claims of a Massachusetts Miracle. How will you respond?
0088b961c18037c9522514d8977af5fa872b9d6e.zh: 布什阵营正以波士顿港的污染问题，反驳你所宣称的“马萨诸塞奇迹”。你会怎样回应？

50a0c285e94c637c48eedc0fe101b4ec35521ccb.source: The Christian right is livid. Already they are talking about fielding a splinter candidate or staying home this fall.
50a0c285e94c637c48eedc0fe101b4ec35521ccb.zh: 基督教右翼怒不可遏。他们已经在议论，是另推候选人，还是今年秋天干脆不投票。

c61e3e2efd342ca01a460fa73a1bae7061b5fb19.source: The Clinton Administration has added 23 million jobs to the American economy and unleashed an unprecedented wave of prosperity and innovation. I will continue his policies as President so that all Americans can prosper in the coming years.
c61e3e2efd342ca01a460fa73a1bae7061b5fb19.zh: 克林顿政府为美国经济新增了2300万个就业岗位，带来了前所未有的繁荣与创新浪潮。作为总统，我会延续他的政策，让所有美国人在未来几年都能繁荣发展。

d8112ea1a13e8f6678cb542708c81ee513b055cd.source: The Clintons are always good for plenty of tabloid fodder, as are you.
d8112ea1a13e8f6678cb542708c81ee513b055cd.zh: 克林顿夫妇总能为小报提供大量谈资，你也是如此。

5ee584acffbad5d34bce6004c787aee2ebf41af9.source: The Clintons have added a greatly to the political life of the United States. I support Hillary Clinton in her campaign.
5ee584acffbad5d34bce6004c787aee2ebf41af9.zh: 克林顿夫妇为美国的政治生活作出了很大贡献。我支持希拉里·克林顿的竞选。

58235c59cec986d7cb0f4bc3a54f03d9607debca.source: The Club For Growth is a conservative PAC that supports open markets.
58235c59cec986d7cb0f4bc3a54f03d9607debca.zh: 增长俱乐部是支持开放市场的保守派政治行动委员会。

78783b4c02b3c4387d6acaca078943cf311162aa.source: The Cold War is over. We should cut defense spending and stop operating so many bases overseas. I would pull troops out of places like Germany and Okinawa, where we are no longer defending anything.
78783b4c02b3c4387d6acaca078943cf311162aa.zh: 冷战已经结束。我们应当削减国防开支，不要再在海外运营那么多基地。我会从德国和冲绳等地撤军，在这些地方，我们已经没有什么需要防卫的了。

d7bc20be344f1acf6abd880cbf41d60e4cb4db9c.source: The Confederate Flag is a symbol of slavery, racism, and rebellion against the United States. It's abominable that in 2012, any state could consider flying such a symbol.
d7bc20be344f1acf6abd880cbf41d60e4cb4db9c.zh: 邦联旗帜象征奴隶制、种族主义和对美国的叛乱。到了2012年，竟然还有州考虑悬挂这样的象征，实在令人憎恶。

a79f10eecf0275da38fbfdd5fcbc9a7ddb3be625.source: The Confederate Flag is a symbol of southern heritage and history. I don't see a problem.
a79f10eecf0275da38fbfdd5fcbc9a7ddb3be625.zh: 邦联旗帜象征南方的传统和历史。我看不出有什么问题。

21da72e8360334acbc14be62593c16efed1dfc4c.source: The Constitutional Unionists are not your biggest issue in this campaign.
21da72e8360334acbc14be62593c16efed1dfc4c.zh: 宪法联邦党人不是你这次竞选中最需要担心的对手。

cf8da26f0eeb54f05d4769786dc97bb897b75844.source: The Court has had nine justices since 1869, and any attempt to change that is sure to destroy the Court's legitimacy even further. We must look at other kinds of reform.
cf8da26f0eeb54f05d4769786dc97bb897b75844.zh: 法院自1869年以来一直有九名大法官，任何改变人数的企图，肯定都会进一步摧毁它的正当性。我们必须考虑其他形式的改革。

a8178042a7f07552e509cd1fcede5657c136d35b.source: The Cuban community in Florida is livid at your response. You
a8178042a7f07552e509cd1fcede5657c136d35b.zh: 佛罗里达州 的古巴社区对你的回应感到愤怒。你

bdf125c187441a3191dd65bc814ea5d0678c695f.source: The Deep South has been Goldwater's stronghold this whole election, but they're Democrats at heart. We'll swing through Mississippi, Alabama, and Georgia to wrap this up.
bdf125c187441a3191dd65bc814ea5d0678c695f.zh: 整个选举期间，深南部一直是戈德华特的堡垒，但那里的人骨子里还是民主党人。我们到密西西比州、阿拉巴马州和佐治亚州转一圈，结束竞选。

601d04923fd7922c60dd9d802dc222689790e071.source: The Democrat-Republican rivalry is alive and well, regardless of your encouragement or lack thereof.
601d04923fd7922c60dd9d802dc222689790e071.zh: 无论你是否鼓励，民主党与共和党之间的竞争依然激烈。

e783df4b7f3e8f7faa0b279e6619c3a549898303.source: The Democratic Convention erupted into spontaneous cries of “He kept us out of war!” as you were nominated. Do you plan to campaign on this position, or will you add some nuance to it?
e783df4b7f3e8f7faa0b279e6619c3a549898303.zh: 你获得提名时，民主党大会上的代表自发高呼：“他让我们免于战争！”你打算以此为竞选主张，还是给这个说法加上更审慎的说明？

2782717f7b22aaa2e0b0f71ada63f65dca9d2c4f.source: The Democratic Party is a friend of the working-class, and of immigrants from abroad. We denounce the vile bigotry of the Whig Party, as evidenced by Frelinghuysen.
2782717f7b22aaa2e0b0f71ada63f65dca9d2c4f.zh: 民主党是工人阶级和外国移民的朋友。弗里林海森的表现，就是辉格党卑劣偏见的明证，我们对此予以谴责。

ce7bc76f985b981d0eec08e80de603bbfd1c58de.source: The Democratic Party is pretty-well united in support of this law.
ce7bc76f985b981d0eec08e80de603bbfd1c58de.zh: 民主党上下基本一致支持这项法律。

229ac3a8ef3a08ec9ca86a61e0fd1689ef6c63b9.source: The Democratic Party still wins a lot of its support from immigrants, leaving aside the current environment of full-on Americanism.
229ac3a8ef3a08ec9ca86a61e0fd1689ef6c63b9.zh: 即便如今强调唯有“美国人”身份的民族主义情绪高涨，民主党的支持仍有很大一部分来自移民。

8bf5fd06a61be8851580de60daf49471a8055e98.source: The Democratic base is happy, but this definitely puts you on the liberal end of the debate.
8bf5fd06a61be8851580de60daf49471a8055e98.zh: 民主党基本盘很高兴，但这无疑把你放在了这场争论的自由派一端。

9bbd29c9bddf9dfa77481c27543216e057180d8b.source: The Democratic base is solidly against tariffs, but keep in mind the fact that the crucial Midwestern states have a more nuanced view.
9bbd29c9bddf9dfa77481c27543216e057180d8b.zh: 民主党的基本盘坚决反对关税，但别忘了，关键的中西部各州，对这个问题的看法更复杂。

46ed8b3fef42f161317c1f5ce92b3aa75656c55e.source: The Democratic base wants something more assertive on the environment.
46ed8b3fef42f161317c1f5ce92b3aa75656c55e.zh: 民主党基本盘希望你在环境问题上更坚决一些。

45703759666013f2dba556576eb203517d9d4083.source: The Democratic idea has been that if you legislate to make the masses prosperous, their prosperity will find its way up through every class which rests upon them. We need to help our farmers and our workers by allowing the coinage of silver.
45703759666013f2dba556576eb203517d9d4083.zh: 民主党的理念是：如果通过立法让广大民众富裕起来，他们的富足就会向上传递，惠及一切依赖他们的阶层。我们需要准许白银铸币，帮助农民和工人。

2274bcdc040854bd2064615a13b5ec0ce2e50b24.source: The Democratic idea? You are a Republican.
2274bcdc040854bd2064615a13b5ec0ce2e50b24.zh: 民主党的理念？你可是共和党人。

66ad386424f4577b3325bf7836f3388fcf3829c0.source: The Democratic machines, already skeptical of you, find no reassurance in your silence on the Irish question.
66ad386424f4577b3325bf7836f3388fcf3829c0.zh: 民主党的政治机器本就对你持怀疑态度，你在爱尔兰问题上的沉默，未能打消他们的疑虑。

773c142150062b8fbeff2cb3af809bad1bb71b2c.source: The Democrats are in favor of our current naturalization laws. That is my position and I stand by it.
773c142150062b8fbeff2cb3af809bad1bb71b2c.zh: 民主党支持现行入籍法。这就是我的立场，我会坚持。

7b5bec1486edebc34e2a79c5bb5f938f36c496f5.source: The Democrats are running on a surrender platform. Surrender to COVID, surrender to illegal immigrants, surrender to China, Iran, and Palestine. These aren't people who love America, folks, believe me.
7b5bec1486edebc34e2a79c5bb5f938f36c496f5.zh: 民主党的政纲，就是投降。向新冠投降，向非法移民投降，向中国、伊朗和巴勒斯坦投降。各位，相信我，这些人不爱美国。

7c8659e9ebfe6c6c62291171e2daff91fba45d1b.source: The Democrats are too anti-war, in large part, to support this view.
7c8659e9ebfe6c6c62291171e2daff91fba45d1b.zh: 民主党人总体上的反战倾向太强，无法支持这个看法。

a4f11a27bf1db8bf304c39b8c58dc518d3723311.source: The Democrats have always been the party of states' rights. I was a little surprised to see Cleveland intervene in this case.
a4f11a27bf1db8bf304c39b8c58dc518d3723311.zh: 民主党一向主张州权。我有点惊讶，克利夫兰竟然会在这件事上介入。

7bf02777216ab07c72306729c7743825f4b8bb62.source: The Democrats have an advantage in the House of Representatives, so you are probably in bad shape. However, a lot depends on how Kennedy deals with Harry Byrd. It's possible that some kind of deal will need to be struck for any candidate to get a clean majority in the House.
7bf02777216ab07c72306729c7743825f4b8bb62.zh: 民主党在众议院有优势，所以你的处境可能很糟糕。然而，很大程度上取决于肯尼迪如何处理哈里·伯德。任何候选人都可能需要达成某种协议才能在众议院获得绝对多数席位。

8eaaec7b9eec51eb729fbd0fd538e8b6c20c4456.source: The Democrats have an advantage in the House of Representatives, so you are probably in good shape. However, a lot depends on how you deal with Harry Byrd. It's possible that some kind of deal will need to be struck with Byrd or Nixon to get a clean majority in the House.
8eaaec7b9eec51eb729fbd0fd538e8b6c20c4456.zh: 民主党在众议院有优势，所以你的状况可能不错。然而，很大程度上取决于你如何处理哈里·伯德。可能需要与 伯德 或 尼克松 达成某种协议才能在众议院获得绝对多数。

c3a1d4497156b13a9c51575c50d437f5d3e7f1c2.source: The Democrats have spent years trying to erase the stigma that they are soft on defense. This won't help.
c3a1d4497156b13a9c51575c50d437f5d3e7f1c2.zh: 民主党花了多年时间，试图洗掉在国防上软弱的污名。这可帮不上忙。

24a93f2d72be4e9f575475d2c545fbee477f465c.source: The Democrats, with their huge majorities, have passed bill after bill outside of the American mainstream. I've been left with little choice.
24a93f2d72be4e9f575475d2c545fbee477f465c.zh: 民主党凭借庞大的多数，一部接一部通过偏离美国主流的法案。我几乎别无选择。

8a5b4cccbcac3a810f40907a56e7ac18b43440d0.source: The Department of Agriculture uses subsidies to rationally manage food production. It would be foolish to reverse that policy.
8a5b4cccbcac3a810f40907a56e7ac18b43440d0.zh: 农业部通过补贴合理调节粮食生产。推翻这项政策是愚蠢的。

0547f9ec15b770aa4844fcde239834b2376f2649.source: The Department of Homeland Security is deporting hundreds of thousands of illegal immigrants each year. How can anyone suggest that we're not trying to address this issue?
0547f9ec15b770aa4844fcde239834b2376f2649.zh: 国土安全部每年驱逐数十万非法移民。怎么会有人说我们不努力解决这个问题呢？

553b703b5302b01bc5f5bea178e1953bf2799dd9.source: The Donald seems to be specializing in gutter politics this year.
553b703b5302b01bc5f5bea178e1953bf2799dd9.zh: “那位唐纳德”今年似乎专攻低俗的政治攻击。

6adb7dfdfc272a109fb6011f7592194145dd91e8.source: The East Coast -- from Maryland and Pennsylvania to New York and Connecticut.
6adb7dfdfc272a109fb6011f7592194145dd91e8.zh: 东海岸——从马里兰州、宾夕法尼亚州，到纽约州、康涅狄格州。

c24764c05aaea9f995d5f2af9a8b8c33e982aa75.source: The Eisenhower Administration has unfortunately failed to take any real action in undoing the excesses of the New Deal. I would like to see a more conservative Administration in power.
c24764c05aaea9f995d5f2af9a8b8c33e982aa75.zh: 遗憾的是，艾森豪威尔政府没有采取任何实质行动，纠正新政的过度举措。我希望看到一个更加保守的政府执政。

3ef90190e3bd5b94772c256de8f17c0c53d2e4bd.source: The Election of 1976 and the Administration of Jimmy Carter
3ef90190e3bd5b94772c256de8f17c0c53d2e4bd.zh: 1976 年选举和 吉米·卡特 政府

e540c176b2da2a02b2b51ae484d4220ef357e0d7.source: The Elian issue is simple -- a small, politically active minority in Florida wants him to remain. There is also the issue of supporting or opposing Bill Clinton to consider.
e540c176b2da2a02b2b51ae484d4220ef357e0d7.zh: 埃利安问题很简单——佛罗里达州一个人数不多、政治上却很活跃的群体希望他留下。此外，还需要考虑支持还是反对比尔·克林顿。

921e102a596a6e19d7854c690399303f0f4d1f75.source: The Euro is destined to fail. I can hardly blame Germany for losing patience with its less fiscally scrupulous neighbors.
921e102a596a6e19d7854c690399303f0f4d1f75.zh: 欧元注定失败。我很难责怪德国对那些在财政上不够谨慎的邻国失去耐心。

5bae43a8398b8ac149233bc75a020b7fbafc8266.source: The European Union has been a complete disaster, and I can't blame any country, especially the United Kingdom, that would want out.
5bae43a8398b8ac149233bc75a020b7fbafc8266.zh: 欧盟完全是一场灾难，我不能责怪任何想要退出的国家，尤其是英国。

7adb905546c87322e5291309c2adc6abe0cb86a9.source: The FBI director has handed down a severe criticism of Clinton's email practices while Secretary of State, though he declined to recommend any indictments. Do you have any comment?
7adb905546c87322e5291309c2adc6abe0cb86a9.zh: 联邦调查局局长严厉批评了克林顿担任国务卿期间使用电子邮件的做法，但没有建议提起任何刑事指控。你有什么评论？

631ca27c2449bd9534bb40912cd492850f95c602.source: The FBI director, James Comey, has handed down a severe criticism of your email practices while Secretary of State, though he declined to recommend any indictments. Do you have any comment?
631ca27c2449bd9534bb40912cd492850f95c602.zh: 联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米严厉批评了你担任国务卿期间使用电子邮件的做法，但没有建议提起任何刑事指控。你有什么评论？

864d53e7f40840dad0dab509bbba4c450910268a.source: The FBI has recommended the indictment of several of Hillary Clinton's aides, based on classified intelligence which they obtained from secure facilities and emailed to her. Do you have any comment?
864d53e7f40840dad0dab509bbba4c450910268a.zh: 联邦调查局建议起诉希拉里·克林顿的几名助手，因为他们从安全设施取得机密情报，再用电子邮件发给她。你有何评论？

38c00074299cf9bcfd174bf4635d92ce935af489.source: The FBI has recommended the indictment of several of your aides, based on classified intelligence which they obtained from secure facilities and emailed to you. Do you have any comment?
38c00074299cf9bcfd174bf4635d92ce935af489.zh: 联邦调查局建议起诉你的几名助手，因为他们从安全设施取得机密情报，再用电子邮件发给你。你有何评论？

1e98673d8e0f4f2445ed255bcb7caa2562d0be66.source: The FBI really covered for Crooked Hillary on this one. We will be asking, "Where's the indictment?" every day in my speeches, and on social media.
1e98673d8e0f4f2445ed255bcb7caa2562d0be66.zh: 联邦调查局这回真是包庇了“骗子希拉里”。我会每天在演说和社交媒体上追问：“起诉书在哪里？”

60664ddf399b1de4cf019a1648a69861940bbde2.source: The Federal Reserve idea is worthy of support, but I would prefer that private banks were given a larger role in its operation.
60664ddf399b1de4cf019a1648a69861940bbde2.zh: 联邦储备制度的构想值得支持，但我希望让私人银行在其运作中发挥更大作用。

d7c11b68fc4c282ad726da3cca08e80aa95192a2.source: The Federal Trade Commission is a necessary step forward for reform in this country.
d7c11b68fc4c282ad726da3cca08e80aa95192a2.zh: 建立联邦贸易委员会，是我国改革中必要的一步。

46df528af9f60c6e07180524cb1dcf7329ed6261.source: The First Battle: A story of the campaign of 1896
46df528af9f60c6e07180524cb1dcf7329ed6261.zh: 第一次战役：1896 年战役的故事

48bb908402bda50a0c88fd301b3bd3fea7cacf72.zh: 佛罗里达州 重新计票/2000 年选举

6e606c1e7f72a174aa5ecceaf3846331e8904ea4.source: The G.O.P.'s Journey From the Liberal Days of Nixon
6e606c1e7f72a174aa5ecceaf3846331e8904ea4.zh: 共和党从 尼克松 自由时代开始的旅程

2c082a9c0d7fb98d627deb5de47a7bc38dbb52a3.source: The Governor of California can barely be called a Republican. We will coordinate our itinerary with the established party apparatus on our visit.
2c082a9c0d7fb98d627deb5de47a7bc38dbb52a3.zh: 加利福尼亚州州长简直算不上共和党人。访问期间，我们会与现有的党组织协调行程。

78d9568bf57d14b69db4adda3eaefdfc541eaf92.source: The Great Financial Crisis: Causes and Consequences

8d389a5e4242f3c0148ea4f14a82af4b8b47fa08.zh: 伟大的 共和党 口角 -- 1916 年

5002063dc922763e45a8faf021440ca7f70ad5b1.source: The Great Society is founded upon the best of intentions, but we cannot afford this growth in spending on wasteful programs throughout our government.
5002063dc922763e45a8faf021440ca7f70ad5b1.zh: 伟大社会的出发点再好，我们也承担不起政府在浪费性项目上不断增加的支出。

55ad2ac8343815fcec5c6c672fea0f71c73f0bf2.source: The HUAC is a necessary defender of American values, and I don't see anything to criticize in its current conduct.
55ad2ac8343815fcec5c6c672fea0f71c73f0bf2.zh: 非美活动调查委员会是捍卫美国价值观的必要力量，我看不出它当前的行动有什么可批评的。

55167e1373592fcea1d667f5cd751bd1f94f6381.source: The HUAC is not something I plan to address very much as I campaign.
55167e1373592fcea1d667f5cd751bd1f94f6381.zh: 我不打算在竞选中多谈非美活动调查委员会。

b5035dfc065b17e7e172d58220e6e9b0c5e8059f.zh: 快乐斗士，就是我们的选择！

d09a03dbe60f06c5365fddd91ca3ba6299afd996.source: The Head Start program is another product of the out-of-touch, intellectual elite. It's a waste of money.
d09a03dbe60f06c5365fddd91ca3ba6299afd996.zh: 启蒙计划又是脱离现实的知识精英搞出来的东西，纯粹是在浪费钱。

162f481597acbdb91b6313cea43b310f289416ee.source: The Iraq invasion and Clinton's vote is a bit of a weak spot... if you can focus attention to it.
162f481597acbdb91b6313cea43b310f289416ee.zh: 伊拉克入侵和克林顿的投票，算是个弱点，前提是你能把大家的注意力引到那里。

9690ebc4f0cc6aeae6015097ada6bad8c56c38dd.source: The Irish uprising is a domestic issue of Great Britain and should not be the concern of any patriotic American.
9690ebc4f0cc6aeae6015097ada6bad8c56c38dd.zh: 爱尔兰起义是英国的内政，任何爱国的美国人都不该过问。

2a23c3f6ab28030768538bacbc4be7cbc0973446.source: The Irish vote in the North has gone heavily in your favor recently. It's a good idea to keep it that way.
2a23c3f6ab28030768538bacbc4be7cbc0973446.zh: 最近，北方爱尔兰选民的选票明显倾向于你。设法保持这个势头，是个好主意。

7c753ac2ac16bf520c12f56cbaf45d96a12ef1dd.source: The Irish vote will be a huge part of your support in this election. You need to keep them energized.
7c753ac2ac16bf520c12f56cbaf45d96a12ef1dd.zh: 在这次大选中，爱尔兰选民将成为你支持基础中的重要部分。你必须保持他们的热情。

0d4e8d6e2f96e4bda23a8da162ede054a1362194.source: The Jewish state of Israel is set to declare its independence on May 15, 1948. Do you support Truman's decision to recognize this new nation?
0d4e8d6e2f96e4bda23a8da162ede054a1362194.zh: 犹太国家以色列准备在1948年5月15日宣布独立。你支持杜鲁门承认这个新国家的决定吗？

e61e6f573192557a0524db82070e452a5033617d.source: The Jewish state of Israel is set to declare its independence on May 15, 1948. Will your Administration recognize this new nation?
e61e6f573192557a0524db82070e452a5033617d.zh: 犹太国家以色列准备在1948年5月15日宣布独立。你的政府会承认这个新国家吗？

70183aee633f43abeb57ec46de87d115144a2314.source: The Johnson Administration has done a lot of good things for this country. I will continue his policies as President.
70183aee633f43abeb57ec46de87d115144a2314.zh: 约翰逊政府为这个国家做了许多好事。担任总统后，我会延续他的政策。

a148f074bbde9b0a3c0547fa7b0256dff6fdc449.source: The Keating-Owen Act has passed and provides federal protections against the use of child labor.
a148f074bbde9b0a3c0547fa7b0256dff6fdc449.zh: 《基廷—欧文法》已经通过，联邦层面开始提供限制使用童工的法律保护。

fb976c2fc6b18a42f0fc76050a3d31e69e7eccc2.source: The Klan’s endorsement is bad enough for your reputation. Your silence on it is worse.
fb976c2fc6b18a42f0fc76050a3d31e69e7eccc2.zh: 三K党的背书，已经够损害你的名声了。你对此保持沉默，更加糟糕。

8f9e600771b18cf2a9ba72852ab7d933d8831d74.source: The Kyoto Protocol would commit the United States (along with many other countries) to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Would you support this plan as President?
8f9e600771b18cf2a9ba72852ab7d933d8831d74.zh: 《京都议定书》将要求美国和许多其他国家减少温室气体排放。作为总统，你会支持这项计划吗？

228266832bd527b5eb0929d896b4b24d9c112beb.source: The League of Nations idea is viewed with suspicion by many conservatives, and anti-war progressives alike.
228266832bd527b5eb0929d896b4b24d9c112beb.zh: 许多保守派和反战的进步派，都对建立国际联盟的构想抱有疑虑。

d144365b3269d5bd5b491145be73c2b2ecbf1d65.source: The Liberty Party lurks as an abolitionist third party, and will pressure the Whigs. Conversely, John Tyler hopes to use the Texas issue to energize an independent campaign, if Polk wavers. Other campaign issues are tariffs, internal improvements, and the banking system.
d144365b3269d5bd5b491145be73c2b2ecbf1d65.zh: 自由党作为废奴主义第三党伺机而动，将给辉格党施加压力。另一方面，如果波尔克动摇，约翰·泰勒希望利用得克萨斯问题，为独立参选动员支持。关税、国内公共工程建设和银行体系，也是本届竞选的议题。

4cb06ab0ce62caf95c079b503ca700c8ffcd35ae.source: The Making of the President 1960 (video documentary, 1963)
4cb06ab0ce62caf95c079b503ca700c8ffcd35ae.zh: 1960 年总统的制作（视频纪录片，1963 年）

c78e78ad29e2ec8f54c7595204cf9d4112a2a7bc.source: The Making of the President 1968 (Landmark Political)
c78e78ad29e2ec8f54c7595204cf9d4112a2a7bc.zh: 1968 年总统的诞生（具有里程碑意义的政治）

b2ad33a870de02c74c65324604ff58e9682bd07b.source: The Marshall Plan is a waste of resources, and will slow the development of Europe by forcing nations to rely on foreign subsidies, rather than rebuilding their own economies.
b2ad33a870de02c74c65324604ff58e9682bd07b.zh: 马歇尔计划是浪费资源。它迫使各国依赖外国补助，而不是重建自身经济，将拖慢欧洲的发展。

2ef22ceef432e4a77d72b38bf8383d95a016445b.source: The Marshall Plan is one measure of Truman and George Marshall that has broad support.
2ef22ceef432e4a77d72b38bf8383d95a016445b.zh: 马歇尔计划是杜鲁门与乔治·马歇尔提出的一项广受支持的措施。

e50b84ec4e08b6290dc9860fb4b0d78df0c5838f.source: The Marshall Plan is provocative towards the Soviet Union, and is likely to lead to further aggression and escalation from them.
e50b84ec4e08b6290dc9860fb4b0d78df0c5838f.zh: 马歇尔计划是在挑衅苏联，很可能引发他们进一步的侵略和事态升级。

938c3aa2e8da8ac8959e00acb21b6ebd9ef05f7b.zh: 理查德·尼克松 的回忆录

2bb120ea01682501a835e923027248b6505e9f17.source: The Midwest is critical to our success in this election, and we can't take any chances. Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio will be good hosts for our final few rallies.
2bb120ea01682501a835e923027248b6505e9f17.zh: 中西部对我们赢得这次选举至关重要，不能冒任何风险。最后几场集会，放在伊利诺伊州、印第安纳州和俄亥俄州很合适。

e68fea086bba516c2fde44794bc332dff46d480d.source: The Midwest is critical. We'll hit as many states as we can between Iowa and Ohio.
e68fea086bba516c2fde44794bc332dff46d480d.zh: 中西部至关重要。我们会尽可能跑遍艾奥瓦州至俄亥俄州之间的各州。

e104c31905b4feb90d3a5749415b1d317fa00e1b.source: The Midwest. Especially Illinois, Michigan, and Ohio.
e104c31905b4feb90d3a5749415b1d317fa00e1b.zh: 中西部，尤其是伊利诺伊州、密歇根州和俄亥俄州。

5ba9b651a5b480dbcdb51228d05065897b416cb6.source: The Mormon Church has been the guiding force of my life. It's only natural for me to discuss this influence in my campaign speeches.
5ba9b651a5b480dbcdb51228d05065897b416cb6.zh: 摩门教会一直指引着我的人生。我在竞选演说中谈论它的影响，再自然不过。

7e20582bc4bdc5fa9899b7d7bd7aeac2cbf8d282.source: The Navy is more than adequate to meet our current needs, and will remain so as long as imperialist Republicans avoid intervening in Cuba or Hawaii.
7e20582bc4bdc5fa9899b7d7bd7aeac2cbf8d282.zh: 海军完全足以应付当前需要。只要那些帝国主义共和党人不插手古巴或夏威夷，今后也会如此。

89568e0690cad599d121c46bd6f3d8bb7d42d93c.source: The Republican obstruction is a clear and obvious attempt to subvert democratic norms. We should all be very concerned about this move, and I will stand by the nomination of Merrick Garland when I am elected.
89568e0690cad599d121c46bd6f3d8bb7d42d93c.zh: 共和党的阻挠，显然是在企图破坏民主惯例。我们都应该高度警惕这种做法。我当选后，会坚持对梅里克·加兰的提名。

f9253b935c79574461eee944cdf85f94fc85ab24.source: The Republican playbook is very simple. Their actual policies hurt the economy, favor the rich, and drive up our nation's deficits. Since they can't win the economic debate honestly, they've created a vast, right-wing outrage machine to obfuscate their objectives.
f9253b935c79574461eee944cdf85f94fc85ab24.zh: 共和党的策略很简单。他们的实际政策伤害经济，偏袒富人，并推高国家赤字。既然无法在经济辩论中堂堂正正地获胜，他们就建立了一个庞大的右翼煽愤机器，来掩饰自己的目标。

17a8c5532ff517c4931ef0e6c7b453d11602d762.source: The Republican position in Congress is not supported by most of the public.
17a8c5532ff517c4931ef0e6c7b453d11602d762.zh: 国会共和党的立场，没有得到多数公众支持。

815cbda87c0ec5c2944daf1a1f616fa65548b347.source: The Republicans and Donald Trump want to pull us out of the Paris Accords, turn coal loose in the country, and take us back decades when it comes to environmental regulation. That won't happen when I am President.
815cbda87c0ec5c2944daf1a1f616fa65548b347.zh: 共和党和唐纳德·特朗普想让我们退出《巴黎协定》，在国内放任煤炭产业，并让环境监管倒退几十年。我当总统时，不会发生这种事。

d0cb60fa4e9a9cfbbace4446e63df5cf387bc441.source: The Republicans are grasping at straws with this inflation argument. They know that Kennedy and Johnson have managed the economy far better than Eisenhower, so they are resorting to the only argument they have left.
d0cb60fa4e9a9cfbbace4446e63df5cf387bc441.zh: 共和党人拿通胀说事，不过是在抓最后一根救命稻草。他们知道，肯尼迪和约翰逊管理经济的表现远胜于艾森豪威尔，只能诉诸仅剩的这一套说辞。

d7c831a70dbc6620c6f73e59d7a8791109dbf950.source: The Republicans are putting out a nice platform, but their own Congress has sandbagged half of these proposals in the past two years alone. I will call Congress into session and make them put their money where their mouth is.
d7c831a70dbc6620c6f73e59d7a8791109dbf950.zh: 共和党提出了一份漂亮的党纲，但光是过去两年，他们控制的国会就阻挠了其中一半的提案。我将召集国会开会，逼他们拿出实际行动，兑现承诺。

6175220f2b8db7ab4af334ea973e3e88ba37a28d.source: The Republicans can't beat us on the issues, like raising the minimum wage or making college more affordable. So instead their allies in the right-wing media use these non-stories and innuendo to defend the privilege of the 1%. There is nothing to see here.
6175220f2b8db7ab4af334ea973e3e88ba37a28d.zh: 共和党无法在提高最低工资、减轻大学费用负担这些议题上击败我们。所以，他们在右翼媒体中的盟友就拿这些根本不算新闻的事和影射来维护最富有的1%人群的特权。这里没什么可看的。

5deda600d14fba43078e4d16f02931d730b8c5a0.source: The Republicans did not nominate you so that you could go on the trail and talk about socializing the health care system.
5deda600d14fba43078e4d16f02931d730b8c5a0.zh: 共和党提名你，可不是为了让你在竞选途中宣扬医疗社会化。

1baa1db118cd6e9a20959b0e8157f823d3a6439c.source: The Republicans had no idea that were nominating an environmentalist.
1baa1db118cd6e9a20959b0e8157f823d3a6439c.zh: 共和党人根本没想到，自己提名的竟是个环保派。

8362068093763e1956de127b85a711eef12255fe.source: The Rockies have had some alarming polling numbers recently. We should roll through there and make sure they're still on our side, before making a final stop in California.
8362068093763e1956de127b85a711eef12255fe.zh: 最近，落基山地区的民调有些令人担忧。我们应到那里走一趟，确保他们仍站在我们这边，最后再停留加利福尼亚州。

7e59e79c250aa1f05abf53fdf722d4c8047cfcb8.source: The Russians gave her $2 million. The Saudis, the Arabs, they gave her a lot. Millions from the Bank of Switzerland and Deutsche Bank. It's all about the charity, right?
7e59e79c250aa1f05abf53fdf722d4c8047cfcb8.zh: 俄罗斯人给了她二百万美元。沙特人、阿拉伯人，给了她很多。瑞士银行和德意志银行也给了数百万。都是为了慈善，对吧？

38c4d832a4b39478c4083dae0f1060035d82c55d.source: The Second Amendment, people. I am a strong supporter of the Second Amendment.
38c4d832a4b39478c4083dae0f1060035d82c55d.zh: 各位，第二修正案。我坚定支持第二修正案。

cfac4c50850e98236ae317101ff3aad174624590.source: The Social Security program has unfunded liabilities of over $100 trillion. It's time for us to admit that the Social Security program is bankrupt before it drags the rest of the federal government down with it.
cfac4c50850e98236ae317101ff3aad174624590.zh: 社会保障计划尚无资金覆盖的负债超过100万亿美元。我们是时候承认它已经破产了，免得把整个联邦政府也拖垮。

20653e4c85d9591de7e8fe7b5bfe01d21d122d44.source: The Social Security system is a financial time bomb. We need to get rid of it, or at the very least cut its benefits significantly.
20653e4c85d9591de7e8fe7b5bfe01d21d122d44.zh: 社会保障制度是一颗财政定时炸弹。我们需要废除它，或者至少大幅削减它的福利。

3208736c38849bca95eb4bc1bf65823f89ab948b.source: The Southern Democrats are an easy target for attack. We can excite our core voters while risking little, if we denounce them.
3208736c38849bca95eb4bc1bf65823f89ab948b.zh: 南方民主党人很容易成为攻击目标。谴责他们，能激励我们的核心选民，而风险很小。

7990bc296337959b34c3dd2356d64c402d2d571e.source: The Soviet Union has blocked West Berlin from receiving any supplies from Western Europe. What are your thoughts on this situation?
7990bc296337959b34c3dd2356d64c402d2d571e.zh: 苏联封锁了西柏林，使其无法从西欧获得任何物资。你怎么看待这个局面？

9761eb2947b96a0edfb035ee4d8515ac5a76abe1.source: The Soviet takeover of West Berlin provides additional ammunition to your Republican critics.
9761eb2947b96a0edfb035ee4d8515ac5a76abe1.zh: 苏联接管西柏林，为你的共和党批评者提供了更多攻击材料。

0c176dac19a4524839a0ffaccd5228477d2eba8b.source: The Supreme Court has consistently stood in the way of progress by implementing an overly narrow interpretation of the Constitution. I support drastic measures to reduce its influence.
0c176dac19a4524839a0ffaccd5228477d2eba8b.zh: 最高法院一贯把宪法解释得过于狭隘，阻挡进步。我支持采取激烈措施，削弱它的影响。

3433e440323d8f065ff511d0e061864c37856f4f.source: The TPP is a key piece of our battle against excessive Chinese influence in Asia, and it will lead to greater economic growth here in the United States. I support Barack Obama's efforts to pass this deal.
3433e440323d8f065ff511d0e061864c37856f4f.zh: 跨太平洋伙伴关系协定，是我们遏制中国在亚洲过大影响力的一项关键措施，也会促进美国的经济增长。我支持贝拉克·奥巴马推动通过这项协议的努力。

6b064a56551fac839e7809e15013250b14b554d9.source: The Tea Party is a positive, invigorating force in American politics. They are drawing badly needed attention to our government deficits.
6b064a56551fac839e7809e15013250b14b554d9.zh: 茶党是美国政治中积极、振奋人心的力量。他们让政府赤字受到亟须的关注。

cdb87e5987d1ff641b7502626b56ad304211ea2a.source: The Tet Offensive was an absolute disaster for the North Vietnamese. Why should it have been prevented?
cdb87e5987d1ff641b7502626b56ad304211ea2a.zh: 春节攻势对北越来说是一场彻底的灾难。为什么要阻止它？

ea62d404a74f24f5e4a2eb41f94918f78210ca06.source: The U.S.-China relationship has destroyed middle class jobs for close to three decades. We need drastic changes including more protection for American manufacturing.
ea62d404a74f24f5e4a2eb41f94918f78210ca06.zh: 美中关系近三十年来摧毁了中产阶级的就业。我们需要重大改变，包括加强对美国制造业的保护。

a7999c373a169edcab535c2a80f58dded6275432.source: The Union is the most important object, and we will do anything we must to preserve it.
a7999c373a169edcab535c2a80f58dded6275432.zh: 联邦是最重要的目标。为维护它，我们会采取一切必要措施。

c7149eb5cb1b9e1527443452e5ff5080c6c41c5c.source: The United States enters 2012 with a struggling economy. After a severe recession from 2007-2009, unemployment remains over 8%, and many voters are frustrated with the slow pace of job creation. At the same time, the annual deficit has exploded since Obama took office, with some advocating for immediate cuts in government spending.
c7149eb5cb1b9e1527443452e5ff5080c6c41c5c.zh: 美国带着困境中的经济进入2012年。2007年至2009年严重衰退之后，失业率仍超过8%，许多选民对就业增长缓慢感到失望。与此同时，奥巴马上台后年度赤字急剧膨胀，有人主张立即削减政府开支。

420089369c2de0a648f978b8564555fecf9707d7.source: The United States has historically subsidized corn producers. With recent price increases in the corn market, do you still believe that such a program is necessary?
420089369c2de0a648f978b8564555fecf9707d7.zh: 美国历来补贴玉米生产者。如今玉米市场价格已经上涨，你是否仍认为这项计划有必要？

2b58a9dbcccb8f6812d5ca3c978d3611a86ae51f.source: The United States has no right to say who should or shouldn't have a nuclear weapon.
2b58a9dbcccb8f6812d5ca3c978d3611a86ae51f.zh: 美国无权决定谁应该或不应该拥有核武器。

4a7d149259070f29ab56296b10ecae8427e92d45.source: The United States is in the midst of a financial calamity, with masses of unemployed men on the streets. What will you do to revive business in this country?
4a7d149259070f29ab56296b10ecae8427e92d45.zh: 美国正陷于金融灾难，大批失业男子流落街头。你将如何振兴本国的工商业？

01c6762d7e2921fa9792b76fb241f96617d0bca1.source: The United States is much too entangled in the Middle East. We should pull back from the region and end sanctions in Iraq. I might remind people that these sanctions have killed hundreds of thousands of Iraqi children.
01c6762d7e2921fa9792b76fb241f96617d0bca1.zh: 美国过度卷入中东事务。我们应当从该地区抽身，并结束对伊拉克的制裁。我可能会提醒人们，这些制裁已经害死了数十万伊拉克儿童。

4717bef35929b96a1dfde6b85acbadc96c321a5a.source: The United States started selling large amounts of grain to the Soviet Union, in 1973. What is your opinion on this policy?
4717bef35929b96a1dfde6b85acbadc96c321a5a.zh: 美国从1973年开始向苏联大量出售粮食。你对这项政策有何看法？

c27a12c14135109642560e37abbdcf0b734befcd.source: The Vietnam War and the disorder in this country shows that our leadership has failed. I will work for American enterprise, end the war with honor, and end the violence in the streets.
c27a12c14135109642560e37abbdcf0b734befcd.zh: 越南战争和国内的混乱表明，我们的领导层已经失败。我会支持美国企业，让我们体面地结束战争，并制止街头暴力。

46edd4b70a1bd6b360b259bcee1dacf816e08b48.source: The WCTU is one of the most spiritually uplifting, morally righteous groups in our society. I pray that the Lord will see fit to guide them to success in their mission.
46edd4b70a1bd6b360b259bcee1dacf816e08b48.zh: 妇女基督教禁酒联合会，是我们社会中最能振奋精神、最具道德正义感的团体之一。我祈祷，上帝能引导她们完成使命。

da54dc8e934c6ed6bdf28e7efd90c5485f6d8850.source: The WCTU is popular in some rural areas, but not in the northern cities that you need to win this fall.
da54dc8e934c6ed6bdf28e7efd90c5485f6d8850.zh: 妇女基督教禁酒联合会在一些农村地区很受欢迎，但在你今年秋天需要赢下的北方城市，并非如此。

9d91a689c57be6f13133769fc2a78da478e5fed7.source: The War on Poverty is a national disgrace. It is a program that steals from the productive to finance the lazy and the shiftless.
9d91a689c57be6f13133769fc2a78da478e5fed7.zh: 向贫困宣战是国家的耻辱。它从勤劳创造财富的人那里抢钱，拿去养活懒汉和游手好闲之徒。

15ec46171455d2d3bf4e4fb040f1e171abffdf86.source: The Warren Court is the first Supreme Court in history which has had the guts to use constitutional law for the benefit of the common citizen. I will continue to appoint sound judges like Mr. Warren, Abe Fortas, and Thurgood Marshall.
15ec46171455d2d3bf4e4fb040f1e171abffdf86.zh: 沃伦法院是美国历史上第一个敢于运用宪法、为普通民众谋利益的最高法院。我会继续任命沃伦先生、埃布·福塔斯和瑟古德·马歇尔这样优秀的法官。

ccf4e2c23649f877fac5a7415d62adee76f8d306.source: The average worker would do much better if their money was invested in the stock market. I support a plan to allow workers to contribute at least some of their Social Security contribution to an individual investment account.
ccf4e2c23649f877fac5a7415d62adee76f8d306.zh: 如果把钱投资于股市，普通劳动者会得到好得多的回报。我支持一项计划，允许劳动者将至少部分社会保障缴费存入个人投资账户。

6d3c130eb400cd80222a5a8847af4d3355d961b2.source: The background of your running mate, Theodore Frelinghuysen, has caused much distress among the Catholics of this country? Will you make any statements on this issue?
6d3c130eb400cd80222a5a8847af4d3355d961b2.zh: 你的竞选搭档西奥多·弗里林海森的背景，让国内许多天主教徒深感不安。你会就此发表声明吗？

2295db1f0197314ecab4f5caf9a71a197cffd25c.source: The bank issue is dead and has been for 15 years.
2295db1f0197314ecab4f5caf9a71a197cffd25c.zh: 银行问题早已过时，已经如此十五年了。

bb343a268257cb45574dcea616f01adfe79431f2.source: The best course for a Green Party candidate is to oppose foreign intervention under almost all circumstances.
bb343a268257cb45574dcea616f01adfe79431f2.zh: 对于绿党候选人而言，最好的做法是在几乎所有情况下都反对对外干预。

935c5efe1bdd6806479f19928c66505c120be093.source: The best way to combat global warming is through the effort of American enterprise. With the right incentives, I'm confident that we will find solutions to the problems of solar and wind energy, with minimal disruptions to existing jobs and businesses.
935c5efe1bdd6806479f19928c66505c120be093.zh: 应对全球变暖的最好办法，是依靠美国企业的努力。有了恰当的激励，我相信，我们会找到解决太阳能和风能问题的办法，同时尽量减少对现有工作岗位和企业的冲击。

280f31dae1f1165b30b2cdc9aa6208179442dec3.source: The best way to gather votes is to run up our totals in liberal states like New York, Massachusetts, and California. We will focus on these areas heavily.
280f31dae1f1165b30b2cdc9aa6208179442dec3.zh: 争取选票的最佳办法，是在纽约、马萨诸塞和加利福尼亚这样的自由派州提高得票总数。我们会把重点放在这些地区。

17fcee32bad1fd58774c16fe2c1211d3cee4c409.source: The best way to prevent future Communist aggression is not through the death of 25,000 American kids in Vietnam. I support a comprehensive summit aimed at codifying peace in the modern world.
17fcee32bad1fd58774c16fe2c1211d3cee4c409.zh: 预防今后共产主义进攻的最好办法，绝不是让两万五千名美国年轻人在越南丧命。我支持召开全面的首脑会议，以正式协议确立当今世界的和平。

7b1ca6f073ae93119dd98676e2aa6c62dad588a9.source: The best you can do for now is continue to sound the call for a return to sanity in American politics. Perhaps if the riots and discord continue, you will have a better chance of making your voice heard in 1972.
7b1ca6f073ae93119dd98676e2aa6c62dad588a9.zh: 现在你能做的最好的事情就是继续呼吁美国政治恢复理智。也许如果骚乱和不和继续下去，你将有更好的机会在 1972 年表达你的声音。

4afec88876aaa5a8b6c20be395e6b898a7188966.source: The big newspapers should remind the voters that I represent a return to prosperity after the Democratic disaster of the previous four years. They should be paying as little attention to Bryan as possible.
4afec88876aaa5a8b6c20be395e6b898a7188966.zh: 各大报纸应当提醒选民：经历过去四年民主党造成的灾难，我代表的是繁荣的回归。它们应当尽量少报道布赖恩。

4f5abfe7efce28964faab9d8333afe8bc72b6d7f.source: The bombing of Serbia killed many innocent civilians and increased antagonism with Russia and China. I believe military intervention should be a last resort.
4f5abfe7efce28964faab9d8333afe8bc72b6d7f.zh: 轰炸塞尔维亚杀死了许多无辜平民，也加剧了与俄罗斯和中国的对立。我认为，军事干预应当是最后的手段。

f9beb8bdc75d6d118bced2a59d44cabbab4109c4.source: The border fence is inhumane. We should expand legal immigration instead of living in fear of Mexican culture.
f9beb8bdc75d6d118bced2a59d44cabbab4109c4.zh: 边境围栏不人道。我们应该扩大合法移民，而不是生活在对墨西哥文化的恐惧之中。

f110a30597ddf62b0034261fc0f9b30cbf331890.source: The border fence should become a border wall, with more depth to its patrols. It is simply too easy for migrants to sneak across the border right now.
f110a30597ddf62b0034261fc0f9b30cbf331890.zh: 边境围栏应该升级为边境墙，并扩大巡逻的纵深。现在移民偷偷越过边境实在太容易了。

d39f9c7a6fa1ff3d1690e545beded9c8b44e18fa.source: The Warren Court is unpopular overall, but this clashes with many liberal supporters who have a positive view of the Court.
d39f9c7a6fa1ff3d1690e545beded9c8b44e18fa.zh: 沃伦法院总体上不受欢迎，但这个立场与你许多赞赏该法院的自由派支持者相冲突。

76bb421a15f66704647842adad841cddffdf5c96.source: The West Coast is a very competitive region. Can you make the case for Republican policies there, particularly in those places such as San Francisco which rely on foreign trade?
76bb421a15f66704647842adad841cddffdf5c96.zh: 西海岸选情竞争激烈。你能在当地为共和党政策争取支持吗，尤其是在旧金山这样依赖对外贸易的地方？

670c59d23f56200c05c6e69511025f222f0fe443.source: The Whig Party attempts to stand apart from these nativist mobs, yet their own candidate for Vice President has associated with virulent anti-Catholics.
670c59d23f56200c05c6e69511025f222f0fe443.zh: 辉格党试图与这些本土主义暴徒划清界限，但他们自己的副总统候选人，却与极端反天主教人士有交往。

e53bd1946f32a5d4440f5ba19d8ef4cd760aa6f7.source: The Whig Party supports a one-term limit for the President, with Jackson fresh in mind. Harrison pledged he would follow this guideline during his campaign....
e53bd1946f32a5d4440f5ba19d8ef4cd760aa6f7.zh: 杰克逊执政的记忆仍然鲜明，所以辉格党支持将总统任期限制为一届。哈里森在竞选时，也曾承诺遵守这一原则……

fb5709203b2bf0031a22370d01d7b446fdc7293a.source: The Wilson-Gorman Tariff Act of 1894 lowered the rates on many goods, while still falling well short of Cleveland's ideal levels. What do you think about this act as a whole?
fb5709203b2bf0031a22370d01d7b446fdc7293a.zh: 1894年的《威尔逊—戈尔曼关税法》降低了许多商品的税率，但与克利夫兰理想的水平仍相差甚远。总体上，你如何评价这部法律？

a5239f204e0446c94b3cf6db80cb96ee299b5fc5.source: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz - A Monetary Reform Parable
a5239f204e0446c94b3cf6db80cb96ee299b5fc5.zh: 绿野仙踪 - 货币改革寓言

60586fd2c535eb0cd8374e09324e8283d6508223.source: The absence of some traditional Republican stalwarts at the convention becomes a bit of a news story, but only for a day or two.
60586fd2c535eb0cd8374e09324e8283d6508223.zh: 一些传统共和党中坚人物缺席党代会，成了一条新闻，不过也就持续一两天。

cbc6b220f45777c0b497032446409466b85d47a5.source: The actions of Lyndon Johnson since 1964 are exactly what Goldwater warned us about. The American people are ready to reconsider the message of true conservatism.
cbc6b220f45777c0b497032446409466b85d47a5.zh: 林登·约翰逊自1964年以来的所作所为，恰恰印证了戈德华特当年的警告。美国人民已经愿意重新考虑真正保守主义的主张。

d887d8e5b1bdf825d879af68e7740c7d45d2a8f8.source: The announcement of Quayle didn't go over quite like we wanted to. Let's have him campaign in safely Republican areas for the time being, until this furor subsides.
d887d8e5b1bdf825d879af68e7740c7d45d2a8f8.zh: 宣布奎尔人选后的反应，并不完全如我们所愿。目前先让他到共和党稳占优势的地区竞选，等这阵风波平息。

0e3c9611b6086ae92d8415111739ab591c011f1a.source: The answer here is obvious. High tariffs force farmers to purchase overpriced equipment and do nothing to increase crop prices.
0e3c9611b6086ae92d8415111739ab591c011f1a.zh: 答案显而易见。高关税迫使农民购买价格过高的设备，却丝毫不能提高农产品价格。

dc86db289d2f40c1c14697adcbe751748e3863ec.source: The answer is obvious. By continuing to rely on non-renewable energy sources, we place ourselves at greater risk for future energy shocks and we contribute to global warming.
dc86db289d2f40c1c14697adcbe751748e3863ec.zh: 答案很明显。继续依赖不可再生能源，我们既增加了未来遭遇能源冲击的风险，也加剧了全球变暖。

36b32e04afe2237a6a14e226a9bafa0bad8c3d68.source: The attacks do stick a little bit, but the issue of your Nixon pardon always lingers in the background.
36b32e04afe2237a6a14e226a9bafa0bad8c3d68.zh: 这些攻击多少起了作用，但赦免尼克松的问题始终在背后挥之不去。

818659365aec7187f58a9292123757a418fa3bd3.source: The attacks themselves are bad enough, but the way you have swung to the right in your own positions is disheartening to many progressives.
818659365aec7187f58a9292123757a418fa3bd3.zh: 袭击本身已足够糟糕，但你自己的立场也向右转，让许多进步派灰心。

001bf3053f5aa30b32cb893d49121cac6e5e2650.source: The average person is over the Benghazi episode at this point, but it's important to movement conservatives.
001bf3053f5aa30b32cb893d49121cac6e5e2650.zh: 普通人这时已不太在意班加西事件，但它对于投身保守主义运动的人仍很重要。

1480b043bd47735193c6db06949a2b3de89053e9.source: The budget for the Department of Housing and Urban Development was cut by nearly $4 billion in 2012. Do you think subsidized housing for the poor is a good place to begin reducing the federal deficit?
1480b043bd47735193c6db06949a2b3de89053e9.zh: 住房和城市发展部2012年的预算削减了近40亿美元。削减对贫困者的住房补贴，是开始降低联邦赤字的好办法吗？

e70588373dce397c7128ade3e9fc0edd434db3e8.source: The campaign is rapidly moving towards its close, and civil rights remains as a major issue in America today. Is there any last-minute appeal you would like to make to win voters over?
e70588373dce397c7128ade3e9fc0edd434db3e8.zh: 竞选正在迅速接近尾声，民权仍是美国的重要议题。你想在最后关头提出什么主张，以争取选民？

a74e0ce0cb581c91a0367bc02f678b3a632b3aac.source: The chairman and CEO of Las Vegas Sands, Sheldon Adelson is a billionaire gambling tycoon.  Despite the economic hit on the gambling industry, Adelson is willing and ready to bankroll your campaign.
a74e0ce0cb581c91a0367bc02f678b3a632b3aac.zh: 谢尔登·阿德尔森是拉斯维加斯金沙集团的董事长兼首席执行官，也是一位身家数十亿的博彩业巨头。尽管博彩业受到经济冲击，他仍愿意并准备好资助你的竞选。

7ae6881b882c84a86f9dd380e8247d93c5aa7db6.source: The choice in this election is clear. I think every worker deserves to be paid a living wage, and Donald Trump doesn't. This issue is at the core of what the Democratic Party is fighting for.
7ae6881b882c84a86f9dd380e8247d93c5aa7db6.zh: 这次选举的选择很明确。我认为，每个劳动者都应获得足以维持生活的工资，唐纳德·特朗普却不这么想。这正是民主党奋斗目标的核心。

59bbbcb4bb6e55e92ec0198f332dbc1373334efd.source: The consensus view is that the U.S. should continue to strike foreign terrorist networks. Voters don't want to see a U.S. pullback, nor do they wish to see a large-scale conflict or ground invasion.
59bbbcb4bb6e55e92ec0198f332dbc1373334efd.zh: 普遍看法是，美国应继续打击境外恐怖网络。选民既不希望美国退缩，也不希望出现大规模冲突或地面入侵。

812f352bbf10352fca93e012f97dab3a3f945826.source: The conservatives in your party are not looking for someone who wavers on this issue, but this may be a safer response overall.
812f352bbf10352fca93e012f97dab3a3f945826.zh: 党内保守派不想找一个在这件事上摇摆的人，但总体而言，这个回答或许更稳妥。

4d99a872b16844173134356def1eaf6de94a4aa4.source: The continued escalation of violence at Trump's rallies can only benefit you.
4d99a872b16844173134356def1eaf6de94a4aa4.zh: 特朗普集会上的暴力持续升级，只会让你获益。

d32be83b426a322192601e44801b03a58769745b.source: The core belief of our party is that the federal territories should be settled by honest, free, hard-working men and their families. A homestead act would be right in line with this philosophy.
d32be83b426a322192601e44801b03a58769745b.zh: 我们党的核心信念是：联邦领地应当由诚实、自由、勤劳的人及其家庭来定居。宅地法完全符合这一理念。

d86f229fca32536b95a128560b69be5c3b1e1c2f.source: The corrupt Democrats and their media enablers have stonewalled our attempts at infrastructure spending at every turn, throwing their own voters under the bus to spite me.
d86f229fca32536b95a128560b69be5c3b1e1c2f.zh: 腐败的民主党及其媒体帮凶，一再阻挠我们的基础设施支出，只为与我作对，就牺牲他们自己的选民。

ca255fa0c36ceef615cfff38d9fbf910378d66be.source: The country is not really clamoring for policies right now that are more conservative than those of Eisenhower's. Most voters are registered Democrats.
ca255fa0c36ceef615cfff38d9fbf910378d66be.zh: 本国眼下并不特别渴望比艾森豪威尔更保守的政策。大多数选民登记为民主党人。

394e5e552b0f68103702074ca65e33124343dd1a.source: The creation of an independent Treasury will be one of the key initiatives of my Presidency.
394e5e552b0f68103702074ca65e33124343dd1a.zh: 设立独立国库，将是我担任总统期间的重点措施之一。

0c0dfcb7047e9d108fff7232fc9e5d9c638b2d12.source: The crisis resulted from a regional war against Israel. We need to work towards lasting peace agreements to prevent this in the future.
0c0dfcb7047e9d108fff7232fc9e5d9c638b2d12.zh: 这场危机源于针对以色列的地区战争。我们必须努力达成持久和平协议，防止它再次发生。

2da5c8f1cb6544a0f27a865728393592774d0314.source: The crooked media is in the tank for Joe Biden and his son Hunter, and they are doing everything they can to make my term, one of the most successful ever, look like a disaster. Don't fall for it!
2da5c8f1cb6544a0f27a865728393592774d0314.zh: 这些无耻的媒体一边倒地袒护乔·拜登和他的儿子亨特，千方百计把我这个史上最成功的任期之一说成一场灾难。别上他们的当！

665ee20ff4cc087b8638ee46c868db0045b6da94.source: The culture wars have been a feature of American politics for decades, and 2012 is no exception. An increasingly empowered GLBT community demands acceptance for gay marriage while most conservatives still find the idea to be anathema to their sensibilities. The ever-present debates on abortion, religious issues, and gun control are still running strong as well.
665ee20ff4cc087b8638ee46c868db0045b6da94.zh: 文化战争在美国政坛已持续数十年，2012年也不例外。力量日益增强的GLBT社群要求社会接受同性婚姻，但多数保守派仍认为这与他们的价值观水火不容。关于堕胎、宗教问题和枪支管制的争论，也始终激烈。

622ebd01761c82a63b9be8a9c46033d701a82a5d.source: The culture wars have been a feature of American politics for decades, and 2012 is no exception. An increasingly empowered LGBT community demands acceptance for gay marriage while most conservatives still find the idea to be anathema to their sensibilities. The ever-present debates on abortion, religious issues, and gun control are still running strong as well.
622ebd01761c82a63b9be8a9c46033d701a82a5d.zh: 文化战争在美国政坛已持续数十年，2012年也不例外。力量日益增强的LGBT社群要求社会接受同性婚姻，但多数保守派仍认为这与他们的价值观水火不容。关于堕胎、宗教问题和枪支管制的争论，也始终激烈。

43534f43debc399a46bff7904485f477e8237364.source: The current system for selecting Senators is unimaginably corrupt. State legislatures have every incentive to select the most corrupt, retrograde candidate for the job.
43534f43debc399a46bff7904485f477e8237364.zh: 现行联邦参议员选任制度，腐败得难以想象。州议会有各种动机，把最腐败、最顽固守旧的人选送进参议院。

90e71f498895f4e696f80cca375316a46358ebc7.source: The debates in 1960 were an anomaly. If Nixon has no interest this time, I'm fine with that.
90e71f498895f4e696f80cca375316a46358ebc7.zh: 1960年的辩论是个例外。如果尼克松这次没兴趣，我也无所谓。

76d2ba9481b9cbaf6c95c9cd753511981c74a593.source: The debates went well for you. Trump looked a little out of his depth on a few occasions.
76d2ba9481b9cbaf6c95c9cd753511981c74a593.zh: 辩论对你很有利。特朗普有几次显得力不从心。

68a64e7ca496ed16a9359c6d05dba84aef99c5c4.source: The differences between us are much smaller than the things that unite us. We both wake up every day and fight for average Americans -- for their health care, their housing and education costs, and their personal rights.
68a64e7ca496ed16a9359c6d05dba84aef99c5c4.zh: 我们之间的分歧，远远小于把我们团结起来的共同点。我们每天醒来，都为普通美国人奋斗，为他们的医疗、住房与教育费用，以及个人权利奋斗。

5623707ec052ef4658823fc1d6765d237237e468.source: The draft is evil and should be abolished. We would never need it in the first place if warmongers like Johnson hadn't gotten us into this mess over in Vietnam.
5623707ec052ef4658823fc1d6765d237237e468.zh: 征兵制度是邪恶的，应该废除。如果不是约翰逊这样的战争贩子把我们拖进越南这摊烂事，我们本来就根本用不着它。

fb8f334ed381a4b3a14884af0d3a5efba9c05f3d.source: The economy would be even better without the obstructionism of Congress, or the excessive profiteering and price-gouging from many companies. But overall, we've seen great prosperity since the end of World War II.
fb8f334ed381a4b3a14884af0d3a5efba9c05f3d.zh: 如果没有国会的阻挠，以及许多公司的牟取暴利和哄抬物价，经济会更好。不过总体上，第二次世界大战结束以来，我们经历了很大的繁荣。

fe63d35e0ed5e1aab6d1e28e802efb7c118458a8.source: The election closes in chaos. Peace talks collapse, you accuse Nixon, Nixon accuses the Democrats of bugging his plane, and the upshot is mass confusion and anger among the voters. Good luck tonight!
fe63d35e0ed5e1aab6d1e28e802efb7c118458a8.zh: 选举在混乱中收尾。和平谈判破裂，你指控尼克松，尼克松又指控民主党在他的飞机上安装窃听器，结果选民一片困惑、愤怒。祝你今晚好运！

84e88d93a8c28427928a6abb502ec7a136c57b9c.source: The entire city of Chicago and half of the Midwest was blocked to rail traffic. It was impossible for this fracas
84e88d93a8c28427928a6abb502ec7a136c57b9c.zh: 整个芝加哥市和中西部一半地区的铁路交通被封锁。这场争吵是不可能的

1d6ab93de2242bcc5c5da84b62ef6d1a6155dc75.source: The entire global warming alarm is a fantasy. A lot of people are pushing it so they can increase their own power and decision making.
1d6ab93de2242bcc5c5da84b62ef6d1a6155dc75.zh: 所谓全球变暖警报，完全是幻想。许多人鼓吹它，只是为了扩大自己的权力和决策权限。

8435c118f454587954678d20ebcfbbcaa886eec6.source: The fact of the matter is, the deficit just isn't as important as some people make it out to be. If every person has access to a quality education and reliable health care, the economy will grow enough over time to make the deficit a non-issue.
8435c118f454587954678d20ebcfbbcaa886eec6.zh: 事实是，赤字并没有一些人说得那么重要。如果每个人都能接受优质教育，拥有可靠的医疗保障，经济就会随着时间充分增长，让赤字不再成问题。

67327dfeaf1ecb934650b05bcb1640347a880ca3.source: The fact of the matter is, there is no way that Republicans will not fill these seats on the Court, and you're simply stating the obvious.
67327dfeaf1ecb934650b05bcb1640347a880ca3.zh: 事实是，共和党不可能放着这些法院席位不填，你不过是在说显而易见的事。

3416bd1e3b7b0eac57f0e464627b4721e23da175.source: The fact of the matter is, we as Democrats don't have the power to stop this. We need to make sure that we can win enough states, red states even, to contest the Senate over the next few years.
3416bd1e3b7b0eac57f0e464627b4721e23da175.zh: 事实是，作为民主党人，我们没有力量阻止这件事。必须确保我们能赢下足够多的州，甚至包括红州，才能在未来几年争夺参议院控制权。

1a3cae48a50c8096f57bc086d9134c7c45649e0c.source: The fact that this is even under consideration as a demand shows how far beyond compromise the South has drifted.
1a3cae48a50c8096f57bc086d9134c7c45649e0c.zh: 这种要求竟然还被认真考虑，本身就说明南方已经走得太远，无法再妥协。

6fe714823685a9cd77b80a977716c6f1ed5a3c57.source: The failing New York Times and many others have totally exaggerated this to make us look divided in the face of Hillary Clinton. I would be glad to work with Mitt and get him into the convention hall.
6fe714823685a9cd77b80a977716c6f1ed5a3c57.zh: 日渐衰败的《纽约时报》和许多其他媒体，把这件事完全夸大了，想让我们在希拉里·克林顿面前显得四分五裂。我很愿意与米特合作，让他走进党代会会场。

8cc57774dc852894722339615ed2a6fd815f09a1.source: The farm vote is one of the largest blocs that is in doubt this fall. Advisors were really hoping you would do something to appeal to their interest.
8cc57774dc852894722339615ed2a6fd815f09a1.zh: 农民选票是今年秋季仍未确定归属的最大票源之一。顾问们原本很希望你能采取行动，争取他们的支持。

d531eed6f7bc9fb9164d97f2523d50a3182a5a42.source: The federal deficit has recently increased after two decades of steady decline. What are your thoughts on this?
d531eed6f7bc9fb9164d97f2523d50a3182a5a42.zh: 联邦赤字在连续二十年稳步下降后，最近又增加了。你对此怎么看？

610c233e6cb394a0b41e21c942befb290fea8b1c.source: The federal government has every right to issue interest bearing bonds. Of course, under a solvent Administration there would be no cause for doing so. This whole episode reflects more poorly on the performance of President Cleveland than it does on any great legal issue.
610c233e6cb394a0b41e21c942befb290fea8b1c.zh: 联邦政府完全有权发行付息债券。当然，如果政府财政健全，就没有理由这样做。这件事与其说涉及重大的法律问题，不如说更暴露了克利夫兰总统执政表现之差。

1bd346c70871d381323e30b95ce6513f333cd744.source: The federal government has forced Arizona's hand by being too lax on enforcement for far too long.
1bd346c70871d381323e30b95ce6513f333cd744.zh: 联邦政府执法不力，而且放任得太久，逼得亚利桑那州不得不出手。

fdc0252cf67d91c428e7a3346af63ca0cc51c86a.source: The final days of the campaign are here, and both campaigns are throwing everything they have left in to come out on top. Where should your campaign concentrate its last efforts?
fdc0252cf67d91c428e7a3346af63ca0cc51c86a.zh: 竞选进入最后几天，双方都在倾尽剩余力量，力争获胜。你的阵营应把最后的努力集中在哪里？

c4815b1208f4645b98137e6e35557414d6d92b58.source: The first thing is, let's take a moment of respect for the people who were affected by this horrible tragedy. And I trust that the European authorities are on this case and over the coming weeks we will get more information about what happened.
c4815b1208f4645b98137e6e35557414d6d92b58.zh: 首先，让我们向受到这场可怕悲剧影响的人们致意。我相信，欧洲当局正在调查，未来几周，我们会得到更多事件信息。

701ecdaf2433dddfe90f804fa9e353746ad466ff.source: The flow of illegal immigrants into the U.S. has slowed in recent years. We should be focusing more on expanding legal opportunities and bringing immigrants out of the shadows.
701ecdaf2433dddfe90f804fa9e353746ad466ff.zh: 近年非法移民流入美国的速度已经放缓。我们应该更多地着眼于扩大合法渠道，让移民不再躲在暗处。

be49c75d6937b5c03bae4fbe336a0f90b58af8f3.source: The focus of this campaign needs to be our competence, and the scandals and extreme policy of the Reagan Administration. I trust that voters will see through this attempt to deflect attention from the real issues.
be49c75d6937b5c03bae4fbe336a0f90b58af8f3.zh: 这场竞选的焦点应当是我们的执政能力，以及里根政府的丑闻和极端政策。我相信选民能看穿这种转移实质问题的企图。

5cb44508c540db0a06b70644338bda5d4799b647.source: The focus on Social Security in the final days of the campaign energizes fiscal conservatives nationwide. Will it be enough to make up the difference?
5cb44508c540db0a06b70644338bda5d4799b647.zh: 竞选最后几天，把重点放在社会保障上，鼓舞了全国各地的财政保守派。这足以弥补差距吗？

1e0d0ffa7b42ed9fdb955eb10b202fcf0e52b327.source: The forces of Pancho Villa have killed over 30 Americans in separate incidents, and even launched a raid into New Mexico. How will you respond to this, as President?
1e0d0ffa7b42ed9fdb955eb10b202fcf0e52b327.zh: 潘乔·比利亚的部队在几次事件中杀死了三十多名美国人，甚至突袭了新墨西哥。作为总统，你会如何回应？

8d42b81dea9cb3f14354bbaf5326152d820afb45.source: The former CEO of Dreamworks, Katzenberg has spent his whole life bringing dreams to life. You've always dreamed of the White House, haven't you?  With a little cash, he can help that dream come true.
8d42b81dea9cb3f14354bbaf5326152d820afb45.zh: 梦工厂前首席执行官卡岑伯格，一生都在让梦想成真。你不是一直梦想入主白宫吗？只要拿出一些钱，他就能帮你实现这个梦。

b87a3936a73c0f835b12e375952b6be3d56966ae.source: The former acting chair of the DNC, Donna Brazile is a good friend of yours, and 'helped' in your primary win against democratic socalist upstart Bernie Sanders.
b87a3936a73c0f835b12e375952b6be3d56966ae.zh: 民主党全国委员会前代理主席唐娜·布拉齐尔是你的好友。在你战胜民主社会主义新秀伯尼·桑德斯的初选中，她也曾“帮过忙”。

2ccd48e3a34e408b7caa8439e51bda3dca82e576.source: The former mayor of New York City who grew to national fame after 9/11, Rudy Giuliani is hoping to inject that same patriotic magic that's fueled his career since into your longshot campaign.
2ccd48e3a34e408b7caa8439e51bda3dca82e576.zh: 鲁迪·朱利安尼曾任纽约市市长，在“9·11”后名声大振。他希望把此后一直支撑自己政治生涯的爱国主义魔力，注入你这场胜算不高的竞选。

f17f45abe15d12c2f5e060390ecbb8f6a45c21df.source: The former spokeswoman and vice president of corporate communications at the Motion Picture Association of America, Kate Bedingfield knows the media biz better than anyone on your campaign, and could aid in your media strategy, especially in the midst of this national lockdown.
f17f45abe15d12c2f5e060390ecbb8f6a45c21df.zh: 凯特·贝丁菲尔德曾任美国电影协会发言人和企业传播副总裁。她比竞选团队中的任何人都熟悉媒体行业，能帮助你制定媒体策略，尤其是在全国封锁期间。

63278c8d8110cb9977ae648f506dd1de41943067.source: The humble nature of your personality is widely noted, and stands in stark contrast to the braggadocio of your opponent.
63278c8d8110cb9977ae648f506dd1de41943067.zh: 人们普遍注意到你谦逊的性格，这与你对手的夸夸其谈形成了鲜明对照。

c3e14e1a7d880fa5c4901af48c6eeb398452c95b.source: The humblest citizen in all the land, when clad in the armor of a righteous cause, is stronger than all the hosts of error.
c3e14e1a7d880fa5c4901af48c6eeb398452c95b.zh: 哪怕是全国最卑微的公民，只要身披正义事业的铠甲，也比谬误的千军万马更强大。

4f91d30ab4227bfbbb5c7f7139aed8a34ef0588d.source: The husband of your first daughter, Ivanka, Jared Kushner is a Jewish businessman who has served faithfully in the administration as your czar on Israel policy, most notably being the architect of the Abraham Accords.  Bringing him into the campaign would bolster relationship with Jewish voters, and the powerful AIPAC.
4f91d30ab4227bfbbb5c7f7139aed8a34ef0588d.zh: 贾里德·库什纳是你大女儿伊万卡的丈夫，也是一位犹太裔商人。他忠实地在政府中担任你的以色列政策负责人，最显著的成就是推动《亚伯拉罕协议》。把他带进竞选团队，能改善你与犹太选民及强大的美国以色列公共事务委员会的关系。

dc1ed4b128acf141aa32af1959e48ea7c9da1d7f.source: The idea is definitely getting around that you are soft on Communism. Party operatives are scratching their heads right now.
dc1ed4b128acf141aa32af1959e48ea7c9da1d7f.zh: 你对共产主义过于软弱的说法，确实正在流传。党内操盘手眼下都感到摸不着头脑。

5ae92f60de61d0bcf4b122b258e96f3eebe00f70.source: The idea that there is a moderate opposition in Syria is fantasy. Every side is terrible, and we'd be best served to pull back from the entire fray and let it play out.
5ae92f60de61d0bcf4b122b258e96f3eebe00f70.zh: 认为叙利亚存在温和反对派，完全是幻想。各方都很糟糕；最好抽身退出整个混战，让它自行发展。

8750291e589474e80741b14b2446753825bfed1e.source: The idea that we support social equality for blacks in society is a canard put down the Democrats, in a clumsy and transparent attempt to score political points.
8750291e589474e80741b14b2446753825bfed1e.zh: 所谓我们支持黑人在社会中享有平等地位，是民主党人炮制的谣言，目的只是拙劣而明显地捞取政治好处。

3fde104ff9b5836dbe691de85d4c4fef36d10549.source: The important thing is that you won. Go about implementing your agenda accordingly, and pay no attention to Democrats and agitators who call for 'compromise' and 'conciliation'.
3fde104ff9b5836dbe691de85d4c4fef36d10549.zh: 重要的是你赢了。相应地执行你的议程，不要理会那些呼吁“妥协”和“和解”的民主党人和煽动者。

d9593652fd0b53c666b49c8d53985ae53f0a0488.source: The important thing is that you won. Go about implementing your agenda accordingly, and pay no attention to Democrats and pundits who call for 'compromise' and 'conciliation'.
d9593652fd0b53c666b49c8d53985ae53f0a0488.zh: 重要的是你赢了。相应地执行你的议程，不要理会那些呼吁“妥协”和“和解”的民主党人和专家。

980a35235e5415cf416b9051e4c8e8b02654e3ed.source: The impulse is noble, but you come across as a little petty as you awkwardly read from these leaflets at your latest press conference.
980a35235e5415cf416b9051e4c8e8b02654e3ed.zh: 出发点很高尚，但你在最近的记者会上，笨拙地读着这些传单，显得有点斤斤计较。

1b549a3c104a25da9c8e730a8f9e5db9d124aada.source: The incumbent governor of Wisconsin, Scott Walker was one of your rivals for the Republican nomination this year, and now is a hesitant supporter.  In bringing him on board, you're hoping he'll be able to swing the states of Wisconsin, Minnesota and Michigan.
1b549a3c104a25da9c8e730a8f9e5db9d124aada.zh: 现任威斯康星州州长斯科特·沃克，是你今年争取共和党提名的对手之一，如今有些勉强地支持你。把他招入团队，是希望他能让威斯康星、明尼苏达和密歇根三州转向你。

1d186be24cdef51820bf096bfe3364f17a9e9807.source: The incumbent, popular governor of Michigan, Gretchen Whitmer is as much a darling of liberals as she is loathed by conservatives.  Still, she would be willing to campaign throughout Michigan and its neighboring states in support of your campaign.
1d186be24cdef51820bf096bfe3364f17a9e9807.zh: 现任密歇根州州长格雷琴·惠特默颇受欢迎，自由派有多喜欢她，保守派就有多厌恶她。不过，她愿意走遍密歇根及邻近各州，支持你的竞选。

67ef2970afcc01267baf206a89cae1b3f0ce3b72.source: The gay marriage issue is less salient in the so-called culture wars compared to guns and abortion.
67ef2970afcc01267baf206a89cae1b3f0ce3b72.zh: 在所谓的文化战争中，同性婚姻不像枪支和堕胎那样显眼。

26c08831a08e8bec97390230437826e5ca572e6c.source: The good people of South Carolina have already worked out a compromise on this issue, and I don't see how it's useful for us today to revisit that.
26c08831a08e8bec97390230437826e5ca572e6c.zh: 南卡罗来纳州的善良民众已经就此达成了妥协，我看不出我们今天重新翻出这件事有什么益处。

5a16aabc5d925f1f92729316dea3f9ba96df97e2.source: The government has no business regulating the value of a home. We will never fully recover from this recession until prices are allowed to find their floor, and then start increasing through market forces.
5a16aabc5d925f1f92729316dea3f9ba96df97e2.zh: 政府无权管控房屋价值。只有让价格找到底部，再靠市场力量开始回升，我们才能彻底走出这场衰退。

5b37f555c79e4953be4f8b0afbd155b0ab6cc62e.source: The great mass of voters in this country are Republicans. If we keep the mainstream elements of the party happy, they will deliver us a victory in November.
5b37f555c79e4953be4f8b0afbd155b0ab6cc62e.zh: 本国广大选民都是共和党人。只要让党内主流满意，他们就会在十一月为我们带来胜利。

642ec096a83d6a10d2b48e019d5765fef462b580.source: The happy warrior rises! Despite a climate of chaos and a split in the Democratic Party, you've beaten back the opposition and secured a third term for the Democrats. Johnson breathes a sigh of relief after this, and poor Nixon is once again a loser. He did quite well, however, so you best work hard, lest the midterms act mercilessly.
642ec096a83d6a10d2b48e019d5765fef462b580.zh: 快乐斗士奋起了！尽管全国混乱、民主党四分五裂，你仍击退对手，为民主党赢得连续第三届总统任期。约翰逊终于松了口气，可怜的尼克松又成了输家。不过，他的表现相当不错；你最好努力执政，否则中期选举可不会手下留情。

a6cc7dbb3b44a6d5cf3583410c59e78ce077ad83.source: The happy warrior rises! Despite a climate of chaos and a split in the Democratic Party, you've beaten back the opposition and secured a third term for the Democrats. Johnson breathes a sigh of relief after this, and poor Nixon is once again a loser. It seems America is ready to give the New Deal Democrats one last chance. If you succeed, you might be able to rebuild the coalition that's won them so many elections (well, not the Deep South, but you knew that).
a6cc7dbb3b44a6d5cf3583410c59e78ce077ad83.zh: 快乐斗士奋起了！尽管全国混乱、民主党四分五裂，你仍击退对手，为民主党赢得连续第三届总统任期。约翰逊终于松了口气，可怜的尼克松又成了输家。看来，美国准备再给新政民主党人最后一次机会。倘若成功，你或许能重建那个为他们赢得过无数选举的联盟——当然，深南部除外，这你早就知道。

c95a2e8f5cb05ed5bd41e15a1e6c43c7a0c1284f.source: The happy warrior rises! Despite a climate of chaos and a split in the Democratic Party, you've beaten back the opposition and secured a third term for the Democrats. Johnson breathes a sigh of relief after this, and poor Nixon is once again a loser. To the shock of pundits countrywide, you beat Nixon and Wallace handily. The bombing halt and your inspiring words compared to Nixon must have won it for you.
c95a2e8f5cb05ed5bd41e15a1e6c43c7a0c1284f.zh: 快乐斗士奋起了！尽管全国混乱、民主党四分五裂，你仍击退对手，为民主党赢得连续第三届总统任期。约翰逊终于松了口气，可怜的尼克松又成了输家。全国评论家都大吃一惊：你轻松击败了尼克松和华莱士。停止轰炸，加上你比尼克松更鼓舞人心的演说，想必就是制胜之因。

bd20b78861c4d3ce4b563d26b39a5cb21e9509a6.source: The headlines today say, “KENNEDY ADVOCATES APOLOGY TO SOVIET UNION”, which is probably not a good thing.
bd20b78861c4d3ce4b563d26b39a5cb21e9509a6.zh: 今天的头条写着：“肯尼迪主张向苏联道歉。”这大概不是什么好事。

6352833283c8b6953f46a7b48eb08f84801ca3c6.source: The headlines today say, “NIXON ADVOCATES APOLOGY TO SOVIET UNION”, which is probably not a good thing.
6352833283c8b6953f46a7b48eb08f84801ca3c6.zh: 今天的头条写着：“尼克松主张向苏联道歉。”这大概不是什么好事。

dff84c821fc64f1fbf3bf71c98c5ab18f45d290b.source: The independence of Israel is cause for great celebration among America's Jewish community, particularly in New York.
dff84c821fc64f1fbf3bf71c98c5ab18f45d290b.zh: 以色列独立，让美国犹太人群体，尤其是纽约州的犹太人欢欣鼓舞。

0ba9e3a8c12f442f3d0d8cef4825a5f73a936729.source: The independent Treasury idea has broad support in the party, and also shows that Democrats are trying to do something after the 1837 crisis.
0ba9e3a8c12f442f3d0d8cef4825a5f73a936729.zh: 独立国库的主张在党内有广泛支持，也表明民主党人在1837年危机之后，正试图有所作为。

f314781a1aca5e392dd7bb8befe602cb5461e4cd.source: The independent Treasury is a halfway measure, designed to cover for the disaster that was the war against the Second Bank of the United States.
f314781a1aca5e392dd7bb8befe602cb5461e4cd.zh: 独立国库是个折中办法，旨在掩饰打击美国第二银行所造成的灾难。

7c80db790e780d20449aa1f2d964fdfe1be7a857.source: The inflation rate we have in this country speaks to the heart of the Democrats' problems in running the economy. They claim to be the party of the working man, but they are fine with debasing wages and property values with their misguided social engineering.
7c80db790e780d20449aa1f2d964fdfe1be7a857.zh: 我国的通胀率，直指民主党管理经济的根本问题。他们自称是劳动者的政党，却不介意用错误的社会改造政策，侵蚀工资和财产价值。

82368ca3df03eafb9a4d04d914de070ef17e2714.source: The international system we have in place is the gold standard. Not only is this highly advisable from a business standpoint, but it is driven by the power of Great Britain. We are better off working within this system.
82368ca3df03eafb9a4d04d914de070ef17e2714.zh: 现行国际制度是金本位制。它不仅对工商业极为有利，也由英国的实力推动。我们留在这个体系内，更为有利。

712f85777634674321ecad63d7d4dd9d113374a3.source: The larger focus in this campaign is going to be my experience and my foreign policy credentials. And also on my dangerously unqualified opponent.
712f85777634674321ecad63d7d4dd9d113374a3.zh: 这场竞选会更着重于我的经验和外交资历，也会突出我的对手缺乏资格，足以带来危险。

9329983b1c856491e3c03a19d34825f929a1a47d.source: The larger part of your supporters are resolutely in favor of a higher income tax, and are surprised by your unexpected veto.
9329983b1c856491e3c03a19d34825f929a1a47d.zh: 你的大多数支持者坚决赞成提高所得税，因此对你出人意料的否决感到惊讶。

4ff9cc410563094f8e8c36f19218168c2c31887c.source: The largest part of the party was advocating for Dole's selection, and they are pleased to see him on the ticket.
4ff9cc410563094f8e8c36f19218168c2c31887c.zh: 党内最大的一股力量一直主张选择多尔，如今看到他成为竞选搭档，他们很高兴。

d56e747d3268e77ffefd3fc2978f0bab43f1a3f2.source: The last few days will be business as usual. My goal is to bring my message to all parts of America, whether it be in close states or those that clearly tilt towards one of the main candidates.
d56e747d3268e77ffefd3fc2978f0bab43f1a3f2.zh: 最后几天，一切照常。我的目标是把主张传到美国各地，无论是胜负接近的州，还是明显倾向某位主要候选人的州。

8c49b5af847c471a097c1f3b30cd45982b14a3f4.source: The last thing we need is a return to excesses and witch-hunts of the early 1950s. We need to keep ourselves focused on the external Communist threat.
8c49b5af847c471a097c1f3b30cd45982b14a3f4.zh: 我们最不需要的，就是重回1950年代初的过激做法和政治猎巫。我们应该集中关注外部的共产主义威胁。

41424cd6af20dec0ba099ad3209fff864a08d4be.source: The last thing we need is someone like Ron Paul taking up precious prime time coverage at our convention. We will seat all duly elected delegates, but Ron Paul will never speak at my convention.
41424cd6af20dec0ba099ad3209fff864a08d4be.zh: 我们最不需要的，就是罗恩·保罗这样的人占用大会宝贵的黄金时段转播。我们会让所有依法选出的代表就座，但罗恩·保罗绝不会在我的大会上演讲。

d8e44129c61896810ee515e984f9a18929a3f6f6.source: The law is the law. Elian belongs in Cuba with his father. These questions are never easy, but the Clinton Administration and Janet Reno did what they had to do.
d8e44129c61896810ee515e984f9a18929a3f6f6.zh: 法律就是法律。埃利安应当回到古巴，与父亲一起生活。这类问题从来不容易，但克林顿政府和珍妮特·雷诺做了他们必须做的事。

5e305f55f107c63684c36d140db2e26aefda185e.source: The leader of the conservative wing in the Republican Party, Barry Goldwater is perhaps the most controversial candidate nominated for the Presidency in recent memory. Goldwater has made his name on his staunch conservatism, arguing for Social Security reform, small government, and a halt to further civil rights legislation. However, as beloved by his supporters as Goldwater is, the moderate-liberal wings of the Republicans have no love lost for him- especially after the long, contentious primary that saw him narrowly defeat Nelson Rockefeller, and his self-damaging vote against the Civil Rights Act of 1964.
5e305f55f107c63684c36d140db2e26aefda185e.zh: 共和党、巴里·戈德华特 中的保守派领导人可能是近年来最具争议的总统提名候选人。 戈德华特 以其坚定的保守主义而闻名，主张 社会保障 改革、小政府和停止进一步的 民权 立法。然而，正如戈德华特一样受到他的支持者的喜爱，共和党的温和自由派并没有失去对他的爱——尤其是在他以微弱优势击败纳尔逊·洛克菲勒的漫长而有争议的初选之后，以及他在1964年对民权法案进行自我伤害的投票之后。

0b2d4ce71cf1d1bd36c3a661402bdf3fbff2e20e.source: The leadership of this country has been a disaster, and because of this many lies have been spread about me. I am the one who can fix our problems with trade, with ISIS, with Obamacare, and with many other issues.
0b2d4ce71cf1d1bd36c3a661402bdf3fbff2e20e.zh: 这个国家的领导层简直是一场灾难，也正因如此，关于我的谎言到处流传。只有我能解决贸易、“伊斯兰国”、奥巴马医改，以及许多其他方面的问题。

889429e418754817f95c11543e71065549187fb1.source: The left believes that any woman who doesn't agree with its radical agenda for America is a sellout. We know better. Sarah Palin was a very successful Governor, one of the most successful ever, really.
889429e418754817f95c11543e71065549187fb1.zh: 左翼认为，任何不赞同他们激进美国议程的女性都是叛徒。我们可不这么想。萨拉·佩林是一位非常成功的州长，真的，是有史以来最成功的州长之一。

482ef05d29112cdf10efa2448fcade614b97be2e.source: The legacy of this campaign depends on a couple of factors. First of all, did you receive 5% of the popular vote? If so, congratulations! You will enable the Green Party to run a vigorous campaign in 2004 and present a true choice to the American people. Also, the Democrats were a little peeved that you "stole" votes from them in this election. Hopefully that doesn't lead to a backlash.
482ef05d29112cdf10efa2448fcade614b97be2e.zh: 此活动的影响取决于几个因素。首先，你获得了5%的选票吗？如果是这样，恭喜你！您将使绿党在2004年开展一场轰轰烈烈的竞选活动，为美国人民提供一个真正的选择。另外，民主党对你在这次选举中“偷”了他们的选票感到有点恼火。希望这不会导致强烈抵制。

a37e640ab6f47cf662aaf71faf308d2abc2b8f99.source: The level of Mike Pence's social conservatism is certainly more than most Americans are familiar with.
a37e640ab6f47cf662aaf71faf308d2abc2b8f99.zh: 迈克·彭斯在社会议题上的保守程度，确实超出了大多数美国人所熟悉的范围。

e89c3fae66b1cc8d590564b07954ae098d48cd23.source: The level of disruption from globalization has simply been too much for American workers over the past few years. I don't support TPP, and there will be a pause on any new trade deals during my Presidency.
e89c3fae66b1cc8d590564b07954ae098d48cd23.zh: 过去几年，全球化给美国劳动者带来的冲击，实在过于严重。我不支持跨太平洋伙伴关系协定，担任总统期间，也会暂停任何新的贸易协议。

872ef1b1b54e5fbf0acc9cb146d1a1380322fa33.source: The liberal media would rather cover this kind of salacious gossip than focus on my record-low unemployment, booming economy, and incredibly successful foreign policy victories. We're too smart to play into their hands.
872ef1b1b54e5fbf0acc9cb146d1a1380322fa33.zh: 自由派媒体宁愿报道这种香艳八卦，也不关注我创纪录的低失业率、繁荣的经济，以及极其成功的外交胜利。我们很聪明，不会上他们的当。

3349b77ed07901140c11143a25f7ab24da5fecd5.source: The majority of white voters do not place police brutality as the cause of the long, hot summer. In terms of tradeoff, youth and black voters will turn out heavily for this fall.
3349b77ed07901140c11143a25f7ab24da5fecd5.zh: 多数白人选民不认为警察暴行是那个漫长炎热夏季的起因。作为交换，青年和黑人选民会在秋季踊跃投票。

54973c09f21142abcac6b959aec3f68374b66c83.source: The maximum duration of unemployment insurance, with all extensions factored in, has been reduced from 99 weeks. Do you think this is appropriate in the current economic climate?
54973c09f21142abcac6b959aec3f68374b66c83.zh: 即使计入所有延长期限，失业保险的最长期限也已经从99周缩短。你认为，在目前的经济环境下，这样做合适吗？

def6063d2a56cf0ad5f17a8cca90a47224ac11da.source: The media loves to do this kind of thing. They gush all over this Republican or that Republican. Then once they are on the national stage, suddenly you have a totally phony story. Last time it was Mitt. Sad!
def6063d2a56cf0ad5f17a8cca90a47224ac11da.zh: 媒体就喜欢干这种事。他们先对这个共和党人或那个共和党人大加吹捧，等这些人登上全国舞台，就突然冒出完全虚假的故事。上次轮到的是米特。真可悲！

678916543f98afe097524fadea2713d7ac556114.source: The media totally leaves out the part where I said the ban should be temporary, until we can figure out what's going on. But they want to paint me as some kind of bigot to further their liberal agenda for America.
678916543f98afe097524fadea2713d7ac556114.zh: 媒体完全不提我说过，禁令应该是暂时的，等我们弄清楚究竟发生了什么。但他们想把我描绘成某种偏执的歧视者，好推进他们在美国的自由派议程。

d31cc70f9bba5e81ed077a21bc07ddcd64ed87ee.source: The moneychangers of the temple duped (or bribed) Grover Cleveland into issuing gold bonds. While the rest of the country suffered in indignation, bankers like J.P. Morgan and the Rothschilds made off with millions.
d31cc70f9bba5e81ed077a21bc07ddcd64ed87ee.zh: 圣殿里那些兑换银钱的人，蒙骗了——或者收买了——格罗弗·克利夫兰，让他发行黄金债券。全国其他人忍受痛苦、愤愤不平时，J. P. 摩根和罗斯柴尔德家族这样的银行家却卷走了数百万。

991e202279182279ea0de0627f623c4a03ff4b72.source: The most fervent anti-war wing of the party cheers you on.
991e202279182279ea0de0627f623c4a03ff4b72.zh: 党内最坚定的反战派为你喝彩。

2e14b5a90324e354fb87479d3119e73386930a2e.source: The most important priority is to prevent the election of George W. Bush to President. I will not put my name on the ballot in any contested state. I expect that people in other places will see that a vote for me symbolizes a vote for a new kind of politics in the long term.
