2e14b5a90324e354fb87479d3119e73386930a2e.zh: 最重要的目标，是阻止乔治·W.布什当选总统。我不会在任何竞争激烈的州把自己的名字列上选票。我希望，其他地方的人能明白，从长远看，投我一票象征着支持一种新的政治。

31408f52bfb85bc1a28fc3bf284c992f5e64525b.source: The most important thing right now is to remember our heroes from 9/11. I will be making a number of campaign stops these next few days where I mention our veterans, and our other heroes.
31408f52bfb85bc1a28fc3bf284c992f5e64525b.zh: 现在最重要的是缅怀“9·11”中的英雄。未来几天，我会在若干场竞选活动中谈到我们的退伍军人，以及其他英雄。

ae2ef8521d48bb2dbc4fe5730c3860ceb6d4bf19.source: The most mainline Southerner among Wallace's options, Thurmond did well in his own right when running in 1948.
ae2ef8521d48bb2dbc4fe5730c3860ceb6d4bf19.zh: 作为 华莱士 选项中最主流的南方人，瑟蒙德 在 1948 年竞选时凭借自己的能力表现出色。

58213e9eb4610909c3b76d9a9672e450e774e489.source: The most prominent organization for promoting the US-Israel alliance, AIPAC seeks to further the close relationship, and is the most important and well-funded group in doing so.
58213e9eb4610909c3b76d9a9672e450e774e489.zh: 美国以色列公共事务委员会，是促进美以联盟的最知名组织，致力于深化两国密切关系，也是这方面最重要、资金最充裕的团体。

f8db92a14013612bd816f2bba13f457b37f4a5f0.source: The most recent data (for 2010) on Pell Grants indicate that 60% of all college students receive one. In that same year, the program cost $36 billion. What changes, if any, would you recommend to this program?
f8db92a14013612bd816f2bba13f457b37f4a5f0.zh: 关于佩尔助学金的最新数据，也就是2010年的数据，显示60%的大学生都领取了这项资助。同年，这项计划花费了360亿美元。你会建议怎样调整这项计划，还是维持原样？

1a4657b5c9b209ef952f3c52c83b518cd3aa47fd.source: The murders and rioting in America will be your first order of business, and more long term, the war on Vietnam. If both of those are dealt with, your silent majority will be pleased. Other than that, inflation must be dealt with, as well as the excess of Great Society. Good luck, and welcome back to the executive branch!
1a4657b5c9b209ef952f3c52c83b518cd3aa47fd.zh: 美国的凶杀与骚乱是你上任后首先要处理的问题；从更长远看，还有越南战争。如果两者都能解决，你的“沉默的大多数”就会满意。此外，你还得应对通货膨胀，以及“伟大社会”政策的过度扩张。祝你好运，欢迎重返行政部门！

e05bf50b60f644049b82cca504de048cdc63f301.source: The nation is not in the mood for more kids coming home in caskets.
e05bf50b60f644049b82cca504de048cdc63f301.zh: 全国上下都不想再看到更多年轻人躺在棺材里回家。

d2fb48f35ef90d23e7915efa7aae628eba4c86ea.source: The newer Fugitive Slave Law was the result of reasoned compromise in Congress. I may disagree with aspects of that Compromise, but I must accept it as a whole.
d2fb48f35ef90d23e7915efa7aae628eba4c86ea.zh: 新版《逃奴法》是国会经过理性妥协的产物。我可能不同意那项妥协的某些部分，但必须接受整体。

2e60390e58d95fc1ede99d0fc8bd0e157ce67858.source: The newly wed wife of your first son, Don Jr., Kimberly Guilfoyle is a passionate supporter of the campaign, and is sure to rile up the MAGA base.
2e60390e58d95fc1ede99d0fc8bd0e157ce67858.zh: 金伯利·吉尔福伊尔是你大儿子小唐纳德的新婚妻子，热情支持竞选，必定能点燃“让美国再次伟大”基本盘的激情。

7c1a290e830294adfba0f40a62f6fb377b62faf6.source: The newspapers are noting that you have emphasized your Union Army roots and drawn the lines clearly against Bryan's misplaced extremism.
7c1a290e830294adfba0f40a62f6fb377b62faf6.zh: 报纸注意到，你强调了自己在联邦军服役的经历，并与布赖恩不合时宜的激进主张划清了界限。

26c1003cce1910d0d1bb9b04fabdf0cceb847afd.source: The nomination battle was contentious, but progressives across the country have noticed your commitment.
26c1003cce1910d0d1bb9b04fabdf0cceb847afd.zh: 提名之争虽然激烈，但全国的进步派都注意到了你的坚持。

a7a54ca01571df68f59fc77701e09e6f8655ed09.source: The novelty of a personal visit from the "Great Commoner" could probably swing the West Coast states in your direction. However, it will take two weeks to travel and return via train.
a7a54ca01571df68f59fc77701e09e6f8655ed09.zh: “伟大平民”亲自访问的新奇可能会让西海岸各州转向你的方向。然而，乘火车往返需要两周时间。

4d29f8eff976509e76702f0150eca506e3d532cc.source: The only way we will end gun violence in this country is through large-scale legislation and the confiscation of troublesome weapons. The Second Amendment was never meant to apply to individuals.
4d29f8eff976509e76702f0150eca506e3d532cc.zh: 要结束我国的枪支暴力，唯一办法就是大规模立法，并没收带来问题的武器。第二修正案从来就不是针对个人的。

281c748799e58eaafe03a8f03322c55b8a1be0fd.source: The options you have for policy are quite open. Will you extend an olive branch to the Sanders supporters and pivot left, or will you stick to your centrist views and be a bipartisan president? Either way, you'll be very polarizing, so let’s hope you can calm down America after this campaign season.
281c748799e58eaafe03a8f03322c55b8a1be0fd.zh: 你在政策上有相当大的选择空间。你会向桑德斯的支持者伸出橄榄枝，转向左翼，还是坚持自己的中间派观点，做一位谋求两党合作的总统？无论怎样，你都会引发强烈的政治分歧。希望你能在这个竞选季之后，让美国平静下来。

4b5d889ef25753d9e2c0065cfbe26f167aeb8436.source: The options you have for policy are quite open. With your choice of Sanders as a running mate, you have sent a message about what you want to do during your term, so many expect some action on climate change and workers rights to come quickly, and with efficacy. Whatever you do, you'll be very polarizing, so let’s hope you can calm down America after this campaign season.
4b5d889ef25753d9e2c0065cfbe26f167aeb8436.zh: 你在政策上有相当大的选择空间。选择桑德斯做搭档，已经传达了你在任期内想做什么的信号，因此许多人期待你迅速而有效地推进应对气候变化与保障劳动者权利的措施。不论你做什么，都会引发强烈的政治分歧。希望你能在这个竞选季之后，让美国平静下来。

6d1d7935368382d99d8098b95d66195febde2946.source: The proper authority for enforcement rests with the federal government. This law goes further than federal laws and even if constitutional, should be repealed.
6d1d7935368382d99d8098b95d66195febde2946.zh: 这方面的执法权限应归联邦政府。这项法律超出了联邦法律的规定，即使合宪，也应该废除。

f2181722869c2184443be127caea2120996b5e89.source: The proper way for any Republican to balance the budget is through tariffs -- not through some radical change to the tax system.
f2181722869c2184443be127caea2120996b5e89.zh: 共和党人平衡预算的正确办法，是关税——不是激进地改变税制。

1c883885a0233fda66a281e8e57de5fe2ed11b43.source: The prospect of war with a backwards country such as Mexico should play no part in our calculations.
1c883885a0233fda66a281e8e57de5fe2ed11b43.zh: 与墨西哥这样一个落后国家开战的可能性，不应影响我们的盘算。

66e8cc2c8233bc0d592a0ef93f54d6c67f1a2ce8.source: The protests, when they get to a certain level, seem to help Trump more than hurt him. But many progressives don't like to hear you distance yourself like this.
66e8cc2c8233bc0d592a0ef93f54d6c67f1a2ce8.zh: 抗议达到一定程度时，似乎对特朗普帮助多于伤害。但许多进步派不喜欢听到你这样与抗议者划清界限。

a200243f27d5e89459eb1c23527a951524757d6c.source: The public is clamoring for more vigorous action after the death of several Americans at the hands of Pancho Villa.
a200243f27d5e89459eb1c23527a951524757d6c.zh: 数名美国人死于潘乔·比利亚之手，公众正强烈要求采取更有力的行动。

1098b670be7db5c8f2572853bbe7abafb4591e26.source: The public is surprised by the rather conservative tone of your acceptance, and so are luminaries such as Teddy Roosevelt.
1098b670be7db5c8f2572853bbe7abafb4591e26.zh: 你的接受提名演说语调颇为保守，让公众感到惊讶，泰迪·罗斯福等政界名人也是如此。

4e628d3e93c8afb941cf17389aab3cd7bdd5a949.source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. He will have 4 more years to slash inflation and defend his reputation. He will have to be cautious and show restraint, as you came close to beating him. He with have the public breathing down his neck and Watergate looming over him for his term.
4e628d3e93c8afb941cf17389aab3cd7bdd5a949.zh: 公众就是觉得你不能胜任。这是推出你这样一个华盛顿局外人参选的代价，而天平最终倾向了福特。他将再有四年时间降低通胀、捍卫声誉。他必须谨慎克制，因为你差点击败了他。整个任期，公众都会紧盯着他，水门事件也会如影随形。

a8f66be4bca0db864d0655b84e0dac8231dd6c84.source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. Lots of Democrats are incredibly angered that you could lose by such a margin, and are accusing you of throwing away the presidency with a single interview.
a8f66be4bca0db864d0655b84e0dac8231dd6c84.zh: 公众就是觉得你不能胜任。这是推出你这样一个华盛顿局外人参选的代价，而天平最终倾向了福特。许多民主党人对你竟输得如此惨烈极为愤怒，指责你凭一场采访就把总统宝座拱手丢掉了。

2b8f01bae19803036fa4b514eff31b0150a12912.source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. Many Democrats are wondering if Watergate might have affected the Republicans more than DC as a  whole, and more standard Democrats could have won this. certainly, your Playboy scandal makes them question nominating someone few people knew.
2b8f01bae19803036fa4b514eff31b0150a12912.zh: 公众就是觉得你不能胜任。这是推出你这样一个华盛顿局外人参选的代价，而天平最终倾向了福特。许多民主党人正在想：水门事件是否对共和党的伤害比对整个华盛顿更大，换一个更常规的民主党候选人是否就能获胜。你的《花花公子》风波，当然让他们怀疑提名一个鲜为人知的人是否明智。

78fa89fb236ab3ff2238d08b8ba67655fec77c3a.source: The other three candidates must find some way to prevent a Lincoln victory. In that case, the House of Representatives will choose.
78fa89fb236ab3ff2238d08b8ba67655fec77c3a.zh: 另外三名候选人必须设法阻止林肯获胜。若无人取得选举人票多数，总统将由众议院选出。

dfd26700b16739e7f2231745184594a49ea9e710.source: The pacifists in your party are revitalized by your acceptance speech.
dfd26700b16739e7f2231745184594a49ea9e710.zh: 你的接受提名演说让党内和平主义者重新振奋起来。

c63b6f7c2569bcefd1287f0c3ec3ecc7c196bb1b.source: The party has a little more of a nuanced position on this issue.
c63b6f7c2569bcefd1287f0c3ec3ecc7c196bb1b.zh: 民主党在这个问题上的立场，要更细致一些。

13853f46b4f12170e4558483d0f048535166858b.source: The passions of these times seem to be towards someone who is more righteous in their behavior. We should attack Clay's conduct, and especially in the Northeast.
13853f46b4f12170e4558483d0f048535166858b.zh: 当下的社会风气，似乎更倾向于支持品行端正的人。我们应当攻击克莱的品行，尤其是在东北部。

b268415050527a82e5da60ac5b7fdf225a2b7154.source: The peace talks collapsed on the final weekend before the election. Unfortunately, the news has also broken that you had something to do with it! Settle in to watch the returns, and pray that you can somehow pull this out...
b268415050527a82e5da60ac5b7fdf225a2b7154.zh: 和平谈判在选举前的最后一个周末破裂了。不幸的是，你与此事有关的消息也被曝光了！坐下来看计票结果吧，祈祷自己还能设法赢下来……

87399b08fad5677bdd9b227832d77c828bf441d7.source: The people who will elect you this fall are very much in favor of gun control. Try not to disappoint them.
87399b08fad5677bdd9b227832d77c828bf441d7.zh: 今年秋天会投票支持你的人，十分赞成枪支管制。尽量别让他们失望。

95e94aa9af8247a59d88db1048354450684e6fe9.source: The pill is not the biggest issue this election.
95e94aa9af8247a59d88db1048354450684e6fe9.zh: 避孕药不是这次选举中最重要的问题。

78014f0e5e42ff45b2927d16d493c01a3330f4ec.source: The political establishment on both sides got it dead wrong on Iraq. And now we have ISIS. I am the candidate who can destroy ISIS and radical Islamic terrorism!
78014f0e5e42ff45b2927d16d493c01a3330f4ec.zh: 两党的政治建制派在伊拉克问题上都错得离谱。现在我们又面对“伊斯兰国”。我才是能消灭“伊斯兰国”和激进伊斯兰恐怖主义的候选人！

9202d6f43d604172b6267c54f8900f324b195940.source: The poor man is called a socialist if he believes that the wealth of the rich should be divided among the poor, but the rich man is called a financier if he devises a plan by which the pittance of the poor can be converted to his use.
9202d6f43d604172b6267c54f8900f324b195940.zh: 穷人认为应该把富人的财富分给穷人，就被称为社会主义者；富人设计一个办法，把穷人仅有的一点钱挪为己用，却被称为金融家。

9cc97f43a1a59d89161239c0b0afd7ebbe94a4fa.source: The potential upside of this message is complicated by the controversy over Dan Quayle's National Guard service.
9cc97f43a1a59d89161239c0b0afd7ebbe94a4fa.zh: 丹·奎尔在国民警卫队服役的争议，使这番宣传可能带来的好处变得复杂了。

5f6b49f944ff245a44a83d72669cc8685d486c8c.source: The practice of hiring detectives from agencies like the Pinkertons is justified by the militancy and danger of the American labor movement.
5f6b49f944ff245a44a83d72669cc8685d486c8c.zh: 美国劳工运动如此激进而危险，企业雇用平克顿等机构的侦探，是有理由的。

3214c24882844d7330f909cee9e502e47d2ce29f.source: The primary purpose of our tariffs should be revenue. But should a small amount of protection
3214c24882844d7330f909cee9e502e47d2ce29f.zh: 我们关税的主要目的应该是收入。但应该少量保护

d532d333a1619b0bc17ca12cca3a045809da9806.source: The problem is, if we go negative against Carter, he's sure to hammer us on the Nixon pardon. We really have a lot to lose here.
d532d333a1619b0bc17ca12cca3a045809da9806.zh: 问题是，如果我们对卡特发动负面攻势，他肯定会拿赦免尼克松来猛攻我们。我们在这里确实有很大风险。

a647ccbc04aeebf6acdae26737b60b2681d606a7.source: The problem is, this idea was clearly targeted at Andrew Jackson, and Democrats in general. You're really taking the Whig position here.
a647ccbc04aeebf6acdae26737b60b2681d606a7.zh: 问题在于，这个主张显然是针对安德鲁·杰克逊和整个民主党的。你实际上采取了辉格党的立场。

1aece77ad523d3de417d45b122c55e56cf933f60.source: The riots outside of the convention hall are the eight-hundred pound gorilla in the room. You can't just ignore them.
1aece77ad523d3de417d45b122c55e56cf933f60.zh: 会场外的骚乱，是眼前那个谁都无法回避的大问题。你不能装作看不见。

98aba3d8239615b476a9635c49721c983bf55069.source: The risk with Huckabee is his potential to turn off moderate voters in swing states with religious pronouncements.
98aba3d8239615b476a9635c49721c983bf55069.zh: 赫卡比 的风险是他有可能通过宗教声明来关闭摇摆州的温和派选民。

6c04d19bb2b5b87dcb9424eeb066b825dd32147a.source: The selection of Dan Quayle as a running mate is deeply concerning, for what it says about Bush himself as much as anything.
6c04d19bb2b5b87dcb9424eeb066b825dd32147a.zh: 选择丹·奎尔作为竞选搭档，令人深感忧虑，其中很大一部分原因就在于，这反映了布什本人是什么样的人。

5fb116c2b9711fbfc1645388a75af2f8e024b9c0.source: The sexist liberal media continues to blame this phenomenal woman for lazy John McCain's implosion in 2008. When I win this election, the failing New York Times will see just how wrong they've been!
5fb116c2b9711fbfc1645388a75af2f8e024b9c0.zh: 充满性别歧视的自由派媒体，继续把懒惰的约翰·麦凯恩在2008年的惨败归咎于这位非凡女性。等我赢得选举，日渐衰败的《纽约时报》就会知道，他们错得有多离谱！

b66a2fd963530b1e13e10341d78544fd5c679090.source: The slavery issue is increasingly becoming a problem for the Whigs of the South, and there's no reason to give them a pass on it.
b66a2fd963530b1e13e10341d78544fd5c679090.zh: 奴隶制问题越来越令南方辉格党人头疼，没有理由在这个问题上放过他们。

a575c43489f1c81db4076a6e7e66515bbc0dbd11.source: The socialist Democratic Party is pushing for lockdowns at every opportunity. They will stop at nothing to exert their control over patriotic, hard-working American citizens and businesses. Not on my watch!
a575c43489f1c81db4076a6e7e66515bbc0dbd11.zh: 社会主义民主党一有机会就推动封锁。他们会不惜一切代价，控制爱国、勤劳的美国公民和企业。我执政时，休想！

ec0366688c7bb78face2dfe19fbd4ece18bc7cf3.source: The socialist angle is always effective, but the irony of Barry Goldwater calling anyone an extremist is not lost on many.
ec0366688c7bb78face2dfe19fbd4ece18bc7cf3.zh: 指责对手是社会主义者，向来有效，不过许多人也看得出，巴里·戈德华特居然指责别人极端，实在讽刺。

35a8474d26b320b8ec6cefbb9f92d65fc5b67a86.source: The standard-bearer of the conservative Republicans, Reagan can virtually assure a victory in California, where he presides as Governor. He has taken a firm stand against protests and disorder in that state and will reinforce Nixon's credibility as a champion of good order.
35a8474d26b320b8ec6cefbb9f92d65fc5b67a86.zh: 作为保守派共和党的旗手，里根 实际上可以确保他在担任州长的 加利福尼亚州 中获胜。他对该州的抗议和骚乱采取了坚定的立场，并将加强 尼克松 作为良好秩序捍卫者的信誉。

3c05ca314bd466f4571493adec1f1a133e4a5f0a.source: The state of Florida has a margin of victory under half a percent, and with the election hinging on its result, the recounts in the state are going to decide it. Every court option and legal procedure will be investigated by you and your opponent, so be ready for the long haul. Let’s hope this delay in fundamental democracy doesn't result in the unpreparedness of any critical governmental agencies. That would be truly terrible!
3c05ca314bd466f4571493adec1f1a133e4a5f0a.zh: 佛罗里达州 州的胜率不到 0.5%，选举结果取决于该州的重新计票结果。每个法庭选项和法律程序都将由您和您的对手进行调查，因此请做好长期准备。我们希望基本民主的延迟不会导致任何关键政府机构措手不及。那真是太可怕了！

ce5f0f8181650391513e3579f5b06e7e7bde98ff.source: The tactic of 'gunwalking' led directly to the death of a Border Patrol agent. If we see people breaking the law, it makes no sense not to punish them. I would support the removal of Eric Holder as Attorney General.
ce5f0f8181650391513e3579f5b06e7e7bde98ff.zh: “放枪追踪”手法直接导致了一名边境巡逻员死亡。既然发现有人违法，却不惩处，毫无道理。我会支持撤换司法部长埃里克·霍尔德。

d8962e6daab82f05ee23e486a47781787b5ccc2b.source: The tariff commission is supported by many moderates and businessmen.
d8962e6daab82f05ee23e486a47781787b5ccc2b.zh: 许多温和派和商人支持关税委员会。

ccab849df5af6190f0909867adc1092d9cf8efc7.source: The pundits might say this is crazy, but we're going to visit Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota. I think I can do four, maybe five rallies in one day. Maybe six.
ccab849df5af6190f0909867adc1092d9cf8efc7.zh: 评论人士也许会说这太疯狂了，但我们要去密歇根州、威斯康星州和明尼苏达州。我想一天能办四场，也许五场集会。说不定六场。

8f35b72823851a5633fa3165aa5b0067abdb77b4.source: The purpose of the Senate is to act as an objective legislative body. It is dangerous to tamper with the Constitutional provisions established by our founding fathers.
8f35b72823851a5633fa3165aa5b0067abdb77b4.zh: 参议院的作用，是成为一个客观的立法机构。随意改动建国先贤确立的宪法规定，是危险的。

7890ff7251d95ba4279b1d0290927ac7a1c2bfa2.source: The questions surrounding the so-called "Bridgegate" scandal and New Jersey aren't going away, and today Chris Christie snapped at a reporter over the issue. Was his behavior appropriate?
7890ff7251d95ba4279b1d0290927ac7a1c2bfa2.zh: 围绕新泽西州所谓“桥门”丑闻的疑问仍未平息，今天克里斯·克里斯蒂因这一问题对一名记者发了火。他的行为是否恰当？

36d6fdf2c169cf5cc60c1670e7f8d7319f1bf939.source: The rail strikes threw most of the country into fear and panic. They were pleased when Cleveland put an end to the madness.
36d6fdf2c169cf5cc60c1670e7f8d7319f1bf939.zh: 铁路罢工让全国大部分地区陷入恐惧和惊慌。克利夫兰结束了这场混乱，人们对此很满意。

d9f2705238f26c0abb79f59dbf34c81f502b7386.source: The railroad is a winning issue in the North. There's no reason to hold back here.
d9f2705238f26c0abb79f59dbf34c81f502b7386.zh: 铁路是能在北方赢得选票的议题，没有理由在这里有所保留。

cfef1cc5c61f36d047841c3d9973aca367b5e593.source: The reaction is not too good, overall. You quickly decide that Butz must go, but you got a couple days of embarrassing press first.
cfef1cc5c61f36d047841c3d9973aca367b5e593.zh: 总体而言，反应不太好。你很快决定巴茨必须离职，但在此之前，已经有了几天令人尴尬的报道。

c5a42a903175689e9d5fd6676c54c6704ea773a7.source: The reaction that occurred should terrify any thinking American. Entire neighborhoods were burned and pillaged. They even looted their own storekeepers in many cities.
c5a42a903175689e9d5fd6676c54c6704ea773a7.zh: 那样的反应，应让每个有头脑的美国人感到恐惧。整个街区被烧毁、洗劫。在许多城市，他们甚至抢劫了自己社区的店主。

f7d18cca0931ab66289fb8706e42d1b931ba2b70.source: The real crime here is what Donald Trump was doing, and we saw that with the impeachment proceedings. He shouldn't even be the President right now.
f7d18cca0931ab66289fb8706e42d1b931ba2b70.zh: 这里真正的罪行，是唐纳德·特朗普所做的事，我们在弹劾程序中已经看到了。他现在根本就不该再当总统。

27e611852890fa051354064059a5aad6c873ad4e.source: The reluctance of Bernie to endorse you after a couple of personal meetings fuels rampant speculation about the causes.
27e611852890fa051354064059a5aad6c873ad4e.zh: 几次私下会面后，伯尼仍不愿背书支持你，外界对原因的猜测因而四起。

61c2972a374b64ea5511ce9ac98ce732f9429e58.source: The respectable city newspapers are unanimously pro-McKinley. As such, William Randolph Hearst senses that supporting you would be a terrific business opportunity.
61c2972a374b64ea5511ce9ac98ce732f9429e58.zh: 受人尊敬的城市报纸一致支持麦金莱。因此，威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特 (William Randolph Hearst) 认为支持您将是一个绝佳的商机。

91216af8e12dc5806aea8fbb4b09fdf8e0b77aa9.source: The results are coming in, and the phone is ringing. You reach slowly into your drawer and pull out something you never thought you would use. The TV announcer drawls, "The biggest loser of tonight is Ralph Nader! Nader appears to have only received
91216af8e12dc5806aea8fbb4b09fdf8e0b77aa9.zh: 结果即将出来，电话响了。你慢慢地把手伸进抽屉，拿出一些你从未想过会用的东西。电视播音员慢吞吞地说：“今晚最大的输家是拉尔夫·纳德！纳德似乎只收到了

b281e0a60c7c0231560474f2cb4a3cc0016f7621.source: The right-wing media wants to present me as some kind of a gun-grabber, when that couldn't be further from the truth. My only crime is not parroting the NRA's every last word on this issue.
b281e0a60c7c0231560474f2cb4a3cc0016f7621.zh: 右翼媒体想把我描绘成某种要没收枪支的人，事实却完全相反。我唯一的“罪”，就是没有在这个问题上逐字鹦鹉学舌般地重复全国步枪协会的每句话。

e60b21efc5464f5f00cd19205862149178d4161e.source: The tax cuts for the rich will certainly be scaled back under your administration, as well as you will reduce military spending. With all this new money, perhaps social security can be expanded. Just watch the deficit, and you could get re-elected if you follow through with your competent persona.
e60b21efc5464f5f00cd19205862149178d4161e.zh: 你的政府肯定会缩减对富人的减税，也会减少军费开支。有了这笔新增资金，也许可以扩大社会保障。只要注意赤字，并兑现自己能干的形象，你就可能获得连任。

5a5383f58f636a7d035c297f8add9ed08a3b598c.source: The threat of a Southern schism has forced our hand. We must accept the protection of slavery in federal territories, and protect the instution in future states like Kansas and New Mexico.
5a5383f58f636a7d035c297f8add9ed08a3b598c.zh: 南方分裂的威胁，迫使我们作出选择。我们必须接受在联邦领地保护奴隶制，并在堪萨斯、新墨西哥等未来的新州维护这一制度。

c5504784f135b1d279ccaa50ddbadf98dee0831d.source: The titans of American industry were counting on you to put down this nonsense idea of free silver, and to protect them from the other whims of the populist Democrats. Your defeat will go down as one of the most ignominous in the history of American politics.
c5504784f135b1d279ccaa50ddbadf98dee0831d.zh: 美国工业巨头指望你能放下 自由铸银 这个无稽之谈的想法，并保护他们免受民粹主义民主党的其他异想天开的影响。你的失败将成为美国政治史上最耻辱的失败之一。

717abe07f60aec648faf83733ae2b1aa43bdc108.source: The trick with COVID is to strike a sensible compromise between slowing the spread of the disease, and protecting the health of the economy.
717abe07f60aec648faf83733ae2b1aa43bdc108.zh: 应对新冠的关键，是在减缓传播与保护经济健康之间，作出合理的折中。

6436566ddf8f0417fe43a73d387d9ab3425627c3.source: The truth is that Mike and I talked, and he's a great man, one of the best ever, and he decided is was time to focus on other priorities and leave a legacy for his family. And of course Nikki is great and we're thrilled to have her on the team.
6436566ddf8f0417fe43a73d387d9ab3425627c3.zh: 事实是，迈克和我谈过。他是个很棒的人，史上最出色的人之一。他决定，是时候关注其他优先事项，为家人留下一份遗产。当然，妮基很棒，我们很高兴她加入团队。

0de40c2e464a5bbef16b1c1849dc8ab74ef27531.source: The two parties are almost the same on every major issue. Neither supports meaningful campaign finance reform, universal health care, free college education, a peaceful foreign policy, or the protection of American workers. I present a true alternative to the American people.
0de40c2e464a5bbef16b1c1849dc8ab74ef27531.zh: 两党在每个重大议题上几乎都一样。两党都不支持有实质意义的竞选资金改革、全民医疗、免费大学教育、和平的外交政策，或保护美国劳动者。我为美国人民提供真正的替代选择。

6841368e015c31249c421032232ff87d63bfd577.source: The unemployment rate is currently under 4%, in spite of the chaos that prevails in our nation. What will you do as president to keep unemployment low?
6841368e015c31249c421032232ff87d63bfd577.zh: 尽管我国混乱不堪，目前失业率仍低于4%。担任总统后，你会做些什么，以保持低失业率？

4e5420aa2c14beb6df8388f5348c10222f06b8c5.source: The unemployment rate right now is under four percent. Workers, particularly those in labor unions, enjoy high purchasing power and an ever-expanding lifestyle. Economic growth throughout the 1960s has been outstanding.
4e5420aa2c14beb6df8388f5348c10222f06b8c5.zh: 目前失业率低于4%。劳动者，尤其是工会成员，拥有很强的购买力，生活水平也不断提高。整个60年代的经济增长都非常出色。

ea561e7d65b0c2c86ee2620242ae39c771767d8a.source: The unemployment rate won't stay low for long if we continue to pass new regulations on housing, mining, and industrial concerns. I speak for the working man when I say that we need to get the federal government out of these areas.
ea561e7d65b0c2c86ee2620242ae39c771767d8a.zh: 如果我们继续给住房、采矿和工业企业增添监管，低失业率就维持不了多久。我代表劳动者呼吁：联邦政府必须退出这些领域。

02e8ed3645338c203feaf7285d9cf281cac4b99a.source: The upper Midwest is key. I will start in Iowa, travel through Wisconsin, and end up in Michigan.
02e8ed3645338c203feaf7285d9cf281cac4b99a.zh: 中西部北部是关键。我会从艾奥瓦州出发，途经威斯康星州，最后到密歇根州。

8c462af26c22bbfca9e88b81e73fe768264e933f.source: The use of injunctions is a favored court tactic for union busting and it must stop. I support the right of striking workers to picket their workplace while on strike.
8c462af26c22bbfca9e88b81e73fe768264e933f.zh: 法院喜欢用禁令来打击工会，这种做法必须停止。我支持罢工工人在罢工期间，到工作场所设置纠察线的权利。

c8432b55a60ba30611a43b2660f23db75ba68d9b.source: The vitality and way of life in our country is under constant attack from Communism. I support any measure which combats that ideology.
c8432b55a60ba30611a43b2660f23db75ba68d9b.zh: 共产主义不断攻击我国的活力和生活方式。我支持任何对抗这种意识形态的措施。

4bfe16a7015c3896ee4f6ab1503b09ff8a3f3d87.source: The voice seems strained. Your vision suddenly clears. You are in a white room. As your eyes trail sluggishly around the room, you notice something strange. There are a series of glass pods lining the sides of the room. In each pod, there is a person inside each, with every person having some form of cap on their head.
4bfe16a7015c3896ee4f6ab1503b09ff8a3f3d87.zh: 声音似乎很紧张。你的视野突然变得清晰。你在一个白色的房间里。当你的目光缓慢地扫视房间时，你注意到了一些奇怪的事情。房间的两侧排列着一系列玻璃吊舱。每个吊舱里都有一个人，每个人的头上都戴着某种形式的帽子。

821b05fdedbbf956376f2d272edc3488df5baa6c.source: The voters are confused because you used your time in Congress to fight
821b05fdedbbf956376f2d272edc3488df5baa6c.zh: 选民们很困惑，因为你利用在国会的时间来进行斗争

349a2e6b0d0da200b1087bbb1a0785e0dcfa6231.source: The water level of Lake Mead (the reservoir near Hoover Dam) has been steadily dropping in recent years. Should the Bureau of Reclamation regulate the use of this water more strictly?
349a2e6b0d0da200b1087bbb1a0785e0dcfa6231.zh: 米德湖，也就是胡佛水坝附近的水库，近年水位持续下降。垦务局是否应该更严格地管理这些水资源的使用？

71aa610b8421932e768c752ae411e2a5c25ea754.source: The way our current President has been kowtowing to the repressive leaders of Cuba is a disgrace. It really is.
71aa610b8421932e768c752ae411e2a5c25ea754.zh: 我们现任总统向古巴那些压制民众的领导人卑躬屈膝，实在是耻辱，真的。

519a453125f9ef205ab5d195b10b22c883323492.source: The wife of your second son, Eric, Lara Trump was a former TV producer for Inside Edition, and could bolster the campaign's efforts blanketing the airwaves.
519a453125f9ef205ab5d195b10b22c883323492.zh: 拉拉·特朗普是你二儿子埃里克的妻子，曾任《内幕版》电视节目的制作人，可以加强竞选团队覆盖广播电视媒体的攻势。

0bffaacf4df2c6a54c2ab39f0d8e9ef658f3ce2c.source: The word of the Lord demands that we give our attention to the poor, the sick, and the feeble. This campaign is not about me -- I am a mere servant of Christ.
0bffaacf4df2c6a54c2ab39f0d8e9ef658f3ce2c.zh: 上帝的话语要求我们关怀贫穷、患病和衰弱的人。这场竞选不是为了我自己——我只是基督的仆人。

2cf014bffe6286ebcaf14149cef8e45540dfcf36.source: The worst of all worlds is to equivocate on such a central issue of the times. People of all persuasions doubt your motives, while the Democrats are making hay with this issue.
2cf014bffe6286ebcaf14149cef8e45540dfcf36.zh: 对这样一个时代核心议题含糊其辞，只会两头不讨好。各种立场的人都怀疑你的动机，而民主党人正借此大做文章。

1dee385af86f7be9061565092b2b02b6e160786a.source: The worst thing we can do right now is to sabotage the progress we have seen by continuing to squander our money on a war in Vietnam. I support a full employment economy as well -- meaning we must be vigilant against misguided attempts to raise interest rates.
1dee385af86f7be9061565092b2b02b6e160786a.zh: 眼下，我们最不该做的，就是继续把钱浪费在越南战争上，破坏已经取得的进步。我也支持充分就业的经济，因此必须警惕那些错误的加息企图。

c71ff55a70eacac141de98ec99dab130c7e67009.source: There are gold men and there are silver men. Compromise on this issue does not fit into the mood of the moment, especially since this represents a change in position from your silver advocacy.
c71ff55a70eacac141de98ec99dab130c7e67009.zh: 有人支持金本位，也有人支持自由铸银。当下的气氛容不得在这个问题上妥协，何况，这还意味着你改变了原先拥护白银的立场。

f2d6b009f5d6bf29bf3bd45c24cc1448f189f9d3.source: There are gold men and there are silver men. Compromise on this issue does not fit into the mood of the moment.
f2d6b009f5d6bf29bf3bd45c24cc1448f189f9d3.zh: 有人支持金本位，也有人支持自由铸银。在当下的气氛中，就这个问题妥协并不合时宜。

93b171de8f8ba78ad44a21723e40d5d923268369.source: There are individuals in this country working for less than a dollar a day. Only through desperation would a man ever consent to such an arrangement.
93b171de8f8ba78ad44a21723e40d5d923268369.zh: 在我国，有人每天挣的钱还不到一美元。只有走投无路的人，才会接受这种待遇。

bf2facb19ef0d1a39ea2b48670074a8a3f0aa784.source: There are legitimate concerns about the Clinton Foundation. Are your conflicts of interest any less concerning? This is the immediate counterattack from Dems.
bf2facb19ef0d1a39ea2b48670074a8a3f0aa784.zh: 人们对克林顿基金会确有合理的担忧。可你自己的利益冲突就不值得担忧吗？这便是民主党人的即时反击。

13521ee36c4f4a1f45f47903605dfb2653d3d685.source: There are no good options in Syria. We need to continue our support for the moderate rebels, and we need to defeat ISIS wherever they appear. I also support extensive aid and funding to countries that are bearing the brunt of the refugee problem.
13521ee36c4f4a1f45f47903605dfb2653d3d685.zh: 在叙利亚，没有什么好选择。我们需要继续支持温和派反对武装，并在“伊斯兰国”出现的任何地方击败它。我也支持向承受难民问题主要压力的国家提供广泛的援助和资金。

4a9d7851c368186ce20fe6adf6a767f183037792.source: There are plenty of other issues like radical Islamic terrorism, our terrible trade deals, and many others that I want to focus on in this campaign.
4a9d7851c368186ce20fe6adf6a767f183037792.zh: 在这场竞选中，我还想聚焦许多其他议题，比如激进伊斯兰恐怖主义、糟糕的贸易协议，等等。

4c8d61d3bc71383957682e48ab4a05cc723ac392.source: There are plenty of ways we can strengthen this system by reducing the role of government within it. For example, younger Americans should have the option to invest in personal health accounts.
4c8d61d3bc71383957682e48ab4a05cc723ac392.zh: 减少政府在这一体系中的作用，有很多办法能让它更健全。例如，年轻的美国人应该可以选择把钱投入个人医疗账户。

063d4eaaec9707b98dc66564a6265b94667b7abe.source: There are pros and cons to embracing Bernie so closely.
063d4eaaec9707b98dc66564a6265b94667b7abe.zh: 如此密切地拥抱伯尼，有利也有弊。

f70678210f8b2d20a4d34e653002ef59b17e6ce8.source: There are some attacks about this meeting, but it could also help keep German-Americans in the fold.
f70678210f8b2d20a4d34e653002ef59b17e6ce8.zh: 有人抨击这次会见，但它也可能有助于留住德裔美国人的支持。

c28b9e7b42be54a93f8a283f11105fc0c2948658.source: There are some guffaws, but you are enough of a mountebank in the first place that you might come out ahead on this deal.
c28b9e7b42be54a93f8a283f11105fc0c2948658.zh: 有人大笑嘲讽，不过，你本来就够像个江湖骗子了，这笔交易也许反而能让你占点便宜。

5afc0ad0cc932f888109fe38f40e282fc4d912b7.source: There are some legitimate complaints behind these abhorrent actions. I will work for peace in Vietnam and civil rights in the United States. In the meantime, I support the rights of university administrators as they combat this problem.
5afc0ad0cc932f888109fe38f40e282fc4d912b7.zh: 这些令人厌恶的行为背后，也有一些合理诉求。我会推动越南和平和美国民权事业。与此同时，我支持大学管理者有权处置这一问题。

eea24126fa7bb1cb4e8d6bb0ab637f283f5b6bd3.source: There are some very bad things happening right now. The last eight years have been a disaster for this country.
eea24126fa7bb1cb4e8d6bb0ab637f283f5b6bd3.zh: 现在发生着一些非常糟糕的事。过去八年，对这个国家是一场灾难。

9800f87c666ef406a9d877d253a70b3cd7500300.source: Theodore Frelinghuysen has served as a Senator from New Jersey, and as Mayor of Newark. He is known as something of an evangelist, being involved in numerous bible societies and advocating for moral uplift. Associates of Frelinghuysen have voiced anti-Catholic sympathies, however. His selection would help with nativists, but exacerbate the Whigs' problems with the Catholic vote. Southerners with a long memory also recall his loud opposition to the Indian Removal Act.
9800f87c666ef406a9d877d253a70b3cd7500300.zh: 西奥多·弗里林海森 曾担任 新泽西州 的参议员，并担任纽瓦克市市长。他被认为是一位福音传教士，参与了众多圣经社团并倡导道德提升。然而，弗里林海森 的同事表达了反天主教的同情。他的选择将有助于本土主义者，但会加剧天主教投票中的辉格党人问题。记忆深刻的南方人还记得他曾大声反对《印第安人迁移法案》。

03c678cbe1a723e58d9132057f33e970c2435e33.source: Theodore Roosevelt is hitting the campaign trail hard this fall. However, he continues to make bellicose speeches about the war in Europe. Will you attack Roosevelt and Hughes for this?
03c678cbe1a723e58d9132057f33e970c2435e33.zh: 今年秋天，西奥多·罗斯福正在四处大力竞选助阵，却仍不断就欧洲战争发表好战言论。你会因此攻击罗斯福和休斯吗？

60b563900abbdee2a990419b8963ab3c320012b4.source: Theodore Roosevelt is hitting the campaign trail hard this fall. However, he continues to make bellicose speeches about the war in Europe. Will you distance yourself from his rhetoric?
60b563900abbdee2a990419b8963ab3c320012b4.zh: 西奥多·罗斯福今年秋季正积极投入竞选活动，但仍不断就欧洲战争发表好战言论。你会与他的说法划清界限吗？

7279efdb1bfa650ef9430cdd1fa13193a59a0f48.source: There are a few unwanted rumors out there that you and Obama don't totally get along. Unless you wanted those to leak out?
7279efdb1bfa650ef9430cdd1fa13193a59a0f48.zh: 外头有几条令人不快的传闻，说你和奥巴马并不完全合得来。除非，那正是你想让人听到的消息？

9d9bf352b168aafb499e2b7567f556f0f8f4547f.source: There are a lot of angles you can attack from, but for the most part people are happy with Johnson's programs. You'd do better targeting the Democrats on the war or the incessant rioting.
9d9bf352b168aafb499e2b7567f556f0f8f4547f.zh: 你可以从许多角度进攻，但总体而言，人们对约翰逊的各项计划还是满意的。拿战争或没完没了的骚乱来攻击民主党，效果会更好。

d182c92c878888d2951265856bd7d4c80f338973.source: There are a lot of places in America where men like that kind of thing. We will win the Yankee Puritan vote in any case.
d182c92c878888d2951265856bd7d4c80f338973.zh: 美国有不少地方的男人都喜欢这类活动。反正，北方清教徒的选票我们都会拿到。

c93f7837fa73684fdabda6e538993394730b57e2.source: There are a number of attacks which focus on your fondness for horse-racing, drinking, gambling, female conversation, and the like. Do you have a response to this?
c93f7837fa73684fdabda6e538993394730b57e2.zh: 有人不断攻击你对赛马、饮酒、赌博、与女性闲谈等活动的喜好。对此，你有什么回应？

a07fecdb09dde08333a28e63bb4fa046ee9763c8.source: There are better ways to help the poor among us.
a07fecdb09dde08333a28e63bb4fa046ee9763c8.zh: 帮助贫困者，还有更好的办法。

bef89b5833eaa06778fd6a4453c766c71459b27b.source: There are certainly rumblings of discontent with the scientific establishment, but your best path to reelection probably consists in handling COVID well.
bef89b5833eaa06778fd6a4453c766c71459b27b.zh: 确实有人对科学界表达不满，但你连任的最佳路径，大概还是妥善处理疫情。

0c959d42538b02d8f7ed510eca1ef258df79111f.source: There are definitely some murmurs about what you mean by this.
0c959d42538b02d8f7ed510eca1ef258df79111f.zh: 确实有人在私下议论，你这番话究竟是什么意思。

f57f12d7553ae311907f35b91d00c5bca840a6ee.source: There are enough concrete problems for you to focus on. It seems like a bit of a detour to attack liberalism as a theory, instead of focusing on your own solutions.
f57f12d7553ae311907f35b91d00c5bca840a6ee.zh: 你有足够多的具体问题可以集中火力。攻击自由主义理论，而不聚焦自己的解决办法，似乎有点绕远了。

d569f00bc90c71c5bef596261312d1356f4b354b.source: There are some very serious questions out there about her stamina. And another thing, her people lied about this whole incident until that video came out. Notice how Hillary has barely been campaigning at all the last few weeks?
d569f00bc90c71c5bef596261312d1356f4b354b.zh: 外界对她的体力有一些非常严肃的疑问。还有，她的人一直在这件事上撒谎，直到视频曝光。注意到了吗，希拉里过去几周几乎都没怎么竞选？

e2effabe414b1adeeb2fb7d300249358e4d673b0.source: There are some whispers that you have caved to the Southern wing of the party and done little to advance a child labor law.
e2effabe414b1adeeb2fb7d300249358e4d673b0.zh: 有些人私下议论，说你向党内南方派系屈服，几乎没有为推动童工立法做什么。

5c5536c16ce5a65c36c85b844b03ab0f004155c9.source: There are too many competitive states around the nation. To keep our entire party engaged, I pledge to visit all 50 states during this campaign.
5c5536c16ce5a65c36c85b844b03ab0f004155c9.zh: 全国有太多竞争激烈的州。为了让整个政党都积极参与，我承诺在这次竞选中访问全部50个州。

d0ce78096015be06cf5e354218866d9d085937f1.source: There has already been considerable reform of the stock markets since the dangerous days of the 1860s. There's no need to take this idea any further.
d0ce78096015be06cf5e354218866d9d085937f1.zh: 自1860年代那些危险的日子以来，股票市场已经历了相当多的改革。没有必要再推进这个主意了。

d6e5ae82abc4f93963326fedfdac01f8088190da.source: There has been a coordinated, violent terrorist attack on Berlin today, resulting in the death of at least 100 people. How will you address this?
d6e5ae82abc4f93963326fedfdac01f8088190da.zh: 今天，柏林发生了一起协同实施的暴力恐怖袭击，造成至少100人死亡。你会如何回应？

60cd85762881aa5e3e564c80569b741cfac5d8c5.source: There has been a coordinated, violent terrorist attack on London today, resulting in the death of at least 100 people. How will you address this?
60cd85762881aa5e3e564c80569b741cfac5d8c5.zh: 今天，伦敦发生了一起协同实施的暴力恐怖袭击，造成至少100人死亡。你会如何回应？

794d466c286f69c695344313e3c86525eda26566.source: There has been a deafening silence for many years on the issue of equal rights in the South. It's time we had a true enforcement of the 14th and 15th Amendment.
794d466c286f69c695344313e3c86525eda26566.zh: 多年来，南方的平等权利问题一直被令人窒息的沉默笼罩。我们该真正执行第十四和第十五修正案了。

2be17dab79ca446feccd5033846309e7bc94e33c.source: There has been a lot of debate in your party on this issue, but allowing each state to make their own decision is a good compromise, right?
2be17dab79ca446feccd5033846309e7bc94e33c.zh: 党内对这个问题一直有大量争论，但让各州自行决定，是个不错的妥协，对吧？

73a05e1c99847281f8adf72b6dd6db524d1aed03.source: There has been a proposal for a series of television debates between you and Kennedy. Is this something you are interested in?
73a05e1c99847281f8adf72b6dd6db524d1aed03.zh: 有人提议安排你与肯尼迪举行一系列电视辩论。你对此有兴趣吗？

9653682802beac8e54f7d3e22b73d83d4fcc040d.source: There has been a total abdication of responsibility in this country over the past five years. The riots in Detroit and Newark are simply the final straw in what we can accept. I will crack down severely on disorder and nominate judges who will overturn atrocious decisions such as
9653682802beac8e54f7d3e22b73d83d4fcc040d.zh: 过去五年来，这个国家完全放弃了责任。底特律和纽瓦克的骚乱简直是压垮我们所能接受的最后一根稻草。我将严厉打击骚乱，并提名法官推翻诸如此类的残暴决定

8c91084ae28342404100ab9bba1fb9b705fd9025.source: There has been a violent terrorist attack in Nice today, resulting in the deaths of almost 100 people. How will you address this?
8c91084ae28342404100ab9bba1fb9b705fd9025.zh: 今天，尼斯发生了一起暴力恐怖袭击，造成近100人死亡。你会如何回应？

600b2f76ad2638f6d2882e7d4d258853e3e0ad8a.source: There has been an increase in Asian-American hate crimes in 2020, along with the rise of COVID and some of your inflammatory statements (such as Kung-flu!). What do you have to say on this topic?
600b2f76ad2638f6d2882e7d4d258853e3e0ad8a.zh: 2020年，随着新冠疫情蔓延，以及你的一些煽动性言论，比如“功夫流感”，针对亚裔美国人的仇恨犯罪增加。你对此要说些什么？

6e8680b5349f372f221bf38966f74a0c8272d317.source: There is a need for some level of subsidies, but what we have now is too much.
6e8680b5349f372f221bf38966f74a0c8272d317.zh: 某种程度的补贴是必要的，但现在给得太多了。

3e025a0485ad83fddc7bb3abcfc17dd9530fdf9f.source: There is absolutely a danger of this happening. That's why we have a National Flood Insurance Program which provides strict guidelines on where people are permitted to build.
3e025a0485ad83fddc7bb3abcfc17dd9530fdf9f.zh: 这种风险确实存在。因此，我们设立了全国洪水保险计划，严格规定哪些地方可以建房。

41fcdec0d646e446f5e23b990bfbca27e3d4b9ba.source: There is definitely some sniping between yourself and Roosevelt, but you may also hold the more popular position.
41fcdec0d646e446f5e23b990bfbca27e3d4b9ba.zh: 你和罗斯福之间确实出现了互相挖苦的情况，但你的立场也许更受欢迎。

cfca1eb881dd19a4fd5c4bfbf01d625ca512926e.source: There is far more we can do. Jobs training programs and a continued fight against discrimination will ensure that all Americans can share in the low unemployment rate.
cfca1eb881dd19a4fd5c4bfbf01d625ca512926e.zh: 我们还能做得更多。职业培训项目和持续反对歧视的努力，会让所有美国人都能分享低失业率带来的好处。

fb957aeb1ca8ecac99b90ae1db145b6568b730f5.source: There is no denying that this answer helps you with the anti-war crowd, but it also exposes you to a lot of attacks.
fb957aeb1ca8ecac99b90ae1db145b6568b730f5.zh: 毫无疑问，这个回答有助于你争取反战群体，但也让你面对大量攻击。

70ef0521e548cb738c46365aedebdaf4598cb9bb.source: There is no one more capable and thoughtful whom we've talked to than Elizabeth Warren. She understands the issues that this country faces, and how to be an effective leader in addressing them.
70ef0521e548cb738c46365aedebdaf4598cb9bb.zh: 在我们谈过的人选中，没有谁比伊丽莎白·沃伦更有能力、更深思熟虑。她了解这个国家面临的问题，也懂得如何有效地领导大家解决这些问题。

29e836893add653835426f54bb44b217f7642fa5.source: There is no time for that diversion. Heaven knows what rumors McKinley will spread while I am gone, and winning the Midwest should be our primary focus.
29e836893add653835426f54bb44b217f7642fa5.zh: 没有时间这样分心了。天知道，我不在的时候，麦金莱会散布什么谣言。拿下中西部，应当是我们的首要目标。

baa276174ccccc33139f49f9f662c25f79807971.source: There is nothing I'm more proud of from my time in Congress than creating the conditions that allowed for a booming tin industry to flourish within our borders.
baa276174ccccc33139f49f9f662c25f79807971.zh: 我在国会任职期间，最引以为豪的，就是创造了条件，让本国的镀锡板产业蓬勃发展。

66e29c1d43edf604952122c7f0fce7177a2ee7bb.source: There is one week left until election day. Every state is important, but where will you give an extra push with what is left of your financial resources to educate the American voters?
66e29c1d43edf604952122c7f0fce7177a2ee7bb.zh: 离投票日还有一周。每个州都很重要，但你会把剩余经费用在哪里，加大宣传力度，向美国选民阐明立场？

bde7a3422dbe48a461e12f78232bb60390ca9a69.source: There is one week left until election day. Every state is important, but where will you give an extra push with your personal campaigning to swing the final results?
bde7a3422dbe48a461e12f78232bb60390ca9a69.zh: 离投票日还有一周。每个州都很重要，但你会亲自在哪里加大竞选力度，争取左右最终结果？

ee9da1060a581a985f886e643db8c115fda7b352.source: There is only one choice in this election. Donald Trump is so unqualified, and vastly offensive to our ideals, that his election could be an existential disaster for the nation. I am the safe, responsible alternative who will take our country forward.
ee9da1060a581a985f886e643db8c115fda7b352.zh: 这次选举只有一个选择。唐纳德·特朗普如此缺乏资格，又如此严重地冒犯我们的理想，他的当选可能给国家带来生存层面的灾难。我是稳妥而负责任的另一选择，会带领国家前进。

369979774f084f9aca62c47973e9b4214de099c5.source: There is plenty to attack Trump on, but it seems odd to hear a sitting President take such a negative line during one of their final moments in the spotlight.
369979774f084f9aca62c47973e9b4214de099c5.zh: 特朗普有很多地方可以攻击，但一位现任总统在最后几次备受瞩目的时刻之一，采取如此负面的论调，听起来有点奇怪。

b4dcb01e985ae674932f12551a0f3cf95d488f30.source: There has been an increase in Asian-American hate crimes in 2020, along with the rise of COVID and the inflammatory statements of Trump. What do you think about this?
b4dcb01e985ae674932f12551a0f3cf95d488f30.zh: 2020年，随着新冠疫情蔓延和特朗普发表煽动性言论，针对亚裔美国人的仇恨犯罪增加。你对此有什么看法？

8f37b6cba2a93fb793044db69c9b2b26cbea152e.source: There have been a large number of sit-ins recently, where black students and activists are sitting at whites-only lunch counters and department stores to advocate for desegregation. Do you support this movement?
8f37b6cba2a93fb793044db69c9b2b26cbea152e.zh: 最近发生了大量静坐抗议，黑人学生和活动人士坐在仅供白人使用的简餐柜台及百货商店中，要求废除种族隔离。你支持这个运动吗？

dc459faa973c4721de9908a9f9e82acca290c008.source: There have been some interesting investigations into this that the American people should look into. But my focus now, we have the economy, China, and so many of these other issues.
dc459faa973c4721de9908a9f9e82acca290c008.zh: 这件事有一些值得关注的调查，美国人民应该看看。不过，我现在关注的是经济、中国，以及许多其他问题。

7e2824ad53c120e2f66a7a424c13ff48130a335e.source: There have been some terrible decisions made by the Court. We might consider some measures to make the court more accountable to the popular will.
7e2824ad53c120e2f66a7a424c13ff48130a335e.zh: 法院作出过一些糟糕的裁决。我们可以考虑一些办法，使法院更受民意约束。

84920149f7f6d9e1e8130dfc5acd2923fb06cac3.source: There have recently been riots and armed clashes between nativists and Irish immigrants in Philadelphia and elsewhere. Do you have any plans to condemn the Irish violence in these episodes?
84920149f7f6d9e1e8130dfc5acd2923fb06cac3.zh: 最近，费城等地的本土主义者与爱尔兰移民之间发生了暴乱和武装冲突。你是否准备谴责这些事件中爱尔兰人的暴力行为？

3d1ad2b69374606a06d01e2cfb3ab0a89215d998.source: There have recently been riots and armed clashes between nativists and Irish immigrants in Philadelphia and elsewhere. Do you have any plans to condemn the nativist violence in these episodes?
3d1ad2b69374606a06d01e2cfb3ab0a89215d998.zh: 最近，费城等地的本土主义者与爱尔兰移民之间发生了暴乱和武装冲突。你是否准备谴责这些事件中本土主义者的暴力行为？

c8724c79f62f8450099e413a8515d863fce75101.source: There is a burgeoning textile industry in the Upper South. Their success depends on cheap cotton, protection, and an absence of destabilizing labor issues.
c8724c79f62f8450099e413a8515d863fce75101.zh: 南方北部地区的纺织业正蓬勃发展。它的成功有赖于廉价棉花、贸易保护，以及没有破坏稳定的劳资问题。

3923d09ee6cbb5fbb7bbbf4ddc45192d60a850d6.source: There is a certain element of conservatism in the southern states. I don't think that their temperament aligns with that of Bryan. I will simply repeat the message that he is a radical.
3923d09ee6cbb5fbb7bbbf4ddc45192d60a850d6.zh: 南方各州多少具有保守倾向。我不认为它们的性情与布赖恩合拍。我只需反复强调，他是个激进分子。

2a78774a6a75a715d84d3ad0735be26a32e33e4f.source: There is a cynicism in our poorest neighborhoods engendered by poverty and by the brutality of the police. I will vigorously address both of these issues when I'm elected.
2a78774a6a75a715d84d3ad0735be26a32e33e4f.zh: 在最贫困的社区，贫困和警察的暴行让人们对一切都失去了信任。我当选后会大力解决这两个问题。

1b2a9b94b453a409e2a95b61552aa7f8fb8463b1.source: There is a danger of 'teaching to the test'. We do need some testing in place, but to do so on an annual basis is too frequent and interferes with good educational practice.
1b2a9b94b453a409e2a95b61552aa7f8fb8463b1.zh: 存在“为了考试而教学”的危险。我们确实需要一些测试，但每年都考太频繁，也妨碍了良好的教学实践。

a62141c8df03fb9589b118cda11be8de8783e775.source: There is a lot more to jurisprudence than someone's belief on a small aspect of the abortion issue. My goal will be to appoint to most qualified judges available.
a62141c8df03fb9589b118cda11be8de8783e775.zh: 法学远不止一个人对堕胎问题某个小方面的看法。我的目标是任命能找到的最合格法官。

5e6c193cb571c6d0ca3628c97ce0826b99211a50.source: There is some chatter about whether these crowds you're drawing signify anything. You're the underdog for sure, but maybe you're on to something.
5e6c193cb571c6d0ca3628c97ce0826b99211a50.zh: 有人议论，你吸引来的这些人群究竟意味着什么。你无疑处于劣势，但也许你真的找到了突破口。

78651659072cb50e62fd2db091b527dc6ad9ddd2.source: There is some gossip from California that the popular Governor, Hiram Johnson, feels deeply snubbed by your recent visit, and he hasn't been shy about expressing that opinion.
78651659072cb50e62fd2db091b527dc6ad9ddd2.zh: 加利福尼亚州传出一些议论：颇受欢迎的州长海勒姆·约翰逊觉得，你最近的来访严重怠慢了他，而且他毫不掩饰这种不满。

58dafbcb21e8aeb6036abbe3b82b344b8cd343be.source: There is still a large anti-war, anti-imperialist group within the Democratic Party, and they view this stance as a betrayal.
58dafbcb21e8aeb6036abbe3b82b344b8cd343be.zh: 民主党内仍有一大批反战、反帝国主义人士，他们认为这个立场是背叛。

5afa19ff836eb2190b7daca91c213941d5a73e76.source: There is still conservative opposition to the Federal Reserve, but even that wing of the party is divided on the issue.
5afa19ff836eb2190b7daca91c213941d5a73e76.zh: 保守派仍有人反对联邦储备制度，但就连党内这一派在此事上也存在分歧。

79462bf9dfb41eadd379a3c9d225407265969f56.source: There is still some hope that the nations of Europe would accept the United States as a mediator, and that a peaceful solution could be found to the current war.
79462bf9dfb41eadd379a3c9d225407265969f56.zh: 人们仍抱有一线希望：欧洲各国或许会接受美国调停，为当前的战争找到和平解决办法。

886406ed78cfb37558c475f4fd6a2cf29e6917dd.source: There is talk of a Presidential Debate for the first time since 1960. Is this something that you're interested in doing?
886406ed78cfb37558c475f4fd6a2cf29e6917dd.zh: 有人提出举行自1960年以来首次总统辩论。你有兴趣参加吗？

1bc0790f76396fc0d60d772f302486a1a3cb6537.source: There may be a method to your madness, but if you're going to go all the way out West, why not stay for a few days and build some real enthusiasm?
1bc0790f76396fc0d60d772f302486a1a3cb6537.zh: 你这番看似疯狂的举动，也许自有道理。不过，既然大老远跑到西部，为什么不多留几天，真正激起些热情？

4d69ae2e09488ad63f6ae8021c7bb95ade24ea33.source: There may be differences between our wings of the party, but we must remember that we are all Republicans, and we stand united in our common goals.
4d69ae2e09488ad63f6ae8021c7bb95ade24ea33.zh: 党内各派也许有分歧，但我们必须记住，大家都是共和党人，都为共同的目标团结奋斗。

904a72fe44a7e3f0c8fab838594723df7fbc12c2.source: There might be a market for anti-globalization views in these states, but they also might be very close on election night. Will left-wing voters risk a vote on you instead of Gore?
904a72fe44a7e3f0c8fab838594723df7fbc12c2.zh: 这些州可能有人认同反全球化观点，但选举之夜的结果也可能十分接近。左翼选民会冒险投你，而不是戈尔吗？

edfa7febeadadb8f3c2b516f9ba3aadb0b55ab96.source: There might have been a better line of attack to take.
edfa7febeadadb8f3c2b516f9ba3aadb0b55ab96.zh: 也许本可以选择一条更好的进攻路线。

38aae65a0e0c32532875cd49414c767861faba55.source: There should be a federal program to cover any shortfall when a homeowner is forced to sell for less than the value of their mortgage.
38aae65a0e0c32532875cd49414c767861faba55.zh: 如果房主被迫以低于所欠按揭金额的价格出售房屋，就应该设立联邦计划，补足差额。

f051b5b7621bddabbaab85688753a5e0e4826111.source: There should be a public insurance company offering health care to all Americans. Private insurers are simply too greedy and too likely to turn down people with pre-existing health conditions.
f051b5b7621bddabbaab85688753a5e0e4826111.zh: 应该设立一家公共保险机构，为所有美国人提供医疗保障。私人保险公司实在太贪婪，也太容易拒绝有既往病史的人。

02d19e4d43b3ce66db5ceac4df256c9c42fd126b.source: There should be increased safety requirements, and greater measures against illegal ownership by criminals. Sportsmen should be allowed to own handguns for personal use.
02d19e4d43b3ce66db5ceac4df256c9c42fd126b.zh: 应该提高安全要求，并加强打击犯罪分子非法持枪的措施。射击运动爱好者应该可以持有手枪供个人使用。

16fe077a222fefbb8cc43124344e315b291648c9.source: There should not be a limit on how many terms a President can serve. This is why we have an election every four years -- to gauge the will of the American people.
16fe077a222fefbb8cc43124344e315b291648c9.zh: 总统能任职多少届，不应受到限制。我们每四年举行一次选举，就是为了检验美国人民的意愿。

01bca4c37833f48588e798818d4c9c9973a77bd5.source: There shouldn't be limits on the duration of unemployment insurance. This program is the only thing supporting many displaced workers, and the economic benefits of unemployment insurance are also beyond dispute.
01bca4c37833f48588e798818d4c9c9973a77bd5.zh: 失业保险的领取期限不应该设上限。许多失业工人全靠这项计划维持生活，而且失业保险的经济效益也无可争辩。

67d1278c018056f9960756f0d64876ed1c79b6ae.source: There was a mass shooting at a gay nightclub in Orlando overnight, perpetrated by a Muslim, resulting in 50 people killed. What is your reaction?
67d1278c018056f9960756f0d64876ed1c79b6ae.zh: 昨夜，奥兰多一家同性恋夜总会发生大规模枪击案，凶手是一名穆斯林，造成50人死亡。你有什么反应？

104dacafcc68eddd8c75d03aafb941e3964dba31.source: There was a recent effort in Congress to pass a program to provide medical care to elderly Americans, but it was narrowly defeated. Will you make a further push for this type of program as President?
104dacafcc68eddd8c75d03aafb941e3964dba31.zh: 国会最近尝试通过一项为美国老年人提供医疗保障的计划，但以微弱差距遭到否决。作为总统，你会继续推动这类计划吗？

e2d04ad7ba626f19b25e008f2e90afd6cfbff31d.source: There were some rumors that you might replace Mike Pence as your running mate this year. What made you decide to keep him on board?
e2d04ad7ba626f19b25e008f2e90afd6cfbff31d.zh: 有传闻说，你今年可能更换迈克·彭斯这位搭档。是什么让你决定留下他？

5b67b58e21cb04d710c576f4ecf7bcad33b9ff56.source: There would be no increase in the deficit if the Supreme Court hadn't overturned the income tax.
5b67b58e21cb04d710c576f4ecf7bcad33b9ff56.zh: 如果最高法院没有推翻所得税，赤字就不会增加。

6f70ff5e6aa5f6827d25cd16a3e10e3c81435619.source: There's a certain panache to this answer that farmers find appealing.
6f70ff5e6aa5f6827d25cd16a3e10e3c81435619.zh: 这番回答有一种洒脱劲儿，很讨农民喜欢。

0a23cb05c442ef23012154d73fbc3aea2a4b876b.source: There's a consensus from both sides that the top tax rate is too high. Your answer definitely puts you on the liberal end of the debate.
0a23cb05c442ef23012154d73fbc3aea2a4b876b.zh: 双方都认为，最高税率过高。你的回答无疑把你放在了争论中偏自由派的一端。

ce21df80f6f5d1877e2fae2f07ee91ab515ad1ca.source: There's a list of 20 federal judges that I will promise to make appointments from? If that will make Ted Cruz endorse me, it seems like a small price to pay.
ce21df80f6f5d1877e2fae2f07ee91ab515ad1ca.zh: 有一份二十名联邦法官的名单，要我承诺从中提名人选？如果这样能让特德·克鲁兹背书支持我，那看来代价很小。

2ce3a633c7a2867fac9a15b3284eaaa4a1f13084.source: There's a lot of confusion over your change of heart.
2ce3a633c7a2867fac9a15b3284eaaa4a1f13084.zh: 你改变心意，让大家很困惑。

27aa10c98b882477a8db7916db2a6286122e2a71.source: There's a terrific video out there -- have you seen it? It's just Hillary Clinton being on both sides of every issue for almost ten minutes. And remember when we thought John Kerry was a flip-flopper?
27aa10c98b882477a8db7916db2a6286122e2a71.zh: 有一段很棒的视频——你看了吗？足足快十分钟，全是希拉里·克林顿在每个议题上两面下注。还记得我们曾经觉得约翰·克里反复无常吗？

7f902e1da73cbd7b66cd2dab0225f407201d44b2.source: There's absolutely no evidence that Hunter Biden did anything inappropriate in this case, the other side is putting forward debunked conspiracy theories to the contrary.
7f902e1da73cbd7b66cd2dab0225f407201d44b2.zh: 没有任何证据表明，亨特·拜登在这件事上有不当行为。对方提出的相反说法，都是已被驳倒的阴谋论。

2d9068230d39bde921da00e467c7589b539307e5.source: There's absolutely no evidence that masks do anything to stop coronavirus. Even Dr. Fauci said so -- he changed his mind because he hates me, by the way -- but he was clearly saying masks do not help against coronavirus. Look it up!
2d9068230d39bde921da00e467c7589b539307e5.zh: 没有任何证据表明，口罩对阻止冠状病毒传播有用。连福奇医生都这么说过——顺便说，他后来改口，是因为他讨厌我——但他当时明确说，口罩对冠状病毒没用。自己查查！

e2f02d5aa979a72dbbb75c28b2da093a586d3695.source: There's an element of truth in this statement, and also grumblings of discontent from progressives.
e2f02d5aa979a72dbbb75c28b2da093a586d3695.zh: 这番话有几分道理，但进步派中也出现了不满的议论。

0d743450a3318c49f2d62cd93804aafc930a73c2.source: There's been a lot of talk from your camp about cutting spending to reduce the growing inflation, what programs would you have in mind?
0d743450a3318c49f2d62cd93804aafc930a73c2.zh: 你的阵营一直在谈削减开支，以降低不断上升的通胀。你具体想削减哪些项目？

a5d24c6748df325f991b57c499bdd691a6f18d2c.source: There's certainly nothing wrong with this answer -- it is a little cautious however.
a5d24c6748df325f991b57c499bdd691a6f18d2c.zh: 这番回答当然没什么问题，不过确实有点谨慎。

dc2fb7a04f6e38edab9ac75baee5dc894a76c21f.source: There's just one problem with this idea -- Confederate veterans will never accept money from the Federal government. Since they deem this idea to be an exercise in humiliation, I am left with no choice but to oppose it myself.
dc2fb7a04f6e38edab9ac75baee5dc894a76c21f.zh: 这个主意只有一个问题：邦联军老兵绝不会接受联邦政府的钱。他们认为这是在羞辱自己，因此，我也别无选择，只能反对。

c4029efa73d80e62b00e2fe2c5ae707313aa262a.source: There's no harm in keeping a low profile during this campaign.
c4029efa73d80e62b00e2fe2c5ae707313aa262a.zh: 在这次竞选中保持低调，没有什么坏处。

5b90fccff562755a572a261f8681a1dc87fea179.source: There's no need to talk about Andrew Jackson at this point. Let's focus on Texas and other issues of our current time, rather than rehashing the battles of a decade ago.
5b90fccff562755a572a261f8681a1dc87fea179.zh: 现在没有必要谈论安德鲁·杰克逊。让我们把重点放在得克萨斯等当前议题上，不要重提十年前的纷争。

8c983ce583df93fcaf9c912e583f2017f7078187.source: There's no reason not to focus your record with Dwight Eisenhower. People like him, and you served under him for eight years.
8c983ce583df93fcaf9c912e583f2017f7078187.zh: 没有理由不强调你与德怀特·艾森豪威尔共事的政绩。人们喜欢他，你也在他手下任职了八年。

7e1aee5e7271ed27642676681f2b74f992d6b33e.source: There's no reason not to take an opportunity when you're given one.
7e1aee5e7271ed27642676681f2b74f992d6b33e.zh: 机会送上门，没有理由不抓住。

bbae52cbd4d1f234a157a04360d83ad926e9c7e0.source: There's no reason to equivocate on the Oregon issue. People want aggressive action there.
bbae52cbd4d1f234a157a04360d83ad926e9c7e0.zh: 没有理由在俄勒冈问题上含糊其辞。人们希望在这里采取强硬行动。

54e62d68ee016697624ba51201e389b0f37b93aa.source: There's no reason to hold back here -- Cassius Clay has put his cousin in a very awkward position.
54e62d68ee016697624ba51201e389b0f37b93aa.zh: 这里没有必要手下留情——卡修斯·克莱已经让他的亲戚陷入了十分尴尬的处境。

eace43c29074a52a9c590a1dc0d2cee8225064ed.source: There's no reason to say anything that will make life awkward for Van Buren. You need a united party.
eace43c29074a52a9c590a1dc0d2cee8225064ed.zh: 没有必要说些让范布伦难堪的话。你需要一个团结的政党。

28e726487ccbd17b63cfdd8b0dcf5653a4591470.source: There's no right or wrong answer -- just be aware that your support will take a small hit in the rest of the country as you tour the isolated West Coast.
28e726487ccbd17b63cfdd8b0dcf5653a4591470.zh: 没有对错之分；只要记住，当你巡访偏远的西海岸时，其他地区的支持会略有下降。

eeefafda8f528ececddc92938e435135a1139aaf.source: There's no way I can compete with Bryan's oratorical talents. Instead, I will receive groups of visitors at my home in Canton, Ohio. We have the financing to pay for these visits, and anyone who shows up will receive a free sandwich while I deliver a speech.
eeefafda8f528ececddc92938e435135a1139aaf.zh: 我无法与布赖恩的演说才华较量。相反，我会在俄亥俄州坎顿的家中接待一批批来访者。我们有钱支付这些访问的费用；我发表演说时，到场的人都能免费领一份三明治。

a241772aac4468fcb79a59b7ed0a2124e74aa30a.source: There's no way that the United States should be shipping money overseas to support a European-model welfare state. That would be the height of lunacy.
a241772aac4468fcb79a59b7ed0a2124e74aa30a.zh: 美国绝不应该把钱送到海外，去维持欧洲式福利国家。那简直荒唐到了极点。

91ae98acef9a86e5716e0986ef05c0b1b4c9d298.source: There's not a dime's worth of difference between the Democrats and Republicans. My goal is to win this election outright.
91ae98acef9a86e5716e0986ef05c0b1b4c9d298.zh: 民主党和共和党的差别，连一角钱都不值。我的目标，是直接赢下这场选举。

791647a92d60cc7ca5777779c6f7053de2d7dcec.source: There's not much to be gained by commenting on the Clintons or inserting yourself into New York politics.
791647a92d60cc7ca5777779c6f7053de2d7dcec.zh: 评论克林顿夫妇，或把自己卷入纽约政坛，并没有多少好处。

ec7d22dd432f3e075f02d5a6263a851d8084159d.source: There's not much you can add to the Beltway flap du jour.
ec7d22dd432f3e075f02d5a6263a851d8084159d.zh: 对于华盛顿政坛今天又闹出的这场风波，你也没什么可补充的。

ce33eb4db57e4a37d6848c73c7b73d0951bbcac4.source: There's not much you can do but apologize and deflect, but polls are definitely swinging towards Hillary Clinton in the aftermath of this video.
ce33eb4db57e4a37d6848c73c7b73d0951bbcac4.zh: 除了道歉和转移注意力，你能做的并不多。不过，这段视频曝光后，民调确实在向希拉里·克林顿倾斜。

0c6e316cd69447971d2409c829822fdcc39a8329.source: There's not much you can do but apologize and deflect, but supporters admire your pugnacious spirit in response to this.
0c6e316cd69447971d2409c829822fdcc39a8329.zh: 除了道歉和转移注意力，你能做的并不多。不过，支持者很欣赏你对此表现出的好斗精神。

8188f323cb2b3e42908bd82192c4825abd6a6ba3.source: There's nothing in this decision which contradicts my own ideas on slavery. Slavery can hardly thrive in a territory where the residents oppose the practice, regardless of the Court's abstractions on the issue.
8188f323cb2b3e42908bd82192c4825abd6a6ba3.zh: 这项判决与我对奴隶制的观点并不矛盾。无论法院对此作出怎样抽象的论断，奴隶制都很难在居民反对它的领地兴盛起来。

de67e57b3c1586a577d2f0aa90963399d7ad0fb9.source: There's nothing the Republicans can do about it, but at least you have the moral victory of a strong statement against injustice.
de67e57b3c1586a577d2f0aa90963399d7ad0fb9.zh: 共和党对此无能为力，但至少，发表有力声明反对不公，让你在道义上赢了一局。

20147948bfcb5a4a38efefc79b64260fd0728aa3.source: There's nothing wrong with attacking the Republicans, but you also have a legitimate, positive record of accomplishment you could focus on.
20147948bfcb5a4a38efefc79b64260fd0728aa3.zh: 抨击共和党没有什么不妥，但你也有实实在在的政绩，可以作正面宣传。

4471f370c3b81d5c2b80b76b84e7e686d8c003e0.source: There's nothing wrong with calling out a little personal loyalty.
4471f370c3b81d5c2b80b76b84e7e686d8c003e0.zh: 强调一点个人忠诚没有什么不对。

5696a81680621da54ca0811d10149a53631032f5.source: There's nothing wrong with campaigning in the Midwest.
5696a81680621da54ca0811d10149a53631032f5.zh: 在中西部竞选，没有什么不妥。

a8988ff1ef3490d911983ed2075656996b5d146d.source: There's nothing wrong with defending the current system, which is the Democratic system in large part.
a8988ff1ef3490d911983ed2075656996b5d146d.zh: 为现行制度辩护并无不妥；这套制度在很大程度上正是民主党的产物。

a98f0976a49bcc0563b0924cac45eb1c512970de.source: There's nothing wrong with embracing Barack Obama this fall.
a98f0976a49bcc0563b0924cac45eb1c512970de.zh: 今年秋天，积极支持贝拉克·奥巴马没有什么不对。

d73c967701905745b1b28c8406b23463f6ea5513.source: There's nothing wrong with finding other issues to press forward on.
d73c967701905745b1b28c8406b23463f6ea5513.zh: 另找议题展开攻势，没有什么不妥。

98a8b13bf0f8758af695a3cf4e2c4a1fa9831dfb.source: There's nothing wrong with keeping the discussion focused on Texas.
98a8b13bf0f8758af695a3cf4e2c4a1fa9831dfb.zh: 把讨论重点放在得克萨斯，没有什么不妥。

753ab598b20930a4bcbb7aad674e7635ea37c981.source: There's nothing wrong with playing it safe.
753ab598b20930a4bcbb7aad674e7635ea37c981.zh: 谨慎行事，没有什么不妥。

4c84f41f1ce7ffe357c78c16611b6cac4dfcd235.source: There's nothing wrong with pointing to a positive record of accomplishment.
4c84f41f1ce7ffe357c78c16611b6cac4dfcd235.zh: 强调自己的积极政绩，没有什么不妥。

c66038fd0900ea5450da1018e3f735aeb20753e9.source: There's nothing wrong with postponing judgment on this issue.
c66038fd0900ea5450da1018e3f735aeb20753e9.zh: 暂缓对这个问题作出判断，没有什么不妥。

5a2eeca92c2b179e5d48cb04e37be05d6b2ff603.source: There's nothing wrong with singing the praises of Obama.
5a2eeca92c2b179e5d48cb04e37be05d6b2ff603.zh: 赞扬奥巴马，没有什么不妥。

5d6814ddfb9078fd2b2c0ba9fa94f21adb3c0172.source: There's nothing wrong with sticking to the usual program.
5d6814ddfb9078fd2b2c0ba9fa94f21adb3c0172.zh: 坚持通常的竞选安排，并没有什么不妥。

bbf5bdfb2ef3fd019c008fc3fc18fc7bde0f50dc.source: There's nothing wrong with taking this position.
bbf5bdfb2ef3fd019c008fc3fc18fc7bde0f50dc.zh: 采取这个立场没有什么问题。

5f045773ff14faa596a71dde3be174472b789337.source: There's nothing wrong with this choice.
5f045773ff14faa596a71dde3be174472b789337.zh: 这个选择没有什么问题。

d3847f694b6c400b1c7a0c4036342c9f8cb7a65b.source: There's nothing wrong with this response.
d3847f694b6c400b1c7a0c4036342c9f8cb7a65b.zh: 这个回答没有什么问题。

183eb1e24e4122d35a67c18588bf46098630072e.source: There’s a lot of blame being thrown around the Democratic Party, and almost all of it is directed at you. To blow such a commanding polling lead is almost unheard of- indeed, some whisper that you intentionally sabotaged your campaign, as ridiculous as this may be. No matter the reason, your political career is over. Best read up on Thomas Dewey.
183eb1e24e4122d35a67c18588bf46098630072e.zh: 民主党周围有很多指责，几乎所有的指责都是针对你的。打破如此压倒性的民调领先优势几乎是闻所未闻的——事实上，有人私下说你故意破坏你的竞选活动，尽管这可能很荒谬。不管出于什么原因，你的政治生涯已经结束了。最好阅读托马斯·杜威。

ab1bd04a17df20f9aef1b03eade5659501dd2b6b.source: These activists are trespassing on the property of lawful businesses. I think there are better methods of pushing for change in the South.
ab1bd04a17df20f9aef1b03eade5659501dd2b6b.zh: 这些活动人士擅自进入合法商家的场所。我认为，要推动南方的改变，有比这更好的办法。

7e484439256e4622679025d6003dce2e565d64b0.source: These agreements are bad because they favor the rights of countries like China and Mexico over those of the United States. I support foreign trade, but I do not support the surrender of America's rights and sovereignty.
7e484439256e4622679025d6003dce2e565d64b0.zh: 这些协定不好，因为它们偏袒中国和墨西哥等国的权利，损害美国的权利。我支持对外贸易，但不支持放弃美国的权利和主权。

2a151cf21ce83b8fbb4da25e51c0f236f0aed2c3.source: These are desperate, slanderous attacks from the Goldwater camp. I hardly knew either of these two men when I was in office, and I trust that the legal system will handle this situation with competence and tact.
2a151cf21ce83b8fbb4da25e51c0f236f0aed2c3.zh: 这些是戈德华特阵营绝望之下发起的诽谤攻击。我任职时与这两人都没多少交往，相信司法系统会妥善、审慎地处理此事。

d4d60df052b9a5c069a0207b59a05e4b98f5b372.source: These are good motives, but the spoils system has been in decline for years. Most voters are more worried about finding work and regaining prosperity.
d4d60df052b9a5c069a0207b59a05e4b98f5b372.zh: 出发点不错，但政党分赃制多年来已日渐衰退。多数选民更在意找到工作、恢复繁荣。

7ce30698ad4c37d64d0ee894a7b0e0d75e26ccc2.source: These are good points to bring up on the campaign trail.
7ce30698ad4c37d64d0ee894a7b0e0d75e26ccc2.zh: 这些都是值得在竞选中强调的观点。

5c64c2d0a2a2d10ed28f761ce30cb305e01b981f.source: These are good points to bring up, and they seem to really move the crowds as you travel the nation.
5c64c2d0a2a2d10ed28f761ce30cb305e01b981f.zh: 这些观点很值得强调。在全国巡回演说时，它们似乎真的打动了听众。

3a1429127aa3eac1325dc1f8c8f9a3e156719bea.source: These are good themes to address in your campaign.
3a1429127aa3eac1325dc1f8c8f9a3e156719bea.zh: 这些都是适合在竞选中强调的主题。

748fbfac7c5b27da30d84a53e1c308287111ea43.source: These are impressive demonstrations, but we shouldn't read too much into them when drafting our policy. The majority of Americans are against military involvement in Europe.
748fbfac7c5b27da30d84a53e1c308287111ea43.zh: 这些示威声势浩大，但我们制定政策时，不应过度解读。大多数美国人反对在欧洲采取军事行动。

6b5c00895f65aade02a478771131c65e0b544b52.source: These are odd talking points for a New Deal Democrat. A few supporters are really scratching their heads today.
6b5c00895f65aade02a478771131c65e0b544b52.zh: 作为新政派民主党人，提出这些主张很奇怪。今天，一些支持者确实感到摸不着头脑。

fe59ad3390605f2f66a183190cfb9fff4d0f4d95.source: These are perfectly reasonable measures to take that will save lives in the midst of a global pandemic. It's a shame that Republicans, including Trump's Postal Service head, are willing to undermine this process so brazenly.
fe59ad3390605f2f66a183190cfb9fff4d0f4d95.zh: 这些措施完全合理，可以在全球疫情中挽救生命。共和党人，包括特朗普任命的邮政部门负责人，竟愿意如此公然地破坏这一过程，实在遗憾。

21fa613c94c5007b70e2afa4fcd860ad1554d5e3.source: These organizations and agreements are a scheme to enrich corporations at the expense of the American worker. Employment and wages will plummet while corporate profits expand.
21fa613c94c5007b70e2afa4fcd860ad1554d5e3.zh: 这些组织和协定，是牺牲美国劳动者、让企业发财的图谋。就业和工资将暴跌，企业利润却会增长。

92feaefeb32e41d3383126ce3d29c0f9899aeff2.source: These parades show that there is, indeed, a great national enthusiasm for American action in the world.
92feaefeb32e41d3383126ce3d29c0f9899aeff2.zh: 这些游行表明，全国确实热烈支持美国在世界上有所作为。

18233318d99d501635d80bf745ae4d06b280e9f5.source: These programs should only aid the truly needy. It seems like the criteria is a little loose to me.
18233318d99d501635d80bf745ae4d06b280e9f5.zh: 这些计划应该只帮助真正有需要的人。我觉得，资格标准有点宽松。

472b574ff75b7f8ecd47a48fac63502f25527d2a.source: These states have to be won to win the election.
472b574ff75b7f8ecd47a48fac63502f25527d2a.zh: 要赢得选举，就必须赢下这几个州。

3872b38e9dfcbf3d23067935a649350dc451b595.source: These stories are absolutely false. I never used illegal drugs and those who say I did are completely mistaken.
3872b38e9dfcbf3d23067935a649350dc451b595.zh: 这些说法完全是假的。我从未使用过非法毒品，说我吸过毒的人完全弄错了。

87b43af730088dbd2b24648ca3b60ad42867c068.source: These subsidies were well-intentioned, but I think that solar and wind have more long-term potential.
87b43af730088dbd2b24648ca3b60ad42867c068.zh: 这些补贴出于好意，但我认为，太阳能和风能的长期潜力更大。

c974d5f992668094106b3f8b3cb3c4efa3f4b37a.source: These types incidents will happen when the federal government's due process Amendments fail to account for the innate differences among the citizens of the South.
c974d5f992668094106b3f8b3cb3c4efa3f4b37a.zh: 联邦政府有关正当法律程序的宪法修正案，没有考虑到南方公民之间天生的差异，这类事件因此会发生。

481f5a1d9335cf133dda91c2d82c20ce0f4545ee.source: These types of attack ads are meant to distract from the real issues in this campaign. We won't dignify them with a response.
481f5a1d9335cf133dda91c2d82c20ce0f4545ee.zh: 这类攻击广告，是想转移人们对这场竞选实质问题的注意力。我们不会回应，抬举这种手段。

de8b43a478bc3d80d9ab9ca8569c19841f03dfbf.source: These types of bailouts support big government, big labor machine politics at the expense of everyone else. There's no way I would support this kind of deal.
de8b43a478bc3d80d9ab9ca8569c19841f03dfbf.zh: 这类救助拿其他所有人的利益，去供养大政府和大工会的政治机器。我绝不会支持这种交易。

0bce479d15e6012ec1db4c47437caac644fab507.source: These types of stories should be irrelevant to a political campaign. We've all done things when we were young that we're not proud of.
0bce479d15e6012ec1db4c47437caac644fab507.zh: 这类说法不应与竞选有关。我们年轻时都做过一些并不引以为豪的事。

f437323fe90538c121283ce89764884793372e5a.source: These were poorly thought out positions, and we will highlight that, but we should spend most of the campaign focusing on my own merits.
f437323fe90538c121283ce89764884793372e5a.zh: 这些立场考虑不周，我们会突出这一点，但竞选的大部分时间还是应该强调我自己的长处。

7571212e8e994667376420e585edfabf29382137.source: These will absolutely work. The condition of the indigent classes in this country is appalling.
7571212e8e994667376420e585edfabf29382137.zh: 它们绝对会奏效。这个国家贫困阶层的处境实在令人震惊。

c3d295b20b83d97fb9f3bf0a4e36a32eea00041e.source: These workers were very well paid in comparison to the average person in their area. I don't see a problem with what Apple is doing.
c3d295b20b83d97fb9f3bf0a4e36a32eea00041e.zh: 与当地一般人的收入相比，这些工人的薪酬相当不错。我看不出苹果的做法有什么问题。

e5c1403f61d5116efdfa07652bf1b6923c40a23c.source: They already regulate it too strictly in my opinion. Water should be much cheaper in the Southwest.
e5c1403f61d5116efdfa07652bf1b6923c40a23c.zh: 在我看来，他们管得已经太严了。西南部的用水应该便宜得多。

d45e9ade525b5651fe9a57e3b465c389cab9708b.source: They are absolutely necessary. Farmers are not in a good position to bargain for their crops, and any economic weakness in that sector can easily cause a recession in the broader economy.
d45e9ade525b5651fe9a57e3b465c389cab9708b.zh: 它们绝对必要。农民在农产品交易中处于不利的议价地位，这个行业一旦疲弱，很容易导致整体经济衰退。

ad7c790386e618e4d39dffa6d30ff2413e61d79a.source: These are the same people who said my campaign was hopeless and gave me terrible advice for the last year and a half. Not too smart!
ad7c790386e618e4d39dffa6d30ff2413e61d79a.zh: 就是这帮人，过去一年半一直说我的竞选没希望，还给我出馊主意。真不怎么聪明！

b45bf5f86a577facf3bb259fc9565b84e544de60.source: These are the types of radical abolitionist measures which have caused so many problems in our politics. The federal law takes precedence.
b45bf5f86a577facf3bb259fc9565b84e544de60.zh: 这些激进的废奴主义措施，已经给我们的政治生活带来了太多问题。联邦法律具有优先效力。

7f0715954d342640466e09521c06955f87bed95f.source: These attacks are wrong and they should prosecuted to the full extent of the law. At the same time, we need more answers from China. Millions of lives and trillions of dollars have been lost, yet they continue to block any serious investigation into the origins of this virus.
7f0715954d342640466e09521c06955f87bed95f.zh: 这些袭击是错的，应依法严厉追诉。同时，我们需要中国给出更多答案。数百万生命、数万亿美元已经损失，他们却继续阻挠任何对病毒起源的认真调查。

7240944a77b47e9434d3c34ed8c447d300b659c7.source: These banks would have never grown so large in the first place without colluding with the federal government. They only exist now because of a corrupt and possibly unconstitutional bailout.
7240944a77b47e9434d3c34ed8c447d300b659c7.zh: 如果没有与联邦政府勾结，这些银行一开始就不可能膨胀到这么大。它们如今还能存活，只是靠一场腐败、甚至可能违宪的救助。

092e941c9780187d9dff2ea1ff76650999b1be99.source: These debates will expose Donald Trump as woefully unprepared and unqualified to assume the position of President. I am eagerly looking forward to participating.
092e941c9780187d9dff2ea1ff76650999b1be99.zh: 这些辩论会暴露出，唐纳德·特朗普完全没有准备好，也没有资格担任总统。我热切期待参加。

491c931533edba3a0232c669ccbba676fa137f92.source: These groups have a right to free speech, but Goldwater is neither a Klan member nor a Bircher.
491c931533edba3a0232c669ccbba676fa137f92.zh: 这些团体享有言论自由，但戈德华特既不是三K党成员，也不是伯奇协会成员。

eed2ddc598e938f6e6fc3657ef06de36eac859a8.source: These measures are a step in the right direction. Nothing destroys so many lives in this country as does the pernicious habit of drinking alcohol.
eed2ddc598e938f6e6fc3657ef06de36eac859a8.zh: 这些措施迈出了正确的一步。在我国，没有什么比酗酒恶习毁掉更多人的生活。

b9f9244314bc991ec2022efd3a74b5c558263a57.source: These men are Americans and they are attempting to bring badly-needed order to the islands of Hawaii. If managed properly, an annexation will allow us to enjoy the benefits of Hawaii's innumerable sugar plantations. These islands are also a perfect location for a naval base.
b9f9244314bc991ec2022efd3a74b5c558263a57.zh: 这些人是美国人，正努力为夏威夷群岛带去急需的秩序。如果处理得当，吞并能让我们享受到当地无数甘蔗种植园的好处。这些岛屿也是海军基地的绝佳地点。

4b64076d671d287ee6fe662d629e95ffc3ef2b9b.source: These moderators ganged up on John McCain. They ganged up on Mitt Romney. I don't understand why Republicans keep going up there to let some hack from MSNBC browbeat them in front of 50 million people.
4b64076d671d287ee6fe662d629e95ffc3ef2b9b.zh: 这些主持人围攻过约翰·麦凯恩，也围攻过米特·罗姆尼。我不明白，共和党人为什么还老是上台，让MSNBC某个蹩脚的主持人在五千万观众面前对他们横加训斥。

aa53937889055e9aa9eb1dae6ae9f2fa98a38f54.source: These new federal programs we’re making are only serving to speed our inflation problem. We’re going to cut federal bureaucracy, slash tax rates, and let the private sector pull the people up into the wealth we as Americans are capable of.
aa53937889055e9aa9eb1dae6ae9f2fa98a38f54.zh: 我们正在建立的这些新联邦项目，只会加剧通胀。我们将精简联邦官僚机构、大幅降低税率，让私营部门带领人民走向我们美国人有能力创造的富裕生活。

996d170ecc2a8c249adab1719d90af2da81ee239.source: They have a point. The Civil Rights Act was watered down by obstruction and interference from segregationist senators, and I’d like to see one with better protections make it to my desk in my second term.
996d170ecc2a8c249adab1719d90af2da81ee239.zh: 他们说得有道理。《民权法案》受到支持种族隔离的参议员阻挠和干扰，内容被削弱了。我希望在第二任期，能有一项提供更充分保障的法案送到我的办公桌上。

72ad3c17db241432b69d567c5c76c99160e0e2a8.source: They keep saying "Russia Russia Russia". I've heard other people say this was an inside job from a DNC whistleblower. You know, the guy that assassinated or something like that. Strange!
72ad3c17db241432b69d567c5c76c99160e0e2a8.zh: 他们不停地说“俄罗斯、俄罗斯、俄罗斯”。我听别人说，这是民主党全国委员会内部的举报人干的。你知道，就是那个遭暗杀之类的人。真奇怪！

fdd5bafdb6e2d2e452e4b8413f0f8a144564d2d6.source: They said a miracle would be needed for Barry Goldwater to win, and it seems a miracle has taken place. Your supporters flood the streets as pollsters and pundits struggle to explain how this occurred. By shrewd competence, good fortune, and what seems like divine intervention, Barry Goldwater has won the election.
fdd5bafdb6e2d2e452e4b8413f0f8a144564d2d6.zh: 他们说巴里·戈德华特需要奇迹才能获胜，看来奇迹已经发生了。你的支持者涌上街头，民意调查专家和专家们努力解释这是如何发生的。凭借精明的能力、好运和看似神圣的干预，巴里·戈德华特赢得了选举。

b9c0ec032f902db5bb4833054b0387ceb83b888b.source: They say discretion is the better part of valor, but allowing the rift to grow wider might spell doom in future elections. Thankfully, with how you’re polling in the rest of the country, it shouldn’t be an issue for you.
b9c0ec032f902db5bb4833054b0387ceb83b888b.zh: 俗话说，谨慎也是勇气的一部分。不过，任由裂痕扩大，可能会给今后的选举埋下祸根。好在你在全国其他地区的民调表现很好，这对你应该不成问题。

b4a94ab93129738e9fb4f9b889ae4876fff88759.source: They say there's a war on women, but we now have reports that Bill Clinton is a rapist and women who are coming forward, and Hillary is right there trying to silence them.
b4a94ab93129738e9fb4f9b889ae4876fff88759.zh: 他们说有人在向女性宣战，但现在有报道称，比尔·克林顿是个强奸犯，女性正在出面发声，而希拉里就在旁边试图让她们闭嘴。

52fee2004ee378033d686ac82f311caca551822d.source: They say you might be contagious for a little bit, or maybe not, but it's best if we take 3-4 days off before we get back out there.
52fee2004ee378033d686ac82f311caca551822d.zh: 他们说，可能还会有一点时间具有传染性，也可能没有，但最好先休息三到四天，再出去竞选。

dfb20be960d501bffec6c5ae37d2a17e5ef5b546.source: They talk about October surprises -- this is one the biggest ones ever. And people are trying to post the story and Facebook won't even let them post it. If that's not an assault on democracy, what is?
dfb20be960d501bffec6c5ae37d2a17e5ef5b546.zh: 大家都谈十月惊奇，这次就是有史以来最大的一次之一。人们想发这个故事，Facebook却连发布都不让。如果这不算攻击民主，什么才算？

d937c8f6cd201dac39ba41903c1a94346fc9433b.source: They're going to wish they had confirmed him, once I am elected President. This choice is overly conciliatory, when we consider it was made in the face of a colossally obstructionist strategy on the part of the Republicans.
d937c8f6cd201dac39ba41903c1a94346fc9433b.zh: 等我当选总统，他们就会后悔没有确认他了。共和党采取了如此严重的阻挠策略，而这个人选是在这种情况下提出的，实在过于迁就他们。

32f8efe3f75890de53457490f2e75b8b6db7cd67.source: Things may have been closer and more contested than you hoped for, but the final result remains. Can you help bring the country back together after a tumultuous few years? Or will you be seen as a lame duck from the first day -- unable to keep the two wings of your party coordinated? Time will tell.
32f8efe3f75890de53457490f2e75b8b6db7cd67.zh: 事情可能比你希望的更接近、更有争议，但最终结果仍然存在。你能帮助这个国家在经历了几年的动荡之后重新团结起来吗？或者你会从第一天起就被视为跛脚鸭——无法保持你的政党的两翼协调吗？时间会证明一切。

e626a131de5b6239a8858b9e553b968056c5e205.source: Things went great for a few days, until Mr. Quayle laid down a whopper of a gaffe during a speech in Michigan, which was immediately picked up by the national news.
e626a131de5b6239a8858b9e553b968056c5e205.zh: 头几天一切都很好，直到奎尔先生在密歇根州的一次演说中闹出了一个惊人的口误，立刻被全国媒体报道。

1ac324d94ab15c85881c1ad8186fea4395243f44.source: Think Hillary Clinton Will Crush Donald Trump in the General Election? Don’t Be So Sure.
1ac324d94ab15c85881c1ad8186fea4395243f44.zh: 认为 希拉里·克林顿 会在大选中粉碎 唐纳德·特朗普 吗？别那么肯定。

7d7e20be58b3a22bc40f3b7bcdc06349167081c6.source: This Act has no basis in economic reality. If we could wave a magic wand and ensure 3% unemployment and 0% inflation with a balanced budget and no trade deficit, do you think we wouldn't have done it already?
7d7e20be58b3a22bc40f3b7bcdc06349167081c6.zh: 这项法案脱离了经济现实。如果挥一挥魔杖，就能在预算平衡、没有贸易赤字的同时，保证失业率3%、通胀0%，你以为我们还不会早就这样做吗？

99a960d66687a86ed718fce4bdb6956b19959957.source: This Amendment is a necessary reform in the functioning of our government, and removes a significant avenue of corruption from our electoral process.
99a960d66687a86ed718fce4bdb6956b19959957.zh: 这项修正案是政府运作中必要的改革，消除了选举程序中一个重要的腐败渠道。

f434275c375357603b922a85fc9fd76d9938e54f.source: This a good liberal answer on economic policy.
f434275c375357603b922a85fc9fd76d9938e54f.zh: 这是一个不错的自由派经济政策回答。

8a53084d6904ad1cc93f51d41cefa9a529dc077c.source: This a good way to please your liberal base without associating yourself with the McGovern disaster.
8a53084d6904ad1cc93f51d41cefa9a529dc077c.zh: 这是一个讨好自由派基本盘的好办法，又不用让自己与麦戈文的惨败联系起来。

377c9b72c05c419562f268e85f60ffaf84b28082.source: This acceptance is a touch conservative, but has enough to appeal to all Republicans.
377c9b72c05c419562f268e85f60ffaf84b28082.zh: 这篇接受提名演说略显保守，但内容足以吸引各派共和党人。

3260cbb3cc2994f6a8d5bccaa7512863e30e452e.source: This act was the result of countless hours of compromise and negotiations. It's time we closed this issue and stopped changing our entire tariff system every time a new Administration takes over.
3260cbb3cc2994f6a8d5bccaa7512863e30e452e.zh: 这部法律经过了无数小时的妥协与协商。该让这个问题告一段落了，别再每换一届政府，就把整套关税制度改上一遍。

ffaf89326b5a174d7826073f6082523221237dda.source: This action is perfectly in line with my own doctrine. The will of the voters in Kansas clearly calls for admission as a free state.
ffaf89326b5a174d7826073f6082523221237dda.zh: 这个行动完全符合我的学说。堪萨斯选民的意愿，显然是以自由州身份加入联邦。

2c07e67dc5b13fa4f0f01a66da1a300c0fd9951e.source: This an orthodox Republican answer. If only your party could get the South to see the light...
2c07e67dc5b13fa4f0f01a66da1a300c0fd9951e.zh: 这是正统的共和党回答。要是本党能让南方也认识到这一点就好了……

552e1e665489d7b8047c1d9983f9c6c2ba3ac1e3.source: This answer appeals to your core voters.
552e1e665489d7b8047c1d9983f9c6c2ba3ac1e3.zh: 这个回答能吸引你的核心选民。

3a2707a831796b5b1357fc730ca03d61c7503ecb.source: This answer has the expected supporters and detractors.
3a2707a831796b5b1357fc730ca03d61c7503ecb.zh: 这个回答得到了意料之中的支持，也引来了意料之中的反对。

6c32ad9ca3dc358205fb5494e27db785ffb20078.source: This answer is a bit apathetic, and you've missed a good chance to win support from the farm states.
6c32ad9ca3dc358205fb5494e27db785ffb20078.zh: 这个回答有些漠不关心，你错过了争取农业州支持的好机会。

fdccd1e2441aec0e3bed28a67c93dc2dc105ab03.source: This answer is a bit soft for the abolitionist wing. There is great fear that
fdccd1e2441aec0e3bed28a67c93dc2dc105ab03.zh: 这个答案对于废奴派来说有点温和。人们非常担心

2848e3dadc264ebd33be7f6fac188beb42e514d7.source: This answer is a good way to emphasize that you wish to change things within the system.
2848e3dadc264ebd33be7f6fac188beb42e514d7.zh: 这个回答很好地强调，你希望在现有制度内推动改变。

42d1de67f44f75efd493dda9122f258ecf0d5d1a.source: This answer is an unpleasant surprise for many potential supporters.
42d1de67f44f75efd493dda9122f258ecf0d5d1a.zh: 这个回答让许多潜在支持者感到意外，而且并不愉快。

5d9151bb64597d13329613917b64f59745a7063f.source: This answer is definitely a step behind the times, in most regions.
5d9151bb64597d13329613917b64f59745a7063f.zh: 在大多数地区，这个回答确实落后于时代了。

2799645d1e95ed1b043c7e1170a831f4f9f3c4d7.source: This answer is right in line with the traditional platform.
2799645d1e95ed1b043c7e1170a831f4f9f3c4d7.zh: 这个回答完全符合传统纲领。

bb68a496610f45ed753f34e682c3076cdcc410a0.source: This answer may be fatal to your chances of winning Iowa.
bb68a496610f45ed753f34e682c3076cdcc410a0.zh: 这个回答可能彻底断送你赢得艾奥瓦州的机会。

55a092e44bd1c22a8b7e8718d880ea83b6c335ac.source: This answer pleases conservatives in your party.
55a092e44bd1c22a8b7e8718d880ea83b6c335ac.zh: 这个回答让党内保守派满意。

08de891d2ee0104c1e93f0f41c5aa4cb52d1eff0.source: This answer pleases the majority of Republicans.
08de891d2ee0104c1e93f0f41c5aa4cb52d1eff0.zh: 这个回答让大多数共和党人满意。

2c9cb9eecca18f06a522e334a14a77cd35e44920.source: This answer pleases what's left of the isolationists in your party.
2c9cb9eecca18f06a522e334a14a77cd35e44920.zh: 这个回答让党内剩下的孤立主义者满意。

9ddf6017ab12301a267f3b0e031f74ed3878674e.source: This answer satisfies the Southern wing of the party while providing some concession to Northern Democrats in states like New York.
9ddf6017ab12301a267f3b0e031f74ed3878674e.zh: 这个回答让党内南方派满意，同时也向纽约等州的北方民主党人作了一些让步。

0446723b60a96ee958c490836af1b5a91ddd17e8.source: This answer sounds too strident and waffling to have much appeal on either side. Hopefully the damage is limited.
0446723b60a96ee958c490836af1b5a91ddd17e8.zh: 这个回答语气太冲，又摇摆不定，很难讨好任何一方。希望损害有限。

f667e946aa8249ca633accd4405fcd533bf305b2.source: This answer strikes a good balance between appealing to your base and winning the undecided voter.
f667e946aa8249ca633accd4405fcd533bf305b2.zh: 这番回答很好地平衡了两件事：吸引基本盘，以及争取尚未决定的选民。

4c9e1ed9dfbff301f1215251a2ddc8fed44ecee1.source: This answer, after the 1984 debacle, really has observers scratching their heads.
4c9e1ed9dfbff301f1215251a2ddc8fed44ecee1.zh: 经历1984年的惨败之后，这个回答实在让观察人士摸不着头脑。

6c997703fd7a7f2baf7889eee900d5459c337b0d.source: This antitrust legislation was passed with good reason. Business competition will inherently fail wherever monopolies exist.
6c997703fd7a7f2baf7889eee900d5459c337b0d.zh: 反托拉斯立法的通过，自有充分的理由。垄断存在的地方，商业竞争就必然失灵。

2576b6f28020d6033bae1cab4584bfda75b60739.source: This appeals to Southern voters, with the downside of driving moderate Northern voters away.
2576b6f28020d6033bae1cab4584bfda75b60739.zh: 这能吸引南方选民，代价则是把北方温和派选民推开。

316256122e242201559bff0129d245f193835c79.source: This appears too much of a pander to Texans to go over well, when it runs against the normal principles of your party.
316256122e242201559bff0129d245f193835c79.zh: 这看起来太像是在迎合得克萨斯州选民，而且违背了你党通常坚持的原则，因此难以获得好评。
