a534ac73c350d3b1e8f0ad588b5a6e960b6dd943.source: This argument seems stale after years of aggressive Soviet expansion, combined with a minimum number of internal security leaks.
a534ac73c350d3b1e8f0ad588b5a6e960b6dd943.zh: 苏联多年来积极扩张，而国内安全泄密事件却不多，这套论点显得陈旧了。

1b71038d2bf25b6073e9f50a56a98bfce415ba5a.source: This attack was a tragedy, but it underscores the need to the United States to have a more limited foreign policy. The Cold War is over, and it doesn't make sense to deploy troops in so many parts of the world.
1b71038d2bf25b6073e9f50a56a98bfce415ba5a.zh: 这次袭击是一场悲剧，但也凸显出美国需要更加克制的外交政策。冷战已经结束，在世界那么多地方部署部队，并不合理。

71a57c34182ec0096846d8bb0d55c2d2cb8e8a3c.source: This attack will do little to help win anybody but outspoken segregationists.
71a57c34182ec0096846d8bb0d55c2d2cb8e8a3c.zh: 除了直言支持种族隔离的人，这种攻击几乎争取不到谁。

42851255eb0119ae540562b94bba7d3bec5a2526.source: This attempt to reconcile with the Southern Democrats has fallen on deaf ears. Unfortunately, it seems to have cost you elsewhere.
42851255eb0119ae540562b94bba7d3bec5a2526.zh: 试图与南方民主党人和解的努力，没有得到回应。遗憾的是，似乎还让你在其他地方付出了代价。

cc219c9f6db66bad12e23ac89ccc73ec14e860ba.source: This bill is broadly acceptable to progressives, and there are whispers that your campaign is rather more conservative than expected.
cc219c9f6db66bad12e23ac89ccc73ec14e860ba.zh: 进步派普遍能接受这项法案。有人私下议论，你的竞选比原先预期的更加保守。

ec8d0cf99f37cf82e6a400774830056492dbe59d.source: This brings a rousing cheer from your supporters, but is a signifiant break with your position so far.
ec8d0cf99f37cf82e6a400774830056492dbe59d.zh: 这让支持者热烈欢呼，但与你迄今的立场有明显不同。

df23db6384d1b739dbba1ecab561c55c8857e732.source: This business in Israel is no business of America. I wish them the best, but we should not be obtrusively inserting ourselves into these multilateral peace negotiations. Doing so will only serve to entangle us in the long run.
df23db6384d1b739dbba1ecab561c55c8857e732.zh: 以色列的这些事与美国无关。我祝愿他们一切顺利，但我们不应贸然插手这些多边和平谈判。长远来看，这只会把我们卷进去。

dbbc438f971bf4838a5f565c535de6c2dd117fd5.source: This cabal may be hoping for recognition from the United States, but for now they are simply a group of Pacific island adventurers. I have no wishes for either their success or their failure.
dbbc438f971bf4838a5f565c535de6c2dd117fd5.zh: 这个阴谋集团可能希望得到美国的认可，但目前他们只是一群太平洋岛屿冒险家。我不希望他们成功或失败。

5858240f742838f7516c5316a84eb55fe10ed5f0.source: This campaign is about my experience and ability to serve as President. We're going to focus primarily on those qualifications as I campaign. The fact that I'm a woman speaks for itself.
5858240f742838f7516c5316a84eb55fe10ed5f0.zh: 这场竞选，关乎我担任总统的经验和能力。竞选时，我们要主要聚焦这些资格。我是女性这个事实，本身已经很清楚了。

6db2b765ca058143a57097881ae20f8176ad3bc7.source: This campaign is about our fight for hard working American families, regardless of their background. I'm not going to fall into the trap of making this election about Trump's behavior, instead of his disastrous policies.
6db2b765ca058143a57097881ae20f8176ad3bc7.zh: 这场竞选，是我们为辛勤工作的美国家庭而进行的奋斗，无论他们有什么背景。我不会掉进那个陷阱，让选举围绕特朗普的行为，而非他灾难性的政策展开。

7fc3c0244f9f61d04abc2a2cba47ebac58745041.source: This can't be right! Only 270 electoral votes? That's less than that LOSER Bush! Sleepy Joe's Democratic fraud machines have rigged the election against you! Without fraud? Well without fraud you would be looking at TREMENDOUS victories! A historic landslide, surely! You can post a tweet about the rigging now: "Even with Democratic fraud we won BIG! More electoral votes than George Washington. Democrats are crying - not sad at all!" With this margin of victory, the Democrats have managed to steal the House from you! You'll have to find a way to pass your Make America Great Again agenda despite this setback.
7fc3c0244f9f61d04abc2a2cba47ebac58745041.zh: 这不可能！只有270张选举人票？这比那个 LOSER 布什 还少！瞌睡乔的民主党欺诈机器已经操纵选举来对付你！没有欺诈？好吧，如果没有欺诈，您将看到巨大的胜利！肯定是历史性的山体滑坡！您现在可以发布有关操纵行为的推文：“即使存在民主党欺诈，我们也赢得了巨大！比乔治 华盛顿州 还多的选举人票。民主党人在哭泣 - 一点也不悲伤！”凭借这一优势，民主党已经从你们手中夺走了众议院！尽管遭遇挫折，你仍必须找到一种方法来通过你的 让美国再次伟大 议程。

2c49762caaed1c7f6c56f06cba5e2c844f842bfe.source: This case is no excuse for the rioting and disorder that we're seeing in many large cities, which in no way honors George Floyd. I condemn this situation unequivocally.
2c49762caaed1c7f6c56f06cba5e2c844f842bfe.zh: 这件案子不能成为许多大城市里骚乱和失序的借口，那根本不是在纪念乔治·弗洛伊德。我毫不含糊地谴责这种局面。

42f16b9f1e608f6d4725f370526008aefc76b11b.source: This certainly helped unseat Slobodan Milosevic, but as President I will make sure that America treads carefully before intervening in foreign nations' affairs.
42f16b9f1e608f6d4725f370526008aefc76b11b.zh: 这确实有助于让斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇下台，但作为总统，我会确保美国在干预外国事务前谨慎行事。

6d490c609ff7973673fc80977b254ceb563d8477.source: This certainly helps you with the urban hard hat vote, but it could hurt you in the South, where most states are right-to-work.
6d490c609ff7973673fc80977b254ceb563d8477.zh: 这肯定有助于你争取城市建筑工人的选票，却可能在南方伤害你，因为那里的多数州实行工作权法。

2076eda0d50f73153d13af15b3089677f50b515e.source: This certainly hurts you in New York. Perhaps other parts of the country will see things differently.
2076eda0d50f73153d13af15b3089677f50b515e.zh: 这肯定会损害你在纽约州的支持。也许其他地区会有不同的看法。

18b2e5f44f4b1e18a55cd2b3ff08de0af40e49b0.source: This certainly shakes up the race. Fusion tickets have been organized in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.
18b2e5f44f4b1e18a55cd2b3ff08de0af40e49b0.zh: 这无疑打乱了选情。纽约、新泽西和宾夕法尼亚已组成联合选举人名单。

23dcba289705ac409b86f6654ebf0503ea9cce33.source: This clarification helps downplay your radical reputation, while also dampening damage done to your numbers among those who are voting for your civil rights positions.
23dcba289705ac409b86f6654ebf0503ea9cce33.zh: 这番澄清有助于淡化你的激进形象，同时减轻对支持率的损害：那些因你的民权立场而投票支持你的人，也没有被进一步推远。

c7b06cdb7d0ff1be45553801908c31b5e28d5c23.source: This clip will show up all over the news and the internet for days. Let's continue to make our own case to the American people.
c7b06cdb7d0ff1be45553801908c31b5e28d5c23.zh: 未来几天，这段视频会铺满新闻和互联网。让我们继续向美国人民陈述自己的主张。

fb434c519aa1270b25097c2829d4b3803b44236c.source: This comes off as a very market-focused philosophy in combatting global warming.
fb434c519aa1270b25097c2829d4b3803b44236c.zh: 这种应对全球变暖的理念，显得非常依赖市场。

02c768b2e75c8fe565f7f1ed601e92e68a80dfd4.source: This comes off like a laundry list of left-liberal demands, which many feel were repudiated in the 1984 election.
02c768b2e75c8fe565f7f1ed601e92e68a80dfd4.zh: 这听起来像是一长串左翼自由派的诉求，许多人认为，这些主张在1984年选举中已经遭到选民否定。

a99c9f924bc819b847ce60826d7af90755c50e48.source: This could be a fantastic method of creating work for our idle workers. What better way is there to implement a massive public works project?
a99c9f924bc819b847ce60826d7af90755c50e48.zh: 这也许是给失业工人创造工作的绝佳办法。还有什么比这更适合实施大规模公共工程？

97b704bb216abc5aaef0146b082e9d1c24368c99.source: This could be a good idea, but sometimes the voters want to hear a little more substance, especially since your personality is unappealing to some.
97b704bb216abc5aaef0146b082e9d1c24368c99.zh: 这可能是个好主意，不过选民有时希望多听些实质内容，尤其是一些人并不喜欢你的个性。

47506097cf6b2db4bf256062193789bd8bb085c9.source: This could be a reasonable compromise on trade... or a way to pass the buck to whoever the next President will be.
47506097cf6b2db4bf256062193789bd8bb085c9.zh: 这或许是贸易问题上合理的妥协，也可能是把责任推给下一任总统。

feaf94f6bb1b321e20576f7b557e0107ee6c3454.source: This could be a way to reach out to moderates, but most silver Republicans hail from the West.
feaf94f6bb1b321e20576f7b557e0107ee6c3454.zh: 这也许能争取温和派，但支持自由铸银的共和党人大多来自西部。

1da15408a03dd7b34f1922a4818ee1567b5fdfde.source: This could be an interesting way to turn the media attacks on you into a strength.
1da15408a03dd7b34f1922a4818ee1567b5fdfde.zh: 这可能是把媒体攻击转化为自身优势的有趣办法。

b86657e19edeaf21d07fbffcef01bc99c7ed88d0.source: This could cost you some nativist support, but that wing is hopefully concentrated in states that aren't close.
b86657e19edeaf21d07fbffcef01bc99c7ed88d0.zh: 这可能让你失去一些本土主义者的支持；但愿这一派主要集中在那些选情并不胶着的州。

d45a0572297197a84f8363ca333fb0118653f1e7.source: This could destroy my campaign in the final days. We must accuse the Gore campaign of leaking this to discredit my candidacy, and challenge their credibility and timing.
d45a0572297197a84f8363ca333fb0118653f1e7.zh: 这可能在最后几天毁掉我的竞选。我们必须指责戈尔阵营泄露此事，意图抹黑我参选，并质疑他们的可信度和选择这个时机的用意。

49a3c300833f25ebc9a9d90af8c863af4e88def8.source: This could help to keep traditional conservatives from defecting this fall.
49a3c300833f25ebc9a9d90af8c863af4e88def8.zh: 这可能有助于防止传统保守派在今年秋天倒戈。

20b23ff5535817080f3619d2fbf4521cfe204bb7.source: This could work very well for you. Make sure you also offer some policy specifics to keep your base fired up.
20b23ff5535817080f3619d2fbf4521cfe204bb7.zh: 这可能对你很有效。记得也提出一些具体政策，让基本盘保持热情。

1016af9a0d03ae8e780fe66143d416a50c1f6961.source: This could work, and maybe you'll remind the Nader crowd why they should hold their nose and vote for you.
1016af9a0d03ae8e780fe66143d416a50c1f6961.zh: 这可能奏效，也许你会提醒纳德的支持者，为什么他们应该捏着鼻子投你一票。

e55770f6136d22d406b49c0f79249b4158ea5518.source: This deal is a completely asinine joke. We still owe Iran $150 billion if we change our mind. We just give them the money.
e55770f6136d22d406b49c0f79249b4158ea5518.zh: 这项协议是个蠢透了的笑话。即使改变主意，我们还是欠伊朗1500亿美元。我们就是把钱送给他们。

ca8f038ce4392b6e281d5e217e6c9e511b2c40ed.source: This deal was one of Barack Obama's real achievements during his time in office that we will uphold and enforce. I fully support it.
ca8f038ce4392b6e281d5e217e6c9e511b2c40ed.zh: 这项协议是贝拉克·奥巴马任内的一项实在成就，我们会维护并执行它。我完全支持。

618eec2c80e2eec694526a3e2f78fc92668e8f87.source: This debate has no place in our system of federalism. The individual states have every right to decide how they wish to handle the issue of commerce and drinking on Sunday.
618eec2c80e2eec694526a3e2f78fc92668e8f87.zh: 在我们的联邦制下，这不应成为联邦层面的争论。各州完全有权自行决定，如何处理星期日的商业活动与饮酒问题。

aec915bd01a1ae7bea39db7ab6efbbf6a923158f.source: This decision is a real perversion of the Constitution. I think a lot of people are really upset about this and I hear about it every day. And believe me, we're going to do something about it.
aec915bd01a1ae7bea39db7ab6efbbf6a923158f.zh: 这个判决实在是歪曲宪法。我想，很多人对此非常愤怒，我每天都能听到他们的意见。相信我，我们会采取行动。

6e674c54dccad26cd92e30a276040908881f1c50.source: This decision was a milestone for equality in our country. I will appoint judges who feel the same way about it.
6e674c54dccad26cd92e30a276040908881f1c50.zh: 这项判决是我国平等事业的里程碑。我会任命对此持相同看法的法官。

03d32f3963791cf837fbae4d5faed9e73a3f9aa5.source: This decision was atrocious. I don't think it's an exaggeration to say that our way of life is at stake here when we don't allow our schools to teach basic moral values to our children.
03d32f3963791cf837fbae4d5faed9e73a3f9aa5.zh: 这个裁决糟糕透顶。学校不能向孩子传授基本的道德价值观，我认为，说我们的生活方式正面临危险，一点也不夸张。

25cbbd4f6eadb0129c73907f31ce37a84ed53fd6.source: This definitely helps you with the black and liberal vote in the north.
25cbbd4f6eadb0129c73907f31ce37a84ed53fd6.zh: 这确实有助于争取北方的黑人和自由派选民。

69e8eccd7e7315bd5bc0995e04aea1d4f7fbfba4.source: This discussion has grown tiresome, but I will continue to advocate for a moderate solution on this issue.
69e8eccd7e7315bd5bc0995e04aea1d4f7fbfba4.zh: 这场讨论已经令人厌烦，不过我仍将主张以温和方式解决这个问题。

c50dcab4bf1fef96dd6bff1f8a9ce2a0672164d2.source: This discussion has grown tiresome, but let me restate that I oppose the annexation of Texas.
c50dcab4bf1fef96dd6bff1f8a9ce2a0672164d2.zh: 这场讨论已经令人厌烦，不过让我重申：我反对吞并得克萨斯。

75bc2552e19f441a83b506671cc740189c66031f.source: This discussion has grown tiresome, but let me restate that I support the annexation of Texas.
75bc2552e19f441a83b506671cc740189c66031f.zh: 这场讨论已经令人厌烦，不过让我重申：我支持吞并得克萨斯。

7ba3d2f8f0c6c0381f30199f6284139cffeeddae.source: This election is a battle for the soul of America. If Donald Trump is President for four more years, the damage to this nation may be irreversible.
7ba3d2f8f0c6c0381f30199f6284139cffeeddae.zh: 这场选举是争夺美国灵魂的斗争。如果唐纳德·特朗普再当四年总统，对这个国家的伤害可能无法挽回。

a821dae6ed12f60b6d0b749acbbe3cb35790195e.source: This election is a battle for the soul of America. The radical Democrats want to destroy free speech, handcuff our police, open our borders, and implement a nationwide program of socialism. You must stop them.
a821dae6ed12f60b6d0b749acbbe3cb35790195e.zh: 这场选举是争夺美国灵魂的斗争。激进的民主党想摧毁言论自由，束缚警察，开放边境，并在全国实行社会主义。你们必须阻止他们。

47142b0c68560c07bc2f8efc08481aaf259f0174.source: This email system was a lapse in judgment, and I apologize. It was simply a matter of convenience to prevent me from carrying two phones everywhere, but if I was doing it again, I might do something different.
47142b0c68560c07bc2f8efc08481aaf259f0174.zh: 使用这套邮件系统是判断失误，我为此道歉。当时只是图方便，免得走到哪里都带两部手机。如果再来一次，我也许会作出不同选择。

44fa65921e443ddba9cf1bc6b37af66de5f8a468.source: This entire case is a farce from start to finish. It's a minor civil case.
44fa65921e443ddba9cf1bc6b37af66de5f8a468.zh: 这整个案子从头到尾都是闹剧，不过是个小小民事案。

ed90630b9ba11f47d155d92837c87b38fcba4e4e.source: This entire thing wouldn't even be an issue if marijuana were decriminalized as it should be. The DEA should never be prosecuting non-violent, licensed growers of medicinal marijuana.
ed90630b9ba11f47d155d92837c87b38fcba4e4e.zh: 如果大麻像本来就应该的那样实现非刑事化，整件事根本就不会成为问题。缉毒局绝不应该起诉那些持有许可、没有暴力行为的医用大麻种植者。

af7e2edb2240cc7810318327485192c2284cd0cf.source: This episode shows that Mr. Clay is, at heart, an insider who is overly favorable to Northern politicians. It brings to mind the Corrupt Bargain of a prior election.
af7e2edb2240cc7810318327485192c2284cd0cf.zh: 这件事说明，克莱先生骨子里就是个过分偏袒北方政客的政坛圈内人。这让人想起了早先那次选举中的“腐败交易”。

7ae597f73d8fbce38cd3b72ddce9a9141cb15771.source: This falls a bit flat- especially to conservative allies, who are decidedly not in support of the Social Security program as it stands.
7ae597f73d8fbce38cd3b72ddce9a9141cb15771.zh: 这番话没起到多大效果，尤其是保守派盟友并不支持现有的社会保障制度。

4ec56eccc18c7b7347da1c0e4a1f225702ccd507.source: This gives the impression that you don’t really care about the environment at all.
4ec56eccc18c7b7347da1c0e4a1f225702ccd507.zh: 这让人觉得你根本不在乎环境。

1a4878742239535b2e4cc5b6ccd7b3ac6941c72e.source: This goes a step further than the party platform and galvanizes those who support the women's vote.
1a4878742239535b2e4cc5b6ccd7b3ac6941c72e.zh: 这个立场比党纲更进一步，让支持妇女选举权的人士振奋起来。

8bf298d4aa652347842ff821f34ea27b17edf3c1.source: This group is Exhibit A in the dangers of allowing women to become politically active. They are engaged in a naive quest to purify American life from an imagined evil.
8bf298d4aa652347842ff821f34ea27b17edf3c1.zh: 这个团体正是允许妇女参与政治会带来危险的最好例证。她们天真地追求，把一种想象中的罪恶从美国生活中清除出去。

481aac7ffc2b76632a98824cd4a8962a0a080294.source: This has a certain appeal to your wide coalition. You backup Johnson and simultaneously throw a bone to the left.
481aac7ffc2b76632a98824cd4a8962a0a080294.zh: 这对你广泛的支持者联盟颇有吸引力。你既支持约翰逊，也给左翼一点甜头。

2a61b56c4b5fc8bbde986f2873df2399acb865f6.source: This has been a Democratic idea since the days of Andrew Jackson. We support it completely.
2a61b56c4b5fc8bbde986f2873df2399acb865f6.zh: 自安德鲁·杰克逊时代以来，这一直是民主党的主张。我们完全支持。

b2fa231f1050b9e44f74c935b42f5ec94809879a.source: This has been misunderstood from the first day. All I'm calling for is for us to not send unqualified hacks to negotiate our trade deals. I love trade.
b2fa231f1050b9e44f74c935b42f5ec94809879a.zh: 从第一天起，这就被误解了。我要求的，只是别派那些不够资格的庸才去谈贸易协定。我喜欢贸易。

13af99b51884c480fe125bd327af82488577566a.source: This has no hope of becoming law, but we have to include the plank in order to appease the southern delegates who secured my nomination.
13af99b51884c480fe125bd327af82488577566a.zh: 这不可能成为法律，但我们必须把这一条写进党纲，安抚那些确保我获得提名的南方代表。

93ebf0d8fbc50f2a46ef613b50bd7758f0d9fdeb.source: This has the potential to develop into another out-of-control federal program. It's best not to go down that road.
93ebf0d8fbc50f2a46ef613b50bd7758f0d9fdeb.zh: 这可能发展成又一项失控的联邦计划。最好不要走这条路。

e83de15dd0ddddd0f6a48a8f43b31d443936736c.source: This has to rank as one of the biggest upsets in political history. Prepare to implement your radically progressive agenda in the United States of America!
e83de15dd0ddddd0f6a48a8f43b31d443936736c.zh: 这必须被列为政治史上最大的冷门之一。准备好在美利坚合众国实施您激进的进步议程！

62e86cfd2e375cf1095260109fbe4c5ca751d5f0.source: This idea does not appeal to most Americans, especially in your party.
62e86cfd2e375cf1095260109fbe4c5ca751d5f0.zh: 这个主张不受大多数美国人欢迎，在你党内尤其如此。

6d0cf3793cfd9bc1cc723d1dd1dba94779fb2d0c.source: This idea does not appeal to most Americans, though you might get a few Henry Wallace supporters.
6d0cf3793cfd9bc1cc723d1dd1dba94779fb2d0c.zh: 这个主张不受大多数美国人欢迎，不过你也许能争取到少数亨利·华莱士的支持者。

bfbc9568f2a6dd0d9f4281ac0957666ea1aa64cc.source: This idea was a failure from day one. Federal education funds are needed the most in low-income districts which have disproportionately suffered from this legislation.
bfbc9568f2a6dd0d9f4281ac0957666ea1aa64cc.zh: 这个主意从第一天起就失败了。低收入学区最需要联邦教育经费，却因这部法律蒙受了格外严重的损失。

29ae2dae19d54cbcaad1c09fdb7b5907dbec7eea.source: This in line with the feelings of your Party.
29ae2dae19d54cbcaad1c09fdb7b5907dbec7eea.zh: 这符合你所在政党的倾向。

7200029d24debfc7111cb44e0e911a53b954b592.source: This in line with your expected position, although it could be hurting you in some regions.
7200029d24debfc7111cb44e0e911a53b954b592.zh: 这符合人们预期的立场，不过可能会损害你在某些地区的支持。

8dc2adad91a9391d598fe1e108d3810459f726fc.source: This incident was a source of insinuation against Van Buren during the nomination battle. In the main election, however, we shouldn't mention anything that could cause a rift in the party.
8dc2adad91a9391d598fe1e108d3810459f726fc.zh: 在提名角逐中，有人借此影射攻击范布伦。不过，到了正式大选阶段，我们不应提及任何可能导致党内分裂的事情。

ca2d4dbfeafadf4f81c666fbbc1ea799207940b0.source: This increase in crime we see is the natural consequence of integration. I will not allow the black community in this country to get fancified notions of what they can get away with when I'm President.
ca2d4dbfeafadf4f81c666fbbc1ea799207940b0.zh: 如今犯罪增加，正是种族融合的自然后果。我当总统后，绝不会让美国黑人社区妄想可以为所欲为。

ed406ee319431b5a1ce8117ac182365c9068c80b.source: This invasion was one of the biggest disasters in the history of the United States. We're going to dredge up a lot of memories about this before our campaign is through.
ed406ee319431b5a1ce8117ac182365c9068c80b.zh: 这场入侵是美国历史上最大的灾难之一。竞选结束之前，我们要反复翻出许多关于这件事的记忆。

a0e83a0a0db0e2108058a9ce128cc4d94aa40d98.source: This investigation by our so-called FBI was a farce from start to finish. How can someone destroy massive amounts of evidence in the midst of a federal investigation and not be charged?
a0e83a0a0db0e2108058a9ce128cc4d94aa40d98.zh: 我们所谓的联邦调查局，这次调查从头到尾就是一场闹剧。一个人怎么能在联邦调查期间销毁大量证据，却不被起诉？

6b9fb0d29c1610362d79cf0639a3f9cbe3b9b969.source: This invigorates a certain wing of the party, but it could also cost you in certain states.
6b9fb0d29c1610362d79cf0639a3f9cbe3b9b969.zh: 这会振奋党内某一派，但也可能让你在某些州付出代价。

839a8cb3dd5babc46b64918dac937b7855b93e93.source: This is a bad answer for you, considering that it's your own health care plan.
839a8cb3dd5babc46b64918dac937b7855b93e93.zh: 考虑到这正是你自己的医疗改革方案，这个回答对你很不利。

df96eda34c85d82f2a96ae75587818c80c1acddb.source: This is a bad answer. While you do appear tough on communism, it costs you the anti-war movement.
df96eda34c85d82f2a96ae75587818c80c1acddb.zh: 这个回答不好。你虽然显得对共产主义强硬，却付出了失去反战运动支持的代价。

8f6b0d40c0d25bea12d84eef3a96e5ac89f8aa70.source: This is a bad response politically. Social Darwinism is still a minority view, held mainly among the Ivy League upper-crust. You shouldn't imply that you agree with such views.
8f6b0d40c0d25bea12d84eef3a96e5ac89f8aa70.zh: 从政治上说，这个回答很糟糕。社会达尔文主义仍是少数人的观点，主要流行于常春藤名校的上层精英中。你不应该暗示自己赞同它。

a1ae1a6bca946d72804ebcc344d377608b3b2a1b.source: This is a big break from the Democratic platform. You'd better be prepared to explain this a little more.
a1ae1a6bca946d72804ebcc344d377608b3b2a1b.zh: 这与民主党纲领有很大出入。你最好准备好进一步解释。

d65e052af6a4dfedb8f3eaa379881328d7dc095b.source: This is a big shift from your earlier stance. While it may improve your standing with Midwestern moderates, those who were voting for you because of your civil rights position are quite upset and demoralized.
d65e052af6a4dfedb8f3eaa379881328d7dc095b.zh: 这与你先前的立场相比，是个重大转变。虽然可能改善你在中西部温和派当中的处境，但那些因你的民权立场而投票支持你的人，十分不满，也很泄气。

99b5b89b8aaeb4f50bc029297c041643d9959fea.source: This is a bit of a change from other Democrats, but it doesn't hurt to look strong on defense.
99b5b89b8aaeb4f50bc029297c041643d9959fea.zh: 这与其他民主党人的立场有所不同，但展现国防上的强硬形象并无坏处。

a5cf414c9a640671c78c6ce91d0983dd05888d74.source: This is a bit of a change from your earlier position, but it won't do you much harm.
a5cf414c9a640671c78c6ce91d0983dd05888d74.zh: 这与先前的立场有些不同，但不会给你造成太大损害。

9d5d5a7baf32f7fafd95f5322715498b1ca4af16.source: This is a bit of a sore point among much of the left.
9d5d5a7baf32f7fafd95f5322715498b1ca4af16.zh: 对许多左翼人士来说，这有点戳中了痛处。

b5f4925ba1413b7e33519a8d3f0132ed415adabf.source: This is a bit of a weak response, but the demand has thus far been limited to radical Southerners, and seems unlikely to make headway.
b5f4925ba1413b7e33519a8d3f0132ed415adabf.zh: 这个回应有些软弱，不过，目前这个要求还局限于南方激进派，似乎不太可能取得进展。

e0a689b42c6b2bf7e4f04f8dbec32e35347f4449.source: This is a bold position, but it could definitely help some Texas Democrats make up their minds.
e0a689b42c6b2bf7e4f04f8dbec32e35347f4449.zh: 这个立场大胆，但肯定能帮助一些得克萨斯州民主党人作出决定。

873d722f3b40e5f34def34bd9dceff5ec961daa7.source: This is a bread-and-butter response with emphasis on your bread-and-butter issue.
873d722f3b40e5f34def34bd9dceff5ec961daa7.zh: 这是个惯常而稳妥的回答，着重强调了你的主打议题。

8a757433ead65d997b0d3423054af980bbcaf055.source: This is a break from the party platform, but it might help in the Western states.
8a757433ead65d997b0d3423054af980bbcaf055.zh: 这偏离了党纲，但可能有助于争取西部各州。

037428e8097c9d6b2b9c2a29962e899843999a56.source: This is a break from your previous statements, and an unwelcome one in the eyes of most potential supporters.
037428e8097c9d6b2b9c2a29962e899843999a56.zh: 这与你此前的表态不同，多数潜在支持者不欢迎这种变化。

ea61511f56c3dedd1c201c3d2f67d31b5fff1091.source: This is a broadly popular stance, but it definitely alienates a key bloc of Democrats.
ea61511f56c3dedd1c201c3d2f67d31b5fff1091.zh: 这是一个广受欢迎的立场，但也确实疏远了民主党一个重要的支持群体。

8e676b9ae184f43ee1296ce3279250f042995c82.source: This is a broadly popular stance.
8e676b9ae184f43ee1296ce3279250f042995c82.zh: 这是一个广受欢迎的立场。

6c6b1e2ae0119524f96215a75e1884fded5d329a.source: This is a clumsy gesture towards a party which has irreconcilably split away.
6c6b1e2ae0119524f96215a75e1884fded5d329a.zh: 对一个已经彻底分裂出去、无法调和的政党，这番示好显得笨拙。

973ed762d13eb439fa57c70d9940ed4cb874dd89.source: This is a concern of many Democratic voters. There's a little mumbling about your sudden reticence.
973ed762d13eb439fa57c70d9940ed4cb874dd89.zh: 许多民主党选民都担心这一点。你突然缄默起来，也引发了一些私下议论。

909460a1ba28a9007112eebb31687e3a523a83ba.source: This is a conservative stance, but acceptable to the party.
909460a1ba28a9007112eebb31687e3a523a83ba.zh: 这是个保守的立场，但本党能够接受。

4fe7ffd9306f724c3dfbc1dcbd910fc27794b4de.source: This is a controversial answer, but as an outsider it could help feed your popularity.
4fe7ffd9306f724c3dfbc1dcbd910fc27794b4de.zh: 这个回答有争议，但你是个局外人，或许反而能借此提升人气。

2e83f35f9bd1f3881ea359b9ed00ee47c702750e.source: This is a controversial stance, and it is probably aligned with the minority within your party.
2e83f35f9bd1f3881ea359b9ed00ee47c702750e.zh: 这是一个有争议的立场，站在你党内少数派一边的可能性很大。

ca30a798ed1cc82016d12860c84575b72bd84844.source: This is a controversial step, but perhaps it can work out for you.
ca30a798ed1cc82016d12860c84575b72bd84844.zh: 这是有争议的一步，但也许能对你有利。

a13e1add057dc64cfdf78b7abaadf0d194b82b07.source: This is a controversial step, which has certainly created much bewilderment from your party.
a13e1add057dc64cfdf78b7abaadf0d194b82b07.zh: 这是有争议的一步，确实让党内许多人十分困惑。

7f15d4c43f1a6678e28873a3bdbac878300a04ba.source: This is a core argument of your campaign, and a good place to differentiate yourself from the Republicans.
7f15d4c43f1a6678e28873a3bdbac878300a04ba.zh: 这是你竞选的核心论点，也是与共和党人拉开区别的好机会。

fff1415390e867d14f2938445ed9c62a970efc83.source: This is a corrupt, ludicrous practice which Congress uses to hide the true size of our budget and Social Security deficits.
fff1415390e867d14f2938445ed9c62a970efc83.zh: 这是一种腐败、荒唐的做法，国会借此掩盖预算赤字和社会保障赤字的真实规模。

a8471da9c73c15e09c398239d38737f72719ffb9.source: This is a crowd-pleaser for the base, but you run the risk of alienating elderly voters.
a8471da9c73c15e09c398239d38737f72719ffb9.zh: 这会讨基本盘欢心，但你也冒着疏远老年选民的风险。

b72d788adc22b581c9b62453204a4a64eb469458.source: This is a damaging attack, but at least you are fighting back against its worst effects.
b72d788adc22b581c9b62453204a4a64eb469458.zh: 这是一次伤害很大的攻击，但至少你在努力反击，抵消其最严重的影响。

d1f0c842fa5250cbd058a61420557e1c04efd290.source: This is a dead issue, politically, and would distract from the primary message we are attempting to make in this election.
d1f0c842fa5250cbd058a61420557e1c04efd290.zh: 从政治上说，这个议题已经过时了，会分散我们在本次大选中要传达的核心信息。

ce2e1f3d0b78d528b6dc17dd4661df5fa05f926b.source: This is a decent response for you if you're trying to appeal to a larger base.
ce2e1f3d0b78d528b6dc17dd4661df5fa05f926b.zh: 如果你想扩大支持基础，这个回答还不错。

16371bbfd1f970641fe9c7006a5dc54993c50243.source: This is a good answer to fire up the base.
16371bbfd1f970641fe9c7006a5dc54993c50243.zh: 这个回答很能点燃基本盘的热情。

ff0cbc77b15e669d424e563a430b2e747bced14b.source: This is a good answer to fire up the base. But women voters, including your own wife, are upset with you. Enjoy sleeping on the White House couch for a few days.
ff0cbc77b15e669d424e563a430b2e747bced14b.zh: 这个回答很能点燃基本盘的热情。不过，女性选民，包括你自己的妻子，都对你不满。准备在白宫沙发上睡几天吧。

0a137b2c19714c376bfc4bb4fbab98052c52b4ad.source: This is a good answer to win over white moderates, but it’s a disappointing answer to your party, especially blacks and liberals.
0a137b2c19714c376bfc4bb4fbab98052c52b4ad.zh: 这个回答有利于争取白人温和派，却让党内人士失望，尤其是黑人和自由派。

ed3a8091e48bcb71c59ac0bdcce5d522630eddc4.source: This is a good answer. You manage to mollify LBJ and also soothe unions who are anxious about the effect these agreements have.
ed3a8091e48bcb71c59ac0bdcce5d522630eddc4.zh: 回答得好。你既安抚了约翰逊，也让担忧这些协议影响的工会安心。

164b1d2329dd01f0e7f946f026ab5a1f5b3ab4e6.source: This is a good appeal to those in industry, but many in the middle class are skeptical of unions.
164b1d2329dd01f0e7f946f026ab5a1f5b3ab4e6.zh: 这很好地争取了工业界，但中产阶级中有不少人对工会持疑虑。

32093861cfc08cc023860084cd660b9693bcc9ed.source: This is a good chance to present yourself as the voice of common-sense and honesty, but many Democrats favor the proposed law.
32093861cfc08cc023860084cd660b9693bcc9ed.zh: 这是一个把自己塑造成常识与诚实代言人的好机会，但许多民主党人支持这项拟议法律。

ef3d76ae01e79f481780155d9e3b7d59f7c19190.source: This is a good chance to present yourself as the voice of common-sense and honesty.
ef3d76ae01e79f481780155d9e3b7d59f7c19190.zh: 这是一个把自己塑造成常识与诚实代言人的好机会。

95b9221743d027f1960943acfa5bf2356bbec987.source: This is a good combination of policies which is acceptable to liberals and moderates alike.
95b9221743d027f1960943acfa5bf2356bbec987.zh: 这是个不错的政策组合，自由派和温和派都能接受。

b6870cbe666357e1fc004982fa99b6cecff74492.source: This is a good compromise position if you don't want to support the Amendment.
b6870cbe666357e1fc004982fa99b6cecff74492.zh: 如果你不想支持这项修正案，这是个不错的妥协立场。

9d8686198bf01a42b0171a4e32af9335c38b1278.source: This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish supporters were hoping for more.
9d8686198bf01a42b0171a4e32af9335c38b1278.zh: 这个回答已经不错，但一些犹太人支持者原本期待你说得更多。

e8677298217dca8f28b831286bb3ffe4578e86a6.source: This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish voters were hoping for more.
e8677298217dca8f28b831286bb3ffe4578e86a6.zh: 这个回答已经不错，但一些犹太选民原本期待你说得更多。

c822e75bc7486aff2a6aec7f401dc761c601dfa5.source: This is a good hedge. Even John Kerry voted against the Protocol.
c822e75bc7486aff2a6aec7f401dc761c601dfa5.zh: 这是个不错的保留说法。连约翰·克里都投票反对过议定书。

f42844b25d925f1d04730beb9704e92cb14d8921.source: This is a good idea and it should be expanded.
f42844b25d925f1d04730beb9704e92cb14d8921.zh: 这是个好主意，应该扩大实施。

185ce42e530ac66fe09d97b96fec33ac25b6576f.source: This is a good idea for dealing with any issues or questions relating to Bill Clinton.
185ce42e530ac66fe09d97b96fec33ac25b6576f.zh: 这是应对任何与比尔·克林顿有关的问题或质疑的好办法。

04824ef397ad52e1e4f04c2a6ce7442782ff873f.source: This is a good liberal answer, but perhaps a bit too liberal.
04824ef397ad52e1e4f04c2a6ce7442782ff873f.zh: 这是个不错的自由派回答，但也许有点过于自由派了。

883d3888549f70d11dcc84945f3eed589b452894.source: This is a good message to campaign on.
883d3888549f70d11dcc84945f3eed589b452894.zh: 这是一个不错的竞选主张。

9763461447e3b1d302bc45ac0f2dd3b7b392ab74.source: This is a good middle ground for you to stake out. I'm confident the American people will appreciate your sensibilities.
9763461447e3b1d302bc45ac0f2dd3b7b392ab74.zh: 这是个适合你占据的折中立场。我相信，美国人民会欣赏你的判断。

5713df08fb73678c1397500f50459b7d323f9794.source: This is a good opening to attack Hillary Clinton after some of the recent mayhem.
5713df08fb73678c1397500f50459b7d323f9794.zh: 最近几番混乱之后，这是攻击希拉里·克林顿的好机会。

57fd632cd8ef5fe33d85e3f58a12be78e6bb3ab3.source: This is a good opening to remind voters of Bush's unpopularity and possible lack of judgment.
57fd632cd8ef5fe33d85e3f58a12be78e6bb3ab3.zh: 这是个提醒选民布什不受欢迎、而且可能缺乏判断力的好机会。

1d3ef5a55beaeb8f702de13fd0c023dc6ae7fd8e.source: This is a decent talking point for 1948.
1d3ef5a55beaeb8f702de13fd0c023dc6ae7fd8e.zh: 在1948年，这是一个不错的竞选论点。

d4f4bc0589b520241566fb39ae81233b695ce62e.source: This is a decent, liberal answer except that it leaves you open for attacks: conservatives accuse you of being a tree hugging hippie.
d4f4bc0589b520241566fb39ae81233b695ce62e.zh: 这是个不错的自由派回答，不过留下了攻击的把柄：保守派指责你是个抱着树不放的嬉皮士。

aeeac6c9331669a885c191f86948fe0623f499af.source: This is a disappointing answer to your supporters.
aeeac6c9331669a885c191f86948fe0623f499af.zh: 这个回答让你的支持者失望。

afdf4a33dbd5a9f1698d71ed12cb1df8ee0bb063.source: This is a dissatisfying answer to many in your party.
afdf4a33dbd5a9f1698d71ed12cb1df8ee0bb063.zh: 这个回答让党内许多人不满意。

c68622bc8bf545dc6f548848b1536c679ee6531f.source: This is a dovish answer, but it repudiates some of your own actions as President.
c68622bc8bf545dc6f548848b1536c679ee6531f.zh: 这个回答偏鸽派，却否定了你担任总统时自己采取过的一些行动。

8d13374350ccf382ecec2490ca35f70255df680a.source: This is a dovish answer, but one that many Americans agree with.
8d13374350ccf382ecec2490ca35f70255df680a.zh: 这个回答偏鸽派，但许多美国人都赞同。

58fa53ccc6f98a46a4799c9a64058e54e9453eaa.source: This is a drain on American finances for a cause that threatens to entangle us in future wars, not of our making. I oppose the actions we have taken.
58fa53ccc6f98a46a4799c9a64058e54e9453eaa.zh: 这会消耗美国的财力，还可能让我们日后卷入并非由我们引起的战争。我反对我们已经采取的这些行动。

7120fe2f7922e1f091c5a5a7a4b7af2357cb242a.source: This is a fair and sensible policy that will allow skilled immigrants to enter the United States. It's ludicrous to state that this will somehow compromise our culture and our values.
7120fe2f7922e1f091c5a5a7a4b7af2357cb242a.zh: 这是一项公平、合理的政策，能让有技能的移民来到美国。说它会损害我们的文化和价值观，实在荒唐。

727620db9658552a90aa40592cbb798fce96d2c0.source: This is a fake laptop. End of story. I don't know how it got passed around, but you have to strongly suspect Russian intelligence or other nefarious actors here.
727620db9658552a90aa40592cbb798fce96d2c0.zh: 这是一台假笔记本电脑，事情就是这样。我不知道它是怎么流传出来的，但这里很值得怀疑俄罗斯情报部门或其他恶意势力的作用。

485987241337d9fd02bc808610fd30b88fb6c9b2.source: This is a fine answer for New England and the far North, but it will definitely cost you votes elsewhere.
485987241337d9fd02bc808610fd30b88fb6c9b2.zh: 这个回答在新英格兰和北方腹地很合适，但肯定会让你在其他地方失去选票。

6f800a6a326f383f85d649d779fb594094b4e684.source: This is a flat-out confusing answer to get from Mitt Romney.
6f800a6a326f383f85d649d779fb594094b4e684.zh: 米特·罗姆尼给出这种回答，简直让人摸不着头脑。

6ef7ca5c08e255918907758917b76f30f3b6aeec.source: This is a generational shift in the world energy game in the favor of the United States. There are plenty of regulations in place to protect our drinking water, and we simply cannot afford to miss out on the benefits of shale oil.
6ef7ca5c08e255918907758917b76f30f3b6aeec.zh: 这是世界能源格局中对美国有利的一次时代性转变。保护饮用水的法规已经很多，我们绝不能错失页岩油带来的益处。

714de4be8028c2224391932bf0117707d24f3344.source: This is a giveaway to oil companies that will not resolve America's underlying energy issues. We need more government investment in renewable energy sources, and strict regulations on oil and coal.
714de4be8028c2224391932bf0117707d24f3344.zh: 这是在给石油公司送好处，却无法解决美国根本性的能源问题。我们需要增加政府对可再生能源的投资，并严格监管石油和煤炭行业。

af2b5da5ecdd9ac423b5104076cd3a6fe4179993.source: This is a good answer for a Green Party candidate.
af2b5da5ecdd9ac423b5104076cd3a6fe4179993.zh: 对于绿党候选人而言，这是个好回答。

579d7017280dc743d40f41127f7ee56af5cf3c71.source: This is a good answer for this situation.
579d7017280dc743d40f41127f7ee56af5cf3c71.zh: 对于这个局面，这是个不错的回答。

a21c6dfc7c41a45310efbdae905e92b30cec1188.source: This is a good answer that should win support for you from Democrats.
a21c6dfc7c41a45310efbdae905e92b30cec1188.zh: 这是个不错的回答，应该能为你赢得民主党人的支持。

1e304d260ebe484076b2c79eef5554c9e912ba23.source: This is a good answer that should win support for you from Republicans.
1e304d260ebe484076b2c79eef5554c9e912ba23.zh: 这是个不错的回答，应该能为你赢得共和党人的支持。

be1dba381002b04f1778eda16f4b3092397f088c.source: This is a good answer that supports the record and policies of yourself and Eisenhower.
be1dba381002b04f1778eda16f4b3092397f088c.zh: 这是个不错的回答，支持了你自己和艾森豪威尔的政绩与政策。

53c895d8b227821e729d0c7ed7df0d2879a8a2ef.source: This is a good opportunity to take Roosevelt and Hughes down a peg. It seems like you are leaving something on the table if you ignore it.
53c895d8b227821e729d0c7ed7df0d2879a8a2ef.zh: 这是挫一挫罗斯福和休斯锐气的好机会。放着不用，似乎有点浪费。

33a5b8fe993cd0c22859d7f426153e593d9a801c.source: This is a good point to emphasize, especially if you don't support the Texas annexation.
33a5b8fe993cd0c22859d7f426153e593d9a801c.zh: 这一点值得着重强调，尤其是在你不支持吞并得克萨斯的情况下。

355f283d343df1215ea5615c35c1a59f56c79742.source: This is a good position in line with much of your party.
355f283d343df1215ea5615c35c1a59f56c79742.zh: 这是个不错的立场，与党内许多人的看法一致。

3e7c125729f0a1c08213a13c56e3c8838681f7d4.source: This is a good position to run a campaign on.
3e7c125729f0a1c08213a13c56e3c8838681f7d4.zh: 以这个立场开展竞选，是个不错的选择。

e64e00deaf99063f92e677df09903129742d9973.source: This is a good program overall. Perhaps some minor details can be fixed, but without standardized testing there is no way to monitor the quality of our educational system.
e64e00deaf99063f92e677df09903129742d9973.zh: 总体来说，这是个不错的计划。也许可以修正一些小细节，但没有标准化测试，就无法监督教育体系的质量。

c4a71e021503bdc1c5bab00303f9b62beb091eef.source: This is a good response to fire up the base.
c4a71e021503bdc1c5bab00303f9b62beb091eef.zh: 这是一个能激发基本盘热情的好回答。

d09203c43dabc671b7b477b032c786f884edbf99.source: This is a good response, but you’re imitating Nixon and diminishing the booming economy of the Democrats, which deflates your core supporters.
d09203c43dabc671b7b477b032c786f884edbf99.zh: 回答不错，但你在模仿尼克松，贬低民主党执政下繁荣的经济，让核心支持者泄了气。

8e534470469bd700bc5cfac12064f7df10335bfc.source: This is a good selling point for the undecided voter. You have a decent chance of winning the personality battle against a man like Romney.
8e534470469bd700bc5cfac12064f7df10335bfc.zh: 这很能打动尚未决定的选民。面对罗姆尼这样的人，你很有机会赢下个人魅力的较量。

cb9cd7cf11fc27895e6acfbfde4433e5d67bce4f.source: This is a good strategy, if the goal is moving past the Clinton years and presenting yourself as an acceptable mainstream leader.
cb9cd7cf11fc27895e6acfbfde4433e5d67bce4f.zh: 如果目标是告别克林顿时代，把自己塑造成一位大家能接受的主流领导人，这就是个好策略。

7af815b7f80b5ecfc6ed59db2703e7e7b3950a1c.source: This is a good strategy. You need to make the case that you've also acted with integrity in office, given the climate of this year's election.
7af815b7f80b5ecfc6ed59db2703e7e7b3950a1c.zh: 这是个好策略。鉴于今年选举的氛围，你必须说明，自己执政时同样坚守了廉正。

d6d7dc98b964f7dd814b3535082cc4fab8a4d717.source: This is a good theme to carry through with on your campaign.
d6d7dc98b964f7dd814b3535082cc4fab8a4d717.zh: 这是一个值得贯穿整个竞选的好主题。

09495294c6efa65f030e1765f699d6a48f603ef1.source: This is a good theme which distinguishes your own brand from that of Reagan.
09495294c6efa65f030e1765f699d6a48f603ef1.zh: 这是个不错的主题，能让你的政治形象与里根有所区别。

eec18b0f71628c28e70a4652e1607fbbb31a1f9c.source: This is a good way to finesse this issue. It has the added advantage, since you were a dark horse candidate, of uniting the factions of your party.
eec18b0f71628c28e70a4652e1607fbbb31a1f9c.zh: 这是巧妙处理这个问题的好办法。你本来就是提名战中的黑马，这样做还能够团结党内各派。

58f26cb8404ab7da5c2f06b27aa9be984444da67.source: This is a good way to point to the positive accomplishments of your party.
58f26cb8404ab7da5c2f06b27aa9be984444da67.zh: 这是强调本党积极政绩的好办法。

8a3ba5fae464c9329cfff3611e15fc4006ce8bb6.source: This is a good way to rally Northern support.
8a3ba5fae464c9329cfff3611e15fc4006ce8bb6.zh: 这是动员北方支持的好办法。

54e6485c6aff61b8fd5efd479efe3c9e2da62d0c.source: This is a good way to stick up for your policies as President, and to show the consequences of a gridlocked Congress.
54e6485c6aff61b8fd5efd479efe3c9e2da62d0c.zh: 这是为总统任内政策辩护、展示国会僵局后果的好办法。

2bdae5de48b552efe352ab6df3570f252d102c5d.source: This is a good, broad answer that doesn’t alienate anyone.
2bdae5de48b552efe352ab6df3570f252d102c5d.zh: 这是一个不错的、兼顾各方的回答，不会疏远任何人。

9629e99d8bf856ebefa995c896b3bdc6495168a8.source: This is a good, conservative answer on foreign policy.
9629e99d8bf856ebefa995c896b3bdc6495168a8.zh: 这是个不错的保守派外交政策回答。

cb775c4b9a485424fb54a235ca8d29dd7bf7da4e.source: This is a good, conservative answer that will motivate your base. As always, make sure you find the right balance between getting your troops out and appealing to undecided voters.
cb775c4b9a485424fb54a235ca8d29dd7bf7da4e.zh: 这是个不错的保守派回答，会鼓舞你的基本盘。还是那句话，既要动员自己人投票，也要吸引未决定的选民，务必找到合适的平衡。

76453970709ffc68bab0e4d2624715a3f6f477cd.source: This is a good, left-wing answer that will motivate your base.
76453970709ffc68bab0e4d2624715a3f6f477cd.zh: 这是个不错的左翼回答，会鼓舞你的基本盘。

a59509f1ece08143c830164763ea803149810fc6.source: This is a good, liberal answer but it might be a bridge too far in the climate of 1968.
a59509f1ece08143c830164763ea803149810fc6.zh: 这是一个不错的自由派回答，但在1968年的氛围下，或许走得太远了。

ab3a9b278ed24fcd0538f76cf1fdd67d423db249.source: This is a good, liberal answer that will motivate your base. As always, make sure you find the right balance between getting your troops out and appealing to undecided voters.
ab3a9b278ed24fcd0538f76cf1fdd67d423db249.zh: 这是个不错的自由派回答，会鼓舞你的基本盘。还是那句话，既要动员自己人投票，也要吸引未决定的选民，务必找到合适的平衡。

9afb409392bae0bc0ace492b6c0d3820610b1bfa.source: This is a good, liberal answer, but a bit outside the mainstream.
9afb409392bae0bc0ace492b6c0d3820610b1bfa.zh: 这是个不错的自由派回答，但有点偏离主流。

b34959105dde0235b34ddb5c04a93847a3d22d1a.source: This is a good, mainstream answer on foreign policy.
b34959105dde0235b34ddb5c04a93847a3d22d1a.zh: 这是个不错的主流外交政策回答。

28d89c969d3f95d376adf587db3621810e33d624.source: This is a good, mainstream answer. As always, make sure you balance the need to win moderates against the desires of your core supporters.
28d89c969d3f95d376adf587db3621810e33d624.zh: 这是个不错的主流回答。还是那句话，要在争取温和派与满足核心支持者之间取得平衡。

c9b859009106d101df56d1038308a72addd7534d.source: This is a good, moderate appeal that should draw sensible voters from across the spectrum.
c9b859009106d101df56d1038308a72addd7534d.zh: 这是不错的温和诉求，应当能吸引各个阵营中的理性选民。

eadb5c98a964faa14b33df71165073c734558daa.source: This is a good, proactive step that helped minimize the damage from Butz's gaffe.
eadb5c98a964faa14b33df71165073c734558daa.zh: 这是积极而明智的一步，有助于尽量减轻巴茨失言造成的损害。

5786acf058e27ebb76990e32473adf25e4f799f0.source: This is a good, safe answer on the topic.
5786acf058e27ebb76990e32473adf25e4f799f0.zh: 这是个不错而稳妥的回答。

578f65af1cded8891149a8de61fc10b8f71b84aa.source: This is a good, solid response to the question.
578f65af1cded8891149a8de61fc10b8f71b84aa.zh: 这是个不错、扎实的回答。

f3fbdf009a57d89fd5e2d3a35ec8b28fe76e2760.source: This is a great answer if you want to lose the election.
f3fbdf009a57d89fd5e2d3a35ec8b28fe76e2760.zh: 如果你想输掉选举，这真是个绝妙的回答。

e473c858a01b8630a02ca66b0e7ce37f545fe38d.source: This is a great answer if, as your selection of Humphrey suggests, you plan to run as a strong supporter of civil rights.
e473c858a01b8630a02ca66b0e7ce37f545fe38d.zh: 如果选择汉弗莱意味着你打算积极支持民权，那么这个回答就非常好。

ebc9878c97ecb45989f5e53a72f95e9eb943827b.source: This is a great answer that reminds the nation of the fruitless endeavor that is Vietnam.
ebc9878c97ecb45989f5e53a72f95e9eb943827b.zh: 这个回答很好，提醒全国人民：越南战争是一场徒劳的事业。

5d9221ac9c020cde5448ba75511b2d401b2872a3.source: This is a gross misrepresentation of my statements. I was speaking hypothetically about the future 40 or 50 years from now. And I would remind you that these statements were most likely leaked by Russian intelligence.
5d9221ac9c020cde5448ba75511b2d401b2872a3.zh: 这严重歪曲了我的话。我是在假设四五十年后的未来。还要提醒你，这些言论很可能是俄罗斯情报部门泄露的。

77932f309c786e22b8686efdc6c36a1c9811b84f.source: This is a gutsy move, but people get the message. In any case, at least they're looking at your face instead of a toxic waste dump.
77932f309c786e22b8686efdc6c36a1c9811b84f.zh: 这一步很大胆，但人们理解了你的用意。无论如何，至少他们现在看到的是你的脸，而不是有毒废物堆场。

bf63069d11102a215efae83edad7bed2e14fa404.source: This is a guy with a terrific record in state government, really terrific as Governor of Indiana. A wonderful Congressman you might have heard. And we need experience. Experience is very important.
bf63069d11102a215efae83edad7bed2e14fa404.zh: 这个人在州政府里政绩出色，当印第安纳州州长时真是出色。你们可能听说过，他还是一位很棒的国会议员。我们需要经验，经验非常重要。

efdd60722ad36ae6874807008751815c21f6bc1d.source: This is a hedging of the Republican platform which does not play well with the party. Territorial expansion is not supported at the moment.
efdd60722ad36ae6874807008751815c21f6bc1d.zh: 这等于在共和党纲领上含糊退让，党内对此并不满意。目前大家不支持领土扩张。

8d6536ca815559f8cae3354a6640bc969e6968cb.source: This is a huge leap forward between the United States and Soviet Union, and I hope to oversee additional arms control measures during my time as President.
8d6536ca815559f8cae3354a6640bc969e6968cb.zh: 这标志着美国与苏联关系取得重大进展，我希望在总统任内继续推动军备控制措施。

d5a43104efc2668b99617e874df3fb12bb1aa4d6.source: This is a huge leap forward between the United States and Soviet Union.
d5a43104efc2668b99617e874df3fb12bb1aa4d6.zh: 这标志着美国与苏联关系取得重大进展。

f3ddda6c750289f20f69414f86c60fa324fbf5c1.source: This is a liberal answer that still engages moderates. The negative? Conservative Democrats are upset by the answer.
f3ddda6c750289f20f69414f86c60fa324fbf5c1.zh: 这个回答偏自由派，却仍能争取温和派。坏处呢？保守派民主党人不高兴了。

1685384f7591d02d37479159549a24a332e531f1.source: This is a limited compromise. Palmer of course is an old man who will lose all of the states you conceded him, but every vote will count in Kentucky.
1685384f7591d02d37479159549a24a332e531f1.zh: 这是有限的妥协。帕尔默毕竟年事已高，你让出的州他一个也赢不了；但在肯塔基，每一票都很关键。

54038ddefa35bada1349e3130f84def956196674.source: This is a little incongruous with some of what you and Robert Kennedy have been doing recently in the area of investigating union abuses.
54038ddefa35bada1349e3130f84def956196674.zh: 你和罗伯特·肯尼迪最近一直在调查工会的不当行为，这番话与其中一些做法有点不一致。

5de384ff2ababdd097220fc923dbcad00c1c1587.source: This is a little incrementalist, especially compared to your attacks on Bernie Sanders in the primaries.
5de384ff2ababdd097220fc923dbcad00c1c1587.zh: 这有点偏向渐进改革，尤其与你初选中攻击伯尼·桑德斯的言辞相比。

91eaeb5f230bd5083fdf8742ee35cf01a67afa9d.source: This is a little lukewarm, but it does get the idea across.
91eaeb5f230bd5083fdf8742ee35cf01a67afa9d.zh: 这有点不冷不热，不过也传达了你的意思。

97b2d7682d02e1d473c57f20f17847e7ef90d891.source: This is a little out of step with Whig ideology.
97b2d7682d02e1d473c57f20f17847e7ef90d891.zh: 这与辉格党的理念略有出入。

9bd31860c6b9b3787bf0c3ecb1bf90d805ccc84c.source: This is a little to the morally conservative side vis-a-vis most Americans.
9bd31860c6b9b3787bf0c3ecb1bf90d805ccc84c.zh: 与大多数美国人相比，这个立场在道德观上稍显保守。

678691801d9e475b7c03523362593ba8f4355719.source: This is a mainstream position for a Republican to take.
678691801d9e475b7c03523362593ba8f4355719.zh: 这是共和党人通常会采取的主流立场。

3941998dad17189e92b848bea50676d6ea229c66.source: This is a middle-ground answer that doesn’t rebuff any voters.
3941998dad17189e92b848bea50676d6ea229c66.zh: 这是个中间立场的回答，不会把任何选民推开。

92f6cf3c5e7758adedff617c4c31da785e335099.source: This is a minor civil case, pursued by a few disgruntled people for political purposes. Many many people were very satisfied with Trump University.
92f6cf3c5e7758adedff617c4c31da785e335099.zh: 这不过是一桩小小的民事案件，由几个心怀不满的人出于政治目的提起。很多很多人对特朗普大学都非常满意。

c969fdaeda68ee4bd9841859e68e6bdb035ef87c.source: This is a moderate answer that offends very few people.
c969fdaeda68ee4bd9841859e68e6bdb035ef87c.zh: 这是个温和的回答，几乎不会得罪什么人。

de79b03fdcfb364556ff2e63de13f0c6fb78ff3a.source: This is a moderate answer, being both patriotic and appeases college students.
de79b03fdcfb364556ff2e63de13f0c6fb78ff3a.zh: 这是个温和的回答，既体现爱国立场，也安抚了大学生。

af6de083600042f2e22b8f5120383ce37b7bdb37.source: This is a moderate enough position, but progressives and Hispanics sense that you trying to back away from your earlier pledges on this issue.
af6de083600042f2e22b8f5120383ce37b7bdb37.zh: 这个立场还算温和，但进步派与拉美裔感觉，你正在试图退回去，不再履行此前在这个问题上的承诺。

31b36912284da67a9a913294b8bd136f016d9ae5.source: This is a moderate position, but it leaves some supporters a little disappointed.
31b36912284da67a9a913294b8bd136f016d9ae5.zh: 这是温和的立场，但让一些支持者有点失望。

4d587ed583c223601f175f4288b131fdb3878f1f.source: This is a moderate stance, but is that the best option in this election? Many Democrats want to hear more from you.
4d587ed583c223601f175f4288b131fdb3878f1f.zh: 这是温和立场，但在这次选举中，是最佳选择吗？许多民主党人希望听到你说得更多。

6f6faf95918a954c67d0372791ad9a526217c610.source: This is a pretty mainstream position by this point, in either party.
6f6faf95918a954c67d0372791ad9a526217c610.zh: 到这个时候，这已经是两党都相当主流的立场。

f774e55f2d5c84d76eb2f6254189445c09e4ac34.source: This is a pretty passive answer for a Cold War environment.
f774e55f2d5c84d76eb2f6254189445c09e4ac34.zh: 在冷战的环境下，这个回答相当消极。

25975e1f75d3f0fcbbc7a64ec587d7c14e1c181b.source: This is a pretty safe answer that appeals to your party without alienating moderates.
25975e1f75d3f0fcbbc7a64ec587d7c14e1c181b.zh: 这个回答相当稳妥，既能吸引党内人士，也不会疏远温和派。

9464a70dfcdba95bbb228d5838840527ad7f1064.source: This is a pretty standard answer for a Democrat. Of course, if you're elected, liberals in the party (such as Ted Kennedy) will expect you to take action on this issue.
9464a70dfcdba95bbb228d5838840527ad7f1064.zh: 对民主党人来说，这是相当标准的回答。当然，如果当选，特德·肯尼迪这样的党内自由派会期待你在这个问题上采取行动。

da98426350dcc3a839a205f7464d4e84a187eb4b.source: This is a principled viewpoint, that also removes what little chance you might have of carrying New York and New Jersey.
da98426350dcc3a839a205f7464d4e84a187eb4b.zh: 这个立场有原则，却也让你失去了赢得纽约和新泽西的那一点微弱希望。

bc33b224824d607a4decc7b5676418e91785c0dd.source: This is a rallying cry that can certainly help your party in the North and West.
bc33b224824d607a4decc7b5676418e91785c0dd.zh: 这个号召肯定能帮助你们党争取北方和西部的支持。

fba9d5341ae57e33c3b7e6c77061a9038a450a9c.source: This is a real opening for us. I will challenge Nixon on this issue relentlessly.
fba9d5341ae57e33c3b7e6c77061a9038a450a9c.zh: 这对我们是个真正的突破口。我会不断就此向尼克松发起挑战。

d0a502e8f3a04bf24a7bca7c672c9b2319090665.source: This is a reasonable point of view that pleases your supporters.
d0a502e8f3a04bf24a7bca7c672c9b2319090665.zh: 这是个合理的观点，让你的支持者很满意。

547b63691940f08aec5527e39e86f5936d615886.source: This is a regime that has publicly stated its desire to 'wipe Israel off the map'. It would be suicidal to watch them develop a nuclear weapon without making some attempt to strike back.
547b63691940f08aec5527e39e86f5936d615886.zh: 这个政权公开说过，想把“以色列从地图上抹去”。眼看着他们发展核武器却不试着回击，无异于自寻死路。

a35ad62771860328951f2fdad2291fe1dd7c284d.source: This is a safe answer -- it won't hurt you or help you either way.
a35ad62771860328951f2fdad2291fe1dd7c284d.zh: 这个回答很稳妥，不论怎样，都不会给你带来损失或帮助。

365cb5449b436217a909d3620b5a1fd584f87b3b.source: This is a safe answer that won't hurt you too much with anybody.
365cb5449b436217a909d3620b5a1fd584f87b3b.zh: 这是个稳妥的回答，不会严重得罪任何一方。

047dd1c5f208a3e76c37441ccafb8576ed732081.source: This is a safe position for a Republican to take.
047dd1c5f208a3e76c37441ccafb8576ed732081.zh: 对共和党人来说，这是个稳妥的立场。

5b7f9df696c685eda1e9f5bc2f9e9f5ee480229c.source: This is a safe, moderate answer.

e7ae40d85fe42cc938e7143f9ea2f60c41bd2370.source: This is a safe, standard response and your visit makes you look statesmanlike in contrast to Trump.
e7ae40d85fe42cc938e7143f9ea2f60c41bd2370.zh: 这是一个稳妥而常规的回应。你的访问也让你显得比特朗普更有政治家的风范。

816b802abca43982cbf7f2f1b37cd8f5d7bf213f.source: This is a safe, standard response to such events.
816b802abca43982cbf7f2f1b37cd8f5d7bf213f.zh: 对于这类事件，这是一个稳妥而常规的回应。

2f329384210e852ac11df0bcf71895e334ec18ce.source: This is a scare tactic in the first place, and in any case I have always supported the colonization of freed slaves back to Africa.
2f329384210e852ac11df0bcf71895e334ec18ce.zh: 这首先就是恐吓手法。况且，我一直支持把获释奴隶送往非洲殖民安置。

d608817c2af340fe3ecbe5b0d9b759db5fd2cdc9.source: This is a sensible piece of legislation. I support it and I think that every decent American supports it too.
d608817c2af340fe3ecbe5b0d9b759db5fd2cdc9.zh: 这是一项合理的立法。我支持它，也认为每个正派的美国人都会支持它。

ca1a0f80ddb17c3d26cd27762ef86a16ff04de25.source: This is a sensible policy that will reduce teen pregnancies and help our children make informed decisions.
ca1a0f80ddb17c3d26cd27762ef86a16ff04de25.zh: 这是一项合理的政策，能减少青少年怀孕，并帮助孩子作出知情的决定。

bb75b4c56f0b94c7f780aafd14c05e4f42d5ba10.source: This is a signature accomplishment of the Obama Administration, and I support it whole-heartedly.
bb75b4c56f0b94c7f780aafd14c05e4f42d5ba10.zh: 这是奥巴马政府的标志性成就，我全心全意支持。

dd2f7e829ca4a48a2ca5d24fd9bafd410cf1b656.source: This is a simple decision -- anything you can do to emphasize your close relationship with Andrew Jackson is a net positive.
dd2f7e829ca4a48a2ca5d24fd9bafd410cf1b656.zh: 这是个简单的决定——凡是能突出你与安德鲁·杰克逊亲密关系的做法，总体上都对你有利。

62df504c369a778f24d32713aada9799afbb81d0.source: This is a situation that we need to watch carefully, and I am open to a variety of measures if necessary.
62df504c369a778f24d32713aada9799afbb81d0.zh: 这是我们需要密切关注的局势。如有必要，我愿意考虑多种措施。

83d70064301dd575b12d18b44e4c3f0b19ff6671.source: This is a somewhat irrelevant comment.
83d70064301dd575b12d18b44e4c3f0b19ff6671.zh: 这番评论多少有些跑题。

c48bada8f773fcda310908b9064f235b5422c19f.source: This is a specialized occupational question that can best be answered by the ATF and the Department of Justice.
c48bada8f773fcda310908b9064f235b5422c19f.zh: 这是个专业执法问题，最好由烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局和司法部来回答。

df1ed9870d759ed31766640e8cc4ae9e1d2a8601.source: This is a standard, Republican position.
df1ed9870d759ed31766640e8cc4ae9e1d2a8601.zh: 这是标准的共和党立场。

6e60b12028b3555b6a22b531cfcc4f48ffc68c3c.source: This is a standard, non-political response to any tragic event.
6e60b12028b3555b6a22b531cfcc4f48ffc68c3c.zh: 这是面对任何悲剧时常见的、非政治性的回应。

e26a79b3968482603d4d0ebe7d6abeac63dda58f.source: This is a strange aside to take, but one that is unlikely to make much of an impression.
e26a79b3968482603d4d0ebe7d6abeac63dda58f.zh: 这是个奇怪的岔题，不过大概不会给人留下太深印象。

4cef8e8c6cce35b0cb4691ff3517dc88050bc3d0.source: This is a strong answer, but it certainly helps you with the Jewish vote in New York and elsewhere.
4cef8e8c6cce35b0cb4691ff3517dc88050bc3d0.zh: 这个回答很强硬，不过，它确实有助于你争取纽约和其他地方的犹太选票。

da0eaf3fbd5d15394dfd89b91910c3752b0abea7.source: This is a strong pro-silver answer, while still acknowledging the difficulties a fixed price could cause in the Treasury.
da0eaf3fbd5d15394dfd89b91910c3752b0abea7.zh: 这个回答坚定支持铸银，同时也承认，固定比价可能给国库带来困难。

be22a1845ca50480a70430b600c5de32e88c80f8.source: This is a strong, patriotic position, and helps mute some jingoistic criticism of the Democrats' anti-war stance.
be22a1845ca50480a70430b600c5de32e88c80f8.zh: 这是一个坚定、爱国的立场，有助于平息一些沙文主义者对民主党反战立场的批评。

8b998351e64b5fe4d0b7f92e26ffa3b528260acf.source: This is a sure way to motivate the base, but it may not be the most popular economic prescription at this point.
8b998351e64b5fe4d0b7f92e26ffa3b528260acf.zh: 这肯定能激发基本盘，不过在这个时候，也许不是最受欢迎的经济方案。

915b741496496ef60b45e5ca0c179c4f0a367d2f.source: This is a surprising anti-Israel answer coming from you, that hurts you marginally.
915b741496496ef60b45e5ca0c179c4f0a367d2f.zh: 这番反以色列的话出自你口中，令人意外，也让你受到轻微损失。

936ec09aead664850f4a9f37f2f06217fb9a56cd.source: This is a surprisingly anti-war position for you, given initial expectations.
936ec09aead664850f4a9f37f2f06217fb9a56cd.zh: 考虑到最初的预期，你这个反战立场令人意外。

e287ef11a99e072da227bd7cddb53529b0d9bd97.source: This is a surprisingly conservative position, based on the current environment and even your own past statements.
e287ef11a99e072da227bd7cddb53529b0d9bd97.zh: 考虑到目前的环境，甚至你自己过去的表态，这个立场保守得令人意外。

c0b66975397032b3ea55b725a13b18c0333595f2.source: This is a surprisingly progressive position, compared to what your stance was in the primaries. But it is definitely making the news today.
c0b66975397032b3ea55b725a13b18c0333595f2.zh: 与你初选时的立场相比，这出人意料地进步。不过，今天的新闻肯定会报道。

f741735248bd1726e42a9280616f8122e9719c69.source: This is a surprisingly radical viewpoint, and many moderates are expressing concern about it.
f741735248bd1726e42a9280616f8122e9719c69.zh: 这个观点出人意料地激进，许多温和派对此表示担忧。

f9a8400d4be868d84e46aebf7e13903914d10add.source: This is a tad sympathetic to the protestors, but it gets the job done. But moderates, focused on the chaos, are bothered by your acknowledgment of student complaints.
f9a8400d4be868d84e46aebf7e13903914d10add.zh: 这对抗议者略有同情，但还是达到了目的。不过，关注混乱局面的温和派，对你承认学生诉求有所不满。

c54ab707eaa5ec482751a7e7ec36c2e6223e53f8.source: This is a terrible idea. Can't you just picture twenty million employees performing make-work jobs at miniscule wages?
c54ab707eaa5ec482751a7e7ec36c2e6223e53f8.zh: 这主意糟透了。你就不能想象一下，2000万雇员拿着微薄工资，做着纯粹为了安排就业而硬造出来的工作吗？

a46db61917ae8c8e56d4c0bbce7eac5dc7b9d311.source: This is a naked power grab by the Republicans, Trump, and Mitch McConnell that puts the integrity of the Court in serious jeopardy. It was just four years ago that McConnell took the exact opposite position on this same issue.
a46db61917ae8c8e56d4c0bbce7eac5dc7b9d311.zh: 这是共和党、特朗普和米奇·麦康奈尔赤裸裸的夺权，严重危及法院的公信力。就在四年前，麦康奈尔在同一个问题上采取的还是完全相反的立场。

281eaadb55de6257ceb783ac08cbf07b15f01b7b.source: This is a necessary step against the overreach and abuse of power of the Executive branch.
281eaadb55de6257ceb783ac08cbf07b15f01b7b.zh: 这是遏制行政部门越权和滥权的必要措施。

f9043c7e3344ddac9c033051c00979d973cf1bb0.source: This is a necessary step forward in the self-determination of the Philippines.
f9043c7e3344ddac9c033051c00979d973cf1bb0.zh: 这是菲律宾迈向自决必不可少的一步。

7bdf2b785837782912837e95f2f958e4ff6dfded.source: This is a necessary step to enforce the Brown decision and uphold the ideals of America.
7bdf2b785837782912837e95f2f958e4ff6dfded.zh: 这是落实布朗案判决、捍卫美国理想的必要一步。

f4ff00bea66f4551a2fd0301c7e0d371d32fa974.source: This is a necessary step to protect our allies in Europe from current and future threats to their security. I will strongly support this as President.
f4ff00bea66f4551a2fd0301c7e0d371d32fa974.zh: 这是保护欧洲盟友免受当前和未来安全威胁的必要措施。作为总统，我会大力支持。

1cc0879dba4dfe4ce8f1c0fd8147106e114bed16.source: This is a nice thing to hope for, but for the moment there are a lot of popular Democratic Congressmen in states that you need to win. Tactfulness might be the better strategy.
1cc0879dba4dfe4ce8f1c0fd8147106e114bed16.zh: 这个愿望当然不错，但眼下，你需要赢下的州里，有许多受欢迎的民主党众议员。措辞圆融一点，或许是更好的策略。

405c2e48756d5ede4c6bc3786e6c73d19ddf6187.source: This is a no-brainer. Just sit back and let Carter shoot himself in the foot.
405c2e48756d5ede4c6bc3786e6c73d19ddf6187.zh: 这不用动脑筋。坐着看卡特搬起石头砸自己的脚就行。

1a38fee2eaa485160e71180c38136ee2966bdac7.source: This is a non-issue. Bill Clinton is one the best Presidents of the last fifty years, and we should be focusing on his policies and successes, not his personal affairs.
1a38fee2eaa485160e71180c38136ee2966bdac7.zh: 这根本不是什么问题。比尔·克林顿是过去五十年来最优秀的总统之一，我们应当关注他的政策和成就，而不是他的私生活。

67720e80e8fadd9dd44cc3f7f0d0e2f6f8ce7dd7.source: This is a petty, personal attack, designed to distract from the real issues facing our country.
67720e80e8fadd9dd44cc3f7f0d0e2f6f8ce7dd7.zh: 这是小气的个人攻击，意图转移人们对国家面临的实质问题的注意力。

8e0ec5c4545a37b1c95425eb58dbce92de39eb39.source: This is a popular stance for Democrats and progressives.
8e0ec5c4545a37b1c95425eb58dbce92de39eb39.zh: 这个立场受到民主党人和进步派的欢迎。

718a22056883f663704fc87c088fcbda185db631.source: This is a popular, mainstream answer on this issue. Even Republicans are looking for ways to defuse Cold War tensions these days.
718a22056883f663704fc87c088fcbda185db631.zh: 这个回答很受欢迎，也符合主流。在这些日子里，连共和党人都在寻找缓和冷战紧张局势的办法。

49e243e73f19a83890caa7ea8c2d2caba6730eeb.source: This is a positive campaign message, and it should especially reinforce your lead in your home state.
49e243e73f19a83890caa7ea8c2d2caba6730eeb.zh: 这是一个积极的竞选主题，尤其应该能巩固你在家乡州的领先优势。

5d363219004f8b850472e3c2e589b27e0b383b1c.source: This is a positive step forward for our criminal justice system. Certain crimes, like murder, demand such punishment if true justice is to prevail.
5d363219004f8b850472e3c2e589b27e0b383b1c.zh: 这对我们的刑事司法体系是积极的一步。对于谋杀等某些罪行，要让真正的正义得到伸张，就必须施以这样的惩罚。

24dc6b8486415a7eb048cb4ca004b4d9a314c10d.source: This is a pretty conservative answer for a Democrat.
24dc6b8486415a7eb048cb4ca004b4d9a314c10d.zh: 对民主党人来说，这个回答相当保守。

4c3db54578ad84d59a429d463221ad010f1d2056.source: This is a pretty conservative answer for a Democrat. It sounds like something Ronald Reagan might say.
4c3db54578ad84d59a429d463221ad010f1d2056.zh: 对民主党人来说，这个回答相当保守，听起来像罗纳德·里根会说的话。

4313285ea0750296a728d72231de5f5ccd4e4dd4.source: This is a pretty liberal policy, but it's broadly popular with Democrats and particularly important to Hubert Humphrey.
4313285ea0750296a728d72231de5f5ccd4e4dd4.zh: 这项政策颇为自由派，但在民主党内广受欢迎，对休伯特·汉弗莱也尤其重要。

d4dce42d2255000bbfb7b4c77b923f9af18a0c71.source: This is a theme that will establish you as a moderate, mainstream conservative. To run a national campaign against a popular Administration, this might be the right tone to strike.
d4dce42d2255000bbfb7b4c77b923f9af18a0c71.zh: 这个主题将使您成为温和的主流保守派。要开展一场全国性的运动来反对一个受欢迎的政府，这可能是正确的打击基调。

8b258591300782f3db4b67202c9aa09db487ed2a.source: This is a total overreaction as usual. And how about the fact that the Democrats were sending fake protestors to my rallies to get these headlines up in the first place?
8b258591300782f3db4b67202c9aa09db487ed2a.zh: 照例，这完全是反应过度。再说，民主党派冒牌抗议者到我的集会上，不就是为了先制造出这些新闻头条吗？

2133c6903fac5ae34780e8addc96b21cb9a9b134.source: This is a typical Republican position.
2133c6903fac5ae34780e8addc96b21cb9a9b134.zh: 这是典型的共和党立场。

e9a2f72dec69581f040a8ab91bbab3b0ad99b357.source: This is a vague answer, but one that is easily used to paint you as a radical.
e9a2f72dec69581f040a8ab91bbab3b0ad99b357.zh: 这个回答很模糊，却很容易被拿来把你描绘成激进分子。

717588a101f3203b67c11188d91ed5e143820499.source: This is a valuable component of our international presence. We should maintain the funding we have in place, which is miniscule in proportion to our overall budget.
717588a101f3203b67c11188d91ed5e143820499.zh: 这是我们国际影响力的重要组成部分。我们应该维持现有的资金，这与我们的总体预算相比微乎其微。

824ac63bd6719d5e0928662321b6d33e80e6fa1c.source: This is a very advanced position for a Republican to take on federal regulation.
824ac63bd6719d5e0928662321b6d33e80e6fa1c.zh: 对共和党人来说，在联邦监管问题上采取这个立场，已是相当进步了。

9b67d8d0eb6ce3f6bedca03c434a5f144f510d04.source: This is a very disappointing answer to liberals and activists alike, not least of which is your running mate Humphrey, but it may win over wary moderates- and it certainly won’t push Southern Democrats further away.
9b67d8d0eb6ce3f6bedca03c434a5f144f510d04.zh: 这个回答让自由派和活动家都十分失望，尤其是你的竞选搭档汉弗莱。不过，它也许能争取谨慎的温和派，肯定也不会让南方民主党人离你更远。

7bf1c2265fe995c041c1af3ee87f7ccb7847c81e.source: This is a very popular pick among religious conservatives, many of whom believe that Barrett shares their core beliefs on religious freedom and abortion.
7bf1c2265fe995c041c1af3ee87f7ccb7847c81e.zh: 宗教保守派很欢迎这个人选，其中许多人认为，巴雷特与他们在宗教自由和堕胎上的核心信念一致。

79dd8f0f78891b207f527c83a9707caf8ff9a68e.source: This is a very serious issue and the integrity of the Court is at risk. We're going to create a commission when I'm elected to recommend ways in which we can reform the federal court system and restore the faith of the American people.
79dd8f0f78891b207f527c83a9707caf8ff9a68e.zh: 这是个非常严肃的问题，法院的公信力正面临风险。当选后，我们会成立委员会，建议如何改革联邦法院体系，恢复美国人民的信任。

212cba85c8dcd72704ffe70c5e63cd954a19a9b4.source: This is a vigorous, straightforward defense of your views on the gold standard.
212cba85c8dcd72704ffe70c5e63cd954a19a9b4.zh: 这是对你金本位立场有力而明确的辩护。

9afeac7fb4b76e8d47fc501a388e927e6be110c6.source: This is a weak answer to liberals, but appeals strongly to moderates.
9afeac7fb4b76e8d47fc501a388e927e6be110c6.zh: 在自由派看来，这个回答软弱无力，却很能吸引温和派。

87298b9b04beef0f99acb067bca8be6c366c8a46.source: This is a weak point of Johnson’s, and is sure to hurt him..
87298b9b04beef0f99acb067bca8be6c366c8a46.zh: 这是约翰逊的一个弱点，肯定会伤到他。

66f56b2e0bdfa63ffd506c377d5f544c74ed6165.source: This is a well-meaning group of honest Christian women. I am neither especially opposed to nor especially supportive of their goals.
66f56b2e0bdfa63ffd506c377d5f544c74ed6165.zh: 这是由善意、诚实的基督教妇女组成的团体。对于她们的目标，我既不特别反对，也不特别支持。

f88964b2ec52b0798268cba8bcbbc07b6aa452c5.source: This is about as statesmanlike a comment as can be expected to come from The Donald.
f88964b2ec52b0798268cba8bcbbc07b6aa452c5.zh: 这大概已经是能指望“那位唐纳德”说出的，最有政治家风范的话了。

7bf6cfe1700d3fdb0ea2a274d8e3e67a2066dded.source: This is absolutely not what you need to say if you want to win this fall.
7bf6cfe1700d3fdb0ea2a274d8e3e67a2066dded.zh: 如果你想在今年秋季获胜，就绝对不该这么说。

93421f30e7eccdab304ce1f8d07dce297fcfe37c.source: This is absolutely obscene, and it's not going to keep growing when I am President.
93421f30e7eccdab304ce1f8d07dce297fcfe37c.zh: 这实在荒唐透顶。我当上总统后，它不会继续增长。

162dd3c88c968931ddf954f5fe7188461c9aad4d.source: This is absolutely the wrong solution to our business downturn. We must allow the free coinage of silver to reduce the burden of our debts.
162dd3c88c968931ddf954f5fe7188461c9aad4d.zh: 这绝对不是解决商业萧条的正确办法。我们必须允许白银自由铸币，减轻债务负担。

f0a7bc66aca57355a5663514d78fe5d441a92c7a.source: This is absolutely the wrong solution to our business downturn. We must increase tariffs to stimulate American business.
f0a7bc66aca57355a5663514d78fe5d441a92c7a.zh: 这绝对不是解决商业萧条的正确办法。我们必须提高关税，促进美国工商业。

ce15a0d3b02f4860aaee1ff4c14ba692964e99c4.source: This is an abstract question at this point. We can barely hold this country together as it is, without addressing some theoretical expansion into the Caribbean.
ce15a0d3b02f4860aaee1ff4c14ba692964e99c4.zh: 眼下，这是个空泛的问题。维持国家统一已经十分困难，根本顾不上讨论向加勒比扩张这种假设。

9fa8edf043a1da84ceefa25c2ce9b9ee2ccb6319.source: This is an acceptable answer to assuage Johnson and the Democratic establishment, but you’ve done nothing to win over disaffected doves.
9fa8edf043a1da84ceefa25c2ce9b9ee2ccb6319.zh: 这个回答足以安抚约翰逊和民主党权势人物，却丝毫没有争取到心怀不满的鸽派。

3020f5e0e436adfa83c1d65ffdd5661710d66d19.source: This is an acceptable response, but it wouldn't have harmed you to be a little more bold.
3020f5e0e436adfa83c1d65ffdd5661710d66d19.zh: 这是个可以接受的回应，不过再大胆些也无妨。

484f787748d55c57566bdfad803cc27fdb07198e.source: This is an answer is that really is in tune with the country. However, liberals and blacks notice your evasiveness about civil rights.
484f787748d55c57566bdfad803cc27fdb07198e.zh: 这个回答确实契合全国的情绪。不过，自由派和黑人注意到，你在民权问题上躲躲闪闪。

d3648be844e907efb47f118df4d2b2723821fca2.source: This is an attempt by Republicans to deflect attention from the unpopularity of their own candidate, Mr. Bush, and his elitist background and policies.
d3648be844e907efb47f118df4d2b2723821fca2.zh: 共和党这样做，是想转移人们对他们自己的候选人布什先生不受欢迎、以及他精英阶层的出身和政策的注意力。

6ff12ad8b91e19d007c8608af36c796b01199a28.source: This is an easy way to separate yourself from Reagan.
6ff12ad8b91e19d007c8608af36c796b01199a28.zh: 这是一个轻松与里根拉开距离的办法。

9402b54d037441981ad349e1703384676824d655.source: This is an embarrassing issue, but your best course is to minimize it and hope that it doesn't come up too much during the campaign.
9402b54d037441981ad349e1703384676824d655.zh: 这件事很尴尬，但最好的办法还是淡化它，希望竞选期间不会被频繁提起。

9bfcbc94d284d6c5e060a7feba850fd0d2f1dcfa.source: This is an idea that I support, and I will try my best to see it implemented.
9bfcbc94d284d6c5e060a7feba850fd0d2f1dcfa.zh: 我支持这个主意，会尽力让它付诸实施。

f089400695820f62694da5bc361cc7b754c942d5.source: This is an interesting idea, but I'm more concerned about issues like education and health care.
f089400695820f62694da5bc361cc7b754c942d5.zh: 这个主意很有意思，但我更关心教育和医疗等问题。

7451736481b296c25f8191309d8436372c0edf88.source: This is an interesting strategy, but maybe not the best. Some think you are pushing yourself too far from the center to win a national election.
7451736481b296c25f8191309d8436372c0edf88.zh: 这个策略有点意思，但也许不是最好的。有些人认为，要赢得全国选举，你把自己推得离中间路线太远了。

087b3e0fcfeb2e6e91f9e1f3a4f4c9755c4d12d6.source: This is an issue I would have to consider more closely over the next couple of years. Let's see how the current negotiations go.
087b3e0fcfeb2e6e91f9e1f3a4f4c9755c4d12d6.zh: 未来几年，我必须更仔细地考虑这个问题。先看看目前的谈判如何发展吧。

f2ec103741359b3e45c0166e67e9681a125b67aa.source: This is an issue I'd have to consider carefully, but perhaps if we got the Soviet Union on board I'd be open to it.
f2ec103741359b3e45c0166e67e9681a125b67aa.zh: 这需要慎重考虑。不过，如果能让苏联也同意，我或许愿意接受。

584d43aacf1452cf69cbf37951fcf387143a01b0.source: This is an issue of state politics that I will stay removed from.
584d43aacf1452cf69cbf37951fcf387143a01b0.zh: 这是州一级的政治问题，我不会介入。

7241f574af93b515f2095463a84c9abaf8985623.source: This is an issue that has been blown way out of proportion. In many of these cases, I've proposed my own alternative to a given bill, and Congress has acted on it.
7241f574af93b515f2095463a84c9abaf8985623.zh: 这个问题被严重夸大了。在许多情况下，我都为有关法案提出过自己的替代方案，而国会也采取了行动。

5d90edac96d4285d1527b4f9d0c1913bfadc1a58.source: This is an issue that unites your party, and the states you need to win. There's no reason to downplay it.
5d90edac96d4285d1527b4f9d0c1913bfadc1a58.zh: 这个议题能团结你们党和那些你必须拿下的州，没有理由淡化它。

b4236daf3c34591e6f24c7bbbf06475848ef9c0b.source: This is an outdated doctrine that could needlessly commit the United States to an unnecessary war. We should view any such blanket statements with grave suspicion.
b4236daf3c34591e6f24c7bbbf06475848ef9c0b.zh: 这套过时的主义，可能无谓地把美国拖入不必要的战争。对这种一概而论的声明，我们应当保持高度警惕。

2a729fddf0b76800176c48d301ca62ce8a83eacd.source: This is an unconscionable violation of civil rights and will certainly lead to racial profiling.
2a729fddf0b76800176c48d301ca62ce8a83eacd.zh: 这是对公民权利的严重侵犯，绝对无法容忍，而且必然会导致执法人员按种族筛查嫌疑人。

b48647d5fea29b757c15a59e522acb8c8bfef6c4.source: This is an unexpected area for you to praise Obama in.
b48647d5fea29b757c15a59e522acb8c8bfef6c4.zh: 你竟然在这个领域赞扬奥巴马，令人意外。

5d3e93278037c4d81ec02fa9ed85e05ffa4a103a.source: This is an unfounded rumor that the McKinley campaign has disseminated to discredit my candidacy.
5d3e93278037c4d81ec02fa9ed85e05ffa4a103a.zh: 这是麦金莱阵营为损害我的候选人声誉，散布的无稽谣言。

e66c91940f5fca2ea0403c4dfd3447298042440b.source: This is an unusual move, but it makes voting for you an easier pill to swallow for progressives and moderates alike, who just want to stop Trump this year.
e66c91940f5fca2ea0403c4dfd3447298042440b.zh: 这个举动不寻常，但对今年只想挡住特朗普的进步派和温和派来说，投票支持你都更容易接受了。

9d4ef05690b4179008589d0b1e29a9c64dfe024f.source: This is an unwelcome change of position to your supporters and contributors.
9d4ef05690b4179008589d0b1e29a9c64dfe024f.zh: 你的支持者和捐款者并不欢迎这种立场变化。

ccf1ab842a58c123209a25f358f8a50bcd5b9a54.source: This is anathema to Southerners, Westerners, and many Republicans in general.
ccf1ab842a58c123209a25f358f8a50bcd5b9a54.zh: 南方人、西部人以及许多共和党人，通常都无法接受这种立场。

40e87e42a99066182738174c35a5f1dc1482a800.source: This is anathema to most Northerners, including many moderates and Democrats.
40e87e42a99066182738174c35a5f1dc1482a800.zh: 大多数北方人，包括许多温和派和民主党人，都极为反对这个主张。

1363d6ad52d3853b0cafa7e25e4ac02687a33d13.source: This is anathema to your voting base. They are talking about dumping you now and just voting for Nixon.
1363d6ad52d3853b0cafa7e25e4ac02687a33d13.zh: 你的选民基本盘对此深恶痛绝。他们现在正议论着抛弃你，干脆投尼克松。

81a604403ba4b85d790158f2df74f7a40c662eac.source: This is another answer that offends nobody, but also pleases nobody.
81a604403ba4b85d790158f2df74f7a40c662eac.zh: 这又是一个不冒犯任何人、也不让任何人满意的回答。

2a7c45dbef66de6e5109daaefb4e242ef4fa635d.source: This is another case of pointy-headed intellectualism that will regulate our factories right out of business and kill the jobs of the working man.
2a7c45dbef66de6e5109daaefb4e242ef4fa635d.zh: 这又是尖脑袋知识分子的空论。他们要用监管把我们的工厂整到倒闭，让劳动者失去饭碗。

79c9d113f5a5edcebbd276f20fe77d455d9bfedd.source: This is another case of radical Islamists attempting to destroy the values that we stand for. We have to admit that a huge part of Islam is at war with America and the western world, and we continue to have far too many people who are looking the other way.
79c9d113f5a5edcebbd276f20fe77d455d9bfedd.zh: 这又是激进伊斯兰主义者企图摧毁我们所珍视的价值观。我们必须承认，伊斯兰世界中有很大一部分，正与美国及西方世界为敌；但仍有太多人装作没看见。

f094badf23fab3cf644f2e01b4e0d4195cec4350.source: This is another case where your earnest Christian beliefs might be better left unstated.
f094badf23fab3cf644f2e01b4e0d4195cec4350.zh: 这又是一个最好把你虔诚的基督教信念留在心里的场合。

0be25f56295cda8dfbc9fc0203f8c5b300c852fe.source: This is another costly project that promises very little return on our investment.
0be25f56295cda8dfbc9fc0203f8c5b300c852fe.zh: 这又是一个耗资巨大、却几乎看不到投资回报的工程。

b9a612af80d2f301c99b019eb5acf6ded2b8c72e.source: This is another fake news story that's basically a lie. The media is always trying to stir up drama between us, but Mike has been great!
b9a612af80d2f301c99b019eb5acf6ded2b8c72e.zh: 这又是一个基本属于谎言的假新闻故事。媒体总想在我们之间挑起事端，但迈克一直很出色！

b5d3962939c4fef8da296178ad406fa240f3d4fe.source: This is another hot-button issue where it might be better for a Democrat to hedge a little.
b5d3962939c4fef8da296178ad406fa240f3d4fe.zh: 这又是一个敏感议题，民主党人或许还是稍微留些余地更好。

f75a4b12d59aeeecd83804adc2cd5f03da1b08a3.source: This is another position taken straight from the platform of Bernie Sanders. Interesting decision.
f75a4b12d59aeeecd83804adc2cd5f03da1b08a3.zh: 这又是一个直接取自伯尼·桑德斯党纲的立场。这个决定挺有意思。

f81e542b5376c2fdd7bc2b4e815d598a8c85dfaf.source: This is another sad attempt to crush the spirit of the working man. It's difficult to distinguish between Pinkertons and vigilantes during some of these repression actions.
f81e542b5376c2fdd7bc2b4e815d598a8c85dfaf.zh: 这又是一次压垮工人精神的可悲尝试。在某些镇压行动中，平克顿侦探与私刑暴徒几乎没有区别。

6fa1fc5c9813c2d017cfc5ad9a0ba475e528dba6.source: This is bordering on treason. The American people deserve to hear about this.
6fa1fc5c9813c2d017cfc5ad9a0ba475e528dba6.zh: 这几乎是叛国。美国人民有权知道这件事。

664e60e94179e504c5f6487ffeec601bd31336ed.source: This is certainly evocative of the Bill Clinton era.
664e60e94179e504c5f6487ffeec601bd31336ed.zh: 这确实让人想起比尔·克林顿的时代。

a4d92a7dc1ebc3547d0470654f82e668f0fb1ded.source: This is certainly the party line on the tariff issue.
a4d92a7dc1ebc3547d0470654f82e668f0fb1ded.zh: 这无疑符合本党在关税问题上的立场。

f98429b2418951be35794b20650855aa49b36683.source: This is clear political gamesmanship which I cannot support in good conscience. The Reserve should be used in cases of national emergency only. Furthermore, why did Clinton announce this decision so close to the election?
f98429b2418951be35794b20650855aa49b36683.zh: 这显然是在耍政治手腕，我无法昧着良心支持。储备只能在国家紧急情况下动用。另外，克林顿为什么在这么接近选举的时候宣布这个决定？

d1b254c32c54aaa180d80953dde8ed614c21b501.source: This is congressional obstructionism at its worst. We've seen any number of judges be appointed in the final year of a term. We can't have what we're seeing right now.
d1b254c32c54aaa180d80953dde8ed614c21b501.zh: 这是国会阻挠政治最恶劣的表现。我们已经见过许多法官在总统任期最后一年获任命。我们不能接受眼下这种局面。

adc1d50543547771400efdd38bf986f0f69c98c8.source: This is definitely a passive answer for the situation you are currently facing.
adc1d50543547771400efdd38bf986f0f69c98c8.zh: 面对你当前的处境，这个回答显然很被动。

6a0a27c2f79f54c3fbbfec0a75e37a9047fc2da2.source: This is definitely an extreme stance for a Democrat to take.
6a0a27c2f79f54c3fbbfec0a75e37a9047fc2da2.zh: 对于民主党人来说，这无疑是一个极端立场。

1d9ae9741ce02a53d3e1532a971f3cb57cfdd083.source: This is definitely going to be part of our campaign, along with many other things.
1d9ae9741ce02a53d3e1532a971f3cb57cfdd083.zh: 这肯定会成为我们竞选的一部分，另外还有许多事情。

5665b59d9dd95c11212d9c937d0eda2f4de4c942.source: This is definitely more of a Republican issue at this point.
5665b59d9dd95c11212d9c937d0eda2f4de4c942.zh: 眼下，这显然更像是共和党的议题。

f7671d6f983f0c2bdd1ddb3e20375431e1e3ec17.source: This is definitely something that deserves a reprimand at the very least. I don't agree with these views.
f7671d6f983f0c2bdd1ddb3e20375431e1e3ec17.zh: 这至少值得予以谴责。我不赞同这些观点。

ec289104233ea6620932444ef0b471d3ea19aac0.source: This is definitely something that my team will approach with fresh eyes when I am President, but I can't say more than that right now.
ec289104233ea6620932444ef0b471d3ea19aac0.zh: 我当上总统后，团队肯定会以新的眼光审视这件事，但现在不能说得更多。

dd9d71d0b1137ebb19bdc9f2f03c3d934c21d290.source: This is definitely taking things too far. The

d072925006d39bfec4135d8661ad96c274be980c.source: This is definitely the majority opinion among the public.
d072925006d39bfec4135d8661ad96c274be980c.zh: 这无疑是公众中的主流看法。

167dfa4ed0a054195f75dd7970c2a3a5cc9a395b.source: This is definitely too soft of a stance to take on the issue of military spending and the Soviet Union.
167dfa4ed0a054195f75dd7970c2a3a5cc9a395b.zh: 在军费和苏联问题上，这个立场无疑太软弱了。

4b66178f06b6db381855d7fc4cfe4d9ff1c3acc5.source: This is entirely appropriate for an economy recovering from the worst recession since the 1930s. Additionally, there have been repeated jobs proposals in Congress, all of which have been sabotaged by Republican obstructionism.
4b66178f06b6db381855d7fc4cfe4d9ff1c3acc5.zh: 对于一个正在从1930年代以来最严重衰退中复苏的经济体，这完全合适。此外，国会一再提出就业提案，全都遭到共和党的阻挠破坏。

ec1840b1661fc6f16bec43705637b7ae6a69dc7d.source: This is exactly what Rockefeller wanted to hear, and he is putting his considerable resources at your disposal.
ec1840b1661fc6f16bec43705637b7ae6a69dc7d.zh: 这正是洛克菲勒想听到的，他正在将自己庞大的资源交给你使用。

cb2670a3c83c3dafee310c155ce9fe7bdc9b9e61.source: This is exactly what your party wants to hear and will push for on this issue.
cb2670a3c83c3dafee310c155ce9fe7bdc9b9e61.zh: 在这个问题上，这正是本党想听到、也会争取推动的主张。

28a469124736ffbdfe3134a692577ad1ecb5c763.source: This is exactly what your party wants to hear.

674fab6d2887d8dc0602fe1a705002d2da511704.source: This is factually true, although the deficit and debt remain very high.
674fab6d2887d8dc0602fe1a705002d2da511704.zh: 这在事实上是对的，不过赤字与债务仍然很高。

4ad1bf26bb70fea6a718a020e9ba3bc30d7b8fe2.source: This is fine with me, but it is a small part of the overall solution. We need to drill wherever we can, while encouraging innovation in other sectors of the energy market.
4ad1bf26bb70fea6a718a020e9ba3bc30d7b8fe2.zh: 我对此没有异议，但这只是整体解决办法中的一小部分。我们需要在一切可以钻探的地方钻探，同时鼓励能源市场其他领域的创新。

9ddec8fa859bd2dd272cae18959d6b01e21bfe91.source: This is getting it completely backwards. American families have every right to defend themselves from America's crime epidemic.
9ddec8fa859bd2dd272cae18959d6b01e21bfe91.zh: 这完全是本末倒置。面对美国的犯罪浪潮，美国家庭完全有权保护自己。

c02211bb471b2ea10b2c92b1b1bf3f5d2ba79a0d.source: This is great. We need any good news we can get at this point.
c02211bb471b2ea10b2c92b1b1bf3f5d2ba79a0d.zh: 太好了。眼下，只要是好消息，我们都需要。

5b3456e1fb88aee00ac41543de085221bc7af769.source: This is in line with the opinion of many Whigs.
5b3456e1fb88aee00ac41543de085221bc7af769.zh: 这与许多辉格党人的看法一致。

9260f704bcc78f911c6d7fe04a5ecfad8a1f8484.source: This is in line with the stance of the party, but will it appeal to progressives?
9260f704bcc78f911c6d7fe04a5ecfad8a1f8484.zh: 这符合本党的立场，但能吸引进步派吗？

0f7fe98121f0b5000bde5076e465446bfe1ced4b.source: This is just a little thing, like the flu almost, that the media and the Democrats are attempting to spin into the second coming of the plague. They would rather destroy the American economy and society than see me get reelected.
0f7fe98121f0b5000bde5076e465446bfe1ced4b.zh: 这只是个小问题，差不多像流感，媒体和民主党却想把它渲染成瘟疫重来。他们宁可摧毁美国经济和社会，也不愿看到我连任。

366f54cea2dc62f4c57163df851871fef219f936.source: This is just another sad chapter in the fiscal mismanagement of the veterans' pensions. The best we can do now is to remain vigilant for the day when these pensions are universally offered to all aged veterans.
366f54cea2dc62f4c57163df851871fef219f936.zh: 这不过是老兵抚恤金财政管理混乱中，又一个可悲的篇章。眼下，我们能做的最好选择，就是继续留意何时才会把这些抚恤金普遍发给所有年迈的老兵。

ee22060b70bbcb900562181db2b39f8d44e0e20a.source: This is just what most Democrats want to hear.
ee22060b70bbcb900562181db2b39f8d44e0e20a.zh: 这正是大多数民主党人想听到的话。

ce59b71d75bed96ddd4470036c33f5b05d808e6b.source: This is just what the conservative wing of your party doesn't want to hear.
ce59b71d75bed96ddd4470036c33f5b05d808e6b.zh: 这正是党内保守派最不想听的话。

44b886e3a447c3440d2dd5cc416337cf716cafc9.source: This is just what the liberal wing of your party wants to hear.
44b886e3a447c3440d2dd5cc416337cf716cafc9.zh: 这正是党内自由派想听的话。

41b93395779640fa313b88c32e794f30c6a4d812.source: This is just what you were saying in the Democratic primaries.
41b93395779640fa313b88c32e794f30c6a4d812.zh: 这正是你在民主党初选时的说法。

00efa51a9eb86969a1f8e190189d574d28a27f78.source: This is just what your supporters want to hear.
00efa51a9eb86969a1f8e190189d574d28a27f78.zh: 这正是你的支持者想听到的。

beaaf41c5433444a6b2da67a255c01860110c79a.source: This is likely to help you with urban voters, though a few moderates may be turned off by this new allegiance. On the balance, it should be a positive for you.
beaaf41c5433444a6b2da67a255c01860110c79a.zh: 这可能会帮助你赢得城市选民的支持，尽管一些温和派可能会对这种新的忠诚感到反感。总的来说，这对你来说应该是积极的。

fde9985b7d17e011c5ffcd231bb0b5854fef8e32.source: This is misrepresentation of what I said. I never claimed to invent the internet, I was merely pointing out that government research which I supported as a Senator was a crucial piece of the equation.
fde9985b7d17e011c5ffcd231bb0b5854fef8e32.zh: 这是在歪曲我的话。我从未声称发明了互联网，只是指出，我担任参议员时支持的政府研究，是其中至关重要的一环。

e42d2db2c9e007a6cc653cc102d86d77b9cf4936.source: This is more extreme than what most people expect to hear from you. There are rumblings of discontent from black voters that you are selling them out.
e42d2db2c9e007a6cc653cc102d86d77b9cf4936.zh: 这比大多数人预期会从你口中听到的话更极端。黑人选民中已经有人不满，认为你出卖了他们。

9a599e348d7816b82e3e6331be9f4c7b849cfdb3.source: This is more properly a state responsibility. It is outside the scope of the federal government to regulate working conditions in this manner.
9a599e348d7816b82e3e6331be9f4c7b849cfdb3.zh: 这更应当由州政府负责。以这种方式规范劳动条件，超出了联邦政府的权限。

5e34f6fa922a41455f4c2b39d2d04f4a78615947.source: This is music to the ears of your farmer constituency.
5e34f6fa922a41455f4c2b39d2d04f4a78615947.zh: 这番话让你的农民选民听了十分受用。

00f1e95c5dafe632f71ff3232b5e1df4e2cc9b75.source: This is music to your supporters' ears.
00f1e95c5dafe632f71ff3232b5e1df4e2cc9b75.zh: 你的支持者听了会心花怒放。

ee1768c18b2888c04c1a7147198417b29437b342.source: This is my preferred position. But unfortunately, it looks as though the courts will rule that Obama has gone too far.
ee1768c18b2888c04c1a7147198417b29437b342.zh: 这是我倾向的立场。但遗憾的是，看来法院会裁定奥巴马走得太远了。

6b938dac8e8d83ec23f1731fe80dab7a95d20ffb.source: This is nearly the worst of all worlds. You've come off as indecisive as well as unprincipled, and left a bad taste for many.
6b938dac8e8d83ec23f1731fe80dab7a95d20ffb.zh: 这几乎是最糟糕的结果。你显得既优柔寡断，又毫无原则，让许多人十分反感。

18c5556688edbe598bd0f71b4b0e143fef4e23fe.source: This is no time for false pride. Let's do what we can to build a fusion ticket where that action makes sense, and worry about the rest when we get to it.
18c5556688edbe598bd0f71b4b0e143fef4e23fe.zh: 现在不是死要面子的时候。凡是组成联合选举人名单有意义的地方，我们都应尽力促成；其他问题，到时候再说。

da40beb2001e04eb2c7f3dae891b2a8fc5c35902.source: This is nonsense. I have served as the Governor of Texas, the second largest state in the country, for nearly six years.
da40beb2001e04eb2c7f3dae891b2a8fc5c35902.zh: 这简直是胡说。我在美国第二大州得克萨斯州担任州长，已经近六年了。

69ba61d71ae21e89bc6552890a11593f62164f08.source: This is not a good response for a Democratic candidate.
69ba61d71ae21e89bc6552890a11593f62164f08.zh: 对于民主党候选人来说，这不是个好回应。

27c5062ac89a8a19375a1f57e7bc50c5e75580d7.source: This is not a good way to win support from the Democrats in 1976.
27c5062ac89a8a19375a1f57e7bc50c5e75580d7.zh: 这可不是1976年争取民主党人支持的好办法。

3edd70070338482f18b907cb5945f94e75d4548b.source: This is not a high priority for me as President. We need to create an old age insurance program and increase our funding for education.
3edd70070338482f18b907cb5945f94e75d4548b.zh: 作为总统，这不是我的优先要务。我们需要设立老年保险计划，并增加教育经费。

9befab8a739c71e31ee9a42a6b7e2b97b41f1f74.source: This is not a measure that I support.

59c49d74bb2c6b09eb9c793e9cea7553c9999214.source: This is not a popular answer in the farm states, and seems surprisingly glib on economic plight for a Democrat.
59c49d74bb2c6b09eb9c793e9cea7553c9999214.zh: 这个回答在农业州并不受欢迎，而且对一位民主党人来说，面对经济困境的态度轻率得令人意外。
