e8820371ef841c1b79eb76c15cfbf4f4f67f908d.source: This is not a popular answer with Republicans.
e8820371ef841c1b79eb76c15cfbf4f4f67f908d.zh: 这个回答在共和党人中并不受欢迎。

b81e95361c88ef1b446f35a1a16d705d3044e501.source: This is not a popular policy, and does not help assuage the latent doubts over your vote for Iraq, to boot.
b81e95361c88ef1b446f35a1a16d705d3044e501.zh: 这不是受欢迎的政策，还无法消除大家对你伊拉克战争投票本就存在的疑虑。

e78e478f77a7274234d6d8d7d2428869e2f68658.source: This is one of the big decisions of your campaign -- will people turn out to vote for you in close states? Time will tell.
e78e478f77a7274234d6d8d7d2428869e2f68658.zh: 这是你竞选中的重大抉择之一——在胜负接近的州，人们会不会出来投你一票？时间会给出答案。

d22329f276723ae9319a603892d1bb59ca9828df.source: This is one of the key objectives of our current tariff policy, and I would support a strong infrastructure program as President.
d22329f276723ae9319a603892d1bb59ca9828df.zh: 这是现行关税政策的主要目标之一。如果当选总统，我会支持一项有力的基础设施建设计划。

55ecf2aa227d2c5f109834baa32352c52048c429.source: This is one of the most dangerous ideas I can think of. A federal agency to combat pollution will hurt business, increase unemployment, and undermine the wages of our workers.
55ecf2aa227d2c5f109834baa32352c52048c429.zh: 这是我能想到的最危险的主意之一。设立治理污染的联邦机构，会损害企业、增加失业，削弱工人的工资收入。

cf7c2eb7ef177f4d30e0af296fdc17f0786b5b22.source: This is one of the most far-fetched ideas that I've heard in my political career.
cf7c2eb7ef177f4d30e0af296fdc17f0786b5b22.zh: 这是我政治生涯中听过的最不切实际的想法之一。

e2116605b21607cff6f62a56526c9e1964e19b29.source: This is one of the most ill-conceived decisions I have seen in my lifetime.
e2116605b21607cff6f62a56526c9e1964e19b29.zh: 这是我一生所见最欠考虑的决定之一。

8a3bed5df922f8c3108604e0c4c5a3a3c2f1f417.source: This is one of the worst decisions in the history of the court. If they can't see that campaign finance regulation is entirely constitutional, then we do need to have an Amendment in place.
8a3bed5df922f8c3108604e0c4c5a3a3c2f1f417.zh: 这是最高法院历史上最糟糕的判决之一。如果他们看不出竞选融资监管完全符合宪法，那我们确实需要通过修正案。

1d87f250b3359bb19ec576a1feddb0f7f6103b72.source: This is one of your best issues and you're leaving it on the table?
1d87f250b3359bb19ec576a1feddb0f7f6103b72.zh: 这是你最有优势的议题之一，你竟然弃而不用？

4b77c22aa477580a36cf911c35a9c31cafa2264a.source: This is one time when it just might do to keep your mouth shut.
4b77c22aa477580a36cf911c35a9c31cafa2264a.zh: 这种时候，闭口不言或许就够了。

40ff5d1ab2c9425df7c8d2c77b4ddcedc4eb7666.source: This is only to be expected for the candidate who came in second place during our nomination process.
40ff5d1ab2c9425df7c8d2c77b4ddcedc4eb7666.zh: 在党内提名竞争中位居第二的候选人，获得这样的待遇理所当然。

33c6aa08f2d60980033dd117f429644cdf630570.source: This is out of step with the current mood. Voters
33c6aa08f2d60980033dd117f429644cdf630570.zh: 这与当前的情绪不相符。选民

5af198978535d5d4e76c5c5433665aaf18262af0.source: This is part of my platform, but it won't be a central part of my campaign speeches.
5af198978535d5d4e76c5c5433665aaf18262af0.zh: 这是我政纲的一部分，但不会成为竞选演说的核心内容。

50c58ad2fc530398b94b9d1797a2fe1ce870ccb9.source: This is perfectly within the realm of acceptable punishment.
50c58ad2fc530398b94b9d1797a2fe1ce870ccb9.zh: 这完全属于可以接受的惩罚方式。

37892bd77664d6b14b3f7f81a4bc30e2b6156192.source: This is probably a better idea. By no means do you need to win Nebraska to become President.
37892bd77664d6b14b3f7f81a4bc30e2b6156192.zh: 这大概是个更好的主意。你完全不必拿下内布拉斯加，也能当选总统。

f4ce019926a5f1b1c368dbcc47c832806d5ffdc3.source: This is probably a good approach.
f4ce019926a5f1b1c368dbcc47c832806d5ffdc3.zh: 这大概是个不错的做法。

6eb8d88a0cf01678a9322ed86e028608f0ae4a51.source: This is probably the best response for you, but it may make some moderates feel uneasy.
6eb8d88a0cf01678a9322ed86e028608f0ae4a51.zh: 这大概是最适合你的回答，但可能会让一些温和派感到不安。

9e9b60a72ad6c8183590f9af0618c4d378be8f22.source: This is probably the best response you can give, given some of these things that happened when you were young and immature.
9e9b60a72ad6c8183590f9af0618c4d378be8f22.zh: 考虑到年轻不成熟时发生的一些事，这大概是你能给出的最佳回应。

93df6f9ee166732dcf07485a319c06b4c0c46382.source: This is probably the best stance to take, particularly if you care to win a state like New York or Pennsylvania.
93df6f9ee166732dcf07485a319c06b4c0c46382.zh: 这大概是最好的立场，尤其是你想赢得纽约或宾夕法尼亚这样的州时。

fcb201540cacbe0ec4d0376679d238ff3bcb4292.source: This is probably the best stance to take.

fee52e2a10b04f01867cd4cfa4be262fefb4e0e3.source: This is probably the best strategy. A few attacks on legitimate issues, but not so many that your campaign looks petty and negative.
fee52e2a10b04f01867cd4cfa4be262fefb4e0e3.zh: 这大概是最好的策略。针对实际议题作一些攻击，但不要多到让竞选显得琐碎、负面。

f5d785232bed9b4ad8038b58eda77c48f1bdebc9.source: This is not a typical Republican position, but it could help you with the urban wing of the party.
f5d785232bed9b4ad8038b58eda77c48f1bdebc9.zh: 这不是典型的共和党立场，但可能有助于你争取党内城市派。

c1f7a206ff4014d9301cd3712e778d7a3fe24480.source: This is not a winning argument for a Republican in a national election.
c1f7a206ff4014d9301cd3712e778d7a3fe24480.zh: 对参与全国选举的共和党人来说，这不是一套能赢的论点。

647ef76323b747000e8c28550d0bdc3a4322b58f.source: This is not an issue that we plan to address in our campaign.
647ef76323b747000e8c28550d0bdc3a4322b58f.zh: 我们不打算在竞选中评论这个问题。

06e04c8f45e7ab78a029875402690479dff665ae.source: This is not inspiring stuff to the Democratic base.
06e04c8f45e7ab78a029875402690479dff665ae.zh: 这些话可鼓舞不了民主党基本盘。

53a07ea46589fd4d9b7abb022914d473525213b4.source: This is not regulation of commerce under the Commerce Clause. This is direct action by the federal government to build and operate a public works project. I'm not sure that this is Constitutional.
53a07ea46589fd4d9b7abb022914d473525213b4.zh: 这不是依据商业条款监管商业，而是联邦政府直接建设和经营公共工程。我不确定，这是否合宪。

419056bc77f3bd08a1d9f39ad0a04f4f6309b749.source: This is not something that we should address in our campaign. We should channel our focus on other issues.
419056bc77f3bd08a1d9f39ad0a04f4f6309b749.zh: 这不是我们应当在竞选中讨论的事情。我们应该把精力集中到其他议题上。

4ef64af95298628b99a17747a0d1dba8f9417e3d.source: This is not the best response for a Democrat.
4ef64af95298628b99a17747a0d1dba8f9417e3d.zh: 对民主党人来说，这不是最好的回应。

afcf9183ae1897c42ae4ddfe79171ff6b2bc779f.source: This is not the best response to a revelation that should be hurting Bush. By inserting yourself into things, you've not helped your image heading into the election.
afcf9183ae1897c42ae4ddfe79171ff6b2bc779f.zh: 这次曝光本该伤害布什，你的回应却不是最好的。把自己卷进去，并没有改善你临近大选时的形象。

304f61b22f0744c47f3916d2ca6fed1c42a83cf2.source: This is not the kind of answer that Republicans want to hear.
304f61b22f0744c47f3916d2ca6fed1c42a83cf2.zh: 这可不是共和党人想听到的回答。

e60feb4154f66b14b18697d5ee5b22053cdfa141.source: This is not the policy prescription that Democrats want to hear from their Presidential candidate.
e60feb4154f66b14b18697d5ee5b22053cdfa141.zh: 这不是民主党人想从本党总统候选人口中听到的政策方案。

61fc306ec3d0a788edde875931932bd2cac05e90.source: This is not the preferred answer for this situation.
61fc306ec3d0a788edde875931932bd2cac05e90.zh: 在这种处境下，这不是最合适的回答。

f8de23f108971ce628e70c4d9e4860eb38983449.source: This is not the right way to “pivot to the center” for the general election.
f8de23f108971ce628e70c4d9e4860eb38983449.zh: 为了大选“向中间转向”，这样做可不对。

875714ee04d00887949464b5e65114d40030f993.source: This is not what most Democrats want to hear you say when you talk about Medicare.
875714ee04d00887949464b5e65114d40030f993.zh: 谈到联邦医疗保险，大多数民主党人可不想听你说这种话。

55b05db97e0f0f7822dcc3880579bc9ebb01668e.source: This is not what your party wants to hear out of you!
55b05db97e0f0f7822dcc3880579bc9ebb01668e.zh: 这可不是党内人士想听你说的话！

4fd655a7f40ecb5335e82f44d5b470b5666e3250.source: This is not what your supporters want to hear out of you.
4fd655a7f40ecb5335e82f44d5b470b5666e3250.zh: 这可不是支持者想听你说的话。

03996d4e2185f7b68d28fdd88aac7b23e9081cc3.source: This is nothing compared to the lies and equivocation of Donald Trump. And furthermore, it's appalling that Republicans are so willing to throw aside all ideals and cooperate with the Russians, the moment it's convenient for them.
03996d4e2185f7b68d28fdd88aac7b23e9081cc3.zh: 与唐纳德·特朗普的谎言和含糊其辞相比，这根本不算什么。更令人震惊的是，共和党人一看到有利可图，就如此愿意抛开一切理想，与俄罗斯人合作。

9a35ee0dbebd96ef7d2dadf8a9860e49442027af.source: This is nothing less than a betrayal of your own essence. You are a Creationist and you always will be.
9a35ee0dbebd96ef7d2dadf8a9860e49442027af.zh: 这简直是背叛自己的本质。你是创造论者，而且永远都会是。

847ec899ffdcaf9d344d446ee17d6a6956265a45.source: This is one of the big decisions of your campaign -- can you run up your vote total in large, liberal states to hit the 5% threshold nationally? Time will tell.
847ec899ffdcaf9d344d446ee17d6a6956265a45.zh: 这是你竞选中的重大抉择之一——你能否在自由派大州提高得票总数，从而在全国达到5%的门槛？时间会给出答案。

6fba50593ed9fbdf62ced795d01c95573207fdfd.source: This is probably the best you can do with this attack.
6fba50593ed9fbdf62ced795d01c95573207fdfd.zh: 面对这次攻击，你大概也只能应对到这个程度了。

1c4c013b8663e2fd2e52c3cc79fc0faf7bedeac6.source: This is probably the best you could do under the circumstances. Good luck!
1c4c013b8663e2fd2e52c3cc79fc0faf7bedeac6.zh: 在这种情况下，你大概也只能应对到这个程度了。祝你好运！

5abbc873eca0128fb330e670be58d2287a786a94.source: This is probably unconstitutional and would represent another step in the transformation of our country into a police state.
5abbc873eca0128fb330e670be58d2287a786a94.zh: 这大概违宪，也意味着我国朝警察国家又迈出了一步。

7aedc7a9f8081ac792ae732a81fd26eabe605657.source: This is probably your best bet. Bush might lose a few votes, but there's nothing you can do to pile on.
7aedc7a9f8081ac792ae732a81fd26eabe605657.zh: 这大概是你最好的选择。布什也许会丢掉一些选票，但你也没什么办法再补上一刀。

4068798670ab3d4333c5fa411c09b6435b8d2e38.source: This is probably your best choice. It's just unfortunate that the Democrats continue to demagogue the public on this issue, rather than address the failures of their banking policy.
4068798670ab3d4333c5fa411c09b6435b8d2e38.zh: 这大概是你最好的选择。可惜民主党人仍然借这个议题煽动公众，而不去面对其银行政策的失败。

b2af0cc503a9a6c37c47937c0dd9dee76a2a53c9.source: This is probably your best course for the time being.
b2af0cc503a9a6c37c47937c0dd9dee76a2a53c9.zh: 眼下这大概是你最好的做法。

76a8b436ec06d6c87a610a9cb5d4fd07992dc728.source: This is probably your best option.
76a8b436ec06d6c87a610a9cb5d4fd07992dc728.zh: 这大概是你最好的选择。

d81ffb2b2917e68b46afbb09fe63da0da5799d12.source: This is probably your best response. Take the attack to Bush.
d81ffb2b2917e68b46afbb09fe63da0da5799d12.zh: 这大概是你最好的回应。主动向布什发起攻击。

02d1c5547993b2f8b682f377326e781aca196d53.source: This is probably your best stance vis a vis the Northern wing of the Democratic Party.
02d1c5547993b2f8b682f377326e781aca196d53.zh: 在应对民主党北方派时，这大概是你最好的立场。

e81d045c442d15e01b961bb5d69d9f05d767b124.source: This is probably your best strategy. The voters like Carter for now, but hopefully some will think twice about his leadership as election day approaches.
e81d045c442d15e01b961bb5d69d9f05d767b124.zh: 这大概是你最好的策略。选民眼下喜欢卡特，但希望随着选举日临近，有些人会重新考虑他的领导能力。

94b6b75e95ab2820ddab790a5b559e2d5cfea35d.source: This is really more of a Republican idea, and it's not like old-age health insurance is unpopular...
94b6b75e95ab2820ddab790a5b559e2d5cfea35d.zh: 这其实更像共和党的主张，而且老年医疗保险又不是不受欢迎……

f8cd5d44029c03355746ff03c6608f5085aaaae3.source: This is red meat for your base.
f8cd5d44029c03355746ff03c6608f5085aaaae3.zh: 这正是你的基本盘最爱听的话。

c586fdc1a4981f7e7a709315f9d2f67c75c820c8.source: This is right in line with the Democratic platform, and with your own position over the years.
c586fdc1a4981f7e7a709315f9d2f67c75c820c8.zh: 这完全符合民主党的纲领，也符合你多年来的立场。

fb56198517cfde03b41958b641caf64c0f6d11fe.source: This is right in line with the goals of your party.
fb56198517cfde03b41958b641caf64c0f6d11fe.zh: 这完全符合本党的目标。

fb9642d3fd338bbfce963c3f88992b0bb18995c4.source: This is right in line with the preferred Republican platform.
fb9642d3fd338bbfce963c3f88992b0bb18995c4.zh: 这完全符合共和党属意的纲领。

978208d618b0126e29dc89cbcb35b68c5282ef37.source: This is right in line with your views to date.
978208d618b0126e29dc89cbcb35b68c5282ef37.zh: 这与你迄今的观点完全一致。

37a4a29b37403232ddea8299883f129174084279.source: This is settled law. It is not appropriate to have public schools lead students in prayer, even if it is voluntary.
37a4a29b37403232ddea8299883f129174084279.zh: 这个问题在法律上已有定论。公立学校带领学生祈祷并不合适，即使名义上是自愿的。

365724e738428d7e2fe5223ee0c0597e4f39a693.source: This is something I whole-heartedly support. We have rivers that are unusable to humans, acid rain falling from the skies, and smog so thick in some cities that people can barely see.
365724e738428d7e2fe5223ee0c0597e4f39a693.zh: 我全心全意支持这个提议。有些河流已经无法供人使用，天上下着酸雨，有些城市的烟雾浓得让人几乎什么都看不见。

d431ce441827484b62f1792fc03bc2debaee8fd8.source: This is something that is more appropriately addressed by individual states, though I will do anything I can to enforce the decisions of our Supreme Court.
d431ce441827484b62f1792fc03bc2debaee8fd8.zh: 这个问题更适合由各州分别处理，不过我会尽一切努力，执行最高法院的判决。

cb314968e433ae646476c3b23ae19b5658372cb1.source: This is the exact answer Johnson, the party, and the base was looking for.
cb314968e433ae646476c3b23ae19b5658372cb1.zh: 这正是约翰逊、民主党和基本盘期待的回答。

ccdfffb3ab89810737cf55dc78c53652453995ca.source: This is the exact opposite of what you need to be saying.
ccdfffb3ab89810737cf55dc78c53652453995ca.zh: 这番话与你应该说的恰恰相反。

6d668343457292d952d1db50eb21249749e2931c.source: This is the first step that those who wish to abolish Social Security would like to implement. The integrity of Social Security should be preserved at all times.
6d668343457292d952d1db50eb21249749e2931c.zh: 这正是那些想废除社会保障的人打算迈出的第一步。我们必须始终维护社会保障制度的完整性。

9e0997bf1adec07c3896eba37e85b137b570ba24.source: This is the guy who lost in 2012. He was a loser. And then he gave speeches against me from the beginning. I mean, is this really the kind of guy we want at our convention?
9e0997bf1adec07c3896eba37e85b137b570ba24.zh: 这个人2012年输掉了选举。他是个失败者。后来，从一开始就发表演说反对我。我是说，我们真的想让这种人参加我们的党代会吗？

0467bf8b0d5fad519516ddfc6507979acb0529f2.source: This is the kind of aggressive stance that the American people want to hear.
0467bf8b0d5fad519516ddfc6507979acb0529f2.zh: 这正是美国人民想听到的强硬立场。

1f5aff4ae8b7d4698ac989acc17249e91194a442.source: This is the kind of issue that I wasn't thinking about very much when I was younger. But it's clear to me now what a terrible thing abortion is.
1f5aff4ae8b7d4698ac989acc17249e91194a442.zh: 年轻时，我没怎么思考这个问题。但现在，我很清楚，堕胎是多么可怕的事。

9551f0d60efae6ee5afeda3e3e24300448179858.source: This is the kind of specious attack that doesn't merit serious discussion in a national campaign. I trust that voters will be smart enough to focus on the real issues.
9551f0d60efae6ee5afeda3e3e24300448179858.zh: 这类似是而非的攻击，不值得在全国竞选中认真讨论。我相信，选民足够明智，会把注意力放在真正的问题上。

168e652ae644409cbed412d7a0003d010efb0cd7.source: This is the kind of woman Sarah Palin is and the kind of woman we want in our campaign. Let's just remind her to keep firing away at Crooked Hillary and all the crimes and anti-woman activites of the Clinton cabal.
168e652ae644409cbed412d7a0003d010efb0cd7.zh: 萨拉·佩林就是这种女性，也是我们竞选团队需要的女性。只要提醒她，继续猛攻“骗子希拉里”，以及克林顿小集团的一切罪行和反女性活动。

4a0ff39dd3f8c60f201377ca4aef54b485d3e113.source: This is the last thing that Democratic supporters expected to hear you say, and many are unpleased.
4a0ff39dd3f8c60f201377ca4aef54b485d3e113.zh: 这是民主党支持者最不可能预料到你会说的话，许多人对此不满。

0bd266dc0b6694fca785b7f17c360e9486c06252.source: This is the logical conclusion of the Republican program, if they succeed in closing off slavery and slowly extinguishing it.
0bd266dc0b6694fca785b7f17c360e9486c06252.zh: 如果共和党成功遏制奴隶制，并使之逐渐消亡，这就是他们纲领合乎逻辑的结果。

c1b5c48bc435e865f4dd9aed9e45f62fdbaab1a8.source: This is the mainstream answer shared by all major politicians (unless you count a guy like Reagan).
c1b5c48bc435e865f4dd9aed9e45f62fdbaab1a8.zh: 这是所有主要政治人物共同持有的主流回答，除非你也把里根那样的人算进去。

659548925cbc2fbd8d5df2049e77a23f8dfc27fe.source: This is the more hawkish and cautious response.
659548925cbc2fbd8d5df2049e77a23f8dfc27fe.zh: 这个回应更偏鹰派，也更谨慎。

c83f5952b9032acd44927a41e2efa59e555c3a15.source: This is the most odious, dangerous decision to be handed down in the history of the Court. What is to prevent the Court from forcing slavery next upon the states themselves, under some dubious interpretation?
c83f5952b9032acd44927a41e2efa59e555c3a15.zh: 这是最高法院历史上最可憎、最危险的判决。谁能阻止法院下一步借助某种可疑解释，强迫各州接受奴隶制？

bbce36c358c0c624588210dd59d5a65f12509541.source: This is the party line that people want to hear. Good luck this fall!
bbce36c358c0c624588210dd59d5a65f12509541.zh: 这是人们想听到的本党立场。祝你今年秋季好运！

891297b3b36db6438d78080af40c45e1ffde1179.source: This is the party line, but after a bitter nomination fight, some are disappointed that your success would preempt their 1848 campaigns.
891297b3b36db6438d78080af40c45e1ffde1179.zh: 这符合本党的立场。不过，提名争夺如此激烈，有些人会失望地发现：你的胜利将抢先堵住他们在1848年竞选的机会。

ee3607dd3c82726abf89db89da2d3d6d313f68c1.source: This is something that we badly need right now. We have a housing shortage in this country, and too many working-class Americans cannot afford a home.
ee3607dd3c82726abf89db89da2d3d6d313f68c1.zh: 这是我们眼下迫切需要的。本国住房短缺，太多工薪阶层的美国人买不起住房。

0495e04093837773be9d7c1d1513f1ee75375a02.source: This is something that we will research and consider seriously over the next four years. I'd have to see the details of any proposal before I could give my opinion.
0495e04093837773be9d7c1d1513f1ee75375a02.zh: 未来四年，我们会认真研究、考虑这个问题。我必须先看到具体提案，才能发表意见。

91c9002aa11ae49e421f46e1da313ffd9f931b67.source: This is something that we're going to look into very seriously. But how does this compare to Hillary Clinton taking over $10 million from Saudi Arabia for her so-called charitable foundation?
91c9002aa11ae49e421f46e1da313ffd9f931b67.zh: 这件事我们会非常认真地调查。不过，跟希拉里·克林顿为她所谓的慈善基金会从沙特阿拉伯收下一千多万美元相比，又算什么？

4c3df3f677b4be89bf521a5e50bf24f7a0f8bc3a.source: This is something we should work for to reform the monetary supply. That being said, the United States should not unilaterally leave the gold standard until we have some agreement in place.
4c3df3f677b4be89bf521a5e50bf24f7a0f8bc3a.zh: 我们应当争取这样做，以改革货币供给。不过，在达成某种协议之前，美国不应单方面放弃金本位制。

b317a849ea069f22659837d9abbb5b14abe6aa4b.source: This is somewhat effective, but the number of patronage jobs is dwindling each year and other states are worried about how many there are to go around.
b317a849ea069f22659837d9abbb5b14abe6aa4b.zh: 这多少有些效果，但酬庸官职一年比一年少，其他州也担心，自己还分得到多少。

500e6be4737a6566ed5f80741a839a650ce99964.source: This is somewhat true, but it seems like you are leaving a potential line of attack on the table.
500e6be4737a6566ed5f80741a839a650ce99964.zh: 这话有几分道理，但你似乎放弃了一条潜在的进攻路线。

6caffa9208f264235d8096f796b540dca580563c.source: This is sure an unusual situation, given that no candidate besides yourself and Polk seemed poised to win an electoral vote. Unfortunately, the Democrats have won a majority in the House and seem likely to confirm James K. Polk as the ultimate winner. How will your legacy be remembered?
6caffa9208f264235d8096f796b540dca580563c.zh: 这肯定是一种不寻常的情况，因为除了你自己和 波尔克 之外，没有任何候选人似乎准备赢得选举人票。不幸的是，民主党已经赢得了众议院多数席位，并且似乎有可能确认 詹姆斯·K.·波尔克 为最终获胜者。您的遗产将如何被铭记？

5ff957d6262792b33fa032e5e508add3b0a5e50f.source: This is surely an unusual situation, given that no candidate besides yourself and Clay seemed poised to win an electoral vote. Fortunately, the Democrats have won a majority in the House and seem likely to confirm you as the ultimate winner. Best wishes for your term in office.
5ff957d6262792b33fa032e5e508add3b0a5e50f.zh: 这肯定是一个不寻常的情况，因为除了你和克莱之外，似乎没有候选人准备赢得选举人票。幸运的是，民主党已经赢得了众议院多数席位，并且似乎很可能确认你是最终的赢家。祝您任期顺利。

c0696e3ea020e874da2ccd936e690bb9dd2a092c.source: This is surprisingly strident rhetoric, given your past views. But it inspires a lot more outrage in foreign policy circles than among actual voters.
c0696e3ea020e874da2ccd936e690bb9dd2a092c.zh: 考虑到你过去的观点，这番言辞强硬得令人意外。但外交政策圈的愤怒，远比实际选民强烈。

908f438c5663e7dc61cc27372306e96ebba138a1.source: This is the best answer for the situation. It was the presumed answer though, so it has affected the polls minimally.
908f438c5663e7dc61cc27372306e96ebba138a1.zh: 这是当前情况下最好的回答。不过，人们本就预料你会这样说，所以对民调影响很小。

89416b9c96a8677130f53e0121af0ed121d0e58c.source: This is the best answer. Of course, it estranges the extreme doves, but most doves are in lockstep with your campaign. As a bonus, you coax a few moderates into supporting you.
89416b9c96a8677130f53e0121af0ed121d0e58c.zh: 这是最好的回答。当然，它疏远了极端鸽派，但大多数鸽派与你的竞选步调一致。额外的好处是，你还说动了一些温和派支持你。

c528e17be78c240e2f05db266e5907771e1b471b.source: This is the party line, but it's also a controversial issue with much disagreement.
c528e17be78c240e2f05db266e5907771e1b471b.zh: 这符合本党路线，但也是个争议很大、意见不一的问题。

a83f75ad674123a699cd1c9a3edb5357f10ba327.source: This is the same answer your opposition has.
a83f75ad674123a699cd1c9a3edb5357f10ba327.zh: 你的对手也是这么回答的。

c2acecf394d1db78e4ff81a759fdb7766ba9bc17.source: This is the sensible answer that has an appeal to everyone. Well, everyone but the kooks.
c2acecf394d1db78e4ff81a759fdb7766ba9bc17.zh: 这是个合理的回答，能吸引所有人。嗯，除了那些怪人。

4e7f4bdf5c50d36e61ad8d94c6d0daf69e702d44.source: This is the sort of uncompromising rhetoric on the silver issue that you are rapidly becoming known for. No matter though -- everyone dislikes Grover Cleveland.
4e7f4bdf5c50d36e61ad8d94c6d0daf69e702d44.zh: 这种在白银问题上寸步不让的措辞，正迅速成为你的招牌。不过，没关系——反正大家都不喜欢格罗弗·克利夫兰。

14b7d7bc4c02e01adf799c0b1f8023c76f173ba2.source: This is the standard, safe response.

efb4ba633c485a917ccd5d7b69d54ef34c857a24.source: This is the type of aggressive, expansive move by the Southern Democrats that led to the split in our party. Under no circumstances would I support the reopening of the Atlantic slave trade.
efb4ba633c485a917ccd5d7b69d54ef34c857a24.zh: 南方民主党人这种咄咄逼人、扩张性的举动，正是导致我们党分裂的原因。无论如何，我都不会支持重启跨大西洋奴隶贸易。

76229ef10e29327e8b23a7a6fabb911eb69cd7e1.source: This is the type of cronyism that occurs when government selects certain industries for protection under a tariff act. I support low tariffs across the board.
76229ef10e29327e8b23a7a6fabb911eb69cd7e1.zh: 政府通过关税法，挑选某些产业加以保护，就会发生这种裙带勾结。我支持全面降低关税。

0dcb655bfb3aae3f41863974e5d9516c2a75da16.source: This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you from alienating any large segment of voters.
0dcb655bfb3aae3f41863974e5d9516c2a75da16.zh: 这种中间立场的回答，能避免疏远任何一个大的选民群体。

b541c85bfcbea7cae26ea4a0e0eb15196f62a51b.source: This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you from alienating any large wing of the party.
b541c85bfcbea7cae26ea4a0e0eb15196f62a51b.zh: 这种中间立场的回答，能避免疏远党内任何一个大派别。

8f45f2902b64645ad93b050b5712b94b35abf09c.source: This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you in contention, but some conservatives are upset.
8f45f2902b64645ad93b050b5712b94b35abf09c.zh: 这种中间立场的回答，能让你继续保持竞争力，但一些保守派不高兴了。

0f832e866e52e622c2fa31049480c1a96aa9c100.source: This is the type of non-issue that is indicative of the broken American political system. George Bush was wrong for America before this news broke, and he is still wrong for America.
0f832e866e52e622c2fa31049480c1a96aa9c100.zh: 这类无关紧要的问题，恰恰说明美国政治体制出了毛病。消息曝光前，乔治·布什就不适合美国，现在也依然不适合。

75381ae2ee2040232f4dcbcd39f2c7cc27936e5e.source: This is the wrong way to go about balancing the budget. I oppose these cuts.
75381ae2ee2040232f4dcbcd39f2c7cc27936e5e.zh: 这不是平衡预算的正确办法。我反对这些削减。

7ba2cbf8fd1f64f11fe7cf02a14900c25f37a750.source: This is the wrong way to reform the American health care system. We should be focusing on malpractice reform and on cutting red tape for private insurers.
7ba2cbf8fd1f64f11fe7cf02a14900c25f37a750.zh: 这不是改革美国医疗体系的正确办法。我们应该把重点放在医疗事故责任制度改革，以及为私人保险公司减少繁文缛节上。

0a837c5e02fe5cc064a2b07db7c2bf6cf9f88ec9.source: This is too liberal for many in your party to stomach.
0a837c5e02fe5cc064a2b07db7c2bf6cf9f88ec9.zh: 这对党内许多人来说，自由派色彩浓得难以接受。

5980b579e4b0e3414c23d1a0f875448773e95c6f.source: This is too much of a 180 on the gun control issue for most people to process.
5980b579e4b0e3414c23d1a0f875448773e95c6f.zh: 你在枪支管制问题上来了个180度大转弯，多数人难以接受。

9233c9f12dcbafdcfb3e1ae3a475e9aea474f262.source: This is too much of a 180 on the immigration issue for most people to process.
9233c9f12dcbafdcfb3e1ae3a475e9aea474f262.zh: 你在移民问题上来了个180度大转弯，多数人难以接受。

f1a66091e7e09a82137a6e50513d1b979563b136.source: This is too much of a 180 on the refugee issue for most people to process.
f1a66091e7e09a82137a6e50513d1b979563b136.zh: 你在难民问题上来了个180度大转弯，多数人难以接受。

784cf8459987f71a857585e2b915fafb288187df.source: This is true, and binds yourself to the strong economy and the slain President.
784cf8459987f71a857585e2b915fafb288187df.zh: 这话属实，也让你与强劲的经济和遇刺身亡的总统联系起来。

d51dcdf24bd50e81bd14906952b1c4f827a7b976.source: This is unfortunately one of those issues where, no matter how many times you repeat yourself, people will continue to press you.
d51dcdf24bd50e81bd14906952b1c4f827a7b976.zh: 遗憾的是，有些问题就是这样：无论你重复多少遍，人们还是会不断追问。

e22a511c180732f8ba82e4812300abb8b35a1a47.source: This is very out of touch with the current mood of America. On the bright side, you do receive a boost in Florida from Cuban-Americans.
e22a511c180732f8ba82e4812300abb8b35a1a47.zh: 这与美国当前的情绪非常脱节。好的一面是，佛罗里达州的古巴裔美国人给你的支持有所增加。

784fefd8caac95bd9e2f7606e9110333f0341b0a.source: This is vintage Nixon. You should do well with your appeals to law and order as long as your rhetoric doesn't sound too extreme.
784fefd8caac95bd9e2f7606e9110333f0341b0a.zh: 这很有尼克松一贯的风格。只要言辞不过于极端，你维护法律与秩序的呼吁应该会有良好效果。

385dc6f47f70c72df58faf9ea9ed9768df5fe84f.source: This is way out there for a Democrat. What do you mean by this?
385dc6f47f70c72df58faf9ea9ed9768df5fe84f.zh: 对于民主党人来说，这实在太离谱了。你这是什么意思？

eccc54419887a2158600fa6a858d1f90e13389f8.source: This is what Mr. Tillman and others wanted to hear, but there are rumblings in the Midwest that you are too friendly with extremist elements in the former Confederacy.
eccc54419887a2158600fa6a858d1f90e13389f8.zh: 这正是蒂尔曼先生和其他人想听的话，但中西部已有人议论，说你与前邦联地区的极端势力过于亲近。

9b42b3d8e73c2950c9ec6cdf5196d01522b0c8fc.source: This is what many of your supporters call “amnesty”. Many of them are upset with this response.
9b42b3d8e73c2950c9ec6cdf5196d01522b0c8fc.zh: 你的许多支持者把这称为“特赦”。他们当中很多人对这番回答很不满。

75c13e856ecccf8991102d6bc4a794be7eb5b8d6.source: This is what your supporters want to hear.
75c13e856ecccf8991102d6bc4a794be7eb5b8d6.zh: 这正是你的支持者想听到的话。

b9d59d3b4b7a42f74d33c86dada630b234527bc3.source: This is widely seen as a poor response to the news that broke. Hopefully you can still win the election.
b9d59d3b4b7a42f74d33c86dada630b234527bc3.zh: 人们普遍认为，你对刚曝光的消息回应不佳。但愿你仍能赢得大选。

768f7c2fe330085f0d6f52a216f573d10ecd7115.source: This is yet another example of Dukakis's poor judgment when it comes to defending American values.
768f7c2fe330085f0d6f52a216f573d10ecd7115.zh: 这又一次说明，杜卡基斯在捍卫美国价值观方面判断失当。

6b406591a8c5aa11271af55354127d3b77818ac4.source: This is yet another example, like Benghazi or many others, of a politically motivated witch hunt. I support my associates completely, and fully expect to see their names cleared before this is done.
6b406591a8c5aa11271af55354127d3b77818ac4.zh: 这又是一次出于政治动机的迫害，和班加西及许多其他事情一样。我完全支持同事们，也充分相信，事情结束之前，他们会洗清指控。

dfa5aa10829f32b9f942ce1b494eae3e354270bb.source: This is yet another positive example of progressive legislation that has been enacted over the previous few years.
dfa5aa10829f32b9f942ce1b494eae3e354270bb.zh: 这又是过去几年通过的进步主义立法的一个正面例子。

f971844f1e0764b47c6fbd1d557bc863efc4d98f.source: This isn't a central issue in this election, but you are definitely closer to the majority opinion here.
f971844f1e0764b47c6fbd1d557bc863efc4d98f.zh: 这不是本次大选的核心议题，不过，你在这里确实更接近多数人的看法。

42c737d9af8e21fd6c331c373b3a7f916fac6629.source: This isn't a good response for the majority of your party.
42c737d9af8e21fd6c331c373b3a7f916fac6629.zh: 对本党大多数人来说，这不是个好回应。

361849017c00e5cb711a85ea5430628d38468b5a.source: This isn't a part of our message in this campaign.
361849017c00e5cb711a85ea5430628d38468b5a.zh: 这不是我们这次竞选宣传的一部分。

5cb6a2fdfd0ad67f1c93bad929f1168d69ad3c63.source: This isn't a subject that I plan to address on the campaign trail.
5cb6a2fdfd0ad67f1c93bad929f1168d69ad3c63.zh: 我不打算在竞选中讨论这个问题。

2e15dff723b3506f6135161de96867cbe40d578c.source: This isn't an appropriate story for me to comment on. I will stick to the issues in my campaign speeches, and my spokesperson will issue a brief denial that we had anything to do with the timing of this revelation.
2e15dff723b3506f6135161de96867cbe40d578c.zh: 这件事不适合由我评论。我会在竞选演说中坚持谈议题，由发言人简短声明，我们与消息在此时曝光毫无关系。

4dc7e3a270f8176c1ba4b9f99ee4090d3b5f3244.source: This leaves everyone in a bad situation. Congress will now choose from the top three candidates in the electoral vote count. You are highly unlikely to be the compromise candidate in this situation, however. It is unclear whether Congress will select Douglas or Bell, or if they will deadlock and precipitate a Constitutional crisis. If Douglas is selected, how would the South react? There are even whispers about a civil war.
4dc7e3a270f8176c1ba4b9f99ee4090d3b5f3244.zh: 这让每个人都处于糟糕的境地。国会现在将从选举人票计数中排名前三的候选人中选出。然而，在这种情况下，你不太可能成为妥协的候选人。目前尚不清楚国会是否会选择道格拉斯或贝尔，或者他们是否会陷入僵局并引发宪法危机。如果选择道格拉斯，南方会如何反应？甚至还有关于南北战争的传言。

4629a8bc669e750af2756c8988a1a787e0cf4a14.source: This leaves everyone in a bad situation. Segregationists from the South are demanding concessions before they will support a candidate, leaving the House deadlocked. Perhaps you can work out a deal with Dewey to circumvent this, based on who has the plurality of popular and electoral votes. It's always possible that one of you could serve as the other's Vice President.
4629a8bc669e750af2756c8988a1a787e0cf4a14.zh: 这让每个人都处于糟糕的境地。来自南方的种族隔离主义者在支持候选人之前要求做出让步，这使得众议院陷入僵局。也许你可以根据谁拥有多数选票和选举人票，与 杜威 达成一项协议来规避这一问题。你们中的一个总是有可能担任另一个的副总统。

a26263e8639fb70e491f990d9dbf87e85dcfbce5.source: This leaves everyone in a bad situation. Segregationists from the South are demanding concessions before they will support a candidate, leaving the House deadlocked. Perhaps you can work out a deal with Truman to circumvent this, based on who has the plurality of popular and electoral votes. It's always possible that one of you could serve as the other's Vice President.
a26263e8639fb70e491f990d9dbf87e85dcfbce5.zh: 这让每个人都处于糟糕的境地。来自南方的种族隔离主义者在支持候选人之前要求做出让步，这使得众议院陷入僵局。也许你可以根据谁拥有多数选票和选举人票，与 杜鲁门 达成一项协议来规避这一问题。你们中的一个总是有可能担任另一个的副总统。

986526ad17f4c218b5468d49ffddfe146c35bb30.source: This legitimizes your detractors and right-wing claims that you are weak on Communism.
986526ad17f4c218b5468d49ffddfe146c35bb30.zh: 这让批评者和右翼关于你对共产主义软弱的指控显得有了依据。

8f627811d0747c79ce5d042fabf534af152258b3.source: This line of reasoning could work, if voters don't find it too clever by half.
8f627811d0747c79ce5d042fabf534af152258b3.zh: 如果选民不觉得你聪明反被聪明误，这套说辞也许管用。

31fcfcc69d033b634a0db2731e1b6bc925651239.source: This looks like an appalling misuse of police force, and incidents like this are the reason Black Lives Matter exists. I'm proud to do my small part to support the peaceful protests happening right now.
31fcfcc69d033b634a0db2731e1b6bc925651239.zh: 这看起来是令人震惊的警察滥用武力。正是这类事件，促成了“黑人的命也是命”运动。我很自豪能尽一点自己的力量，支持目前的和平抗议。

00ceb4f8cbc4f2f6740c5e28b8ef6d639ff37d6e.source: This looks to be a real turning point in your campaign. Your call for a bombing halt undercuts the argument that you are a stooge for LBJ, and it's definitely helping you bring the anti-war vote back.
00ceb4f8cbc4f2f6740c5e28b8ef6d639ff37d6e.zh: 这看来会成为你竞选的真正转折点。你呼吁停止轰炸，削弱了你只是约翰逊傀儡的说法，也确实帮助你争取回反战选票。

370616f6dd273f1f8bcd26f1e11f2728287db6de.source: This makes a broad appeal to your potential coalition while emphasizing the centrality of free silver to your campaign.
370616f6dd273f1f8bcd26f1e11f2728287db6de.zh: 这番话广泛争取了潜在支持联盟，同时强调了自由铸银在竞选中的核心地位。

feb8ccdd2660b9af9516ab9497b9f68b2eeb1100.source: This makes everyone happy for now, but it also gives Kennedy an opening to out-campaign you in some important swing states.
feb8ccdd2660b9af9516ab9497b9f68b2eeb1100.zh: 暂时大家都满意，不过这也给了肯尼迪机会，让他在一些重要摇摆州的竞选力度超过你。

b1190b6813d1df151fafb5e8dd07c2e03ad6804f.source: This isn't an important issue in our current campaign.
b1190b6813d1df151fafb5e8dd07c2e03ad6804f.zh: 这不是我们当前竞选中的重要议题。

fd872263aa6b16dce75e2132a9254267c1707880.source: This isn't an issue that I have strong feelings about, one way or the other. I think it is the kind of thing that each state can figure out for themselves.
fd872263aa6b16dce75e2132a9254267c1707880.zh: 在这个问题上，我没有特别强烈的支持或反对意见。我认为，各州可以自行决定。

2fc523d87be9cddc920be21761df6cc7bcb62677.source: This isn't an issue that our campaign plans to address. It would be unwise to antagonize Great Britain at this crucial juncture.
2fc523d87be9cddc920be21761df6cc7bcb62677.zh: 我们不打算在竞选中讨论这个问题。在这个关键时刻得罪英国，是不明智的。

114023bc00fdc415de24eaa0182efd825d7fa979.source: This isn't an issue we should be concerned about. Additional regulation of drugs and medicinal practice would undermine our national liberty.
114023bc00fdc415de24eaa0182efd825d7fa979.zh: 我们不该为这个问题操心。进一步监管药品和行医活动，会损害我国的自由。

ec076d0c2ed72ec78c3acc73a9cf805c7c27ace8.source: This isn't an issue worth addressing. It will please no one and offend everyone, at least within our party's rank-and-file.
ec076d0c2ed72ec78c3acc73a9cf805c7c27ace8.zh: 这不是值得讨论的问题。至少在本党普通党员中，提起它谁也讨好不了，反倒会得罪所有人。

b80eba4ce0062e554514fa8f8d93919525be7d53.source: This isn't bad, but it completely ignores the issue of Vietnam and does nothing to rebuke the notion that you will continue Johnson's policies there.
b80eba4ce0062e554514fa8f8d93919525be7d53.zh: 这不算差，但完全回避了越南问题，也丝毫没有反驳你会继续推行约翰逊越南政策的看法。

64279259061f77610ff8e53408583b73b18caf84.source: This isn't that popular of an idea. Even Democrats are divided on it...
64279259061f77610ff8e53408583b73b18caf84.zh: 这个主意没有那么受欢迎。连民主党内部都意见不一……

f2bb9d52a9669cc9b2c99f3180d2b5e55a1bd72e.source: This isn't the type of issue I prefer to address on the campaign trail. Let's stick to positive talk about the future of our nation.
f2bb9d52a9669cc9b2c99f3180d2b5e55a1bd72e.zh: 这不是我想在竞选中讨论的那类议题。让我们继续积极谈论国家的未来。

82e15adcc05dd262dc36a00b7532641662a6c28a.source: This isn't what you did in 2011. Have you had a change of heart?
82e15adcc05dd262dc36a00b7532641662a6c28a.zh: 这可不是你2011年的做法。你改变主意了吗？

73929cea27e5901ae0cb9aa0f36e37b6f77b2052.source: This issue divides your party, and you've cast your lot very clearly. Let's see what happens.
73929cea27e5901ae0cb9aa0f36e37b6f77b2052.zh: 这个问题让党内意见分裂，而你已经明确选边站了。看看会发生什么吧。

fedb6bc9d855f29dda109ba90e48e21fbcce4795.source: This just shows how terrified the DNC and the political establishment are of substantive change to the system. I am the outsider candidate who will fix Washington and drain the swamp.
fedb6bc9d855f29dda109ba90e48e21fbcce4795.zh: 这恰恰说明，民主党全国委员会和政治建制派有多害怕对体制作出实质改变。我是体制外的候选人，会整顿华盛顿，排干这片沼泽。

56086c10ec005259cf8c9fad0841d6ba512376ec.source: This kind of answer angers nobody, but it doesn’t particularly please anyone either. Perhaps some moderates in border states will be swayed.
56086c10ec005259cf8c9fad0841d6ba512376ec.zh: 这种回答不会惹恼谁，但也没让谁特别满意。也许边界州的一些温和派会被说动。

38a644bf8c7f72c4a0ca5f3ecbb4cdbedab6b681.source: This kind of idea is way off the mark. We need to focus on reducing the size of government and lowering taxes.
38a644bf8c7f72c4a0ca5f3ecbb4cdbedab6b681.zh: 这种主意完全错了方向。我们应该集中精力缩小政府规模、降低税收。

8575a98c92caa6931dafa204bd434565c885457e.source: This language could be a turnoff to some moderates, but your strength in holding to this position appeals to others.
8575a98c92caa6931dafa204bd434565c885457e.zh: 这种说法可能使一些温和派反感，但你坚定不移地坚持立场，也吸引了另一些人。

e5da185d8670200d21c75351ed5cb071e22b4aae.source: This obviously helps in the South, but it hurts you in other areas. Some towns insist on playing Dixie at your campaign events, and other such things...
e5da185d8670200d21c75351ed5cb071e22b4aae.zh: 这显然有助于争取南方，却会使你在其他地区受损。有些城镇坚持在你的竞选活动上演奏《迪克西》，还有其他类似的事……

40c39afb8450e497c7f6ae792862074fd8525471.source: This only paints you as indecisive towards voters. Even Nixon is more insistent, wanting to retain the program.
40c39afb8450e497c7f6ae792862074fd8525471.zh: 这只会让选民觉得你犹豫不决。连尼克松都比你坚决，主张保留这个项目。

ae06daee7e20f7e8585767b894d28a3ef64ac945.source: This outrage is an elitist conspiracy to undermine my chances in the final days of this race. NBC was sitting on this video for 11 years! It almost reminds you of what they did to Bush in 2000.
ae06daee7e20f7e8585767b894d28a3ef64ac945.zh: 这桩丑闻，是精英们为了在竞选最后几天破坏我的胜选机会而策划的阴谋。NBC把这段视频压了十一年！几乎让人想起他们在2000年对布什干的事。

a04eced6e463f5f251fd66cdbb2dabd7dedae4eb.source: This package was yours from start to finish. You need to stand by it.
a04eced6e463f5f251fd66cdbb2dabd7dedae4eb.zh: 这套援助方案从头到尾都是你的主张。你需要坚持支持它。

5a32e603d0cdc2b000679017882c9a9e36ff44c0.source: This party has no discernible platform or political positions on any issue. They are the carcass of the pro-slavery wing of the Whig Party, masquerading as saviors of the Union.
5a32e603d0cdc2b000679017882c9a9e36ff44c0.zh: 这个党在任何议题上都没有明确的纲领或政治立场。他们不过是辉格党亲奴隶制派的残骸，却装成联邦的救星。

5fe417b28123965ac203f9767162a1ae9016beaa.source: This plan will take money out of the public schools and will not fix the underlying problem of poor education in the United States.
5fe417b28123965ac203f9767162a1ae9016beaa.zh: 这个计划会抽走公立学校的经费，却无法解决美国教育不佳的根本问题。

74d6a1784e73b1477e7bf054caf06f8994b9b150.source: This plays into criticism of you as a radical, but there are some people who favor taxing the rich.
74d6a1784e73b1477e7bf054caf06f8994b9b150.zh: 这让人更容易把你批评为激进分子，但也有一些人支持向富人征税。

b31903dd0fc2b381280c873db34710f40d486047.source: This plays towards moderate voters, but turns off the liberals of the Democratic party. You’ve deprived the base of their previous enthusiasm by being too cautious.
b31903dd0fc2b381280c873db34710f40d486047.zh: 这迎合了温和派选民，却让民主党自由派反感。你过于谨慎，消磨了基本盘原有的热情。

b56a420007392c152af7a8df3e06a27b4202c932.source: This policy distorts the free market and favors certain types of food over others. It is an example of crony capitalism.
b56a420007392c152af7a8df3e06a27b4202c932.zh: 这项政策扭曲自由市场，偏袒某些食品而损害另一些食品的利益。这是裙带资本主义的一个例子。

1b889291d5f1a862a54ade1926b30026f693c70c.source: This policy has contributed to the degradation of the American diet and contributes to our exploding obesity and diabetes epidemics. It should be ended.
1b889291d5f1a862a54ade1926b30026f693c70c.zh: 这项政策使美国人的饮食质量下降，加剧了迅速蔓延的肥胖和糖尿病问题。应该取消它。

67e42138f589eaa514df22bc59951bcac4144440.source: This policy helps support an unsustainable Soviet system. I believe that we should never bail out communism from its failures if we're serious about winning the Cold War.
67e42138f589eaa514df22bc59951bcac4144440.zh: 这项政策在支撑一个无法持续的苏联体制。如果我们真想赢得冷战，就绝不应该为共产主义的失败解围。

64e5c9fe65de5d8dcd4a13a888ec3e96b8674fa7.source: This policy is a win-win for us. It helps our own farmers prosper, and it is a public relations victory for the world to see the Soviet Union depending on American enterprise.
64e5c9fe65de5d8dcd4a13a888ec3e96b8674fa7.zh: 这项政策对我们是双赢。它让本国农民更加富裕，也是一场宣传上的胜利，让世界看到苏联依赖美国的企业。

54e836d18b54f8a85a9e13bda7992e73c5467dcd.source: This policy is economically unviable. It is also yet another "solution" to our problems which I deem to be unconstitutional.
54e836d18b54f8a85a9e13bda7992e73c5467dcd.zh: 这项政策在经济上行不通。我还认为，它又是一种违宪的所谓“解决办法”。

a8b9c00d1af7a91435cb55532e22ad7660bc4544.source: This may be more accurate, given your record. Let's see how it flies with the voting public this fall.
a8b9c00d1af7a91435cb55532e22ad7660bc4544.zh: 考虑到你的政绩，这也许更贴切。看看今年秋季选民是否买账吧。

99e2aa8caa429689b695030cb24791e0fb955388.source: This measure is premature at the present time. We have added greatly to the welfare of the Philippines and should not leave before our work is done.
99e2aa8caa429689b695030cb24791e0fb955388.zh: 眼下采取这项措施，为时过早。我们极大改善了菲律宾的福祉，不该在工作完成之前离开。

967e0701af85101b015b0fde2e09e6a654def772.source: This measure passes in any case, but you are not receiving much credit for it.
967e0701af85101b015b0fde2e09e6a654def772.zh: 无论如何，这项措施都会通过，但你并没有因此获得多少赞誉。

966fd11fc1aa90b8fae4705208fcb6fceeedbd09.source: This message appeals to solid conservatives only. Clinton is too popular elsewhere.
966fd11fc1aa90b8fae4705208fcb6fceeedbd09.zh: 这种说法只吸引坚定的保守派。克林顿在其他人群中太受欢迎了。

12b720d92b95e6ca9e550732c8dcb2097949e669.source: This might be true, but there are more people in your Party opposed to Wallace than supportive of him.
12b720d92b95e6ca9e550732c8dcb2097949e669.zh: 这或许属实，但党内反对华莱士的人，比支持他的人更多。

e96f1088a869ac6d2954f075b8c03be683f420fc.source: This might be what some people want to hear, but will the middle-of-the-road votes be there for you in November?
e96f1088a869ac6d2954f075b8c03be683f420fc.zh: 这或许是一些人想听的话，但十一月中间派会投票支持你吗？

69b1405c22051d7ffe7208dcdd9fdaad020445f7.source: This might help you in the Deep South, but it will definitely not help with black and liberal turnout in other regions.
69b1405c22051d7ffe7208dcdd9fdaad020445f7.zh: 这也许有助于争取深南部，但肯定无助于提高其他地区黑人和自由派选民的投票率。

f4519dc374841b54f4ad437963aabfb8fcf65cf8.source: This might make you look a bit more moderate, but your relations with labor have gone from bad to worse. It is probably not worth it on the balance.
f4519dc374841b54f4ad437963aabfb8fcf65cf8.zh: 这也许会让你显得稍微温和一些，但你与劳工的关系已经越来越糟。总的来看，大概不值得。

96c755cc245d23bb691ed92ca0c31b516955fab5.source: This might make you look more conservative, but it's not the popular answer for this election.
96c755cc245d23bb691ed92ca0c31b516955fab5.zh: 这或许让你显得更保守，但不是这次选举中受欢迎的回答。

98d5d988b9e043b755cfae66d1d862d2c4edd887.source: This might not be the right answer in the case of Nixon. It comes off as overly aggressive, and if 8 years as Vice President is not enough experience, where does that leave you?
98d5d988b9e043b755cfae66d1d862d2c4edd887.zh: 用来回应尼克松，这也许不合适。它显得过于咄咄逼人；如果当了八年副总统还不算经验足够，那你又算什么呢？

0cb151351ac7a508a37f60778ef0e99057d843cf.source: This might play well in the South, but it definitely detracts from your national appeal.
0cb151351ac7a508a37f60778ef0e99057d843cf.zh: 这或许在南方讨好，但肯定会削弱你在全国的吸引力。

e3382ee3b9d76f1123a081e61a3b96234c6ed837.source: This moderate turn is welcomed by moderates and Southern Democrats alike, making up ground among them- but liberal supporters are very deflated at your seeming abandonment of the issues they champion.
e3382ee3b9d76f1123a081e61a3b96234c6ed837.zh: 这次转向温和路线，同时受到温和派和南方民主党人的欢迎，你在他们当中追回了一些支持；不过，你似乎抛弃了自由派支持者珍视的议题，让他们十分泄气。

1d641c119d4f96c42198976b52ccb6dffe641980.source: This move seems to help Bell in the South. He has removed himself from the Midwestern ballots. Breckinridge ignores your overtures.
1d641c119d4f96c42198976b52ccb6dffe641980.zh: 这项举动似乎帮助了贝尔在南方的竞选。他已退出中西部各州的选票，而布雷肯里奇没有理会你的示好。

5b8890cbda66b5dccb69955c221fef1dc970ee0a.source: This movement has my full support, as do the other civil rights measures of our day. I will push for a Civil Rights Act as President.
5b8890cbda66b5dccb69955c221fef1dc970ee0a.zh: 这个运动得到我的全力支持，当今其他民权措施也是如此。作为总统，我会推动一部《民权法》。

e0edc3ad1ab9df784b23be1b32ffe5f374faddf7.source: This needs to be a key centerpiece of our campaign. Our current President is widely popular, and I can easily make the case that I was a central part of his Administration.
e0edc3ad1ab9df784b23be1b32ffe5f374faddf7.zh: 这必须成为竞选的核心主题。现任总统广受欢迎，我很容易论证，自己是他政府的重要组成部分。

0d8b4f40137b1abc3d7f39abda923c1f832738be.source: This policy will hurt the small storeowner and serves as yet another example of wasteful government spending. We should be looking to reduce the deficit -- not to add new programs.
0d8b4f40137b1abc3d7f39abda923c1f832738be.zh: 这项政策会损害小店主，又是政府浪费开支的一个例子。我们应该减少赤字，而不是增设计划。

9fdb6ec99db163e60accc6eba4713c22e0551b3e.source: This position is a little too passive for those who want to see a tough, Cold War leader as President.
9fdb6ec99db163e60accc6eba4713c22e0551b3e.zh: 对于那些希望总统成为强硬冷战领袖的人，这个立场有点过于消极。

44c2a30be0cd1bcbfa935acf2c2c7a973e74c85d.source: This position is broadly popular, but will it cost you in some regions?
44c2a30be0cd1bcbfa935acf2c2c7a973e74c85d.zh: 这个立场广受欢迎，不过会不会让你在某些地区付出代价？

da2ab957a91bae70487017e0e004a31617931c53.source: This position is fairly conservative compared to that of most Democrats.
da2ab957a91bae70487017e0e004a31617931c53.zh: 与大多数民主党人相比，这个立场相当保守。

09c8e169fff6d385f2297e2c009fcd881cb5732b.source: This position is lifted straight from the Republican platform.
09c8e169fff6d385f2297e2c009fcd881cb5732b.zh: 这个立场直接照搬了共和党党纲。

22e9d1cfe613109590d97f9802732da5524ea357.source: This position is popular within your party, and Lyndon himself doesn’t disagree with it.
22e9d1cfe613109590d97f9802732da5524ea357.zh: 这个立场在党内很受欢迎，林登本人也不反对。

44d0c5d655555523586d976aa16306cd559b0ddb.source: This position is too anti-war for many in your party to accept.
44d0c5d655555523586d976aa16306cd559b0ddb.zh: 这个立场过于反战，让党内许多人无法接受。

5ed867a87b7ee580593d5c35f8e702285e15d7a0.source: This position is too dovish for the mainstream of the Republican Party. In the future you might do better to take a more moderate stance.
5ed867a87b7ee580593d5c35f8e702285e15d7a0.zh: 对共和党主流而言，这个立场过于偏鸽派了。今后你或许应该采取更温和的立场。

81364de080bbd33c6aebc8b8847d053c155e951d.source: This practice undermines our public education system, and should not be permitted.
81364de080bbd33c6aebc8b8847d053c155e951d.zh: 这种做法破坏了我们的公立教育体系，不应该允许。

15bb34bb9511d153b2672b26d542f3237e126250.source: This program has proven itself to be a disaster. The sooner we forget about it the better.
15bb34bb9511d153b2672b26d542f3237e126250.zh: 事实证明，这项计划是一场灾难。越早把它抛到脑后越好。

4e82f26ab3ecc55f10567da7dfd0824119e970fc.source: This program is a good starting point, but I would much prefer a program of national health insurance for all Americans -- not just the elderly.
4e82f26ab3ecc55f10567da7dfd0824119e970fc.zh: 这项计划是个不错的起点，不过我更希望设立面向所有美国人的全国医疗保险，而不只是老年人。

6ef7707ecb35258c948bdebd5d85af98ff7d263b.source: This program will be a centerpiece of our defense against the Soviet Union for many years to come.
6ef7707ecb35258c948bdebd5d85af98ff7d263b.zh: 这项计划将在未来许多年里成为我们防御苏联的核心。

33ca6d0a5b7e930653d5d63634a4b916643b8bbd.source: This program will be a disaster. Not only is it an unconstitutional violation of personal freedom, but it will lead to a decline in American health care and will prove to be financially impossible to maintain without socializing the health care system.
33ca6d0a5b7e930653d5d63634a4b916643b8bbd.zh: 这项计划将是一场灾难。它不仅违宪，侵犯个人自由，还会导致美国医疗质量下降；除非把医疗体系收归公共管理，否则在财政上根本无法维持。

283003e1fbbd74bb47a759302b705847a2ea0071.source: This program would represent a massive new financial commitment for the federal government, when care of the elderly properly rests with the affected family.
283003e1fbbd74bb47a759302b705847a2ea0071.zh: 这项计划意味着联邦政府要承担巨额的新开支，而照顾老人本应由相关家庭负责。

ab7ca28e8e4966d0401da7ff23e5c73b23f3f9d0.source: This puts you at odds with many Democrats, and the minimum wage is popular as well.
ab7ca28e8e4966d0401da7ff23e5c73b23f3f9d0.zh: 这使你与许多民主党人意见相左，而且最低工资本身也很受欢迎。

b6820975256ced6bf59622dc2413d4ea35fe0c1a.source: This puts you at odds with many Republicans, but a higher minimum wage is not the most unpopular idea.
b6820975256ced6bf59622dc2413d4ea35fe0c1a.zh: 这使你与许多共和党人意见相左，不过提高最低工资也不是最不受欢迎的主张。

187d222be5f19cce3e093a6d1e8690e37ddb8cd8.source: This seems like an overly critical response where Dr. King is concerned.
187d222be5f19cce3e093a6d1e8690e37ddb8cd8.zh: 对于金博士而言，这似乎是一个过于批评的回应。

7eba188fb040c1d1fad09859182fc6df3fd98d86.source: This seems like another attempt by the Clintons to stretch the rules. Hillary Clinton is clearly from Arkansas and should seek office from that state if she so desires.
7eba188fb040c1d1fad09859182fc6df3fd98d86.zh: 这看来又是克林顿夫妇试图钻规则空子。希拉里·克林顿显然来自阿肯色州，如果她想竞选公职，就应在那里参选。

afed954301a0fe5d612d5746790fd6426faa7b37.source: This seems like basic, common sense to most of your supporters.
afed954301a0fe5d612d5746790fd6426faa7b37.zh: 对于大多数支持者来说，这似乎只是基本常识。

0748564b68994d73cf5a1164954a06148d3f6713.source: This seems like enough to make the party semi-enthusiastic for your campaign.
0748564b68994d73cf5a1164954a06148d3f6713.zh: 这似乎足以让党内对你的竞选多少有点热情。

00dcebaf18b1c3eadb4e1442aa2b0d34304b2555.source: This seems remarkably hands-off for what appears to be a major scandal in the Clinton camp.
00dcebaf18b1c3eadb4e1442aa2b0d34304b2555.zh: 克林顿阵营看起来出了重大丑闻，你竟然这么不愿插手，实在令人意外。

8fe0f39ef18e2619d627bb81df5cf1a348c730f2.source: This seems surprisingly passive, given the negative opinions about this episode.
8fe0f39ef18e2619d627bb81df5cf1a348c730f2.zh: 考虑到大家对这件事的负面看法，这样似乎出奇地被动。

93089f00c970ac745824b855e287854494533da4.source: This seems to be a bit of a self-criticism. And are things going poorly in China right now?
93089f00c970ac745824b855e287854494533da4.zh: 这似乎有点像是在自我批评。而且，中国眼下的局势很糟糕吗？

b90b705d08f4be0324f960224057154862c67d1e.source: This seems to be a change of heart from your earlier position.
b90b705d08f4be0324f960224057154862c67d1e.zh: 这似乎表明，你改变了此前的立场。

d85d9fbf8dbfc125e515306b5ebb0b76ffacf37f.source: This seems to be an effective deterrent so far.
d85d9fbf8dbfc125e515306b5ebb0b76ffacf37f.zh: 目前看来，这似乎是一种有效的威慑。

e4ff6dd96092a581acf328b3cfc007a6abced12e.source: This seems to be in line with your less interventionist positions.
e4ff6dd96092a581acf328b3cfc007a6abced12e.zh: 这似乎符合你较少干涉别国的立场。

214275943c5fa2d3e0964065822293abf5c83faa.source: This seems to go against your own policy, and is more of an isolationist position at this time.
214275943c5fa2d3e0964065822293abf5c83faa.zh: 这似乎违背了你自己的政策，而且在这个时候更偏向孤立主义立场。

ed600522954da8bc40b6836871d3c7963aac7cdd.source: This should be a model for other trade agreements as the developing world continues to seek the benefits of globalization.
ed600522954da8bc40b6836871d3c7963aac7cdd.zh: 随着发展中国家继续寻求全球化的益处，这应当成为其他贸易协定的范本。

1cf14bc45afb520c86a5d14d149d4a947d67ba74.source: This should be the primary goal of our policy in Vietnam. It's tragic how many American boys have died to defend a country that is not ready to defend itself.
1cf14bc45afb520c86a5d14d149d4a947d67ba74.zh: 这应是我们越南政策的首要目标。如此多的美国年轻人，为保卫一个尚未准备好自卫的国家而丧命，实在令人痛心。

d9a392e45f3fc00f113830cc669bef40e566cd38.source: This should hit the spot, given the riots and chaos this country has witnessed over the past three years.
d9a392e45f3fc00f113830cc669bef40e566cd38.zh: 鉴于过去三年全国经历的骚乱与混乱，这番话应该正中选民心思。

036fafe967dae6248030c36383daf2dd921f1a03.source: This shouldn't be a political decision that the President makes, it should be based on the science. The CDC is not recommending anything like a national lockdown right now, and I'm going to respect their expertise.
036fafe967dae6248030c36383daf2dd921f1a03.zh: 这不应该是总统作出的政治决定，而应该以科学为依据。疾病控制与预防中心目前并没有建议全国封锁这类措施，我会尊重他们的专业意见。

5c9a5e33356e09bcd948ba93d70de8e0a73a7b79.source: This sounds a little too liberal for the direction of your party and supporters.
5c9a5e33356e09bcd948ba93d70de8e0a73a7b79.zh: 相对于本党及支持者的倾向，这听起来有点过于自由派了。

0b426c51bb4742ff0586c405cf1393ffbc3468f8.source: This sounds like a good idea. Farmers and other laborers need to be unified this fall if we're to have a chance of beating McKinley.
0b426c51bb4742ff0586c405cf1393ffbc3468f8.zh: 这个主意不错。今年秋天，我们要想击败麦金莱，就必须把农民和其他劳动者团结起来。

ce13ae8c12db2de66cfb0f11fe62714cb2adf167.source: This puts you at odds with the Democratic Party, but it could help you with the defense hawk types.
ce13ae8c12db2de66cfb0f11fe62714cb2adf167.zh: 这让你与民主党立场冲突，却可能帮助你争取国防鹰派。

ed9fb44dc9b88fd19b4f74754c16338182875182.source: This puts you closer to Clay's position, and is a disappointment to the general public.
ed9fb44dc9b88fd19b4f74754c16338182875182.zh: 这使你更接近克莱的立场，也让一般民众感到失望。

c3e7da93342ad5091b45bf263ce395f03fe6f75f.source: This puts you outside of the party mainstream, to say the least. Hopefully it will help in a couple of the Northern states.
c3e7da93342ad5091b45bf263ce395f03fe6f75f.zh: 至少可以说，这让你偏离了党内主流。希望它能在北方几个州帮到你。

21cb0426d3b631c5fab310071f4cd40d0f37f5ed.source: This puts you well on your way to running a progressive campaign this fall.
21cb0426d3b631c5fab310071f4cd40d0f37f5ed.zh: 这让你今年秋季的竞选，明显朝着进步主义方向发展。

4f84141506f6f9ff632995477c9848ab22c2f5f0.source: This recent act is not something that I plan to address very much as I campaign.
4f84141506f6f9ff632995477c9848ab22c2f5f0.zh: 我不打算在竞选中多谈最近这项法案。

3c21d8acca5eb05a255decbeb3c7092cf89e9b5e.source: This relationship has its pros and cons. China should be doing more to live up to their end of our trade agreements, and they must stop manipulating their currency.
3c21d8acca5eb05a255decbeb3c7092cf89e9b5e.zh: 这段关系有利有弊。中国应该更努力履行贸易协定中自己的义务，也必须停止操纵汇率。

176767cb2e0ebcdd225fb1808fa1c35bbdd1f145.source: This reminds many progressives of Hillary Clinton the hawk.
176767cb2e0ebcdd225fb1808fa1c35bbdd1f145.zh: 这让许多进步派想起了那个鹰派希拉里·克林顿。

5029bb754dcd5f9f22801dd908150307ff024a07.source: This response is a bit of a gamble for you. You've certainly fired up your conservative base, but what will the rest of the country think.
5029bb754dcd5f9f22801dd908150307ff024a07.zh: 这个回答对你有点冒险。你确实鼓舞了保守派基本盘，但全国其他人会怎么想？

2f2c4110d6c0160aa6a436de61324292bdc4a6d1.source: This response is a little disappointing to environmentalist Democrats.
2f2c4110d6c0160aa6a436de61324292bdc4a6d1.zh: 这个回答让民主党中的环保人士有点失望。

fc8ea940d6e3e7038be9452f36ec31c405811855.source: This seems a little too union-friendly for many potential Republican voters.
fc8ea940d6e3e7038be9452f36ec31c405811855.zh: 对于许多潜在的共和党选民来说，这似乎对工会有点过于友好了。

9a1e741e261865226ad6018812d23e48746ca5f3.source: This seems like a bit of an eccentric position to many people.
9a1e741e261865226ad6018812d23e48746ca5f3.zh: 在许多人看来，这个立场有些古怪。

940d441b3ccf8e9e34105b8c402b88645c6cfa0a.source: This seems like a coded argument for segregation to some, and is also a repudiation of Eisenhower.
940d441b3ccf8e9e34105b8c402b88645c6cfa0a.zh: 在一些人看来，这似乎是在以隐晦的说法为种族隔离辩护，而且也否定了艾森豪威尔。

5df715fa69451a7477e5a2a8e7079f76bb8b05cf.source: This seems like a coded argument for segregation to some.
5df715fa69451a7477e5a2a8e7079f76bb8b05cf.zh: 在一些人看来，这似乎是在以隐晦的说法为种族隔离辩护。

0f2fcd346bd2494a51836edb076e2ebd096965ab.source: This seems like a confident, assertive, but well-grounded theme to base your campaign on.
0f2fcd346bd2494a51836edb076e2ebd096965ab.zh: 这似乎是一个自信、坚定，却又有充分依据的竞选主题。

bad1d42762aba44e3f825d9360fea75ea47daa97.source: This seems like a non-sequitur to many, albeit one with a grain of truth.
bad1d42762aba44e3f825d9360fea75ea47daa97.zh: 许多人觉得，这像是在答非所问，尽管多少有点道理。

0b620be42f47bff5824589a6190f6ab8c6cbddf8.source: This seems like a semi-retreat to the orthodox conservative view on trade.
0b620be42f47bff5824589a6190f6ab8c6cbddf8.zh: 这似乎多少是在退回传统保守派的贸易观点。

9ff9fef1d3cdbf94b23777841bd059637ff873d1.source: This seems like a shocking rebuke of Obama, and like a needlessly hawkish statement for the current political environment.
9ff9fef1d3cdbf94b23777841bd059637ff873d1.zh: 这像是在猛烈斥责奥巴马；在当前政治环境下，也显得鹰派得没有必要。

eba83dd9fc998c16f0371f1e0fd1d339a9648b37.source: This seems like a waffle to many voters, and doesn't convey the strength that is expected from a President.
eba83dd9fc998c16f0371f1e0fd1d339a9648b37.zh: 许多选民觉得你在含糊其辞，看不出总统应有的魄力。

4e715bf74a5e936277ff2c473e9052338eef4643.source: This seems like an overly cautious stance on one of your signature first-term achievements.
4e715bf74a5e936277ff2c473e9052338eef4643.zh: 对于第一任期的一项标志性政绩，这个立场似乎过于谨慎了。

db26163de41ee61ee14a33837261a9d103eee048.source: This sounds like a political non-starter. It's an interesting idea but let's steer the conversation towards something more productive.
db26163de41ee61ee14a33837261a9d103eee048.zh: 这听起来在政治上根本推不动。想法挺有意思，但我们还是把话题转向更有成果的事情吧。

11ca9f15b86c592d7a3aabe5921708a233126419.source: This sounds like the most ridiculous idea yet from Mr. Clay's long public career. I trust that enterprising individuals and companies will develop this technology.
11ca9f15b86c592d7a3aabe5921708a233126419.zh: 这听起来是克莱先生漫长政治生涯中迄今最荒唐的主意。我相信，有进取心的个人和企业会发展这项技术。

5b6754569eadd2831a21eb61b433219c396f42ef.source: This stance definitely goes too far for many of your supporters.
5b6754569eadd2831a21eb61b433219c396f42ef.zh: 对你的许多支持者来说，这个立场确实走得太远了。

3e189ad28de65ed6c43cbf8f3d8b4b00500fcf7c.source: This stance has appeal to what remains of the isolationists, but to most it seems like a dangerous retreat in the face of Communist aggression.
3e189ad28de65ed6c43cbf8f3d8b4b00500fcf7c.zh: 这个立场对剩下的孤立主义者有吸引力，但对大多数人来说，这是面对共产主义侵略时的危险退却。

ee97d130b4ddb912fb69ca8655ce03de0f6219e4.source: This stance helps you in a couple of coal states, but definitely raises eyebrows among the mainstream left.
ee97d130b4ddb912fb69ca8655ce03de0f6219e4.zh: 这个立场能在几个产煤州帮到你，但肯定会让主流左翼侧目。

f0189a615f3bdbde65955bc1a0424b58c6e8c406.source: This stance may rankle some true believers, but it will definitely help you compete in the Midwest and Northeast.
f0189a615f3bdbde65955bc1a0424b58c6e8c406.zh: 这个立场也许会惹恼一些坚定的信徒，但肯定有助于你在中西部和东北部争取选票。

bc1482a0cebeebd4ce344b7a19c983af0a6b57d2.source: This statement brings cheers from all corners of the party.
bc1482a0cebeebd4ce344b7a19c983af0a6b57d2.zh: 这番话赢得了党内各方的欢呼。

400360b45c1385d06680da17728f2235160d3479.source: This statement evokes memories of the “triangulator”, Bill. But that might help you as much as it hurts you.
400360b45c1385d06680da17728f2235160d3479.zh: 这个表态让人想起擅长“三角定位”的比尔。不过，它对你的帮助，可能和伤害一样大。

5d88fbcc717951a3b16a4647c5985629e79a69b0.source: This statement isn't enough to appeal to moderates, and is disappointing to progressive supporters.
5d88fbcc717951a3b16a4647c5985629e79a69b0.zh: 这个表态不足以吸引温和派，也让进步派支持者失望。

cfb812909558eff800e36e3dee0f614e8e130534.source: This statement will motivate the base, but it's a little impractical at this point.
cfb812909558eff800e36e3dee0f614e8e130534.zh: 这番话会激发基本盘，不过眼下有些不切实际。

6f4a56c44278d83c40179f32fe7de5f79d5ebeb8.source: This story is disinformation, nothing is proven about the laptop, and no reputable news agency will run with this story. Why should I insert myself into the middle of this controversy?
6f4a56c44278d83c40179f32fe7de5f79d5ebeb8.zh: 这个故事是虚假信息，关于电脑的说法都没有得到证明，也没有信誉良好的新闻机构愿意跟进。我为什么要把自己卷进这场争议？

ce7bb2aec0d0e58f35a9d2fee2c526fd32005b8e.source: This story is having a definite effect on your campaign, unfortunately.
ce7bb2aec0d0e58f35a9d2fee2c526fd32005b8e.zh: 不幸的是，这件事确实正在影响你的竞选。

0e1b7f5236c3cf9e3563aec0502766881e548055.source: This strategy isn't a disaster, but why work so hard to distance yourself from a popular, successful President who you worked under?
0e1b7f5236c3cf9e3563aec0502766881e548055.zh: 这个策略不算灾难，但你为什么如此费力地与一位受欢迎、成功、而且自己曾为之工作的总统保持距离？

3ec194512abeeb4d26117177e49426947b991faf.source: This strikes a bit of an aggressive note for some in your party.
3ec194512abeeb4d26117177e49426947b991faf.zh: 党内一些人觉得，这番话显得有点咄咄逼人。

cfba5b01b8b2075751a488f70579e2041cd393a3.source: This strikes a moderate chord with the public, and makes it clear where you stand in this election.
cfba5b01b8b2075751a488f70579e2041cd393a3.zh: 这在公众中传递了温和的基调，也明确了你在这场选举中的立场。

9087b5f588f6b0241874661564e92f2bcf504db9.source: This strikes a moderate tone, but it may be out of step in 2016.
9087b5f588f6b0241874661564e92f2bcf504db9.zh: 这听起来很温和，但可能与2016年的形势脱节。

d4be7c29281ec6e05f17b8e84c4ce55e2f278e15.source: This strikes me, and many Democrats, as a potential waste of federal land and resources.
d4be7c29281ec6e05f17b8e84c4ce55e2f278e15.zh: 在我和许多民主党人看来，这可能是在浪费联邦土地和资源。

7ba945235593a0127816a18fa7a51a4390b077e4.source: This talking point seems to play well among voters, even if it makes party insiders a little nervous about the direction of your potential Administration.
7ba945235593a0127816a18fa7a51a4390b077e4.zh: 这套说法似乎很受选民欢迎，即使它让党内人士对你可能执政后的方向有点紧张。

1ab452d93181a6a7f314ad94abcbd2ca2726f8a0.source: This turns off Southerners a bit, but the trade-off in terms of flexibility is probably worth it.
1ab452d93181a6a7f314ad94abcbd2ca2726f8a0.zh: 这让南方人有些反感，不过换来行程安排的灵活性，大概仍然值得。

6f702f32b6eb5a8d209e4bd3c1c99e82e5812a94.source: This type of incrementalism is leaving many Democrats uninspired.
6f702f32b6eb5a8d209e4bd3c1c99e82e5812a94.zh: 这种渐进改革，让许多民主党人提不起劲。

debfb46c621ad68be199c99afd1aae3c226b907d.source: This video clip is just one more piece of evidence that Donald Trump is a fake conservative who doesn't share Christian values. And of course, it also shows yet again how grossly unqualified Trump is to serve as President.
debfb46c621ad68be199c99afd1aae3c226b907d.zh: 这段视频又一次证明，唐纳德·特朗普是个不认同基督教价值观的假保守派。当然，它也再次说明，特朗普多么缺乏担任总统的资格。

7cb7a0006acd763eff4187bc05f832165f9477ce.source: This view is a little out of the mainstream, but not that much.
7cb7a0006acd763eff4187bc05f832165f9477ce.zh: 这个观点稍稍偏离主流，但也没有偏得太远。

31affb754dce74aed009aa51c5c1c3738c1074c3.source: This view is right in line with the party platform.
31affb754dce74aed009aa51c5c1c3738c1074c3.zh: 这个看法与党纲完全一致。

61be8aee5b37ac167b9e4bec8e2d4ba2d96b8187.source: This was a good policy. Our economy has rebounded considerably since early 1975, and millions of new jobs have been created.
61be8aee5b37ac167b9e4bec8e2d4ba2d96b8187.zh: 这是项好政策。自1975年初以来，经济已经明显复苏，创造了数百万个新工作岗位。

d0e4f217e5cea849ace14efc5efecbd80efd04a8.source: This was a pretty typical arrest, really. We don’t have any idea why George Floyd died. Maybe it was the drugs, who knows? Then you have the media fomenting riots and using them to get China Joe elected this fall.
d0e4f217e5cea849ace14efc5efecbd80efd04a8.zh: 这其实是一次挺普通的逮捕。我们不知道乔治·弗洛伊德为什么死。也许是毒品，谁知道呢？然后，媒体煽动骚乱，借此让“中国乔”今年秋天当选。

ea8e05bd66a8733b50f120dc2caf0811b7b6e2ea.source: This was about what everyone expected. Good job. Good effort.
ea8e05bd66a8733b50f120dc2caf0811b7b6e2ea.zh: 这正是每个人所期望的。好工作。很好的努力。

5cedc0b22c7ec173eaeec41c228caa7a7ffb96b5.source: This was an ill-considered and insensitive comment on my part, and I apologize. While this is a real issue, saying it describes "half" of Trump's supporters is a definite exaggeration.
5cedc0b22c7ec173eaeec41c228caa7a7ffb96b5.zh: 我这句话欠考虑，也不体谅人，我为此道歉。虽然这个问题确实存在，但说特朗普“一半”的支持者都如此，显然夸大了。

76654b66ca43b88d515757c240950d9e92be1aeb.source: This was an issue that had no bearing on the security of the United States. We also ruined any chance of mediation by insisting on the autonomy of Kosovo.
76654b66ca43b88d515757c240950d9e92be1aeb.zh: 这件事与美国的安全毫无关系。我们坚持科索沃自治，也毁掉了任何斡旋的机会。

60f44f838b4c5a8c2e4b0e9d642410cbebafbb37.source: This was definitely not supposed to happen. Good luck!
60f44f838b4c5a8c2e4b0e9d642410cbebafbb37.zh: 这绝对不应该发生。祝你好运！

2797a20ee0d6f33790880fbfa9b2c9dfe502e4bf.source: This was hardly a surprise, considering the stranglehold that the two-party system holds on American politics. To make matters worse, you didn’t even get 5% of the popular vote, so the Green Party will have to do without federal matching funds.
2797a20ee0d6f33790880fbfa9b2c9dfe502e4bf.zh: 考虑到两党制度对美国政治的束缚，这不足为奇。更糟糕的是，你甚至没有获得 5% 的普选票，因此 绿党 将不得不在没有联邦配套资金的情况下进行。

53ed02e36adf54eedfbc2fe6df00c47ea3f2c69b.source: This was in line with a 1943 decision from the Supreme Court. It seemed highly likely at the time that this law was going to be struck down by the Massachusetts Supreme Court.
53ed02e36adf54eedfbc2fe6df00c47ea3f2c69b.zh: 这符合最高法院1943年的一项判决。当时看来，这项法律极有可能被马萨诸塞州最高法院推翻。

b9fe15662c67cb6df8858f1b1cbe5a73fe4fb987.source: This was made without our advance knowledge, and it is not something that we can pledge to do at this point.
b9fe15662c67cb6df8858f1b1cbe5a73fe4fb987.zh: 这个声明事先没有知会我们，而且眼下我们还不能承诺这样做。

5620d387f4702e670afe5a0a81e89dfa7e937520.source: This was probably the best answer, as you manage to tackle the concerns of your big tent of voters.
5620d387f4702e670afe5a0a81e89dfa7e937520.zh: 这大概是最好的回答，你兼顾了广泛选民联盟中各方的关切。

00a5e823a0a6b8fc8f155b8e405477c6c77c8282.source: This was probably the worst answer you could give. You simultaneously anger Democrats and Negroes, and appear as a far-right extremist.
00a5e823a0a6b8fc8f155b8e405477c6c77c8282.zh: 这大概是你能给出的最糟糕回答。你同时激怒了民主党人和黑人，显得像个极右翼分子。

391efa7ff1e65d8ef1d47a8af49bf02017d5aaba.source: This was the act of a tyrant. Pullman was engaged in abominable business practices, and in the darkest hour Cleveland cast his lot with the company over the working man.
391efa7ff1e65d8ef1d47a8af49bf02017d5aaba.zh: 这是暴君的行径。普尔曼公司的经营做法令人发指；而在最黑暗的时刻，克利夫兰竟选择站在公司一边，反对工人。

5a1fe3890c183386ad980260635fecb982e12706.source: This was the expected outcome, as it seemed your new brand of politics just didn't sit well with the American public. Obama's legacy will be continued by Clinton through fighting climate change, trying to add a public option to Obamacare, and continuing with his economic prosperity, as well as possibly regaining both chambers of congress. Establishment Republicans are incredibly angry that you lost, thinking that 8 years of Obama was their chance to come back to the White House, only for you to come in and stop that.
5a1fe3890c183386ad980260635fecb982e12706.zh: 这是预期的结果，因为你的新政治品牌似乎不太适合美国公众。 奥巴马 的遗产将由 克林顿 延续，通过应对气候变化、尝试为 奥巴马医改 增加公共选择、继续经济繁荣，以及可能重新赢得国会两院。建制派共和党人对你输了感到非常愤怒，认为 奥巴马 的 8 年是他们重返 白宫 的机会，只是你进来阻止了。

ceb96cde75c4bedfa4fcd3089979d3a2876611d4.source: This was the expected outcome, as it seemed your new brand of politics just didn't sit well with the American public. Obama's legacy will be continued by Clinton through fighting climate change, trying to add a public option to Obamacare, and continuing with his economic prosperity. At least it was fairly close, it could have been much worse. Establishment Republicans are angry at you for losing, swatting aside many of their candidates only to lose to the likes of Clinton.
ceb96cde75c4bedfa4fcd3089979d3a2876611d4.zh: 这个结果在意料之中：看来你的新式政治路线并不合美国公众的胃口。克林顿将延续奥巴马的政治遗产，应对气候变化，尝试为奥巴马医改增加公共医保选项，并继续维持他任内的经济繁荣。至少票数还算接近，本来可能输得更惨。建制派共和党人对你的失败很愤怒：你把他们的诸多候选人扫到一旁，结果却败给克林顿这样的人。

5700f568efdbe1be267541d6549361f48fd48a32.source: This was the expected outcome, as it seemed your new brand of politics really didn't sit well with the American public. Obama's legacy will be continued by Clinton through fighting climate change, trying to add a public option to Obamacare, and continuing with his economic prosperity. With their margin of victory, you can assume that Republicans will not be able to stop much of it. Your entire party is incredibly angry about how you threw away a very winnable election, dooming them for the next few years
5700f568efdbe1be267541d6549361f48fd48a32.zh: 这个结果在意料之中：看来你的新式政治路线确实很不合美国公众的胃口。克林顿将延续奥巴马的政治遗产，应对气候变化，尝试为奥巴马医改增加公共医保选项，并继续维持他任内的经济繁荣。鉴于民主党的胜选优势，你可以预料，共和党人很难阻止其中多少议程。全党都因你白白丢掉一场大有胜算的选举而怒不可遏，未来几年他们都得为此受苦。

634ddbfe9a129d469941ea79c8350cdad641d048.source: This whole situation with the Clinton Foundation really should be against the law. You have foreign governments giving this charity millions of dollars, and that's supposed to have no effect on her Presidency?
634ddbfe9a129d469941ea79c8350cdad641d048.zh: 克林顿基金会这整套做法，真该被认定为违法。外国政府向这个慈善机构捐赠数百万美元，难道就能说，这对她当总统毫无影响？

9b5a47d303785700b50bdd166b77fa8ee2bf753f.source: This will be a common pattern throughout the entire campaign.
9b5a47d303785700b50bdd166b77fa8ee2bf753f.zh: 这种情形，将在整个竞选期间反复出现。

8093a26c0f4763359bdbfc91a2d24f463b118dc0.source: This will certainly galvanize the vote in New York.
8093a26c0f4763359bdbfc91a2d24f463b118dc0.zh: 这肯定会激发纽约州选民的热情。

b671fad238f900d5a3064141a5257f484ffdf166.source: This will certainly galvanize your base, but it's hard to imagine that you can get national health insurance passed after the failures of Truman on this front.
b671fad238f900d5a3064141a5257f484ffdf166.zh: 这肯定会激发你的基本盘，但杜鲁门在这个问题上已经失败，很难想象你能让全国医疗保险获准通过。

c774415c80f575db57ffd648d38a2aa61fa0723a.source: This will guarantee victory for us if successful. Let's roll the dice.
c774415c80f575db57ffd648d38a2aa61fa0723a.zh: 只要成功，这就能保证我们获胜。让我们赌一把。

cbfb6c609339ca1bd62e70a59633c4621a1947d3.source: This will help you drive turnout in the northern states, and hurt a little in the South.
cbfb6c609339ca1bd62e70a59633c4621a1947d3.zh: 这有助于提高北方各州的投票热情，但会让你在南方略受损失。

434be3d9a629a31829df94e09d7ea22081785a1d.source: This will obviously be a more popular position in certain regions.
434be3d9a629a31829df94e09d7ea22081785a1d.zh: 显然，这个立场在某些地区会更受欢迎。

587ad8cc24d89c15eff05ed036407dbbe9c0b13d.source: This won't hurt you too much, but it does nothing to differentiate you from Nixon and Eisenhower.
587ad8cc24d89c15eff05ed036407dbbe9c0b13d.zh: 这不会严重损害你，但也无法让你与尼克松和艾森豪威尔有所区别。

e7054f48f314a76d04aa36a65db60c0485008be3.source: This would be a good answer, but unfortunately you signed off on the New York bailout. It will take some tortuous logic to explain how this position is consistent with that act.
e7054f48f314a76d04aa36a65db60c0485008be3.zh: 这本来会是个不错的回答，但不幸的是，你已经批准了纽约救助。要解释这个立场如何与那项行动一致，恐怕得费尽周折。

9d2994f9c532a416a19cce9faa9ea6dfcea54ee2.source: This would be a positive step forward for all three countries, including the United States.
9d2994f9c532a416a19cce9faa9ea6dfcea54ee2.zh: 这将使包括美国在内的三个国家都向正确方向迈进。

a5b7ebe7497f3835d56ae63dd1dce1e79ef95bf2.source: This would be a positive step forward for the nation, and I support an expansive amendment on the issue.
a5b7ebe7497f3835d56ae63dd1dce1e79ef95bf2.zh: 这将让国家朝正确方向迈进，我支持在这个问题上制定适用范围广泛的修正案。

d9fef2201fa7dac94b1714d47c6d566ff66275c2.source: This would be a strictly personal invite. We are friends. And besides, it might blunt some opposition to my candidacy from New York.
d9fef2201fa7dac94b1714d47c6d566ff66275c2.zh: 这纯粹是私人邀请。我们是朋友。何况，这或许也能缓和纽约州一些人对我参选的反对。

ed3326e40d9f9cd0210751692f798bfb491876bb.source: This would be a worthwhile arrangement for the laboring classes across the civilized world. When I'm elected, however, we will allow the free coinage of silver regardless of what agreements are or aren't in place.
ed3326e40d9f9cd0210751692f798bfb491876bb.zh: 这将是一项有益于整个文明世界劳动阶层的安排。不过，我当选后，无论是否达成协议，都会允许白银自由铸币。

56fba387d26e569494673410dbef356f4df9ce6e.source: Thomas B. Reed is a savvy career politician with numerous connections in Congress, where he is currently Speaker of the House.
56fba387d26e569494673410dbef356f4df9ce6e.zh: 托马斯·B.·里德 是一位精明的职业政治家，在国会拥有众多人脉，目前担任众议院议长。

5503fc3fe3ecef09fe207a5d86d29aec06c32b69.source: Thomas Birney is a stooge of the Democrats, attempting to agitate emotions and divide our party. People ought to feel free to vote for him if they want to hand this election to James K. Polk.
5503fc3fe3ecef09fe207a5d86d29aec06c32b69.zh: 托马斯·伯尼是民主党的傀儡，企图煽动情绪、分裂我们党。如果人们想把这场大选拱手让给詹姆斯·K.·波尔克，尽管投票给他好了。

5932d89193442dc2966081978cd78222d21cc799.source: Thomas Dewey, Governor of New York, makes his second attempt at the Presidency. He became famous for his prosecutions of Mafia figures in New York, and is an exemplar of the Republican Party's eastern business establishment. Dewey waged a hard-hitting campaign against Roosevelt in 1944 that alienated some voters. Advisors this time are recommending that he take a more cautious, conciliatory approach, especially in light of the huge lead he enjoys.
5932d89193442dc2966081978cd78222d21cc799.zh: 托马斯·杜威，纽约州 州长，第二次尝试担任总统。他因在纽约州中起诉黑手党人物而闻名，并且是共和党东部商业机构的典范。 杜威 于 1944 年针对 罗斯福 发起了一场严厉的竞选活动，疏远了一些选民。这次顾问们建议他采取更加谨慎、和解的态度，特别是考虑到他享有巨大的领先优势。

48af2f3f6faef77d5a6656fdf5f12cbe55921104.source: Thomas E. Dewey and His Times
48af2f3f6faef77d5a6656fdf5f12cbe55921104.zh: 托马斯·E. 杜威 和他的时代

18b5ca0b199f5c83f3057ac3499763f0356cc3ad.source: Thomas R. Marshall has served as Wilson's Vice President since 1913, but the two have had icy relations. However, keeping Marshall on the ticket would preserve party unity and avoid a distracting storyline during the campaign. Marshall was previously the Governor of Indiana and is popular in that state. Politically, he is more moderate than Wilson has been.
18b5ca0b199f5c83f3057ac3499763f0356cc3ad.zh: 托马斯·R.·马歇尔 自 1913 年以来一直担任 威尔逊 的副总裁，但两人关系冷淡。然而，将 马歇尔 保留在选票上将保持政党团结并避免竞选期间出现分散注意力的故事情节。 马歇尔 曾任 印第安纳州 的州长，在该州很受欢迎。在政治上，他比 威尔逊 更加温和。

45156f7d76352dd76982787ebf3defc2b9ff72aa.source: Those decisions, you know, I think our military is a fine force and that's not necessarily the best use of its resources.
45156f7d76352dd76982787ebf3defc2b9ff72aa.zh: 这类决定，你知道，我认为我们的军队是一支优秀的力量，而这未必是利用其资源的最佳办法。

834684f925690cd1952a45c32bbb0b1e354df38f.source: Those few who pay close attention admire your integrity and avoidance of regional favoritism on this issue. Except for those who live in New England of course.
834684f925690cd1952a45c32bbb0b1e354df38f.zh: 少数密切关注此事的人，欣赏你的原则，以及你没有偏袒某个地区的做法。当然，住在新英格兰的人除外。

d008505bad4a5c170d711c5b9b0de1d7d851c9dc.source: Those tax cuts have your name on them. Are you saying they weren't enough?
d008505bad4a5c170d711c5b9b0de1d7d851c9dc.zh: 那些减税可是以你的名义实施的。你是在说它们力度不够吗？

823f2e8b5ba25bb079ce1deea2a0ebd96befbefb.source: Those were the words of Barack Obama, as he watches a large flatscreen television across the room from him. The audio output from it relays the projection of the state of Utah in favour of him, completing his 538 vote nationwide sweep of the presidential election. He chuckles to himself. His master plan of tricking the US public into thinking he was an earnest man, that hoped everyone would succeed. He'd played them like fiddles. With his new house and senate supermajorities, he could instate his master plan. First, he would pass a bill that knocks down every Christian church in America and use the rubble to build monuments to Allah. Next, he was going to raise taxes to 101% percent on billionaires, and use the money to buy every school and start teaching communist history. Finally, he would amend the constitution, and remove every odd-numbered amendment, making the American population bend to his every whim (probably, he hadn't thought that far yet). He wonders how anyone could have possibly missed such an obvious plan. It seems only a few people on the internet realized it, but thankfully nobody took them seriously...
823f2e8b5ba25bb079ce1deea2a0ebd96befbefb.zh: 这是 贝拉克·奥巴马 当他看着房间对面的大平板电视时说的话。它的音频输出传达了 犹他州 州对他有利的预测，完成了他在全国范围内的总统选举中以 538 票横扫的结果。他暗自窃笑。他的总体计划是欺骗美国公众，让他们认为他是一个认真的人，希望每个人都能成功。他像拉小提琴一样演奏它们。凭借他的新众议院和参议院的绝对多数，他可以实施他的总体规划。首先，他将通过一项法案，拆除美国所有的基督教教堂，并用废墟建造安拉纪念碑。接下来，他打算将亿万富翁的税率提高到101%，并用这笔钱购买每所学校并开始教授共产主义历史。最后，他将修改宪法，并删除每一项奇数修正案，让美国人民屈服于他的每一个突发奇想（可能他还没有想那么远）。他想知道怎么会有人错过如此明显的计划。网上似乎只有少数人意识到这一点，但幸运的是没有人认真对待他们......

b4fc7d87e2caac8dd67d3a36f4d79346da3e8639.source: Those were the words of the clerk in the US Senate. They went through each Senator by state, asking for a voice vote from each of them. After all, was said and done, the tally was 81-19 in favour of the motion. the clerk said 'The motion passes. The bill will now be presented to the president for signing.' He stood up and turned around, only to see president Ralph Nader standing 2 inches behind him, which causes the Clerk to stumble back. 'Oh, h-hello there President Nader. I was just going to pres-' He gets interrupted by the loudest yell he had ever heard, when president Nader bellowed at him:
b4fc7d87e2caac8dd67d3a36f4d79346da3e8639.zh: 这是美国参议院书记员的话。他们逐州询问了每位参议员，要求他们进行口头投票。毕竟，该动议最终以 81 比 19 的票数通过。书记员说：“动议通过了。”该法案现在将提交给总统签署。他站起来并转身，却看到总统拉尔夫·纳德站在他身后2英寸处，这让书记员踉踉跄跄地向后退了一步。 '哦，哈-你好，总统 纳德。我正要演讲——”总统 纳德 对他吼叫时，他被他听过的最响亮的喊叫声打断了：

89ef732a15a545bb89db8362fd9460ee0f5f1e62.source: Those who love gun rights, love your answer. Others accuse you of politicizing this tragedy.
89ef732a15a545bb89db8362fd9460ee0f5f1e62.zh: 热爱拥枪权的人很喜欢你的回答，其他人则指责你把这场悲剧政治化。

ec306316490fefcacef251e5dade41a7a7b36830.source: Those words rang out from the president's office, despite the door being shut. In the room, were President Bill Clinton and Vice President Al Gore.'I BROUGHT THE ECONOMY BACK FROM A TERRIBLE STATE RUN BY INCOMPETENT REPUBLICANS. I WON DURING THE MID-TERMS AND GAVE YOU A FREE TICKET TO THE PRESIDENCY. AND WHAT DO YOU DO? YOU LET THE SON OF THE GUY WHO I BEAT BECOME PRESIDENT! 538 VOTES TO 0!' Those were the words of a less than happy Bill Clinton. Gore responded 'I-I don't know what happened, I-I thought I ran a good campaign b-but...' Clinton interrupted, saying 'You know exactly what happened Gore. For some reason, you did a tank photo op like Dukakis, which is already bad enough. BUT THEN you accidentally fired the tank, I have no clue how, those things are hard to fire, and you hit a group of spectators. Killing 5. Your court date is in a month so you better start prepping a defence team.' 'co-' 'If you’re asking me for a pardon, you can shove it. Then in your speech to the nation about it, you claimed the ghost of William Mckinley had fired the tank by controlling your body. You then spent 50 thousand dollars of taxpayer money on hiring an exorcist to try and remove him. That’s why you lost, Al.
ec306316490fefcacef251e5dade41a7a7b36830.zh: 虽然门关着，这句话还是从总统办公室里传了出来。屋内坐着比尔·克林顿总统和阿尔·戈尔副总统。“我把经济从无能的共和党人糟蹋的惨状里救了回来。我赢了中期选举，给你铺好了直通总统宝座的路。可你干了什么？你让那个被我打败的家伙的儿子当上了总统！538票对0票！”这是怒气冲冲的比尔·克林顿说的话。戈尔答道：“我——我不知道怎么回事，我——我以为自己的竞选做得不错，可——”克林顿打断他：“你明明知道怎么回事，戈尔。不知为什么，你像杜卡基斯那样跑去坐坦克拍照，这已经够糟糕了。然后你竟然误开了炮——我都不知道你怎么做到的，那玩意儿很难打响——还击中了一群观众，打死了5个人。一个月后你就要出庭，最好赶快准备辩护团队。”“能——”“想让我赦免你？门儿都没有。接着，你在向全国解释此事的演说里，声称是威廉·麦金莱的鬼魂控制了你的身体，开炮打响了坦克。你又花了纳税人的5万美元，雇一个驱魔师来把他赶走。阿尔，这就是你败选的原因。”

a0cba9c024a4621c9154c037009835cb0578f2ea.source: Though it may seem like a foregone conclusion to attack Goldwater on the Klan endorsement fiasco, the fact remains that we are still behind in the South, where the Klan still has substantial influence. Should we press this line of attack?
a0cba9c024a4621c9154c037009835cb0578f2ea.zh: 针对三K党背书的风波攻击戈德华特，似乎理所当然，但事实是，我们在南方仍然落后，而三K党在那里依然颇有影响力。我们应继续沿这条路线进攻吗？

5929501acda0074bd07dde283ce0284a3209d083.source: Though it was perhaps expected, you could have easily faltered at a number of points. Credit to you for pulling through.
5929501acda0074bd07dde283ce0284a3209d083.zh: 虽然这可能是预料之中的，但您可能很容易在很多方面犹豫不决。感谢你的坚持。

92e125508ac10b5879a42be0793daaaa64b921b5.source: Thoughts and prayers are not enough. Every American should be outraged that the assault rifles used in these attacks are freely available and affordable.
92e125508ac10b5879a42be0793daaaa64b921b5.zh: 牵挂与祈祷还不够。这些袭击中使用的突击步枪可以轻易且廉价地买到，每个美国人都应该为此感到愤怒。

7fd7914627e7113a2fe77d75bbc3af16b0c329dc.source: Thousands of young men have formed paramilitary “Wide Awake” clubs and marched to support Republicans. Should your party embrace this support, or is it too divisive?
7fd7914627e7113a2fe77d75bbc3af16b0c329dc.zh: 成千上万的年轻人组成了准军事化的“觉醒者”社团，列队游行支持共和党。你们党应当接纳这股支持力量，还是认为它过于容易激化分歧？

f21c11d6cdae4b1cb6e1498e2a7f56d2cfff7ca2.source: Thurmond's presence could help tilt the Carolinas in Wallace's direction, but it will take every ounce of Wallace's persuasive acumen to get Thurmond to agree to run.
f21c11d6cdae4b1cb6e1498e2a7f56d2cfff7ca2.zh: 瑟蒙德 的存在可以帮助卡罗莱纳州向 华莱士 的方向倾斜，但需要 华莱士 的每一分说服力才能让 瑟蒙德 同意参选。

a96721a702543a051abe82fccd78df8ae9ab7165.source: Tillman and others have nothing to fear from me. It is the sacred duty of the white man to properly instruct and civilize the black man and other inferior races. Greater understanding must occur within this context.
a96721a702543a051abe82fccd78df8ae9ab7165.zh: 蒂尔曼和其他人不必怕我。白人负有神圣的责任，妥善教导黑人和其他低等种族，使他们文明化。增进相互理解，必须在这个前提下进行。

fd8a6e3a6b1ecefc5afca6c87b59adbb95223a7c.source: Tim Kaine has fought for American workers and families for his entire career. He is amply qualified and ready to step in for our agenda at a moment's notice.
fd8a6e3a6b1ecefc5afca6c87b59adbb95223a7c.zh: 蒂姆·凯恩在整个职业生涯中，一直为美国劳动者和家庭奋斗。他资格充分，随时准备挺身而出，推进我们的议程。

a489f85cb064ec69af5fca7811de29ebcf0c70f2.source: Tim Kaine has served as a Governor and Senator from Virginia, and shares similar political views to Hillary Clinton. He is fluent in both Spanish and English.
a489f85cb064ec69af5fca7811de29ebcf0c70f2.zh: 蒂姆·凯恩 曾担任 弗吉尼亚州 的州长和参议员，并与 希拉里·克林顿 有着相似的政治观点。他精通西班牙语和英语。

928902f5248362b9e0b54906ff1d94c0790ffcf3.source: Tim Kaine has served his home state of Virginia with great energy and effectiveness as a Governor and Senator. He is a hard working and honest person who can appeal to Americans across the ideological spectrum.
928902f5248362b9e0b54906ff1d94c0790ffcf3.zh: 蒂姆·凯恩担任州长和参议员期间，以充沛的精力和出色的成效服务于他的家乡弗吉尼亚州。他勤奋而诚实，能吸引持各种政治观点的美国人。

b180d4743ad3f8f00201f94011e457993cf0bd9b.source: Tim Kaine is very popular within the party establishment, but less well known in the general public.
b180d4743ad3f8f00201f94011e457993cf0bd9b.zh: 蒂姆·凯恩在党的建制派内部很受欢迎，但普通公众对他了解较少。

9c2431dbe77174179b31587b3098165984e236a4.source: Tim Pawlenty served as the Governor of Minnesota for eight years and briefly sought the Republican nomination in 2011. He brings a reputation as a moderate and a strong manager, and could help burnish Romney's credentials in the upper Midwest.
9c2431dbe77174179b31587b3098165984e236a4.zh: 蒂姆·波伦蒂 担任 明尼苏达州 州长八年，并在 2011 年短暂寻求共和党提名。他带来了温和而强有力的管理者的声誉，并可以帮助提升 罗姆尼 在中西部北部的资历。

94e351241663827a7883f4a0f26335f6415402d1.source: Time will tell if Bush governs as a moderate, or a staunch conservative. Many Democrats feel that this election was yours to lose, and it seems unlikely that you will be welcome to run again in four years. Your term as Governor, however, runs through 1991.
94e351241663827a7883f4a0f26335f6415402d1.zh: 时间会告诉我们 布什 是温和派还是坚定的保守派执政。许多民主党人认为这次选举是你的失败，而且四年后似乎不太可能欢迎你再次参选。不过，您的州长任期将持续到 1991 年。

6444ce5cd74da2be619cab0bb901c71a7df57af3.source: Time will tell if Dukakis governs as a moderate, a liberal, or a technocrat. A lot can happen in four years, but the early gossip is that Bob Dole has the inside track for the 1992 nomination. Your next steps are unclear.
