6444ce5cd74da2be619cab0bb901c71a7df57af3.zh: 时间会告诉我们 杜卡基斯 是温和派、自由派还是技术官僚执政。四年内可能会发生很多事情，但早期的传闻是 鲍勃·多尔 有机会获得 1992 年的提名。您的下一步行动尚不清楚。

e6ab707d60ba5eedf237add965caaa845ee88c9d.source: Times have changed since the 1830s, and many are coming around to the idea of some spending on infrastructure.
e6ab707d60ba5eedf237add965caaa845ee88c9d.zh: 时代已不同于1830年代，许多人开始认同，应该在基础设施上花一些钱。

9aa94d6d6d2582122cb45cfa8e0c94b1d81a855b.source: To be fair, you've appeared with people across the Democratic spectrum, and you shouldn't ignore your Southern base completely.
9aa94d6d6d2582122cb45cfa8e0c94b1d81a855b.zh: 公平地说，你与民主党各派人士都一同露过面，也不应完全忽视南方基本盘。

f08cf0a293c760cb1b750b703e6273890faee095.source: To defend against whom? The Cold War is over and we should be working
f08cf0a293c760cb1b750b703e6273890faee095.zh: 防御谁？冷战结束了，我们应该努力工作

7c5bb74af7cfebc12ddd3a972d16d2235ccf21df.source: To many progressives, this seems overly passive in the face of the global warming threat.
7c5bb74af7cfebc12ddd3a972d16d2235ccf21df.zh: 许多进步派觉得，面对全球变暖威胁，这样显得过于被动。

29ce861b053570a4808fa1c2efddf86fc2ee97e8.source: To most Americans, this position is a bit out of the mainstream.
29ce861b053570a4808fa1c2efddf86fc2ee97e8.zh: 对大多数美国人来说，这个立场有点偏离主流。

5360fd8a2e4a96e76946e207b7f409be8521ea8a.source: To the chagrin of Democrats, creating flashbacks to 2000, the popular vote is won by the Democrats, despite your electoral vote win. be prepared for a galvanized liberal base during the mid-terms.
5360fd8a2e4a96e76946e207b7f409be8521ea8a.zh: 让民主党人懊恼的是，他们赢得了普选票，你却凭选举人票获胜，让人又想起了2000年。准备在中期选举中面对一个被充分动员起来的自由派阵营吧。

3fe44c9dfd4c712edb6be65f666993815f032fe1.source: To the shock of many, Obama loses the popular vote while winning the electoral vote. Your Republican colleagues aren't too happy, believing a more geographically oriented pick for the presidency instead of your could have won it for them
3fe44c9dfd4c712edb6be65f666993815f032fe1.zh: 令许多人震惊的是，奥巴马 在赢得选举人票的同时却失去了普选票。你的共和党同事不太高兴，他们相信一个更注重地理的总统候选人而不是你可以为他们赢得总统宝座

151ffbecf61c20e78af22a838c45ebc8bda2aea7.source: To the surprise of many, you became the first Democrat to lose the popular vote while winning the electoral vote! Republicans are seething, trying to cope with the fact that they were so close to victory.
151ffbecf61c20e78af22a838c45ebc8bda2aea7.zh: 令许多人惊讶的是，您成为第一个在赢得选举人票的同时失去普选票的民主党人！共和党人沸腾了，试图应对他们如此接近胜利的事实。

098d5c4b822af2169d8cb04493fb1982a7349f84.source: To what extent are you prepared to make anti-Communism an issue in this campaign, or to attack Harry Truman on the issue?
098d5c4b822af2169d8cb04493fb1982a7349f84.zh: 你准备在多大程度上把反共作为竞选议题，或就此抨击哈里·杜鲁门？

0ae6d9e554db7b41fc669e812977759dc359e069.source: To what extent do you plan to personally campaign in this election?
0ae6d9e554db7b41fc669e812977759dc359e069.zh: 你打算在多大程度上亲自参加这次竞选活动？

5e84a49fd2eb63294320ca58821ddc211d66c1a0.source: To what extent do you support emergency economic legislation to address the effects of COVID-19 on society?
5e84a49fd2eb63294320ca58821ddc211d66c1a0.zh: 你在多大程度上支持紧急经济立法，以应对新冠疫情对社会的影响？

928001a8cdfda0f3cdfe51e50d00b31e1df7da79.source: To what extent will you attack Bill Clinton's history of infidelity, impeachment, and so on as you campaign?
928001a8cdfda0f3cdfe51e50d00b31e1df7da79.zh: 竞选期间，你会在多大程度上攻击比尔·克林顿的不忠、弹劾等过往？

997c0fce2aa73c71773c391a89c3e802af13da84.source: To what extent will you attack Donald Trump for any number of statements he has made about women in his past, including in this election cycle?
997c0fce2aa73c71773c391a89c3e802af13da84.zh: 对于特朗普过去关于女性的种种言论，包括这次竞选期间的言论，你会在多大程度上加以攻击？

9b3c14f57c4426c9785d71660d4c60757ba8fd7a.source: To what extent will you attack Donald Trump for the controversy surrounding Trump University?
9b3c14f57c4426c9785d71660d4c60757ba8fd7a.zh: 围绕特朗普大学的争议，你会在多大程度上借此攻击唐纳德·特朗普？

e3be6380323692869cf47cb1e7d06117bb43eea3.source: To what extent will you attack Donald Trump for the rhetoric he has used about Mexicans, Muslims, women, and other groups?
e3be6380323692869cf47cb1e7d06117bb43eea3.zh: 特朗普对墨西哥人、穆斯林、女性等群体的言辞，你会在多大程度上加以攻击？

ebb8e583458b14a4f3e7ea21266157864b528854.source: To what extent will you attack Dukakis's bill, in 1971, to decriminalize sodomy and bestiality in the Massachusetts Congress?
ebb8e583458b14a4f3e7ea21266157864b528854.zh: 杜卡基斯1971年在马萨诸塞州议会提出了将鸡奸与兽交除罪化的法案，你会在多大程度上攻击这件事？

b4d95a6a3622166b90709d6d9ad60782fee9f264.source: To what extent will you attack Dukakis's opposition to the military actions in Granada and Libya?
b4d95a6a3622166b90709d6d9ad60782fee9f264.zh: 杜卡基斯反对在格林纳达和利比亚的军事行动，你会在多大程度上攻击这一点？

477f809fea4a7625c4f6ea8535b2235110b65059.source: To what extent will you attack George Bush's relationship with Manuel Noriega of Panama?
477f809fea4a7625c4f6ea8535b2235110b65059.zh: 你会在多大程度上攻击乔治·布什与巴拿马的曼努埃尔·诺列加的关系？

2b66e61e9415559490e26f8624f7bb764e34b970.source: To what extent will you attack Hillary Clinton for her changing views on gay marriage, criminal justice, illegal immigration, the Trans-Pacific Partnership, or other issues?
2b66e61e9415559490e26f8624f7bb764e34b970.zh: 希拉里·克林顿在同性婚姻、刑事司法、非法移民、TPP等问题上观点变化，你会在多大程度上攻击她？

6fadc0f334b81773a88b2bcedfd4c6d5dcf1eace.source: To what extent will you attack Hillary Clinton for the foreign donations she has taken for the Clinton Foundation, often from Middle Eastern sources. Or, also, for her paid speeches from Goldman Sachs?
6fadc0f334b81773a88b2bcedfd4c6d5dcf1eace.zh: 对于希拉里为克林顿基金会接受外国捐款，尤其是来自中东的捐款，以及她收取高盛报酬发表演说，你会在多大程度上发动攻击？

fb61988feb36d1d83767ae26d0b64c29a0572aca.source: To what extent will you attack Hillary Clinton's 2002 vote to authorize the war in Iraq?
fb61988feb36d1d83767ae26d0b64c29a0572aca.zh: 希拉里·克林顿2002年投票授权在伊拉克动武，你会在多大程度上攻击这件事？

d4fa0f6d4fdcc40b5a595865a5e727dc2710e097.source: To what extent will you attack Hillary Clinton's decision to set up a private email server in her home, while Secretary of State?
d4fa0f6d4fdcc40b5a595865a5e727dc2710e097.zh: 希拉里·克林顿担任国务卿时，在家中设立私人电子邮件服务器；你会在多大程度上攻击这项决定？

418bd3e1cb3816f98a43f4b30a7c950bb2aebc72.source: To what extent will you attack Hillary Clinton's equivocation on the Benghazi attacks in 2012?
418bd3e1cb3816f98a43f4b30a7c950bb2aebc72.zh: 希拉里·克林顿对2012年班加西袭击含糊其词，你会在多大程度上攻击她？

5e98cea67066e00000ab81b07b734f1cd3d2e2b0.source: To what extent will you attack the veto, by Dukakis, of a bill requiring teachers to lead their students in the Pledge of Allegiance?
5e98cea67066e00000ab81b07b734f1cd3d2e2b0.zh: 杜卡基斯否决了一项要求教师带领学生宣读效忠誓词的法案，你会在多大程度上攻击这件事？

a80dadaf69c53127c63d259e0bf5ab0fe2d47bab.source: To what extent will you campaign focus on your background as the child of Greek immigrants, and your rise through American society?
a80dadaf69c53127c63d259e0bf5ab0fe2d47bab.zh: 你的竞选将在多大程度上突出自己作为希腊移民子女、在美国社会中不断向上奋斗的经历？

bd1e579b5c72bf7b60f06c11febe757592c4a301.source: To what extent will you campaign with Barack Obama, or support his presence on the campaign trail this year?
bd1e579b5c72bf7b60f06c11febe757592c4a301.zh: 今年，你会在多大程度上与贝拉克·奥巴马共同竞选，或支持他参加竞选活动？

6e41ecf4ae938b9508f77990f53acfa28d8bfe57.source: To what extent will you connect the dots between the Clintons' support of free trade and tough sentencing, and the huge unemployment in the black community?
6e41ecf4ae938b9508f77990f53acfa28d8bfe57.zh: 你会在多大程度上，把克林顿夫妇支持自由贸易和严厉量刑，与黑人社群的严重失业联系起来？

8698f3d57ebeb385bd62f93efb0a9af5efd275d6.source: To what extent will you emphasize Dukakis's claim to be a “card-carrying” member of the ACLU in your campaign attacks?
8698f3d57ebeb385bd62f93efb0a9af5efd275d6.zh: 杜卡基斯自称是美国公民自由联盟“持有会员证的正式会员”，你的竞选攻击会在多大程度上围绕这句话展开？

1e437674edc09afe4ac5e387f000b93ba3b1c541.source: To what extent will you emphasize your support for civil rights legislation in New York as you hit the campaign trail?
1e437674edc09afe4ac5e387f000b93ba3b1c541.zh: 展开竞选时，你会在多大程度上强调自己在纽约州支持民权立法的政绩？

ea16bfa1f235459a0170cf8caeeb934c1199c28d.source: To what extent will you make an increase in the minimum wage a key part of your campaign? Do you stand by your commitment to $12/hour?
ea16bfa1f235459a0170cf8caeeb934c1199c28d.zh: 你会在多大程度上，把提高最低工资作为竞选的关键内容？你仍坚持每小时12美元的承诺吗？

c7395cdd7bee775eb6a1576c7cb16cba60e88675.source: To what extent will you make opposition to current trade agreements a part of your speeches and campaign?
c7395cdd7bee775eb6a1576c7cb16cba60e88675.zh: 你会在多大程度上，把反对现行贸易协定作为演说和竞选的内容？

c78833538215cfad46c124e01d4b1924a1569608.source: To what extent will you make your experience as Vice President a theme of your campaign against the youthful Kennedy?
c78833538215cfad46c124e01d4b1924a1569608.zh: 面对年轻的肯尼迪，你会在多大程度上把自己担任副总统的经验作为竞选主题？

6e8e8a6b904887733cfcf8ae003073e245acfb06.source: To what extent will you make your performance as Governor of Massachusetts a centerpiece of your campaign?
6e8e8a6b904887733cfcf8ae003073e245acfb06.zh: 你会在多大程度上将自己担任马萨诸塞州州长的政绩，作为竞选的核心？

16d12b01f52f36b717f8d67ff2ad8ce028c698f3.source: To what extent will you remind voters that you served in the United States Army?
16d12b01f52f36b717f8d67ff2ad8ce028c698f3.zh: 你会在多大程度上提醒选民，你曾在美国陆军服役？

2f5fa6642e9ec15a1d5f0b4b2c47f777c1d3b4b0.source: To what extent will you speak about your religious faith (Mormonism) on the campaign trail?
2f5fa6642e9ec15a1d5f0b4b2c47f777c1d3b4b0.zh: 竞选途中，你会在多大程度上谈论自己的宗教信仰，也就是摩门教？

146de943b4d14893941104bb0b39f62028ad6d2a.source: To what extent will you support the presence of Bernie Sanders on the campaign trail?
146de943b4d14893941104bb0b39f62028ad6d2a.zh: 你会在多大程度上支持伯尼·桑德斯参与竞选活动？

686834361908bea2201fd652244e67c704e73c64.source: To what extent will you undo the draconian immigration and asylum policies that have been enacted under Trump?
686834361908bea2201fd652244e67c704e73c64.zh: 你会在多大程度上撤销特朗普执政期间实行的严苛移民与庇护政策？

d4775d1bdb7eb091f80da01d5aab63160738b53f.source: To what extent will your campaign attack the Massachusetts prison furlough program, and/or the murder committed by Willie Horton?
d4775d1bdb7eb091f80da01d5aab63160738b53f.zh: 你的竞选团队打算在多大程度上攻击马萨诸塞州的离监休假制度，以及威利·霍顿犯下的谋杀案？

30f234d9439aff88ec665c8e6630b07a6daf9f0a.source: To what extent will your campaign focus on your service as an airman in World War II?
30f234d9439aff88ec665c8e6630b07a6daf9f0a.zh: 你的竞选将在多大程度上着重宣传二战期间担任军机飞行员的经历？

45930d66f419831ff030bff2298eff3e10720604.source: Today I have stood, where once Abraham Lincoln stood and took an oath to my country. It is very appropriate then that from this bastion of America, this very heart of the great men who created the principles of freedom in this country, that today we sound the drum for freedom as have our generations of forebears before us done, time and time again through history. Let us rise to the call of freedom-loving blood that is in us and send our answer to the tyranny that clanks its chains upon the Negro. In the name of the greatest country that has ever trod this earth, I draw the line in the dust and toss the gauntlet before the feet of tyranny . . . and I say . . . desegregation today . . . desegregation tomorrow . . . desegregation forever!
45930d66f419831ff030bff2298eff3e10720604.zh: 今天，我站在曾经 亚伯拉罕·林肯 站着的地方，向我的国家宣誓。因此，今天，从美国这个堡垒，在这个国家创造了自由原则的伟人的心中，我们像我们的前几代先辈在历史上一次又一次地敲响自由的鼓声，是非常恰当的。让我们响应我们内心热爱自由的血液的召唤，向黑人的暴政发出我们的回应。以地球上最伟大国家的名义，我在尘埃中划下界限，向暴政的脚下发出挑战。 。 。我说。 。 。今天废除种族隔离。 。 。明天废除种族隔离。 。 。永远废除种族隔离！

27b8eaedc4d3eb1253de2c3bfb9e03f91e9358dd.source: Today it looks like it's the Milwaukee Chamber of Commerce who have made the trip to your house. Do you have something inspiring to tell them in your speech?
27b8eaedc4d3eb1253de2c3bfb9e03f91e9358dd.zh: 看来，今天来你家的是密尔沃基商会。你打算在演说中说些什么，鼓舞他们？

33ec50685c81f565f7b91073f8f73cd2d92df8a7.source: Today we will cover the need for religious tolerance. The Republicans are a party for all Americans.
33ec50685c81f565f7b91073f8f73cd2d92df8a7.zh: 今天，我们要谈宗教宽容的重要性。共和党属于全体美国人。

1b4beff5dd380bfbdd6fe39d5d486f6f46b73b8a.source: Today you have announced the selection of Bob Graham as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
1b4beff5dd380bfbdd6fe39d5d486f6f46b73b8a.zh: 今天，你宣布选择鲍勃·格雷厄姆作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

e7b7a9a4c6b8f38d9bce63f236d11857001f4741.source: Today you have announced the selection of Dick Cheney as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
e7b7a9a4c6b8f38d9bce63f236d11857001f4741.zh: 今天，你宣布选择迪克·切尼作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

80d772c65799998191f17be4db7e635214c2b60d.source: Today you have announced the selection of Evan Bayh as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
80d772c65799998191f17be4db7e635214c2b60d.zh: 今天，你宣布选择埃文·贝赫作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

adacf2a8f3f7e45b171b0d2a79877993a816c0e6.source: Today you have announced the selection of Joe Lieberman as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
adacf2a8f3f7e45b171b0d2a79877993a816c0e6.zh: 今天，你宣布选择乔·利伯曼作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

f57067407d70b0e474fc0b82e37ec30e0eb93b05.source: Today you have announced the selection of John Danforth as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
f57067407d70b0e474fc0b82e37ec30e0eb93b05.zh: 今天，你宣布选择约翰·丹福思作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

2b953635f05a614d6dde877e618a4d7432ae0217.source: Today you have announced the selection of John Kerry as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
2b953635f05a614d6dde877e618a4d7432ae0217.zh: 今天，你宣布选择约翰·克里作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

1cf9f81c39f0dbd414a7d7f480a88beb6e4804fd.source: Today, famous South Carolinian and 1948 Dixiecrat candidate Strom Thurmond has officially switched his party affiliation from Democratic to Republican, an expected move after his endorsement of Barry Goldwater for President.
1cf9f81c39f0dbd414a7d7f480a88beb6e4804fd.zh: 今天，南卡罗来纳州知名政治人物、1948年迪克西民主党人的总统候选人斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德，正式由民主党转投共和党。此前他已支持巴里·戈德华特竞选总统，所以这个举动并不意外。

576b2f42ca505e18f366d5a1f63b4a1a88fcc90a.source: Tom Ridge has served his home state of Pennsylvania well. It would be a shame to ignore that because of a litmus test on one issue.
576b2f42ca505e18f366d5a1f63b4a1a88fcc90a.zh: 汤姆·里奇出色地服务了家乡宾夕法尼亚州。因为单一议题的立场考验就忽视这一点，实在可惜。

a1cdcd437c569f58fdc214e77cf55b1a50716a7d.source: Tom Ridge is the popular Governor of a large swing state. Pennsylvania's 23 electoral votes would almost ensure a Bush victory if Ridge could deliver them. He has a reputation as an able administrator and has been very tough on crime. However, he has also been pro-choice for his entire career, and his selection as running mate could cause issues with the Republican base in other regions.
a1cdcd437c569f58fdc214e77cf55b1a50716a7d.zh: 汤姆·里奇 是一个大摇摆州的受欢迎的州长。如果里奇能够交付的话，宾夕法尼亚州的23张选举人票几乎可以确保布什获胜。他作为一名能干的管理者而享有盛誉，并且对犯罪行为非常严厉。然而，他在整个职业生涯中也一直支持堕胎，选择他作为竞选伙伴可能会引起其他地区共和党基础的问题。

92b1a852c0ed5df80728e0ec3373d11ea7bfc8d4.source: Too big to fail is too big to exist. It's pathetic just how much our representatives have allowed themselves to be bought by financial institutions.
92b1a852c0ed5df80728e0ec3373d11ea7bfc8d4.zh: 大到不能倒，就大到不该存在。我们的民意代表竟能被金融机构收买到这种地步，真是可悲。

c160e785bc108a2c64098c6bcd1434d973f5028d.source: Total avoidance of the subject doesn’t do you any favors, although most Americans quickly move on from the situation.
c160e785bc108a2c64098c6bcd1434d973f5028d.zh: 完全回避这个话题，对你没有好处，不过，大多数美国人很快就不再关注这件事。

296fb8bfaeb319d8d0cc4baab26c4d59208e152b.source: Tough words, Hubert. Radical student organizations disavow you, but working-class and suburban Americans are appreciative towards your law and order stance.
296fb8bfaeb319d8d0cc4baab26c4d59208e152b.zh: 话够硬，休伯特。激进学生组织与你划清界限，但工薪阶层和郊区居民赞赏你维护法律与秩序的立场。

4e911a0584a76c619b34dfe6428f978eef8d2f6a.source: Trade is a bit of a hot potato issue within your party, and it's definitely a bit risky in this election to come out stringly on either side.
4e911a0584a76c619b34dfe6428f978eef8d2f6a.zh: 贸易是你们党内的一个棘手议题。在这次选举中，无论坚决站在哪一边，都有一定风险。

92d9df6077b580c5d25458ec430f220c96b2813e.source: True to form your answer is either mocked or taken for the Gospel. It all depends on the person who is asked.
92d9df6077b580c5d25458ec430f220c96b2813e.zh: 一如既往，你的回答不是被嘲笑，就是被奉为福音。全看你问的是谁。

5b34d826c1c01375b7754d4692267ffb7a361a85.source: True to form, you packed the streets of the Lower East Side and whipped the crowd into a frenzy. The
5b34d826c1c01375b7754d4692267ffb7a361a85.zh: 一如往常，你挤满了下东区的街道，让人群陷入疯狂。这

14e473a51f41502b61d666e7562644f348049b55.source: Truman's Triumphs: The 1948 Election and the Making of Postwar America
14e473a51f41502b61d666e7562644f348049b55.zh: 杜鲁门 的胜利：1948 年大选和战后美国的形成

020dcca1541c2e64ed2d4c64d0bda335624d68ce.source: Trump University is a liability. It's probably best to change the subject as quickly as possible.
020dcca1541c2e64ed2d4c64d0bda335624d68ce.zh: 特朗普大学是你的负担。最好还是尽快转移话题。

8243e087e6d616b8885a2b63d238b229b1d5e870.source: Trump University is a major liability for The Donald.
8243e087e6d616b8885a2b63d238b229b1d5e870.zh: 特朗普大学是“那位唐纳德”的一大包袱。

58ccf829bf8251550b838408d7e91ff76e022a29.source: Trump and his supporters are riotous. As he gives a speech, making massive promises for his next term, your team is despondent. Is this the end of moderate Democrats? Progressives are already yelling that this wouldn't have happened if Bernie had been the nominee. Others point to the age of you and Hillary and wonder if a younger, Obama-like candidate is what they need again. Speaking of him, Obama has called you and tried to cheer you up, but his heart wasn't it. Democrats have once again lost to a candidate many among them consider to be perhaps the worst President in history; you are certain to take the blame for this loss. Your political career is over, in any case. Maybe you can do a Masterclass where you read out your victory speech anyway?
58ccf829bf8251550b838408d7e91ff76e022a29.zh: 特朗普及其支持者欢腾不已。他正在发表演说，为下个任期许下宏大的承诺，你的团队却垂头丧气。温和派民主党人要就此落幕了吗？进步派已经大喊，要是提名人是伯尼，就不会发生这种事。还有人提起你和希拉里的年龄，琢磨是否需要再找一位奥巴马式的年轻候选人。说到他，奥巴马打来电话，试图让你振作，却也没什么底气。民主党又一次败给了一个他们当中许多人视为可能是史上最差总统的候选人，你必然要为这次失败承担责任。无论如何，你的政治生涯结束了。也许可以录一堂MasterClass课，把你的胜选演说念出来？

5727e8633c997eaed727a6227b88149f14ae5368.source: Trump attacks you mercilessly for ducking the debate, and many wonder if you seem perhaps a bit too passive for some voters.
5727e8633c997eaed727a6227b88149f14ae5368.zh: 特朗普毫不留情地攻击你逃避辩论，许多人怀疑，对一些选民来说，你是否显得过于被动。

6103c9f2a1a88834149005958875edd46d3de294.source: Trump is having serious problems with the female vote, and there's no reason you shouldn't twist the knife.
6103c9f2a1a88834149005958875edd46d3de294.zh: 特朗普在女性选民中遇到了严重问题，你没理由不再补上一刀。

c0bafd631e081453d732d0ccab91bb54143dd51f.source: Trump is lying if he says he opposed this war. There's no evidence or recorded statement of his opposition until well after the war began.
c0bafd631e081453d732d0ccab91bb54143dd51f.zh: 如果特朗普说他反对这场战争，那就是撒谎。战争开始很久之后，才有他反对战争的证据或录音表态。

255dbf5b80a83beeecc7e4b9ece3a26189274c49.source: Trump isn't popular. But people were a little started to hear such a negative nomination speech, in what is one of your most important moments in the spotlight.
255dbf5b80a83beeecc7e4b9ece3a26189274c49.zh: 特朗普不受欢迎。但在你最重要的聚光灯时刻之一，提名演说竟然如此负面，大家还是有点吃惊。

c2956436cc2c098cf9a6c467fe1d83373730f596.source: Trump will be hitting you pretty hard on your Iraq vote. The best you can do is muddle the conversation and move along to his weaknesses.
c2956436cc2c098cf9a6c467fe1d83373730f596.zh: 特朗普会抓住你的伊拉克战争投票狠狠攻击。你能做的，最好就是把讨论搅乱，再转向他的弱点。

990fd794f1a2e9b8fe165025a0c39aacd6ac8e7a.source: Trump's 2019 impeachment trial was closely tied the role your son, Hunter, took with a Ukranian energy company called Burisma. Was his appointment appropriate, given your son's background and skill set?
990fd794f1a2e9b8fe165025a0c39aacd6ac8e7a.zh: 特朗普2019年的弹劾审判，与你的儿子亨特在一家名为布里斯马的乌克兰能源公司任职密切相关。考虑到你儿子的背景和技能，他的任命是否恰当？

a0785c98adc0e8cedd1f5285d84b85bc54791485.source: Trump's comments dominate the airwaves for several days, and even bring some condemnation from notable conservatives.
a0785c98adc0e8cedd1f5285d84b85bc54791485.zh: 特朗普的言论连续几天占据广播电视节目，甚至招致一些知名保守派的谴责。

6fbb4d7975c73ef4c77877dee6350fbccbc50b1c.source: Trump's destructive trade war has set our relationship with China back 15 or 20 years, and that's ignoring the racist potshots he's taken at them over COVID. Our global economy depends on healthy trade and good relations between China and the outside world.
6fbb4d7975c73ef4c77877dee6350fbccbc50b1c.zh: 特朗普破坏性的贸易战，让我们与中国的关系倒退了十五至二十年；这还没算他围绕新冠疫情发动的种族主义攻击。全球经济依赖于健康的贸易，以及中国与外界的良好关系。

b3f87f5ea8e89496c39857b82a229fca0cbae0e3.source: Trump's prescriptions would devastate international trade, domestic investment, and most importantly, American employment. They would plunge us into a severe global recession.
b3f87f5ea8e89496c39857b82a229fca0cbae0e3.zh: 特朗普的办法会严重破坏国际贸易、国内投资，最重要的是，美国就业。他们会让我们陷入严重的全球衰退。

2f6130298047e1a80fe55e3ca358d37440100317.source: Trump's response to this shooting has been widely criticized by political commentators.
2f6130298047e1a80fe55e3ca358d37440100317.zh: 特朗普对这次枪击的回应，遭到政治评论人士的广泛批评。

01b1225ba9c8d08b5f283879c86caf38c55796a6.source: Trump's willingness to inflame racial tensions and spread disinformation about China and coronavirus is appalling. There is a direct relationship between his actions and the increase in attacks that we've seen.
01b1225ba9c8d08b5f283879c86caf38c55796a6.zh: 特朗普竟愿意激化种族紧张，散布关于中国和冠状病毒的虚假信息，令人震惊。他的行为与我们看到的袭击增加，有直接关系。

ae00e797535746b0f702ad7adf0f4fe472552608.source: Trying to appeal to New Yorkers may be a lost cause.
ae00e797535746b0f702ad7adf0f4fe472552608.zh: 试图争取纽约州选民，也许只是白费力气。

81607236ec2b79a7500678a80fb6121e71234a8a.source: Trying to drive a wedge between the two wings of the Democratic Party might not be a bad idea. Then again, they hate you far more than they hate each other.
81607236ec2b79a7500678a80fb6121e71234a8a.zh: 试图离间民主党两派，也许不是坏主意。不过，他们对你的恨，远远超过彼此之间的怨恨。

5a2726ef94242843747a3cc20ece8c5c0e94f411.source: Two of my old friends, Jimmy Carter and James Baker, came out with a great study on election integrity a few years ago, and it's time we put their recommendations into action. I think this would represent a reasonable compromise between making it easy to vote, while ensuring our elections are secure from fraud.
5a2726ef94242843747a3cc20ece8c5c0e94f411.zh: 几年前，我的两位老朋友吉米·卡特和詹姆斯·贝克，就选举公正性发表了一份出色研究，是时候落实他们的建议了。我认为，这能合理兼顾投票便利与防止选举舞弊。

11d439b8193a199e93262426a89c72dcda988495.source: Tyler has officially declared his withdrawal from the race. There are some whispers in the party about the jobs which may have come with that bargain, however.
11d439b8193a199e93262426a89c72dcda988495.zh: 泰勒已正式宣布退出比赛。然而，党内有一些关于这笔交易可能带来的工作机会的传言。

f86e7df2d1532240dd675cf9589cc76cb6671f4a.zh: 这是“那位唐纳德”的典型言辞。

d8c716e72f10da360fec163008e92b6d4b3af515.source: Ultimately, the popularity of Woodrow Wilson was just a little much to overcome.
d8c716e72f10da360fec163008e92b6d4b3af515.zh: 最终，伍德罗·威尔逊 的流行只是需要克服一点点。

b60de8ac5ef548c69ef65c3e6fd875fa7b7561ae.source: Umm... you remember the time you personally visited Solyndra, right? Pundits are immediately interpreting this response as an admission that your previous policies have failed.
b60de8ac5ef548c69ef65c3e6fd875fa7b7561ae.zh: 呃……你记得自己亲自参观索林德拉公司的事吧？评论员立刻把这番回答解读为，你承认此前的政策失败了。

29655ddb6b618faa127b8ff71a100f769aa4753e.zh: 难以置信！你赢得了1968年选举！

2be3fa890564039b5b8d14d93c06e0ee47be4d1d.source: Under my first term, we have accomplished more progressive reform than under decades of Republican rule, in spite of any promises which that party may be making now.
2be3fa890564039b5b8d14d93c06e0ee47be4d1d.zh: 在我的第一任期内，我们取得的进步主义改革成果，比共和党执政几十年都多；无论他们现在许下什么承诺，这个事实都不变。

c6305ff72d347860169a22caf2b645742e1b5b24.source: Under no circumstances should the sacred institution of marriage be undermined. The Defense of Marriage Act was passed specifially to address this issue.
c6305ff72d347860169a22caf2b645742e1b5b24.zh: 在任何情况下，都不应该破坏神圣的婚姻制度。《婚姻保护法》正是为解决这个问题而通过的。

f066585e70753b94bda9ce74a29f287f2291cc11.source: Under no circumstances would the United States consider that as a course of action.
f066585e70753b94bda9ce74a29f287f2291cc11.zh: 美国在任何情况下都不会考虑采取这种做法。

9a5b5b95636701e17fc7320ab73a0dc5da9f0375.source: Undoing what's left of the New Deal is not a mainstream position by this point.
9a5b5b95636701e17fc7320ab73a0dc5da9f0375.zh: 到了这个时候，推翻新政剩余措施已经不是主流立场。

71ebdc4149ae873b6dbc1e2c7aada1489eb4ed7b.source: Unfortunately Joe Biden is so senile, he's probably meeting with them to get this marching orders. He's really just the Crazy Bernie and Commie Liz candidate when you get right down to it.
71ebdc4149ae873b6dbc1e2c7aada1489eb4ed7b.zh: 不幸的是，乔·拜登老糊涂了，他与那些人会面，大概是去领命令。说到底，他其实只是“疯狂伯尼”和“共产主义莉兹”的候选人。

634e81a3fc3e02a51e9fb7f9e3d38c4a91ad9281.source: Unfortunately for you, most Democrats agree that we should use a combination of revenue increases as well as spending cuts to balance the budget.
634e81a3fc3e02a51e9fb7f9e3d38c4a91ad9281.zh: 对你不利的是，多数民主党人认同，平衡预算应该既增加收入，又削减开支。

ee4d48b9f7f315991c114828c33d1257d471df71.source: Unfortunately the Treasury was bankrupt. I do think that Cleveland approached this in the usual heavy-handed, abrasive manner, but he was absolutely in the right. This whole episode demonstrates the folly of silver coinage.
ee4d48b9f7f315991c114828c33d1257d471df71.zh: 遗憾的是，国库已经破产。我确实认为，克利夫兰处理此事时，一如既往地强硬而粗暴，但他完全做对了。这整件事证明，白银铸币有多愚蠢。

fb2f8daeda09c58a39b6b14319340180656ad701.source: Unfortunately there's not much you can do with this awkward situation. But you've spoken out enough for Civil Rights that this shouldn't hurt you too much...
fb2f8daeda09c58a39b6b14319340180656ad701.zh: 不幸的是，面对这个尴尬局面，你能做的不多。不过，你为民权说过足够多的话，应该不会受到太大损害……

23a46f19a478c3ea4702c59efd6e1041e5bdb5c0.source: Unfortunately these cuts were pretty limited. I would prefer larger tax cuts and a reduction in government spending.
23a46f19a478c3ea4702c59efd6e1041e5bdb5c0.zh: 不幸的是，这些减税相当有限。我更希望大幅减税，并削减政府支出。

0d8446845200f91cec09624a51a8074925d8471c.source: Unfortunately, Clinton seemed to get the best of you on a number of points during the debates.
0d8446845200f91cec09624a51a8074925d8471c.zh: 遗憾的是，在辩论的好几个问题上，克林顿似乎都胜过了你。

3f304b0bda248a4128726d1000e5795fcacf8061.source: Unfortunately, Dukakis performed pretty well in these debates, and you seemed to miss a beat on a couple occassions.
3f304b0bda248a4128726d1000e5795fcacf8061.zh: 遗憾的是，杜卡基斯在辩论中表现相当不错，而你有几次似乎慢了半拍。

c9deac7258fb3fbd441fd5c00a4740a0982d0bf0.source: Unfortunately, Ford performed pretty well in these debates. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
c9deac7258fb3fbd441fd5c00a4740a0982d0bf0.zh: 不幸的是，福特在这些辩论中的表现相当不错。而且，随着选举临近，经济正在改善，选民也开始更仔细地审视局势……

c199b5420f3bd8f22534c2895857b695725bd6f5.source: Unfortunately, Humphrey absolutely trounced you in the debate you agreed to have. Your gamble did not pay off.
c199b5420f3bd8f22534c2895857b695725bd6f5.zh: 不幸的是，在你同意参加的那场辩论中，汉弗莱把你打得落花流水。你的冒险没有得到回报。

23cf6f6349b1247d8511eeacaa52cec167a66742.source: Unfortunately, an ill-timed health issue has cost you several days of appearances during a critical part of the campaign.
23cf6f6349b1247d8511eeacaa52cec167a66742.zh: 不幸的是，在竞选关键阶段，一次来得不是时候的健康问题，让你缺席了好几天的活动。

ed51e3b008efb7c40266cd738c0ae1df73ff162d.source: Unfortunately, coal is one of the dirtiest forms of energy in existence. I don't see how we can continue to rely on it for the majority of America's energy needs.
ed51e3b008efb7c40266cd738c0ae1df73ff162d.zh: 遗憾的是，煤炭是现有能源中污染最严重的种类之一。我看不出，我们怎能继续依靠它满足美国大部分能源需求。

4423e34d8f85f340f2cfc69b1fa118e4cac7c5bd.source: Unfortunately, for whatever reason, you just weren't on your game in these debates. Even liberal pundits are having a hard time explaining it.
4423e34d8f85f340f2cfc69b1fa118e4cac7c5bd.zh: 遗憾的是，不知为什么，你在这些辩论中就是不在状态。连自由派评论员都很难解释。

c226d7122faa595459aee25d84b358fa6c1ebb93.source: Unfortunately, the economics of farming cannot support the number of farmers who were borrowing money in the early 1980s.
c226d7122faa595459aee25d84b358fa6c1ebb93.zh: 遗憾的是，农业的经济条件无法维持20世纪80年代初举债经营的那么多农民。

e332620f9b5646e34b695cbd419299aea117dbdc.source: Unfortunately, the word “bestiality” is making some voters question the ugliness of this campaign. Advisors agree that you should pump the brakes on your attacks for the time being.
e332620f9b5646e34b695cbd419299aea117dbdc.zh: 遗憾的是，“兽交”一词让一些选民开始质疑这场竞选的丑陋程度。顾问一致认为，你应该暂时收敛攻击。

840ac9afa61153d149dc3b15f9e8a8c66c179ea7.source: Unfortunately, this move backfired. You just don't look all that imposing when you're riding in a tank. Republicans are producing television commercials with the picture.
840ac9afa61153d149dc3b15f9e8a8c66c179ea7.zh: 可惜，这招适得其反。你坐在坦克里，看起来实在没什么威风。共和党人正拿这张照片制作电视广告。

0c860b0555363dabd7b6b138873f424a83c56f72.source: Unfortunately, this position alienates you with moderates in the current high-crime environment.
0c860b0555363dabd7b6b138873f424a83c56f72.zh: 在当前犯罪高发的环境中，这一立场会让温和派疏远你。

6858e47c529fdc2072a40ac188c1a79a3cc0060b.source: Unfortunately, this probably puts South Carolina out of reach for your campaign.
6858e47c529fdc2072a40ac188c1a79a3cc0060b.zh: 遗憾的是，这很可能让你的阵营失去拿下南卡罗来纳州的机会。

7fe64300a0b27c80cf5950c07a10a2b5b0993133.source: Unfortunately, we are limited in what we can reasonably do in Syria. I support the creation of a safe zone in Syria, for opponents of ISIS and the Assad regime, that we will defend and provide aid to. Hopefully this can limit the humanitarian damage and refugee flows.
7fe64300a0b27c80cf5950c07a10a2b5b0993133.zh: 不幸的是，我们在叙利亚能够合理采取的行动有限。我支持在叙利亚设立安全区，供反对“伊斯兰国”和阿萨德政权的人使用，由我们保护并提供援助。希望这能减少人道灾难和难民外流。

0ad7e587d11e16cf84c22f9cd5da5b77ad587438.source: Unfortunately, you've been calling this investigation spurious and politically-motivated for so long, that it's a little hard to square with an apology now.
0ad7e587d11e16cf84c22f9cd5da5b77ad587438.zh: 遗憾的是，你把这项调查说成虚假、出于政治动机，已经说了那么久；现在道歉，多少有点难以自圆其说。

5b3b04930515f90eeda0b3f4aa7b94c5a87a5788.source: Unfortunately, your decision to keep campaigning has really backfired. Your health issue has gotten worse, forcing you to take a significant break from the campaign in October.
5b3b04930515f90eeda0b3f4aa7b94c5a87a5788.zh: 不幸的是，坚持竞选的决定严重适得其反。你的健康问题加重了，迫使你在十月长时间暂停竞选。

5892382e3676cbabc1bcf03586954f8bf76993a0.source: Unions and working-class voters adore your answer, but liberal environmentalists see it as toothless.
5892382e3676cbabc1bcf03586954f8bf76993a0.zh: 工会和工薪阶层选民喜欢你的回答，但自由派环保人士认为它没有力度。

6cce263a7322020b2c71d0908d7c6a6837869f3e.source: Unions have been eviscerated by decades of outsourcing. Public unions are a necessary bulwark of the middle class and should have every right to bargain for fair wages and benefits.
6cce263a7322020b2c71d0908d7c6a6837869f3e.zh: 几十年的外包，让工会遭受重创。公共部门工会是中产阶级不可缺少的堡垒，完全应该有权争取公平的工资与福利。

24477e965df869a7de5e438771139340910f279f.source: Uniting your coalition is the first step towards getting yourself back into the race.
24477e965df869a7de5e438771139340910f279f.zh: 团结你的支持者联盟，是重返竞争的第一步。

b26d91864d3a94d0fa9bd04f1dc2f90cdb51052c.source: Unlike George Bush, I have led the executive branch of government. I will make Massachusetts a centerpiece of my campaign.
b26d91864d3a94d0fa9bd04f1dc2f90cdb51052c.zh: 与乔治·布什不同，我曾领导政府的行政部门。我会把马萨诸塞州作为竞选的核心主题。

c49bcf8fed3081617acce1b82836f0e117fda43c.source: Voters are talking about Carter's poor judgment in doing a Playboy interview -- and about your weird, awkward attempt to pile on...
c49bcf8fed3081617acce1b82836f0e117fda43c.zh: 选民在议论卡特接受《花花公子》采访的糟糕判断，也在议论你趁机追打时那种奇怪、尴尬的表现……

6f399eefa04a5701203691ae236bc47309fa9394.source: Voters do want to hear about your character. Don't downplay it.
6f399eefa04a5701203691ae236bc47309fa9394.zh: 选民确实想了解你的品格。别淡化它。

5648ee4f1f2ad9282a3996ce5e84d7d98d4c144b.source: Voters don't care much what you do, as long as there are no more gas shortages and long lines at the pump.
5648ee4f1f2ad9282a3996ce5e84d7d98d4c144b.zh: 只要不再缺油、加油站前不再排长队，选民并不太在意你具体怎么做。

2ab84278ab45312a73d48c2320504e691f9b1ec0.source: Voters respond to your background and upbringing. Especially in comparison to that of Bush.
2ab84278ab45312a73d48c2320504e691f9b1ec0.zh: 选民认可你的出身和成长经历，尤其是拿它与布什的经历比较时。

424d67b91a0b6642741e291b1277b09df443ffe0.source: Voters want honesty in government, but this message sounds a little strident.
424d67b91a0b6642741e291b1277b09df443ffe0.zh: 选民希望政府诚实，但这个讯息听起来有点咄咄逼人。

d16906f8d7ca1bb8acb2454f49fff8e776a4fa10.source: Voters want honesty in government, but this message sounds a little strident. It is also offensive to the Johnson bloc of the party.
d16906f8d7ca1bb8acb2454f49fff8e776a4fa10.zh: 选民希望政府诚实，但这个讯息听起来有点咄咄逼人，也冒犯了党内的约翰逊阵营。

113a7eae8d019a7df6a234417dacbbc4de46bd0a.source: Voters want more than just gloating with hindsight.
113a7eae8d019a7df6a234417dacbbc4de46bd0a.zh: 选民要的可不只是事后洋洋得意。

abbfa2fda609a7a52a35d4bb8828a9af1b52a9f1.source: Voters, particularly doves, notice your clear anti-war stance. Unfortunately, Lyndon does sabotage you, specifically in Texas.
abbfa2fda609a7a52a35d4bb8828a9af1b52a9f1.zh: 选民，尤其是鸽派，注意到了你明确的反战立场。不幸的是，林登确实在拆你的台，尤其是在得克萨斯州。

2f81778b77a01e4929caaa283d831b95e1f483c5.source: Wallace hopes to bring an end to Civil Rights and desegregation.
2f81778b77a01e4929caaa283d831b95e1f483c5.zh: 华莱士希望终结民权政策和废除种族隔离的进程。

5a15273fd804566ecb95dcd73b7b608781e6f3c2.source: Wallace is trying to throw the election to Nixon. How anyone could believe he's still a Democrat is beyond me.
5a15273fd804566ecb95dcd73b7b608781e6f3c2.zh: 华莱士想把选举送给尼克松。怎么还会有人相信他仍是个民主党人，我实在无法理解。

59d2df9855b23aed1d5b9e4eedb313753f6a00c6.source: Wallace will simply try to carry as many Southern states as he can to increase the odds of a deadlock.
59d2df9855b23aed1d5b9e4eedb313753f6a00c6.zh: 华莱士 将简单地尝试控制尽可能多的南部各州，以增加陷入僵局的可能性。

0ef3dbc34e840bdd9f517e4e318c2605601e699c.source: Wallace's machinations have succeeded. The election will go to the House of Representatives where the Democrats hold a clear majority.
0ef3dbc34e840bdd9f517e4e318c2605601e699c.zh: 华莱士的阴谋得逞了。选举将在众议院进行，民主党在众议院占据绝对多数席位。

a484d300e96381efa7754136f2ff6a2b9cef5603.source: Walter Mondale has served his home state of Minnesota well, and he is the best man for the job.
a484d300e96381efa7754136f2ff6a2b9cef5603.zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔为家乡明尼苏达州尽心服务，是担任这个职位的最佳人选。

fda0114b22635f12fbf42a40822efc13435efef8.source: Walter Mondale is a Senator from Minnesota, a protege of Hubert H. Humphrey, and a key figure for mainstream Democrats. He would help unite the party after a competitive primary, and could help greatly in his home state. Mondale is also a good team player and very eager to help on the campaign.
fda0114b22635f12fbf42a40822efc13435efef8.zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔 是来自 明尼苏达州 的参议员，休伯特·H.·汉弗莱 的门生，也是主流民主党的关键人物。在竞争激烈的初选后，他将帮助团结该党，并且可以在他的家乡发挥巨大作用。 蒙代尔 也是一位优秀的团队合作者，非常渴望在竞选活动中提供帮助。

849cb0e8ef4f0db00f75a6b1f5a55a579b4fa195.source: Walter Mondale is a committed liberal and a true friend of Hubert H. Humphrey. He is the kind of man who all Democrats can get behind.
849cb0e8ef4f0db00f75a6b1f5a55a579b4fa195.zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔是一位坚定的自由派，也是休伯特·H·汉弗莱的真正朋友。他是所有民主党人都能支持的人。

2593551eb6068ddeaa51541b3b25e5951e9c32b3.source: Walter Mondale is a popular choice among mainstream Democrats.
2593551eb6068ddeaa51541b3b25e5951e9c32b3.zh: 沃尔特·蒙代尔是主流民主党人欢迎的选择。

63e2961ff51a8b7f71f3ed5942a8ea8050567016.source: Until green energy technologies are ready to shoulder the load, we need help from oil and fracking.
63e2961ff51a8b7f71f3ed5942a8ea8050567016.zh: 在绿色能源技术准备好承担重任之前，我们还需要石油和水力压裂的帮助。

eeb503fc8e932d2d5809e80300fae475cd3059a1.source: Until you threw in the China comment, this sounded like a relatively restrained opening statement for you.
eeb503fc8e932d2d5809e80300fae475cd3059a1.zh: 在你加上那句关于中国的话之前，这听起来还算是你相对克制的开场声明。

9a59b689e910186765bc711cf9fffc16def60a02.source: Urban Democrats are alarmed by your positive support for Prohibition.
9a59b689e910186765bc711cf9fffc16def60a02.zh: 你明确支持禁酒，让城市里的民主党人感到不安。

5df3ff56903b2e8f2ecac3891675bf97278acb7f.source: Val Demings is a Congresswoman and former police chief from Florida. She could allow Biden to select a black running mate with more moderate credentials than some of the other choices. However, she has had a limited national profile and may be a disappointment to the more progressive wing of the party.
5df3ff56903b2e8f2ecac3891675bf97278acb7f.zh: 瓦尔·戴明斯 是来自 佛罗里达州 的国会女议员和前警察局长。她可以允许拜登选择一位比其他一些选择具有更温和资历的黑人竞选伙伴。然而，她在全国范围内的形象有限，可能会让党内进步派感到失望。

558566c2caf2468b444aa8c713580aae0eefdb3e.source: Val Demings is a woman with many years of leadership experience, who can appeal to both Democratic and independent voters. I think she is a great choice for Vice President.
558566c2caf2468b444aa8c713580aae0eefdb3e.zh: 瓦尔·戴明斯是一位拥有多年领导经验的女性，既能吸引民主党选民，也能吸引独立选民。我认为，她是非常好的副总统人选。

12efa01af338f8a7791a5f876f7fb54620806441.source: Vermont and Indiana are key states for any Republican to win. Would you like to put campaign efforts into winning these states?
12efa01af338f8a7791a5f876f7fb54620806441.zh: 佛蒙特州和印第安纳州，都是共和党人争取胜利的关键州。你想投入竞选力量，拿下这两个州吗？

218f3fbfc66c88d82a92ca1ab1c47d320c3db704.source: Very liberal of you. You’ve won the absolute loyalty of the Negro community, and also lost many white voters. But you’ve exchanged them equally, so polls haven’t moved.
218f3fbfc66c88d82a92ca1ab1c47d320c3db704.zh: 你可真是个自由派。你赢得了黑人社区的绝对忠诚，也失去了许多白人选民。两者相互抵消，民调因此没有变化。

0b399e42d3490d1718ee670559ecc034e087e4ac.source: Veto it. This law goes too far, and besides, we won't have a chance without the support of labor.
0b399e42d3490d1718ee670559ecc034e087e4ac.zh: 否决。这部法律走得太远了；何况没有劳工支持，我们根本没有胜算。

15e66b7ddf012e6a028c17517e84320afe1b3d27.source: Victory in the Syrian Civil War for moderate rebel forces is an impossibility. We need to use our strength to negotiate a peace settlement that will protect their interests and lives, and get our troops out.
15e66b7ddf012e6a028c17517e84320afe1b3d27.zh: 温和派反对武装不可能赢得叙利亚内战。我们需要运用自己的实力，谈成一项和平协议，保护他们的利益和生命，并撤出我们的部队。

e6a39fd1a737c8499bf5547c0f72e9e0a53140b3.source: Vietnam is over, and détente with the Soviet Union has reduced the need for massive defense expenditures. I believe that any attempt to reduce our deficit should include defense cuts.
e6a39fd1a737c8499bf5547c0f72e9e0a53140b3.zh: 越南战争已经结束，与苏联缓和关系也降低了巨额国防支出的必要性。我认为，任何削减赤字的努力，都应包括削减国防开支。

1f6dbef9068abd5c0992890b8f2b95fbecdc845f.zh: 弗吉尼亚州和北卡罗来纳州

e0dbb42ce6e32fd71fbefbafa3d7253bf0f91e9e.source: We all believe in God. I am just as Christian as Mr. Bryan. No more. No less.
e0dbb42ce6e32fd71fbefbafa3d7253bf0f91e9e.zh: 我们都信上帝。我和布赖恩先生一样，都是基督徒，不多也不少。

71c9f082ce94e2616ca56bffa48849e9b051ed96.source: We all have different opinions about the Adamson Act, and I don't propose to make it a big part of my campaign speech.
71c9f082ce94e2616ca56bffa48849e9b051ed96.zh: 我们对《亚当森法》各有看法，我不打算让它成为竞选演说的重要内容。

6f4f7fbfa68b552d792a04310f0ac003d4bbfdb4.source: We all have our own opinions on this practice, but I think the current system is the one that we should stay with. The individual states should be allowed to legislate on abortion as they so please.
6f4f7fbfa68b552d792a04310f0ac003d4bbfdb4.zh: 对这种做法，人人都有自己的看法，但我认为应维持现行制度。各州应有权按自己的意愿制定堕胎法律。

ef982745ee748c40b59f8e656a239f66fd967a38.source: We all know who REALLY won the election, though, don't we? You no doubt will be on Biden's case from now until the end of his term, plotting your epic comeback. Your base is still ravenous as ever, and you might need to throw them a bone, as, after all, you've said about mail-ins and whatnot, they are angered at your loss. You're about to give a speech in Washington DC, near the capitol buildings. Let them know what you think about this election, then they can 'peacefully and patriotically' give that traitor Mike Pence a lesson.
ef982745ee748c40b59f8e656a239f66fd967a38.zh: 不过，我们都知道谁才真正赢得了选举，不是吗？从现在直到拜登任期结束，你肯定都会紧盯着他，谋划自己惊人的回归。你的基本盘仍然像以往一样渴望战斗，也许得给他们点东西。毕竟，你说了那么多关于邮寄选票之类的话，他们对你的败选非常愤怒。你即将在华盛顿特区、国会建筑附近发表演说。让他们知道你怎么看这场选举，然后他们就能“和平而爱国地”给那个叛徒迈克·彭斯一个教训。

91cb292c298a34b098c2615c115046bf61c2223f.source: We all made mistakes when we were younger. I'm no exception.
91cb292c298a34b098c2615c115046bf61c2223f.zh: 年轻时，我们都犯过错。我也不例外。

b50ca75b8e62433f67bba40bc715873c0ef5a007.source: We all say things in the heat of the moment that we might not mean later. You do it, I do it, Hillary Clinton has done it thousands of times. I was passionate about winning and I make no apologies.
b50ca75b8e62433f67bba40bc715873c0ef5a007.zh: 我们都可能在情绪激动时说出事后并不认同的话。你会，我会，希拉里·克林顿干过成千上万次。我当时一心要赢，绝不道歉。

29119780bf8e614842df0bd6686fc13fcdd3657d.source: We almost had immigration reform. A beautiful deal, except that some radical Democrats wouldn't agree to the border security. But I think they'll see the light once they lose this fall.
29119780bf8e614842df0bd6686fc13fcdd3657d.zh: 我们差点就通过移民改革了。那本来是一项很棒的协议，只可惜有些激进的民主党人不肯接受边境安全措施。不过，我想他们今年秋天输掉选举后就会醒悟了。

5d392cc6c28bff0afa4736e427e1fdde9e688412.source: We already have too many grounds for the federal government to interfere in the economy. This would add another new set of regulations that we can't afford.
5d392cc6c28bff0afa4736e427e1fdde9e688412.zh: 联邦政府干预经济的理由已经太多了。这会再增添一套我们负担不起的监管规定。

b5a4074bab7c47dd2c473b6a1b1d6dd20d8b9251.source: We appreciate Senator Sanders and his support. But it's important to note that I won the nomination by a lot. I will be cordial but make few promises.
b5a4074bab7c47dd2c473b6a1b1d6dd20d8b9251.zh: 我们感谢桑德斯参议员及其支持。但必须指出，我以很大优势赢得了提名。我会态度友好，却少作承诺。

f507e8eb67dc5e3b6b065fe9a4c12d08522dda2d.source: We are always mindful of the effect that these strikes may have on the local population. We only use them as a last resort, when targeting extremely dangerous individuals to the security of the United States.
f507e8eb67dc5e3b6b065fe9a4c12d08522dda2d.zh: 我们始终注意这些打击对当地民众的影响。只有在万不得已时，针对对美国安全极其危险的人物，我们才会使用这种手段。

22f9f5c0359e96f173f3484c7db8399f4e716a9e.source: Want to know who's at fault for this Civil Rights Act? It's Hubert Horatio Humphrey.
22f9f5c0359e96f173f3484c7db8399f4e716a9e.zh: 想知道这项《民权法案》该怪谁吗？就是休伯特·霍雷肖·汉弗莱。

245ac21b828318e71aeef899b0fd3be8b49af23b.source: War rages in Europe, while Woodrow Wilson has used his first term to push a number of progressive laws, such as the income tax and Federal Reserve. Charles Evans Hughes has resigned from the Supreme Court to unite his party and deny a second term.
245ac21b828318e71aeef899b0fd3be8b49af23b.zh: 欧洲战火正烈，伍德罗·威尔逊在首个任期内推动了所得税、联邦储备体系等多项进步主义立法。查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯已辞去最高法院大法官职务，试图团结本党，阻止威尔逊连任。

dfacf09dde73f344e7c798ddcdf26546c9a4ebbd.source: Was it an appropriate intervention of the federal government to attach U.S. mail cars to Pullman trains during the strike in 1894? (Thereby making it a federal crime to interfere with the passage of these cars)
dfacf09dde73f344e7c798ddcdf26546c9a4ebbd.zh: 1894年罢工期间，联邦政府把美国邮政车厢挂接在普尔曼列车上，以此介入罢工，是否恰当？（这使妨碍这些车厢通行成为联邦犯罪。）

19d03f3c1c600f241b4e5b692b808162e00634b6.source: Was there really a bargain (a “Corrupt Bargain” to many) between yourself and John Quincy Adams which elevated him to the Presidency in 1825?
19d03f3c1c600f241b4e5b692b808162e00634b6.zh: 你与约翰·昆西·亚当斯之间，是否真的达成了一项让他在1825年当上总统的交易——也就是许多人所说的“腐败交易”？

6a7e633c773bc73986537cb78df6b9d89a8255aa.source: Wasteful programs? Needless to say, the Democratic party is furious and angry calls fill up your offices.
6a7e633c773bc73986537cb78df6b9d89a8255aa.zh: 浪费性项目？不必说，民主党怒不可遏，你的办公室里充斥着愤怒的来电。

ea88355777879a3e9eb0c6fa628dfd8649384aaa.source: Way to avoid giving a response. This question is a landmine.
ea88355777879a3e9eb0c6fa628dfd8649384aaa.zh: 好一招回避回答。这道问题是个雷区。

0b98bb0381113c885d6ac7e006c1f0c39178b26f.source: Way to flex foreign policy. With rumors of ongoing peace talks, this might legitimately become reality. You’ve inspired hope amongst the American people with your brave, idealistic stance.
0b98bb0381113c885d6ac7e006c1f0c39178b26f.zh: 你这番外交表态颇有气势。既然传闻和平谈判正在进行，这个主张真有可能实现。你勇敢而理想主义的立场，让美国人民燃起希望。

3c7dd6e69a14b12ccca54b059da9e9fcc6cb8ec3.source: Way to protest your innocence. But New York, and the rest of the Union, get the message anyhow.
3c7dd6e69a14b12ccca54b059da9e9fcc6cb8ec3.zh: 你倒是很卖力地声明自己清白。不过，纽约和联邦其他地方的人，还是领会到了那个意思。

8a7b4293df851d4b5cf2a722aa278dcf581d9e1d.source: Way to remind the American people about the ineffectual Congress we have.
8a7b4293df851d4b5cf2a722aa278dcf581d9e1d.zh: 好样的，又让美国人民想起了我们这个无所作为的国会。

d5180f095de6e4d85fa030b0bcad369426600cfe.source: Way to stand by your proposals.
d5180f095de6e4d85fa030b0bcad369426600cfe.zh: 好样的，坚持了自己的提案。

d2b442ae26bf6ed4855ee661a1657ee9f35af892.source: Way to stick up for your principles and your policies.
d2b442ae26bf6ed4855ee661a1657ee9f35af892.zh: 好样的，就该捍卫自己的原则和政策。

9a0909576112a2aab54ed1c8a6608171bee98f62.source: We absolutely need a federal program for this purpose. The Bible says that we must love all people -- even those who have been cast aside by our Darwinian industrial machinery.
9a0909576112a2aab54ed1c8a6608171bee98f62.zh: 我们绝对需要一个联邦计划来做这件事。《圣经》教导我们，应当爱所有人——包括那些被我们达尔文式的工业机器淘汰的人。

4a5e7359c97f0f8005dc675f758e464c1f8e4fff.source: We absolutely need laws prohibiting discrimination, and we need to go the extra mile in ensuring equal opportunity for women and minorities. Kennedy and Johnson's executive orders relating to federal hiring do just that.
4a5e7359c97f0f8005dc675f758e464c1f8e4fff.zh: 我们绝对需要禁止歧视的法律，也必须付出更多努力，确保妇女和少数族裔享有平等机会。肯尼迪和约翰逊有关联邦招聘的行政命令，正是在做这件事。

4f5d35501d8d7e4be416a196371a581ebc747af5.source: We accept any European who is able to read and write. America will always serve as a place where the oppressed masses can find a new hope.
4f5d35501d8d7e4be416a196371a581ebc747af5.zh: 只要具备读写能力，欧洲人我们都接受。美国将永远为受压迫的民众提供一个寻找新希望的地方。

c0c024a1d44ecbba1f41354d7a421409b48aa236.source: We are clearly overcrowding our urban areas at the moment. At the very least, we can expand the federal highway system to make more areas accessible to families and developers.
c0c024a1d44ecbba1f41354d7a421409b48aa236.zh: 眼下，城市地区显然过于拥挤。至少我们可以扩大联邦公路系统，让家庭和开发商能够进入更多地区。

c71ac258993e923e4aefcd48c7070cfbb3caa142.source: We are following the right course in Iraq. We must enforce our agreement to prevent Saddam from acquiring weapons of mass destruction. Saddam is allowing the sanctions to harm his people for his own selfish purposes.
c71ac258993e923e4aefcd48c7070cfbb3caa142.zh: 我们对伊拉克采取的路线是正确的。我们必须执行防止萨达姆取得大规模杀伤性武器的协议。萨达姆为了自己的私利，任由制裁伤害本国人民。

255052f0796935586101f18c4ca54660d7ed4795.source: We are going to - wait. Did you really get THAT many electoral votes? Good job... I guess? I must say though, for all of your complaints of Democratic fraud, your margin here really is a bit
255052f0796935586101f18c4ca54660d7ed4795.zh: 我们要 - 等待。你真的得到那么多选举人票吗？干得好……我猜？但我必须说，对于你们对民主党欺诈的所有抱怨，你们这里的利润确实有点

72ddb752b95f0a74aab767b6643fba3144526dc2.source: We are going to Make America Great Again... again! Throw away your prepared remarks accusing the Democrats of fraud, because you're heading back for a second term - and it's a LANDSLIDE! I don't think anyone has won by as much as you have tonight. Nobody thought that anybody could ever win by more than you did in 2016, but you've definitely proved the liberal media wrong. The American people have vindicated your agenda and style of politics - surely the fake news media can see that now? Sleepy Joe will probably go to sleep forever after seeing the landslide you've achieved. Congress is comfortably in Republican hands, and a world of options is open to you!
72ddb752b95f0a74aab767b6643fba3144526dc2.zh: 我们要让美国再次伟大……再来一次！把准备好指控民主党舞弊的演说稿扔掉吧，你即将迎来第二个任期，而且是压倒性胜利！我想，今晚从没有人赢得像你这么多。没人觉得，谁还能比你2016年赢得更多，但你确实证明了自由派媒体是错的。美国人民肯定了你的议程和政治风格——假新闻媒体现在总该看明白了吧？瞌睡乔看到你如此大胜，也许就要永远睡下去了。共和党稳稳掌控国会，你面前有无数选择！

8a1bc527193408224817ac40d8ade0533dc455e4.source: We are going to Make America Great Again... again! Throw away your prepared remarks accusing the Democrats of fraud, because you're heading back for a second term! Democrats are fuming, Sleepy Joe is surely crying! With a somewhat comfortable margin of victory, you can surely tell your followers all about the massive landslide you've achieved. Nate Silver and those fake news analysts are going to have a real hard time explaining THIS one.
8a1bc527193408224817ac40d8ade0533dc455e4.zh: 我们要去 让美国再次伟大... 再次！扔掉你准备好的指责民主党欺诈的言论吧，因为你要回去参加第二个任期了！民主党人很生气，瞌睡乔肯定在哭！凭借一定的胜利优势，您肯定可以告诉您的追随者您所取得的巨大压倒性胜利。内特·西尔弗和那些假新闻分析师将很难解释这一点。

c5ec511de2abfae620702f7e99036f341e316264.source: We are going to Make America Great Again... again! Throw away your prepared remarks accusing the Democrats of fraud, because you're heading back for a second term! The RINOs who doubted you will surely be forced to go along with you now. Fake-News Romney, Screechy Collins, all of them are unhappily congratulating you. With your margin of victory, Republicans have just missed out on taking the House, and will probably keep the Senate, dependent on a runoff election in Georgia.
c5ec511de2abfae620702f7e99036f341e316264.zh: 我们要让美国再次伟大……再来一次！把准备好指控民主党舞弊的演说稿扔掉吧，你即将迎来第二个任期！那些怀疑你的“名义上的共和党人”，现在肯定不得不跟随你。假新闻罗姆尼、尖叫的柯林斯，他们都不情不愿地向你祝贺。凭借你的优势，共和党只差一点就夺回众议院，也很可能保住参议院，具体取决于佐治亚州的一场决选。

d429f6ed6e382c1942f88d31cf284124f5b97641.source: We are going to have a team of fantastic individuals looking into this issue from the first day I am President. And I would hate for it... but we wouldn't take a Muslim ban off the table.
d429f6ed6e382c1942f88d31cf284124f5b97641.zh: 从我担任总统的第一天起，就会有一支出色的团队研究这个问题。我也不愿意走到那一步……但我们不会排除穆斯林入境禁令这个选项。

ddc1eb8e72f398da3c30e09eeec6d069a3c2d0ef.source: We are keeping the unemployment rate artificially depressed with unsound fiscal and monetary policies. In the long-run, this will lead to a poor economy and higher unemployment.
ddc1eb8e72f398da3c30e09eeec6d069a3c2d0ef.zh: 我们正在用不健全的财政和货币政策，人为压低失业率。长远来看，这会损害经济，让失业率上升。

30530bf88f0378ed83a4ecb2911a0d53ce4f47cd.source: We are on the right track economically. We can't deny that there was a recession in 1958, but the recovery has been strong and 1960 will see a very high rate of growth in this country.
30530bf88f0378ed83a4ecb2911a0d53ce4f47cd.zh: 我们的经济方向是正确的。不能否认1958年发生了衰退，但复苏势头强劲，1960年本国将实现很高的增长率。

94b126d85af773082199d5ea584830bcc29639b9.source: We are praying for a full recovery, but we've seen time after time how Trump has disregarded the medical advice on masking and social distancing.
94b126d85af773082199d5ea584830bcc29639b9.zh: 我们为他完全康复祈祷，但也一再看到，特朗普无视戴口罩和保持社交距离的医学建议。

58eda981b1ecc449d0b40bb445d66b11506b0b7e.source: We are running a 45-state strategy. I want our victory and repudiation of the silver Democrats to be as large as possible.
58eda981b1ecc449d0b40bb445d66b11506b0b7e.zh: 我们要在全部45个州开展竞选。我希望这场胜利越大越好，让支持自由铸银的民主党人遭到尽可能彻底的否定。

7947bad5b24e1f741e5e8390252799ea0ac6eeb2.source: We are the Jacksonian Party, and there is no place in our platform for federal spending on such boondoggles.
7947bad5b24e1f741e5e8390252799ea0ac6eeb2.zh: 我们是杰克逊主义政党，纲领中不容联邦政府在这种劳民伤财的工程上花钱。

b4139f4a4ce0afb13a5256536d246b915f840034.source: We are the greatest nation on earth and we cannot rest until every citizen has an opportunity to share in that prosperity.
b4139f4a4ce0afb13a5256536d246b915f840034.zh: 我们是世界上最伟大的国家。在每个公民都有机会分享这份繁荣之前，我们不能停下脚步。

c6727ff3e3d9371836ef5487e8febbc636a11952.source: We are the only thing standing between the world and global domination by the Soviets. I'm prepared to take any measure to prevent the advance of Communism.
c6727ff3e3d9371836ef5487e8febbc636a11952.zh: 阻挡苏联统治全球的，只有我们。我准备采取任何措施，阻止共产主义的扩张。

13939e5ddc392cb6bc9da93c555a42b9bd473afe.source: We barely defeated Ronald Reagan to win our nomination in the first place. We should take conservative positions and make sure we shore up our support in that area.
13939e5ddc392cb6bc9da93c555a42b9bd473afe.zh: 我们当初只是勉强击败罗纳德·里根，才赢得提名。我们应采取保守立场，确保巩固这方面的支持。

cd6f10924c517cd33d583fe845eabc4af210a1db.source: We believe in a liberalism that benefits all Americans. Bush subscribes to Reagan's divisive, winner-take-all economic policies which have made the middle-class poorer.
cd6f10924c517cd33d583fe845eabc4af210a1db.zh: 我们主张惠及全体美国人的自由主义。布什认同里根制造分裂、赢家通吃的经济政策，正是这些政策让中产阶级变得更穷。

cd021f8ac9aa748c510906813e223d894d0f673f.source: We believe that the Supreme Court is the highest law in the land, and should be respected by all decent Americans.
cd021f8ac9aa748c510906813e223d894d0f673f.zh: 我们认为，最高法院是全国最高的法律权威，每一个正派的美国人都应当尊重它。

c0d3123b4eb9825ee43e7628e00a739b0df90407.source: We can afford to lose the South if we can win in the North. I will campaign elsewhere in the country and ignore racial issues as much as possible.
c0d3123b4eb9825ee43e7628e00a739b0df90407.zh: 只要能赢下北方，我们就承受得起失去南方。我会到全国其他地区竞选，尽可能不谈种族问题。

5a5acc936bf2535cd7a52c67f24716a34c1db1b2.source: We can all agree on the need for reform, in this day in age. The question is, will we have sensible, moderate change or naked overreach?
5a5acc936bf2535cd7a52c67f24716a34c1db1b2.zh: 在这个时代，我们都能认同改革的必要性。问题在于，我们要的是明智、温和的改变，还是公然越权？

854ee603eb925b4aa61be68d58b34ff8bd1e70aa.source: We can all agree that the growth in the deficit is concerning. I will fight for an income tax Amendment that will allow us to close this gap without increasing tariffs.
854ee603eb925b4aa61be68d58b34ff8bd1e70aa.zh: 我们都能同意，赤字增长令人担忧。我会争取通过一项所得税宪法修正案，让我们不用提高关税，就能弥补缺口。

b984dde454495fd3e0fccf64f819864432e5a010.source: We can all do basic things like wearing masks to slow the spread. And at the same time, we need to be careful about the impact on small business and the economy. I don't think these Democrat lockdowns are sustainable.
b984dde454495fd3e0fccf64f819864432e5a010.zh: 我们都可以做些基本的事，比如戴口罩，减缓传播。同时，也必须谨慎考虑对小企业和经济的影响。我不认为民主党的这些封锁能持续。

8be54d945ed330d7abcdc76b77bda209097ba548.source: We can all learn a lot from Bill Clinton's ability to compromise with Congress and pursue a moderate political agenda. I will do the same as President.
8be54d945ed330d7abcdc76b77bda209097ba548.zh: 我们都能从比尔·克林顿与国会妥协、推行温和政治议程的能力中学到很多。作为总统，我也会这么做。

a84568998cc4bfaed4057f821c6922cdd03e0309.source: We can always find areas for improvement, but we have successfully defended the United States and our allies from numerous Communist threats over the past eight years.
a84568998cc4bfaed4057f821c6922cdd03e0309.zh: 我们总能找到改进的地方，但过去八年，我们已成功保卫美国及盟友，抵御了许多共产主义威胁。

3e0373c5233562aab191cb61431066fc4e6d01c8.source: We can always point out a few inconsistencies with our opponents, but by and large the Republican platform is a winning platform. If we stick to it we will win in November.
3e0373c5233562aab191cb61431066fc4e6d01c8.zh: 我们总可以指出对手的一些自相矛盾之处，但总体而言，共和党的纲领足以赢得选举。只要坚持下去，我们就会在11月获胜。

3ca8a3b75b1053261f189c8b3f69b083a914afd5.source: We can criticize Cleveland for a lot of things, but his repeal of the Silver Purchase Act is not one of them. I supported Cleveland all the way in the repeal debate.
3ca8a3b75b1053261f189c8b3f69b083a914afd5.zh: 克利夫兰有很多值得批评的地方，但废除《白银购买法》不在其中。在废法争论中，我始终支持他。

6f181c9b0318e8bb57b0b1bcedff6818e91088a2.source: We can emphasize in my own biography that I have led an upright life, without any taint to my personal conduct.
6f181c9b0318e8bb57b0b1bcedff6818e91088a2.zh: 我们可以在我的传记中强调，我一向为人正直，个人品行毫无污点。

27de7a84dd5740313f316c9af31453ca11c1704d.source: We can never be fully satisfied, but we have certainly held our own in the Cold War over the past eight years, compared to where we were during the Korean War.
27de7a84dd5740313f316c9af31453ca11c1704d.zh: 我们永远不能完全满足，但与朝鲜战争时期相比，过去八年，我们在冷战中确实守住了自己的地位。

3130bdfcd682a540a2caa964bb4053f9a391088d.source: We can sit around all day worrying about tactics, but the fact of the matter is, we need to win elections. If Democrats did a better job of appealing to all Americans, we wouldn't be in this predicament right now.
3130bdfcd682a540a2caa964bb4053f9a391088d.zh: 我们可以整天坐着担心策略，但事实是，我们需要赢得选举。如果民主党能更好地争取全体美国人，现在就不会陷入这种困境。

e3ebffc9d9ca01b7a2be028f7c7a4e8e516b2e13.source: We can support the idea of popular sovereignty, but that must include an acknowledgement that Kansas clearly desires to enter the Union as a free state.
e3ebffc9d9ca01b7a2be028f7c7a4e8e516b2e13.zh: 我们可以支持人民主权原则，但同时必须承认，堪萨斯明确希望以自由州的身份加入联邦。

8debb2ec4da04d9b70670c6105f1c302c7f99e23.source: We can win California. Put all efforts into that state.
8debb2ec4da04d9b70670c6105f1c302c7f99e23.zh: 我们能赢下加利福尼亚州。把全部力量投入这个州。

1f9191371f7a70d4f43bbf220950c1306b1f2575.source: We can't afford too much infighting, but some kind of rebuke is essential. I will give a speech and make it a point to mention that I am not considering any type of hasty action on the slavery issue.
1f9191371f7a70d4f43bbf220950c1306b1f2575.zh: 我们不能承受太多内讧，但某种批评不可避免。我会发表演说，明确提到自己并不打算在奴隶制问题上采取任何仓促行动。

94a5d579c6b29b4a2405650731e06168a10df928.source: We can't be out there responding to every little two-bit leaflet that some crank puts out. Let's wait and see how this issue develops.
94a5d579c6b29b4a2405650731e06168a10df928.zh: 我们不能去回应每个偏执怪人散发的廉价小传单。先看看这个问题会如何发展吧。

aec7b3839c89bcd8d3252d5075459ee2b2f7fc48.source: We can't even be sure that Bill is Chelsea Clinton's father. There are a lot of good arguments pointing to other people on this one.
aec7b3839c89bcd8d3252d5075459ee2b2f7fc48.zh: 我们甚至无法确定，比尔是不是切尔西·克林顿的父亲。有不少很有力的说法，指向其他人。

09d360204fbe32f4b614808121021b77110f755d.source: We can't focus too much on the second-banana. Voters want to know why I'm better than Bush.
09d360204fbe32f4b614808121021b77110f755d.zh: 我们不能把太多精力放在副手身上。选民想知道的是，我为什么比布什更好。

6235947fceff9aefbaf1048086dbd582bd349bb3.source: We can't have the American people saying that I'm afraid to debate Hubert Humphrey. Let's do it.
6235947fceff9aefbaf1048086dbd582bd349bb3.zh: 我们不能让美国人民说我害怕与休伯特·汉弗莱辩论。那就辩论吧。

da2b20e8dcb6f828c61f8d774ff9718c664ba9b3.source: We can't have the appearance of disunity on our ticket. We selected Mr. Clay at our convention, and we must live with the consequences.
da2b20e8dcb6f828c61f8d774ff9718c664ba9b3.zh: 我们的竞选组合不能显得不团结。党代会选出了克莱先生，我们就必须接受这一选择的后果。

2bf10cf54697ac233c0fd2c7464fe55808a9d04b.source: We cannot sacrifice the prestige of the Democratic Party by making these kinds of deals.
2bf10cf54697ac233c0fd2c7464fe55808a9d04b.zh: 我们不能为了达成这种交易，牺牲民主党的声望。

7938065737104aa27838a77644d42a25e9281c76.source: We could have prevented the Tet Offensive entirely if we'd never entangled ourselves in this Vietnamese quagmire.
7938065737104aa27838a77644d42a25e9281c76.zh: 要是我们从未陷入越南这个泥潭，根本就不会有春节攻势。

6e46a9d30c55741580e81010df7b03d02addcbb3.source: We could have stabilized this situation much earlier with aggressive intervention from the federal government. This is the type of thing I would have done if I were President.
6e46a9d30c55741580e81010df7b03d02addcbb3.zh: 如果联邦政府更早积极介入，我们本可以更早稳定局势。假如我是总统，这正是我会做的事。

59f9a088fb19f2d7dd2f3b9497e1a056e2c45fd4.source: We created numerous companies like Staples, which are American success stories employing thousands of people.
59f9a088fb19f2d7dd2f3b9497e1a056e2c45fd4.zh: 我们创办了史泰博等许多企业；它们都是雇用数千人的美国成功典范。

b04dc5e418ae2d4663848ae55456a6d6e9e7021e.source: We defeated ourselves throughout this war. American firepower could have knocked North Vietnam into submission if we had been more aggressive.
b04dc5e418ae2d4663848ae55456a6d6e9e7021e.zh: 整场战争里，是我们自己束缚了自己。如果采取更积极的行动，美国的火力本可以把北越打到屈服。

fc90d36a764e8d1a153f48ca2f17720a481170dc.source: We definitely need to make some changes to the Social Security program, but this is going too far.
fc90d36a764e8d1a153f48ca2f17720a481170dc.zh: 我们确实需要对社会保障计划作出一些调整，但这走得太远了。

c4180be5357a229bc9170e51586f3f6003252498.source: We did our best in Vietnam, but unfortunately things didn't turn out the way we wanted.
c4180be5357a229bc9170e51586f3f6003252498.zh: 我们在越南尽了全力，但不幸的是，结果没有如我们所愿。

9e823cf4a625b7cdcd6a80e9f294322ee48ddfb3.source: We don't have any plans to comment upon the Cabinet appointments of President Tyler.
9e823cf4a625b7cdcd6a80e9f294322ee48ddfb3.zh: 我们没有打算评论泰勒总统的内阁任命。

5ff0f5cc469546336a19d1e4f6ebb4e51b00bb11.source: We don't know for sure if the Court will consider this case, and for now we ought to avoid making any statements on it.
5ff0f5cc469546336a19d1e4f6ebb4e51b00bb11.zh: 我们还不能确定法院是否会审理此案，目前应当避免就此发表声明。

3bc4bc0e8a9e2ab031ede083dee44ed7d3e9a302.source: We don't know yet the exact motives behind this attack, but I condemn religious terrorism in the strongest terms if that is the motive. And my heart especially goes out to the Hispanic and LGBT communities that were affected by this terrible act of violence.
3bc4bc0e8a9e2ab031ede083dee44ed7d3e9a302.zh: 我们还不知道这次袭击的确切动机，但如果动机是宗教恐怖主义，我会以最强烈的措辞予以谴责。我尤其牵挂受到这场可怕暴力影响的西班牙裔和LGBT群体。

94960774d8fe49c51cc69bafc8537d219269aba9.source: We don't need to do anything so crazy as to denounce Andrew Jackson, but I think on the banking issue or the tariff issue, my positions are significantly different than what he advocated for.
94960774d8fe49c51cc69bafc8537d219269aba9.zh: 我们没有必要做出谴责安德鲁·杰克逊这种荒唐之举。不过，在银行或关税问题上，我的立场确实与他的主张有很大不同。

aa9a14057fb68a6b6efa7c045846fdf16aad1582.source: We don't need to hammer on the internal improvements issue. We have other things to talk about which will better unite the party.
aa9a14057fb68a6b6efa7c045846fdf16aad1582.zh: 我们没有必要紧抓国内公共工程问题不放。还有其他议题，更能团结党内各方。

6718915aac92bd6d08bdb3aa8736c988f687bdf3.source: We don't plan to focus on Dan Quayle much in this campaign.
6718915aac92bd6d08bdb3aa8736c988f687bdf3.zh: 在这场竞选中，我们不打算把太多注意力放在丹·奎尔身上。

974db8ffd7e98e90709697916b53b07ab0c6f804.source: We don't plan to mention Ronald Reagan very much in this campaign. It is important to establish that I am my own man.
974db8ffd7e98e90709697916b53b07ab0c6f804.zh: 我们不打算在这场竞选中多提罗纳德·里根。树立我有独立主见的形象很重要。

8a11a5b01362418d7c1bbbc197edff2fde22b95f.source: We don't really have a choice. He has far too much support in our party for us to pretend like he doesn't exist. Let's make sure to do a couple of appearances together before this is all over.
8a11a5b01362418d7c1bbbc197edff2fde22b95f.zh: 我们实在别无选择。他在党内的支持太多了，我们不能假装他不存在。在竞选结束前，务必安排几次共同亮相。

ecbdc4ccba7affdbda80bb5e725da95b22c35b07.source: We don't really need to address this question one way or the other. Let's just run our campaign and get our own views out.
ecbdc4ccba7affdbda80bb5e725da95b22c35b07.zh: 我们实在没有必要对这个问题作出肯定或否定的回答。专心竞选，把我们自己的观点传达出去就好。

db58b94faa0aa0275f556a409e75ca558a6dfe3e.source: We don't really plan to discuss this. I'd rather not be responsible for whatever Sanders might say.
db58b94faa0aa0275f556a409e75ca558a6dfe3e.zh: 我们其实不打算讨论这个。我不想为桑德斯可能说的话负责。

731e931a7382bf84ec731ecfaddea244c2184d27.source: We don't stand for the abolition of slavery in the South, so the entire premise of this question is false. This is nothing that we need worry about.
731e931a7382bf84ec731ecfaddea244c2184d27.zh: 我们并不主张废除南方的奴隶制，所以这个问题的整个前提就是错的。我们不必为此担忧。

a4a4c6d4e5d9fffe571c81ece5a1f3333aa40e16.source: We had unbelivable economic growth and it helped out the middle class, and the working people really. Then the Democrats destroyed it with this COVID scare. It's going to come roaring back with me here, just wait.
a4a4c6d4e5d9fffe571c81ece5a1f3333aa40e16.zh: 我们取得了令人难以置信的经济增长，帮助了中产阶级，也实实在在帮助了劳动者。后来，民主党靠这场新冠恐慌把它毁了。有我在，经济会强劲反弹，等着瞧。

ad909cae5aa1aa77a9c3a14a4a21d9e4760ba4b1.source: We have 10% inflation, crippling labor issues, and a legacy of overreach dating to the New Deal. I'm not very satisfied at all with our economic situation.
ad909cae5aa1aa77a9c3a14a4a21d9e4760ba4b1.zh: 我们有10%的通货膨胀、严重妨碍经济运行的劳工问题，以及从新政时期延续至今的政府越权。我对经济状况一点也不满意。

a2009330d805d87197d6e5d28802ae6c7a149145.source: We have Catholics, Jews, and others in this country who should not be forced to pray in a certain way because of what some principal believes in a public school. This is a First Amendment issue in my opinion.
a2009330d805d87197d6e5d28802ae6c7a149145.zh: 这个国家有天主教徒、犹太人和其他人，不应仅仅因为某个公立学校校长的信仰，就强迫他们按某种方式祷告。在我看来，这是第一修正案的问题。

fc5ca51f1ff57985c6f2fa0f768fdc1963220429.source: We have a President in the White House who pardoned the most notorious liar in our nation's history. The previous President, Lyndon Johnson, lied our country into Vietnam. I will be a different kind of President.
fc5ca51f1ff57985c6f2fa0f768fdc1963220429.zh: 如今白宫里的总统，赦免了美国历史上最臭名昭著的骗子。再前一位总统林登·约翰逊，则用谎言把我国拖进了越南战争。我会成为一位不同的总统。

68fe8284fb7638cd1228e3980c4bb1d1925e4c8f.source: We have a President who turns his back on science, decency, and truth itself. A President who spends more time watching Fox News than he does doing his job. We need an adult in the White House.
68fe8284fb7638cd1228e3980c4bb1d1925e4c8f.zh: 我们有一位背弃科学、体面，甚至真相本身的总统。他看福克斯新闻的时间，比做本职工作的时间还多。白宫需要一个成熟负责的人。

a57cd6190009fc8f7f7fce4846793eee4623d486.source: We have a civil case in progress which will draw plenty of attention to this matter. I have plenty of other things to attack Donald Trump over.
a57cd6190009fc8f7f7fce4846793eee4623d486.zh: 目前正在进行的民事诉讼，会让这件事受到足够多的关注。我还有许多其他事情，可以用来攻击特朗普。

f7b90bfddf24d4448e073e079ac3d8e81abc72bd.source: We have a long way to go on this issue, especially in light of the crime we've seen the past ten years. I support strict licensing and confiscation if necessary.
f7b90bfddf24d4448e073e079ac3d8e81abc72bd.zh: 在这个问题上，我们还有很长的路要走，尤其考虑到过去十年的犯罪状况。我支持严格许可制度，必要时也支持没收枪支。

195dbb7d0a881503bc608811a6b46d3058047e96.source: We have a missile gap, and an overly tight monetary policy that is constraining our growth. I'm very concerned that these shortfalls will allow the Soviet Union to gain an advantage if they are not addressed.
195dbb7d0a881503bc608811a6b46d3058047e96.zh: 我们存在导弹差距，过度紧缩的货币政策也在制约增长。如果这些不足得不到解决，可能使苏联取得优势，这让我十分担忧。

d720aaeb5d7c0a65818cf29273f904805b9a7703.source: We have a plan for middle class tax cuts. But it would be irresponsible to make huge changes while we still have a large debt.
d720aaeb5d7c0a65818cf29273f904805b9a7703.zh: 我们有一项为中产阶级减税的方案。但我们仍背负大笔债务，大幅调整会是不负责任的做法。

dfe4115b5e3a3db57bf9c42b538f753a9e85231c.source: We have a system in place that gives precedence to the rights of criminals over law-abiding citizens. I will take a firm stand on this issue as President.
dfe4115b5e3a3db57bf9c42b538f753a9e85231c.zh: 我们现行制度把罪犯的权利放在守法公民之上。担任总统后，我会在这个问题上采取强硬立场。

703e771c7927dc745608a2c38ce8777ac9656b8b.source: We have a timetable. I'm confident that when I'm reelected we'll be getting our troops out. Now if I gave you an exact date, the date depends on a lot of factors. I can't even tell you what all those factors are because some of them are secret.
703e771c7927dc745608a2c38ce8777ac9656b8b.zh: 我们有时间表。我相信，连任后，我们会撤军。至于给出确切日期，日期取决于很多因素。有些因素是保密的，我甚至不能把它们全告诉你。

e0eecbb69a7bd52dbd2e3f9224d987ad8403f4c3.source: We have a wonderful, diverse, and strong party in the Democratic Party. When I'm President, we're going to raise the minimum wage. We're going to further improve Obamacare. We're going to create millions of high paying, green jobs. And we're going to make college more affordable for the next generation!
e0eecbb69a7bd52dbd2e3f9224d987ad8403f4c3.zh: 民主党是一个出色、多元而强大的政党。我当上总统后，我们要提高最低工资，进一步完善奥巴马医改，创造数百万个高薪绿色就业岗位，还要让下一代更能负担大学费用！

89818837254531843a964511d005c01933f590ee.source: We have achieved great strides on this issue in the past twenty years -- and let the record show that Hubert H. Humphrey was at the forefront of this movement as early as 1948. We still have a long way to go, however, before we can truly realize the dream of Martin Luther King.
89818837254531843a964511d005c01933f590ee.zh: 过去二十年，我们在这个问题上取得了重大进展——历史可以证明，休伯特·H·汉弗莱早在1948年就站在这场运动的最前沿。不过，要真正实现马丁·路德·金的梦想，我们还有很长的路要走。

acc6a913b6f4106c3ace7b0f573ad8828c01e974.source: We have achieved great strides on this issue in the past twenty years -- and let the record show that I shepherd the Civil Rights Act of 1957 through the Senate and have supported Civil Rights bills during my time in the House and Senate. We still have a long way to go, however, before we can truly realize the dream of Martin Luther King.
acc6a913b6f4106c3ace7b0f573ad8828c01e974.zh: 过去二十年，我们在这个问题上取得了巨大进步。历史记录也表明，是我推动1957年《民权法案》在参议院过关，并在担任众议员和参议员期间支持民权法案。不过，要真正实现金博士的梦想，我们还有很长的路要走。

d92ae7f6339171d1a2a18cc8a49506c41bdbab6c.source: We have allowed one of the last moderate regimes in the Middle East to be replaced by Muslim fundamentalists. This is an unconscionable betrayal of our ally Israel and will harm American security.
d92ae7f6339171d1a2a18cc8a49506c41bdbab6c.zh: 我们任由中东仅存的几个温和政权之一被伊斯兰原教旨主义者取代。这是对盟友以色列不可容忍的背叛，也将危害美国安全。

c6d319b064efa0f2a50a8b98cc6e87ae42b0dfc7.source: We have almost 9 million illegal immigrants in this country. I support stronger enforcement of immigration laws to reduce this number.
c6d319b064efa0f2a50a8b98cc6e87ae42b0dfc7.zh: 我们国家有将近900万非法移民。我支持加强移民法执法，减少这个数字。

b4457a7280eecbee9e9eafdfa3280d0ec1b72d93.source: We have already implemented reforms to the DNC to prevent this in the future. And also, the idea that the nomination was "stolen" is absurd and unfactual.
b4457a7280eecbee9e9eafdfa3280d0ec1b72d93.zh: 我们已经对民主党全国委员会实施改革，防止将来重演。还有，说提名被“偷走”了，既荒谬又不符合事实。

b2a81897324a8429a3ba01ddf69029ba137c48c7.source: We have already passed the Taft-Hartley Act and a modernized system of price supports for food, and their effect can clearly be seen in the drop in inflation since 1947. I'm confident this trend will continue.
b2a81897324a8429a3ba01ddf69029ba137c48c7.zh: 我们已经通过《塔夫脱—哈特利法》，并更新了食品价格支持制度。1947年以来通货膨胀回落，已清楚显示了它们的效果。我相信这个趋势会持续。

6eb30ea302ac97242d3c0d93c6956cace67044ba.source: We have bigger priorities to deal with right now in America. I don't think that most Americans support or expect this kind of an initiative.
6eb30ea302ac97242d3c0d93c6956cace67044ba.zh: 眼下，美国有更重要的事情要处理。我认为大多数美国人既不支持，也不期待这样的举措。

ae6293481b169b38d8c2445111fa745e8a00360d.source: We have certain rights as a neutral power, and to retreat from those rights would only serve to invite further aggression.
ae6293481b169b38d8c2445111fa745e8a00360d.zh: 作为中立国，我们享有一定的权利。放弃这些权利，只会招致进一步的侵犯。

4a8a3be68ecac84d20cd0375387013aa90189503.source: We have chosen our running mate and our ticket is set. I don't know what they are trying to accomplish.
4a8a3be68ecac84d20cd0375387013aa90189503.zh: 我们已经选定竞选搭档，组合也确定了。我不知道，他们还想达到什么目的。

a0de080806785b22037535912f376c81e15bfc23.source: We have had a draft in place for decades. I will not accept cowardice as an excuse among the young men of America.
a0de080806785b22037535912f376c81e15bfc23.zh: 我们实行征兵制度已经几十年了。我不接受美国年轻人拿怯懦当借口。

aa80e584398bcee8e633b4d654124a50de9fc8e8.source: We have involved Ronald Reagan extensively in our campaign. I think that is clear for anyone to see.
aa80e584398bcee8e633b4d654124a50de9fc8e8.zh: 我们让罗纳德·里根广泛参与了竞选。我想这是谁都看得见的。

60832eb3613151001f569cff07ef1b90c6d258e3.source: We have long supported right-wing government in the Dominican Republic, and we've now propped it up against the will of the people. We can't credibly claim to fight for democracy when we do things like this.
60832eb3613151001f569cff07ef1b90c6d258e3.zh: 我们长期支持多米尼加共和国的右翼政府，现在又违背人民意愿，把它扶了起来。做出这种事，我们就无法令人信服地声称自己在捍卫民主。

7d0f33d11aaa9e70dc643af0164d07cc224042e2.source: We have no idea if Nixon was involved in this or not. I won't cheapen the outcome of this election and risk my own reputation with flimsy innuendo.
7d0f33d11aaa9e70dc643af0164d07cc224042e2.zh: 我们根本不知道尼克松是否参与了此事。我不会用站不住脚的影射玷污这场选举的结果，也不会拿自己的声誉冒险。

1495805f360b3778fbd887a562296e689ae986c7.source: We have no idea what Bernie Sanders might say, and the last thing we need is some kind of distraction before my acceptance speech.
1495805f360b3778fbd887a562296e689ae986c7.zh: 我们不知道伯尼·桑德斯会说什么，我接受提名演说之前最不需要的，就是节外生枝。

d03fb9bb7ecff80905e749a325c3f4cd9a8f153c.source: We have no plans to address the Gag Rule during our campaign.
d03fb9bb7ecff80905e749a325c3f4cd9a8f153c.zh: 我们不打算在竞选中评论禁议规则。

d0704dcbeab50c93fb92b94dac2ed0bd3b5abf22.source: We have no proof that global warming exists, and we should be expanding our production of coal and oil to obtain energy independence. I would not surrender the sovereignty of our nation for such trivial objectives.
d0704dcbeab50c93fb92b94dac2ed0bd3b5abf22.zh: 我们没有证据证明全球变暖存在，而且我们应当增加煤炭和石油产量，实现能源独立。我不会为了这些微不足道的目标，放弃国家主权。

afca37672bddcbb5a94720c6df0c9b9cb44fb61c.source: We have now had 10 years to analyze the effects of the No Child Left Behind Act. Do you think it is time for a change?
afca37672bddcbb5a94720c6df0c9b9cb44fb61c.zh: 我们已经有十年时间分析《不让一个孩子掉队法》的影响。你认为，是时候改变了吗？

a8b36b0619c8f62141714a72d7a61835c6057b33.source: We have passed the Dodd-Frank Act to analyze systemic risks to the financial system.
a8b36b0619c8f62141714a72d7a61835c6057b33.zh: 我们已经通过《多德—弗兰克法案》，用来分析金融体系的系统性风险。

743332e1291ab399ea5a410bf848d3ae0776f518.source: We have seen one Presidential ticket after another with two men on the ticket. Let's give women a fair shake for once! I'm confident our supporters will be motivated and galvanized by the Clinton-Warren ticket.
743332e1291ab399ea5a410bf848d3ae0776f518.zh: 我们已经见过一对又一对男性搭档竞选总统。这回就给女性一个公平的机会吧！我相信，我们的支持者会因为克林顿—沃伦这对组合而受到鼓舞，积极行动。

b2165da4b3e04e1ddbd72c94d662aaa5a1fc704d.source: We have some incredibly gifted scientists, people who have been there long before Obama was around by the way, and we've got to listen to them. We could be talking about hundreds of thousands of lives.
b2165da4b3e04e1ddbd72c94d662aaa5a1fc704d.zh: 我们有些极有才华的科学家，顺便说，他们早在奥巴马出现之前就在那里了，我们必须听取意见。这可能关系到几十万条生命。

901a8c6aea1b223c54ce1d4e5ed9ece1f6156b5e.source: We have some strong statements to make on foreign policy, on federal judges, on religious freedom and taxes, that I think are really gonna show people I'm serious.
901a8c6aea1b223c54ce1d4e5ed9ece1f6156b5e.zh: 在外交政策、联邦法官、宗教自由和税收上，我们要发表一些强有力的声明。我想，这些话会让大家看出，我是认真的。

1ac9573144731823dcc57c57e2496f13812305dd.source: We have taken extensive efforts to increase the military preparedness of the United States. For Mr. Hughes and others to insinuate otherwise is simply false.
1ac9573144731823dcc57c57e2496f13812305dd.zh: 我们已经为加强美国战备付出了大量努力。休斯先生和其他人暗示并非如此，纯属不实。

cdd21b298d19b669754e8e4dc171af5db8c6e6dd.source: We have taken too many steps to expand world trade without adequately protecting American workers from the consequences. I would definitely run a more protectionist Administration.
cdd21b298d19b669754e8e4dc171af5db8c6e6dd.zh: 我们为扩大世界贸易采取了太多措施，却没有充分保护美国工人免受其后果影响。我肯定会让政府采取更强的贸易保护政策。

4c9cfb34469880c130d221085113d2ec57b67e0e.source: We keep emboldening the enemy in Vietnam with half-measures. We will never win this war unless we escalate it.
4c9cfb34469880c130d221085113d2ec57b67e0e.zh: 我们在越南采取的半吊子措施，一再助长敌人的气焰。不升级战争，我们就永远赢不了。

259aebaf8b4bf109072ee51a6c7122b545d9b705.source: We know he's a drug addict and totally corrupt. The FBI needs to be looking into this immediately, and the media needs to be covering the story.
259aebaf8b4bf109072ee51a6c7122b545d9b705.zh: 我们知道，他吸毒成瘾，而且完全腐败。联邦调查局需要立即调查，媒体需要报道这个故事。

5e6c0b9f927efb91912e66072a00c28d5432867f.source: We know that there's an unbelievable amount of election fraud going on right now, and Democrats are making it even worse in 2020. Of course they want me to just lay back and take it!
5e6c0b9f927efb91912e66072a00c28d5432867f.zh: 我们知道，现在正在发生数量惊人的选举舞弊，民主党在2020年还让它更严重。当然，他们想让我躺着忍受这一切！

e6363e769f5c8454e72c99b0334adc9eafeb8a2b.source: We like Scott right where he is -- in the U.S. Senate. I'm confident that's where he'll be in 2013 as well.
e6363e769f5c8454e72c99b0334adc9eafeb8a2b.zh: 我们希望斯科特留在现在的位置，也就是美国参议院。我相信，2013年他也会在那里。

b8e36507863f93a19a9e647a44c6fca51496120a.source: We live in an open society, but that should never serve as an excuse for business to undermine the American worker by paying pauper wages to new arrivals.
b8e36507863f93a19a9e647a44c6fca51496120a.zh: 我们生活在开放的社会，但这绝不能成为企业以微薄工资雇用新移民、损害美国工人利益的借口。

21a2a6b0c25b257b26e5a5a400dc8df8dce1012e.source: We lost a lot of ground diplomatically after this event, and much of that could have been avoided had we issued a formal apology.
21a2a6b0c25b257b26e5a5a400dc8df8dce1012e.zh: 事件发生后，我们在外交上丢失了大量阵地。如果正式道歉，其中很大一部分损失本可避免。

014632f1738e2d1f247bcd471d620284cd4befcf.source: We may as well not even campaign at this rate!
014632f1738e2d1f247bcd471d620284cd4befcf.zh: 照这样下去，我们干脆不用竞选了！

d74d8e355406138993815e5843f332a58140c622.source: We may have our disagreements, but William McKinley is an honorable man. Our campaign will focus on the issues, not on the opponent.
d74d8e355406138993815e5843f332a58140c622.zh: 我们虽有分歧，但威廉·麦金莱是个正直的人。我们的竞选将着眼于议题，而不是针对对手本人。

b6ae76724e13f90c9469bad982cffb502a9e298c.source: We may have our issues with Lincoln, but our primary attacks should be reserved for the duplicitous Southern party, and the ambiguous Constitutional Union organization.
b6ae76724e13f90c9469bad982cffb502a9e298c.zh: 我们或许与林肯有分歧，但主要火力应当留给两面三刀的南方党派，以及立场含糊的宪法联邦党。

37aeee9dc742bea7d9b46a768c5f7186b4eccff9.source: We might consider sacrificing on this issue if it would help appease the Deep South. I don't think we should mention it much in this campaign.
37aeee9dc742bea7d9b46a768c5f7186b4eccff9.zh: 如果有助于安抚深南部，我们可以考虑在这个问题上作出让步。这次竞选不应过多提及此事。

c34157bed3fd41d43d551b7e7cc524523520ea9c.source: We might disagree with these laws, but it is the responsibility of the DEA to uphold them. I do think we can look into reducing the penalties, which should decrease the strain on our prisons and allow people a second chance to lead productive lives.
c34157bed3fd41d43d551b7e7cc524523520ea9c.zh: 我们可能不赞同这些法律，但执行它们是缉毒局的职责。我确实认为，可以研究减轻处罚；这样应该能缓解监狱压力，也让人再获一次过上有成效生活的机会。

84c64790ea933e62e14f0793e145f5b4fb6c9d18.source: We might have a few areas in which we have different opinions, but that is what the Democratic Party is all about. Part of running a national campaign is compromising for the good of the whole.
84c64790ea933e62e14f0793e145f5b4fb6c9d18.zh: 我们或许在几个方面意见不同，但民主党本来就容纳不同观点。为了整体利益作出妥协，也是开展全国竞选的一部分。

7cf4589c55626c571405398e9834531b6fe55a59.source: We might have our differences, but we have both been the Governors of Southern states, and it is important for us to show our camaraderie.
7cf4589c55626c571405398e9834531b6fe55a59.zh: 我们或许意见不同，但都曾担任南方州的州长。让人们看到我们彼此友好，很重要。

b7d27587ed002f8f0833ae9ab354931a43c2dd58.source: We might have our political differences, but I can't say whether I think this impeachment trial was justified or not. It's really a pretty gray area when you get down to it.
b7d27587ed002f8f0833ae9ab354931a43c2dd58.zh: 我们也许有政治分歧，但我无法说自己认为这场弹劾审判是否正当。仔细看，确实是个相当模糊的问题。

f8a7f3a23f53b8ecfbe5317469ee0471f80fb191.source: We must acknowledge that illegal immigration is a serious problem. Now unlike Donald Trump, I support dealing with that problem in a humane way, but ultimately we do need reform with tougher enforcement, and a path to legal status for some immigrants.
f8a7f3a23f53b8ecfbe5317469ee0471f80fb191.zh: 我们必须承认，非法移民是个严重问题。与唐纳德·特朗普不同，我支持用人道的办法解决，但归根结底，我们确实需要改革，加强执法，并为部分移民提供取得合法身份的途径。

c5246d86e0ee2f3194e42fa49a651c9b3e8db28f.source: We must acknowledge the unique nature of this election, and of our opponent. This pledge might help reluctant moderates and far-left progressives support me for now, if they see an open primary coming in three years.
c5246d86e0ee2f3194e42fa49a651c9b3e8db28f.zh: 我们必须承认，这场选举和我们的对手都很特殊。如果犹豫的温和派和最左翼的进步派看到，三年后会有一场没有既定人选的初选，这项承诺也许能帮助他们暂时支持我。

6add6e1de9def7ce7bc6f085eabf82ff6d30135a.source: We must annex Texas as soon as practicable.
6add6e1de9def7ce7bc6f085eabf82ff6d30135a.zh: 我们必须在条件允许时尽快吞并得克萨斯。

15fda5de9f6c445890742e4e63678e2a8e9dcde5.zh: 我们必须立即吞并得克萨斯。

88285c1149cad41d35aa59dcd38dec2d2f2c8e9e.source: We must attack Cassius Clay's statements at once, for the dishonest falsehoods that they are. I am in no way an abolitionist in this debate.
88285c1149cad41d35aa59dcd38dec2d2f2c8e9e.zh: 我们必须立即抨击卡修斯·克莱的言论，指出那是恶意编造的谎言。在这场争论中，我绝不是废奴主义者。

559267d098d3c47c39182dc8cf73b932836454f2.source: We must balance the humanitarian impulse with what is practical and politically feasible. I would prefer to see us offer generous aid to Turkey, Jordan, and other affected countries as we protect people from the brutal Assad regime and defeat ISIS.
559267d098d3c47c39182dc8cf73b932836454f2.zh: 我们必须在人道主义愿望与实际、政治可行性之间取得平衡。我更希望向土耳其、约旦及其他受影响国家提供慷慨援助，同时保护人民免受残暴的阿萨德政权迫害，并击败“伊斯兰国”。

a2aeb5e0acd27a0e9392df0a5d9ec83cb81a01b9.source: We must do better. Our present Administration has advocated a hard money policy which caused the recession of 1958 and left idle industrial capacity in our country.
a2aeb5e0acd27a0e9392df0a5d9ec83cb81a01b9.zh: 我们必须做得更好。本届政府主张紧缩货币政策，造成1958年的衰退，使本国工业产能闲置。

f23ef2f8b8f012ed9c94f81e8e7b8bea9c1f90a2.source: We must do whatever it takes to preserve Medicare. This program is one of the most important functions of the federal government.
f23ef2f8b8f012ed9c94f81e8e7b8bea9c1f90a2.zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价保住联邦医疗保险。这项计划是联邦政府最重要的职能之一。

0abb24aa17822d5877dd30a712df734d28015418.source: We must make no further statements on slavery during this campaign, except that we believe the preservation of the Union to be paramount, and would consider any type of compromise Amendment on this issue once we're elected.
0abb24aa17822d5877dd30a712df734d28015418.zh: 在这次竞选中，我们不得再就奴隶制发表声明，只应强调维护联邦至关重要；当选后，我们会考虑任何有关此事的妥协性宪法修正案。

16e9546feaa55442076bcdebd1314df358de3e09.source: We must not allow the expansion of slavery into any new states or territories. We also must end outrages like the Fugitive Slave Law.
16e9546feaa55442076bcdebd1314df358de3e09.zh: 我们不得允许奴隶制扩展到任何新州或领地，也必须终结《逃奴法》这类暴行。

d02c223f8b04fe3b7de9add4508679c939c460c8.source: We must not undo eight years of progress under President Clinton by cutting key programs and squandering the surplus on tax cuts for the rich. My opponent not only lacks experience, but his conservative ideas are out of step with those of the American public.
