d02c223f8b04fe3b7de9add4508679c939c460c8.zh: 我们不能削减关键项目、把预算盈余浪费在为富人减税上，毁掉克林顿总统执政八年的进步。我的对手不仅缺乏经验，他的保守观念也与美国公众脱节。

cb4162d51303fabe6bd717fdd3475c49ddf88003.source: We must put out a letter, clarifying that we only support abolition if slaveholders can be fairly compensated, with reasonable notice, and if freed slaves can be recolonized to Africa.
cb4162d51303fabe6bd717fdd3475c49ddf88003.zh: 我们必须发表一封信，澄清只有在奴隶主获得公平补偿、得到合理的提前通知，而且获释奴隶可以被送往非洲殖民安置的条件下，我们才支持废奴。

3d89650b160e48c0e0beab2f3d46bb5179cbdcec.source: We must remain steadfast against the acquisition of new territories, and must combat the expansion of slavery to the extent permitted by the Supreme Court's
3d89650b160e48c0e0beab2f3d46bb5179cbdcec.zh: 我们必须坚定反对获取新领土，并且必须在最高法院允许的范围内打击奴隶制的扩张

acf2f09e8e640025385c3749c198516e14dc0752.source: We must rescind this tariff and replace it with something much lower. I support free trade and low tariffs.
acf2f09e8e640025385c3749c198516e14dc0752.zh: 我们必须废除这项关税，改用低得多的税率。我支持自由贸易和低关税。

9dceca885267c5d9b783de1864c09349240b85b7.source: We must secure the upper South. This means we start in in Maryland and Delaware, move through Virginia and West Virginia, and then through Kentucky.
9dceca885267c5d9b783de1864c09349240b85b7.zh: 我们必须拿下南方北部地区。从马里兰和特拉华出发，经过弗吉尼亚和西弗吉尼亚，再到肯塔基。

d8aae42238f73f8f4799d8789fac1de1e59fcd07.source: We need a Green New Deal. Global warming is the great challenge of our era, and we need to make every investment we can to combat it. And furthermore, we need to make tough choices on our current economic and environmental regulations.
d8aae42238f73f8f4799d8789fac1de1e59fcd07.zh: 我们需要一项绿色新政。全球变暖是我们时代的重大挑战，我们需要尽一切可能投资应对。除此之外，我们还必须对现有经济和环境监管作出艰难选择。

3536f8557b6196dac1ec92266889cca58b8262ca.source: We need a Vice President who can help us create a fair deal for the average American. Elizabeth Warren has fought against injustice throughout her career, and we're proud to have her in our campaign.
3536f8557b6196dac1ec92266889cca58b8262ca.zh: 我们需要一位副总统，帮助我们为普通美国人争取公平待遇。伊丽莎白·沃伦在整个职业生涯中都在反对不公，我们很自豪能请她加入竞选团队。

6e1ee4ee2a9e1ea8bddaba71f23a075f0741ea2d.source: We need a federal housing bill that will produce low-income housing and provide cheaper mortgages for all Americans, so that we can get more housing built in this country.
6e1ee4ee2a9e1ea8bddaba71f23a075f0741ea2d.zh: 我们需要一项联邦住房法案，建设低收入住房，并为所有美国人提供更便宜的住房贷款，让本国建起更多住房。

35e1cb0a002bd823c536f2f2f95abfce2774344d.source: We need a minimum wage of at least $12 an hour, and hopefully more. I'm proud to stand with my running mate and advocate for the American worker in their fight against the 1%.
35e1cb0a002bd823c536f2f2f95abfce2774344d.zh: 我们需要至少每小时12美元的最低工资，希望还能更高。我很自豪能与我的搭档站在一起，在美国劳动者对抗最富有的1%人群时为他们发声。

eea2260ab6269a39aa00315b83bbd06cb6a1ba25.source: We need a more balanced trade situation, so that we have jobs available to people at all levels of society. We've really done a disservice to the white and African-American working class over the past twenty years.
eea2260ab6269a39aa00315b83bbd06cb6a1ba25.zh: 我们需要更平衡的贸易局面，让社会各阶层都有工作可做。过去二十年，我们实在辜负了白人和非裔美国劳动阶级。

bfb97e53a2cde121b33d6de4005ae7816e9386b7.source: We need a path to citizenship for those in the country, and we need a system of work permits and strict enforcement on employers, so that immigrants do not depress American wages. We should increase aid to Latin America to reduce the rich-poor divide in our economies.
bfb97e53a2cde121b33d6de4005ae7816e9386b7.zh: 我们需要为已在美国的人提供入籍途径，也需要建立工作许可制度，并严格执法查处雇主，防止移民压低美国人的工资。我们应当增加对拉丁美洲的援助，缩小我们各经济体之间的贫富差距。

b051cfd74fbce5b4d42984d6a7d5d1037f76b692.source: We need a ticket that can appeal to all of our wonderful supporters. Karen Bass will fight tirelessly for better health care, infrastructure, higher wages, and racial equity. I couldn't be more proud to announce her as my running mate.
b051cfd74fbce5b4d42984d6a7d5d1037f76b692.zh: 我们需要一对能吸引所有出色支持者的竞选组合。卡伦·巴斯会不知疲倦地争取更好的医疗、基础设施、更高工资和种族公平。我能宣布她成为我的搭档，感到无比自豪。

73f3788cf32aaf5cd33dd594f02ec043dc052a3d.source: We need greater cooperation between government and corporations. I'm not opposed to government investments and even ownership of key industries, where appropriate.
73f3788cf32aaf5cd33dd594f02ec043dc052a3d.zh: 政府与企业之间需要加强合作。我不反对政府投资，在适当情况下，甚至可以由政府拥有关键行业。

72a3ddb2895783edb496cd7c2bde86e4678bd438.source: We need high tariffs on a variety of products and commodities to stimulate American manufacturing.
72a3ddb2895783edb496cd7c2bde86e4678bd438.zh: 我们需要对各种产品和商品征收高关税，以促进美国制造业。

37dc5f41a1a134ec99d6be1abbf0cd292a6f10da.source: We need huge tax cuts across the board. Corporate, personal, and capital gains taxes should be slashed. This will further expand the economy through increases in investment.
37dc5f41a1a134ec99d6be1abbf0cd292a6f10da.zh: 我们需要全面大幅减税。企业税、个人税和资本利得税都应大幅削减。这将增加投资，进一步推动经济增长。

42d439610db62ecbdde711c1a117ce32b1c0b431.source: We need lower taxes, fewer regulations, and a smaller federal government. This will encourage private enterprise and spur a recovery to our industrial capacity.
42d439610db62ecbdde711c1a117ce32b1c0b431.zh: 我们需要降低税收、减少监管、缩小联邦政府。这将鼓励私人企业，促进工业产能恢复。

0fa020a22f393cc82d2b85126187da2366758010.source: We need more funding for Medicare. We need to hold providers accountable when they fall short, by curbing excess profits for pharmaceuticals and targeting HMOs that drop seniors.
0fa020a22f393cc82d2b85126187da2366758010.zh: 我们需要增加老年医疗保险的经费。服务不到位时，应追究提供方的责任，遏制药品的过高利润，并整治抛弃老年参保人的健康维护组织。

17f3e12f88ee1cb1acce20c0fc0f4ea71309e92e.source: We need more funding for federal programs to mitigate the worst effects of this downturn.
17f3e12f88ee1cb1acce20c0fc0f4ea71309e92e.zh: 我们需要为联邦项目增加拨款，以缓解这次衰退最严重的影响。

89003d2419829cbecc367e3ea7d007a63a99b3f8.source: We need more spending and lower interest rates, and we need to repeal the Taft-Hartley Act and put more money into the hands of the American people.
89003d2419829cbecc367e3ea7d007a63a99b3f8.zh: 我们需要增加开支、降低利率，废除《塔夫脱—哈特利法》，让更多钱回到美国人民手中。

bbeb2fa7a700670934f4a5cc2ef11b3a430f7a08.source: We need more spending and should consider lower taxes to stimulate American economy and industry.
bbeb2fa7a700670934f4a5cc2ef11b3a430f7a08.zh: 我们需要增加开支，也应该考虑减税，以刺激美国经济和工业。

53282e7cb93bf7fc2166bbc3bc6b0a89640a7f75.source: We need more spending for America's struggling schools, and national standards and testing to identify and fix poor performers. Every child deserves a strong, functional school to attend.
53282e7cb93bf7fc2166bbc3bc6b0a89640a7f75.zh: 我们需要增加对美国困难学校的投入，并制定全国统一的标准和测试，找出并改善表现不佳的学校。每个孩子都值得上一所教学扎实、运转正常的学校。

8cd57fef0d6b55bfd8b30579125ef4f4dd79ec73.source: We need more spending to counteract endemic poverty, and for drug treatment programs. We also need stricter gun control laws, and an end to capital punishment.
8cd57fef0d6b55bfd8b30579125ef4f4dd79ec73.zh: 我们需要增加拨款，解决根深蒂固的贫困，并开展戒毒治疗项目。我们还需要更严格的枪支管制法，并废除死刑。

2455cb79ad0a9ba7d99ad71fc7141592269711e0.source: We need some rational management of our nation's resources, but I think too often we err on the side of caution when it comes to utilizing our nation's timber.
2455cb79ad0a9ba7d99ad71fc7141592269711e0.zh: 我们需要合理管理国家资源，但我认为，在利用本国木材方面，我们往往谨慎过头了。

93911e0f56836df79ccb6f1ad809e10d7e7cad6b.source: We need their votes. We cannot risk denouncing the group in any way.
93911e0f56836df79ccb6f1ad809e10d7e7cad6b.zh: 我们需要他们的选票，不能冒险以任何方式谴责这个团体。

fa6b1d32c5014ed1d06f960d7509ecb6067ce265.source: We need this campaign to focus on the substantive issues, like Obama's assault on religious freedom and free speech. There are plenty of people out there digging up dirt on the Clintons.
fa6b1d32c5014ed1d06f960d7509ecb6067ce265.zh: 我们需要让竞选聚焦于实质问题，例如奥巴马对宗教自由和言论自由的攻击。外头已经有大把的人在挖克林顿夫妇的黑料。

5b6dcf62bf9fccaf86a73d43ccbcecf65301be40.source: We need to acknowledge the Know-Nothing point of view. Otherwise, they will bolt to this so-called Constitutional Union party.
5b6dcf62bf9fccaf86a73d43ccbcecf65301be40.zh: 我们需要顾及一无所知党人的观点，否则他们会转投这个所谓的宪法联邦党。

8ecd080ce53db90ba8bdd9757746c19ff7adeb7f.source: We need to address these concerns and state categorically that the Whigs support our current naturalization laws and do not stand for nativism.
8ecd080ce53db90ba8bdd9757746c19ff7adeb7f.zh: 我们需要回应这些担忧，明确声明：辉格党支持现行入籍法，不主张本土主义。

aec2cba0b3ab303d714dc8f8d00878059d9c10c0.source: We need to attack Al Gore's views on the environment, on energy, on taxes, on spending, and on the right direction for our country. He is out of touch with the American people.
aec2cba0b3ab303d714dc8f8d00878059d9c10c0.zh: 我们需要攻击阿尔·戈尔对环保、能源、税收、开支，以及国家应走什么方向的看法。他脱离了美国人民。

5574db73974759fb747e3e78a0f5d62d5a6d3151.source: We need to attack George Bush's views on the environment, on energy, on taxes, on spending, and on the right direction for our country. He is out of touch with the American people.
5574db73974759fb747e3e78a0f5d62d5a6d3151.zh: 我们需要攻击乔治·布什对环保、能源、税收、开支，以及国家应走什么方向的看法。他脱离了美国人民。

050beb9e5487606a34582e5a93921a5583a2035b.source: We need to be doing more to defend our ally in China. I believe that country is in very real danger of falling to the Communists if we don't step in somehow.
050beb9e5487606a34582e5a93921a5583a2035b.zh: 我们应该做更多事情，保卫我们在中国的盟友。我认为，如果我们不以某种方式介入，中国确实有落入共产党之手的危险。

90363427d9b39554618af1456e8a652fc6ecf9fb.source: We need to be just as aggressive on this issue as we are anywhere else. “Fifty-four Forty or Fight!”
90363427d9b39554618af1456e8a652fc6ecf9fb.zh: 在这个问题上，我们也要像在其他问题上一样强硬。“北纬54度40分，否则开战！”

0b452d344dbe7c3a8dbfa3cfa835a3886dd41b6e.source: We need to be realistic. Would the Soviet Union do such a thing if they developed a nuclear bomb? I would never support this action.
0b452d344dbe7c3a8dbfa3cfa835a3886dd41b6e.zh: 我们需要现实一点。如果苏联研制出了核弹，它会这么做吗？我绝不会支持这项行动。

013e4eb5b3d2fa440102e0d619221e34973f8350.source: We need to be talking more about a massive infrastructure bill, and putting our factory workers and our coal miners back to work.
013e4eb5b3d2fa440102e0d619221e34973f8350.zh: 我们需要更多地谈论一项大规模基础设施法案，让工厂工人和煤矿工人重新就业。

4c362050cd0e22d290e41ecd3f62531b2271e882.source: We need to be very aggressive in fighting racism and its effects where they exist. I support programs such as busing, affirmative action, the new HUD department, and anything else that is necessary to integrate all regions of the United States.
4c362050cd0e22d290e41ecd3f62531b2271e882.zh: 凡是存在种族主义及其影响的地方，我们都必须积极对抗。我支持跨区校车接送、平权行动、新设的住房和城市发展部，以及为促成美国各地区种族融合所必需的其他措施。

559e6127e21ca6f7188878f4e4ac546cd055d3fc.source: We need to be very cautious about this program. It's important to ensure that the indigent can receive care, but programs like these always run the risk of adding precipitously to our national deficit.
559e6127e21ca6f7188878f4e4ac546cd055d3fc.zh: 我们必须非常谨慎地对待这项计划。确保贫困者得到医疗很重要，但这类计划总有使国家赤字急剧增加的风险。

04eedf54faa89b00222969845875a00e9e868703.source: We need to be vigilant in every case, but a cap of 10 thousand people is appalingly low from any humanitarian perspective. This conflict has displaced millions, including small children and infants.
04eedf54faa89b00222969845875a00e9e868703.zh: 我们必须在每一个个案上保持警惕，但不管从什么人道主义角度看，一万人的上限都低得令人震惊。这场冲突已经迫使数百万人流离失所，其中包括幼童和婴儿。

927c474dbbb39ea3d88120ba1ef03ea666cf8301.source: We need to be vigilant on the amount of immigration that we allow, but I also agree that we shouldn't restrict the practice based on national origin. In a Cold War world, we need to be mindful of international perceptions.
927c474dbbb39ea3d88120ba1ef03ea666cf8301.zh: 我们必须审慎控制允许入境的移民数量，但我也赞成不应按国籍来源限制移民。在冷战格局下，我们必须顾及国际社会的观感。

26e3d1c70a0d40e35421beca6d95fa0e11a70f48.source: We need to build a country where all citizens are equal before the law and before their fellow man. We need to make sure people from all walks of life get the help they need to succeed.
26e3d1c70a0d40e35421beca6d95fa0e11a70f48.zh: 我们需要建设一个国家，让所有公民在法律面前、在彼此面前都平等。必须确保各行各业的人，都能得到成功所需要的帮助。

725fbc95ba4d6419b99af2c8c4706deb6ec9710e.source: We need to change the imagery on this issue. Let's do a photo-op of me riding in a tank.
725fbc95ba4d6419b99af2c8c4706deb6ec9710e.zh: 我们得改变公众在这个问题上对我的印象。安排我乘坐坦克拍一组宣传照吧。

7766ad2f5f7504c6ac0f27a6d59838408ab54d52.source: We need to clarify- Goldwater only advocates reforming Social Security into a voluntary program.
7766ad2f5f7504c6ac0f27a6d59838408ab54d52.zh: 我们需要澄清：戈德华特只是主张，把社会保障改革为自愿参加的制度。

c5f26b17ed838c488fb1bff9e27162f57942900d.source: We need to consider all options. A controlled debt writedown just might be the best way to reignite the world economy, which is suffering from an abundance of bad debt at the current moment.
c5f26b17ed838c488fb1bff9e27162f57942900d.zh: 我们需要考虑所有选项。目前世界经济背负着大量坏账，有序的债务减记或许正是重振经济的最佳办法。

466f0201aee621196ebb65f5c0223a5bc569ca79.source: We need to constrain future spending increases and allow the economy to grow, which should make our debt more manageable over time.
466f0201aee621196ebb65f5c0223a5bc569ca79.zh: 我们需要限制未来支出增长，让经济发展；随着时间推移，债务就应该更容易管理。

3c3c1b8d67089d8b1b970f76784243fa972ef7c9.source: We need to continue to fight for the legacy of Dr. King. The continuing poverty of the blacks in our cities and in the South is a sobering reminder of how much work is left to be done.
3c3c1b8d67089d8b1b970f76784243fa972ef7c9.zh: 我们需要继续为金博士的遗产而奋斗。我们城市和南方黑人的持续贫困清醒地提醒我们还有多少工作要做。

38c707e23cd16fda582205ec66b3ee0b01fb196e.source: We need to control the spending and interference of the federal government, and reinforce our commitment to a sound American dollar. These policies will bring inflation under control in my Administration.
38c707e23cd16fda582205ec66b3ee0b01fb196e.zh: 我们需要控制联邦政府的开支和干预，重申维护稳健美元的承诺。在我的政府任内，这些政策将使通货膨胀得到控制。

2cb29ffc833adc24caaa8c36bba9c7857971f193.source: We need to counterattack Reagan and Bush for the pointless increases in defense spending, which have destroyed the federal budget this decade.
2cb29ffc833adc24caaa8c36bba9c7857971f193.zh: 我们需要反击里根和布什毫无意义地增加国防开支的做法。这些做法破坏了本十年的联邦财政。

dbfa65883ed553d1526e5df9283d4d3f4c587c76.source: We need to cultivate relationships like the ones we have with Iran and Saudi Arabia, to ensure that we have support from Middle Eastern oil producers.
dbfa65883ed553d1526e5df9283d4d3f4c587c76.zh: 我们必须发展与伊朗、沙特阿拉伯这样的关系，确保得到中东产油国的支持。

5782688aa9f64ebb1c986c476213030679674190.source: We need to cut this rate substantially. It is way too high.
5782688aa9f64ebb1c986c476213030679674190.zh: 我们需要大幅削减这个税率。它实在太高了。

2325009fdeb6a9f1b4915a1c6e07e2f116613a72.source: We need to dispatch an armed garrison to these islands, to make sure there is no mistaking our commitment in our fight against Communism.
2325009fdeb6a9f1b4915a1c6e07e2f116613a72.zh: 我们需要派驻武装守备部队到这些岛屿，明确无误地表明我们反共斗争的承诺。

a6fae92d6056d583f0fee512808d0c3a06c5218b.source: We need to do anything necessary to reduce the staggering rate of murder and violent crime in this country.
a6fae92d6056d583f0fee512808d0c3a06c5218b.zh: 我们必须采取一切必要措施，降低国内高得惊人的谋杀与暴力犯罪率。

aaff8fe0fe044610308f062641699f756f5d10c4.source: We need to do anything we can to ensure quality education for our youngsters. Let's see how this program develops and whether it seems to work or not.
aaff8fe0fe044610308f062641699f756f5d10c4.zh: 我们必须尽一切可能，确保孩子们获得优质教育。先看看这个项目如何发展、能否奏效吧。

f2cfa0c4e2e452d73e1497ba4ea21621e1fa6119.source: We need to do anything we can to move our nation forward on this issue, including a civil rights bill and measures to protect voting rights.
f2cfa0c4e2e452d73e1497ba4ea21621e1fa6119.zh: 我们需要尽一切努力，推动本国在这个问题上前进，包括民权法案和保护投票权的措施。

36db9e989050ec728fea32bbe3ed393b4c29ffb1.source: We need to do anything we can to reduce the power of labor unions in this country, including a national right-to-work law.
36db9e989050ec728fea32bbe3ed393b4c29ffb1.zh: 我们需要尽一切努力削弱本国工会的权力，包括制定一部全国性的工作权法。

546cead52606d7a6d7fc39596c0034393181ec7c.source: We need to do anything we can, including reducing our consumption, working for peace deals, producing domestically, and stabilizing our relationships with oil-producing allies.
546cead52606d7a6d7fc39596c0034393181ec7c.zh: 我们必须采取一切可能的办法，包括减少消耗、推动和平协议、增加国内生产，以及稳定与产油盟友的关系。

51755f1d9654423da621194333a09c3a338581c6.source: We need to do everything in our power to ensure that our poorest citizens have affordable housing. The HUD department is a centerpiece of this initiative.
51755f1d9654423da621194333a09c3a338581c6.zh: 我们必须竭尽所能，让最贫困的公民也住得起房。住房与城市发展部正是这项工作的核心。

35202b11183ae5eb20b6f3e117ec20b9b570b417.source: We need to do more for America. I have a plan to make college and health care affordable for every American, paid for by the 1%. The Republicans want to cut taxes for America's wealthiest citizens, so they can keep buying elections and asking Washington for bailouts and subsidies.
35202b11183ae5eb20b6f3e117ec20b9b570b417.zh: 我们需要为美国做得更多。我有一项计划，让每个美国人都能负担大学教育和医疗费用，由最富有的1%人群出钱。共和党却想给美国最富有的公民减税，好让他们继续花钱左右选举，向华盛顿索取救助和补贴。

c5821c95a47326075fdb07c64dd963cb803c4dbf.source: We need to do something to drive turnout and keep Sanders supporters off of the sidelines. I will pledge to fight for universal health care as President.
c5821c95a47326075fdb07c64dd963cb803c4dbf.zh: 我们需要做些什么，提高投票率，别让桑德斯的支持者袖手旁观。我会承诺，作为总统，争取全民医疗保障。

1b4ee1a8b180bfc267c10386562e732543e3e6cc.source: We need to do two things -- first of all we need better procedures to ensure that our forces in dangerous regions do better at protecting themselves. Secondly, we will investigate who is responsible for this attack, be it Al-Qaeda or some other group, and attack them accordingly.
1b4ee1a8b180bfc267c10386562e732543e3e6cc.zh: 我们需要做两件事：首先，改进程序，让部署在危险地区的部队更好地保护自己。其次，查明是谁策划了这次袭击，无论是基地组织还是其他团体，再对其采取相应的打击行动。

75a8528fd24c138bfa5c6643acdcf51ff208f2db.source: We need to do whatever it takes to ensure that Berlin is adequately supplied. We cannot further embolden Soviet aggression by retreating from the agreed-upon boundaries in our 1945 settlement.
75a8528fd24c138bfa5c6643acdcf51ff208f2db.zh: 我们必须不惜一切，确保柏林获得充足物资。不能放弃1945年协议划定的界限，让苏联的侵略气焰更加嚣张。

94cd3540208b5c4be6cdf9d3e523b98c553efe1d.source: We need to double-down on the states rights issue. Our only hope of victory is through the South.
94cd3540208b5c4be6cdf9d3e523b98c553efe1d.zh: 我们必须更坚定地强调州权议题。取胜的唯一希望，就是南方。

f5e0605a5a82399b611d409714d272769b4b1233.source: We need to elevate the tone of this campaign. I'm not going to continue digging into these old issues.
f5e0605a5a82399b611d409714d272769b4b1233.zh: 我们需要提高这次竞选的格调。我不会继续翻这些旧账。

43f7f590d054a4bf65299153af1065e24972aa51.source: We need to emphasize that Humphrey and Johnson are nothing but socialists and puppets of big union bosses.
43f7f590d054a4bf65299153af1065e24972aa51.zh: 我们需要强调，汉弗莱和约翰逊不过是社会主义者，是大工会头目的傀儡。

81ef0f0f140b545c506e353aaeea0ddb739f0107.source: We need to encourage a healthy economy in general, so that green businesses can obtain the investment that they need to innovate.
81ef0f0f140b545c506e353aaeea0ddb739f0107.zh: 我们需要鼓励总体健康的经济，以便绿色企业能够获得创新所需的投资。

d9b06b730e80423732b44b89189883c7cd850c37.source: We need to establish our independence from the Clinton Administration and let the American people know that I am my own man. I will emphasize my own scandal-free conduct, while pledging to help those Americans who have been left behind during the recent years of prosperity.
d9b06b730e80423732b44b89189883c7cd850c37.zh: 我们需要与克林顿政府保持独立，让美国人民知道，我有自己的原则。我会强调自己没有丑闻的表现，同时承诺帮助那些在近年的繁荣中被抛在身后的美国人。

f74b3a77d0b8cf18118f181e82060f53e5124079.source: We need to expand benefits for Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid. We can use the surplus as well as defense cuts to balance these increases.
f74b3a77d0b8cf18118f181e82060f53e5124079.zh: 我们需要扩大社会保障、老年医疗保险和医疗补助的福利。我们可以利用预算盈余和削减国防开支，来抵补增加的支出。

2228b4151a73bb2bf01e67765eaad64daaddd266.source: We need to extend and expand unemployment insurance. We need a second round of stimulus payments like we had the first time. The economists are clear on this.
2228b4151a73bb2bf01e67765eaad64daaddd266.zh: 我们需要延长并扩大失业保险，再发一轮像第一次那样的经济刺激款。经济学家在这件事上说得很清楚。

6634c422613d79b12e8bac4b648fc3849a497e88.source: We need to extend our tax credits for green energy installations, and increase the amount of spending on research. We also need to take active steps to reduce carbon emissions.
6634c422613d79b12e8bac4b648fc3849a497e88.zh: 我们需要延长绿色能源设施的税收抵免，并增加研究支出。也需要积极采取措施减少碳排放。

6bf2139a7f5ba83806f8fd344438b2b576574e1c.source: We need to find a balance between protecting the environment and protecting our economy. I support this Act but we also need to enforce it in a practical manner.
6bf2139a7f5ba83806f8fd344438b2b576574e1c.zh: 我们必须在保护环境和保护经济之间找到平衡。我支持这部法律，但执行时也必须切合实际。

a32120b7be6a0bab1b450a876ab7173b7b1ad767.source: We need to find a way to shut me up!
a32120b7be6a0bab1b450a876ab7173b7b1ad767.zh: 我们得想办法让我闭嘴！

aca5daa22763423fa2151b11fe6de22d9a7104d2.source: We need to focus less on handouts and more on encouraging initiative among our black and ethnic business owners. They will build the prosperity in our inner cities. I will analyze the War on Poverty on a program-by-program basis and cut those which are unnecessary.
aca5daa22763423fa2151b11fe6de22d9a7104d2.zh: 我们应少发救济，多鼓励黑人及其他族裔企业主发挥主动性。他们会为内城区创造繁荣。我会逐项审查向贫困宣战的各个项目，削减那些没有必要的项目。

5d054e4a7b4a3245f1583f426df18b2c71025433.source: We need to focus more on Indiana and Michigan. Iowa should already be in the bag for us.
5d054e4a7b4a3245f1583f426df18b2c71025433.zh: 我们需要更多关注印第安纳和密歇根。艾奥瓦应该已经十拿九稳了。

f5805164533b1c6bc07b101bec2aa0d059a3fdf1.source: We need to focus on getting our own house in order, or we will soon find ourselves in their condition.
f5805164533b1c6bc07b101bec2aa0d059a3fdf1.zh: 我们需要先把自己的事情处理好，否则很快也会落到他们那样的处境。

053a6b64aa1d6a28f2cd375b77023114c3da13c7.source: We need to focus on states like Missouri, Tennessee, and Arkansas. Clinton may have won them four years ago, but they seem to be wavering this time around.
053a6b64aa1d6a28f2cd375b77023114c3da13c7.zh: 我们需要着重争取密苏里、田纳西和阿肯色等州。克林顿也许四年前赢过这些州，但这次它们似乎开始动摇了。

6cf2a8bb1988f6d4f7eb98db06d62ae5a095a028.source: We need to focus on states like Missouri, Tennessee, and Arkansas. Clinton may have won them four years ago, but with one last push we can make them go Republican.
6cf2a8bb1988f6d4f7eb98db06d62ae5a095a028.zh: 我们需要着重争取密苏里、田纳西和阿肯色等州。克林顿也许四年前赢过这些州，但最后再努力一把，我们就能让它们转向共和党。

bcdbecbab818b3f551428f12d1f042ecaa19dadf.source: We need to focus our efforts in the most efficient manner. I don't think spending a lot of time in Texas is really the thing to do for us.
bcdbecbab818b3f551428f12d1f042ecaa19dadf.zh: 我们必须以最有效的方式集中力量。我不认为把大量时间花在得克萨斯州是合适的选择。

161ed0a28bf33474b08daff94a3ce7ed9031b7f4.source: We need to form a comprehensive energy strategy and re-implement price supports for domestic oil production.
161ed0a28bf33474b08daff94a3ce7ed9031b7f4.zh: 我们需要制定全面的能源战略，并重新对国内石油生产实行价格支持。

56bd307f7ac1b15e2543553314223578f670e92b.source: We need to go after Thomas Dewey hard. I haven't heard him take a serious stand on any major issue of our time, and this country needs a true leader.
56bd307f7ac1b15e2543553314223578f670e92b.zh: 我们得狠狠抨击托马斯·杜威。在当今任何重大议题上，我都没听到他采取过鲜明的立场，而这个国家需要一位真正的领袖。

9bc8215c23065d184100f51cf641af3a39e32963.source: We need to go the other way for now. Talk about moderacy and reason, continued respect of the rights of the states, and promise to win in Vietnam and keep inflation low.
9bc8215c23065d184100f51cf641af3a39e32963.zh: 眼下我们得换个方向。谈温和与理性、继续尊重各州权利，并承诺赢得越南战争、维持低通胀。

d6bc3b751673d42a04215ee062845d734a48424e.source: We need to hold gun stores accountable when their weapons are used in violent crime. We need extensive measures to keep guns off the streets and away from criminals.
d6bc3b751673d42a04215ee062845d734a48424e.zh: 枪店出售的武器被用于暴力犯罪时，我们需要追究枪店的责任。我们需要广泛措施，让枪支远离街头、远离犯罪分子。

99ce2bfb6e10560713764b3bbbc5001a8b2c205a.source: We need to improve our policing practices, prevent riots and disorder, and also address the underlying economic causes that spread dissatisfaction with the status quo.
99ce2bfb6e10560713764b3bbbc5001a8b2c205a.zh: 我们必须改进警务，防止骚乱和秩序混乱，同时解决让人们对现状不满的深层经济原因。

1f806442344fa2ac23de52a884056904182ceecd.source: We need to increase benefits for Social Security. Many people can barely survive on the monthly payment, while we spend billions on the military and run a huge budget surplus.
1f806442344fa2ac23de52a884056904182ceecd.zh: 我们需要提高社会保障福利。许多人靠每月那点钱几乎无法生存，而我们却把数十亿美元花在军队上，还积累了巨额预算盈余。

958de0ff1d19c30e49a3c6e4e4aa6025837c983f.source: We need to increase our vigilance in the War on Drugs, increase prison sentences, and allow capital punishment to be more broadly applied.
958de0ff1d19c30e49a3c6e4e4aa6025837c983f.zh: 我们需要在禁毒战争中加强警惕，延长监禁刑期，并扩大死刑的适用范围。

75cb1488a47eb2c6ceab7cba2885e55c0cec9641.source: We need to increase pay for teachers and increase funding for the Department of Education. I don't support nationwide standards or testing -- they will distort the learning process and lead to education by rote.
75cb1488a47eb2c6ceab7cba2885e55c0cec9641.zh: 我们需要提高教师薪酬，并增加教育部的经费。我不支持全国统一的标准或测试——这会扭曲学习过程，导致死记硬背式的教育。

e0a73ee9337352e10002e3a525ca84f058431b3d.source: We need to increase the support for American agriculture by fighting for exports in our trade deals -- with the Soviet Union, Mexico, and elsewhere.
e0a73ee9337352e10002e3a525ca84f058431b3d.zh: 我们需要在与苏联、墨西哥及其他地方达成贸易协议时争取出口，增强对美国农业的支持。

2ade71c238a23278dabb51795977d5a3719d596c.source: We need to keep it simple. Our primary goal in this campaign is to win the critical states of Iowa, Illinois, and Indiana.
2ade71c238a23278dabb51795977d5a3719d596c.zh: 我们需要保持简单明了。这场竞选的首要目标，是赢下艾奥瓦、伊利诺伊和印第安纳这几个关键州。

7c1877378ee6c5fc19f72e166318f6fa9c9f3b36.source: We need to look at whatever we can do right now to take guns off of the streets and reduce the level of shootings and murders in this country. I am going to push for any kind of assault weapons ban, background check, or other legislation that we can get.
7c1877378ee6c5fc19f72e166318f6fa9c9f3b36.zh: 我们需要考虑现在能采取的一切办法，减少街头枪支，降低全国枪击和谋杀的数量。我会推动任何能够通过的突击武器禁令、背景审查或其他立法。

a86dcc13904337af2f767faa8c720ccb7ce3f4f8.source: We need to make it perfectly clear that we have no use for this secessionist splinter group, and that we are a national party that truly represents Democracy in this country.
a86dcc13904337af2f767faa8c720ccb7ce3f4f8.zh: 我们必须讲得清清楚楚：我们与这个主张分离的分裂派毫无瓜葛，而我们才是真正代表本国民主的全国性政党。

3c5617c3980298d8a184baaa2487a5a77f5710ce.source: We need to make sure that our military is adequately filled with personnel. That being said, I would prefer to see a volunteer system in place. I'm confident that there are enough patriotic young men in this country to make that system work.
3c5617c3980298d8a184baaa2487a5a77f5710ce.zh: 我们必须确保军队有足够的人员。不过，我更希望建立志愿兵制度。我相信，这个国家有足够多爱国的年轻人，能让这种制度运作起来。

02e8429dccf0c6db69cbe99dc4b3bb04a37d4465.source: We need to make sure we don't overextend ourselves into new regions when the situation does not warrant it.
02e8429dccf0c6db69cbe99dc4b3bb04a37d4465.zh: 在局势没有必要时，我们必须确保不会在新的地区过度扩张承诺。

6f7720bbc32277af97f97bd0cf83f910b8fbdc92.source: We need to make the tough choices that will get our sprawling deficit under control. I will increase taxes on the 1% and continue the significant progress that Barack Obama has made in reducing our annual deficit.
6f7720bbc32277af97f97bd0cf83f910b8fbdc92.zh: 我们需要作出艰难选择，控制不断膨胀的赤字。我会向最富有的1%人群增税，并延续贝拉克·奥巴马在减少年度赤字上取得的重大进展。

1fe1a844003a281308b37a0be412a8c6bc84fd59.source: We need to minimize the federal funding of education, even in block grants. It could easily open the door to federal control of our schools.
1fe1a844003a281308b37a0be412a8c6bc84fd59.zh: 我们需要尽量减少联邦教育经费，即便是整笔拨款也应如此。这很容易为联邦控制学校打开大门。

361ad0cd1aa3f01155fa0018dbb148def62416a7.source: We need to mobilize the National Guard and increase our military presence on the southern border, in order to prevent future attacks.
361ad0cd1aa3f01155fa0018dbb148def62416a7.zh: 我们需要动员国民警卫队，加强南部边境的军事部署，防止再发生袭击。

a5da2d89345701035aeeb07c6aa5ae8dba72f6a5.source: We need to negotiate a permanent agreement with Great Britain that grants some of all of the Oregon Territory to the United States.
a5da2d89345701035aeeb07c6aa5ae8dba72f6a5.zh: 我们需要与英国谈判，达成永久协议，将俄勒冈领地的部分或全部土地划归美国。

db3dc339bc12fc4eebd07bb0f5a661e28d55f7c2.source: We need to pull back from West Berlin and maintain a more realistic defense perimeter. We're more likely to be drawn into World War III than to gain anything useful from the defense of that exclave.
db3dc339bc12fc4eebd07bb0f5a661e28d55f7c2.zh: 我们需要撤出西柏林，维持一条更现实的防线。保卫这块飞地，更可能让我们卷入第三次世界大战，而不是带来什么实际好处。

8132fd20796f22a320a602f90c2b45bf44f7d63a.source: We need to pull our forces out of Vietnam as soon as possible. This war is a national disgrace.
8132fd20796f22a320a602f90c2b45bf44f7d63a.zh: 我们需要尽快把军队撤出越南。这场战争让国家蒙羞。

6303820001c3c260a8aa981b1e23ef8b026d6ad2.source: We need to put $2000 in the hands of every American, and we need to put forward a truly substantial relief package for our struggling small businesses and job creators.
6303820001c3c260a8aa981b1e23ef8b026d6ad2.zh: 我们需要让每个美国人都拿到2000美元，并为处境艰难的小企业和创造就业者，提出一项真正有分量的救助方案。

28e6a7327c1428da446be8c12454ac08966910d6.source: We need to strengthen the power of the Drug Czar, and implement tough measures on repeat offenders. We also need programs to assist low-income families so that the children of today don't turn to crime in the future.
28e6a7327c1428da446be8c12454ac08966910d6.zh: 我们需要加强国家禁毒主管的权力，对惯犯采取严厉措施。同时还需要帮助低收入家庭的项目，避免今天的孩子将来走上犯罪道路。

8d1faa306e517cda460bdd9afc198926b82c46d4.source: We need to take the attack to the Democrats after the convention they put on, and specifically challenge Dukakis on defense, economics, and social issues.
8d1faa306e517cda460bdd9afc198926b82c46d4.zh: 民主党办了那样一场大会之后，我们需要主动进攻，具体质疑杜卡基斯在国防、经济与社会议题上的立场。

045f9eebd5b68cc1d357154c8175984034e53912.source: We need to teach the Democrats a lesson this year. I will work tirelessly to pry white northern votes away from Humphrey, so that future candidates on our side know they'd best not trifle with the South.
045f9eebd5b68cc1d357154c8175984034e53912.zh: 今年，我们必须给民主党一个教训。我会不懈地从汉弗莱手中夺取北方白人选票，让今后我们阵营的候选人知道，最好别把南方不当回事。

1f7e5ed520637803e8f95e956486aeb6bf16e444.source: We need to worry about beating the COVID-19 pandemic and protecting the right of every American to have their voice heard at the ballot box. Those will be my first priorities.
1f7e5ed520637803e8f95e956486aeb6bf16e444.zh: 我们需要关心如何击败新冠疫情，并保障每个美国人通过投票表达意见的权利。这些会是我的首要任务。

11498f1bb32b6e42fa58949dd6478f51f5c72140.source: We need whoever we can get.
11498f1bb32b6e42fa58949dd6478f51f5c72140.zh: 能争取到谁，我们就需要谁。

d963b33fa1b5f3878c1f22ca503f67404923fb5c.source: We obviously cannot agree with this decision, but the Supreme Court lays down the law of the land, and we have little choice but to acquiesce.
d963b33fa1b5f3878c1f22ca503f67404923fb5c.zh: 我们显然无法赞同这一判决，但最高法院规定全国必须遵循的法律，我们几乎别无选择，只能接受。

54e68b7417a1aa3987a9c79669d6b84e0e5ff17f.source: We oppose any effort to extend the current borders of the United States. They are plainly driven by the slave states.
54e68b7417a1aa3987a9c79669d6b84e0e5ff17f.zh: 我们反对任何扩大美国现有疆界的努力。这些举动显然是由蓄奴州推动的。

758927a24aa230b0da91413907584bda4f362ec3.source: We oversaw the Massachusetts Miracle. Bush has remained out of the loop on key Reagan scandals, and lacked the judgment to suspend dealings with Noriega.
758927a24aa230b0da91413907584bda4f362ec3.zh: 我们创造了马萨诸塞奇迹。布什却对里根政府的重大丑闻置身事外，也缺乏判断力，没有中止与诺列加的往来。

ff57779437e4f8488462d0cef9433bddc57c1d2b.source: We passed a terrific relief bill way back in April, I was very proactive. And you know, we need to think about spending and defecits as well, before we come out with another huge thing.
ff57779437e4f8488462d0cef9433bddc57c1d2b.zh: 早在四月，我们就通过了一项出色的救助法案，我非常积极主动。你知道，在再推出一项巨额方案之前，我们也需要考虑支出和赤字。

8442f213b7b5f80b3e2b02812a282ac0770a962c.source: We plan to attack Romney's record relentlessly. He oversaw numerous outsourcings and corporate downsizings in his time as CEO, and his company represents the dark side of American business.
8442f213b7b5f80b3e2b02812a282ac0770a962c.zh: 我们打算毫不留情地攻击罗姆尼的履历。他担任首席执行官期间，主持了大量业务外包和企业裁员；他的公司代表了美国商业的阴暗面。

be2cde8a4bc98de322b402fec3546885d13d9991.source: We prefer to focus on issues of policy and economics in this election, and not on political scandals.
be2cde8a4bc98de322b402fec3546885d13d9991.zh: 在这场选举中，我们愿意把重点放在政策和经济问题上，而不是政治丑闻。

ac1728f8137f4c79868e40097bfe353853b54f84.source: We prefer to run a positive campaign, focusing on our own policies and beliefs.
ac1728f8137f4c79868e40097bfe353853b54f84.zh: 我们愿意开展积极的竞选，着重宣传自己的政策和信念。

4ac794a44112776bea796608036db34af1c7fdab.source: We promise an equal opportunity to every person to succeed in America. I oppose discrimination in federal hiring and so on, but we also need to ask ourselves if a quota system is really the best way to monitor this issue.
4ac794a44112776bea796608036db34af1c7fdab.zh: 我们承诺，每个人在美国都有平等的成功机会。我反对联邦招聘等领域的歧视，但我们也得问问自己，用配额制度监督这个问题，是否真是最好的办法。

8a1608400cca0cc54f6262f40b0635b33932f4c8.source: We really can't say it enough, the Democrats want to implement radical socialism in this country. What more proof do you need than incidents like this one?
8a1608400cca0cc54f6262f40b0635b33932f4c8.zh: 我们怎么强调都不够，民主党想在这个国家实行激进的社会主义。像这种事情，你还需要什么更多证据？

a0d2daa912f62b331f083997b878115687f7b2bc.source: We reject Bircherism. Make that an official statement.
a0d2daa912f62b331f083997b878115687f7b2bc.zh: 我们拒绝伯奇协会那套思想。把这句话作为正式声明。

9bdee4708d01ab09cb6a40b0525af7cdb3b1cda9.source: We reject any call for the prohibition of alcohol, and I would not support such laws as President.
9bdee4708d01ab09cb6a40b0525af7cdb3b1cda9.zh: 我们反对一切禁酒主张；作为总统，我不会支持这类法律。

847cce673b828abb776dcf0fe32154b1dd205f82.source: We shall certianly be campaigning in the South to some extent. We can't just concede the entire region to Wallace.
847cce673b828abb776dcf0fe32154b1dd205f82.zh: 我们当然会在南方进行一定程度的竞选，不能把整个地区都拱手让给华莱士。

94c8fa265c459a93ad7115633a73aab146cfee0a.source: We shall certianly be campaigning in the South to some extent. We can't just concede the entire region to Wallace. Plus, we must eat into the small, but potentially decisive support he has recieved in some northern cities.
94c8fa265c459a93ad7115633a73aab146cfee0a.zh: 我们当然会在南方进行一定程度的竞选，不能把整个地区都拱手让给华莱士。另外，我们必须削弱他在北方部分城市得到的支持；那些选票虽然不多，却可能决定胜负。

905f4ef104b5aaca929eff3dfc108c9fb9b183b7.source: We should all be very concerned with the right-wing radicalism that Trump has enabled. It has no place in America, even if this particular remark could have been stated with more finesse.
905f4ef104b5aaca929eff3dfc108c9fb9b183b7.zh: 我们都应高度警惕特朗普助长的右翼激进主义。它在美国没有容身之地，尽管这句话本可以说得更讲究一些。

308bea7716479071916bd1c47768e8b17f1397b7.source: We should all take this moment to appreciate the importance of social distancing and other precautions. It won't be long until we roll out one of the best vaccines in history and defeat this pandemic.
308bea7716479071916bd1c47768e8b17f1397b7.zh: 我们都应该借此机会，认识保持社交距离和其他预防措施的重要性。再过不久，我们就会推出史上最好的疫苗之一，击败这场疫情。

5644d0ed5f7e879fb8f80d45601fe1ee5a6a5a2e.source: We should always be concerned about internal subversion, but the external Soviet threat should be our primary focus at this point.
5644d0ed5f7e879fb8f80d45601fe1ee5a6a5a2e.zh: 我们始终应该警惕内部颠覆，但现阶段应当主要关注苏联的外部威胁。

eff02da828cd3452fa9137bcb8961c7a80b52083.source: We should always be looking for areas of agreement, however limited, between ourselves, the Soviet Union, and Red China. At the very least, we can implement arms treaties and avoid the threat of a nuclear war.
eff02da828cd3452fa9137bcb8961c7a80b52083.zh: 我们应始终寻找与苏联、红色中国之间的共同点，哪怕十分有限。至少，我们可以落实军备条约，避免核战争的威胁。

8daa79bbe354c1fcdccd0c88cfe11085617e9515.source: We should always be wary of the corruption inherent in these large unions. I cannot say that I'm a supporter of the AFL-CIO.
8daa79bbe354c1fcdccd0c88cfe11085617e9515.zh: 我们应当时刻提防这些大工会内部根深蒂固的腐败。我不能说自己支持劳联—产联。

532b8b1b1b80a2d944a46fd8454afb337fde16e1.source: We should attack the Northern Democrats on their opposition to, or flip-flopping on, the issues of tariffs and internal improvements. They are on soft ground in that debate.
532b8b1b1b80a2d944a46fd8454afb337fde16e1.zh: 我们应当抨击北方民主党人在关税和国内公共工程问题上的反对立场，或其反复摇摆的态度。他们在这场争论中站不住脚。

74ce4b2814821113e6420962ed1e9fc506688a35.source: We should avoid taking a strong position on this tariff. There are men in our party who stand on both sides of the issue.
74ce4b2814821113e6420962ed1e9fc506688a35.zh: 我们应当避免在这项关税上采取鲜明立场。党内在这个问题上，两边都有人支持。

13c322b8bbc2f0c0cbb6072c0a20c5b0de82a607.source: We should avoid talking about Humphrey. It’s in poor taste.
13c322b8bbc2f0c0cbb6072c0a20c5b0de82a607.zh: 我们应该避免谈论汉弗莱。这样做不够得体。

e94dba4475543b897dc59f1dc0ede9151a19d1be.source: We should be calling on Great Britain to treat the perpetrators of this uprising with leniency, and to consider the relationship it has with Ireland.
e94dba4475543b897dc59f1dc0ede9151a19d1be.zh: 我们应当呼吁英国从宽处置这次起义的参与者，并重新考虑它与爱尔兰的关系。

e450c84722e7091f9483de3c46660338aff327af.source: We should be focusing on more important issues, such as educating the next generation of American children to compete effectively in the global economy. This incessant focus on picayune facets of the abortion debate detracts from the political conversation.
e450c84722e7091f9483de3c46660338aff327af.zh: 我们应该聚焦更重要的问题，比如教育下一代美国儿童，让他们能够在全球经济中有效竞争。没完没了地盯着堕胎争论中的琐碎细节，会偏离政治讨论的重点。

68f76b2ae8f0bf9340633f7e5cfae7e54cfa1ee7.source: We should be making every effort we can with this program, but if the Soviet Union were to offer sufficient concessions, it should certainly be a bargaining chip.
68f76b2ae8f0bf9340633f7e5cfae7e54cfa1ee7.zh: 我们应该尽一切努力推进这项计划，但如果苏联愿意作出足够让步，它当然也可以成为谈判筹码。

56d30729728e01d6d499f9a1d97155f684fc5cfd.source: We should be talking less about Bobby Baker and Billy Sol Estes and more about my great successes in office.
56d30729728e01d6d499f9a1d97155f684fc5cfd.zh: 我们应少谈博比·贝克和比利·索尔·埃斯蒂斯，多谈我执政以来的卓越成就。

725307647fe2c72f1731fdd7b4538897e2bd04bf.source: We should be talking less about Elian, and more about my plans to expand upon the great prosperity of this nation.
725307647fe2c72f1731fdd7b4538897e2bd04bf.zh: 我们应当少谈埃利安，多谈我的计划，看看如何进一步扩大这个国家的繁荣。

4bfaa7a5e942f2f74116f457ad50bb504dc3b3bd.source: We should be vigilant against labor union excesses, and the Taft-Hartley Act was a good start. I believe that we should keep that law in place.
4bfaa7a5e942f2f74116f457ad50bb504dc3b3bd.zh: 我们应该警惕工会的过度行为，《塔夫脱—哈特利法》是个不错的开端。我认为，应该保留这部法律。

283fe957d552c2033fe4c3fe96f8d6f18d3ab86b.source: We should condemn the apparent lawlessness of the Irish arrivals, and ask whether we ought to reconsider our generous naturalization policies.
283fe957d552c2033fe4c3fe96f8d6f18d3ab86b.zh: 我们应当谴责这些新来的爱尔兰人显然目无法纪的行为，并反思是否应该重新考虑宽松的入籍政策。

5a21b6896b85a41449f00252dd0dcc094b0a6331.source: We should enact tax cuts to return this money to the American people. My plan will reduce the burden for all Americans who currently pay income tax.
5a21b6896b85a41449f00252dd0dcc094b0a6331.zh: 我们应当减税，把这笔钱还给美国人民。我的方案将减轻所有目前缴纳所得税的美国人的负担。

a0b05d13e7a0258a676d311f1b188612762f20b4.source: We should establish a safe zone in Syria for refugees, while doing anything we can to effect a transition from Assad.
a0b05d13e7a0258a676d311f1b188612762f20b4.zh: 我们应该在叙利亚为难民建立安全区，同时尽一切可能，促成阿萨德下台后的政治过渡。

ca2634aad40e1b485468d6141d3e02afa5e90f25.source: We should focus on defending the Affordable Care Act from the attacks being levied on it.
ca2634aad40e1b485468d6141d3e02afa5e90f25.zh: 我们应该把重点放在捍卫《平价医疗法案》、抵御针对它的攻击上。

983a415863dbe3a03c593bf07b5203dbbfecad48.source: We should have been more active in brokering a compromise solution between Mubarak and the protestors.
983a415863dbe3a03c593bf07b5203dbbfecad48.zh: 我们本该更积极地促成穆巴拉克与抗议者之间的妥协方案。

ab8ec4524e81a5a2ead3a5b54a18777eda82932c.source: We should have found a better way to resolve this issue, rather than intrude into the sovereignty of an American state.
ab8ec4524e81a5a2ead3a5b54a18777eda82932c.zh: 我们本应找到更好的解决办法，而不是侵犯一个美国州的主权。

7397d37b52d02b73a1b01ded942345bd5f45eeae.source: We should have found other methods to end this strike besides legal chicanery.
7397d37b52d02b73a1b01ded942345bd5f45eeae.zh: 我们本应寻找别的方法结束罢工，而不是玩弄法律花招。

bb0f32c5e3e5c0864c276695d36bc9e06413ef86.source: We should have had greater security in those places where we were attacked. Let us not forget, however, that this attack greatly hurt the Viet Cong and was a victory for the United States.
bb0f32c5e3e5c0864c276695d36bc9e06413ef86.zh: 那些遭到袭击的地方，本应加强戒备。不过别忘了，这次进攻重创了越共，对美国来说是一场胜利。

3f815953c22c71c322b8aa49fc63665d4878ea27.source: We need to reaffirm our commitment to non-intervention in business affairs. Companies need stability before they will have the confidence to expand.
3f815953c22c71c322b8aa49fc63665d4878ea27.zh: 我们需要重申，不干预企业事务。只有环境稳定，企业才会有信心扩大经营。

404d9b07a0c8db4f67af055d3065ff70a4627823.source: We need to reduce our troop strength to the minimum necessary level to prevent the downfall of South Vietnam while we work these issues out at the bargaining table.
404d9b07a0c8db4f67af055d3065ff70a4627823.zh: 在谈判桌上解决这些问题的同时，我们必须把兵力减至防止南越垮台所需的最低水平。

3e6b2b6f5bc87ebd121dd4b88f7357b6019e52f4.source: We need to reject this endorsement right away.
3e6b2b6f5bc87ebd121dd4b88f7357b6019e52f4.zh: 我们必须立即拒绝这项背书。

39f30750ddcc62c2d4398b10471dce826659eb9a.source: We need to remain an engaged, committed defender of human rights in the world. We should do everything possible to secure the friendship of nations like Russia and China, and to prevent atrocities and genocide in the developing world.
39f30750ddcc62c2d4398b10471dce826659eb9a.zh: 我们需要继续积极参与世界事务，坚定捍卫人权。我们应当尽一切努力，与俄罗斯和中国等国建立友好关系，并防止发展中国家发生暴行和种族灭绝。

362b4546ea208c3e3504cf1bc43c191aca00c9f4.source: We need to remember how the past several months transpired, and the strength that Bernie enjoys among the grassroots. Simply ignoring him was not an option for our campaign.
362b4546ea208c3e3504cf1bc43c191aca00c9f4.zh: 我们需要记住过去几个月发生了什么，以及伯尼在基层中拥有的力量。我们的竞选团队根本不能选择无视他。

1434f9a5c31327e94637c64e8db8698335ba36b2.source: We need to remind union workers at every opportunity that Mr. Wallace is anti-union and regressive on every economic issue of the day.
1434f9a5c31327e94637c64e8db8698335ba36b2.zh: 我们必须抓住每个机会提醒工会工人：华莱士先生反对工会，在当今每个经济问题上都主张倒退。

c49dda86e01d9fa1f4abc81bebe8421f7e150570.source: We need to remind voters that Wallace is still a Democrat, and that his goal is to throw the election to the House.
c49dda86e01d9fa1f4abc81bebe8421f7e150570.zh: 我们必须提醒选民，华莱士仍是个民主党人，他的目标是让选举交由众议院决定。

1b6641135d2eaff8e032eb13611013b2ef7b8a53.source: We need to renew the Assault Weapons Ban and make it permanent. I support other measures such as trigger locks to reduce gun violence in this country.
1b6641135d2eaff8e032eb13611013b2ef7b8a53.zh: 我们需要延长《攻击性武器禁令》，并使其永久有效。我也支持扳机锁等其他措施，减少我国的枪支暴力。

8ede7876073fde938814f28f9a884dbb45e7ba73.source: We need to run an attacking campaign against Al Gore. We will expose his misstatements and emphasize that his proposals will squander our budget surplus and greatly increase the size and scope of government.
8ede7876073fde938814f28f9a884dbb45e7ba73.zh: 我们需要对阿尔·戈尔发起攻击性竞选。我们会揭露他的不实言论，并强调他的提议将挥霍预算盈余，大幅扩大政府的规模和干预范围。

cdf0a9f54b3cc1f1ec87e45eff7ee4e5fea51145.source: We need to send American troops to Syria to eradicate ISIS once and for all.
cdf0a9f54b3cc1f1ec87e45eff7ee4e5fea51145.zh: 我们需要把美军派往叙利亚，彻底消灭“伊斯兰国”。

7b980bd543efe699aaaed3e5aa67e5ede355ad1b.source: We need to shore up our base. Let's make sure we win in Pennsylvania and New York, where the stakes are highest.
7b980bd543efe699aaaed3e5aa67e5ede355ad1b.zh: 我们需要巩固基本盘。确保拿下宾夕法尼亚和纽约吧，那里的胜负最为关键。

17065559c55b961299a7bba664a1f3f2521597a9.source: We need to show that we understand the problems of our day, which includes support for canals, harbors, and railroads.
17065559c55b961299a7bba664a1f3f2521597a9.zh: 我们必须表明，自己理解当今的问题，其中就包括支持运河、港口和铁路。

c977253ea6c98d831a44cd32df0973fa3c4446a4.source: We need to strengthen our labor unions and protections for the nation's industry, including trade protections if necessary.
c977253ea6c98d831a44cd32df0973fa3c4446a4.zh: 我们需要加强工会，并保护本国工业，如有必要，也包括贸易保护措施。

e5cc0009ce298e3c70e31fb5842f80563a155f6d.source: We stand steadfast in support of this tariff. It is one of the few positive accomplishments of Mr. Tyler's so-called Presidency.
e5cc0009ce298e3c70e31fb5842f80563a155f6d.zh: 我们坚定支持这项关税。它是泰勒先生那个所谓总统任期中，为数不多的积极成果之一。

b93094881b678358575b10dd38d810d803c65162.source: We still need a national health care system. We still need a federal education system. Our work is never finished as long as poverty exists in the United States.
b93094881b678358575b10dd38d810d803c65162.zh: 我们仍需要全国性的医疗保障体系，也需要联邦教育体系。只要美国还存在贫困，我们的工作就永远没有完成。

93c6020c8d39f8624f1ec13b6b01ce2d27d383fb.source: We support the admission of Kansas as a free state, as soon as possible.
93c6020c8d39f8624f1ec13b6b01ce2d27d383fb.zh: 我们支持尽快接纳堪萨斯以自由州身份加入联邦。

b6c57ad20b3f007b20054e0b6f1d0885d1dd5522.source: We support the free coinage of silver priced at a 16-to-1 ratio against gold. The results will aid farmers and workers of all classes and contribute to an American renewal.
b6c57ad20b3f007b20054e0b6f1d0885d1dd5522.zh: 我们支持按金银比价16∶1自由铸造银币。这将帮助各个阶层的农民和工人，推动美国复兴。

5e20babad9e5904121fceabcc864006e302fd445.source: We support this idea as a positive step for working men in this country.
5e20babad9e5904121fceabcc864006e302fd445.zh: 我们支持这个主张，认为它对本国劳动者是积极的一步。

c75751152de5dde8e5157a2135b6e538709402a6.source: We take the issues affecting minority communities very seriously. We're going to push for police reform, clean water, economic justice, and we're going to denounce Trump's dangerous and hateful rhetoric.
c75751152de5dde8e5157a2135b6e538709402a6.zh: 我们非常认真地对待影响少数族群的问题。我们会推动警务改革、清洁用水和经济公正，也会谴责特朗普危险而充满仇恨的言论。

931e98991c81e8d428d31cee5fd3695960adedde.source: We want Sanders on the campaign trail as much as possible, and we will discuss with him what we can do to make it happen.
931e98991c81e8d428d31cee5fd3695960adedde.zh: 我们希望桑德斯尽可能多地参加竞选活动，会和他商量，看看我们怎样才能促成这件事。

72ac146cd42cd201b3a5e6a13b494dcaee14a65a.source: We want to compete in every southern state. I will run to the right of Wallace on economic issues while lamenting the interference of the federal government in education and housing.
72ac146cd42cd201b3a5e6a13b494dcaee14a65a.zh: 我们要在南方每个州展开竞争。我会在经济问题上采取比华莱士更右的立场，同时抨击联邦政府对教育和住房的干预。

5fffc19fd74b8d4c19dccfa2d72c5c9afebcd4f3.source: We welcome the support of women and men. Where women are granted the vote, we are confident that they will support our ticket.
5fffc19fd74b8d4c19dccfa2d72c5c9afebcd4f3.zh: 我们欢迎妇女和男子的支持。在妇女拥有投票权的地方，我们相信，她们会支持我们的竞选组合。

9cf49d09438e712a3e624f42f55c77c60b92e1e9.source: We were trying to provide more aid to South Vietnam, but Congress would not approve additional expenditures. The results of that policy are clear.
9cf49d09438e712a3e624f42f55c77c60b92e1e9.zh: 我们曾尝试向南越提供更多援助，但国会不肯批准额外支出。这项政策的后果，现在已经很清楚了。

fef16cc78e16a6c59084b54aa5a5929f33ed5642.source: We will absolutely not address this in our campaign. If it comes to this next year, then we can make a more specific determination at that point.
fef16cc78e16a6c59084b54aa5a5929f33ed5642.zh: 我们绝不会在竞选中谈论这个问题。如果明年真走到那一步，到时再作更具体的判断。

629079e9129080595c4d824370c5bb56f9c34e10.source: We will attack Barack Obama relentlessly. He has gone back on his pledge to clean up our political system, he has destroyed hundreds of thousands of jobs in his first term, his values are out of touch with those of most Americans, and his health care reform is disastrous.
629079e9129080595c4d824370c5bb56f9c34e10.zh: 我们会毫不留情地攻击贝拉克·奥巴马。他背弃了整顿政治体系的承诺，第一个任期毁掉了数十万个工作岗位；他的价值观与多数美国人格格不入，医疗改革也灾难深重。

53a03fe0906d33093aca05b71b114df8f666ba5c.source: We will attack Mitt Romney relentlessly. He has flip-flopped on key issues and he destroyed thousands of jobs at Bain Capital. He is out of touch with the American people, and he's attacking us for a health care plan that is nearly identical to his own plan in Massachusetts.
53a03fe0906d33093aca05b71b114df8f666ba5c.zh: 我们会毫不留情地攻击米特·罗姆尼。他在关键议题上反复变卦，在贝恩资本毁掉了数千个工作岗位。他不了解美国人民的生活，却因为我们的医疗改革而攻击我们；这套改革和他自己在马萨诸塞州实行的方案几乎一样。

0e0c3ac8f8a74f930435eca0726c38d8944a9d57.source: We will attack Southern Democrats the same as we would Northern Democrats. They represent the same ideas about slavery -- they differ only in their boldness about it.
0e0c3ac8f8a74f930435eca0726c38d8944a9d57.zh: 我们将像攻击北方民主党人一样攻击南方民主党人。他们在奴隶制问题上的观念相同，只是表现得大胆与否有所区别。

db4851d4b4dd38a8bb28490b6c62ea1062783ae3.source: We will attack the Republican embrace of immigration as opportunistic and disingenuous. It doesn't take a genius to figure out which party the Know Nothings joined.
db4851d4b4dd38a8bb28490b6c62ea1062783ae3.zh: 我们将抨击共和党拥护移民的态度，指出那是投机取巧、虚情假意。稍加思考，就知道一无所知党人后来加入了哪个政党。

8621615dfbc5df0657fb5c39ca3704159098fc21.source: We will attack the Republican penchant for underhanded racist attacks which they have displayed in this campaign.
8621615dfbc5df0657fb5c39ca3704159098fc21.zh: 我们会抨击共和党热衷于卑劣的种族主义攻击。他们在这次竞选中已经暴露了这一点。

d14910af8874acbbc5c2d9cc6e346d9202251a09.source: We will attack the prison furlough system in general, perhaps with a “revolving door” ad or something of that nature. And the Willie Horton episode is certainly an egregious example of the practice.
d14910af8874acbbc5c2d9cc6e346d9202251a09.zh: 我们要从整体上攻击离监休假制度，比如拍一则“旋转门”广告。霍顿事件当然就是这个制度最恶劣的例子。

48af5f6468c1c27e16a91218d390fff60b559357.source: We will be asking, “Where's the indictment?!” every day in my speeches, and on social media.
48af5f6468c1c27e16a91218d390fff60b559357.zh: 我会每天在演说和社交媒体上问：“起诉呢？！”

c3eb13177a88f3a69ae4279cb0baa3ff86d7bb57.source: We will campaign up and down New York and the Eastern Seaboard.
c3eb13177a88f3a69ae4279cb0baa3ff86d7bb57.zh: 我们将在纽约州和东海岸各地竞选。

53e71c2df2e378d5fd242af607f6966e1d6e876f.source: We will condemn the activity of any such self-styled revolutionaries. John Brown was a fanatic and a lunatic.
53e71c2df2e378d5fd242af607f6966e1d6e876f.zh: 我们将谴责任何这类自封革命者的行动。约翰·布朗是个狂热分子，也是个疯子。

3959bc84b4ab6d7267e42a446d1a346f988f1b4e.source: We will defend our base at Guantanamo and do anything else that is necessary if Cuba continues its hostility. However, it is too early to make a conclusive determination at this point.
3959bc84b4ab6d7267e42a446d1a346f988f1b4e.zh: 如果古巴继续敌视我们，我们将保卫关塔那摩基地，并采取其他一切必要措施。不过，目前还不宜作出最终判断。

2e001eaa0ff4cb828455bffb80f766f20f0a1c0d.source: We will dispatch a military expedition to Mexico, with clear orders to continue their pursuit regardless of any interference that may arise from the nation's Carranza government.
2e001eaa0ff4cb828455bffb80f766f20f0a1c0d.zh: 我们将派远征军进入墨西哥，明确命令他们继续追击，不理会卡兰萨政府可能采取的任何阻挠。

8c002994b6f3119d7c1318c8c910200f6532e133.source: We will emphasize that a vote for Al Gore is a vote for the scandals and liberal policies of the Clinton Administration. We offer a true, conservative alternative to the American people. I will discuss my evangelical Christianity and small-government beliefs.
8c002994b6f3119d7c1318c8c910200f6532e133.zh: 我们会强调，投票给阿尔·戈尔，就是投票支持克林顿政府的丑闻和自由派政策。我们为美国人民提供真正的保守派选择。我会谈论自己的福音派基督教信仰，以及小政府理念。

326eb8fd5787f9eed3eb1be5840322b10231dc50.source: We will focus on Texas and the South.
326eb8fd5787f9eed3eb1be5840322b10231dc50.zh: 我们将集中争取得克萨斯州和南方。

07766dd0bf284ee17832d118e535b493f2e67867.source: We will focus on free-silver and especially on the issues affecting farmers. We will seek a reduction in private debts and an end to the monopolistic practices of the railroads. We will also fight for the lowest possible tariffs.
07766dd0bf284ee17832d118e535b493f2e67867.zh: 我们将以自由铸银为重点，特别关注影响农民的问题。我们要减轻私人债务，结束铁路公司的垄断做法，也要争取尽可能低的关税。

a5dc9a2d55c45ae250eef3d7998e2111afdb0b61.source: We will focus on the Midwest.
a5dc9a2d55c45ae250eef3d7998e2111afdb0b61.zh: 我们将集中争取中西部。

b31805d8b94b842474ff5b8376a1985f7e5e78b0.source: We will focus on the Southwest, starting in New Mexico and Oklahoma, and finishing in Texas.
b31805d8b94b842474ff5b8376a1985f7e5e78b0.zh: 我们会集中力量在西南部，从新墨西哥州和俄克拉荷马州开始，最后到得克萨斯州。

1b8127acf50b5935fdb16db9b3c4dbc948d202d2.source: We will frame Texas as an issue of national pride and national expansion. I rebuke the idea of Calhoun that this is purely a Southern enterprise.
1b8127acf50b5935fdb16db9b3c4dbc948d202d2.zh: 我们将把得克萨斯描述为关乎国家荣誉和领土扩张的问题。我反对卡尔霍恩将此视为纯粹南方事业的说法。

bb0d845c7bcbc5330a0778160c7c9b89638ad686.source: We will hammer Bush on his lack of experience and qualifications for the Presidency. We should point to the tactics his operatives used to defeat John McCain as evidence that he is not nearly as moderate and conciliatory as he claims to be. We will point out his connections to America's economic elites.
bb0d845c7bcbc5330a0778160c7c9b89638ad686.zh: 我们会紧抓布什缺乏担任总统的经验和资格这一点。我们应指出，他的操盘手为了击败约翰·麦凯恩而使用的手段，证明他远没有自己所说的那么温和、那么愿意和解。我们会指出，他与美国经济精英的联系。

c920e310e1794ae6bde1bbdcce0871dc2e37e800.source: We will hammer on this theme, and particularly Mr. Bush's claim that he knew nothing about it. What kind of executive is he if he knew nothing about Iran-Contra?
c920e310e1794ae6bde1bbdcce0871dc2e37e800.zh: 我们会紧抓这个主题，特别是布什先生声称自己对此一无所知这一点。要是连伊朗门都不知情，他算什么行政领导人？

dad94a7a1fbd8acb5714f6e8c01eeb4ebbed77fb.source: We will hit the West Coast hard, from Washington, through Oregon, down to California.
dad94a7a1fbd8acb5714f6e8c01eeb4ebbed77fb.zh: 我们会沿西海岸大力竞选，从华盛顿州经过俄勒冈州，一路到加利福尼亚州。

97f1ec16f88e32d253d3448337b7af9c7ef17649.source: We will keep silent on this episode as we campaign.
97f1ec16f88e32d253d3448337b7af9c7ef17649.zh: 我们在竞选中不会评论这件事。

2095fd7832ebff2af9b4fe9b2794b1536ca3754b.source: We will never recognize or annex the so-called Hawaiian government while I am President.
2095fd7832ebff2af9b4fe9b2794b1536ca3754b.zh: 只要我担任总统，我们就绝不会承认所谓的夏威夷政府，也不会吞并它。

c475619c31fd7f11888e2c7fe6a6668fd738799e.source: We will never win the peace in Vietnam by caving in to the Communists. I cannot support such an ill-conceived measure.
c475619c31fd7f11888e2c7fe6a6668fd738799e.zh: 向共产党人屈服，绝不可能赢得越南的和平。我不能支持这样考虑不周的措施。

96f834bde285ef95d128a1f3726e883033c589fc.source: We will not recognize Israel. There's no way we can divert resources from Europe to defend that nation, and we would be seriously jeopardizing our relations with oil-producing Arab states.
96f834bde285ef95d128a1f3726e883033c589fc.zh: 我们不会承认以色列。我们无法从欧洲转移资源来保卫这个国家，而且我们将严重危及我们与阿拉伯产油国的关系。

a04294183ee6bb446fdc405dde9b6220d2dc705c.source: We will plan our own visit to that state, and call upon the Governor and his opponents equally, to avoid giving offense.
a04294183ee6bb446fdc405dde9b6220d2dc705c.zh: 我们将自行安排赴该州的行程，对州长和他的对手一视同仁地拜访，以免得罪任何一方。

6deb3db98db6d657c8816fb7d316bb132c0cd7d6.source: We will point out that the Reagan EPA is chiefly at fault for the lack of funds and action in that case, and we'll attack Bush's dishonesty.
6deb3db98db6d657c8816fb7d316bb132c0cd7d6.zh: 我们会指出，里根政府的环保署应对这件事缺乏资金、行动迟缓负主要责任，并攻击布什的不诚实。

da3ccf08b11e667c3d49f0bcdf4db8b32b835b8d.source: We should have more laws and regulations to reduce our total carbon emissions. Sensible next steps include some combination of a cap-and-trade program domestically, as well as international agreements with other nations.
da3ccf08b11e667c3d49f0bcdf4db8b32b835b8d.zh: 我们应该制定更多法律法规，减少碳排放总量。合理的下一步，包括把国内的总量控制与排放权交易计划，同与其他国家达成的国际协定结合起来。

a8fd1412a88e4ba53bcd2eda4ba3809610ec720d.source: We should hold back on this kind of rhetoric, given the unusual nature of this year's election.
a8fd1412a88e4ba53bcd2eda4ba3809610ec720d.zh: 鉴于今年大选的特殊情况，我们应当克制这种言辞。

e1b90449c4eea1a1b877c60a29bc78a137a275eb.source: We should incorporate Medicare into a larger, universal single-payer health insurance program. Many proposals I hear about are overly cautious and lacking in ambition.
e1b90449c4eea1a1b877c60a29bc78a137a275eb.zh: 我们应当把老年医疗保险纳入更广泛、覆盖全民的单一支付方医疗保险制度。我听到的许多提议都过于谨慎，缺乏雄心。

d84f757ac71d89581feb2f8812a476db61d24344.source: We should keep the tax cuts as is for the foreseeable future. I don't think it's sound economics to rise taxes on this group.
d84f757ac71d89581feb2f8812a476db61d24344.zh: 在可预见的未来，我们应该维持现有减税政策。我不认为对这群人增税是合理的经济政策。

0e65aeebde4fd94a7c03e78d51f7bb59ae7ecddd.source: We should monitor these expenditures very closely to make sure that they are being allocated properly. There is always the chance of cronyism and misappropriation when there is spending of this magnitude.
0e65aeebde4fd94a7c03e78d51f7bb59ae7ecddd.zh: 我们应该非常密切地监督这些支出，确保资金分配妥当。如此大规模的支出，总存在裙带关系和资金挪用的风险。

a9fe306d3003119a3e7b9f1a456a2a70313cb504.source: We should monitor this program very carefully to determine if it can be done in a cost-effective manner.
a9fe306d3003119a3e7b9f1a456a2a70313cb504.zh: 我们应当仔细监督这项计划，看看能否以合理的成本实施。

061b13d8e2173f1bf3b294f5ffa33c37c5685048.source: We should not have the federal government involving itself in the health care business. Private enterprise has built an outstanding health care system and will continue to do so in the future.
061b13d8e2173f1bf3b294f5ffa33c37c5685048.zh: 联邦政府不应介入医疗行业。私人企业已经建立了出色的医疗体系，今后也会继续如此。

4c30cf97cb7f905ab252bcd4c9c1dac0202a516e.source: We should put our focus into Georgia and North Carolina.
4c30cf97cb7f905ab252bcd4c9c1dac0202a516e.zh: 我们应该重点争取佐治亚州和北卡罗来纳州。

7027911a1dbb6c452061f9959fe4c68592ddc172.source: We should stop bombing North Vietnam and attempt to negotiate a peace settlement. In the mean time, we should be putting our troops at risk only when absolutely necessary.
7027911a1dbb6c452061f9959fe4c68592ddc172.zh: 我们应停止轰炸北越，尝试谈判达成和平解决方案。在此期间，只有在绝对必要时，才应让我们的部队冒险。

4c2079f9399d67e32a143930cc4aae021f1f9fc6.source: We should talk about states rights' and the Democrats plan to destroy the 10th amendment.
4c2079f9399d67e32a143930cc4aae021f1f9fc6.zh: 我们应该谈州权，以及民主党人摧毁第十修正案的计划。

fa380ca99bcca1b9b1485686f28db1bcf876f65b.source: We should try to keep things as they are. The economy has been unusually good the past few years, and we already have a large federal debt to pay down.
fa380ca99bcca1b9b1485686f28db1bcf876f65b.zh: 我们应当尽量维持现状。过去几年经济异常良好，而且我们已经有大笔联邦债务需要偿还。

38ae5c1772ebd7fb2216220823b57d6603c4c2af.source: We shouldn't be taking any refugees from Syria. We're talking about some very bad people here, who don't have America's interests at heart.
38ae5c1772ebd7fb2216220823b57d6603c4c2af.zh: 我们不应该接纳任何来自叙利亚的难民。这里说的可是一些非常糟糕的人，他们并不关心美国利益。

277a3c8daef8819a5b6313808367101558f2daac.source: We shouldn't dignify Donald Trump's views with a debate. I will decline to participate in them.
277a3c8daef8819a5b6313808367101558f2daac.zh: 我们不应该通过辩论，抬高特朗普观点的地位。我会拒绝参加。

652e6281fb1a4bda73011e59d5baa129ba2d144c.source: We shouldn't mention Nader by name, but it wouldn't be a bad idea to emphasize the more liberal aspects of our platform to reduce his support.
652e6281fb1a4bda73011e59d5baa129ba2d144c.zh: 我们不应点名提纳德，但强调纲领中更偏自由派的部分、减少他获得的支持，也不是坏主意。

9f9b3a9bc843483f1096422dd6a77e4f7af6c0c9.source: We won't have much to say about Frelinghuysen. He seems to avoided the vices which have plagued Henry Clay throughout his life.
9f9b3a9bc843483f1096422dd6a77e4f7af6c0c9.zh: 我们不会对弗里林海森作过多评论。他似乎没有沾染那些困扰亨利·克莱一生的恶习。

7499027b4d185b4298e4683ab38b0bc9144c32c4.source: We won't say anything about this, except when Ms. Clinton attacks us. We will bring it up in that case as a counterattack.
7499027b4d185b4298e4683ab38b0bc9144c32c4.zh: 我们不会谈这件事，除非克林顿女士攻击我们。那种情况下，我们会提出来反击。

95665ad638564fd22852a911a1ebf84ea0ccf316.source: We would also like to move a little more in the direction of lower tariffs, but overall this is a good law.
95665ad638564fd22852a911a1ebf84ea0ccf316.zh: 我们也希望进一步降低关税，但总的来说，这是一部不错的法律。

d6ba26cdd8a3cb64819108a5adaa18d6a102add6.source: We would be better served to focus on other issues as we campaign.
d6ba26cdd8a3cb64819108a5adaa18d6a102add6.zh: 竞选中，我们最好把重点放在其他议题上。

64884b0c01288a407d76add73f2328a50fc6ac01.source: We would do better to focus on political views and attacks, rather than reemphasize my own heritage.
64884b0c01288a407d76add73f2328a50fc6ac01.zh: 与其再次强调我的家世背景，不如着重宣传政治主张并发起攻击。

f6d90250ce360bb130b789d2461913c81c896da6.source: We would have stabilized Iraq and won a great victory there, if we hadn't pulled out so hastily.
f6d90250ce360bb130b789d2461913c81c896da6.zh: 如果我们没有那么仓促地撤出，就能让伊拉克稳定，取得伟大胜利。

01976e6396ef079224371c39319bf0312b886633.source: We would prefer for tariffs to be higher, but the creation of a Tariff Commission is certainly a sensible step in the right direction.
01976e6396ef079224371c39319bf0312b886633.zh: 我们希望提高关税，但成立关税委员会，无疑是朝着正确方向迈出的明智一步。

bb592f4ff4e2efac258a9c3b938610a4e8de1e86.source: We'd be more than happy to see Bernie Sanders on the campaign trail this fall, if that's what he wants.
bb592f4ff4e2efac258a9c3b938610a4e8de1e86.zh: 如果伯尼·桑德斯愿意，我们非常欢迎他在今年秋天参与竞选活动。

2ec0dbe063d90e826823449df0359b3b60de377b.source: We'll arrive in New York via Ohio and Pennsylvania.
2ec0dbe063d90e826823449df0359b3b60de377b.zh: 我们途经俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州，最后抵达纽约州。

4bf8bdc42369663ee056ec9bf90a736a992c500c.source: We'll attack the Constitutional Union party the same as any other opponents.
4bf8bdc42369663ee056ec9bf90a736a992c500c.zh: 我们将像攻击其他对手一样攻击宪法联邦党。

e2d15cc5be37237efff00338ebd1e4d1c82d95d3.source: We'll attack the Republicans the same as any other opponents.
e2d15cc5be37237efff00338ebd1e4d1c82d95d3.zh: 我们将像攻击其他对手一样攻击共和党。

e0483663895fec25ef83c32cafcea9262e47a7d6.source: We'll attack the Southern Democrats the same as any other opponents.
e0483663895fec25ef83c32cafcea9262e47a7d6.zh: 我们将像攻击其他对手一样攻击南方民主党人。

ec06a59d21472b591be42d040e2b522ca6670b99.source: We'll barnstorm as much of the Midwest as we can, going from state to state.
ec06a59d21472b591be42d040e2b522ca6670b99.zh: 我们会尽可能在中西部巡回拉票，一个州接着一个州。

03eac994ada7a4b9266408c98fb835a7335f011a.source: We'll bring up Trump University whenever Trump attacks us. Maybe it will get him to shut up for a bit.
03eac994ada7a4b9266408c98fb835a7335f011a.zh: 只要特朗普攻击我们，我们就提特朗普大学。也许这样能让他闭嘴一会儿。

e3f14f57353e8be7afb28d4a1795691b48417678.source: We'll criticize this as much as anything else about Bush's campaign.
e3f14f57353e8be7afb28d4a1795691b48417678.zh: 我们会像批评布什竞选中的其他问题一样，批评这件事。

4502892a671eb52849449a9d4d53e74eb2000c16.source: We'll have to make decisions like these at some point. It's better to do so now when we still have some control over the outcome, rather than waiting for a budget crisis to kick in.
4502892a671eb52849449a9d4d53e74eb2000c16.zh: 这种决定，我们迟早得作。趁现在还能在一定程度上掌控结果就做决定，总比等预算危机爆发后再做要好。

1d4de85d8a96b4630ccff38c1a2b198853a51652.source: We'll need to pivot left somewhat if we want to cut in on Johnson's majority. By promising to respect the Civil Rights Act and highlighting our own forwardness on the issue, we can assuage liberal fears.
1d4de85d8a96b4630ccff38c1a2b198853a51652.zh: 要蚕食约翰逊的多数支持，我们得稍微向左转。承诺尊重《民权法案》，强调我们在这个议题上的积极态度，就能缓解自由派的担忧。

9da91c08bedb6cec53ab6fd752531fbb88bd362c.source: We'll take as many refugees as Saudi Arabia takes. And in any case, we're going to helping out with a safe zone in Syria to protect vulnerable people.
9da91c08bedb6cec53ab6fd752531fbb88bd362c.zh: 沙特阿拉伯接纳多少难民，我们就接纳多少。不管怎样，我们会帮助在叙利亚建立安全区，保护处境脆弱的人。

13bd9a1623747e20e4042c5b7ee3c2f8dac15e63.source: We'll win some states and lose some states in the South. I will campaign elsewhere in the country and ignore racial issues as much as possible.
13bd9a1623747e20e4042c5b7ee3c2f8dac15e63.zh: 在南方，我们会赢下一些州，也会输掉一些州。我会到全国其他地区竞选，尽可能不谈种族问题。

e6d3c3410c702f086728ef6c335c85e7aa698cb6.source: We're going to appear with Barack and Michelle, but we need to be careful about running for the third term of Obama's Presidency. There are significant differences between us as well.
e6d3c3410c702f086728ef6c335c85e7aa698cb6.zh: 我们会与贝拉克和米歇尔共同亮相，但必须谨慎，不能把竞选变成争取奥巴马的第三个任期。我们之间也有重大差别。

9d83e6113f48787ba2a52053cccb9bad7ad6e464.source: We're going to be fair, but we're going to be tough. I've always supported the rule of law in my career, for decades now, regardless of what some right-wing websites try to say about me.
9d83e6113f48787ba2a52053cccb9bad7ad6e464.zh: 我们会公平，也会强硬。几十年来，在整个政治生涯中，我一直支持法治，不管一些右翼网站想怎么说我。

6763ca6c37e956df7aa78623cd953c463321d1f5.source: We're going to be having huge infrastructure projects to rebuild our country. We can't be dependent on China to power our economy or it will be a disaster.
6763ca6c37e956df7aa78623cd953c463321d1f5.zh: 我们会开展大规模基础设施项目，重建国家。我们不能依赖中国来带动经济，否则将是一场灾难。

6ac79886943451b510772d30d2627e792c3c9658.source: We're going to be incredibly pro-Second Amendment. And it's definitely a factor I'll consider as we're making appointments, you know, with judges and so on.
6ac79886943451b510772d30d2627e792c3c9658.zh: 我们会极其坚定地支持第二修正案。在任命法官等人选时，你知道，这肯定是我要考虑的因素之一。

abfb671a4e76a01835521d0e5d75b9901656e75d.source: We're going to be incredibly strong on the Second Amendment. If you look at Hillary, she's very obviously someone who hates guns. And I mean, I'm just talking about the facts here. But we're going to make guns even more legal.
abfb671a4e76a01835521d0e5d75b9901656e75d.zh: 我们会极其坚定地支持第二修正案。看看希拉里，她显然讨厌枪支。我的意思是，我只是在讲事实。但我们要进一步放宽枪支的合法使用。

61a7a2e30cd2fc6be1ad93db137ce5dfff947b54.source: We're going to be mentioning Benghazi a lot in our campaign.
61a7a2e30cd2fc6be1ad93db137ce5dfff947b54.zh: 我们会在竞选中经常提起班加西。

3575ff69fc9247974a29b011b9381b3a9f5640c3.source: We're going to be putting out 2-3 tweets a day about how the Clintons have failed the black community on trade and immigration and criminal justice. We have an opening to do much better than Romney or McCain did with this group.
3575ff69fc9247974a29b011b9381b3a9f5640c3.zh: 我们每天会发两到三条推文，讲克林顿夫妇如何在贸易、移民和刑事司法上辜负黑人社群。在这个群体中，我们有机会比罗姆尼或麦凯恩做得好得多。

66e775fd4e2db41b073d7fd9b8d0c6a99910ecd6.source: We're going to build back better than ever before. I'm going to work for every American, repairing our critical infrastructure at home and our standing in the world.
66e775fd4e2db41b073d7fd9b8d0c6a99910ecd6.zh: 我们要比以往更好地重建。我会为每个美国人工作，修复国内的关键基础设施，以及我们在世界上的地位。

10a938f69a376143bf62258aa36eb6b290b5f09e.source: We're going to build the wall, and Mexico is going to pay for it.
10a938f69a376143bf62258aa36eb6b290b5f09e.zh: 我们要修那堵墙，而且墨西哥要为它付钱。

0a3a7472620dfafa27c5afddc8f8ab054d2123c3.source: We're going to campaign hard in Michigan, Wisconsin, and Iowa on this final day of the campaign.
0a3a7472620dfafa27c5afddc8f8ab054d2123c3.zh: 竞选最后一天，我们会在密歇根州、威斯康星州和艾奥瓦州大力竞选。

171d9aca390cb656b334f0182cd3bd8230e39e1a.source: We're going to campaign hard in Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota on this final day of the campaign.
171d9aca390cb656b334f0182cd3bd8230e39e1a.zh: 竞选最后一天，我们会在密歇根州、威斯康星州和明尼苏达州大力竞选。

c2350de5e6e6cfb5073a0cc1ea67cd95736c0043.source: We will print and mail campaign material in massive quantities. We will hire speakers to blanket the four corners of the nation. We will print ads every day in every major paper. Bryan cannot compete with us on money.
c2350de5e6e6cfb5073a0cc1ea67cd95736c0043.zh: 我们会大量印制、邮寄竞选材料，雇请演说者走遍全国，每天在各大报纸刊登广告。论资金，布赖恩争不过我们。

caf62ea2191b25acf768e88e8f59bc1d489ae170.source: We will recognize Israel. It is the right thing to do in the aftermath of the Holocaust, and if that's not enough, we can kiss New York good-bye if we don't.
caf62ea2191b25acf768e88e8f59bc1d489ae170.zh: 我们会承认以色列。经历大屠杀之后，这是应当做的事；如果这个理由还不够，那么不承认它，我们就别想赢下纽约州了。

5bd79a67f2d8a6b7b8f5d293a29fc6f5ed1fe557.source: We will refer to this episode on our campaign speeches and so on, but it doesn't need to be a central aspect of our message.
5bd79a67f2d8a6b7b8f5d293a29fc6f5ed1fe557.zh: 我们会在竞选演说等场合提到这件事，但不必把它当作宣传的核心。

9db2498a140b2b93a2d0dc73a10ed4728365beea.source: We will remind laborers that inflation will debase the value of their wages. Silver coinage is a rural policy.
9db2498a140b2b93a2d0dc73a10ed4728365beea.zh: 我们会提醒劳工，通货膨胀会降低工资的价值。白银铸币是面向农村的政策。

5d74c1be7681944ce4c1c5d5bc3874bca36639ae.source: We will respect the rights of the states. I call for greater understanding, but certainly not for an overthrow of the natural order.
5d74c1be7681944ce4c1c5d5bc3874bca36639ae.zh: 我们会尊重各州的权利。我呼吁增进相互理解，但绝不是要推翻自然秩序。

f1a1ef39836e96115578868e85df50bb6ee7c6fa.source: We will run a heavily biographical campaign this fall, including ads which highlight my military service.
f1a1ef39836e96115578868e85df50bb6ee7c6fa.zh: 今年秋天，我们将大力围绕我的个人经历开展竞选，包括突出我军旅经历的广告。

a564130de2616bc408fbfa8551fef67b44f88342.source: We will run a national campaign and gather as many votes as possible towards our goal of becoming a viable third-party. I will tell liberal Americans to resist the urge to vote for Al Gore, by reminding them of the many ways in which he does not differ from Republicans.
a564130de2616bc408fbfa8551fef67b44f88342.zh: 我们将开展全国竞选，尽可能多地争取选票，朝着成为一个有竞争力的第三党的目标迈进。我会提醒自由派美国人，戈尔在许多方面与共和党人并无区别，劝他们克制投票给阿尔·戈尔的冲动。

1d827c100d1b0a0005f5caed7601a61e2fcfd714.source: We will send overtures to Mr. Seward and invite him to come visit us in Springfield. It's important to have a united party.
1d827c100d1b0a0005f5caed7601a61e2fcfd714.zh: 我们会向苏厄德先生示好，邀请他到斯普林菲尔德拜访我们。保持党内团结很重要。

8062b84682af7db08604fa12f63ff6eab8701234.source: We will strike a balance between emphasizing my own experience, along with making some attacks on George Bush.
8062b84682af7db08604fa12f63ff6eab8701234.zh: 我们会在强调我自身经验与攻击乔治·布什之间取得平衡。

64a4b5432d6924b69418cb3c3b3366a32dbedbcb.source: We will take the attack to the Republican Party this fall -- it is impossible to satisfy the demands of both wings of that party, and Hughes must surely cast his lot with one and alienate the other.
64a4b5432d6924b69418cb3c3b3366a32dbedbcb.zh: 今年秋天，我们将主动攻击共和党：那个党的两派诉求，根本无法同时满足。休斯必然要选择一方，疏远另一方。

ce8a49a287ab0bb5d9cab6b46420910c8b1d064f.source: We will travel to California and the West Coast.
ce8a49a287ab0bb5d9cab6b46420910c8b1d064f.zh: 我们将前往加利福尼亚州和西海岸。

dbc038bd60b2811a2b880e4d6f92bb71ebe375f2.source: We will vigorously enforce the Monroe Doctrine, the same way that we have since 1823. This includes support for the struggles of the people in Cuba, should they gain independence. We also appreciate Grover Cleveland's vigorous action in Venezuela last year.
dbc038bd60b2811a2b880e4d6f92bb71ebe375f2.zh: 我们将像 1823 年以来那样大力执行门罗主义。这包括支持古巴人民的斗争（如果他们获得独立）。我们也赞赏克利夫兰去年在委内瑞拉采取的积极行动。

2d9c9e31bc42781eab25e84b7006201b8d758d95.source: We won't address Mr. Walker's letter directly, but we are in favor of annexation.
2d9c9e31bc42781eab25e84b7006201b8d758d95.zh: 我们不会直接评论沃克先生的信，但我们赞成吞并。

686f2ba86e8bf358bd373d921b712c117ca60fd3.source: We're going to repeal and replace Obamacare under my Administration. And under my new plan, people are going to get unbelievable health care like they've never seen before.
686f2ba86e8bf358bd373d921b712c117ca60fd3.zh: 在我执政期间，我们要废除并取代奥巴马医改。按照我的新方案，大家会得到前所未见、好得难以置信的医疗保障。

76c71f84eb807ad26eba6ff4ba5aeaae0cc21f40.source: We're going to spend our final day in Florida, rallying the Hispanic, Jewish, and black communities against the outrages of Donald Trump and his campaign.
76c71f84eb807ad26eba6ff4ba5aeaae0cc21f40.zh: 我们会把最后一天安排在佛罗里达州，团结西班牙裔、犹太人和黑人群体，反对唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选团队的恶劣行为。

84ae35318743f57f157393738f2ca8b4c89d4fce.source: We're going to support anyone in this country who tries to get a college education. We're going to protect Social Security and make sure our veterans are adequately cared for.
84ae35318743f57f157393738f2ca8b4c89d4fce.zh: 我们会支持本国每一个努力接受大学教育的人。我们要保护社会保障，确保退伍军人得到妥善照顾。

baf9b397adba16e166927638f6500130b5515402.source: We're going to take care of people when I'm President. Absolutely no cuts to Social Security and Medicare. We have millions and millions of people relying on these programs.
baf9b397adba16e166927638f6500130b5515402.zh: 我当上总统后，我们会照顾好人民。绝不削减社会保障和老年医疗保险。数以百万计的人靠着这些项目生活。

e765f5f01771d7d2ddd7cb078b2d8e84a6df580b.source: We're going to tremendously push for an infrastructure bill. And you know, one of my favorite pieces of infrastructure is The Wall. That would create so many jobs for a very low cost, but certain people don't want to protect America.
e765f5f01771d7d2ddd7cb078b2d8e84a6df580b.zh: 我们会大力推动基础设施法案。你知道，我最喜欢的一项基础设施，就是那堵墙。它能以很低成本创造很多工作，但某些人不想保护美国。

3537a75e9e2336360140e6afa454b3f694f33d01.source: We're going to undo some of these policies from day one, and I plan to make a strong push for an immigration reform bill that can help us deal with the backlog of asylum applications, and bring some of the undocumented out of the shadows.
3537a75e9e2336360140e6afa454b3f694f33d01.zh: 我们会从第一天起撤销其中一些政策。我还计划大力推动一项移民改革法案，帮助处理积压的庇护申请，并让部分无证移民不必再躲藏生活。

231c42ec25bc661ef62dfbfd83a94c17c9698ba7.source: We're going to visit Colorado and Nevada, and maybe a short stop in Arizona, to rally Hispanic turnout and highlight Trump's outrages for a final time.
231c42ec25bc661ef62dfbfd83a94c17c9698ba7.zh: 我们会访问科罗拉多州和内华达州，也许在亚利桑那州短暂停留，动员西班牙裔投票，并最后一次强调特朗普的恶劣行为。

6a33fb11ca7acda409cc43a9803b4c1cf3a96185.source: We're going to visit Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota. I want us to appear with Bernie Sanders and Barack Obama to push our message on trade, the African-American turnout, and party unity.
6a33fb11ca7acda409cc43a9803b4c1cf3a96185.zh: 我们会访问密歇根州、威斯康星州和明尼苏达州。我希望与伯尼·桑德斯和贝拉克·奥巴马共同亮相，传达我们在贸易、提高非裔美国人投票率和党内团结方面的信息。

96f2af95adbc7bc2207b521e5b43d12ec5b36648.source: We're going up the Eastern Seaboard, from Maryland all the way to Connecticut.
96f2af95adbc7bc2207b521e5b43d12ec5b36648.zh: 我们沿东海岸北上，从马里兰州一直到康涅狄格州。

c4d64e8dd52e74c366119130c7760133266fcd1d.source: We're in the midst of a COVID pandemic and Trump has refused to accept the legitimacy of this year's results. I think it's best if we buy a 30-minute TV slot and take my case directly to the American people.
c4d64e8dd52e74c366119130c7760133266fcd1d.zh: 我们正处于新冠疫情中，特朗普又不肯承认今年选举结果的正当性。我认为，最好买下三十分钟的电视时段，直接向美国人民陈述我的主张。

d784184cb845486575c577e35f2d322a2b963f0c.source: We're just now asking this question? The federal government has been bloated for decades.
d784184cb845486575c577e35f2d322a2b963f0c.zh: 我们现在才问这个问题？联邦政府已经臃肿了几十年。

a069bb5558c4949db4fffc524de0b989f9fdb93e.source: We're not going to have a national lockdown. That's just fear-mongering from the Republicans to distract from how they've mishandled the pandemic. This is something each locality can decide for themselves, based on local conditions.
a069bb5558c4949db4fffc524de0b989f9fdb93e.zh: 我们不会实行全国封锁。那只是共和党人在制造恐慌，转移大家对他们疫情处置失当的注意力。这件事，各地可以根据当地情况自行决定。

fc417423cf083ab203f60ff254eb39fc4bf9e6cd.source: We're out here to show that we understand what it's gonna take to fix black America and open our great prosperity to all Americans. And it could be a really wonderful thing if we get people like Ben Carson in the right place to make a difference.
fc417423cf083ab203f60ff254eb39fc4bf9e6cd.zh: 我们出来竞选，是要表明自己懂得如何解决美国黑人群体面临的问题，让全体美国人共享这个国家的繁荣。如果让本·卡森这样的人处在能够发挥作用的位置上，那可能真是一件好事。

c46f05ea41d4e57b5b7ed8e50616db7e98289bab.source: We're proud to have Dan Quayle on the ticket, and he will be making important appearances in key swing states this fall.
c46f05ea41d4e57b5b7ed8e50616db7e98289bab.zh: 我们很自豪能与丹·奎尔组成竞选搭档。今年秋天，他将到关键摇摆州参加重要活动。

1c23e05fd202aafe1bc0c657f5c3ee080feacbf5.source: We're way ahead, so why screw up a good thing? I will talk in general about the future greatness of this country once I'm President, and avoid alienating any potential allies or partners in government.
1c23e05fd202aafe1bc0c657f5c3ee080feacbf5.zh: 我们遥遥领先，何必搞砸大好局面？我会泛泛谈论自己当上总统之后，这个国家将有多么伟大的未来，避免疏远任何潜在盟友或执政伙伴。

6547150802163ba4bcf63aef83fbc109dc08f4d2.source: We've all seen Hillary Clinton lie about this scandal from the first day until now, and she's still lying about it. It's unbelievable what she thinks she can get away with.
6547150802163ba4bcf63aef83fbc109dc08f4d2.zh: 我们都看到了，从第一天到现在，希拉里·克林顿一直在这场丑闻上撒谎，现在还在撒谎。她以为自己能蒙混过关，真让人难以置信。

d7158ab4225bf9fc392db77571312dcb0356be14.source: We've all seen the issues with the European Union, and it obviously hasn't been perfect. But I'd hope that any country consider things very carefully before they decided to leave.
d7158ab4225bf9fc392db77571312dcb0356be14.zh: 我们都看到了欧盟的问题，它显然并不完美。但我希望，任何国家在决定离开之前，都非常慎重地考虑。

5d7e8bd391c698b10414dea852b5821cb85717ef.source: We've already built most of the wall during my first term, actually. The failing New York Times barely talks about it. I feel pretty good that The Wall will be there for a long time to come.
5d7e8bd391c698b10414dea852b5821cb85717ef.zh: 其实，我们在第一任期内已经建好了大部分墙。日渐衰败的《纽约时报》几乎不谈这个。我很有信心，这堵墙会屹立很久。

1a38bf304ea6003c4b518865cf5162aeda4a6145.source: We've both changed our opinions about things in the past. Let's be judicious about the attacks that we make.
1a38bf304ea6003c4b518865cf5162aeda4a6145.zh: 我们过去都改变过一些观点。我们发动攻击时，还是审慎一点吧。

264ed83ee4fde377beb0961464b9184130a7e398.source: We've built a lot of infrastructure already. One of the things the media never talks about is The Wall, we've built hundreds of miles of beautiful wall on the border. And so I'm not sure we need another big bill right now.
264ed83ee4fde377beb0961464b9184130a7e398.zh: 我们已经建了很多基础设施。媒体从来不谈的一件事，就是那堵墙。我们在边境建了几百英里漂亮的墙。所以，我不确定现在还需要另一项大型法案。

038cb3bd8db4936b8ce5f95123b2fbe9d26936fb.source: We've done some unbelievable things for conservatism in America, things people wouldn't have dreamed of four years ago. The largest tax cuts in history. Fighting for religious freedom. Standing up to China. I'm very proud.
038cb3bd8db4936b8ce5f95123b2fbe9d26936fb.zh: 我们为美国保守主义做了些令人难以置信的事，四年前人们根本不敢想。史上最大规模的减税，争取宗教自由，对抗中国。我非常自豪。

1245f0ca32e3d5099d2cde4fac66797f3de780b4.source: We've got a lot of issues to focus on and galvanize people. It seems like people respond a lot better, to be honest, they respond better when I'm talking about the corruption of the Clintons. About guns, you know, that kind of thing.
1245f0ca32e3d5099d2cde4fac66797f3de780b4.zh: 我们有很多议题可以聚焦，激发大家的热情。老实说，讲克林顿夫妇的腐败时，大家的反应似乎好得多。还有枪支，你知道，就是这类事情。

24d0e51b653c20cd8c2b7b1da8d1a11b7919f8e0.source: We've got a small troop presence in Afghanistan right now, and we should probably keep it that way. I'm confident that country will continue to gradually stabilize over time, with a consistent but minimal investment from the United States.
24d0e51b653c20cd8c2b7b1da8d1a11b7919f8e0.zh: 我们目前在阿富汗的驻军规模很小，大概应该维持如此。我相信，只要美国持续但有限地投入，这个国家就会随着时间逐渐稳定。

b34cf6e9c38dc350934e45d7cd449073479ec3b4.source: We've had a terrific President in Barack Obama for the last eight years. I will do everything in my power to defend his policies from attack.
b34cf6e9c38dc350934e45d7cd449073479ec3b4.zh: 过去八年，贝拉克·奥巴马是一位出色的总统。我会尽我所能，捍卫他的政策，抵御攻击。

54db0c7b7b2cd3582884bbf680ce87c8b13e125a.source: We've had too many competing votes and constitutions to make any determination about Kansas. We should not admit that state at this time, until there is more clarity.
54db0c7b7b2cd3582884bbf680ce87c8b13e125a.zh: 关于堪萨斯，彼此竞争的投票和宪法方案太多，难以下定论。目前不应接纳它入联邦，必须等局势更明朗。

5d221df66bd68f50fd0ccc4c529fd7ee3c3716da.source: We've obviously had our falling out at the Convention this year, but we will eventually need to rebuild our party. Going on the attack in this case will only make things worse.
5d221df66bd68f50fd0ccc4c529fd7ee3c3716da.zh: 今年党代会上，我们显然已经闹翻，但最终仍需要重建本党。这时候展开攻击，只会让事情更糟。

8b58375647412fa912e6c44c80b49628cdfb1756.source: We've run up quite a national debt over the past few years, and rightly so, but now that World War II is over, we should focus on paying down this debt.
8b58375647412fa912e6c44c80b49628cdfb1756.zh: 过去几年，我们累积了相当多的国债，而且这样做有其道理。但第二次世界大战既然已经结束，我们就应该着力偿还债务。

9da8d888fef282ae57502a9bd74b4ab727c16125.source: We've seen alarming measures during Wilson's first term. I stand firmly opposed to the income tax, the new interference with business, and the reduction in tariffs which will undermine our prosperity.
9da8d888fef282ae57502a9bd74b4ab727c16125.zh: 威尔逊第一任期推出的一些措施令人担忧。我坚决反对所得税、对企业的新干预，以及将损害我国繁荣的降低关税政策。

364e8c799f78410b7e2ee57a650dee603d583f7e.source: We've seen some alarming things out of Cuba, but this isn't necessarily a lost cause. Cuba has not declared itself a Communist state and we should be making overtures to prevent that.
364e8c799f78410b7e2ee57a650dee603d583f7e.zh: 古巴出现了一些令人担忧的事，但不一定已无可挽回。古巴尚未宣布自己是共产主义国家，我们应该主动接触，防止它走到那一步。

f635c46fd71b0e81ed2c6b3fa6bf8662c990e1c0.source: We've taken moderate, sensible steps thus far. I support the mobilization of additional troops, along with other policies designed to maintain peace and deter aggression.
f635c46fd71b0e81ed2c6b3fa6bf8662c990e1c0.zh: 到目前为止，我们采取了温和、务实的措施。我支持动员更多部队，并配合其他旨在维持和平、威慑侵略的政策。

4f679ade74f201c97f42f7addbc948a58cb01166.source: We've tried to build Afghanistan into a stable, modern nation for nearly 20 years now, spending over $1 trillion in the process. It's time for their government to stand on its own, without American troops.
4f679ade74f201c97f42f7addbc948a58cb01166.zh: 近二十年来，我们一直试图把阿富汗建成一个稳定的现代国家，为此花了超过一万亿美元。现在，是他们的政府在没有美国军队的情况下独立支撑起来的时候了。

21746e028ef96e79ebeefb0027876ea1ce3c3ea1.source: We're going to crack down on waste and fraud. There's a terrible amount of bad stuff going on out there.
21746e028ef96e79ebeefb0027876ea1ce3c3ea1.zh: 我们要严厉打击浪费和欺诈。外头有太多糟糕透顶的事。

36d0151bff69d88aa05490f86a8e1aab64932d36.source: We're going to defeat COVID and get America working again. I'm going to push for this day and night from the moment I step into the White House.
36d0151bff69d88aa05490f86a8e1aab64932d36.zh: 我们要击败新冠疫情，让美国重新运转。从踏入白宫的那一刻起，我就会日夜推动这件事。
