0acae93a27a16545b09389fad4745e38a84528a0.source: We're going to do some tremendous rallies in Nevada and Colorado. Some truly unbelievable rallies.
0acae93a27a16545b09389fad4745e38a84528a0.zh: 我们要在内华达州和科罗拉多州办几场盛大的集会。一些真正让人难以置信的集会。

409410d46b2a2522261ef7d6123dcbce3ca54ba1.source: We're going to end NAFTA and we're going to get a new deal with China when I'm President. What's happened with trade in the last twenty years is a disgrace.
409410d46b2a2522261ef7d6123dcbce3ca54ba1.zh: 等我当上总统，我们要终止《北美自由贸易协定》，还要跟中国谈一份新协议。过去二十年贸易上发生的事，是个耻辱。

0b7a47e80d44f69653f7b1837a5942b34a2f72aa.source: We're going to find whoever did this and bring them to justice. And let us remember, our country is at its best when we stand united. Islam is a religion of peace, and we only encourage the spread of terrorism if we overreact against innocent, patriotic Americans in the wake of this.
0b7a47e80d44f69653f7b1837a5942b34a2f72aa.zh: 我们要找出凶手，让他们接受司法制裁。也请记住，国家团结一致时，才最能发挥力量。伊斯兰教是和平的宗教；如果事后对无辜、爱国的美国人反应过度，只会助长恐怖主义蔓延。

6d6f34e4bde689cb46caa89d9e9ef8fd602ceb65.source: We're going to head out west and do some rallies in Arizona and Nevada. I think we'll win both of those states and really surprise a lot of people.
6d6f34e4bde689cb46caa89d9e9ef8fd602ceb65.zh: 我们会向西，去亚利桑那州和内华达州办几场集会。我认为，两州我们都会赢下，让很多人真正大吃一惊。

ebe826b77f0bb3d05e7670e63f2fbfc28923a970.source: We're going to hit our rolodex and solidify our campaign organization and fundraising. I'm going to hit the trail for Democrats in the 2014 midterms. We will be well-prepared to outspend Jeb Bush and we will unite the party before the primaries.
ebe826b77f0bb3d05e7670e63f2fbfc28923a970.zh: 我们要动用人脉，巩固竞选组织和筹款能力。我会在2014年中期选举中为民主党奔走助选。我们会做好充分准备，在竞选支出上压过杰布·布什，并在初选前团结全党。

85bfed9e40d7fadbe2cde09478fb8af70de82f08.source: We're going to hit the Midwest, from Ohio to Wisconsin and Iowa.
85bfed9e40d7fadbe2cde09478fb8af70de82f08.zh: 我们去中西部，从俄亥俄州到威斯康星州和艾奥瓦州。

2536d59a5157ed9b88c8630930752a175f05e8ef.source: We're going to hit the West Coast, and especially California.
2536d59a5157ed9b88c8630930752a175f05e8ef.zh: 我们将前往西海岸，尤其是 加利福尼亚州。

78fe33a431e2cd172dc513ea89254d583722d1f8.source: We're going to pass the greatest tax cut in history when I'm President, you can count on it. And we're going to fix the mess that Obama has left with this terrible economy.
78fe33a431e2cd172dc513ea89254d583722d1f8.zh: 我当上总统后，我们要通过有史以来最大规模的减税，你尽管放心。我们还要收拾奥巴马在这个糟糕经济下留下的烂摊子。

6b8cb550e5bf903f752c93941fbae9c1c58ecad9.source: We're going to propose an infrastructure bill pretty soon after my inauguration, and it's going to be $500 billion or more. We're going to put people to work rebuilding our roads, bridges, ports, and power grid for the 21st century.
6b8cb550e5bf903f752c93941fbae9c1c58ecad9.zh: 就职后不久，我们就会提出一项基础设施法案，规模至少五千亿美元。我们要让人们参与重建道路、桥梁、港口和电网，使之适应二十一世纪。

1ccd630ad5711c53db1fd1c5dfc2d07d576399a8.source: We're going to release the vaccine when it's safe to do so, as soon as we can. We have the best researchers and the best drug companies in the world, and what they've accomplished in this short period of time is astounding.
1ccd630ad5711c53db1fd1c5dfc2d07d576399a8.zh: 我们会在安全时，尽快推出疫苗。我们有世界上最好的研究人员和制药公司，他们在这么短时间内取得的成绩，令人惊叹。

9ac149e0106f0226c2eee71c68b2cfea440ba97f.source: Well connected to the mainstream Democratic establishment, there are few complaints about Biden's performance thus far, though he does have a reputation as being gaffe-prone.
9ac149e0106f0226c2eee71c68b2cfea440ba97f.zh: 与主流民主党建制派有着良好的联系，迄今为止，几乎没有人对 拜登 的表现提出抱怨，尽管他确实有容易失态的名声。

f009fac3c44a5b1ddfe979ce474a7b1874db1d1c.source: Well done! You've prevented another term of Democrats and succeeded your father as the next Republican president. You barely won, however, so let’s hope your bipartisanship and compassionate conservativism resonate with many Americans.
f009fac3c44a5b1ddfe979ce474a7b1874db1d1c.zh: 干得好！你阻止了民主党再次执政，继你父亲之后成为下一位共和党总统。不过你只是险胜，所以但愿你的两党合作与富有同情心的保守主义，能引起许多美国人的共鸣。

900bc8784f166be72906e3c13b00c948ba70600e.source: Well done! You've prevented another term of Democrats and succeeded your father as the next Republican president. You've managed to flip a few seats in the house and Senate, but it's best you act quickly on your promises or the midterms could take that all away.
900bc8784f166be72906e3c13b00c948ba70600e.zh: 干得好！你阻止了民主党再次执政，继你父亲之后成为下一位共和党总统。你设法夺下了众参两院的一些席位，但最好尽快兑现承诺，否则中期选举可能把这一切夺走。

1e9efa58a9f076defa825482ea51975d1ec0cbc4.source: Well done! You've prevented another term of Democrats and succeeded your father as the next Republican president. Your impressive margin allows the Senate and House to stay in Republican hands, with a Republican president for the first time since Dwight Eisenhower!
1e9efa58a9f076defa825482ea51975d1ec0cbc4.zh: 干得好！你阻止了民主党再次执政，继你父亲之后成为下一位共和党总统。你取得了令人印象深刻的优势，使众参两院继续掌握在共和党手中，这是德怀特·艾森豪威尔以来首次由共和党同时掌握总统职位和两院！

57871a9dbed0254ed493144dbf0cae751ad4d3b1.source: West Virginia State Board of Education v. Barnette
57871a9dbed0254ed493144dbf0cae751ad4d3b1.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州教育委员会诉巴尼特案

d3257a1923fe9021310806b561e0a1c7522e2905.source: We’ll be sure to enforce the Act to the best of our abilities. Anything past that, I can’t. We’ll do what we need to do, whether that’s another Act or not.
d3257a1923fe9021310806b561e0a1c7522e2905.zh: 我们会尽最大努力执行这项法案。除此之外，我无法作出承诺。无论是否需要另一项法案，我们都会采取必要的行动。

3772fd11a14f5e524871acf616b3a6abeccfb347.source: We’ll stick to typical railing against Republicans. Anything drastic we do will just anger one side or the other. Leave it for some other poor bastard to clean up.
3772fd11a14f5e524871acf616b3a6abeccfb347.zh: 我们就照常抨击共和党人。任何大动作都会惹恼其中一方。留给别的倒霉蛋去收拾吧。

3b936d75a70c96e9ff5a6c36a1e28e0697e9417e.source: We’re going to expand welfare, expand Social Security, expand Medicare, and give the average American a leg up. It’s what the American people deserve.
3b936d75a70c96e9ff5a6c36a1e28e0697e9417e.zh: 我们会扩大福利、扩大社会保障、扩大老年医疗保险，让普通美国人得到更多助力。这是美国人民应得的。

ddbb66150395e03d1352bc9d1ad3064e6144929d.source: We’re seeing a lot of growth with what we’re doing now, and the last thing we should do is rock the boat. You won’t see any big changes to government policy in my next term.
ddbb66150395e03d1352bc9d1ad3064e6144929d.zh: 目前的政策正带来可观的增长，最不应该做的就是打乱局面。我的下一任期，政府政策不会有重大改变。

9eb32db2d5e1c89f1bc02d9c4ac9f47cbf139aa5.source: We’re so far ahead, why should we even bother? A fair portion of our base already dislikes the war, and we have no reason to remind them.
9eb32db2d5e1c89f1bc02d9c4ac9f47cbf139aa5.zh: 我们领先这么多，何必费心？我们的基本盘中已有相当一部分人不喜欢这场战争，我们没理由再提醒他们。

65c3dec7f36a5bd716302e8c0edce4a73d41d7f4.source: What can you say? We've all been out here for weeks with very little sleep. No one knows more about foreign policy than Joe Biden, so I'm sure it was just a slip of the tongue.
65c3dec7f36a5bd716302e8c0edce4a73d41d7f4.zh: 还能说什么呢？我们在外面奔波了好几个星期，几乎没睡。没人比乔·拜登更懂外交政策，所以我相信，他只是一时口误。

a1aae618cdcca34584bebf6e95cc7fb839d3e7c6.source: What controversy? Three seats opened up, and I filled those seats. Now Democrats want to destroy the very foundation of judicial independence that our entire democracy rests upon.
a1aae618cdcca34584bebf6e95cc7fb839d3e7c6.zh: 什么争议？空出了三个席位，我补上了。现在，民主党却想摧毁我们整个民主赖以存在的司法独立基础。

650758d7d6994f6124f4c725fd09abb93104e687.zh: 对于怀疑你在这次选举中是否真心致力于保守派事业的人，你有什么话要说？你会作出什么重大姿态吗？

0178eb9a8b65f0abb828a1a1139cd05cf9727951.source: What do you make of Martin Van Buren's 1842 visit to Henry Clay's estate? Is Clay too friendly with Northern interests?
0178eb9a8b65f0abb828a1a1139cd05cf9727951.zh: 马丁·范布伦曾在1842年造访亨利·克莱的庄园。你如何看待此事？克莱是不是与北方利益集团走得太近了？

27cc3bdddede9a8d6d9825867814ef78c0958fdb.source: What do you make of Woodrow Wilson's response to the raids and outrages of Pancho Villa?
27cc3bdddede9a8d6d9825867814ef78c0958fdb.zh: 对于伍德罗·威尔逊应对潘乔·比利亚袭击和暴行的做法，你怎么看？

6ba78635ef555e817e3da56bcb33f4f692b5fb76.source: What do you make of the Preparedness Day Parades which have sprung up across the country this summer?
6ba78635ef555e817e3da56bcb33f4f692b5fb76.zh: 今年夏季，全国各地兴起了“备战日”游行。你对此怎么看？

0efc56e43a137dda6f6c7fb9222c4334ea8fe694.source: What do you say to the notion that high tariffs hurt farmers?
0efc56e43a137dda6f6c7fb9222c4334ea8fe694.zh: 对于“高关税损害农民”这一说法，你如何回应？

049a7b9b3730f12a24eac72fa7554f9b411fc180.source: What do you think about proposals for the federal government to build an expansive interstate highway system?
049a7b9b3730f12a24eac72fa7554f9b411fc180.zh: 对于由联邦政府建设大规模州际公路系统的提议，你怎么看？

2deaa0c6571a06784d1488aaddeb0f49878e33a5.source: What do you think about the efforts of the AFL-CIO and other large unions? Do they have a positive effect on America?
2deaa0c6571a06784d1488aaddeb0f49878e33a5.zh: 你如何看待劳联—产联及其他大型工会的活动？它们对美国产生了积极影响吗？

c71b735f9b54b301423a56846013e55909e7887d.source: What do you think about the proposed Constitutional Amendment to limit the President to two terms in office?
c71b735f9b54b301423a56846013e55909e7887d.zh: 有人提议通过宪法修正案，将总统任期限制为两届。你怎么看？

b830c4b25687a129602a43ee3203233df6715b66.source: What do you think of Bill Clinton's recent action to tap the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to reduce the costs of home heating, particularly in the northeast?
b830c4b25687a129602a43ee3203233df6715b66.zh: 比尔·克林顿最近决定动用战略石油储备，降低家庭取暖成本，特别是东北部地区的成本。你对此有什么看法？

df9c786bfc7e179e141610c5246508a59a474647.source: What do you think of leaving the Midwest for a week and making a circuit of the crucial upper South states? (i.e. Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, and Kentucky)
df9c786bfc7e179e141610c5246508a59a474647.zh: 你会离开中西部一周，巡访几个关键的南方北部州吗？（即特拉华、马里兰、弗吉尼亚、西弗吉尼亚和肯塔基。）

b70939952ed2cf1b05d33e1533c1786b441a91c1.source: What do you think of programs that require schools to use busing to achieve racial balance?
b70939952ed2cf1b05d33e1533c1786b441a91c1.zh: 对于要求学校用校车接送学生、以实现种族构成平衡的计划，你怎么看？

276681c0f6df1a14b8e28c842880876f2dee9794.source: What do you think of proposals to build a sophisticated missile defense system in Eastern Europe?
276681c0f6df1a14b8e28c842880876f2dee9794.zh: 你如何看待在东欧建立先进导弹防御系统的提议？

9fd893f581e3513b60958ef857bce4a95615c473.source: What do you think of the late Dr. Martin Luther King?
9fd893f581e3513b60958ef857bce4a95615c473.zh: 你如何看待已故的马丁·路德·金博士？

9d2917a8fc3daf8419da9b732e3cdfc22a93cc61.source: What do you think the next steps should be in regards to Medicare?
9d2917a8fc3daf8419da9b732e3cdfc22a93cc61.zh: 你认为联邦医疗保险下一步应该怎么走？

15aebcc637410550393c9eb6ccf4be2402736ec8.source: What do you think we should do next in regards to Social Security?
15aebcc637410550393c9eb6ccf4be2402736ec8.zh: 你认为，社会保障下一步应该怎么走？

38bcb1b55057704379626d4990397f87f314abde.source: What do you want me to say? She's my wife. Can't people find something better to worry about?
38bcb1b55057704379626d4990397f87f314abde.zh: 你们想让我说什么？她是我妻子。难道大家就找不到更值得担心的事吗？

1df2a84015c884970a3d680cb56530236715de67.source: What do you want me to say? That I'd be happy if Sleepy Joe nominated four leftist judges to the Supreme Court in some hare-brained court-packing scheme? I'm sure if he does that, we'll be more than happy to retaliate when the voters put us back in charge.
1df2a84015c884970a3d680cb56530236715de67.zh: 你想让我说什么？说我会高兴地看着瞌睡乔，按某种荒唐的扩充法院方案，提名四位左翼大法官？我确信，要是他这么干，等选民让我们重新掌权，我们会很乐意反击。

4e9e55d823d612f9fbf2e62cc0eb0788b2a48f39.source: What does it sound like I said? We need extreme solutions to extreme problems.
4e9e55d823d612f9fbf2e62cc0eb0788b2a48f39.zh: 你觉得我的话听起来像什么意思？极端的问题，就需要极端的解决办法。

7403e6050e05d03fbe95b8e97fb975b45e6aab5b.source: What else can you say at this point? At least it seems like they won't be going after you personally, but this can't help with your favorability ratings.
7403e6050e05d03fbe95b8e97fb975b45e6aab5b.zh: 到了这个时候，你还能说什么？至少看来他们不会追究你本人，但这对公众好感度可没有帮助。

0382eb5adb585465013219ee33d87b6e8dc6f19f.source: What good is a Court decision banning segregation if we don't actually do something to integrate our schools? People oppose busing because they oppose school integration, pure and simple.
0382eb5adb585465013219ee33d87b6e8dc6f19f.zh: 如果我们不实际采取措施，让学校实现种族融合，法院禁止隔离的判决又有什么用？人们反对校车接送，就是因为他们反对学校种族融合，事情就是这么简单。

fac9d738a153d4d54aa3787f3593832415f545b4.source: What grand gesture? I'll just remind them that Hillary Clinton is going to be President if I lose.
fac9d738a153d4d54aa3787f3593832415f545b4.zh: 什么重大姿态？我只要提醒他们，如果我输了，希拉里·克林顿就会当总统。

c8baae0baef66544a4fe15f9b92270ca9ae53a43.source: What happened in Orlando last right was a terrible tragedy, and our thoughts and prayers go out to everyone affected.
c8baae0baef66544a4fe15f9b92270ca9ae53a43.zh: 昨夜在奥兰多发生的事是一场可怕的悲剧。我们牵挂所有受影响的人，为他们祈祷。

dd191e077a487d1e66ed4684f0b640b7f5fd8c94.source: What happens next is your choice. Another governorship wouldn't hurt, and perhaps you can run again in 4 years if you're up to it. Unfortunately (for you), civil rights will persist.
dd191e077a487d1e66ed4684f0b640b7f5fd8c94.zh: 接下来怎么做，由你决定。再当一届州长也无妨；如果你愿意，也许四年后还可以再次参选。遗憾的是——对你而言——民权政策仍将继续。

afe95adf4f5785b3caa85b04e0d5b9711b55c160.source: What is your opinion on measures that would aim to restrict the sale or production of alcohol?
afe95adf4f5785b3caa85b04e0d5b9711b55c160.zh: 你如何看待限制酒类销售或生产的措施？

32d2ce8040a5015c476a484dddd973b71dad8575.source: What is your opinion on the 'gunwalking' tactics that led to the 'Fast and Furious' scandal?
32d2ce8040a5015c476a484dddd973b71dad8575.zh: 你对导致“速度与激情”丑闻的“放枪追踪”手法有何看法？

79d3dd51e4733f119a53229233fca596a676870e.source: What is your opinion on the Tea Party movement?
79d3dd51e4733f119a53229233fca596a676870e.zh: 你对茶党运动有何看法？

e9855883847889150cac23880a53eae5fe1a363b.source: What is your opinion on the court-ordered busing of students within school districts, in a way designed to achieve racial balance in our schools?
e9855883847889150cac23880a53eae5fe1a363b.zh: 你对法院命令学区通过校车接送学生、以实现学校种族构成平衡，有何看法？

a811ba19597186a665a123f70739f3856b6c0fe9.source: What is your opinion on the current level of education funding in the United States? Would you increase federal education funding, even if it meant higher taxes or a larger budget deficit?
a811ba19597186a665a123f70739f3856b6c0fe9.zh: 你对美国目前的教育经费水平有什么看法？即使意味着提高税收或扩大预算赤字，你也会增加联邦教育经费吗？

35730a3011c9a0732d411ef63093a49844c4002d.source: What is your opinion on the expansion of mail-in voting and early voting in this election? Do you have any concerns?
35730a3011c9a0732d411ef63093a49844c4002d.zh: 你对这次选举扩大邮寄投票和提前投票有什么看法？有什么顾虑？

eb524cb781ea8b33a553f19683a53507f783ecf6.source: What is your opinion on the formation of fusion tickets in the Northern states to consolidate the anti-Lincoln vote?
eb524cb781ea8b33a553f19683a53507f783ecf6.zh: 你如何看待北方各州组成联合选举人名单，以整合反林肯选票的做法？

2853c061185a16c8c988404dff3f61b3465a83e7.source: What is your opinion on the legality of abortion? Would you attempt to legalize or prohibit this practice at the federal level?
2853c061185a16c8c988404dff3f61b3465a83e7.zh: 你对堕胎是否合法有何看法？你会尝试在联邦层面将其合法化，还是禁止堕胎？

cee948b148da5e0397cbc85ff5f09faf35be19dd.source: What is your opinion on the overthrow of the Hawaiian monarchy by the Dole group? Do you support the annexation of Hawaii into the United States?
cee948b148da5e0397cbc85ff5f09faf35be19dd.zh: 你如何看待多尔集团推翻夏威夷君主制？你支持美国吞并夏威夷吗？

da068c1259e4d02326f7e04c160e4f0eb46549ed.source: What is your opinion on the performance and conduct of our current President, Bill Clinton?
da068c1259e4d02326f7e04c160e4f0eb46549ed.zh: 你如何评价现任总统比尔·克林顿的执政表现和行为？

544024a47b26396a782ba5b110bd2928db450cf2.source: What is your opinion on the recent Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty?
544024a47b26396a782ba5b110bd2928db450cf2.zh: 你如何看待最近签订的《中程核力量条约》？

8ff18675f4e7c74a97f51c20d6ad907997da8395.source: What is your opinion on the selection of Dan Quayle as George Bush's running mate?
8ff18675f4e7c74a97f51c20d6ad907997da8395.zh: 对于乔治·布什选择丹·奎尔作为竞选搭档，你怎么看？

ef78da9def7a67d9e35afd784b989a8f725d6ada.source: What is your overall position on the Vietnam War?
ef78da9def7a67d9e35afd784b989a8f725d6ada.zh: 你对越南战争的总体立场是什么？

ff88628950581beb72c6f8d5257ce9ed8fd7d538.source: What is your overall strategy for the 2000 campaign?
ff88628950581beb72c6f8d5257ce9ed8fd7d538.zh: 你在2000年竞选中的总体策略是什么？

896bebb8acaceb8f212bf48df7079718aee983a5.source: What is your position on American trade policy? How do you feel about the World Trade Organization or NAFTA?
896bebb8acaceb8f212bf48df7079718aee983a5.zh: 你对美国贸易政策持什么立场？你如何看待世界贸易组织或《北美自由贸易协定》？

a787a54ae8ebda1db6dee76e70d4694d0f375797.source: What is your position on Rural Free Delivery of the mail, signed into law earlier this year by Grover Cleveland? Is this an acceptable strain to place on the finances of the Post Office?
a787a54ae8ebda1db6dee76e70d4694d0f375797.zh: 你如何看待格罗弗·克利夫兰今年早些时候签署成法的农村免费投递邮件制度？让邮政部门承担这笔财政负担，是否可以接受？

983574b4ab5df6ba808a7599b359f85289ccea39.source: What is your position on a pardon of Vietnam War draft evaders?
983574b4ab5df6ba808a7599b359f85289ccea39.zh: 对于赦免逃避越南战争征兵者，你持什么立场？

6325485518affd54215b5d0710c85121e80102af.source: What is your position on abortion?

65e0f9097bfed81052a29f47cc2fa97e2e203e01.source: What is causing the massive increase of crime in America? How will you reverse the trend?
65e0f9097bfed81052a29f47cc2fa97e2e203e01.zh: 美国犯罪大幅增加的原因是什么？你将如何扭转这种趋势？

171b7f25dd325fd5f1bd7b2e541dfc7af9d62a77.source: What is more important for your campaign -- competing with Humphrey in the swing states, or winning over Wallace voters in the south?
171b7f25dd325fd5f1bd7b2e541dfc7af9d62a77.zh: 对你的竞选来说，哪件事更重要：在摇摆州与汉弗莱竞争，还是争取南方的华莱士选民？

8dd68ed29f64a26baa5df63771d606ae84a6b8a2.source: What is more important for your campaign -- competing with Nixon in the swing states, or winning over Wallace voters in the south and some northern cities?
8dd68ed29f64a26baa5df63771d606ae84a6b8a2.zh: 对你的竞选来说，哪件事更重要：在摇摆州与尼克松竞争，还是争取南方及北方部分城市的华莱士选民？

088ef90ae8b24d5eee9ae09b51c5bae4e050e2d0.source: What is more important to you -- competing with Nixon in the border states (to help Humphrey) or winning over Humphrey voters in the northern cities (to help Nixon)?
088ef90ae8b24d5eee9ae09b51c5bae4e050e2d0.zh: 对你而言，哪件事更重要：在交界各州与尼克松竞争，帮助汉弗莱；还是在北方城市争取汉弗莱选民，帮助尼克松？

ea8ffaa886cb41a74d005910e1c3b1dcae489de6.source: What is the idea behind this outburst? The Bank War was, perhaps, Andrew Jackson's central initiative as President.
ea8ffaa886cb41a74d005910e1c3b1dcae489de6.zh: 你突然这么说，究竟是什么用意？“银行战争”或许是安德鲁·杰克逊担任总统时最核心的政治行动。

8dfa2808b5422a259f1d8b5ebe843100e662a201.source: What is the idea here? Henry Clay opposed to tariffs?
8dfa2808b5422a259f1d8b5ebe843100e662a201.zh: 这是怎么回事？亨利·克莱反对关税？

265a98061b7d3c443d13a8956a7cff9ffbc8972f.source: What is the maximum number of troops that you would commit to Vietnam?
265a98061b7d3c443d13a8956a7cff9ffbc8972f.zh: 你最多愿意向越南派遣多少军队？

c57bcd313bdd0ea1d69a946bc7ba03f6df53bb00.source: What is the overall theme of your campaign, remembering that the Democratic Party is underfunded and severely divided?
c57bcd313bdd0ea1d69a946bc7ba03f6df53bb00.zh: 鉴于民主党资金不足、内部分裂严重，你的竞选总体主题是什么？

eb56faa9baa91ea4244943ef492bfaf19592ce3b.source: What is the point? Are they going to make Gary Johnson the President? Why don't they just vote for Hillary and cut out the middle man.
eb56faa9baa91ea4244943ef492bfaf19592ce3b.zh: 有什么意义？他们能让加里·约翰逊当总统吗？为什么不直接投希拉里，省掉中间这一步？

c3e0c0b09a036de8f68f818627bf7cdc33307aff.source: What is your current position on the banking system?
c3e0c0b09a036de8f68f818627bf7cdc33307aff.zh: 你目前对银行制度持什么立场？

fa77e002e3c59526fa45f643d7ff2b6dfc001d72.source: What is your definitive position on the tariff issue?
fa77e002e3c59526fa45f643d7ff2b6dfc001d72.zh: 你对关税问题的明确立场是什么？

a03be2e26060276fd5427a19f122b710f4045deb.source: What is your guiding foreign policy philosophy?
a03be2e26060276fd5427a19f122b710f4045deb.zh: 你的外交政策遵循什么基本理念？

e353b4382e1766f33353b1325c18795eeb5db442.source: What is your interpretation of the antitrust statutes? Do large American business profit from monopolistic practices?
e353b4382e1766f33353b1325c18795eeb5db442.zh: 你如何解释反托拉斯法律？美国大企业是否从垄断行为中获利？

af2ec713fc1d113e78ee9e2cd4f9b1199a45eaf5.source: What is your opinion of Barack Obama's performance as President?
af2ec713fc1d113e78ee9e2cd4f9b1199a45eaf5.zh: 你如何评价贝拉克·奥巴马担任总统的表现？

5fde63f71f454c852a7ceb89f7b61fa3aa89e630.source: What is your opinion of Lyndon Johnson's new Medicare program?
5fde63f71f454c852a7ceb89f7b61fa3aa89e630.zh: 你如何看待林登·约翰逊新推出的老年医疗保险计划？

b3220cda3a8c9558d39f66bee35519479ab74eeb.source: What is your opinion of the Immigration and Nationality Act of 1965? Is it a good idea to liberalize our immigration policy and to outlaw national origin quotas?
b3220cda3a8c9558d39f66bee35519479ab74eeb.zh: 你如何看待1965年《移民与国籍法》？放宽移民政策、取消按国籍来源设置的配额，是好主意吗？

626d1aaa6f0c556c460865f93a4b50fb453c5c4f.source: What is your opinion of the military draft that is currently in place?
626d1aaa6f0c556c460865f93a4b50fb453c5c4f.zh: 你如何看待目前实行的征兵制度？

db54d48b24ff8e701e2e97f6f89df5eb23c6649b.source: What is your opinion on abortion, and specifically the recent
db54d48b24ff8e701e2e97f6f89df5eb23c6649b.zh: 您对堕胎有何看法，特别是最近的堕胎

b9e0692aa0db8b57cefca8596937c51e10c43ff1.source: What is your opinion on directing some Department of Education funding towards a school voucher program?
b9e0692aa0db8b57cefca8596937c51e10c43ff1.zh: 对于把教育部的一部分经费用于学券计划，你有何看法？

4d75e63f4a38a8a1a7189cc924335d2a10e99311.source: What is your take on the Black Lives Matter movement?
4d75e63f4a38a8a1a7189cc924335d2a10e99311.zh: 你如何看待“黑人的命也是命”运动？

52ef059a55c2715e3589324238d89ed1614182f4.source: What is your vision for the foreign policy of this country?
52ef059a55c2715e3589324238d89ed1614182f4.zh: 你对美国外交政策有什么愿景？

bd25bc8b7b1bee4f1f71c6aa835131f674e0ecad.source: What key points will you emphasize as you accept your party's nomination for President of the United States?
bd25bc8b7b1bee4f1f71c6aa835131f674e0ecad.zh: 接受本党美国总统候选人提名时，你将强调哪些要点？

7fe55a1cccc82309e96464687b7c13811b568585.source: What kind of tone will you attempt to set in your campaign this fall?
7fe55a1cccc82309e96464687b7c13811b568585.zh: 今年秋季，你打算为竞选定下什么样的基调？

15e653a9fed51d319b608240b7e4d35ffbf52aa6.source: What measures should be taken to assist states, such as Texas, which have been hurt by the recent crash in oil prices?
15e653a9fed51d319b608240b7e4d35ffbf52aa6.zh: 针对得克萨斯州等受到近期油价暴跌冲击的州，应采取什么援助措施？

8b737a87d44ff8511343e8dd4045624dccdc8263.source: What measures should be taken to make college more affordable?
8b737a87d44ff8511343e8dd4045624dccdc8263.zh: 应该采取哪些措施，让大学教育更容易负担？

8e5036b8eb4369750419e085a76105ddc95c1735.source: What message will you emphasize about the political views of Donald Trump on economic and budget issues?
8e5036b8eb4369750419e085a76105ddc95c1735.zh: 关于特朗普在经济和预算问题上的政治观点，你会着重传递什么信息？

7d54783728800a0d74a37262eb5a2fe1b332cc7e.source: What message will you emphasize as you accept your party's nomination for President of the United States?
7d54783728800a0d74a37262eb5a2fe1b332cc7e.zh: 接受本党美国总统候选人提名时，你会着重传递什么信息？

b93047103d0b6f620a408ae3eb37cddc9ca46f93.source: What motivated you to place Newton Baker on the ticket for your attempt at reelection?
b93047103d0b6f620a408ae3eb37cddc9ca46f93.zh: 在争取连任时，你为什么选择牛顿·贝克作为竞选搭档？

01d6460bd01a7a0f3a3b9c3073a9dc7504bd60e7.source: What motivated you to support the candidacy of Elmer Haskett for Vice President, as strongly as you did?
01d6460bd01a7a0f3a3b9c3073a9dc7504bd60e7.zh: 你为什么如此大力支持埃尔默·哈斯克特竞选副总统？

1bd6a3574f97959a7a257082b5b2448a03aaeaa2.source: What points about your opponent, Michael Dukakis, will you emphasize as you campaign?
1bd6a3574f97959a7a257082b5b2448a03aaeaa2.zh: 竞选时，你会着重强调对手迈克尔·杜卡基斯的哪些方面？

deaebb8e23c2eb6ba4b3c2dcfeca65fc58068e48.source: What points do you wish to touch upon as you accept the Republican nomination? A written transcript will be transmitted to voters across the country.
deaebb8e23c2eb6ba4b3c2dcfeca65fc58068e48.zh: 接受共和党提名时，你打算谈哪些要点？演说的书面稿将传送给全国各地的选民。

bac4a779934570c226ea2183f8c3ea008f7ec27d.source: What points will emphasize in your acceptance letter, as you accept the Democratic nomination for President?
bac4a779934570c226ea2183f8c3ea008f7ec27d.zh: 在接受民主党总统提名的公开信中，你将着重阐述哪些观点？

334d0f9727d7ac8555acd4f8e712dc5158ca76f7.source: What points will emphasize in your acceptance letter, as you accept the Whig nomination for President?
334d0f9727d7ac8555acd4f8e712dc5158ca76f7.zh: 在接受辉格党总统提名的公开信中，你将着重阐述哪些观点？

8226d0fb1fcc5b9db0929ba5c46d1c57df611856.source: What position should your party take on foreign immigration and nationalization in this election?
8226d0fb1fcc5b9db0929ba5c46d1c57df611856.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当对外国移民与入籍问题采取什么立场？

9047b34bc96fb30980f8f9e82712d8026c08ed3d.source: What position should your party take on the tariff question in this election?
9047b34bc96fb30980f8f9e82712d8026c08ed3d.zh: 在本次大选中，你们党应当对关税问题采取什么立场？

05dd06daecdedfb6c2dd22e5690f810c9b242afa.source: What position will you take in regards to the war in Europe as you campaign?
05dd06daecdedfb6c2dd22e5690f810c9b242afa.zh: 在竞选中，你会对欧洲战争采取什么立场？

73144d1f5d2863f9ebd2f56cf2f22a459fb6ef32.source: What position will you take on the Texas annexation issue?
73144d1f5d2863f9ebd2f56cf2f22a459fb6ef32.zh: 在吞并得克萨斯的问题上，你将采取什么立场？

e02e3431f14fc2642d90c0001d38556a3051af1d.source: What should your party's position be on the Tariff of 1842, which increased tariffs?
e02e3431f14fc2642d90c0001d38556a3051af1d.zh: 《1842年关税法》提高了关税。你们党应当对此持什么立场？

493ebb45e6e5d22d566f3ac00b4dd3df9884ab41.source: What should your party's position be on the raid of John Brown, late in 1859?
493ebb45e6e5d22d566f3ac00b4dd3df9884ab41.zh: 对于约翰·布朗在1859年末发动的突袭，你们党应当采取什么立场？

5bd89238b972536296808a6e8bdb36c35118b4f0.source: What steps will you take to reduce or increase spending as President, per your priorities?
5bd89238b972536296808a6e8bdb36c35118b4f0.zh: 作为总统，你会按照自己的优先事项，采取哪些措施削减或增加支出？

0e6f45111fb68b53a9546a7e1b5c22f14c988d6a.source: What themes will you emphasize as you accept the Democratic nomination and begin your campaign?
0e6f45111fb68b53a9546a7e1b5c22f14c988d6a.zh: 接受民主党提名、展开竞选时，你会强调哪些主题？

f7f31470b2c2f786b2f4abe9817364de57a9c9dc.source: What themes will you emphasize as you accept the Republican nomination and begin your campaign?
f7f31470b2c2f786b2f4abe9817364de57a9c9dc.zh: 在接受共和党提名、展开竞选时，你会强调哪些主题？

5dd5b0740c4407716abfddf20666c8d5470390c4.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Ben Carson as your running mate?
5dd5b0740c4407716abfddf20666c8d5470390c4.zh: 你选择本·卡森作为竞选搭档，理由是什么？

6fc8b9f9b2a6e55e074a66a737978ad88bbfe65c.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Bernie Sanders as your running mate?
6fc8b9f9b2a6e55e074a66a737978ad88bbfe65c.zh: 你选择伯尼·桑德斯作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

9d9856b5f31033cc8787df34ff571b5f932659e4.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Chris Christie as your running mate?
9d9856b5f31033cc8787df34ff571b5f932659e4.zh: 你选择克里斯·克里斯蒂作为竞选搭档，理由是什么？

22a5406290ae590ed0dac84a470c5a05e8914c5a.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Cory Booker as your running mate?
22a5406290ae590ed0dac84a470c5a05e8914c5a.zh: 你选择科里·布克作为竞选搭档，理由是什么？

6a0199cb02b8635d4f89983af8d68fecd7ec5ed5.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Elizabeth Warren as your running mate?
6a0199cb02b8635d4f89983af8d68fecd7ec5ed5.zh: 你选择伊丽莎白·沃伦作为竞选搭档，理由是什么？

6aa426f981ae04b75cd256990877811a103bdd06.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Jeff Sessions as your running mate?
6aa426f981ae04b75cd256990877811a103bdd06.zh: 你选择杰夫·塞申斯作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

926ef97fef93a5405419032b242a8bd56398f1c1.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Julian Castro as your running mate?
926ef97fef93a5405419032b242a8bd56398f1c1.zh: 你选择朱利安·卡斯特罗作为竞选搭档，理由是什么？

3f1e04a64dde9f9da7cdbcbb6ddc8012127d447f.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Mike Pence as your running mate?
3f1e04a64dde9f9da7cdbcbb6ddc8012127d447f.zh: 你选择迈克·彭斯作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

c54f2e66564ce7c97dc9058fc43440254097a2c6.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Sarah Palin as your running mate?
c54f2e66564ce7c97dc9058fc43440254097a2c6.zh: 你选择萨拉·佩林作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

0a361927c9f8f8f20681ed2a4a543b8098bd4cce.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Scott Brown as your running mate?
0a361927c9f8f8f20681ed2a4a543b8098bd4cce.zh: 你选择斯科特·布朗作为竞选搭档，理由是什么？

df422c9a8425d9705c60fdba990097d00be856dd.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Sherrod Brown as your running mate?
df422c9a8425d9705c60fdba990097d00be856dd.zh: 你选择谢罗德·布朗作为竞选搭档，理由是什么？

181ecaaee101891bbd8b1eaf045dcc8f9c20afa7.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Tim Kaine as your running mate?
181ecaaee101891bbd8b1eaf045dcc8f9c20afa7.zh: 你选择蒂姆·凯恩作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

d2d6deba43ca35efe833d31103c9578c3e723043.source: What we have now is a good compromise. I don't see any need to change current military policy.
d2d6deba43ca35efe833d31103c9578c3e723043.zh: 现行制度是一种不错的折中。我看不出有什么必要改变目前的军事政策。

bba243f814cbf7ea0d8a23a4edc862afc46ce5ef.source: What we have now is a good start, but we need to be taking more affirmative action to fight against the effects of racial injustice in this country.
bba243f814cbf7ea0d8a23a4edc862afc46ce5ef.zh: 现有措施是良好的开端，但我们还需要采取更多平权措施，消除这个国家种族不公造成的影响。

6d6679e8a2d3311519ead1b86da03deb6c685a9e.source: What we saw in Chicago was a police riot, pure and simple.
6d6679e8a2d3311519ead1b86da03deb6c685a9e.zh: 我们在芝加哥看到的是一场警察骚乱，纯粹而简单。

73576b7467c69960fb702cd95e9e4646266ee415.source: What we've done so far is a good start, but we're still far from prepared to meet the type of emergency which might arise.
73576b7467c69960fb702cd95e9e4646266ee415.zh: 我们至今所做的，是个不错的开端，但距离应付可能出现的紧急事态，还远远没有准备好。

9e2408f4a13f6e97f894f2513c77cfd093f48642.source: What is your position on capital punishment?

24e085f41b7bce3fd8a5f4ac8bc47b9086ed4f4b.source: What is your position on expanding the Clean Air Act of 1963? Do you believe that stricter enforcement against pollutants is necessary, or does the current law suffice?
24e085f41b7bce3fd8a5f4ac8bc47b9086ed4f4b.zh: 你对扩大1963年《清洁空气法》的适用范围有何立场？你认为有必要更严格地治理污染物，还是现行法律已经足够？

6908d3296d57bad85a55da1ec6ae3d690abd98a2.source: What is your position on gay marriage?
6908d3296d57bad85a55da1ec6ae3d690abd98a2.zh: 你对同性婚姻持什么立场？

0dced8b80b22a561dc14e1cb9d542815c04189ed.source: What is your position on gun control?
0dced8b80b22a561dc14e1cb9d542815c04189ed.zh: 你对枪支管制持什么立场？

fd88e57fb552c27c4652f0642a5a9919a2082544.source: What is your position on right-to-work laws? Would you support a national bill to repeal Taft-Hartley and do away with right-to-work?
fd88e57fb552c27c4652f0642a5a9919a2082544.zh: 你对工作权法持什么立场？你会支持通过全国性法案，废除《塔夫脱—哈特利法》，取消工作权法吗？

14c92251d581a1118bf8d55d721fc5f87e60666f.source: What is your position on the European Union? Do you believe that countries such as the United Kingdom should exit the Union, given the current problems?
14c92251d581a1118bf8d55d721fc5f87e60666f.zh: 你对欧盟持什么立场？考虑到目前的问题，你认为英国等国家应该退出欧盟吗？

c531ed0a0ac3f5dbe85f8af11dff64482b70dadf.source: What is your position on the Oregon boundary question?
c531ed0a0ac3f5dbe85f8af11dff64482b70dadf.zh: 你在俄勒冈边界问题上的立场是什么？

7fc4ead1bb065d8ee69c4e2a2258487508c0b6f8.source: What is your position on the Supreme Court's
7fc4ead1bb065d8ee69c4e2a2258487508c0b6f8.zh: 您对最高法院的立场是什么

e27b8d4f8966e8f7213ffce5f03a1649dbb1ffc1.source: What is your position on the Trans-Pacific Partnership? Would you pursue further trade agreements as President?
e27b8d4f8966e8f7213ffce5f03a1649dbb1ffc1.zh: 你对跨太平洋伙伴关系协定有什么立场？担任总统后，你是否会推动更多贸易协议？

b4b9ec58c27d538f980c03415d4470627e77f389.source: What is your position on the abortion issue?
b4b9ec58c27d538f980c03415d4470627e77f389.zh: 你在堕胎问题上持什么立场？

d7c4782e509b4770b6f8d65ef6dd3670fdc2e198.source: What is your position on the creation of land grant universities for secondary education?
d7c4782e509b4770b6f8d65ef6dd3670fdc2e198.zh: 你对设立用于中等教育的赠地大学持什么立场？

cb3b3057bc9c95b8d4f676f9d1bf9b0c3a2ac7cf.source: What is your position on the federal government making loans to states or cities in need of financial help? An obvious recent example is the $2.3 billion bailout of New York city.
cb3b3057bc9c95b8d4f676f9d1bf9b0c3a2ac7cf.zh: 你对联邦政府向需要财政帮助的州或城市提供贷款持什么立场？最近一个明显的例子，是向纽约市提供23亿美元救助。

ab3fb0990c449ea0d95edacfb59141514bfe68ac.source: What is your position on the need for a federal infrasctructure bill? How large should any package be?
ab3fb0990c449ea0d95edacfb59141514bfe68ac.zh: 你对联邦基础设施法案的必要性有什么立场？一揽子方案的规模应有多大？

3f2ccebbf768ddcacd3adb04af4bfa67dccd8a5c.source: What is your position on the passage of “personal liberty laws” by various states, to flout the Fugitive Slave Act?
3f2ccebbf768ddcacd3adb04af4bfa67dccd8a5c.zh: 一些州通过“个人自由法”，对抗《逃奴法》。你对此持什么立场？

5988a4cfb0e51c528ca33f9b90e4c91afd481133.source: What is your position on the power of labor unions in the United States?
5988a4cfb0e51c528ca33f9b90e4c91afd481133.zh: 你对美国工会的权力持什么立场？

88bdc7fa8c00e4267d5617ace349880a0dde5b20.source: What is your position on the social equality of blacks in American society?
88bdc7fa8c00e4267d5617ace349880a0dde5b20.zh: 你对美国社会中黑人的社会平等地位持什么立场？

c51371bc3103bb8ce28d09f755f7e4950cbf8fe1.source: What is your rationale for the recent truce in Afghanistan? Do you plan to pull out all American troops before the election?
c51371bc3103bb8ce28d09f755f7e4950cbf8fe1.zh: 你最近与阿富汗方面达成停战安排的理由是什么？是否打算在选举前撤出全部美军？

51ad2388de1d3b9e18a8c5bac2f923003d391d47.source: What is your reaction to the news that President Trump has contracted COVID-19 and been hospitalized?
51ad2388de1d3b9e18a8c5bac2f923003d391d47.zh: 得知特朗普总统感染新冠病毒并住院的消息，你有什么反应？

5bb1a3440fa9be6ae9126b603b5f0cacce49fbfa.source: What is your stance on the Six-Day War that occurred last year, and how should Israel handle the new territories it has taken possession of?
5bb1a3440fa9be6ae9126b603b5f0cacce49fbfa.zh: 你对去年发生的六日战争持什么立场？以色列应如何处理新占领的领土？

7ed300986221018a49e547f22d62f88ef2ab780d.source: What will your overall campaign strategy be this year?
7ed300986221018a49e547f22d62f88ef2ab780d.zh: 今年，你的总体竞选策略是什么？

4845b38c660cb3507e6ec9d5c9fd430c69a81fb8.source: What will your position be on the women's suffrage question as your campaign this fall?
4845b38c660cb3507e6ec9d5c9fd430c69a81fb8.zh: 今年秋季竞选时，你会在妇女选举权问题上采取什么立场？

aaf456ee6ae2b2b56fd20f20ee08f9d2b6be6eef.source: What would you do as President to combat increasing unemployment in America's industrial cities?
aaf456ee6ae2b2b56fd20f20ee08f9d2b6be6eef.zh: 作为总统，你会怎样应对美国工业城市日益严重的失业？

65a8d3e3190d984d87bf116c6a0a7c6779dd96fd.source: What would you do as President to get the exploding crime rate in this country under control?
65a8d3e3190d984d87bf116c6a0a7c6779dd96fd.zh: 作为总统，你会采取什么措施，控制国内急剧上升的犯罪率？

023a324484c2aca5a2fa959d4b4d846385962ef4.source: What you've achieved tonight is a stellar victory that will be studied for the rest of American history. From Nader’s Raiders to the White House in 30 years, let’s hope your surprise victory has also netted the Green Party some senate seats, or you’ll have to compromise big in the coming years, considering your stiff opposition from both parties. This definitely wasn’t supposed to happen - Good luck!
023a324484c2aca5a2fa959d4b4d846385962ef4.zh: 你们今晚取得的胜利是美国历史上值得研究的辉煌胜利。从纳德的攻略到30年后的白宫，我们希望你的意外胜利也为绿党赢得了一些参议院席位，否则考虑到双方的强烈反对，你将不得不在未来几年做出重大妥协。这绝对不应该发生——祝你好运！

c1789bdde7d0c1b2f2f708b22b130fbb9523b230.source: What you've said is true, but you've certainly staked out a liberal position on the issue.
c1789bdde7d0c1b2f2f708b22b130fbb9523b230.zh: 你说的属实，但你在这个问题上显然采取了自由派立场。

a76bb331735ebdcf4734e321b6d833c293cb8370.source: What's happening in Syria right now is obviously tragic. The last thing we need right now is the divisive and unstable leadership of Donald Trump to make things worse.
a76bb331735ebdcf4734e321b6d833c293cb8370.zh: 叙利亚正在发生的事情，显然是一场悲剧。我们现在最不需要的，就是唐纳德·特朗普分裂而不稳定的领导，让事情变得更糟。

214f507c8d61e2bab87a1c0fcd65d4edb96f39df.source: What's happening now in Europe is criminal. The working class is being punished to fulfill the avarice of huge, multinational banks. Germany should be doing much more to assist Greece, Italy, and Spain before it is too late.
214f507c8d61e2bab87a1c0fcd65d4edb96f39df.zh: 欧洲如今的情况简直是犯罪。劳动阶级受到惩罚，只为满足庞大跨国银行的贪欲。德国应该趁还来得及，为希腊、意大利和西班牙提供更多帮助。

01e667707650a76478ebbe9e535c126b0d487c18.source: What's wrong with a national bank? Your supporters are concerned by this statement.
01e667707650a76478ebbe9e535c126b0d487c18.zh: 国家银行有什么不好？你的支持者对这番表态感到担忧。

70b50def47d1f818ff34caf8bbddf601639e1253.source: What's wrong with letting New York decide this issue one way, and many other states can decide it the other way? I mean, am I nuts here?
70b50def47d1f818ff34caf8bbddf601639e1253.zh: 让纽约州按一种方式决定这个问题，其他许多州按另一种方式决定，有什么不对？难道是我疯了吗？

daf7858b747414a00a650a8e5bd981120d893790.source: What? The voters that you need detest making interracial marriage illegal.
daf7858b747414a00a650a8e5bd981120d893790.zh: 什么？你需要争取的选民，可都厌恶把跨种族婚姻定为违法。

d4ab707593d551a7d77e88e86cc0baea7fce0d7c.source: What? You're supposed to be a man of the people, not of the trusts.
d4ab707593d551a7d77e88e86cc0baea7fce0d7c.zh: 什么？你不是该代表人民吗，怎么倒成了托拉斯的代言人？

4b03888a1cb20c7e695ee24ecdce06375a2de523.source: What?! The purpose of your candidacy is to provide a solid, left-wing alternative to the two main parties. People are wondering what you meant by taking this stance.
4b03888a1cb20c7e695ee24ecdce06375a2de523.zh: 什么？！你参选的目的，是在两大党之外提供一个坚定的左翼选择。人们正在问，你采取这个立场到底是什么意思。

de3dc3799f499d2d6761aa14bd1e3c066bf2a9fc.source: What we've unfortunately seen in Cuba is the consequence of insufficient support for anti-Communist governments and movements. We need to be much more aggressive in our actions against the Castro government.
de3dc3799f499d2d6761aa14bd1e3c066bf2a9fc.zh: 遗憾的是，古巴的情况，是对反共政府和运动支持不足的结果。我们需要采取远为积极的行动，对抗卡斯特罗政府。

565b45783dc72a702fbd5871fe2ad25bd35d23ae.source: What were you thinking with this answer? You are the anti-war candidate and your rejection of detente has terrified doves about your position on Vietnam.
565b45783dc72a702fbd5871fe2ad25bd35d23ae.zh: 你给出这个回答时到底在想什么？你是反战候选人，却拒绝缓和关系，让鸽派对你的越南立场大为惊恐。

419ad49a4cb55d4bfe38f87503c41635ef2a6eeb.source: What will be the main focus of your acceptance speech at the Republican Convention?
419ad49a4cb55d4bfe38f87503c41635ef2a6eeb.zh: 你在共和党全国代表大会的接受提名演说，会以什么为重点？

503992581546434268f94fa0bf32f3e89da5b04b.source: What will be the overall message of your campaign?
503992581546434268f94fa0bf32f3e89da5b04b.zh: 你的竞选总体上要传达什么信息？

45658a8e77bda00c5bf183a97c1dc9f89b743283.source: What will be the overall theme of your campaign as you criss-cross the United States?
45658a8e77bda00c5bf183a97c1dc9f89b743283.zh: 你穿梭于美国各地时，竞选的总体主题将是什么？

77ac0aa91403911e5f1875d55b8089f7b05fc499.source: What will be the overriding theme of your nomination speech at the Democratic Convention?
77ac0aa91403911e5f1875d55b8089f7b05fc499.zh: 你在民主党全国代表大会上的提名演说，将以什么作为贯穿全篇的主题？

1858d996f59b7e60664c31dcae330d9f58455e23.source: What will be the overriding theme of your nomination speech at the Republican Convention?
1858d996f59b7e60664c31dcae330d9f58455e23.zh: 你在共和党全国代表大会上的提名演说，将以什么作为贯穿全篇的主题？

1402f339394b16489a0936cd74775eee6178e41f.source: What will be the thrust of your speech as you accept the Republican nomination in Miami?
1402f339394b16489a0936cd74775eee6178e41f.zh: 你在迈阿密接受共和党提名时，演说的重点将是什么？

1d313588fd3d9ca68d87d258e9702fc09c9b89ba.source: What will be your overall campaign strategy this year?
1d313588fd3d9ca68d87d258e9702fc09c9b89ba.zh: 今年，你的总体竞选策略是什么？

2753b38a34591bb4560fc70658e369732008ffd8.source: What will happen next is up to you, although most people have some expectations. Tax cuts will certainly be going into effect, and some bills related to gay marriage or LGBTQ+ people in the military will as well. Just keep an eye out for 2004, and don't make the same mistakes as your dad.
2753b38a34591bb4560fc70658e369732008ffd8.zh: 接下来会发生什么，取决于你，尽管多数人已经有所预期。减税肯定会实施，一些涉及同性婚姻或LGBTQ+人士在军中服役的法案也会出台。只是要留心2004年，别重蹈你父亲的覆辙。

fa69a876c7224f734ae57731eeb0ef407bcf781f.source: What will happen next is up to you, although most people have some expectations. Tax cuts will certainly be going into effect, and some bills related to gay marriage or homosexual people in the military will as well. Just keep an eye out for 2004, and don't make the same mistakes as your dad.
fa69a876c7224f734ae57731eeb0ef407bcf781f.zh: 接下来会发生什么，取决于你，尽管多数人已经有所预期。减税肯定会实施，一些涉及同性婚姻或同性恋者在军中服役的法案也会出台。只是要留心2004年，别重蹈你父亲的覆辙。

02fbd003ea1e25363c28111c4ebf1cc146c6d875.source: What will you do to help resolve the severe housing shortage in this country?
02fbd003ea1e25363c28111c4ebf1cc146c6d875.zh: 你会采取什么措施，帮助解决本国严重的住房短缺？

64e387ef27c8b1e62dc2ba7fb37aa07c2651d27e.source: What will you say in your acceptance speech at the Democratic Convention in Chicago? Will you address the rioting outside and the legacy of Robert Kennedy?
64e387ef27c8b1e62dc2ba7fb37aa07c2651d27e.zh: 在芝加哥民主党全国代表大会的提名接受演讲中，你会说些什么？你会谈到场外的骚乱和罗伯特·肯尼迪留下的事业吗？

601c2c98eb24aeeff4838d955308671798b3d925.source: What will you say to the American people as you accept your party's nomination for President?
601c2c98eb24aeeff4838d955308671798b3d925.zh: 在接受本党总统候选人提名时，你会对美国人民说些什么？

31908661d6f8bddadd24e6d2d6f5e6a970e5ddd6.source: What will your message be as you accept the Republican nomination for President on national television?
31908661d6f8bddadd24e6d2d6f5e6a970e5ddd6.zh: 你将在全国电视直播中接受共和党总统候选人提名，届时会传达什么信息？

39a16366b1cf79b6b082f1624f3e8f5a18587e4c.source: Whatever your personal feelings, you must do something to reach out to Bernie Sanders and his legion of supporters.
39a16366b1cf79b6b082f1624f3e8f5a18587e4c.zh: 无论你个人有什么感受，都必须采取行动，争取伯尼·桑德斯及其大批支持者。

3d9e00292cb6218779166d636a70a233455bdce3.source: When I am President, you will finally have someone who takes our antitrust legislation seriously. I will break up monopolistic banks and railroads in places where they stifle competition.
3d9e00292cb6218779166d636a70a233455bdce3.zh: 我当上总统后，你们终于会有一个认真执行反托拉斯法律的人。在垄断银行和铁路公司扼杀竞争的地方，我会拆分它们。

5e656356a1c8b178644b1dcb3107cce12db6ee09.source: When I get elected, we're going to get a Democratic Congress with me. That's how it's done.
5e656356a1c8b178644b1dcb3107cce12db6ee09.zh: 我当选时，民主党也会跟着我一起赢下国会。办法就是这样。

cc7a0ac7cf0474e1a8d1039cde3fef0196b74eff.source: When I'm President, I'm going to appoint Ted Cruz to the Supreme Court. And if he doesn't want the seat, we're letting him name his choice.
cc7a0ac7cf0474e1a8d1039cde3fef0196b74eff.zh: 我当上总统后，会任命特德·克鲁兹进入最高法院。如果他不想要这个席位，我们就让他挑一个人。

af12a263eb1a79e6c42fd7205ce49e40a54ba2e2.source: When I'm thinking about a running-mate, I'm thinking about the person who will make the best President if, God forbid, they must step into that role. Tim Kaine has outstanding experience and judgment and I'm proud to make him my running mate.
af12a263eb1a79e6c42fd7205ce49e40a54ba2e2.zh: 考虑竞选搭档时，我想的是：万一不得不接任总统——但愿永远不会发生——谁最能胜任？蒂姆·凯恩有出众的经验和判断力，我很自豪能请他做搭档。

68ee8611866f80ca9207d91c4a7fbdd0fff887d0.source: When it makes sense to wear a mask, I wear a mask. I have a mask in my pocket right now. Sometimes it makes sense, and sometimes there's no reason to wear one.
68ee8611866f80ca9207d91c4a7fbdd0fff887d0.zh: 戴口罩合理的时候，我就戴。我现在口袋里就有一个。有时戴口罩合理，有时却没理由戴。

6ad15695a2594dc58a9f8ca9ba2882cb594b3290.source: When you look at all the work that Val Demings has done in Florida, in Orlando and elsewhere, both as a Congresswoman and a Police Chief, you see how she can take her experience and help us build on the push for police reform and equality that we are seeing.
6ad15695a2594dc58a9f8ca9ba2882cb594b3290.zh: 看看瓦尔·戴明斯在佛罗里达州、在奥兰多及其他地方，作为众议员和警察局长所做的工作，就能看出，她能运用经验，帮助我们推进眼下的警务改革与平等诉求。

a64c78e38b36b33f5b3f874109482ddc62ef4222.source: When your advisors explained that you needed to be your own man and detach yourself from the unpopular Johnson, this is not what they were thinking.
a64c78e38b36b33f5b3f874109482ddc62ef4222.zh: 顾问说你需要有自己的主张，与不受欢迎的约翰逊拉开距离时，可不是让你这么做。

bff1310ace803164843f12c2f7ac4f4913a2cd75.source: When, several months later, the Freedom Police came to take him for 'interviews', he wasn't even that upset.
bff1310ace803164843f12c2f7ac4f4913a2cd75.zh: 几个月后，当自由警察来带他进行“采访”时，他甚至没有那么沮丧。

7a83379c38e46d5eaf1d4dd60e5dde265500ed00.source: Whenever Ms. Clinton implies that I'm unqualified to serve as President, we will immediately ask what was going on her brain when she installed this server?
7a83379c38e46d5eaf1d4dd60e5dde265500ed00.zh: 只要克林顿女士暗示，我不够资格担任总统，我们就会立即问：她安装这台服务器时，脑子里到底在想什么？

e5cd2e6cd78d5075dc0e0d3db64f28cb8b819258.source: Whenever Ms. Clinton implies that I'm unqualified to serve as President, we will immediately ask what was going on her brain when she voted for the war in Iraq?
e5cd2e6cd78d5075dc0e0d3db64f28cb8b819258.zh: 只要克林顿女士暗示，我不够资格担任总统，我们就会立即问：她投票支持伊拉克战争时，脑子里到底在想什么？

8c953c7efc1fa0a49eb21e5f81092d2c872f7ccf.source: Where are the scandals from my administration in Massachusetts? I am clearly the more competent alternative in this election.
8c953c7efc1fa0a49eb21e5f81092d2c872f7ccf.zh: 我在马萨诸塞州执政时，有什么丑闻？在这场选举中，我显然是更有执政能力的选择。

1a3c41716f274827110a1786056bcb3b121cbda8.source: Where do you want to concentrate your attention on during the final day of the campaign?
1a3c41716f274827110a1786056bcb3b121cbda8.zh: 竞选最后一天，你想把注意力集中在哪里？

7e10deb0b33244bb62bbf5715c24aa967f0f84d3.source: Where is Hillary Clinton's apology for the email server, the war in Iraq, the dead ambassador in Benghazi, the Goldman Sachs speeches, and so many other issues of importance?
7e10deb0b33244bb62bbf5715c24aa967f0f84d3.zh: 希拉里·克林顿对于邮件服务器、伊拉克战争、在班加西遇害的大使、高盛演说，以及那么多重要问题的道歉在哪里？

e728c9567005a510f350cbd67d624d233f3178e1.source: Where is the investigation into the Russian leaks? Where is the investigation into Trump's blatantly illegal business practices over many years? This is an unprecededented and outrageous act of political interference by the FBI.
e728c9567005a510f350cbd67d624d233f3178e1.zh: 对俄罗斯泄密事件的调查在哪里？对特朗普多年来公然违法的商业行为的调查在哪里？联邦调查局这种政治干预史无前例，令人愤怒。

627cc6327f9f96e1b78351c0033a7739359f2f7d.source: Where we have mature, stable industries, tariffs can be lower. They should be high on most products.
627cc6327f9f96e1b78351c0033a7739359f2f7d.zh: 对已经成熟、稳定的产业，关税可以较低，但大多数产品的关税应当较高。

b578704fcbf6af56f3caaa3971fba3f2fe115bae.source: Where will you focus your efforts on the last day before the election?
b578704fcbf6af56f3caaa3971fba3f2fe115bae.zh: 在选举前的最后一天，你会把精力集中在哪里？

5b001bfbd47867892cd28ae487289ff41351e5d8.source: Where will you make the final stop(s) of your campaign before the voting begins?
5b001bfbd47867892cd28ae487289ff41351e5d8.zh: 投票开始前，你将在哪里进行最后一站或几站竞选活动？

83bb2d4d926718b2860e5b114ccc4d003324917f.source: Where will you spend the final day of your campaign?
83bb2d4d926718b2860e5b114ccc4d003324917f.zh: 你会在哪里度过竞选的最后一天？

6628a6583c32dd344559472e490fbd5723e2b62b.source: Where will you spend your final day before the election?
6628a6583c32dd344559472e490fbd5723e2b62b.zh: 选举前的最后一天，你会在哪里度过？

e337a5cb082ba9b0e8f49e897f5cbc58aa280928.source: Where will you spend your final day of the campaign?
e337a5cb082ba9b0e8f49e897f5cbc58aa280928.zh: 你将在竞选的最后一天去哪里？

ebb7ec469713304d1602c68470164ed593d57304.source: Where will you travel to during your final days before the election?
ebb7ec469713304d1602c68470164ed593d57304.zh: 投票前的最后几天，你将前往哪里？

93a615d4ca190557bdac9c878ffe7f6a71f6cdc2.source: Where would you like to campaign on the last day before election day?
93a615d4ca190557bdac9c878ffe7f6a71f6cdc2.zh: 在选举日前的最后一天，你想到哪里竞选？

5fc2b6b79592ed66c6446690251b35c118bc9cc0.source: Where you go from here is anyone’s guess. Undoubtedly, your effectiveness will be decided by the makeup of Congress- it will certainly be yet another struggle to pass your agenda through the moderates and liberals that make up much of the government- but for now, sit back and relax, knowing you’ve pulled off an upset greater than 1948!
5fc2b6b79592ed66c6446690251b35c118bc9cc0.zh: 任何人都在猜测你接下来会去哪里。毫无疑问，你的效率将取决于国会的组成——要让你的议程通过政府大部分的温和派和自由派，肯定会是另一场斗争——但现在，坐下来放松一下，知道你已经完成了比 1948 年更大的失败！

88e669e6c5e5f91baaac1a20c74196fad9ff6d4f.source: Where you go from here is up to you. If you are still interested in holding office, you can run for a Senate position or perhaps a governorship. Maybe you can run for president again in 4 years? You could also go the other way and abandon running for politics, maybe taking up a job offer at a TV station. The world is your oyster.
88e669e6c5e5f91baaac1a20c74196fad9ff6d4f.zh: 你从这里去哪里取决于你。如果您仍然有兴趣担任公职，您可以竞选参议院职位或州长职位。也许四年后你可以再次竞选总统？你也可以走另一条路，放弃从政，也许接受电视台的工作机会。世界是你的牡蛎。

3f43af4b3c5e7d31d5a0fc5ec19bf183c79efcaa.source: Which gun control measures do you favor? Which ones do you oppose?
3f43af4b3c5e7d31d5a0fc5ec19bf183c79efcaa.zh: 你支持哪些枪支管制措施？反对哪些？

92594c06bd2d920393e380728b49f82071533f07.source: Which of the following best describes your position on Social Security?
92594c06bd2d920393e380728b49f82071533f07.zh: 以下哪项最能描述你对社会保障制度的立场？

e8fbea371b2db7a4fc38e5ef0531894a25139ccf.source: Which of the following best describes your position on education?
e8fbea371b2db7a4fc38e5ef0531894a25139ccf.zh: 以下哪项最能描述你的教育立场？

db4cab4b19bdc53a191dcbfbccb426d54102d0a5.source: Which of the following best describes your position on the $200 billion surplus that is projected for this year?
db4cab4b19bdc53a191dcbfbccb426d54102d0a5.zh: 以下哪项最能描述你对今年预计2000亿美元预算盈余的立场？

0618591762158109f3bdad6f499a80959199bd8f.source: Which of the following most closely matches your overall campaign message?
0618591762158109f3bdad6f499a80959199bd8f.zh: 以下哪项最符合你的总体竞选诉求？

dcb61d67c1dc039da7126fdcb2254fe49428cd44.source: Which of the following will be your primary campaign message?
dcb61d67c1dc039da7126fdcb2254fe49428cd44.zh: 以下哪项将成为你竞选的主打诉求？

59dd3ed68ac5ab99a7b5c77214bfbde3fa5fe67b.source: Which of these themes will you emphasize the most as you campaign for President this year?
59dd3ed68ac5ab99a7b5c77214bfbde3fa5fe67b.zh: 今年竞选总统时，你会最着重强调以下哪一项主题？

48b6c5d0646f8fe1fbc243a2e94435ba58257585.source: While attending a 9/11 memorial event today, Hillary Clinton was caught on video going limp and being carried into a van, apparently for medical attention. Do you have any comment?
48b6c5d0646f8fe1fbc243a2e94435ba58257585.zh: 今天参加“9·11”纪念活动时，有视频拍到希拉里·克林顿身体瘫软，被人抬进一辆厢式车，显然是为了接受医疗照护。你有什么评论？

758343f11b86e1e637cf6c4778348732aa959e12.source: While attending a 9/11 memorial event today, you were caught on video going limp and being carried into a van, apparently for medical attention. Do you have any comment?
758343f11b86e1e637cf6c4778348732aa959e12.zh: 今天参加“9·11”纪念活动时，有视频拍到你身体瘫软，被人抬进一辆厢式车，显然是为了接受医疗照护。你有什么评论？

bbf70fa571c7ed9384d908bde28c415ba8a31017.source: While his Libertarian views make him non-competitive in 2012, Gary Johnson hopes to use the election as a springboard for his party and ideology. The success of Ron Paul in the Republican primaries suggests a potential market for Johnson's views, but he realistically will be fortunate to win more than 2% of the popular vote.
bbf70fa571c7ed9384d908bde28c415ba8a31017.zh: 虽然他的自由主义观点使他在 2012 年没有竞争力，但 加里·约翰逊 希望利用这次选举作为他的政党和意识形态的跳板。 罗恩·保罗 在共和党初选中的成功表明 约翰逊 的观点存在潜在市场，但实际上他将幸运地赢得超过 2% 的普选票。

b14d1c1e0202b34f6b9c7e6e6d0f070c87445930.source: While most people are expecting a third term of Reagan, you know you didn't get elected solely on that idea. Your economic policy won't change for the most part, but you might be able to cool tensions a bit with the USSR, as that was one of the worries Americans had with Reagan. If all goes well, then you can be re-elected, and be the first president-vice president duo to be elected to 2 full terms each.
b14d1c1e0202b34f6b9c7e6e6d0f070c87445930.zh: 虽然大多数人期待的是“里根的第三届任期”，你知道自己并不只是靠这个主张当选。你的经济政策基本不会变，但也许可以稍稍缓和与苏联的紧张关系——这正是美国人对里根的一项担忧。如果一切顺利，你就能连任，成为首对先后各自当选两届完整任期的总统与副总统搭档。

f9d0722fdbc14c83f803e4a72e9ff03d10926191.source: While some say this is yet another changed position on your part, it could help mend fences with the left of your party.
f9d0722fdbc14c83f803e4a72e9ff03d10926191.zh: 虽然有人说，你又一次改变了立场，但这可能有助于修复你与党内左翼的关系。

ef1d64d80e9163b4bd75f6e6f7113b4d2a80ff1a.source: While the Electoral College ended in a tie, the Democrats have a huge advantage in the House of Representatives and are sure to elect you in that manner. Hopefully the closeness of this election doesn't undermine your promises to clean up Washington and unite the people of this country.
ef1d64d80e9163b4bd75f6e6f7113b4d2a80ff1a.zh: 虽然选举人团投票打成平局，民主党在众议院拥有巨大优势，肯定会通过众议院选举让你当选。但愿这场选举的胶着，不会损害你整顿华盛顿政坛、团结美国人民的承诺。

348b701164f6f976f7aa1a2123ea5db0050a4fd7.source: While the Electoral College ended in a tie, the Democrats have a huge advantage in the House of Representatives and are sure to elect your opponent in that manner. Perhaps you can still play a role in 1980, or seek your old Congressional leadership positions. In any case, you can still take solace in the fact that you did the right thing by pardoning Nixon and moving the country beyond the Watergate episode.
348b701164f6f976f7aa1a2123ea5db0050a4fd7.zh: 虽然选举人团投票打成平局，民主党在众议院拥有巨大优势，肯定会通过众议院选举让你的对手当选。或许你在1980年仍能发挥作用，或者谋求重返原来的国会领导职位。无论如何，你仍可以宽慰自己：赦免尼克松、让国家走出水门事件的阴影，是正确的决定。

e54bb09c0c7723c9652943f71ef72c1bc7186c83.source: While true, people are getting the idea that you are dancing around a hot issue.
e54bb09c0c7723c9652943f71ef72c1bc7186c83.zh: 虽然说得没错，但人们开始觉得，你在绕开一个热门议题。

1424600e1605bf08ccfe8ad1eec712ec13a80bcd.source: While true, this is the exact opposite of what Americans believe how the war is going and doesn’t endear you to anti-war voters.
1424600e1605bf08ccfe8ad1eec712ec13a80bcd.zh: 虽说属实，但这与美国人对战局的看法完全相反，也不会让反战选民喜欢你。

a024ac31c6d55d6f4bfd2f78a1825b9625174b7c.source: White voters are content, but blacks demand more from the Democrats, due to the poverty in their urban communities.
a024ac31c6d55d6f4bfd2f78a1825b9625174b7c.zh: 白人选民满意，但黑人希望民主党做得更多，因为他们的城市社区仍陷于贫困。

8b6b660da6f0906863fbc90c3d9a27b703792ee8.source: Whites and Negroes are naturally unsuited to mix together in society. The entire premise of desegregation is a farce, and my campaign is dedicated to ending this misguided policy.
8b6b660da6f0906863fbc90c3d9a27b703792ee8.zh: 白人与黑人天生就不适合在社会中混在一起。取消种族隔离的整个前提就是一场闹剧，我的竞选就是要终结这项错误政策。

8a71c0667b4b3ea2699b94c4fb88bee65d6334d3.source: Who authorized this meeting? Did I authorize this meeting? We're telling Bernie Sanders that he'd better fall in line. We have an election to win.
8a71c0667b4b3ea2699b94c4fb88bee65d6334d3.zh: 谁批准了这次会面？是我批准的吗？我们要告诉伯尼·桑德斯，他最好服从党的安排。我们还有一场选举要赢。

3c09af9d872f45abc3d10e6d29220962fcbc0467.source: Who cares what I think about this issue? Go ask Joe Biden about it -- he's the one who will have no qualms about signing off on this insane plan if he's elected President.
3c09af9d872f45abc3d10e6d29220962fcbc0467.zh: 谁在乎我怎么看这个问题？去问乔·拜登吧——他要是当选总统，签下这种疯狂方案时，可不会有半点顾虑。

8f3874eda297e1f39fe2987572c83011f02479e2.source: Who is this Jimmy Carter person anyway? He's untested and takes both sides of every important issue. We need to make sure people understand that.
8f3874eda297e1f39fe2987572c83011f02479e2.zh: 这个吉米·卡特到底是谁？他未经考验，在每个重要问题上都两边讨好。我们必须让人们明白这一点。

64c578098c3276bdc001b06e28072b243df8d2b9.source: Who knows if anything will come of your openness to negotiate on this issue. In the short term, perhaps not really.
64c578098c3276bdc001b06e28072b243df8d2b9.zh: 谁知道，你愿意在这个问题上谈判，会有什么结果。短期内，也许真的不会有什么。

ff73aeb115fab3b1178e7efcd517ef3438c1dc2f.source: Who knows if it means anything nationally, but a raucous crowd turned out to support the two of you.
ff73aeb115fab3b1178e7efcd517ef3438c1dc2f.zh: 谁知道这在全国层面是否有意义，不过，一大群热烈的群众到场支持你们两人。

42afde2ba7776bff197a94a42aabeffa0674d607.source: Who knows what the future holds? If all goes well, maybe you can run again in 1968. Make sure to keep the economy chugging and the Vietnam War going smoothly, or you may be in trouble- Goldwater seems to have kicked the hornet’s nest of conservatives, and they’ll be looking to challenge you in the future...
42afde2ba7776bff197a94a42aabeffa0674d607.zh: 谁知道未来会怎样？如果一切顺利的话，也许你可以在1968年再次参选。一定要保持经济的发展和越南战争的顺利进行，否则你可能会遇到麻烦——戈德华特似乎已经捅了保守派的马蜂窝，他们将来会找机会挑战你的……

7a02a8b0c4f858ee5d1efd0fc3c406688dd7e592.zh: 为什么 特朗普 几乎获胜？

941f8e7d59bcf014db71602a7e148ad72eb1cf30.source: Why Dukakis thought it would be a good idea to veto this bill is beyond me, but we won't let him forget it in this campaign. I will say the Pledge of Allegiance wherever I go on the trail.
941f8e7d59bcf014db71602a7e148ad72eb1cf30.zh: 杜卡基斯为什么会觉得否决这项法案是个好主意，我实在无法理解。但这场竞选中，我们不会让他忘掉这件事。我每到一处竞选，都会宣读效忠誓词。

20ddef79e72749d88baed6b6783f2804a21184e0.source: Why Roosevelt continues to press such an unpopular point in his speeches is beyond me, but we will certainly waste no chance to attack him and Hughes on the issue.
20ddef79e72749d88baed6b6783f2804a21184e0.zh: 我不明白，罗斯福为什么还在演说中不断强调这么不受欢迎的观点；不过，我们肯定会利用每个机会，就此攻击他和休斯。

c47568e55a5f72033ab9a883a17d67bc378ce230.source: Why are you attacking Medicare? This is a policy that is popular and something you have long backed.
c47568e55a5f72033ab9a883a17d67bc378ce230.zh: 你为什么要攻击联邦医疗保险？这项政策既受欢迎，也是你长期支持的。

83666d9daa72b78acae2425241436d6272ba5485.source: Why did you pick Bill Miller as your running mate?
83666d9daa72b78acae2425241436d6272ba5485.zh: 你为什么选择比尔·米勒作为竞选搭档？

575f250ac01d5403171a9088fdca26eb1f1975a5.source: Why let Bush off the hook like that? You look almost too magnanimous heading into Election Day.
575f250ac01d5403171a9088fdca26eb1f1975a5.zh: 为什么就这样放过布什？临近选举日，你显得宽宏大量得有点过头了。

15af70ca1cd6c740357f0df975a44932b07aa732.source: Why not campaign in New York itself?
15af70ca1cd6c740357f0df975a44932b07aa732.zh: 为什么不就在纽约州竞选呢？

4a08528f49fef8d8a23eb9063e378011dd187a40.source: Why screw up a good thing? I will campaign on the positive record of Bill Clinton and the Democrats over the past eight years, and pledge to continue those policies. I will appear with Clinton at a few rallies during the campaign to make sure Americans get the message.
4a08528f49fef8d8a23eb9063e378011dd187a40.zh: 好端端的局面，为什么要搞砸？我会以比尔·克林顿和民主党过去八年的良好政绩展开竞选，承诺延续这些政策。竞选期间，我会与克林顿共同出席几场集会，确保美国人明白这一点。

0717445f8837ce8ee8a478e273701a15736b712f.source: Why should I tie myself to the sinking ship that is the Southern Democrats? With the numbers I have, they should be begging me for help. Either get with the program, or get the hell out of my way.
0717445f8837ce8ee8a478e273701a15736b712f.zh: 为什么要把自己绑在南方民主党人这艘正在下沉的船上？凭我这样的支持率，该是他们求我帮忙。要么跟上我们的步调，要么他妈的别挡我的路。

0dead3d67e5d0a2dbb2fe6952466d2f72ecbe8e7.source: Why would you not want to debate Nixon? He has an awkward, sometimes surly personality and you would surely look good in comparison.
0dead3d67e5d0a2dbb2fe6952466d2f72ecbe8e7.zh: 你为什么不想与尼克松辩论？他性格拘谨，有时还阴沉不快，相比之下，你肯定会显得出色。

4c49032b55bceb64b1550709d9a6c8e59d0288b7.source: Will you continue the tradition of debating your opponent in the month before the election?
4c49032b55bceb64b1550709d9a6c8e59d0288b7.zh: 你会延续在选举前一个月与对手辩论的传统吗？

ad9ead1fa4e6dd1c6498bba86656b2d6e2fa85dd.source: Will you divert your attention from the Midwest long enough to visit California, Oregon, and Washington?
ad9ead1fa4e6dd1c6498bba86656b2d6e2fa85dd.zh: 您会将注意力从中西部转移足够长的时间来访问 加利福尼亚州、俄勒冈州 和 华盛顿州 吗？

4ab696d14b51b70c94c9195937c91e6ef70dc63b.source: Will you give Bernie Sanders a prime speaking slot at the Democratic Convention?
4ab696d14b51b70c94c9195937c91e6ef70dc63b.zh: 你会让伯尼·桑德斯在民主党全国代表大会上获得一个重要演讲时段吗？

6392e379b32111d5595b9e0ccf9086222e7b064a.source: Will you keep your name on the ballot in Oregon and California, even if doing so might divide the anti-Lincoln vote?
6392e379b32111d5595b9e0ccf9086222e7b064a.zh: 即使可能分散反林肯的选票，你仍会在俄勒冈和加利福尼亚的选票上保留自己的名字吗？

8307eed16819fe9fa78c5d5e4ab1abab6c83b2a2.source: Will you launch an air campaign against Iranian nuclear sites if diplomatic negotiations continue to yield minimal results?
8307eed16819fe9fa78c5d5e4ab1abab6c83b2a2.zh: 如果外交谈判继续收效甚微，你会对伊朗核设施发动空袭吗？

1dabbdff9c62e0b1a7fae12ccfb11b66e6a87b41.source: Will you make a judge's views on abortion a strong component of your appointments?
1dabbdff9c62e0b1a7fae12ccfb11b66e6a87b41.zh: 任命法官时，你会把其对堕胎的观点作为重要考量吗？

25fb218007af7daa3ef62b6428419471505603c2.source: Will you make any statements about the increased regulation of narcotics and stimulants such as a cocaine, which began with the 1914 Harrison Act?
25fb218007af7daa3ef62b6428419471505603c2.zh: 1914年的《哈里森法》开始加强对麻醉药品，以及可卡因等兴奋剂的监管。你会就此发表意见吗？

5dd9a462cdcdca93dff6783e3f88b1de2e0bec08.source: Will you press for your party to include a condemnation of lynching in the party platform?
5dd9a462cdcdca93dff6783e3f88b1de2e0bec08.zh: 你会推动本党在党纲中加入谴责私刑的条款吗？

85fb4a9da0250e79b5526f3f9340a70395e3ea3b.source: Will you send campaigners to Nebraska, in an attempt to deliver an embarrassing defeat to Bryan, or should those resources be focused on South Dakota, Wyoming, and Iowa?
85fb4a9da0250e79b5526f3f9340a70395e3ea3b.zh: 你会派竞选人员前往内布拉斯加，争取让布赖恩在家乡难堪地落败，还是把这些资源集中到南达科他、怀俄明和艾奥瓦？

c41834c01b6f4f6a6459c9930061d3233cccbfc8.source: Will you sign the Revenue Act of 1916, which would increase the income tax and establish a Tariff Commission?
c41834c01b6f4f6a6459c9930061d3233cccbfc8.zh: 你会签署1916年《税收法》吗？它将提高所得税，并设立关税委员会。

2131ea22423b93ede402a7f476bc8c776d745daf.source: Will you stand by your calls to keep all Muslims from entering the United States?
2131ea22423b93ede402a7f476bc8c776d745daf.zh: 你仍坚持要求禁止所有穆斯林进入美国吗？

86331163628cbc20f833f1e07997e61027099f39.source: Will you try to compete with Johnson and Humphrey's machine in Texas?
86331163628cbc20f833f1e07997e61027099f39.zh: 你会尝试在得克萨斯州挑战约翰逊和汉弗莱的政治机器吗？

08cfd4eae969a4055c43bbc09a1222781a37706d.source: Will you try to compete with Johnson and Humphrey's political machine in Texas?
08cfd4eae969a4055c43bbc09a1222781a37706d.zh: 你会尝试在得克萨斯州挑战约翰逊和汉弗莱的政治机器吗？

c1ee8a1c5167aee5d45f8375d8875180270a407b.source: Will you wear an American flag lapel on your suit as you campaign?
c1ee8a1c5167aee5d45f8375d8875180270a407b.zh: 竞选时，你会在西装翻领上佩戴美国国旗徽章吗？

5cc3def1ec7595655c48aedb4ff31b33e187ac1a.source: Will you work towards international agreements to create a monetary system based on "bimetallism", i.e. a combination of gold and silver?
5cc3def1ec7595655c48aedb4ff31b33e187ac1a.zh: 你会争取达成国际协议，建立以“金银复本位制”为基础的货币制度吗，也就是同时以黄金和白银为本位？

91b007398b26f7bd5b851cbca577d4e8c1a03a3d.source: William Jennings Bryan electrified the convention in Chicago with his famous "Cross of Gold" speech.
91b007398b26f7bd5b851cbca577d4e8c1a03a3d.zh: 威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩 以其著名的“黄金十字”演讲使芝加哥大会充满活力。

ba5e2d6b47d873c242d73e17265de70510f96a75.source: William Jennings Bryan is a devout, honest man. It's unfortunate that he proposes such misguided policies.
ba5e2d6b47d873c242d73e17265de70510f96a75.zh: 威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩是个虔诚、诚实的人。可惜，他提出的政策如此误入歧途。

00a0905b04539fe4f0ddbf285a170ce1a4e1c9de.source: William Jennings Bryan makes an eloquent appeal to the heart. It's important for voters to realize that his solutions will not help our country.
00a0905b04539fe4f0ddbf285a170ce1a4e1c9de.zh: 威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩口才出众，善于打动人心。必须让选民明白，他的办法救不了我们的国家。

324ce9e067c241b794c377aff5d90f2a080fef36.source: William McKinley runs as the establishment Republican while William Jennings Bryan brings a radically different agenda to the race. The bad economy and the coinage of silver dominate discussion.
324ce9e067c241b794c377aff5d90f2a080fef36.zh: 威廉·麦金莱代表共和党建制派参选，威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩则提出截然不同的激进纲领。低迷的经济与银币铸造问题，主导着竞选讨论。

a2fd487893b96d080199f5d3981f5a3d91aa5b1c.source: William McKinley stands for the ideals of stability and the established order. He runs as a Republican, a Civil War veteran, a tariff man, and a supporter of American industry and the gold standard.
a2fd487893b96d080199f5d3981f5a3d91aa5b1c.zh: 威廉·麦金莱 代表稳定的理想和既定秩序。他以共和党人、南北战争退伍军人、关税人员以及美国工业和金本位制的支持者身份参选。

549c977ca76e88d11ed19575b60d0a93f49f0b1a.source: William Randolph Hearst knows my opinions and he is free to endorse me or not endorse me. I will not cater to his whims.
549c977ca76e88d11ed19575b60d0a93f49f0b1a.zh: 威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特知道我的看法，愿意支持我或不支持，都是他的自由。我不会迎合他的奇想。

78bcf99ebb6afdf8a47f69ce02ef6ca0ab8000d0.source: Willing to consider air strikes against Iran if other measures fail. Wants Russia, China, and other powers in the region to put more pressure on the ruling regime as well. Seeks to work within regional power structures when projecting American influence.
78bcf99ebb6afdf8a47f69ce02ef6ca0ab8000d0.zh: 如果其他措施失败，愿意考虑空袭伊朗。也希望俄罗斯、中国及地区其他大国向伊朗执政当局施加更多压力。寻求借助地区权力格局发挥美国的影响力。

f8b9075a687df282796f3bc7f3e431c2e5da77c7.source: Wilson and I may have our differences on other issues, but I believe an eight-hour workday is broadly popular and worthy of praise.
f8b9075a687df282796f3bc7f3e431c2e5da77c7.zh: 威尔逊和我在其他问题上也许有分歧，但我认为八小时工作制广受欢迎，值得赞扬。

298964d8f15569e25f9f11a530bfd8f4d1d169c1.source: Wilson has repeatedly taken half-measures, when we should be doing much more to prepare for the threat of war.
298964d8f15569e25f9f11a530bfd8f4d1d169c1.zh: 面对战争威胁，我们本该做更多准备，威尔逊却一再采取半吊子的措施。

e3483b6be1cfd28687bab78bc8b2e48b7676aaf3.source: Wilson will emphasize the U.S. non-involvement with World War I, and his legislative achievements.
e3483b6be1cfd28687bab78bc8b2e48b7676aaf3.zh: 威尔逊将强调美国尚未卷入第一次世界大战，以及自己的立法成就。

72a0cdd362d87c947ce16e56c1ae0ae88da0a6f6.source: Wilson's impetuous actions in pushing this into law, with no chance for debate in Congress, are incorrect and dangerous.
72a0cdd362d87c947ce16e56c1ae0ae88da0a6f6.zh: 威尔逊不让国会有机会辩论，就急着推动这项法律通过，这种做法是错误而危险的。

969ed287b966e35d89330ae76a6b42b9e1ccf7e0.source: Winning a nationally televised debate with Hillary Clinton will be the greatest experience of my life.
969ed287b966e35d89330ae76a6b42b9e1ccf7e0.zh: 赢下一场与希拉里·克林顿的全国电视辩论，将是我一生最棒的经历。

0140b477e0324c07f4a8bcad630d1cf8e85e9b87.source: Winning over the anti-war crowd is crucial, but you’ve swung too far and alienated the mainstream population.
0140b477e0324c07f4a8bcad630d1cf8e85e9b87.zh: 争取反战群体至关重要，但你转得太远，疏远了主流民众。

93a6aa9327852f172389d48d21dee7118edd91d5.source: Winona LaDuke is a Native American activist of Ojibwe ancestry. She lives in Minnesota and has been active in attempts to regain land that once belonged to various American Indian tribes. She has written a book and started organizations in support of this issue.
93a6aa9327852f172389d48d21dee7118edd91d5.zh: 薇诺娜·拉杜克 是一位具有欧及布威血统的美国原住民活动家。她住在明尼苏达州，一直积极尝试夺回曾经属于各个美洲印第安部落的土地。她写了一本书并成立了一些组织来支持这个问题。

eb62277b4dc2d5488bda5cfebcde1f86dc5f7561.source: With a cabin in Vermont, he and his family were isolated from the chaos of the rest of the country. Despite the frigid winters, and even though his only neighbour was Bernie Sanders... life like this wasn't too bad. He audibly sighed and continued eating dinner with Bernie.
eb62277b4dc2d5488bda5cfebcde1f86dc5f7561.zh: 在 佛蒙特州 的一间小屋里，他和他的家人远离了这个国家其他地方的混乱。尽管冬天很冷，尽管他唯一的邻居是伯尼·桑德斯……这样的生活也不算太糟糕。他叹了口气，继续和伯尼一起吃晚饭。

c0c9150d17cf128ae268f8db91a07216466449f0.source: With a country that is getting more and more prosperous by the day, I'm sure that we can find a good solution in the area of health care.
c0c9150d17cf128ae268f8db91a07216466449f0.zh: 本国日益繁荣，我相信，我们能够在医疗保障方面找到一个好办法。

9eff994e0c6ce46726da6e150ab1311d3972282e.source: With adversaries out there like China, Iran, Russia, North Korea, and others -- there are even people just doing weird things in their basement sometimes. She really should have been more careful.
9eff994e0c6ce46726da6e150ab1311d3972282e.zh: 外面有中国、伊朗、俄罗斯、朝鲜等对手——有时候，甚至只是些在自家地下室里乱搞的人。她确实应该更谨慎。

d609dc1520bba66d26c31f9646e43f95e68f5032.source: With all of the maneuvering, chicanery, and propoganda that the Republicans threw at you, it's amazing that you even had a chance.
d609dc1520bba66d26c31f9646e43f95e68f5032.zh: 尽管共和党对你进行了各种诡计、欺骗和宣传，但你居然还有机会，真是太神奇了。

9f3a3fb68e88ef8f8ed248d13504b8ca105fec09.source: With all of the new programs that have implemented over the past five years, do you still believe there is room for the federal government to expand its responsibilities?
9f3a3fb68e88ef8f8ed248d13504b8ca105fec09.zh: 过去五年已经实施了这么多新项目，你是否仍认为联邦政府有进一步扩大职责的余地？

f4c897ad9e2bf96f809fcba47232a8f964bddbc0.source: With luck, you will be able to duplicate the eight years of peace and prosperity under Eisenhower. Unfortunately, the Democrats maintain their majority in both houses of Congress. With luck, they will be good partners in a bipartisan governing coalition. Your first order of business is to mend fences with Lyndon Johnson, who is returning to his role as Senate Majority Leader.
f4c897ad9e2bf96f809fcba47232a8f964bddbc0.zh: 运气好的话，你将能够复制艾森豪威尔下的八年和平与繁荣。不幸的是，民主党在国会两院仍保持多数席位。幸运的话，他们将成为两党执政联盟中的好伙伴。你的首要任务是与林登·约翰逊修复关系，他将重返参议院多数党领袖的角色。

81259b1de39406fd8ffcf115119c68a06ac534e7.source: With minimal cost and minimal loss of life, President Johnson was able to prevent a Communist uprising in the Dominican Republic. I fully support his actions in that area.
81259b1de39406fd8ffcf115119c68a06ac534e7.zh: 约翰逊总统以极小的代价和极少的人员伤亡，阻止了多米尼加共和国的共产主义起义。我完全支持他在那里的行动。

2740f8202d2aefe131508030105e3d1278080e6d.source: With minor changes like an increase to the retirement age and means testing after a certain benefit level, we can ensure the solvency of this program long into the future.
2740f8202d2aefe131508030105e3d1278080e6d.zh: 只需小幅调整，例如提高退休年龄，以及在待遇达到一定水平后按经济状况审核资格，我们就能确保这项计划在很长时间内有能力履行支付义务。

087534e7d70f1b5e79cc4a34a2fc4196e3a9e9f3.source: With minority voter suppression, Russian interference, social media misinformation, and the Postal Service's sabotage of mail-in voting, I don't know why Trump should be the one to doubt the integrity of this year's election. It's Democrats who should be worried!
087534e7d70f1b5e79cc4a34a2fc4196e3a9e9f3.zh: 少数族裔选民遭打压，俄罗斯干预，社交媒体传播虚假信息，邮政部门破坏邮寄投票——我不知道，特朗普为什么倒成了怀疑今年选举公正性的人。该担心的是民主党！

6bd8aba3bbd3558f947f57cfd7ecc63dd3f5c219.source: With the caveats added, this position can help finesse the issue among conservatives and moderates alike.
6bd8aba3bbd3558f947f57cfd7ecc63dd3f5c219.zh: 加上这些限定条件之后，这一立场能帮助你兼顾保守派与温和派，巧妙应对这个议题。

58b7bb0b9a6bbd416705386b3b425c3ebb955a37.source: With the death of Osama Bin Laden in 2011 at the hands of the Navy SEALs, a dark chapter from America's history appears to be closed. No significant terrorist attacks have occurred during the Obama Administration, and the war in Iraq appears to have been successfully ended. However, potential trouble looms with Iran's nuclear program.
58b7bb0b9a6bbd416705386b3b425c3ebb955a37.zh: 2011年，奥萨马·本·拉登被海军海豹突击队击毙，美国历史上一个黑暗篇章似乎就此结束。奥巴马执政期间没有发生重大恐怖袭击，伊拉克战争看来也已成功结束。不过，伊朗核计划仍酝酿着潜在危机。

42f7a468dea843e6c2710a844573ab484507b308.source: With the new perspectives I bring, I will be in a unique position to ensure clean, honest government at the federal level. McKinley, on the other hand, is a Republican hack who will continue the status quo.
42f7a468dea843e6c2710a844573ab484507b308.zh: 我带来的新视角，使我有独特的条件，确保联邦政府廉洁、诚实。而麦金莱不过是个共和党政客，会继续维持现状。

bef6dffde6e9909d9319be07bfe58da5e1a2ae16.source: With the tragic passing of Ruth Bader-Ginsburg, it appears that Republicans are poised to place another conservative judge on the Supreme Court. What are your thoughts on their tactics?
bef6dffde6e9909d9319be07bfe58da5e1a2ae16.zh: 露丝·巴德·金斯伯格不幸去世，共和党似乎准备再让一名保守派法官进入最高法院。你怎么看他们的策略？

956db7fb1ed7d48376ef548b371194ed558fcc73.source: With the tragic passing of Ruth Bader-Ginsburg, you have the opportunity to nominate a new Supreme Court Justice. Who will you choose?
956db7fb1ed7d48376ef548b371194ed558fcc73.zh: 露丝·巴德·金斯伯格不幸去世，你有机会提名一位新的最高法院大法官。你会选择谁？

82f67a5591292f3789096d222a700f60efad618e.source: With the walkout of the South, it might be best to moderate the Democratic party line on this issue.
82f67a5591292f3789096d222a700f60efad618e.zh: 既然南方派已经退出，这个问题上，最好让民主党的传统立场温和一些。

5c8f5cdde90adb830aa0fa89978d3f79bfea739c.source: With what we've seen recently in Hong Kong and Xinjiang, we can no longer afford to be naïve about where China is heading. I will aggressively continue our policy of pivoting to Asia to contain the rising influence of China.
5c8f5cdde90adb830aa0fa89978d3f79bfea739c.zh: 鉴于最近在香港和新疆看到的情况，我们不能再对中国的发展方向抱有天真想法。我会积极延续转向亚洲的政策，遏制中国日益增长的影响力。

d99c3ec7d2e1df6eb5699b5514d05c2dac8fffc9.source: Within minutes, headlines of “Lockdown Joe” are flooding right-wing news sites. You are definitely putting yourself front and center on this issue.
d99c3ec7d2e1df6eb5699b5514d05c2dac8fffc9.zh: 几分钟内，“封锁乔”的头条就涌入了右翼新闻网站。在这个问题上，你确实把自己推到了聚光灯下。

7124e6138312ca19c6409804bab275d2e5249bba.source: Without Texas we are done in this election. I will clearly state my disagreement with Wallace, but we should focus on other issues for the most part.
7124e6138312ca19c6409804bab275d2e5249bba.zh: 没有得克萨斯州，这场选举我们就完了。我会明确表示与华莱士意见不同，但总体还是应该集中谈其他议题。

366aa681e3ea915caea19ee6093232f9242b359f.source: Without compromising on the silver issue, what can you say about McKinley to Bourbon Democrats to try and bring them back into the fold?
366aa681e3ea915caea19ee6093232f9242b359f.zh: 在不就白银问题妥协的前提下，你能向波旁民主党人怎样评价麦金莱，争取让他们回归本党阵营？

6c194301c2b083db34273d4ed54a11c9e3b9b15c.source: Without federal support including loans and land grants, there are certain railroads which would simply be too large to construct with private capital. I was disappointed by the defeat of this bill.
6c194301c2b083db34273d4ed54a11c9e3b9b15c.zh: 没有包括贷款和赠地在内的联邦支持，某些铁路规模太大，单靠私人资本根本建不成。这项法案遭到否决，让我失望。

842f7e2d5498d2a6966e1588a14474cc00c86e15.source: Women can vote now in Colorado, Utah, Idaho, and Wyoming. This certainly can't hurt you in those states.
842f7e2d5498d2a6966e1588a14474cc00c86e15.zh: 如今，妇女已经可以在科罗拉多、犹他、爱达荷和怀俄明投票。这在这些州当然不会害了你。

03e9277f4856f4d609d3c33392f7ca9e4734a5d9.source: Woodbury is a little less moderate on some of the issues that could carry a state like Pennsylvania or New York. We shall see what happens.
03e9277f4856f4d609d3c33392f7ca9e4734a5d9.zh: 在一些可能决定宾夕法尼亚或纽约等州归属的议题上，伍德伯里略显不够温和。且看结果如何。

19e757df90035cd48898d543b0b0adad8f6b164e.source: Woodrow Wilson and the Progressive Era, 1910-1917
19e757df90035cd48898d543b0b0adad8f6b164e.zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊 和进步时代，1910-1917

f93d4abaa7994406a64cfcd983657f92820381c3.source: Woodrow Wilson has recently pushed through the Adamson Act to avert a railroad strike, which establishes an eight-hour day for railroad employees. Will you attack this action in your campaign?
f93d4abaa7994406a64cfcd983657f92820381c3.zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊最近推动通过《亚当森法》，以避免铁路罢工，为铁路雇员确立了八小时工作制。你会在竞选中抨击这一举措吗？

a210da9736d96d0bb60e2856c25c1d9d7c906442.source: Woodrow Wilson won in a 1912 landslide, and has passed an array of legislation in his first term. In 1916, however, foreign affairs are beginning to dominate. A loud minority of Democrats are aggressively anti-war and expect the same from Wilson. Can Wilson make the case that his passage of an antitrust act, a child labor law, an income tax Amendment, and the Federal Reserve Act, all warrant reelection? His recent remarriage has also fed some gossip.
a210da9736d96d0bb60e2856c25c1d9d7c906442.zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊 在 1912 年以压倒性优势获胜，并在第一个任期内通过了一系列立法。然而，到了 1916 年，外交事务开始占据主导地位。少数民主党人强烈反对战争，并期望 威尔逊 也能做到这一点。 威尔逊 能否证明他通过的反垄断法、童工法、所得税修正案和联邦储备法都值得连任？他最近的再婚也引发了一些八卦。

55434c239d1c07114408547cfdb9afeb2850aecf.zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊 的活动

49601699bd183771d33672aeb28b1dae02f4554d.source: Woodrow Wilson, Irish-Americans, and the Election of 1916
49601699bd183771d33672aeb28b1dae02f4554d.zh: 伍德罗·威尔逊，爱尔兰裔美国人和 1916 年选举

e8d285bc06ccbc11455385ddefeaf778c823d4ef.source: Word is getting around that you seem to have snubbed Bernie Sanders. This is probably not a good idea.
e8d285bc06ccbc11455385ddefeaf778c823d4ef.zh: 大家渐渐传开了，说你似乎冷落了伯尼·桑德斯。这大概不是好主意。

ee957e4052b4007d34e35f2fa3e182e58ff991e6.source: Word makes its way to New York that you and Martin Van Buren were able to put political differences aside and enjoy a few days of warm, personal companionship.
ee957e4052b4007d34e35f2fa3e182e58ff991e6.zh: 消息传到了纽约：你与马丁·范布伦暂时搁置政治分歧，共度了几天温暖融洽的私人相聚时光。

b1b8320bf907309c6da227ab24835300a59c85d6.source: Word makes its way to New York that you had Martin Van Buren in your own hometown and did not extend an invitation to him.
b1b8320bf907309c6da227ab24835300a59c85d6.zh: 消息传到了纽约：马丁·范布伦到了你的家乡，你却没有向他发出邀请。

5f887681c2bcc7a94e7c253216c828dc2d10236c.source: Workers are hoping you would take a stronger stand on this, as the man of the people in this election.
5f887681c2bcc7a94e7c253216c828dc2d10236c.zh: 工人们希望，你作为本次选举中代表人民的候选人，能在这个问题上采取更坚定的立场。

505f07a6964b33257a00bc2a60b19b27f41e369d.source: Would support an invasion of Iran and advocates for air strikes against their nuclear program. Believes in American Exceptionalism and unilateral action without restraints. Opposes membership in the United Nations. Supports increased military spending and American force projection.
505f07a6964b33257a00bc2a60b19b27f41e369d.zh: 支持入侵伊朗，主张空袭其核计划。相信美国例外论与不受限制的单边行动。反对美国留在联合国。支持增加军费、扩大美国向海外投送武力的能力。

20cf11b2287d6d9f139886ab9efda08085a05346.source: Would support any measure to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapons, but would need to see some evidence that other measures have failed before supporting an invasion. Willing to cooperate with allies and to work within the U.N. where necessary.
20cf11b2287d6d9f139886ab9efda08085a05346.zh: 支持采取任何措施阻止伊朗获得核武器，但在支持入侵之前，需要看到其他措施已经失败的证据。愿意与盟友合作，必要时在联合国框架内行动。

600a4eb1008cd8f5887542246ae23b6237c95b37.source: Would you advocate cutting Peace Corps funding to help address the deficit?
600a4eb1008cd8f5887542246ae23b6237c95b37.zh: 你是否主张削减和平队经费，以帮助解决赤字问题？

3a107057f067b1b81d2d88b61abf5cc1907ef226.source: Would you appoint federal judges who support the decision
3a107057f067b1b81d2d88b61abf5cc1907ef226.zh: 您会任命支持该决定的联邦法官吗

63a403156bbdfd3894ec0a19ea3b9a15e1446fae.source: Would you be willing to call an unconditional bombing halt of North Vietnam in the hopes of restarting peace negotiations?
63a403156bbdfd3894ec0a19ea3b9a15e1446fae.zh: 为了争取重启和平谈判，你愿意无条件停止轰炸北越吗？

50dfc83a6520b27646aa2d707bff542149713773.source: Would you be willing to place increasing responsibility in the hands of South Vietnam for their own defense?
50dfc83a6520b27646aa2d707bff542149713773.zh: 你愿意逐步让南越承担更多自身防务责任吗？

5ebc2048041b996a81851a77c045a8e3f3e79a4f.source: Would you support federal "Blue Laws" to protect the sanctity of Sunday?
5ebc2048041b996a81851a77c045a8e3f3e79a4f.zh: 你支持制定联邦“蓝色法”，维护星期日的神圣性吗？

d3351ca94e7e6746116a5280850dc501e10fcc29.source: Would you support posting active U.S. Army troops on the U.S.-Mexico border to prevent illegal immigration and drug smuggling?
d3351ca94e7e6746116a5280850dc501e10fcc29.zh: 你是否支持在美墨边境部署现役美国陆军，以阻止非法移民和毒品走私？

6a5a3e18589300121c8d181a7266e2cf7b0c54f8.source: Would you support the annexation of Texas, even without an agreement with Mexico, and a possible war?
6a5a3e18589300121c8d181a7266e2cf7b0c54f8.zh: 即使未与墨西哥达成协议，而且可能引发战争，你仍会支持吞并得克萨斯吗？

9279ab048981d88343a558b0698a1024a86b84f3.source: Would you support the passage of a federal civil rights bill as President to address the worst excesses of segregation in the South?
9279ab048981d88343a558b0698a1024a86b84f3.zh: 作为总统，你会支持通过一项联邦民权法案，制止南方种族隔离中最恶劣的行为吗？

a1ad9e927b10e26750d51d6bea3dc959c93b9046.source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. Carter put up a strong fight, however, and without the Playboy scandal, you likely wouldn't have won. The Democrats are sure to make some electoral changes after two outsiders in a row preventing them from winning...
a1ad9e927b10e26750d51d6bea3dc959c93b9046.zh: 哇！你顶住不利局势，击退民主党，为本党又赢得一个任期。赦免尼克松后，多数人都以为你完了，但你证明他们错了。不过，卡特奋力一战；要是没有《花花公子》风波，你很可能赢不了。连续两位局外人阻碍民主党获胜之后，他们肯定会推动一些选举改革……

a974a8ecd18863a551dfea488cb83311a1d20457.source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. You barely squeaked by, however. Carter gave you a run for your money, and congress isn't too friendly towards you either, so you better tread carefully.
a974a8ecd18863a551dfea488cb83311a1d20457.zh: 哇！你顶住不利局势，击退民主党，为本党又赢得一个任期。赦免尼克松后，多数人都以为你完了，但你证明他们错了。不过，你只是勉强险胜。卡特让你打得十分吃力，国会对你也不太友好，你最好小心行事。

f17fa232aca16f0f6aaebc5cbc3e6ffa26439a73.source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. You won by a quite shocking margin. It seems your rose garden strategy worked well.
f17fa232aca16f0f6aaebc5cbc3e6ffa26439a73.zh: 哇！你顶住不利局势，击退民主党，为本党又赢得一个任期。赦免尼克松后，多数人都以为你完了，但你证明他们错了。你的获胜优势大得令人震惊。看来，你的玫瑰园策略奏效了。

93639e16b150ee1d71b6adf6cb856c1431f33819.source: Wow! No candidate achieved a majority in the electoral college.
93639e16b150ee1d71b6adf6cb856c1431f33819.zh: 哇！没有候选人在 选举人团 中获得多数票。

5b2c6f2f042cf9851ee0f5279f2e60d081e678d8.source: Wow! No candidate holds a majority in the electoral college.
5b2c6f2f042cf9851ee0f5279f2e60d081e678d8.zh: 哇！没有候选人在 选举人团 中占据多数。

1e54f77788ed2a9f7f3da5f0a2087cda575ab164.source: Wow! No candidate received 270 electoral votes, but the House will elect George W. Bush as President.
1e54f77788ed2a9f7f3da5f0a2087cda575ab164.zh: 哇！没有候选人获得 270 张选举人票，但众议院将选举 乔治·W.·布什 为总统。

bc464f5ac5469568644f9b9c0aebf38836eae617.source: Wow! You have pulled out 2016 election.
bc464f5ac5469568644f9b9c0aebf38836eae617.zh: 哇！您已退出 2016 年大选。
