3f5722e4a6c2804dc1cea68e924e0a97969cea92.zh: 你突然被推到政治聚光灯下，又骤然跌落，实在戏剧性十足。接下来做什么，由你决定。或许可以重返众议院，尽管未必还能担任领导职位。四年后再参选的可能性不大，里根及其支持者联盟已经准备好推举他了。或许他会像你这次向保守派示好一样，向你伸出橄榄枝，考虑让你担任他的副总统？

2faecef0349a4e1d77a7f1c118bddc74abe5c1d7.source: Your rebuke only worsens the fracture in the party, but Humphrey is pleased by your steadfast support- as are liberals nationwide. You may have broken the Solid South, but the rest of the country might just make up for it.
2faecef0349a4e1d77a7f1c118bddc74abe5c1d7.zh: 你的斥责进一步加剧了党内分裂，不过，你坚定的支持让汉弗莱和全国自由派都感到欣慰。你或许打破了“稳固南方”，但全国其他地区的支持，也许足以弥补损失。

408f44a3e03de6a39e9c5fbac4fd2211ca738ab6.source: Your renunciation of Black Lives Matter does not sit well with the progressive movement.
408f44a3e03de6a39e9c5fbac4fd2211ca738ab6.zh: 你对“黑人的命也是命”运动的否定，让进步派运动难以接受。

3f4a85d01b49367ff572e4cb6d84ed9ba3858197.source: Your response is a little cautious, so no damage will occur. However, no benefit will come from it also.
3f4a85d01b49367ff572e4cb6d84ed9ba3858197.zh: 你的回应有些谨慎，不会带来损害，也不会带来好处。

796901d04902de7a63852830b65356b8ab5fbe90.source: Your response is really in tune with the mood of the country.
796901d04902de7a63852830b65356b8ab5fbe90.zh: 你的回应确实契合全国的情绪。

ba8b10c2e43fa40d5d038f1fae0098bf3a301301.source: Your response leans conservative, hurting approval from liberals, but does great for many moderates.
ba8b10c2e43fa40d5d038f1fae0098bf3a301301.zh: 你的回应偏保守，损害了自由派对你的认可，却很能争取许多温和派。

3edd34ac88af45eda2d04f280cb60c5fc1f9fc29.zh: “杜威在民权问题上反击”，新闻头条这样写道。人们正在注意此事。

52078659d6bc8d1f6c183736911346173ed56b31.zh: “不出所料，你输掉了 2000 年选举。”

8279263e32c08591c386d1c185e8eabf5469a013.zh: “上帝啊！你赢得了 2000 年选举！”

20ac55b630c679eb3d1ed81e9102054cf0dbd893.source: ”The Senate will now vote on H.R. 5411, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2001.”
20ac55b630c679eb3d1ed81e9102054cf0dbd893.zh: “参议院现在将对 H.R. 5411 号《2001 财年国防授权法案》进行投票。”

7aa1e3af6f0aeb45bbc4d014797a9f2fafab2806.source: You've done it. The terror that has been the Trump administration comes to a close with your win tonight. They say third times the charm, and you certainly proved it tonight. Your margin, which clocks in at 306 electoral votes exactly, is certainly humorous, as that's the amount Trump had 4 years ago. The Senate remains hanging in the balance, due to two runoff elections in Georgia. Republicans are calling foul play, but you knew that would happen.
7aa1e3af6f0aeb45bbc4d014797a9f2fafab2806.zh: 你做到了。今晚的胜利，终结了特朗普政府带来的可怕岁月。俗话说，事不过三，你今晚确实证明了这一点。你恰好拿到306张选举人票，实在有点好笑，因为特朗普四年前拿到的就是这个数。由于佐治亚州有两场决选，参议院控制权仍悬而未决。共和党人指责有人作弊，可你早就知道他们会这么说。

ecd4f84cf4c814abfe9547b3c9454fb9a8170cd5.source: You've gained a bit for being honest, but this can't be good for your chances in Texas.
ecd4f84cf4c814abfe9547b3c9454fb9a8170cd5.zh: 诚实让你得到了一点好处，但这肯定不利于你在得克萨斯州的胜算。

c74ea5fe9c5e079a61deab5dbc373a5bf096a3dd.source: You've given a good speech, but most Americans don't have strong feelings about Thomas Dewey, and you haven't really energized them.
c74ea5fe9c5e079a61deab5dbc373a5bf096a3dd.zh: 你的演说不错，但大多数美国人对托马斯·杜威没有强烈感受，你也没能真正激发他们的热情。

bb3b5c27ff7b72d2b54bdb53d9ac41d3af266f01.source: You've lost the support of so many groups with that response that I don't know where to begin.
bb3b5c27ff7b72d2b54bdb53d9ac41d3af266f01.zh: 这番回答让你失去了太多团体的支持，我都不知道该从哪儿说起。

c03ae4d2ebd5d46981a8c9e9bacc3be1102e3bc1.source: You've managed to come across as Nixon's equal in these debates, and that alone is a good start...
c03ae4d2ebd5d46981a8c9e9bacc3be1102e3bc1.zh: 在这些辩论中，你成功地表现出与尼克松旗鼓相当，单是这一点，就是个不错的开端……

a09d18a3aa5e04745c4a61199cf56359ad9dd441.source: You've managed to offend everyone with this answer. Sounding conservative and praising labor unions at the same time?
a09d18a3aa5e04745c4a61199cf56359ad9dd441.zh: 这个回答把所有人都得罪了。既要说得保守，又要赞扬工会？

f40f50219b5ec1b772e5bd85b2ef85d9be274a1f.source: You've offended nobody, but also pleased nobody. There are whispers from some that you can't take a stand on any important issue.
f40f50219b5ec1b772e5bd85b2ef85d9be274a1f.zh: 你没有冒犯任何人，也没有让任何人满意。有人私下议论，说你在任何重要问题上都拿不出立场。

733c8b234093b5171fb3a90297d6663061ca0c24.source: You've recently appeared with George Wallace, infamous Governor of Alabama, on the campaign trail. What do you have to say about that?
733c8b234093b5171fb3a90297d6663061ca0c24.zh: 最近，你与臭名昭著的亚拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士一同出现在竞选活动中。你对此有什么要说的？

722a7b8b6ed0c25573ea2e3cd2dfb44934721bff.source: You've redeemed yourself in the eyes of labor and energized the Democratic base.
722a7b8b6ed0c25573ea2e3cd2dfb44934721bff.zh: 你在劳工眼中挽回了形象，也激发了民主党基本盘的热情。

bb82072095f0572fdb09d66d5bf44cd159720f09.source: You've run a couple of ads which have been confusing to voters, more than anything. What do you stand for? What is Bush doing wrong?
bb82072095f0572fdb09d66d5bf44cd159720f09.zh: 你投放的几则广告，主要效果似乎是让选民摸不着头脑。你到底主张什么？布什究竟错在哪里？

90b501411e61754ef8ce010e797a5b80bdc7856a.source: You've seen what's going on out there. Riots, fires, disrespect for police. We need to do everything we can to allow law-abiding citizens to defend themselves at home and in public.
90b501411e61754ef8ce010e797a5b80bdc7856a.zh: 你已经看到外头发生的事。骚乱、纵火，不尊重警察。我们需要尽一切努力，让守法公民能在家中和公共场合自卫。

826efd91dc75f941636fb32af07241b3a1f1ac74.source: You've spent years convincing your Republican base that you had changed your mind on this issue. What gives?
826efd91dc75f941636fb32af07241b3a1f1ac74.zh: 你花了多年时间，说服共和党基本盘相信，你在这件事上已经改变主意。现在又是怎么回事？

a1f5b931270fc398788f7e9f866a1c7e58291966.source: You've strangely taken the side of the right in one of this election's defining issues.
a1f5b931270fc398788f7e9f866a1c7e58291966.zh: 在本次选举的标志性议题之一上，你竟然站到了右派一边。

67b55e31ed9f65226a5ee1c2a26aa64874e3fd0a.source: You've taken the same position as Ford on this issue. But it is probably the majority view at this time.
67b55e31ed9f65226a5ee1c2a26aa64874e3fd0a.zh: 你在这个问题上采取了与福特相同的立场。不过，它大概也是目前多数人的看法。

a7a578a83d26340f100c1d334902c3e4b3782419.source: Romney will try to frame his business and executive experience as a contrast to the background and results of Obama.
a7a578a83d26340f100c1d334902c3e4b3782419.zh: 罗姆尼将突出自己的商界经历和行政经验，与奥巴马的背景及施政成果形成对比。

711596c301da7e280141d8ebe695fc3a84072f4c.source: Better to finesse this issue, than to turn off a wing of the party like you just did.
711596c301da7e280141d8ebe695fc3a84072f4c.zh: 最好巧妙处理这个问题，而不是像你刚才那样，得罪党内一整派人。

3f25221bd3d735eb1a471483d57a41920d995ff4.source: Better to just ignore this letter.
3f25221bd3d735eb1a471483d57a41920d995ff4.zh: 最好直接不理会这封信。

ee8cd0cf43668d39a71201fc3da7b42d11176e17.source: Better to keep the German vote in line -- A few Know-Nothings (in the North) may vote for Bell, but they are more likely to despise Stephen A. Douglas, and vote for the man who can beat him.
ee8cd0cf43668d39a71201fc3da7b42d11176e17.zh: 最好稳住德裔选民的支持。北方一些一无所知党人或许会投给贝尔，但他们更可能厌恶斯蒂芬·A.·道格拉斯，转而支持能够击败他的人。

a7f23a4c9c774b18af2fb3deb6a9ac139c9d9c99.source: Betty Ford is out there making some pretty bold statements about sexuality, marijuana, and other topics. Conservatives want to know if you can have a quiet chat with her to tone it down a bit.
a7f23a4c9c774b18af2fb3deb6a9ac139c9d9c99.zh: 贝蒂·福特正在公开谈论性、大麻等话题，言论颇为大胆。保守派想知道，你能否私下与她谈谈，让她收敛一点。

ff8136df4a3695fe9957ed2bba0a9ca0695f70ff.source: Biden looked down, tears in eyes... he lost everything. He had failed the Democratic party, who would surely catapult him, and anyone involved in this loss, millions of miles away from them. He had failed Barack, who had put so much trust in him as to intervene on his behalf in the primaries. Not only had he failed the millions who had trusted him in the primaries, but he had failed his family. From now on, "Biden" would be a dirty phrase, his kids wouldn't be able to get anywhere without being associated with him. He would be a burden to everyone.
ff8136df4a3695fe9957ed2bba0a9ca0695f70ff.zh: 拜登低下头，眼里含着泪水……他失去了一切。他辜负了民主党，后者肯定会将他以及所有卷入这场损失的人弹射到距他们数百万英里之外的地方。他辜负了巴拉克的信任，巴拉克非常信任他，甚至代表他干预初选。他不仅辜负了数百万在初选时信任他的人，也辜负了他的家人。从现在开始，“拜登”将成为一个脏话，他的孩子们如果不与他联系，就寸步难行。他会成为每个人的负担。

bfde29297d3a1832f01e5ed695d97a25a35d1709.source: Biden picked up the pistol he kept in his drawer. Maybe McGovern could tell him how to deal with a loss like this.
bfde29297d3a1832f01e5ed695d97a25a35d1709.zh: 拜登 拿起他放在抽屉里的手枪。也许麦戈文可以告诉他如何应对这样的损失。

aa331f83453a40ee612087aa49737efe2ad1486e.source: Biden was going across the media, trying to popularise his claims of electoral fraud before the Congressional certification occurred. In addition, he was preparing a major rally near the Capitol, where he could show those crooked Republicans a piece of his mind. January 6th was going to be a date to live in infamy. Joe was gonna fight like hell.
aa331f83453a40ee612087aa49737efe2ad1486e.zh: 拜登 正在通过媒体，试图在国会认证发生之前宣传他对选举舞弊的指控。此外，他正在国会大厦附近准备一场大型集会，在那里他可以向那些不诚实的共和党人表明他的想法。 1 月 6 日将是一个臭名昭著的日子。乔要拼命战斗。

c2e0db46ed0662ae277eebe8fe179415801b7ada.source: Big cities have a higher social burden than most jurisdictions. It's only right that they should receive extra financial help to compensate.
c2e0db46ed0662ae277eebe8fe179415801b7ada.zh: 大城市承担的社会负担比多数地方更重。给予它们额外财政帮助作为补偿，是理所当然的。

88ee896091f277326f6f24e20162c7b0a04693ae.source: Right-wing media spins your promise to raise taxes. The left is concerned about what exactly your "tough choices" will be.
88ee896091f277326f6f24e20162c7b0a04693ae.zh: 右翼媒体对你增税的承诺大做文章。左翼则担心，你所谓的“艰难选择”到底是什么。

ee4be8307cada190153ead07455a8f3b25621de3.source: Right-wing websites have been circulating a story about a laptop that your son, Hunter, purportedly lost. Do you have any comment?
ee4be8307cada190153ead07455a8f3b25621de3.zh: 右翼网站一直在传播一则故事，涉及据称被你的儿子亨特遗失的一台笔记本电脑。你有什么评论？

774cb9f6dfaf4a8848e0a9616869eefae0184dd3.source: Rockefeller and Nixon competed vigorously for the 1968 nomination. Rockefeller's moderate reputation and New York location could both be assets in the campaign.
774cb9f6dfaf4a8848e0a9616869eefae0184dd3.zh: 洛克菲勒 和 尼克松 为 1968 年的提名展开了激烈的竞争。 洛克菲勒 的中等声誉和 纽约州 的位置都可以成为竞选活动中的资产。

644171cdf382f168477e621c1b3cb31c3a8be9c8.source: Rockefeller and his supporters are concerned about the tepid nature of your endorsement, after the promises you had to make to get him in the ticket...
644171cdf382f168477e621c1b3cb31c3a8be9c8.zh: 为了让洛克菲勒加入竞选组合，你之前不得不作出那些承诺；如今你表态如此温吞，让他和他的支持者感到担忧……

6f0d31cc359ae5aada4d692ca2e85480606b36b7.source: Rockefeller gives you a silent, unmistakable glare. He never thought he'd live to see a Republican of your ilk speaking out against his business.
6f0d31cc359ae5aada4d692ca2e85480606b36b7.zh: 洛克菲勒一言不发，却明显狠狠瞪了你一眼。他从未想过，有生之年竟会看到你这样的共和党人，公开反对他的企业。

42a9a6797e2960f3c19bfd28c915607d58e76333.source: Rockefeller knows my positions well. I feel as if it would be unbecoming to give him personal assurances, however. I work for all of the American people.
42a9a6797e2960f3c19bfd28c915607d58e76333.zh: 洛克菲勒很了解我的立场。不过，亲自向他作保证，我觉得有失身份。我为全体美国人民服务。

fb919a31488cb1e980b5fa5fff2914701cacee83.source: Rockefeller gives you a solemn nod of approval. His support will be priceless this fall.
fb919a31488cb1e980b5fa5fff2914701cacee83.zh: 洛克菲勒郑重地点头表示赞许。今年秋天，他的支持将无比珍贵。

9f20c1c34c3fe85d8c377e22fe020c83ca25cd0a.source: Romneycare will most likely be replacing Obamacare (although they aren't all too different), as well as the Bush tax cuts will be extended to help the economy grow. If you're able to recover it and don't make any major mistakes, you should be able to win re-election in 2016. Get ready to move into the White House!.
9f20c1c34c3fe85d8c377e22fe020c83ca25cd0a.zh: 罗姆尼医改很可能将取代奥巴马医改，尽管两者其实差别不大；布什减税政策也将延长，以帮助经济增长。如果你能让经济复苏，又不犯大错，应该可以在2016年赢得连任。准备搬进白宫吧！

9880994826c583d959e5a47f65ed23faa3a8e94b.source: Romney is an avowed peace candidate however, which could hurt Nixon in the South. He will mainly help Nixon compete against Humphrey -- not against Wallace.
9880994826c583d959e5a47f65ed23faa3a8e94b.zh: 罗姆尼 是一名公开的和平候选人，这可能会伤害南方的 尼克松。他将主要帮助尼克松与汉弗莱竞争——而不是与华莱士竞争。

378b7c19842660dc436313ce710cb57813cfd106.source: Should corporations be permitted to hire private detectives for security, and to infiltrate into labor movements?
378b7c19842660dc436313ce710cb57813cfd106.zh: 应当允许企业雇用私人侦探负责安保，并渗透进劳工运动吗？

11e56395ca2c9e69b64d52aaec67307b2478235a.source: Should low-income parents be able to use federal vouchers to send their children to private schools?
11e56395ca2c9e69b64d52aaec67307b2478235a.zh: 是否应允许低收入家长使用联邦教育券，让孩子上私立学校？

a46d087d667217fa1aee1678ee23d24c857da41c.source: Should middle school students learn about contraception in health class, or will this simply encourage them to experiment?
a46d087d667217fa1aee1678ee23d24c857da41c.zh: 初中生是否应该在健康课上学习避孕知识，还是这样只会鼓励他们尝试性行为？

e9b38aeeb362cf7b93cf9645341de6e29ff3825f.source: Should large banks like Chase, Citibank, and Bank of America be broken up to reduce the risk of another financial crisis?
e9b38aeeb362cf7b93cf9645341de6e29ff3825f.zh: 是否应该拆分摩根大通、花旗银行和美国银行等大银行，以降低再次发生金融危机的风险？

2acffc71cda3c0bf3f161ee49c32a46c16d02c05.source: Should the Confederate flag be removed entirely from the South Carolina statehouse grounds?
2acffc71cda3c0bf3f161ee49c32a46c16d02c05.zh: 是否应该把邦联旗帜完全撤出南卡罗来纳州议会大厦周边场地？

cf369d28d83807264e55e60954ebcddbb2c64908.source: Should military women serve in combat roles?
cf369d28d83807264e55e60954ebcddbb2c64908.zh: 军中女性是否应该担任作战岗位？

c7f475dcd78a69f52ad5a1897c3f0ec219232cf2.source: Should the DEA prosecute medicinal marijuana growers in states where that practice has been legalized?
c7f475dcd78a69f52ad5a1897c3f0ec219232cf2.zh: 在已经允许种植医用大麻的州，缉毒局是否应该起诉种植者？

3af23c593863e8d21b2560c996878bb053765df3.source: Should the Social Security Trust Fund be purchasing U.S. Treasury bills? Should it be allowed to invest in other bonds and securities to potentially increase its rate of return? Or conversely, should the funds be held in a 'lockbox' to guarantee benefit payments?
3af23c593863e8d21b2560c996878bb053765df3.zh: 社会保障信托基金应当购买美国短期国债吗？是否应允许它投资其他债券和证券，以争取更高回报？还是应当把资金锁进“保险箱”，确保福利金能够支付？

97a86ab3127486fc1507512ae78f5165956279cb.source: Should the United States apologize to the Soviet Union for the controversy surrounding the downed U-2 spy plane and surrounding espionage?
97a86ab3127486fc1507512ae78f5165956279cb.zh: 对于U-2侦察机被击落及相关间谍活动引发的争议，美国应该向苏联道歉吗？

213a827e41807e5cca2d1adf9d34d660617b8ba4.source: Should the United States contribute funds to help stabilize the European Union's sovereign debt problems, in order to prevent a possible debt contagion?
213a827e41807e5cca2d1adf9d34d660617b8ba4.zh: 美国是否应该出资帮助欧盟稳定主权债务问题，以防债务危机蔓延？

ff188ecb23c4122d6858f52f5d41c359a23b31b5.source: Should the United States have been so quick to drop its support for Hosni Mubarak in 2011, given recent events in Egypt?
ff188ecb23c4122d6858f52f5d41c359a23b31b5.zh: 考虑到埃及近期的局势，美国在2011年是否不该那么快就放弃支持胡斯尼·穆巴拉克？

93b41990cc62fbbecacbde1cd4f5d46945fc27d8.source: Should the federal government continue to finance newer companies that attempt to develop alternative energy resources, such as solar power and electric car manufacturers?
93b41990cc62fbbecacbde1cd4f5d46945fc27d8.zh: 联邦政府是否应该继续资助尝试开发替代能源的新企业，例如太阳能企业和电动汽车制造商？

dc01a07ce11d75090e3f13c2db431d207612e6f3.source: Should the federal government make an effort to build a canal through Nicaragua to more efficiently link trade in the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans?
dc01a07ce11d75090e3f13c2db431d207612e6f3.zh: 联邦政府应当努力修建横贯尼加拉瓜的运河，更高效地连接大西洋与太平洋之间的贸易吗？

6adf8ab56c1d960798dd72365100672a00e7975f.source: Should the government be doing more to stabilize home prices?
6adf8ab56c1d960798dd72365100672a00e7975f.zh: 政府是否应该采取更多措施稳定房价？

ab5bdfa42c8c9789b65760ad8a2282392ba7f5b8.source: The Negro problem apparently wasn't enough for our federal bureaucrats, because they decided to add Mexicans and Orientals to the list as well. I oppose new immigration to this country.
ab5bdfa42c8c9789b65760ad8a2282392ba7f5b8.zh: 黑人问题显然对我们的联邦官僚来说还不够，因为他们决定将墨西哥人和东方人也添加到名单中。我反对新移民进入这个国家。

068d7e0989cebae689e850972d7d306ba819a66a.source: The New York Stock Exchange is a private company providing liquidity to other companies. The last thing our fragile economy needs is some hare-brained intervention in this process.
068d7e0989cebae689e850972d7d306ba819a66a.zh: 纽约证券交易所是一家私人企业，为其他企业提供流动性。我们脆弱的经济，最不需要的就是对这个过程横加一些荒唐的干预。

2408c1adce20d76760cb0bc7e6d6dfc318eb5ef7.source: The New York Post has broken a story about a laptop that Hunter Biden purportedly lost. Do you have any comment?
2408c1adce20d76760cb0bc7e6d6dfc318eb5ef7.zh: 《纽约邮报》披露了一则故事，涉及据称被亨特·拜登遗失的一台笔记本电脑。你有什么评论？

c0a097e02ea4ce41638b1b0a89d12a6ca116482f.source: The Panic of 1893 with Lawrence Reed
c0a097e02ea4ce41638b1b0a89d12a6ca116482f.zh: 劳伦斯·里德的 1893 年恐慌

74106efcd2a0eb0c31fd0244ca2f3e6d96dfd90f.zh: 通往 佛罗里达州 的道路

32d312bb1489364873334f7107d0515f565cfd46.source: The Peace Corps is a pointless department and it should be abolished.
32d312bb1489364873334f7107d0515f565cfd46.zh: 和平队是个毫无意义的部门，应该撤销。

591929e98753e548ddd7b6b0f83e536f7574e35d.source: The Pershing Expedition makes its way into Mexico as the campaign at home progresses.
591929e98753e548ddd7b6b0f83e536f7574e35d.zh: 国内竞选正在进行，潘兴远征军也在向墨西哥境内推进。

9c82cba089c0080614c87dd9fb1f9ba595d0a987.source: The Plains have been a bit rocky in their support for us recently. We'll go through there and secure their votes.
9c82cba089c0080614c87dd9fb1f9ba595d0a987.zh: 最近，大平原地区对我们的支持有些摇摆。我们去那里走一趟，稳住他们的选票。

5baa21d4de46a7af371bfcb23c6302b72bcb836b.source: The Pill does not augur well for the social health of this nation. If we could get the support I'd love to see an Amendment that settles this issue once and for all.
5baa21d4de46a7af371bfcb23c6302b72bcb836b.zh: 避孕药对这个国家的社会风气可不是什么好兆头。只要能争取到支持，我非常希望通过宪法修正案，彻底解决这个问题。

cfc6e62cc0b214c58826134374e17f7b9fc98352.source: The President is supposed to do what the American people want them to do, and the people in this country are pro-life, and I will respect that.
cfc6e62cc0b214c58826134374e17f7b9fc98352.zh: 总统应该做美国人民希望他做的事，而这个国家的人民反对堕胎，我会尊重这一点。

958c54e1ee11f1f9b5b2b5d4213078fdf7b3161c.source: The Pullman Strike of 1894 disrupted half of the nation's rail traffic and threatened to throw our society into complete turmoil. A small group of radicals should never have the power to disrupt the lives of millions.
958c54e1ee11f1f9b5b2b5d4213078fdf7b3161c.zh: 1894年普尔曼大罢工扰乱了全国一半的铁路运输，险些让社会陷入彻底混乱。绝不能让一小撮激进分子有权打乱数百万人的生活。

de5a88192f108152f1985a64162e17b973bb9034.zh: 拉尔夫·纳德 阅读器

b0d1a71f0831dc2aadea646bf6c0fe3d1fadad1c.source: The Real Making of the President: Kennedy, Nixon, and the 1960 Election
b0d1a71f0831dc2aadea646bf6c0fe3d1fadad1c.zh: 总统的真实塑造：肯尼迪、尼克松 和 1960 年选举

cdbe85baa49eb62ea9be72040e5fd000e8c103c0.source: We have the example of Solyndra staring us in the face, and people want to do the same thing again with other companies? We should end this program as soon as possible.
cdbe85baa49eb62ea9be72040e5fd000e8c103c0.zh: 索林德拉公司的教训就在眼前，有人竟然还想在其他公司身上重来一次？我们应该尽快结束这项计划。

3f15720927d41f41543b3fcd107b74074d591c4c.source: The Republican Party will always stand for free enterprise and common-sense solutions. I am conservative just the same as Ronald Reagan is.
3f15720927d41f41543b3fcd107b74074d591c4c.zh: 共和党始终支持自由企业和符合常识的解决办法。我和罗纳德·里根一样，都是保守派。

7082db775e1a303558a54f6cc1b9140498a65402.source: We have the upper-hand here, and we need to hammer the Southern Whigs on their allegiance to a party that is drifting towards increasingly radical positions.
7082db775e1a303558a54f6cc1b9140498a65402.zh: 我们在这里占据上风，必须猛烈抨击南方辉格党人：他们仍然效忠一个立场日趋激进的政党。

8899022d2004cdae720ca1d2080b7e7cfc0cbc78.source: We have to be realistic. I am pro-life in most cases, but we also need exceptions for cases of rape and incest. I do agree, however, that taxpayers should never be forced to finance this practice.
8899022d2004cdae720ca1d2080b7e7cfc0cbc78.zh: 我们必须现实一点。我在多数情况下反对堕胎，但也需要为强奸和乱伦的情况设立例外。不过，我确实赞同，绝不应该强迫纳税人为堕胎提供资金。

06cd13ecf442ae656a7e0d8aabd1d458c31dbf8c.source: We have to be very realistic about how much cooperation is possible between the U.S. and China, but Trump's actions the past four years haven't helped. The last thing we need to be doing right now is inflaming the situation.
06cd13ecf442ae656a7e0d8aabd1d458c31dbf8c.zh: 对于美中能开展多少合作，我们必须非常现实，但特朗普过去四年的行动并没有帮助。现在最不该做的，就是进一步激化局势。

4acf3a602823dfbd4997b825b2db1c7d9bca83dd.source: We have to consider each case individually. New York was a one time thing, and they also had to make significant reforms before this loan was approved.
4acf3a602823dfbd4997b825b2db1c7d9bca83dd.zh: 我们必须逐案考虑。纽约只是一次特殊安排，而且贷款获准前，纽约也必须实行重大改革。

a1d0296c9261c03362ae4b22b04e2ec80cf4d66b.source: We have to make difficult choices. I don't like this any more than most people, but small cuts are necessary to put us on a fiscally sustainable path.
a1d0296c9261c03362ae4b22b04e2ec80cf4d66b.zh: 我们必须作出艰难抉择。我和大多数人一样不喜欢这样，但小幅削减是让财政走上可持续轨道所必需的。

a912140a4041480e3b442768153ef6310a642ace.source: We have to put this waste somewhere. I understand the objections from some in Nevada, but where else are we supposed to store it?
a912140a4041480e3b442768153ef6310a642ace.zh: 总得找个地方存放这些废料。我理解内华达州一些人的反对意见，但不放在那里，我们还能存到哪儿？

bbf695797c3f628a20e6db2566a733c41f5e7f1d.source: We have worked for years with many other countries to negotiate this agreement. I support the environment and believe the Protocol should be ratified.
bbf695797c3f628a20e6db2566a733c41f5e7f1d.zh: 我们已与许多其他国家协商这项协定多年。我支持环保，认为应当批准议定书。

39a4e28ce048bd09060419d93f636000f86748f9.source: We have too much of a farm surplus right now, and we need to reduce subsidies for production so that prices can fall into balance and benefit the consumer.
39a4e28ce048bd09060419d93f636000f86748f9.zh: 目前农业剩余产品太多，我们需要减少生产补贴，使价格恢复平衡，让消费者受益。

798e7b0e81b82d899debdf74a3a0204b486e4717.source: We join the Republicans in denouncing this decision. We may have our differences, but we can all agree that this Court has acted well beyond its bounds in this case.
798e7b0e81b82d899debdf74a3a0204b486e4717.zh: 我们将与共和党一起谴责这项判决。彼此虽然有分歧，但都能同意：在此案中，法院的作为远远越过了界限。

a502850fd50f9858595799627e4afbffdb011809.source: We just don't know yet -- I've heard some scary things but we need to see here in a few weeks, it's something we'll be checking very closely.
a502850fd50f9858595799627e4afbffdb011809.zh: 我们还不知道。我听过一些可怕的消息，但需要过几周再看看。这件事，我们会非常仔细地检查。

bb755ba56ddbdfbc54c91c89b5eec9a9461c1437.source: What Truman really means when he calls this the "Do-Nothing" Congress is that they won't pass a program for national health insurance or the drastic expansion of Social Security. I will attack Truman for calling a pointless session for his own political purposes.
bb755ba56ddbdfbc54c91c89b5eec9a9461c1437.zh: 杜鲁门所谓“无所作为的国会”，其实是说他们不肯通过全国医疗保险计划，也不肯大幅扩张社会保障制度。我要抨击他为了自己的政治目的，召开毫无意义的特别会议。

9e49e50d6dca7101f15f2a7cef5e801cfbbc0871.source: What a campaign! You’ve managed to surpass expectations and net yourself some electoral votes! You should have no trouble gaining federal matching funds next election, and you can take solace in the fact that the people of D.C. chose the only capable man this election.
9e49e50d6dca7101f15f2a7cef5e801cfbbc0871.zh: 多么棒的活动啊！您已经超出了预期并为自己赢得了一些选举人票！下次选举你应该可以毫无困难地获得联邦配套资金，而且你可以因为华盛顿人民在这次选举中选择了唯一有能力的人而感到安慰。

670de7e97125b26fcd6e10214f18581c66ded258.source: What Would It Take To Turn Blue States Red?
670de7e97125b26fcd6e10214f18581c66ded258.zh: 怎样才能把蓝州变成红色？

8897c31e9e9b1b2a86805c39adedc3fa326c1041.source: What a strange and completely tin-eared response.
8897c31e9e9b1b2a86805c39adedc3fa326c1041.zh: 这回答真奇怪，而且完全不懂察言观色。

399d38258d3ea4a1f2d37733cb9c6d50f866272e.source: What about the honesty and integrity of Jimmy Carter? Whether it's abortion, gun control, busing, or labor, he's taken both sides of too many issues to count.
399d38258d3ea4a1f2d37733cb9c6d50f866272e.zh: 那吉米·卡特的诚实与廉正呢？不论堕胎、枪支管制、校车接送还是劳工，他在太多问题上两边都说过好话，多得数不清。

be110f4758d06566ddc46737dea47067df19c4fb.source: What a ride. Good luck tomorrow!
be110f4758d06566ddc46737dea47067df19c4fb.zh: 这一路真够跌宕起伏。祝你明天好运！

c523bb7bc9700aeaa168c0995d6d62dbaef12236.source: What actions do you support to mitigate the effects of climate change?
c523bb7bc9700aeaa168c0995d6d62dbaef12236.zh: 你支持采取哪些行动来减轻气候变化的影响？

e3eea4cb82686f98c1ceeb829d901621690ee435.source: What actions would you take in Syria to help stabilize the situation there, and to combat ISIS?
e3eea4cb82686f98c1ceeb829d901621690ee435.zh: 你会在叙利亚采取哪些行动，以稳定当地局势、打击“伊斯兰国”？

e0bba85ab0ca333d20c8a676ab3837e23ffe549e.source: What an exciting last day of the campaign! Let's see how the voting goes tomorrow.
e0bba85ab0ca333d20c8a676ab3837e23ffe549e.zh: 竞选的最后一天真热闹！看看明天的投票结果吧。

081d4fc6ab2a135f41853b63c9224a27c9ec9268.source: What are the next steps that the United States should take to combat global warming?
081d4fc6ab2a135f41853b63c9224a27c9ec9268.zh: 为应对全球变暖，美国下一步应该做什么？

7be603494afc3f44ca2a167b6293aec4ad6682b9.source: What are your feelings in the

9f82e13930a50395da384ad520efb1a48c57f2f7.source: What are your opinions on child labor legislation, as exemplified by the recent Keating-Owens child labor bill?
9f82e13930a50395da384ad520efb1a48c57f2f7.zh: 最近提出的基廷—欧文童工法案，是童工立法的一例。你对这类立法有什么看法？

f0e7b0810128861e10c1ca2ba3de9aeeae37fea4.source: What are your thoughts on the Women's Christian Temperance Union? Is this group a positive force in American life?
f0e7b0810128861e10c1ca2ba3de9aeeae37fea4.zh: 你如何看待妇女基督教禁酒联合会？这个团体对美国社会具有积极作用吗？

bfe50aef6b1584c6619a199e47ed1da531b5acf5.source: What are your thoughts on the USS Cole bombing, which has killed 17 American sailors. How should we prevent such incidents of terrorism in the future?
bfe50aef6b1584c6619a199e47ed1da531b5acf5.zh: “科尔”号驱逐舰遭到炸弹袭击，17名美国水兵遇难。对此你有什么看法？我们应如何防止今后再发生这样的恐怖袭击？

75cbbe2921e59bbaf8d4d784cbbe944c6f9bde7d.source: What are your thoughts on the death of George Floyd and the wave of protests in the wake of his death? What will you say to the nation?
75cbbe2921e59bbaf8d4d784cbbe944c6f9bde7d.zh: 对于乔治·弗洛伊德之死，以及此后兴起的抗议浪潮，你有什么看法？你会对全国说些什么？

5733872739b78de288c10a62f1cf1bedb685eb0b.source: What are your thoughts on the death of George Floyd and the wave of protests in the wake of his death? Will you make an appearance at a Black Lives Matter event?
5733872739b78de288c10a62f1cf1bedb685eb0b.zh: 对于乔治·弗洛伊德之死，以及此后兴起的抗议浪潮，你有什么看法？你是否会出席一场“黑人的命也是命”运动活动？

9d5b8c312bd6216753bf4cdcd7e8c4013c81c343.source: What?! You lost?! By 1 electoral vote? Rage fills your body as the results come in. Your vision begins to go red. Those crooked Dems cheated you! They rigged it just enough that you lose, so they could taunt you. Donald Trump does not get cheated. You built an empire with just a small loan of a million dollars. You became President despite every pundit and pollster. No no no, Donald Trump does not lose. You're going to PERSONALLY do the recount in
9d5b8c312bd6216753bf4cdcd7e8c4013c81c343.zh: 什么？！你输了？！以 1 票选举人票？当结果出来时，愤怒充满了你的身体。你的视野开始变红。那些不诚实的民主党人欺骗了你！他们的操纵足以让你输掉，这样他们就可以嘲笑你。 唐纳德·特朗普 不会被骗。你只用一百万美元的小额贷款就建立了一个帝国。尽管有很多专家和民意调查专家，你还是成为了总统。不不不，唐纳德·特朗普没有输。您将亲自进行重新计票

30fd2efc6c212d18120a9a930306de30da5d31fb.source: What?! You quickly clarify this statement, but it is too late. You have massively damaged your credibility with your base, and have probably lost a lot of votes to Buchanan or even Gore.
30fd2efc6c212d18120a9a930306de30da5d31fb.zh: 什么？！你很快澄清这番话，但已经太迟了。你严重损害了自己在基本盘中的信誉，很可能把许多选票送给了布坎南，甚至戈尔。

ba81f8d375907fdd7f3447e76519de3f392877a2.source: What?! You quickly clarify this statement, but it is too late. You have massively damaged your credibility with your base, and have probably lost a lot of votes to Nader or even Bush.
ba81f8d375907fdd7f3447e76519de3f392877a2.zh: 什么？！你很快澄清这番话，但已经太迟了。你严重损害了自己在基本盘中的信誉，很可能把许多选票送给了纳德，甚至布什。

3582b69821b1d206b9f61f1b9be2efde5309b6d8.source: Whatever else people can say about this campaign, it certainly hasn't lacked in verbal combat between you and Mr. Trump.
3582b69821b1d206b9f61f1b9be2efde5309b6d8.zh: 不管人们还能如何评价这场竞选，它肯定不缺少你与特朗普先生之间的唇枪舌剑。

408abd4677ce44b33982f8797bd3d9359d146738.source: Whatever ends up happening on election day, I cannot comment about the aftermath at this point. If that scenario develops I will hear what each side has to say and make a decision at that point.
408abd4677ce44b33982f8797bd3d9359d146738.zh: 无论选举日最终发生什么，现在我都不能评论之后的安排。如果真的出现那种局面，我会听听双方怎么说，再作决定。

d3b119d6c2f98822f4316e80fbb8b5d24bc48397.source: Whatever our private feelings, we have no choice but to denounce such extralegal actions.
d3b119d6c2f98822f4316e80fbb8b5d24bc48397.zh: 无论私下怎么看，我们都只能谴责这种法律之外的行动。

6147fd2010cf564474da00cccf9f4d3c088aaa78.source: Whatever happened, there's no excuse for the riots, the fires, the hatred of white people, and the hatred of police that we're seeing. We have to respect our police or we won't have a country.
6147fd2010cf564474da00cccf9f4d3c088aaa78.zh: 不管发生了什么，都不能为我们看到的骚乱、纵火、仇视白人和仇视警察开脱。我们必须尊重警察，否则就没有国家了。

25ef14e9a64c87de400b2be354b4bb5969024421.source: Whatever our thoughts, let's send our prayers for the people affected and hope that no further incidents occur in the future.
25ef14e9a64c87de400b2be354b4bb5969024421.zh: 不论我们怎么想，都让我们为受到影响的人们祈祷，希望未来不再发生类似事件。

8fc2f6091260808edf95ec8a285cbcd55ae799b9.source: Whatever you did, it must have worked. Observers were leaving your campaign for dead just a few months ago. On the political front, you can continue the policies of Reagan or turn in a more moderate direction. Internationally, you can hopefully oversee a period of relaxed tension with the Soviet Union.
8fc2f6091260808edf95ec8a285cbcd55ae799b9.zh: 无论你做了什么，它一定有效。就在几个月前，观察家们还认为你的竞选活动已经死了。在政治方面，你可以继续里根的政策，或者转向更温和的方向。在国际上，您有望度过一段与苏联紧张关系缓和的时期。

e1cb57c63d5e0fed5146a64a74ad753e9ec6434f.source: Whatever you want to say about Obamacare, it won't be around for long when I'm President, believe me. We're going to repeal and replace the Obamacare disaster so fast, it's going to be truly something.
e1cb57c63d5e0fed5146a64a74ad753e9ec6434f.zh: 你想怎么说奥巴马医改都行，但相信我，我当上总统后，它不会存在太久。我们会极其迅速地废除并取代奥巴马医改这场灾难，场面会很了不起。

2513d18abc02c835c828a5c6fbf40904aa7702e1.source: Wow! You held Humphrey to a draw and seemed in command of yourself throughout. What a turnaround from 1960.
2513d18abc02c835c828a5c6fbf40904aa7702e1.zh: 哇！你和汉弗莱打了个平手，而且全程镇定自若。与1960年相比，真是大有改观。

ef6eacf68f4c2f59947d8a1cb74cd03bad3335e0.source: Wow! You outperformed most polls, and have taken the US political landscape by storm. Clinton calls to concede and congratulate you, and the Senate and House stay in the Republicans' hands. You give a victory speech to a roaring crowd of thousands in New York City, while the Democrats give a muffled congratulations.
ef6eacf68f4c2f59947d8a1cb74cd03bad3335e0.zh: 哇！你的表现超出了大多数民调的预期，席卷了美国政坛。克林顿打来电话认输，并向你祝贺。参众两院仍由共和党掌控。你在纽约市向欢呼的数千名观众发表胜选演说，民主党人则低声表达祝贺。

eaae18678a6bc92bf07e5a912ef8c2a7e2bc7555.source: Wow! You outperformed nearly every expectation out there, and have taken the US political landscape by storm. Clinton calls to concede and congratulate you, and the Senate and House majorities grow to healthy proportions in the wake of your victory. You give a victory speech to a roaring crowd of thousands in New York City, while the rest of the world is silent with shock.
eaae18678a6bc92bf07e5a912ef8c2a7e2bc7555.zh: 哇！你的表现超出了几乎所有人的预期，席卷了美国政坛。克林顿打来电话认输，并向你祝贺。随着你的胜利，共和党在参众两院的多数席位也扩大到了稳固的规模。你在纽约市向欢呼的数千名观众发表胜选演说，世界其他地方则因震惊而陷入沉默。

730283efd660992cd7c03c1a5cd75170a4f71c25.source: Wow! You outperformed the expectations of many, and have taken the US political landscape by storm. Clinton calls to concede and congratulate you, and the Senate and House remain relatively stable. You give a victory speech to a roaring crowd of thousands in New York City, while the rest of the world tries to figure out what happened.
730283efd660992cd7c03c1a5cd75170a4f71c25.zh: 哇！你的表现超出了许多人的预期，席卷了美国政坛。克林顿打来电话认输，并向你祝贺。参众两院的席位格局则相对稳定。你在纽约市向欢呼的数千名观众发表胜选演说，世界其他地方仍在琢磨究竟发生了什么。

cd0de71dbb7b977277968857e8f8958f6cde9f39.source: Wow. In one stroke, you outrage every type of union member. Even prominent union leaders are now backing Wallace rather than you.
cd0de71dbb7b977277968857e8f8958f6cde9f39.zh: 哇。你一下子把各类工会成员全都惹怒了。连知名工会领袖现在都转而支持华莱士，不再支持你。

ac548be73e06fffc147cfce1b09669ef369b5d38.source: Wow. No candidate has achieved a majority in the Electoral College
ac548be73e06fffc147cfce1b09669ef369b5d38.zh: 哇。没有候选人在 选举人团 中获得多数票

8db38e79db158c5119e91643cc000d1fc2ca5312.source: Yeah I mean, if you're in a crowd, mingling, it makes sense. You do see some people, and there's no one within 100 feet of these people and they're in the middle of a field, and they're walking around with masks on, and it's insane.
8db38e79db158c5119e91643cc000d1fc2ca5312.zh: 是的，我是说，如果在人群中，跟人来往，戴口罩合理。但你也会看到有些人，方圆一百英尺没有别人，站在一片田地中央，还戴着口罩走来走去，简直疯了。

759ed32ddc0fd9f88049de86a98832bb35e034d6.source: Year after after, Republicans subject themselves to sham debates with slanted questions and one-sided moderators. Why should we force the voters to watch that charade again?
759ed32ddc0fd9f88049de86a98832bb35e034d6.zh: 年复一年，共和党都去参加虚假的辩论，问题偏颇，主持人偏袒一方。为什么还要逼选民再看一次这种闹剧？

871f8108be01d8d2552829f71564b03f1591c0a7.source: Yes it is. One of the biggest obstacles to private sector capital investment is the size and debt of the federal government. The current stagnation in the economy is evidence of this fact.
871f8108be01d8d2552829f71564b03f1591c0a7.zh: 没错。联邦政府的规模及其债务，是私营部门资本投资的最大障碍之一。当前经济停滞，就是这件事的证据。

74886f3778ca3a4e50cf5aa1dbe130d83b29dbab.source: You've come out more strongly in favor of abortion than Carter, or even McGovern did. You're definitely making headlines today.
74886f3778ca3a4e50cf5aa1dbe130d83b29dbab.zh: 你支持堕胎的立场，比卡特，甚至比麦戈文，都更鲜明。你今天肯定要上新闻头条了。

8ce90010689cb74c69818954fabb2b876d128ea8.source: You've certainly made headlines with your attacks, but with Truman so unpopular, it might be for the best.
8ce90010689cb74c69818954fabb2b876d128ea8.zh: 你的抨击确实登上了头条，不过杜鲁门如此不受欢迎，这样做也许才是上策。

50deab2ae59e3a4731c4b3f5e286a943d9da32ae.source: You've definitely come down with the hawkish wing of the party on this issue.
50deab2ae59e3a4731c4b3f5e286a943d9da32ae.zh: 在这个问题上，你明确站到了党内鹰派一边。

70b84232fa874184af43aec43f028391137003b2.source: You've definitely come down with the dovish wing of the party on this issue.
70b84232fa874184af43aec43f028391137003b2.zh: 在这个问题上，你明确站到了党内鸽派一边。

0ab29151d435afceafc1e4ad611d666a9581f877.source: You've definitely enjoyed a day of generally positive press coverage with this stance. But behind the scenes, conservatives and veterans are upset.
0ab29151d435afceafc1e4ad611d666a9581f877.zh: 采取这个立场，让你今天总体上得到积极的媒体报道。不过，幕后保守派和退伍军人很不满。

cfdd9e633045d21f798405796f6ae878c898039b.source: You've don- wait. What? You've, uh, really won there, haven't you? You flipped more than Texas, more than Maine's 2nd district. You've flipped states that haven't gone blue since Clinton, Carter, and/or Lyndon Johnson! Well done, I guess. You're getting flooded with calls, including one from
cfdd9e633045d21f798405796f6ae878c898039b.zh: 你已经不用等了。什么？你，呃，真的赢了，不是吗？你翻转的次数超过了得克萨斯州，超过了缅因州的第二区。你已经翻转了自克林顿、卡特和/或林登·约翰逊以来没有变蓝的状态！干得好，我想。您接到了大量的电话，其中包括来自

da87250671eebb012633c2198f2f70c5b189438d.source: Your supporters are in shock. You can make every effort to explain that you were misquoted, but you have lost a bit of your trustworthiness.
da87250671eebb012633c2198f2f70c5b189438d.zh: 你的支持者惊呆了。你可以尽力解释说，别人误引了你的话，但你的可信度已经受损。

445d4ce8df28a3307e13e0ed63e12e9e173e1bbf.source: You've done it. The terror that has been the Trump administration comes to a close with your win tonight. They say third times the charm, and you certainly proved it tonight. But my, my, by a single vote in the electoral college you did. This is one of the closest elections in US history, and you can be sure that Republicans everywhere, Trumpians or not, will be fuming at this result, and calling foul play. Be prepared for 2000 all over again.
445d4ce8df28a3307e13e0ed63e12e9e173e1bbf.zh: 你做到了。今晚的胜利，终结了特朗普政府带来的可怕岁月。俗话说，事不过三，你今晚确实证明了这一点。可是，天哪，你在选举人团中只靠一票优势获胜。这是美国历史上最接近的选举之一。你可以肯定，各地共和党人，无论是不是特朗普派，都会对结果怒不可遏，指责有人作弊。准备好再经历一次2000年吧。

ad956382f6ac0776e6e5ef2125e2c39e93dcd72a.source: Your supporters hate the railroads, and you should fall in line with their wishes.
ad956382f6ac0776e6e5ef2125e2c39e93dcd72a.zh: 你的支持者憎恨铁路公司，你应该顺应他们的意愿。

893d54c93323970072a4923d07667ce8d001c0dc.source: Your supporters can't believe what you just said. You favor even more tax cuts for the rich? They're not the ones voting for you this November...
893d54c93323970072a4923d07667ce8d001c0dc.zh: 你的支持者不敢相信你刚才的话。你还主张进一步为富人减税？今年十一月投票支持你的，可不是他们……

580e8fc634e6309b2c2c3e3af7f674009eb6824e.source: Your supporters want stronger action on the housing issue.
580e8fc634e6309b2c2c3e3af7f674009eb6824e.zh: 你的支持者希望在住房问题上采取更有力的行动。

0c31fad48d78969881179be0f5c7cc493552b49d.source: Your talk about an “appallingly low” level and “millions” of refugees immediately starts the right-wing rumor mill churning about your refugee plans.
0c31fad48d78969881179be0f5c7cc493552b49d.zh: 你关于“低得惊人”的水平和“数百万”难民的言论立即引发了右翼谣言工厂对你的难民计划的炒作。

5c691813b8216198a2f2030b790eec2870f90b68.source: Your time slots are heavily watched, but people really wanted to see the debates.
5c691813b8216198a2f2030b790eec2870f90b68.zh: 你的电视时段有很多人观看，但大家真正想看的是辩论。

a63ebe97cd00794b6978ebdb6d1055929516df13.source: Your trip to California went as well as could be expected.
a63ebe97cd00794b6978ebdb6d1055929516df13.zh: 你的加利福尼亚州之行，顺利程度已达到了可以期待的上限。

9a4ea370b61eeb88494480079801e3dc6c88144c.source: Your unexpected praise of Obama is not helpful for your campaign.
9a4ea370b61eeb88494480079801e3dc6c88144c.zh: 你出人意料地赞扬奥巴马，对竞选没有帮助。

eecba2a1c95cbd11d52e6c7509074882561f3138.source: Your use of Twitter has garnered outsized attention in your run for the Republican nomination, but some advisors are leery of your erratic tendnecies on that site. How will you proceed?
eecba2a1c95cbd11d52e6c7509074882561f3138.zh: 在争取共和党提名的过程中，你在推特上的发言获得了格外多的关注，但一些顾问对你在这个平台上反复无常的表现有所顾虑。你接下来会怎么做？

cfefa28507762222fc57a919ebfe89bc884d22e1.source: Your weakness on this issue has given many in the party second thoughts about your nomination. Your only salvation may be the odious nature of your opponents.
cfefa28507762222fc57a919ebfe89bc884d22e1.zh: 你在这个问题上的软弱，让党内许多人重新考虑提名你是否正确。你或许只能指望对手足够可憎，来挽救局面。

45b85ab0e8edd72f702f0bc776124f925374ce05.source: Your willingness to use “defund the police” rhetoric establishes you as a firm supporter of Black Lives Matter -- and opens you up to heated attacks from the right.
45b85ab0e8edd72f702f0bc776124f925374ce05.zh: 你愿意使用“削减警察经费”的说法，使你成为“黑人的命也是命”运动的坚定支持者，也让你面临右翼的猛烈攻击。

87f98efa79a4f905f9d1e1df5df5c043f492fe20.source: Your words of support help as LBJ begins campaigning in the South. He will cajole and strong-arm that region's politicians into disavowing the unpledged elector movement.
87f98efa79a4f905f9d1e1df5df5c043f492fe20.zh: 林登·约翰逊开始在南方竞选，你的支持之词起到了帮助。他会对当地政治人物软硬兼施，迫使他们公开否认支持未承诺选举人运动。

cae8b53f60742a546130d9a9aa04eaec239a57ac.source: You’d think he’d have retired from politics by now.
cae8b53f60742a546130d9a9aa04eaec239a57ac.zh: 真让人以为他早该退出政坛了。

3258b1be51e6f4c62421b63181c4063d7427c31a.source: You’ve affirmed your typical, realistic, but dovish stance.
3258b1be51e6f4c62421b63181c4063d7427c31a.zh: 你重申了自己一贯务实、但偏鸽派的立场。

a63ff0a35e3488d1fd16841529ece66e67c595a8.source: Betsy DeVos is a scion of the powerful DeVos family of Michigan politics, and has served since 2017 as your controversial Secretary of Education. In hiring her, you'll be hoping you can use her influence to bring Michigan into your column a second time.
a63ff0a35e3488d1fd16841529ece66e67c595a8.zh: 贝齐·德沃斯出身于密歇根州政界颇具影响力的德沃斯家族，自2017年起担任你的教育部长，任内争议不断。聘用她，是希望借助她的影响力，再次拿下密歇根州。

749f3c97e129e1bb9954f16455bb0d0366e18986.source: Roger Ailes produces a couple of vivid ads on this issue. The story is embarrassing enough, but Dukakis seems completely unable to respond to your attacks.
749f3c97e129e1bb9954f16455bb0d0366e18986.zh: 罗杰·艾尔斯围绕这个问题制作了几支生动的广告。这件事本身就够尴尬了，而杜卡基斯似乎完全不知道如何回应你的攻击。

d5c839175cbf9da1d4d76fdb3cc43caad2d1d3f8.source: Should the proposed constitution for the state of Kansas be accepted by Congress, and Kansas admitted as a free state?
d5c839175cbf9da1d4d76fdb3cc43caad2d1d3f8.zh: 国会是否应当接受为堪萨斯州提出的宪法，并接纳堪萨斯以自由州身份加入联邦？

1ae0098f86f93b86b201bc87fa9f2ffbc714fdb7.source: The New York Times runs a front page story about your pivot on trade, with several hot takes for and against.
1ae0098f86f93b86b201bc87fa9f2ffbc714fdb7.zh: 《纽约时报》在头版报道了你在贸易上的转向，并刊登了几篇赞成与反对的即时评论。

a4ce641203072e48fdc4b96f0cd8322a0a932bb7.source: We just need to let you know, it appears that your opponents have consolidated into a "fusion ticket" in the states of Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and New York.
a4ce641203072e48fdc4b96f0cd8322a0a932bb7.zh: 我们需要提醒你：你的对手似乎已经在宾夕法尼亚、新泽西和纽约组成了“联合选举人名单”。

bb40d93339498163e3a1c2f70810817743ef3d2a.source: YMCA screeched out from the TV screen as Donald J. Trump walked on stage.
bb40d93339498163e3a1c2f70810817743ef3d2a.zh: 唐纳德·J.·特朗普走上舞台时，电视里正尖声播放着《Y.M.C.A.》。

476e0517592df11d4c0afb886db21ce787351c76.source: You've done it. The terror that has been the Trump administration comes to a close with your win tonight. They say third times the charm, and you certainly proved it tonight. But MY GOD. What a win. Not only have you won back the states he took from Obama, but you also won some states not won since before the turn of the century. Even Democrats are shocked at what you've managed to do. Trump and every Republican, Trumpist or not, is raising hell that you rigged the election. It seems the magical Trump poll effect couldn't save him this time...
476e0517592df11d4c0afb886db21ce787351c76.zh: 你做到了。今晚的胜利，终结了特朗普政府带来的可怕岁月。俗话说，事不过三，你今晚确实证明了这一点。但天哪，这是何等的胜利！你不仅夺回了他从奥巴马手里抢走的州，还赢下了世纪之交前就没再投向民主党的一些州。连民主党人都对你的成绩感到震惊。特朗普和所有共和党人，无论是不是特朗普派，都在大吵大闹，说你操纵了选举。看来，这次神奇的特朗普民调效应也救不了他了……

ceb43183830afbdb90d7986bca4a402fcf18e056.source: You’ve been fighting for civil rights your entire life, and now in a critical moment, you’re against it? Anyways, Democrats have revolted against you.
ceb43183830afbdb90d7986bca4a402fcf18e056.zh: 你为民权奋斗了一辈子，现在到了关键时刻，却反对它？总之，民主党人已经起来反对你了。
